title: The Concrete Graveyard
body:
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlmmqb/23vsSPyctMPooB1bqgTtNzds6hdh6e5Zpjgdq4437HVTK2p4XF5YVvqm84feyJc1hXjkY.png)</center>

<center><sub>Image of Jamshaid's birds (different place), image by author</sub></center>

Ashfaq is a good friend of mine. He is very fond of birds, so he has built a proper \
on the top floor of his home, which houses parrots, pigeons, chickens, and more. When I met him, he took me to the roof to show me this \

It was a four-story flat-like house, and we were standing on the roof of this tall building. After looking at the birds, I peered over the parapet at the city below, and to be honest, what city was it? It was a disorganized, merciless jungle. In this jungle of cement, there was smoke, dust, and chaos.

Then suddenly, my wandering eyes froze at one spot. I saw a strange sight before me, one that made my breath catch in surprise. It was the roof of a house where a carpet of greenery seemed to be spread. Thick, succulent grass was growing, and along the walls, roses and office-time plants were set in a few pots. Nearby, a bird quenched its thirst from a water container kept there and went on its way.

I cried out spontaneously:
\
\nAshfaq looked at my amazement with great wonder, smiled, and said:\n\

Dear readers! This sentence kept echoing in my mind.
'A graveyard atop the house'
How true it is. The very next morning, I climbed up to my own roof again and began to observe the roofs of the buildings in the area. Intense white sunlight, iron frames, rusted tires lying around, piles of broken furniture; someone had thrown trash, while another had stacked trunks... all were scorching in the sun. I was about to run away in frustration when suddenly, in the middle of it all, my eyes fell on a relatively old building. There, an elderly gentleman was watering plants in pots. The roof was green, exactly like the one I had seen in Brother Ashfaq’s neighborhood and which I had described as \

Dear readers! I left my house immediately and reached that elderly man. He was Hasan Chacha, who lived in our own neighborhood.
I asked:
\

There was contentment on his face. It was a simple matter... he bought air, and what a cheap medicine it was!

Respected readers! The question is, why is greenery disappearing from our cities and our lives? The reason is clear: greed! A shop in place of a tree is a symbol of more profit. A park can become a housing society. We have understood progress to mean only this: more concrete, more vehicles, and more shopping malls. The sole principle of our urban planning is to earn the maximum rupees per square foot. Where is the air to breathe in all this? There, you have the answer to your question as to why greenery is vanishing from our cities and lives.

But even knowing this, we remain indifferent, and then we sit down to treat this airlessness... sometimes with air-purifying machines, sometimes air conditioners, sometimes vitamin pills, and sometimes depression medication; in short, one thing or another. But we do not want to move toward the actual cure because it pinches our capital. On the other hand, we do not worry about the money we waste along with our deteriorating health. Or to put it in simpler words, our lifestyle has become such that we are buying the medicine that nature wants to give us for free, but we have thrown this free gift out not just from our homes, but from our very lives.

Welfare organizations start tree-planting campaigns. It is the need of the hour and should be done. Politicians promise to build parks. That is welcomed, and some even do it practically, which is very good. But think for a moment: will this work only happen through the long-term planning of large projects? So far, we have seen that our entire system runs on \

... for example, when floods come, there will be talk of drainage; when the heat intensifies, thoughts of plantation drives will occur, or there will be talk of importing air conditioners. But no effective strategy is formed beforehand to prevent this ailment.

Dear readers! I believe we must treat this. We can at least start from the roof of every home, just like Hasan Chacha. Let us all decide to make a green roof on our houses. Ten percent of every building’s rooftop must be green. I request you to look out of your window... how many trees do you see? How is your roof? Is there only scorching sun and water tanks there, or is there some sign of life and greenery? Your children might see artificial greenery in video games at home; these days, green carpets have also arrived that look just like grass but are artificial. But can you get the pleasure of walking on real grass from that? Not at all! It is as if we are making our next generation one that is cut off from nature, a generation that will think fruit comes from the market, not a tree, and water comes from a tank, not rain!

So then, what should be done? Should we keep waiting for the government? Should we do what our attitude usually is on such occasions? That is, shift the entire burden onto the government and feel relaxed ourselves?

No! Not at all! Look, Hasan Chacha started alone. You and I can do it too. One pot, one seasonal plant, tomato, coriander, mint... and a small start. When you grow greenery on your roof, you won't just be planting plants; you will be lowering the temperature. You will be providing water to free-roaming and flying birds. You will be giving clean air to your lungs, and above all, you will be giving a message.
That message will be:
\

Dear readers! This is the true hallmark of being a responsible citizen. So, next time you look at the city from a tall building and it looks like a desolate, hot desert of cement, do raise a question:
\

\nThen, if the answer comes in the negative, do make some effort... through your means, your money, or your words... to bring it back to life, because a natural and organic environment is our most fundamental need.

title: Delicious winter khichdi recipe
body:
​

![da23155b-6935-44e8-a932-7fb8d1764902.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPZFpGATN6yxwkmKcrvNDRXeKM6r6UFzsbZ8Y6N4j8qAp/da23155b-6935-44e8-a932-7fb8d1764902.jpg)

​

Friends, how are you all? I hope you are all doing well, and I am also doing well. Alhamdulillah, today I have come to you with a great recipe. I will show you how to make a winter khichuri, which is very tasty to eat on a winter morning and can also be made at other times. Today I will make khichuri in a healthy way.

​

 > Amigos, ¿cómo están? Espero que estén todos bien, yo también estoy bien. Alhamdulillah, hoy les traigo una receta estupenda. Les mostraré cómo preparar un khichuri de invierno, que es delicioso para comer en una mañana de invierno y que también se puede preparar en otras épocas del año. Hoy prepararé khichuri de una manera saludable.

Khichuri rice

 lentils

moong dal

onion

 green chillies

 bay leaves

salt

 turmeric powder

 coriander powder

 whole roasted cumin seeds

dried chillies

ginger

garlic

batter

white oil

cinnamon

 large cardamom

small cardamom

 >  peppercorns

 > Arroz Khichuri

 > Lentejas

 > Lentejas moong

 > Cebolla

 > Chiles verdes

 > Hojas de laurel

 > Sal

 > Cúrcuma en polvo

 > Cilantro en polvo

 > Semillas de comino tostadas enteras

 > Chiles secos

 > Jengibre

 > Ajo

 > Masa

 > Aceite blanco

 > Canela

 > Cardamomo grande

 > Cardamomo pequeño

 > Granos de pimienta

​

To prepare winter khichuri, first, I will chop the onions finely. Then I will take all the rice and dal together, wash them well, and soak them for half an hour so that my khichuri can be much softer. It is definitely necessary to wash the rice well first.

​

 > Para preparar khichuri de invierno, primero picaré finamente las cebollas. Luego, juntaré el arroz y las lentejas, los lavaré bien y los dejaré en remojo durante media hora para que el khichuri quede más suave. Es fundamental lavar bien el arroz primero.

![69f181ea-5aa8-43e5-b844-64814e279e60.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUTtJrX9UNJzRNWRUptgD2LzvniF1BGeQ1tAMj9hWUFsM/69f181ea-5aa8-43e5-b844-64814e279e60.jpg)

![9507d71f-0fc3-4dd5-b652-9f713c902914.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcKHSVhzeAFrmjL4s7CyK9HdPG4dcgX9kkG5ukDsnPRHb/9507d71f-0fc3-4dd5-b652-9f713c902914.jpg)


![601cfdb7-b20a-4a79-b530-76bb542453ca.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTyvRs7knqAYFgQ5SiHRm2XNFu4Cy8mCu3VR2sX8u1YKZ/601cfdb7-b20a-4a79-b530-76bb542453ca.jpg)

Also, after that, I will put it in the oven, there I will add chopped onion and chopped green chili, after a while I will add oil and fry everything well, then I will add all kinds of hot spices, here the hot spices will be used for taste, and then I will add all kinds and grind them well with a little water.

​

 > Además, después de eso, lo pondré en el horno, allí agregaré cebolla picada y chile verde picado, después de un rato agregaré aceite y freiré todo bien, luego agregaré todo tipo de especias picantes, aquí las especias picantes se usarán para dar sabor, y luego agregaré todo tipo y las moleré bien con un poco de agua.

![e2866ac6-0d31-49ae-935f-8b51e2b2890a.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUBoXL3XFi5LMTA9G1TqVXMTNyCrjFdH3kKMZpRgq8cWB/e2866ac6-0d31-49ae-935f-8b51e2b2890a.jpg)

![71fb2011-8868-4537-bc03-c71d4e7afc32.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSU7Z68Us3oztQC3a98tCiVGww3Mjh4xwrSeya3ixAc7f/71fb2011-8868-4537-bc03-c71d4e7afc32.jpg)

![70100fb6-c11c-4d80-b8a9-8d851561d926.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaRYksBFu9YxbGUujpuohcbnY7cgjYj4sbLkaFDQmGDfA/70100fb6-c11c-4d80-b8a9-8d851561d926.jpg)

![4b95d2c8-f3c3-4ff7-b64a-c6e464ca9e92.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcML6keXm1S7QyBhr2QZoFPmaAenUebPWJmMeyaKRoBb5/4b95d2c8-f3c3-4ff7-b64a-c6e464ca9e92.jpg)

After kneading them well for a while, I will add the pre-soaked rice and fry the rice well in spices and oil for another five minutes. Then, when there is no water left, I will measure the excess water carefully, and finally, I will check the salt again.

​

 > Tras amasar bien la masa durante un rato, añadiré el arroz previamente remojado y lo freiré con especias y aceite durante otros cinco minutos. Luego, cuando no quede agua, mediré cuidadosamente el exceso y, por último, volveré a comprobar la sal.

![efd7e5f0-ecbf-4c3c-892f-609e6c6499af.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZNc35yaSEs6dcdjX1yNNNXpNwdcj5nvBz2HfZDzbvzQH/efd7e5f0-ecbf-4c3c-892f-609e6c6499af.jpg)

![8d0070f4-f0c8-495c-8096-c20a65ecad0f.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXVkGPumTL6jXs5BCcbwZBC6ZAGyMswVdmVq27ejoJDdn/8d0070f4-f0c8-495c-8096-c20a65ecad0f.jpg)

![14ac23b1-5f4b-47cf-9611-aa2408b1eb6a.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQJFwQq1aPLvptpZadStzqHBKQsZNXfWFrfgzBS4uEVw1/14ac23b1-5f4b-47cf-9611-aa2408b1eb6a.jpg)

![001694ab-1112-499e-97f0-b06590086646.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPQmBzUCvyfAanYEP5EKhNh5hmjqmyHPXkVyDHc45VRx5/001694ab-1112-499e-97f0-b06590086646.jpg)

Then I will cover it with a lid for half an hour, and it will cook for a little while. By this time, my khichuri will be ready. Today I have made soft khichuri. You can see how delicious and refreshing it is. I like to eat this hot khichuri, but it is much better on a winter morning. I hope you will like it a lot.

 > Luego lo taparé durante media hora y se cocinará un rato. Para entonces, mi khichuri estará listo. Hoy he preparado un khichuri suave. Como ven, está delicioso y refrescante. Me gusta comerlo caliente, pero está mucho mejor en una mañana de invierno. Espero que les guste mucho.

​
![eae2185f-70f5-4dab-b7ac-e813f0f9668f.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbtYeD1oKtPiZCEf4DCait3ycTCJWmjLfrY2yk7hMYbEc/eae2185f-70f5-4dab-b7ac-e813f0f9668f.jpg)

![001694ab-1112-499e-97f0-b06590086646.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPQmBzUCvyfAanYEP5EKhNh5hmjqmyHPXkVyDHc45VRx5/001694ab-1112-499e-97f0-b06590086646.jpg)

![c87068bd-3e1a-4bf7-9b36-07fab9ea0868.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcHUUigP6qjeQSWMtHxQviC4327Q3ynTwxRnXAYhp9n6v/c87068bd-3e1a-4bf7-9b36-07fab9ea0868.jpg)

![0fd93252-4e1b-4939-9b55-b7128329648b.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWvBnPKc3VFJxPZwpHkJmXeFzX5uQ8JgXN57BPzncDmZA/0fd93252-4e1b-4939-9b55-b7128329648b.jpg)

![09db0620-d40d-460f-96f4-594ec5a5aa1c.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXRxGWo7qFdeHW2YvqPX1dFftYGLn4f3jpPnfwVaLNYKn/09db0620-d40d-460f-96f4-594ec5a5aa1c.jpg)


Khichuri is very beneficial for our health. Bengalis love to eat Khichuri very much, and they like Khichuri on any occasion because it contains various vegetables along with rice and dal. Today I have mixed potatoes here. The vegetables can be of different types. It is very healthy for children. Everyone can eat it. Adults can eat a lot. I hope you will make some at home and you will enjoy its taste.

 > El khichuri es muy beneficioso para la salud. A los bengalíes les encanta y lo disfrutan en cualquier ocasión, ya que contiene diversas verduras junto con arroz y lentejas. Hoy les presento una mezcla de papas. Las verduras pueden ser de diferentes tipos. Es muy saludable para los niños. Todos pueden comerlo. Los adultos pueden comer en abundancia. Espero que lo preparen en casa y disfruten de su sabor.

​

title: Bread without butter. My Actifit Diary: April 28 2026
body:
I just realized that I didn’t take many pictures today. Most of them are of the bread experiments from today: Olive Bread; Sesame Bread; 100% whole wheat bread; Mediterranean Bread. They came out incredibly well, and tomorrow I’ll do the first “big” round of olive bread to see if the recipe fits our everyday process. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/52f74016-2ec3-4904-bfe7-2e4442049fdd.jpg) As soon as I took the loaves out of the oven, I had to run to prepare a quick lunch. I had cooked white beans, so I just converted them into a quick salad. Took me 6 minutes, I was impressed by myself. And it was delicious. Unfortunately, Kami ate it all – Ellie and I picked her up at school to testify in at her friend’s court date. The case will probably not create justice for her friend, but it’s one of those where it’s good that they try. And Kami is thinking about becoming a lawyer, so being grilled by one is a good real life experience on that. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/43fb7c7a-701f-46b6-88e1-0ed36056f633.jpg) It was pretty brave of her to go despite all that, so I was fine with her eating all of my lunch. And she got another one afterwards, Ellie bought her a burger to go. I? I finally got some tofu at the supermarket. They didn’t have it the last times I went, so I bought 6 packages to freeze. Besides that, I didn’t get anything until I arrived at home. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2e441eba-beeb-4652-a51a-33ef952eef65.jpg) But what I got! The bread was fantastic. Super crunchy crust (a little too hard, actually, I’ll have to reduce baking time a little in this shape), and the flavor, oh my, the flavor! So good. Danny and his girlfriend were working on their computers when I came into the bakery and cut the bread, so they got to try. Danny’s girlfriend has a bodybuilding competition in 2 weeks, so she’s not allowed to each much bread, but didn’t want to skip it, either. And honestly, it’s so much better than the regular bread here. No extra sugar nor extra yeast in those. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f1ffcf8b-2d8d-467f-9cf1-4a793ec6268a.jpg) I got my own dinner now, a favorite – Cevichocho, but my way: Sweet lupines (chochos), tofu, tomato, lemon juice, olive oil, loads of black pepper. So now I’m getting tired. I already did my Duoling when preparing the bread, so maybe I’ll take some time to write a post on the main account. Or not. I’ll see. Have a good night!

body:
>  ![343205.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23wMcSx9rbEjBhJtbHMYiYwddVVECXenjDLavzu6hsUsoQqJT3NPEPgDELMLAyg65v4Ba.png) Holaaaa, feliz noche, ¿cómo están, amigos? Por aquí todo muy bien, gracias a Dios. Ya tomé como costumbre siempre compartir algo con ustedes y ya hoy les juro que se me olvidó por completo y me iba a dormir sin ello, jajajajaja. Yo hoy les quería comentar mi día sábado, que la verdad fue bastante movido para lo que lo planifiqué; literalmente, ya a las 9, que no había llegado a la casa, ya quería llegar porque las piernas me dolían muchísimo. Como de costumbre, yo los sábados realizo mis labores de cenicienta, donde, bueno, lavo y demás. Yo me levanté de lo más normal, a eso, calculando que saldría en la noche solo a la actividad de mi sobrina que les comenté, pero no fue así.
Hellooo, good evening, how are you all, friends? Everything’s going really well here, thank goodness. I’ve got into the habit of always sharing something with you, but I swear I completely forgot today and was about to go to bed without doing it, hahahaha. I wanted to tell you about my Saturday today, which, to be honest, was quite hectic compared to what I’d planned; literally, by 9 o’clock, I hadn’t even got home yet, but I was already keen to get there because my legs were aching terribly. As usual, on Saturdays I do my Cinderella chores, where, well, I do the washing and so on. I got up as normal, reckoning I’d only be going out in the evening for my niece’s event I told you about, but that wasn’t how it turned out.
![IMG-20260425-WA0008.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/244Uoi5ijLmQSq5KxNVVxU4X9vkimGpR5KMzwYqkggyqT9jojirsjdme8tXDcBCDtVN2s.jpeg) ![20260425_115421.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23yd5wep8Q1HweMjvyGdxvPqvLEBXZjYEUvhFw3Hqs9SBwRLrEmoK2tZEZzoNJKh9Hgua.jpg) ![20260425_115147.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23wqkoAtBnWSrb5Lj5fLV85sgfjpkuBkpZaVZN2zVAyMVW3Ppnsq2rS98NDF8X38ZUoWG.jpg) Mi hermana nos convido a mi papá y a mi para ir a ver jugar a davian mi sobrino esta vez jugarían en un estadio diferente en juan griego y ya son casi las eliminatorias y aunque el aún esta aprendiendo nosotros siempre vamos apoyarlo, mi papá era el que no estaba tan entusiasmado pero a ultima hora salimos para alla y les cuento que hasta nos perdimos porque mi hermana nos dio la direccion mala y llegamos al lugar que no era jajajaja, y con todo el tiempo que perdimos en eso llegamos y ya el juego había comenzado pero esta vez perdió el equipo donde juega mi sobrino, y ademas de eso jade mordio a mi papá jajajajaja, le dije que me la sujetara para ir al baño y se volvio loca por querer ir conmigo y mordió al abuelo jajajaja.
My sister invited my dad and me to go and watch my nephew Davian play; this time they were playing at a different stadium in Juan Griego, and it’s almost the play-offs now. Even though he’s still learning, we always go to support him. My dad wasn’t really that keen, but at the last minute we set off. I’ll tell you, we even got lost because my sister gave us the wrong address and we ended up somewhere else, ha ha ha. And with all the time we wasted on that, by the time we got there the game had already started, but this time the team my nephew plays for lost. And on top of that, Jade bit my dad, ha ha ha ha ha. I asked him to hold her for me so I could go to the loo, and she went crazy wanting to come with me and bit Grandad, ha ha ha ha.
![20260425_120756.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23viEQXSBjpfmy58yrGskg62g8MHwniqvMGN3SKEDJ3sikUkuMNkXZiUs1sjdiJRUaJZg.jpg) ![20260425_120801.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23uR5ZvPW4DCk4riJAN77QB4jkqhqJZPZp49XgmFGbQKrM4za5A7xXc5yVv3Umai3m1iD.jpg) ![20260425_131705.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23yTd42C1dwXG31vJr9zBGZayCBC5ohRdQ8gd7MSrvnzZEWiiRgf778x26qm1JhgAxotf.jpg) ![20260425_120742.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23xAgVLkjWzyoB4qroKwJALX7nb2B4JHU2KXNqbKvnH9pu1tjwTyF5E18QcNDHA6x1Eek.jpg) Por otro lado luego fuimos hacer mercado a rio que la verdad me gusto mas que las veces que vamos a rattan tanto por mi y la comida que las carnes se ven mucho mejor hasta por la comodidad de jade, ella esta vez paseo como nunca en sus carritos de comida fue super comico pero siempre amo de ella que apesar de que nunca se había subido en un carrito de esos ella se adapto como si siempre lo hiciera y se porto muy bien paseo por todo rio, ya que en el hay carritos marcados especialmente para mascotas incluso hubo un momento que ella inicio sola y luego no entraba en el carrito de compras jajajajaja ¡Saludos!
On the other hand, we then went grocery shopping at Rio, which I actually liked better than when we go to Rattan – both for myself and the food, as the meat looks much better, and even for Jade’s comfort. This time she had a blast riding in the shopping trolleys – it was hilarious – but I always love that, even though she’d never been in one before, she took to it as if she’d always done it and behaved really well, exploring all over Rio, as there are trolleys specially marked for pets. There was even a moment when she set off on her own and then wouldn’t get back into the shopping trolley, hahahaha! Cheers!
![20260425_143056.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23uFVhi1riT1C1LymfcffyGwNpJ51xBVP9buNR1Wwfs2oBcZN6UmagDrCksjWJvMFDwCX.jpg) ![20260425_140258.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23uQrMaD7CsFePAgMk99yfR1KP8foQuixjzeDk5v345hE1R1F3unp2AMRd6XA6fKGAf32.jpg) ![20260425_140220.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23wWwL388VcKnwPzK37oTRHxrMrboLhBa92ZMYZwwBhH7sKHfS25KJ6BWhFMQrKRz9ZXU.jpg) ![20260425_144637.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23u67PiQ9xMExFw1x6MDEsfuapXw7RKSijrxx2caGKFX31DEfPypCE9NW6qQKDyw7pmjv.jpg) ![20260425_140652.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23wMaemXxubLkXxmCDfaBXXKe6r9kWSFav2rrns4CQBdrLjJefNCD2Lk545QbUKikkmqZ.jpg) ![20260425_143059.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23tmL4xosCpfhbqjGkJvoCrLtFaM9zMhSArcjwKH4eUHDQn7RrvHP4b7et8ZEaKKQVzAP.jpg)

title: LOH #286 | Bullying and addiction is not something that should be glorified ✋🏻🚫 [ESP/ENG]
body: > Hola amigas de Ladies Of Hive, espero que estén teniendo un buen día. Hoy como siempre estuve leyendo las preguntas que está vez nuestra amiga @marivic10 nos propuso para responder. [Dos preguntas](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-286) con diferentes temas que pueden servir para llegar a conocernos mejor y también, para saber que haríamos en ciertas situaciones que se presentan en la vida en general como el bullying que puede existir tanto en la niñez como en la adultez, solo que siendo mayores se suele disfrazar de bromas pesadas o de humor negro. Y además también compartiré con ustedes parte de mi gusto por el cine y lo que siento por alguna película que realmente me haya cambiado mi forma de ver la vida.

> Hello, Ladies Of Hive, I hope you’re having a lovely day. Today, as always, I’ve been reading the questions our friend @marivic10 has suggested we answer. [Two questions](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-286) on different topics that can help us get to know each other better and also find out what we would do in certain situations that arise in life in general, such as bullying, which can occur in both childhood and adulthood, although, as we get older, it tends to be disguised as practical jokes or dark humour. And what’s more, I’ll also be sharing with you some of my love of cinema and how I feel about a film that has truly changed the way I see life. ![1000123385.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EoeM9JVhd4SQe8EQYcQ6R6YpbTUrzGcVTX1JujRrtKZqagzFqEG7Jkzyg4b9qPFzZrL.png)
> **¿Qué piensas sobre el acoso escolar? ¿Cómo lo abordarías? Si tiene hijos, ¿cuál sería su mejor consejo para su hijo si fuera víctima de acoso y qué haría?**

> **What are your thoughts on school bullying? How would you address it? If you have children, what would be your best advice for your child if they were to become a victim of bullying, and what would you do?** ![1000123385.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EoeM9JVhd4SQe8EQYcQ6R6YpbTUrzGcVTX1JujRrtKZqagzFqEG7Jkzyg4b9qPFzZrL.png) ![1000182086.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/Ep3en2qtXQDXcskmjWWXTfDg66HxFQuLGNS1PqNQMkHcNv3tL6yNkX5UKUQLXoVDDAV.jpg)

> Recuerdo que en mi infancia siempre me decían que era una persona muy delicada o sumamente sensible, como si fuera lo peor que pudiera tener en mi personalidad. Parte de las personas que lo decían eran familiares cercanos, personas mayores que en su misma ignorancia caían en repetir los patrones de maltrato que tal vez vivieron ellos y que no supieron gestionar, más que buscando la manera de cargar sus miedos en los que no podían o no sabían defenderse, como yo que era pequeña y simplemente estaba viviendo muchos cambios que posiblemente me llevaban a ser así de sensible. Pero ese rasgo de mi personalidad me ayudó a ser más empática conmigo y con los demás, sobre todo cuando estudiaba, recuerdo que siempre intentaba tratar de la mejor manera a mis compañeros porque las cosas que no me gustaría que me hicieran a mi, yo no las hacía a otros. Era como una mini adulta en el cuerpo de una niña, me costó bastante superar ciertas cosas sobre todo porque pensaba que luego de crecer todo sería más sencillo, pero resulta que los adultos son los encargados de la crianza de sus hijos, por eso pienso que el bullying comienza como una forma de tratarse desde casa. Si un niño mira que su mamá o papá habla despectivamente de alguien, que se expresan de mala manera, es lo que van a repetir, porque lo que reflejamos también es parte de cómo hemos sido criados y también de nuestra propia personalidad. Muchos de los que recurren a hacer bullying tienen miedos muy arraigados, sienten que deben buscar un foco para aplicar el daño y no ser ellos las víctimas de los demás. Cómo todo comienza desde casa, si tuviese hijos pienso que le recordaría que debe saber que el respeto se gana y que todos somos importantes, no hay nadie superior o inferior, como seres humanos somos iguales aunque nos veamos exteriormente distintos. Buscaría siempre la manera de recordarle que no debe permitir que una situación donde le hacen daño baje su autoestima, que la opinión de otros solo es el reflejo de lo que ellos mismos llevan por dentro. No puedes dar lo que no tienes, si no sabes dar amor muy posiblemente toda tu vida sea un conflicto y termines siempre en relaciones donde las cosas no funcionen de la mejor manera porque existe una forma errónea de relacionarse con otros. El respeto hacia otros es importante, pero conocer nuestros límites también, así que le diría a mi hijo que no tiene que aguantarse nada solo por no querer que las cosas escalen. Es mucho peor si se permiten estos malos tratos, ya que se da a entender que no tienes el poder de parar esa situación, y pienso que siempre hay una salida y una solución a esas personas que se dedican a hacer bullying, hacer las cosas correctamente tal vez no te dará aplausos o la aprobación que esperas, pero no es lo que realmente importa. Siempre tener una conciencia tranquila será mejor que ir por la vida dañando a otros, al final lo que das regresa en cualquier momento.

> I remember that when I was a child, people always told me I was very delicate or extremely sensitive, as if that were the worst thing about my personality. Some of the people who said this were close relatives, older people who, in their own ignorance, fell into repeating the patterns of abuse that they themselves may have experienced and were unable to cope with, rather than finding a way to deal with their fears, they took them out on those who could not or did not know how to defend themselves, like me, who was small and simply going through many changes that may well have made me so sensitive. But that trait of my personality helped me to be more empathetic towards myself and others, especially when I was at school; I remember always trying to treat my classmates as kindly as possible because I didn’t do to others the things I wouldn’t want done to me. I was like a miniature adult in a child’s body; I found it quite hard to get past certain things, especially because I thought that once I grew up everything would be easier, but it turns out that adults are responsible for raising their children, which is why I think bullying starts as a way of treating others at home. If a child sees their mum or dad speaking disparagingly about someone, or using harsh language, that’s what they’ll repeat, because what we reflect is also part of how we’ve been brought up and part of our own personality. Many of those who resort to bullying have deep-seated fears; they feel they must find a target to inflict harm upon so as not to become victims themselves. As it all starts at home, if I had children, I think I would remind them that respect is earned and that we are all important; no one is superior or inferior. As human beings, we are equal, even if we look different on the outside. I would always look for ways to remind them not to let a situation where they are hurt lower their self-esteem, that other people’s opinions are merely a reflection of what they themselves carry inside. You cannot give what you do not have; if you do not know how to give love, it is very likely that your whole life will be a struggle and you will always end up in relationships where things do not work out for the best because you have the wrong approach to relating to others. Respect for others is important, but so is knowing our own limits, so I would tell my son that he doesn’t have to put up with anything just because he doesn’t want things to escalate. It’s much worse if you let this kind of mistreatment go unchecked, as it implies you don’t have the power to stop the situation, and I believe there’s always a way out and a solution for those who bully others. Doing the right thing might not earn you the applause or approval you’re hoping for, but that’s not what really matters. It’s always better to have a clear conscience than to go through life hurting others; in the end, what you give comes back to you at any moment. ![1000123385.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EoeM9JVhd4SQe8EQYcQ6R6YpbTUrzGcVTX1JujRrtKZqagzFqEG7Jkzyg4b9qPFzZrL.png)
> **¿Eres fanático de las películas de terror, de acción o te gusta más el romance? Cuéntame sobre una película que te haya enseñado una lección importante.**

> **Are you a fan of horror movies, action movies, or are you more into romance? Tell me about a movie that taught you an important lesson.** ![1000123385.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EoeM9JVhd4SQe8EQYcQ6R6YpbTUrzGcVTX1JujRrtKZqagzFqEG7Jkzyg4b9qPFzZrL.png) ![1000182115.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23wC37jh8ahbJZTgAMurR3RqC1sSSRcmrcoLWcE8z6msK6QWkynFXaYuEEs7gcJrgXUXa.png)
Imagen mejorada con Gemini IA - Image enhanced with Gemini AI.

> Soy de las que ve películas más sobre el género de drama, me gusta poder ver historias reales que muestren situaciones que vive cualquier ser humano. Sobre todo que sean interesantes y que dejen algún mensaje o reflexión importante, de esas que las ves y luego pasan los años, y aún sigues recordandola por la impresión que te deja. Tengo varias películas que me han gustado de este género, pero hubo una que realmente en su momento me dejó pensando en lo fuerte que puede ser el deseo de querer ver a alguien bien mientras esta persona se autodestruye. La película se llama **Beautiful Boy** y muestra la historia de un joven con problemas de adicción a las drogas, es muy fuerte de ver porque muestran no solo su deterioro por la adicción, también muestran el lado familiar sobre todo a su padre quien es el que está hasta el final de la película muy preocupado por su hijo. Es fuerte, las escenas te hacen sentir mal no solo por el joven si no por el padre, los hermanos, la madre, todos de alguna manera sufren en silencio por este hijo que está perdido y lo más triste es que tiene varios intentos por rehabilitarse pero continúa recayendo. Hay una escena donde el padre le dice a la madre que ya no puede hacer nada más por su hijo, también muestran escenas intermedias entre la niñez del joven y la actualidad y eso hace que sea aún más triste de ver. No es de mis películas favoritas, pero si me causó una gran impresión, recuerdo que llore y me sentí muy mal al terminarla. Sin embargo, no se puede dejar de lado el hecho de que es una buena película con excelentes actores y una historia que puede ser la de muchas personas en la vida real y no solo en la ficción.

> I’m the sort of person who tends to watch more dramas; I like seeing real-life stories that depict situations any human being might experience. Above all, I like them to be interesting and to convey an important message or insight – the sort of film you watch, and even years later, you still remember it because of the lasting impression it leaves on you. There are several films in this genre that I’ve enjoyed, but there was one that really made me think at the time about how strong the desire to see someone well can be, even as that person is self-destructing. The film is called **Beautiful Boy** and tells the story of a young man struggling with drug addiction. It’s very hard to watch because it shows not only his decline due to addiction, but also the family’s perspective, particularly that of his father, who remains deeply concerned for his son right until the end of the film. It’s harrowing; the scenes make you feel for not just the young man, but also his father, his siblings, his mother – they all suffer in silence in their own way for this son who is lost, and the saddest thing is that he makes several attempts at rehabilitation but keeps relapsing. There’s a scene where the father tells the mother that there’s nothing more he can do for their son; they also show flashbacks between the young man’s childhood and the present day, which makes it even sadder to watch. It isn’t one of my favourite films, but it did make a big impression on me; I remember crying and feeling really low when it ended. However, one cannot ignore the fact that it is a good film with excellent actors and a story that could be that of many people in real life, not just in fiction. ![1000123385.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EoeM9JVhd4SQe8EQYcQ6R6YpbTUrzGcVTX1JujRrtKZqagzFqEG7Jkzyg4b9qPFzZrL.png)
>Espero que les gustara este post, también me gustaría que me dejen sus comentarios; con gusto los leeré y responderé. Un abrazo grande. 🤗\n\n

title: Between Shadows and Yokai | Capturing the Essence of Ghost of Yotei Legends
body:
<div class=text-justify>

I’ve been diving into Ghost of Yotei’s Legends mode lately, and honestly, it’s been a blast. For those who aren't familiar, it’s the online multiplayer component where you can team up with one to three other players, depending on which mode you jump into.


<center>   
![1000360564.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23wgFFh2nQRY1RekyqmrViHBg3xkQRj1LxNTFjrkMTSQ6hxWzqpdUUhwimmWWeo6HVBdi.jpg)
 </center>

The game offers a few different ways to play. You’ve got the Story mode, where you fight through various missions leading up to a confrontation with one of the \

Then there’s the classic Survival mode, where you face off against waves of enemies, and finally the Raids—the most challenging content in the game that absolutely requires a full four-player squad to complete.

<center>  
![1000360002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tS2gBS47GyB3jYLVbJc9uEAEzUsnMz7YGmeRhCHZTLDYexm4TWheG1ZzX2KRFWkRToF.jpg)
![1000360005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tRxWiu4ejT4CXYs4pEaL8rPh6C3QbtxfJYir7dnwob5UYLWmGCPf4ZZthRVyFMcvfZg.jpg)
  </center>


What’s really cool is that, unlike the main campaign, Legends leans heavily into the supernatural and Japanese mythology. Each mission is presented as a stylized \

of Atsu’s journey, reimagining the main story’s villains as dark legends and yokai.


<center> 
![1000359995.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23wgN4Rkr4AfTbePcAtLDqsaUFgWemekbWqWSGzKRaXAFwcw9fDCzcyB6YstMFgKgQYJf.jpg)
![1000359997.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23ywuEATfPjefBSWVDi7qsLJKy6v6Uo4n873BYdKLoDYXFrpRbfr5E5T1rKhyoVMYazRj.jpg)
![1000359998.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23vsBzf5dor6vbX78b5cEqwD2VkWS3hbbw56vjbwVSyw6JrZvpEVruBummST5a2kYvfEH.jpg)
   </center>




The images I’m sharing here are from the second mission of \
The objective is to escort and protect a spirit cart. You essentially have to help it \

on souls using the lanterns in its eyes, which act as soul-collectors.



<center>  
![1000359994.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tGeSLm5bnGCXcHR2keyz6R6o8ddkEu6GFTvuR43XVJbUpqa9PezWL39A7a8Xab4NUsY.jpg)
![1000360007.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tvVmHyHqcnkhJ3hbYwszjjYxoY4vwsjhRwg7FbmyzT7HN7wYbXXWyHDUNb5aJhKovSx.jpg)
![1000359999.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23t7BM156B8GPutDXwjyWrhwKVVKsNfVhyYVjnmUmSaQs86MQZo8FHkLyhknojEurNVKR.jpg)
</center>



In exchange for your help, you can use the power stored in those lanterns to fire off blasts that strip away the \

of certain enemies. You’ll see them glowing green, blue, or yellow based on their connection to the Moon, Sun, or Storm. Once you break that connection, they become vulnerable and much easier to finish off.
![1000360004.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23t7BByQYNJVYQgjXHRFg6C3wL8xF11Fc6aMmN4XHtybdkaTDrbP6DykDHsDiaHhNT8LC.jpg) ![1000360001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23uFH1gypQb3KeJKU3eeyoviTRMFGtPKoAqKhtRwzFdM7dDobAMmHcb65gVBnLp59eu5f.jpg) ![1000360000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23swntqpHt3AaP6niTfs21QGK5zcBVmHfP1FxMZwhSHVNrbr5EYJSWhny9xCPN3T4wfUC.jpg)
The finale involves destroying these floating wardrobe-like entities called Void Jufu. There are three in total, and they definitely fight back—they cast a specific type of magic that can kill you instantly if you’re not careful. Even though this content is designed for a duo, I’ve been tackling it solo since I don’t currently have a PlayStation Plus subscription for online play.

title: I don't think we should have implemented Outsider. / Outsider はアカンのじゃなかろうか。
body:
[![Splinterlands Release Notes 2026-04-28](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZUWKioqBhVTQ8gFwAYG4oPoPFU37YNWZdiEfHRovXa1r/image.png)](https://docs.splinterlands.com/platform/release-notes/2026#id-2026-04-28)

### [ENGLISH]

A new update has been released. Reading through the Release Notes, there are a lot of small details listed, but well…

I have various thoughts about it, but I suppose it’s the result of many different intentions coming together. The developers must be going through a lot as well, so hang in there!

With that said, here are a few points that caught my attention.

---

First up is the latest update to the SPS rental market.

This is good. Very good.

To begin with, the previous SPS rental screen was way too confusing, especially for beginners. I tried it when it was first implemented, but it was so hard to understand that I stopped using it. 🤣

In the new interface, lending and borrowing are much easier to understand.

![SPS RENTAL](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWPyuJT5ULRa1HZco17MmtQt9wXnhE2zNAfEtLP2agDvQ/image.png)

On the left side, the BIDS represent orders from people who want to borrow, and on the right side are orders from people who want to lend. At a glance, it’s easy to understand the going rental price. It feels like a very well-designed screen—what do you think?

Also, the AUTO RENEW BIDS (or OFFER) switch is a nice addition. Rentals seem to be fixed at 7 days, and it allows automatic renewal after expiration. Previously, once a rental expired, it just ended, and you had to re-register every time, which many people found inconvenient.

You can now register both BID and OFFER with a single button from the same screen, making it very user-friendly.

However, it’s not without issues. I wish the PRICE field allowed one more digit. I wonder what price range the developers were expecting? Since there aren’t enough digits, both lenders and borrowers are forced to double (or halve) their prices at once, making it harder to find a middle ground.

Also, I wonder if adding labels like BUY SIDE and SELL SIDE might prevent confusion with actual buying and selling? Or is this terminology natural in English-speaking regions?

Another thing that caught my attention is that **Outsider has been added as a new rule**.

![Outsider](https://images.ecency.com/DQmazyAjRLGvVe1QkKVEekR4cRm1EmAr7CUPFtFPJ4rD6Ep/image.png)

When this rule is selected, it seems that you can summon one Wild unit.

In my personal opinion, this is not a good idea. Why allow Wild cards when Wild and Modern formats are intentionally separated? Some players choose Modern specifically because they don’t own Wild cards.

When comparing similar cards between Wild and Modern, Wild cards are generally superior in both power and cost. I thought that was by design. That’s exactly why Modern has value—it restricts access to those powerful Wild cards. 😡

That said, since it’s already been implemented, there’s no choice but to adapt. It will depend on how frequently this rule appears. If it’s rare, then it might be acceptable.

There’s also the Are You Not Entertained? rule, which allows Gladiator cards, but it doesn’t appear very often. If the frequency stays low, the overall impact should be minimal.

Still, some cards are extremely strong, which makes this tricky. It brings back memories of being completely crushed in the past.

For example:

https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/untamed/Kron%20the%20Undying_lv2.png

KRON is incredibly annoying. Long-time players might remember being bullied by LLAMA KRON.

LLAMA isn’t usable in Modern now, but KRON still has 3 power, and if you boost its health by +1, it can heal 4 HP every round while continuously firing magic attacks. Not fun.

In the current Modern environment, there are fewer units with Heal compared to before, so it’s almost guaranteed to perform well. Maybe Earth will become stronger?

https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/promo/Chain%20Golem_lv2.png

This is another card that might give some players trauma. It has both Shield and Void, with 3 power and 8 health—an excellent tank. Being Neutral makes it even better. Its versatility allowed it to be used in any element, making it extremely popular.

Even now, it would undoubtedly perform well as a tank. I’d love to have it, but if you asked me whether I’d buy it now, probably not. I don’t play Wild, and buying it just for the Outsider rule? I don’t think so.

https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/untamed/Cornealus_lv2.png

CORNEALUS is another unit with Heal. It has high health and can even gain Thorns, making it capable of tanking. It’s also great placed at the back to counter Sneak attacks.

I have strong memories of it surviving forever with Heal during rules like Noxious Fumes or Earthquake—while my team was wiped out, it would still be standing alone at full health. 🤣

There are many other units with unpleasant memories attached, but just the addition of one powerful old card already feels quite discouraging.

If strong Beta units with superior stats or Untamed units with powerful ability combinations start appearing in Modern, it could lead to various issues... 😱Atchonbrique.

---

The images below include the BATTLE URL with a referral link.
If you are thinking of getting started, take a look at the BATTLE before you sign up.



[![BATTLE URL](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdFyv4Ep3buivhRL15L1YbU3DUKEKHTDSbKxQcwQUsuyC/image.png)](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_0f9afb5257750511d55dee2d9383fb52?ref=sakurakko)


![Separator.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sakurakko/23zSQpURqMgpo5FuaQVKT1UG8Dxmivcj6ZFG4XD7GLXtN5UkPKZi5j2byDtJpSdMjqZaU.png)




### [日本語]

新しいアップデートがリリースされました。Release Notes を読むとなんだかこまごまと書かれていますが、うん…

いろいろと思うところはありますが、いろんな思惑が組み合わさっているのでしょう。運営の人もいろいろ苦労していると思いますが頑張ってください！

という事で、私が気になった部分をいくつかピックアップして紹介。

---

まずは **SPSレンタル市場最新情報** です。

これはいい。とても良い。

そもそも前のSPSレンタルの画面が分かりづらすぎて初心者ではさっぱりわからなかったからね。私も実装当時に触ってみたけど、余りにわからなくてやらなくなったよ。🤣

新しい画面では貸す、借りる、がとても分かりやすくなってますね。

![SPS RENTAL](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWPyuJT5ULRa1HZco17MmtQt9wXnhE2zNAfEtLP2agDvQ/image.png)

左側のBIDS側が借りたい人の注文、右側が買いたい人の注文ですね。パッと見てレンタル価格がいくらくらいなのかわかりやすい作りになっています。とってもGoodな画面に思えますがどうでしょ？

また AUTO RENEW BIDS（or OFFER）のスイッチもいいね。レンタルは一律7日のようですが、満期後に自動的に継続できるようです。以前は満期になったらそれで終わりになってて毎回登録しないといけないのが面倒だっていう意見もあったからね。

同じ画面から BID も OFFER もボタン一つで登録できるようだしとっても使いやすくなっていい感じです。

しかし、問題が無いわけではなくて。PRICEの桁数はもう一桁くらい増やしてほしかったな。運営さんはレンタル価格がいくらくらいになると思ってたんでしょう？桁が足りなくて、貸す方もも借りる方も、金額を一気に2倍（もしくは1/2）にするしかないからなかなか折り合わないという事だと思います。

あとは、BUY SIDE、SELL SIDE の記述があると売り買いと間違わないのかな？っていう疑問があるんだけど、英語圏では自然な表記なの？

そしてもう一つ私が気になったのは **Outsider が新ルールとして追加された** という事です。

![Outsider](https://images.ecency.com/DQmazyAjRLGvVe1QkKVEekR4cRm1EmAr7CUPFtFPJ4rD6Ep/image.png)

このルールが選ばれたときは Wild の ユニットを1体召喚できるというルールなんだと思いますが。

個人的な意見とすれば、これはダメでしょう。Wild と Modern をわざわざ分けているのになぜ Wild のカードを使えるようにしちゃうの？Modern をプレイしている人は Wild のカードが無いので Modern をプレイしているという人もいると思うんですけどね。

Wild と Modern で同じようなカードを比べた場合、やっぱり、カードパワーもコストも Wild の方が優れていると思います。そういうデザインにしているっていう認識だったんだけど。だからこそ Modern は強力な Wild のカードを使えないことに意味があるのに。😡

とはいうものの。追加されてしまったのであればしょうがない。実際にプレイして対応を考えないとね。このルールが表示される頻度にもよりますが、そんなに出てこないならまぁいいです。

Gladiator カードを使用できる Are You Not Entertained? のルールもありますけど、表示される頻度はそれほど多くないですし。頻度が多くなければそれほど影響もないでしょう。

でも、一部のカードはとっても強いので悩ましいです。昔、ボッコボコにされた記憶がよみがえってきます。

たとえば。

https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/untamed/Kron%20the%20Undying_lv2.png

KRON なんかはめちゃくちゃ嫌ですよね。昔からのプレイヤーであれば LLAMA KRON でいじめられた記憶を持っている人もいるかもしれません。

今のモダンでは LLAMA は使えないけれど、パワーは3点あるし、Healthを+1すれば毎ROUND4点回復しながらバンバン魔法を撃ってきます。やだなー

いまの Modern 環境では Heal が使えるユニットが昔より少なくなっているので活躍すること間違いなしでしょう。Earth がつよくなるかも？

https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/promo/Chain%20Golem_lv2.png

これもトラウマになってる人がいるかもしれませんね。 Shield と Void の両方を持っていてパワーが3点、Health も8点と優秀なタンクです。Neutral なのが一番優秀。どのエレメントでも使えるという汎用性の高さで非常に良く使われていました。

今でもタンクとして大活躍間違いなしです。とっても欲しいですけど、今から買うかと言われたら買わないかな。私は Wild はプレイしていないですし、Outsider の為だけにかうの？ って言われたら買わないと思います。

https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/untamed/Cornealus_lv2.png

CORNEALUS も Heal 持ちのユニット。Health が高くて Thorns まで覚えてくれるので タンクが出来ます。最後尾に置いて Sneak 対策にもいいですよね。

私の記憶には Noxious Fumes や Earthquake ルールの時に Heal でめっちゃ粘られて。こっちは壊滅してるのに一人だけぴんぴんしてるっていうヤなイメージがすっごい残ってます。🤣

他にもいろいろ嫌な思い出のあるユニットはありますが、昔の超強力なカードが1体入るっていうだけでかなり憂鬱です。

Beta の単純にステータスが優秀なユニット、Untamed のアビリティの組み合わせが優秀なユニットなどがモダンに現れるとなるといろいろ問題が発生しそうで...😱ｱｯﾁｮﾝﾌﾞﾘｹ

---

以下の画像をは紹介リンク付きBATTLE URLを含みます。
これから始めようと思っているなら、バトルを見てから登録してみてね。

[![BATTLE URL](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdFyv4Ep3buivhRL15L1YbU3DUKEKHTDSbKxQcwQUsuyC/image.png)](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_0f9afb5257750511d55dee2d9383fb52?ref=sakurakko)

title: Corazón decorativo/ Decorative heart 💗😍
body:
> Hello gente! Qué tal todo? Por estos lados del mundo todo bien gracias a Dios, trabajando en casa en diferentes proyectos manuales y hoy justamente les vengo a compartir uno de ellos que por supuesto es para la habitación de Miranda y se trata de un **corazón con palitos de altura o brochetas** que vi en una de mis múltiples visitas a Pinterest y que me pareció súper lindo para el cuarto de mi niña.
Hello everyone! How are you all getting on? Over here, thank goodness, everything’s fine. I’ve been working from home on various craft projects, and today I’m here to share one of them with you – it’s for Miranda’s bedroom, of course. It’s a **heart made from tall sticks or skewers** that I spotted during one of my many visits to Pinterest, and I thought it would look absolutely lovely in my little girl’s room.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZnfKU3yjAtnNkYWUSsHTrFusc4XYk87ogQEiSUbtoqBD/1777429639101.png) *** Este corazón es netamente un proyecto decorativo, aunque si lo haces mucho más grande que el que yo hice puede ser utilizado para exhibir fotografías y la verdad es que queda muy lindo, ya que también vi esa versión. Como les dije está elaborado con palitos de altura cortados en diferentes tamaños los cuales se unen con silicón caliente creando figuras geométricas dentro del mismo lo que lo hace bastante llamativo además de una decoración bastante original y por supuesto lo quería para la habitación de mi muñeca. Y ahora sin más vamos con el paso a paso.
This heart is purely a decorative project, although if you make it much bigger than the one I made, it can be used to display photographs, and to be honest, it looks really lovely – I’ve seen that version too. As I said, it’s made from tall sticks cut to different lengths, which are joined together with hot glue to create geometric shapes within it, making it quite eye-catching as well as a rather original decoration – and of course I wanted it for my doll’s room. And now, without further ado, let’s get on with the step-by-step guide.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdhtxtnw1uMRts1GzYY7Bi5YMSwZubt173aMaMeboPyGD/1777429139373.jpg) *** ## Materiales Palitos de altura (brochetas) Pintura al frío blanca y lila Esponja Pincel Pistola de silicón
## Materials Skewers White and lilac cold-set paint Sponge Paintbrush Hot glue gun
## Paso a paso/ Step by step Para la elaboración de este proyecto decidí hacer uso de algunas imágenes que puedes encontrar en pinterest para guiarme sobre la forma que le daría al corazón y la forma en que debía pegar los los palitos de altura y poder ir ensamblando el corazón, así que después de buscar un poco escogí una imagen y en base a esa, decidí trabajar y en mi caso decidí iniciar por la parte inferior del corazón mirando siempre la imagen referencial para guiarme en cuanto al diseño, aunque a medida que avanzaba, terminé creando mi propio diseño.
When working on this project, I decided to use some images I found on Pinterest to guide me on the shape of the heart and how to attach the vertical sticks so I could assemble the heart, So, after searching a bit, I chose an image and, based on that, decided to get to work. In my case, I decided to start at the bottom of the heart, always referring to the reference image to guide me with the design, although as I went along, I ended up creating my own design.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVFmiGuRW4f27TTT9a9XSmw65VUxGtHtRcij7MnQ4E9KK/1777428768256.jpg) *** Este proyecto, aunque se ve sencillo, requiere bastante precisión al momento de cortar y ensamblar, sobre todo porque al trabajar con silicón caliente se forman pequeños bultos y realmente no queremos que todo esto se vea al momento de pintar la pieza, así que hay que trabajar con muchísimo cuidado cada vez que ensamblamos, o pegamos los palitos de altura, ya que además de tratar de ubicarlos correctamente tenemos que crear el menor desastre posible con la pega.
Although this project looks simple, it requires a fair amount of precision when cutting and assembling, particularly because working with hot silicone causes small lumps to form, and we really don’t want these to be visible once the piece is painted. So we need to take great care whenever we assemble the pieces or attach the height sticks, as not only do we have to position them correctly, but we also need to make as little mess as possible with the glue.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRXV6iL5WhujibKrekXdkNbk348gfzfZZkJwyGDfLPMCo/1777428768510.jpg) *** A medida que avanzamos es muy emocionante ver cómo el corazón ha tomado forma, aunque el mío está un poco gordito y lo deshice unas cuantas veces 🤣
As we go along, it’s really exciting to see the heart taking shape, although mine’s a bit chubby and I’ve had to redo it a few times 🤣
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZagZNv1QLsFeV2DnsXpLooB3G8yVajTFeZXGfCHt2ZRX/1777428768758.jpg) *** Una vez terminamos de unir todos los palitos de altura y tenemos la forma de nuestro corazón lista lo que yo hice fue tomar la pistola de silicón y la pasé por todos los bultos y porciones de pega que quedaron en los palitos de altura, todo esto con la finalidad de que la superficie se viese lo más prolija posible, así que con la punta de la pistola estando aún caliente fui alisando los pequeños bultos y derritiendo toda la pega que afeaba la superficie de nuestro corazón y una vez listo con ayuda de la esponja lo pinté de blanco, ya que usé palitos de altura que estaban pintados de negro y como Miranda quería el corazón de color lila lo más conveniente era pintar primero de blanco.
Once we’d finished joining all the vertical sticks together and had the shape of our heart ready, what I did was take the hot-glue gun and run it over all the lumps and bits of glue left on the vertical sticks, all with the aim of making the surface look as neat as possible, so, with the tip of the gun still hot, I smoothed out the small lumps and melted all the glue that was spoiling the surface of our heart. Once ready, I painted it white using a sponge, as I’d used black-painted sticks and, since Miranda wanted the heart to be lilac, it made most sense to paint it white first.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQNCSJTz7SWxP5GLZZWnmyQa6QXfaPr735TbNB2XfYmGR/1777428768959.jpg) *** Una vez secó bien le di una segunda capa de blanco y en cuanto estuvo seco, con una lija fina traté de deshacerme de cualquier irregularidad en los palitos de altura y finalmente apliqué el color lila al corazón dándole 2 capas de pintura y de esta forma está listo este lindo corazón decorativo para la habitación de mi muñeca.
Once it was completely dry, I gave it a second coat of white and, as soon as that was dry, I used fine-grain sandpaper to smooth out any unevenness in the vertical slats. Finally, I painted the heart lilac, applying two coats of paint, and with that, this lovely decorative heart for my doll’s room is ready.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPCMSsyAFsCfsfpxaDHuzBDkxocG7VRxe6crKCNwfVPaW/1777428769203.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUKbjG9kkoxTCQXn6hjUxqNhrUWdSvNwNgQYdBsNqQ74E/1777428960285.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPSUf7iKUz5NQPE6p2dPvRLurP3Q8ZZbHhsc6MNe4GjYU/1777429139544.jpg) *** Como pueden ver, el resultado final es muy lindo, y aunque seguramente pudo quedar mejor, estoy conforme con el resultado, y lo más importante de todo es que a Miranda le gustó mucho espero que a ustedes también. >As you can see, the end result is really lovely, and although it could certainly have turned out better, I’m happy with how it turned out, and most importantly, Miranda really liked it – I hope you do too.

title: Hoy es un día perfecto para agradecer!! [Esp-Eng] ❤️‍🩹
body:
>

<center>![InShot_20260428_220949539.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmek4e6ibqwETGJrcZpKThy2qEnsCXbCGBquDJZ6fFWob2/InShot_20260428_220949539.jpg)</center>




Hace pocos días estuve conversando con mi pareja acerca de la situación de duelo que estamos viviendo en familia... En lo difícil que resulta agradecer en ciertas etapas o situaciones de la vida. 

Nos acostumbraron a que debemos agradecer de corazón, que debemos agradecer por lo bueno y por lo malo con una sonrisa... Eso siempre me pareció tan falso, tan artificial y tan poco creíble.

Pero resulta que en medio de una conversación le pregunté a mi pareja ¿Que agradeces de esto que estamos viviendo? una pregunta casi balbuceada, pues es casi obvio pensar que nada bueno puede salir de perder a un ser querido, pero por el contrario los agradecimientos fueron  apareciendo uno tras de otro.

En medio de esa conversación comprendí, que aún en lo malo siempre hay un agradecimiento que puede salir del corazón... Siempre pensé en ¿Porque voy a agradecer por comer una arepa viuda, pelada, sola? O ¿Porque agradecer la miseria que nos toca vivir en un país tan rico?

<div class=\

> ![17774287692832190580469248196220.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfPJaPVSRyvLvdvySGFtbNdpg5MkDRCb6fvNpQACBMN7G/17774287692832190580469248196220.png)[1] Sentí por tanto tiempo que agradecer en la escasez, en la austeridad era sinónimo de conformismo o de falsedad... Hoy veo todo tan distintos; y es que los seres humanos no dejamos de aprender, cada situación que nos toca vivir siempre nos deja un aprendizaje y un agradecimiento. Siempre me dije el agradecimiento siempre viene de lo bueno, el que agradece en lo malo es mentiroso, o tal vez conformista... Pero la verdad es que siempre debemos agradecer y siempre hay motivos para agradecer.

> ![InShot_20260428_221059077.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcZB3MBBxgSP6sndFy2xuFbSCWrf6JmiCo5CBkpHm7Vc8/InShot_20260428_221059077.jpg) Con esa conversación aprendí que todas las situaciones que nos pasan, desde lo más sencillo hasta lo más complicado ocurren porque así debe ser, así como podemos tener días maravillosos, hay otros días complicados, pero que por el hecho de ser un día vivido debe ser un día agradecido. Yo creo que habrá momentos en la vida donde agradecer cueste un poco más que otros, no creo que eso nos haga malos seres humanos, porque siendo sinceros es un agradecimiento forzado pero a todas estas agradecer es un hábito y como todos los hábitos debemos ser constantes y tenerlos como una disciplina. Llegara un punto en el que agradecer será un hábito aprendido, y de tanto hacerlo comenzará a fluir espontáneamente y es allí cuando la magia del agradecimiento aparece, porque la vida cambia cuando se aprende a agradecer en todo momento. No es que la vida se vuelve más fácil, no es que te volviste un conformista, es que cuando le sonríes a la vida ella te sonríe de vuelta, los problemas no se van a acabar, los días grises van a llegar, pero tu manera de ver el mundo cambia, es más ligera y en lugar de ver una montaña de problemas, vas a mirar las pequeñas bendiciones que son la luz que te sostienen en los momentos duros.
![InShot_20260428_221140052.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT7eFQyGzu4X63ZDgz5fHEUnYrpgtrjdXtFMatHLpCN8S/InShot_20260428_221140052.jpg)
Así pues que después de mis 40 años de vida, en pleno duelo, aprendí que ahora siempre será un momento perfecto para agradecer. ______ ###
❤️❤️❤️❤️English Version.❤️❤️❤️❤️
_______
![InShot_20260428_221013870.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNaXN8LhSjvSGeMvJ6N2rzdm6C3U1emVi8uQL56541771/InShot_20260428_221013870.jpg)
A few days ago, I was talking with my partner about the grief we're experiencing as a family... about how difficult it is to be grateful in certain stages or situations of life. We've been conditioned to believe that we should be grateful from the heart, that we should be thankful for the good and the bad with a smile... That always seemed so false, so artificial, and so unbelievable to me. But it turns out that in the middle of a conversation, I asked my partner, \

It was almost a stammered question, because it's almost obvious to think that nothing good can come from losing a loved one, but on the contrary, expressions of gratitude started appearing one after another.


In the middle of that conversation, I understood that even in bad times, there is always gratitude that can come from the heart... I always thought, \

> ![17774287692832190580469248196220.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfPJaPVSRyvLvdvySGFtbNdpg5MkDRCb6fvNpQACBMN7G/17774287692832190580469248196220.png)[1] For so long, I felt that gratitude in times of scarcity and austerity was synonymous with complacency or insincerity. Today, I see everything so differently; it's because human beings never stop learning. Every situation we experience leaves us with a lesson and something to be grateful for. I always told myself that gratitude only comes from good things, that someone who is grateful in bad times is a liar, or perhaps complacent. But the truth is, we should always be grateful, and there are always reasons to be grateful.

> ![InShot_20260428_221059077.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcZB3MBBxgSP6sndFy2xuFbSCWrf6JmiCo5CBkpHm7Vc8/InShot_20260428_221059077.jpg) Through that conversation, I learned that everything we experience, from the simplest to the most complicated, happens for a reason. Just as we can have wonderful days, there are also difficult ones, but because it's a day we've lived, it should be a day we're grateful for. I believe there will be times in life when gratitude is a little harder than others. I don't think that makes us bad people, because, to be honest, it's a forced gratitude. But gratitude is a habit, and like all habits, we must be consistent and treat it as a discipline. There will come a point when gratitude becomes a learned habit, and with so much practice, it will begin to flow spontaneously. That's when the magic of gratitude appears, because life changes when you learn to be grateful at every moment. It's not that life gets easier, it's not that you've become a conformist, it's that when you smile at life, it smiles back. Problems won't disappear, gray days will come, but your perspective on the world changes; it becomes lighter, and instead of seeing a mountain of problems, you'll see the small blessings that are the light that sustains you in tough times.
![InShot_20260428_221140052.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT7eFQyGzu4X63ZDgz5fHEUnYrpgtrjdXtFMatHLpCN8S/InShot_20260428_221140052.jpg)
So, after my 40 years of life, in the midst of grief, I learned that now will always be a perfect time to give thanks. _____ # ![1746651717170760710626541328692.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmetewFXFfpLPkHUT3bqXyuaa5BHUDoDt3Lm8aFTakkWSf/1746651717170760710626541328692.png) * Portada creada en Inshot con fotografía personal. * Demás imágenes utilizadas son de mi galería personal y [1](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/mujer-llorando-escultura-7388180/) imagen de pixabay Texto traducido al inglés en [Traductor de Google](https://www.google.com/search?q=traductor&oq=tra&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUqDggAEEUYJxg7GIAEGIoFMg4IABBFGCcYOxiABBiKBTIGCAEQRRg5MgYIAhBFGDwyBggDEEUYPDIGCAQQRRg8MgYIBRBFGEEyBggGEEUYPDIGCAcQIxgnMgcICBAAGIAEMgcICRAAGIAEMgcIChAAGIAEMgcICxAAGIAEMgcIDBAAGIAEMgcIDRAAGIAEMgYIDhBFGDzSAQgxNDIwajBqNKgCDrACAfEFXQuFKBa0YtQ&client=ms-android-xiaomi-terr1-rso2&sourceid=chrome-mobile&ie=UTF-8) ____________ #

title: Under the Heat, Wealth is Carried Together
body:
![PSX_20260429_091203.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYrrqkR28xQc5rHBLfHNZCDUhEnDjm4o94PaRLoZ53Dyc/PSX_20260429_091203.jpg)
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
The heat of the midday sun was sharp, stinging our skin mercilessly. At the edge of the pier, the bustle was like a never-ending pulse. Fishing boats were moored, bringing home the seafood that so many people hoped for. There was no time to pause, as every second mattered to those who depended on the day's catch.

Several men were seen swiftly lifting large green boxes. They were filled with fresh seafood that had just arrived from a long journey amidst the waves. The weight was excruciating, but their hands were used to it. They worked in silence, understanding each other only through their movements and gazes.

Amidst the bustle, a motorbike was seen being used to transport goods. Simple creativity born of necessity. Large boxes were tied tightly, then slowly moved one by one. Sweat poured, clothes soaked from the effort, but no complaints were heard.

This is real life. It's not always easy, not always easy. There's fatigue to endure, heat to fight, and time that can't be wasted. All of this is done for one simple goal: bringing home sustenance for the family.

Behind every box lifted lies a story of struggle. About waking up early, battling the sea, and returning with hope. And on land, the struggle isn't over. There's still energy to be expended to ensure the results reach the right hands.

The day may be tough, but for them, this is part of life that must be endured. Because with every drop of sweat, there's always hope growing.
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

title: Health protection for students on cold days
body:
Greetings students and guardians. How are you all? I hope you are all doing well during the rainy season. 

Basically, it is the month of Baishakh. Since the beginning of the month of Baishakh, there have been heavy clouds in the sky. Heavy clouds and rain have started with them. Compared to the month of Chaitra, the weather is a little colder in the month of Baishakh and the season has changed. Basically, due to the change in the season, there has been a tendency for storms in the month of Baishakh.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmb6Rqoc3Q1HjaYvgWNL6DfuGwvz4aTNtWmWk22ypPRVqG/pexels-kingzubby-12135497.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/two-kids-in-rain-12135497/)


Weather changes play an unpredictable role in the lives of our students. Basically, when the monsoon season starts, various problems arise in the bodies of children and the elderly. One of these problems is cold-related problems. 

Basically, students have to provide health protection to them along with studying. And their parents have to play the most important role in providing this health protection. Because if their health protection is not ensured, their children will never be able to study well and they will lag behind in their studies. 

Since it is a rainy day, there is a possibility of rain starting after a while. Sometimes rain is seen in black clouds. Sometimes even if there are no clouds, the possibility of rain increases a hundredfold. That is, in the current situation, no one can say when the rain will come. 

I have seen with my own eyes, after waking up in the morning, the children are taken out from the family for school. Their bags, pens, and everything is packed. But there are not enough umbrellas for the students to go to school. Whether the financial condition of the family is good or bad. It seems to be a very difficult task for the family to arrange an umbrella for the students. 

Students arrive at school drenched in the morning rain. Due to the rain falling on their heads, children suffer from various cold-related problems.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTXZfdWx2khDy9nP1YT2PgCj13NEHX3SGEDDJkBqiW1t4/pexels-vika-glitter-392079-4345665.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/sick-boy-sleeping-in-bed-4345665/)



When a child is affected by cold-related problems, he can face many problems. Cold, cough and fever can occur due to rainwater remaining on his head. When a child has cold or cold-related problems, he will not be able to study in school and his studies will face major problems. 

In addition, due to not going to school, the child will lag behind a lot. Because he will not be able to participate in the subjects that are explained in school. This is a matter of shame and misfortune for him. 

In that case, we must be aware of the parents. Students must prepare all their materials before going to school. Along with the materials, umbrellas must be arranged for them during the rainy season. Otherwise, they must be protected during any rainy season. It is especially important that we make sure that they do not face any problems related to cold. 

Basically, we should play an important role in sending children to school during the rainy season. The safety of children's lives must be ensured in schools that are far away and have to cross rivers. If necessary, the parents will take the children to school and take the responsibility of picking them up from school. 

 It is our hope and wish that all children can study well and continue their studies safely during the monsoon. For this, we all must play an important role. 

To ensure a bright future for your child, you must follow the above rules. Thank you very much for being with the education community.

title: ESP/ Donde todo pesa… él me alivia - ENG/When Everything Feels Heavy… He Lifts Me
body:
Hoy quiero hablar de la actitud de mi hijo.
Es increíble cómo alguien tan pequeño puede ser tan feliz. Es alegre, le encanta bailar, reír, descubrir el mundo. Y en medio de mis días difíciles —cuando no hay corriente, cuando el dinero no alcanza, cuando todo pesa— ahí está él, como una luz, recordándome que todavía hay motivos para sonreír.
A veces lo miro y pienso qué fácil sería tener su edad, no entender nada de lo que pasa, vivir sin preocupaciones. Pero enseguida me corrijo: si tuviera su edad, no lo tendría a él. Y entonces todo cobra sentido, porque él es, sin duda, lo mejor que me ha pasado en la vida.
Tiene un pelo hermoso, unos ojitos llenos de luz y una inteligencia que me sorprende cada día. Caminó rápido, empezó a hablar muy temprano, y con apenas un año ya dice palabras como mamá, papá, agua, papa, pollo… y muchas otras que inventa en su propio idioma, pero que yo, como su mamá, entiendo perfectamente.
Le gusta jugar, curiosear, descubrir. A veces es un poco loquito, grita sin razón y me desespera, pero incluso eso forma parte de su magia.
No me gusta verlo enfermo. Es algo que me duele, aunque sé que es inevitable. Más siendo alérgico y asmático, en una familia donde todos lo somos, y en un clima tan cambiante que un mismo día trae sol fuerte y frío en la noche. Su naricita lo siente todo: moquitos, fiebrecitas… preocupaciones de mamá.
Pero su pediatra me tranquiliza, me dice que es normal a su edad.
Mañana le toca vacuna, la tercera dosis de la Neumosin. Sé que puede darle fiebre o catarro, y no me gusta verlo llorar cuando lo inyectan… pero también sé que es por su bien. Nunca le ha faltado una vacuna, porque su salud es mi prioridad.
Ser mamá no es fácil. Menos en circunstancias difíciles. Pero cuando lo miro, cuando lo veo reír, cuando me dice “mamá”… entiendo que todo vale la pena.
Porque él es mi fuerza, mi alegría, y mi razón.
me gustaría leer a otras mamás:
¿Cómo sus hijos iluminan sus días más difíciles?
¿Alguna vez los miran y desean, aunque sea por un momento, ver el mundo como ellos lo ven?
¿Qué es eso que hace tu hijo que te llena el corazón por completo?
¿Cómo sobrellevas cuando se enferman y te sientes impotente?
Y en medio de todas las dificultades… ¿qué es lo que te da fuerzas para seguir como madre?
Las leo 🤍

![1773632292323.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/AJoGxNm1J73ngFkdAjPPvcyUYVPPK8y6G8scN9iNe1tCNPxr8rmLHHs2r4u7tYw.jpg)
Today I want to talk about my son’s attitude.
It’s incredible how someone so small can be so happy. He’s joyful, he loves to dance, to laugh, to discover the world. And in the middle of my difficult days—when there’s no electricity, when money isn’t enough, when everything feels heavy—there he is, like a light, reminding me that there are still reasons to smile.
Sometimes I look at him and think how easy it would be to be his age, to not understand anything that’s going on, to live without worries. But then I correct myself: if I were his age, I wouldn’t have him. And that’s when everything makes sense, because he is, without a doubt, the best thing that has ever happened to me.
He has beautiful hair, bright little eyes, and an intelligence that surprises me every day. He learned to walk quickly, he started talking very early, and at just one year old he already says words like mom, dad, water, potato, chicken… and many others he invents in his own language, which only I, as his mom, can truly understand.
He loves to play, to explore, to be curious. Sometimes he’s a little wild, he shouts for no reason and it drives me crazy—but even that is part of his magic.
I don’t like seeing him sick. It hurts me, even though I know it’s inevitable. Especially because he’s allergic and asthmatic, in a family where we all are, and with such a changing climate—hot sun during the day and cold at night. His little nose feels it all: runny nose, slight fevers… a mother’s worries.
But his pediatrician reassures me and says it’s normal at his age.
Tomorrow he has a vaccine, the third dose of Neumosin. I know it might give him a fever or a cold, and I don’t like seeing him cry when he gets the shot… but I also know it’s for his own good. He has never missed a single vaccine, because his health is my priority.
Being a mother is not easy, especially in difficult circumstances. But when I look at him, when I see him smile, when he says “mom”… I understand that everything is worth it.
Because he is my strength, my joy, and my reason.
I’d love to hear from other moms:
How do your children bring light into your hardest days?
Do you ever look at them and wish, just for a moment, to see the world through their eyes?
What is something your child does that fills your heart completely?
How do you cope when they get sick and you feel helpless?
And in the middle of all the struggles… what keeps you going as a mother?
I’m reading you 🤍
![IMG20260322080528.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/242rwF8CgWXd7oZPuZtdM4LiEWQJdwTd1QMCcXNREf54rdgqAqTZWmjzzYdWLs2So1MWN.jpg)

A propósito de tan infausto acontecimiento, escribí y publiqué en esta plataforma el siguiente [post](https://peakd.com/hive-179291/@josemalavem/willie-el-malo-siempre-presente).

Ahora, para celebrar su nacimiento, con cuyo hacer nos dio tanto a la salsa, a la música latina y universal, a nuestra alegría, hago esta entrega.
\
, compuesta por él, es una de sus canciones más conocidas y apreciadas. Apareció por primera vez en el álbum \

en 1979. Como fue línea de Willie, esta canción amorosa habla, con gran ritmo y expresividad, de la imposibilidad de poder realizar el encuentro con la mujer deseada, a la que, ni siquiera, se le puede acercar. Sin poderte hablar (original) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u5rEC9qlGks Sin poderte hablar (en vivo, 2010) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5pum5l7OtI [Letra](https://www.letras.com/colon-willie/672832/)
