title.body: <center>[WIRED](https://www.wired.com/story/great-clown-pagliacci-internet-meme/)</center>\nAn overwhelming majority of **Brazilian** society is poor, and as such, having extra money is something that almost never happens in these people's budgets. Even though the unemployment rate in Brazil is currently **5.8%** (the lowest rate in many years since the federal government has been tracking it) and the \

(so to speak) has increased reasonably, the fact is that the purchasing power of the population is declining significantly.\nThere are different types of explanations for this scenario, but nothing new under the sun. Between corrupt governments and economic decisions that hardly benefit the poorest segment of the country, Brazil continues to be built in ways that are still \

when compared to other world economies. The feeling of less financial autonomy is real, has a latent effect, and brings brutal consequences for many families. The search for financial freedom has never been so difficult.\nThis is definitely not new, but it is reaching more alarming levels as other sectors are being placed under a \

, such as the entertainment industry. Access to culture (in an amplified way), although sometimes it happens through different initiatives that are free (something that always brings particularities that change with the reality of each region of the country), mostly needs to be paid for in order to be better appreciated.\nIn general, the vast majority of events that are paid for tend to be obviously better. This doesn't tend to hold true as a rule, but that's basically how things work. We can't ignore the weight of money in cultural access... And in this respect, the presence of the poorest classes becomes increasingly less visible. Their precarious budgets don't allow them to experience these leisure moments, limiting them to a monotonous routine at quite high levels.\nEvents like watching a movie in a cinema or seeing a play in a theater have become a kind of \

because prices are getting higher and higher. Predatory capitalism makes a point of crushing the presence of these groups in certain cultural spaces, showing that money always speaks louder (and you need it to access these places). In Brazil, the price of entertainment is high... And by extension, access to culture becomes something \

.
---
<center>**El precio de la diversión.**</center>
Una inmensa mayoría de la sociedad **brasileña** es pobre, por lo que tener dinero extra es algo casi inexistente en sus presupuestos. Si bien la tasa de desempleo en Brasil se sitúa actualmente en el **5,8%** (la más baja en muchos años desde que el gobierno federal comenzó a registrarla) y el “ingreso promedio” ha aumentado considerablemente, el poder adquisitivo de la población está disminuyendo significativamente.
Existen diversas explicaciones para esta situación, pero nada nuevo bajo el sol. Entre gobiernos corruptos y decisiones económicas que apenas benefician a los sectores más pobres del país, Brasil continúa construyéndose de maneras que aún resultan \

en comparación con otras economías mundiales. La sensación de menor autonomía financiera es real, tiene un efecto latente y conlleva consecuencias brutales para muchas familias. La búsqueda de la libertad financiera nunca ha sido tan difícil.
Esto no es nuevo, pero está alcanzando niveles más alarmantes a medida que otros sectores, como el del entretenimiento, se ven sometidos a un “escrutínio” exhaustivo. El acceso a la cultura (de forma amplificada), aunque a veces se produce a través de diversas iniciativas gratuitas (que siempre presentan particularidades que varían según la realidad de cada región del país), en la mayoría de los casos requiere pago para poder apreciarla mejor.
En general, la gran mayoría de los eventos de pago tienden a ser, obviamente, mejores. Si bien esto no siempre es así, básicamente funciona de esta manera. No podemos ignorar el peso del dinero en el acceso a la cultura... Y en este sentido, la presencia de las clases más pobres se vuelve cada vez menos visible. Sus precarios presupuestos no les permiten disfrutar de estos momentos de ocio, limitándolos a una rutina monótona y bastante elevada.
Eventos como ir al cine o al teatro se han convertido en una especie de \

debido a los precios cada vez más altos. El capitalismo depredador se empeña en aplastar la presencia de estos grupos en ciertos espacios culturales, demostrando que el dinero siempre tiene más peso (y se necesita para acceder a estos lugares). En Brasil, el precio del entretenimiento es alto... Y, por extensión, el acceso a la cultura se convierte en algo \

. ---
**O preço da diversão.**
Uma maioria esmagadora da sociedade **brasileira** é pobre, e sendo assim, dinheiro sobrando é algo que quase sempre nunca acontece no orçamento dessas pessoas. Ainda que a porcentagem de desemprego no Brasil seja de atuais **5.8%** (a menor taxa em muitos anos desde que o rastreamento vem sendo feito pelo governo federal) e que a “renda média” (por assim dizer) tenha aumentado razoavelmente, o fato é que o poder de compra da população está decaindo muito. Há diferentes tipos de explicações para esse cenário, mas nada de novo sob o sol. Entre governos corruptos e decisões econômicas que em quase nada beneficiam a faixa mais pobre do país, o Brasil segue sendo construído de modos ainda “ortodoxos” quando comparados a outras economias mundiais. A sensação de menos autonomia financeira é real, tem efeito latente e traz consequências brutais para muitas famílias. A busca pela liberdade financeira nunca foi tão pesada. Isso definitivamente não é uma novidade, mas está alcançando níveis mais alarmantes à medida em que outros setores vão sendo colocados sob uma “lupa”, como é o caso do entretenimento. O acesso à cultura (de um modo amplificado) ainda que, por vezes, aconteça através de diferentes iniciativas que são gratuitas (algo que sempre traz particularidades de mudam com a realidade de cada região do país), em sua maioria precisa ser pago para poder ser melhor apreciado. Em linhas gerais, a grande maioria dos eventos que são pagos tendem a ser obviamente melhores. Isso não tende a se manter como uma regra, mas é basicamente assim que as coisas funcionam. Não podemos ignorar o peso do dinheiro ao acesso cultural... E neste aspecto, a presença das classes mais pobres se torna cada vez menos visível. O orçamento precário não lhes permite viver esses momentos de lazer, limitando-os à uma rotina maçante em níveis bastante altos. Episódios como assistir a um filme no cinema ou assistir uma peça no teatro se tornou uma espécie de “artigo de luxo”, porque os preços estão cada vez mais altos. O capitalismo predatório faz questão de esmagar a presença desses grupos em determinados espaços culturais, evidenciando que o dinheiro sempre fala mais alto (e é preciso tê-lo para acessar esses lugares). Em solo brasileiro, o preço da diversão é caro... E por tabela, o acesso à cultura se torna algo “elitizado”. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/the-price-of-fun-fuc)

I heard patent lies are usually obvious, I don't know how true this is.
So, why go through all the trouble to lie? I mean, if someone with a good knowledge of patent law was present while something like this is being presented, he will spot the lie instantly.




A patent gives you the sole right over a piece of work or anything you know you are the owner. A patent is similar to having a copyright, and a lie to this is looking for trouble.



People do this all the time, infringing on people's right.
They lie about their ownership.
Eventually, it is all a lie.
You may like the work, but if it was not gotten from the right source, don't go for it.

title.title: Una mano lava la otra… hasta que una falta | One hand washes the other… until one is missing
title.body:
Una mano le dijo a la otra:
—Gracias por todo. Supiste hacerlo bien.
—Quisiera seguir haciéndolo.
—Sabes que eso no está en las manos… sino en el cerebro.
—Ah, sí… ese que tratamos de engañar. Se cree todo: trucos, mañas, apariencias.
—¿Sí? ¿Cómo cuál?
—Que puedo ser tú al otro lado del espejo.


![Gemini_Generated_Image_nhddbonhddbonhdd.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eleidap/23xAZpdQjb2iqJWkwrAwQWB2RHQiu159fW6qLCYnq4PffrLJBDehK5K3FLbAwkrLiTAy6.png) Imagen creada con Nano BAnana 2


Mi derecha fracturada obligó a la izquierda.

En vez de escribir, dibujaba garabatos de letras.
Anudaba, indecisa.
Lavaba, con dudas.
Acariciaba, sin experiencia.

Pero entrenaba. Sin fallo.

Aprovechó su momento.
Quiso ganarle espacio a la diestra.

Lo intentó todo, como minimizando el dolor y la inmovilidad de la otra:
“Mira, destapo. Escribo. Limpio. Manejo”.

No se cansaba. Aunque doliera.
Dispuesta a protagonizar lo manual.

A veces la compadecía.
Otras, me enorgullece.

Le prometí tenerla presente.
Hacerla parte de esfuerzos y logros.

Porque, como con el cuatro,
sin una derecha que pulse… no hay acorde que suene.

Lo que más extrañé fue tenerlas juntas,
recogiendo el agua que refresca mi rostro.

No hay nada igual a eso.

¿Será por eso que una mano lava la otra…
y las dos lavan la cara?


***ENGLISH VERSION ***
One hand said to the other:

Thanks for everything.
You knew how to do it well.

I would like to keep doing it.

You know well that that
is not in the \

But in the brain.

Oh, yes! That one that
we try to deceive... it believes everything: tricks, wiles, appearances.

Yes? Like which one?

That I can be you on the other side of the mirror.
My fractured right [hand], forced the left.
Instead of writing,
it drew scribbles of letters.
It knotted indecisively.
It washed with doubts.
It caressed without experience.
But that yes, it trained
without fail. It took advantage of its moment to gain space from the right.
It tried everything, as if
minimizing the pain and immobilization of the other: look that I uncover, I write,
I clean and I drive.
It didn't get tired, even if
it hurt. Ready to star manually.
Sometimes I felt pity for it.
Others, it makes me proud. I promised it to keep it present, participant of efforts and
achievements. Like with the cuatro, without a right that presses there is no chord that sounds.
What I missed the most was
having them together taking the water that refreshes my face. There is nothing that is
better or equal to that.
Could it be for that reason that one
hand washes the other and both wash the face?

title.title: Hivechess Lecture: Activity can be more important than a piece
title.body:
![17774078751684424163572700257727.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/AK56Ya5bU9ebUivWjV2zhTFA7JDheP5hKkffjCPj17Vu8aByMPvJUmEmxKbXq3p.jpg)


Welcome to a new Hivechess lecture and we will be looking at a new lesson that talks about activity being more important than a piece. The game we will be using in today's lesson is from the Baku Open between Daniel Dubov, a grandmaster and Aarav Sinha, a Fide Master. I watched this game because I was interested by the rating difference, a difference of about 300 elo rating. Dubov is rated 2654 while Sinha is rated 2315. That speaks to a huge difference in their rating so it was an interesting game to watch.

**1. d4 Nf6 2. Nf3 e6 3. c4 b6 4. Bf4 Bb4+ 5. Nbd2 Bb7 6. a3 Be7 7. e3 Nh5 8. Qc2 Nxf4**

The opening played was the Queen's Indian Defense: Miles Variation, which I found it weird that Dubov allowed a capture of his bishop on f4. 

![Screenshot_20260428-195235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23uFiJb2EVVk3LAgznT2CeT7k9hsYpZWnKZu2tWhikYavF4NhWYqDrqXsExJcJZ8yQrVq.jpg)

Although it does not mean much after white went for the Qc2 variation, which after the exchange of the knight for the bishop, there could be possible play on the b1 to h7 diagonal. I just find it weird because in such position, bishop to g3 is quite logical, and after there is an exchange of the knight for the bishop, white gets the open h-file for his rook. These minor advantages can come in handy when the game gets to the middlegame stage. Computer's top recommendation in this position are Qd3, Bd3 or Bg3, which is why i said it's weird as well that Bg3 was not played.

**9. exf4 O-O 10. Bd3 h6 11. O-O-O d5 12. h4 Bd6 13. f5 exf5 14. Bxf5 Nd7 15. c5 bxc5 16. Bxd7 Qxd7 17. dxc5 Bf4 18. g3 Bxd2+ 19. Rxd2 d4**

The crucial moment for this lesson came in on move 19 with black's move d4, where he sacrificed a pawn in exchange for activity on the queenside. 


![Screenshot_20260428-211141.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23u6NNGe1RQh2ZxgPngV8vcEEEyj7Vz5TmtxqJs979BCnJC55eE1jzcMS6TsbFwGqqX3k.jpg)

After white grabbed the pawn, it was not enough to get a strong edge. This is because black has Qb5 and a long range diagonal attack on white knight that so happens to be connected to the rook on h1. This brought about the activity which makes the game balance despite being a piece down. 


![Screenshot_20260428-211921.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23u6MwfErK3HzMwT2ZvvLWAi4eSsEPEKdTuo1coaCZfvDfu74dqwCbSu18PYxjpmpRVi9.jpg)

Even after trying to complicate the position, it was still hard to get any initiative when it was black calling the shots with his attacks and white had to defend. This sacrifice of a piece give a 2300 rated player to force a draw against a super grandmaster. Do not undervalue the power of activity for this is what makes it possible to sac in chess. 

Here is the game link:

https://lichess.org/broadcast/baku-open-2026/round-1/yjKuc0DL/oQPfGuQl

And here is the PGN game:

```
[Event \

] 1. d4 Nf6 2. Nf3 e6 3. c4 b6 4. Bf4 Bb4+ 5. Nbd2 Bb7 6. a3 Be7 7. e3 Nh5 8. Qc2 Nxf4 9. exf4 O-O 10. Bd3 h6 11. O-O-O d5 12. h4 Bd6 13. f5 exf5 14. Bxf5 Nd7 15. c5 bxc5 16. Bxd7 Qxd7 17. dxc5 Bf4 18. g3 Bxd2+ 19. Rxd2 d4 20. Rxd4 Qb5 21. Rb4 Qc6 22. Rf4 Rad8 23. Re1 Rd5 24. b4 Rfd8 25. Rfe4 Ba6 26. R4e3 Bb5 27. Ne5 Qa6 28. c6 Ba4 29. Qe2 Qb6 30. Rc3 Rd1+ 31. Rxd1 Rxd1+ 32. Kb2 Qd4 33. Nd3 Rb1+ 34. Kxb1 Qxc3 35. Qe8+ Kh7 36. Qe4+ Kg8 37. Nc5 Qxa3 38. g4 a5 39. Qe8+ Kh7 40. Qe4+ Kg8 41. Nxa4 Qxa4 42. Qe8+ Kh7 43. bxa5 Qd1+ 44. Kb2 Qd2+ 45. Kb3 Qd3+ 1/2-1/2 ``` See you in the next lecture.

![IMG_20240321_084456.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/244A6pfkc7DMsWnjFQmLVbvQzV34mzYjRrcv2o7SQn8mULbY7yNtRaTzPGXryAmAocn7C.jpg)
Today's photos were also taken in Spain, and you know that's one of my happiest places in the world. To be more specific, they're memories from our walk through Badajoz before the first concert of that tour, and I wanted to share the excitement of that moment, since we haven't had very good days between yesterday and today. One of our bass players was in a car accident on Monday, and that shook our musical world. Today we had to film a music video for our social media, and amidst smiles and hugs, we tried to hide our sadness about what happened to Daniel. After all, we're all artists, and we can pretend everything's fine, even when our hearts are broken. I get very immersed myself when I write my posts, and monotonous weeks like these, while returning to happy places like the ones I'm sharing in these pictures.

> ![IMG_20240321_085142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/242YGJ8xziGQhQA5u4EXwwQmkot73GZapsWqE4RgaXzFUmtvhfoBjmFAJiF9X76bT8EPj.jpg) ![IMG_20240321_084718.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xVTcRhNQr1UtNWtegXRUNhhnPwtmFqrVB851i8gFfp7vyvbwEC4gCh6BGby7Kyk3bzu.jpg)
Our bandmate Daniel is now stable. The first 24 hours were crucial, but he's about to be discharged to recover at home. It was a sad day, but we managed to get on with work. Yesterday we recorded the music, today we filmed the video, and we found out that this Saturday we have a concert outside of Caracas, specifically in San Antonio de los Altos. I've never traveled to that area, so I'm really looking forward to Saturday being the most amazing day of the week, and a great way to start May, just like this photo shoot before our first concert of an international tour.
![IMG_20260428_205953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23s9CMZoFtkhXHABzoSkfCjqgT3BfPTFDoNgZhyNp74zTPe783bgti6z8S6HbyWcJKotq.jpg)
Yes, that's life; each day shows us its best side and, at the same time, its cruelest. But as I've written in many of my posts, what's important is how we assimilate everything that happens and how we grow by learning from it. Sometimes I wonder if I'll ever see these places I photographed in Spain again, since we literally explored so many hidden corners. But if it doesn't happen again, then I'm left with the joy of having lived those moments to the fullest. I haven't lost the habit of going for walks and exploring every new place I discover, especially if it's safe to do so. And photographing everything that catches my eye helps me have clearer memories of these adventures.

> ![IMG_20240321_133426.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23vPRSucUXqKhharaAAFQQxjnbFwUcPrsQXPHHcR7DeQX8FZWbpWqtNdkmjaUjSnhEyGu.jpg) ![IMG_20240321_133651.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/246atKLurRjhcgyvoBjnBfAh9BW1thPss4GkEyEQadmAqxCtHDMzQgP9oZ5UGV9uA3EUM.jpg)
Reliving our hike across these vast, green plains outside Badajoz brings back the joy of those moments when I connect with the beauty and power of nature, and doing so midweek while writing for this community is a truly therapeutic activity. Life goes on—good things, bad things, things that directly affect us and things that affect people we love—but nothing is permanent. Every situation is different, and it reminds us that we can never lose our zest for life. It makes me laugh a little to write this because I always seem to be the most optimistic person among my colleagues, although if you read me regularly, you know that I often struggle to help myself 😅
![IMG_20240320_143740.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/244eCPJYWvSp72gTsSTqWN4LEoPMfbQgataGKf2ka21TNHsGf42JUswy2X7D7PLkjkJTc.jpg)
I want to wrap up with some personal plans for the rest of the week. I want to do things right this Wednesday: start my day with a workout, go to my weekly vocal class, rehearse with the choir, and then visit our friend at home in the afternoon if he's been discharged from the hospital. This week I'll also meditate and pray for the many people who need it, both here in my country and for others far away, like a good friend who lives in Spain and is supporting her mother during her recovery. I've been able to take a few walks near my house, but they haven't been particularly photogenic, although I did enjoy everything around me when I went for a stroll. I have high hopes for this weekend, so I'll continue to give it my all and be ready to receive all the beautiful things life has to offer... Until the next post, everyone! 🙏
![IMG_20240321_133454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/EoTeK6DWKdbQb6MNkY6XAHzAEMmgny4pvoMNyUsHgMh58bmEjGBiAKF8EF9Jhtgt55e.jpg) [//]:# (!worldmappin 38.88569 lat -6.92567 long Badajoz d3scr)

The picture I am sharing today is from yesterday when I was out taking pictures amidst the greenery, and I caught this beautiful butterfly sitting on the tender tip of a green tree. The black patterns on its white wings are like nature's own hand-painted artwork. It was sitting quietly with its wings folded, but its inner beauty was very clear.

I thought I would enjoy its beauty for some time, but if I hesitated, the butterfly would get scared and run away, so I quickly took some pictures without hesitation.

When I took the picture, there were a few other people with me, we were having fun and taking photos at the same time. However, today's butterfly is very small, yet its beauty is very beautiful, just looking at it makes my heart feel good.

Thank you everyone, see you again in the next post.

title.title: [ESP - ENG] ✨🛍️ A Crazy Weekend 😂💖
title.body: > ¡Hola hola Comunidad! ✨✨, éste fin de semana definitivamente fue uno de esos que te deja agotada por varios días, entre hacer mercados de comida, salida con amigos y diligencias sorpresa, llegué al lunes y estaba tan cansada que no pude ni siquiera escribir éste post, por esa razón está saliendo el día de hoy. Y tampoco es que estoy teniendo el día tranquilo, porque con el nuevo emprendimiento que estoy llevando (del que les hablaré luego), a duras penas y saco tiempo para leer 😭, ¿Pero saben algo? Estoy muy feliz estando ocupada 🤣.

> Pero en fin, toda la locura del fin de semana empezó el viernes a las 5am en la travesía titulada “aventuras en la cooperativa Cecosesola” 🤣, afortunadamente ésta vez las señoras respetables de la tercera edad no estaba en modo agresividad y supervivencia, y nadie me empujó o piso mientras recorrí las instalaciones. Tal fue la calma, que pudimos guardar las bolsas en el paquetero y poder entrar juntas (mi hermana y yo) a todos los espacios, porque normalmente yo me quedo afuera cuidando las bolsas.

> Como ese día llegamos cansadas a la casa, no hicimos mercado de víveres sino que lo dejamos para el sábado. Todo tranquilo y de repente, estábamos en el centro averiguando precios de ventiladores para la iglesia donde asiste mi papá 🤣. Como se nos hizo mediodía, aprovechamos la excusa del almuerzo para ir a comer cachapas, porque aquí somos fan de las cachapas 🤣, y además compré una extra para el día siguiente, porque justamente tenía reunión con mi grupito de amigos.

- - -

El domingo me fuí al segundo servicio de la iglesia, y después me reuní con mi grupito de amigos, los extrañaba un montón y me hacía falta hablar con todos ellos en persona 💖, recargaron mi tanquecito amor fraternal.

![separador nuevo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/EoibzJBuKooMnVdgJahuM46NCrLqCQuNqYyj1hFhu6eT7e3G3jft7A7Tu33wLKDwTCF.png)
Hello my beautiful people ✨💕!
- - -

> Hello hello Community! ✨✨, This weekend was definitely one of those that leaves you exhausted for days on end. Between grocery shopping, going out with friends and unexpected errands, I got to Monday and was so tired I couldn’t even write this post, which is why it’s only going up today. And it’s not as if I’m having a quiet day either, because with the new venture I’m working on (which I’ll tell you about later), I can barely find the time to read 😭. But you know what? I’m really happy being busy 🤣.

> Anyway, the whole weekend’s madness kicked off on Friday at 5am with the outing dubbed ‘Adventures at the Cecosesola Co-op’ 🤣. Fortunately, this time the respectable elderly ladies weren’t in full-on survival mode, and nobody pushed or stepped on me as I made my way through the shop. It was so calm that we were able to leave our bags in the luggage room and go into all the areas together (my sister and I), because normally I stay outside looking after the bags.

> As we were tired when we got home that day, we didn’t go grocery shopping but left it until Saturday. Everything was quiet, and suddenly we found ourselves in the town centre checking out prices for fans for the church my dad goes to 🤣. As it was getting late, we used lunch as an excuse to go and eat cachapas, because we’re big fans of cachapas here 🤣, and I also bought an extra one for the next day, as I happened to have a get-together with my little group of friends.

- - -

On Sunday I went to the second church service, and afterwards I met up with my little group of friends; I’d missed them loads and really needed to chat to them all in person 💖 – they really topped up my little tank of sisterly love.

- - - ![Banner_20250718_175732_0001.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/48Vjprgf7L64hn2E1pd3Px4kDfvdqTJTphafvcf7mh8hY4Dn4JZTf8nr8Y3UVKMnBV.gif)

title.title: Flexiones que Explotan el Core [Esp/Eng]
title.body:
>

Flexiones que Explotan el Core. Parace algo contradictorio; que si las flexiones están enfocadas en el desarrollo y fortalecimiento del tren superior, también funcionan para activar el core y las piernas. El que piense lo contrario está equivocado; porque es cierto que el tren superior se fortalece en gran medida y si posicionamos brazos y manos de diferentes maneras, el trabajo se enfatiza en músculos específicos; claro está, siempre teniendo contraído el resto de la musculatura. De igual manera; la tensión que se siente en el núcleo y piernas es grandiosa, porque estos músculos son esenciales para activarse con las flexiones. Ahora, como siempre es costumbre; no me dedico a realizar ejercicios comunes que pueden llevar al tedio, al contrario, me encanta realizar combinaciones donde todo el cuerpo se involucre y como lógicamente vamos a ejecutar flexiones, éstas se llevarán a cabo de manera diferente. Así que vamos a prepararnos, porque con este rutina tendrás que flexionar y mover todo tu cuerpo. Actívate y dale movimiento a tu vida. >Push-ups That Target the Core. It might seem a bit contradictory: while push-ups are primarily focused on developing and strengthening the upper body, they also work to engage the core and legs. Anyone who thinks otherwise is mistaken; because it’s true that the upper body is strengthened significantly, and if we position our arms and hands in different ways, the workout emphasizes specific muscles—of course, while keeping the rest of the muscles engaged. >Similarly, the tension you feel in your core and legs is intense, because these muscles are essential for performing push-ups. Now, as is my custom, I don’t stick to routine exercises that can get boring; on the contrary, I love doing combinations that engage the whole body, and since we’re obviously going to be doing push-ups, we’ll be doing them in a different way. So let’s get ready, because with this routine, you’ll have to push and move your whole body. Get active and bring some movement into your life.

![1000450616.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKYPFKfqxZP6zPNmknCSrDBj19LXpgvKRnfsTLMwkyVNB2yrpSTg1mtPFjGp3uX.gif)Portada de mi Autoría Editada en/Cover of my Authorship Edited in [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
Logos propiedad de/ logos owned by @hiveio, @fulldeportes
# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **APERTURA LATERAL DE BRAZOS MÁS ELEVACIÓN ALTERNA DE RODILLAS**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera, con brazos al frente extendidos hacia abajo y manos juntas. >[**Warm-up 1**, **SIDE ARM STRETCH WITH ALTERNATING KNEE LIFTS**]() >[Posture]() >Stand with your feet hip-width apart, arms extended downward in front of you, and hands together.
![1000450558.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKqakEe8FNZSuZSAHwAX1EHBTRa2q3Jm9YNF6RMXNZ3Wc6nHgTHeZccyt9LGSeu.gif)
[Ejecución]() Durante 3 minutos continuos, vamos elevando las rodillas de forma alterna; mientras al mismo tiempo, abrimos y cerramos brazos. >[Execution]() >For 3 continuous minutes, lift your knees one at a time while simultaneously opening and closing your arms.
![1000450573.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKqaUUpmdrwVmbv7b1gxdHtorGaC4naawx7EtXQeDeaw9hkzYgDKiou6cpBDQuH.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **SKIPPING MÁS GOLPES ALTERNOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera, con brazos en posición de combate. >[**Warm-up 2**, **SKIPPING WITH ALTERNATING STEPPING**]() >[Stance]() >Feet hip-width apart, arms in a boxing stance.
![1000450575.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKp9WbRRHZs1HGG9fTAwLHmsjrn5YCF6RGgKxBgHwgoJJkX4MdRMRHgMXsTWdZo.gif)
[Ejecución]() Este calentamiento lo llevamos a cabo, ejecutando un trote rápido elevando las rodillas y lanzando golpes frontales alternos. 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >We perform this warm-up by jogging briskly while lifting our knees and throwing alternating jabs. 3 minutes of exercise.
![1000450577.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKqakEhGVguYYdrdACUbGgqudr3PCBsoRnMFqhxafhTmnQh2FNNqNzD8nXEwHvr.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **EXTENSIÓN ALTERNA DE CODOS CON DESPLAZAMIENTO LATERAL MÁS FLEXIONES CLÁSICAS**]() [Postura]() La posición para este ejercicio inicia de la siguiente manera; adoptamos la postura de plancha, apoyados con los antebrazos; piernas al ancho de la cadera. >[**Station 1**, **ALTERNATING ELBOW EXTENSIONS WITH SIDE-TO-SIDE MOVEMENT PLUS CLASSIC PUSH-UPS**]() >[Starting Position]() >The starting position for this exercise is as follows: assume a plank position, resting on your forearms, with your legs hip-width apart.
![1000450579.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK6XT9BgQVhaARDZT3goxiRFn5URfYktegmAgdkYfjpAXAAgrJqCSxVE1jwpoZ6.gif)
[Ejecución]() Sin duda alguna todo el tren superior se mantiene trabajando sin pausa. El núcleo y piernas se benefician en gran medida. Son flexiones, pero el núcleo explota. Para llevar a cabo el movimiento; extendemos los codos, abrimos brazos y piernas hacia un lado, nos desplazamos; ejecutamos la flexión y volvemos a apoyar los antebrazos. Extendemos nuevamente los codos, nos desplazamos hacia el lado opuesto, ejecutamos otra flexión y regresamos a la postura inicial. Serían 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series; cada vez que hagas el desplazamiento es una repetición. >[Execution]() >Without a doubt, your entire upper body is working nonstop. Your core and legs get a major workout. They’re push-ups, but your core really gets a workout. To perform the movement: extend your elbows, open your arms and legs to the side, shift your weight; perform the push-up, and return to rest on your forearms. Extend your elbows again, shift your weight to the opposite side, perform another push-up, and return to the starting position. That’s a total of 20 repetitions over 4 sets; each time you shift your weight counts as one repetition.
![1000450583.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK56AFp78vNgkLVWBTApZEGdGhpQXPKdmB2cuxWgCGUmrQsuK95kKs3CfS6Cb4Q.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **FLEXIONES LATERALES MÁS RODILLAZOS OBLICUOS**]() [Postura]() Posición de flexiones con apertura un poco más allá del ancho de hombros. Giramos el torso y cadera, tomando una posición lateral; una pierna que al frente y otra atrás. >[**Station 2**, **SIDE PUSH-UPS WITH OBLIQUE KNEE RAISES**]() >[Posture]() >Assume a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Rotate your torso and hips into a side-facing position, with one leg in front and the other behind.
![1000450585.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK5691eS8JvAjUqbVFQuL9Wi9t4cDf5ZpDeERQRmarXYA4P9zj8oLBppEauvqb8.gif)
![1000450595.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKAppz5GFEEHyeJYTwVBxrTgau49WZDpp32rsZepJWtXQoWbNYxKUZJFPffkg7t.gif)
[Ejecución]() Cuando hagan este movimiento me avisan que músculos se activaron; porque realmente todo el cuerpo está activo y recibiendo beneficios. Los brazos están que arden, núcleo y piernas full; me encanta porque la cadera y oblicuos se fortalecen en gran medida. Para llevarlo a cabo; simplemente realizamos la flexión de codos, estando abajo, lanzamos el rodillazo lateral. Serían 20 repeticiones en 4 series por lado. >[Execution]() >When you do this move, let me know which muscles you feel working because your whole body is actually engaged and reaping the benefits. My arms are on fire, and my core and legs are totally engaged; I love it because it really strengthens my hips and obliques. To do it, simply perform a push-up, and when you’re at the bottom, drive your knee out to the side.
![1000450593.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK6X45zNBmDHgmrqm42GibZtte9qtcAByNq6F21H1gvyu2383TVhnHyUB3avmMN.gif)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUdVDp6Uaz8B36ffosJiDqKd2t5qG2LL2u7J5n4bt5goq/1777412468791.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **EXTENSIÓN DE CODOS MÁS FLEXIÓN DIAMANTE**]() [Postura]() Posición de plancha; antebrazos en el piso con manos entrelazadas. Piernas al ancho de la cadera. >[**Station 3**, **ELBOW EXTENSION AND DIAMOND PUSH-UP**]() >[Posture]() >Plank position; forearms on the floor with hands clasped together. Legs hip-width apart.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbrd8EuBRBbGiW3kgFz7PHEWe3ZMaLghEeZtc1mnJxD35/1777412469079.gif)
[Ejecución]() Trabajo innegable para el tren superior, con énfasis en tríceps y pectorales. El núcleo y piernas siempre en total tensión. Ejecutamos el ejercicio, extendiendo los codos; al subir, vamos formando un diamante con las manos y ejecutamos luego esa flexión. Subimos y volvemos a flexionar los codos para volver a la postura inicial. Serían 20 repeticiones en 4 series. >[Execution]() >This exercise provides a solid workout for the upper body, with a focus on the triceps and chest. Keep your core and legs engaged throughout. Perform the exercise by extending your elbows; as you come up, form a diamond shape with your hands and then perform the push-up. Push up and bend your elbows again to return to the starting position. Aim for 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZSR4LVT68gKK3yp7GpsAgtYiup7mcjP3Bz5ZtzttpHcU/1777412469219.gif)
[**Relajación**, **CAMINATA SUAVE CON MOVIMIENTOS CIRCULARES CON BRAZOS**]() [Postura]() De pie, con piernas al ancho de la cadera; codos flexionados con brazos a los lados. >[**Relaxation**, **GENTLE WALK WITH CIRCULAR ARM MOVEMENTS**]() >[Posture]() >Stand with your feet hip-width apart; elbows bent, arms at your sides.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmevbZJc5TYMv1AT83i8euREgNG6nhPhXcJyY5NBZTtyPt/1777412469562.gif)
[Ejecución]() Respirando y exhalando; durante 3 minutos de relajación y paz corporal, mientras realizamos la caminata suave, vamos girando los brazos dos veces a los lados y dos veces al frente. >[Execution]() >Breathing in and out; for 3 minutes of relaxation and physical calm, as we take gentle steps, we swing our arms twice to the sides and twice in front of us.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfFHygQ5Y5e5dwNJyM8yBCFZhztnw3DWexX9z2E4tMbFh/1777412469738.gif)
Gracias por preferir nuestro canal. Recuerda que debes tomar descansos de calidad, hidratarte y alimentarte sanamente. Hasta la próxima y si deseas una rutina en particular, en los comentarios la puedes solicitar. >Thank you for choosing our channel. Remember to take quality breaks, hydrate and eat healthy. Until next time and if you want a particular routine, you can ask for it in the comments. #

title.title: 新的一天出门溜达
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![zYwUVi9zKZdOdw7n_IMG_20260429_082418.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/zYwUVi9zKZdOdw7n_IMG_20260429_082418/zYwUVi9zKZdOdw7n_IMG_20260429_082418.webp)
![EEQKZARGLi9LV4aS_IMG_20260429_082421.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/EEQKZARGLi9LV4aS_IMG_20260429_082421/EEQKZARGLi9LV4aS_IMG_20260429_082421.webp)
![jEAAUkdC2kt8Ka2f_IMG_20260429_083540.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/jEAAUkdC2kt8Ka2f_IMG_20260429_083540/jEAAUkdC2kt8Ka2f_IMG_20260429_083540.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

本来以为今天不出门的，但是周末出去溜达一圈，晒伤了，就在家里休息了几天！把家里的早餐啥的吃完了！今天感觉要下雨本来以为也不出门的，但是休息几天了，我想出门溜达一圈，随便锻炼一下身体。更加是随便吃个美味的早餐！哈哈～出门时间实在太饿了，顺了一瓶牛奶就出门，哈哈～要是可以吃完牛奶我也饱了不想出门啦！

不过也有几天没出门了要出门行运啦！一路溜达去早餐店，发现今天超市也开始五一特价啦！好多人早早排队准备进去买东西了！要是不知道还以为这些大妈是早早过来领鸡蛋的！原来是超市早上有特价大米啥促销大减价，我一看有我喜欢吃的增城丝苗米，我决定等我吃完早餐也去抗一袋回家！这个特价不买才是傻瓜！

这个柴米油盐省得一分是一分，何况是我喜欢的大米！买到就是赚到。每年总是期待它特价囤多点，等到下一次它再特价。不然吃完再吃原价米，感觉有点贵吃不起啊！所以我就匆匆忙忙去我们经常光顾的早餐店点了一份鲜虾云吞吃，我家老头例排也是炒河粉！也不知道整天吃啥好！都是平常经常吃惯的早餐，吃完早餐我就准备去逛超市啦！顺便多走走路！哈哈～我还抗一袋米回家当是负重锻炼啊！累啊！回来时候还下雨了～

---

title.body:

---

Hola Amiguitos, Papitos y ZoeTubers! En esta ocasión recitaré dos poemas del poeta y escritor salvadoreño Alfredo Espino: Los Pericos Pasan y La Tórtola.
El poema Los Pericos Pasan, es una representación de la belleza natural de nuestra fauna salvadoreña; esos pájaros color verde que dibujan en el cielo libertad y canto por lo majestuosos paisajes.
El poema La Tórtola, es una poesía tan dulce que manifiesta las emociones que conectan con todo lo que rodea al paisajismo colorido de los pueblos mágicos de El Salvador, el campesino, los árboles, los animales, la Madre Tierra que se conecta con el alma del campo en la vida del hombre sencillo. 
Alfredo Espino es el máximo exponente poeta salvadoreño en la poesía lírica, capaz de llevarte a viajar a través de sus versos a los paisajes coloridos de El Salvador, con tan solo cerrar tus ojos y sentir su poesía llena de vida eterna...

Dedico estos poemas a todos mis suscriptores fieles e incondicionales que tienen el buen gusto de disfrutar mis poemas y cuentos infantiles, les mando muchas energías positivas y un fuerte abrazo 🤗✨

¡Espero disfruten muchísimo los poemas:  Los Pericos Pasan y La Tórtola de Alfredo Espino! 😉

[fuente](https://es.dreamstime.com/foto-de-archivo-mirada-profunda-en-ojos-azules-image66672543)

#

MIRADA PROFUNDA 

Detrás de los cristales 
veo la transparencia 
del mar en tu mirada
como un cielo puro de azul. 

En tus pupilas se escapan 
cicatrices de un pasado 
que se van con el horizonte 
cada vez que me alejo
de tu impregnante mirada
de lágrimas escondidas 
en la tenue paz de un parpadear
que acecha en el acoso
tu dolor escondido. 

Más allá de tí 
están las palabras
que el viento ladrón 
se traga con los suspiros
el mensaje pasajero y secreto 
de ese pasado insólito 
en lo hondo de tu mirada
fundida en los azules. 

#

![IMG_20251030_131924_223@1552195531 (2) (1).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYcAMnp8rXxSwGJ2UfAxwEZZ95N8qY1vTvdx9fKjqrsCy/IMG_20251030_131924_223@1552195531%20(2)%20(1).png)

#

DEEP GAZE

Behind the glass,
I see the transparency
of the sea in your gaze,
like a pure blue sky.

In your pupils escape
scars of a past
that vanish with the horizon
each time I move away
from your penetrating gaze
of hidden tears
in the faint peace of a blink
that stalks, in the harassment
of your hidden pain.

Beyond you
are the words
that the thieving wind
swallows with sighs,
the fleeting and secret message
of that unusual past
deep in your gaze
melted in the blues.

#


![IMG_20251030_131924_223@1552195531 (4) (2).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR4DSjEWNtm9S72maUQTvxDdKtLm3NSiuo2utWBUPWPVe/IMG_20251030_131924_223@1552195531%20(4)%20(2).png)

title.title: León de limpiapipas inspirado en Silver Shield Sentry. (ESP-ENG)
title.body:
Hola hola! Muy feliz noche del martes, espero estén pasando una buena semana y que todos sus objetivos que se cumplan a cabalidad en estos días, casi termina abril, se va un mes lleno de aprendizajes y que de alguna u otra forma fué de cosas buenas.

>Hello everyone! Happy Tuesday night! I hope you're having a great week and that all your goals are fully achieved these days. April is almost over; it's been a month full of learning and, in one way or another, good things.



https://images.ecency.com/DQmUDmGxByP8AxbyZTbZyHT4SymgpGZKGgAL5eJtD9JjYDs/1001429584.jpg



En esta oportunidad les quiero compartir una nueva idea de limpiapipas, se trata de una figura de león inspirada en la carta de Splinterlands Silver Shield Sentry, son guerreros que llevan sus armas preparados para luchar. 


>This time I want to share a new pipe cleaner idea with you; it's a lion figure inspired by the Splinterlands Silver Shield Sentry card. They are warriors who carry their weapons ready to fight.


<center>
![Silver Shield Sentry.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWx2FqTqab8En15pp7ezuLW2H2nUHi8sizpz6yc9kq6tP/Silver%20Shield%20Sentry.jpg)
[Silver Shield Sentry](https://splinterlands.com/card-detail/947/regular/20/?tab=lore) 
</center>


Realicé un león de limpiapipas inspirado ena carta, es súper tierno y tamaño mediano, para esta figura solo utilicé limpiapipas, no colocamos base, ya que solo se trata de unir y enrollar los limpiapipas, yo amé el resultado y se que ustedes también, a continuación los materiales y el paso a paso.



>I made a pipe cleaner lion inspired by a letter. It's super cute and medium-sized. For this figure, I only used pipe cleaners; we didn't add a base since it's just a matter of joining and coiling the pipe cleaners. I loved the result, and I know you will too. Below are the materials and step-by-step instructions.


<center>
![ezgif-7061e5e3df14597f.gif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRYxb8oUpfS9pPTo38V48aa5bWZtcvJmHHGzqQpk46geV/ezgif-7061e5e3df14597f.gif)
</center>





![1000100308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQX1QCU8EKjdgAjeZpBNuDdZqxkg2pWGQEVHPRjdtuyPX/1000100308.png)


| Materiales| Materials|
| --------|---------|
| Limpiapipas beige, marrón, blanco, negro| Beige, brown, white, black pipe cleaners |
| Tijera, silicón | Scissors, silicone|
| Paleta de sombras| Eyeshadow palette |
| Brocha, encendedor|Brush, lighter|


![1001426267.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uQvpLXZ4nnGLw2RUf8439Pn9fE3nz8maJtANjLdDQu2c66b8cMVnfgnUcdqCyMGbfWE.jpg)

![1000100308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQX1QCU8EKjdgAjeZpBNuDdZqxkg2pWGQEVHPRjdtuyPX/1000100308.png)


### *Paso a paso / Step by step*
#


El primer paso que voy a realizar será enrollar tres limpiapipas color piel en un bolígrafo, luego voy tomar un limpiapipas de 30 cm e introducimos las tres partes que enrollamos, ahora voy a unir las puntas del limpiapipas largo y giramos tres veces, cortamos y acomodamos en forma de circulo.


>The first step I'm going to take is to wrap three skin-colored pipe cleaners around a pen. Then I'm going to take a 30cm pipe cleaner and insert the three parts we wrapped. Now I'm going to join the ends of the long pipe cleaner and twist them three times, cut them, and arrange them in a circle.



|![1001426278.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tSYpvoLFtdnthtnrgwdM7uW9m6FoQXbqjpjfHp8U7SXDWi73Z649gRaBF32gNe49CFp.jpg)|![1001426279.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tmL1aztjD6qe6XmwZotwApabTdXhXoug1KebWWFxeRTGdCaZMsjJfzoz8oFH6xcTCSb.jpg)|![1001426280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/Eo6LTpcwNtuYwarToH8HLYJx4Sc4pcp3begdjFxFE1teNYavW9Ao2bPCNh8d5mEVzLo.jpg)|
|-|-|-|




Ahora vamos a realizar el mismo procedimiento solo que en este voy a formar el círculo y dejaré el sobrante sin cortar, voy a pasar el limpiapipas a través del segundo círculo, pegamos con silicón, doblamos y enrollamos el limpiapipas al rededor, voy a continuar cubriendo hasta alcanzar el grosor deseado.


>Now we're going to do the same procedure, only this time I'm going to form the circle and leave the excess uncut. I'm going to pass the pipe cleaner through the second circle, glue it with silicone, fold and wrap the pipe cleaner around it, and continue covering until I reach the desired thickness.


|![1001426282.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tSayGixUHvua4rKfeLcdg8ivmvB5gjJ1z9cV8NnCCoaCfV6AtfBbZE3ULw9eT94VQjK.jpg)|![1001426287.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tmL4usN6T6NUyvgifDd9BdNBf6gxFEHB6joF7dGWRUcKNjK6pSPtFrpLfnjL3M8T4pe.jpg)|![1001426309.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tvijGnJSWfcHw3QRYnzkvQBX1zv3nTBUiLx9b2Li3TkY1b7PVkRvkW1JT5YgKmm3une.jpg)|
|-|-|-|





Ahora realicé dos círculos de color piel para las orejas así mismo dos círculos de color marrón que ubiqué en el medio. Luego comencé a realizar la melena en color marrón claro.


>Next, I drew two skin-colored circles for the ears, as well as two brown circles which I placed in the middle. Then I started drawing the mane in light brown.


|![1001426315.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23vsSgv5jnVkRd7jeT4CVWYKsTAeNpDQU6qdGQJgfDHngBD1zWrCXbGRjUVdK3RNLJUsU.jpg)|![1001426370.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23w2sW4vMkLEDNYwp2bGWN9t5Kai3EA9DSq4Ce6UaRTysrXMPLeQbZMd1JBJE9gWSLtfv.jpg)|![1001426433.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23vi4AAazA7vYwaxiNhiWCpZyHTH2QPuScK9SpEqrvk1mi8g8to5aHjPpg5LhahKX9nhX.jpg)|
|-|-|-|




Solo debes cortar 17 piezas de limpiapipas de 7 cm doblar y pegar al rededor de su cabeza, en este paso verás como va tomando forma de león. También vamos a cubrir la parte de atrás con limpiapipas marrón.


>Simply cut 17 pieces of 7cm pipe cleaner, fold them, and glue them around the head. At this stage, you'll see it begin to take the shape of a lion. We'll also cover the back with brown pipe cleaners.


|![1001426434.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uFa9Ef8ZkQz2BsLYsQznMd9Nox7N5TwurAMW3KmLY6QUePqApYTTbdbdKFADFkQFVQC.jpg)|![1001426435.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uQvwVQ1n3mDL7k4yEDqARgZqzeaN4u7saJh3tfRJxvshynQXi1cWjYDg7vet1DgmbEo.jpg)|![1001426445.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23vi66bYnRLthgxXq3GhGXCCmaC3pEtJsXkYYp3MALFpPsENmdZFztr6z44QMcn8UYbpX.jpg)|
|-|-|-|






Ahora cortamos una pequeña pieza para las patitas en color marrón y enrollamos el limpiapipas color piel también, pegamos, y realizamos el mismo paso con las patitas superiores.

>Now we cut a small piece for the legs in brown and wrap the skin-colored pipe cleaner around it as well, glue it on, and repeat the same step with the upper legs.



|![1001426489.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23vi6BL6Xojyzcds7UnLbj1MHgZT1JKoyfzwacC74iJFr8UuZKTTWZ1W1vNz7pyHFy8da.jpg)|![1001426571.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tmNNrkk5epCEeNnMULHpUMfr281x1XhNoPGn87yfVFGG2wqkJk9ajB7Q7hM54aX2ond.jpg)|![1001426599.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23vi6PPE8tapTLQQeLJHhGh5HwsNcGwJvQSjcks57gJEEahoZpLQ1m92AgpB2AGVkeNcU.jpg)|
|-|-|-|




Ahora vamos a realizar la cola para esto solo utilicé el alambre del limpiapipas y en la punta dejamos un poco de pelusa. Ahora vamos a comenzar agregar la sombre de color marrón claro sobre el limpiapipas.



Retiramos el exceso con una brocha más gruesa, ahora realicé los ojitos con limpiapipas negro, la nariz de color blanco, también aplicamos un poco de color en las mejillas y marcamos dos puntos blancos en los ojitos.


>Now we're going to make the tail. For this, I only used the pipe cleaner wire, leaving a little fuzz at the end. Now we'll start adding light brown shading over the pipe cleaner.

>We remove the excess with a thicker brush. Now I made the eyes with black pipe cleaners, the nose with white, and we also added a little color to the cheeks and two white dots around the eyes.

|![1001426645.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23u6BQTtUpZJiQaXkvYnsxAXBsenq313Woev1f7KBUts6PpUrHBxbq712xStFyFLDGc4f.jpg)|![1001426664.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uFY9TaF5vaDDr7Z9nwL6ztzcvgBcG5Wv8xLkEvMPTHBsz8VweXovNKtakRLea5RBaLY.jpg)|![1001426678.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23vi61fQehF2sc3XTk3Qdma6S74vfrGnGAdotbSM5fN1W7eLAsMHY6GvU2U2iFxCbXSKj.jpg)|
|-|-|-|


|![1001426747.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23u6BmdPpSqrnUXiXkQwJ6nu8ffmALCRVRQd2xWjAjBp3mn5x1MkudB1YaEGnKdfKzZ58.jpg)|![1001426763.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23w2unCXgWvJY4nKrHYzkykRcfikat4vxoJQhTDeb9s4wMbiHejxYr2KZZoYtmbSpPLQ5.jpg)|
|-|-|




Y listo, de esta forma terminé esta figura, espero les haya gustado el resultado, muchas gracias por el apoyo y por visitar mi publicación, nos vemos en una próxima oportunidad con más ideas creativas.


>And that's it! This is how I finished this figure. I hope you liked the result. Thank you so much for your support and for visiting my post. See you next time with more creative ideas.


![1001426901.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/EoGzGipi99t1zmH12mhc6zhFFmFWZZxA2JuVEvTFoRbzgAEkmYrCAwf27BA6rKiG3EN.jpg)


Más del resultado final:
>More on the final result:


![1001426886.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uFZyyUxHuSBosQVp1opvhVzfgxVwK4iYVv2LT9EyHMRF8aDE4XPXMQEKkDiZb9e96MT.jpg)


![1000100308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQX1QCU8EKjdgAjeZpBNuDdZqxkg2pWGQEVHPRjdtuyPX/1000100308.png)


![1000095868.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWG8Jt6SU3neCCGF5ZCDw8KzpFGS63KR5cYgcCEoKEYgi/1000095868.png)

title.body:
![jondometita-bully-1061363_1920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chefqueen/AK2D29KGKbtpkBbndGVSN4sq1Rcd9EjhASMTobWM7AsmttKSXpHxpBWN4mZmH6q.png)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/bully-stop-bullying-no-to-bullying-1061363/)

Bullying has become more rampant not just in school but all over community. It wasn't this loud when I was complaining then that people are becoming to make bullying looks like something normal. Society started blaming the victims that why will he or she walk that way to becoming the victims,I watch gradually how the society now careless about the abuser but blame the victim of ending up as a victim. 

School bullying is one thing that has been damaging kids emotionally, socially and academically either they do it physical or thorough text social media,I heard some school mates open groups where they cyber bully their mates . It's no more love and peace between students again ,it's now more full of wickedness and hatred, some kids are being taught supremacy from home when they should be taught empathy and being account for their actions.
School has now been some parents fear which usbt supposed to be so , school is supposed to be home away from home where all child are safe.

School should take mores serious measure about bullying in school, apart from the curriculum that is to be taught to them ,they should organize social a activities where they teach students about the real life,rewards of kindness and empathy and consequences of hurting others. School should have cordial relationships with parents where they inform the parents early whenever they notice a new strange behavior of their child ,so they can correct it early.

If I'm to be a parent and my child happens to be bullied,my advice will be to be bold enough to report to an older person that knows can handle that situation,I wouldn't tell him or her to fight back because obviously he or she can't handle the attacker in the first place that's why he was bullied Because what they created in them is fear at first, fear to speak out. 

I will walk down to the school to report and will make sure they respond to the case and make him face the consequences of the actions. I must see that the action that the school took will bring fear to others with same character. That way I will be resting assured that my child is safe.

School bullying should not be taken with levity hand at all, it shapes this kids mentality on how things is supposed to be ,it change how they see themselves and how they see others

title.body:
Price of hardware has become insane, and I wish I'd have built a new system before it got this bad. Now I'm in this state where I fear if I buy now I'll overpay, or if I wait it could possbily go even higher in cost. Which is a wild situation to be in.

I'm currently running Ubuntu 18.04 which is waaay out of date obviously.
But my reason for sticking with this sytem is I have so much bespoke configurations and installations that won't necessarily be there if I upgrade.
And my hardware is also woefully antiquated, but it still does what I need.

Recently I performed an update that I had put off for months and months, and ended up unable to login to my Ubuntu with Nvidia drivers.
I spent 4 days reinstalling drivers etc. with no luck.
But if I boot with Noveau(open source Nvidia) I can get in. 

The main thing I don't want to lose is VMware Workstation because the majority of my VM's are for that hypervisor.
I also have a Pop_OS computer, and disovered that there were no VMware Kernel modules for it. But I don't recall if that's specific to it being Pop_OS, or if that's just newer Linux kernels in general.
There was a big shakeup and VMware got bought out by Broadcomm so I have to research my options moving foward.

>



# Es el mejor

​

#




En el ámbito laboral hay mucha competencia entre el talento humano; si **en efecto**, las personas poseen cualidades y aptitudes que los hacen profesionales realmente brillantes y cuando tienen en sus manos un proyecto de gran envergadura ponen todo el empeño, esfuerzo y conocimiento en marcha para sacar adelante el trabajo en el menor tiempo posible y con la mayor eficiencia y eficacia. 

Cuando el líder de un equipo se dirige hacia ellos para proponerles que preparen en maqueta e informe todo lo relacionado con la nueva estructura de la organización, una renovación que mejorara los espacios que se espera este lleno de innovaciones y esté a la vanguardia con la tecnología para ser cada día más una organización altamente competitiva.

Todos atentos a los detalles, parámetros y directrices a seguir porque quieren comenzar ya a trabajar, sobre todo cuando les dicen que el proyecto que resulte ganador lo llevara a cabo todo el equipo en conjunto siguiendo las pautas de quien lo elaboro. De manera que cuando una propuesta resulta ganadora como la mejor, es un aliento y oportunidad de crecimiento para todo personal dentro de la organización donde labora, ya que el objetivo es crecer dentro de la misma demostrando de que está hecho y cuanto es capaz de hacer.

Cuando en la práctica se demuestran las habilidades se da el reconocimiento que merecen, destacando su trabajo siempre como ejemplo para el resto de sus compañeros y una motivación para esforzarse cada vez más. Valorar el desempeño y recompensarlo con promociones, remuneraciones, ascensos o trasferencias las personas sienten que son valoradas e importantes para la organización.
​
​<center>![WhatsApp Image 2022-05-12 at 3.28.50 PM.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeucn6MeLy6DkeFM7A2nU8vB9xADUBt8Yr6bzbsja2DRK/WhatsApp%20Image%202022-05-12%20at%203.28.50%20PM.jpeg)</center>

​

# It's the best



#
In the workplace, there is fierce competition for talent; indeed, people possess qualities and skills that make them truly outstanding professionals, and when they are entrusted with a major project, they devote all their dedication, effort, and expertise to getting the job done as quickly as possible and with the greatest efficiency and effectiveness. 
​
When a team leader approaches them to ask them to prepare a mock-up and report on everything related to the new organizational structure—a revamp designed to improve workspaces—it is expected to be full of innovations and at the cutting edge of technology, enabling the organization to become increasingly competitive.
​
Everyone pays close attention to the details, parameters, and guidelines to be followed because they want to get started right away, especially when they’re told that the winning proposal will be carried out by the entire team together, following the guidelines set by the person who developed it. So when a proposal is selected as the best, it serves as an encouragement and an opportunity for growth for all staff within the organization where they work, since the goal is to grow within the organization by demonstrating what they’re capable of and how much they can accomplish.
​
When employees demonstrate their skills in practice, they receive the recognition they deserve, and their work is consistently held up as an example for their colleagues and serves as motivation to strive for even greater achievements. By evaluating performance and rewarding it with promotions, bonuses, pay raises, or transfers, people feel valued and important to the organization.

#

Made With Canva
So, last Saturday we had our hangout as usual, and it was just so much fun that we did not want it to end. We are currently on the first topic for this week, which is “A QUIET TIME”. But before we proceed with the details of the topic, let us take a look at the winners of the last topic, which was “PAST THOUGHTS”. This topic was geared toward each member of the community, telling us about how our past thoughts and opinions could be used as a tool to cancel us in the present day. For many, things that are said in a moment of foolishness or youthful exuberance could end up being the very thing that destroys all we’ve worked hard to build years later. We got to see that while this is a sad development, it’s becoming increasingly popular. There is a belief that people change and their stance on certain issues can also change as they grow and evolve, but many don’t consider that. They’re simply punished, and everything they’ve worked for goes down the drain, just like that. It was an enlightening read. ***

title.title: UCL Semi-final 1 st Lag Day 1
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXat8SfwF6Lh9vDbBjPqtJYGoNWgeUpcH57dGazzDdDPC/1777425366252.jpg)

UCL ဆီမီးဖိုင်နယ် ပကျော့ပွဲစဉ်များ ဒီတပတ်မှာ ကစားမည် ဖြစ်၏။ ဒီနေ့ မြန်မာစံတော်ချိန် မနက် ၁ နာရီခွဲမှာ PSG vs Bayern Munchen တို့ ကစားသွားခဲ့၏။ တကယ် အကြိတ်အနယ် ရှိသည့် ပွဲကောင်း တပွဲ ဖြစ်ခဲ့၏။ ပရိတ်သတ် အကြိုက် ဖျော်ဖြေမှုပေးနိုင်သည့် ပွဲလည်း ဖြစ်ခဲ့၏။ တိုက်စစ် အားသန်သည့် အသင်းတွေ ဖြစ်တာ နှင့်အညီ အပြန်အလှန် ထိုးဖောက်မှုတွေနဲ့ ကြည့်လို့ ကောင်းလှ၏။ မင်း တိုက်စစ်ဆို ငါလည်း တိုက်စစ် ဆိုပြီး ကစားသွားခဲ့ကြ၏။ ထို့ကြောင့်လည်း အပြန်အလှန်သွင်းဂိုးတွေနဲ့ ဂိုးတွေလည်း များသွားခဲ့၏။

ဦးဆောင်ဂိုးကိုတော့ Bayern Munchen တို့ စတင် ရခဲ့ခြင်း ဖြစ်၏။ ၀-၁ ဖြင့် ပွဲကို ဦးဆောင်ထား၏။ သို့ပေမဲ့ PSG တို့က ချေပဂိုးနှင့် ဦးဆောင်ဂိုးတို့ကို တဆက်ထဲ သွင်းယူ၏။ ၂-၁ ဖြင့် PSG တို့ ပြန်ဦးဆောင်၏။ Bayern Munchen တို့ ချေပဂိုး ပြန်သွင်း၏။ ၂-၂ သရေ ဖြစ်သွား၏။ ပထမပိုင်း ၄၅+၅ မိနစ်မှာတော့ PSG တို့ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုး သွင်း၏။ ၃-၂ ဖြင့် ပထမပိုင်း ပြီးသွားခဲ့၏။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQmxV2oiT2qnGqbvVh7gtgXmQhryMEwJaMqUVkA1KfCPw/1777425366276.jpg)


ဒုတိယပိုင်း ၅၆ နှင့် ၅၈ မိနစ်တို့မှာ PSG အသင်း ၂ ဂိုးဆက် ထပ်မံ သွင်းယူပြီး ၅-၂ ဖြင့် ပွဲကို ဦးဆောင်၏။ Bayern Munchen ကလည်း အလျော့မပေးဘဲ နောက်ကနေ ပြန်လိုက် ကစား၏။ ၆၅ နှင့် ၆၈ မိနစ်တို့မှာ Bayern Munchen တို့ ၂ ဂိုး ပြန်လည်လို့ သွင်းယူနိုင်ခဲ့၏။ သရေ ရလဒ် ဖြစ်စေဖို့ လိုအပ်နေသည့် ချေပဂိုး ၁ ဂိုးကို ထပ်မံ မသွင်းယူနိုင်သဖြင့် ၅-၄ နဲ့ ပွဲပြီးသွားခဲ့၏။ ဂိုးများပေမဲ့ ဂိုးမပြတ်သွားသဖြင့် ဒုတိယကျော့ Bayern Munchen အိမ်ကွင်းမှာ ကစားမယ့်ပွဲစဉ်က ထပ်ပြီး ကြည့်ကောင်းမယ့် ပွဲစဉ်ဖြစ်မှာ အသေအချာပင်။

နက်ဖြန် မနက် ၁ နာရီခွဲမှာတော့ Atletico Madrid vs Arsenal တို့၏ ဆီမီးဖိုင်နယ် ပကျော့ ပွဲစဉ် ကစားမည် ဖြစ်၏။ ဒီပွဲစဉ်ကတော့ ရှေ့ပွဲစဉ်နဲ့ တူမည် မထင်ပေ။ ခံစစ်အသားပေး ကစားဟန် Atletico Madrid ကြောင့် ဒီပွဲက ပျင်းဖို့ကောင်းလိမ့်မယ်ဟု အများစုက ထင်ကြေးပေးထားကြ၏။ အသင်းတိုင်းက သူ့ အားသာချက်နဲ့ သူ၊ သူ့ ကစားဟန်နဲ့ သူ မလား။ ကိုယ့် အကြိုက် မဟုတ်တိုင်း ပွဲက ကောင်းမှာ မဟုတ်ဘူးဟု ပြောလို့ မရပေ။

ဆီမီးဖိုင်နယ် အဆင့် ပွဲစဉ်များဖြစ်သည်မို့ ကြည့်မကောင်းမှာ ပူစရာ မလိုပေ။ UCL မှာ ဒုတိယ နေရာနဲ့သာ ကျေနပ်ခဲ့ရဖူးသည့် နှစ်သင်း တွေ့ဆုံမှုက စိတ်ဝင်စားဖို့ ကောင်းမှာ အသေအချာပင်။ ပကျော့မှာ အိမ်ရှင် Atletico Madrid ကပဲ အသာရသွားမလား ဒါမှမဟုတ် ဧည့်သည် Arsenal က အကောင်းဆုံး တုန့်ပြန် ကစားပြီး လိုချင်တဲ့ ရလဒ်ကို အရယူသွားနိုင်မလားကတော့ မကြာမီ သိရတော့မည် ဖြစ်၏။ 

_(photos from UCL page)_

title.title: American Pie (1999) Captured A Generation At Exactly The Right Time. It Turned A Simple Premise Into One Of The Most Iconic Comedies Of The Nineties.
title.body:
Released in 1999 and directed by Paul Weitz, American Pie arrived right as teen comedies were starting to find their voice again. What made this film stand out was how it balanced outrageous humor with a surprisingly honest look at adolescence. It pushed boundaries, but it also understood the awkward reality of growing up.

![IMG_0816.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVukK7WBKb8mGWjPWjsVJqnLyFMT1c9Qg1ixjDenaix9K/IMG_0816.webp)

The plot centers around a group of high school friends who make a pact to lose their virginity before graduation. It is a premise that could have easily become one dimensional, but the film expands it into a series of interconnected stories that explore insecurity, pressure, and friendship.

Jason Biggs leads the film as Jim, delivering a performance that is equal parts awkward and endearing. Jim’s misadventures drive some of the most memorable scenes in the movie, and Biggs commits fully to the character without holding anything back.

Chris Klein plays Oz, the athlete who begins to discover there is more to life than popularity. Thomas Ian Nicholas as Kevin struggles with expectations in his relationship, while Eddie Kaye Thomas as Finch adds a different kind of confidence and unpredictability to the group.

Then there is Seann William Scott as Stifler, who quickly became one of the most iconic characters in the film. Scott’s performance is loud, outrageous, and completely over the top, but it works perfectly within the tone of the movie. Stifler represents the reckless energy that pushes everything forward.

The supporting cast is just as strong. Alyson Hannigan as Michelle brings one of the film’s funniest and most unexpected arcs. Shannon Elizabeth, Tara Reid, Mena Suvari, and Natasha Lyonne all add personality and depth to their roles, helping round out the story.

Paul Weitz directs the film with a clear understanding of its audience. He leans into the humor but never loses sight of the characters. That balance is what keeps the film from becoming just a collection of shock jokes.

What makes American Pie work so well is its honesty beneath the comedy. The characters are not cool or confident most of the time. They are awkward, unsure, and trying to figure things out. That relatability is what connects with audiences.

Of course, the film is also known for its outrageous moments, many of which have become part of pop culture history. These scenes are bold and sometimes ridiculous, but they are delivered with a sense of timing that makes them land.

At its core, the movie is about friendship. The bond between the main group gives the story its heart. No matter how chaotic things get, that connection keeps everything grounded.

The film also captures a very specific moment in time. Late nineties culture, music, and attitudes are all woven into the background, giving it a strong sense of identity. It feels like a snapshot of that era.

Over the years, American Pie has remained a defining entry in the teen comedy genre. It influenced a wave of similar films, but few managed to replicate its balance of humor and sincerity.

Some critics focused on the film’s more outrageous elements, but that misses the bigger picture. The movie succeeds because it understands its characters and treats their experiences as more than just punchlines.

![IMG_0817.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXWAhMUoZL3fMKrBo5h44sXuDUiXA1mfs1GM5uciji4cm/IMG_0817.webp)

In the end, American Pie is an excellent film because it delivers exactly what it promises while also offering something more. It is funny, memorable, and surprisingly genuine.

More than two decades later, it still holds its place as one of the most recognizable and influential comedies of its time.

title.title: Encuentro de Talentos: \
•||•  Lecciones de vida que solo una buena travesura te puede enseñar 🌟💫🤍
title.body:
> Hola, amigos de **Hive** espero se encuentren muy bien. El día de hoy nos tocó el tema de la semana: **Encuentro de Talentos: Travesuras**, en donde vamos a explorar un tema variado que nos haga sentir diferente, es por eso que este tema es muy bueno, espero les guste. Bienvenidos sean todos a mi blog en esta oportunidad. Quiero hablarle sobre la travesura, aquella le de niños realizamos juntos nuestros hermanos, o quizás también en solo, Pero que de alguna u otra forma nos hacen recordar buenos momentos ya que hacer niño Completomente inocente no sabemos a veces lo que hacemos es por eso que en esta oportunidad les quiero comentar acerca de algunas travesuras que para mí fueron las más inocentes de mi vida. Alguna de las travesuras que hice de niña fue exactamente cuando tenía 10 años, y estábamos en plena revolución del grupo salserín, es por eso que un día mi abuela tenía guardado un afiche tipo postal de esos que venían dentro del periódico de este famoso grupo, mi abuela no sé lo quería dar a nadie, porque realmente consideraba que no tenía favoritas entre mus primas y yo, pero lo quería a cualquier precio, es por eso que mientras dormía, me fui directamente y le quité la parte del periódico donde estaba la postal y me fui. Realmente siento que mi abuela mientras estuvo viva no supo nunca quién fue la que le quitó aquella postal, y siento que esto es una de mis travesuras más grandes que hice de niña. Otra de mis pequeñas travesuras la hice cuando tenía exactamente 13 años de edad, y no sé si realmente fue una travesura o una irresponsabilidad de mi parte, pero en aquel tiempo estaba muy de moda llevar un piercing en el ombligo, y yo lo quería tener, pero lamentablemente a mis padres nunca le gustaron esta idea ya que lo veían un poco anticuado, además tenía una percepción muy diferente de lo que hoy en día tenemos nosotras las madres actuales. Así que esta travesura comenzó una tarde cuando yo misma me perforé ese ombligo con aguja y un pequeño arete, recuerdo que cuando mis padres se dieron cuenta me querían desaparecer, porque a ellos realmente nunca le gustó esta idea. El tiempo pasó y me lo tuve que quitar, pero no fue hasta los 16 años cuando recurrí a un especialista en este tipo de perforaciones y lo realicé nuevamente, aunque sinceramente tampoco le gustó en ese tiempo esta idea loca, pero aún en la actualidad mantengo ese orificio, y considero que ya esa moda pasó y a mi edad ya no es tan bonito verlo. Una travesura que pasó de tiempo en tiempo, y que aún en la fecha mantengo esa marca, pero un poco más allá de los estereotipos, siento que esto en gran parte muchas veces lo que mas se niega, se vuelve tentador. En conclusión, siento que las travesuras sean pequeñas o grandes forman parte de nuestra vida, y nuestro recuerdo, es por eso que cuando las oigo o las recuerdo, siempre me río ya que es una época que no va volver jamás. Entre tantas travesuras, estas son las más recordadas en este momento. Espero que les haya gustado y nos vemos una próxima publicación.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/23tvY7nHkcGMWLiCwA5e11pEYTcMhkv6gzj2dW5426zxHXWWAUp3odgvvo4QSKm7Xz97u.png)

title.title: MAKING HOMESTEADING SUSTAINABLE
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcEXyutAa5G5EwNLRYiqMnawy6K2pBsLcQMADjsgxZnbm/1777423567286.jpg)

#### The very concept of ‘sustainability’ in homesteading has long been both a means of keeping people off of the land and, for those who are already on it, keeping them striving and straining (rather than thriving and evolving). As @vincentnijman and I are not following either of these methods, and as we believe fully in Flow, Living In Gift, and in the meek inheriting the earth, we have entirely alternative treasure coming to us from the land and our mission is to make these riches available to the wider world community.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVwrm7TFt8ebqgufNNsM1ySrDJA1byUuWfAWsQCKHnNKf/1777423594464.jpg)

**Just because we are not earning any money right now from our Art., nor an adequate level of nourishment purely from our land, nor having a weatherproof shelter over our heads, nor the resources to do any repairs or to install the basic amenities that most of modern society takes for granted – DOES NOT MEAN that we are in any way blocked from moving our vision and purpose forward. Even if we cannot see it ourselves on certain days!**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNyg1AzPMZwc7JEA7fW227WywDgk7vwQj8UcVV7QyzHcf/1777423654178.jpg)
*incidentally, we are more than self-sufficient in sambuca/ elderflower!*

Our tension around not earning currently has certainly felt super challenging, but our fears pale into insignificance when we immerse ourselves in the true reason that we are NOT in the mainstream, not on the treadmill of income and expenditure, and not resting back into the conventional comforts of a more sterile life. It takes a while to gain perspective; emotions are natural within the container of any massive change like we are making, and they need a place to go. This is not the kind of landscape in which we can be calm and collected about everything that is transpiring around us: this is the most dynamic of lifestyles and the most potent phase of our steep-issimo learning curve.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ1VjnTPURyMB7mVCHFrvVgwEQureHk4xa49eEAZAt3tY/1777423779526.jpg)

In my [Blessings Of Liberti discourse with The New Earth Sovereignty Academy](https://academy.newearthhorizon.com/) we had a suggested exercise based on “the 21 Universal Laws” to explore one of the listed, to feel into how it can help us navigate what we are currently faced with. I chose Universal Law # 12: The Law Of Initiation – **\

** - I've spent some time shifting the fears that I’ve been holding around ***the extreme unknown*** of our vision manifesting in our #sovereignhomestead.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdZdN1idzaTN2cydQgumTxbGrHQke8oW7gr4mZqk7KzhD/1777424176295.jpg)

Fear can be truly blinding, and our shared fear has risen up multiple times in our first year and a half together, which is quite a combination to contend with! Two divine cocreators projecting from their tensions interwoven in yinyang unity… A rather solid catastrophised vision can appear! But we can now see this is simply part of the necessary ‘detoxing’ of our conditioning: in a twinflame relationship we can move through such seeming ‘ruts’ fairly rapidly; even if they seem really **real**, they are fleeting in the bigger scheme of things. Sometimes it takes a serious potential failure, to shake us into our strengths – into our manifesting power. Recognising what we are creating, and what we can better create.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmczaFYvKg6tHk8Cb4k7wwvjyxkPh7YHzN5gTMpXFQtfkt/1777424403604.jpg)

We realised this week that we can’t ultimately do much with our property, without any funds. And the only large funding possibility we have immediately, is the (potential) sale of the beautiful Arthouse - but until that happens, we need to look at other funding realms, not just to keep us alive and functioning, but to actually manifest (the appropriate foundations of) the full vision.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXsyUXNqYb7nRaNN9FQxn3ekPqEVqhES5sbvxiEwS5cuT/1777424447860.jpg)

Having confidence in our vision has been a wee bit difficult, amongst all the chaos, the dynamic situation on the land, and our having to juggle without the everyday basics. We have revelled in the chaos to some degree, but now being almost a year into our homesteading adventure, we are required to shift gear. The initiation phase is slowing, and we recognise our need to create structure, sense, plans: to reel in our vision, and to communicate with the world about it, in order to gain support and more phsyical momentum (rather than floaty, dreamy 'just bumbling along'!)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUkqHBn22W5gQozCqhYV9NZ6j3f7AiKUBFYsfQiWdCu2d/1777424514221.jpg)

So our plans are beginning to by typed, sketched, outlined. We are considering a form of appropriate ‘crowd funding’, or borrowing against the sale of the house if we can find friends or family to help us bridge this particular time, whilst we begin creating a more tangible list of benefits and treasures that we can share with our inner circle – in the short, medium and long-terms.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbs2c5QpSk171WEetPzCPw4tQsBuWZzPs9pMwViH8Ux9C/1777424603705.jpg)

The difficulty that Vincent and I have had in our lives in earning a steady income are very similar: our livingness, intelligence, absolute authenticity and our aversion to compromise. All have led us here, to our sovereign relationship with land and elements, to our quirky rapport with commerce, and to our increasing commitment to A New Earth: conventional systems rejecting our Gifts has been distracting and disempowering for a long time….. *Until it isn’t any more*.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme7Z8rUBaHUJeVairHat6tVaa1695q2kkMYzGKyCyTaC6/1777424673337.jpg)

#### Treating the Initiation Period as a phase rather than an identity has been a vital transitioning step. It is easy to take rejection personally, or to feel like a victim; in fact, all the evidence points us to a nice, comfy spot in the hierarchy, if we’re willing to embrace the ‘starving artist’ paradigm, and to position ourselves at the bottom of the provided pyramid, to receive the crumbs from above. I think too, that the availability of prescribed or offered structures to contain our identity is hugely tempting. It is *so much easier* to take anything that is already there, than to make something from nothing, on a tabula rasa.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSEg9NDtXUgD6Qb5D5p7iUCu5PTzEJpDf946bNXz9YfV1/1777424715234.jpg)

### Yes, there are plenty of funds, prizes and rewards/ attention and applause/ benefits and privileges for us, if we’re willing to dumb our vision down: to package it and brand it, label and sell it, under taxation and restrictions and being led by market forces and clicks, algorithms, AI and a terrible agenda. We are not that, and what we are sharing defies a box or a logo. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ92SEyVB869x5dvGLQsHMEzUpKxXgGMmKZpySgwoGGJ8/1777424779684.jpg)

We are glad about that, and yet it is absolutely exhilarating and nerve-racking at the same time, to fully confess a Vision that we are called to. I've presented Vision after Vision in my life, had them rejected initially, made good of them, but then have had my vital forces completely drained by the ways in which folks have picked up my Vision and squashed it into a box (where there's no room for me to continue my work). We know that we have specific energy, wisdom and solutions to share, and they are HOLISTIC, IMMERSIVE and ACTUALLY SUSTAINABLE. Our vision is aligned with spiritual health and with regeneration of landscape and elemental interrelations.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdY3MN8katPmaC3URvYXtq4y6Jhu22APCzsj5arLXspmG/1777424875540.jpg)

As we've blogged about this past year, a lot of our initial work on the land (this first year) is simply watching it doing exactly what it is naturally doing. And acting ONLY from a deep knowing that we are guardians and not ‘owners’ (even if we do ‘own’ the land on paper). Our job is to work with and not against, in the most symbiotic and mind-full way that we possibly can. E basta. In the knowing that the land needs this of us, and that we can be an example of how to transition to harmonious natural ways, without compromising our creativity, our playfulness nor our unique expression. We have decades of immersive experience in cocreating purely and spontaneously, listening to our calling, and honing our focus to be rightly-aligned with the vastly-alternative reality that is coming.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmefB32ufDNTwih1H2SKgrjJ5XDD22ea1a7RVBLPMZE8qQ/1777424979079.jpg)

Keep connected with @vincentnijman and I via Hive, Patreon, Nostr and the New Earth Commons – we look very much forward to sharing more about our journey with you all!

# With LOVE!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPNBCoL2kPM2gMDgGg42b7yTPQqYyEhVzW8xn7uV7d3cq/1777269272977.jpg)

![fTwX4bQ0EqnBinaj_IMG_20260425_114611.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/snowli/images/fTwX4bQ0EqnBinaj_IMG_20260425_114611/fTwX4bQ0EqnBinaj_IMG_20260425_114611.webp)
![zVhlm2DCIBfHPkAx_Screenshot_20260425_102826.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/snowli/images/zVhlm2DCIBfHPkAx_Screenshot_20260425_102826/zVhlm2DCIBfHPkAx_Screenshot_20260425_102826.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

做糖耐量检测的那天上午，要从早上开始抽血一直到中午，空腹抽完第一次血之后喝三百毫升糖水，从喝第一口开始计时之后每隔一个小时要抽一次血共抽四次。

还记得以前在学校做入学体检，也是要空腹，刚排队抽完血我就头晕眼花看不清路，颤颤巍巍走到食堂门口看不清人了，赶紧在饭桌坐下，然后一直冒冷汗，休息了一会才缓过来，立马去食堂窗口买了几个包子吃。

自那以后我就发现我对抽血有恐惧，会条件反射，就像我晕车一样，一说要坐车我就开始不舒服了，还没上车感觉就晕了，所以一说要抽血我也是感觉早上出门的时候感觉没吃早餐没力气。

要是平时的话，忙起来到九点还没吃也没啥，或者在家睡懒觉直接睡到中午也没事。这次抽血要抽四次，听着就害怕。他们都是觉得糖水难喝，想吐，而我是担心晕血。

去到之后抽了第一次，感觉还好，不是太痛，喝糖水也不是太难喝，因为空腹抽血，平时早上我都要喝水的，只是现在喝的是糖水，上面的没啥感觉，甜度我可以接受，喝到最后几口，真的感觉齁甜，因为可能还剩一点没融化。但是我还是按时喝完了，没有吐也没有反胃，就是感觉太甜了。

后面还有三次抽血，我就玩了一会手机，后面想起回家的票还没买，就研究起了五一回家的票，看了一圈，4.30晚上也没有票了，5.1也没有了，只能买5.2的。看好时间之后又研究在哪里买有优惠。在同程看了又去12306看，最后在高铁管家下的单。为此还下载了一个高铁管家app。

就这样一来二去对比价格，选回家的票，又选从家里到南宁的票，最后这三次抽血的三个小时就在选票中度过了。我本以为我会中途晕血或者低血糖。因为没吃早饭又到了午饭时间才抽完血，结果我很坚强没有晕。也没有任何低血糖症状。

最后一次抽血，因为我前面已经抽了三次了，手肘和左手手腕边缘都抽过了，右手手肘也抽了，但是那里有一根血管比较显眼，工作人员还想从这里抽，结果这个血管可能比较浅又比较滑，进针之后没有回血，然后她又左右挑了几次都没有找到，然后最后只好选择在右手腕部边边那里抽，就这样抽完了四次血液标本，我终于可以吃东西了。

最后一次抽血第一针没扎中，来回挑了几次我都没有觉得痛，好像一点感觉都没有，不懂是不是因为那里没有痛觉神经，真的一点也不痛。🤣

所以说，勇敢狗狗，不怕抽血，但是如果还有下次，我希望不用再做这个糖耐量试验了。🙈

---
