title.title: Escuela en casa
title.body:
> Saludos queridas madres y padres de Hive, les cuento que estas últimas semanas hemos tenido que recurrir de nuevo a las actividades académicas desde casa, pues en la escuela donde estudiando mi hijo y sobrino las actividades han sido suspendidas hasta nuevo aviso por problemas con un enjambre de avispas, tal motivo parecería menor pero no lo es, pues esta escuela es muy antigua y en su estructura se ha mantenido por años la presencia de estos animales y aunque cada cierto tiempo van los bomberos y las aumentas ellas simplemente cambian de lugar dentro de la misma edificación pues ese ha sido su hogar desde hace décadas.
Cada cierto tiempo las avispas se alborotan y vuelve a suceder lo mismo, van los bomberos y al poco tiempo vuelven otra vez, sin embargo, en esta ocasión el problema se ha intensificado e incluso trabajadores de la institución han sido picados por las avispas, por lo que están suspendidas las actividades hasta que no se una solución mas efectiva al problema por parte gubernamental, pues la edificación es tan antigua que forma parte del patrimonio arquitectónico de la ciudad, así que no se pueden hacer intervenciones en la estructura sin los permisos debidos.
Por otro lado, agradezco infinitamente a mi hermana quien se ha puesto con mi hijo y sobrino a asistirle en sus actividades académicas porque yo he estado muy ocupada estos días con mi trabajo, ellos prácticamente han hecho una escuela en casa y eso también tiene motivado a mi niño, quien de ha visto también un poco aburrido por no poder ir a la escuela, de verdad espero pronto se solucione el problema y no tengamos que finalizar el año escolar con esta modalidad a distancia.

This might seem like a minor issue, but it's not. The school is very old, and these insects have been present in its structure for years. Although the fire department visits periodically and the wasps are removed, they simply move to a different location within the building, as it has been their home for decades.
Every so often, the wasps become agitated, and the same thing happens again. The firefighters come, and soon after, they return. However, this time the problem has intensified, and even employees of the institution have been stung by the wasps. Therefore, activities are suspended until a more effective solution is found by the government. The building is so old that it is part of the city's architectural heritage, so no work can be done on the structure without the proper permits.
On the other hand, I am incredibly grateful to my sister, who has been helping my son and nephew with their schoolwork because I have been very busy with work these days. They have practically created a homeschool, and that has also motivated my son, who has been a little bored from not being able to go to school. I truly hope the problem is resolved soon and that we don't have to finish the school year with this distance learning format.

title.title: DALTHIN IRONHOOD card.
title.body:
Congratulations on buying the DALTHIN IRONHOOD card. This card is a Dwarf Tank or Frontline Warrior. It is really good for defense protecting your team and staying on the field for a time.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdfc2oTMcBB53RsVxMBGnt6opgEQABZCgrnbP3yzF2Fdz/1777424662423.jpg)

The image shows that the card costs 7 Mana has an Attack of 3 Armor of 5 Health of 6 Speed of 4 and is based on the Fire Element. These stats show that it is not meant for attacking. For being strong and strategic.

Here are the benefits and analysis of the DALTHIN IRONHOOD card:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPiwAwsSDMxHnTh5uU5GDooS1CzdxwBvqhxvZr6kfcA19/1777424662493.jpg)

* **Strong Defense**: The cards Armor 5 and Health 6 mean it has a level of defense. Many cards have attack power but weak defense. DALTHIN IRONHOOD is different.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbv2yvu1iovTURzpGFe2jdQR131poJuc48A9vBPwRjiuU/1777424662558.png)

* Having Armor 5 means the enemys first few physical attacks will not directly reduce Health. This gives you time to strategize and attack with other Damage Dealer cards.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSL7Mq33HVS4PLRyMarvpLiyVFeyTAN9vaeg3sYpEifiN/1777424662671.png)

The DALTHIN IRONHOOD card is ideal for the line. If you place it in the position most of the enemys attacks will fall on this card. As a result your Mage, Archer or Assassin type cards in the line will be able to attack safely. This advantage can change the outcome of matches.

* **Long-term survivability**: With Health 6 and Armor 5 this card is not easily knocked out. Times the entire team collapses due to the Tank card dying quickly.. Dalthin IRONHOOD reduces that risk.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRALmRdoUkPxNNs1FcYbyBnTEPtWLNHbPvwkuBdpHscwX/1777424662625.png)

* The it survives, the longer your Damage Dealer cards can attack. So it indirectly increases the chances of the entire team winning.

DALTHIN IRONHOOD is especially effective in Fire Element teams. Since it is a Fire Element card it can work well in a Fire Summoner or Fire Buff-based team. If Summoner Attack Boost is given its Attack 3 will increase further. If you get Speed Buff again you will have the opportunity to hit before the enemy.

* **Medium Attack Power**: Attack 3 is not very high. It is good enough as a Tank card. Because the job of a Tank card is not to attack but also to stand in front of the enemy and withstand the enemys attacks.

* This card can also deal damage in addition to that job. As a result it is not a shield but also acts as a weapon if necessary.

The card has balanced Speed. Since it is Speed 4 it is neither too slow nor too fast. Many Tank cards are very slow so they attack later.. Dalthin IRONHOOD can work relatively quickly. This increases the Miss chance meaning there is also a possibility of avoiding some enemy attacks.

* ** in strategic matches**: In matches where Mana is high this card is very valuable. Because even though it has a 7 Mana Cost, its defense and durability make it worth the cost.

* It may not always be usable in Low Mana matches. Its great in Medium or High Mana matches.

There are three ability icons below the card. Usually these indicate special abilities, such as Shield, Taunt, Protection, Retaliate or Team Support type skills. If there is Shield it will reduce the damage of Melee/Ranged attacks. If there is Taunt it will pull all attacks towards itself. If there is Protection, the entire team can gain Armor.

* **Useful for players**: New players often don't realize how important the Frontline card is. DALTHIN IRONHOOD is a effective card that will teach newbies how to use Tank.

* By buying it you don't just buy a card. Also open a door to strategic play.

DALTHIN IRONHOOD is also useful for players. High-level players know that Attack Power alone cannot win. Sometimes a strong Defender can turn the match around. DALTHIN IRONHOOD is a card that can be an MVP in the situation.

* **Powerful in combo use**: This card becomes more dangerous when used with a Heal card. If there is a Healer behind Health will be restored even after Armor is broken. As a result it will be difficult for the enemy to take it down.

The card has an advantage in Arena and Ranked matches. In matches where every win is important you need a stable and reliable card. DALTHIN IRONHOOD is a card that can give you consistency.

* **Future upgrade potential**: Level 6 is visible meaning it is an advanced level card. If you can level up more in the future, Attack, Health or Ability can increase more.

* So it is an investment not only for the present but also for the future.

The card creates stress. Sometimes when the enemy sees an Armor + Health tank in front they are forced to change tactics. With this card on the field the opponent knows that the Frontline cannot be easily broken. As a result you also get an advantage.

* **Why is it a purchase decision**: If you want a card that lasts a long time protects the team deals moderate damage fits for Fire teams is effective in ranked matches and is upgradeable in the future then buying DALTHIN IRONHOOD is a smart decision.

DALTHIN IRONHOOD is not a card; it is a Battlefield Guardian. Its real strength is to stand in front and protect the team absorb enemy damage and bring an advantage in fights. This card is very useful, for players and those who want to build a balanced team.

If you use it with Summoner Healer Damage Dealer cards it will greatly increase your teams chances winning. Therefore it can said that purchasing this card is an far-sighted decision.

# <center>**César actuaización**</center>

***

<div class=\

>

¿Te acuerdas de ese pequeño niño que hacía que mi mundo se volviera un caos por no entenderlo?

Ya tiene 11 años, un cuasi pre adolescente, un niño más maduro, comprensivo y una personalidad hermosa. El humor negro activo siempre como su mamá.

Este jovencito, luego de ser un reto para mí, ya es un compañero de vida tranquilo y que me sabe manejar muy bien.

Le agradezco todos los días por su comprensión y paciencia para sobrellevar situaciones que solo nosotros sabemos que pasan.

No tengo palabras para expresar mi amor por él y todos esas emociones que hace que nazcan de adentro de mí siendo una persona que no demuestra sus sentimientos por nada del mundo.


Cada día él evoluciona sin tener que presionar ni guiar tan seguido, ya yo quiero que vaya aprendiendo cosas de su edad, como por ejemplo, responsabilidades en el hogar.

Lo que he hecho es que lo pongo a él mismo a hacer las actividades, incluso que estudie solo. Así él va soltando sus habilidades y se sepa defender.

Él mismo ya se sabe preparar un sánduche y calentarlo en la cocina, dado que tiene permiso de prender una sola hornilla que es de baja llama y tiene encendedor automático.

Actualmente barre su cuarto, lava platos sucios y ayuda a cualquier actividad que sea fácil y rápida ya que si es una actividad de mucho rato se distrae y no termina de hacer lo que se le manda.

Hay días que no quiere hacer las actividades que se le pongan, incluso escolares, pero a quién no le pasa ...

Yo a veces me reflejo mucho en él y me pongo en sus zapatos, ya que hay padres que sienten que para educar a sus hijos es con obligaciones, porque la disciplina es así, y quizás tienen razón, solo que yo no lo obligo, más bien converso con él y le explico el por qué debe hacerlo, así él entiende qué es ser responsable, el por qué se le está dando la orden y lo hace con más motivación.

César es de los niños que te responden con un \

.

Eso pasa es cuando lo reto, que también pasa, no todo es color de rosa, también peleo con él ya que todos tenemos emociones negativas o queremos imponernos. Es contradictorio, solo que eso no pasa tan seguido.

Su carácter es muy dócil pero cuando quiere dar su punto de vista, es bastante serio y hasta que no lo escuche, no deja de exigir ser escuchado.

Lo bueno es que tenemos una relación muy abierta y ambos sabemos que lo mejor de tener una relación sana es ser comunicativo uno con el otro.

Saber expresar lo que nos molesta o nos alegra, es algo que hemos estado trabajando desde hace un tiempo y nos ha ido muy bien.

Cómo mamá de un jovencito con autismo, me ha hecho crecer como mamá, persona y más, que no siempre vamos a tener los mismos comportamientos que teníamos y que cada día en un constante cambio y evolución.

Pensaba que íbamos a tener cambios hormonales, además de los olores, con mucho más intensidad, espero sigamos así y con el respeto presente siempre, seamos mejor de lo que somos hoy día.



 

***


# <center>English <a id=\

> *** #
**César update**
*** Do you remember that little boy who made my world turn into chaos because he didn't understand it? He is already 11 years old, a quasi-preteen, a more mature, understanding child and a beautiful personality. Black humor always active like his mother. This young man, after being a challenge for me, is now a calm life partner who knows how to handle me very well. I thank you every day for your understanding and patience in dealing with situations that only we know happen. I have no words to express my love for him and all those emotions that he causes to be born from within me being a person who does not show his feelings for anything in the world. Every day he evolves without having to pressure or guide so often, and I want him to learn things of his age, such as responsibilities at home. What I have done is that I make him do the activities himself, even having him study alone. This way he unleashes his skills and knows how to defend himself. He himself already knows how to prepare a sandwich and heat it in the kitchen, given that he has permission to turn on a single burner that has a low flame and has an automatic igniter. Currently he sweeps his room, washes dirty dishes and helps with any activity that is easy and quick since if it is an activity that lasts a long time he gets distracted and does not finish doing what he is told. There are days when you don't want to do the activities that are assigned to you, even school ones, but who doesn't happen to that... Sometimes I reflect a lot on him and put myself in his shoes, since there are parents who feel that educating their children requires obligations, because discipline is like that, and maybe they are right, except that I don't force him, rather I talk to him and explain to him why he should do it, so he understands what it means to be responsible, why he is being given the order and he does it with more motivation. César is one of those children who responds with \

That happens when I challenge him, which also happens, not everything is rosy, I also fight with him since we all have negative emotions or want to impose ourselves. It's contradictory, it just doesn't happen that often. His character is very docile but when he wants to give his point of view, he is quite serious and until he is heard, he does not stop demanding to be heard. The good thing is that we have a very open relationship and we both know that the best thing about having a healthy relationship is being communicative with each other. Knowing how to express what bothers us or makes us happy is something we have been working on for a while and it has gone very well. As a mother of a young boy with autism, it has made me grow as a mother, a person and more, that we are not always going to have the same behaviors that we had and that every day in a constant change and evolution. I thought we were going to have hormonal changes, in addition to the smells, with much more intensity, I hope we continue like this and with respect always present, we become better than we are today *** # **Soy Ana Fuentes**💛💛 *** >-Fotos Redmi Note 9S >-Canva

title.body:
>

Pangolins, also called scaly anteaters, are mammals that have large, protective keratin scales, covering their skin. Depending on the species, they live in hollow trees or burrows. I had no idea that Pangolins are nocturnal, and their diet consists of mainly ants and termites, which they capture using their long tongues. The tongues can stretch longer than their own bodies.

**These nocturnal, insectivorous mammals play a vital ecological role by regulating termite and ant populations and helping maintain healthy soils and forests.** <sup>2</sup>

They tend to be solitary animals, meeting only to mate and produce a litter of one to three offspring, which they raise for about two years.

The name \

. 

I was surprised by the physical appearance of a Pangolin because it resembles the animal I know best -- the Armadillo. The Pangolin is marked by large, hardened, overlapping, plate-like scales, which are soft on newborn pangolins. However, as the animal matures, its scales harden. The scales are made of keratin, the same material from which human fingernails and tetrapod claws are made, and are structurally and compositionally very different from the scales of reptiles. 

The Pangolin's scaled body is comparable in appearance to a pine cone. It can curl up into a ball, similar to the armadillo, when threatened, with its overlapping scales acting as armor, while it protects its face by tucking it under its tail. The scales are sharp, providing extra defense from predators.

Pangolins are threatened the most by human intervention. The most danger comes from poaching for their meat and scales, which are used in traditional medicine. Also, heavy deforestation of their natural habitats have reduced the species number significantly. 

Listed as the most trafficked mammals in the world, as of January 2020, there were eight species whose conservation status was listed in the threatened tier.<sup>1</sup>

*Key drivers of their decline include:*
- relentless poaching for their scales, used in traditional medicine-particularly in parts of Asia;
- demand for bushmeat and luxury cuisine, especially in certain African and Southeast Asian markets;
- habitat destruction due to deforestation and agricultural expansion;
- Weak enforcement of international and national laws aimed at protecting them.

It is reported that between 2016 to 2024, seizures of Pangolin products involved more than an estimated half a million Pangolins across 75 countries and 178 trade routes. Pangolin scales accounted for 99% of confiscated parts. 

Even with heightened awareness and diligent efforts to curb the trafficking across continents, information campaigns, and international trade bans, enforcement agencies warm that seizures represent only a small fraction of the actual volume in circulation, with countless shipments going undetected.<sup>2</sup>

body.title: The Rapture Doctrine Examined
body.body:
https://youtu.be/w-U6Pv7ZvnE?si=jL5EQU14BW5DqYnI

The modern doctrine of a pre-tribulation rapture is widely taught as a central component of end-times theology.

It is often presented as a clear biblical teaching—that believers will be removed from the earth prior to a period of tribulation.

But when we step away from inherited assumptions and examine the actual texts in context, a different picture begins to emerge.

This study does not argue from tradition or denomination.

It asks a single question:

👉 Does the rapture doctrine come from the text itself…
or from how the text is commonly interpreted?


---

🔎 Method

Each passage will be examined using:

Immediate literary context

Parallel passages

Greek word usage

Internal consistency across Scripture


No assumptions. Just the text.


---

⚖️ 1. Matthew 24:40–41 — “One Taken, One Left”

> “Then two men will be in the field; one will be taken and one left.”



This is one of the most commonly cited “rapture” passages.

The assumption: 👉 “Taken” = rescued
👉 “Left” = judged

But the context says the opposite.


---

📖 Context: Days of Noah

> “The flood came and took them all away…”
— Matthew 24:39



In the immediate context:

The ones “taken” are those taken in judgment by the flood

The ones “left” are those who remain


This pattern is consistent: 👉 Judgment removes
👉 The righteous remain

There is no rapture in this passage—only a warning of sudden judgment.


---

⚖️ 2. 1 Thessalonians 4:16–17 — “Caught Up”

> “…we who are alive… will be caught up… to meet the Lord in the air…”



This is the central rapture text.

But the interpretation depends entirely on one assumption: 👉 That “caught up” means leaving earth permanently.

Let’s examine the Greek.


---

📘 Greek Term: ἁρπάζω (harpazō)

Meaning:

to seize

to take suddenly


It does not define direction or destination.


---

📘 Greek Term: ἀπάντησις (apantēsis)

This word is critical.

Used in:

Matthew 25:6 (meeting the bridegroom)

Acts 28:15 (meeting Paul)


In both cases: 👉 People go out to meet someone… and then escort them back

This was a technical term for welcoming a dignitary.


---

📌 Conclusion

The passage describes: 👉 Believers rising to meet the returning King
👉 And accompanying Him as He continues His descent

Not leaving the earth permanently.


---

⚖️ 3. 2 Thessalonians 2:1–3 — Timing of the Gathering

> “…concerning the coming of our Lord… and our gathering together to Him…”



Paul directly addresses the timing of the gathering.


---

📖 Key Statement

> “That day will not come unless the falling away comes first, and the man of sin is revealed…”



This creates a problem for pre-tribulation rapture theology.


---

📌 Implication

The gathering:

does not happen first

occurs after identifiable events


Paul is explicitly correcting the idea that the gathering is imminent.


---

⚖️ 4. Revelation 3:10 — “Kept From the Hour”

> “I will keep you from the hour of trial…”



This verse is often used to argue for removal from the earth.


---

📘 Greek Phrase: τηρέω ἐκ (tēreō ek)

Meaning:

to keep

to preserve out of


Not necessarily to remove.


---

📖 Parallel Usage

> “I do not ask that you take them out of the world, but that you keep them from the evil one.”
— John 17:15



Same structure:

kept from

but not removed



---

📌 Conclusion

Revelation 3:10 speaks of: 👉 protection within
👉 not removal from the earth


---

⚖️ 5. John 14:2–3 — “I Will Come Again”

> “I will come again and receive you to Myself…”



Often interpreted as: 👉 Jesus coming secretly to take believers away


---

📖 But the Text Says:

“I will come again”

This aligns with:

visible return

public arrival

final gathering



---

📌 No Indication of:

❌ two separate comings
❌ secret removal
❌ pre-tribulation escape


---

⚖️ 6. Internal Consistency Across Scripture

When all passages are read together:

The Pattern Is Consistent:

Christ returns once

The dead are raised

The living are gathered

Judgment follows


There is no separate, earlier event described.


---

⚠️ 7. The Core Issue

The rapture doctrine depends on:

separating passages that are unified

redefining words outside their context

inserting a timeline that the text does not state


It is not built from a single clear passage.

It is constructed by combining interpretations.


---

📌 Conclusion

When examined using: ✔ context
✔ Greek language
✔ parallel passages
✔ internal consistency

The conclusion is clear:

👉 The rapture doctrine is not explicitly taught in Scripture
👉 It is derived from interpretation, not direct textual statement


---

💬 Final Question

If the rapture is a clear biblical teaching…

Why does it require:

redefining key terms

separating unified passages

and ignoring immediate context?


---

📣 Closing

This is not about tradition.

This is about whether the doctrine: 👉 comes from the text itself
👉 or from how the text has been read

承上回: 跟雲兄來到古堡咖啡之後, 我們沒有馬上去咖啡廳那邊, 反而是去了右手邊的古堡那邊看海. 這談間, 發現雲兄大學年代, 經常會跟他的朋友, 就是幾個男生到處去玩, 全程沒女生, 原來他挺享受這種出遊方式. 原因嘛, 不要說太白了, 懂的都懂, 男人不會糾結這糾結那, 省時省心省力啊. 

我自己的話, 當年都不是由高考直上大學, 所以第一, 我沒經歷過校園生活, 沒機會這樣約朋友出去玩, 第二, 我年輕時的朋友也不多, 現在也很少, 不過我是那種但求貴精不貴多的人. 真正的朋友, 三幾個足矣. 

所以這次跟雲兄雙人成行, 我挺感謝他的, 不是他幫我share了這次出行的使費, 而是給我一個機會體驗一下, 只有男生出行的樂趣. 嗯, 內心百感交集完之後, 繼續我們的行程, 看完海了, 看看遠處有座廟. 那就朝著那個方向去吧.

一開始, 我們先要下個小坡, 去到圖一打石澳那個石碑前, 在圖中可以見到, 其實已經離古堡那邊有點距離了, 但下坡的話還好, 不是太難走. 去到圖二, 屌囉, 要慢慢爬上去, 雖然我們可以選擇不走樓梯, 改為慢坡,但這種斜度的坡對我來說都吃力了. 加上爬坡的話, 其實要兜遠一些. 但衡量過後, 還是決定, 可以不爬樓梯就不爬樓梯了. 

沿途又經過一個海邊的打卡點, 發現好多人坐下來不知做甚麼, 又不是在拍照, 都在低頭玩手機, 大概是走到累了想休息一下吧? 我沒走幾步路已經有點累, 但是, 才剛開始, 不要太丟人了, 頂硬上吧. 

走著走著, 怎麼見到有停車格? 難度我們可以直接開車進來? 但想了一下, 不對, 入口好像就只能跟人進, 不能給車進, 也許是以前車可以進, 現在不讓進了吧? 要是能開車進來, 估計都擠滿車, 人都不用走了. 

去到海洋文化廣場, 見到有美女臭美拍照, 我也幫下你吧, 偷拍你一下. 嘿嘿, 開玩笑的, 我是想拍那個美人魚雕像而已. 去到那個得度石的時候, 我跟雲兄開始研究, 到底這個古堡的石堆是天然還是人工造出來的? 我是偏向天然的, 人工造的話, 應該要天價, 汕尾這個地方, 算不上好出名的旅遊城市, 估計市政府不願意花這個錢投資. 

之後離遠看到西遊記人物的雕像 (在最後一張圖, 但可能這裡看不清,後面回程時雲兄有拍下來, 到時再share出來吧), 其實走到這裡, 我們兩個都出好多汗了, 要命的是, 明明車上很多枝水, 我們就是忘記拿. 這個時候, 我已經不想走了, 但, 總不能掃人興, 才來了多久, 走不動, 就先停下來抖抖氣吧. 硬走下去, 分分鐘要打120叫救護車送我去醫院呢.

# ***Mientras haya una travesura pendiente, el corazón sigue joven***

Las travesuras, es verdad, mi querida amiga, pueden ser de todas las edades. Desde que uno está tan pequeño que ya sabe diferenciar lo bueno de lo malo, hasta llegar a la adultez —ya sea de adulto contemporáneo o simplemente un adulto muy mayor como un abuelo porque,  he visto a varios abuelos haciendo travesuras de esas que te dejan loco y uno se ríe, y dije no en forma despectiva es la forma de como nosotros hablamos, y repito uno piensa mira a este, después de viejo haciendo esas vainas de carajito jajajaja

Fíjate que las cosas comienzan por pura curiosidad, cuando uno es un carajito, (niño) la travesura es casi un instinto, uno mete el dedo en el enchufe o pinta la pared de la sala no por echar a perder, sino por ver qué pasa, es esa etapa de la inocencia donde el \

son apenas una idea borrosa, pero es solo en esa etapa, pero la adrenalina de que no te descubran ya se siente sabrosa.

Ahora bien también está esa travesura de la rebeldía (Juventud), el enfoque cambia hacia la identidad, muchas veces en esa etapa uno busca romper las reglas establecidas por esas figuras de autoridad, y todo es para reafirmar quién es uno,  luego cuando ya uno está más recorrido y entra en la adultez, la travesura cambia el tono, ya no es por romper un jarrón, sino por romper la rutina, ese puede ser una forma de escape creativo para no volverse uno amargado con tanto trabajo y tanta cuenta por pagar y de eso hay bastante, allí la travesura se vuelve una complicidad, un guiño con un amigo o una broma en la oficina para soltar el estrés, es como un remedio pal alma.

El tema de hoy es muy parecido a lo que me paso hoy en el trabajo, resulta que un compañero de trabajo cuando llega a las 2.30 de la tarde me dice Lanz la placa de tu carro termina en tal número, yo le dije si, y de inmediato le pregunte qué paso, él me dijo no nada todo bien, pero allí no quedo todo, cuando salí del trabajo rumbo al estacionamiento que llego justo donde estacione mi auto, resulta que no me podía montar por la puerta del piloto, pues la rata esa estaciono su carro tan pegado al mío que la puerta de lado le piloto no la podía abrir, de inmediato lo llame y la rata lo único que hacía era reír y reír, hasta que pude hablar y le dije, mira tu carro en la puerta tiene un gran golpe que se hundió la puerta creo que alguien le dio una patada, pero parece que fue con mucha rabia, allí su risa paro y le corte la llamada, claro no le di patada, pero le dije eso en forma de devolver la travesura.

Pero lo más bonito, y lo que me dejó pensando es con respecto a los abuelos, es que al final de nuestro camino y digo a si porque todos vamos para allá, las travesuras se vuelve un acto de libertad absoluta, he visto a mi abuelo, ya con sus canas bien puestas, saltándose la dieta por puro gusto solo para hacer molestar a mi abuela o escondiéndole las llaves  para verla dando vueltas, solo por el placer de soltar una carcajada,  a esa edad ya no hay nada que demostrar, solo ganas de vivir, es como si el espíritu dijera, bueno, ya crecí, ya cumplí, ahora me toca reírme.

Definitivamente, al final, esas maldades sanas son las que nos mantienen vivos, no importa si tienes 5 o 90 años, esa chispa en los ojos cuando estás tramando algo es lo que nos recuerda que, mientras haya una travesura pendiente, el corazón sigue joven.

# As long as there is a prank pending, the heart stays young
#

Pranks, it’s true, my dear friend, can belong to all ages. From when you are so small that you already know how to tell right from wrong, to reaching adulthood—whether as a contemporary adult or simply a very old adult like a grandfather because, I’ve seen several grandfathers doing the kind of pranks that leave you crazy and you just laugh. And I didn't say it in a derogatory way, it's just how we talk; I repeat, one thinks: \
hahahaha.\n\nNotice that things start out of pure curiosity; when you are a \
(a kid), pranking is almost an instinct. You stick your finger in the socket or paint the living room wall not to ruin things, but to see what happens. It's that stage of innocence where \

are just a blurry idea—but only at that stage—yet the adrenaline of not being caught already feels great.

Now, there is also that prank of rebellion (Youth); the focus shifts toward identity. Often in that stage, you look to break the rules established by authority figures, and it’s all to reaffirm who you are. Then, when you’ve been around the block and enter adulthood, the prank changes its tone. It’s no longer about breaking a vase, but about breaking the routine. That can be a form of creative escape to keep from becoming bitter with so much work, and so many bills to pay—and there are plenty of those. There, the prank becomes a moment of complicity, a wink with a friend, or an office joke to let off stress; it’s like a remedy for the soul.

Today's theme is very similar to what happened to me today at work. It turns out that a coworker, when he arrives at 2:30 in the afternoon, says to me: \
and I said yes, and immediately asked him what happened. He told me: \
But it didn’t end there. When I left work for the parking lot, and reached the exact spot where I parked my car, it turned out I couldn't get in through the driver's door, because that \
parked his car so close to mine that I couldn't open the driver's side door. I called him immediately, and all the \
did was laugh and laugh, until I could finally speak and said: \

Right then, his laughing stopped, and I hung up. Of course, I didn't kick it, but I told him that as a way to return the prank.\n\nBut the most beautiful part, and what left me thinking regarding grandfathers, is that at the end of our road—and I say it like that because we are all headed there—pranks become an act of absolute freedom. I’ve seen my grandfather, with his gray hair well in place, skipping his diet just for the fun of it to annoy my grandmother, or hiding her keys to see her spinning around, just for the pleasure of letting out a loud laugh. At that age, there’s nothing left to prove, just the desire to live. It’s as if the spirit says: \

are what keep us alive. Este día rinde homenaje no solo a los niños que luchan contra esta enfermedad, sino también a sus padres , seres queridos y a todos aquellos que los cuidan. National Brave Day was created in 2015 by ***BraveHearts For Kids***. This organization was founded in 2008 by Jeremy and Amy Jacobs after their daughter Ava was diagnosed with a medulloblastoma brain tumor when she was just over a year old. The organization provides resources, guidance, and information to families facing a childhood cancer crisis. > El Día Nacional de los Valientes fue creado en 2015 por ***BraveHearts For Kids.*** Esta organización fue fundada en 2008 por Jeremy y Amy Jacobs después de que a su hija Ava le diagnosticaran un tumor cerebral de meduloblastoma cuando tenía poco más de un año. La organización brinda recursos, orientación e información a las familias que enfrentan una crisis de cáncer infantil. - Approximately 1 in 285 children will develop cancer before the age of 20. - In the United States, approximately 47 children are diagnosed with cancer every day. - More than 95% of childhood cancer survivors will have a serious health problem by the time they reach 50. - The average cost of childhood cancer treatment in 2019 exceeded $834,000. - The average 5-year survival rate for pediatric cancers is approximately **84%**. body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g44b9ef30fa2b9d8af6a5fc5515ec7e62635853ade317d16075ac4956c47db44c4e0a60014dfd1367b03439b82a44515d576163c79f66f9e10d525aa27f514188_640.jpg)
Сегодняшняя прогулка по горам была просто великолепной! Я выбрал один из своих любимых маршрутов, который ведет через густой лес и вдоль маленького горного ручья. Погода была прекрасной, солнечно и не слишком жарко, идеальные условия для пешей прогулки. На полпути я встретил группу туристов, которые шли в обратном направлении. Они оказались новичками в походах и с радостью делились своими впечатлениями. Один из них рассказал, что недавно начал заниматься скалолазанием, и его захватили новые высоты и вызовы, которые это занятие предоставляет. Мы немного поговорили о лучших маршрутах для скалолазания в этом районе. Далее, я заметил на тропе интересное растение — это была редкая орхидея. Я никогда не видел ее в дикой природе, и это было удивительное зрелище. Напоследок, я остановился на небольшом скалистом утесе с видом на долину, и это было идеальное место для отдыха и наслаждения природой. body.title: Travesuras enmarcadas // Mischief in a Frame
body.body:
ya dibuja una sonrisa muy grande en cada uno de nosotros. ¿Por qué? Porque es díficil que alguien se sienta libre de culpa al hablar de este tema. Hasta la persona más tranquila y disciplinada en algún momento fue artífice de algo que hoy se puede recordar con mucha gracia, nostalgia y hasta melancolía. Es como abrir un libro e irnos directamente a esa sección de la cual podemos esperar hasta lo inesperado, y sé que muchos tienen esa travesura que simplemente no pueden olvidar y que ahora hasta se convierte en un tema de conversación con quienes nos rodean. Al pensar en este tema, reconozco que lo primero que vino a mi mente fue cuando siendo niño me comía la leche en polvo con azúcar a escondidas de mi madre. Todo aquello era un verdadero reto. Mi madre siempre compraba una lata de leche y la guardaba en el estante de la cocina. Por lo tanto, se requería de una buena preparación por mi parte, así que la estrategia era esperar la hora en la que mi mamá se ponía a coser. Eso sí que eran unos minutos bastante tensos para tratar de no hacer mucho ruido y poder llenar una taza de leche. Algo que me ayudaba era el ruido de la máquina de coser, ya que mientras sonaba yo podía actuar con cierta confianza. Un silencio repentino de pronto me daba cierto temor pero de una forma u otra siempre encontraba la manera para poder lograr mi cometido. >I think the word ‘mischief’ alone brings a huge smile to all our faces. Why? Because it’s hard for anyone to feel entirely free of guilt when talking about this subject. Even the calmest and most disciplined person has, at some point, been the architect of something that today can be remembered with great amusement, nostalgia and even a touch of melancholy. It’s like opening a book and going straight to that section where we can expect the unexpected, and I know that many of us have that mischievous act that we simply cannot forget and that now even becomes a topic of conversation with those around us. >When I think about this topic, I realise that the first thing that sprang to mind was when, as a child, I used to sneakily eat powdered milk with sugar behind my mother’s back. It was quite a challenge. My mother always bought a tin of milk and kept it on the kitchen shelf. So it required careful planning on my part; my strategy was to wait until Mum started sewing. Those were certainly some rather tense minutes, trying not to make too much noise whilst filling a cup with milk. Something that helped me was the sound of the sewing machine; whilst it was running, I could go about my business with a certain degree of confidence. A sudden silence would make me a bit nervous, but one way or another I always found a way to get the job done. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYCPhu1iZVpZsBDvMu5XhgqgV44hwg6zL3sXb4WKg9Y9f/dimitrisvetsikas1969-girl-5224229_640.jpg Ya con mis hermanos un poco más grandes las travesuras ya eran compartidas, un reto para mi madre quien siempre debía estar pendiente de los tres. En una ocasión junto con mi hermano recuerdo que mi mamá había cocinado sopa. Al sentarnos en la mesa mi madre dejó un limón picado a la mitad, y enseguida mi hermano le exprimió la mitad del limón a su sopa ya que según él, así comían los adultos. Obviamente al hacerlo la comida adquirió un sabor demasiado a limón, así que aplicando un razonamiento infantil decidimos echarle azúcar para recuperar el sabor. Obviamente al no lograr el objetivo le decidimos echar sal a ver qué pasaba, y lo único que logramos fue un gran castigo y regaño por parte de mi madre. Por supuesto, no podía faltar una travesura hecha en grupo, y esto fue en una ocasión donde mis amiguitos y yo quisimos hacer una especie de fiesta en el patio de la casa de uno de ellos. Recuerdo que dentro del grupo dos de mis vecinas dijeron que conseguirían un pollo para cocinarlo, algo que a todos nos causó gracia ya que eso no estaba a su alcance. Entonces me dijeron a mi que las acompañara a la casa de un familiar de ellas ya que supuestamente allí estaba lo que íbamos a buscar. ¿Cuál fue la sorpresa? Pues que la idea de ellas era robarse una gallina viva para luego mandarla a matar y preparar. La excusa era que en esa casa habían muchas gallinas y según nosotros nadie notaría la pérdida. Lo cierto es que terminamos agarrando la gallina pero nadie se atrevió a matarla así que tuvimos que regresarla de noche y metida en un saco. >By the time my brothers were a bit older, we were all getting up to mischief together – quite a challenge for my mum, who always had to keep an eye on all three of us. I remember one occasion when my brother and I were sitting down to a meal my mum had cooked. As we sat down at the table, she left a lemon cut in half on the table, and straight away my brother squeezed half of it into his soup because, as he put it, that’s how grown-ups ate. Obviously, doing so made the food taste far too lemony, so, using childish logic, we decided to add sugar to restore the flavour. Obviously, as that didn’t work, we decided to add salt to see what would happen, and the only thing we achieved was a severe telling-off and a scolding from my mother. >Of course, we couldn’t resist getting up to some mischief as a group, and this was on one occasion when my little friends and I wanted to have a sort of party in the garden of one of their houses. I remember that two of my neighbours in the group said they’d get hold of a chicken to cook, which we all found funny as that was beyond their means. So they asked me to go with them to a relative’s house, as that was supposedly where we were going to find what we were looking for. What was the surprise? Well, their plan was to steal a live hen, have it slaughtered, and then cook it. The excuse was that there were plenty of chickens at that house and, as far as we were concerned, no one would notice it was missing. The truth is that we ended up catching the chicken, but no one dared to kill it, so we had to return it at night, tucked inside a sack. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmds8dcUR67st7SSGbDwYXxL6LSEsfFKYU2LqxGFhsSweL/sunriseforever-boys-3396713_640.jpg No cabe duda de que este tema da para mucha tela que cortar, y como diría mi abuela esto da para escribir un libro o filmar una película. Al meditar en esos episodios de mi infancia, como adulto entiendo que aquello no tenía el más mínimo sentido pero en el fondo de aquel niño todo parecía ser el plan perfecto. Siendo sinceros, creo que antes de todas mis travesuras ya mi madre sabía la clase de niño que yo era, y hasta me atrevería a decir que antes de tomar la leche en polvo ya mi mamá sabía que lo haría. Como niños, no razonamos sino que actuamos y esperamos que ante el plan más descabellado de todos al final las cosas salgan tal como lo pensamos. Si bien las travesuras no dejan de ser parte de la vida, en mi caso creo que aquellas que surgieron en mi infancia tienen un color muy especial. No fue algo planeado ni predeterminado, simplemente fueron acciones espontáneas que surgieron en respuesta al momento. En medio de la inocencia y la ignorancia se crea una especie de ambiente de posibles soluciones y buenas acciones, desencadenando el hilo de una experiencia que siempre nos deja ese sabor especial innato de nuestra infancia. Quizás ya no estamos para algo siquiera similar a lo vivido, pero todavía podemos rememorar y aflorar en nuestra mente y corazón aquello que de manera traviesa revive ese niño que una vez fuimos. >There’s no doubt that this topic could go on and on, and as my grandmother would say, it’s enough to fill a book or make a film. When I reflect on those episodes from my childhood, as an adult I realise that it didn’t make the slightest sense, but deep down, to that little boy, it all seemed like the perfect plan. To be honest, I think that even before all my mischief, my mother already knew what sort of child I was, and I would even go so far as to say that before I drank the powdered milk, my mum already knew I would do it. As children, we don’t reason; we simply act and hope that, even with the most far-fetched plan of all, things will turn out exactly as we imagined. >Whilst mischief is always part of life, in my case I believe that the pranks I got up to as a child hold a very special place in my heart. It wasn’t something planned or premeditated; they were simply spontaneous acts that arose in response to the moment. Amidst innocence and ignorance, a sort of atmosphere of possible solutions and good deeds is created, setting in motion a chain of experiences that always leaves us with that special, innate flavour of our childhood. Perhaps we are no longer in a position to experience anything even remotely similar to what we once did, but we can still recall and bring to the surface in our minds and hearts those mischievous moments that revive the child we once were. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZvyuAhKsedhp4QPBzUyUcDcyxqF1893SmxDh111hAaaC/quangminh7617-kids-7011614_640.jpg --- Enlaces de las imágenes // Image links: https://share.google/j1LwxBbtddEgB6mJ3 https://share.google/t89rM8y3iOgxNPA4r https://share.google/gLUWjSTFMKa5XiTt2 --- ***Gracias por darle valor a esta publicación con tu tiempo y atención.*** ***Hasta pronto.*** --- >***Thank you for taking the time to read this post.*** >***See you soon.***

Hola Amiguitos, Papitos y ZoeTubers! Este día recitaré el poema Los Ojos de Los Bueyes del poeta y escritor salvadoreño Alfredo Espino.
El poema de Los Ojos de Los Bueyes, expresa la ternura y sacrificio que estos animales hacen junto al campesino para cultivar la tierra, su tierra joven y antigua, tibia y alambrada.
La tradición del arado que se pega a la tierra y que cansa con esfuerzo y dolor a la yunta de los bueyes en el campo. Los bueyes que representan perseverancia, son con el campesino los que trabajan arduamente para sacar las cosechas del campo. 
Alfredo Espino a través de sus versos en Los Ojos de Los Bueyes está atento a los detalles que le rodean desde la poesía

En esta fecha previa al Día de La Madres (10 de Mayo - El Salvador), dedico este poema con mucho cariño a mis suscriptores, muchas bendiciones a todas las madrecitas queridas, reciban un fuerte abrazo y muchas bendiciones!

<center>![pink bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tbwLgrCrvjkBiLAtdtz7yZQj4tDbmuzC7N83gcXL7nZA6UfsqYFtZJnGa5RUdM6LqFs.png)</center>

<div class=\

> 🇺🇸 ~ **Hi, friends! Did you miss me? I sure missed you all a lot.** I’ve had a pretty busy couple of weeks, and I’m sure a lot of interesting things have been happening around here. I’ll be catching up little by little with blogs and my friends’ communities, but most of all, **I hope everyone is doing well 🙏 💗** >! [SPANISH VERSION] > 🇪🇸 ~ **¡Hola amigos!, ¿me extrañaron?, yo sí los he extrañado mucho,** he tenido 2 semanas bastante ocupadas y seguro muchas cosas interesantes han ocurrido por aquí, estaré poco a poco poniéndome al día con blogs y comunidades amigas, pero especialmente, **espero que todos se encuentren bien 🙏 💗** |![VID_20260428_172903.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23wgBTocLPFQvb8FJU8KsT4dmr3CXED7QZABo7U8uRuQw8F8Myes6qx5MraZmms5bmobA.gif)|![1777340823312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23z7WbXKjiDGf8kYWny458PPhZXG3jX93MdnwRuYkrwMH51519Dg2458DtDQ7YQBZHvfZ.jpg)|![VID_20260428_173031.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23uFTmyc9uqi4UYW1uJyFeMsfTzJo9CmoqEkfPm8ZZwTXkPbRXDVbxEpsPKtmwgboXxvP.gif)| |-|-|-|

>

**To bring you up to speed, I’d like to start by sharing the story of this adventure:** Last Saturday, April 25, we attended a veterinary health day organized by [“Misión Nevado Zulia”](https://www.instagram.com/nevadozulia/) and the [“Golden Pets”](https://www.instagram.com/goldenpets.ve/) store, from which, by the way, we received a direct invitation to attend (we’re so grateful to you!).

The owner of this store knows that I have kittens at home and that we also care for community kittens, and since, unfortunately, there is a health issue regarding rabies in the state, it is essential that everyone, without exception, keep their vaccinations up to date.

>! [SPANISH VERSION]
> **Para ponernos al día, quiero comenzar compartiendo el recorrido de esta aventura:** El pasado sábado 25 de Abril asistimos a una jornada de atención veterinaria organizada por [\

](https://www.instagram.com/goldenpets.ve/) de la que por cierto recibimos una invitación directa para asistir (¡super agradecidos contigo!). > > La dueña de esta tienda sabe que tengo gatitos en casa y que también contamos con gatitos comunitarios, y como lamentablemente en el estado hay un problema de salud respecto a la rabia pues es menester que todos sin excepción tengan sus vacunas al día.
![pink bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tbwLgrCrvjkBiLAtdtz7yZQj4tDbmuzC7N83gcXL7nZA6UfsqYFtZJnGa5RUdM6LqFs.png)
|![1777340823078.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/EqBbfn3JfpLZQqRkRKSQ79WBwkHvXzPeZhTNvGX5c9rkJsQXAbw1BySQFeciBeXhQWg.jpg)|![1777340823100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/EoeDRzjAHotE7z3D4UFJmWnwt6BfuLT3VFFq5ozqw6xbiKVkvNDviEVuBQgYmQrkXVj.jpg)| |-|-| |![1777340823210.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23vsWhCfydR6jQeKd7Y6FyynpQ5pLmCVFxYacg3Z2S9MwPfBpQQtjXJHjMLMdz22u5AS3.jpg)|![1777340823172.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23u62spcEnrQivKQKUBW7tXFXxax56rTrv9C84mwbbxvXNj5TgLr3H5rw2QHrKmJ7SRuh.jpg)| |![1777340823233.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/EowFhnkipncutY9HW5twwxW5iCVbJTBKR25KiSxwqnEb3KRx2tsQBTd5w8pmBkMFs6z.jpg)|![1777340823124.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/EowGaU4XpwxsoPxh73dz4McsGkkLuaZzJa98ctx4c2nuy5VFdSc8Xw7Eqf6EkKwUS3e.jpg)|
![1777340823264.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/Epta6pyJDWR4Q9Wu3mMcNQkXKB7n8gCUetsz6ysCCPfPZ2H3Q2aQm5aaATfAH9FJGnE.jpg) ✦ We arrived at the site early, before the veterinarians started work. It was very cloudy, and it rained for several hours straight ✦
|![1777340823135.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/EpC9SJKgF2tdPRSN3VX8fAF1636XVYz9YjcZ4t3UYR6jvrxmZosMq4b6Mo1unQpiu57.jpg)|![1777340823067.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/EqNEhp2fQc9CJWggvb2NsvzBFniD8uBDfQZyH8Zssz8mZVoh9b32zhPg6urWKd7Xm7P.jpg)| |-|-| |![1777340823044.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/EokdaVqCg6nGZftsYsZaf6tQFmPNUs2ptkidChKMS7jz2cFahMwTYojRvySRXtNP72r.jpg)|![1777340823018.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/EpEJCtapbGSDGEC4bTQAqGFaL64K9j7CEoCUkDRY5dDCxC3UCRJk61uxWhBnhSSVkh8.jpg)| |![1777340823006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/EoiVmq6avx3D5rMci7SWcN8q2kFz5VF8MahSomFVFxRhqV8HrfBQVESKttXhmfDHUwo.jpg)|![1777340822996.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/EopsveNxi9sGfn6CctTAWzfkkYJ3d7ue3Put8zNH9Hk22U2seRYehS4amnvbU7U9w1h.jpg)|
![1777340822959.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23y8qRvf1hsTARWV2tJEbCod2TwNgTtTxjM2DQSxjhsg5qqgwag6UJxTvjaEmyDUtTTsT.jpg) ✦ This is the first time I’ve attended a Mision Nevado event; I’ve previously attended events organized by the Maracaibo Animal Protection Institute (IMPA), so it was interesting to see how different they can be from one another, given that both are government-funded ✦
![pink bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tbwLgrCrvjkBiLAtdtz7yZQj4tDbmuzC7N83gcXL7nZA6UfsqYFtZJnGa5RUdM6LqFs.png)

> The event started at 9 a.m., so to make sure we got there on time, we woke up at 6 a.m., and by around 7:30 a.m. I was already putting the kittens in their carriers and crates. Some journalists are crying foul when people are hitting on them in social media. They even claimed of being attacked. Actually, it's just them playing victim. Some of media organizations are owned or partly owned by politicians, or even being funded by another country who has their own interest in a nation that's out of their jurisdiction. They're already unmasked, yet pretending of being legitimate and independent organization.

body.title: Day 48:  Vibe coding can still be a real pain.
body.body:
#
A dividend hunting app

Today I set my mind to creating an app which would allow me to enter stocks that I was tracking and look back over the previous month to check if there were any dividends. I'm pleased to say that at the end of the day I now have an app / webpage that works. **it isn't fancy at all** but it does work. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/Enz42RDGcR1WyggxryLEuaYDkVxi9BTQ9HAH62YTsHAWeNhjQ6p9nLWQ1zJF2hkpKnx.png) Now that may not seem very interesting. After all I could just go to Yahoo finance enter in each ticker symbol and get the information very quickly. However, eventually I would love to make a sandbox version of a HIVE stock market and getting stock quotes would be imperative for that. I need somewhere to get a BUY/SELL price. I need to have an oracle that tells me if dividends are payable. ... and it needs to be automated as I certainly can't go and manually do it every single sale and every single dividend!
#
But I'm not a coder. I don't speak computer

Two years ago a task like this would have been completely beyond my ability. Now with vibe coding it **IS** possible but that doesn't mean it is easy. I can type in what I want to chatgpt or other AI but that doesn't mean I don't need to do other things. I need to have an API to access financial databases. With the API I need to have a secret key stored on a private backend. I need to have a typescript code/webpage running on that backend to process my data requests from the front end webpage. And of course I have to have a front end for me to interact with. **I wish it was as easy as just typing a prompt and letting the AI do the work** and perhaps if I used a CLI type AI like Claude it would be. However using the tools I have it still as a steep learning curve. What goes where. How do I access everything and of course... What tools work for what?
#
Today's Gotcha's

In today's efforts? Lots of little things. ### For example I started with a Finnhub API ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23uFqLj3zKr4ZYYTJgjUXRautCco7qUcZ9LH6mhdn4KtovAaEJg4JXT7fWGVKbhKQrKZH.png) **But it didn't play nicely with the dividends I needed** ### So I tried FMP ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23sxon1fgCi398q5WkTR9jjezJMzrhDDYykSe8ognb18rKyjn6Hqrv6AmQqhYoRXekwps.png) and it would have worked except it changed the way the webpage has to interact with an endpoint giving me no end of headaches. But I finally got it working.... only to find out that Canadian stocks only work with the premium subscription. **Grrrr*** ### Eventually I found an API (sort of) that worked. **Horray!** Except that I got errors when looking at HDIF and ZWQT ETF's. **Oh brother** Until I figured out that they require HDI.to and ZWQT.to to signify they are on the Toronto stock exchange. Maybe its a little thing but its still more bug hunting trying to figure out ...**OK, *now* what is wrong**

#
But at the end of the day....

body.title: Recipe: Delicious Shredded Chicken - Receta: Delicioso pollo esmechado. 🍗🧅🍅
body.body:
> Hello my friends, how are you? It's a pleasure to greet you, sharing my daily recipes again. This time it's a delicious shredded chicken. >Holaa mis amigos como estan? gusto en saludarlos, nuevamente compartiendo mis recetas diarias, en esta oportunidad se trata de un rico pollo esmechado.

![Picsart_26-04-28_21-45-25-790.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maricrochets/23w2wVytA17M9CWcctsGreb8CkHZb9xNw2D4tHAxMU9hPd1pAsczYPeinSMRZT1Vbt5qp.jpg)

> >🍅 **Ingredientes:** >800 grms de pollo. Cebolla blanca. Tomate. Ajies dulces. 2 o 3 dientes de ajo. Pimenton verde. Cebollin. Zanahoria. Sal y pimienta. Salsa inglesa. Aceite el necesario.

![IMG_20260428_212213_478.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maricrochets/23z7NHbywggqhHzsxiqBqhtEXQ7RWpLj7kacf3VhbhR8B5KbJxicr6AqZEmvEp5jemRzj.jpg) ![IMG_20260428_212213_503.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maricrochets/23yJJK5Lzkf6TZqQdp2UvXUioY1ba7vnCGkze7PGD4W5bUUGjdLoZBXzrEuYxFXhcHHXe.jpg)

> 🍅 **Preparation:** We start by washing the chicken well and placing it in a pot with enough water to boil. Add 1 clove of garlic, a piece of onion, and 1 scallion. Let it cook until tender, then shred it. While the chicken is cooking, finely dice all the vegetables, grate the carrot, and crush the remaining garlic. In a pan, add all the vegetables and prepare a stew. Shred the chicken and add it to the pot, covering it and simmering over low heat. Add a little of the broth from the cooking liquid to retain the flavors. This chicken can be used in various dishes. Thank you, friends, for your support. Best regards. 🙏🏻🫂 >🍅 **Preparacion:** >Comenzamos lavando bien y colocando el pollo en una olla para hervirlo con suficiente agua, le agregamos 1 diente de ajo, un trozo de cebolla, 1 rama de cebollin y esperamos que se cocine para esmecharlo o deshebrarlo. >Mientras vamos picando todos los vegetales, en cuadritos muy pequeños, rallamos la zanahoria y machacamos el resto de los ajos, en una sarten agregamos todos los vegetales y preparamos un guiso, esmechamos el pollo y lo agregamos para cocinarlo a fuego lento con la olla tapada, tambien le colocamos un poco del consome donde lo cocinamos para mantener los sabores, este pollo puede ser utilizado para diferentes platillos. Gracias amigos por su apoyo, saludos. 🙏🏻🫂

body.title: Let's go shopping at Bintulu
body.body: Good Morning.. all my wonderful friends. How are you? This is one of the newest buildings here in Bintulu that you can visit if you do come here. An apartment with some shops. I took a drone photo of the whole area from the hotel's forth floor. SK ONE GARDEN ============= This was not here a couple of years ago. This has been completed for about a year. Since my hotel is next to this whole block of buildings, which consists of shopping places, eateries, and many more.
/> This is the inside of the building. There are apartments here, too. Quite a few big and many shops have not been rented out yet.

/> The basement has its grocery section. This is well built except that one thing is missing. The people. Sarawak is home to around 2.70 million people spread across many states. So many places still lack human beings. The trees here in Sarawak outnumber the humans by perhaps a 1000 times.

/> Let's go check out their department store and see what we can buy. A lot of the things here are imported. The best thing about shopping here is the less crowded area. You can enjoy your shopping in peace.
/> Carnaroli rice This is a type of rice that I've never heard of at all.
/> Super Cheese Rings If you love snacks, these are some of the ones you would definitely hunt for. These are the big packs. Good for one whole movie.
/> The cheese puff. That is one huge pack of cheese puff.
/> These are from Singapore. Vinegar evil guinea pig chips. Never knew that the guinea pigs could be so evil.
/> The beer area Some of the Calberg beer here. This has nice decorations so I took a photo of it here just to remember.
/> Thank you very much for reading this post. Have a great day. @luueetang YouTube: www.youtube.com/luueejanice Tiktok: www.tiktok.com/@luueejanice

¡Saludos, compañeros corredores 🤜🏽🏃🏽! Este martes fue un día redondo para la disciplina y mi bienestar integral. La jornada comenzó temprano con una pequeña pero intensa sesión de spinning durante la mañana, ideal para activar el metabolismo y fortalecer las piernas. Sin embargo, el plato fuerte llegó al final de la tarde🕖: completé siete relajantes kilómetros nocturnos recorriendo Los Próceres y la Avenida Los Ilustres. El clima en nuestra amada Caracas estuvo simplemente espectacular, con una temperatura refrescante que osciló los 19°C, brindando ese ambiente perfecto que todo runner agradece. Sinceramente, espero que el resto de la semana se mantenga bajo estas condiciones tan agradables para seguir sumando zancadas.
​Ahora, solo espero poder dormir temprano para completar el entrenamiento con un descanso reparador  🛌🏽💤. Es fundamental recordar que dormir las ocho horas recomendadas también forma parte esencial del plan de entrenamiento. Un sueño de calidad permite que los tejidos musculares se regeneren, optimiza la recuperación cardiovascular y consolida los beneficios del esfuerzo físico realizado. Además, dormir bien fortalece el sistema inmunológico, mejora el estado de ánimo y nos brinda la agudeza mental 🧠necesaria para enfrentar los retos del día siguiente. Sin un buen descanso, el rendimiento se estanca y el riesgo de lesiones aumenta.
​Gracias a todos los que leyeron la publicación y se mantienen motivados en esta bonita vida con estilo saludable🎁. Como ya es nuestra bonita costumbre, les regalo algunas fotografías de la ruta y de lo que fue esta productiva jornada. ¡Que tengan todos un descanso reparador y nos vemos pronto en el asfalto!

traducido con Google traductor 

Greetings, fellow runners🤜🏽🏃🏽! This Tuesday was a well-rounded day for both discipline and my overall well-being. The day started early with a short but intense spinning session in the morning—ideal for boosting metabolism and strengthening the legs. However, the main event came in the late afternoon🕖: I completed seven relaxing nighttime kilometers running through Los Próceres and Avenida Los Ilustres. The weather in our beloved Caracas was simply spectacular, with a refreshing temperature hovering around 19°C, providing that perfect environment that every runner appreciates. I sincerely hope the rest of the week stays under these pleasant conditions so I can keep clocking in those strides.
Now, I just hope to get to bed early to complete my training with some restorative rest. It is fundamental to remember that sleeping 🛌🏽💤 the recommended eight hours is also an essential part of the training plan. Quality sleep allows muscle tissues to regenerate, optimizes cardiovascular recovery, and consolidates the benefits of the physical effort performed. Furthermore, sleeping well strengthens the immune system, improves mood, and provides us with the mental sharpness 🧠 needed to face the next day's challenges. Without proper rest, performance stagnates and the risk of injury increases.
Thank you to everyone who read this post and stays motivated in this beautiful, healthy lifestyle🎁. As is our wonderful tradition, here are some photographs of the route and today’s productive session. Wishing you all a restful sleep, and see you soon on the asphalt!

body.title: We persist !!?...
body.body:
>

In the end, when love really arrives, what defines the story is not that everything turns out perfect, that's pure storytelling, what defines it is what you are made of and who you are when things don't go well as you expect. >Why? Well, it's very easy to have a very high standard for what you want to receive and never review it with the same honesty as to what you give. And this reflection opens a big space to a phrase that I always say, in love there are no guarantees, that's the first thing to understand and also the most difficult thing to accept. Because since we were little we were taught to look for the perfect other, the one who never fails, the one who never hurts, without realizing that we ourselves have failed, we have broken hearts, we have made decisions that hurt people we cared about. And that forces us to look at ourselves honestly before demanding from the world what we have not yet finished building in ourselves, do you see? Losing your best friend, your partner, your half, with whom you laughed and cried about everything, hurts a lot, but also, losing a project that didn't work and for which you gave your life, for which you went where you didn't want to go destroys your soul into a thousand pieces and it can take years to close that cycle, that door, without rancor, with respect, with humility. Look, the reflection that this conversation leaves us is that despite suppressing ourselves by losing ourselves in the sight of others, the person you were before that, does not disappear, just learns as a defense mechanism, to not be seen so as not to generate conflict (because the erroneous belief is assumed that being oneself does not leave anything good). *We all deserve a stable love*... And the day, you decide to choose yourself again over the approval of anyone, you will have really worked on building your self-esteem, although be careful with that, because that process often comes with relapses, in which it costs a lot to detach from the retina of the other, but once you achieve it, you will have experienced the concept of true freedom. Reconciliation without responsibility only guarantees access to the repetition of the damage. To repair is not to return, nor to ask for forgiveness, nor to talk about it endlessly; it is to take charge of what was injured and work to not reproduce it again. Definitely, a stable relationship is one in which you break something of your ego in every disagreement, every fight, every argument, because they understand that the responsibility for conflicts, does not depend on one, but on two. In addition, it is that relationship in which there are natural and healthy conflicts, and despite this we choose each other every day. Janitze 🦋

___

___ Any images in this post are taken with my iPhone 14, the Infinix pro-note 30 or with the camera Rolleiflex 2.8 f, and edited with [Canva]( https://www.canva.com/) ___ Separator made with [Canva]( https://www.canva.com/) by @janitzearratia ___ Translation with |[DeepL](www.DeepL.com/Translator (English Version)) ___ ___

body.title: 🎪 Digital Circus: De un boceto de práctica a una ilustración detallada
body.body: > **Hello everyone!** It has been a while since I last posted an illustration here, but as I do from time to time, I’m back with a brand-new piece. Recently, I’ve been spending my free time practicing on a budget-friendly pen tablet. Through consistent practice, I’ve managed to improve my digital technique and streamline my workflow. As a result of this growth, I want to share my latest illustration inspired by **Digital Circus**, a series that really caught my eye.

> **¡Hola a todos!** Tenía un buen tiempo sin poder compartir una ilustración por aquí, pero como cada cierto tiempo, hoy les traigo una pieza nueva. Últimamente, he dedicado mis ratos libres a practicar con una tableta gráfica económica. Gracias a esta constancia, he logrado evolucionar en mi técnica y optimizar mis tiempos de trabajo. Como resultado de este proceso, quiero mostrarles mi más reciente ilustración de **Digital Circus**, una serie que captó poderosamente mi atención. --- ### 🎨 The Creative Process / El Proceso Creativo | English | Español | | :--- | :--- | | I decided to draw **Pomni**, though I must admit that I didn't have high expectations at first; I saw it as just another practice sketch. However, as I progressed, I began taking it more seriously, adding more depth and detail. | Decidí retratar a **Pomni**, aunque debo admitir que al inicio no tenía grandes expectativas; lo veía simplemente como un ejercicio de práctica. Sin embargo, conforme avanzaba, decidí tomármelo más en serio y elevar el nivel de detalle. | | The project started quite simply as a standard portrait of a girl, but I gradually introduced elements that aligned with the character's identity. I began with a clean but simple lineart, so I challenged myself to make the coloring stand out. | El concepto comenzó de forma sencilla: el retrato de una chica común. Poco a poco, fui integrando elementos característicos del personaje. Partí de un *lineart* simple, pero me propuse compensar esa sencillez con un coloreado minucioso. | ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lokotrones/23tSqbfpFMqs8c9MmTnL6qVo9Fa1siYEbZnZb2m67N3qDfUpx6qkVAFAdzcWrr4DNMgek.jpg) --- ### 🖌️ Technical Execution / Ejecución Técnica > **Skin & Palette:** I chose a pale, rosy skin tone and emphasized the lips and makeup. Using various references, I worked on the red and blue palette for the outfit; this was a bit tricky since I handled them in separate layers, but the final result was well worth the effort. > > **Piel y Paleta:** Apliqué una base de piel en tonos rosados y pálidos, resaltando los labios y el maquillaje. Utilizando diversas referencias, logré equilibrar la paleta de rojos y azules de la vestimenta, lo cual fue un reto técnico al trabajar cada sección en capas separadas. **The \

/ El caos del cabello:**
To be honest, I have a love-hate relationship with drawing hair. It is an exhausting and complex process that feels chaotic at the start, but eventually, it gains the right shape and texture. In contrast, creating the background was much smoother, drawing inspiration directly from the show’s episodes.

Sinceramente tengo una relación de amor-odio con el pelo; realizarlo es un proceso exhaustivo y complejo que suele generarme caos al principio, aunque al final logra tomar la forma y el detalle que busco. Por otro lado, el fondo fue más fluido, inspirándome directamente en la estética de los episodios de la serie.

body.title: Ogłoszenie klasyfikacji generalnej kampanii na FB
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeu1wHYLMVFS5JdwXAfUZZbk33s6Hgt1nBz76vZnKmswF/dfuns_2026_04_28_2023143269eb7b380e.jpg) 1 kwietnia zakończyliśmy pierwszą odsłonę kabekowej kampanii na Facebooku i pierwotnie miałem plan od razu opublikować klasyfikację generalną. Niestety moce przerobowe mam dość ograniczone i nic z tego nie wyszło. Uznałem jednak, że warto poczekać do końca miesiąca i dokładnie 2 lata po rozpoczęciu akcji zrobić jakieś wydarzenie z rozdaniem nagród dla TOP50. Wczoraj to się odbyło. Pierwsze miejsce zajął Krzysztof Słowik z wynikiem 995 punktów, który otrzymał nagrodę specjalną w postaci srebrnej monety 10 zł ze Zbigniewem Herbertem. Na drugim miejscu znalazł się Marcin Sobiczewski (990 punktów), który otrzymał 10 miliardów dolarów z Zimbabwe. Na ostatnim miejscu podium był Marcin Tomczak (921 punktów), który otrzymał miliard dolarów z Zimbabwe. TOP50 otrzymało specjalne, numerowane medalo-magnesy (można je odebrać w Królestwie do końca czerwca). ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYnizo5JtcFdFpHmdfQbP5prATitdJ4eCTGcWChMmLwzS/dfuns_2026_04_28_2023142a915c8c576f.jpg) Przed rozdaniem nagród zaprezentowałem różne statystyki dotyczące naszego Facebooka. Zestawiłem też ze sobą dane z marca 2024 (tuż przed podjęciem działań), z kwietnia 2024 (płatne reklamy na FB), z maja 2024 (pierwszy miesiąc kampanii) i marca 2026 (koniec pierwszej odsłony). ||Marzec 2024|Kwiecień 2024|Maj 2024|Marzec 2026 -|-|-|-|-| Liczba postów|33|39|52|49 Mediana lajków|12|11|18|69 Średnia lajków|13,6|11,9|18,9|71,9 Odwiedziny|257|335|322|836
Jak widać średnia lajków z 13,6 wzrosła do 71,9. To znacząco poprawiło sytuację. Niestety nie ma efektu kuli śniegowej. Obecnie utrzymujemy się na podobnym poziomie, co i tak jest sukcesem biorąc pod uwagę fakt, że wiele osób ewakuowało się z Facebooka. Ciągle też trzeba przypominać, że kampania trwa. Ale tak już jest skonstruowany ten świat. Nic samo się nie posuwa do przodu. Nawet jeśli coś się rozpędzi, to bez dbania o to prędzej czy później to stanie.

We’re in the home stretch to reach the next level, which makes me very happy, since in this type of game, when you level up, you get new things, and that would be great for the farm to keep growing. We’re currently at level 18 with a total of 3,978 experience points, and to reach the next level, we need a total of 4,912, so we’re very close. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPTY1aXLmHinKZLMuZAf64V8VJW8QDK5nSTBBKE6gwXUn/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQRR28bfHx1rnkiSZJ8vGDS7hqdV2PsrnTcNnxx1Lw4ZR/image.png) Este juego también se actualizó comenzados desde el pase de temporada, la cual está iniciando y cada día que pase nos toca recolectar alguna recompensas, siendo una tarea algo complicada, pero no imposible de lograr. Mientras que otro lado en la sección de tareas tenemos tres nuevas tareas, donde son enviar tres cosas por el helicóptero, producir tres artículos y sembrar cuatro cosas, donde cada nos dará recompensas por haberla completado. Me fui por la tarea que consistía en enviar tres cosas por el helicóptero, la cual me pareció un poco más fácil, ya que tenía los productos que nos estaban pidiendo las personas para que fueran enviados y así poder también ayudarlo. Donde la primera carga fue de varias frutas y verduras que necesitaba dicha persona y como en la granja yo las puedo sembrar se las envié. La siguen te carga si fue un poco más exigente, puesto que nos pidió productos ya fabricados y lo bueno es que también ya lo tenía listo y de esa manera poder conseguir la tarea y que nos diera como recompensa monedas y experiencia. >This game has also been updated with the start of the season pass, which is just beginning. Every day, we have to collect certain rewards—a somewhat complicated task, but not impossible to accomplish. Meanwhile, in the tasks section, we have three new tasks: sending three items via helicopter, producing three items, and planting four crops. Each one will reward us upon completion. # >I went with the task that involved sending three items via helicopter, which seemed a bit easier to me, since I already had the products people were asking us to send so I could help them out. The first shipment consisted of various fruits and vegetables that person needed, and since I can grow them on the farm, I sent them over. The next shipment was a bit more demanding, since they asked for ready-made products, but the good thing was that I already had them ready, so I was able to complete the task and earn coins and experience as a reward. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbuCd4vpDEWLXErZanvBXLYxhB4sVtPYQdZtfHQQdTeV6/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ3iZXe5bL59dyhPxmWFkG7Y4wxpv6fW4swLw33qtBBJA/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQQL2sTEywZwaHpRHsKniukGpKRqK61btexS4wDC6a2FD/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmarT8GP8tMubhYWHfX2DmmWtyXzvzaTt9fhE2JyUr8Bxn/image.png) Con cada una de las tareas que logre hacer la igual que las respectivas misiones aparte de logro llegar al nivel 19 siendo algo muy importante, divertido y a la vez nuevas responsabilidades que tengo que asumir para así poder seguir creciendo y no perder nada. Con este nuevo nivel de la granja logré desbloquear 8 cosas nuevas que seguro nos dará grandes recompensas, pero lo más relevante es que tengo la oportunidad de poder construir un laboratorio y a la vez poder hacer sándwich en la granja. Por eso cada una de estas cosas nuevas que desbloquee las tengo que aprovechar al máximo y así poder ganar y seguir disfrutando de este juego. >With each task I complete, as well as the corresponding missions—not to mention reaching level 19, which is a major milestone—I’m having fun while also taking on new responsibilities that I need to handle in order to keep growing and not fall behind. With this new farm level, I’ve unlocked 8 new features that are sure to bring us great rewards, but the most important thing is that I now have the chance to build a lab and make sandwiches on the farm. That’s why I need to make the most of each of these new features I’ve unlocked so I can keep winning and enjoying this game. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX6dBT2Ey36mwZwEf5dAGKBHUShN6VhZRDSYZGCPgYi7F/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRJvXcRScE5mjouUAhKHPFoSwNbjyGqfJioJm51ApohdX/image.png) Tenemos que seguir trabajando para poder dar lo mejor y que ninguno de nuestros trabajadores descanse, ya que siempre habrá algo que hacer en esta granja, además la idea es poder completar todas las misiones que nos están pidiendo, ya que con más recompensas que nos da estoy seguro de que puede subir de nivel mucho más rápido y así poder desbloquear cosas. Mientras que, por otro lado, seguimos pendiente del pase de esta temporada, puesto que los días pasan y cada día es muy importante para así poder ganar y conseguir cosas que podremos usar o simplemente venderlas en el mercado y así poder ganar mucho dinero. >We have to keep working hard to give it our all and make sure none of our workers rest, since there will always be something to do on this farm. Plus, the goal is to complete all the missions we’re being asked to do, because with the extra rewards we get, I’m sure we can level up much faster and unlock new things. It is good to be religious. 
It is good to be religious because we come to know God through religion. If there were no religion, we would not have known God. Religion is the agency through which the idea and knowledge of God has been transferred to us. When we were without God, we lived our lives according to the lustful instincts hair of the world. We had no fear of God in our character. When we did not know about God, we were separated from God and our lives were empty. But thank God for religion because it has made us to really know who God is.

Everything that we have had in the world has a way of presenting itself to be real or fake. We have true religion as well as we have the false religion. In the true religion, we get to learn about God and all that concerns Him truthfully. The true religion is the religion that acknowledges that there is a true God who is not something that we can make by ourselves or carve by ourselves. The true religion accept that the Lord Jesus Christ is the Son of God who was manifested in the flesh to take away the store sins of the world. 

Those who are serving the true God are those who will escape the problems of this world when God shall judge the world for all the sinful works which they have done

body.title: Activa en el estadio, con el martes de Intervalos 😎😎💕💕🔥
body.body: > Volvemos al estadio para el entrenamiento de intervalos, entrenamiento que con el tiempo he aprendido a disfrutar, y a canalizar lo importante que es para seguir avanzando. Sali a las 5:35 am de casa, y que tal, ya estaba todo bien clarito parecian las 6:00 am, si que se prognosticabas elevadas temperaturas en este dia, y tal cual fue, un calor bien intenso reino en este dia. Inicie mi entrenamiento con 1,5 kilometros de calentamiento, calente en el parque de tal forma que ya estar a 5 minutos para las seis en el estadio.Al llegar al estadio ya estaba abierto y ya varias personas estaban entrenando, generalmente bien temprano van unas chicas y unas señoras a caminar, y tambien unos perritos que van con sus dueños. Tome agua, respire profundo e inicie mi entrenamiento. Lo aputado para hoy fueron 5 repeticiones de 800 mts, una distancia que se respeta mucho, ya despues de 400 mts todos los intervalos son de respeto, porque aguantar dolor y fatiga nos lleva a retar nuestra mente. --- El tiempo promedio de cada intervalo estuvo entre 4:09 y 3:59 minutos, el descanso fue de dos minutos, antes del ultimo intervalos descanse un minuto mas ya que me sentia algo fatigabda, y la idea es estar estable para realizar de forma provechosa los intervalos, ya que sino, no vamos a mantener el ritmo exigido, y si vamos a otro diferente lamentablemente no se obtendran los beneficiso de este tipo de rutina. Mantuve tambien la frecuencia cardiaca que se debe estar en estetipo de entrenamiento en zona 5. En la ultima serie vi la gloria, me senti feliz de terminar el entrenamiento. Al finalizar me hidrate, respire profundo y me recupere caminando hasta casita. Seguimos preparandonos, y avanzando en los entrenamientos, sin carrera aun a la vista.💕💕🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️ . >Greetings and blessings.! >

>We’re back at the stadium for interval training—a workout I’ve come to enjoy over time and have learned to appreciate for how crucial it is to keep making progress. I left home at 5:35 a.m., and wow, it was already so bright out—it felt like 6:00 a.m. The forecast had predicted high temperatures for the day, and that’s exactly how it turned out; the heat was intense all day long. I started my workout with a 1.5-kilometer warm-up, warming up in the park so that I’d arrive at the stadium five minutes before six. When I got to the stadium, it was already open, and several people were already training. Usually, some young women and older ladies come very early to walk, along with some dogs out with their owners. I drank some water, took a deep breath, and started my workout. My goal for today was 5 repetitions of 800 meters—a distance that demands a lot of respect. After 400 meters, every interval is a challenge, because enduring pain and fatigue pushes us to challenge our minds. --- >The average duration of each interval was between 4:09 and 3:59 minutes. I rested for two minutes between intervals, but before the last one, I rested an extra minute because I was feeling a bit tired. The idea is to maintain a steady pace to get the most out of the intervals; otherwise, we won’t be able to keep up with the required pace, and if we switch to a different pace, unfortunately we won’t reap the benefits of this type of routine.I also kept my heart rate within the target range for this type of training in Zone 5 During the last set, I felt a sense of accomplishment; I was happy to finish the workout. When I was done, I hydrated, took a deep breath, and recovered by walking home. We continue to prepare and make progress in our training, with no race in sight yet.💕💕🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️ --- Todo el contenido es de mi autoría y las imágenes son de mi propiedad Fotos fueron tomadas con mi HONOR X6a Plus Separador editado en Canva Traducido con [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > All content is my own and the images are my property. > Photos were taken with my HONOR X6a Plus > Translated with [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > Publisher edited in the application Canva [Puedes chequear mi actividad en Strava](https://www.strava.com/activities/18289962074?utm_source=com.whatsapp&utm_medium=referral) --- [ You can check my activity at Strava](https://www.strava.com/activities/18289962074?utm_source=com.whatsapp&utm_medium=referral) ![SRL-image-14.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTN93piGhVsStGYqyRaiGAqHLC4oXUyMuBepEzJJrRW59/SRL-image-14.png) --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@mcookies/activa-en-el-estadio-con-el-martes-de-intervalos)
