body.title: Our Recent Guild Brawl and Featured Battle
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfUbS897pcCc582But3UTtcnGnLAcF9P8s9mNd4YTmWKh/image.png)

Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome back to my blog!

Our guild has just wrapped up another brawl. This time we had a solid improvement. We climbed to fourth place, up from last week’s seventh place finish. In today’s post, I’ll break down our overall results, highlight my personal performance, and showcase one of my favorite battles.

***

# Guild Rank and Personal Performance

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUrNsb6pdNkCq5XKhMPTwwjiYJHJ487cjbgnEX4nL1ZfT/image.png)

We had a solid brawl this week, finishing in fourth place. It's a big improvement from our performance last week when we ended up in seventh place. We earned ninety nine crowns which we can use to upgrade our buildings. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcGFToV7BWtr9yNLF3xTBrBf4qAkd1fGDQS6Ru7Jov7cd/image.png)

Personally, my results were great during the brawl and I was satisfied with my overall results. I won six out of eight battles, which helped our guild’s ranking. My efforts also contributed eighteen points to the final score. Compared to previous brawls, the rewards this time were much better and felt more worthwhile. Each of us who joined received rewards of 5,186 merits and 63 SPS.

***

# Featured Battle

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSTejnsjiNu6raBax5Jt9crKomhNQu9NSSCrkqCmNMkYJ/image.png)

We can use two gladiators in this brawl having the \

ruleset. I chose the Fire splinter inspite of my archon, Fithe Bladestone, being only at level two. The reason is I have strong gladiator cards in Fire. My tank was Doomshield Warden. He has the Flank ability that enables me to place another melee unit that can attack in second position. The other melee unit I picked was Molten Elemental. It has dual attack of melee and ranged that it can use from second position. My two gladiator cards are strong. First is Fina Voxom, a legendary melee card with high damage and Opportunity ability. She hunts the enemy's low health units and quickly trigger her bloodlust, adding to her stats. Next gladiator card was Orella Abadon, another melee unit but with Sneak ability. Next is a no attack unit Ashveil Tactician. Her Inspire ability increases the melee attack of my units. Finally my prized card, Shiraza. Its Weapons Training ability grants two magic attack to no attack units making it one of my most valued cards.

The enemy had a higher level archon and units. He used a dual tank combo of Saltwraith Bulkhead and gladiator Marisol Contuma followed by magic damage dealers including his second gladiator card, Captain Katie. Fina made her first kill in the first round and triggered her bloodlust. It went easier for my team since then as Fina followed up with another kill and another. She one shot each enemy unit while increasing her power with each kill.

[Replay the Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_jUSoT86pH06mkkFb0CRo?ref=logen9f)

***

# Come Play Splinterlands!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAX3xcPAwc8omveh7imyKtqbHntKgVLqLckGTCHSjPyw/image.png)

Start your Splinterlands adventure today with my [referral](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=logen9f). You can play the game for free in the Frontier Mode or take your game to the next level by purchasing a spellbook. Buying a spellbook allows you to earn SPS tokens and use the  market to sell in game assets. Also, we will both get 500 Credits which can be used top purchase cards once you buy a spellbook.

Hola a todos. Hoy, según yo, me tocaba trotar a un ritmo muy suave pero ya después del km 2 no pude aguantar la tentación de acelerar. Luego del 3 y medio volví a un ritmo lento. Al final, conseguí un ritmo promedio de 6:32 por km.



Salí a trotar de noche porque en la mañana el sol estaba muy fuerte, y eso que apenas eran las 7 de la mañana. Así que decidí hacer las otras actividades del día y dejar para la nochecita mi carrera de hoy. 


Este es el día 26 consecutivo que estoy trotando y estoy a solo 2 días de lograr mi meta, la de correr 28 días seguidos.


Este será sin duda el mes en el que más kilómetros habré recorrido. De hecho, creo que ya he superado por bastante mi antiguo record.


Lo que no me gusta para nada de correr en la noche es que las fotos no salen muy bien, y si voy corriendo mucho menos aún. Pero el clima y las calles libres compensan ese punto negativo.

Por ahora, me despido hasta mañana. Quiero mencionar que hoy estaba muy contento porque ya salió la camiseta oficial para la carrera de los 10 km que será el 7 de junio. Así que ahora solo falta seguir entrenando para estar listo para ese día.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmdsMVdSHnho1Uqw8Nu3UaGUv9CzAttesTt5cZrRGEx5sL/separadores_55.png  
 
English

Hi, everyone. Today, I was supposed to go for a very easy jog, but after about 2 km, I couldn't resist the urge to speed up. After 3.5 km, I slowed back down. In the end, I averaged a pace of 6:32 per km.



I went out for a run at night because the sun was already very strong in the morning, even though it was barely 7 a.m. So I decided to do the rest of my daily activities and save today’s run for the evening. 


This is the 26th consecutive day I’ve been running, and I’m just two days away from reaching my goal of running 28 days in a row.


This will undoubtedly be the month in which I’ve covered the most kilometers. In fact, I think I’ve already surpassed my old record by quite a bit.


What I really don’t like about running at night is that the photos don’t turn out very well, and even less so if I’m running. But the weather and the empty streets make up for that downside.

For now, I’ll sign off until tomorrow. I want to mention that I was really happy today because the official T-shirt for the 10K race on June 7th is out. So now I just need to keep training to be ready for that day.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmdsMVdSHnho1Uqw8Nu3UaGUv9CzAttesTt5cZrRGEx5sL/separadores_55.png  
 
https://images.ecency.com/DQmSbsPSfzWTeyw3YVKjRx6HTQmtJqEYNAyHkmpgGXHeDTc/mi_publicacion.jpg

body.title: Entrenamiento de Caminata de Montaña Los Chivos - Taguaguay
body.body:
> Saludos amigos de Hive y de @fulldeportes, hoy voy a compartir con ustedes este entrenamiento de caminata de montaña que realicé en la ruta del cerro Los Chivos - Taguaguay, en la comunidad de Villa de Cura, municipio Zamora, estado Aragua. >Greetings to all my friends on Hive and @fulldeportes. Today I’m going to share with you this mountain walking training session I did on the Los Chivos–Taguaguay trail, in the community of Villa de Cura, Zamora municipality, Aragua state.
![GridArt_20260428_175450365.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/243ziAHsDtQFehttZXLYJGFDDz9WkiQNgSMzh9aeBpQHaCKMTYs6p9EmLk5u2GD539w6V.jpg) Cabe destacar que este entrenamiento lo realicé el día de ayer lunes 28 de abril, en la cual llovió a la 4 de la tarde, ya había pensado suspender el entrenamiento porque parecía que la lluvia iba a ser fuerte, sin embargo fue un corto tiempo, por eso pensé hacer un recorrido plano pero me imaginé que eso lugares estarían llenos de mucho barro. Inicié desde la avenida Lisandro Hernández, activando la aplicación Strava desde mi teléfono, que contaba con poca batería porque se fue la luz y no me dió tiempo de cargarlo. >It’s worth noting that I did this training session yesterday, Monday 28 April, when it rained at 4 pm. I’d already considered cancelling the session because it looked like it was going to be a heavy downpour, but it was only brief, so I thought about doing a flat route but realised those areas would be full of mud. I set off from Lisandro Hernández Avenue, activating the Strava app on my phone, which was running low on battery because there had been a power cut and I hadn’t had time to charge it. ![IMG_20260427_170127.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/241Zmj2QN1JSowoi9HRNg28UpKhtUGQLSYVdxGgQAsx1Fvh3wAd7cbGqzrcixdnxq9QdW.jpg) ![IMG_20260427_170226.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/2458LHWuNrG1VMPQUuiYEaysLkezcsWXrySpoTyL3GXuKGGkVkqcbqdtwPVeh7TZurjAD.jpg) ![IMG_20260427_170235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/245T7XNLkiMCyveUtFUmnKrj1kvQXxaeQXgf9tj3BJrhbUmSN4ESGN43unxFXwfLEDWA5.jpg) Asimismo me adentré a la montaña, algunas partes había que subir con cuidado porque el barro estaba en el camino, al llegar a la primera cima donde está la cruz, llevaba un tiempo de 8 minutos a un ritmo al 100%,con un clima fresco. Después continúe avanzando para subir la segunda pendiente, ya llevaba un tiempo de 12 minutos, parecía que podía mejorar el tiempo, aumenté el paso en la tercera loma y llegué a dónde estan las máquinas con tiempo de 15 minutos. >I also headed into the mountains; in some places I had to climb carefully because there was mud on the path. By the time I reached the first peak where the cross stands, I’d been running for 8 minutes at full pace, in cool weather. I then carried on to climb the second slope; I’d already been running for 12 minutes. It looked as though I could improve my time, so I picked up the pace on the third hill and reached the machines in 15 minutes. ![IMG_20260427_170857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/245wHWYMWyFKpzkSoBFMKc4FZLm1QmqHnythjJvouqYumRrXqqAU556yGZ8BWKP5pjXtV.jpg) ![IMG_20260427_171307.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/243zXZFNWNXY9VJENbLFpntpu9jZBocqP6czfanxRW4MU26N2ydQCCL5EuEsEgZb6K7oJ.jpg) ![IMG_20260427_171323.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23sUF7M5RgM3rE9SEGrer4LodsFccD9pbGtUSrGrWJ4d97AJfvvX79o2YbTPB3r6reYDR.jpg) Después comencé a descender, para recuperarme un poco del esfuerzo de estos primeros kilómetros, al llegar al desvío que conduce a diferentes sectores como Las Mercedes y Fundavilla, llevaba un tiempo de 20 minutos. Luego comencé a subir, tratando de mantener el paso, para continuar avanzando y pasar por Las Torres con un tiempo de 30 minutos. Aumenté el paso para ver si podía bajar el tiempo, al pasar por La Piedra, llevaba un tiempo de 34 minutos, el teléfono comenzó a avisarme que le quedaba poca batería. >I then began my descent, to recover a little from the exertion of those first few kilometres; by the time I reached the turn-off leading to various areas such as Las Mercedes and Fundavilla, I had been running for 20 minutes. Then I started climbing again, trying to keep up the pace to keep moving forward and pass through Las Torres in 30 minutes. I picked up the pace to see if I could improve my time; as I passed through La Piedra, I had been running for 34 minutes, and my phone started warning me that the battery was running low. ![IMG_20260427_172802.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23sJhuRGMh6eECT8wrn4yT3mk3sPdb928uDpHKYUsLmqqqQxB6W521HfxbjWZiKd4nqXY.jpg) ![IMG_20260427_173027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/244xuFk8wQAuQUXuuwZcgd48gZidWYWLWAjoCR6yHfCHgbZmg6avmNjXj1A6XS5LNLcaj.jpg) ![IMG_20260427_173115.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/245TBTpgT54dtETbf6h4wKFNCtFm87YkZ9cPccbF4a5jHaG5pc1frMgWB6Eh29Vu6mmwN.jpg) Continúe avanzando, recorriendo una parte plana, y la aplicación marco un tiempo de 42 minutos, al frente de la laguna de Taguaguay, la cual ha sido mi mejor tiempo. Después descendí unos metros y se me apagó el teléfono. Después me regresé por el mismo camino, para terminar de bajar y salir de la montaña, llegando nuevamente a la avenida Lisandro Hernández con un tiempo de 1 hora 54 minutos, con un desnivel positivo de 376 m ,un desnivel máximo de 766, registrado en la aplicación Strava. >I carried on walking along a flat stretch, and the app recorded a time of 42 minutes as I passed Taguaguay Lagoon – my best time so far. I then descended a few metres and my phone switched off. body.title: How to escape from my refuge!
body.body:
# ***
How to escape from my refuge!
***

> **Escape?...** The question strikes me like a bolt from the blue. Whilst other children of my generation, back in the 1960s, no doubt fantasised about climbing over the fence and discovering what lay beyond the horizon, my world was bounded by a much more intimate and secure landscape. My short answer will always be ‘no’.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbVbdPkzLwq8DjuPx4GiXBYmxM79n8Dvo1v6ugpcp5BCt/yoyo.png)
I grew up under the wing of two Andean parents in a Venezuela that still retained that silent, respectful rigour of provincial life. In my home, discipline didn’t require shouting; it hung in the air, in the weight of words and in that overprotection which, in my case, was a suit of armour. My visual impairment during those first ten years of life made me the centre of a family solar system dedicated to looking after me. I wasn’t a child who sought out the street; I was a spoilt child, glued to books and board games.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUPPn9NfMkQ8HZ6fEmp22v4q5hE7KLGhhMm7V9LeCAzFr/de_nino.jpg)
I was that model pupil, the one who never gave Mum a single cause for complaint at primary or secondary school. My rebellious streak had nowhere to go because there was nothing to rebel against. I remember that the harshest punishment I received throughout my childhood was a pinch on the palm of my hand. A minimal pain, almost symbolic, which for my sensibilities at the time was enough to understand the boundaries.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYzXeMbt3K9JL1FAboC5RXTXQwKHGBfxFkZ6Fan4D83Lm/clentes.jpg)
How do you escape from a place where you feel safe? In those years, when the world was for me a blurred watercolour of light and shadow, my home was not a prison, but the only place I could navigate with complete confidence. To run away would have been to give up the warmth of my family, and for a child who learned to see with affection rather than with his eyes, there was no destination outside the home worth the risk. *** ***

body.body:
/>

“Well, there was no way anyone could know that a hurricane whose core was hundreds of miles offshore could hit that hard.”

“Listen, if we throw tomatoes at the screen, it will wreck the screen, but Grayson, can you build us a transporter machine like the ones on _Star Trek_ real quick?”

“Nope. He deserves it, but, wrong century. Call me in 2220.”

Mrs. Thalia Ludlow cracked up laughing at the interplay of bad politicians and her grandchildren eight-year-old Edwina and six-year-old Grayson Ludlow, but …

“It's real bad when grandkids are as young as mine, and they know an adult is telling a patent lie,” she said to Mrs. Gladys Jubilee Trent.

“Oh,” Mrs. Jubilee Trent said, “you should have heard Gracie and Velma just roasting that man, talking about, 'Sir, do you have your phone? Do you watch the news sometimes? And if you don't, what are you even doing?' So then Milton walked in and said, 'Forget this mess – I'mma run for whatever and replace this guy!' So then Tom tried to be the voice of reason and said you have to be at least 18 to be in office, only to have Milton respond, 'Well, I'm half of eighteen but I have way more sense than this guy, so, let's work something out!'”

Mrs. Ludlow laughed, and then sighed.

“It's actually really sad, what Lofton County has come to in terms of governance. I'm from San Francisco, and San Francisco definitely has its corrupt element, but this is on a whole different level.”

Mrs. Jubilee Trent smiled faintly.

“San Francisco is younger, and like all major port cities, more mobile,” she said. “Here, we have literally settled on our lees – pun fully intended in Virginia – and so the old wineskins have burst at last. But, this is a necessary part of the process of things getting better – people have to see that their lives depend on it, and that the danger is not going to be confined to those they think less of.”

“Because hurricanes and tornadoes don't care,” Mrs. Ludlow said, “while there is a God in Heaven who remembers and is just, and does care and knows how to make others care and do right.”

“Ain't it the truth,” Mrs. Jubilee Trent said. “That's why we gotta raise these babies to do right before pressure is applied like this.”

“Yep,” Mrs. Ludlow said. “Cannot have our grandchildren out here in danger of being covered with tomators and then roasted like the present crew is getting. Nope.”

“To think that if it were the year 2220, Grayson would have just built the transporter and then beamed Edwina, Gracie, and Velma into the press conference with the tomatoes and the roasting,” Mrs. Jubilee Trent said. “Gots to be more careful out here – time is winding up!”

body.title: 🍂 El Minimalismo en mi VIDA 👀 -  Estudiantes me Entrevistan [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
/>

* * *

En la entrevista que me hicieron en clase, donde cada estudiante me hacía una pregunta, hubo una más personal, porque tenía que ver con mi vida y la relación con el minimalismo. Creo que respondí muy rápido y dejé muchos puntos por fuera. Hasta hoy, casi una semana después, sigo pensando en la pregunta.

Impacto del minimalismo en mi vida.
===================================

Solo en los últimos años he analizado esto, de hecho el término \

lo conocí ya bastante adulto 😁. Con el tiempo fui uniendo las piezas y me di cuenta que ese término usado para la decoración y la arquitectura, que después lo veía en el diseño gráfico; podía usarlo para la vida misma. Nada de esto fue de golpe, aunque en los últimos dos años, me he concentrado más en analizarlo y sobretodo desde que comencé a crear contenido del tema. Ya hace bastante tiempo, sentía el ruido cuando estaba en casa de familiares, que guardan demasiadas cosas, tienen demasiados adornos y no hay un rincón en alguna pared, sin un cuadro. Comencé a sentirme saturado y cuando iba a lugares más ligeros, sentía alivio. Mi amor por la naturaleza es desde niño, cuando mis papás me llevaban a acampar por todo el país. Desde ahí tuve esa conexión que fui perdiendo cuando crecí y mi entorno no era tan cercano a las excursiones. Me dejé llevar por amistades hacia lo típico que se hace en la ciudad. Ahora que vivo solo, he conectado más con el silencio, con lo simple. Esto también lo he combinado con el ahorro, que desde siempre fue algo muy marcado en mí. Estudiar Un Curso de Milagros, también me acercó al minimalismo; mucho en la parte de emociones y sobretodo a disminuir los deseos. Entender que un espíritu es simplemente un observador sin juicios, o sea un contemplador y nada más, me hizo entender de lo poderoso de la más simple pureza. Si tuviera que enumerar los hitos importantes de mi vida, que me despertaron al minimalismo serían: * Conocer la naturaleza desde niño * Superar la crisis económica del 2017 * Un Curso de Milagros * Hive * Vivir solo. * Crear con tenido de minimalismo. Ahora me parece divertido, analizar todo con un lente minimalista. Al final es un filtro que le doy a la observación y que siempre le da mayor paz a mi vida. * * * English ======= During the interview I did in class—where each student asked me a question—there was one that was more personal, because it had to do with my life and my relationship with minimalism. I think I answered too quickly and left out a lot of points. Even now, almost a week later, I’m still thinking about that question. The Impact of Minimalism on My Life. ==================================== I’ve only really analyzed this in the last few years; in fact, I didn’t even know the term “minimalism” until I was quite grown up 😁. Over time, I started putting the pieces together and realized that this term—which I’d seen used in interior design and architecture, and later in graphic design—could be applied to life itself. None of this happened overnight, though in the last two years, I’ve focused more on analyzing it—especially since I started creating content on the topic. For quite some time now, I’ve felt overwhelmed when visiting relatives who keep too many things, have too many decorations, and don’t have a single corner on any wall without a picture. I started to feel saturated, and when I went to more minimalist places, I felt relief. My love for nature dates back to my childhood, when my parents took me camping all over the country. From then on, I had that connection, which I gradually lost as I grew up and my surroundings weren’t as conducive to outdoor excursions. I let myself be swept up by friends into the typical city lifestyle. Now that I live alone, I’ve reconnected with silence and simplicity. I’ve also combined this with frugality, which has always been a strong part of me. If I had to list the major milestones in my life that led me to minimalism, they would be: * Experiencing nature as a child * Overcoming the economic crisis of 2017 * A Course in Miracles * Hive * Living alone. * Creating with a minimalist mindset. Now I find it fun to analyze everything through a minimalist lens. Ultimately, it’s a filter I apply to my observations, and it always brings greater peace to my life. body.title: Updating the tomato and paprika plants [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
> Hello, friends of Hive and Hive Garden. I hope you’re all doing well. Today I wanted to let you know that I’ve finally finished transplanting the Margariteño tomato plants that I’d been meaning to plant for quite some time now, as their pots had become too small for them and I wanted to prepare the soil before planting them, but I hadn’t got round to it until yesterday afternoon, when I finally finished everything. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZDpMkA4acHR7wZ2Pta5LFvMc9xhmZRtbPPxNbsXrrJhU/1777421421000.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKPWdv7yDVPr1rR7CZtNEi4dSVi3ywSZWuh3BMdRgeoU/1744729162354.png) I’d already told you about this tomato and pepper seedbed, and last time I showed you that I’d transplanted some of the tomato plants into large pots filled with soil enriched with the compost I’ve been making. By the way, today when I was watering them, I spotted some buds, so they’re about to flower. I hope they all do well and that I’ll be able to harvest them. Well, as you know, I still had a few more plants left to transplant, but as I didn’t have any large pots to put them in, I had no choice but to plant them directly in the ground, although you know I didn’t want to do that because this soil is rather poor; it seems to lack sufficient nutrients, which is why I started making compost and began preparing everything to try and help the plants thrive. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRRyANemqRRUg3miBys2PqHDJkg4QuigZErYQY4NAD5Ld/1777420587775.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZP9C6LtsHsJmBp1n4fbZHVGGfnmkGzWgr5PfiYtPi1eR/1777420587856.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmehxyPtRT7a2HLYXbEjJLJWovUkaajKLW1uXPxUbSmNsV/1777420441639.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKPWdv7yDVPr1rR7CZtNEi4dSVi3ywSZWuh3BMdRgeoU/1744729162354.png) What I did was start preparing the soil where I was going to plant them, so I dug some fairly deep holes, poured a bit of water into them, and then filled them with the soil I’d prepared—a mixture of compost—and left them for, I think, three days, keeping them moist so that it would mix with the soil in the garden. Then yesterday, what I did was take the plants out of the pots they were in and put them into the holes I’d dug for them, which I’d made in a sort of trench so that when I water them, they’re all watered at the same time and the job is a bit easier, even though there aren’t too many plants. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNuFaLUAoyu9Ljd6ZGXneZfCAsfxVhoL2mm5JMnTK6pi1/1777420441739.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSH66JXPJeGjyTkbVCANhrqkNZ7C4fy8mRqk9oz18iZ27/1777420441815.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPw9kqc9dNa3F2da6SaswHyCyWiQMPtbxW9j4SVFWBohi/1777420441890.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcaGkvTK1G9Yfh1nddG3k8Q6CUgi2EaDXJ8py7oAmeJgN/1777420441997.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKPWdv7yDVPr1rR7CZtNEi4dSVi3ywSZWuh3BMdRgeoU/1744729162354.png) Now I have to make sure I water them every day and keep an eye out for ants, which are another of the dangers these plants face here at home, because it’s happened before that we’ve planted them and the ants have damaged the plant right from the root, and we’ve lost them, but I hope that this time, with more attention and care, we’ll be able to harvest the tomatoes. The paprika plants are growing more slowly, but I also had to move them to larger pots, where they can stay a while longer, and they’ve already got buds too, with some about to open. Let’s see how it all turns out. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbMNNyocgz4mUrJWf1DgEcehnYcbfQeZGtBZ1mCYXC9NY/1777420588090.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSvRx8Tuk27e5UE5ddvdZge3xZxy7bWMdLfWirJek3SFf/1777420587925.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYkk5UDqxjvRR9QyjQMbk9UJB7GKBtDtLA31ce8yiReQh/1777420588005.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKPWdv7yDVPr1rR7CZtNEi4dSVi3ywSZWuh3BMdRgeoU/1744729162354.png) Well, friends, that’s all for today. I’ll be back in a week to give you an update. Best wishes, and take care.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQqBK4zq2HWSFCnzaTBCorQVhth77Fx4CSZt1mYdJtPiF/1744729162300.png) Hola amigos de Hive y de Hive Garden, espero que todos estén muy bien. Hoy quiero contarles que terminé de trasplantar las matas de tomate margariteño que tenía pendientes por sembrar desde hace tiempo ya porque los envases les estaban quedando pequeños y quería preparar la tierra antes de sembrarlas, pero no me había dado chance y fui poco a poco hasta que ayer tarde terminé todo. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKPWdv7yDVPr1rR7CZtNEi4dSVi3ywSZWuh3BMdRgeoU/1744729162354.png) Ya les había contado de este semillero de tomates y pimentón y la última vez les mostré que había trasplantado algunas de las de tomate a unos envases grandes con tierra abonada con el compost que he estado haciendo y por cierto hoy cuando las estaba regando le vi unos botones así que están por florecer y espero que a todas les vaya bien y pueda cosechar. Bueno como saben todavía me quedaban otras matas más por trasplantar, pero como no tenía envases grandes donde meterlas no me quedo de otra que hacerlo directamente en la tierra aunque saben que no quería hacer eso porque esta tierra es bastante mala, pareciera que no tuviera nutrientes suficientes y por eso me puse a preparar el compost y comencé a preparar todo para tratar que las matas prosperen. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRRyANemqRRUg3miBys2PqHDJkg4QuigZErYQY4NAD5Ld/1777420587775.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZP9C6LtsHsJmBp1n4fbZHVGGfnmkGzWgr5PfiYtPi1eR/1777420587856.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmehxyPtRT7a2HLYXbEjJLJWovUkaajKLW1uXPxUbSmNsV/1777420441639.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKPWdv7yDVPr1rR7CZtNEi4dSVi3ywSZWuh3BMdRgeoU/1744729162354.png) Lo que hice fue comenzar a preparar la tierra donde las iba a sembrar, entonces hice unos huecos un tanto profundos, les eché algo de agua y después les eché de la tierra que tengo preparada con la mezcla de compost y las dejé creo que tres días y las estuve humedeciendo para que se mezclara con la tierra del patio. Después ayer ya lo que hice fue sacar las matas de los envases en los que las tenía y ponerlas en los huecos que había hecho para ellas, que los hice en una especie de zanja para que cuando riegue, se rieguen todas a la vez y que el trabajo sea un poco más sencillo, aunque no son demasiadas matas. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNuFaLUAoyu9Ljd6ZGXneZfCAsfxVhoL2mm5JMnTK6pi1/1777420441739.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSH66JXPJeGjyTkbVCANhrqkNZ7C4fy8mRqk9oz18iZ27/1777420441815.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPw9kqc9dNa3F2da6SaswHyCyWiQMPtbxW9j4SVFWBohi/1777420441890.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcaGkvTK1G9Yfh1nddG3k8Q6CUgi2EaDXJ8py7oAmeJgN/1777420441997.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKPWdv7yDVPr1rR7CZtNEi4dSVi3ywSZWuh3BMdRgeoU/1744729162354.png) Ahora tengo que estar pendiente de regarlas cada día y estar pendiente de las hormigas, que es otro de los peligros que tienen estas matas aquí en la casa, porque ya ha pasado que hemos sembrado y las hormigas dañan la mata desde la raíz y las perdemos, pero espero que esta vez con más atención y más cuidado podamos cosechar los tomates. Las de pimentón crecen más lentos pero también las tuve que pasar a otros envases más grandes y ahí pueden estar un tiempo más y esas ya tienen botones también y algunos están por abrir, vamos a ver cómo resulta todo. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbMNNyocgz4mUrJWf1DgEcehnYcbfQeZGtBZ1mCYXC9NY/1777420588090.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSvRx8Tuk27e5UE5ddvdZge3xZxy7bWMdLfWirJek3SFf/1777420587925.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYkk5UDqxjvRR9QyjQMbk9UJB7GKBtDtLA31ce8yiReQh/1777420588005.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKPWdv7yDVPr1rR7CZtNEi4dSVi3ywSZWuh3BMdRgeoU/1744729162354.png) Bueno amigos eso es todo por hoy, ya vengo en una semana para darles la actualización. Saludos y que estén muy bien.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSYRMxzXzCiqTVgUiNPZyrAfxRYV1CQVGjj7KEm2TsV31/1745361627552.jpg)

body.title: Technology Perspectives: Past, Present, and Predictions
body.body: I am older than Facebook. I remember when Netflix mailed DVDs. I am older than Google, which once promised not to be evil. I am older than the World Wide Web itself. I remember the DOS prompt, and A and B floppy disk drives being more important than an internal C hard drive. However, fiction presented computers as almost magical devices, and \

was often treated as a literal parallel dimension we would travel, but here we are with ads and echo chambers on Web2 social media while we try to build Web3 for a world that isn't ready for it yet.
![Mechanical_typewriters_-_Southern_Moreton_Bay_Islands_Museum,_Russell_Island,_Moreton_Bay,_Queensland,_2012.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/EokcZe43ZttM3WKC8a6TRTARrYNApUD5EPicov6zLwKdRBxzKYWx1QvZk1FwTkbE74i.jpg) *I remember one similar to the rightmost example here. [Photo credit](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mechanical_typewriters_-_Southern_Moreton_Bay_Islands_Museum,_Russell_Island,_Moreton_Bay,_Queensland,_2012.jpg)*
Beyond that, I remember standalone word processors and manual typewriters. I remember a time when families often owned only a single television, tuned into scheduled programming with rabbit-ear antennae for PBS, ABC, CBS, NBC, FOX, and the VCR on channel 3. There was a time we didn't even own a VCR. They were incredibly expensive 30-odd years ago when my family got one because a well-meaning relative gave me some videocassettes for Christmas one year, and we had no way to play them. Electronic toys required disposable batteries to function, and those were a significant expense. My childhood was almost entirely analog. My most-used toys were LEGO, Tonka trucks, and [Matchbox cars.](https://peakd.com/hive-179513/@jacobtothe/matchbox-memories) I rode a Big Wheel tricycle until I graduated to a hand-me-down bicycle. If we wanted to know something, we needed to use reference books at home, or visit the library. Library card catalogs were literally a cabinet of index cards. Cross-country travel required an atlas, not GPS, for navigation.
![BIG_Wheel_(3327257572).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/23zS3TCA39ZrHCZhthTrXNLn5nAdP68rvzLprgg3CCx6rv7vZ7RJdArWdhdr7ftMUkpT9.jpg) *My wheel cracked, and pebbles soon added a rattling sound effect. [Photo credit](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:BIG_Wheel_(3327257572).jpg)*
Was life better then? In some ways yes, in some ways no. I'm not a nostalgic Luddite with rose-tinted glasses when looking back on the past. Technological advancements bring convenience, but convenience also breeds apathy. I grew up learning to not blindly trust Google results even before it became a wasteland of advertisements, to say nothing of A.I. slop. We knew Mapquest could give bad directions. People get fooled now by A.I. deepfakes, but I remember chain letter e-mails and spam relying on classic grifts, urban legends, and Photoshop to spread nonsense, too. My biggest concern today is not the proliferation of screens so much as the blind acceptance of corporate and government surveillance through our devices, and blind reliance on the top search results in Google or an A.I. prompt response. I like the convenience of technology, but I grew up without it. Imagine how it was for our grandparents or great-grandparents who remembered a time before electricity. We grumble about subscriptions, but accept the power bill as a necessity when they used iceboxes and kerosene lanterns. Why should they pay Edison Electric when what they had worked just fine?
![myshoun-ai-generated-8620394_640.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/AJhY4KwQHnmD5yzUp7QDGg5vH6UPsvA9oJu4rZ75Msk7X7djGVLRrnC2t5L1qSB.jpg) *A.I. slop seems fitting. [slop credit](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/ai-generated-robot-reading-humanoid-8620394/)*
All of this is to say I think I have some experience on which to base some predictions. We are lurching into a world of Limited Language Model \

and tools. It reminds me of the dot-com boom. Corporations are dumping money into ventures that seem more hype than anything else, and only after a lot of them crash and burn will we see what survives the strain of a bursting bubble.

In another year or so, a new generation of server GPUs will likely hit the market from AMD, Intel, and less well-known enterprise-focused competitors, potentially disrupting Nvidia's position. No one seems to want Microsoft's Copilot despite their heavy push for integrating it everywhere. Companies which rushed into A.I. integration are often backpedaling as they discover where slop has messed up their systems.

I think it has a future as a tool, but not the way its loudest proponents believe, and while it will bring changes and disruption, it won't create systemic unemployment. Feel free to revisit my predictions in five to ten years and see whether I got it right or not.

body.title: Grief, Then Light
body.body:
Yesterday, I witnessed what you'd call a solemn-magical moment. The solemn part, I had planned for, but the magical... unexpected. 

I happen to attend the wake of a choir member who passed away a few months ago. His funeral will be coming up tomorrow, Wednesday, so the church held a wake for him yesterday's evening, as tradition demands. 

Inside, the church held that particular weight. Solemn mass. Hymns sung low. The readings and sermon, all reminded us of how ephemeral this life is - today one is here, the next day, they're gone - to the great beyond.  

We stood, we sat, we prayed. Grief has its own gravity, and for an hour, we all moved inside it - in that kind of quietness that comes with final goodbyes. Then the mass ended, and everyone began to move out, carrying their grief with them. 

I joined, oblivious that the world outside has changed color.

Outside, I noticed that everything looked dipped in warmth, like a light had poured over them - the ground, rooftops, trees, the people... everything under the sky. 

And hanging there, right in the middle of it, was the sun - it's golden-orange hue surrounded by the thick grey clouds. The way it hung seemed like it had forced its way through the clouds. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTdpRfHGq3CQCpghunEQWWT7wUkXPAGtdeewvNaQB1vHi/1777420516205.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR3S7pogDG6ZN4nrp3iYUG4LiysWhtUcLugeKK7LyX8iC/1777420516329.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSUVhDoHkaoPQjH6QjDdaJuuw1qEAY7PscQv464sZU98C/1777420516419.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNf8QcFSYqMaxpdsr1HmUZQXu6m6pAqw9LrNxofLhoSeT/1777420516500.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWLLiF7igJmVwFvRuVToferBtwGQvpLGCUdfpcDKBDZke/1777420516577.jpg)

And the amazing thing is, it wasn't half gone behind the clouds, rather, it was a perctround. Unbroken. Full. 

I stood, hooked. I couldn’t move. 

Solemn for the goodbye I’d just left. Magical for the light I’d just found. One moment I was in mourning. The next, I was hooked by something that felt untouched.

I’ve seen sunsets over Aba. The usual fade, the quick drop behind buildings. But this one refused to be less than whole. It felt like an answer I wasn’t asking for.

I stood there longer than I meant to. Breathing it in. Letting sorrow and beauty sit in my chest at the same time.

You don’t get many moments like that. Where death and light show up together, neither apologizing. 



Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@luchyl/grief-then-light--bhu)

body.title: Discovering Practice Mode in Splinterlands and Reaching Level 9 in Rising Star Game
body.body:
## Splinterlands

Only 2 days left until a new season begins in Splinterlands and I start my journey in the Wild format.

As I mentioned in other posts, I chose the Wild format because I want to have fun playing all the cards available in Splinterlands, but soon I will also test the Modern format because the rewards are better and there are no bots in that format.

There is still a lot of information for me to discover about the game and I am learning little by little. For those who are new to Splinterlands, I will give 3 interesting tips:

- Complete Campaign Mode to understand how battles work in the game.

- Start your journey in Frontier format.

- Use Practice Mode to test your battle strategies.

In my previous posts I explained about Campaign Mode and Frontier format, so now let's learn about Practice Mode.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNLfr6pX8CUBVq9g1Ady6Gykjg37eKA758czFkXK7AQrX/d.png</center>

To find Practice Mode in Splinterlands you need to go to the PLAY option and then to Practice.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmU8krHQmwNbnp1UV4KYH5RZsLtiLdEUmwyQyrwgp1StWg/dd.png</center>

This page has several settings for how you can simulate your battles in Splinterlands. They don't affect your ranked score, so you can play without worry and test your strategies.

Another interesting detail about Practice Mode is the Ghost Cards option. This allows you to use all the cards that exist in Splinterlands, even if you don't own any of them in your collection.

So, if you're a Splinterlands newbie, use Practice Mode and become an experienced player.

----

-----

## Rising Star Game

I reached level 9 in Rising Star Game and tomorrow I'll finally reach level 10 and unlock the Music Lessons. This means my journey will be even more fun because I'll be able to buy packs and unlock the Music Lessons, finally solving my EGO problem.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVJimZ7cqos5gR1V7veN7apQiKb6EdqyJLcNRC9SQLScK/ddd.png</center>

My EGO is at 29.54% and I believe I can get it down to 0% in just one day, so I'm not worried.

You can access the games at the following links: **[Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=arkartus)** and **[Rising Star Game](https://www.risingstargame.com/)**.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@arkartus/discovering-practice-mode-in-splinterlands-and-reaching-level-9-in-rising-star-game-31y)

body.title: The Art of the Conscious Pause
body.body:
When I just started my teenage phase I used to think reflection means for  perfect moments like sunsets, or it meant empty rooms, also having a long walk at night with deep thoughts. Well, in real life I didn't know that I'm not gonna have those ideal settings. My father taught me that reflection can happen anywhere at anytime. Like even if I'm outside in a chaos, it doesn’t matter as long as I allow myself to pause and think.

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zoe01/23zGcLzDPganiea79j4fsXgZhebd8dAoudETSanh6PrLZjveaP7261KKp91ZJ8rTkmgEy.png)

In beginning it did feel a bit overwhelming. I'm currently a student and I have to socialise with many people so my phone is contasntly filled with notifications and I also have too many responsibilities. I have to carry the expectations of my parents as well. 

I always have kept my schedules busy otherwise I would overthink a lot, so I always have something to do and it keeps me busy for a long period, but somehow I would still feel disconnected from myself, like I was feeling empty from inside..

Last few months I was getting exhausted easily, I was not feeling good about myself even though there were no big issues. Then I decided to sit alone without my phone. And I thought if I do not put my phone on silent then I won't be able to avoid any kind of disturbance. So, I had to do it. 

After I silenced my phone in the beginning, I was feeling restless because I constantly overthinking like \

. So yeah, I won't say that it completely felt good or bad, It was a mixture of so many things. But for a long time I felt that I'm gonna lose everything if I don't check my phone right now. As time passed the voice in my head was fading slowly and then something changed within me. At first I was replaying everything I did the whole day, also thought about what I enjoyed and what I disliked and tried to understand how these things made me feel. I could recall the moments which I usually do eating fast unnecessarily as if I'm under pressure, the way I reacted to my mom without thinking, and the small little things which made me happy but I never noticed it. While thinking about all of these my inward kinda felt powerful. It felt like finally I could understand myself and found a new version of myself. Which I had been ignoring for a long time. Since then, I have been trying to make reflection a habit of my daily routine, so it's kinda rare as I'm busy so it gets irregular. But to be honest I do not believe anymore that I need a perfect moment to reflect. Because a perfect moment doesn’t exist, the moment becomes perfect only when I decide. So, it could be like when I'm trying to sleep or doing some chores or when I take a short break from my studies or while taking a bath. Also, I had a wrong thought about reflection that I'll be judging myself for the things I did also it's not about pointing out the wrong things only. Instead, that I'll try to understand the cause which means reaching the roots of all. Like why did I react in a certain way? And what makes me angry and what makes me happy. So, reflection helped me to become more aware of my own way of leasing life and I could easily figure out the causes of my emotions. Also, I think that if I can't understand myself then I can't expect others to understand me. So, this is my only way of reconnecting with myself. Even phone has a reset button and that what reflection feels like in my life. I feel refreshed. I know that life is unpredictable, but still if I could create some space to reflect then it's gonna help me to stay more grounded. And I know that's the only spirit I need in my life. ____ The images are created with [Gemini](gemini.google.com) and edited with [Canva](www.canva.con) ____

>

   
Hola, amigos, como todos los martes, me encuentro aquí en el encuentro de talento para participar en el llamado que nos hace cada martes nuestra amiga @angelica7. Esta vez viene con un tema que nos trae a la memoria la mejor etapa de nuestra vida: la infancia, ya que se trata de las travesuras. Al leer este tema de \

enseguida pienso en los niños. Ellos son los que disfrutan cada travesura y cada una de ellas lo hacen por curiosidad y buscan descubrir un mundo diferente. Las travesuras que hacemos de niños a veces pueden parecer un caos. Sin embargo, en realidad se trata de pura magia infantil, ya que las travesuras reflejan la libertad de ser niño, y la curiosidad es lo que lleva a los niños a meterse en líos. A veces la gente lo ve como maldad, pero no es así; simplemente forma parte del proceso de crecer. Los niños exploran el mundo mientras se divierten. Eso les hace felices. Mientras escribo, recuerdo algunas de mis propias travesuras, aunque debo mencionar que yo no era muy traviesa, así que voy a transportarme de vuelta a la infancia, a esa época en la que todo era tan bonito y éramos tan inocentes, y en la que disfrutaba de cada una de mis travesuras. Esta travesura de la que les cuento me hizo muy feliz en ese tiempo, y cuando la recuerdo, me doy cuenta de lo inocentes que éramos para aquel entonces. Así que aquí va una de las travesuras que solía hacer cuando era niña; les aseguro, solo de pensarlo todavía me hace reír y me llena de alegría. Además, ¿quién no ha hecho alguna travesura? Bueno, aquí va una que recuerdo muy bien: cuando tenía 9 años, solía reunirme con mis amigos. Cerca de donde vivíamos, había una urbanización en la que todas las casas tenían timbre. Íbamos en grupo y elegíamos a una persona para que tocara el timbre, y cuando lo hacía, salíamos corriendo para que la persona que abría la puerta no nos viera. Eso nos hacía reír, hasta que un día pillaron a uno de nosotros y descubrieron quiénes eran los que iban a tocar el timbre en las tardes. Que susto. Otras travesuras de mi infancia que recuerdo y que me hacen reír: cuando solía comer a escondidas leche en polvo mientras escondidas de mi madre; cuando me corté el pelo muy corto; otra vez que quemé unos pantalones elásticos con la plancha; cuando daba vueltas hasta marearme… En resumen, hacíamos un montón de travesuras inocentes por curiosidad, por energía y simplemente por diversión. La verdad es que esas pequeñas cosas que llamamos travesuras nos hacían felices. ¿Y ustedes qué travesuras hicieron de niños?
![esta1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23yJLu4hcazZYeBsuFYamfbdLYeQrqfn5TFfryfLsLEhqx5KLdhNUpt2g4B76y8oNgb3J.jpg) ![esta2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23w2qS8yRXoEteipVb2nzXwvExnxvciBTR7phUYxfoRar6ZY6gTQLXGgHvzhvAxx3Dhkt.jpg)
--- ## English --- >Hi, friends! Just like every Tuesday, I’m here at the Talent Gathering to join in on the call our friend @angelica7 sends out every Tuesday. This time, she’s brought up a topic that takes us back to the best time of our lives: childhood—specifically, mischief. When I read this topic of “mischief,” I immediately think of children. They’re the ones who enjoy every bit of mischief, and they do it all out of curiosity, seeking to discover a different world. >The mischief we get into as children can sometimes seem like chaos. However, it’s actually pure childhood magic, since mischief reflects the freedom of being a child, and curiosity drives children to get into trouble. Sometimes people see it as naughtiness, but that’s not the case; it’s simply part of growing up. Children explore the world while having fun. This makes them happy. As I write, I remember some of my own mischief, though I should mention that I wasn’t very mischievous myself, so I’m going to transport myself back to childhood—that time when everything was so beautiful and we were so innocent, and when I enjoyed every bit of mischief. >This little prank I’m telling you about made me so happy back then, and when I think back on it, I realize just how innocent we were back then. So here’s one of the pranks I used to pull when I was a kid; I promise, just thinking about it still makes me laugh and fills me with joy. Besides, who hasn’t pulled a prank? Well, here’s one I remember very well: when I was 9 years old, I used to hang out with my friends. Near where we lived, there was a neighborhood where every house had a doorbell. We’d go in a group and pick one person to ring the doorbell, and when they did, we’d run off so the person opening the door wouldn’t see us. That made us laugh—until one day they caught one of us and figured out who was ringing the doorbell in the afternoons. What a scare. >Other childhood pranks I remember that make me laugh: when I used to sneakily eat powdered milk while hiding from my mom; when I cut my hair really short; another time when I burned a pair of stretchy pants with the iron; when I spun around until I got dizzy… In short, we got up to all sorts of innocent mischief out of curiosity, energy, and just for fun. body.body:
**“Nube” está bien elegida y bien aterrizada.** En español, **nube** es un sustantivo femenino — *la nube* — y se usa tanto para la nube del cielo como, en contexto moderno, para **“the cloud” digital** ([Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-spanish/cloud), [Inklingo](https://www.inklingo.app/spanish/dictionary/nube)).

La frase **“Las nubes blancas son bonitas”** suena natural y clara. Si quieres una variante un poco más común en conversación, también funciona **“Las nubes blancas son hermosas”** o **“se ven bonitas”**. La imagen de la nube orográfica además mete una capa extra de valor, porque conecta vocabulario con fenómeno real: una nube puede formarse cuando el aire asciende por una montaña y se enfría ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cloud)).

Me gusta el formato porque no te quedas en traducción seca; **das palabra + frase + imagen + contexto**. Eso enseña mejor, carajo, porque la memoria recuerda escenas mucho más que listas.

title.title: I Am #AliveAndThriving Today! || #IAmAliveChallenge || Daily Off-Grid Jungle Journal Entry: Day #1369 - OpenClaw Installation in Process, and Now For AI-Agent Details - GaiaYoga Gardens, Lower Puna, Far East Big Island, Hawai'i - Monday, April 27, 2026
title.body: ![Hive-Banner-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGM7REKBsvoBhPiEV5Fvb8tb333qQ8N9x2YfxaF9vWohE9Qf39RUEAn3LfysdgfbYpZ.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_165212543.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23zbMU5M6xn6wxkdCNtdbACJgDDXDhFrXrrznRn9CzvyFVAw8RqzSjmsa5Y9T4yh6wrdQ.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) >I live naked and barefooted, very close to Earth and Nature, in an 18-acre, off-grid, clothing-optional, food-forest intentional community ([GaiaYoga Gardens](https://gaiayoga.org)), way out in the jungles of Lower Puna, far East Big Island, Hawai'i, and I have for more than 7 years now. Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 22.97% HIVE Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.061 USD HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.991 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.03211634 SWAP.HIVE HEARTBEAT ALIVE Price: 0.07434047 ALIVE BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00116816 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.144577 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.000176 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 76,360.6 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 453.17 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 55.49 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 4,593.00 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 73.05 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #130 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#101 (among active witnesses only)/461.9k HP in votes/48 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 In every spare moment that I have lately, and they're a bit challenging to find, I've been researching as deeply as I can into the details and the variations of setting up and configuring my own personal and local multi-agent AI system, using RamaLama-Podman-OpenClaw, in my Arch/Artix-Linux-based laptop, and I'm making excellent progress. After an extremely helpful and clarifying chat with Grok3 (*on X*) last night and this morning, I'm happy to say that I've begun, and I'm part way through, the OpenClaw installation process. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_165133573_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tvaNKivPa27Tu15dW72jYFFVGxWpMk7EUeXTveRPY1z9AUozVVkbRkomcZwwzbi6yx3.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_165426064_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tvaHbwEs1XaNfi5F7sYNjyJ7QHzjRvuk4nc2K6n833JL7VyXWpdnzuM5K7veoGgq9E3.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I actually started, then decided to do it a slightly different way, using Git, which would make updating easy, and it would allow me to use my future ai-agent helpers to use the OpenClaw source code to extend its capabilities, or even to build my own custom iteration of it. I've also been researching other forks and implementations of OpenClaw in other programming languages, and for different purposes and use cases. One particularly interested me, ClawSwarm, which is a light-weight Rust-based implementation, with complex multi-agent setups being its in-built speciality. It's also part of the larger Swarm ecosystem, which is a very rich framework for innumerable iterations of multi-agent templates, tools, and different setups. I'm going with the original OpenClaw for now, but I'm certainly going to keep an eye on ClawSwarm and Swarm. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_165534297.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wWnSCEfJVr5JWkzbkTYtoPzmF6h4WPKaeRkMQ3z28MhyYxKdoR6dpzR3xPJjB8ApZcq.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_165554705.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uFJtbg1rjWQBg6k4rq68CuCYAwe6spqK8tLiKLYaqFghbZniV7HtKrboFmZEcL2fWhW.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) After getting OpenClaw installed and at least partially configured, my next order of operations is to focus on and consider the details of the specialized agents, and to decide on which models to pair with them, which as I mentioned in my post yesterday, may indeed take a bit of time, since I want to do it well. I'm building a coherent team framework, with each agent filling a specific, and complementary role. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_165725722.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wqXSVuJBz19DshJZV8BbjGL5mTi3xUpCgCDiAbYBB9TCotiE35w19crWqf3iwhWDrHr.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_165856500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQiGwKyRniLg7Pdj9bPvhTADHWNAWbdhBKFDtR5yxu9yBLMTAEMfDcphVg3HvqFsUVX.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) On the coding and development side of things, I'll be using a model with high coding capability, and I'll include excellent coding tools to complement it, to make a very effective coding-and-development agent. I'll also likely try a side implementation, to install and run Claude Code locally, using my own model. That setup doesn't really easily integrate with the one that I'm currently building, but it could probably be used as a secondary very-helpful side tool, that I could invoke when needed. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_170034960.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wqEjZtqzVLSpnpRMLs4QFPxFjnTXWJfUo3VukFREvmyRcxQUQUMaSzz6fB7AkWGLY3R.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_170059355.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tva5TKDhyhfg2dCjHiqTkWQjaBnBcbzt1WXxyWa2sLeRYpoUuX6pKtkokVRvkYMw3ou.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I'm so focused and excited about all this because I know that I'll be able to successfully implement it, and because what I'll be able to accomplish with it is pretty freaking incredible. I'll be using these tools, and building a framework, that will allow me to then build even better tools and frameworks, as I progress. Once I get my foot in the door, it's a done deal. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_170253926_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23x159qTc19S3sYiydLBBstvcXz4o8yFMNqktokTyKq9EBT52Mf1tP1nnv26Bb4rVcTqJ.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_170313544_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uFH1mLmJiTv3nwDnkCYxcyYizHtWqWDm4U4QrnUAXdfe2C6a8pJvdkFusZM7e8xChHi.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Monday, I left the Flow House, after finishing up my Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, by about 2:45PM, giving my attention first to some photography for my posts, and then to a few small jungle-community tasks, including chopping and dumping bad/used coconuts at the upper coco bar, tidying up the area a bit, and traversing the property in search of harvestable bananas, of which I found one rack. With those, and one or two other small tasks completed, I went to Wabisabi to make myself some food, and to collect my jar of leftover superfood fire coffee from the fridge, and with those in hands I headed back to the Flow House, to dive into another round of researching how to build collaborative agentic-AI systems, and to begin my evening Hive tasks. I got through all my notifications by a bit after 10:30PM, and after some asset management, and more AI research, I went to bed by 1AM. I woke up by around 6:30AM, still feeling that I needed more sleep, doing more AI research, going to make my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, then returning to the Flow House for more AI research, and to write this post. It's now just before 1:45PM, so it's a very good time to wrap this up, so that I may attend to my other few important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before leaving the Flow House a little later in the afternoon, to focus first on some photography for my posts, and then on jungle-community/land work and tasks. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! Until the next incarnation of these posts! ***Always forward, onward, upward, and whaleward, ho, together we go!*** 😁🙏💚✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_170413870_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tbipFaqST1dvEJEjk3pgURvcLGTBBroVu15nnED29CXS6YxEfvAwYfQfwEqQLuzgxTr.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_170537817_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tbkX5i7ZNqxz6z8bcuAryhi76vz9hG2depy2eAEaquE4p1ZXW68LcKY3sWeQSBbUH4Z.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### 2026 Life Goals ``` 1.) Do regular integral practices again, alone or with others. 2.) Prepare regular batches of my medicinal teas collected from the land again. 3.) Make my plant nursery, and the gardens, beautiful again. 4.) Begin learning relevant coding/programming languages to more fully contribute to the sovereignty-driven technologies where I am active, like Arch Linux, Hive, Qortal, DeSo, and Bastyon. ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) *All photos were taken with my **Motorola G Play 2024 Android Phone**.* ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1RxBbudG9rt2dp1cGCcDqm1HJsmhBZUTJ8yUepXHTDRdUuVF5MhuePSiKAaiqqoQ.png) Thank you all so much who have helped me get to where I am today, and allowing me to share more of the beauty and magic from my life and my world with you, and for your continuous appreciation and support! I am truly deeply grateful! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1RxBbudG9rt2dp1cGCcDqm1HJsmhBZUTJ8yUepXHTDRdUuVF5MhuePSiKAaiqqoQ.png) If you'd like to find me on other alternative platforms where I have accounts (I spend most of my time here on ***Hive***), click on this signature image below to go to my *LinkTree* page. 原本上个月也就是3月底我有一场Session做为Speaker要分享，但是上个月我非常忙碌根本没时间准备PPT材料，于是就顺延到4月份，也就是今天分享。为了此次分享，两周前我就开始准备材料。但可不是光准备材料这么简单，我还要深入了解产品细节，还要准备一个demo展示环节。前前后后用了2周时间，上周五和这周一周二，我基本啥都没干，就是对着PPT组织语言，练习怎么演讲才能不卡壳，尽量熟练讲下来。

虽然我觉得准备的比较充分，但只要没有结束总觉得一颗石头压在身上。今天演讲时候倒是挺顺利的，一个小时的会议，我用了半个小时就讲完了。没有提问的同事，然后就结束了，比我想象的简单一些。从去年年底这个演讲任务就定下来了，因为演讲的内容我不太熟悉，当时我就觉得有些压力，可为了绩效只能硬着头皮接住。随着演讲日期临期，感觉这块大石头越来越重，压得我有些喘不过气来。

title.title: Beauty in Nature’s Imperfections
title.body:
This morning’s walk reminded me once again that nature is already beautiful on its own. But sometimes, another part of nature comes along and changes it in unexpected ways, and that is when something even more unique appears. While walking in the garden today, I noticed a few leaves that had been eaten by worms. Normally, some people might only see damage, but when I looked more closely, I found the patterns surprisingly interesting. ![1000136895.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoEoYN8TD4GCsn8vuTXPz9gdieuvEytUiGhqd4PqyBBoAr7RsugGT7xahhYt4uxdg1N.jpg) The tiny holes and uneven edges created designs that did not feel random at all. They looked almost like natural cutouts, as if the leaves had been carefully altered into something artistic. In black and white, those details became even more noticeable. The contrast made the shapes stand out, and what might have been ignored in color suddenly felt more expressive and full of character. That is one of the things I enjoy most about photography. It teaches me to slow down and notice details that are easy to overlook. A leaf does not have to be perfect to be worth photographing. In fact, sometimes it is the imperfections that make it more interesting. The marks left behind, the missing pieces, and the unusual shapes can all become part of its beauty. I think that also says something about life. Not everything beautiful has to remain untouched or flawless. Sometimes the experiences that change us, even the difficult ones, give us a different kind of character. They may leave marks, but those marks can also become part of what makes us unique. So today, I found beauty in leaves that had been altered by something as simple as a worm. And honestly, I thought that was pretty cool. More than anything, I am just glad I was able to go for a walk this morning and find another quiet reminder that beauty can appear in unexpected forms. Have a good day ahead. *** ![1000136894.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoAYKwB368BPWSVUR3VubUWCiaR2MFkktq88WNAcqRKj6s9vjsrYLDoByE1nomSYJAF.jpg) ![1000136893.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6HYCNU5npPPy1Uixk7UPKYhxRtA8EPNrgoab64jA5WkKngvh5jfWnq32yx3m7BAy2.jpg) ![1000136890.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoAU2PY3dd3HFPfJrSEaA4Yh5tK8uFweaPVqL1f5SFQvthniLbDkHWMZQZmT5x3eb1i.jpg) ![1000136892.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EowDj14C2AjGzC1d3GD6kQb7C1qUamCAztZv5Ao7bPYgQghHq1u1NqJ75Lhnf1kY4Z6.jpg) ![1000136891.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6Dbdt5XSs7T9cjkmzot7mKFjF7JHDe6Rt8CW6XtGiYrqtQJQapq9LMLci8R9jS4qE.jpg) ***

”To see in color is a delight for the eye, but to see in black and white is delight for the soul.”

title.title: Film Review: Black Panther (2018)
title.body:
![(source: tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/fkK8HB4LIN3ulmpGsq8QJv18jUf.jpg)


In 2018 the Marvel Cinematic Universe reached a point where it was no longer just breaking box-office records, but also where the critics, including the most hardened art-snobs who couldn't stand superhero films, were brought to their knees. That moment came thanks to the film *Black Panther*, which was unanimously and single‑mindedly hailed by critics as an epochal masterpiece on a par with *[Citizen Kane](https://peakd.com/hive-121744/@drax/film-review-citizen-kane-1941)* and *[The Godfather](https://peakd.com/film/@drax/retro-film-review-the-godfather-1972)*, and this attitude was reflected a few years ago in an ‘Oscar’ nomination that was unthinkable for such a genre. However, much like the box‑office records, this achievement had little to do with the quality of the film itself. *Black Panther* acquired its divine status even before its premiere, thanks to an extremely skilful propaganda campaign that made maximum use of the domestic political circumstances in the USA, namely the insistence on ‘political correctness’ and the righting of all the wrongs of American and world history. The titular protagonist of the film is black, and the director was Ryan Coogler, an African‑American filmmaker who had made a name for himself with the politically engaged film *Fruitvale Station*, dedicated to the suffering of African‑Americans at the hands of white police. Thus, *Black Panther* was not only pre‑subscribed to panegyrics, but also inoculated against all negative criticism, given that a bad word about this film would in many circles be interpreted as racism.

The titular protagonist, played by Chadwick Boseman, first appeared in the film *[Captain America: Civil War](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-captain-america-dawn-of-justice-2016)*, where he was introduced as T’Challa, prince of the African nation of Wakanda, who is simultaneously endowed with superhuman powers. The film’s plot at the very beginning seeks to explain where those powers came from and what they have to do with the specificities of his homeland. To the rest of the world, Wakanda is a poor, remote and underdeveloped country surrounded by inaccessible jungles and mountains, which made it uninteresting to white colonisers and thus allowed it to preserve its independence. In reality, a meteorite containing vibranium had fallen on Wakanda millions of years earlier – a precious metal used to produce superior weapons, and on the basis of which the Wakandans created a superior technological civilisation. However, this civilisation is unknown to the outside world due to a policy of self‑isolation that T’Challa, after his father’s death and his ascension to the throne, seeks to maintain. The problem is that two decades earlier, supplies of vibranium were stolen by the South African mercenary Ulysses Klaue (Andy Serkis), with the help of people from within Wakanda itself. T’Challa, together with his associates, goes to South Korea to try to find Klaue, and there he encounters CIA agent Everett Ross (Michael Freeman), who reluctantly helps him. Klaue is captured, but then freed by his aide Killmonger (Michael B. Jordan), who it turns out has not only personal motives for his actions, but also plans to seize power in Wakanda and use its superior technology to take revenge on white nations and peoples for all the evil that black people have suffered throughout history.

At first glance, *Black Panther* could be understood as a kind of antithesis to *Thor* – i.e. Wakanda represents a kind of antithesis to Asgard – a fairy‑tale, wondrous paradise where, instead of blonde and blue‑eyed Nordic whites, only black people live. Many found the epochal nature of the film precisely in the banal fact that all the characters in the film are black, and that it attempts to address some serious global problems from the perspective of African‑Americans, or black people in general. The screenplay by Ryan Coogler and Joe Robert Cole thus seeks to confront the tragic past of colonial conquests, slavery, institutional racism, and its unresolved consequences in the form of poverty, drugs and crime. In doing so, it offers two opposing solutions to the problem – one embodied in racial solidarity, radicalism and violence directed against the oppressor, which more than half a century ago was symbolised by Malcolm X; the other is the path of compromise and non‑violence preached by Martin Luther King and Nelson Mandela. *Black Panther* is distinguished by the fact that these two attitudes are clearly expressed and elaborated through the two main characters, but also that the screenplay does not automatically take sides in this debate – that both positions have their arguments and that the villain will have the opportunity to justify them right up to the end, and the audience will retain at least some understanding for him.

The political engagement of the screenplay – the attempt to talk about serious problems in a truly serious manner – is a great achievement for a film of this genre, but it also carries the risk of doing so at the expense of what matters most to the majority of the audience: colourful escapist entertainment. *Black Panther* mostly manages to avoid this trap, and not only because of the hundreds of millions invested in special effects, but also because of the creative resources that were able to come to the fore. This applies to the successful attempt to present Wakanda simultaneously as a super‑technological utopia, but also as a place that developed naturally and preserved ancient African traditions. An important role is played here by the skilful use of costumes, set design, props, and also the largely effective music of Ludwig Göransson. The direction is also mostly good, and this can come in handy in the scenes of T’Challa’s visions of meeting his deceased ancestors, which will remind some older viewers of the famous 1982 film *[Cat People](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-cat-people-1942)*. Coogler, however, is far less adept at action scenes, so some of them, such as the car chase in the middle of the plot, induce yawns, and even the final battle is not particularly impressive.

The cast, on the other hand, is mostly up to the task. Chadwick Boseman is excellent in the role of a Marvel superhero who distinguishes himself from all others by far greater responsibility and foresight, but also by statesmanlike charisma. Michael B. Jordan, otherwise one of Coogler’s regular collaborators, is more than a worthy adversary. Among the supporting roles, the Guyanese actress Letitia Wright stands out most as T’Challa’s geeky sister Shuri. Some other actors, however, were not so lucky – Martin Freeman mostly functions as a white ‘token’, i.e. his character is the equivalent of the black characters who in earlier times served solely to fill a racial quota. *Black Panther* is far from the unquestionable masterpiece it was described as, but its quality testifies that even a franchise as calculated as Marvel’s can afford something more than mere fist‑fighting.

RATING: 7/10 (+++)

*(Note: The text in the original Croatian version is available [here](https://draxblog.com/2020/05/25/recenzija-crna-pantera-black-panther-2018/).)*

😂

Jack and the Beanstalk?

We sold a house a couple of years ago.  My daughter had her heart set on a price, because we needed that price to buy the house we wanted. Our house was not in good shape.  We painted, and washed, and tore up shrubs.  We polished as best we could and slapped that price tag on the house.  Realtors were skeptical. One offered 1/3 less than what my daughter was going for.  My daughter persisted.  Finally we found a realtor willing to ask our price. 

One potential buyer offered dramatically less than she wanted, at least 25% less.  Two days later a man drove by, jumped out of his car, looked in the garage window and offered very close to asking.  We were stunned, but waited.  A few hours later he offered full price.

What is something worth? It's not an objective value. This man had tried to buy a house in our neighborhood a few months before and missed out.  He had a young child.  We lived in a great school district.  He wanted that house for his child. He wanted that school district for his child. And, he was a contractor, so he could afford to fix the house up.

The house was not worth the money, but it was worth it to him. 

A really lucky day for us.

title.title: [ESP/ENG] Partido de infarto
title.body:
Una introducción necesaria 

El partido de ida de las semifinales de la Champions League entre el París Saint-Germain y el Bayern Múnich, efectuado hoy en el estadio del equipo francés fue una locura de principio a fin. El actual campeón, el PSG, se impuso por 5-4 en el Parque de los Príncipes en un encuentro que ya ha pasado a la historia. El 5-4 final es el marcador con más goles en la historia de unas semifinales de la Champions, lo que demuestra que los dos equipos salieron a buscar la victoria.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNYbCaLDjpj1Y5ZMuyinPornzJAvV1sPGpan7aomxx82B/1777418567234.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/PSG_espanol/status/2049232176076460157?t=U7edii-tX4JmYjUNk02yNg&s=19)



Un festival ofensivo y errores defensivos

Más allá del criterio de los expertos disfruté de un partido que tuvo en los primeros 70 minutos a un PSG dominador y, a falta de 20 minutos ganaba 5-2.

Pero, el Bayer sacó la extirpe de los equipos alemanes que nunca se rinden y fueron a por el partido y, a punto estuvieron de una remontada épica.

A partir de mis apreciaciones, estos son los elementos que destaco de este gran partido.


· Locura de goles: El partido fue un ida y vuelta constante. Harry Kane adelantó al Bayern de penal, pero Kvaratskhelia empató rápidamente. Neves puso el 2-1 de cabeza, Olise igualó el 2-2, y Dembélé anotó el 3-2 antes del descanso tras una mano de Davies.

· Remontada fugaz: En la segunda mitad, el PSG arrolló con dos goles en dos minutos (Kvaratskhelia y Dembélé) para poner el 5-2, dejando al Bayern medio noqueado.

· Reacción bávara: El Bayern demostró una fe inquebrantable. Upamecano acortó distancias de cabeza y Luis Díaz marcó el 5-4 encendiendo la alarma en el equipo de Luis Enrique.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWqMagLKGnEEikHKHDFax2fu5UuhcjjrmS39eV7S93VxJ/1777418881482.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/PSG_espanol/status/2049253166198239668?t=ZeharTCW8_VcvGDiXeb9CA&s=19)


Claves tácticas, fortalezas y debilidades

Paris Saint-Germain

· Fortalezas: Su ataque es brillante, con calidad individual para desequilibrar y una notable efectividad en jugadas de estrategia.
· Debilidades: Muestra fragilidad defensiva, especialmente en jugadas aéreas y a balón parado, algo que el Bayern sabe explotar.

Bayern Múnich

· Fortalezas: Goza de una capacidad de reacción admirable para levantarse en el marcador, una eficacia letal en el juego aéreo y un ataque liderado por Harry Kane y Olise.
· Debilidades: Sufrió desconcentraciones graves en defensa y desconexión entre líneas en las transiciones defensivas.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVjcdsrVMXziTgxLYcBaJqd39YBTHKTYSZbJKCH8tGCBD/1777418247947.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1537637981059270&set=a.813034380186304&type=3&mibextid=rS40aB7S9Ucbxw6v)



Un comentario final 


¿Qué Nos Espera en la Vuelta?

La vuelta será el miércoles 6 de mayo en el Allianz Arena. Con 5-4, la eliminatoria está abierta, pero el PSG parte con ventaja y meter un gol en Múnich sería vital. El Bayern, con su afición, buscará aprovechar su fortaleza ofensiva y meter presión desde el inicio. Esta dinámica promete un partido emocionante, aunque probablemente más controlado y táctico que esta locura de ida.

Nota: Utilicé el traductor DeepL Translate.


ENGLISH 



A Necessary Introduction 

The first leg of the Champions League semi-finals between Paris Saint-Germain and Bayern Munich, held today at the French team's stadium, was crazy from start to finish. The current champions, PSG, won 5-4 at the Parc des Princes in a match that has already gone down in history. The final 5-4 is the score with the most goals in the history of a Champions League semi-final, which shows that both teams went out looking for victory.

An offensive festival and defensive errors

Beyond the criteria of the experts, I enjoyed a match that had a dominant PSG in the first 70 minutes and, with 20 minutes to go, they were leading 5-2.

But, Bayer took the extirpation of the German teams that never give up and went for the game and, on the verge of an epic comeback.

From my assessments, these are the elements that I highlight from this great match.

· Goal madness: The match was a constant back and forth. Harry Kane put Bayern ahead from the penalty spot, but Kvaratskhelia quickly equalised. Neves made it 2-1 with a header, Olise equalised at 2-2, and Dembélé made it 3-2 before half-time after a handball by Davies.

· Fleeting comeback: In the second half, PSG overwhelmed with two goals in two minutes (Kvaratskhelia and Dembélé) to make it 5-2, leaving Bayern half knocked out.

· Bavarian reaction: Bayern showed unwavering faith. Upamecano shortened the deficit with a header and Luis Díaz scored the 5-4, setting off the alarm in Luis Enrique's team.

Tactical keys, strengths and weaknesses

Paris Saint-Germain

· Strengths: Their attack is brilliant, with individual quality to unbalance and a remarkable effectiveness in strategic plays.
· Weaknesses: He shows defensive fragility, especially in aerial plays and set pieces, something that Bayern knows how to exploit.

Bayern Munich

· Strengths: He has an admirable ability to react to get up on the scoreboard, a lethal efficiency in the air and an attack led by Harry Kane and Olise.
· Weaknesses: He suffered serious lack of concentration in defense and disconnection between the lines in defensive transitions.

A final comment 

What Lies in Store in the Vuelta?

The second leg will be on Wednesday, May 6 at the Allianz Arena. At 5-4, the tie is open, but PSG start with an advantage and scoring a goal in Munich would be vital. Bayern, with their fans, will be looking to take advantage of their offensive strength and put pressure on them from the start. This dynamic promises an exciting match, although probably more controlled and tactical than this madness of the first leg.

Note: I used the DeepL Translate translator.
