title.title: 5 Minutes Free Writing - Patent Lie
title.body:
Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - Patent Lie . Hope you enjoy the story.


![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQsrYoCZoBa4O0CuJSnewuXt6L2u0XKPj5x1EaVd1SARg&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQsrYoCZoBa4O0CuJSnewuXt6L2u0XKPj5x1EaVd1SARg&s=10)
[Source](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQsrYoCZoBa4O0CuJSnewuXt6L2u0XKPj5x1EaVd1SARg&s=10)

Sitting in the accused corner, Kent was asked by the judge how does he plead to the charge of a patent lie?

Kent stood up, buttons up his suit and respondes with \

and all parties are set to go to trial.

The charge is brought about by a distributor of Kent's patented machine a weight scale that claim to be able to help regulate metabolism and in turns help users to lose weight.

With a 2 years research period and a whole hard disk of data and research paper. They went ahead to file for patent and recruitment of distributor. Claiming it to be the first of it's kind in the industry. 

His distributor faces question from the customer who is more health conscious and thus were self monitoring the numbers from the scale daily. 

Eventually the customer sees no improvement in the numbers and thus concluded that patent claim of the weight scale is nothing but a hoax and felt cheated , decided to bring a lawsuit to protect other consumer and also to bring justice for the effort she took over the months due to this patent lie.

title.title: ¿Quieres \
cariño? (Es/ En)
title.body:
>


Me encanta la temática de este martes en [Encuentro de Talentos: \

](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-travesuras) y es que nos invitan a hablar de nuestras travesuras, prácticamente a todo tiempo, de niños, adultos... La cuestión es que te vayas a tus recuerdos más recónditos y recuerdes esos momentos que pusieron esa nota divertida y hasta de peligro en tus ocurrencias traviesas, y esto me trajo a la mente unas que aún hoy día lo recuerdo con mucha nitidez de mi infancia. Empecemos.

Cuando tenía como 8 años, recién llegada del pueblo de mi abuela, donde la naturaleza reinaba, llegué a la ciudad a vivir a uno de los tantos barrios y recuerdo que cerca de casa había como un patio, según yo, donde había muchos árboles, plantas, pero este parecía como una colina en descenso. Este lugar quedaba en la casa de una vecina; allí había árboles frutales y demás, pero tenías que descender. Recuerdo que a una amiguita y a mí nos pareció genial meternos allí, bajar por ese cerro y ponernos a jugar a la comidita con lo que teníamos a mano: tierra, piedrecillas, frutas; allí nuestra imaginación era la protagonista, nos perdimos en nuestro juego y no nos percatamos del tiempo.

Hasta que oímos las voces de nuestros padres llamándonos, pero a gritos destemplados; para cuando respondimos, recuerdo que nuestros papás nos gritaron que no nos moviéramos, que ellos nos iban a buscar. Mi amiga y yo nos vimos las caras, pues no entendíamos el porqué de esas instrucciones, pues a nosotras nos parecía fácil salir de donde nos habíamos metido..., pero para cuando vi la cara de mi padre, en el acto supe que estaba en problemas, aunque no entendía por qué. Nuestros padres nos sacaron con gran cuidado y, para cuando reaccionamos, ya estábamos castigadas, aun sin entender qué habíamos hecho.

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23uQrpVZsa5KfdcDaXwjZKwHZp58xGT2zvUaCrfWVpov9k9hgVBdKbkiwvDohGoBYGcbA.png)
[Fuente/ Source](https://gemini.google.com/app/0b4aabd7ef5faecc?utm_source=app_launcher&utm_medium=owned&utm_campaign=base_all)
</center>



Resulta que en ese lugar había habido un deslizamiento de tierra por las lluvias y todo ese terreno estaba propenso a tener nuevos deslizamientos y nosotras nos pudimos haber ido con todo y árboles, plantas y comidita, jajajajaja; nos habíamos metido en una zona peligrosa con riesgo de derrumbes. Después de eso no me quedaron ganas de seguir inspeccionando terrenos desconocidos. Ahora, cuando ya somos adultos, hacemos diferentes tipos de travesuras, pero ya con mucha más conciencia de lo que vamos a hacer; entre varias que se me vienen a la mente, recuerdo una muy divertida.

Cuando estaba trabajando hace ya unos cuantos años, yo tenía a un amigo muy enamoradizo que siempre tenía varias enamoradas. Pero había una chica en especial que a él le gustaba mucho y ella vendía comidas para las oficinas y nos ofrecía sus menús todos los días y él siempre le compraba comida y, para cuando ella lo llamaba por teléfono o le llevaba la comida, él se derretía ante su voz o su presencia. Todos los compañeros de trabajo le hacíamos broma al respecto, hasta que un día a mí y a un amigo en común, también compañero de trabajo, decidimos hacerle una pequeña travesura.



Resulta que yo imitaba muy bien la forma de hablar de la chica y siempre le hacía bromas imitándola, y mi amigo solo se reía al ver la pericia mía para imitar a la chica de sus sueños. Ese día en cuestión, decidimos hacerle una llamada y, por supuesto, me iba a hacer pasar por ella. Recuerdo que ella tenía una forma muy característica de pronunciar la palabra \

de una forma muy sugestiva que a mi amigo le alborotaba las hormonas, ya que parecía que le estaba ofreciendo otras cosas, jajajaja.\n\nEntonces le realicé la llamada, con ese tono sugestivo, ofreciéndole su anhelado \

, y ese hombre cambió la voz, la cara se le puso roja, tartamudeaba; todo esto lo estábamos viendo, ya que realicé la llamada desde una oficina aledaña y las divisiones eran con vidrios, así que lo teníamos en todo su esplendor de alboroto. Llegó un momento en que no aguantamos y las risas nos delataron; él estaba tan embelesado hablando por teléfono que no nos vio. Esa fue la anécdota de la oficina y todavía cuando nos vemos le digo: \

; y eso es motivo para volvernos a reír. Bueno, mis queridos, disfruté mucho contándoles estas anécdotas. Gracias por la propuesta; está genial. ¡Mis saludos!
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/Ep1Zrugx4BiYcpV4Hv2BNMkMpwdThPBy4Yr261o73GxzLousmZAjq7zzCEoqUwtK9ST.png) [Fuente/ Source](https://gemini.google.com/app/0b4aabd7ef5faecc?utm_source=app_launcher&utm_medium=owned&utm_campaign=base_all)

English

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23ywqKdcNtCvef3XLsfWYLqqP51Gyeyq7fRzG6ofksHm6qbmYp9FHZKh8ouq8D2FpYTN2.png)
I love this Tuesday’s theme on [Talent Gathering: “Mischief”](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-travesuras)—it invites us to talk about our mischievous moments, from childhood to adulthood… The idea is to delve into your deepest memories and recall those moments that added a touch of fun—and even danger—to your mischievous antics, and this brought to mind some from my childhood that I still remember very clearly today. Let’s begin. When I was about 8 years old, having just arrived from my grandmother’s village, where nature reigned, I moved to the city to live in one of the many neighborhoods. I remember that near our house there was what I thought of as a courtyard, where there were many trees and plants, but it looked like a sloping hill. This place was on a neighbor’s property; there were fruit trees and such, but you had to go down the slope. I remember that a little friend and I thought it was great to go in there, go down that hill, and start playing house with whatever we had on hand: dirt, pebbles, fruit; there, our imagination took center stage, we got lost in our game, and we didn’t notice the time passing. Until we heard our parents’ voices calling us, but shouting wildly; by the time we answered, I remember our dads yelling at us not to move, that they were coming to get us. My friend and I looked at each other, because we didn’t understand the reason for those instructions—it seemed easy to us to get out of where we’d gotten ourselves into… but when I saw my father’s face, I knew right away that I was in trouble, even though I didn’t understand why. Our parents pulled us out with great care, and by the time we realized what was happening, we were already grounded, still without understanding what we’d done. It turns out that there had been a landslide in that area due to the rain, and the whole area was prone to further landslides—we could have been swept away along with the trees, plants, and snacks, hahahahaha; we had wandered into a dangerous zone at risk of landslides. After that, I lost all desire to keep exploring unfamiliar terrain. Now that we’re adults, we get into all kinds of mischief, but with much more awareness of what we’re doing; among the many things that come to mind, I remember one that was really funny. A few years ago, when I was working, I had a friend who was a real romantic and always had several girlfriends. But there was one girl in particular he really liked—she sold food to the offices and offered us her menus every day. He always bought food from her, and whenever she called him on the phone or brought him his meal, he’d melt at the sound of her voice or her presence. All of us coworkers would tease him about it, until one day a mutual friend of ours—who was also a coworker—and I decided to play a little prank on him. It turns out I was really good at imitating the way the girl spoke, and I’d always joke around by mimicking her, and my friend would just laugh at how skillfully I could imitate the girl of his dreams. On that particular day, we decided to give him a call, and of course, I was going to pretend to be her. I remember she had a very distinctive way of pronouncing the word “pasticho” in a very suggestive way that really got my friend’s hormones racing, since it sounded like she was offering him other things, hahaha. So I made the call, using that suggestive tone, offering him his longed-for “pastichito,” and that guy changed his voice, his face turned red, he stuttered; we could see all of this, since I made the call from a nearby office and the partitions were made of glass, so we had him in all his flustered glory. There came a point when we couldn’t hold it in anymore, and our laughter gave us away; he was so engrossed in talking on the phone that he didn’t see us. That was the office anecdote, and even now when we see each other, I say to him, “Hi, sweetheart, do you want a pastichito?”—and that’s enough to make us laugh all over again. Well, my dears, I really enjoyed sharing these stories with you. Thanks for the invitation; it’s great. Best regards!

title.body:
[![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWa5VzutxvhDfu5KQ4dfec5anhuJyqUWGc7cdxpXEiwFy/459d56d5e3779ce9c5ef19d69e93a9fb)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=valentinazoera/49752589)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=valentinazoera/49752589)


---

Hola Amiguitos y Papitos! Espero hayan pasado unas felices fiestas navideñas al lado de sus familias y seres queridos. Recitaré mi último poema de este año 2020, escrito por el poeta y escritor salvadoreño Alfredo Espino, el poema se llama: Luna en el Rancho, deseo de todo corazón les guste y que los disfruten muchísimo.

Alfredo Espino, es el poeta niño que a través del tiempo nos hace sentir con sus versos la belleza de la vida del campo, la pureza del amor, del arte y la literatura que está plasmada en toda su obra poética en Jícaras Tristes, que es un poemario de los más leídos y de gran difusión, por su estilo sencillo y su capacidad descriptiva de hacerte sentir cada elemento del campo y de la naturaleza.

Quiero dedicar este poema con mucho cariño y agradecimiento a todos mis suscriptores, siento mucha gratitud por confiar en mi trabajo, les mando mis mejores deseos, mucha salud, trabajo, prosperidad y sobre todo, sean felices y aprovechemos cada día desde el amor y la felicidad.

¡Espero disfruten muchísimo el poema: Luna en el Rancho, de Alfredo Espino!😉
FELIZ AÑO NUEVO 2021 Y BENDICIONES TOTALES 🙏✨🎁

title.title: Bitbank Launches Japan’s First Visa Card for Direct Bitcoin Bill Payments with 0.5% Crypto Rewards
title.body: https://img.leopedia.io/DQmY4fMnS4KEG3mLpbA24RFGcr2oe36VwqgxT8xnrdhHYM2/japanbtccredit.png \n\nJapanese cryptocurrency exchange Bitbank, a licensed entity under the Financial Services Agency (FSA), has officially bridged the gap between digital assets and traditional retail finance. In a strategic partnership with Epos Card, a subsidiary of the Marui Group, Bitbank has introduced the \

card. This Visa-based credit instrument represents a significant milestone in Japan’s regulatory landscape, becoming the first credit card from a regulated exchange to allow users to settle monthly bills directly using Bitcoin (BTC) from their exchange accounts.

**The Mechanism of Integrated Settlement**
Unlike traditional crypto cards that often require manual liquidation into fiat before spending, the EPOS CRYPTO card automates this process at the point of repayment. When a user settles their monthly credit statement, the system automatically sells the necessary amount of Bitcoin at the prevailing platform price to cover the yen-denominated debt. This systems-level integration reduces friction for long-term holders (HODLers) who wish to utilize their assets for daily expenses like utilities, dining, or retail shopping without exiting the crypto ecosystem entirely.

**Data-Driven Rewards and Strategy**
The card’s value proposition is centered on a 0.5% cashback rate, paid in cryptocurrency. Users have the flexibility to choose their reward currency among Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), or Astar (ASTR). These rewards are deposited directly into the user’s Bitbank account, creating a self-reinforcing loop of asset accumulation. From a data perspective, this move targets the retail segment that seeks \

exposure to crypto through everyday consumption.

**Regulatory and Market Context**
Japan has long been known for its stringent but clear regulatory framework for digital assets. The launch of this card signifies a \

that Bitbank is now leading. By utilizing the Visa network, the card is accepted at millions of merchants globally, effectively transforming a Bitbank balance into global purchasing power. However, users must remain mindful of the tax implications inherent in Japan's \

during the settlement process, as each bill payment triggers a taxable event. This product is a calculated step toward the mainstreaming of Web3 infrastructure in one of the world’s most advanced financial markets.

The bagworm has a unique way of surviving the body, namely by building its nest from leaves and silk that is shaped like a pagoda, the shape of this bag is what makes me interested in capturing its beauty, this canton functions as camouflage and protection from predators and extreme weather, and cities often find it attached tightly to the leaves. However, this is a very serious pest and should not be allowed, this caterpillar can eat various leaves and can make holes in it, but this one caterpillar continues to be in the bag so we cannot see it directly, if we are curious about the shape of the caterpillar then we must damage the silk bag first, because the contents are in the bag. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWbD7StgSop2h3yfvQjshiZZMAm1qPpPK3162nufSzDh4/img_20260416_wa0084.jpg) Honestly, I really like the shape of the silk pouch, it looks like a naturally constructed pagoda, this is one of the caterpillars that has extraordinary natural architectural skills, but it is a pest. ![1000006789.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theithei/23xpALazLPd5aMcwpzNbdh3MZ4YZZXVaC6XEABUC5V6pnFDXu9kSQnQh4wAWsWtquypUz.png)


Here is another round of the Doodle Magic challenge. This time, I started with a bright blue abstract shape that had some sharp, jagged points on one side and a long tail on the other. Looking at the movement I immediately saw hair caught in a massive gust of wind.
Used that original blue silhouette as the absolute anchor for the entire hairstyle. The way the shape flickers at the back and sweeps across the top felt so natural for a character in motion like saying hello and waving. From there i  built a simple, expressive face and a bright pink collared shirt to create a fun, high contrast look against the dark purple background.
Stuck to my favorite clean and flat aesthetic for this one. It’s always such a satisfying puzzle to take a random, organic blob and find the human personality hiding inside it.
Why not give it a try?

title.body:
You see, interest rates are one of the main tools governments and central banks use to control inflation and stabilize the economy. When interest rates rise, borrowing becomes more expensive. This affects individuals which reduces spending overall. When spending drops, demand for goods and services falls, and that helps slow down inflation.

So my friend, it shows that the knock-on effect on developing countries is significant. Many of them depend on foreign investment and loans, often in stronger currencies like the US dollar. When first world countries raise interest rates, investors pull money out of developing economies and move it to safer, higher return markets. This can weaken developing countries currencies, increase their debt burden, and drive up inflation locally, especially for imported goods like fuel and food.

And yes system is evolving. Just take the last five years as example. 
The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted global supply chains, leading to shortages and inflation. Governments responded with massive stimulus spending, which boosted demand but also contributed to rising prices. Then came aggressive interest rate hikes, especially in major economies, to control that inflation. At the same time, digital transformation accelerated remote work, e-commerce, and digital payments became central, not optional.

Don't misquote, the system is likely to evolve also in a few key ways like:

**More regional trade blocs instead of full global dependence.**

**Greater use of digital currencies and financial technology.**

**Stronger focus on energy transition and sustainability.**

**Continued tension between growth and inflation control.**

So when I say the system is evolving, I mean it is moving from a highly globalized, efficiency driven model to one that is more cautious, technology driven, and influenced by geopolitical and environmental realities

Do you understand?

title.title: Las travesuras || Encuentro de talentos
title.body:
> Saludos mi gente bella y positiva,hoy estoy animada de estar en esta gran comunidad **EmpoderarTalent**, deseándole muchas Bendiciones. Es grato estar participando en la iniciativa de mi querida amiga @angelica7, la cual invita esta semana en [ Encuentro de Talentos]( https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-travesuras ), con el Tema **Las travesuras**. > _Greetings, my beautiful and positive friends! Today I’m thrilled to be part of this wonderful **EmpoderarTalent** community, and I wish you all many blessings. It’s a pleasure to be participating in the initiative of my dear friend @angelica7, who is hosting this week’s [Talent Gathering]( https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-travesuras ), with the theme **Mischief**._
![GridArt_20260428_123406683.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EouBgdZZMkpaz8xaY6eT3XeexcQYvh6VbbMKYNvceFbCyA7eiq6iWHg4FerVgxBW5Fp.jpg)

> Este tema siempre lo tenemos presente en las conversaciones familiares, cuando nos reunimos, contando todas las anécdotas, y es que las travesuras forman parte de nuestra niñez y motivo de risas, así que todos hemos pasado por muchas travesuras. > This topic always comes up in our family conversations when we get together and share all our stories—after all, mischief is part of our childhood and a source of laughter, so we’ve all been through plenty of it.
![IMG_20260419_122013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/Ep5q8bMzEVQrgQchn5syQBc2Gy54dJdoyXBoXTRUSnPihJXhAzLhgUw5YoXnVx8ycQu.jpg)

> Recuerdo algunas travesuras que cometí. Aquí en mi casa, había un gran árbol de jovito, una fruta amarilla como un ají entre agridulce, muy sabrosa. Mis amiguitos venían a jugar conmigo y estaban pendientes; cuando goteaba uno, salían corriendo a tomarla. Una vez estábamos jugando cuando se me ocurrió lanzar ají dulce que mi madre siempre tenía, y la lancé cuando una niña tomó el ají pensando que era jovito y la mordió, y enseguida la escupió. Todos empezamos a reír; cuando mi madre se enteró, me regañó. >I remember some of the mischief I got into. Here at my house, there was a big jovito tree—a yellow fruit that looked like a chili pepper, with a bittersweet taste, very tasty. My little friends would come over to play with me, and they were always on the lookout; whenever one fell, they’d run out to grab it. Once we were playing when it occurred to me to throw a sweet chili pepper that my mother always had, and I threw it just as a girl picked up the pepper thinking it was a jovito and bit into it, and immediately spit it out. We all started laughing; when my mother found out, she scolded me.
![IMG_20260424_091800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23uR19y2EyrfYWnDb94dpFc9Pq4PE4atrp8T9JvFKyAwQe1poGQLFuTcMAnZj5QpAKkxs.jpg)

> Otra de mis anécdotas de travesuras fue cuando estudiaba; le dije a mi madre que iba a estudiar con mis amigas porque teníamos un examen de Matemática y estaba muy difícil. Ese día nos fuimos a la playa; resulta que cuando llegué a casa me castigaron por una semana; ya mi madre estaba enterada porque una vecina le había dicho. >Another one of my mischievous stories was when I was in school. I told my mom I was going to study with my friends because we had a math test and it was really hard. That day, we went to the beach instead. It turns out that when I got home, I was grounded for a week—my mom already knew what had happened because a neighbor had told her.
![IMG_20260422_120633.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/Ep1Zqvf5M1K9Ce3RPdgovcWheCyGyAumDSJGQJRzwaJMVhYzNpJGRq9Lx42rtizdoau.jpg)

> Hoy estaba chatendo con mis compañeros de estudios del pasado, por medio del WhatsApp— cuando estabamos en la secundaria, alli en ese grupo contamos las travesuras que cometimos cuando eramos adolescentes y bueno reimos demás, un amigo conto cuando cambiaban los examenes, o cuando iban a la cantina y le decian a la venderora no me has dado el vuelto de 5 Bfs, cuando no haia pagado, pues eran tantos estudiantes que iban a la cantina que volvian loca a la cantinera, que no se daba cuanta y caia en gran travesura. > Today I was chatting with my old classmates on WhatsApp—the same group we had back in high school. In that group, we were reminiscing about the mischief we got into as teenagers, and we laughed our heads off. One friend told a story about when they’d swap exams, or when they’d go to the cantina and tell the cashier, “You didn’t give me my 5 BFS change,” even though they hadn’t paid, There were so many students going to the cafeteria that they drove the cashier crazy; she didn’t realize what was happening and fell for their big prank.
![IMG_20260427_183649.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23xySdGufWfSVytVQKCXTTkeKHhXiYUpsD48GbMDWzQgNdaVPVAyacLmoiwdVWcWUTBDd.jpg)

> Hay muchas travesuras cuando ya estamos adultos, pero de manera más concientes, para activar esa diversión o juego. No hace mucho asisti a una fiesta y comenzamos a bailoar, una de mis amigas se quito los zapatos y se los escondimos, esa mujer paso mucho tiempo buscandolo, luego hicimos especie de rifa y se los ganó jejeje. Otro dia también metimos unos cubiernos en la cartera d euna amiga, cuando llego a su casa que abrió su cartera vio sus cubiernos y bueno fue risa y risa nunca supo quien de nostras lo hizo. > We get up to all sorts of mischief as adults, but in a more deliberate way, just to have some fun or play around. Not long ago, I went to a party and we started dancing. One of my friends took off her shoes, and we hid them. She spent ages looking for them, and then we held a sort of raffle, and she ended up winning them back, hehehe. Another day, we also put some shoes in a friend’s purse. When she got home and opened her purse, she saw the shoes, and well, it was nonstop laughter—she never found out which one of us did it.
![IMG_20260418_175613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EqYvg8oUVzNsvbipS23fx5nEzXoMWeEF2ZgF192j1YA5pn1NwrtP3TSvrpEy5NDyquB.jpg)
Me encantó escribir estás líneas dando mi opinión de este tema, que tiene mucha tela que cortar. Invito a participar a @marabuzal **Gracias por su atención, hasta la próxima, mis aventureros.** >I loved writing these lines to share my thoughts on this topic, which has a lot to unpack. I invite you to join the conversation @marabuzal . **Thank you for your attention, and until next time, my adventurers.**
![IMG_20260418_175016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/242DETFFaXdTmVYCmYzGu5GFB81LZNssmcZZqZ3RYe2nDVPGho7udhowoc2zNkHojwGSa.jpg)

title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVhBT523R5GQDMTTv9ps17iWmFsaPPHWjphfXa8eddbFg/1000174827.jpg 
[source](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/rag-doll-with-puzzle-pieces-floor_948189.htm#fromView=search&page=3&position=19&uuid=dea06272-7c92-41d3-b2ba-ef75d84ca4a9&query=Problem+solving+AI+generated+)
This is a fact that many are very ignorant of. It can be the situation of things and those that know when, where and how to step in stay in real [profit](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-profit). I hope you are not left in the complainers cadre of [life](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-life). It was one of those things I was looking at. Maybe I may write a broader [article](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-article) concerning how tech has been stepping in but for today, let's focus on those who dare to become problem solvers.  

We are living in a [world](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-world) where many do their best to avoid problems. So what's a problem? Ok, I have not focused on things like ‘personal palava’. As an [entrepreneur](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-entrepreneur), one can define a problem as an [opportunity](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-opportunity). Personally, I call a problem ‘a pending transaction’. It is a [transaction](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-transaction) hanging and just waiting for who is actually due to have it.  

It was one of those news last [year](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-year) that Aso Rock is owning electrical bills in millions or well, I think it was in the billions. What was the [Next](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-next-2007-film) step the [government](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-government) made? I actually don't know if the bill was cleared but Aso Rock Villa [NOW](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-negotiable-order-of-withdrawal-account-now) uses [solar](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-solar). Did you see that coming?.   

The problem of steady and reliable [electricity](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-electricity) has been a pain in the neck for Nigerian citizens. Opt for a generator and you will spend a [lot](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-lot-commodities) on gas fees and machine maintenance too. I think [Power](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-power-1986-film) [banks](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-bank) has become a norm nowadays. Actually, I decided to give mine out when I bought my new smart phone last year and the battery has been very durable. Before it will be able to run out, there should be general electricity as it was normal as of last year when we were at the comfort of 18 hours electricity least on a daily basis.  

The situation changed late last year and has worsened. We hardly even enjoy 5 hours of general electricity in a whole 24 hours as I am currently speaking. It doesn't really affect my [smartphone](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-smartphone) actually because I can do a recharging while in the office working with our generator and I must add, those producing smart phones saw the early need to [address](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-address) this problem by opting for long lasting phone battery life.  

Where are we heading to in this article? The fact is this; people are looking for where to store [energy](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-energy-industry) for reserve purposes or better still, a new way of creating their own dependent [energy](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-energy). My [brother](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-brother) decided to [buy](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-buy) me a rechargeable fan; a gift I really appreciated. So what did he discover; the poor electricity circulation is making sleep [time](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-time) not very enjoyable. After [loads](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-load-mutual-fund) of [work](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-work) in the office, you will have to come and manage sleeping in a hot house.

And he made a very smart decision, a rechargeable fan was the needed alternative. At least it can be charged in the office during work hours and used while in the house.   

The fan itself is very portable and surprisingly generates a good spin to give one a comfortable night sleep. Think of having an extra 10 hours of cool breeze without electricity. I am just imagining how fast these fans will spread because I am already planning to buy one for someone and of course he will be introducing someone else too and it goes on and on.   

A [company](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-company-business) has just stepped in to solve the problem of after general electricity. We haven't even entered into the aspect of solar because this is one of my main targets both for office and home use. title.title: Wie lange braucht Bürokratie um zu funktionieren
title.body:
Hallo Freunde,

ich weiß nicht wie ich das ganze erklären soll, aber ich habe immer mehr das Gefühl ich stecke in einem Hamsterrad der Verwaltung, bei der jede Handlung so lange braucht, dass man nichts auf die Reihe bekommen kann. Man stößt etwas an und dann braucht es manchmal Jahre bis irgendwas anläuft und beginnt zu funktionieren. Und dann ist es meistens zu spät. Ich meine wenn man Monate braucht um eine Spendenquittung auszustellen, wie soll es dann weiter gehen? Wie soll man dann erwarten, dass andere bereit sind eine Spende abzugeben? Wenn man dann wieder Monate darauf warten darf, dass man die Spendenquittung bekommt? Und nicht nur dort. Ich hasse es manchmal im öffentlichen Dienst zu sein, weil wir es nicht auf die Reihe bekommen innerhalb von Tagen auf Probleme zu reagieren. Und dann hat man mal eine Antwort auf das was man gebraucht hat, mehrere Monate nachdem man eine Anfrage gestellt hat. 

Und dann ist die Antwort meistens nichtmal brauchbar und wenn man etwas machen muss, dann rennt man immer wieder gegen Wände und darf sich dann die Frage stellen, was man hier eigentlich macht. Aber hey, was soll ich sagen, irgendwie funktioniert es seit Jahrzehnten und wie das funktioniert... Keine Ahnung. 

Mal schauen wie es weiter geht. In diesem Sinne, gehabt euch wohl.

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 27 2026
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f2639bb8-c4e9-40c9-9b3a-aeb7a2875ff4.jpg) Hey Actifitters, Yesterday really didn't go as planned, and as a result I don't have much steps to show for it, and even less photos. It started normally though with a few breaks in the yard during the day. Of course, Le Chat never stops making us laugh. Something as simple as planes flying over will make her very worried. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/41eb0395-d9a2-4ab2-80e7-652cc4d767e1.jpg) But in the afternoon, before sundown, when we started our walk in the small forest behind the front yard, that's when all fell apart. I got a call from my managers and even though I tried to deal with it while walking in the forest, it was pretty clear that I had to walk back to my desk. I hadn't even had time to snap a single photo before we were already walking back... Much later, we went again in the small forest, which was very dark by then. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e3846105-171f-4ab8-ab68-3ef0566c7dd6.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/de2f29b1-726d-4857-92cf-a952afe0ecfe.jpg) Kaia looked a bit confused, it's not easy to jump over obstacles in full darkness! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/016cd96f-e9be-45f7-bcce-4ee8c7cb0697.jpg) Plus there was something else more interesting: Le Chat joined us. All we could see at first were her two glowing eyes and there she was. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bccf143c-3c90-45da-9970-7f717958a6a5.jpg) Well, like I said, definitely not what the plan was. Low step count, not enough outdoor time, not our best day! And more things to do for work in the next few days. I'm not sure I'll be able to go for another run, but of course we will try and make sure we take better walks with Kaia. As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow.

title.title: Así disfrutamos en Cracovia [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
> ## Español Hola a todos! como les conté en el post anterior, el fin de semana pasado estuvo mi amigo Luis en Polonia visitandonos y además de ir a conversar con él en la pizzería, el día sabado decidimos ir todos juntos a la hermosa ciudad de Cracovia donde la pasamos maravilloso, primero porque tuvimos un clima muy bueno y fresco, ideal para caminar por las increíbles calles de Cracovia, y segundo por la maravillosa compañía. Ahora bien, la primera parada fue en el centro de Sosnowiec, ya que tomaríamos el tren allí para ir a Cracovia, y como este tardaba un poco, decidimos parar en un restaurante donde Pawel y Luis se refrescaron con una cerveza y Olivia y yo los acompañamos comiendo frutas jajaja. Una vez en Cracovia, nos pusimos a recorrer las calles, donde nos dimos cuenta que ahora sí se empieza a notar la primavera, lo cual es maravilloso, además estuvimos un rato viendo cocinar a los participantes del MasterChef ya que el programa se estaba transmitiendo desde Cracovia y nosotros estabamos tomando algo en frente de ellos. Entre caminar, hacer fotos, comer delicioso y tomar alguna cerveza se nos pasó el día y la verdad es que estuvo increíble, Luis probó un plato polaco que no había comido antes y visitamos un rooftop que ninguno conocíamos por lo que fué una experiencia única que me encantaría repetir, además Olivia se portó de maravilla por lo que pudimos estar hasta la noche allí disfrutando. Así que sí, recorrer Cracovia con amigos, disfrutar de una deliciosa comida y una fresca cerveza es una experiencia que recomiendo, pues nosotros la pasamos genial y esperamos repetir un día así pronto. ## English Hi everyone! As I mentioned in my previous post, my friend Luis was visiting us in Poland last weekend. Besides meeting up with him at the pizzeria, on Saturday we all decided to go together to the beautiful city of Kraków, where we had a wonderful time—first, because the weather was lovely and cool, perfect for strolling through Kraków’s incredible streets, and second, because of the wonderful company. Now, our first stop was downtown Sosnowiec, since we were going to take the train there to go to Krakow, and since it was taking a while, we decided to stop at a restaurant where Pawel and Luis cooled off with a beer and Olivia and I joined them by eating fruit, hahaha. Once in Krakow, we set out to explore the streets, where we realized that spring is definitely starting to show, which is wonderful. We also spent some time watching the MasterChef contestants cook since the show was being broadcast from Krakow and we were having a drink right in front of them. Between walking, taking photos, eating delicious food, and having a few beers, the day flew by, and honestly, it was incredible. Luis tried a Polish dish he’d never had before, and we visited a rooftop bar none of us had been to before, so it was a unique experience I’d love to repeat. Plus, Olivia was such a good girl, so we were able to stay there until nightfall, enjoying ourselves. So yes, exploring Kraków with friends, enjoying a delicious meal and a cold beer is an experience I highly recommend—we had a great time and hope to do it again soon.

title.title: Faith and Spirituality: What the Law could not do, because human nature was weak, God did. Romans 8:3
title.body: The letter to the Romans is perhaps the epistle that best expresses the theological thought of the apostle Paul. In it, the apostle Paul presented himself as a profound expert on the doctrine of the Kingdom of God and its law, with the intention of training the fledgling Church of Rome in the Christian faith.\nAnd in the letter written by the apostle, there is a passage referring to the limitation of the law of Moses with respect to the grace of God. And about this, the apostle Paul agreed with the teachings of the apostle James when in his letter he explained that the higher spiritual gifts such as wisdom, which are so necessary for an adult Christian, cannot be obtained through the works of the law but by firmly and faithfully asking God for these gifts. However, there is something that cannot be overlooked. The spiritual gifts are fundamentally a gift from God to men, gifts that men, and this is true, can gradually come closer through listening to and living the word of wisdom.\nAnd to clarify the relationship of the law of Moses with the gift of faith, the apostle Paul wrote: \
Romans 4:16. And then Paul, to reinforce his thinking, wrote about overcoming the law through the sacrifice of Christ: \

Romans 8:3.
Christian spirituality is ultimately an invitation to a new freedom, the freedom of the children of Israel according to the spirit, and this freedom is directly related to spiritual gifts, and not with the accomplishment of imperatives, prohibitions, and orders. Because with Christ, there is a new law that frees men from the slavery of the flesh and leads them to the freedom of the spirit. Growing in grace, as Paul taught, is growing in that faith which, based on the word of wisdom, bears fruit of life.
![Faith and Spirituality. What the Law could not do, because human nature was weak, God did. Romans 8,3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmehtV21DnJVp7jAHzZYPsVrYQ4eDtmj9VYyTDND5eWZKj/Faith%20and%20Spirituality.%20What%20the%20Law%20could%20not%20do,%20because%20human%20nature%20was%20weak,%20God%20did.%20Romans%208,3.jpg)

title.title: La Prisa - Mensaje diario de 5 minutos
title.body:
La gente corre, incluso, cuando no sabe muy bien hacia dónde va.  
La prisa se ha convertido en una especie de estado permanente, y si algo tarda, sentimos que estamos perdiendo el tiempo.  

Mientras más rápido intentamos vivir, menos nos alcanza el tiempo y es porque en esa carrera dejamos de hacer algo fundamental: detenernos a mirar con calma lo que nos rodea, escuchar con atención a quienes tenemos cerca, disfrutar del momento que no produce nada, pero que lo significa todo.  

La prisa es útil para llegar a tiempo, pero cuando se convierte en forma de vida, termina robándonos algo mucho más valioso: la posibilidad de vivir realmente lo que nos está pasando.  

Recuerda, la vida no ocurre cuando todo está resuelto, ocurre mientras pasa el tiempo que estamos intentando resolver.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeA5ubuHagj21ZwgWjPnYDxfdLWaYAFNuywnGF6S6Ehwt/1777415620295.jpg)

ENGLISH

People rush, even when they don't quite know where they're going.

Haste has become a kind of permanent state, and if something takes time, we feel like we're wasting it.

The faster we try to live, the less time we have, and that's because in that race we stop doing something fundamental: stopping to calmly observe our surroundings, listening attentively to those close to us, enjoying the moment that produces nothing, but means everything.

Haste is useful for arriving on time, but when it becomes a way of life, it ends up robbing us of something much more valuable: the possibility of truly experiencing what's happening to us.

Remember, life doesn't happen when everything is resolved; it happens while we're trying to resolve the time that passes.

title.title: Communication is key / La comunicación es clave - LOH #286 (eng-esp)
title.body:
Greetings, everyone.

I have two children, and since they were born, I've understood that my main responsibility isn't just to give them material things, but to build a solid foundation of self-confidence.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfLkhWFzHbQHuXtg4SHwjHm9SMmH6tFe6xrtxdhrUGdxM/1777404695509.jpg)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/school-bullying-teenager-lonely-9060270/)

Something I emphasize a lot is working on their self-esteem every day. I don't do it with empty words or pats on the back telling them they're beautiful no matter what, but with concrete actions: I acknowledge their achievements, I correct them without humiliating them, I listen without interrupting, and I never minimize what they tell me.


If a child grows up knowing that their worth doesn't depend on the opinions of others, when a cruel comment or classroom taunt comes along, that blow won't destroy them. It will hurt, of course, but it won't define who they are. That's the first line of defense against bullying.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc1U1npAeknukNoViq7ceU52z7qu3D6YWiQmv8w7tFn93/1777404771247.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/vectors/bullying-stop-bullying-rubber-stamp-7208740/)

The second is communication. In my house, there are no taboo subjects or uncomfortable questions. My children know they can talk to me and their mother about anything because we've already been through it all. I was a child, I was a teenager, I was in a Cuban classroom with forty students where the law of the strongest prevailed daily.

I survived and learned from all of that.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRtusXRbYneCgdbcqT5P6NFxDEWiL7rVYwyF4daeeKrxv/1777404900826.jpg)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/insult-bullying-sadness-depression-7690957/)

Now, as an adult, I have the psychological tools to help them. But those tools are useless if they don't trust me enough to tell me what's happening to them.

The abuser relies on the silence of their victim, and most victims, unfortunately, choose to appease the abuser in this regard.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPm2tDrcpzDBhpAy5UFqi1cSSFwkPcxZJcynTYLVXHNs5/1777405016965.jpg)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/stop-enough-it-is-enough-politics-1001138/)

That's why I insist so much that they talk. I don't scold them when they tell me something difficult. I don't react with violence or despair. First I listen, then I think, and then I act, always keeping them informed every step of the way. There's no other way. Communication is the only real vaccine against bullying.

***
**Leer en español**
***

Saludos, estimadas.

Tengo dos hijos y desde que nacieron entendí que mi principal responsabilidad no era darles cosas materiales solamente, sino construirles una base sólida de seguridad personal. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfLkhWFzHbQHuXtg4SHwjHm9SMmH6tFe6xrtxdhrUGdxM/1777404695509.jpg)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/school-bullying-teenager-lonely-9060270/)

Algo que hago con bastante énfasis es trabajar todos los días en su autoestima. No lo hago con discursos vacíos ni con palmaditas en la espalda diciéndoles que son bellos como quiera, sino con hechos concretos: reconozco sus logros, corrijo sin humillar, escucho sin interrumpir y jamás minimizo lo que me cuentan. 

Si un niño crece sabiendo que su valor no depende de la opinión ajena, cuando llegue el comentario cruel o la burla del aula, ese golpe no lo va a destruir. Le va a doler, claro, pero no va a definir quién es. Esa es la primera trinchera contra el acoso escolar. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc1U1npAeknukNoViq7ceU52z7qu3D6YWiQmv8w7tFn93/1777404771247.png)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/vectors/bullying-stop-bullying-rubber-stamp-7208740/)

La segunda es la comunicación. En mi casa no hay temas prohibidos ni preguntas incómodas. Mis hijos saben que pueden hablar conmigo y con su madre sobre cualquier cosa porque nosotros ya pasamos por todo eso. Yo fui niño, yo fui adolescente, yo estuve en un aula cubana con cuarenta alumnos donde la ley del más fuerte se imponía a diario. 
Yo sobreviví y aprendí de todo eso. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRtusXRbYneCgdbcqT5P6NFxDEWiL7rVYwyF4daeeKrxv/1777404900826.jpg)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/insult-bullying-sadness-depression-7690957/)

Ahora de adulto tengo las herramientas psicológicas para ayudarlos. Pero esas herramientas no sirven de nada si ellos no confían en mí para contarme lo que les pasa. 
El abusador confía en el silencio de su víctima y la mayoría de víctimas deciden complacer al abusador en este aspecto, lamentablemente. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPm2tDrcpzDBhpAy5UFqi1cSSFwkPcxZJcynTYLVXHNs5/1777405016965.jpg)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/stop-enough-it-is-enough-politics-1001138/)

Por eso insisto tanto en que hablen. No regaño cuando me dicen algo difícil. No reacciono con violencia ni con desesperación. Primero escucho, luego pienso y después actúo, siempre con ellos al tanto de cada paso. No hay otra fórmula. La comunicación es la única vacuna real contra el acoso.

title.title: NBA Playoffs: Jokić Shines, the Thunder Sweep, and the Magic Work Their Magic in Orlando (English/Spanish)
title.body:
![gettyimages-2272966621-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/23tm7PreF1vRufYrT2WLJEHMcTi47r383zXRmRjNizXmc4vuaRKcZJvAfM8KrpyHYrsJy.png)


This Monday, April 27, will go down in the history of these playoffs as the day the champion’s experience refused to fade and the Thunder’s youth proved they are no longer just a promise, but a dominant force.

🏔️ Denver Nuggets 125 - 113 Minnesota Timberwolves

Series status: Minnesota leads 3-2

At Ball Arena in Colorado, the Nuggets played with their hearts on their sleeves to avoid elimination. After the scare in the previous games, Denver tightened the screws and secured a vital 12-point victory that forces a Game 6.

Nikola Jokić gave a masterclass in all-around basketball with a triple-double of 27 points, 12 rebounds, and 16 assists. The “Joker” controlled the pace of the game from start to finish.

Jamal Murray stepped up in the clutch moments, scoring 24 points, while the surprise of the night was Spencer Jones, who came off the bench to contribute 20 crucial points.


![gettyimages-2272974214-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/23u5zYyQdib87gKpfJ97Xdmpbr7LQ2K1FBtLfXnYExT7NDwKNPqZH3TSzHVPbTsGU8QFa.png)


Without Anthony Edwards on the court (who missed the game due to an ankle injury), Julius Randle took the lead with 27 points, but it wasn’t enough to stop the home team’s offense. The series returns to Minnesota, where the Wolves will try to close it out in front of their home crowd.

🌵 Phoenix Suns 122 - 131 Oklahoma City Thunder

Series status: OKC wins 4-0 (ADVANCES)

The Suns' dream is over. The Thunder showed no mercy at the Footprint Center and completed the sweep, proving they are the hottest team in the West.

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was once again unstoppable with 31 points and 8 assists.

Chet Holmgren posted an impressive double-double of 24 points and 12 rebounds, thwarting any comeback attempts in the paint.

Despite 24 points from Devin Booker and 23 from Jalen Green, the Suns never managed to figure out OKC’s defensive rotation. Phoenix heads home with many doubts about their project, while Oklahoma awaits their opponent well-rested.

![gettyimages-2272966646-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/23tvVh1C1upvN3GEAjvjY3FQQJrqEeGaQTyRsxfWjEtxGeesyPA1XLK1zu5mS9ZWC7w9C.png)


🪄 Orlando Magic 94 - 88 Detroit Pistons

Series status: Orlando leads 3-1

In an old-school slugfest, the kind where every basket is hard-fought, the Magic managed to impose their defense at home to put Detroit on the ropes.

Orlando’s defense held the Pistons under 90 points. Desmond Bane was the offensive engine with 22 points, backed by Franz Wagner, who scored 19 before leaving the game with an injury.


![gettyimages-2273464926-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/23tbnkKYUNRHVuxRgha88CuzxZ6pA7pTFk45FyrxWaNDPbD3ZVDawzzio2Pmjkzixfm2z.png)


Detroit now has to win three straight games if it wants to advance, a mission that seems impossible given the energy this Orlando team is displaying.

#### NBA Playoffs: Jokić se agiganta, el Thunder barre y el Magic pone la magia en Orlando

La jornada de este lunes 27 de abril pasará a la historia de estos playoffs como el día en que la veteranía del campeón se negó a morir y la juventud del Thunder confirmó que ya no es una promesa, sino una realidad dominante.

🏔️ Denver Nuggets 125 - 113 Minnesota Timberwolves

Estado de la serie: Minnesota lidera 3-2

En el Ball Arena de Colorado, los Nuggets jugaron con el corazón en la mano para evitar la eliminación. Tras el susto de los juegos anteriores, Denver ajustó las tuercas y se llevó una victoria vital de 12 puntos que obliga a un Juego 6.

Nikola Jokić dio una clase magistral de baloncesto total con un triple-doble de 27 puntos, 12 rebotes y 16 asistencias. El \

controló el ritmo del partido de principio a fin.

Jamal Murray apareció en los momentos calientes sumando 24 puntos, mientras que la sorpresa de la noche fue Spencer Jones, quien viniendo desde el banco aportó 20 puntos fundamentales.

Sin Anthony Edwards en cancha (quien se perdió el juego por la lesión del tobillo), Julius Randle tomó el liderazgo con 27 puntos, pero no fue suficiente para frenar la ofensiva de los locales. La serie regresa a Minnesota, donde los Wolves intentarán cerrarla frente a su gente.

🌵 Phoenix Suns 122 - 131 Oklahoma City Thunder

Estado de la serie: OKC gana 4-0 (AVANZA)

Se acabó el sueño para los Suns. El Thunder no tuvo piedad en el Footprint Center y completó la barrida, demostrando que son el equipo más en forma del Oeste.

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander volvió a ser indetenible con 31 puntos y 8 asistencias.

Chet Holmgren firmó un doble-doble imponente de 24 puntos y 12 rebotes, anulando cualquier intento de remontada en la pintura.

A pesar de los 24 puntos de Devin Booker y los 23 de Jalen Green, los Suns nunca pudieron descifrar la rotación defensiva de OKC. Phoenix se va a casa con muchas dudas sobre su proyecto, mientras Oklahoma espera al rival descansado.

🪄 Orlando Magic 94 - 88 Detroit Pistons

Estado de la serie: Orlando lidera 3-1

En un duelo \

, de esos donde cada canasta cuesta sangre, el Magic logró imponer su defensa en casa para poner a Detroit contra las cuerdas.

La defensa de Orlando dejó a los Pistons por debajo de los 90 puntos. Desmond Bane fue el motor ofensivo con 22 puntos, apoyado por un Franz Wagner que sumó 19 antes de retirarse con molestias.

Detroit ahora tiene que ganar tres juegos seguidos si quiere avanzar, una misión que parece imposible ante la energía que está mostrando este equipo de Orlando.

Estonian Ott Tanak is their main test pilot, as I understand, but they just can't turn back on Hanninen and his greqt experience on any surface, and especially gravel because he is a Finn, and that's their favorite surface.

body.title: Three Songs by Bon Jovi  | Music & Natto (Three Tunes Tuesday Edition) [ENG/SPA]
body.body: > Hello, fans of good music. It’s already Tuesday, so you know what this post is going to be about, right? That’s right—music, great music—and for that reason, we’ll continue with more famous rock bands, including one of the best-known across multiple generations: Bon Jovi. I’m writing this post thanks to the weekly contest hosted by the great @ablaze every Tuesday in the Hive Music community. So, as a thank you, I’m bringing you three iconic songs that are very dear to me. I assume the members of this community already know them, but I’ll introduce Bon Jovi anyway—one of the most famous Rock bands of the ’80s. Although they don’t have the same impact today as they did back then, they remain a great role model. Formed in New Jersey, their style and musical genre have undergone many changes and evolutions over the decades, shifting from Glam Rock to Ballads and Pop Rock. However, it is both Jon’s unforgettable voice and the lyrics of their famous songs that have left an indelible mark on the minds of millions.

>
Hola, fanáticos de la buena música. Ya es martes, así que ya saben de qué va a tratar este post, ¿no? Así es, de música, de buena música y para eso seguiremos con más bandas de Rock famosas, entre ellas una de las más conocidas por más de una generación: Bon Jovi. Este post lo hago gracias al concurso que semanalmente nos trae el gran @ablaze cada martes en la comunidad de Music de Hive. Así que, como agradecimiento, les traigo tres canciones icónicas y muy queridas por este servidor. Supongo que los miembros de esta comunidad ya los conocen, pero igual les presento a Bon Jovi, una de las bandas de Rock más conocidas de la época de los 80. Aunque actualmente no tienen el mismo impacto que en aquel entonces, siguen siendo un gran ejemplo a seguir. Formado en New Jersey, su estilo y género musical han tenido muchos cambios y evoluciones con el paso de las décadas, pasando del Glam Rock a la Balada y al Pop Rock. Sin embargo, es tanto la voz inolvidable de Jon como las letras de sus canciones famosas lo que han quedado marcadas para siempre en la mente de millones.

/>

Livin' On A Prayer - Bon Jovi

> Let’s start this selection with one of the earliest and most famous singles from their vast discography. The song that completely defined a generation—the ’80s generation. “Livin’ On A Prayer” is the second single from Bon Jovi’s third studio album, Slippery When Wet (1986). The song is about perseverance and hope in difficult times. It tells the story of a couple—Tommy and Gina—who work hard for each other but struggle due to life’s hardships. Still, they both manage to find the strength they need thanks to their love for one another. Personally, I never really paid attention to the lyrics or the meaning of this song; I just listened to it a lot as a teenager because of its rhythm and melody. However, now that I know what it’s about, it’s impossible for me not to feel somewhat connected to what it conveys. Although, unlike Tommy and Gina, I don’t have anyone by my side, I do hold onto the hope that better times will come. We all have that hope in mind, and this song is perfect for conveying that feeling. The phrase we hear repeated in the song—“Whoa, we’re halfway there, oh-oh, livin’ on a prayer”—is nothing more than a ritual, a declaration, a powerful message of hope. We must not abandon that hope if we want to achieve our goals in life, especially when we’re living in difficult times like these. “For love” or whatever else we have by our side, we can find the strength we need to keep going. It truly is a song that captures so well what many of us feel, and that’s why it has remained alive in the hearts of so many to this day.

>
Empecemos esta elección con uno de sus primeros y más famosos sencillos de toda su enorme discografía. La canción que definió por completo a una generación, la generación de los 80. Livin' On A Prayer es el segundo sencillo del tercer álbum de estudio de Bon Jovi titulado Slippery When Wet (1986). La canción habla de la perseverancia y la esperanza en tiempos difíciles. Nos cuenta la historia de una pareja -Tommy y Gina- quienes trabajan duro para ambos, pero la tienen difícil debido a las dificultades de la vida. Aún así, ambos logran encontrar la fuerza que necesitan gracias al amor que se tienen. Personalmente nunca tuve en cuenta la letra y el significado de esta canción, simplemente la llegué a escuchar cuando era adolescente muchas veces debido a su ritmo y la melodía que tiene. Sin embargo, ahora que conozco de lo que trata me es imposible no sentirme en parte identificado con lo que transmite. Si bien, a diferencia de Tommy y Gina, no tengo a nadie a mi lado, sí cuento con la esperanza de que llegarán tiempos mejores. Todos tenemos esa esperanza en mente y esta canción es perfecta para transmitir dicho sentimiento. La frase que escuchamos repetirse en la canción “whoa, we're halfway there, oh-oh, livin' on a prayer”, no es más que un rito, una declaración, un poderoso mensaje de esperanza. Esa esperanza no hay que abandonarla si queremos lograr nuestros objetivos en la vida y más si vivimos en tiempos difíciles como los actuales. “Por amor” o por lo que sea que tengamos a nuestro lado, podemos conseguir las fuerzas que necesitamos para seguir adelante. De verdad que es una canción que describe muy bien lo que muchos sentimos y es por eso que ha logrado estar vivo en el corazón de muchos hasta ahora.

> Let’s move on to another iconic, famous, and unforgettable song from our ’80s Rock band. During the transitional and evolving era of the ’90s, Bon Jovi had to reinvent themselves and experiment with new sounds, giving rise to this gem of a song titled “Bed of Roses”. It is the second single from their fifth studio album, Keep The Faith (1992). The song moves away from Glam Rock and experiments more with the Power Ballad, a much slower, more emotional, and intense subgenre that the band mastered during that era. The lyrics have a tone that is both reflective and romantic, even spiritual. In short, it speaks of a rocker’s fleeting, excess-filled life—you know, the drinking, drugs, and sex. Our singer tells us about the consequences of living that way, but always ends with a strong desire to reach the love of his life in a “bed of roses”. Thus, it is clear that, more than a declaration of love, this is a letter of repentance from the author to his current partner. By saying he is “sleeping on a bed of nails”, he conveys the intense, stabbing pain he feels due to the decisions he has made and the life of excess and deceit he has led. I remember that song perfectly too, since it was one of the ones I listened to most as a teenager. Again, I didn’t know anything about its meaning back then; I just listened to it for its rhythm and its slow, emotional melody. But now I have mixed feelings about it—not only because I criticize the life of excess it describes, but also because I feel I can partly relate to it when I listen to it now. Let’s just say I have my own “bed of nails”, too, but instead of being a hotel bed or something like that, it’s just a single bed.

>
Sigamos con otra gran canción icónica, famosa e inolvidable de nuestra banda de Rock ochentera. Durante la transitoria y evolutiva época de los 90, Bon Jovi tuvo que reinventarse y probar otros sonidos, naciendo así esta joya de canción titulada Bed Of Roses. Es el segundo sencillo de su quinto álbum de estudio titulado Keep The Faith (1992). La canción se aleja del Glam Rock y experimenta más con el Power Ballad, un subgénero mucho más lento, emotivo y fuerte que logró dominar la banda en aquella época. La letra tiene un tono tanto reflexivo como romántico y hasta espiritual. En resumen, habla de la vida efímera y llena de excesos de un rockero, ya saben, las bebidas, las drogas y el sexo. Nuestro cantante nos cuenta las consecuencias de tener una vida así, pero finaliza siempre con un fuerte deseo de llegar al amor de su vida a una “cama de rosas”. De esta manera está claro que, más que una declaración de amor, es una carta de arrepentimiento que hace el autor a su actual pareja. Al decir que está “durmiendo en una cama de clavos”, denota un fuerte dolor punzante que tiene debido a las decisiones que ha tomado y la vida que ha tenido de excesos y engaños. Dicha canción la recuerdo perfectamente también ya que era de las que más escuchaba cuando adolescente. De nuevo, no sabía nada de su significado en aquel entonces, solo la escuchaba por el ritmo que tiene y por su melodía lenta y emotiva. Pero ahora solo tengo ciertos sentimientos encontrados, no solo porque critique dicha vida de excesos que nos describe, sino también por lo parcialmente identificado que me siento al escucharla ahora. Digamos que también tengo mi “cama de clavos”, pero en vez de ser la cama de un hotel o algo parecido, es una cama de soltero, nomás.
>\n\nLast but not least, let’s talk about the third Bon Jovi song I’m sharing with you today. This is the one that has fascinated me the most out of all the songs I’ve heard by this Rock band. \

is from my generation, being the first single from their seventh studio album, Crush (2000). The lyrics speak to a sense of independence and the affirmation of wanting to live life the way you want to live it, without letting yourself be influenced by what others say. I remember very well when I first discovered this song, watching its famous music video on YouTube.\n\nThat music video was one of the most impressive things I’d ever seen back then. Over a decade ago, when I was just beginning to explore other genres like Rock and Pop, this Bon Jovi song stuck with me forever. Its upbeat, catchy rhythm is hard to forget, and its lyrics were among the few I could understand without needing a translator or explanations. Just the simple phrase from the chorus—\

—is enough to understand what it's about. Living life to the fullest—but more than that, it’s about living in the present without worrying about the future or the past. Many of us get stuck in the past, while others feel frustrated about the future; either way, we neglect the precious present we have right now. That’s why “It’s My Life” exists—to remind us how short life is and how precious every passing second becomes. That’s why we have to live it, without needing to please anyone, just by being ourselves and charting our own course. And as Frankie said: “I did it my way”, because no one else will know how we’ll live our lives but ourselves.

>
Por último, pero no menos importante, hablemos de la tercera canción de Bon Jovi que les traigo hoy. Esta es la que más me ha llegado a fascinar de todas las canciones que he llegado a escuchar de esta banda de Rock. It's My Life es de mi generación, siendo el primer sencillo del séptimo álbum de estudio titulado Crush (2000). La letra habla del sentido de independencia y la reafirmación de querer vivir la vida de la manera en la que uno mismo desee vivirla, sin dejarse influenciar por lo que digan los demás. Recuerdo muy bien cuando llegué a conocer esta canción, viendo su famoso videoclip de YouTube. Dicho videoclip fue de lo más impresionante que llegué a ver en aquel entonces. Hace como más de una década atrás, cuando apenas y estaba conociendo sobre otros géneros como el Rock y el Pop, esta canción de Bon Jovi llegó para quedarse en mi subconsciente para siempre. Su ritmo movido y pegadizo es difícil de olvidar y su letra era de las pocas que lograba entender sin necesidad de traductores ni significados. Ya con la simple frase del coro “it's my life, it's now or never, I ain't gonna live forever, I just wanna living my life” es suficiente como para comprender de qué trata. Vivir la vida al máximo, pero más que eso, es vivir el presente sin pensar en el futuro o el pasado. Muchos llegamos a quedarnos en el pasado y otros nos frustramos por nuestro futuro, sea como sea, dejamos de lado el presente tan valioso que tenemos. Es por eso que It's My Life existe, para recordarnos lo corta que es la vida y lo valioso que llega a ser cada segundo que pasa. Es por eso que hay que vivirla, sin necesidad de agradarle a nadie, solo siendo nosotros mismos y trazando nuestro propio camino. Y como dijo Frankie: “I did it my way”, porque nadie más sabrá cómo viviremos nuestra vida sino nosotros mismos.

>
Tell me, do you know Bon Jovi too? Which of his songs is your favorite? Leave your answer in the comments.

>
Dime, ¿conoces también a Bon Jovi? ¿Cuál de todas sus canciones es tu favorita? Déjame tu respuesta en los comentarios.

# <center><u>**Peace be upon you all**</u>💚🌟</center>

<center><u>**Welcome Back to @alive.chat Tuesday Challenge. Let's Stake ALIVE Together.**</u></center> 
<center>![](https://media.tenor.com/h5hZkSuVcXIAAAAC/welcome-back.gif)</center> 

I hope you are all doing great, healthy, and well. I’m happy to have you here and warmly welcome you all.

<center>![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SiJNYXS5WrkQGHwUTqc8ovYW5dnPFQJstbWui91WWNjsSipwyPyZ5ZEqXFc6gRK.jpg)</center>

The ALIVE staking activity is not just about staking ALIVE tokens; it’s about strengthening and supporting our wonderful WE ARE ALIVE community. When we stake ALIVE tokens, we show our belief in our community and its long-term vision. Every staked token is a vote of confidence in the community we are building together.

Your participation in the staking activity matters and adds value to the ALIVE ecosystem. By staking ALIVE tokens, you earn handsome rewards as well, so it’s a win-win situation for everyone.

Let’s stake together, encourage and support each other, and keep building a strong ALIVE community.

<center>**<u>We are alive, we are growing, and we are moving forward together.</u> 💪✨**<center>

<center>![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SiJNYXS5WrkQGHwUTqc8ovYW5dnPFQJstbWui91WWNjsSipwyPyZ5ZEqXFc6gRK.jpg)</center>

# <center><u>**Special Thanks and HEARTBEAT Power Up Day**</u></center>

Very special thanks to @benthomaswwd for donating 10K HEARTBEAT for the prize pool. And because of his generosity, now participants and winners are also receiving HEARTBEAT Tokens, along with other Tokens.
Don't forget to participate in the daily activity that he hosts on @heartbeatonhive for more fun and rewards.

If anyone would like to donate any tokens toward the @alive.chat rewards pool, you are most welcome to do so. Your contributions help strengthen the community and support fellow members.

<u>Along with ALIVE Power Up Day, every Tuesday is HEARTBEAT Power Up Day! 💓 Stake both ALIVE and HEATBEAT tokens, enter the weekly draw, and grow your rewards. Learn more at @heartbeatonhive!</u>

<center>![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SiJNYXS5WrkQGHwUTqc8ovYW5dnPFQJstbWui91WWNjsSipwyPyZ5ZEqXFc6gRK.jpg)</center>

# <center><u>**Challenge Task and Rules.**</u></center>

<center>**<u>Kindly read the rules before participating in the challenge activity. You must follow all the rules mentioned below to be eligible for the Prizes.</u>** 

Let's break down the details!
</center>

1. To be eligible, each participant must **<u>must stake at least 10 ALIVE and hold them until Monday, 00:00 AM UTC at a minimum, and share their staking activity (posted or not) in the comments section.</u>**

2. Staking that counts as participation must take place between **<u>Tuesday, 00:00 AM UTC and Wednesday, 11:59 PM UTC</u>**. It’s OK if you staked ALIVE tokens before the challenge post was published, as long as it happened within this time frame.

3. **<u>Unstaking ALIVE before the mentioned time in the rule #1 will remove you from participation.</u>**

4. **Using #alive tag is mandetory, addittionally you can use  #aliveandthriving, and #AliveChat for your posts.**

5. The list of participants from last week’s challenge and the reward distribution report will be published in the next challenge post.

6. Feel free to share your post and receive upvotes from the community.

7. **<u>It’s not mandatory, but we really appreciate it if you reblog the post and tag your friends in your posts and comments.</u>**

8. **<u>Engage with other participants and community members; don't forget the purpose of this activity is to encourage and support each other.</u>**

![Polish_20220714_121631044.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SiJNYXS5WrkQGHwUTqc8ovYW5dnPFQJstbWui91WWNjsSipwyPyZ5ZEqXFc6gRK.jpg)

links.body:
<div class=text-justify>

HBD has been one of the most consistent and most powerful coins in the hive Blockchain. Its use within the hive ecosystem is undoubtedly one of the most I have witnessed as an hive user, especially in comparison to other coins within the Blockchain. Even though I do not use a lot of the other coins within the hive Blockchain, I know for a fact that HBD has been one of the most used coin within the Blockchain especially because until a few months ago, HBD was the official payout system for every blog and even now that hive is the official payment system, There are those who still choose to view their coins in HBD.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPUdjBgZA9954b2JCdvtYsdbmCUHfNBaX6k4PLX4cfUxE/1000035008.png 
[SOURCE](https://chatgpt.com/)

In my opinion, this is because HBD is the only coin close in value to dollar or USDT within the hive Blockchain. And even though it has seen its own fair share of lows, it's fair to say HBD is strong, and HBD is stable even compared with the hive coin. Right now hive is at the all time lowest I have seen it since my hive journey started over 4 years ago, and I must admit, I never saw this coming, not even in my wildest imaginations. But right now we are facing the harsh reality of the crypto market and we must accept it for what it is. However, with regards to everything going on with the crypto market, I do not believe saving in HBD is very idle.

I have been giving this a lot of thought lately, and watching the US close the Strait of Hormuz is a terrible sign of things to come.  This is an engineered economic catastrophe in the making, and the US will not be unscathed.  Medication, fertilizer, and all plastic are petroleum products, not just fuels.  As dozens of refineries around the world are mysteriously being destroyed by fires, this makes the coming catastrophe even worse.

On top of this coming economic nightmare, countries all over the world are turning the internet into a surveillance tool as bad as cell phones.  

>\

That will not be true when every word we say is permissioned because our use of the internet requires KYC.  I've been reading that people are pushing for operating systems to be KYC, which means even using a computer will be dependent on permission from overlords.  You mentioned Goolag banning people on a whim, and this actually dramatically understates the problem that is social credit scores are going to be applied to everyone, and if we don't say the things the Big Tech gods want to hear, we will be silenced and cut off from not just the internet, but computing devices themselves.

I am unwilling to tolerate such tyrannical oppression, and have begun an initiative for Community Association to Manufacture consumer Products (CAMP) and I intend to enable us to crowdfund producing products from shampoo to cars, without being dependent on our benevolent overlords largesse, because I don't think they have any.  I think they're deliberately crashing the economy to do us dirty, and I think we'll have to make an economy that works for us whether they like it or not.

Highwaymen used to kill travelers and take their money.  I think Big Tech are planning to kill most of us and take our wealth from our cold, dead fingers.  I am making moves locally to get some industrial production going, and expect that things will get a lot worse economically very soon.  Things like fuel, electricity, medicines, food, and every product that requires fuel to make - which is all of them - are going to become, first, much more expensive, and second, far less available at any price.  The lack of fertilizer is causing a catastrophe for farmers right now, as many cannot get the fertilizer they need to plant crops now, and this means that a lot of food will not be available this fall.  I live in dairy country, and it's impacting people here today.  I also paid $.20 more per gallon for gas today than I did one week ago, and if that keeps up, things are going to get desperate, because trucks that can't get diesel can't ship goods.  Diesel is ~$7 a gallon now, and that adds to the price of every item shipped.  While they are still being shipped.

If the KYC requirement for even booting up a computer becomes law, I expect censorship and social credit score managed by AI to eradicate free speech completely.  These are fatal to entrepreneurial development, and we will not like the Web3 Palantir may allow us to use, if we're good enough in their eyes to participate.

Hedge.  Plan B, C, D, and so forth may be necessary to have any quality of life if the Strait of Hormuz stays closed, and alternative communications may be necessary very soon, for everyone that has ever said anything Peter Thiel doesn't like.  They've been harvesting our data for a long time, and I don't think that they won't use what we've said against us.  I'm pretty sure that's why they spied on us and kept the files until now, so they could use our words against us.

I hope I'm completely paranoid, and nothing at all bad happens to anyone ever.  But I wish in one hand and work with the other, and the only hand that ever turns up anything worth having is the working hand.

Thanks!

---
Munetaka Murakami se convirtió este lunes en el líder en vuelacercas de toda la MLB. Desplazó a Yordan Álvarez quién se mantuvo anclado en 11. Lo hizo con dos compañeros a bordo, en partido celebrado entre los Medias Blancas y los tambaleantes Angeles, que han comenzado a bajar la guardia.

Detrás de ese jonrón vino el turno de Miguel Vargas. Del muchacho habíamos hablado hace poco sobre su nueva arma ofensiva, la fuerza con el madero. Y de veras que no nos hizo quedar mal, pues el turno se convirtió en un back to back( jonrones consecutivos), y fue en definitiva la carrera que decidió el partido, pues a pesar de que en ese momento el partido se colocaba 8 carreras a 5, los Angeles reaccionaron más tarde en el juego, pero solo llegaron a 7.

Vale destacar que los Medias Blancas lograban la remontada con el batazo de Murakami, pues los de Anaheim habían comenzado con ventaja que llegó a ser de 5 a 1, dónde se incluyó jonrón de Jorge Soler, el cubano más destacado ayer por parte del equipo contrario, quien además impulsó otra con roletazo al cuadro en la rebelión angelina de la novena entrada.

Juego entretenido este, pero que deja a relucir las debilidades de ambos cuerpos de relevistas, pues la fiesta de los  Angelinos se aguó en el mismo Lucky 7, al permitir las 7 carreras, y en el caso de los White Sox, los pañales se ensuciaron en la novena entrada cuando pasaron un gran susto.


El otro cubano destacado del día fue Randy Arozarena, quien frente a los Mellizos bateó de 3-2 con una anotada. De todas maneras, los Marineros perdieron, aunque cabe destacar que han recuperado terreno en su cuenta de victorias y derrotas y ya archivan un balance pegado a los 500.

Hoy se sigue jugando Béisbol. Esperemos por más hazañas.
