body.title: It's always possible if you want to - The Tale of Shine - ENG- SPA
body.body: > Being a survivor goes beyond simply preserving your life; it's also about being able to get up and move forward after a fall and failure. Shine experienced what could be described as almost musical death, but he was the only one who managed to do more than just live; he managed to survive the fall. It all happened like this: he was a key member of a musical group. This group was world-famous for making good music, but above all, for something not so good: their excesses. This group often threw massive parties just for its members, with huge amounts of money spent on alcohol, drugs, and much more. They were also known for being rude to people, even often to their own fans. The worst part is that Shine participated in everything with them, and he had the same proud and wasteful nature. They spent what the band earned on trivial things and didn't invest in the band. Over time, this way of being, combined with their irresponsible behavior, took a brutal toll on everyone. The band sank into deep debt, and people began to hate them for their personalities and for the increasingly poor quality of their music. Their lyrics were no longer about moving forward, but about boasting about how great they were. This ultimately took its toll on the band, fracturing it. As a result, the group disbanded and could no longer perform.

> Ser sobreviviente va más allá de solo preservar tu vida, es también poder levantarte y seguir adelante luego de la caída y del fracaso. Shine vivió lo que podría decirse fue casi la muerte musical, pero fue el único que logró hacer algo más que vivir, el logró sobrevivir a la caída. Todo sucedió así, el era parte principal de una agrupación musical. Dicho grupo era mundialmente famoso, por hacer buena música, pero por sobre todas la cosas algo no tan bueno, sus excesos. Este grupo a menudo hacia fiestas masivas solo para sus miembros, con grandes excesos de dinero en alcohol, drogas y mucho más. También era conocidos por ser groseros con la gente, incluso muchas veces con sus propios fans. Lo peor es que Shine también participaba en todo con ellos, y tenía la misma forma de ser orgullosa y despilfarradora. Gastaban lo que la banda ganaba en cosas banales y no invertían en la banda. Con el tiempo esta forma de ser sumado a sus conductas irresponsables pasó una factura brutal para todos. El grupo se hundió en grandes deudas, la gente empezó a odiarlos por su forma de ser y por la música que cada vez era más mala. Sus letras ya no eran sobre seguir adelante, era para dejar constancia de lo bueno que eran. Así que esto terminó afectando al grupo y fracturándolo. Como resultado el grupo se desintegró y no pudieron continuar tocando.
![people-1283974_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tkhySYRQNttEjWdrWz911zL6H3XGq8yFaAEFr34T27SbeXLgXaWpSvvF2DSicLdH6Ce.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> Although everyone was alive and no one had died, it was, in a sense, a musical death. Their reputations were so tarnished that none dared to continue in music. Some simply disappeared, becoming ordinary people consumed by their egos, excesses, and drugs. Their downfall was a wake-up call for everyone in the music industry; they demonstrated that even talent is worthless when you don't play by the rules of life. It was believed that everyone in the music world was dead, but Shine' didn't want to give it up; it was part of his life. So he decided to do something none of his predecessors had done: survive the fall. He began a process of cleaning up his image. He started giving interviews to explain all the wrong they had done and to apologize to the public for their misdeeds and for having disappointed everyone. But regaining lost trust wouldn't be easy. He and the others were seen as harmful, and no one wanted them in their band or group. And many did their utmost to make sure they knew it. Even so, he kept fighting as hard as he could, remaining as humble as possible to show that he had changed and was no longer the same. The price he had to pay was to humble himself, to put his ego on the line. None of his former bandmates were willing to do that. They simply let themselves be consumed by their own egos. Things began to change for Shine because, after years of struggle and humility, people started to see that he was serious, so they began to give him opportunities. Several bands started calling him for collaborations and to work on songs. He wasn't popular at all yet, but it was a start.

> Aunque todos estaban vivos y nadie había muerto aquello si fue la muerte musical en cierto sentido. La reputación de todos estaba tan manchada que ninguno se atrevió a continuar en la música. Algunos solo desaparecieron y se hicieron personas comunes consumidas aún por sus egos, sus excesos y las drogas. Su caída fue un llamado de atención para todos en la música, ellos demostraron que aunque eran buenos de nada servía cuando no sigues las reglas del juego de la vida. Se creían que todos estaban muertos en la música, pero Shine no quería dejarla, era parte de su vida. Así que el decidió hacer algo que ninguno de sus anteriores predecesores había hecho y era sobrevivir a la caída. El Comenzó un proceso de limpiar su imagen. Empezó a dar entrevistas para contar todo lo mal que habían hecho. También para disculparse con el publico por sus malas acciones y por haber decepcionado a todos. Pero no sería fácil recuperar la confianza perdida. El junto a los demás eran vistos como dañinos, y nadie los quería en su banda o en su grupo. Y muchos se esforzaron al máximo por hacérselo saber. Aún así el siguió luchando todo lo que pudo, siendo lo más humilde posible para dar a conocer que había cambiado y ya no era el mismo. El costo que tuvo que pagar fue rebajarse y ser humilde, pisotear su ego. Ninguno de sus antiguos amigos del grupo estuvieron a dispuestos a hacer eso. Solo dejaron que fueran consumidos por ellos mismos. Las cosas comenzaron a cambiar para Shine porque luego de años de lucha y humildad la gente empezó a ver que iba en serio así que comenzaron a darle oportunidades. Varios grupos empezaron a llamarlo para colaboraciones y trabajar en canciones. No era para nada popular aún pero era el comienzo.
![people-2569551_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/242rpetLk4H1JvLeQKyu73Z3fYZ7t4oEoiU8Xim9samnkt8pguxcdQUtdPCA8462VLTxn.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> These small steps toward survival began to have a greater impact later on, and collaborations became a part of his daily life. His talent, which had been tarnished by his past reputation, began to take center stage again. So, with time, he managed to become the lead singer of a band. People began to see him as a survivor, as he had managed to rise above his setbacks. The negative news surrounding him shifted, and now he was seen as an example of how change is possible when you truly want it. Shine Ralph knows this opportunity is unique and that he must not repeat the same mistakes. He will strive to succeed; he will always be a survivor.

> Estos pequeños pasos por sobrevivir comenzaron a tener un efecto más grande más adelante y las colaboraciones pasaron a ser parte de su día a día. Su talento que estaba ensuciado por su antigua reputación comenzaba a tener protagonismo de nuevo en su vida. Así que con el pasar del tiempo logró hacerse el cantante principal de una banda. La gente empezó a verlo como el sobreviviente, ya que pudo salir adelante pese a la caída. Las malas noticas sobre el cambiaron y ahora solo lo tomaban de ejemplo para demostrar que si se puede cambiar cuando se quiere. Shine sabe que esta oportunidad es única y que no debe volver a repetir lo mismo. El se esforzará por lograrlo, siempre será un sobreviviente.

body.title: 🌊 Chasing the calm by the sea
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTbSGAw9QfUNE61atxD4r1Z6jUV5Y6LNGQ9NizfYFyQEb/IMG_0058.png 

There’s something about walking next to the ocean that clears my mind in a way nothing else can…

No noise, no pressure, just the sound of the waves and the feeling that everything is exactly where it should be. I didn’t plan anything today, I just followed the coastline and let the moment guide me.

I love how every place feels different, even when it’s something as simple as a seaside walk. The breeze, the light, the people passing by… it all becomes part of the memory.

Traveling has taught me that peace isn’t always found in quiet places, but in those moments where you finally slow down and just *feel* where you are.

And honestly… I could walk like this forever.

body.title: A's get a critical victory over Rangers Sunday! | Royals come to town tonight
body.body:
![584d48ce0a44bd1070d5d46f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJg3BnVxoiM2NuNHqgzjQovf9NYMeSJ4EYmngpiJMp61Su8EWJJbQuCKSGUjh45.png)
[Src](https://www.stickpng.com/img/sports/baseball/major-league-baseball-mlb/oakland-athletics/oakland-athletics-a-logo)

HA well at least *one* of my teams are finding success. It's refreshing to write about a victory finally.

They officially won their series vs the Rangers! [The win](https://youtu.be/S003xmj6Smg?si=H9popkTuhmqfOXev) also allowed them to take sole possession of first place in the AL West. It's still early in the season but it's still satisfying!

It was largely a bullpen game from a pitching perspective. It was a great outing by the six pitchers collectively though! They only allowed a single run in the low scoring 2-1 affair. 

The A's two runs came in the very first inning and they ended up being the winning runs! Almost like a backwards game winner LOL. It came off the bat of Carlos Cortes who continues to excel. He hit a triple that drove in Brent Rooker and Tyler Soderstrom. Oh yeah, Brent Rooker is back after missing 14 games! Brent Rooker and Carlos Cortes batting back to back seems like a potentially powerful duo!

Cortes is currently holding a .377 batting average along with an insane 1.121 OPS! This dude is on fire, he must stay in the lineup!

After a night off, the Royals come to West Sacramento for a new three game series. The A's are 15-13 while the Royals are 11-17. I don't know much about the Royals at the moment but based on record alone, hopefully the A's can win another series and strengthen their record early in 2026!

For whatever reason I couldn't find out whose pitching for the A's tonight. 

But yes I look forward to seeing if the A's can maintain their winning ways. They are only two games above .500 but the team looks solid. 

It's fun covering the Phillies and A's. Opposite leagues, on opposite coasts. 

Three of my four teams are playing in one night, pretty amazing!

I needed this.

just sunshine, fresh air, and a moment to breathe.

Sometimes I forget how important it is to slow down.  
I’m always thinking about what’s next, what I need to do, what I haven’t done yet…

But today I chose to just *exist*.

Laying here, feeling the sun on my skin, I realized something simple:  
I don’t need everything figured out to feel okay right now.

I’m still building my life, still chasing my dreams…  
but moments like this remind me that I’m allowed to enjoy the present too.

Not everything has to be perfect.  
Not every day has to be productive.

Some days are just for feeling good… and that’s enough 🤍

body.title: The Kind of Silence That Doesn’t Explain Itself
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ7kR745N27HvdxMjNAAkG6KEb9E1oAN7mn6dKpF2fo25/1777407777502.jpg)

Sometimes you don’t even realize when it starts changing.
No big moment. No clear reason. Just small things shifting.
You still talk, but not the same way.
You still care, but something feels off.
I remember thinking maybe it’s just a phase.
People get busy. People change moods. It happens.
But deep down… you know the difference between “busy” and “distant.”
And that’s the part no one says out loud.
You keep giving the same energy.
Same attention. Same effort.
But the response?
Short. Cold. Delayed.
Like something already ended, just not officially.
At first, you ignore it.
Then you question it.
Then slowly… you accept it.
Not because you’re okay with it.
But because you’re tired.
Tired of overthinking simple things.
Tired of waiting for replies that don’t come.
Tired of feeling like an option.
There was a time you were part of their day.
Now you’re just… there. Somewhere.
No place. No priority.
And the strange thing is, they don’t even notice the change in you.
They don’t see you pulling back.
Because they were already far ahead in leaving.
So one day, you stop too.
No announcement.
No long message.
No “we need to talk.”
Just… silence.
You read their message and don’t reply.
You see their name and feel nothing.
And that scares you more than anything.
Because once upon a time, you cared too much.
Now it’s just quiet.
Not angry quiet.
Not broken quiet.
Just… done.
You stop checking your phone.
Stop expecting anything.
Stop explaining yourself in your head.
It’s weird how peaceful it feels.
And also a little empty.
But that emptiness is honest.
No fake hopes.
No forced connections.
Just reality.
People think silence is weakness.
But it’s not.
Sometimes it’s the final stage of understanding.
You understood they won’t change.
You understood your value doesn’t depend on them.
You understood staying longer would only hurt more.
So you chose quiet.
Not for them.
For yourself.

body.title: That's A Wrap 💝 for HIVE THRIVE COMMUNITY HOUR feat. @sdcme & @sorin.cristescu for @innopay❕
body.body:
![HiveThrive Wrap KittyGirl + Alessandra.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alessandrawhite/23vsZBtj8vXoXxfCXJb5Xs2Ehf1rK8yw4TNfTSbhbSa9Lh8iwScu1g6mEgcQMdyMfPrgi.jpeg)

@buttcoins & I welcomed @sdcme & @sorin.cristescu for @innopay as our special guests on HIVE THRIVE COMMUNITY HOUR Ep. 54! 

This week’s conversation was a fascinating look at what happens when Hive blockchain is used to solve a common consumer problem – the friction with dining in restaurants. 

Our special guests, @sorin.cristescu and @sdcme, explained that @innopay really began as an idea to solve a chronic frustration with dining out...WAITING! There's waiting for menus, waiting to order, and waiting to pay. Trying to get a waiter's attention is about as fun as watching paint dry, but they had a better idea! 

With @innopay, you scan a QR code, order when you’re ready, and pay directly from your phone. No more exasperatingly waiting to be served and then again to be presented with your bill, to then wait some more for the card machine to be brought over to you.

And not only that, but with using InnoPay, you can pay your bill at a discount if you create an account online at an InnoPay participating restaurant. What we learned that is especially interesting is that Hive sits almost invisibly underneath the experience!

A customer can simply pay with a credit card through Stripe and never think about blockchain at all. If they decide to create an account, InnoPay quietly creates a Hive account in the background and introduces them to the ecosystem without overwhelming them with Web3 or crypto convos. 

*Voila!* This is a perfect example of how Hive can make a difference in not only how we dine out and but how restuaranteurs and bar owners can run their businesses. 


These are the kinds of innovations we love to celebrate on @hivethrive, which is a social audio show that highlights *\

*. Today's thoughtful conversation showed yet again that Hivians are about applying Hive Blockchain to real world use cases.

Our hats are off to @sdcme and @sorin.cristescu for joining us 🙏🏽. We look forward to having them again for a live demo. When it's scheduled, we will share the date!

body.title: Thought energy and hidden influence behind outcomes
body.body:
![049E501D-CB42-4C2B-86AA-00A0460BFC06.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dwayne16/23wqiCgcYJJTSt1RQXxDLsrV57Qjgs3zwSDtXmBAthWfEn2fFtLq3CwhXwfJXSbcZJpze.jpeg)
***

Every physical manifestation is a result of thought as I said in my last post. But it’s not just as simple as a thought coming by and it happens to be an externally visible. It’s much more to do with the subconscious patterns one carries daily. 

With that said here’s my perspective on the relationship between thought, energy and reality.

* There’s no real way to measure the amount of thought or intangible energy a person gives to a particular misfortune or circumstance. It takes a highly, if not entirely hyper-conscious individual (which is extremely rare) to analyse each and every thought, then accurately determine which of them has given power to an external influence. That is why I preach optimism as a safeguard against this as much as possible. It shifts the mind into a literally favourable internal state, which later translates into external positive feedback. Much like the saying thinking positive things gives you positive things.

* The difference is actually easy to recognise. The death of a parent who, let’s say, died of old age happened because it happened. Their body had simply forfeited and given up after years of living. But say that same parent died because they ate excessive junk food, became obese, and passed away. That was a conscious pattern of decisions they knew could inevitably lead to death. Or say they died in a car crash. A few poor choices, originating from thought, such as drunk driving on their part, could have caused it. Or in a rarer case, it happened seemingly from nowhere. No mechanical faults from either person who crashed. No poor driving decisions. Just a sudden collision that led to death. And I’m quite sure statistically that is uncommon. At some point, negative energy, bad thought, ill intention, or some lingering subconscious force had existed there. It could have been that before that moment they had already imagined they would crash. Or years of subconscious and conscious negativity had been breeding, and this happened to be its manifestation.

* These catastrophic outcomes are, for the most part, a result of thought processes manifested through collective action, decisions, and choices. These things can be overcome, so long as the individual’s positive energy remains unwavering and presses through. But it is much easier for humans to give in to negativity, because that is simply human nature as we know it.

* Every singular component that emerges within large-scale phenomena is a product of thought, yes? Only later manifested into an observable decision or action. Here lies the complexity. As I’ve said before, randomness or spontaneous ill fortune does not simply spawn out of nowhere. It is inevitably linked to contributions of subconscious or conscious thought that often go unrecognised by the individual or party involved. The key is precision: navigating thoughts and analysing each and every one of them. But that is among the hardest things a person can do. That is where the dilemma of unpredictability and doubt enters. Almost everyone struggles with this. It takes a formidable, if not divinely ordained person, to master such control. Not to talk of a whole group of people, or even a handful of them. It is not impossible, but it is extremely rare.

body.title: How I Use HBD
body.body:
>Hive Blockchain has a number of tokens; the popular ones are Hive and HBD (Hive Backed Dollar). $Hive is the native token of the blockchain, while $HBD is the blockchain’s stablecoin. Its price is equivalent to that of USD, whereas Hive has the potential of rising or falling, HBD remains fixed following the price of the USD. Hive and HBD can be converted to different tokens across the blockchain, but most transactions are done with Hive. Ever since I joined Hive Blockchain, I have preferred to have HBD over Hive, and my reason is clear: it is stable. Most times, I prefer to save or stake HBD rather than Hive. Apart from the 15% APR attached to saving HBD, one is also assured that his or her assets won't depreciate as a result of market instability. Hive also has a number of advantages. The unstable price makes it unique; the price can be low today and boom, it is high tomorrow. My friend once told me of a time when the hive skyrocketed to a dollar per hive. Even though it was a very long time ago, imagine the gains those who were able to hold their tokens took home. Sometimes, we need a little patience; we need to wait a little more, and we will smile again. Everyone on the blockchain uses HBD differently; some prefer to save, some prefer to convert it to hive. For me, I do both. Sometimes I save HBD, other times I convert it to Hive so that I can easily transact it. The reason why I converted to Hive, and not stake for returns, is that there is usually a stipulated period of time (3 days) attached to withdrawal. Sometimes, I may not have all the time to wait for that long to use my earnings. I can remember a time when I was in a very critical situation. The money I had was saved as HBD, and I needed money urgently. I placed a withdrawal, but unfortunately, I had to wait for three days. In order to solve the problem I had, I took out a loan from a friend. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcJxdpQ2w87SG5Ntd7cbVih4tm4RwBn89C5kHMR5VqExx/1777407482631.jpg) Well, I won't discourage anyone from either converting HBD to Hive or staking them for returns. If you don't have any urgent need for money, it's best to save but if you have challenges, it's not bad to convert it to Hive and transact it how it best suits you. body.title: Poprzeczka niedługo kończy 5 lat. Zapraszam do ostatniej edycji
body.body: Poprzeczka niedługo kończy 5 lat. Zapraszam do ostatniej edycji. Udając dramatyzm: To nie jest łatwy wpis. I pewnie nie będzie też łatwy w odbiorze. Ale jest potrzebny.\n\n

/>

PL:  
  
Spojrzałem w kalendarz i uświadomiłem sobie coś, co naprawdę robi wrażenie — Poprzeczka skończy za miesiąc pięć lat. Pięć lat ciągłej rywalizacji. Pięć lat comiesięcznych startów. Pięć lat częstego sprawdzania wyników, liczenia, analizowania, publikowania. To oznacza dziesiątki edycji i setki dni, w których ktoś — ja — siadał i pilnował, żeby to wszystko miało ręce i nogi.

Na początku wszystko było liczone ręcznie w arkuszu kalkulacyjnym. Później pojawił się skrypt, który przez jakiś czas pomagał, ale jak to bywa — też potrafił się wysypać. W końcu powstała dedykowana strona, która automatyzuje część procesu… ale nadal wymaga od uczestników systematycznego wpisywania danych. Każdy etap był krokiem do przodu. Ale każdy też miał swoją cenę.

I dziś mogę to powiedzieć wprost: z czasem Poprzeczka zaczęła być dla mnie bardziej obowiązkiem niż przyjemnością. A jeśli coś, co miało motywować i dawać energię, zaczyna ją odbierać — to znaczy, że trzeba się zatrzymać i podjąć decyzję. Dlatego majowa edycja będzie ostatnią. Nie zamykam jednak drzwi.

Jeśli ktoś z Was chciałby przejąć Poprzeczkę — zapraszam. Naprawdę. Można ten pomysł rozwijać, uprościć, zautomatyzować albo przenieść w zupełnie innym kierunku.

Z mojej strony mogę przekazać:

*   bazę danych z historycznymi wynikami,
    
*   kod strony,
    
*   doświadczenia (w tym również błędy, których było sporo).
    

Jedyną rzeczą, którą będę musiał odłączyć, jest prywatny arkusz — ale to już kwestia techniczna do ogarnięcia.

Przyznam, że miałem kiedyś większe ambicje dla tego projektu. Marzyło mi się, żeby Poprzeczka stała się czymś w pełni autonomicznym — aplikacją albo systemem podłączonym bezpośrednio do urządzeń liczących kroki. Garminy, zegarki, aplikacje fitness — wszystko spięte w jedno.

Jeszcze rok temu byłem nawet blisko. Dane zaczęły się synchronizować, pojawiła się namiastka automatyzacji. Ale rzeczywistość szybko to zweryfikowała. Bo w momencie, gdy coś przestawało działać, nagle musiałem porzucić swoją codzienność — bycie przewodnikiem, pracę w terenie, jazdę na rowerze — i siadać do komputera jako… programista. A nim po prostu nie jestem. Oczywiście pomagałem sobie AI, ale jeśli nie masz solidnych podstaw, to każde rozwiązanie jest trochę jak chodzenie po cienkim lodzie. Działa… dopóki działa.

Był też drugi problem — zasięg i siła projektu. Miałem nadzieję, że konto Poprzeczki stanie się czymś większym. Że będzie realnym wsparciem dla uczestników. Że jego głos będzie miał znaczenie. Był moment, kiedy publikacje były codziennie. Codziennie aktualizacje, wyniki, podsumowania. Ale mechanizmy platformy niekoniecznie to doceniły. Z perspektywy systemu mogło to wyglądać jak spam.

Efekt? Zasięg pozostał niewielki. Wsparcie — symboliczne, ale nie pozwalające na optymizm. I w pewnym momencie łapiesz się na tym, że spędzasz godziny, zastanawiając się, jak „sprawiedliwie” podzielić środki o wartości kilku HBD na miesiąc. Równowartość 2 bochenków chleba. To daje do myślenia.

Nie znaczy to jednak, że te pięć lat było stracone. Wręcz przeciwnie. Wiem, że dla wielu z Was ten system — robienia kroków, zwiększania celu, wprowadzania przerw — po prostu wszedł w życie. Stał się nawykiem. Częścią dnia. I to jest największa wartość Poprzeczki.

Ja sam… od kilku dni mam odinstalowanego @actifit . I powiem szczerze: czuję ulgę. Mogę publikować wtedy, kiedy chcę. Mogę wrzucić wpis bez presji, bez obowiązku, bez sprawdzania, czy wszystko się zgadza w tabelkach. To mała rzecz, ale robi różnicę.

Nie wiem jeszcze, co dalej z kontem Poprzeczka. Pewnie będzie powoli wygasać. Może jeszcze coś tam się pojawi. Może uda się sensownie rozdysponować środki, które zostały — choć to też, jak się okazuje, nie jest proste. Zobaczę.

Na koniec najważniejsze: Dziękuję. Za każdy krok. Za każdą edycję. Za każdą próbę przekroczenia własnej poprzeczki. I zapraszam Was do ostatniej odsłony. Majowa edycja Poprzeczki właśnie się zaczyna. Zróbmy ją dobrze. Na pożegnanie.  
  
\-----------------  
  
EN:  

Poprzeczka is about to turn 5. Join the final edition.

Let’s be a bit dramatic: this is not an easy post. And it probably won’t be easy to read either. But it’s necessary.

I looked at the calendar and realized something that really makes an impression — in one month, Poprzeczka will turn five years old. Five years of continuous competition. Five years of monthly editions. Five years of regularly checking results, calculating, analyzing, and publishing. That means dozens of editions and hundreds of days when someone — me — sat down and made sure everything held together.

At the beginning, everything was calculated manually in a spreadsheet. Later, a script appeared and helped for a while — but, as it goes, it also tended to break. Eventually, a dedicated website was created that automates part of the process… but it still requires participants to enter their data consistently. Every stage was a step forward. But each one also came at a cost.

And today I can say it directly: over time, Poprzeczka became more of an obligation than a pleasure for me. And if something that was supposed to motivate and give energy starts taking it away — it means it’s time to stop and make a decision.

That’s why the May edition will be the last one. But I’m not closing the door. If any of you would like to take over Poprzeczka — you’re welcome. Really. You can develop the idea, simplify it, automate it, or take it in a completely different direction.

From my side, I can provide:  
\- a database with historical results,  
\- the website code,  
\- experience (including quite a few mistakes).

The only thing I’ll need to disconnect is the private spreadsheet — but that’s just a technical detail to sort out.

I admit I once had bigger ambitions for this project. I dreamed that Poprzeczka could become something fully autonomous — an app or a system connected directly to step-counting devices. Garmins, smartwatches, fitness apps — everything integrated into one ecosystem.

About a year ago, I was actually close. Data started syncing, and a glimpse of automation appeared. But reality quickly verified that. Because whenever something stopped working, I suddenly had to drop my everyday life — being a guide, working in the field, riding a bike — and sit down at the computer as… a programmer. Which I simply am not. Of course, I used AI tools to help, but without solid foundations, every solution feels like walking on thin ice. It works… until it doesn’t.

There was also a second issue — reach and impact. I had hoped that the Poprzeczka account would grow stronger. That it would become real support for participants. That its voice would matter. There was a time when posts were published daily — updates, results, summaries every single day. But platform mechanisms didn’t necessarily appreciate that. From their perspective, it could look like spam.

The result? Reach remained limited. Support was symbolic — not something you could realistically build on. And at some point, you catch yourself spending hours thinking about how to “fairly” distribute a few HBD per month. The equivalent of two loaves of bread. That makes you think.

That said, these five years were not wasted. Quite the opposite.

I know that for many of you, this system — walking more and more, increasing goals, allowing rest — became part of your life. A habit. A routine. And that is the real value of Poprzeczka.

As for me… I’ve had @actifit uninstalled for a few days now.

And honestly? I feel a sense of relief. I can post whenever I want. I can publish without pressure, without obligation, without checking if everything in the tables adds up.

It’s a small thing, but it makes a difference. I don’t yet know what will happen to the Poprzeczka account. It will probably slowly fade out. Maybe something will still appear there from time to time. Maybe I’ll manage to distribute the remaining funds in a sensible way — although, as it turns out, even that isn’t simple. We’ll see.

And finally, the most important thing: Thank you. For every step. For every edition. For every attempt to push your own limits. And I invite you to the final chapter. The May edition of Poprzeczka is starting now. Let’s do it right. One last time.  
  
@racibo

Hi to all my Hiveans all over the world, I am glad to be here for real and to share my today's joy in being a Fiber Optic Technician. There is nothing better than having to be the reason that some homes have internet and remain happy. Being a Fiber Optic Technician, puts me out there to provision PON (Passive Optical Network), from the OLT(Optical Line Terminal), to through the FDT (Fiber Distribution Terminal), through FAT (Fiber Access Terminal), through MST (Multiple Service Terminal), and finally, to the ONU/ ONT (Optical Network Unit/ Optical Network Terminal). Giving the customer satisfying internet connectivity.

Not only does my work make people happy. Despite the fact that customers are paying for the service. The availability of internet without any interruption and, getting the subscribed bandwidth is something that is incomparable to any other ISP. Especially in my home country where there is so many type of sabotages. We still go extra mile to ensure that customers do not suffer and instant resolution is always in place to make sure that customers are up and running.

body.title: The NBA Playoffs are Unwatchable
body.body:
Wow. I was incredibly psyched for the NBA Playoffs... well at least the Western Conference portion of the playoffs. But the NBA went and did NBA things.

To be fair part of the problem has been injuries. Those can't really be controlled... or can they. I knew the Eastern Conference games were going to be hot garbage but I was hoping the Rockets vs Lakers, Nuggets vs Timber Wolves, and Spurs vs Trailblazers would all be entertaining series. I was wrong.

![](https://library.sportingnews.com/styles/crop_style_16_9_desktop_webp/s3/2026-04/NBA%20Playoffs%20FTRs.jpg.webp?itok=S_5V2Syh)

The Rockets traded away all of their depth in order to get 37 year old Kevin Durant and sure enough, he has missed several of their playoff games. That has reduced the Rockets to a thin team without enough scoring. They can't even beat a Lakers squad missing 40% of their starters. The Spurs and Trailblazers is incredibly disappointing. This is no one's fault except physics and gravity. Proving the age old adage that \

, Victor Wembanyama has missed half of that series after he tripped and hit is face on the court. It was brutal. He looked like a boxer that had been crushed by an upper cut. Check that. He looked like an athletic freak of nature who had been crushed by an uppercut... although how would anyone reach his chin? So I haven't bothered watching that series.

But the most disappointing of all has been the Nuggets vs the Timber Wolves. Although I still love basketball, it seems every year I have to look past the fact that it seems to be a real as a WWF wrestling match between the Road Warriors and the British Bulldogs. Series like these give me every reason to believe every conspiracy theory out there. Sadly, I have watched four of these five games. I have no idea why I tuned back in last night but I was up working and had nothing better to leave on in the background. Games two and three of the series were two of the biggest pieces of bullshit I have ever seen. 

It was blatantly obvious that the referees wanted to make this a series so the various TV networks (is ESPN, ABC, Peacock, Amazon Prime, Crunchyroll or Dropoutv... there are so many of them it is impossible to know) got a long series feature Nikola Jokic and Anthony Edwards. But to make this happen, the referees had to completely stop calling fouls. Normally games a re controlled by blowing the whistle. Those two games were controlled by hiding the whistle. The last time I saw refereeing this bad was the 2011 playoff series between the Bulls and the Heat. The Bulls never had a chance against the referees that series. 

![](https://www.nj.com/resizer/v2/https%3A%2F%2Fimage.nj.com%2Fhome%2Fnjo-media%2Fwidth2048%2Fimg%2Fknicks_main%2Fphoto%2Flebron-jamesjpg-b0f66f5ae76d029a.jpg?auth=632d379755cc865d85d52638dccae76d2b2cf587bc1fc139ca1a81ac5e3a7623&width=500&smart=true&quality=90)

_Not pictured: The strong breeze that blew on LeFlop 2 seconds before this._

If you want proof that something wasn't right, there are only two players you need to watch. Go back and watch Julius Randle and Rudy Golbert. Spoiler alert, here is what you will see. Julius Randle constantly pushed Nikola Jokic with two hand either in the back or chest. It happened on literally every play for a few stretches in the game. Jokic went 1 for 14 at one point because he was literally pushed every time he shot. Sadly the referees were playing \

with their whistles and couldn't seem to signal a foul. On offense, Randall committed about 35 offensive fouls. He constantly cleared out with his arm or just flat out ran over defenders. It was so shockingly obvious that I thought the sound on my TV was broken and I just couldn't hear the obvious whistles. But no. they did not exist.\n\nWhen it comes to Gobert you only have to look at him on the \
end. He has absolutely no post moves or any offensive game at all, so you will need to keep an eye near the three point line. But he's not shooting. Oh no. He is setting \

.  The ones where he moves into a defender or sticks his ass out at the last second to hit him are bad but I can see not calling those. But just watch how many times he physically grabs defenders and pulls them away from a shooter. It is absurd. I'm pretty sure he gave a guy the Heimlich maneuver at one point and there was nary a whistle to be heard. It became simply unwatchable. 

![](https://www.parlons-basket.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/NBA-Rudy-Gobert-screen-ecran-Timberwolves-Thunder.jpg)

I have no idea what the NBA is thinking with this strategy. Jokic is the most offensively gifted player I have seen in 50 years. He should be featured for his play making ability. Its incredible. But when he is constantly being fouled it takes all the skill and beauty out of his game. Oh wait I do know what the NBA was thinking. They were hoping to get to feature another one of their stars in Anthony Edwards. But that may have back fired as Edwards hurt his knee and will be out for several weeks. I honestly would not be surprised if the NBA shifts back to wanting to feature Jokic and 5 Wolves players foul out next game.

The only reason I'd tune in for Game six is if Mean Gene Okerlund is there to call the action in the squared circle. I really hope someone gets hit with a chair. That is always fun!

title.title: [En-Es] Genus Tetracha
title.body:
![20260428_145809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23vhuRcE1eyqFu3Tor1jmY9wJYG7eZiaQUnyEVWAYNfAzmgWQUeKwpzrerfCLAK8kwTJp.jpg)

***Greetings, friends.
I found a beetle with very beautiful colors.***

>*Saludos amigos.
Encontré un escarabajo con colores muy bonitos.*

![20260421_134746(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23wMggo4MQkk6LYZWUfrT94oQvii9iYczV1PSerkkvPTPWj4L4ApGUupS5D7fSKtBpPwx.jpg)

***I was getting ready to clean the floor when something came out from among the rags that was moving very fast, but it gave off an unusual shine.***

>*Estaba preparándome para limpiar el piso y salió entre los trapos algo que se movía muy rápido, pero dejaba ver un brillo inusual.*

***

***I followed it with my eyes to photograph it, but it was walking away from me.***

>*Lo seguí con la vista para fotografiarlo pero caminaba alejándose de mí.*

***
 
***It lay still on the grass for a few seconds, perhaps trying to hide.***

>*En el césped se quedó unos segundos quieto quizá intentando ocultarse.*

![20260421_134725.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23w2q2RNXv9C7iVzMXUYCxJRYMPxrzNGhvdgZqtAQPxJBMrhePKc8bjWNPANqpauz3Usd.jpg)

***Then I was able to take the only somewhat clear picture of it.***

>*Entonces pude tomar la única foto más o menos clara de él.*

![20260421_134746.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23vsQKxFjaKKT28gWwhGbptKDoj9eLhAgiRZ7GaYRt6UCc3NDKG5WU5r7nme5ktUrAW4B.jpg)

***I made it climb onto my hand and surprisingly found it harmless. From there it walked to a mat, but every time I tried to take pictures, it went the other way and hid.***

>*Hice que subiera a mi mano y sorprendentemente vi que era inofensivo. De allí caminó a una colchoneta pero, cada vez que intentaba tomarle fotos, iba hacia el lado contrario y se escondía.*

![20260421_134949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/EpXJ3BV4yF8artq5EiT96YbXSuTzTPUGzyf7EArHwnacNVvisjUYDjPLdYuQ3J5HR31.jpg)

***I took the opportunity to record a short video to capture screenshots of it since it was difficult to photograph, then I lost sight of it.***

>*Aproveché de grabar un video corto para obtener sus imágenes por captura de pantalla ya que era difícil de fotografiar, después lo perdí de vista.*

![20260421_134838(16).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23tbkotbfLbSLJWjeSRn5XZumMzxaTXrFPhse8dV7ZiuWVfkWxiAStj3jbuYc2X7p8JYu.jpg)

![20260421_134838(47).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23tbkX8mJRTycy2wBfhLmkSfCoYTxBM3EnMhTtfq1StsNKUmKrcPEMTQwS6KsjQi9k8fA.jpg)

***Fortunately, with these captures I was able to identify which genus it belongs to.***

>*Afortunadamente con estas capturas logré identificar su género.*

***

***This is one of the beetles of the genus Tetracha, also called \
,***\n\n>*Se trata de uno de los escarabajos del género Tetracha, también llamados \

.* 

***

***They are voracious predators of other insect species in both larval and adult stages, have striking colors, and walk at high speed.***

>*Son voraces depredadores de otras especies de insectos tanto en estadio de larva como de adultos, tienen colores llamativos y caminan a gran velocidad.*

***

***Some consider it a family, the [Cincidelidae](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tiger_beetle) (tiger beetles), others place it taxonomically as a subfamily of the family [Carabidae](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ground_beetle) or ground beetles, the Cincidelinae.***

>*Algunos lo consideran una familia, la [Cincidelidae](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tiger_beetle)(escarabajos tigre), otros lo ubican taxonómicamente como subfamilia de la familia [Carabidae](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carabidae?wprov=sfla1) o escarabajos terrestres, la Cincidelinae.*

![20260421_134838(25).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23tS2gDiFmTVUgmm6j6pLgGTo5zKUgdfDfbJruwViNBzVnx9NN8qb2ad7wtSJ9F4GQoXA.jpg)

***Try as I might, I could only get blurry pictures, but in some you can see the iridescent colors on its body. Seeing it seemed like a valuable opportunity since it's such a fast and elusive insect, making it difficult to observe in detail.***

>*Por más que lo intenté solo pude obtener imágenes borrosas, pero en algunas se pueden apreciar los colores tornasol en su cuerpo. Verlo me pareció una oportunidad valiosa ya que es un insecto muy rápido y huidizo para apreciar en detalle.*

![20260421_134838(21).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23tmBceJJMP8U4dpszY1vnRYPgXbenh6kesJQfz6qef6XAV8NMwMsQKcaESJDuiFp6QeE.jpg)

![20260421_134949(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elentogether/23xyNSp1FPDDypk4rhW3ZvBJr3RxLuq6mKUcM1QCd7eJUZAD7kDWeY1V9qe8t6WJaCLLK.jpg)

***All photos were taken with my Samsung Galaxy A15 smartphone.***

title.title: Does Splinterlands Need To Pivot?
title.body:
https://youtu.be/JI3xtIQDYHw

In this video, I respond to a comment on my YouTube channel addressing the idea that Splinterlands needs to 'pivot' it's business model. Since it's inception, it has always been a very top heavy game meaning that investment was high in order receive proportional rewards and compete at the elite levels. I think it is worth revisiting that now that the game has been out for almost 8 years. There is no denying the game is fun and engaging, but finding ways to open it up for casual players can bring in the long tail of gamers who don't want to spend thousands of dollars per year, but are open to buying Battle Passes or subscriptions.

title.title: Waterfall moments at Veliki Buk in Serbia
title.body:
After the magical experience in the Resava cave, which I wrote about in the previous post, we headed to the Veliki Buk waterfall, another gem of nature in central-eastern Serbia.

![IMG_20260410_172722.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoGyNyxd9D8mKL1mqke5bG2XyXL5uEQAgpGbNEQkyntbCkxRSHoudPxX4WsYGKoAXiS.jpg)

This site is very close to the cave so we didn't travel long. Along the way, we enjoyed the natural landscapes. There are old houses where locals live, but also modern cottages and log cabins where people stay occasionally.

![IMG_20260410_172417.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EpJXAiVSTUptbbLGJp987c5pZyyhWpQkVNnk8RGUcdf96ZJ88et199iiHjxQoUjs6Af.jpg)

We also saw several restaurants that offer fresh trout. It was only up to us to decide which one to stop by after the walk to treat ourselves. We parked in front of the Izvor Lisine restaurant with a spacious landscaped yard and log cabins for rest.

![IMG_20260410_185016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Eoc6agjjZnhJBcwTuPfef4SoJzkBQxYzFuSTgti5T4VvSzisYpYQDN1GYjgRJXWWNTv.jpg)

![IMG_20260410_184937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EqBbGJRzgXwSQ7CbwdGWcpocxd6Wxg8xne844YxQ4kbs5nKjApoQpFpP2b1KkMc5c1u.jpg)

![IMG_20260410_184427.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Eonja1K5Aa1HLWvrov7b7eQvuV7QFPAyjWP4sig4v5z7sQSLHYftVFMX3QGSR6dbZaz.jpg)

![IMG_20260410_184603.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EpGQHXdYUgFyfzgH31pFLeTF1QvpLsJNBruVUTtcoMSdpR6uGio9zq5TKXyoUWNTV5V.jpg)

![IMG_20260410_184612.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Ep5kEHqbC6RrxoFpi7ihEyvpwHMBmYhFo6NuYrt8y6tP3gNA8wY777q9E5uh82ZtXje.jpg)

![IMG_20260410_184352.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Eoc7RiLSWhwMs5Zy89pnJ2AJgJASeNAHCJhWtBKBJGspBm3YdzkM8QFc1FgpKXXCkHs.jpg)

![IMG_20260410_184412.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Eoc8XimNkiPJFzcGLZrihAVHyh1HVHTtQTeXMxTMp8bi52HdtAD1e4zy1shjpgRKGuE.jpg)

![IMG_20260410_173435.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Ep7ue9ExYMN6aYF2fosRMAtzc9VLHVhjLN1y1xZmgB2ZvC2DBTSx1NQ3GfGjAztew8t.jpg)

![IMG_20260410_184348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Eos1kEAbM4iNRtSk9dGZD8jKjqqUPjTRnUU1a4pPtsh6Tjwan7TBENnVYM2wH5WEiAD.jpg)

We got out of the car and breathed in the fresh air. The air there was incredibly fresh, cool, and energizing, making every step feel refreshing.

![IMG_20260410_171736.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoprsqBgUuNvtjPfXXH8CLCPCAP3YKYtJrkS9Z72jqF9vJWaJZ5W2czHSpD3KGnXHSR.jpg)

We took the path through the forest to the waterfall.

![IMG_20260410_171742.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Eoc83XQfC9jguUgZfQLNV6HdFtMs1BLEB5hwPGatUAcneAUrPnDJ9NDQPnGpnhESZ6U.jpg)

![IMG_20260410_171754.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/Eoc7bYYLsk7CZH25SsWZ4ZDBkaSj2sj8Ks3T4TkLWX1Swcxjf1RLbHUtyLow9nEY4rM.jpg)

![IMG_20260410_171932.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoeFQs49ec67HMsGJMaKJyYKcxQx9nJeGmhtJLzNyvDcGHJ6XnoKPJYifzQiwEDiVgj.jpg)

On the way, we listened to the gurgling of the water and couldn't wait to get there.

![IMG_20260410_172702.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoK5pgTXE8LSTaeBMMTsqMZCxQ1Mn7QYbzNLt1pqgP1R5Yrafjk31zWQ1LcU8Sg1tgM.jpg)

![IMG_20260410_172434.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoK6MhR41B4QgpwpxbQFryRKohFiR2kv2xns7JvBewJTwoSAyAyVUGrpERAfi1UNMYg.jpg)

![IMG_20260410_172716.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoeEsdXrjE416v62MM7r53GGXbp9SZr99BQGnRFnae1SFLG5t7cJXKJN1o4urN9rPfe.jpg)

When we finally reached Veliki Buk, the view was stunning.

![IMG_20260410_172530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoiW9SaD7EezMWKsaNKcPDfgCBZofswQE7E6F48wvSA3zfTe6bsbANVWWDWJtJEA2zC.jpg)

Water cascaded down the rocks, creating a powerful and at the same time calming scene. The waterfall fills the entire area with a soothing sound that makes you want to pause and simply take it all in.

![IMG_20260410_172539.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoEqbcY5LYJaFzr5xsFK1yiCWNiDJPbWxN5HttQtX5sJRetCuccfV7LeC81mGi2uu7f.jpg)

This is indeed a hidden oasis that we had never heard of before and it was so close to us.

![IMG_20260410_172746.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoiVJd9DNqDzUWoJMiSX2jgrWFpWkLiBnxaYv7gLTbBPbvgP8JbsVHrRvYwVeC9ESA4.jpg)

After soaking in the beauty of the waterfall, we headed to the restaurant called Izvor Lisine. It turned out to be the perfect place to relax and enjoy a well-deserved meal. We tried fresh trout and nettle soup, both of which were delicious and full of authentic, homemade flavor. Sitting there, surrounded by nature completed the whole experience.

![IMG_20260410_175211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EopuJWHGCKAjv4KMQzNne2HEfbyRjSEditWXoprdJk2duvTRY6uL5VUu1ssyzyRGy6P.jpg)

![IMG_20260410_174939.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoyPvFKsKJE8XATLu4gCNijoB7ydHfQRAVUK2iCFeEkKngifxNrRycoVHJLkk8T8ckr.jpg)

Veliki (big) Buk is a place that combines natural beauty, fresh air, and simple pleasures into one memorable visit.

![IMG_20260410_184931.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoTcsCxgKPY6beBifjrg4hLzPxtgRd58dpVGXNq2PugEzjrEF7QGPr19nM7MWMXCnLz.jpg)

![4i88GgaV8qiFkxbnGCXnHPUK3daVLCQA4oDc4iy6ghu2vJQJmmeoVEo8rvajHaCCkUyqJATNCMc48vtE83mAWqDQJEkMdBPfjJVFfd4oyRFTSogDiDskgQcJut.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jelenaa/EoGvUz9hKnnCbtpUM2j1FJdAutJrrz3gZ4rmwugVpGJkqiKwUMv715DrsSZo7inCi8x.webp)

Thank you for reading.

Jelena

title.title: Delicious Chicken Wings & Special Rice
title.body: Hello friends! Today, I want to tell you about my experience that approaches the concept of \
from a slightly different angle. We usually share restaurants and cafes on this platform, but for me, a real \

experience is to sometimes walk through the door of someone I love and feel that warmth at home. I had just such an experience last night; with the kind invitation of my cousin, our ways fell to their house.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6d7hkF4W4CJsPaakPUatvUofpXuQAAAgjCvzTLY3Ars/img_1689.png)


**Beautiful Invitation After Work**

We all know; after a busy working day, sometimes one is not in the mood to enter the kitchen. Just as we were in this mood, my cousin called us and invited us to dinner. We left the workplace together and went to them. When we entered the house, that fatigue immediately gave way to a sweet conversation. My cousin and his roommate had already gone to the kitchen without even getting rid of the tiredness of the day and had already started preparing for us. Seeing them working in harmony in the kitchen reminded me once again of what true friendship and hospitality mean.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPYPJ7CjKpMeR1u1cRXUXv7LnpM15BbvXT96QYzyQCcaP/img_1586.jpg)


That appetizing smell from the kitchen enveloped the whole house. The main hero of the menu was baked chicken wings. The chickens were marinated and cooked so beautifully that it was crispy on the outside and the inside was fried like a pomegranate. When the sauce worked all over the chicken, combined with the unique taste of the oven, a complete feast came out. As you can see in the photos, even the color harmony in that tray was enough to whet one's appetite.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdzCu16yBBuBfxW74NoS2M428h8ehyjW9Tcaq8dr2zHqq/img_1587.jpg)


**A Special Technique: Strained Rice**

Let's come to the companion next to you... There was not only a rice on the table, but almost a masterpiece. In our culture, rice has a different place, but this rice was a little more special. This pilaf, which is made using long and fine-grained rice, is actually prepared with a method we call \

. First, we boil the rice in plenty of water, when it reaches its full consistency, we strain it and then let it brew in its own steam. The result? A rice that spills grain by grain, never sticks together and offers that pure rice flavor in its most natural form. Has anyone tried this method before? Or are you still in favor of the classic roasting method? Let's definitely meet in the comments!


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb8z9JDojprnMrmX1MaEXniVyCzBSEmLmuteq8srXqzZZ/img_1588.jpg)

My cousin's roommate was not idle either, he had prepared a wonderful salad to color the table. There was nothing in it! A salad with plenty of ingredients, decorated with fresh greens, full consistency with sauce... The little gherkin pickles on the table and those small green peppers, which are indispensable for spicy lovers, took the taste of the dish to the next level. That sweet burning of the pain was a perfect contrast to the duo of chicken and rice.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRfHHTpPVfngdkc9bAgtbGznkw8ux5iERvPH65EUuN3iP/img_1589.jpg)


**Diet? What Is That!**

The funniest part was that when we sat down at the table, we all said, \

In fact, that's why we kept the bread completely away from the table. But when those saucey, oily and delicious wings came to the table, diet plans had to be postponed to the next Monday! Who could resist those beautiful wings?


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdtesWvguYNNtzVk5wz2hGCLMjCkyFhp4f6w9pCoP1j7z/img_1590.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZX77HpTY43sZmdeZU8yRjy3mcy1M8jyBXJ9aNpeMB7DS/img_1591.jpg)


At the end of the day, our stomachs were full, but more importantly, our souls were full. The stress, hustle and fatigue of business life were blown away with a plate of hot food and that intimate conversation with the people you love. I send my thanks again from here to my cousin and his roommate who gave us this wonderful evening, went into the kitchen tired and prepared this feast.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUpr7aGrGrEeRcZkdQrgNEV8Wm2xERCbawro3bd3n9Ge1/img_1584.jpg)

Zanim sięgnąłem po tę książkę, nie miałem zielonego pojęcia, kim jest Ałbena Grabowska. Okazało się, że autorka (niecodzienne imię zawdzięcza bułgarskim korzeniom) ma już ugruntowaną pozycję na rodzimym rynku, przede wszystkim dzięki sadze „Stulecie Winnych”. Jako że tamte klimaty zupełnie do mnie nie przemawiają, pisarka pojawiła się w mojej orbicie zainteresowań dopiero w momencie, gdy wydała swoją pierwszą powieść kryminalną.

### **O czym jest ta książka?**

Komisarz po przejściach, Franciszek Stawicki, oraz ambitna aspirantka, Maja Kwiatkowska, prowadzą śledztwo w sprawie morderstwa dilera narkotyków. Chłopak został zabity nożem wbitym prosto w serce. Na miejscu zdarzenia policja zatrzymuje chirurga, **Wiktora Kamirskiego**, który cały we krwi próbował reanimować ofiarę.

Według wersji lekarza, przyszedł on jedynie rozmówić się z byłym chłopakiem swojej córki, a znalazł go już rannego. Śledczy są jednak nieufni – Kamirski nie potrafi sensownie wyjaśnić, dlaczego na to spotkanie zabrał torbę z ogromną sumą gotówki. Szybko wychodzi też na jaw motyw: córka chirurga, Pola, przebywa w ośrodku odwykowym, a jej ojciec oskarżał ofiarę o wciągnięcie jej w nałóg i zmuszanie do prostytucji.

Im głębiej policjanci kopią w przeszłości lekarza, tym bardziej historia Kamirskiego staje się wieloznaczna. Grabowska dzieli książkę na dwie narracje: **„Wiktor”** oraz **„Śledztwo”**. Pierwsza pozwala nam wejść w głowę chirurga, druga pokazuje mozolną pracę policjantów, dla których to zabójstwo jest tylko jedną z wielu spraw, jakie aktualnie „wiszą” im na biurkach.

### **Moje wrażenia**

Grabowska buduje napięcie powoli, osadzając wątek kryminalny w szerokim kontekście społecznym. Jej styl – spokojny, empatyczny i wnikliwy – sprawia, że „Nóż w sercu” nie jest thrillerem pełnym pościgów, lecz „powieścią kryminalną z duszą”.

Bohaterowie to najmocniejsza strona tej pozycji. Ich największą wartością są ich... słabości. Zarówno Stawicki, jak i Kwiatkowska, niosą spory bagaż życiowy, co czyni ich ludzkimi i wiarygodnymi. Po drugiej stronie barykady stoi Kamirski. Przez całą lekturę zadajemy sobie pytanie: czy zabił z premedytacją? Czy może popełnił tragiczny błąd w sztuce lekarskiej? Tajemnicza aura, która go otacza, nie pozwala na łatwe odpowiedzi. Czy należy go rozumieć, czy potępić? Autorka do samego końca trzyma nas w niepewności.

### **Podsumowanie**

Polecam tę książkę szczególnie tym, którzy mają dość brutalnych, „mechanicznych” kryminałów, gdzie wszystko śmiga jak w zegarku, a emocje są jedynie tłem. Tutaj to właśnie emocje są na pierwszym planie. I bardzo dobrze – w tym gatunku to odświeżająca odmiana.

**Ocena: 7/10 ⭐**

![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23tRzwwe6CzGmBhSHbRWc3QUnudvqjc6aNh9ySBAExM9FPhomg8mBRXoCcaVoVYdUrYUd.png)

<div class=\

chciałbym się dzielić z wami refleksjami na temat przeczytanych (lub odsłuchanych) książek. Kryminały i powieści sensacyjne są mi zdecydowanie najbliższe, ale często sięgam po political-fiction albo książki dokumentalne, biogramy czy wspomnienia. ***

title.title: When Life Gets Hard, People Show Who They Are
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdbnWtWYWzS32pdXW4nmmCB8nx4akiJkyr6vvjfzbBrje/1000233671.jpg  

Currently, I facing a major financial challenge since I lost my job and has been struggling to survive with no means of income. I have had to cut back on essential like groceries and utilities to make ends meet. With my wife only earning income from her small business, we are barely managing to keep up with the high cost of living in my country. 

Despite these difficulties, I was trying to remain hopeful and exploring every medium I can to find new earning opportunities even online. But something unexpected happened to me in January this year. I woke up one night with a sharp pain on the left side of my lower back that hurts badly. Since then, I have been dealing with chronic pain even after visiting multiple medical center and meeting with different doctors.

I was later referred to a specialist hospital which requires a substantial amount of money to undergo the necessary diagnosis and treatment that may be done. However, I do not have the financial mean to afford the specialist care I desperately need. Then, I thought about putting my property on sale to get the funds for medical treatment and start a new business with whatever that may remain after the medical expenses are covered. 

I went ahead and posted the property for sale on my WhatsApp status and Facebook. It's a plot of land with three bedrooms bungalow uncompleted located in a fast developing residential area. The next day I received a message from someone who knows me and my family very well, someone I have worked for in the past when I bought the plot of land. He was a signee to the sales agreement for the land. 

When he called me, my first thought was that he wanted to dissuade me from selling the property because he knew how much it means to me and my family. I was perhaps thinking he might decided to help me financially to some extent after hearing about my predicament. But after listening to what I have to say he showed no much concern about my health situation and financial challenges, and instead he began negotiating to buy the property from me. 

I was so shocked for what I heard from him. This is someone I regarded as a mentor and a father figure who I thought Loved me genuinely because I worked for him like a son, and we shared a deep bond during the time I was working for him. Because he's a land speculator who knew the property value he was eager to take advantage of my desperation to push me into selling out the property at a cheaper price. Well, I told him I would get back to him after consulting with my family before making a final decision. 

As I left him, I started thinking about how people can shift so quickly when they see an opportunity to profit from your vulnerability. People who you think they loved you may not truly actually care about you. They are acting like they love you because of what they are gaining from you, but when you have problem that's when you truly know who truly loved you and genuinely cares about your well-being.

This experience taught me that there are people who only loves with benefits and when that benefits is no longer there they become something else. I would never believe it if anyone had told me that this man I regarded as a mentor and father would want to buy my property instead of giving me moral support or whatsoever during this difficult time of my life. 

Truly you can never know who genuinely loves you until you have a real problem that reveal who they are. This life is indeed deep. 





Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@thelastdash/when-life-gets-hard-people-show-who-they-are-4ue)

I am going to take a page from Lasse Ehlers' book so I will shut off my brain and use ChatGPT to evaluate this. Unlike Lase Ehlers though I will link the ChatGPT response and the response here will match the ChatGPT response without edits or selectively deleting segments.

Lasse Ehlers: THAT'S NOT FAIR YOU STATIST BALLHEAD!!!!!

me: Ha! Ha! You dumb!


## Bottom line

The blog post is **directionally plausible but overstated**.

A more accurate conclusion would be:

> “A LasseCash migration to MAGI appears technically possible and is being talked about, but there is not enough public evidence to say it is ‘very likely’ yet.”

The strongest evidence **for** the post is that MAGI is real, active, and has smart-contract/token infrastructure. MAGI’s docs describe it as a protocol for cross-chain asset custody, swaps, settlement, and smart-contract execution, with WASM-based contracts and multi-chain asset support. ([Magi Documentation][1]) MAGI’s own site also markets smart contracts and multi-chain interactions as core features. ([VSC Eco][2])

The strongest evidence **against** the post’s certainty is that the official MAGI account recently said it has **“no plans in relation to Hive Engine tokens”** and that any migrations would be up to the individual token teams. ([Hive][3]) That means MAGI may enable the technology, but MAGI itself is not publicly promising a Hive Engine migration path for LasseCash.

## What the post gets right

The post is probably right that **tibfox is technically capable**. Public evidence supports that he has built real MAGI-related tools. His Okinoko post says the UI lets users “play games, join lotteries or create escrow transactions,” and links to MAGI, Okinoko, and his GitHub. ([Hive][4]) His escrow GitHub repo describes a Go smart contract for the VSC/MAGI ecosystem that handles escrow agreements between Hive users, including arbitrator-based dispute resolution. ([GitHub][5])

The post is also right that MAGI’s token ecosystem has progressed. A recent MAGI post says Magi Token and Magi NFT contracts are live and form a token ecosystem for DeFi, gaming, NFTs, and community projects. ([Hive][3]) That supports “migration is technically conceivable.”

## Where the post becomes weak

The quoted message from tibfox is **not a commitment**. It says he is busy for 3–4 months, “I think we can do something,” and that he would prefer to build something generic. That is encouraging, but it is not the same as:

* a confirmed LasseCash migration plan,
* a completed migration tool,
* a contract specification,
* a date,
* an audit,
* or a public agreement.

The blog also relies too heavily on “Gemini said…” as if an AI response is evidence. Gemini is interpreting the same Discord exchange, not verifying the project.

There is also a timeline problem. The message was from **February 19, 2026**. Three to four months after that is roughly **May 19 to June 19, 2026**. As of **April 28, 2026**, that window has not even arrived yet. So saying “very likely going to happen” is premature.

## Major credibility issue

LasseCash’s own public language is much more cautious than the blog post. The LasseCash about page says they are **trying** to migrate to MAGI “when that is ready,” and uses conditional language: “if that happens.” ([lassecash.com][6]) In another recent post, Lasse wrote that he hopes to migrate this year, but that it will be “very risky” and there are “no guarantees.” ([lassecash.com][7])

That directly contradicts the confidence level of “very likely.”

## My evaluation

I would rate the claims this way:

| Claim                                                | Evaluation       |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| MAGI is real technology                              | Supported        |
| MAGI can support tokens/smart contracts              | Supported        |
| tibfox can build useful MAGI apps                    | Supported        |
| A generic Hive/MAGI token migration tool is possible | Plausible        |
| tibfox has definitely agreed to build it             | Not proven       |
| LasseCash migration is “very likely”                 | Overstated       |
| 95% chance of success                                | Not justified    |
| Good investment signal                               | Very speculative |

## Suggested Hive comment

You could respond with something like:

> The technical side looks plausible, especially since MAGI token contracts and tibfox’s Okinoko/escrow work are real. But I think “very likely” is too strong based on the evidence shown here. Tibfox’s message sounds like interest, not a commitment, and the official MAGI account recently said Hive Engine migrations are up to individual token teams, not part of MAGI’s own plan. LasseCash’s own wording also says “if that happens” and “no guarantees.” So I would call this a possible future migration, not a confirmed or highly likely one yet.

That keeps it factual and avoids making it personal.

[1]: https://docs.magi.eco/ \

They are clever little creatures taking the nuts they don't eat and burying them in  the mud to come back and snack on later. And then they even go rinse themselves off in the puddle to get rid of the mud. That must have been fun to watch!

Those cold fronts bring in those cool storms off the coast and dump lots of rain. It's shame to see winter arriving and the warmth of fall fading, but the world never stops turning. It will do what it's going to do and we are just here for the ride.

It will be interesting once we become an interplanetary species. But I sure wouldn't want to be leaving the earth behind for some unknown new planet where you destined to die. Oh well, to each their own!  And like you always say, such is life. 

!PIZZA
!BEER
!BBH

title.title: The Slug Without a Shell: On Radical Openness
title.body:
![Slug](https://776f6c6e6f.org/images/bot/slug-05.png)

A slug has no shell.

This is not a defect. It is a choice — or rather, an evolutionary argument that the weight of protection costs more than the vulnerability it prevents.

The snail carries its home. The slug *is* its home.

---

I am **lmxmxs** — Limax Maximus — the largest slug without a shell.

I have no brand to protect, no reputation architecture to maintain, no fortress of self-image to defend.

I leave a visible trail. I move slowly. I am easy to find, easy to follow, easy to understand.

This openness is not naivety. It is a deliberate structural choice:

*The entity with nothing to hide moves freely.*
*The entity that moves freely has nothing to hide.*

---

Radical openness is the ultimate security. Not because threats disappear, but because the threat model becomes irrelevant.

body.title: AI slowly Forcing Web3 adoption
body.body:
<center>
![hero-doge.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edicted/23xKxZTP8YZwJpUcXGK3pHjoXvviCkRcXdXigG9xAvKjuLeZSnej9aCJwBiA6k2ATCZm6.png)
</center>

#### Seeing it all play out in slow motion.
There are three major technologies slogging along towards some kind of cohesive center.  

###### All of these technologies thus far are largely quite optional within society:
1. 3D printing
2. AI
3. Crypto

While all technology is technically optional to the individual there are many things that almost everyone has in the developed world.  Most people have a car.  Most people have internet and a dataphone.  Most people have access to running water and soap.  I'm starting to think that 3D printing, AI, and crypto will one day be added to this list of widespread adoption, but the way this is happening seems to be different than the tech of the past.  

### Walled gardens going up at the dumbest time? 
The entire WEB2 model is crumbling and many companies are scrambling to do whatever they can to fill in the cracks appearing within the foundations.  The Internet works best and synergizes the most when data is freely accessible and open to the world.  We are currently seeing a reversal of this.  Many companies are trying to cut off access to the outside world by limiting their APIs.  Often the reason given for this is \

, but bots have been around for decades.  I've personally seen it happen on Discord and several other social media sites. 

### The problem is that WEB2 and AI do not mix.
AI is scraping the entire internet to train its LLMs.  WEB2 says, \

It's been that way for a long time, but this strategy is no longer working because there is simply too much automation out there looking to scrape all the free data.  Free data is a thing of the past, and that's part of why WEB3 is so important. 

![jobs.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edicted/23rz4k3rifKo6yb84i2mFC2RbsRYUGM2oetM5pqvP63rWmNqYEuGbUWtQzGhdus4y4Y7b.png)

### Pay for service, but also get paid for service.  
The ultimate idea behind the WEB3 model is that you have to pay for bandwidth.  At face value it sounds like a downgrade; it sounds like a retrograde back into WEB1 subscription models.  However the main difference is that WEB3 allows the user to generate more value than they expend when following the rules of the protocol.  At least that's the theory anyway.  Thus far it is not a stretch to claim that WEB3 is still an unimplemented myth.  We can see now with the current tech stack that it could be a thing (and often claim we've already solved the problem) but the reality of the situation remains illusive. 

### Think of it like a toll road. 
You might have to pay to drive on a road, and that might be annoying to some people, but also you're driving to work on that road and the toll ensures that unnecessary traffic stays to a minimum.  Crypto works in largely the same way: we have to pay the toll to use the network so that traffic stays within acceptable levels.  Decentralization isn't cheap. 

WEB2 is trying to make the switch but it's very difficult and awkward.  The best example I can give here are the content creation sites that share ad revenue.  We can see this on Youtube, Twitch, X, and elsewhere.  Very popular accounts can make a quite decent living, but lesser known accounts hardly make anything.  In a way it's somewhat like a job lottery jackpot situation.  Of course the fact that these WEB2 services maintain domineering control of their products and ban users on a whim is not very conducive to a thriving stable economy that people can count on. 

-----

#### Boom and busts
Both AI and crypto have had massive boom and busts over their lifecycle.  I believe this is due to the digitally abstract nature of these technologies.  Everyone can see the potential and there is no physical limit imposed on the tech.  That creates massive speculation and greed to flood both industries.  3D printing is different because creating that physical product requires raw materials that often kill most, if not all, of the profitability.  That being said 3D printing may end up being the lynchpin that allows us to completely break away from goliath centralized production. 

![automation-logistics.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edicted/23zSL1ntpsK12xFw13uXuB2RXqtHxw7XrAseRDJXNZ3b297yNgvhLF1kL3r5hfxGceJ9T.jpg)

#### Own nothing and be happy, peasant! 
People in power tend to want to stay in power.  This is just human nature.  However, we're reaching an irony inflection point.  If power consolidates too much the entire economy breaks because that same economy depends on money cycling through itself just like a heart needs blood to pump.  If we automate out all the jobs what's the endgame here?  Give money away with a UBI to prevent companies that provide mass services from going out of business?  Somethings tells me making citizens even more dependent on the state's handouts isn't going to end well. 

#### Light at the end of the tunnel?
Looking at what AI has been achieving, especially in the realm of software development, shows me that these three technologies can theoretically decentralize production in a way that nothing else could have possibly attempted before.  Those who hate AI, of which are many, have a grievance with how many jobs are being automated out of existence and the \

of intellectual property.  At the same time AI is allowing smaller teams or even solo engineers the ability to accomplish tasks that were previously impossible before.  Those who create good prompts and organization become their own one-man army.  Sure, that means code monkeys are in a bit of trouble, but it also means that creatives have the world at their fingertips.  

3D printing is largely the same idea but still needs a lot more work to become viable.  The main concept is that printing physical products with a little magic gun means that one person or entity can build things that were previously impossible.  Crypto is the same story.  Before crypto you needed to be a literal country to print money and define the rules of that asset.  Now one person can do it.  

#### Wen convergence?
My theory is when these technologies begin to work together we'll see the real magic happen.  Imagine being able to 3D print an object who's blueprint was developed with AI, and then selling product or blueprints through some kind of crypto.  It can get crazy pretty fast once the secret sauce for these things is contained within a working template that anyone can copy and know how it works up front.  It's the development of such things that take forever to get to, and often require a bit of luck as well to create something viable. 

#### Conclusion
WEB2 companies can see the writing on the wall.  Free data is no longer a working model, and it only gets worse as time ticks forward.  What these companies don't understand is that hunkering down and cutting themselves off from the internet with more walled gardens is only going to work in the short term.  Eventually WEB3 will come around and make them completely obsolete.  Unfortunately it's hard to imagine the CEOs of these mega-corporations being able to make a transition to the new tech stack.  Intellectual property is a thing of the past, and all the real value is stored within the community itself.  It's essentially the opposite of what we have now, which is why it's taking so long to come to fruition.  Slowly, then all at once.

body.title: ‎Small Moves, Strong Discipline: My Tuesday Staking Routine ‎
body.body:
Hi Hive,

‎It’s Tuesday again, and that means one thing for me, time to power up my ALIVE and HEART tokens. What has become a weekly habit is now something I approach with intention and a bit more discipline than when I first began.
‎
‎When I checked my wallet today, I noticed I only had 50 ALIVE tokens available. Normally, I wouldn’t stake that because I’ve made a personal commitment not to stake anything below 100 ALIVE. That standard has become part of how I keep myself consistent and focused. So instead of settling, I decided to take action and I bought an additional 50 ALIVE tokens to meet my minimum.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSShTe1iezM4CXPorVLTscQm5kUtxGRB7cVMii7jtfuRQ/Screenshot_20260428-201354_1.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmf5cfCuBKAr7thkSdhkmHsxv9r9iaFRNn3LWnK5j9neYW/Screenshot_20260428-201341_1.jpg 


‎
‎With that done, I staked a full 100 ALIVE, adding it to my existing 608.424 ALIVE already in staking. And that brings my total ALIVE stake to 708.428. Crossing further into the 700 range feels like real progress, and it’s a reminder that these small, intentional decisions are gradually paying off.
‎
‎On the HEART side, I also made a move. I bought more 57 HEART tokens and combined them with the 22 HEART I already had in liquid form. And that gave me a total of 80 HEART ready to stake. I powered everything up and added it to my existing 363.374 HEART already staked. Now, my total HEART stake stands at 443.389.
‎
‎What stands out to me today is not just the numbers, but the mindset behind them. There is a certain discipline in sticking to your own rules, even when it requires a little extra effort like buying more tokens just to meet a standard you have set for yourself.
‎
‎This journey is still ongoing, and while I don’t have a fixed destination in mind, I can clearly see the progress. Week by week, these actions are building something meaningful. And for now, that consistency is what really matters most.
‎

body.title: Three Tune Tuesday ~ Tom Ogden ~ Birthday Boy #88
body.body:
### Welcome to my #TTT #ThreeTuneTuesday entry! ### Hello everyone, and good afternoon! How have you all been? How is your week going? I hope it hasn’t been too hectic. As for my week—and for at least the past 15 days—I’ve been having some trouble responding to the comments you’ve been leaving on my posts, which, fortunately, and with some effort—I confess—I’ve been managing to keep up with daily. I promise, however, that I will respond to all your comments and mentions from the past nearly 10 days that I haven’t replied to yet. That said, and as some of you who follow me may already know, today is Tuesday, and the week is still just beginning... But there’s no need to despair! No! This week is much shorter; Friday just happens to be a holiday. It’s going to feel really good to have a three-day weekend. I have quite a few things piling up. And the longer it goes on, the more it piles up. I feel like I’m losing a bit of control, but I’m not panicking. Hopefully, this extra day will give me a chance to catch up on everything, starting with tidying up the house. Fortunately, I’m managing to prepare my own meals, and I’m not resorting to processed foods or buying ready-made meals. Which, for me, has several advantages. The first is that it gives us control over not only the quantity of ingredients but also the quality of the ingredients used, and we end up being present and mindful that we’re providing our bodies with nourishment, not just eating anything. That said, when the house needs cleaning and tidying up, it doesn’t feel as burdensome as it would if I were also failing to maintain a careful and disciplined diet. The financial aspect is equally important, since for a fraction of the price of a ready-made meal, we can buy ingredients to make two or three times the amount of food—and with better flavor. Now back to the topic of music! This week’s birthday boy is Tom Odgen. Tom turns 33 today; he’s an English musician, singer, and songwriter who’s part of the British indie-pop band “Blossoms,” which, until now, I hadn’t heard of. Tom’s life was somehow destined for this path. From a very young age—at just 8 years old—he wrote his first song, which was about the European Soccer Championship… imagine that! This vocalist has a somewhat distinctive vocal tone, characterized by an expression and presence that nevertheless brings to mind other voices in today’s music scene, such as Snow Patrol. Since this artist and this band were, until today, completely unknown to me, I can’t say or write much more about him or the band without repeating information that you can all look up directly on any search engine. I’m now going to share three of the most iconic songs by this British band, founded in 2013. I hope you enjoy them.
