title.title: Television Review: Dark Wings, Dark Words (Game of Thrones, S3X02, 2013)
title.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/fFFpqTdqddCXcP35GH7S7eKX3rr.jpg)

**Dark Wings, Dark Words (S03E02)**

Airdate: 7 April 2013

Written by: Vanessa Taylor
Directed by: Daniel Minahan

Running Time: 56 minutes 



The sheer scope of *Game of Thrones*, even in its third season, remained a potent source of surprise for that portion of the audience which had not ventured into George R.R. Martin’s source novels. For those unacquainted with *A Clash of Kings* or *A Storm of Swords*, upon which this season is broadly based, the narrative continued to unfold with a density that could be both exhilarating and daunting. ‘Dark Wings, Dark Words’, the season’s second episode, stands as a prime example of this narrative abundance. Devoid of the large-scale battles or dragon-fueled spectacle that would come to define later episodes, it instead offers a treasure trove of introductions—new characters, clandestine organisations, and foundational concepts—that diligently expand the world of Westeros and tighten the psychological screws on its inhabitants. 

One of the most significant concepts formalised here is that of the ‘warg’. The term is first heard north of the Wall, where Jon Snow, now embedded with the wildlings, encounters the scout Orell (Mackenzie Crook). Orell is described as a man who can inhabit the minds of animals, using a bird’s eyes to scout the haunted forest. This ability has immediate, grim utility, as Orell’s avian proxy discovers the grisly remains of the Night’s Watch at the Fist of the First Men. The scene efficiently establishes the wildlings’ tactical advantage while reinforcing the desperate plight of the surviving brothers, with Samwell Tarly’s struggle to keep pace underscoring the physical cost of their retreat.

The concept, however, resonates far beyond the Frostfangs. South of the Wall, in the wolfswood, Bran Stark’s party encounters Jojen and Meera Reed (Thomas Brodie-Sangster and Ellie Kendrick). Jojen, the frail but preternaturally calm boy from Bran’s dreams, explicates the nature of Bran’s own abilities. He identifies Bran not just as a ‘warg’—a skinchanger who can enter the mind of his direwolf, Summer—and hints at the greater ‘greensight’ he must learn to hone. This parallel introduction cleverly binds the supernatural threads of the narrative, suggesting a latent power in the Stark bloodline that may become central to the war against the encroaching cold.

While the Starks grapple with mystical destinies, the more visceral horrors of war continue unabated. Theon Greyjoy’s storyline takes a sharp, brutal turn into torture porn, as he is subjected to excruciating pain by mysterious captors. The episode deliberately obfuscates the identity of his tormentors, offering only the sly, unsettling presence of a servant boy (Iwan Rheon) who claims to be sent by Theon’s sister, Yara. This narrative choice, while generating mystery, also marks the episode’s most notable structural flaw—a rather convenient and over-elaborate enigma that feels somewhat contrived amidst the otherwise grounded political machinations.

Meanwhile, King Robb Stark, the Young Wolf, finds his campaign stalling. The news of his grandfather Hoster Tully’s death is a sombre blow, but the devastating raven from Winterfell, informing him of the castle’s sack and the apparent loss of his brothers, strikes at the very heart of his cause. His demoralisation is palpable, a stark contrast to his earlier invincibility, and signals the beginning of his tragic unravelling.

The episode’s most delightfully cynical developments occur in and around King’s Landing. Here, the political theatre is masterfully stage-managed by the women of House Tyrell. Margaery Tyrell, played with exquisite duplicity by Natalie Dormer, continues her campaign to secure the Iron Throne through marriage. Her manipulation operates on multiple levels: with Sansa Stark, she orchestrates a meeting with her grandmother, the formidable Olenna Tyrell (Diana Rigg). In the serene gardens of the Red Keep—filmed in the beautiful Trsteno Arboretum near Dubrovnik—Olenna, the ‘Queen of Thorns’, deploys a disarming blend of warmth and shrewdness to win Sansa’s trust and extract the unvarnished truth about Joffrey: he is a ‘monster’. This intelligence is then weaponised by Margaery in a breathtakingly audacious private audience with the king. Feigning shared trauma from her unconsummated marriage to homosexual Renly, she subtly aligns herself with Joffrey’s cruel appetites, admiring his crossbow with a thrill that suggests a disturbing compatibility. Dormer’s performance is a brilliant example of layered deception, portraying a character who is herself playing a role in a deadly game.

The casting of Diana Rigg as Olenna is a symbolic masterstroke. Rigg, who earned fame as the iconic, assertive Emma Peel in *The Avengers* half a century earlier, embodies a lineage of televised female strength. Her presence immediately establishes Olenna as a matriarch of immense political savvy and wit, a woman who has navigated the patriarchy of Westeros for decades and emerged as its most sharp-tongued operator. While one could read a feminist statement into this casting, the character transcends mere ideology; she is simply superb television, and her first scene instantly becomes one of the series’ most memorable.

Away from the capital, the war’s chaos breeds strange new allegiances. Arya Stark, fleeing Harrenhal with Gendry and Hot Pie, stumbles upon the Brotherhood Without Banners, led by the jovial yet dangerous Thoros of Myr (Paul Kaye). This introduction is fascinating precisely because of its historical resonance. The Brotherhood is not a noble house’s army but an ad-hoc militia of peasants, deserters, and outlaws, formed to protect the smallfolk from the depredations of all warring factions. Such groups have existed throughout history during periods of state collapse, and their presence in Westeros lends the conflict a gritty, authentic texture. The scene at the Inn at the Crossroads is rich with tension and revelation, particularly when Sandor ‘the Hound’ Clegane arrives. The history between Clegane and Thoros adds depth, but the real spark ignites when the Hound recognises Arya, setting a new chain of events in motion.

The episode’s most physically compelling sequence belongs to Brienne of Tarth and her captive, Ser Jaime Lannister. Their uneasy journey towards King’s Landing is a battle of wills and weary bodies. Brienne’s rigid honour clashes with Jaime’s pragmatic survivalism, culminating in a daylight duel on a bridge. It is a pathetic, powerful fight: Jaime, malnourished and shackled, is a shadow of the swordsman he once was, and Brienne subdues him with relative ease. Their struggle is brutally interrupted by the arrival of Locke (Noah Taylor) and his men, soldiers of House Bolton. Their capture introduces a new threat and severs the fragile dynamic that had begun to develop between captor and prisoner, propelling both towards fresh horrors.

*Dark Wings, Dark Words* is an episode that prioritises rich, character-driven exposition over action. It successfully integrates a daunting array of new elements—from the mystical (wargs, greensight) to the political (the Tyrell matriarchy) to the anarchic (the Brotherhood)—without feeling overstuffed. Its strength lies in its commitment to the series’ foundational principle: that words, alliances, and betrayals are the true weapons of Westeros. If it stumbles slightly with the overly cryptic handling of Theon’s torture, this is a minor flaw in an otherwise meticulously crafted piece of television. The episode confirms that even in its third season, *Game of Thrones* could still surprise, not with shock, but with the slow, deliberate, and utterly compelling expansion of its world.



RATING: 8/10 (+++)

title.title: Isla De Plata Beach, Venezuela / Playa Isla De Plata Venezuela [ENG-ESP]
title.body:
>

Welcome, Dear Readers.

Hi everyone, I hope you're all doing great. I haven't been able to share this other adventure with you yet, but here's what happened: we went to Isla de Plata Beach, and I'll tell you all about it. You catch the boats from the same pier to get there. It’s like going to the first beach I told you about earlier, except this one is closer and on the opposite side—let’s say about 10 minutes away. The crystal-clear waters are a sight to behold. Located in Mochima National Park between Anzoátegui and Sucre, I liked this island so much more than the first one I visited. Here you can choose between two spots on the beach, but I noticed that at the other end the tide was too strong—the waves broke more there—so we preferred to stay on the calmer side. I used to see photos of this island on social media, and all I ever saw was that cement factory in the background, but I didn’t know where it was until I actually visited. Sure, the view of the pollution is a bummer, but everything else is amazing. That pirate statue is at the Puerto La Cruz pier, but we couldn’t find it to take a photo until we drove by and spotted it. The sun was out that day. We actually visited two beaches on this trip, but I got really sunburned those days. It was worth it—new adventures in my own country. There are still beaches on my list to visit in the future; I hope it’s soon. We have this paradise right here in Venezuela. Of the few places I’ve been, I’d come back here. Of course, you need a good budget—you spend money like anywhere else—but it’s totally worth it. I hope you liked my story. See you next time. Thanks for reading. Take care. Thank you all Note: These photos were taken from my phone and edited In: Canva

Bienvenidos Apreciados Lectores.

Hola a todos, espero que se encuentren genial, no había podido traerles esta otra aventura, pues así es fuimos a la playa isla de plata quédate para contarte.
En el mismo embarcadero se agarran las lanchas para llegar a ese lugar es como si fuéramos a la primera playa que les compartí anteriormente solo que esta queda antes y del lado opuesto, digamos que unos 10 minutos aguas cristalinas un espectáculo, ubicado en el parque nacional mochima entre Anzoátegui y Sucre, esta isla me gusto demasiado mucho más que la primera que fui, aquí puedes estar de dos ángulos de la playa pero me di cuenta que en el otro extremo la marea era demasiado fuerte allí rompían las olas más, por lo que preferimos estar en la parte con más serenidad.
Siempre veía fotos de esta isla en redes sociales y siempre se veía era ese fondo de la industria cementera pero no sabía en qué lugar quedaba hasta que lo conocí si lo malo es esa vista de contaminación pero de resto es lo máximo, ese pirata está en el muelle de puerto la cruz pero no lo conseguíamos para tomarnos foto hasta que pasando en el carro nos dimos cuenta, ese día el sol estaba favorable, en realidad conocimos dos playas en esta ocasión pero me queme mucho esos días, valió la pena nuevas aventuras en mi país, quedan playas en lista por visitar en un futuro espero sea pronto, este paraíso lo tenemos aquí en Venezuela, de los pocos lugares que he ido yo volvería aquí, claro hay que tener un buen presupuesto se gasta dinero como todo sin embargo vale demasiado la pena, espero les haya gustado mi relato, nos vemos en una próxima ocasión, gracias por leer cuídense.

title.title: When Pain Teaches You Too Much
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNd4JoYNRjnMbGNi6hyNMPAvx891ETt9h15nK9djgjDcm/1777404500803.jpg)

Sometimes life doesn’t teach us gently. It doesn’t sit with us and explain things in a calm voice. Instead, it pushes us through moments that quietly change who we are. One day you are someone who trusts easily, who believes in people, who feels deeply. And then slowly, without even noticing, you become someone who questions everything.
I once heard a line that stayed in my mind: some people make you so “wise” that even if someone cries at your feet, you still can’t trust them. At first, it sounded a bit harsh. But the more I thought about it, the more real it felt.
The truth is, this kind of “wisdom” doesn’t come from books or advice. It comes from experiences that leave marks. Maybe someone you trusted lied to you. Maybe someone promised to stay and didn’t. Maybe you gave your loyalty, your time, your emotions… and in return, you got silence or betrayal.
These moments don’t just hurt once. They sit inside you. They replay in your thoughts. And slowly, they start building a wall. Not a visible wall, but one that changes how you see people.
Before, you used to believe words. Now, you look for hidden meanings.
Before, tears made you soft. Now, they make you suspicious.
Before, you gave chances easily. Now, you hesitate, even when someone seems genuine.
And here’s the hard truth — this change feels like protection. It feels like you are finally being careful, finally being “smart.” But at the same time, something inside you becomes distant. Not just from others, but from your own natural self.
I’ve seen this in everyday life. In small conversations. In friendships that feel a bit cold. In people who smile, but don’t open up anymore. It’s like everyone is carrying their own silent lesson from the past.
But here’s something I keep asking myself — is this really the kind of wisdom we want?
Because if we reach a point where even real emotions look fake to us, then we are not just protecting ourselves… we are also losing something valuable. We start missing out on genuine people, honest apologies, and real connections.
Not everyone is the same. Not everyone will repeat what someone else did to you. But when your past becomes your only reference, it becomes hard to see the difference.
I’m not saying we should go back to being naive. That version of us didn’t always work either. But maybe there is a middle ground. A space where we stay aware, but not completely closed. Where we take time to trust, but don’t refuse it completely.
It’s not easy. I still struggle with it sometimes. There are moments when I doubt even simple kindness. And then I remind myself — every person deserves to be seen for who they are, not for what someone else did.
Pain can teach us a lot. Sometimes too much.
But maybe real strength is not in becoming hard…
maybe it’s in staying soft, just a little, even after everything.

Сегодня я решил исследовать один из моих любимых горных маршрутов. Погода была просто великолепной — солнечно и свежо. По пути я встретил группу туристов, которые поднимались в горы с интересными рассказами о своих приключениях. Один из них, кажется, был профессиональным фотографом, и он показывал свои снимки местной флоры и фауны. Это вдохновило меня на то, чтобы тоже попробовать поймать некоторые моменты своего путешествия. На одном из привалов я увидел удивительное явление — цветение редкой горной орхидеи. Это было невероятно красиво, и я не мог упустить момент, чтобы сделать несколько фотографий. В целом, прогулка прошла очень вдохновляюще, и я снова ощутил всю прелесть общения с природой. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). title.title: ETH Market Shakeout Whale Moves vs Long-Term Growth
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYY9NBWWf6fD53QqfVCtggCt2u3RdvRVmBcXG7TnsZjFX/1000002691.png 
*Source: rizqimaruf*


Ethereum is definitely in the spotlight this week. If you’ve been watching the charts, you know things are feeling a bit tense. We’ve seen some price corrections, and honestly, the 'noise' is everywhere.

The big story right now, as reported by [ **Coin Bureau** ](https://x.com/i/status/2048979267556421763) and other major alerts, is the massive whale movement. A wallet linked to Galaxy Digital just moved **45,000 ETH (around $104 Million)** to exchanges. Usually, this is a signal that big players are ready to sell, and it’s exactly why we saw that quick 1.3% dip recently.

But instead of just following the crowd, I took a deep dive into Etherscan to see what’s actually happening on-chain. Here’s the breakdown from my latest analysis:
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQFCEPezyDZjLBSxJdudZA1uRL171oi18MMhBsyfZcoCY/1000002685.png 
Source: etherscan.io

Looking at the big picture, while the price is struggling to find its footing, network activity is through the roof. Transaction counts have spiked to historic highs. It’s a massive tug of war between panic sellers and people scooping up the dip.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTLnEiRPYVe5H1zZDg7z4yjaSaTduSZ67k54mTwfuCk5Z/1000002690.png 
*Source: etherscan.io*

The data shows a major rush with over **114,000 pending transactions.** Traders are scrambling to react to the whale news, causing some serious network congestion.

​However, the most bullish part for me is the long term growth. Ethereum unique addresses just officially crossed the **406 Million** mark! Users are joining the ecosystem every single day, regardless of the short term price drama.

​Plus, we have big news on the adoption front **Western Union** is planning to launch a stablecoin on Solana soon. This just goes to show that institutional interest in the crypto space is only getting stronger.

**My Take:**
Short term volatility is just part of the game, especially when whales are moving big bags. But when you look at the 406M growing addresses and institutional moves, the infrastructure looks solid. I’m staying focused on the macro and not letting the noise shake me out.

​What are you guys doing? Buying this dip or waiting for more clarity? Let’s talk below.


*\

title.title: 76ers get crushed by Celtics in Game 4 of First Round of NBA Playoffs despite Joel Embiid's return | Game 5 tonight in Boston
title.body:
![nba-philadelphia-76ers-logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AK3eyGpWbyoaTTjJeeKnj44681PrD7tPGkoXMiDJYKDywwjPDVKgyqJH3UhvszU.png)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/nba/nba-philadelphia-76ers-logo/)

Man... Sunday's loss was WAY more depressing than the Game 1 loss. The Sixers NEEDED to tie this series and Joel Embiid made his improbable return which was pretty cool. I respect the toughness for sure, it's pretty shocking he came back just 17 days after his appendectomy! Kelly Oubre Jr. also played despite his own injury. 

But the Sixers swiftly got absolutely owned. What a letdown. My gosh, it was never even slightly competitive. There's this idea surrounding the Sixers that's gaining steam and that is, the Sixers *might* be better without Joel Embiid, and I'm sorta starting to entertain this theory. It's hard to say. I'm unsure if Embiid knows how to play with other competent players, which the Sixers have. It's like as soon as Embiid shows up to a game, the team's pace slows down and he feels as if he has to play Superman or something. Or maybe the other Sixers don't know how to play with Embiid. But it also doesn't help when Embiid plays sporadically in spurts throughout the season and never ever seems to be able to gain any genuine chemistry with these teammates. V.J. Edgecombe only had six points and hasn't looked the same since that awesome Game 2. It's overall just sad man. Just a tough situation no matter how you slice it.

Payton Pritchard of the Celtics will haunt my nightmares I swear. He's annoyingly good and dropped an absurd 32 points in Game 4, it was like he couldn't miss. Legit Steph Curry vibes and I'm dead serious. 

### What it felt like watching the Sixers crumble in Game 4:

![suck-soul.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/Eo6BJwB3rx3Yqga7WtzDgdDMgfmjAoKjdW8zpie98mQ2BsSva3CqP18DfTezEpkP2P7.gif)
[Src](https://tenor.com/view/suck-soul-gif-25974533)

A 3-1 comeback is borderline impossible. I'll be here for a historical bounce back don't get me wrong. But at this point as sad as it sounds, I wouldn't hate it if the Sixers could at least win tonight and push it to a Game 6. That would be a mild consolation prize. A good Play-In victory over the Magic who are currently **beating the #1 seed Pistons 3-1**, followed by pushing the Celtics, who could win the Finals, to 6 games. 

Hey, if the Sixers win tonight, Game 6 will be in Philadelphia. Winning tonight *could* change the series if the Sixers somehow look better with Embiid. Maybe that first game was just a matter of rust who knows. 

Let's just win and ignore the fact that they're down 3-1! Backs are against the wall! Go all out! Ya never know when you'll be in the playoffs again!

# #GOSIXERS

title.title: Systems in Motion A Day Measured in Data Discipline and Direction
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNsRqDrWJMRFSKewt38XZa99k2aurVbhGAa8JEMPbZdnX/image.png 



I am starting to understand something very clearly now. My life is no longer random. It is slowly transforming into a system. Not perfect. Not fully optimized. But structured. Measurable. Trackable. That alone changes everything.

Today was not just another day of running orders and making money. It was a full scale reflection of how I operate under pressure, how I make decisions in real time, and how disciplined I truly am when no one is watching. Every action fed into a larger system that I am building whether I like it or not.

## Morning Phase Controlled Start Controlled Intent

The day began early. The kind of early where most people are still asleep but I am already thinking in terms of movement, positioning, and opportunity. This is where the edge begins. Getting ahead before the demand spikes.

First order hit at 7 38 am for 18 29. Not impressive but necessary. It opened the flow. It got me into the system.

From there the sequence continued

9 09 am for 15 42  
9 53 am for 25 91  
11 23 am for 48 71  
12 19 pm for 60 17  

That 60 dollar order was not just another batch. It was a pivot point. It shifted the trajectory of the entire day. It reminded me that the system rewards patience and positioning more than constant movement.

Momentum is real but it is fragile. It builds quickly and can collapse just as fast if discipline is not maintained.

## Midday Phase Peak Performance Window

This is where I operate at my highest level. Not because it is easy but because I am locked in mentally. Every move becomes calculated. Every decision becomes faster and sharper.

Parking lots are no longer just places to wait. They are strategic zones. Each store represents probability. Each order becomes a mini equation involving distance, item count, time, and tip potential.

I am no longer guessing. I am recognizing patterns.

This is the difference between working and executing.

## Afternoon Phase The Real Test of Discipline

This is where the system gets exposed.

3 25 pm for 16 09  
4 44 pm for 13 38  
5 54 pm for 10 92  

These were not strong orders. I knew that before accepting them. That is the truth.

But I still took them.

Why

Because I was already there  
Because I did not want to wait  
Because I convinced myself that something was better than nothing  

This is where most people lose without realizing it. Not in effort. Not in opportunity. But in discipline.

Earlier in the day I proved I could secure high value orders. I hit nearly 50 and 60 dollar batches. That means the capability is there.

So the real question is not whether I can earn more. The real question is why I lower my standards later in the day.

That is not a skill issue. That is a discipline issue.

## Evening Phase Closing the Loop

Final order came in at 7 04 pm for 21 78. A decent close but not exceptional.

Total for the day came out to 230 67  
Active time 5 hours 32 minutes  
9 batches completed  
Roughly 41 dollars per hour  

On paper this is strong performance. Most would look at this and call it a successful day.

But I am not chasing average anymore. I am chasing control and consistency.

## Parallel System The Body

While the income system is running, the body system cannot be ignored. They operate together whether I acknowledge it or not.

Meal for the day consisted of chicken eggs beans asparagus and a pickle.

This is clean. This is intentional. This is far from how I used to eat.

But clean is not enough anymore.

My target is 186 grams of protein per day. That is the number that aligns with my goals for muscle growth recovery and hormonal balance.

This meal contributes but it does not complete the system.

And incomplete systems lead to inconsistent outcomes.

If I want precision results I need precision input.

## The Enhancement Layer Controlled Inputs

Then there is another layer. The one that requires discipline at a different level.

MOTS c  
Retatrutide  
Measured and intentional use  

This is not random. This is structured input into the system.

I am observing everything  
Energy levels  
Hunger signals  
Recovery  
Mental clarity  

Everything is data now

But I realized something important today

The biggest risk is not the compounds themselves. The biggest risk is careless execution.

Leaving things exposed  
Handling without precision  
Rushing through the process  

That is not how high level systems operate

If I want high level output then every part of the process must match that standard

## System Integration Everything is Connected

Income decisions  
Food intake  
Daily habits  
Execution discipline  

They are all the same system expressed in different ways

Taking a low paying order is the same mindset as missing protein targets  
Rushing through preparation is the same mindset as rushing through decisions  

The problem is never isolated

And neither is the solution

## Current Position Honest Assessment

I am not behind

But I am not optimized

I am in the transition phase  
Awareness is high  
Execution is improving  
Consistency is not locked in  

That is where the real work happens

## Strategic Adjustments Moving Forward

Raise standards in the afternoon  
No more low value orders just because I am already in position  

Hit protein targets daily  
Not close not approximate exact  

Tighten every process  
From how I prepare food to how I handle injections to how I select orders  

Because small inefficiencies compound quickly over time

## Final Reflection

Today was not about the 230 dollars

It was about visibility

I can now see the system clearly

I am building something structured something intentional something measurable

And once every part of the system aligns

The results will not depend on luck or motivation

They will be a direct outcome of the system itself

And that is the point where everything changes

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@chronocrypto/systems-in-motion-a-day-measured-in-data-discipline-and-direction-3ke)

title.title: Why Do Same Splinterlands Monster Cards Have Different Prices? Vicious Giraffe Price Ranges from 2 Cents to $55?
title.body:
![Loving the MOO The Healer That Keeps Your Tank Alive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tm9d38TxjHRjexcDvb16LcahBMkPof2NqVmQhPN22mAhBnkj15ktavcbpNCeZtJzZsx.png)


You may noted that in the Splinterlands market there are some monster cards of the same type are listed at very different prices. Yes that is absolutely true. If you open the market and select any monster you will see different prices for each level. 

At Level 1 you may get it for just a few cents but the maximum level card can cost a lot more like $50, $80 or even $100. What is the reason for this?? In todays post we will discuss exactly all these.

As an example I selected the monster card **Vicious Giraffe** and we will talk about how much it costs at the minimum level and how much at the maximum level.

Remember that the price of any monster card depends on its level and CC. In simple words if the monster card is upgraded it will naturally be sold at a much higher price. But if the same monster card is at its initial level it will be available at a much cheaper price. Its stats and abilities also depend on its upgrade level.

![Screenshot 2026-04-28 103722.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23wC7vH7HFbHBcZnfBN9MZrUZzKnXCKYBKHKgbGKpgwfzB5HXK3gde7XpP5vqdHijCfgF.png)

At the starting level the monster card only has its basic stats and abilities but as soon as you upgrade it you will see improvements in both its stats and abilities.

I have shared three different prices of the same monster card with you. As you can see **Vicious Giraffe** has three different prices

* One is available for only **2 cents**
* The second is available for **46 cents**
* The third is available for **55 dollars**

![Screenshot 2026-04-28 103740.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23wWTTnRqJd5VmcwqEQdqZKkuVEfgdBXBqNa8gw5urZC4BwBxisQkamMBoUrTrFX64669.png)

There is a huge difference in these prices. \

body.title: Black Rock Quarry.
body.body:
[![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaJU2PmUebamnJ3AgvprBGWSvCBCg5RX9PLiXUFsH3S86/d81a9670a44994c75c03e0064115285b)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=lazybug/7b3582e4)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=lazybug/7b3582e4)


---

<center><sup>The thumbnail was created in Canva.</sup></center>

<div class=\

>

After descending via the elevator, I fought through several Hiss soldiers while navigating toward the Black Rock Quarry. I bypassed a stuck elevator by jumping down the shaft and survived multiple ambushes from ground and aerial threats. Finally, I cleansed a control point to reveal the quarry entrance.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZZ2rdophNHgBRsqGu9Ukaf9Wq6oGGdT45ja7Hf5gKtdM/screenshot_1_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNaC8NSdfEFQbdhx2MLsmLTYrVannTKoxBrXvhMyywo5k/screenshot_2_.png)

So after checking the elevator down and confirming the power was stable, I was moving towards the Black Rock Quarry to continue my investigation. There was this Hiss soldier on my way who tried to block the corridor, so I had to take care of him. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaYeccMtMevz3PqpxELdy5bRFnkLKJ9QFS466GraqbL4L/screenshot_3_.png)

Then I reached this big space where I found this control point that I claimed for our side, which would work like a manual save for me if things went wrong later. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXTFL4wH7HamYZ5rjQQpdYmAi79Pjp16Q8phZfSyMM14u/screenshot_4_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWiLsnk9BC4WpfX4uwjd319DpnyLuRsqd1T78T9PtLkQ6/screenshot_5_.png)

There was this Hiss soldier standing near the far railing who didn't see me at all until I hit him with a piece of concrete. He was turned to the other side, which gave me the perfect opening to strike.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQkjv7AMhs9EF96bKNPdL8YK3gP3Qwuyyau7AHsgpwJGQ/screenshot_6_.png)

And there came a flying Hiss soldier next, hovering near the ceiling. I had to take him down carefully by tracking his erratic movements and timing my shots with the Service Weapon. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTa3bjcszLajoKAPsh1vzeoHUJZrD5bVs1uMZNQsBvJp4/screenshot_7_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNdReb9i4qhtPgUoeCvCVEUx9sYXnkR6JxvRoYZWgRC4K/screenshot_8_.png)

I was heading towards Black Rock Quarry with a sense of urgency, but I found this elevator that was completely stuck between floors. Since I couldn't get the doors to cooperate, I had to jump down through the elevator shaft to reach the lower levels.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdE8PvCzaNPFqjgjAmYos2gWNmu79UbdsaXGFhZGN7mAR/screenshot_9_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU9gcZkA8N5acH1hZkakqfd1KEQzu36p6Eo9KiJt4p5gT/screenshot_10_.png)

There were monsters on our way trying to ambush me from the narrow maintenance spaces. I had to take care of them while navigating below, firing my weapon into the shadows to keep them at a distance. I kept moving downward until I could see the ground floor.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRbMMJR7dYCHT4V7XLpF95XWvEfTgAyh6x886SFT7MVFm/screenshot_11_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma91ydwZqe4jzpfGxkWbBuHAb69m4x5zCDo4T6ZZdRWB7/screenshot_12_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdYPEaPKB8bqaGy1wCfuBua8tjkGxM7LY8n9wdzp1sJeg/screenshot_13_.png)

After reaching the ground floor, I found out a large party of Hiss was waiting to ambush me. I had to act fast while dodging their concentrated attacks and also attacking them back with everything in my arsenal.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTZPzi6tMmwrqNdsLtJCEa5EWsDs3mtGfCxkEuJe9w195/screenshot_14_.png)

When I reached this specific control point that was heavily corrupted by the Hiss resonance, I knew I had to cleanse it. It was the only way to reveal my walk ahead towards Black Rock Quarry and stabilize the shifting walls of the sector.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdMvpcbLb1avY1Dq9dMCnpQCaATv6wQwHr42vDvzn95ea/screenshot_15_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaJU2PmUebamnJ3AgvprBGWSvCBCg5RX9PLiXUFsH3S86/screenshot_16_.png)

After cleansing the control point, the whole appearance of the place was changed as the building's internal geometry shifted back into place.

I finally found the entrance of the Black Rrock Quarry where more Hiss soldiers were waiting to ambush me.

**To be Continued...**

---

body.title: Get Rid Of The Problem Or Get Used To The Problem.
body.body: > ## Hello, everyone. I welcome you to my blog. I have seen in many movies how individuals deal with ghosts even though ghost stories sound unreal and many people don't believe in the existence of ghosts, so they don't take ghost stories seriously or to heart. Even some of the movies try to portray the doubt in the hearts of many when it comes to ghost stories, and when those seeing the ghost try sharing with friends how they are seeing a ghost, the friends, family members, and even loved ones tend to doubt them; most of the time, those who claim to see ghosts are always recommended to visit a psychiatrist. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcxsSQGK3bgb64FGXLW6ne3Db26GN4zxUNA2JZKvvHmze/1777403619272.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/person-behind-fog-glass-ZC0EbdLC8G0) According to movies, when a ghost is haunting you or causing you sleepless nights, you have just a few ways or options to actually break free from the shackles of the ghost, and most of the time the best option is to go the spiritual route, either to a church or to visit a traditional man or location that can help you that can help disconnect you from the ghost haunting you. For a ghost to be haunting, according to the movies I have seen, there has to be a connection; there must be something connecting you and the ghost, and for it to go away, that connection has to go away too. Most of the time it is the spiritual men that can pinpoint that connection and make getting rid of the ghost easy. In the case where someone I know is a tech freak dies and is somehow haunting me and making me uncomfortable, then I will have to go in search of answers. I need to know why they will not let me. What do they want? And why they don't want to rest in peace, as the dead have nothing to do with the living, I have to look for a way to get rid of the ghost, more like getting the ghost off my back. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeLZf2o1KumYMYFtJ9DbQVvvFcN2MVi839Rzy8aDUrHDY/1777403619228.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/man-and-woman-holding-hands-tzQkuviIuHU) There are two ways I will handle the matter: I either get rid of the ghost or get used to having the ghost around because there is no way I am ditching my gadgets because of a ghost. I either find a way to get rid of the ghost or get used to having the ghost around, but ditching my gadgets because of a ghost is not even an option; I need my gadgets and to stay in the tech space because a lot about me revolves around the tech space.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZES1F7ocCJUUZTJbeG5ezPMSG8q3uabkVyXRRyxyxqe4/1777403208666.jpg)




Flow (FLOW) just posted a clean +11.45% gain on Binance, spiking from a low of $0.03770 to a high of $0.04406 on volume of nearly 60 million FLOW traded. The move looks small in dollar terms but the story behind this project is much bigger than the price suggests.

What Is Flow?

Flow is a high performance Layer 1 blockchain built by Dapper Labs  the same team behind CryptoKitties and NBA Top Shot. Flow blockchain powers major NFT and gaming projects like NBA Top Shot, NFL All Day, UFC Strike, Blocto Wallet, and Matrix World, primarily focused on digital collectibles but expanding into other areas.   These aren't small partnerships  these are some of the biggest sports and entertainment brands on the planet.

What's Driving the Move?

Flow's March 2026 ecosystem recap showed major updates including AI agent integrations via the x402 protocol, the 13th season of flagship game MFL kicking off, and the Japanese app 24karat.io reaching 250,000 weekly users. A new unified DeFi app from KittyPunchXYZ also launched, and the PL Genesis hackathon concluded with over $150,000 in prizes distributed.  Real builders, real activity.
On top of that, FLOW's recent gain represents nearly 3x outperformance versus Bitcoin, indicating that alpha seeking capital may be rotating into select altcoins  the gain isn't just market beta, it suggests specific interest in Flow's prospects. 

The Tokenomics Are Changing

This is the part most people are missing. The Flow Foundation burned 50.3 million FLOW  approximately 3% of supply via a buyback in February 2026 and plans to acquire at least 50 million more from the open market. A fee update increased transaction costs to fund validator rewards, aiming for net deflation at sustained throughput of 250 TPS.  A project actively burning its own supply is a strong signal of long-term conviction.

The Technical Picture

The 1H chart on Binance is textbook bullish. Price broke cleanly above all three EMAs  EMA 25 at 0.04010, EMA 50 at 0.03947, EMA 100 at 0.03908  on a massive volume spike. The chart shows weeks of flat consolidation near $0.0376 followed by a sharp breakout candle with no wicks below  buyers are in control.

The Bigger Picture

Flow hosts major brands like Disney, NBA, and NFL, with over 100 million NFTs distributed, and developer activity hit record highs in 2025, with Flow being the top L1 choice at ETHGlobal hackathons.  The infrastructure is real, the partnerships are real, and now the price is starting to reflect that.
From its all time high of $42.40, FLOW currently trades -99.9% below that peak. The recovery runway is enormous if adoption continues to build.

body.title: Microsoft Is Splitting From OpenAi?
body.body:
Microsoft and OpenAI announced that they are changing the terms of their partnership. And this is not a small change. We are talking about changes to the original deal that essentially helped build the entire AI boom of recent years.

At the same time, OpenAI is announcing a partnership with Qualcomm to build its own smartphone chip. In other words, on the same day that it changes its relationship with Microsoft, it is also entering the hardware game.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQGeTd4S3U663izH3KNEBhND4RmA2ADX8MVfFe3ZZmckX/image.png)


## What Changed in the Agreement

To understand what happened, we need to remember where it all started. Microsoft had invested more than $13 billion in OpenAI since 2019. It had exclusive rights to its models. That meant that if you wanted to use OpenAI through the cloud, your only option was Microsoft Azure.

Now that is changing. Under the renewed agreement, OpenAI can now bring all of its products to any cloud provider it wants: Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, or anyone else. Microsoft’s license to OpenAI’s intellectual property remains in place until 2032, but it is now non-exclusive.

“And what does Microsoft gain from this?”

A lot. First, Microsoft stops paying revenue share to OpenAI for products it sells through Azure. Second, it remains the “primary cloud provider,” meaning OpenAI’s new products will launch first on Azure. Third, and perhaps most importantly, Microsoft remains a shareholder in OpenAI with a 27% stake, a stake that was valued at $135 billion last year.

## Revenue Share and AGI

And this is where things get even more interesting. OpenAI will continue paying Microsoft revenue share at the same rate, 20%, until 2030. There is a cap, but it was not disclosed.

So what does that mean? Every time someone pays for a ChatGPT subscription, a portion goes to Microsoft. And that will continue.

But there is another crucial point. Under the old agreement, this revenue share would automatically stop the moment OpenAI reached AGI, meaning artificial intelligence that matches or surpasses human capabilities. Now that clause is gone. Microsoft will continue receiving its share until 2030, regardless of how far OpenAI’s technology advances.

In other words, Microsoft locked in its revenue. And according to analysts, this is a sign that OpenAI is performing much better than the market expected. It is even estimated that around 45% of Microsoft’s AI backlog comes from OpenAI. Yes, you read that correctly. Almost half.

## The Door Opens for Amazon and Google

Now let’s move to the next part. Because all of this does not only concern Microsoft and OpenAI. It affects the entire cloud market.

OpenAI had been trying to expand for months. In February, it announced a massive deal with Amazon: an investment of up to $50 billion from AWS and an expansion of their previous agreement by $100 billion over the next eight years.

According to a Financial Times report, Microsoft had even considered legal action because it believed that this partnership violated the exclusivity agreement.

Now all of that is in the past. Amazon CEO Andy Jassy announced that within the next few weeks, OpenAI’s models will be available to AWS customers through Bedrock. That means that if you are a business using AWS, you will be able to use OpenAI’s models without leaving Amazon’s ecosystem. The same will apply to Google.

It is no coincidence that OpenAI’s revenue chief, Denise Dresser, said earlier this month that the Microsoft agreement “limited our ability to serve enterprises where they are.” Now that problem is solved.

## OpenAI and Qualcomm

And as if that were not enough, another major piece of news arrived on the same day. OpenAI is partnering with Qualcomm to build a chip for smartphones. Taiwan’s MediaTek is also part of the agreement, while China’s Luxshare will co-design and manufacture the device itself. Mass production is expected in 2028. Qualcomm’s stock rose 7% shortly after the market opened, but eventually closed up 0.98%.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVPCYQCbaCRTUq76Dyma9RNcKrwS7nA2FUQXMic9Fsswq/image.png)


“Why a smartphone?”

According to analyst Ming-Chi Kuo, only through a device that captures what the user is doing in real time can OpenAI offer a fully integrated AI agent. The smartphone is the device that knows everything about you: what you think, what you read, what you say.

And remember this. Last year, OpenAI acquired the startup of former Apple design chief Jony Ive for $6.4 billion. In other words, it has been building a hardware ecosystem for some time. Sam Altman has even said that the device they are preparing will feel like “sitting in a beautiful cabin by a lake,” instead of the chaos of Times Square. Calmer, more personal.

A new Ethereum-based token, Ayylien (AYYLIEN), has launched from the same deployer wallet behind AstroElon (ELONONE) — a community-driven memecoin that previously reached a peak market capitalization of approximately $160 million during the 2021 cycle.

The launch is already drawing attention across crypto-native communities due to its verifiable on-chain origin, cultural positioning, and early traction following distribution.

### A Launch Tied to Proven On-Chain History
Ayylien’s deployment is directly linked to the original AstroElon deployer, providing a transparent and traceable connection between the two projects. AstroElon was part of the 2021 wave of Ethereum-native memecoins, alongside tokens such as SHIB, that helped define the role of community coordination and internet culture within crypto markets.

At launch, 30% of Ayylien’s total supply was allocated to existing ELONONE holders via an airdrop, reinforcing continuity between the two communities and reactivating a holder base established during the previous cycle.

This distribution model has contributed to immediate on-chain activity and participation, with thousands of wallets interacting with the token shortly after launch.

From “Ayy Lmao” to Alien Pepe: The Meme Behind the Token
Ayylien is based on the long-standing “Ayy Lmao” meme, which first emerged on internet forums around 2012–2013. The phrase became widely associated with image macros of a grey alien, often used as a reaction image across early social platforms.

Over time, this visual identity merged with Pepe the Frog, resulting in a widely recognized “alien Pepe” variant. This crossover reflects the organic evolution of internet memes, where formats are continuously remixed and reinterpreted across communities.

Ayylien positions itself as an on-chain representation of this lineage, translating a familiar and historically persistent meme into a tokenized form on Ethereum.

### Early Growth and Market Participation
Since launch, Ayylien has seen rapid early community expansion, driven by both legacy ELONONE holders and new participants drawn to the project’s cultural positioning.

**Initial activity has included:**

High wallet distribution following the airdrop

Active trading on decentralized exchanges

Rapid social media growth and engagement

While still early, this level of participation reflects renewed interest in Ethereum-based memecoins after a prolonged period dominated by short-cycle trading environments on alternative chains.

Macro Context: Renewed Interest in Ethereum Meme Culture
Ayylien’s launch coincides with a broader shift in market sentiment. After an extended period of high-frequency, short-lived token cycles, there are signs of renewed focus on longer-term community formation and culturally rooted assets on Ethereum.

This shift mirrors aspects of the 2021 environment, where memecoins were not only speculative assets but also social coordination mechanisms built around shared narratives and identities.

### External Narrative Catalysts
Beyond crypto-native dynamics, Ayylien’s theme intersects with growing public interest in extraterrestrial narratives. Ongoing discussions around UFO and UAP declassification efforts by government agencies have contributed to a wider cultural resurgence of alien-related themes in mainstream media.

While not directly tied to the project, this broader context reinforces the relevance of the underlying meme and its recognizability beyond crypto-specific audiences.

A Cultural Asset Rather Than a Technical Protocol
Ayylien does not introduce new technical infrastructure or protocol-level innovation. Instead, it exists as a cultural asset, rooted in the preservation and continuation of internet meme history within blockchain ecosystems.

Its trajectory is therefore expected to be shaped primarily by:

Community participation

Cultural relevance

Market sentiment within the Ethereum ecosystem

### Conclusion
Ayylien represents a continuation of a specific era of crypto culture — one defined by the intersection of memes, community coordination, and on-chain experimentation.

With a launch tied to a historically recognized deployer, a widely understood meme origin, and early signs of engagement, the project is positioned within a broader re-emergence of Ethereum-native community tokens.

body.title: Les retraits instantanés changent l’expérience des casinos en ligne en Belgique
body.body:
Le secteur des casinos en ligne en Belgique connaît une transformation importante grâce à l’arrivée des retraits instantanés. Autrefois, les joueurs devaient attendre plusieurs jours avant de recevoir leurs gains, mais les nouvelles solutions bancaires permettent désormais d’effectuer certaines transactions en seulement quelques minutes. Cette évolution répond à une demande croissante de rapidité et de simplicité dans les services numériques. Les analyses de Michèle Winandy mettent également en avant l’importance de cette tendance dans l’évolution actuelle du marché belge du jeu en ligne.

Une rapidité devenue essentielle pour les joueurs

Dans un environnement numérique où les utilisateurs sont habitués aux paiements immédiats, les délais de traitement classiques paraissent de plus en plus longs. Les casinos capables d’offrir des retraits rapides attirent naturellement davantage de joueurs, car ils apportent un sentiment de confiance et de transparence.

Les nouvelles infrastructures bancaires européennes, notamment les virements instantanés SEPA, permettent aujourd’hui de réduire considérablement les délais de paiement. Certaines plateformes traitent automatiquement les demandes après validation du compte, ce qui accélère fortement le processus.

Des technologies modernes au service des transactions

Les casinos en ligne utilisent désormais des outils technologiques avancés pour fluidifier les opérations financières. L’automatisation des contrôles et l’intégration des systèmes d’Open Banking permettent une communication plus rapide entre les opérateurs et les banques.

Ces innovations réduisent les interventions manuelles et limitent les erreurs administratives. Les joueurs bénéficient ainsi d’une expérience plus simple, avec des paiements traités presque en temps réel dans certaines situations.

La vérification du compte reste indispensable

Même si les retraits sont plus rapides qu’auparavant, les règles de sécurité restent très strictes. Les opérateurs agréés en Belgique doivent respecter des obligations précises concernant l’identification des utilisateurs.

Avant d’effectuer un retrait important, les plateformes demandent généralement :

une pièce d’identité valide ;  
une confirmation d’adresse ;  
une vérification du moyen de paiement utilisé.

Les systèmes numériques comme Itsme facilitent désormais ces procédures et permettent d’accélérer la validation des profils.

Les avantages des retraits instantanés

Les paiements rapides offrent plusieurs bénéfices aux joueurs. Ils réduisent le stress lié à l’attente et donnent une meilleure visibilité sur les finances personnelles. De nombreux utilisateurs considèrent également que la rapidité des retraits est un indicateur du sérieux d’une plateforme.

Par ailleurs, les joueurs peuvent gérer plus facilement leur budget lorsque les transactions sont immédiates. Cette transparence financière participe à une expérience de jeu plus moderne et plus confortable.

Des limites existent encore

Malgré les progrès technologiques, tous les retraits ne sont pas automatiquement instantanés. Certains facteurs peuvent ralentir les opérations :

des vérifications de sécurité supplémentaires ;  
des montants élevés nécessitant un contrôle manuel ;  
des incompatibilités entre certaines banques et les systèmes de paiement rapide ;  
des bonus encore soumis à des conditions d’utilisation.

Les délais peuvent donc varier selon les situations et les méthodes de paiement utilisées.

Un marché belge en pleine évolution

Le marché belge continue d’évoluer sous l’effet des nouvelles attentes des joueurs et des innovations numériques. Les opérateurs cherchent à améliorer constamment la rapidité des services tout en respectant les réglementations imposées par les autorités.

Selon plusieurs spécialistes du secteur, les prochaines années pourraient voir apparaître des systèmes encore plus automatisés, avec des validations biométriques et des paiements quasi immédiats directement connectés aux applications bancaires mobiles.

body.title: De la Mujer, su Valor y su Esencia -¿Empoderamiento y Soledad?- Queremos sus Reflexiones desde el Respeto (ES/EN)
body.body:
<center>![español dandelion_tea-women-7755902_1920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23wgYN7Y9XaNDKovCnqWRNuGA63yZ2Ev1ZDtDXFYPB5xvtVhxMuW9zHbpTaMrWQCmpRWz.png)</center>

> *<center>[Pixabay-Dandelion_tea; editada en Paint](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/mujeres-dia-de-la-mujer-7755902/)</center>*

###### <center>*Definitivamente, la mujer se ha empoderado, pero le ha costado entender lo que esto significa; porque, aunque no ha dejado a un lado la carga profesional, familiar y personal, ella sigue enfrentando con resiliencia las exigencias de un mundo que pide, en forma impositiva, productividad, independencia y una autovaloración medible en imagen.*</center>

###### <center>*El asunto es que muchos nos preguntamos: **¿Hasta qué punto esto la ha diferenciado de su contraparte masculina, llevándola por caminos de enfrentamiento, individualización, soledad y hasta aislamiento?***</center>


<center>![dandelion_tea-woman-7202209_1920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/EoAdgYfHpEkDSRSDRVv8qyQPqYmUZw3hfX91xbKAHdSSYhy9miPxZsbhboQ6Bsh5u8Y.png)</center>
> *<center>[Pixabay-Dandelion_tea](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/mujer-leyendo-sala-de-estar-ni%c3%b1a-7202209/)</center>*

<div class=\

*Me decía una amiga y vecina, que tiene un doctorado en educación, que a la mujer se la considera hoy en día catalizadora del gran cambio en cuanto a los paradigmas que se tienen sobre este género.* Que se espera que en muchos aspectos ellas sean las mismas autoras del cambio de visión que sobre ellas tiene el mundo. Existen mujeres que han recibido el premio Nobel, que ostentan el grado de presidente de un país, que están reescribiendo la historia a nivel de la sociedad; sin embargo, según mi vecina la doctora, aún enfrentan, aunque no lo parece, dificultades para gestionar sus propias emociones… *¿A qué viene esto?*
***“Si logras preguntarles a muchas de las mujeres profesionales y hasta creadoras de contenido que tú conoces, en forma personal, sobre sus vivencias, sus emociones y sobre el camino que día a día recorren para mantenerse activas, te vas a dar cuenta de que muchas de ellas en su interior aún no se sienten merecedoras de esto que se llama empoderamiento de la mujer.”***
Según ella, la mujer hoy en día, aunque parezca increíble, se ha olvidado de sus verdaderas características o cualidades que la convierten o definen en eso, en mujer. Características como la capacidad de ser emocionales, amorosas, cohesivas, unificadoras, instintivamente serviciales y cooperadoras, magnéticas y, sobre todo, suaves o sutiles.
***“Nos hemos puesto en batalla contra el sexo opuesto para enfrentarnos, ante esta rivalidad entre la mujer y el hombre, donde existen muchas diferencias financieras y desigualdades de oportunidades en cuanto a la participación social y productiva; eso ha hecho que se nos olviden cuáles son las verdaderas razones por las cuales somos mujeres, dejándonos muchas veces... Solas.”***
![aa Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/EpENCDNzyLK3DFfDJ78tnyAFUGSHQwGvSXyvGBid5xw7NVPngEma7XarBEvmAB8BXVZ.png)
> *
[Pixabay-Dandelion_tea](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/mujer-mesa-de-trabajo-leer-libro-6741608/)
* ### Preguntamos al colectivo femenino Si reflexionamos sobre esto, la historia de opresión que ha vivido la mujer a lo largo de los siglos, donde ni siquiera tenía la oportunidad de hablar o expresarse, mucho menos soñar con algún tipo de igualdad de género, la ha llevado a construir armaduras, precisamente para defenderse de esta batalla que se ha armado entre la mujer y el hombre. *Más, la verdadera fuerza de ella no es la capacidad de hacer las mismas cosas que hacen los hombres, sino que está en la de diferenciarse en aspectos de sutileza, de intuición, de capacidad unificadora y de ser verdadera luz que cohesiona el núcleo familiar.* Hoy es triste ver cómo mujeres tratan de ocultar estas características para mostrarse fuertes, poderosas, a la defensiva y con una energía masculina que muchas veces las aleja de su rol, tan importante e imprescindible dentro de la sociedad.
***Pero no debemos hablar por nosotros, que somos creadores de contenido hombres, o desde algún tipo de diversidad de género, pues en #Hive y en la misma comunidad de @holos-lotus existen muchas mujeres valiosas que son faros de luz hacia el bienestar y el empoderamiento, no solo de la mujer, sino del ser humano en general.***
*A ellas, en @hive es a quienes les podemos preguntar lo que piensan sobre esta situación.*
Y es cierto que la mujer se ha alejado del verdadero sentido que la diferencia del hombre, de su verdadera esencia, buscando la manera de nivelarse o equilibrarse en oportunidades.
*Pero el trabajo de la mujer no es ser igual que el hombre.*
Se necesita reconocer la energía propia, que el hombre le reafirme desde su puesto, la importancia que tiene para su propio desarrollo y crecimiento, para el de todos, esta energía femenina.
![dandelion_tea-women-6472547_1920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23tvcWG3kD7qYEE7aq9YGY5JmB7YkKoWJ95EGHXZr9naJi7cQNBMaw9ChV2yoMcCJibZR.png)
> *
[Pixabay-Dandelion_tea](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/mujeres-muchachas-amigos-amistad-6472547/)
* ### ¿De allí nacen problemáticas de hoy? Queremos saber… Es frecuente ver mujeres empoderadas, autosuficientes, gestionándose una carrera exitosa en la sociedad, con problemas de estrés y, muchas de ellas, solitarias, madres solteras y hasta algunas, sin tener en su horizonte el menor deseo de formar una familia. *Cuando la mujer rechaza su propia energía completamente distinta a la del hombre por tratar de parecerse a él y obtener sus mismos reconocimientos, puede caer en situaciones como la intolerancia a las relaciones, aumento en el número de divorcios, miedo al compromiso, rechazo a la procreación y distanciamiento a características humanas tan importantes como las relacionadas con las manifestaciones de afecto que terminan siendo vistas como debilidad.*
Para todos, entender esto es un poco difícil.
***
Y hasta puede verse un tanto irrespetuoso tratar el tema o expresar esto desde la orilla opuesta...
*** Pero la mujer que con buena introspección entiende las palabras que mi amiga, con un doctorado en educación, ha terminado entendiendo de su núcleo de amistades femeninas y de su propia experiencia, reflexiones sobre conductas asumidas que no nacen desde la esencia de la mujer, sé que puede reflexionar. Palabras que pueden llegar a ser un punto de reflexión importante para que se consiga y se entienda su verdadera esencia.
*El asunto no es perseguir una igualdad de género mediante concepciones equivocadas, sino a través del razonamiento, la reflexión y la empatía.*
***Tener a ambos géneros como importantes y necesarios para la sociedad y, sobre todo, con autovaloraciones que nazcan de la propia esencia de cada quien.***
![linea .png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/242Y3nb9vTVZpveXNPJDkaZkCw3jJwQvXSupzLhUmL5VbMw8qtcND1L14H5dkhTwvpUfL.png)
![english .png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/Eo4CYFaBzyGwsEXfSBcJoPDNbkPa2gF542BBgnJQRXqSKpuwwaLKMygA3GPQz6XgLS9.png)
#
On Women, Their Strength, and Their Essence —Empowerment and Solitude?— We Welcome Your Reflections with Respect
![dandelion_tea-women-7755902_1920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23wgYSYPjVFdRaTsukJ2QixfAarj3MyZu3VPYFVjaBVbpuJYfGLCNRKfwm73wBmH9sNEk.png)
> *
[Pixabay-Dandelion_tea; edited in Paint](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/mujeres-dia-de-la-mujer-7755902/)
* ######
*Women have certainly become empowered, but they have struggled to understand what this means; for although they have not set aside their professional, family, and personal burdens, they continue to face with resilience the demands of a world that imperatively calls for productivity, independence, and a sense of self-worth measured by appearance.*
######
*The point is that many of us wonder: **To what extent has this set her apart from her male counterpart, leading her down paths of confrontation, individualization, loneliness, and even isolation?***
![dandelion_tea-woman-7202209_1920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/EoAdgYfHpEkDSRSDRVv8qyQPqYmUZw3hfX91xbKAHdSSYhy9miPxZsbhboQ6Bsh5u8Y.png)
> *
[Pixabay-Dandelion_tea](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/mujer-leyendo-sala-de-estar-ni%c3%b1a-7202209/)
*

> ### “Are we still… on our own?” *A friend and neighbor of mine, who has a doctorate in education, told me that women are now seen as catalysts for major shifts in the paradigms surrounding gender.* In many ways, they are expected to be the very agents of change in how the world views them. There are women who have won the Nobel Prize, who hold the office of president of a country, who are rewriting history at the societal level; however, according to my neighbor, the doctor, they still face—even if it doesn’t seem like it—difficulties in managing their own emotions… *What’s the point of this?*
***“If you manage to ask many of the professional women and even content creators you know, on a personal level, about their experiences, their emotions, and the path they take day by day to stay active, you’ll realize that many of them, deep down, still don’t feel worthy of this thing called women’s empowerment.”***
According to her, women today—as incredible as it may seem—have forgotten the true characteristics or qualities that make them, or define them, as women. Characteristics such as the ability to be emotional, loving, cohesive, unifying, instinctively helpful and cooperative, magnetic, and, above all, gentle or subtle.
***“We have pitted ourselves against the opposite sex in a battle, facing this rivalry between women and men, where there are many financial disparities and inequalities of opportunity regarding social and productive participation; this has caused us to forget the true reasons why we are women, often leaving us... alone.”***
![aa Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/EpENCDNzyLK3DFfDJ78tnyAFUGSHQwGvSXyvGBid5xw7NVPngEma7XarBEvmAB8BXVZ.png)
> *
[Pixabay-Dandelion_tea](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/mujer-mesa-de-trabajo-leer-libro-6741608/)
* ### We ask the women’s collective If we reflect on this, the history of oppression that women have endured over the centuries—a history in which they did not even have the opportunity to speak or express themselves, much less dream of any kind of gender equality—has led them to build armor, precisely to defend themselves in this battle that has raged between women and men. *Moreover, her true strength does not lie in her ability to do the same things men do, but rather in her capacity to distinguish herself through subtlety, intuition, a unifying spirit, and her role as the true light that binds the family together.* Today, it is sad to see how women try to hide these characteristics in order to appear strong, powerful, defensive, and with a masculine energy that often distances them from their role, which is so important and essential within society.
***But we shouldn’t speak for ourselves—as male content creators—or from the perspective of some form of gender diversity, because on #Hive and within the @holos-lotus community itself, there are many valuable women who are beacons of light guiding the way toward well-being and empowerment, not only for women but for humanity as a whole.***
*At @hive, it is these women we can ask what they think about this situation.*
And it is true that women have strayed from the true essence that sets them apart from men, seeking ways to level the playing field or achieve balance in opportunities.
*But a woman’s role is not to be the same as a man’s.*
She needs to recognize her own energy, and for men to reaffirm—from their own position—the importance of this feminine energy for her own development and growth, and for everyone’s.
![dandelion_tea-women-6472547_1920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23tvcWG3kD7qYEE7aq9YGY5JmB7YkKoWJ95EGHXZr9naJi7cQNBMaw9ChV2yoMcCJibZR.png)
> *
[Pixabay-Dandelion_tea](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/mujeres-muchachas-amigos-amistad-6472547/)
* ### Is this the root of today’s problems? We want to know… It’s common to see empowered, self-sufficient women building successful careers in society, yet struggling with stress—and many of them are lonely, single mothers, and some don’t even have the slightest desire to start a family. *When women reject their own energy—which is completely different from men’s—in an attempt to resemble men and gain the same recognition, they can fall into situations such as intolerance toward relationships, rising divorce rates, fear of commitment, rejection of procreation, and distancing themselves from such important human traits as those related to expressions of affection, which end up being viewed as weakness.*
*For everyone, understanding this is a bit difficult.*
***And it might even seem somewhat disrespectful to address the issue or express this from the opposite perspective...***
But the woman who, through deep self-reflection, understands the insights my friend—who holds a doctorate in education—has come to grasp from her circle of female friends and her own experience—reflections on adopted behaviors that do not stem from the essence of womanhood—I know she can reflect on this. Words that can become an important point of reflection for achieving and understanding one’s true essence.
*The issue is not to pursue gender equality through misguided notions, but through reasoning, reflection, and empathy.*
***To view both genders as important and necessary for society and, above all, with self-worth that stems from each person’s own essence.***
![linea .png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/242Y3nb9vTVZpveXNPJDkaZkCw3jJwQvXSupzLhUmL5VbMw8qtcND1L14H5dkhTwvpUfL.png)

Taki ruch, który niczego nie wymusza, a pozwala wszystko poukładać. Organizm robi swoje, jeśli dasz mu przestrzeń. I właśnie o to dziś chodziło. --- 🇬🇧 ### Recovery The day after a race sets its own pace. The legs still carry yesterday’s effort, but the mind is already calmer. Instead of running, I went for a walk – forest, water, a bit of sun. The kind of movement that doesn’t force anything, but lets everything settle. The body does its job when you give it space. That’s what today was about.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f02ecfa6-8f90-4177-9860-50d88ae60bc2.jpg)
🇵🇱 Po takim biegu nie ma sensu kombinować z jedzeniem. Ciało domaga się konkretu, więc wjechała wołowina. Porządna porcja białka, coś co realnie wspiera regenerację, a nie tylko wygląda dobrze w tabelkach. Prosto, naturalnie i dokładnie tak, jak trzeba po mocnym wysiłku. --- 🇬🇧 After a race like that, there’s no need to overthink. The body asks for something real, so beef was the obvious choice. A solid dose of protein, something that actually supports recovery instead of just looking good on paper. Simple, natural, exactly what’s needed after a hard effort.

body.title: Setting Realistic Crypto Targets Is Becoming More And More Challenging
body.body:
/></center>

[source](https://debutart-static-v1.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/projectitem/0/0/9b529f72987b997a8c2206415a23fdab/63100_full-retina.jpg?2020-02-1117:11:21)

Crypto has a way of drawing you in to the point you can never let go especially when you are involved in the various staking projects. There is no stopping and I guess only when you sell does that happen. Crypto up until now has all been about a 4 year cycle of non stop hustling and now this time frame has been extended. This is tiring as there is no end in sight and there can be no thought of taking a break because no one knows what sort of time line we have now.





When starting out in crypto staking projects like HIVE or COTI in my case you are not sure what is possible as a realistic target. After a year or two being involved you understand far more and have the knowledge and experience to set a few targets that will encourage you to push yourself. This is what having a target does as it drives you on challenging yourself to achieve whatever target has been set. If you achieve it too soon then it was not really that challenging and a new target is set.

Thinking back I had a 15K COTI target around 4 years ago because that was the minimum number required in order to stake and earn rewards. This starting from 0 was also a realistic but challenging target which was eventually achieved. Achieving 15K COTI now is rather simple especially when the daily rewards earned on their own would get this done in less than 5 months.

The same with HIVE as what was once seen as a difficult target is somewhat easier due to having grown the stake to such an extent the daily target number I was aiming for 3 years ago is being achieved through curation and APR rewards so having a target number now is virtually impossible as the growth is organically happening. Once you see the growth in real time taking place targets on HIVE I feel are no longer that necessary anymore and it should be more about enjoying yourself because the fun factor is what keeps you motivated.

A couple of years ago I stopped thinking about growth targets and it was more about staying consistent because consistency and compounding is what drives the overall growth. If you are not consistent then your growth trajectory will be directly affected and the daily numbers will drop. Start out as you mean to go on is the only way and there is no off button or pause button.

When I look at my COTI stake of 277K which has taken 4 years to accumulate having had targets set at 60K per year and that number is no longer a challenging number. If I had to set a number now that would push me to my limits it would have to be double that number at around 120K COTI per year. This is a large number and at the last ATH would be worth $80K and why it is definitely a must do target because the opportunity is here and the personal challenge needs to be accepted. One can never have enough crypto and why having some type of target in mind is important as a motivational tool.

The problem is finding the motivation to do this because when you have been pushing yourself for so long day in and day out you kind of have to rest the mind in order to refocus. There is no question the mind reset will happen as this is too good an opportunity to miss and the growth needs to kick on and proceed. I have realised recently this is not always that easy as real life events get in your way and priorities do change. This last week was extremely challenging on a personal level and it does knock you so I definitely need to reset again and push for an extra 120K COTI this year hitting 400K COTI by May next year.

links.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1885
Tuesday 28, April 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1950
Noxsoma Life Camp:  

Super Power Tuesday. Flex’em up mi gente.   

Recently I sat through an extra-too-long article that exemplified what I call, “Trickle-down Podcasting.” It works the same way in journalism. This example probably makes your humble observer guilty of this, however Ego is going to give Us a pass. Why? If you don’t figure it out before the end of this song, “the secret” will be revealed before we leave the stage.  

Dick calls himself a journalist. Mary, according to Dick, is a mean, malevolent, media maven who is always starving for attention. Mary is the type, according to Dick, (and her reputation), who performs for likes and followers.  Like a stripper gyrates her booty for tips.  

So what does Dick do? Dick gives Mary exactly what she craves, attention, while criticizing her for, you guessed it, craving attention. 

What did Dick get out of this superfluous hyperbole? Attention? (He got mine, but it wasn’t enough to remember his name. I hope his name isn’t really Dick.)  

I already knew who Mary was. And I know enough to avoid all the red flags she waves in order to get her dopamine hits. 

Dick was using Mary the same way Mary was using the guy she was using to get Dick to write about her using that guy. And then getting dissed by another guy. It’s almost like Mary was Snow White, with all the guys in this story.  

Dick is a trickle-down journalist. The type, (at least in the piece we’re referring to), that gloms on to a glommer in order to catch some of that overflowing attention. Dick plays the role of a critic, but might very well be an accomplice. 

Nuff said. I think you get it.  

So why do we get a pass? Because we’re not shining any light on Dick or Mary, who might even be working together. It’s all about the example. The savvy observer already knows this. The witty observer knows, but doesn’t know they know. But now you know.  (See below.)     

Before we turn you loose, Do check out today’s Episode if you have not done so already. It’s explanatory. 

Also, there’s some Substack stuff. Several posts from last year are showing up, (with audio), as well as Noxsoma Life Camp videos. The videos are long, about 30 minutes, just so you know. They are about dealing with, “Life”. 

“Life Camp.” 

May First, the Noxsoma Comic-Strip will begin appearing. Daily. If you scroll through Substack like it’s an underground newspaper, you will find your underground comics right here. In the booth, in the back, in the corner, in the dark. They are naughty, but not unsafe at any job.   



Stay safe, stay sane, stay strong, stay savvy, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed.   

PEACE 





Promos & Affirmations

![1950.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWVrD9UBiKz4J8hosks6kCCj1sCYAoWDkjF4jRL7xd1k1/1950.png)

Ubiquity
Secret City Shoutout. 
What’s new with the project. How fast time is moving. New season coming. Quick.                      
 
Today's Episode:   https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1885_full_4-28-26_1950_promos:5?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9 
Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe. 

There’s always some crazy guy at train stations in the Northeastern United States, especially in Philly. I know this because I grew up there and encountered many over many years. Also in New York, Midtown and Brooklyn. DC, but that’s an easy call, everyone’s crazy there. I’d guess Boston as well, but I don’t have much first-hand experience in Beantown. 

I’m not using “crazy” as a pejorative. There are several types of crazies that haunt train stations and track platforms. Some are frustrated. Some are burnt out. Some are legit, mentally ill, but somehow prefer to be feeding pigeons and dumpster diving than being in a shelter. Some, but fewer and fewer, are vets. And some, are hiding. I don’t know Cain from Abel at first glance, however for some reason, the vibes that generate from this vessel attracts a certain type of “crazy.” The not-so-crazy that burnt out from the system. Generally speaking a low-level government employee that just couldn’t hide between the cracks of the system, or take the bullshit anymore. 

They crawled so deep into the wabbit hole, that they couldn’t get out. Not everyone can be a whistle-blower. And not everyone can be a whistle-blower and live to tell about it. So you divest your escrow in the slush-fund the pension board holds for you. And you downsize. Downsize again. Until you eventually drop out. Most of these cats are clever enough to merge into the underground economy. Barter for pleasures. Catch the day-old bread between the back door of the bakery and the dumpster. Find safe places to nod, get fed, have a shower every now and then. They are crazy, because they know too much. Not in a, “needs to be silenced,” way. In a way that makes one paranoid, because any name on any sheet of paper will immediately be routed to “one of Them.” 

Guys like me, don’t want to meet guys like them. Because there but for the grace of god go I, your humble vagabond could be one of those paranoid, quasi-schizophrenics that needs to get “what I know” to someone who could do something about it. 

I love Malcolm's quote, “If you don’t stand for something, you’ll fall for anything.” My starship is a vessel that needs to run on high octane dilithium crystals. For the first half century of life, (maybe a little less), it was fueled with high grade bovine excrement. It’ll fly. But we wull have some trouble making the jump into hyper-space.  

I learned about the “Straw man” from one of these characters, before I ever saw, America: Freedom to Fascism, a documentary by Aaron Russo. 
One night on a crowded bus, one of these characters started listing the corrupt players in Philadelphia politics, how they got where they were, and how they were all connected. Right up to Harrisburg. 

How cannabis became illegal in America, and NATO countries. It’s not about getting’ high. It’s about cotton and paper. And that comes down to money and control. 
A lotta cats get that wake up call, and they wanna be a rooster. Cluckin’ and crowin’ and running their mouths like they got a hot stock tip. This is where Abe Lincoln comes in. “Better to remain silent and be thought a fool, than to speak and remove all doubt.” Only, some kinds of blabbering are more pernicious than others. 
Likewise, when you only have a small percentage of the info, like, you are inventory of USA, Inc., and you decide to do some radical shit. You’ll end up as one of those dudes on the subway. You might even be Nick Fuentes. I heard he was stiffed for half a mil. But I don’t know. And I know nothing else. So for your humble vagabond, who has watched Nick as many times as I’ve watched Charlie – zero. I might be painting a target on my channel. And for what? 
Anyway, most of these cats I encountered was pre-internet. They were intriguing conversations. And then they were over. The stuff Universe wanted me to know was returned, by Universe. So I learned a little bit about the straw man thing, and that led to some other levels.  But I’m not a missionary about any of this stuff. I don’t call for group action against a company or individual. I just withdraw. Products that have HFCS, off my list. Off my plate. Out of my system.  
So back to the “crazy guys.” There might be some on the train platforms, but there are a lot more scattered throughout the internet. I subscribed to a lot of the ones I still follow during the plandemic They are still digging into the “debunked” conspiracy theories that emerged in 2017, and before. The accusations, innuendos, logos, and code words. I’m like, “Okay. Let’s see what happens.” 
Nine years later, I’m like, “Okay. Let’s see what happens.” 
Well, a lot did happen, but nothing like what was “promised.” The sixteen year plan to “destroy America,” was thwarted, or so we were told, coincidentally, by the 20 16 election. America is still standing, albeit under a pyramid of military, diplomatic, social, academic, and general health failures, that’s bending her back. And what about the pedophiles? We survived Biden, Covid and the WHO, and now that Jesus Trump Superstar is back at the Whites’ House, and the country has effectively, (they like to say, “strategically”), lost another 21st Century war, that wasn’t ours to wage, we wonder if we’ll be wobbly or standing tall, ish, on July 4th.  
    
The cosmic pen took over this one my friends. It may be a tough read, or listen, but just imagine how tricky it was to write. I never did get to the original idea. But there’s always tomorrow.
