links.body: >My city, Coimbra—Portugal, once again established itself as one of the main hubs of visual culture with the 4th edition of the Comic Festival. It took place last weekend (April 24, 25, and 26) with a more comprehensive program than previous editions, featuring new areas dedicated to pop culture, comic books, and illustration.   ㅤ Once again, the Convento de São Francisco cultural center hosted this edition, incorporating the former church of the Convento de São Francisco—thus expanding the exhibition space. The event’s production and programming were handled by GuessTheChoice, while the Coimbra City Council oversaw the organization. ![2-Coimbra Comics Festival 2026©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tvef5gGxM1HvW5BWYbvyM9BKxJDgf5ZKgtwrHaL1ERPG1WJeRWFd62ghY6R7yQJYTKo.jpg)

>The program was varied and designed for different audiences: exhibitions and book launches, author signing sessions, drawing workshops, a board game area, cosplay contests, film screenings, and a videogame area. ![3-Coimbra Comics Festival 2026©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23xekAZTf4jwQjeeePTsxFgUPSMxG7RGFFyFFy3L9ZtDmjyK4dRNxVHcTQW8zV5kUnxym.jpg)

>With the participation of more than 60 national and international authors and illustrators, the festival has established itself as a strategic hub for creative collaboration. Notable Portuguese guests included Daniel Maia (who designed the poster), André Carrilho, Luís Louro, Ricardo Cabral, Osvaldo Medina, Raquel Costa, Joana Rosa, João Mascarenhas, Filipe Abranches, André Carrilho, Carina Correia, Duarte and Henrique Gandum, and Kachisou, among others. International artists: Ángel de la Calle, Marcello Quintanilha, Pierre-François Radice, and Anna Poszepczyńska.   ㅤ The festival poster was designed by Daniel Maia, a comic book author, illustrator, editor, educator, and researcher with over 30 years of experience in the field. Throughout his career, he has won a dozen Portuguese comic book awards and also gained international recognition by winning Marvel Comics’ global talent search, ChesterQuest (2009). Among his works are titles such as CoBrA: Operation Goa, O Infante Portugal in Universos Reunidos, The Boy in the Bot vol. 1, and Apparition Metempsychosis: Book One. ![4-Coimbra Comics Festival 2026©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23uFPYBCCRnL2CM6wCvvP2ySsWknWgkiu9agxcrQsb2QvKy2ot8S89u4HaW5CWgrhDsmb.jpg) ![5-Coimbra Comics Festival 2026©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tvaGXhpSnV6XKzhKaDHMeJLJWHj83vwdR8s4TwyXQveunUeEfPN56VQndoKrUxoBwtn.jpg) ![6-Coimbra Comics Festival 2026©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23vsJMxgLVNjB7RhXmCFRFPLYg5APuovonkWQYa7eG4QoWttyjtWwYLuvQ2gjGFGLqKSZ.jpg)

>The Artists’ Alley area continued to be a major highlight, with dozens of artists showcasing their work and talent, as well as a space dedicated to publishers featuring comic books and literature—both the latest releases and great classics—and merchandising stores offering a wide variety of pop culture products featuring characters and titles known to all. ![7-Coimbra Comics >Cosplay was the big highlight of this 4th edition, marking the first time in Portugal that a qualifier was held for one of the largest international competitions, the Cosplay Central Crown Championships.   ㅤ This qualifier selected the cosplayer who will represent Portugal in the grand final in May at MCM London. In addition to this qualifier, the event also featured the traditional contest open to anyone who wanted to participate and was attended by some of the country’s top cosplayers, who were available for meet-and-greets, panels, and workshops. ![23-Coimbra Comics Festival 2026©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/245HuKyWuxZ13oUAqmsfJqiL1JwTVhDXw4z1RbtrdekvnQjyuZjvsuWqZ1gEp1drWp237.jpg) ![24-Coimbra Comics Festival 2026©Paulo Abrantes-39.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tmFZCzbUERKEeKARNc7aAaWKNmBQbiq8fQLehbkJkAZRjAPpw5S1jnWbviSoWSdpbkx.jpg) ![25-Coimbra Comics Festival 2026©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tbRgNggg3thfxQxtf9amcSXmjnQiPWrcmSRNYYGNWCYw1xkNqVJWdXeS7BGwZXQRtcp.jpg) ![26-a_Coimbra Comics Festival 2026©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/244UhLFYLdGzMaAoP93CJ8nD7x3w1mfTVrfVbfGxTrNdDg3GWmQe9Sw2nMeiwVHwHrUF7.jpg)

>Several exhibitions added further points of interest, such as “Butterfly Chronicles” by João Mascarenhas, “Dystopias and Metamorphoses: The Illustrated Classics” by André Carrilho, “Rattlesnake” by João Amaral, and “Kachisou: Between Comics and Illustration,” by manga artist Kachisou, who was present at the festival. ![27-a_Coimbra Comics Festival 2026©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23xKmxqrwZqqJitC6vGb1ZYVEUb1khpuawnRvFMzE3jWvfEK2nyoXFafmc2v9TAPueqMJ.jpg) ![26-Coimbra Comics Festival 2026©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23z7BhUYDs6URucPDCVwSGqqQqgtnsnYxqdEdpfDGx9ZwDpXcJNDPLwYLzej41tsm3B9T.jpg)

>In an area dedicated to gaming featuring consoles, virtual reality, PC gaming, and retrogaming, gaming fans tried out titles such as “Dungeons & Dragons,” “Lorcana Winterspell,” “Azul Duel,” and “Scrabble,” with demonstrations, panels, and tournaments. ![27-Coimbra Comics Festival 2026©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23zkeBGe979VMgcCMNmeTZUbUYweG8CPzA3vNNn3gYQ5xZwb9HgcAJ25SoEMuwEEAqk8Z.jpg) ![28-Coimbra Comics Festival 2026©Paulo Abrantes-33.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23xyNyEcymareiCM2BJTpEguG568RmB7SRmhRgLcgXFLLoDAHDHJkq9tWdnACd4ndy3Th.jpg) ![29-Coimbra Comics Festival 2026©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23yJ69xmV39gNJW6G4kW1EsXL6xBbR1xqp9vs2nV986GnYHezwdWAoz3A8QZATmyCAais.jpg)

>The Coimbra BD Comic Festival is much more than just an event on the city’s cultural calendar; it’s the place where the community comes together. Here, comic book creators and fans come together amid watercolors, video game controllers, conversations about art, books, exhibitions, and cinema. By blending illustration with the world of gaming, the festival brings the city to life and shows the world that Coimbra is, in its own right, a must-visit destination for anyone who loves comics and pop culture. ![30-Coimbra Comics Festival 2026©Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23uFPY8T48uAKhD2dQhRYALk5cMYJYXSseyAnmw94DYFWnNsFrnaQm1BiUrpv79o96eJb.jpg)

>This community is looking for evidence that the festival actually exists. links.title: Staying Strong Through Job Rejection and Uncertainty.
links.body: Waking up every morning and thinking of yourself as an unemployed young fellow hits in a kind of way I cannot really relate to sometimes. Every day, every time, one of the most important things people think of, especially when you are just getting to an adult age, is how to get money and live a better life. But when you have eventually tried some aspect of getting a job and you have not been able to get any, it feels so bad and tiring at the same time. Because being financially buoyant is one of the things that makes us who we are as humans. Apparently, most of our daily activities need money directly and indirectly.\n\n

>

Why have I decided to talk about this? I thought about how life was back then in the olden days when our parents and the grown adults would have to walk miles to make sure they were able to seek a job. But the sad truth about seeking a job for them is that most of them will walk through a long part and still get rejected. But has this stopped them from reapplying to get another job again? No. One thing I have come to notice about jobs is that sometimes we tend to give up so easily, and aside from the fact that some employers just try to frustrate the efforts of people applying for jobs, we still have to summon courage to fight hard.

I could remember when I was still an undergraduate; I was developing myself in some aspect, and also writing a CV was also part of it, so I crafted my CV myself to apply for any job I wanted to apply for. But as the time I got to my final year in the university, I could not keep up with the job, and I had to quit because of the final year stress and other things. But since then, getting a new role has been so demanding, it looks like I have not even been making an effort at all.

We, the current generation, are so lucky, and the reason is we can easily apply for jobs from the comfort of our home and also get a remote job that pays so well. But sometimes this opportunity can be so scarce because there are limited offers for larger people, and the employers only want to pick the best. This is why you have to be the best at what you do and learn it to the extent that you can beat your chest outside and believe that you can. 

Having a job that pays you well is better than having a job that requires more of your efforts and then you get paid pennies. Most of the time, this type of job will frustrate our efforts to the extent that we will want to give up or think we can't do it anymore. But the truth of the matter is that you can do it, and you can be better at what you do so long as you don't give up and you keep the ball rolling. One day your own luck will surely come, and you will eventually be happy in the end.

links.title: ​Adding experiences: Laughing at her
links.body:
​Adding experiences: Laughing at her


​Hello, friends! How are they doing? I'm stopping by to tell you about an amazing experience I had last week. As the title of this post says, the goal is to keep adding moments and, on this occasion, I had to \

in the best possible way.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfVZGZwFuLc3WYopnQnN7sruf7TEo9phUeohL5WL4JHq3/232792.jpg 


​Together with my boyfriend, I decided to venture to a night of Stand Up Comedy. The star of the night was the comedian Carlos Luis Medina. I'm going to be totally honest with you: I didn't know him, but I got out of there being a fan. From minute one until we left, I didn't stop laughing; it has a humor with a lot of sense that grabs you immediately.


​The Discovery: Pizpa

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcDejLnaXUyD5viirEkLBwntbWXRXYZHAhcxv5cNx5fw2/232796.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQman6cSYtH2oQtLXvJ7R9f6jCBPW2xRD71j3MUmnNKj8Rb/232793.jpg 



​Besides discovering a great artist, I finally met the local Pispa. I had heard a lot about this site, but I had not had the opportunity to visit it. It's a small and dark place, but with the perfect atmosphere for comedy.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZVMnY4pAcPkkewsnuLgJfccnM9tY3TrVLY4Kt27SpMDf/232795.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYJDJjHiAZMFdVtReybJ21QReMWkZ5tuoSEK1DY8Qg5Bn/232798.jpg 



​The attention: Simply excellent.
​Drinks and cocktails: Highly recommended, of great quality.
​The food: Their pizzas are, without a doubt, one of the best I've tried.
​The show: Real-life comedy
​What I loved most about Carlos Luis Medina was his ability to interact with the public. His style is genuine and generates natural laughs because he makes comedy based on everyday reality; he describes those things that happen to all of us and manages to make us see ourselves reflected in his jokes.
​He told us that he is not from Caracas, and although he mentioned that sometimes that can be a barrier, the truth is that he has adapted incredibly. In fact, by his mischievousness and his way of speaking, he reminded me a lot of the essence of El Conde del Guácharo, but with his own renewed style.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcsfUKh8pLCP6ya3ufXNWAVeEvZcRTdEoz37xcXufGwNk/232808.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfMCHUYzxYRqrdPy3Udmt3Etc6gMducAPGbQKr7p6Edpk/232790.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXuMoDeMLTHW8o3QeZ9b7rzEs8T2VwEtYeGm1KJ4DRQvR/232791.jpg 



​Final verdict: My boyfriend and I didn't stop laughing all night. It was a super fun experience that I would recommend 100 times. If you have the opportunity to go to Pizpa and see Carlos Luis, do not hesitate!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeWboqwit8yDKyxj2DcBuh3wepFfZWukgKXh6Z5NCemRH/232794.jpg 

​Resources:

- Photos from my galery, taken by my Iphone13 Pro
- Writing of my person

links.title: [ENG-SPN] Fulcanelli, Cioran, and a Church in Aranda / Fulcanelli, Cioran y una iglesia en Aranda
links.body:
![P1050452.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EqJ1uCb8kqewCGHx4snZ2ZZm3HPRnRUp7vN8w9X19zv3hzdFn8ySjJbj4E4hJbd3Vvo.JPG)

Perhaps that unfortunate son of pessimism, the Romanian thinker Emil Cioran, was right when he asserted, in one of his best-known books, \

that what distinguishes us from our ancestors is nothing other than our audacity in the face of Mystery. And even more so, we might add, if we focus part of that ancestral Mystery once again on the jargon of architecture, which, for a privileged son of Mystery, Fulcanelli, always represented Gothic architecture.

![P1050447.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/2423uzquZFVqehCdit2d6TWSN87SygPcf5AHP8n49jfaGyGsL83NfXQZijqrmYiWunFw6.JPG)

We continue our adventure in the oldest part of Aranda de Duero's historic center, not far from the Isabeline jewel that is the Church of Santa María la Real and a medieval bridge. Its modern paving, however, seems to stifle the metaphorical \

left by thousands of pilgrims' boots over the centuries, allowing us to be seduced, willingly and unconditionally, by the mystery of another Gothic church: that of San Juan Bautista.

![P1050448.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23ywsFzPHtvnFU86oMdCfGCcJzRfpjPzZQgQ4HxAbm2Y3CTfbABkaZBzWG2Jf7DpeTpDa.JPG)

Indeed, built a century earlier and not as spectacular, but perhaps more compact than Santa María, this church, dedicated to the figure who had to diminish, inevitably, so that Christ might increase, and now a Museum of Sacred Art, still possesses, in its curious structure, something defining and unique: the first defensive tower ever built in Aranda.

![P1050459.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23y92EZat5c58Ak8W3VcgGqazqFatKPoLiyvgmrpjvAhYXsRYD686FAbJcor98pocta2r.JPG)

Tal vez tuviera razón aquel desventurado hijo del pesimismo, que fue el pensador rumano Emil Cioran, cuando afirmaba, en uno de sus libros más conocidos, ‘Silogismos de la locura’, que lo que nos diferencia de nuestros antepasados, no es otra cosa que nuestro descaro frente al Misterio y más aún, podríamos añadir, si parte de ese Misterio ancestral volvemos a focalizarlo en ese argot de la arquitectura, que, para un hijo privilegiado del Misterio, Fulcanelli, representó siempre el Gótico.

![P1050466.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23zGgjaWcbqundBXsWSiaGrXMP7H7HmfbTF7VUgkSpJH97ZLGFDLsAX9db5sVWhGEc5GL.JPG)

Continuamos nuestra presente aventura en lo más antiguo del casco viejo de Aranda de Duero, aunque no lejos de esa joya isabelina, que es la iglesia de Santa María la Real y de un puente medieval, cuyo moderno empedrado, sin embargo, parece sofocar el metafórico miserere que miles de botas de peregrinos fueron dejando a lo largo de los siglos, para dejarnos seducir, voluntariamente y sin condiciones, por el misterio de otra iglesia gótica: la de San Juan Bautista.

![P1050468.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/245wTyNnD1CHyhSvcaJus1Vn7joEyaXDtyKKvDjoFxo8h9yhSYZasHT9PLFm7jE6w3kK3.JPG)

En efecto, levantada un siglo antes y no tan espectacular, pero sí, quizás, más compacta que la de Santa María, esta iglesia, dedicada a la figura del que tenía que menguar, irremediablemente, para que Cristo creciera y hoy en día convertida en Museo de Arte Sacro, todavía posee, en su curiosa estructura, algo determinante y singular: la primera torre defensiva que hubo en Aranda.

![P1050477.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/245n7YC8kf2wgmWtPxNqzXk5n6kdD6h37RGjLkopWUc3jGfmZ7Jy18tnbTqgZTEx1SLF3.JPG)

![P1050488.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23ynS7uua6gzdjGXo6oThWW4od5FamjS4cRxwAfTu6ooCaQ3SJfEo4yd8QTGDJVd8FrfK.JPG)

links.title: Celebrating Gabriela's Birthday at La Pergola |Celebrando el Cumpleaños de Gabriela en la Pergola
links.body:
>
 
# English

Welcome back to my blog. I hope you’re all doing well. After a long weekend—which is why I’m popping in here again today—I want to tell you about Gabriela’s birthday party, one of Diego’s friends from college.

She sent us the invitation ahead of time via WhatsApp—it would be on Friday, April 24, at La Pergola at 8:00 pm. I’d been wanting to go there for a while because I’d heard good things about the place. That’s why this seemed like the perfect time to visit and check out this bar-restaurant.

Diego and I, as always, arrived early. In fact, even after the birthday girl, we were the first guests there. We took the opportunity to catch up with them. Gabriela was moving from Bogotá to San Cristóbal and told us she’d rented an apartment with her boyfriend in La Concordia. I was curious to know why they were moving back from Colombia, and they explained that here in Venezuela they have better savings opportunities. And that it was best to be close to family. That’s how they began their move to Venezuela.

We also talked about work, college, and mutual friends. Until people started arriving and their reservation for 19 people filled up. At that point, we placed our orders. Since Diego hadn’t had dinner, he ordered a hamburger. And for the two of us, we ordered half a pitcher of sangria. What I didn’t like was that, in addition to the ice we had in our glasses, the pitcher was also filled to the brim with sangria. 

The burger in the photos looked like it came with fries, but no—you had to buy those separately. The burger was delicious. The meat and seasoning were great. We spent the evening chatting; I caught up with some old friends who started college with me, and around 11 p.m. they brought out the cake and we sang “Happy Birthday.”

We had a wonderful time. It was fun to celebrate his birthday at this place.

We'll read you in the comments! 💛

---

# Español 

Bienvenidos un día más a mi Blog. Espero que se encuentren bien. Luego de un fin de semana largo, porque hasta hoy otra vez aparezco por aquí, quiero contarles como fue la celebración de cumpleaños de Gabriela una de las amigas de la universidad de Diego.

Ella con anticipación nos envió la invitación por Whatsapp, sería el viernes 24 de abril en la Pergola a las 8:00 pm. Yo quería ir a este sitio desde hace un tiempo. Porque escuche buenas referencias del lugar. Es por eso que este seria el momento para visitar y conocer este bar restaurant.

Diego y yo como siempre llegamos temprano al sitio. Inclusive luego de la cumpleañera fuimos los primero invitados. Aprovechamos el momento, para colocarlos al día. Gabriela se estaba mudando de Bogota a San Cristóbal y nos conto que había alquilado un apartamento junto con su novio en la Concordia. A mi me dio curiosidad saber, porque se regresaban de Colombia y me explicaron que aquí en Venezuela tienen mejor capacidad de ahorro. Y que lo mejor era estar cerca de la familia. Así comenzaron la mudanza a Venezuela.

También conversamos de los trabajos, de la universidad y de los amigos en común. Hasta que comenzo a llegar la gente y su reserva para 19 personas se lleno. En ese momento hicimos nuestros pedidos, como Diego no había cenado pidió una hamburguesa. Y para los 2 pedimos media jarra de sangría. Lo que no me gusto, es que adicional del hielo que teniamos en las copas, la jarra también estaba repleta de sangría. Lo que me parece un poco aprovechado, porque era más hielo que sangría. 

La hamburguesa en las fotos parecía que traia papas fritas, pero no, esas había que comprarlas a parte. La hamburguesa estaba deliciosa. La carne y la sazon estaban muy buenas. Estuvimos conversando, yo me reencontre con amigos viejos que iniciaron la universidad conmigo y llegadas lass 11 de la noche trajeron la torta y cantamos cumpleaños.

La pasamos de maravilla. Fue divertido compartir su cumpleaños en este lugar. 

¡Nos leemos en los comentarios! 💛 

---

links.title: hive-index trend
links.body:
Another update to hive-index is now live.

This time it's minor, but still useful feature: the trend.

Previously, I added a 30-day activity histogram for each operation. This adds valuable information on the recent dynamics of a given operation, but it's a bit hard to tell whether the overall tendency is increasing or decreasing.

This is where the trend comes to the rescue. It's calculated from the slope of the linear regression of the 30-day activity and is presented as a percentage.

Head to https://index.hive-adventures.com/ to see it for yourself in action.

![hive-index](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeugCqbTEzp33gkMcidaGrDytNoRJXGnS4n1QSJF94Qfp/trend.png)

Hopefully you'll find this useful. Please let me know what you think, and if you have any suggestions or questions, just leave a comment.

![Caitlin Donagh](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/EprTd8BPeCzsMuPN6u7Vbxe3nM9qmGKyFQi6XAhYF89TLupWAwMJGPv7q2dfum8oNYV.jpg)

![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

This mural is located on the wall of the [Santropol Roulant](https://www.instagram.com/sroulant) on Roy Street near Saint-Laurent Boulevard in Montreal. It's a community center that brings local residents together through various activities, such as a local produce market in the summer. The pedestrian street in front has been transformed into a public square: **Les Terrasses Roy**, with tables, gardens, and a sandbox—perfect for a break.

![Carte.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23t86iFDzsvnBSgBRFW8bVVyuHo7YjJZA5Su1W8N54gUCFngXAUpgK9aYis3VEGtAo1BF.jpg)

> *Cette murale se trouve sur le mur du [Santropol Roulant](https://www.instagram.com/sroulant) sur la rue Roy proche du boulevard Saint-Laurent à Montréal. Il s'agit d'un centre communautaire qui rassemble les habitants du quartier grâce à diverses activités, comme un marché de produits locaux en été. La rue devant est piétonne transformé en place : **Les Terrasses Roy**, avec des tables, des jardins et un bac à sable, idéale pour une pause.*

🗺️ Position on [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/#map=18/45.516737/-73.575933)

links.title: Cialis Professional: What Is This Professional Pill, Really?
links.body: I will say it honestly: [cialis professional tadalafil](https://www.imedix.com/drugs/cialis-professional/) sounds like the kind of medicine that arrives wearing a tailored suit and expecting applause. The name is slick. It sounds upgraded, premium, maybe even a little mysterious. And that is exactly why people get curious about it. What makes this product interesting is not only what it may do, but how much of its reputation comes from the name itself.\n\n

></center>

The first thing that caught my attention is that “Professional” is not some magical scientific category. It is not like regular tadalafil went to graduate school and came back with a diploma. In most cases, the real story still comes down to tadalafil, the ingredient commonly associated with Cialis. That is where the actual action is. The branding sounds dramatic, but the body only cares about chemistry, dose, timing, and safety.

What I find genuinely interesting about tadalafil is its personality. Some erectile dysfunction medicines are talked about like fast, dramatic performers. Tadalafil has a different reputation. It is more like the calm, confident one that does not need to rush into the room yelling, “I’m here!” That longer-lasting image is one reason people became so interested in it. For many adults, the appeal is not just physical effect. It is the feeling of less pressure, less clock-watching, and less turning intimacy into a military operation.

Another thing people often get wrong is expecting a pill like this to do all the work alone. It does not create chemistry out of thin air. It does not replace attraction, mood, comfort, or common sense. I always think this is one of the most human parts of the topic: people want medicine to solve the whole moment, when in reality it can only support part of it. The rest still belongs to the person, the body, and the situation.

The side effects are also more interesting than people expect. A lot of readers assume a product in this category should only affect one very specific area. Then suddenly there is a headache, facial flushing, indigestion, nasal congestion, maybe even back pain, and the reaction is basically: excuse me, why is my lower back attending this event? But that is how these drugs work. Blood vessels and smooth muscle do not read advertising copy. If the medicine affects circulation, the body may answer in several places, not just the place the user had in mind.

What also makes Cialis Professional fascinating is how much confidence the name can create. People hear “Professional” and immediately think stronger, better, smoother, more advanced. But medicine is not luxury skincare. A more impressive name does not automatically mean a better or safer product. That is where I become a little suspicious, in the healthiest possible way. The smart question is never “Does the name sound premium?” The smart question is “What exactly is in it, how reliable is it, and is it even appropriate for this person?”

And then there is the truly unglamorous but very important medical part: safety. This is still not a casual candy. If someone uses nitrates, has unstable heart disease, gets chest pain, or has major blood pressure issues, the conversation changes fast. That is one of the most important facts for the general public. A medicine can have a polished image and still come with very serious rules. In that sense, Cialis Professional is a good reminder that the body is not impressed by branding. It responds to physiology.

If I had to explain why this topic is worth reading about, I would put it simply: Cialis Professional is interesting because it lives at the crossroads of medicine, marketing, confidence, expectation, and real biology. It sounds glamorous, but underneath the glossy name is a very practical story about tadalafil, timing, side effects, and how people project huge hopes onto small tablets. That, to me, is what makes it worth talking about. It is not just a pill with a flashy label. It is a perfect example of how medicine and human psychology love to show up to the same party together.

links.title: Salir de la zona de confort, retroalimentación del emprendimiento ( Es-En)
links.body:
Un saludo para mis amigos de la blockchain y especialmente los que visitan a @Beentrepreneur.

Luego de varios días con problemas de conexión, algo ya común para los cubanos, me encuentro con un texto donde @damarysvibra toma el término \

de uno de mis posts; esa simple mención me llena de emoción.
***
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTaxhrPrjB1HHrRHUcwufFJ7nuqJxdy1chbZD9RZcP5Kf/1777402103925.jpg)
***
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbbTWM7L4qcLpDVKibHF8Yd7EvKkAShWFyRA7MDwaAzCp/1777402085192.jpg)
***
***
En estos días he realizado varios pasteles, de hecho estoy fatigada, pero feliz. En la pastelería, crear una zona de confort es difícil porque tradicionalmente los clientes escogen decoración, colores y sabores. En mi caso ha sido más sencillo porque ofrezco lo referente al chocolate y, por tanto, vienen al seguro.

Realizar pasteles de idéntica medida, mismo diámetro, mismo peso, decoración similar, se convierte en un ritual meditativo. Eliminar la incertidumbre permite que la mano recuerde cada movimiento y ese hecho te libera de estrés aunque estés cansada.

Esa repetición calibrada no mata la creatividad, solo facilita la ejecución. Al dominar la base y la receta, pues hay más calma para explorar texturas y acabados.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmeFVot5pDmMNnMX6iHBg5kQWg7BpVVz5bZa1E3xkAZK4b/1777401325340.jpg

---

---

Así, lo monótono se vuelve especialización. Pero hay clientes que imponen retos. Tuve un pedido de pastel para 50 personas; enseguida en mi mente se dibujaron 2 pasteles en un envase cada uno. Luego pasaron los días y me dije: es hora de asumir retos.

Hasta ahora había estado muy cómoda, pero este pedido me exigía salirme de la zona de confort. Quise hacer un solo pastel con facilidad para porcionarlo.

Le pedí entonces a mi cuñado Armando que me realizara una base de madera con un soporte central. Él, diestro carpintero, pidió medidas y no se hizo esperar.

---

---


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZKHtePVY1YXcTvPwFNv2T7YSkJaLp56MoVJgt8zau2PG/1777401756910.jpg)


---

---

Mi hermana fue parte de este resultado; ella supo qué necesitaba exactamente y, una vez realizada, me envió una imagen.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmeDCUXWKcAic6F4gv9QTDbLPFmUsL8WFtw28jU33WUj5Y/1777400115954.jpg

---

---

Empecé por hornear 4 bizcochos, luego a enfriarlos, rellenarlos, montarlos con un separador para porcionar con facilidad y popotes para sostener el peso del de arriba, y dejarlo reposar en la nevera. Ya había logrado una parte importante del trabajo.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmctTJiNgb5Ce7JSP9ftnxLhneXC7GKBDgvbsQ6hZb2tML/1777400238799.jpg

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmUFxVzPWU96yVhRVM4gFc3nAtVDBHuq7Xo9RyTnMEkJoa/1777400238838.jpg

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmNy25p3AmcWmCxCksJFjP58BheytLd5rXkEr14qDFdJNH/1777400238877.jpg

---

---

Hubo un momento que tuve dudas; quería decorar con otros colores, pero ante tanta presión algo me dijo: \

.

Y entonces di rienda suelta a mi amor por el chocolate y en varios preparados: cremas, merengues, bombones y drip. Pues hice mi primer pastel alto.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmUakh79adsXUZD9yk4JNu9r5PbraLdaANyRmFDE3YFoF5/1777400581957.jpg

---

---

La festejada fue la madre de un artista amigo, Ivo Dovale, del cual he hablado en otras comunidades. 98 años festejó Elda, y yo orgullosa de que mi pastel estuviera en su mesa.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6kyBKmK4qNYU73MBBMXkKSygKYCq78jhnJrXLKM94TX/1777400727632.jpg

---

---

Para la resolución de este montaje, muy seguro para trasladar, miré algunos tutoriales y, sobre todo, lo enfrenté sin miedo, porque salirse de la zona de confort significa explorar, avanzar y crecer.

Tengo mucho que aprender. Dice un amigo repostero que el que lleva unos años hace lo que hacen todos, y que yo, desde un comienzo sin apenas experiencia, he impuesto una estética muy personal que no debía cambiar.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmRoN96Daty8y5HpDDnTNU3KSPXWruizRi2qgyxmKKohU2/1777401021815.jpg

---

---

Y así voy, enfrentando retos y desafíos en un oficio de valientes.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmfFnEMCYnFkP4yn3RAjCC5Yi2Bw4pZMYk2wKE2HWeExdE/1739658658260.jpg

<sub>Gracias por visitar mi blog. Soy crítica de arte, investigadora social y amante de la cocina. Te invito a conocer más de mí, de mi país y de mis letras. Texto y fotos de mi propiedad.</sub>

https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAxqWjfHD2t6iFUv1FivzQTFzsMmbGqywoexFuT14L8s/1750582840520.jpg

**Leaving the comfort zone: feedback from entrepreneurship**

Greetings to my friends on the blockchain, and especially to those who visit @Beentrepreneur.

After several days with connection problems – something common for Cubans – I came across a text where @damarysvibra takes the term \

from one of my posts. That simple mention fills me with emotion.
***
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTaxhrPrjB1HHrRHUcwufFJ7nuqJxdy1chbZD9RZcP5Kf/1777402103925.jpg)
***
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbbTWM7L4qcLpDVKibHF8Yd7EvKkAShWFyRA7MDwaAzCp/1777402085192.jpg)
***
***
These days I have made several cakes; in fact, I am tired, but happy. In baking, creating a comfort zone is difficult because traditionally customers choose decoration, colors, and flavors. In my case it has been simpler because I focus on chocolate and therefore they come to me with confidence.

Making cakes of identical size, same diameter, same weight, similar decoration, becomes a meditative ritual. Eliminating uncertainty allows the hand to remember every movement, and that fact frees you from stress even when you are tired.

That calibrated repetition does not kill creativity, it only makes execution easier. By mastering the base and the recipe, you have more calm to explore textures and finishes.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmeFVot5pDmMNnMX6iHBg5kQWg7BpVVz5bZa1E3xkAZK4b/1777401325340.jpg

---

---

Thus, the monotonous becomes specialization. But there are clients who impose challenges. I had an order for a cake for 50 people; immediately in my mind I saw two cakes, each in a container. Then days passed and I told myself: it's time to take on challenges.

Until now I had been very comfortable, but this order demanded that I step out of my comfort zone. I wanted to make a single cake that was easy to portion.

So I asked my brother‑in‑law Armando to make me a wooden base with a central support. He, a skilled carpenter, asked for measurements and didn't delay.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmbQcbp9R74QtPMjcrENUUTi8wkoMtwRqB5aTmPeNn6GpG/1777399988615.jpg

---

---

My sister was part of this result; she knew exactly what I needed and, once it was done, she sent me an image.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmeDCUXWKcAic6F4gv9QTDbLPFmUsL8WFtw28jU33WUj5Y/1777400115954.jpg

---

---

I started by baking 4 sponge cakes, then cooling them, filling them, assembling them with a separator for easy portioning and straws to support the weight of the top one, and letting it rest in the fridge. I had already achieved an important part of the work.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmctTJiNgb5Ce7JSP9ftnxLhneXC7GKBDgvbsQ6hZb2tML/1777400238799.jpg

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmUFxVzPWU96yVhRVM4gFc3nAtVDBHuq7Xo9RyTnMEkJoa/1777400238838.jpg

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmNy25p3AmcWmCxCksJFjP58BheytLd5rXkEr14qDFdJNH/1777400238877.jpg

---

---

There was a moment when I had doubts; I wanted to decorate with other colors, but under so much pressure something told me: \

And then I gave free rein to my love for chocolate and various preparations: creams, meringues, chocolates, and drip. And so I made my first tall cake.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmUakh79adsXUZD9yk4JNu9r5PbraLdaANyRmFDE3YFoF5/1777400581957.jpg

---

---

The guest of honor was the mother of an artist friend, Ivo Dovale, whom I have talked about in other communities. Elda celebrated 98 years, and I was proud that my cake was on her table.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6kyBKmK4qNYU73MBBMXkKSygKYCq78jhnJrXLKM94TX/1777400727632.jpg

---

---

To solve this assembly, very safe for transport, I watched some tutorials and, above all, I faced it without fear, because stepping out of your comfort zone means exploring, advancing, and growing.

I have a lot to learn. A baker friend says that those who have been doing this for a few years do what everyone else does, and that I, from the beginning with hardly any experience, have imposed a very personal aesthetic that I should not change.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmRoN96Daty8y5HpDDnTNU3KSPXWruizRi2qgyxmKKohU2/1777401021815.jpg

---

---

And so I go, facing challenges and hurdles in a trade of the brave.


***
***

links.title: Rethinking Career Paths in a Modern World
links.body:
Graduates are getting much every year in the labour market and still there is no certainty that job is sure for everyone. I checked when i graduated two years ago from the university and we were more than 4000 graduating in our current level and now we have over 30 universities in the country when there is polytechnic there. Now imagine having that number for more than 30 schools, there is now how one can be certain of work out there and this is why most people go into handiwork and start learning things that will fetch them money without waiting for government job.

![IMG_4069.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayorkeys/23yTjRheYTnxNLDHa5zabfbMCaoaLrBEcMUJ5SF51ckGfxMQSQTbUoTxitmTKR4otBCW5.jpeg)

Now the journey is also different because getting an handiwork will also involve money to learn so that is why capital is needed. For everyone having an handiwork will need some tools, also after learning will need various things to push the brand to people which is called visuality and now most of them learn handiwork but still decided to learn more skills which are digital this period and the market world is filled up but even at that people are getting wise up.

I always imagine how those people then use to walk around searching for job and wont even see a vacancy not to talk of people that will see but will take various interviews and still won’t get a job. I sat down one day and i was like which one is better now between the physical job and remote job because both of them has the advantage and disadvantage but surely one still has upper chance provided that there are equipment that will hasten the process.  

## PHYSICAL JOB
Physical job are those ones that will require you to be in the office everyday to work and you will have some specific time and duration to work. 

> Benefit of physical work 
One of the benefit of the physical work is that you can stay in the office and you have conveniency in terms of power supply which is provided by the company.

> Disadvantage 
Imagine the distance of work place to your house is very far, you will have to wake up early, meet up with early bus to work and go past traffic everyday, the stress can be draining but if it is worth the pay you are good to go.

## REMOTE JOB
This is working from home and also getting paid at your convenience. Many people do say they prefer remote work to physical but do not know the real work behind it.
For remote work you enjoy benefit of working from home and getting to work when you want to but not waking up like physical so early just to get to the work place. As far as the remote work is very good if the pay is very little there will be a lot of issues.

Getting paid for a job of 80,000 naira and you will need to do some big data bundle that will last you for a month. That price might not pay since you will need other things to sort to meet up because as a remote worker you need to have the following and without that you might not stay long in working for any company.

1. Good electricity:- this is the major push for a remote worker because you will need constant electricity to power your appliances like your laptop.
2. Good Network:- You need a fast connection to meet up daily task and also anytime a meeting is set up which one must be there, a bad network can detriment you
3. A Conducive Environment:- As a remote worker you need a quiet environment that do not have noise which enables you to think and carry out your work effectively. Without this you can’t go far as a remote worker..

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@mayorkeys/rethinking-career-paths-in-a-modern-world-5an)

links.title: A Third Option
links.body:
#
My most recent getaway

# A trip to Surabaya
Recently I went on a trip to Surabaya, Indonesia. Considering I live near Vancouver, Canada it is a very very long trip. It was also very isolating. English isn't widely spoken and I was visibly different. I found it very interesting that I didn't see another \

person for at least two weeks while I was there. Not in the airport. Not in the malls. Not in the hotel. Not on the street. That was surprising to me. Living in Vancouver area there is always a mix of people. Asian, White, Black and from many nationalities. When I travel to Manila? Same thing. There are primarily Asian/Filipino but there are always some other nationalities and ethnicities mixed in. Surabaya was foreign enough that I was far from what I knew .... ***and that is exactly what I was looking for***
# The common question
As a foreigner that stuck out there were a few things that happened. First: Young children stopped to stare on occasion. Second: I passed a lady on her phone while walking on the street. The startled look on her face when she looked up to see a white guy beside her was priceless. If I was actually talking to someone though I got the question: \

.

Being the honest guy that I am I always gave the same answer:

**Neither**

I probably should have just stayed with the script.  I suppose its a bit like when people ask \
and the answer is supposed to be \
.  Any other answer breaks the script and can be awkward.\n\nI guess people want an answer of either \

to continue the script. But I honestly wasn't there for either. I was there to getaway from everything and have quiet time to just be me. To find myself without distraction. To have time to focus on taking care of myself instead of doing everything else that needed to be done.
# Escaping the routine
Arguably I have a good life in Canada. I have a loving wife. I have two great sons. I have a dog, two cars, and a house. Add in that I have a job, a good church, and no safety or financial worries and everything is perfect, right?
**Except my daily routine, chore and to-do list mean that there is always something occupying my attention**

So even if I'm just sitting and relaxing my mind is thinking: * Should I do the dishes? * Go to the gym? * What should I make for dinner? * Is there laundry? * etc, etc, etc. There is no time to just sit and reflect. No time to just be me without something pulling me. # The third option: Be quiet and reflect ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/terganftp/23wMU52PLttcNKomBVW1oBCsHt7jYMtC7qDqusW6Yp1oxsSki4ZngQDQehknnibTgScxw.png) Image created with Dall-e That's why I was in Surabaya. To be in a hotel where food was available every morning just go down and eat. The gym was on the 5th floor just go down and exercise. There were no bills to pay, no chores to do, no wife or kids to chat with, no to do list to get done. I was truly free to reflect and think. Four times a day I would hear the mosque's broadcast their prayers and I have a reminder to read my bible and pray. I may not be Muslim but I enjoyed the daily reminder anyways. There was no reason why I shouldn't go to the gym so I went every day. There wasn't a pantry with snack food so I didn't eat anything more than I should.
**Stress and decision making vanished**

#
How two months away changed me

When my wife would call and ask \

it frustrated her as she hadn't found the peace of just being free.  That is something I really enjoyed though.

### Freedom

With nothing pulling me I was free to do exactly what I wanted.  I found out I really did enjoy going to church.  I found out I really did enjoy exercising and reading my Bible.  I got caught up on all the anime I wanted to watch and even played video games for the first time in a long time.

It also showed me what I missed.  I missed the hummus I make, the soy milk I make, the chili and other foods I appreciate.  I missed the quiet cool mornings walking around the park listening to the birds and seeing the mist on the lake.  I missed chatting with my sons and snuggling with my wife watching a movie.

<center>**My time away showed me what was important to me and how much I enjoy my home.**</center>

That is something that gets blurred when every day is an endless list to chores and even the things I enjoy just get lumped in with \

.  

Stepping away.
.. quiet time to reflect
.... freedom to think
...... freedom from the to-do list

Helped me bring things into perspective.

<hr>

* If I was in Surabaya or business?  **I would be thinking about the job**
* If I was in Surabaya for vacation? **I would have been thinking about what sights to see**

I'm very glad I took the third option.  The one that very few people tend to think about in the fast pace of modern life.

But for all those people who think \

.  That is exactly what I did...and I'm so glad I had the opportunity.  I'm also glad I'm back home! But someday....when the to do list seems to be grinding on me....I know a little trick to step away from a crazy world.

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 28 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gbcb32970a93161a5f95517d5b18ede37a7da4665f68a0421929e36982c1c73927210d80a114bf2a8548c6a94d2c884763a7b7aa3a780aa26247c2c454aa50b10_640.jpg)
Hoy, mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente refrescante. Comencé mi recorrido en un parque donde conocí a un artista callejero que pintaba murales vibrantes. Me contó que trabaja en su arte desde hace más de cinco años, y que busca transmitir mensajes de esperanza y unidad a través de sus obras. Sus colores y la energía que emanaba eran contagiosos. Mientras continuaba mi camino, pasé por un mercado local lleno de aromas deliciosos. Conocí a una señora mayor que vendía frutas y verduras orgánicas. Me comentó que cultivaba su propio huerto y que cada día se despertaba a las 5 a.m. para cuidar de sus plantas. No pude resistirme y compré algunas fresas, que estaban realmente jugosas. A lo largo del recorrido, también noté cómo la ciudad se estaba preparando para una fiesta local, con banderas de colores y luces adornando las calles. La atmósfera era animada y alegre, lo que hizo que mi caminata fuera aún más especial. Sin duda, cada día en la ciudad siempre trae nuevas sorpresas y oportunidades para conectar con las personas y disfrutar del entorno. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

body.title: Chocolate pudding
body.body:
>
![post hive - 2026-04-28T133243.018.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23uR2nSmRG9VhURAZxi6fqmnQH9ud7VfCa5bENfrT1yygXEjN7CSDNUuxbb7XXEwrUpZM.png)
--- One of the things I’ve enjoyed most since my diagnosis is learning to cook and trying new, healthy recipes. It’s been quite a challenge—it was tough at first, but little by little I’ve let my guard down. I’m not sure if that’s for better or worse; I still try to stick to it, but there are just some things that slip through our fingers. Recently, a nutritionist responded to a comment I made asking why gluten-free products are more expensive. She said it’s because they contain other ingredients. I get that, but I still don’t understand the difference. Maybe it’s because they’re hard to find—I don’t know. Anyway, why am I bringing this up? Well, I put myself in the shoes of moms whose children have celiac disease. As we all know, they have to eliminate gluten and follow a strict diet. In my country, a gluten-free diet is expensive compared to other countries. My sister had to move abroad so my nephew could get the care he deserves. Do you think that’s fair? Anyway, if he were here with me, I’d cook for both of us. He loves to eat—my little chubby one—and that’s why I thought of this chocolate pudding. I don’t know if it’s okay for him to eat, I don’t think they recommend chocolate much either; they cut it out for me, though later I consulted a nutritionist, and it turns out it’s okay, as long as it’s unsweetened cocoa. Well, let’s get down to business. As part of the initiative proposed by the @Mundoautismo community, today I’m sharing my attempt at **chocolate pudding**. I say “attempt” because it’s the first time I’ve made it, and I’m not sure if I did it right—though it did turn out really delicious, hehehe… ## Ingredients: - 2 cups plant-based milk - 2 tablespoons cornstarch - 3 tablespoons cocoa powder - 1 tablespoon honey ## Preparation:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EokbjFN2ZQJyazj9nW3QUAVtwWQPxpRUhS6N5aCcMgAvSKDjTSogAy5tq69CpK2YzyQ.png)
Well, the steps for making this pudding are very simple.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eo8SndMTTom7F9ygJKdDPkRFjHJQNuKVUWbbRBFEA3mXa3HJ2ErHQb5auTL3hbVxgzu.png)
In a small pot, add the two cups of milk, followed by the cocoa powder and cornstarch, and a touch of honey (you can use stevia).
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EogNHozYzcHfKgRT9HLLoDn5PSDSN8Aiw4rQCciKiZ9GzPqJgwTiCc7yaboujGW226T.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EpA1WreS4yAtUTSDubc4wHM7HaZwqgtVPLsWjheLT7TU9km2ZiSd4KpJrtGQpTSXu1i.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoprQxedrcvd5p58FVekooxe7ufUsejMKgdwUBgafwoicXukqoN5kYbDiYzTb6D2Z72.png)
Now just stir until it thickens. I think in my case, I let it thicken too much—I’m not sure, but anyway, that’s how it turned out. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eo6KWYPDMZ6htxa6mhEug1Pj9ztDRDZMmFy7BkZeiFZn1a4vdYmjkoHjJYRF619PUG1.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eo4C64Jo4kfVhsLY3cHHm4mqqaPhB9bfh74PyE1KCGFgheiuawB4i32MkCN43vYH1pn.png) |-|-| What I did was let it sit, then put it in the fridge to chill for two hours.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoEqymocHSvcdGEjrjB35yMxeRg3f2tG4ESRhF3DhmvAGLRg57ic9pNiYCzWLVc1jQk.png)
Now all that’s left is to enjoy this delicious pudding—easy and tasty to make. I hope you like it and feel inspired to make it too. Well, friends, this is my entry for the challenge—I hope you enjoy it. If my nephew were here, we’d eat it all together, haha. Sorry, I didn’t see the rule saying I had to be in the photo—I just took step-by-step pictures, as I usually do with my recipes. But hey, here I am enjoying my pudding. 😜 ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23zSC42dRkzT2nvd4eCWsLw1ppfN44m9jawWn8536p5KuvKmhUdBgHYD312apqPsp3VQG.png)|![post hive - 2026-04-28T134229.998.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23xVRXzwdqG4Lk4pa74SBx6vVpMQhb4xye7jRyVbvpBFTJoBcCkhFXmMy4K5M3hT8KZBa.png) |-|-| If I get the chance, I’ll bring you another recipe. I’m inviting @carisma77 and @yolimarag—I know they’re experts at making delicious, healthy meals, so I hope they’ll be able to participate. Until next time. ---
SPANISH VERSION

Una de las cosas que mas me ha gustado a partir desde que tuve mi diagnostico, es aprender a cocinar, probar recetas nuevas y saludables, ha sido todo un reto, al principio fue fuerte, pero poco a poco fue bajando la guardia, no se si, para bien o para mal, aun trato de mantenerme, solo que hay cosas que se nos escapa de las manos. Hace poco una nutricionista respondió a un comentario que le hice, que no entiendo porque los productos sin gluten son mas caros, ella dice que porque contienen otros ingredientes, si yo entiendo eso, aun así, sigo sin comprender la diferencia, será porque cuesta conseguirlos, no se, en fin, porque comento esto, bueno me pongo en el lugar de las Mamás que tienen sus hijos que sufren de TAC, como bien sabemos a ellos les eliminan el gluten, y deben cumplir una dieta estricta, en mi pais, una dieta sin gluten, es cara, comparado con otros paises. Mi hermana tuvo que emigrar para que mi sobrino tuviera la atención que merece, ustedes creen eso justo, en fin, si lo tuviera aquí conmigo, cocinaría para los dos, a el le encanta comer, ese gordito mío, es por el que pensé en este pudín de chocolate, no se si esta acorde a lo que puede comer, creo que tampoco les recomiendan mucho el chocolate, a mi me lo eliminaron, aunque después consulte con una nutricionista, y resulta que si, siempre y cuando sea cacao sin azúcar. Bueno, vamos a lo que nos corresponde, como parte de la iniciativa propuesta por la comunidad de de @Mundoautismo, hoy les traigo mi intento de **Pudín de chocolate**, digo así, porque es la primera vez que lo hago, y no se si lo hice bien, eso si, quedo muy rico jejeje.. ## Ingredientes: - 2 Tazas de leche vegetal - 2 cucharadas de maicena - 3 cucharadas de cacao en polvo - 1 cucharada de miel ## Preparación:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EokbjFN2ZQJyazj9nW3QUAVtwWQPxpRUhS6N5aCcMgAvSKDjTSogAy5tq69CpK2YzyQ.png)
Bueno para la preparación de este pudin, los pasos son muy sencillos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eo8SndMTTom7F9ygJKdDPkRFjHJQNuKVUWbbRBFEA3mXa3HJ2ErHQb5auTL3hbVxgzu.png)
En una olla pequeña añadiremos nuestras dos tazas de leche, seguidamente el cacao y la maicena, el toque de miel (pueden usar estevia).
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EogNHozYzcHfKgRT9HLLoDn5PSDSN8Aiw4rQCciKiZ9GzPqJgwTiCc7yaboujGW226T.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EpA1WreS4yAtUTSDubc4wHM7HaZwqgtVPLsWjheLT7TU9km2ZiSd4KpJrtGQpTSXu1i.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoprQxedrcvd5p58FVekooxe7ufUsejMKgdwUBgafwoicXukqoN5kYbDiYzTb6D2Z72.png)
Ahora solo queda remover hasta que quede espeso, creo que en mi caso, deje que se espesara mucho, no se, pero bueno, así quedo. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eo6KWYPDMZ6htxa6mhEug1Pj9ztDRDZMmFy7BkZeiFZn1a4vdYmjkoHjJYRF619PUG1.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eo4C64Jo4kfVhsLY3cHHm4mqqaPhB9bfh74PyE1KCGFgheiuawB4i32MkCN43vYH1pn.png) |-|-| Lo que hice fue dejarlo reposar, y lo metí en la nevera a refrigerarse por dos horas. Ya solo queda degustar de este rico pudin, fácil y rico de preparar. Espero les guste, y se animen también hacerlo, bien amigos esta es mi entrada a la iniciativa, espero sea de su agrado, si tuviera a mi sobrino, nos lo comeríamos entre los dos jeje. Disculpen, no vi la regla donde dice que debo salir, solo tome fotos del paso a paso, como acostumbro con mis recetas, pero epa, aquí salgo disfrutando de mi pudin. 😜 Si me da chance, les traeré otra receta, invito a @carisma77 y @yolimarag, se que ellas son unas expertas en preparar ricas comidas saludables, espero logren participar. Hasta la próxima.

body.title: Heavy pressure to code something every single day otherwise the tokens goes waste
body.body:
Since I started using AI coding tools with subscriptions, it has been a really amazing experience, and I started liking the way I sit and vibe code. I sometimes find it very hard to even step away from my computer. In general, I have started liking this new way of life, which is vibe coding. Earlier, we had to do everything by ourselves, where we had to come up with a solution for our problem, and at the same time, designing a few things can be exhausting. Another main reason is that I have paid the money for the pro subscription, and as long as the tokens are available, I have to continue using it until it resets. I mostly keep working until the tokens are exhausted and wait for a couple of days for the tokens to recover. Sometimes, if we don't use the tokens properly, ultimately it is our money that is getting wasted, which is not good, right? 

Today, most of the tough parts are handled by AI. Most of the draining and repetitive tasks are also handled by AI, and the code ideation part is still with us, where we can give assistance to the way AI thinks, and we can be a part of the ideation. Sometimes the solutions provided by AI are far better, but sometimes we also have to be very careful with what we are getting from AI. So, in general, coding with the help of AI is really amazing, and we don't feel tired when AI is doing the heavy lifting, and it is fun to sit and watch that. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUE1tdq3r6WQg9k8P41oTGozCNQZ5HtdZY9xj55mkUeNg/image.png)

Source - Gemini

I saw a few comments on social media channels where some people had mentioned that they have stopped spending time on social media and they have started using that time to vibecode. Someone specifically mentioned that he stopped watching Instagram Reels and started vibecoding. People see this as a new form of drug these days. There are some favourite games for us. People try to recreate those games with the help of vibecoding. Those are coming out of their own interest. This has now become a trend among both youngsters and experienced people who would like to build something that is very interesting. I guess with the help of AI, even non-technical people can build some amazing things, and if it clicks very well, it can be a great thing for the market. 

I see this AI revolution as a way to deliver things faster than it used to be before, and other than that, I don't see a demand for IT needs reducing. Maybe with the help of AI, it can even increase further. A small business or a small shop will even have its tools and website built, as AI has also reduced a lot of development time and cost. We may not know in which direction this can keep going, but hopefully, in a few years, everything should be in good shape.

body.title: Bye Bye Dcity: Burned my NFTs today\n
body.body: Bye Bye Dcity: Burned my NFTS today ----------------------------------- Dcity was the earliest and the passive game in the Hive and actually it was also very popular game too in its initial days when players regularly used to buy and sell the Dcity NFTs. At that time, buying NFTs generated income in SIM tokens, which could be reinvested to buy additional NFTs. It was a kind of satisfaction that the players used to get by increasing their city size. I still remember that the first generation cards used to be Citizen, Basic home, Apartment, Weed farm, Bank, and Military Industrial complex.

/> [Source](https://ecency.com/@r1s2g3/dcity-build-it-for-your-passive-income) Above is the screenshot of my Dcity that I have taken from my old post about Dcity and my Dcity used to look like this. Now Dcity game interface is no longer available so I cannot view my Dcity. But good thing is that these cards are actually NFT and still in my ownership even though interface is no longer available to see them in the old way. This the actual power of blockchain and decentralization that even though game interface and game is no longer available to play, players still own their assets. Game is no longer available to play, so the game developer decided to distribute all the Hive associated with the game account to the players and SIM holders. A big shoutout to the @gerber for this when many of the crypto projects are rugging or shut down without any compensation. More about this can be read at [this post](https://peakd.com/hive-140217/@ecoinstant/dcity-final-claimdrop-70000-hive-up-for-grabs-right-now) where the final payment will be distributed for sending your SIM to null (make sure you read the post clearly before doing the same.) Also the game NFT if burned will yield the SIM (in a similar way when splinterland's core set cards on burning give DEC) , Since game is already no longer playable, it is good to burn those NFT unless you are collector of Dcity NFT and want to keep them. If you have Dcity NFT then you can burn it for SIM using [https://alextrapp.github.io/burnDcity/](https://alextrapp.github.io/burnDcity/) site.

/>

[Source](https://alextrapp.github.io/burnDcity/)

As you see, I have NFT burn worth 5837 SIM and I burned it too.

My next step is to send 1 million SIM to null as a second part to take part in Hive rewards distribution in coming days. I am not in hurry to burn SIM as last day is 26 June 2026. Also when you send SIM , make sure it is 1 Milion or in multiples of natural number of 1 Million because you will get 1 entry for 1 million SIM , not the proportional entry for the SIM burn.

So let us bid adieu to Dcity now and do not panic if you do not have 1 million SIM as you can buy and sell SIM using tribaldex lquidity pool.

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 28 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/ge604ba85725ee87e6d6193583a52f596e36f013bbed4b75005d364f0904d90bff8741eb550a4e89a3e8eb9f6e391a770c630393424872bb6a544ec94ea6fbf59_640.jpg)
My last walk was a delightful jaunt along the South Downs Way, a beautiful national trail in Sussex. The South Downs is known for its rolling hills, charming villages, and stunning views of the English countryside. Starting from the picturesque village of Alfriston, I meandered along the trail, enjoying the vibrant greenery and the soft, gentle undulations of the landscape. One of the highlights was passing by the iconic chalk cliffs of the Seven Sisters, which were absolutely breathtaking. The contrast of the bright white cliffs against the blue sky and the deep green of the fields was simply stunning. Along the way, I spotted several historic landmarks, including the ancient Long Man of Wilmington, a giant figure carved into the hillside, which dates back to the 16th century. There's so much mystery surrounding its origin, and it really makes you think about the people who lived in this area hundreds of years ago. I also met a few fellow walkers on the trail. One particularly interesting encounter was with a local artist named Lucy, who was sketching the landscape. We chatted about her love for capturing the beauty of the Downs, and she shared stories about her inspirations and how the ever-changing light plays a crucial role in her art. As I continued my walk, I stopped by a charming little pub in the village of Eastbourne for a well-deserved pint of local ale and a traditional ploughman’s lunch. The pub was buzzing with warmth and laughter, and it was a great spot to reflect on my walk and the fascinating history surrounding me. Overall, the walk was a perfect blend of natural beauty, rich history, and delightful encounters, making it a truly enriching experience that I can't wait to repeat! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

# CUSCO DIARIES: DETAILS OF THE UNEXPECTED / DETALLES DE LO INESPERADO [ENG-ESP]
### Documentary Photography / Fotografía Documental

<center>

![_DSC9774.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/Eo8Soe7keYF2mxvKo7L1AcZ2zj6Sgg9s1wE1u4eC6bMRHrMwXsLz8G17a2auZVXKmzU.jpg)

*“There are objects and people that appear out of nowhere, but fit perfectly in a frame.”*
*“Hay objetos y personas que aparecen de la nada, pero encajan perfectamente en un encuadre.”*

</center>

***

<div class=\

> ### English Hello friends of the Black and White community. How is the week going? I hope that everything, as I always say, is positive and full of pure good vibes. In Cusco, we find many dreamlike landscapes, and if we stop to observe, we can appreciate details that are found not only in the vegetation, but in encountering the day-to-day lives of the people and the architecture of their houses. Walking down lonely trails and crossing paths with people who appear out of nowhere, or objects that would make no sense to find in the middle of nowhere, yet fit perfectly into a photograph. That is why, in this series, I bring you a little bit of all this. Right now, my schedule is very tight, so my texts aren't as thoroughly planned; I'm just flowing with my thoughts. I am currently taking my monthly exams and I am among the top 20 students in my major. I would like to reach the top 15 this semester, with the ultimate goal of finishing in the top 5 by the time I graduate. It is a difficult challenge, but not impossible. I leave you with this series of 8 photographs, I hope you appreciate them. As always, I'll be reading your thoughts in the comments! ### Español Hola amigos de la comunidad en Blanco y Negro. ¿Cómo va la semana? Espero que todo, como siempre les digo, esté positivo y lleno de pura buena vibra. En Cusco encontramos muchos paisajes de ensueño, y si nos detenemos a observar, podemos apreciar detalles que no solo están en la vegetación, sino en encontrarnos con el día a día de las personas y la arquitectura de las casas. Caminar por caminos solitarios y cruzarte con personas que aparecen de la nada, u objetos que no tendrían ningún sentido al encontrarlos en el medio de la nada, pero que encajan perfectamente en una fotografía. Por eso, en esta serie les dejo un poco de todo esto. Ahora que estoy con los tiempos ajustados, mis textos no están tan planificados, sino que voy fluyendo. Estoy en evaluaciones del mes y actualmente estoy entre los 20 mejores de mi carrera. Quisiera llegar a estar entre los 15 este semestre, para terminar entre los primeros 5 al culminar mis estudios. Es un reto difícil, pero no imposible. Los dejo con esta serie de 8 fotografías, espero las aprecien. Como siempre, ¡los leo en los comentarios! > **¡Kachkaniraqmi!** — *(Quechua: Until we meet again)* ***
