body.title: [ENG - ESP] Spicy Onion And Potato Soup For A Rainy Morning (Spice Up Yourself)
body.body:
### Warmest greetings and happy new week hivers and vegan family 😍💕. 

![0DDB92E6-88DF-47E7-B567-0C7B2AC408FA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKSeJqaDkDGi8nH5NhbyJnGBRf3Tx3sEoGdwtHMNnwpdRpeAJ19CmJxh2fAvay9.jpeg)

![24B7CA31-E362-45B8-B7E6-34D454CCE11B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zkyPHiwQSTvtALLnFDnr3zYfC1ZqHDBfmKTB3FF1bzogZ7PJeNehEZPv983YmfrFXxB.jpeg)

![650617F1-6BF1-4BD4-8E3B-8CD4290B9EE4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244AD8xJCMqMpyxSvPksVUgXQvsq8BmEvVYVPCufbFt2omCtCMAgTA4f3hVZ4Sv9ULZrp.jpeg)

Its good to be with you again today, and we are going to enjoy this simple , budget friendly, hearty soup we can make with just pantry ingredients that am sharing with you. 

I woke up earlier this morning and not just in the mood for tea ☕️, but something hot and spicy because it rained all night and into the morning, making it obvious that we should be aware that the rains are here. With weather like this one, hot soup usually cones to mind.

And as I looked around the pantry to check what ingredients can make the quickest and simplest soup, I decided on onion 🧅 and potato 🥔 soup . A comforting soothing soup that can quickly warm you up with a taste of spice and at the some time serve as food for few hours.

![56DF74CE-8C74-427E-AEBC-710F8057CCC4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243g9K8jwt9eKXeXgDrhwtonukqFSdiGevafqywzfAgzmqrgZfBk393FKr1L4E4NexirJ.jpeg)

Trust me - this soup 🍲 is super easy to make because we don’t need to involve blending process of the potatoes , therefore, not time consuming but a classic in its own with the aroma from the onions.

Below are the detailed step by step process for this delicious soup 🍲.

# INGREDIENTS: (One serving)

![380F2BA3-4913-4E69-A099-E7DFB2BAFD98.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uFYCruW59qdw3YcU8vGmZuneu4Zh4csunBazZpfG4MbC7uQV3UYXavRByLekjckDr4u.jpeg)

1/4 large potatoes (peeled)
1/2 of 1 mediums red onion 
1/4 teaspoon of salt 
1/2 teaspoon of curry
1/4 teaspoon of thyme herb
2 hot red fresh pepper 

# EXTRA INGREDIENTS:

![FAC707AA-8470-433D-BEEE-54DD1A21257B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243M9Ni4HiF3sa2LyCe1Eb1HJ9mT8zwb8z3NsWQwYB8YmrP36JCNDsK5K5zt39EaTX6oP.jpeg)

3/4 glass of spring water 
5 ml cap of vegetable oil
1/2 teaspoon of tomatoes 🍅 paste 

# STEPS FOR PREPARATION:

Step 1.

![EE95A4B8-7A97-49A5-A1EA-AFF5F404001C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244oqw4to2dAaaR3eivX1G2YWGTPkjeAC9o2NqErn3gLM7GSEqgKdDmTnaGDVUrUVDYMJ.jpeg)

![94804510-0DD2-4FDE-AA9B-FC8B5F155103.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wC9M9ngiPMDFztVqN4WN5HAaMFQXQoBvgFEJcaedBKjguyRigXRPwKPhemXjrVRSq2J.jpeg)

Since the potato has been peeled, we will take it into the pan.

![D8C7E081-20A6-4083-BE87-6A1358CA51CE.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uEzR4qbExagKDLQrF13TfvmqAjWFYaHPKSaiHs5RW9w9fDP1kMJBjmfhz7hGXcvEvCG.jpeg)

![01D96BAA-7936-4898-B332-F1C70747E3EC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23w2aN4MgL3FH1FhJy75J61xiDB6PzchWVXuey6wnyHq2CuNm4afdaiNgidzEEa2kdgrX.jpeg)

Then wash it and set it on the cooker to start cooking.

Step 2.

![4E6F3446-21EB-4777-A841-1344FA8C2A36.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242YEJRg7gQM8uv2uGd4cVVpew1Lt2vzT5k2uVahaiC3QZoHEqcVbgJ4L4RS8VJupcPmk.jpeg)

![28776C84-DD56-42A1-934E-3D4E05FC6F78.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/241tfs1R1mVEgcH53z24xViaRU4H8AABSnEPCKu3KRq3j1eYJz6TGf4Jr88LQRkG55r3E.jpeg)

![9130A8FB-5741-460D-B442-75787DCA1453.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244yGfuJS5LYJU2ykKWyjRHLyQ56BJoqLsqHa4q881SLYYdfzt4WdRBt2VsHXwQhfNHxR.jpeg)

We wash and slice the onions 🧅 and  hot pepper readily.

Step 3.

![5E24F7BE-5CF4-48CA-81E1-3D328C7D0EF4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AL7PLmBgeu2kN3XgChfvVFEprRKcyc8nKUUPysJvEU8vgQJkXwapr2Uf3hVzbUg.jpeg)

Once the potato has cooked tenderly, we lower heat.

![AB00E6D5-BBEB-4065-9520-C50FCC3C2F1A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALBhebupDSQsnrjJruvDEAR84wX6SbdRZToMCiibuLgSMqKzz3YUgy19ACvHyxW.jpeg)

![0EF8C2CE-834B-4284-95C4-FD3F4F1550A8.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMYNixDKNcpZcPyizKza7smVxXWCuLpojbCnSvA1UPxJ346dQtViMxci5zExdyUgb6r.jpeg)

Drain and take it into a bowl 🥣 for mashing . As above . 

Step 4.

![A4B213CF-5BF6-4848-B375-CA4179AC1B17.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vsNPCz6ehSfo9KtXfjmutfa1tjgzfBeC6VKCY3Pbi3XF7pMbbnJJpXE5XUXzU3mc9dr.jpeg)

![B8712196-73BC-4A3B-87A1-DE701AADC1E6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wC7Z31TPRTt91zhEU392HphdFsdd5zgujmcPqYL99ZSK9u2DnqCnuPMg7Cfaxkj95Rq.jpeg)

![751C6B21-F2C9-4315-9250-3ED80E3EE813.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23yTfLTi3JmdsTC6xkMMjxhYL8AqBrGcz5UN4EFe6MuWBXqwE7L3yW9VD7Se81Na8qziU.jpeg)

Once its smoothly mashed, we take it back into the pan.

![494E799D-6EA7-4F58-86A4-F8CD78B642DB.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wC9hrSuGwmadFiJg5Q4eRXL7auYe3L5BmQawX9k9VLTBsyuc1VUKN9BcQgQjTQUJaZP.jpeg)

![D2D87075-6B43-4F80-9A1D-AC06663EC676.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ydAAWBgYYATw25Rbu6SbFQyC6rBCPdHoT6j9sD9Hbjwyfn2pZgCgy12FFQtBZmpWZqA.jpeg)

Add our water and stir thoroughly into a purée as above.

Step 5.

![D5EC9513-E67B-4A75-9E01-DE9A80C17413.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vhq7tZTt8JF7b388zuAj9cKssutM1nNh5kHQ3Ls4eQRjMaxtEEdCCNUop3LSckzWTdk.jpeg)

![421E586D-0971-4FC1-80BD-94D74EC9D6C9.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23u5bfy227Fk5jahpSZf5Mh87YKnPsQMFWog2gugJvDxSebBxFqUFp4MXAq2GasV5S1xK.jpeg)

We set it back on the cooker and allow to start cooking.

![F8F600D4-5D80-4CC4-9B79-AC983B459452.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK2CmnsoWVMtLjifWhiMmjqKc81DQ3QHio9KXLSnDrbJchF57UCG3anPK4ooVv3.jpeg)

Once it begins to cook, we add the fresh pepper, salt, curry, thyme and paste .

![F5EFFBC0-538D-4A79-8A9E-437C16398D56.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tvCibHbCKkaZ5EUeyncV4kkACPYgVdHpuD5QFjJ9tAQSPAp4EmmsgqWiWA7rseLKSjG.jpeg)

Stir properly to incorporate.

Step 6.

![3E56B9C7-E314-48D5-A2D0-A9655E86CA97.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AL4Wv5PrgQqbzkGTFTjsggLito4vAvq6YrA1564x138ubP6u63E6pA8QX6awrys.jpeg)

Allow to start thickening, then we add our vegetable oil and onions here above 

![3D8DB8E3-A22B-426E-B58E-7EA2130E4BED.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tvCicpVUH5cNC6Wfv4diCH6oZ7qWG23kjps4BYmXFn6YhSvRjdMBvJjr7nnnXMy6kwe.jpeg)

![9315A643-12AC-4856-9211-B3A31C5171EF.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uFH67cNRuTy4WEjNXzZ7e8enhzmTFvqk8nrdf8FUkQg7j7kemuCeeBPokK1hYtkQgHn.jpeg)

Cook for another 2 minutes  to thicken more and lower heat.

![904DB454-FC91-423D-9B24-84447E4D7B27.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wqkaaVpkBKJaKEbRLeU44Mq3XxPs8WmJh5261wUW3YaGYeMrkTtYBrd9K1PmXnx5Ujz.jpeg)

We serve hot.

![E196DB68-7754-4389-9158-394026A70656.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ydCPfSZtgnNVNkLLEP5Se5oDheKDEbbjVTDaMPak23EoxUEJ5bw8f8BgEPKHUvFJ33N.jpeg)

This is a quick and simple soup 🍲 to turn to on a rainy day for a warm up of our body with satisfaction. Friendly and inexpensive with ingredients from our pantry.

![BA2B8043-49AA-4FEB-BBC8-A4C06A834145.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ynf7nh3DEktpUEDaQTvjKDLfw2UtVzXXh5kUK9kKbYuWbgWf22iGx8rTdwpT1KLXd1s.jpeg)

And apart from the warmth we will get from this soup 🍲, its also a one healing soup for cold 🥶, flu 😷 and bad hash weather. . Incorporate and enjoy this soup with family as the rainy days soon start to set for weather replacement. 

# Thank you for coming with me through this recipe friends. Sending hugs 🤗😍💕.

# Best Regards @sunshine29 🧡

Images are mine.

![DC72C400-9C73-40C2-AB3D-582C72F3F430.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMwo9dpnWRR6a5qCdw8UPgbcTmU3uyb1RSZx1SzchJyqsdt3XBQwAvLaRCVfYtYN4U5.jpeg)

## Espanol Version

### Un saludo muy cordial y que tengáis una feliz semana, amigos y familia vegana 😍💕. 

![0DDB92E6-88DF-47E7-B567-0C7B2AC408FA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKSeJqaDkDGi8nH5NhbyJnGBRf3Tx3sEoGdwtHMNnwpdRpeAJ19CmJxh2fAvay9.jpeg)

![24B7CA31-E362-45B8-B7E6-34D454CCE11B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zkyPHiwQSTvtALLnFDnr3zYfC1ZqHDBfmKTB3FF1bzogZ7PJeNehEZPv983YmfrFXxB.jpeg)

![650617F1-6BF1-4BD4-8E3B-8CD4290B9EE4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244AD8xJCMqMpyxSvPksVUgXQvsq8BmEvVYVPCufbFt2omCtCMAgTA4f3hVZ4Sv9ULZrp.jpeg)

Me alegro de volver a estar hoy con vosotros, y vamos a disfrutar de esta sopa sencilla, económica y sustanciosa que podemos preparar solo con ingredientes que tenemos en la despensa y que voy a compartir con vosotros. 

Esta mañana me he levantado temprano y no me apetecía solo un té ☕️, sino algo caliente y picante, porque ha llovido toda la noche y hasta esta mañana, lo que deja claro que debemos ser conscientes de que han llegado las lluvias. Con un tiempo como este, lo primero que se nos viene a la mente suele ser una sopa caliente.

Y mientras echaba un vistazo a la despensa para ver con qué ingredientes podía preparar la sopa más rápida y sencilla, me decidí por una sopa de cebolla 🧅 y patata 🥔. Una sopa reconfortante y calmante que te calienta rápidamente con su toque picante y, al mismo tiempo, te mantiene saciado durante unas horas.

![56DF74CE-8C74-427E-AEBC-710F8057CCC4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243g9K8jwt9eKXeXgDrhwtonukqFSdiGevafqywzfAgzmqrgZfBk393FKr1L4E4NexirJ.jpeg)

Créeme: esta sopa 🍲 es muy fácil de preparar, ya que no hay que triturar las patatas; por lo tanto, no lleva mucho tiempo, pero es un clásico en sí misma gracias al aroma de la cebolla.

A continuación te explico paso a paso cómo preparar esta deliciosa sopa 🍲.

# INGREDIENTES: (Una ración)

![380F2BA3-4913-4E69-A099-E7DFB2BAFD98.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uFYCruW59qdw3YcU8vGmZuneu4Zh4csunBazZpfG4MbC7uQV3UYXavRByLekjckDr4u.jpeg)

1/4 de patata grande (pelada)
1/2 cebolla roja mediana
1/4 de cucharadita de sal
1/2 cucharadita de curry
1/4 de cucharadita de tomillo
2 pimientos rojos picantes frescos

# INGREDIENTES ADICIONALES:

![FAC707AA-8470-433D-BEEE-54DD1A21257B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243M9Ni4HiF3sa2LyCe1Eb1HJ9mT8zwb8z3NsWQwYB8YmrP36JCNDsK5K5zt39EaTX6oP.jpeg)

3/4 de vaso de agua de manantial 
5 ml de aceite vegetal
1/2 cucharadita de concentrado de tomate 🍅 

# PASOS PARA LA PREPARACIÓN:

Paso 1.

![EE95A4B8-7A97-49A5-A1EA-AFF5F404001C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244oqw4to2dAaaR3eivX1G2YWGTPkjeAC9o2NqErn3gLM7GSEqgKdDmTnaGDVUrUVDYMJ.jpeg)

![94804510-0DD2-4FDE-AA9B-FC8B5F155103.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wC9M9ngiPMDFztVqN4WN5HAaMFQXQoBvgFEJcaedBKjguyRigXRPwKPhemXjrVRSq2J.jpeg)

Ahora que ya hemos pelado la patata, la pondremos en la sartén.

![D8C7E081-20A6-4083-BE87-6A1358CA51CE.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uEzR4qbExagKDLQrF13TfvmqAjWFYaHPKSaiHs5RW9w9fDP1kMJBjmfhz7hGXcvEvCG.jpeg)

![01D96BAA-7936-4898-B332-F1C70747E3EC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23w2aN4MgL3FH1FhJy75J61xiDB6PzchWVXuey6wnyHq2CuNm4afdaiNgidzEEa2kdgrX.jpeg)

A continuación, lávala y ponla en la olla para empezar a cocinarla.

Paso 2.

![4E6F3446-21EB-4777-A841-1344FA8C2A36.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242YEJRg7gQM8uv2uGd4cVVpew1Lt2vzT5k2uVahaiC3QZoHEqcVbgJ4L4RS8VJupcPmk.jpeg)

![28776C84-DD56-42A1-934E-3D4E05FC6F78.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/241tfs1R1mVEgcH53z24xViaRU4H8AABSnEPCKu3KRq3j1eYJz6TGf4Jr88LQRkG55r3E.jpeg)

![9130A8FB-5741-460D-B442-75787DCA1453.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244yGfuJS5LYJU2ykKWyjRHLyQ56BJoqLsqHa4q881SLYYdfzt4WdRBt2VsHXwQhfNHxR.jpeg)

Lavamos y cortamos las cebollas 🧅 y el chile picante sin problemas.

Paso 3.

![5E24F7BE-5CF4-48CA-81E1-3D328C7D0EF4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AL7PLmBgeu2kN3XgChfvVFEprRKcyc8nKUUPysJvEU8vgQJkXwapr2Uf3hVzbUg.jpeg)

Cuando la patata esté tierna, bajamos el fuego.

![AB00E6D5-BBEB-4065-9520-C50FCC3C2F1A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALBhebupDSQsnrjJruvDEAR84wX6SbdRZToMCiibuLgSMqKzz3YUgy19ACvHyxW.jpeg)

![0EF8C2CE-834B-4284-95C4-FD3F4F1550A8.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMYNixDKNcpZcPyizKza7smVxXWCuLpojbCnSvA1UPxJ346dQtViMxci5zExdyUgb6r.jpeg)

Escúrrelo y ponlo en un bol 🥣 para machacarlo. Como se ha indicado anteriormente. 

Paso 4.

![A4B213CF-5BF6-4848-B375-CA4179AC1B17.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vsNPCz6ehSfo9KtXfjmutfa1tjgzfBeC6VKCY3Pbi3XF7pMbbnJJpXE5XUXzU3mc9dr.jpeg)

![B8712196-73BC-4A3B-87A1-DE701AADC1E6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wC7Z31TPRTt91zhEU392HphdFsdd5zgujmcPqYL99ZSK9u2DnqCnuPMg7Cfaxkj95Rq.jpeg)

![751C6B21-F2C9-4315-9250-3ED80E3EE813.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23yTfLTi3JmdsTC6xkMMjxhYL8AqBrGcz5UN4EFe6MuWBXqwE7L3yW9VD7Se81Na8qziU.jpeg)

Una vez que esté bien triturado, lo volvemos a poner en la sartén.

![494E799D-6EA7-4F58-86A4-F8CD78B642DB.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wC9hrSuGwmadFiJg5Q4eRXL7auYe3L5BmQawX9k9VLTBsyuc1VUKN9BcQgQjTQUJaZP.jpeg)

![D2D87075-6B43-4F80-9A1D-AC06663EC676.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ydAAWBgYYATw25Rbu6SbFQyC6rBCPdHoT6j9sD9Hbjwyfn2pZgCgy12FFQtBZmpWZqA.jpeg)

Añade el agua y remueve bien hasta obtener un puré, tal y como se ha indicado anteriormente.

Paso 5.

![D5EC9513-E67B-4A75-9E01-DE9A80C17413.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vhq7tZTt8JF7b388zuAj9cKssutM1nNh5kHQ3Ls4eQRjMaxtEEdCCNUop3LSckzWTdk.jpeg)

![421E586D-0971-4FC1-80BD-94D74EC9D6C9.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23u5bfy227Fk5jahpSZf5Mh87YKnPsQMFWog2gugJvDxSebBxFqUFp4MXAq2GasV5S1xK.jpeg)

Lo volvemos a poner en el fogón y dejamos que empiece a cocerse.

![F8F600D4-5D80-4CC4-9B79-AC983B459452.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK2CmnsoWVMtLjifWhiMmjqKc81DQ3QHio9KXLSnDrbJchF57UCG3anPK4ooVv3.jpeg)

Una vez que empiece a cocerse, añadimos el pimiento fresco, la sal, el curry, el tomillo y la pasta.

![F5EFFBC0-538D-4A79-8A9E-437C16398D56.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tvCibHbCKkaZ5EUeyncV4kkACPYgVdHpuD5QFjJ9tAQSPAp4EmmsgqWiWA7rseLKSjG.jpeg)

Remueve bien para que se mezclen bien.

Paso 6.

![3E56B9C7-E314-48D5-A2D0-A9655E86CA97.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AL4Wv5PrgQqbzkGTFTjsggLito4vAvq6YrA1564x138ubP6u63E6pA8QX6awrys.jpeg)

Dejamos que empiece a espesarse y, a continuación, añadimos el aceite vegetal y la cebolla por encima. 

![3D8DB8E3-A22B-426E-B58E-7EA2130E4BED.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tvCicpVUH5cNC6Wfv4diCH6oZ7qWG23kjps4BYmXFn6YhSvRjdMBvJjr7nnnXMy6kwe.jpeg)

![9315A643-12AC-4856-9211-B3A31C5171EF.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uFH67cNRuTy4WEjNXzZ7e8enhzmTFvqk8nrdf8FUkQg7j7kemuCeeBPokK1hYtkQgHn.jpeg)

Deja que se cocine otros 2 minutos para que espese más y baja el fuego.

body.title: Phillies lose series to Braves with loss Sunday | Giants in town tonight with Jesús Luzardo pitching for the Phils
body.body:
![mlb-Philadelphia-Phillies-Logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJhXiRGysGbqrUVr31VqR8j9iJthXQeNsJRnjA5UgF2TrkK4JXLPjHUG9MUr24D.png)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/mlb/philadelphia-phillies/)

Well right after ending their losing streak the other day, the Phillies promptly lose once again, but I'm not more discouraged than I was to begin with. The Braves look good and I'm glad they got that miserable streak over with. 

Sunday was rough once again. Aaron Nola pitched poorly again and I can't really recall the last time he had a quality start, or stacked good performances together. I feel like this should be a bigger discussion amongst Phillies fans. But Aaron Nola is in a weird spot where he's a beloved player and, with now *former* Phillie pitcher Taijuan Walker pitching poorly and Jesús Luzardo pitching poorly, Nola's struggles sort of go a bit under the radar. But Walker is gone now and Wheeler is back. Nola may begin to be noticed more here if he continues this downward trend. He got through 4 2/3 innings Sunday, allowing six runs. He's now 1-3 with a 6.03 ERA and a 1.56 WHIP in 2026 after coming off the worst season of his career. Eh....

Jesús Luzardo seems equally, if not more lost than Nola. He pitches tonight and hopefully he can show improvement. He's 1-3 with a 6.92 ERA and a 1.54 WHIP. Eerily similar to Nola quite frankly. Nuts.

The season is 17% completed with May right around the corner. The boys are ten games below .500. SHEESH. They gotta do some soul searching but we all do sometimes!

The comeback will hopefully be sweet! They're back home tonight, maybe that will inspire some change. They had a day off too. Let's try to regroup and get that tenth win!

***Welcome everyone to Round 423 of the Show Me A Shadow or SMASh Contest hosted by @melinda010100. The Contest post can be found [here](https://hive.blog/hive-179017/@melinda010100/shadow-hunters-community-smash-contest-ede6fa6fa9acc). This is one of the more popular and longest running Contests in the blockchain and if you haven't heard of this yet, do check it out and perhaps join us in the fun of hunting shadows.***

Last month I took a much needed vacation and went to Manila, Philippines with my wife and grandson. We stayed in a condominium unit owned by my wife's niece. The unit is on the 26th floor of a 34-floor building located in the Bonifacio Global City. 

And right beside the building is an 18-hole golf course. It was about lunchtime when we checked in and when I looked out the window I couldn't help but stare in awe at the sprawling greens and fairways dotted with white sand traps and lined with so many trees. That was definitely a bird's eye view and it was amazing.

Suddenly, I noticed the shadows the trees were casting. As I always say, \

I immediately took out my cell phone and started taking pictures of the spectacle. I was actually looking down on the golf course which aggravated my fear of heights. The soles of my feet actually felt like it was being pricked by a thousand needles. There was this crazy tingling sensation starting from my calves to my hamstring that really made it quite difficult to calmly take pictures.  But I didn't want to waste the opportunity so despite my anxiety I fired away with my cell phone camera.

Mi amiga crismat estuvo de viaje a la ciudad de Caracas, estuvo casi tres semanas allá entre consultas y estudios médicos del hijo menor. 

Al fin regresó y está con la agenda mas llena que nunca debido a las situaciones que encontró a su regreso. 

Ayer hizo un huequito de 30 minutos casi a las diez de la noche para compartir conmigo un poquito de sus días y estos deliciosos dulces que compró para las dos. 

El flaquito nevado ella sabe que me gusta mucho y el Tronkolate es un dulce que ella probó y queria que yo lo probara también. 

Comencé comiendo el Tronkolate y grace elección debí dejarlo de último. Este dulce es realmente delicioso y el relleno no se lo niegan. Es intenso y mucho más chocolate. 

Mientras que el flaquito es más conservador y menos cobertura de chocolate. Es decir una barquilla rellena de chocolate tradicional. 

La verdad es un dulce que muy bien vale la pena degustar. 

**English Version**

My friend Crismat was on a trip to Caracas; she spent almost three weeks there for her youngest son’s medical appointments and tests. 

She’s finally back, and her schedule is busier than ever because of the situations she encountered upon her return. 

Yesterday, she squeezed in a 30-minute window around ten o’clock at night to share a little bit of her days with me and these delicious sweets she bought for the two of us. 

She knows I really like the Flaquito Nevado, and the Tronkolate is a sweet she tried and wanted me to try as well. 

I started by eating the Tronkolate, and thank goodness I saved it for last. This candy is truly delicious, and they don’t skimp on the filling. It’s rich and much more chocolatey. 

Meanwhile, the Flaquito is more traditional and has less chocolate coating. In other words, it’s a traditional chocolate-filled wafer. 

Honestly, it’s a candy that’s definitely worth trying.

title.title: ‎When Rivals Circle: The Enzo Fernández Situation Chelsea Can’t Ignore ‎
title.body:
‎There are certain headlines that don’t just feel like transfer gossip but instead they feel like a warning. News that Manchester City are monitoring Enzo Fernández as a potential summer target to possibly replace the outgoing Silva B.. Not because a deal is close, it's far from it, but because of what it represents.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmR2TgV5dP7CFw1D3uEAFKsewzRGHL5evut4sufyKV1LPT/images%2016.jpeg 

‎[source](https://www.instagram.com/p/DXeeiNhAtHL/)
‎
‎Though the interest is still at a very early stage when I came across it few days ago. City are doing what elite clubs do best, which is planning ahead, scanning the market, identifying profiles that best fit their long-term structure. And Enzo is just one of several names under consideration, with Elliot Anderson also reportedly on their radar. But let’s be honest, these two players don’t carry the same weight. One is a promising talent, while the other is already a World Cup-winning midfielder with a growing influence at Chelsea.
‎
‎And that is exactly why this story hits differently.
‎
‎From a Chelsea perspective, Enzo is not just another player in the squad. He is supposed to be a cornerstone of the rebuild and the kind of midfielder you build around, not casually lose to a direct rival. But football, especially at this level, doesn’t operate on sentiment. But it operates on timing, ambition, and sometimes, uncertainty.
‎
‎And right now, there is a bit too much uncertainty around Enzo.
‎
‎His recent situation before the dismissal of Liam Rosenior which included a short suspension following comments about his future raised eyebrows. Whether it was frustration, honesty, or just poor timing, it added fuel to speculation. Then came his remarks while on international duty with Argentina, where he openly admitted he would “like to live in Spain,” even referencing how Madrid reminds him of Buenos Aires. That’s the kind of comment fans try to ignore but that still lingering in their mind.
‎
‎Like I  said earlier that Bernardo Silva is expected to leave this summer, and Rodri still hasn’t yet committed to a new deal beyond 2027. That’s not a crisis, but it is a transition. And when City enter a transition, they don’t gamble instead they upgrade.
‎
‎That’s what makes this speculation surrounding Enzo dangerous.
‎
‎For me, this is where I start to feel more concerned . Not because Enzo is leaving tomorrow, but because this is how it begins. First, it is “monitoring.” Then it becomes “interest.” And before you know it, it’s a formal bid, and suddenly the narrative shifts from control to reaction.
‎
‎Chelsea cannot afford to be reactive anymore.
‎
‎If Enzo is actually part of the long-term vision, then the club needs to make that clear but not just in words, but in structure, stability, and ambition. Players don’t just stay because they’re told to but  they stay because they believe in where things are going.
‎
‎And that’s the real issue here. This is not just about Manchester City being interested. But it's  about whether Chelsea can create an environment strong enough that interest doesn’t matter.
‎
‎Because once rivals start circling your key players, it’s no longer just a transfer story. But it's a test of your project.
‎
‎
‎

title.title: Visiting the largest market in H-9 Islamabad
title.body: *Hello everyone. Hope everyone is doing fine. Living in a hostel, you quickly learn to find happiness in the small escapes from your daily routine. Life can start to feel repetitive, with the same schedule, the same surroundings, and the same faces every day. So,last Sunday, we decided to do something so we just took a bus and head out to explore. With no detailed plan in mind, we just wanted to go somewhere that felt alive, somewhere that showed the real, everyday side of the city. That’s how we ended up choosing the Sunday Bazaar in Islamabad H-9.*

> *What makes it even more special, especially for students like us, is how practical and useful it is. From affordable clothes and shoes to everyday essentials, accessories, and even fresh groceries, the bazaar offers everything in one place. It’s the kind of market where you can manage your needs on a budget without compromising on variety. We woke up early in morning coz it is a day market.It closes at 6pm i guess.We took our local bus.*

> *As you enter the market,you will notice i is huge market.It has three gates and it is packed with people.We entered from gate 1 and saw long rows of farmers selling their vegetables and fruits.I saw nappa cabbage there which is not easily available in local markets*

> *After exploring the vegetable section, we made our way to the clothing area and it was honestly surprising. The place was filled with racks of thrifted sweaters and coats, all available at incredibly affordable prices. It felt like a hidden treasure for students looking to stay stylish on a budget.*

> *The market was crowded with both students and locals, creating a lively and energetic atmosphere. What stood out the most was the variety. you could find items inspired by top brands like Adidas, Dior, and Gucci, all available in thrifted options. We bought some sweaters for coming winters cause they are on sale now.The market was huge.we spent alot of time in clothing section and we were so hungry at that time so we went to the food court and enjoyed some food*

> *By the time we were done exploring, we were completely exhausted, so we decided to sit in the food court and just relax for a while, chatting and gossiping. But what surprised us was that the crowd hadn’t thinned out at all. It was still just as busy and lively, as if no one was ready to leave.* [//]:# (!worldmappin 33.66507 lat 73.04200 long d3scr)

> *Then we headed toward the shoe section, but by that time we were already running late. We didn’t have enough time to properly explore, so we quickly picked up a pair of slippers for the hostel. Even in that short time, it was clear how huge the section was. I spotted options from brands like Converse, Adidas, Skechers, and many more. It made us realize that if you really want to explore the entire market, you need a lot of time. It’s not a place you can fully experience in just one visit.*

> *What truly makes this market stand out is its incredible variety. From home décor and kitchen utensils to toys and everyday essentials, you can find almost everything in one place. It feels like a complete package , a single market where all your needs, whether practical or decorative, are easily met.*

>
*As the day came to an end, we made our way back, tired but genuinely satisfied.The H-9 Sunday Bazaar is not just a place to shop , it’s a space where students can find affordable essentials, explore endless options, and experience the lively spirit of the city all at once. It’s budget-friendly, diverse, and full of surprises at every corner.
If you’re a student living away from home or simply someone looking for a unique local experience, this market is definitely worth visiting.
Anyways that's all from my side.See you soon*

title.body:
<center>


![IMAG 1 Querida Rebe.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/EouD8BGM9aMyuckZBRBW4WsMPXf7dqmT9EU9RMBT9F1H1KSzDXZAjaukcjGPRq2ufHJ.gif)


<sub>Imagen propiedad de Jesús. Tomadas con su celular XIAOMI, donada  y autorizada su uso para esta publicación, editada en Canva. 
</sub></center>

<div class=\

>
Barcelona, 25 de abril de 2026 Atención: **Universo / Rebe** Querido universo, me complace escribirte para expresarte lo agradecida que estoy contigo. Ya a la edad de sesenta hermosos años solo puedo agradecerte por todo lo que me ha pasado. Porque, a pesar de las circunstancias que he enfrentado cada día, Dios ha estado de mi mano y nunca me ha soltado. Muchas personas han pasado por mi vida, unas siguieron y otras se quedaron y lo agradezco, pues cada una de ellas me dejó alguna enseñanza y crecí emocionalmente. A todos les deseo lo mejor. Unos me apoyaron, otros no; eso también lo agradezco. Algunas veces la vida también nos colocará como instrumento para que otros se desprendan a realizar y alcanzar sus sueños. Aunque muy probablemente no lo verán así. Pero todo se lo dejé al tiempo y sé que la vida siempre se encargará de colocar las cosas en su tiempo y en el momento perfecto. Dios, creaste tu mejor versión en la tierra y fue la mujer. Desde la creación del mundo han existido mujeres hermosas, emancipadoras, echadas para adelante, y agradezco a todas las que han pasado por mi vida, y te escribo en especial por una que trajiste a esta. Una mujer espectacular; sin duda alguna, la cigüeña no se equivocó al colocarnos en el mismo hogar. Eso ya estaba escrito. A ella en especial también van dirigidas estas palabras escritas con el corazón. > Barcelona, April 25, 2026 >To: **The Universe / Rebe** >Dear Universe, I am delighted to write to you to express how grateful I am to you. Now that I am sixty years old, I can only thank you for everything that has happened to me. Because, despite the circumstances I have faced every day, God has been by my side and has never let go of me. >Many people have come into my life; some moved on, and others stayed, and I’m grateful for that, because each of them taught me something and helped me grow emotionally. I wish the best for all of them. Some supported me, others didn’t; I’m grateful for that, too. Sometimes life will also use us as a stepping stone so that others can set out to pursue and achieve their dreams. Although they will most likely not see it that way. But I’ve left it all up to time, and I know that life will always make sure to put things in their place at the perfect time. >God, you created your finest creation on earth, and that was woman. Since the creation of the world, there have been beautiful, empowering, and go-getting women, and I am grateful to all those who have come into my life. I am writing to you especially about one whom you brought into this world. >A truly remarkable woman; there’s no doubt about it—the stork made the right choice in bringing us together under the same roof. It was meant to be. These heartfelt words are especially meant for her.
![Separador Querida Rebe.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/23wgPhTFt3TQvB4vWabCPHzk9RZ7exYXUHH8TModyViadFDdrs1NffUyzQ3zkPZ4vHmBH.png)

>


Están invitados a participar y deslizar su pluma acerca de este tema tan hermoso e interesante: **\
** planteada por Encuentro de @talentos a través de nuestra bella moderadora @angelica7. \n    \nPara más información visite <a href=\

>aquí. >You are invited to participate and share your thoughts on this beautiful and interesting topic: **“The Letter”**, proposed by Encuentro de @talentos through our wonderful moderator @angelica7. >For more information, visit

>aquí.
![Separador Querida Rebe.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/23wgPhTFt3TQvB4vWabCPHzk9RZ7exYXUHH8TModyViadFDdrs1NffUyzQ3zkPZ4vHmBH.png)
![IMAG 2 Querida Rebe.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/EoiaaR5oFargQqT4YNC2UhUZP1uGWZZEQfAmMZT8xURCQ3nd2bLjGCZjE79GqFVkayj.gif) Imagen de mi propiedad tomada del álbum digital personal, publicada anteriormente, autorizado el uso de la imagen para esta publicación, editada en Canva.
![Separador Querida Rebe.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/23wgPhTFt3TQvB4vWabCPHzk9RZ7exYXUHH8TModyViadFDdrs1NffUyzQ3zkPZ4vHmBH.png)

> **Querida, Rebe**. Hermana @mafalda2018, un gusto saludarte; espero se encuentren bien, aun con las vicisitudes que están padeciendo con la problemática del agua y del servicio eléctrico. Definitivamente, el Estado Sucre es tierra de gracia. Han superado muchas tribulaciones y tengo la certeza de que Dios les tiene preparado algo bueno, próspero, especial para ustedes, y permite que puedan canalizar prontamente la solución de esos problemas que les están afectando notablemente la calidad de vida de nuestro pueblo sucrense. ¿Cómo están Silverito, Mario, Carlitos, Manuel, Faraday, las morrocoyas, las hormigas, ardillas y las iguanas? ¿Desde cuándo Manuel no hace pan salado y de jamón?. Déjame ver si te pongo a pegar nuevamente las puticas y las bellas a las once; ya no sé ni cuántas veces las he llevado para Cumaná, pero el agua allí mata a cualquiera que quisiera subsistir. Bueno, sé que será en balde porque las pobres irán a morir antes de tiempo, porque antes había algo de agua y no había tiempo. Ahora hay tiempo, pero no hay agua. ¡Una locura total! Mientras escribo, escucho a Juan Gabriel, a Enrique Iglesias, a Il Volo y a otros tantos que nos encantan. Espero que la paloma que escogí pueda depositar en tus manos esta **carta** especial para ti. ¿Quién lo iba a imaginar? Antes podía viajar hasta tres veces al mes y hasta estar contigo en tu cumpleaños y ahora se ha hecho cuesta arriba; pareciera que viviéramos en países distintos. Rebe, en la familia, el 27 de abril es un día especial por ser tu **feliz cumpleaños**; la cigüeña nos premió al traerte; no pudo haber escogido una mejor familia. Recordaba cuando mamá te cantaba el cumpleaños, y ahora canto para ti. “Estas son las mañanitas que cantaba el Rey David a las muchachitas lindas; te las canto a ti, despierta, Rebe, despierta, mira que ya amaneció, ya los pajaritos cantan, la luna ya se metió…” Wuao, estoy emocionada al escribirte estas letras, pues aunque no fue posible estar contigo físicamente, agradezco a las palomas mensajeras por hacerte llegar mi mensaje. Y por supuesto a la era virtual, la amo. Porque nos une en esos momentos importantes, tan especiales. Estate pendiente si la recibes porque te llamaré en la noche para conversar. Tengo tantas cosas que decirte, pero te adelantaré. Siempre te he dicho que eres una parte importante de mi vida, que te amo; sí que somos diferentes, algo así como el yin y el yang, pero al final las dos somos un todo. Mientras sacaba puntas, ya ni sirve, recordé que siempre que pedías permiso para salir, te serví de salvoconducto. Pero, ¿sabes? Eso al momento no lo entendemos; después, pasado el tiempo, creo que nuestros padres al final lo que querían era que creáramos un lazo de amor, amistad, apoyo inquebrantable. Y mira que ¡lo lograron! >**Dear Rebe**, >Sister @mafalda2018, it’s a pleasure to hear from you; I hope you are doing well, despite the hardships you’re facing with the water and electricity issues. Sucre State is truly a land of grace. You have overcome many trials, and I am certain that God has something good, prosperous, and special in store for you, and that He will enable you to swiftly find solutions to these problems that are significantly affecting the quality of life of our people in Sucre. >How are Silverito, Mario, Carlitos, Manuel, Faraday, the tortoises, the ants, the squirrels, and the iguanas? How long has it been since Manuel stopped making salted bread and ham bread? Let me see if I can get you to take the little ones and the beautiful ones back to Cumaná at eleven; I don’t even know how many times I’ve taken them there, but the water there would kill anyone trying to survive. Well, I know it’ll be in vain because the poor things will die before their time—before, there was some water but no time. Now there’s time, but no water. It’s total madness! >As I write this, I’m listening to Juan Gabriel, Enrique Iglesias, Il Volo, and so many others we love. I hope the dove I chose will deliver this special **letter** to you. Who would have thought? Before, I used to travel up to three times a month and even be with you on your birthday, but now it’s become so difficult; it feels like we’re living in different countries. >Rebe, in our family, April 27th is a special day because it’s your **happy birthday**; the stork blessed us by bringing you here; it couldn’t have chosen a better family. I remember when Mom used to sing “Happy Birthday” to you, and now I sing it for you. “These are the morning songs King David sang to the pretty girls; I sing them to you, wake up, Rebe, wake up, look, the sun has risen, the little birds are singing, the moon has set…” Wow, I’m so moved writing these words to you, because even though I couldn’t be with you in person, I’m grateful to the carrier pigeons for delivering my message to you. >And of course, I love the digital age. Because it brings us together during those important, special moments. Keep an eye out for it—if you get it, I’ll call you tonight to chat. I have so much to tell you, but I’ll give you a heads-up. >I’ve always told you that you’re an important part of my life, that I love you; yes, we’re different—kind of like yin and yang—but in the end, the two of us are one. While I was trimming my split ends—it’s not even useful anymore—I remembered that whenever you asked permission to go out, I served as your safe-conduct pass. But you know what? We didn’t understand that at the time; later, with the passage of time, I think what our parents ultimately wanted was for us to create a bond of love, friendship, and unwavering support. And look—they succeeded!
![Separador Querida Rebe.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/23wgPhTFt3TQvB4vWabCPHzk9RZ7exYXUHH8TModyViadFDdrs1NffUyzQ3zkPZ4vHmBH.png)

>

¿Sabes? Te tengo varios beta a lo venezolano; después te llamo para echarte los cuentos. Vi unas fotos en Facebook, las cuales me trajeron gratos recuerdos de cuando fuimos a la Colonia Tovar con mamá, la gente de Carúpano y de Maracay, ¡wuao! Qué recuerdos más hermosos, gozamos un puyero. Definitivamente, recordar es vivir.


Manita, espero que **la carta** llegue para tu **cumpleaños**, y que la paloma no desvíe su camino por las lluvias. Deseo lo pases super, y espero que los bachacos, las ardillas, Mario, las iguanas, los perros y las flores te canten Feliz Cumpleaños; es que te imagino sentada en el porche tomando un delicioso cafecito y a los árboles esparciendo esa brisa que desprenden sus hojas al pasar. Cuéntame, ¿has visto al colibrí? Debe estar grande. 

Eres hermosa, valiosa, valiente, empática, bondadosa; me encanta tu forma de ser, tu trabajo. Tienes una particular forma de escribir; cada día los posts quedan más hermosos. Recién hice pollo al curry, pero ¡qué va!, como el de mamá y el tuyo, ninguno; son demasiado deliciosos; esa sazón que heredaste de ella fue genial.  Quiero que sepas que estoy muy orgullosa de ti.

Dios permita que pueda ir pronto a Cumaná. Pero recuerda que debo atender a mis gatos; sabes que mis mascotas han sido parte importante de mi vida, de mi crecimiento emocional y espiritual. Algunas veces debemos tomar decisiones que afectarán nuestro andar, y hasta la economía, y asumo lo que fuera porque aprendí que la tranquilidad, la paz y la libertad no tendrán precio.

Hermana bella, deseo que Dios te siga bendiciendo y derramando mucha salud. Que la vida nos siga regalando buenos momentos por compartir para recordarlos cuando estemos más maduras. ¿Sabes?, le doy gracias a Dios porque estás en mi vida; nos sentaremos a la orilla de la piscina, o viajaremos por el mundo, y seguiremos brindando por la vida hermosa que hemos tenido, aun en vicisitudes, porque perfecta no ha sido, pero espectacular sí. 
 
Bueno, deja despedirme, creo que ya escribí mucho para el tiempo que nos conocemos y no olvides ponerle maíz a las gallinas. ¡Ahh!, olvidaba decirte: salió una nueva marca de café, se llama \

es bien delicioso; ¿la probaste? Cuando vaya, te llevaré, y no olvides congelarme un pedazo de torta. Me saludas a Miraida y a Mary. Por aquí ando haciendo de todo un poco; ya culminé unos cursos de Excel, todo bien y con mucha salud, gracias a Dios. Recién cayó palo de agua, y se fue la luz como por once horas. Pero, bueno, que continúe la fiesta. Me despido, recibe un fuerte abrazo tu hermana que te ama y espero verte pronto Con cariño. Doryta. >You know what? I’ve got a bunch of Venezuelan-style stories for you; I’ll call you later to tell you all about them. I saw some photos on Facebook that brought back fond memories of when we went to Colonia Tovar with Mom, the folks from Carúpano and Maracay—wow! What wonderful memories—we had such a blast. Remembering really is living. >Sweetie, I hope **the letter** arrives in time for your **birthday**, and that the pigeon doesn’t get lost in the rain. I hope you have a great time, and I hope the bachacos, the squirrels, Mario, the iguanas, the dogs, and the flowers sing “Happy Birthday” to you; I just picture you sitting on the porch sipping a delicious cup of coffee while the trees send that breeze through their leaves as they rustle. Tell me, have you seen the hummingbird? It must be big by now. >You are beautiful, valuable, brave, empathetic, and kind; I love your personality and your work. You have a unique writing style; your posts get more beautiful every day. I just made chicken curry, but forget it! It’s nothing like Mom’s or yours—they’re too delicious; that seasoning you inherited from her was amazing. I want you to know that I’m very proud of you. >God willing, I’ll be able to go to Cumaná soon. But remember that I have to take care of my cats; you know that my pets have been an important part of my life, of my emotional and spiritual growth. Sometimes we have to make decisions that will affect our journey—and even our finances—and I’ll accept whatever comes because I’ve learned that tranquility, peace, and freedom are priceless. >My beautiful sister, I hope God continues to bless you and shower you with good health. May life continue to give us good moments to share, so we can remember them when we’re older. You know what? I thank God that you’re in my life; we’ll sit by the pool, or travel the world, and we’ll keep toasting to the beautiful life we’ve had—even through its ups and downs—because it hasn’t been perfect, but it has been spectacular. >Well, let me sign off now; I think I’ve written a lot for the time we’ve known each other, and don’t forget to feed the chickens. Oh! I almost forgot to tell you: there’s a new brand of coffee out called “Blue”—it’s really delicious. Have you tried it? When I come over, I’ll bring you some, and don’t forget to freeze a slice of cake for me. >Please say hi to Miraida and Mary for me. I’ve been doing a little bit of everything around here; I’ve already finished some Excel courses, and everything’s going well—I’m in great health, thank God. We just had a downpour, and the power was out for about eleven hours. But, well, let the party continue. >I’ll sign off now. A big hug from your sister who loves you, and I hope to see you soon. >With love, >Doryta.
![IMAG 3 Querida Rebe.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/Ep7ySXrQsbgnk8WGhXG8vC7yPzbwN2p1YeLpnGidUXHTLR1PEwRvFRgsFA6swRN9nTT.gif) Imagen propiedad de Jesús. Tomadas con su celular XIAOMI, donada y autorizada su uso para esta publicación, editada en Canva.
![Separador Querida Rebe.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/23wgPhTFt3TQvB4vWabCPHzk9RZ7exYXUHH8TModyViadFDdrs1NffUyzQ3zkPZ4vHmBH.png)

> Gente bella de #Empowertalent, nunca te prives de escribirles y hacerles llegar una **carta** a esos seres que amas; diles cuán importantes han sido y todo lo que sientes por ellos. Este medio sirve para sanar y hacer felices a las personas y traerá múltiples beneficios positivos. Existirán **cartas** que han sido tan emblemáticas que las guardamos como un tesoro. Mi madre siempre escribió **cartas** a sus seres queridos, más aún en días importantes; y después se tomó el tiempo que, por cierto, no le quedaba mucho, y casi no podía escribir, y aun así las escribió; cada carta era un poema para cada persona que amó. La mía la guardé como el tesoro más valioso y cada vez que quiero sentirla muy cerquita de mí, la leo y la toco; ella está ahí a mi lado, eso trae un remanso de paz a mi corazón y le doy gracias al universo cada segundo, minuto y hora por haberla colocado en mi vida y yo en la suya. >Dear friends at #Empowertalent, never hesitate to write to and send a **letter** to the people you love; tell them how important they’ve been to you and how much you care about them. This act can heal and bring joy to others, and it will have many positive benefits. Some **letters** are so meaningful that we treasure them forever. >My mother always wrote **letters** to her loved ones, especially on important days; and later, she took the time—which, by the way, she didn’t have much of left—and even though she could barely write, she still wrote them; each letter was a poem for every person she loved. I kept hers as my most precious treasure, and every time I want to feel her very close to me, I read it and touch it; she is right there by my side, and that brings a haven of peace to my heart. I thank the universe every second, minute, and hour for having placed her in my life and me in hers.
![Separador Querida Rebe.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/23wgPhTFt3TQvB4vWabCPHzk9RZ7exYXUHH8TModyViadFDdrs1NffUyzQ3zkPZ4vHmBH.png)

Hello everyone.

title.title: Journey through the Candeglia countryside and visit the old noble villa./ Recorre la campiña de Candeglia y visita la antigua villa nobiliaria.
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSNwv54ewmhre7VKyMjLbx7StNxHu4otFL6RXiE1BfKwV/1777397283997.jpg)

Good evening, blog friends, how are you? Here I am again, taking you on one of my trips. This time we're going to Candeglia. I've already taken you here to see the town and the road that leads from Candeglia to Pistoia, but today I'm taking you with me to the countryside of this beautiful little town on the first hills of Pistoia. We took a tour of the countryside to visit a relative who recently moved into the annex of an old noble villa in the countryside. To reach her, we ventured deep into the countryside and along roads that were difficult to navigate, many of them narrow despite being two-way. Luckily, we didn't encounter any other cars, so we were able to travel without any problems. The countryside begins in the town, where you can see a few houses and the bell tower of the small church. Then, of course, you begin to enter the countryside and the roads become increasingly smaller, green, surrounded by grass and trees of various types (unfortunately, I can't recognize them all). They are truly charming roads with relaxing views of the surrounding nature.

> Buenas noches, amigos del blog, ¿cómo están? Aquí estoy de nuevo, llevándolos en uno de mis viajes. Esta vez vamos a Candeglia. Ya los llevé aquí para ver el pueblo y la carretera que va de Candeglia a Pistoia, pero hoy los llevo conmigo al campo de este hermoso pueblecito en las primeras colinas de Pistoia. Hicimos un recorrido por el campo para visitar a una pariente que se mudó recientemente al anexo de una antigua villa nobiliaria en el campo. Para llegar hasta ella, nos adentramos en el campo y por carreteras difíciles de transitar, muchas de ellas estrechas a pesar de ser de doble sentido. Por suerte, no nos encontramos con ningún otro coche, así que pudimos viajar sin problemas. El campo comienza en el pueblo, donde se pueden ver algunas casas y el campanario de la pequeña iglesia. Luego, por supuesto, uno comienza a entrar en el campo y las carreteras se vuelven cada vez más estrechas, verdes, rodeadas de hierba y árboles de varios tipos (desafortunadamente, no puedo reconocerlos todos). Son carreteras realmente encantadoras con relajantes vistas de la naturaleza circundante.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTLJdd18JnznbDmdGbJTcxCT2YL4shvDMZtof6Cz9v8i8/1777397284191.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb4beukMHoe9YveWstdNV1LnPyHW2Uc2kxtM47NZgYB5E/1777397284362.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbEsyHFS7GY79GQPvKyzfyD2S4RR2y6HUcV9JYReyaJ9G/1777397284538.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd8UdqsXZVyJ57kDfebvkj4PjN3dZDmvjTmd2F4W3a4Wp/1777397284731.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP4rpobcHNwtgLFfWcC1dFzrQnFaj2DweA8g1ND1igK97/1777397310195.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXju3AVipmjLRFsT95UNAus991Rd3JH9aC9kmtnPTPab1/1777397310394.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR9Hr5uJA13xtALYatye4qHCA2ZvMNEYb7f4dpriCQJVt/1777397310582.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY5jg8zdTHVHaJuqFe9LC37mdzaNcQU9F9CSYLrhJ92tz/1777397310725.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTmsBRqQzaLxckr9VnfuRNMSJXA7LPUyR2ZaQ6ETS8ggg/1777397310897.jpg)

The view during the journey unfolds around lush fields, even more beautiful when the sun is shining. Here, the panorama is truly typical of the Pistoia countryside, with distant farmhouses, cypress trees and hedges, olive groves and vineyards. Then we reached the road to the villa, a dirt road (luckily we have a 4x4) surrounded by a tree-lined avenue, reeds, olive trees and fields. In the distance, we could see the ancient noble villa belonging to a wealthy Pistoia family, but sadly today it has been abandoned and left to decay. Once we reached the villa, we took a walk around the area. We wanted to do a bit of urban exploration of the villa, but it was surrounded by fences and overgrown weeds, making it difficult to even get close to it. I could only take photos from a distance. It's a shame, it's a beautiful period red villa and certainly holds some hidden treasures inside! We also took a walk in the surrounding fields, it's a really beautiful area for those who love the countryside. It was a pleasant and simple day out. See you soon, blog friends! 💕

> Durante el trayecto, el paisaje se desplegaba entre campos exuberantes, aún más hermosos bajo el sol. Aquí, el panorama es verdaderamente típico de la campiña de Pistoia, con granjas a lo lejos, cipreses y setos, olivares y viñedos. Luego llegamos al camino que lleva a la villa, un camino de tierra (por suerte teníamos un 4x4) rodeado de una avenida arbolada, cañaverales, olivos y campos. A lo lejos, pudimos ver la antigua villa nobiliaria perteneciente a una rica familia de Pistoia, pero lamentablemente hoy está abandonada y en ruinas. Una vez que llegamos a la villa, dimos un paseo por los alrededores. Queríamos explorar un poco la villa, pero estaba rodeada de vallas y maleza, lo que dificultaba incluso acercarse. Solo pude tomar fotos desde lejos. Es una pena, es una hermosa villa roja de época y ¡seguro que esconde algunos tesoros en su interior! También dimos un paseo por los campos de los alrededores; es una zona realmente hermosa para los amantes del campo. Fue un día agradable y sencillo. ¡Hasta pronto, amigos del blog! 💕

title.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1885
Tuesday 28, April 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1950
Noxsoma Life Camp:  
Promos & Affirmations

![1950.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWVrD9UBiKz4J8hosks6kCCj1sCYAoWDkjF4jRL7xd1k1/1950.png)

Ubiquity
Secret City Shoutout. 
What’s new with the project. How fast time is moving. New season coming. Quick.                      
 
Today's Episode:   https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1885_full_4-28-26_1950_promos:5?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9 
Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe. 

There’s always some crazy guy at train stations in the Northeastern United States, especially in Philly. I know this because I grew up there and encountered many over many years. Also in New York, Midtown and Brooklyn. DC, but that’s an easy call, everyone’s crazy there. I’d guess Boston as well, but I don’t have much first-hand experience in Beantown. 

I’m not using “crazy” as a pejorative. There are several types of crazies that haunt train stations and track platforms. Some are frustrated. Some are burnt out. Some are legit, mentally ill, but somehow prefer to be feeding pigeons and dumpster diving than being in a shelter. Some, but fewer and fewer, are vets. And some, are hiding. I don’t know Cain from Abel at first glance, however for some reason, the vibes that generate from this vessel attracts a certain type of “crazy.” The not-so-crazy that burnt out from the system. Generally speaking a low-level government employee that just couldn’t hide between the cracks of the system, or take the bullshit anymore. 

They crawled so deep into the wabbit hole, that they couldn’t get out. Not everyone can be a whistle-blower. And not everyone can be a whistle-blower and live to tell about it. So you divest your escrow in the slush-fund the pension board holds for you. And you downsize. Downsize again. Until you eventually drop out. Most of these cats are clever enough to merge into the underground economy. Barter for pleasures. Catch the day-old bread between the back door of the bakery and the dumpster. Find safe places to nod, get fed, have a shower every now and then. They are crazy, because they know too much. Not in a, “needs to be silenced,” way. In a way that makes one paranoid, because any name on any sheet of paper will immediately be routed to “one of Them.” 

Guys like me, don’t want to meet guys like them. Because there but for the grace of god go I, your humble vagabond could be one of those paranoid, quasi-schizophrenics that needs to get “what I know” to someone who could do something about it. 

I love Malcolm's quote, “If you don’t stand for something, you’ll fall for anything.” My starship is a vessel that needs to run on high octane dilithium crystals. For the first half century of life, (maybe a little less), it was fueled with high grade bovine excrement. It’ll fly. But we wull have some trouble making the jump into hyper-space.  

I learned about the “Straw man” from one of these characters, before I ever saw, America: Freedom to Fascism, a documentary by Aaron Russo. 
One night on a crowded bus, one of these characters started listing the corrupt players in Philadelphia politics, how they got where they were, and how they were all connected. Right up to Harrisburg. 

How cannabis became illegal in America, and NATO countries. It’s not about getting’ high. It’s about cotton and paper. And that comes down to money and control. 
A lotta cats get that wake up call, and they wanna be a rooster. Cluckin’ and crowin’ and running their mouths like they got a hot stock tip. This is where Abe Lincoln comes in. “Better to remain silent and be thought a fool, than to speak and remove all doubt.” Only, some kinds of blabbering are more pernicious than others. 
Likewise, when you only have a small percentage of the info, like, you are inventory of USA, Inc., and you decide to do some radical shit. You’ll end up as one of those dudes on the subway. You might even be Nick Fuentes. I heard he was stiffed for half a mil. But I don’t know. And I know nothing else. So for your humble vagabond, who has watched Nick as many times as I’ve watched Charlie – zero. I might be painting a target on my channel. And for what? 
Anyway, most of these cats I encountered was pre-internet. They were intriguing conversations. And then they were over. The stuff Universe wanted me to know was returned, by Universe. So I learned a little bit about the straw man thing, and that led to some other levels.  But I’m not a missionary about any of this stuff. I don’t call for group action against a company or individual. I just withdraw. Products that have HFCS, off my list. Off my plate. Out of my system.  
So back to the “crazy guys.” There might be some on the train platforms, but there are a lot more scattered throughout the internet. I subscribed to a lot of the ones I still follow during the plandemic They are still digging into the “debunked” conspiracy theories that emerged in 2017, and before. The accusations, innuendos, logos, and code words. I’m like, “Okay. Let’s see what happens.” 
Nine years later, I’m like, “Okay. Let’s see what happens.” 
Well, a lot did happen, but nothing like what was “promised.” The sixteen year plan to “destroy America,” was thwarted, or so we were told, coincidentally, by the 20 16 election. title.title: Culture Wars in Your Wallet
title.body:
The Bank of England’s latest move to swap out famous faces like Winston Churchill or Alan Turing for pictures of wildlife turned out to be more controversial than you’d expect. 

It turns out this is more than just a matter of design, it's hit a certain cultural identity mood... 

And all of a sudden banknotes are a political battle ground! 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23y94G7Ei3V2pdWcZVHbpxGmzJ2U4JZyXbLyB5qRFVwfoJnrRBMQ7NRxFARATxJGgFxbt.png)

People who are upset about losing those historical figures see it as cutting away at national pride. For years, banknotes quietly doubled as little badges of honor, reminders of the thinkers, heroes, and innovators held up as \

. 

Swapping those figures out for wildlife loses all of that! 

### Or should we be celebrating nature more...? 

Supporters of the wildlife design say critics are missing the point. There are plenty of people who are concerned about species die off and protecting the wider environment. 

And there's also the fact that the 'national treasure tradition' only really started a few decades ago, so it's a total social construction. 

There's also the fact that the old consensus about who qualifies as a national icon isn’t holding together anymore. Once, everyone could rally around the same names, but these days, heroes for some are problematic for others. That’s partly down to the way we’ve started reassessing history, partly politics, partly the echo-chamber chaos of social media. Faced with disagreement, picking something as inoffensive as wildlife starts to look like a good move!

title.title: 🌌 SpacePicture of a Day: CG 30: Cometary Globules 🪐
title.body:
![CG 30: Cometary Globules](https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/image/2604/CG30Globules_Salamme_960.jpg)

***

>They're like mountain peaks, but they are forming stars. Bright-rimmed, flowing shapes gather near the center of this rich starfield toward the borders of the nautical southern constellations Puppis and Vela. Composed of interstellar gas and  dust, the grouping of light-year sized cometary globules is about 1300 light-years distant. Energetic ultraviolet light from nearby hot stars has molded the globules and ionized their bright rims. The globules also stream away from the Vela supernova remnant which may have influenced their swept-back shapes. Within them, cores of cold gas and dust are likely collapsing to form low mass stars whose formation will ultimately cause the globules to disperse. In fact, cometary globule CG 30 (upper right in the group) sports a small reddish glow inside its head, a telltale sign of energetic jets from a star in the early stages of formation.

title.title: 🏴‍☠️🔥 Bringing Luffy to Life in Adobe Illustrator 🔥🏴‍☠️/🏴‍☠️🔥 Dando Vida a Luffy en Adobe Illustrator 🔥🏴‍☠️
title.body: > **Version English:** Today I’m excited to share a digital piece from my sketchbook 🎨💻 — a **vector illustration of Luffy**, recreated by me in Adobe Illustrator ✏️⚡

> For this design, I focused on achieving a clean and dynamic look using **precise vector paths created with the Pen Tool**, carefully controlling anchor points and **Bézier curves** to define each shape smoothly 🎯📐. The linework follows a **bold outline style**, typical of anime aesthetics, helping the character stand out clearly against the background 🖤✨

> I built the illustration using **flat color fills first**, establishing the base palette 🎨. Then came the key step: **adding shadows and highlights** 🌗🔥. This is where the transformation becomes truly abysmal — the design goes from flat and simple to having depth, volume, and a much stronger visual impact 💥👀. The shadows were applied strategically to respect a consistent **light source**, enhancing the three-dimensional feel of the character 💡📊
> The pose itself emphasizes **foreshortening and perspective**, especially in the hands, giving the artwork a sense of movement and energy 💪⚡. This adds to Luffy’s bold and fearless personality 😎🔥

/>

👒 **Story Behind the Artwork:**  
In this moment, Luffy isn’t just posing… he’s challenging the world 🌍💥. Standing firm, hand extended, he’s ready to protect his crew and chase his dream of becoming King of the Pirates 🏴‍☠️✨

Every shadow represents a battle fought.  
Every line carries his determination.

And no matter how many obstacles appear… he always moves forward 🚀🔥

This piece is my tribute to courage, freedom, and never giving up 💯❤️

Let me know what you think! 💬🔥 🙌✨

* * *

**Version Español:**

Hoy quiero compartir una pieza digital de mi sketchbook 🎨💻 — una **ilustración vectorial de Luffy**, recreada por mí en Adobe Illustrator ✏️⚡

Para este diseño, me enfoqué en lograr un acabado limpio y dinámico utilizando **trazados vectoriales precisos con la herramienta pluma**, controlando cuidadosamente los puntos de ancla y las **curvas Bézier** para definir cada forma 🎯📐. El lineart sigue un estilo de **contornos marcados**, típico del anime, lo que permite que el personaje destaque claramente 🖤✨

Construí la ilustración comenzando con **colores planos**, estableciendo la base del diseño 🎨. Luego viene la parte clave: **añadir sombras y luces** 🌗🔥. Aquí es donde el cambio es abismal — el diseño pasa de verse plano a tener profundidad, volumen y mucho más impacto visual 💥👀. Las sombras fueron aplicadas respetando una **fuente de luz coherente**, lo que refuerza la sensación tridimensional 💡📊

La pose resalta el uso de **escorzo y perspectiva**, especialmente en las manos, aportando dinamismo y energía a la composición 💪⚡. Esto refleja perfectamente la personalidad valiente y decidida de Luffy 😎🔥

👒 **Historia del dibujo:**  
En este momento, Luffy no solo está posando… está desafiando al mundo 🌍💥. Con su mano al frente, está listo para proteger a su tripulación y seguir su sueño de convertirse en el Rey de los Piratas 🏴‍☠️✨

Cada sombra representa una batalla.  
Cada línea transmite determinación.

Y sin importar los obstáculos… siempre sigue adelante 🚀🔥

Esta obra es un homenaje al coraje, la libertad y la perseverancia 💯❤️

¡Déjame tu opinión! 💬🔥 🙌✨

No hay mejor forma de aprovechar las mañanas de vacaciones que conectando con el asfalto y la naturaleza. Hoy el cuerpo amaneció con el eco del fondo del domingo; sentía esa pesadez característica en las piernas que te invita a tomártelo con calma. La meta inicial era simplemente caminar para aflojar los músculos, pero el running tiene una magia especial: llega un punto en que el mismo cuerpo, casi por instinto, te pide trotar.
​Con la media maratón asomándose en el calendario, la clave es la constancia sin caer en la sobrecarga. Empecé con un ritmo muy suave, escuchando cada zancada. A medida que avanzaba, los músculos fueron despertando y me permitieron aumentar la intensidad de manera progresiva, pero siempre manteniendo el control. Fueron 5 km de trote consciente, seguidos de un par de vueltas caminando para terminar de soltar.
​Lo mejor de entrenar en el parque es el entorno. Perderse entre las sombras de los árboles y el sonido de la naturaleza es la terapia perfecta. No importa cuántas preocupaciones traigas en la cabeza al llegar; después de un par de vueltas, sales con una mentalidad renovada y el espíritu ligero. Cumplimos con los kilómetros, cuidamos las piernas y, sobre todo, despejamos la mente. ¡Seguimos sumando!

title.title: Alberta Referendum 2026. 9 questions for our future.
title.body:
>

  It wasn't a good Sunday night for Alberta. We woke up on Monday with a hangover after the Edmonton Oilers' loss to the Anaheim Ducks in the NHL Playoffs. It was a painful loss, since they were winning during most of the game, and the Ducks tied only at the end of the 3rd period. The loss came in the second minute of overtime.

  Now the Oilers need to win the next 3 games, since the series right now is 3x1 for the Ducks. After waking up with this feeling, the Premier of the province announced the website with the 9 questions that will be asked to the population on October 19th. How are these questions going to change our lives?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23u62sr1th3Z5CYuSrFBXNbEtj46hT6Qr5Mr8urSi7hUF1NmKJb7UwY5wUeYX37ZuNUBR.png)

> The official banner of the referendum's website [Screenshot from the albertareferendum website]

  In reality, Danielle Smith wanted to propose just one question: should Alberta separate from the rest of Canada? But even if she can’t admit it, she knows that the “No” would win, and she and her supporters would probably need to cry in a corner, blaming the Liberals, as they always do.

  Instead, they created 9 questions: 5 about immigrants' rights and provincial benefits, and 4 to see if they can gain more independence from the federal government. And as a friend said, they made long questions that you need to read twice or more to understand what they actually mean. You can find them on the recently released website: https://albertareferendum2026.ca/

  I agree with some criticism against the Liberal mandate that has been in place for a while now—some things went wrong. Usually, left parties can sometimes be too extreme in social policies, and in the end, these policies can hurt a country.

   I am an immigrant, and I am thankful that Canada allowed me to enter and build my new home here. But for a while, it was too easy to enter the country. Canada became known internationally as an easy place to immigrate to, with the false promise of well-paid jobs available for everyone. The reality isn’t like that.

 

  Canada received 218,000 refugees between 2016 and 2021 (

> statscan information ). That’s a lot, and the government is paying for everything for these people, including rent.

  The 5 immigration-related questions are more direct, and some of them can be considered fair to ask.  

  The first is about Alberta taking control of immigration decisions in the province. The second is whether only permanent residents and citizens can access public services like health and education. The third is that only people living in Alberta for at least 12 months can access social programs.

 

  The fourth is that temporary residents (those with work or study permits) would pay a fee to access health and education. And the fifth is about requiring proof of citizenship to vote.

 

  This last one is the one I agree with the most, since you are required to be Canadian to vote in elections, but nowhere do they ask for proof. Usually, on voting day, we just go there and say that we are Canadians. It is a very fragile system based on trust—but humans are humans, right?

  The called constitutional questions are trickier, and it makes more about the hidden agenda of the premier to try to get more powers.

 

  Question 6 is about the province gaining independence to choose provincial superior court judges instead of the federal government. Question 7 is about abolishing the federal Senate. The Senate is composed of appointed politicians, which is not ideal, but the House of Commons is the one with more power and is made up of elected politicians. The Senate is more of a review body, and this question reflects the old argument that Alberta’s opinions aren’t represented by the federal government.

 

  Question 8 is about provinces opting out of federal public healthcare programs while keeping the money to run their own version. That is the trickiest one since they want to keep federal funding but do what they want, which likely means increasing private influence in public health.

 

  The last question is about provincial laws overriding federal laws. This is probably the biggest one and would give Alberta more power to act independently from Canada or other provinces.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/EouA7sEkn5A13qWsaHrWGm2eR7itxzyvGUqeEPgy42snyrMVWstP8cdySagRPm3qFRo.png)

>Not a very pleasant voting we will have on October. [Free-for-use in Unshplash]

  Probably all the constitutional questions, even if “Yes” wins, will face serious obstacles unless other provinces also support these ideas. The immigration ones are more doable, but even those could be challenged in the Supreme Court.

  In the end, this referendum is a summary of the current provincial government’s agenda, which still isn’t focused on improving healthcare and education, and instead prefers to spend time and money fighting with the federal government. I just hope that the Oilers win tonight so they can still have a chance in the playoffs.

[![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23wMS5Mk5RaoA6EdKv35TPtYzT2oppCtUWD6qwC5GUBMb877AgJ5rGzJeoTew2bGQJQWZ.png)](https://vote.hive.uno/@gwajnberg)
Banner created in canva

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23u5tR8RSXuZFgpjQ6Eiqz8JMMjig1nLZFvxM1sFhvNmiGYA2snkPD7Z4TnmFxxRyih87.png)

  Não foi uma boa noite de domingo para Alberta. Acordamos na segunda-feira com ressaca após a derrota do Edmonton Oilers para o Anaheim Ducks nos playoffs da NHL. Foi uma derrota dolorosa, já que eles estiveram vencendo durante a maior parte do jogo, e os Ducks só empataram no final do terceiro período. A derrota veio no segundo minuto da prorrogação.

  Agora os Oilers precisam vencer os próximos 3 jogos, já que a série está 3 a 1 para os Ducks. Depois de acordar com esse sentimento, o primeiro-ministro da província anunciou o site com as 9 perguntas que serão feitas à população em 19 de outubro. Como essas perguntas vão mudar nossas vidas?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23u62sr1th3Z5CYuSrFBXNbEtj46hT6Qr5Mr8urSi7hUF1NmKJb7UwY5wUeYX37ZuNUBR.png)

> O banner oficial do site do referendo [Captura de tela do site do referendo de Alberta]

  Na realidade, Danielle Smith queria propor apenas uma pergunta: Alberta deveria se separar do resto do Canadá? Mas mesmo que ela não admita, sabe que o \

venceria, e ela e seus apoiadores provavelmente teriam que chorar num canto, culpando os liberais, como sempre fazem.

  Em vez disso, criaram 9 perguntas: 5 sobre os direitos dos imigrantes e benefícios provinciais, e 4 para ver se conseguem mais independência do governo federal. E, como disse um amigo, fizeram perguntas longas que é preciso ler duas vezes ou mais para entender o que realmente significam. Você pode encontrá-las no site recém-lançado: https://albertareferendum2026.ca/

 Concordo com algumas críticas ao mandato liberal que já dura algum tempo — algumas coisas deram errado. Normalmente, os partidos de esquerda podem ser extremistas demais em políticas sociais e, no fim, essas políticas podem prejudicar o país.

 Sou imigrante e sou grato pelo Canadá ter me permitido entrar e construir meu novo lar aqui. Mas, por um tempo, foi fácil demais entrar no país. O Canadá ficou conhecido internacionalmente como um lugar fácil para imigrar, com a falsa promessa de empregos bem remunerados disponíveis para todos. A realidade não é essa.

 O Canadá recebeu 218.000 refugiados entre 2016 e 2021 (informações do Statscan). É muita gente, e o governo está pagando por tudo para essas pessoas, inclusive o aluguel.

  As 5 perguntas relacionadas à imigração são mais diretas, e algumas delas podem ser consideradas justas.

  A primeira questão diz respeito a Alberta assumir o controle das decisões de imigração na província. A segunda é se apenas residentes permanentes e cidadãos podem acessar serviços públicos como saúde e educação. A terceira é que apenas pessoas que residem em Alberta por pelo menos 12 meses podem acessar programas sociais.

  A quarta é que residentes temporários (aqueles com permissões de trabalho ou estudo) pagariam uma taxa para acessar serviços de saúde e educação. E a quinta é sobre a exigência de comprovante de cidadania para votar.

  Esta última é a que eu mais concordo, já que é preciso ser canadense para votar nas eleições, mas em nenhum lugar pedem comprovante. Normalmente, no dia da votação, simplesmente vamos lá e dizemos que somos canadenses. É um sistema muito frágil baseado na confiança — mas humanos são humanos, certo?

 As chamadas questões constitucionais são mais complexas e revelam mais sobre a agenda oculta do primeiro-ministro para tentar obter mais poder.

 A questão 6 trata da independência da província para escolher juízes do tribunal superior provincial em vez do governo federal. A questão 7 trata da abolição do Senado federal. O Senado é composto por políticos nomeados, o que não é o ideal, mas a Câmara dos Comuns é a que tem mais poder e é composta por políticos eleitos. O Senado funciona mais como um órgão de revisão, e esta questão reflete o antigo argumento de que as opiniões de Alberta não são representadas pelo governo federal.

 A questão 8 trata da opção das províncias de não participarem dos programas federais de saúde pública, mantendo o financiamento para administrar suas próprias versões. Essa é a mais complexa — elas querem manter o financiamento federal, mas fazer o que bem entenderem, o que provavelmente significa aumentar a influência privada na saúde pública.

  A última questão é sobre as leis provinciais prevalecerem sobre as leis federais. Esta é provavelmente a mais importante e daria a Alberta mais poder para agir independentemente do Canadá ou de outras províncias.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/EouA7sEkn5A13qWsaHrWGm2eR7itxzyvGUqeEPgy42snyrMVWstP8cdySagRPm3qFRo.png)

>Não teremos uma votação muito agradável em outubro. [Uso livre no Unshplash]

 Provavelmente todas as questões constitucionais, mesmo que o \

vença, enfrentarão sérios obstáculos, a menos que outras províncias também apoiem essas ideias. As questões de imigração são mais viáveis, mas mesmo essas podem ser contestadas na Suprema Corte.

 No fim das contas, este referendo é um resumo da agenda do atual governo provincial, que ainda não está focado em melhorar a saúde e a educação, e em vez disso prefere gastar tempo e dinheiro brigando com o governo federal. Só espero que os Oilers vençam hoje à noite para que ainda tenham uma chance nos playoffs.

title.title: RESTRATEGIZING MY QUIET TIME
title.body:
Hello everyone, you're welcome to my blog today.

At what point in life do we sit back, relax, and go through our decisions to assess our achievements?We all are different; we take life in different ways. But anyhow, we need to deal with the problem of the loads of work and everything. It's all about how you handle the pressure and everything. Many people find ways to relieve their stress, either by doing meditation or finding something that helps them distract easily. We all need a break from our constant thoughts that make us feel more pressured.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZskSP6SCtPndtSw4K6gfsPgrYbro5SFCj6JUk7caH7Tj/166726.png 


Life is a never-ending circle that continues on and on. Men and women work round the clock to keep body and soul together, to meet the standards of the economy and to live up to their expectations. Responsible leaders take care of their families and stand out in society. There's never a particular time stipulated for one to sit down and think about life in general, to review their decisions—career-wise, family, marriage, and all around.

Self-evaluation or personal assessment is very vital in the life of every man or woman who is looking to succeed in the future. This is the point where you can sit down and go over the decisions you have made regarding your life, your business, your career, your family, and your social life. Here are things to consider while doing a self-evaluation:

Restrategizing your goals: Go through the goals that you set for yourself in the past to ensure you have achieved most of them, especially certain SMART goals that are achievable.

Focusing more on decisions than matters: Work based on needs and not wants, ensuring that you do only things that are important and not just those that are wants.

Assessing personal growth: Look out for how you have developed yourself—what areas need enhancement, what you are lacking, and where you should put in more effort.

Self-appraisal: Review your achievements and reward yourself for little wins. This encourages you to work harder next time to achieve more.

It is very important to always find time to sit back, relax, and review our achievements. This helps us balance equations and make better decisions in life.

People may not say it out loud, but deep down, they are afraid of silence. And I am not talking about the usual late-night silence or when the environment is quiet. I mean the deeper kind of silence—the silence when someone purposely decides to lock in and hear their own thoughts out loud, like when you can hear the ticking of a clock. 

At some point, I ran away from this too. All my free moments used to be filled with one distraction or another—from music to scrolling, watching movies, chatting, or anything that could distract me. But when I looked at the past, my realization was that I was running. Not from anything external in particular, but from what was sitting quietly inside me.



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUqSFGSYKrFWToyPiNfaqKPTAB4kowigwwmsodaQYjA4a/166712.png 




My quiet time isn’t occasional but a daily routine. It's a consistent practice. It’s a moment I deliberately and intentionally set aside to study and meditate on something important and necessary for me—the Word of God. Doing this has become a rhythm in my life, something I always love to return to, no matter how busy life gets.

Thank you for stopping by my blog.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@betheloji12/restrategizing-my-quiet-time-x3)
