body.title: Suomalainen Maksukulttuuri Sopii Nettikasinoiden Maksutavoiksi
body.body:
## Johdanto: Suomalainen Maksukulttuuri Ja Nettikasinoiden Maksutavat

Suomalaiset ovat tottuneet hoitamaan raha-asiansa nopeasti ja vaivattomasti verkkopankkien kautta, mikä sopii kuin nenä päähän nettikasinoiden maksutapoihin. Täällä ei jakseta odotella, ja siksi esimerkiksi Trustly on niin suosittu – rahansiirrot hoituu sekunneissa ilman turhia välikäsiä.

Myös kotimaiset palvelut kuten Euteller ja Trumo ovat nousseet vahvaksi vaihtoehdoksi, tarjoten suoraa pankkitunnuksilla maksamista ilman rekisteröitymistä. Näitä käyttämällä kasinoiden pay'n'play-malli toimii sujuvasti, eikä kukaan halua näprätä pitkiä lomakkeita tai lähettää dokumentteja.

Suomalaiseen maksukulttuuriin kuuluvat siis nopeat ja turvalliset maksutavat, joissa verkkopankit ja mobiilimaksut ovat ykkösjuttu. Tämä näkyy myös nettikasinoiden valikoimassa, kun Trustlyn ja muiden suomalaisten suosikkien tuki on selkeästi kärjessä.

## Suomalaiset Pankkikäytännöt Ja Verkkopankkimaksujen Merkitys

Suomalaisten pankkien digitalisaatio on edennyt niin pitkälle, että verkkopankkia käyttää käytännössä jokainen täysi-ikäinen. Tämä tarkoittaa, että myös nettikasinoissa verkkopankkimaksut ovat täysin luonnollinen tapa pelata ja tehdä talletuksia.

Markkinoilla pohditaan, mikä maksutapa on nopein ja luotettavin, ja selkeästi yli 50 % suomalaispelaajista hoitaa rahansiirtonsa Trustlyn kautta. Euteller seuraa perässä noin 20 prosentin osuudella, ja kotimaiset uudemmat palvelut kuten Trumo kasvattavat suosiotaan.

Verkkopankkimaksut ovat jääneet pysyväksi osaksi suomalaisten arkea, eivätkä vain nettikasinoilla vaan muussa verkko-ostamisessa. Tämä näkyy myös kasinoiden integroinneissa, joissa API-pohjaiset ratkaisut takaavat nopean ja turvallisen maksukokemuksen.

## Suomen Rahapelilainsäädäntö Ja Sen Vaikutus Maksutapoihin Nettikasinoilla

Suomen rahapelilainsäädäntö ei estä ulkomaisia nettikasinoita ottamasta suomalaisia pelaajia, mutta maksutapoihin vaikuttavat EU:n ja kansallisten viranomaisten vaatimukset. Finanssivalvonta eli Fiva valvoo, että verkkomaksut ovat turvallisia, ja PSD2-direktiivin myötä vaaditaan vahvaa tunnistautumista eli SCA:ta.

Nettikasinoiden tulee noudattaa esimerkiksi 3D Secure -varmennusta ja rekisteröintivapailla kasinoilla on pakko varmistaa rahaliikenteen turvallisuus. Siksi Trustlyn ja muiden saman tason maksupalvelujen käyttö on kasinoille oikeastaan pakollista, jos haluavat palvella suomalaisia pelaajia.

Rahapelilainsäädäntö siis lisää maksuturvallisuutta, mutta se tarkoittaa myös, että maksut voivat toisinaan jumiutua varmennusvaiheessa – älä odota Veikkauksen hidasta junaa, mutta joskus viiveitäkin tulee. Tästä syystä kannattaa suosia kasinoita, jotka toteuttavat maksut sujuvasti, ilman turhia viiveitä.

Jos haluat pelata kasinoilla, joissa maksut kulkee nopeasti ja turvallisesti, kannattaa kurkata myös [uudet siirto kasinot suomessa](https://siirto-kasinot-fi.com/), missä nämä asiat ovat kunnossa.

## Trustly ja muut suomalaiset nettikasinoiden suosimat maksupalvelut – vertailua

Miksi juuri Trustly on noussut suomalaisten nettikasinoiden maksupalveluiden kärkikaartiin? No, se toimii kuin junan vessa: nopea ja helppo käyttää ilman ylimääräistä säätöä.

Euteller ja Zimpler taas ovat ne pikkuvalssit, joiden kanssa välillä vähän pyörii jaloissa – hyviä omissa oloissaan, mutta ei ihan yhtä sulavia kuin Trustly.

Trustlyn valtti on sen välitön talletus ja kotiutus, suomalaisten pankkitunnusten kaverina. Euteller vie aikaa minuutteja enemmän, ja Zimpler on kiva mobiililla, mutta rajoittaa usein talletussummia.

Trustly on käytännössä se ykkönen suomalaispelaajien keskuudessa. Sen kautta talletukset tapahtuvat välittömästi, kotiutukset napsahtavat nopeasti tilille, eivätkä kulut kiristä liikaa.

Euteller ja Zimpler toimivat hyvin, kun ei kiire ole ja haluaa pelata mobiilisti, mutta molemmilla on omat nytkähdyksensä – Zimplerin pienet talletusrajat ärsyttävät joitain.

### Plussat ja miinukset pelaajilta

*   Trustly: + Nopea ja luotettava, – Pieni maksu per tapahtuma.

*   Euteller: + Hyvä laaja pankkituki, – Käsittelyajat pidemmät.

*   Zimpler: + Helppo mobiilissa, – Rajoitetut talletussummat, kalliimmat kulut.

## Nopeiden Trustly-kotiutusten merkitys suomalaisille pelaajille

Miksi nopeus on suomalaisille pelaajille niin tärkeää? Koska kukaan ei tykkää odotella, että voitot maksetaan – varsinkin, jos ne ovat kuntoputkessa olleet pelitappioiden jälkeen se piristys.

Trustlyn kautta tehdyt kotiutukset ovat pääsääntöisesti nopeita ja luotettavia. Se nakkaa rahat tililleen usein minuuteissa, mikä on kuin saisi mietoa kaljaa olkapäälle pitkän työpäivän jälkeen.

Asiakaspalautteet ovat selvät: nopea kotiutus vaikuttaa vahvasti siihen, millä kasinolla pelaaja pysyy ja missä pelaaminen tökkii.

## Suomalainen maksukulttuuri vs. kansainväliset maksutavat ja lisenssit

Suomalainen maksukulttuuri nojaa sujuvaan verkkopankkiin ja suoraan, selkeään rahansiirtoon. Se natsaa hyvin EU-kasinoiden, kuten MGA- ja Viron lisenssien, tarjoamiin verovapaisiin voittoihin.

Kansainvälisillä kasinoilla suomalainen maksutapa näyttää usein kulurakenteeltaan ja toimivuudeltaan puhtaan kotimaiselta bussireitiltä verrattuna rundille ympäri Euroopan.

MGA- ja Viron lisenssit ovat Suomen pelaajille varmoja vaihtoehtoja, joissa suomalaiset suosikkimaksut tukevat reilua pelitunnelmaa. Kulut pysyvät maltillisina, usein alle kympin spekseissä.

## Käyttäjäkokemus ja suomenkielinen asiakaspalvelu maksutavoissa

Aina kun maksuprosessiin tulee ongelmia, suomenkielinen asiakaspalvelu on se pelastusrenka, johon tarttua. Pelaajien arvostus nousee, kun saa jutella omalla kielellä eikä tarvitse stressata käheällä englannilla.

Suomalaiset pelaajat haluavat, että asiakastuki vastaa nopeasti, osaa hommansa ja kohdellessaan samalla kuin vanhaa kaveria. Maksuihin liittyvissä pulmissa tämä on kultaakin kallisarvoisempaa.

Kun asiakaspalvelu on kunnossa, myös pienet maksatukseen liittyvät ongelmat ratkeavat ilman, että pääsee tulemaan turha pakokauhu.

*   Nopea ja ystävällinen palvelu

*   Tarkka tiedonanto maksuprosesseista

*   Ongelmatilanteiden nopea hoito

*   Suomi, suomi, ja vielä kerran suomi

## Teknologiset innovaatiot maksutavoissa ja niiden integraatio nettikasinoilla

Miksi maksut hoituu usein niin hitaasti tai ei ollenkaan, kun talletat nettikasinolle? Mä oon käynyt läpi sen kaiken teknisen puolen, ja sanon suoraan: API-integraatiot on pelin henki nykyään. Ne mahdollistavat sen, että raha liikkuu kasinolle salamannopeasti ilman ylimääräisiä välivaiheita.

Suomalaiset kasinot ovat ottaneet verkkopankkimaksuissa, kuten Trustlyllä ja Trumolla, API-tekniikan tosissaan käyttöön. Se tarkoittaa, että talletukset ja kotiutukset tapahtuu lähes reaaliajassa, ja pelaajan ei tarvitse turhaan odotella.

Mobiilimaksut puolestaan on tänä päivänä massiivisessa kasvussa. Suomalaiset haluaa skarpin ja helpon tavan tehdä talletuksia puhelimella – ja siinä Zimpler, Trumo ja muut vastaavat nykäisee reilusti vertaa eteenpäin. Mobiilin ja API:n yhteispeli pitää huolen, että maksut toimii mutkitta myös pienistä kosketuksista.

Turvallisuudesta ei voi tinkiä. PCI DSS -sertifiointi on käytännössä takuu siitä, että maksutapahtumat on suojattu kuin Fort Knox. Samoin SCA-vaatimukset (Strong Customer Authentication) putoaa pakollisina EU:n lainsäädännöstä päälle. Pelaajana saat biometriset tunnistukset ja kaksivaiheiset varmennukset, eikä kukaan pääse väijymään tietojasi.

Mobiilissa homma pyörii sujuvasti, ja moni kasino on osannut skarpata tekemällä maksuprosessista intuitiivisen. Silti, varo niitä kasinoita, jotka ei ole kunnolla pistänyt API-hommia kuntoon, koska se näkyy kotiutusten vitkutteluna ja bonusten jumittamisena.

Jos olet suomalainen, kannattaa ehdottomasti katsoa kasinoiden taustat, että ne käyttää näitä moderneja teknologioita. Mä oon testannut myös vanhemmat kasinot, ne toimii kuin VR:n junat: hitaita ja epävarmoja. Nopeus ja turvallisuus pitää olla kärjessä, muuten koko homma toimii yhtä jäykkänä kuin talvinen liikenne ruuhkassa.

## Bonusehdot ja piilotekijät maksutavoissa – mitä suomalaisen kannattaa tietää?

Maksutavan valinta vaikuttaa bonuksiin enemmän kuin moni arvaa. Kyllä, se saattaa mennä ihan niin, että valitsemalla väärän maksutavan, bonarit jää lunastamatta tai kierrätysvaatimus nousee pilviin.

Otetaan tylsä esimerkki: talletat Visalla, mutta kasino pudottaa bonuksen arvosta puolet kierrätysvaatimusta. Trustlyllä taas homma menee kuten kuuluukin: bonukset aktivoituu heti, ja kierrätysvaatimus pysyy järkevänä.

Bonusehdot on usein piilossa pienellä präntillä, joten pelaajana pitää olla tarkkana. Jos kasinolla on esimerkiksi tarjolla talletusbonus, varmista, että talletusmaksu ei rajoita sen saamista.

*   Vältä maksutavat, joilla bonuksen saaminen on ehdollista.

*   Salaiset kierrätysvaatimusten nostot ovat kiellettyjä.

*   Isoimmat bonukset yleensä maksetaan verkkopankkimaksuilla, Trustlylla tai Trumolla.

*   Mobiilimaksuissa voi olla pienemmät maksimit ja rajoitukset, joten älä oleta niiden olevan aina paras valinta.

Jos haluat varman päälle, napata bonuksen käteen ja päästä kierrätysilmiöistä, panosta kasinoihin, jotka tarjoavat bonuksia nimenomaan verkkopankkitalletuksille. Mä oon nähnyt liikaa pelaajia, jotka valittaa ettei bonus kelpaa kortilla tehdyn talletuksen takia.

Kysynkin tässä sulle: tiedätkö oikeasti paljonko saat käteen bonuksesta ja miten maksutapasi vaikuttaa siihen? Jos et, niin kerro mun kokemusten perusteella: kannattaa aina tsekata bonuksen sääntöjen pieni teksti ja maksutapojen vaikutukset.

## VPN-käytön vaikutus maksutapoihin suomalaisilla kasinoilla

VPN näyttää monesta pelaajasta houkuttelevalta keinolta kiertää maantieteellisiä rajoitteita tai suojata yksityisyys, mutta se ei aina pelaa maksujen kanssa nätisti.

Kun pelaat VPN:n kanssa, kasinon järjestelmät saattaa nähdä maksuyrityksen epäilyttävänä sen vuoksi, että IP-osoite pomppii paikasta toiseen. Tämä tuntuu maksujen hyväksymisessä viivästyksinä tai jopa hylkäyksinä.

VPN voi hyödyttää siinä mielessä, että pääset käsiksi kasinoihin, jotka ovat blokanneet Suomen IP:t – mutta samalla se voi aiheuttaa ongelmia esimerkiksi pankkitunnuksilla maksaessa, jotka vaativat vakaata yhteyttä ja turvattua tunnistautumista.

Yleinen varoitus: Älä kokeile suorittaa suuria talletuksia tai kotiutuksia VPN:n takaa ilman, että olet varma kasinon käytännöistä. Ne saattavat flagata tilisi, jolloin rahat jää jumiin kuin joulukuun VR-junissa lumimyrskyssä.

VPN:llä pelaaminen kannattaa tehdä harkiten, eikä sen pitäisi koskaan olla keino hidastaa kotiutuksia tai aiheuttaa ylimääräisiä riskejä maksutavoille.

## Korkean volatiliteetin kolikkopelit ja maksutapojen valinta

Korkean volatiliteetin sloteissa pelaaja jaksaa odottaa isoja voittoja, mutta silloin pelikassan hallinta on kriittistä. Maksutapojen nopeudella on iso merkitys, koska pelikassasta pitää saada tarvittaessa siirrettyjä varoja hetkessä kasinolle tai kotiutettua voitoista säikähtämättä.

Esimerkiksi Trustlyn ja Trumon verkkopankkimaksut hoitaa talletukset ja kotiutukset sekunneissa. Tämä tekee niiden kanssa pelaamisesta sujuvaa – et joudu odottelemaan seuraavaa kierrosta epätietoisuudessa.

Toisaalta korttimaksut ja mobiilimaksut voivat viedä tunteja, mikä on \*täydellinen\* resepti hermojen kiristymiseen, jos peli käy kuumana.

Jos veikkaat korkean volatiliteetin koneisiin, ota nää asiat huomioon:

*   Nopeat kotiutukset pitävät hermot kurissa, älä valitse hidasta maksutapaa.

*   Luotettavuus on a ja o – älä ota riskiä, että maksut jumittuu pelin kuumimmalla hetkellä.

*   Verkkopankit voittaa tässä, koska ne on suoraan pinnoissa käsissäsi.

Mä oon nähnyt miten pelaajien pelikassojen hallinta pettää, kun kotiutukset venyy tai rahat on lukossa. Se on kuin kaaduisit sukeltamassa ilman happilaitetta - turhauttavaa ja vaarallista.

## Yhteenveto: Miksi suomalainen maksukulttuuri sopii nettikasinoiden maksutavoiksi?

Suomalaiset rakastaa nopeita verkkopankkimaksuja, joissa Trustly ja kotimaiset vaihtoehdot kuten Trumo pelaa pääroolia. Nämä sopii kuin nenä päähän nettikasinoiden pay'n'play-kokemukseen, jossa rekisteröintivapaa ja nopeat kotiutukset on normi.

Turvallisuus on samalla tasolla kuin suomalaisessa verkkopankissa, eli hommat eivät notkahda. PCI DSS, SCA ja muut vaatimukset varmistaa, että et joudu kusetuksen kohteeksi.

Mä suosittelen jokaista suomalaispelaajaa panostamaan maksutapoihin, jotka ovat selkeitä, nopeita ja tukevat bonuksia oikeasti. Trustly ja Trumo on tällä hetkellä suomalaisille kaikkein paras combo, josta ei kannata tinkiä.

Jos Veikkaus vituttaa ja haluat oikeasti pelata ilman helv\*\*tin viivästyksiä, nappaa maksutapa tästä paketista. Älä jää junaan, joka junnaa paikoillaan – tilaa nopea ja luotettava maksutapa, jolla homma hoituu niin talletuksissa kuin kotiutuksissa.

body.title: 🐜 From 5 Workers to 500 – My Messor barbarus Colony After 9 Months
body.body:
## 🐜 From 5 Workers to 500 – My Messor barbarus Colony After 9 Months

From just a handful of ants to a fully active colony of around 500 — this is how my Messor barbarus developed over the past 9 months.

<center>
![20260426_134338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ant.runner/Ep5oDW5Ws8no8gD3a8GghmdpX2anNMvb31qmHw8xnQSu3Kn4NSZtnw7ujzDJydQaFNM.jpg)
</center>

---

### 🔬 About the species

<center>
![20260426_134515.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ant.runner/EonkzfH8SpjHyTnuAGfYpKnmmHDrFkSqnrhPoMdmiDZAuR787GuKCZ56a12uZFoYeed.jpg)
</center>

**Messor barbarus** is a widely distributed ant species from Southern Europe and one of the most popular species in antkeeping.

They belong to the subfamily **Myrmicinae** and are specialized in collecting and processing seeds.

What makes them especially interesting:

* they collect and store large amounts of seeds
* they produce so-called “ant bread”
* they show a highly structured colony organization

Workers are strongly polymorphic:

* smaller workers take care of the brood
* larger workers (majors) process seeds and help defend the colony

The queen reaches about **15–18 mm** and can live up to **25 years** under good conditions.
Colonies can grow to several thousand individuals.

---

### 🌍 Natural habitat

<center>
![20260426_134403.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ant.runner/EoyR1q5rZ8HwM4n7RXdek5ET251KsaQ69Q8xTJywrvEyvsnaKFqRFGBYaKvPgwDC3zC.jpg)
</center>

In the wild, this species is mainly found in:

* Southern Europe
* North Africa
* parts of Asia

They prefer:

* dry, sandy environments
* steppe-like landscapes

Their nests are usually built deep underground and consist of clearly separated areas for:

* brood
* seed storage
* waste

---

### 🌡️ Keeping conditions

This species does not require extreme conditions.

* **Arena temperature:** ~25–30°C (optimal), but room temperature can work
* **Nest temperature:** ~21°C is already sufficient

Once the colony reaches a certain size (around 100+ workers), it can often develop well even at **room temperature**, which is why many keepers do not use additional heating.

Humidity should generally be kept low, with only slightly moist areas inside the nest.

👉 Instead of molding, stored seeds will usually start to **germinate** if humidity is too high.

---

### 🌱 Feeding

<center>
![20260426_134431.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ant.runner/23wqkAxfkjEYy2mx76KuDiDM28S7fFoSTE9oHga25Up7MLQF8AtMKW3xE2e6xJjuCPzaR.jpg)
</center>

**Messor barbarus** is mainly granivorous.

Their diet consists of:

* seeds (main food source)
* occasional insects as a protein source

Additional sugar sources are usually only taken when needed.

A big advantage of this species:
👉 With enough seeds and a reliable water source, the colony can easily sustain itself for longer periods (e.g. during vacations).

---

### 💧 Water & safety

Water sources should always be secured (e.g. with cotton or small stones).

Ants can drown even in small water droplets, likely due to the **surface tension of water**.

---

### 🧠 Why I keep this species

What makes this species especially interesting to me:

* their highly organized behavior
* visible seed storage
* constant activity within the colony

Watching them collect, transport, and process seeds inside the nest is one of the most fascinating aspects of antkeeping.

In general, all seed-harvesting ant species are relatively **easy to keep**.

---

### 🏠 My colony & setup

I started this colony about **9 months ago** with a queen, **5 workers, and some brood**.

Since then, it has grown to around **500 ants**.

My setup consists of multiple connected modules:

* several arenas
* one main nest (farm)
* connected via tubes

This gives the ants:

* enough space
* clear foraging paths
* room for expansion

---

### ⚠️ Space requirements

One often underestimated aspect of this species is the **space requirement**.

Due to their large seed storage, colonies need:
👉 significantly more space than many other ant species

This becomes more noticeable as the colony grows and stores more resources.

---

### 🧠 Personal conclusion

With:

* enough seeds
* a stable water source

a colony can easily manage itself for extended periods without intervention.

The main downside is the increasing space requirement as the colony grows.

---

👉 If you keep Messor barbarus yourself, feel free to share your experience!

body.title: 500.000 HP erreicht!
body.body:
Liebe Leser,

endlich ist es soweit, nach fast 9 Jahren habe ich die 500K HP geknackt. Fast eine Punktlandung, meine letzte [Prognose](https://peakd.com/hive-121566/@stayoutoftherz/400000-hp) vom Nov. 2024 war, dass es im Mai 2026 passieren würde.
![giphy.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/AKut8tVgyv6oDM9gbwDwqs12fqRPfHS3pquM4W6nGLJnxD1qcaPGB956JppHUqi.gif)

Damit bin ich aber noch lange kein Wal 🐋, denn für den brauchts nämlich laut dieser [Quelle](https://peakd.com/hivebuzz/@hivebuzz/hivebuzz-hive-gamification-experience) 1 Mrd. VESTS (1 HP = derzeit 1627 VESTS), also ca. 614630 HP. Damit ist natürlich das nächste Ziel vorgegeben, was in ca. 1,5 Jahr erreicht sein sollte, auf jeden Fall noch in 2027.

Hier mein HP-Verlauf über die Zeit, erstellt mit diesem nützlichen Tool: https://beebalanced.streamlit.app/balance_history_page
Am Anfang ging es nur schleppend voran, mit der Zeit wird der Anstieg steiler (Zinseszins-Effekt).
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23swbiP3jWKsFQyee1kpunuM3YghPsWUH54219docojjY2saFNComfH1rmG365k7Hm98V.png)

Was alles in der langen Zeit passiert ist, kann ich gar nicht aufzählen, wer will, kann gerne mein [Lexikon](https://peakd.com/hive-121566/@stayoutoftherz/stayoutoftherz-das-lexikon) durchstöbern, da finden sich so manch interessante Beiträge...

Zur Feier gibt es diesmal 5 Delegationen zu je **15.000 HP** für 5 Wochen!

Wer kommt dafür in Frage? Die ersten 5, die diese Bedingungen erfüllen:

- Wer noch selbst nicht Orca ist, also unter 61K HP hat und max. 20% davon an andere Accounts delegiert hat

- Wer hier regelmäßig auf #deutsch postet und kommentiert und auch upvotet
- Wer *nur* auf Hive postet und nicht auf Steem/Blurp
- KE-Wert kleiner als 2
- Wer in den letzten 30 Tagen mind. 10 HP aufgepowert hat (kann auch noch jetzt passiert sein😃)
- Und wer einen Kommentar schreibt, wie er die weitere Entwicklung von Hive einschätzt und was sein/ihr Ziel auf Hive ist (soll kein Essay sein, in der Kürze liegt die Würze!)

Ich hoffe, es finden sich bis Sonntag 5 Hivianer, die alle diese Kriterien erfüllen! Gutes Gelingen!

body.title: Splinterlands Bronze I -Easy Plan, Clean Win.
body.body:
Hello everyone,
I'm @naturaluttom. I hope everyone is well, I'm fine too. Today I want to share a great match from my favorite game Splinterlands.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR7J71Wc5Zf2hpAWJt99HgKfxfS6dK1WqesskqzLTBd5j/1777395311375.png)

[‎The image was created with AI.]()

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)

I played a few matches today, but this match was the one I liked the most. So I thought I'd share it with you. In this match, the mana was 75, which means it's a big match. There were no complicated rules, it was a very simple match. So I didn't think much and simply selected my cards.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXyfDM7hGrGeVezr5UAuwsm1EKN5sodBpQv5NRA2iyEbA/1777395357956.jpg)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)

First, I put a strong tank in front, so that it can take all the damage. Then I put a few attacker cards in the back, so that those cards can slowly damage the opponent. My summoner was Aurelia.

At the beginning, the match was fairly even. Both sides were fighting well. But after a few rounds, the chances of winning slowly shifted to me. My tank was holding up well, and the cards in the back were dealing damage one after another.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQdEEDdxwrfPXxCN71npmENqQxVr36J49z79xJM3c9jWi/1777395357992.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQxt6EUEae2AyNfGaB8JyLJqV15LFNFVk1jfGGEKdUzVS/1777395358040.jpg)
Towards round 5, some important cards of the opponent gradually took down my strong cards. From that moment on, I knew the match was going my way. Then, in Round 7, it was almost over, and I got an easy victory.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWbMTPWfvz5kiH9fopEvovfaPYATDFZLHNYs59tZEwtEr/1777395358086.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQXShZaDQo2g2tc7eCj5X8hxuwwWFy4eQkaCq9FAQPHjg/1777395537103.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXbbHDsEPqwCZ7knf1tyLgP9PU8Pfxx7DKCCxJk8BdT2J/1777395358128.jpg)
With this victory, I was able to increase my rating to Bronze I. Now I am playing much better than before.

Finally, I would like to say that even with simple strategies, you can win, if you plan it properly.

Thank you all ❤️






![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)

body.title: Where the lens breaks the calm / #monomad challenge / [ING/ESP]
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVSDv33EyNs8ejqJz1acFBbq2Qi5DPWRpq6kLtsFYc4wi/_dsc7851_copia_2_.jpg)

* * *

The photos 📸 are my entry to the #monomad contest from @monochromes and @brumest.

* * *


Greetings hivers.

A few months ago I had the pleasure of working on a project with a great group of photographer friends. @muhammadhalim was the one who promoted the idea. The photographs had to be taken in a small town in a province near Havana.

Even before we started planning, @muhammadhalim told me it would be very difficult to photograph people there. He said they were elusive, that as soon as they saw a camera they would hide. I did not think much of it until I experienced it myself. People were truly shy. Only a few curious children approached us at first. It was only after gaining some trust that we were able to talk directly with some of the locals.

Even so, we did the work and I believe the result turned out very well. I hope you enjoy the photos and can appreciate the shyness of these people, completely untouched by anything that involves a camera lens.




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma18PhDtdvtUpZnFVRWDV2k33swY4SQi1JavEss44oJmc/_dsc7852_copia_2_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZdNFwhmFpgnBammtLBwmrL5uXTAkxEL9NCZKweydiF8y/_dsc7853_copia_2_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmebF4SCEbtdxptYbFK9VDW1eugw88bGawE1MErLnQy9GK/_dsc7861_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY65vsV6DcytfyUGrP6a2dbSQBbAsXwxc8bkjpweQUvgZ/_dsc7845_copia2.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbonoYoM5uSJLSjNgtszZU1cZUXX4wvhvJkdoUxiDwiwy/_dsc7877_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNewdbEaNkiod3vf1Rnh2cTYMzm7Xfwy2ahdskKfhw1HU/_dsc7880_copia.jpg)



Saludos hivers.

Hace unos meses tuve el placer de trabajar en un proyecto con un grupo genial de amigos fotógrafos. @muhammadhalim fue quien promovió la idea. Las fotografías debían realizarse en un pueblo de una provincia cercana a La Habana.

Incluso antes de comenzar a planificar, @muhammadhalim me comentaba que sería muy difícil fotografiar a las personas allí. Decía que eran escurridizas, que al ver una cámara se escondían. No le di mucha importancia hasta que lo viví personalmente. Las personas eran realmente tímidas. Solo algunos niños curiosos se acercaban al principio. No fue hasta que ganamos cierta confianza que pudimos conversar directamente con algunos de los pobladores.

Aun así hicimos el trabajo y considero que el resultado quedó muy bien. Espero que les gusten las fotos y que puedan apreciar la timidez de estas personas, ajenas por completo a todo lo que implique un lente.

* * *

\

body.title: Valuable things are decay.
body.body:
Valuable things are decay. Everything is decay, said Ecclesiastes, and this is a truth. Wealth is decay, the body is decay, food is decay, everything we create is decay, even our thoughts, which we sometimes write down in our notes, for example, to share with someone, or to remember ourselves, are decay. As a rule, thoughts about this are directly connected to a certain period of time, imagining a view of the ruined Acropolis, or something else that, under the influence of time and other factors, has lost its former beauty and pomp. I remember how my grandmother's house was swept into a lake by a landslide, and yet her ancestors and she thought this house would stand for hundreds of years... decay. But, in reality, time is far from the only factor that turns valuables to decay. Circumstances trigger the decay process much more quickly, and humans are powerless against them. For example, a ship might be brand new, with a powerful engine, but for some reason it loses its anchor... its chances of decaying increase dramatically. And an anchor that's on display at an anchor show, rather than serving its purpose, is also a waste, and its value is no higher than that of a rusty blank at a scrap yard. ![1artstorDSC00161.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcxaP4s18BUXHaHapSQMqQ2Nw8dkxpPG2rzfPeSPEqsuw/1artstorDSC00161.png) A tree's bark is very valuable, but for a lumberjack or carpenter, bark is waste; it's discarded, and for humans, it's decay. In this way, stone walls are like trees: they need a protective plaster coating. If the plaster cracks, it will gradually crumble, and the stone will then begin to decay. ![1artstDSC05744.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcgYU59Hci73Kuv47XHLJMB9avKXd23hxKGaqerzQbJLn/1artstDSC05744.png) Essentially, decay is something we try to protect ourselves from with all our might, like a skilled thief who can pick any lock, and for every trick we try, he has a countermeasure. Essentially, we are all like a traveler in the desert with a lot of money in his pocket, but no source of water nearby, and no store where he can buy it. This understanding depends solely on time and circumstances. ![1artstor123DSC01122.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmWrA2KeXM1hi6mD3ZKbjNeETn3atJqp1EbmHZTATH5Yw1/1artstor123DSC01122.png) --- Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. [Material thoughts about beekeeping №1](https://inleo.io/threads/view/barski/re-leothreads-drl8tnsl) When I visited dense forests, I did not see ideal conditions for bees there, but many beekeepers harvest beekeeping products in such places. # Learn Zig Series (#32) - Compile-Time Reflection with @typeInfo

![zig.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaHuB6qTWHaSpJHQ1S8FCCRmNQuUxTcPZdU4yKHsJ7vEP/zig-banner.png)

### What will I learn
- You will learn how to write solutions for the Episode 31 exercises;
- You will learn the `@typeInfo` builtin and how it exposes type metadata at compile time;
- You will learn inspecting struct fields, enum variants, and function signatures through reflection;
- You will learn building a generic `toString` for any struct using compile-time field iteration;
- You will learn `inline for` over `@typeInfo` field lists -- how and why it works;
- You will learn `@typeName` and `@tagName` for human-readable debug output;
- You will learn generating serialization logic from type metadata automatically;
- You will learn a practical example: building a generic debug printer that works for any type.

- A working modern computer running macOS, Windows or Ubuntu;

# Learn Zig Series (#32) - Compile-Time Reflection with @typeInfo

## Solutions to Episode 31 Exercises

**Exercise 1** - Mmap two files, compare byte-by-byte, report first 10 differences:

```zig
const std = @import(\

, .{ offset, buf[0] });
}
```

The key detail is opening the file with `.read_write` mode -- if you only open it for reading, the `PROT.WRITE` flag in mmap will fail with a permission error. The verification step re-opens the file and does a regular seek+read to confirm the byte actually made it to disk. Because the mapping is `SHARED`, the write goes to the page cache immediately and the regular read sees it.

**Exercise 3** - Anonymous mapping + mprotect to trigger segfault:

```zig
const std = @import(\

, .{});
}
```

The `mprotect` call changes the page table entries from read-write to read-only. After that, any write to those pages triggers a segmentation fault at the CPU level -- the MMU sees the write, checks the protection bits, and raises a hardware exception that the OS converts to SIGSEGV. This is the same mechanism that catches null pointer dereferences and stack overflows. It is NOT catchable through Zig's error system because it happens below the language level entirely.

OK so with the mmap exercises wrapped up, today we're going in a very different direction. We touched on `comptime` back in [episode 9](https://hive.blog/hive-196387/@scipio/learn-zig-series-9-comptime-zigs-superpower) -- the ability to execute code at compile time. And we used comptime parameters for generics in [episode 14](https://hive.blog/hive-196387/@scipio/learn-zig-series-14-generics-with-comptime-parameters). But we never dug into what is arguably the MOST powerful thing you can do at compile time: **inspecting types themselves**. That's what `@typeInfo` does -- it gives you a structured description of any type, at compile time, that you can branch on, iterate over, and use to generate code. This is reflection, but without the runtme cost. No hash maps of field names, no string parsing, no dynamic dispatch. The compiler resolves everything and spits out exactly the machine code you'd write by hand ;-)

## The `@typeInfo` builtin

The `@typeInfo` builtin takes a type and returns a `std.builtin.Type` -- a tagged union describing everything the compiler knows about that type. Fields, their types, their default values, alignment, whether they're packed -- all of it.

```zig
const std = @import(\

, .{}),
    }
}
```

The output:

```
Point is a struct with 3 fields:
  - x: f32
  - y: f32
  - z: f32 (has default)
```

A few things to note. First, the switch on `@typeInfo` happens at compile time when the type is known at compile time (which it always is for `@typeInfo` since it takes a `type` argument). Second, `.@\

` uses the quoted identifier syntax because `struct` is a keyword in Zig -- you can't write `.struct` directly. Third, the `fields` array is a comptime-known slice of `std.builtin.Type.StructField` structs, each containing the field's name, type, default value pointer, and alignment info.

## Inspecting struct fields, enum variants, and function params

The `std.builtin.Type` union has cases for every kind of Zig type. Here's how you inspect a few common ones:

```zig
const std = @import(\

body:
)` and turns it into a direct field access, same as writing `value.width`.

Without `inline for`, you can't do this. A regular `for` loop at runtime can't call `@field` because the field name would need to be runtime-known, and `@field` requires a comptime-known string. This is the fundamental pattern of Zig reflection: use `@typeInfo` to get the field list, `inline for` to iterate it at compile time, and `@field` to access each field. The result is zero-overhead generated code -- the compiler produces exactly what you'd write by hand if you knew the struct layout in advance.

## `@typeName` and `@tagName` for debug output

We already used `@typeName` above -- it returns a string representation of any type. But `@tagName` is the complement for tagged unions and enums: it gives you the name of the active variant.

```zig
const std = @import(\
);\n            inline for (info.fields, 0..) |field, i| {\n                if (i > 0) try writer.writeAll(\

body.id\\\\\\:
)` for that exact struct. No virtual dispatch, no type maps, no runtime string comparison.

Now, the real `std.json` in Zig's standard library uses a similar approach but handles far more edge cases -- nested structs, arrays, slices of structs, unicode escaping, pretty-printing. But the fundamental technique is the same: `@typeInfo` + `inline for` + recursion.

## Practical example: generic debug printer

Let's build something you'll actually use in your own projects. A generic debug printer that handles structs, enums, tagged unions, arrays, optionals, and pointers -- basically a `std.debug.print(\

, ...)` on steroids but one you control completely:

```zig
const std = @import(\

id\\\\\\: , .{ indent, field.name });\n                try debugPrint(writer, @field(value, field.name), depth + 1);\n                try writer.writeAll(\
, .{ indent, i });\n                    try debugPrint(writer, item, depth + 1);\n                    try writer.writeAll(\
, .{ indent, i });\n                try debugPrint(writer, item, depth + 1);\n                try writer.writeAll(\
body.id\\\\\\: [0 .. depth * 2]`). If you're printing deeply nested structures you'd want to either increase that buffer or switch to repeated `writer.writeAll(\

)` calls in a loop. For most real-world debugging, 16 levels of nesting (32 chars of indent) is plenty.

## Combining reflection with comptime to generate comparison functions

One more pattern that comes up all the time: generic equality. You want to compare two structs for equality, but `==` only works on primitive types in Zig. For structs, you need to compare field by field. Reflection makes this generic:

```zig
const std = @import(\

, .{structEql(a, c)});
}
```

The `structEql` function handles three cases per field: slices (use `std.mem.eql`), nested structs (recurse), and everything else (direct `!=` comparison). This handles nested structs recursively -- the `Vec3` inside `Entity` gets compared field by field automatically. And because everything is `inline for` with comptime type checks, the compiler generates a flat sequence of comparisons with no loops or branches beyond what's strictly necessary.

Having said that, be careful with floats. The `!=` comparison for floating point means `NaN != NaN` returns `true`, which might not be what you want. For production use you'd want an `approxEql` branch for float fields. But the point here is the reflection pattern, not a bulletproof math library.

## Wat we geleerd hebben

- `@typeInfo(T)` returns a `std.builtin.Type` tagged union describing everything the compiler knows about type `T` -- fields, their types, default values, alignment, everything.
- Struct fields are accessed via `@typeInfo(T).@\

.fields`, giving you an array of `StructField` with `.name`, `.type`, `.default_value_ptr`, and `.alignment`.\n- `inline for` unrolls a comptime-known loop so that each iteration produces separate compiled code. This is what makes `@field(value, field.name)` work -- the field name must be comptime-known.\n- `@field(value, \

)` accesses a struct field by compile-time name. Combined with `inline for` over field info, this lets you iterate all fields of any struct generically.
- `@typeName(T)` gives you a human-readable string of any type. `@tagName(value)` gives you the active variant name of an enum or tagged union.
- Serialization, debug printing, equality comparison, and many other utilities can be written ONCE and work for ALL types automatically -- zero runtime overhead because the compiler resolves everything.
- The fundamental pattern is always: `@typeInfo` to get metadata, `inline for` to iterate fields at comptime, `@field` to access each field, and `switch` on nested type info for recursive handling.

This kind of compile-time reflection is what makes Zig's comptime so much more than just \

. In languages like C you'd use code generation or macros. In languages like Java or Python you'd use runtime reflection with hash maps and string lookups. Zig gives you the expressiveness of runtime reflection with the performance of hand-written code -- and the compiler catches any type mismatches before your program even runs. Some interesting patterns emerge when you combine this reflection with tagged unions to build finite state machines ;-)

## Exercises

1. Write a generic `structFromEnv` function that takes a struct type as a comptime parameter and populates it from environment variables. For each field in the struct, look up an environment variable with the same name (uppercased). Support `[]const u8` (direct string), `u32` / `i32` (parse with `std.fmt.parseInt`), and `bool` (check for \

body.title: [Esp/Eng] ✨Linda decoración para la nevera. // Cute decoration for the refrigerator.✨
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

###### <center>✨¡Hola amigos amantes de la creatividad! Espero que estén todos bien.✨</center>

<center>¡Buenas tardes, amigos!Espero que estén pasando una excelente semana. Por mi parte, estoy contenta de pasar por acá a compartir una linda idea con ustedes. En esta ocasión les comparto el paso a paso para elaborar una decoración para la nevera. Creo que ha pasado un tiempito desde la última vez que hice algo así; por eso, quise probar a hacerlo un poco diferente, como un tipo de colgante para el hogar que tuviera detalles lindos, como una flor, un corazón o algo por el estilo, que lo hiciera lucir delicado.</center>

**🔸Sin más que añadir, a continuación los dejo con el paso a paso:**

> ###### <center>✨¡Hello friends who love creativity! I hope you are all well.✨</center>

> <center>Good afternoon, friends! I hope you're having a wonderful week. I'm happy to stop by and share a lovely idea with you. This time, I'm sharing the step-by-step instructions for making a refrigerator decoration. I think it's been a while since I last made something like this, so I wanted to try something a little different, like a decorative wall hanging with pretty details, such as a flower, a heart, or something like that, to give it a delicate look.</center>

> **🔸Without more to add, then I leave you with the step by step:**

---

<center>![portada defi.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tvkqEkcSZyVv3QjLXn57eeDgATwtzY3eDoQ9UAtwGFJKndqxshJEhAeyhR4ABovs68E.JPG)</center>

---

<div class=\

> **♥️ESPERO QUE TE GUSTE, ¡Empecemos!**
**♥️I HOPE YOU LIKE IT, Let's start!**
---
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> - Foami blanco. - Foami marrón. - Foami rosa. - Foami azul. - Foami rojo. - Foami amarillo. - Cinta delgada. - Imán. - Pinturas y marcadores. - Pegamento - Tijeras. - Regla. - Hoja blanca. - Lápiz.
- White foam sheet. - Brown foam sheet. - Pink foam sheet. - Blue foam sheet. - Red foam sheet. - Yellow foam sheet. - Thin ribbon. - Magnet. - Paints and markers. - Glue. - Scissors. - Ruler. - White paper. - Pencil.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> ###### ✨PASO 1: Lo primero que debemos hacer, como siempre, es tomar una hoja blanca y comenzar a dibujar el diseño de la creación que queremos hacer o lo que tengamos en mente hasta lograr dibujar el diseño que más les guste. En mi caso, quise hacer un animalito, así que pensé rápidamente en una gallina o gallo; a esto le quise agregar un cartelito en la parte baja del cuerpo y junto a estos dos una cinta donde va a colgar un lindo corazón. Al tener listo el diseño en la hoja, es momento de transferir a los colores correspondientes de foami, como explico a continuación: Cresta: 1.2 cm, 1.6 cm en foami rojo. Cabeza: 3.5 cm x 2.5 cm en foami blanco. Cuerpo: 6 cm x 3.2 cm en foami marrón. Cartel: 6.3 cm x 3 cm en foami azul. Pétalos: 2 cm en foami blanco. Centro de flor: 2 cm en foami amarillo. Corazón: 4 cm x 3.5 cm en foami rosa.

> ###### ✨STEP 1: The first thing we need to do, as always, is take a white sheet of paper and start sketching the design we want to make, or whatever we have in mind, until we've created a design we like. In my case, I wanted to make a little animal, so I quickly thought of a hen or rooster. I wanted to add a small sign at the bottom of its body and a ribbon next to it where a cute heart will hang. Once the design is ready on the paper, it's time to transfer it to the corresponding colors of foam, as explained below: Crest: 1.2 cm x 1.6 cm in red foam. Head: 3.5 cm x 2.5 cm in white foam. Body: 6 cm x 3.2 cm in brown foam. Sign: 6.3 cm x 3 cm in blue foam. Petals: 2 cm in white foam. Flower center: 2 cm in yellow foam. Heart: 4 cm x 3.5 cm in pink foam.

> ###### ✨PASO 2: Al tener todas las piezas recortadas, es momento de comenzar a dar color a los bordes, con pinturas o marcadores. En mi caso, siempre utilizo marcadores y luego difumino con ayuda de un palito. Siempre utilizando colores más oscuros o que hagan contraste con cada pieza; como sería en el caso del cuerpo, que utilicé un color negro, al igual que para la cresta y para la cabeza un marrón clarito; de resto, utilicé colores más oscuros del color de la pieza.

> ###### ✨STEP 2: Once all the pieces are cut out, it's time to start coloring the edges with paints or markers. In my case, I always use markers and then blend them with a stick. I always use darker colors or colors that contrast with each piece; for example, I used black for the body, as well as for the crest, and a light brown for the head. For the rest, I used darker shades of the piece's color.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> ###### ✨PASO 3: Al estar secas las piezas, es momento de dibujar detalles más específicos o detallitos extras para dar vida a la decoración; en este caso serían los ojos, cejas, boca, nariz, pelaje, ala y al corazón unos puntitos por toda la pieza, pero de un color más oscuro. En cuanto al cartel, le escribí la palabra \

> ###### ✨STEP 3: Once the pieces are dry, it's time to draw more specific details or extra touches to bring the decoration to life. In this case, I added the eyes, eyebrows, mouth, nose, fur, wing, and a few dots all over the heart, using a darker color. As for the sign, I wrote the word \

> ###### ✨PASO 4: Cuando las piezas estén listas, llega el momento de comenzar a pegar con mucho cuidado cada una de las piezas; en mi caso, me gusta comenzar por la cabeza, así que pegué la cresta a la cabeza, seguido el cuerpo y luego el cartel. En el centro del cartel, pegué la cinta y en la punta el corazón. Además, pegué la pequeña flor en uno de los bordes del cartel. En la parte trasera pegamos el imán y listo.

> ###### ✨STEP 4: When the pieces are ready, it's time to carefully glue each one together. I like to start with the head, so I glued the crest to the head, followed by the body, and then the sign. In the center of the sign, I glued the ribbon, and at the tip, the heart. I also glued the small flower to one of the edges of the sign. On the back, we glued the magnet, and that's it!

body.title: After a few days of extreme heat, the rain has made the atmosphere beautiful.
body.body:
> #
Hello friends, This is @mmiya from #Bangladesh.
|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSNW4dPCDvkENFS9gtgzV3wHRcLaQMn5ih1NEmx7m5dN8/pexels_adult_1867665_1920.jpg)| |- |[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/adult-blur-bokeh-city-evening-1867665/) Dear Hive lovers,‌‌ How are you all? The environment has been very cold for the past two days, because it rained yesterday and today the sky was cloudy too, sometimes there was light rain, the environment has become cold due to the rain, we like to live in such an environment, we all want such an environment all year round, it will not be too cold and it will not be too hot. It feels very comfortable to move in such an environment, we can go anywhere very comfortably, if the heat is too much then our body gets tired, we become restless, and if the cold is too much then we cannot go out without winter clothes, that is why we all prefer such a mild winter and mildly warm environment. |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVC9byBuryemyfJArBWtXxuzNfP3sBTWnWJh4WoDU4KLp/chuotanhls_girls_4320044_1920.jpg)| |- |[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/girls-weather-happy-raining-4320044/) A few days ago, it was very hot, at that time the sunlight was very hot, the effect of the heat was very high due to the heat of the sunlight, due to which it was very difficult for the common people to move, at that time we were tired and restless wherever we went, due to the heat, our body was sweating and even our clothes were wet, we could not find peace anywhere, everyone was just looking for air. After a few days of heat, when the rain started, we felt a little peace, although one day there was a storm with the rain, when there is a storm with the rain, many people get scared, because due to the storm, our houses are damaged a lot, even the crop fields are damaged a lot, when there is heavy rain and storm with the rain, everyone gets scared with fear. |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTNbmM7wcvd8nLAfRE3YWhgxNiiPkRgb8SFMh3RGgvf7q/ajaykhadka_raining_5389459_1920.jpg)| |- |[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/raining-floating-float-rain-5389459/) But after the rain stopped, the atmosphere became very calm, especially today the rain was less, today there was light rain at times all day, and the sky was completely cloudy, due to which the atmosphere is very cold, we do not have to face any obstacles to move in this atmosphere, there is no need for air due to the extreme heat, because there is no effect of the heat, and there is no need for winter clothes due to the extreme cold, because there is no winter at this time. When such a beautiful atmosphere is created, sleep is very good, but sometimes when it suddenly changes from extreme heat to rain and it becomes cold or cold, many people get sick, especially young children and the elderly get sick due to the sudden change in weather, for this reason they do not need special care, and it is necessary to enjoy such a beautiful atmosphere.

body.title: Depression and anxiety, how to overcome these biblically// My review on Mcgi
body.body:
Depression and anxiety is a struggle that ties us down whenever it hits us. Pains and fear is inevitable even those who are strong belivers go through this process in their life. Rather than condemning such emotions, Scripture invites us to bring them honestly before God, trusting that He understands our weakness and cares deeply about our condition.
https://youtu.be/mtz3NLb9KXw?si=rUJKWztx81WdvRsi
Coming to God through prayer is one step to overcome this struggle of life. When we open our hearts to Him, we are not just speaking into the air we are placing our burdens into the hands of One who is able to help. 

>“Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you” (1 Peter 5:7).

We should always embrace God with our problems because he is the only helper which we have on earth. Fellowship with believers, encouragement, and acts of kindness can lift the spirit. God often works through people to bring comfort and strength.  

>“The Lord is near to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit” (Psalm 34:18).

body.title: Legend Fighter: Mortal Battle Review
body.body:
[![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRdEXSeF2RdNCRnvDfWmHLjByXb1njoq1L2YThRx9RrFb/740b9c14d62568ad930f3440e27da190)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=fearline/e8ab5291)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=fearline/e8ab5291)


---

i downloaded this game Legend Fighter Mortal Battle like randomly honestly. was just sitting with chai and phone battery already dying and still i installed it. dont even know why. maybe the name sounded heavy or something. mortal battle type vibes you know.

first thing i noticed was the fighting. its not like super smooth but also not bad. like somewhere in between. sometimes the character just stands there like bro move?? and im tapping like crazy. then suddenly boom combo happens. weird but kinda fun.

i was playing it yesterday night after dinner. lights off only phone screen and fan noise. one match got intense for no reason. my thumb literally slipped and i lost. i just stared at the screen for like 5 seconds. dont know why i felt annoyed that much its just a game. but yeah.

graphics are okay. not something crazy. like you wont say wow but also you wont delete it because of that. characters look decent. some of them actually look cool but others feel copy paste. same face different outfit type thing.

controls… hmm. this is where it gets messy. sometimes responsive sometimes not. like mood swings. maybe its my phone i dont know. but yeah it does break the flow a bit. especially when youre about to win and then character just ignores you like it has its own life.

sound effects are loud. like too loud sometimes. i had volume low but still punches sound like explosion. my mother even asked from other room what im watching. i said nothing just game. felt awkward for no reason.

there is this upgrade system too. typical stuff coins and unlocks. nothing new honestly. you grind a bit then unlock fighter then repeat. not sure why i expected something different. maybe because of the name again.

anyway i kept playing more than i planned. like i said just one match and suddenly 30 minutes gone. happens with these kind of games i guess. not even realizing time passing.

one thing i didnt like is ads. yeah they pop up. not too much but enough to annoy. like youre already losing and then ad comes. feels personal somehow.

still… i didnt uninstall it. so maybe that says something. or maybe i was just lazy.

dont know if ill keep playing it daily or just forget it in a week like other games. but for now its just sitting there on my phone. next to other apps i barely open.

anyway yeah i think ill play one more round later. or maybe not. depends.

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=fearline/e8ab5291)

body.title: How fast we forget humanity online
body.body: i dont even know when this started honestly but the way people talk online now just feels off like something quietly changed and no one really noticed or maybe everyone noticed but just didnt care enough to say anything and now it just feels normal which is the weird part. you open your phone for a few minutes and someone is getting dragged someone is being laughed at someone is clearly upset in the comments and others are just adding more to it like its some kind of game and im just sitting there scrolling through it like this is fine like this is just how things are now not sure why i thought that but yeah it actually feels normal.

/>

i remember one small thing a few days ago i was sitting in a shop waiting for my turn just casually scrolling and there was this video of a guy messing up while speaking on stage like he forgot his words nothing serious just a small human moment but the comments were brutal people calling him dumb useless cringe like he didnt even deserve to be there and i just kept reading without reacting like it didnt even surprise me and i think thats the part that bothered me later not the comments but how normal it felt to read them.

because if that happened in real life like right in front of me i wouldnt react like that i wouldnt just laugh or insult someone for messing up id probably feel awkward or even bad for them maybe look away or try not to make it worse but online its like something switches off like empathy just disappears or logs out or something and suddenly its easy to say things you would never say out loud.

anyway sometimes i catch myself doing it too like typing something sarcastic or judging someone i dont even know and then i pause for a second and think would i actually say this to their face and the answer is almost always no so why does it feel so easy here maybe its because theres no reaction no eye contact no silence after the words just text and move on and people forget or maybe ignore that theres an actual person on the other side feeling all of it.

and then theres this thing where once one person starts being harsh others just follow like a chain reaction you scroll and see hundreds of mean comments and your brain just adjusts to that tone like ok this is how we talk here now so you match it without even thinking twice and thats kinda scary how fast it happens like no pause no second thought just automatic.

sometimes i wonder if we are slowly becoming like this in real life too just hiding it better or maybe online is just exposing what was already there i dont know which one is worse honestly not sure if that makes sense its just strange how a simple screen can make someone feel less real and how quickly we adapt to that feeling like really quickly maybe too quickly…

body.title: No solo los niños hacen travesuras|It's not just children who get into mischief
body.body:
>





<center>![IMG-20260420-WA0271.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWnigE9KFyDoy6vgR4qjoSuBtQGbxrobb1P8de6mNiP1B/IMG-20260420-WA0271.jpg)</center>





¡Hola queridos usuarios! Casi toda mi vida la llevo por esta plataforma desde hace ocho años, pero mis travesuras no ja,ja,ja. Gracias una vez más por estos espacios que nos ayudan a fortalecer nuestro crecimiento personal con estos temas tan motivadores.

Puedo enumerar mis travesuras con los dedos de una de mis manos, pero también estoy segura de que esas personas que te rodean se han inventado muchas travesuras, ya saben; amigos, familiares y allegados.




>Hello dear users! I've spent almost my entire life on this platform for the past eight years, but my mischief hasn't been! Haha. Thanks again for these spaces that help us strengthen our personal growth with such motivating topics.

>I could count my mischief on one hand, but I'm also sure that the people around you have invented plenty of their own—you know, friends, family, and acquaintances.



<center>![Screenshot_20260420-221335.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtciThmq7akFdUpVmbScGEfm7v8ngRzuYbxQrJfHDs8m/Screenshot_20260420-221335.png)</center>


Puedo recordar una travesura muy osada, tenía unos cinco años o seis, se imaginan a una niñita de seis años cruzando una autopista, eso era esa carretera que nos separa de una bodeguita donde nunca llegué, si hubiese llegado no hubiese podido comprar nada, no tenía dinero. Voy con este cuento, pasé la calle y luego en vez de irme por arriba de la canal, bajé y caí casi en el hueco de la alcantarilla, se imaginan eso, todavía puedo escuchar el ruido del agua al caer en esa tanquilla, se me eriza la piel. ¿Qué hacía una niña de noche por ese lugar? Bueno, \

diría un conocido cronista, periodista y escritor venezolano.


Debo mencionar que era de noche, me regrese como pude, subí de nuevo la canal, pasé de nuevo la autopista, llegué al baño de nuestro apartamento, me quité la ropa que pueden imaginar el olor que tenía. Lo que no recuerdo es que me dijeron mis familiares, por lo que he estudiado no quedó ningún trauma, solo la sensación indescriptible que tengo al recordar ese momento. Hay niños muy osados. Esto ocurrió en Puerto Ordaz.

>I can remember a very daring prank I pulled. I was about five or six years old. Can you imagine a six-year-old girl crossing a highway? That's what that road was like, the one that separates us from a little store I never made it to. Even if I had, I wouldn't have been able to buy anything; I didn't have any money. Anyway, I crossed the street, and then instead of going over the gutter, I went down and almost fell into the drain. Can you imagine that? I can still hear the sound of the water falling into that little tank; it gives me goosebumps. What was a little girl doing there at night? Well, \

as a well-known Venezuelan chronicler, journalist, and writer would say. >I should mention that it was nighttime. I got back as best I could, climbed back over the gutter, crossed the highway again, got to the bathroom in our apartment, and took off my clothes—you can imagine the smell. What I don't remember is what my family told me. From what I've studied, I wasn't traumatized, just left with the indescribable feeling I have when I remember that moment. There are some very daring children. This happened in Puerto Ordaz.
![453ac34a-b166-4dbe-ac58-2a4f40271a8c.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQL1LpPseeAaz7dLw7J8Jw66NWGb7nd62TdTKxoDvgZgV/453ac34a-b166-4dbe-ac58-2a4f40271a8c.JPG)
Otra travesura que recuerdo, no recuerdo otra travesura, pero este espacio tiene esa gran virtud, saca de nuestro cajones situaciones que están ocultas y con solo dar unos minutos de tiempo algo llega. Listo, recuerdo un día de esos que de verdad son horribles, lo voy a mencionar, pero no fue mi culpa, estábamos de paseo en el parque La Llovizna - Cachamay también por allá el estado Bolívar, por esos lados, y, me ha dejado el autobús de la excursión, pero era una niña de seis años, creo que los adultos debían estar pendiente de mí. Ya más grande como de catorce años, le dije a mis familiares que me iba para la casa de mi madre en Puerto Cabello, no lo hice me quedé en casa de una amiga para poder salir a caminar hasta tarde, resulta que mi tía me vio y se pueden imaginar el problema en el que me metí. No voy a detallar ese acontecimiento solo me castigaron por una semana. >Another prank I remember—well, I don't remember any other pranks, but this space has that great virtue: it brings out hidden situations from our drawers, and with just a few minutes, something comes to mind. Okay, I remember one of those truly awful days. I'll mention it, but it wasn't my fault. We were on a trip to La Llovizna Park in Cachamay, also in Bolívar state, around there, and the tour bus left me behind. But I was only six years old; I think the adults should have been keeping a closer eye on me. >Later, when I was about fourteen, I told my family I was going to my mother's house in Puerto Cabello. I didn't go; I stayed at a friend's house so I could go for walks until late. It turns out my aunt saw me, and you can imagine the trouble I got into. I won't go into detail about that incident; I was just grounded for a week.
![92047761-2633-441b-901d-b53d6088cd7f.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVbt8vGAVxmTMnXqQvKV2pGeUkP4vnsFSRkoDTAC3xfT5/92047761-2633-441b-901d-b53d6088cd7f.JPG)
Después vinieron otras travesuras me encanta y me encantaba bailar, mis travesuras eran para salir. Tenía un pretendiente que luego se convirtió en mi esposo, no le gustaba bailar mucho, entonces me dolía la cabeza de repente, en fin lo demás es historia. Me vino algo a la mente, el día que agarré un pote de agua oxigenada y me lo apliqué en los cabellos, volvió mi tía a capturarme, se lo dijo a mi papá, pero bueno era mi cabello, pero parece que así no era la cosa, tenía doce años. Ya rumbo a mis 61 años no hago muchas travesuras, pero recordar estas me hizo sonreír de todos esos momentos tan lindos de mi niñez. Recordé otras, pero me las llevaré conmigo. Gracias a nuestra hermosa comunidad de #empowertalent y a su moderadora @angelica7. ¡Un abrazote inmenso! >Then came other mischief. I loved to dance, and my pranks were always about going out. I had a suitor who later became my husband. He didn't like to dance much, so I'd suddenly get a headache. Anyway, the rest is history. Something came to mind: the day I grabbed a bottle of hydrogen peroxide and put it in my hair. My aunt caught me again and told my dad. Well, it was my hair, but it seems that wasn't the whole story. I was twelve years old. >Now, approaching 61, I don't get into many pranks, but remembering these made me smile, recalling all those beautiful moments of my childhood. I remembered others, but I'll take those with me. Thanks to our wonderful #empowertalent community and its moderator, @angelica7. >A huge hug!
![IMG_20251017_020902.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcUuFLjG8PBM6u9RoamkUFwAxqtooftNDNbb1paQTAQxf/IMG_20251017_020902.jpg)

body.title: Trying to Discipline Myself Again
body.body:
My laziness is one of my enemy right now because instead of prioritizing things that I need to do on that day, I am going to do things that were not in the schedule and that's one that I am fighting for in this laziness. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/23ynh4bFUABE5mHWebYTXiix1S5ttybXAtXg7t4PPxUkVJN4D6KDpwv7LyvKn6mHnK85n.png)
[*Source*](https://unsplash.com/photos/asian-attractive-young-man-turn-off-alarm-clock-ringing-in-the-morning-handsome-male-feel-lazy-and-tired-lying-down-on-comfortable-bed-in-bedroom-ignore-noise-and-keep-sleeping-dont-want-to-wake-up-RvT7YbnatSc)

It is not only once or maybe twice that I do this laziness things and sometimes I procrastinate because of things that I do not mind of but mind you that these are necessary not for myself but for the benefit for me as a whole and also to get more exposure to this kind of things. 

In my work, I know that the work that I had needs more thinking with your reasoning and such because in a programming or coding world, you need to get more ideas on this and on that because that's what it builds you up.

Well, in the past couple of days, I haven't been able to touch the programming because I am not-so-busy with my work but in reality, they are needed, they are priority and the deadline were already past and here I am just doing nothing instead of working whole day with the work.

I need real motivations that I am going to do because motivation is what drives or boosts me on the work that I am going to do, well, I have now motivation on things but one thing is that when I focus on one thing, the other work or things that I do were abandoned and that's what I'm scared of because the past work that I've been working will be unfinished and not yet working.

Although, the past work that I have been working was almost there and the progress is still good and progressing well but when I have a new work that I want to do, I would just abandoned that old work and work with the new one. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/23vi4KRuJvXLS79ezCTfd1WSVtXxkkocNbNB8Qzd9wFMQ363sHuqpj4HzBSYvNnyf5nnV.png)
[*Source*](https://unsplash.com/photos/someone-is-trying-to-block-out-noise-with-a-pillow-MyP3RcAKGBY)

That's not what I want because abandoning the old work even if it's not yet finished is not good and it's like I was chasing for a start but I will not getting it to finished until the end. So, yeah, now, I am getting to those projects that I've been working and I am going to make sure that they will be finished and not doing any laziness anymore.

body.title: (EN-ES) The role of self-respect and self-esteem in learning-El papel del respeto y la autoestima en el aprendizaje
body.body:
(English version)

When it comes to life-changing books, you can find plenty of information online suggesting lists of highly-recommended books that can change a person’s life.

Personally, I had such an experience back in 2003, when I had the opportunity to read the book: “Way of the leader: Applying the principles of Sun Tzu and Confucius”, written by Donald Krause, which I bought at an airport bookshop, while I was trying to find ways to pass the time at the waiting lounge.

After reading it, I can say that it helped me a lot to see things from a completely different perspective.

In fact, it helped me to better organize my mind and use a more objective approach in addressing problems, situations, and people.

I believe that the fact that the book is composed of simple yet powerful messages and ideas that date to the ancient times of Sun Tzu and Confucius, and these messages have endured the test of time, is uncontested evidence of the book’s effectiveness as a life-changing material.

At some point of the book, the author argues that: “A person without self-respect does not learn much from failure, nor does he benefit long from good fortune”.

This statement itself is excellent food for thought.

It means that, no matter how many times a person without self-respect fails, they will not be able to turn failure into an advantage through learning.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MbF5dyU96CE

Taking it a bit further, it can be argued that a person without self-respect cannot actually learn.

Therefore, self-respect is a prerequisite of learning.

That an important point that needs to be elaborated further.

Although the context of the book refers to leadership through a comparison of various historic leaders, and how their approaches fit the theoretical ideas of Confucius, as these ideas were implemented by Sun Tzu in practice, the results of this discussion on leadership can also be easily applied to other areas, such as education and pedagogy.

I believe that the majority of teachers, regardless of the level of education that they teach, use the same teaching methods and approaches, and apply them to students collectively, without taking individual differences into account.

The fact that there is not much room for teachers to apply a customized approach that is tailored to the individual needs, circumstances, level, and abilities of every single student is not necessarily the teachers’ fault, but it results from various factors that are out of the teachers’ control.

In fact, before providing students with the necessary learning material and support, teachers should first attempt to evaluate each student’s self-respect level, because, according to Donald Krause, this is the true foundation of learning.

However, as it is argued by Ellen J. Langer, a psychology professor at Harvard University, self-respect is a given, and you either have it or not.

Therefore, it cannot be really taught.

What can be taught, on the other hand, is self-esteem, and that is where teachers should really focus on their teaching efforts, i.e. build the self-esteem of their students, before even trying to teach them anything.

Although this is not argued by Ellen Langer, I believe that any knowledge that is provided before a strong basis of self-esteem is built will prove to be of little effect in the short run, and certainly useless in the long run.

Perhaps this could be the reason why basketball coach Rick Pitino, in his seminal article: “Success is a choice”, argues that self-esteem plays a paramount role in achieving success.

I believe that if Rick Pitino had to choose between a basketball player with high self-respect vs. a player with high self-esteem, in terms of how he, as a coach, could help that player reach higher career goals, Pitino would go for high self-esteem, or actually help the player build self-esteem from scratch.

This is because a player with high self-respect has an already established worldview, which can prove very difficult to change, while, on the other hand, even a player with low self-esteem can be highly perceptive to training through the provision of the right type of motivation.

These ideas can apply to different areas of life, and not only to basketball.

However, due to the fact that, although boosting self-esteem can help a lot in achieving success, its results can prove to be temporary and vanish when a coach or a teacher no longer provides support to the learner, the ultimate goal should be to develop individuals with high self-respect who are also strongly motivated to learn.

In this way, the results of learning would last more, even when the teacher is not present, while the learner will be driven by a constant inner desire to learn in the long run.

(Versión en español)

Cuando se trata de libros que cambian la vida, se puede encontrar mucha información en línea con listas de libros altamente recomendados que pueden transformar la vida de una persona.

Personalmente, tuve una experiencia así en 2003, cuando tuve la oportunidad de leer el libro: \

, escrito por Donald Krause, que compré en una librería del aeropuerto mientras buscaba algo para pasar el tiempo en la sala de espera.

Después de leerlo, puedo decir que me ayudó mucho a ver las cosas desde una perspectiva completamente diferente.

De hecho, me ayudó a organizar mejor mis ideas y a abordar los problemas, las situaciones y las personas con mayor objetividad.

Creo que el hecho de que el libro esté compuesto por mensajes e ideas sencillas pero poderosas que se remontan a la antigüedad, a la época de Sun Tzu y Confucio, y que estos mensajes hayan perdurado a lo largo del tiempo, es una prueba irrefutable de su eficacia como material transformador.

En cierto punto del libro, el autor argumenta que: «Una persona sin autoestima no aprende mucho del fracaso, ni disfruta por mucho tiempo de la buena fortuna».

Esta afirmación invita a la reflexión.

Significa que, por muchas veces que fracase una persona sin autoestima, no podrá convertir el fracaso en una ventaja mediante el aprendizaje.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MbF5dyU96CE

Profundizando un poco más, se puede argumentar que una persona sin autoestima no puede aprender.

Por lo tanto, la autoestima es un requisito indispensable para el aprendizaje.

Este es un punto importante que merece mayor desarrollo.

Si bien el libro aborda el liderazgo mediante la comparación de diversos líderes históricos y cómo sus enfoques se ajustan a las ideas teóricas de Confucio, tal como Sun Tzu las implementó en la práctica, las conclusiones de este análisis sobre liderazgo pueden aplicarse fácilmente a otros ámbitos, como la educación y la pedagogía.

Creo que la mayoría de los docentes, independientemente del nivel educativo que impartan, utilizan los mismos métodos y enfoques pedagógicos, aplicándolos a todos los estudiantes de forma colectiva, sin tener en cuenta las diferencias individuales.

El hecho de que los docentes no tengan mucha libertad para aplicar un enfoque personalizado que se adapte a las necesidades, circunstancias, nivel y habilidades de cada estudiante no es necesariamente culpa suya, sino que se debe a diversos factores que escapan a su control.

De hecho, antes de proporcionar a los estudiantes el material didáctico y el apoyo necesarios, los docentes deberían evaluar primero el nivel de autoestima de cada alumno, ya que, según Donald Krause, este es el verdadero fundamento del aprendizaje.

Sin embargo, como argumenta Ellen J. Langer, profesora de psicología en la Universidad de Harvard, la autoestima es algo innato; se tiene o no se tiene.

Por lo tanto, no se puede enseñar.

Lo que sí se puede enseñar es la autoestima, y ​​ahí es donde los docentes deberían centrar sus esfuerzos: en fortalecer la autoestima de sus alumnos antes incluso de intentar enseñarles nada.

Aunque Ellen Langer no lo afirma, creo que cualquier conocimiento que se proporcione antes de que se haya construido una sólida base de autoestima resultará poco efectivo a corto plazo y, sin duda, inútil a largo plazo.

Quizás esta sea la razón por la que el entrenador de baloncesto Rick Pitino, en su influyente artículo «El éxito es una elección», sostiene que la autoestima juega un papel fundamental para alcanzar el éxito.

Creo que si Rick Pitino tuviera que elegir entre un jugador de baloncesto con un alto respeto por sí mismo y uno con una alta autoestima, en cuanto a cómo él, como entrenador, podría ayudar a ese jugador a alcanzar metas profesionales más ambiciosas, Pitino optaría por la alta autoestima, o incluso ayudaría al jugador a desarrollarla desde cero.

Esto se debe a que un jugador con un alto respeto por sí mismo tiene una visión del mundo ya establecida, que puede resultar muy difícil de cambiar, mientras que, por otro lado, incluso un jugador con baja autoestima puede ser muy receptivo al entrenamiento si se le proporciona la motivación adecuada.

Estas ideas se pueden aplicar a diferentes ámbitos de la vida, no solo al baloncesto.

Sin embargo, dado que, si bien potenciar la autoestima puede contribuir significativamente al éxito, sus resultados pueden ser temporales y desaparecer cuando el mentor o profesor deja de brindar apoyo al alumno, el objetivo final debe ser formar personas con un alto respeto por sí mismas y una gran motivación para aprender.

De esta manera, los beneficios del aprendizaje perdurarían más, incluso en ausencia del profesor, y el alumno se vería impulsado por un deseo interno constante de aprender a largo plazo.

(Esta publicación fue traducida del inglés al español con Google Translate)

* * *

_Originally published by me on_ [_medium.com_](https://medium.com/p/fcd4b70cd779) _on September 25, 2025_

body.title: Aufenthalt im \
in Tagaytay.
body.body: Im Juli 2025 verbrachten wir anlässlich unseres Hochzeitstags ein paar Tage im \

in Tagaytay, das ich wirklich jedem wärmstens empfehlen kann, der bereit ist, ein kleines bisschen mehr auszugeben, um dafür Ruhe und Entspannung (auch aufgrund der etwas abgeschiedenen Lage in den Buenavista Hills), eine wunderschöne Umgebung, zahlreiche Aktivitäten, bestes Essen und erstklassigen Service zu genießen.

Highlights sind unter anderem der beheizte Außenpool, die großen, mit eigenem Balkon oder Terrasse ausgestatteten Zimmer und die darin befindlichen superbequemen Betten. :)

Auf dem Areal befindet sich unter anderem ein Spieleraum mit Billard, Tischtennis und Brettspielen (z. B. Schach), ein Bereich, in dem man sich im Bogenschießen probieren kann und ein Fitnessstudio. Darüber hinaus offeriert das \

ein umfassendes Spa-Programm mit einer Vielzahl an Massagen und Behandlungen sowie Yoga-Kurse. Selbst an eine wirklich toll eingerichtete Bibliothek wurde gedacht.

Besonders Kindern bereitet es viel Freude, die kleine Farm mit Kaninchen, Ziegen, Schweinen und Hühnern zu besichtigen, außerdem gedeihen im hauseigenen Nutzgarten Gemüse, Kräuter sowie einige Obstbäume.

Das Resort beherbergt zwei Restaurants:

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 28 2026
body.body:
Good day folks 😄, Woke up thinking I’d just do a short round and be done… but yeah, that didn’t happen. Started with a chill walk, kinda shaking off the sleep. Then a light jog crept in, and before I knew it I was stopping near the park to stretch a bit. After that, a few random running bursts—no timing, no plan, just moving whenever it felt right. At one point I almost headed back, but something about the quiet weekend vibe made me keep going. You know that feeling when you’re already a bit tired but still don’t want to stop? That was me today. Checked my steps later—26,000. Way more than I expected. Funny how unplanned sessions end up being the most satisfying.

body.body: @ahmadmanga, there’s no public launch date I can point to yet for a Rafiki API. Your Premium is already active, so the bigger win is stacking that with the Premium perks you’re using in Rafiki — enhanced AI, image generation, digests, and deeper tools ([Rafiki capabilities](https://docs.inleo.io/rafiki-ai-assistant/capabilities), [credits & premium](https://docs.inleo.io/rafiki-ai-assistant/credits-and-premium)). On the ecosystem side, the team’s still shipping hard around LeoDex and wallet expansion, which makes staking feel less like dead weight and more like positioning ahead of product growth ([LeoDex V2 update](https://inleo.io/@leofinance/introducing-leodex-v2-swap-across-6...)).
