body.body:
![Kopia – Observed lives.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wr1d8aBCn3Adt3tFY93LxScHTKdLrHKAeNBdcB9i9TbXoVW3aVWu4bHwi7KigxAe9FX.jpg)

There are places in this world that are truly extraordinary. Places that are not very visible on maps, yet have great significance. Places you usually come across by accident, just like I did.

While planning my trip to PIZZO in Italy, I carefully explored Google Maps in search of places worth visiting. And I have to admit, this particular spot didn’t catch my attention at all. While browsing the map of PIZZO, I hadn’t noticed it before.
I found out about this place during breakfast at a nearby bar. The owner asked us if we liked animals, because if we did, there was a small, inconspicuous place in PIZZO filled with a lot of heart.

And that place is MUGAT. So what exactly is MUGAT?
MUGAT is a place on the map of PIZZO that provides shelter for stray cats. The animals have their own sanctuary there and everything they need: food, care, play, medical treatment, and above all, a safe space. Some of these cats are waiting for adoption.

Since my sister is a total cat lover, we knew we had to visit this place. And honestly what we saw there, it really makes you think.

>Są takie miejsca na tej ziemi, które są totalnie niezwykłe. Miejsca, które nie są aż tak bardzo widoczne na mapach, ale mają bardzo wielkie znaczenie. Miejsca, do których raczej trafia się przypadkiem, tak jak było to u mnie. 
>
>Planując swoją wycieczkę do włoskiego Pizzo, wcześniej dosyć mocno prześledziłam mapę Google w poszukiwaniu miejsc, które warto odwiedzić. I muszę przyznać, że to miejsce akurat nie rzuciło mi się w oczy. Przeszukując mapę Pizzo, nie widziałam tego miejsca na mapie. Dowiedziałam się o tym miejscu podczas śniadania w pobliskim barze. Właściciel baru zapytał nas, czy lubimy zwierzęta, bo jeśli tak, to jest w Pizzo jedno takie małe, niepozorne miejsce, w którym panuje bardzo dużo serca. 
>
>I tym miejscem właśnie jest MUGAT. A czym jest tak właściwie MUGAT? MUGAT to miejsce na mapie Pizzo, które daje schronienie bezdomnym kotom. Zwierzęta mają tam swój azyl i wszystko to, czego im potrzeba. Jedzenie, opiekę, zabawę, leki i przede wszystkim bezpieczną przestrzeń. Część z tych kotków czeka na adopcję. 
>
>Jako że moja siostra to totalna Kociara, wiedziałyśmy, że musimy odwiedzić to miejsce i powiem szczerze, że to, co można było zobaczyć tam na miejscu naprawdę daje dużo do myślenia.

We changed our plans a bit and right after breakfast we headed to that place. At first, we felt a bit disappointed because when we arrived, it seemed completely empty. We didn’t see a single cat. We were honestly quite sad and disappointed because of that, but suddenly the first gentleman came to greet us. I just hope his expression wasn’t because of us. 😁

>Zmieniłyśmy zatem trochę naszych planów i zaraz po śniadaniu ruszyłyśmy do tego miejsca. Na początku poczułyśmy trochę rozczarowania, bo przyszłyśmy tam i miejsce wydawało się być totalnie puste. Nie widziałyśmy ani jednego kotka. Byłyśmy naprawdę smutne i rozczarowane z tego tytułu, ale nagle przywitał nas pierwszy jegomość. Mam nadzieję, że jego mina nie była odpowiedzią na naszą wizytę. 😁



![20260418_084346.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xp8JWk3WCSpAZRYyemmyR1SYXp6cyfZGcAPhiRkd3Hdu67ZiWRhPPJKgJUpPrATSZQS.jpg)

Gradually, more and more cats started coming toward us. At one point, we didn’t even know where to look, because a cat was approaching from every direction. Some came closer, while others watched us from a distance. It was clear that some were already very used to being around people, while others were still very cautious. I didn’t count them exactly, but I think there were around twenty of them.

>Powoli jednak zaczęło się schodzić w naszą stronę coraz więcej kotków. Nie wiedziałyśmy w pewnym momencie, w którą stronę patrzeć, bo z każdej strony nadchodził jakiś kotek. Niektóre podchodziły bliżej, inne obserwowały nas z daleka. Widać było, że niektóre są już bardzo przyzwyczajone do obcowania z człowiekiem, a niektóre wciąż są bardzo nieufne. Nie liczyłam ich dokładnie, ale myślę, że z powodzeniem było ich tam około dwadzieścia sztuk.


![20260418_085253.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wCE1Xwm18Tdv2HbJTiiWKFuUFdKjmU4WDYdyuKDNXDgeRJKwAk5oNrRbSsdrfk7xyx4.jpg)

![20260418_085239.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xAa7cgppQGE7hg138iUYigD5kFbNjzgFvFpRNHGbTCHPe8K2zn5jYmznJLAtyWSHwgS.jpg)

![20260418_084743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xVMK5sCrEh2zn3YCDzv1xowTez8T7ZyjuSRmCcq3xAMxFvEyAiD3U2WFXxVJZU9wxd5.jpg)


![20260418_084713.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wWyBaQprBCFzXbhkvykSTgxs5CJqVCVkBVbsqmYWTJvQWSk7HMg9aXAwNxGn1vUjayr.jpg)


One of the cats really took a liking to the strap on my phone, so I left it with him for a while and watched him play with it.

>Jedenemu kotkowi bardzo przypadła do gustu moja smycz z telefonu komórkowego, więc zostawiłam mu ją na dłuższą chwilę i obserwowałam jego zabawy.


![20260418_084105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wMeqFvyvj8WejHgtTTn4QeSN5PqgJacguTHA3tynkUq6TwqC49ugU2RREs1qDa1CVvR.jpg)

![20260418_084444.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xempviN3S67fVkMaNCYmjAz5Ei3UhTJ52T2XhhMGXsympJRPWP8hUipeVzggrP9njZt.jpg)

There were so many of them that we were practically running out of hands to pet them all. Quite a few of the cats were competing for attention and wanted to be petted constantly.

>Było ich tam tak dużo, że brakowało nam wręcz rąk, aby je wszystkie pogłaskać. Sporo tych kotków walczyło o swoją uwagę i chciało być głaskanym non stop.


![20260418_083819.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wX1RFQsLsnjDZ4NM6zq3WUu8GddQP1gXALbey77qFnHLnd58qF1KaSitqLohSwgM9xE.jpg)

![20260418_085334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wMYT7xY4gy1dVEZJa6sQY2DeMKhzXSPaBfzPyk28ri6aUZf73s5C6dHhbiTWV6ofReq.jpg)

![20260418_085325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wMct7e9Js9GBjZ6CNwv3KECvbaojcV3pgRt4eZphC1mEPxJj7bk4EsrgLDqzTgE9o2J.jpg)

Some of the cats seemed very pleased with our presence.

>Niektóre kotki wyglądały na bardzo zadowolone z naszej obecności.


![20260418_084209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wCGSnm3MZQoTiefMrybkSVYQCoZ93juqkdBp7FUifcHSKFdhXYcHK2JuSByW7riAeVM.jpg)

Unfortunately, some of the cats also showed signs of illness in their eyes and mouths. However, I am sure they are receiving excellent medical care, and that the people behind MUGAT, along with others of good will, are taking the best possible care of them and that they will recover soon.

>Niestety u części kotków było widać również chore pyszczki i oczka. Jestem jednak pewna, że są pod doskonałą opieką lekarską i właściciele Mugatu i wszyscy ludzie dobrej woli troszczą się o te kotki jak najlepiej i wkrótce wrócą do zdrowia.


![20260418_085152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23tvg5z6AKTg2KfL8MwrrM17trx7NXJdQqZws33VVgjZcyvCL1pWQY7KNqANkGnQcABEc.jpg)

![20260418_083742.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23z7DScL9TYfQmcMWAzrBwJh6Ag5eRFSUruMTPU6x4kp73BWm1FjwjrxwbrQ1shJKEwpo.jpg)

I also took a few photos of the space arranged for these cats by some truly wonderful people. You can really see how much heart and care went into it. The MUGAT association rose to the challenge and created a sanctuary for stray cats. It was clear that the cats feel this is their place — a safe haven they want to return to.

>Zrobiłam również kilka zdjęć zaaranżowanej przestrzeni dla tych kotków przez cudownych ludzi. Widać w tym wszystkim naprawdę bardzo dużo serca i staranności. Stowarzyszenie MUGAT stanęło na wysokości zadania i zbudowało dla bezdomnych kotów azyl. Naprawdę było widać, że kotki czują, że jest to ich miejsce, bezpieczna przystań, do której chcą wracać.



![20260418_084920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wWttKRXPjzQxjvUWnJ41mzq7Wo3QM9Ty2WiPhVNXzSpVEteLyXZ96zFvBS1GPCPGv6t.jpg)

![20260418_084340.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23uQnHjsvoL6SrG8MK87fkWU6Zh15Cmbk4dGDpMKZuEcnz7MMHrbnz1Sd8kFzDrA4DvHr.jpg)

![20260418_083647.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23vhwwax8QQMqV5bdPuejSpduSkHWohgHr9toZQcDcxDPMiVVrEg7KyubwJhGxgPpumhJ.jpg)

![20260418_083725.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23vsLSwKUbpPYg671sDopgF1LbDuorEG1kvovmpWfenvE7MQVGv5xHSZcd3x7mQmKRmYD.jpg)

![20260418_084829.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23w2cNKs62iCpv75S4hrvupvJw9Eh6cDy24dXvDZiTDVDXRPqRs1QUGB1Nfcvhh2ysX1D.jpg)

I also have to admit, I never would have expected to find a place like this in such a small town. I don’t think I’ve ever seen anything like it before. It was built in a completely open space and didn’t resemble a typical animal shelter at all. And I think that’s exactly what makes this place so special.

>Muszę też przyznać, że nigdy bym się nie spodziewała, że w tak małym miasteczku spotkam takie miejsce. Chyba nigdy nie widziałam takiego miejsca. Było to miejsce zbudowane w totalnie otwartej przestrzeni. Z niczym nie kojarzyło się z typowymi schroniskami dla zwierząt. I myślę, że to właśnie najbardziej czyni to miejsce wyjątkowym.

body.title: Overthinking: The Silent Killer of Opportunities...
body.body:
In today’s fast-moving world, thinking before making a decision is important. But what happens when thinking turns into overthinking? Instead of helping you move forward, it starts holding you back. Overthinking is like a silent enemy—it doesn’t make noise, but it slowly destroys your confidence, your time, and most importantly, your opportunities.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZwFNSLQdtgWiPkpFvzvHpsTUk4EPGAtELRAe5dcfzf8w/img_3786.png)

Overthinking begins with simple thoughts. You start analyzing every possible outcome, every risk, and every “what if.” At first, it feels like you are being careful and responsible. But soon, your mind gets trapped in a loop. You think so much that you stop taking action. And in life, missed actions often mean missed opportunities.

For example, imagine you want to apply for a job. You have the skills, but then your mind starts questioning—“What if I get rejected?” “What if I’m not good enough?” “What if others are better than me?” While you keep thinking, someone else applies without overthinking—and gets the opportunity. It’s not always the most talented person who wins, but the one who takes action at the right time.

Overthinking doesn’t just affect big decisions. It also impacts small, daily choices. Whether it’s starting a new project, talking to someone, or trying something new, overthinking creates fear and hesitation. It fills your mind with doubt and makes simple tasks feel complicated. Slowly, this habit becomes a pattern, and you begin to miss chances without even realizing it.

Another dangerous side of overthinking is that it drains your energy. Your mind is constantly busy, but not productive. You feel tired without doing anything meaningful. This mental exhaustion reduces your focus and confidence, making it even harder to take action. It’s a cycle that keeps repeating unless you consciously break it.

The truth is, no decision in life comes with a guarantee. You will never have 100% clarity. Waiting for the “perfect moment” or the “perfect plan” is just another form of overthinking. Opportunities don’t wait for perfection—they reward action.

So, how can you overcome overthinking? Start by simplifying your decisions. Give yourself a time limit to think, and once it’s over, take action. Focus on progress, not perfection. Accept that mistakes are part of growth. Most importantly, trust yourself. You don’t need to have everything figured out to take the first step.

In the end, life is not about thinking endlessly—it’s about doing. Overthinking may feel safe, but it quietly steals your chances to grow, succeed, and experience life fully. The next time you find yourself stuck in your thoughts, remind yourself: action creates opportunities, not overthinking.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPmVP53JytEx7m6DXBX2sp4p6zmaa8ajcdv3prHnrV9H5/0_wj9yq_ch2s3og5dg.gif)

body.title: What are you?
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfNCDvo7xeXS1WpsFYvkpaAh5CQTpSGKCExaqvbx3iXwp/ChatGPT%20Image%20Apr%2028,%202026,%2009_33_09%20PM.png 

The forest felt wrong.

I kept my eyes forward, just like he said, but it didn’t stop the feeling that something just outside my vision was keeping pace with us.

The tall man didn’t slow down. He never did.

“Don’t trust what you can see,” he said.

I frowned slightly. “You already said that.”

“No,” he replied, just as calmly. “I didn’t.”

I wasn’t sure if he was right. 

Something moved between the trees ahead, a shape trying to exist. I didn’t look at it. My eyes stayed fixed forward, even as the pressure behind them started building again.

“It’s changing what I see,” I said.

“It’s changing what you focus on,” he corrected before I could say anything more. “Keep moving.”

I went quiet.

There was something off about the way he said things. Not just what he said but when. Always just when I was about to speak.

We walked in silence for a while. Or maybe longer than a while.

For a second, I just stood there, staring at his back as he kept walking, his figure already starting to blur slightly against the shifting trees. Something cold settled into my chest.

“Wait,” I said, catching up quickly. “You said that already.”

“No,” he replied again, the same calm tone, the same steady pace. “I didn’t.”

\

I asked.

“Long enough,” he said.

The exact same words. The exact same rhythm.

A quiet dread crept in, slow and deliberate. “Ask me something,” I said.

\

“Anything,” I insisted.

A brief silence followed. Then, without turning, he said, “How long have we been walking?”

I opened my mouth to answer, but nothing came out.

Behind us.

Something was there. Something that hadn’t been there before. Or maybe it had. Maybe it always had.

“Don’t look back,” he said.

My body tensed. “Why?”

“Because it’s looking at you.”

I kept my eyes forward.

Step by step, we moved.

But the feeling didn’t fade. It became stronger; something was very, very wrong here.

And after a while, without meaning to, I spoke again.

“How long have we been walking?”

There was a pause.

Then, in the same calm voice, unchanged and certain—

“Long enough.”

I stopped in my tracks and looked ahead.

The tall man was still there. I don’t know when it happened…

but I knew—

That wasn’t him anymore.

body.title: at the National Theater of Cuba/\
, Teatro Nacional de Cuba (Esp-Eng)
body.body:
>

Hello, my friends from worldmappin. What a pleasure to greet you.

A few days ago, I went to the National Theater of Cuba, a colossus of concrete and glass located right in front of the Plaza. The idea was to see \

at the Avellaneda Hall, but this time it wasn't performed by the National Ballet of Cuba, but by the Laura Alonzo Ballet. I confess I felt that mix of skepticism and hope that sometimes precedes great encounters with art. I had already bought my tickets in advance, so I had my seat secured.
>Hola, mis amigos de worldmappin. Que placer saludarlos. 
>
>Hace algunos días fui al Teatro Nacional de Cuba, un coloso de hormigón y cristal que se encuentra ubicado frente a la Plaza. La idea era a ver \

en la Sala Avellaneda, pero esta vez no fue por el Ballet Nacional de Cuba, sino por el Ballet Laura Alonzo, y confieso que sentía esa mezcla de escepticismo y esperanza que a veces precede a las grandes citas con el arte. Ya había comprado las entradas con antelación así que tenía mi butaca segura.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2vNfR8AkAxFoX6CrzZWacJhB2zRVTmivWRirSKBTL8C/1777393136064.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeLi1bcYNzKC2g4SvANKdCLtNyqG217SW29xttxTE2Gnc/1777393273926.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcJgzvG3YsECUNZuDKJ35MEx6iZyAif5UqnwuT5L3xSgv/1777393274081.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfHxpoAszQWs1KLZzfhYMcboQJZVbGF2FQxXFxKTGXx4j/1777393136212.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNvqUcZQw5Qi5rqz7DVaFKmp6o4pxEQYgJw7qHFeD7sPn/1777393136495.jpg)

> The exterior of the theater is covered in abundant vegetation, and of course, the queen of our landscape couldn't be missing: the royal palm. Inside this grand theater there are two majestic halls: the Avellaneda, which pays tribute to the writer Gertrudis Gómez de Avellaneda; and the more intimate Covarrubias Hall, with a capacity for 850 spectators, named in honor of Francisco Covarrubias, considered the founder of Cuban theater. >Los exteriores del teatro están cubiertos de abundante vegetación y claro que no podía faltar la reina de nuestro paisaje, la palma real. En el interior de este gran teatro hay dos majestuosas salas: la Avellaneda, que rinde tributo a la escritora Gertrudis Gómez de Avellaneda; y la más íntima la Sala Covarrubias, para 850 espectadores, en honor a Francisco Covarrubias, considerado el fundador del teatro cubano.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeyLDrT5BncVxze8hvj3dKuniKkBuUYWLufhxJGZfX2K2/1777393219949.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdYBvuyzmmhtJ451A4LkE79B7KEUeb6ghigRVBmXycvDW/1777393220141.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmULpdMya4s8hhfKvkCQSvfen1pj4pGfTBmeLELo8bNPYx/1777393220347.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWGS8ayrBEXyXKs2weVEwkFNuwtEpkzRf3UHM7To2kPF4/1777393220535.jpg)

> It had been many years since I'd last been to this theater, and this was an excellent opportunity to enjoy something different. It was the last day of the classic's run, and of course I was one of the first to arrive. The Avellaneda Hall, with its capacity for over fifteen hundred people, slowly filled up. There were tourists and Cuban families from several generations, dance critics taking notes in the dim light. The air smelled of old wood and gardenia perfume. When the lights dimmed, a dense and magical silence enveloped us. >Hacía muchos años que no venía a este teatro y esta fue una excelente oportunidad para disfrutar de algo diferente. Era el último día de presentación del clásico y por supuesto que fui una de las primeras en llegar. La sala Avellaneda, con su capacidad para más de mil quinientas personas, se fue llenando poco a poco. Había turistas y familias cubanas de varias generaciones, críticos de danza que tomaban notas en la penumbra. El aire olía a madera vieja y a perfume de gardenias. Cuando las luces se atenuaron, un silencio denso y mágico nos envolvió.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb7towHi6S2LXGPTuMWuQZTpqhbodbMLZ4n7K68jWfQ9z/1777393219612.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTbKPHhf1hVwpF6WMPUzaUqgvWsCzWyQuqmRFb7mbmYeK/1777393317172.jpg)

> And then Tchaikovsky rang out – the Tchaikovsky of broken violins, of the impossible love between Odette and Siegfried. The first white feathers appeared on stage with nearly perfect synchronization. The dancers, trained in the Cuban school of ballet, weren't imitating swans: they were swans. Their arms rippled like wounded wings, their feet barely touched the ground; it seemed as if they truly flew. >Y entonces sonó Tchaikovsky, el de los violines quebrados, el del amor imposible entre Odette y Sigfrido. Las primeras plumas blancas aparecieron en el escenario con una sincronización casi perfecta. Las bailarinas, formadas en la escuela cubana de ballet, no imitaban cisnes: eran cisnes. Sus brazos ondulaban como alas heridas, sus pies apenas tocaban la tierra, parecía que en verdad volaban.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcjfup6wc4nZExvr3MFcpSssTpZm7523z9Vt5NmjTPLMa/1777393389594.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUSTnQbbMiVTtxcAS2NZrKT6DNPjhuYgRzGx2iX1NpDom/1777393389639.jpg)

> The lead ballerina was not a blonde, fair-eyed Slavic woman, but a Cuban woman with deep, penetrating eyes. And yet, there she was, Princess Odette with all her tragedy, all her broken charm. And I felt a sense of pride in Cuba, where the universal is tinged with the tropics and yet remains as authentic as the original work. I would have liked to take more photos, but that would have meant missing the enchantment of the night. Even so, here I share some scenes from the ballet. >La primera bailarina no era una eslava rubia de ojos claros, sino una cubana de mirada profunda. Y sin embargo, allí estaba la princesa Odette con toda su tragedia, todo su encanto roto. Y sentí orgullo de Cuba, donde lo universal se tiñe de trópico y aún así resulta tan auténtico como la obra original. Me hubiese gustado tomar más fotos pero era perderme del encanto de la noche. De todas formas, aquí les comparto algunas escenas de la obra.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTCuNxEScHKLn15wXfk7Uc6BvysLzpKDBU5woupza9zHx/1777393417751.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT3JVof6guCG9pFdhWvThqABR6h5hjDfEzJYuVpf2ouxZ/1777393417791.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVW2d1jDEt8WnqwrWCZSA5j6qr66kGaVBQydr1XQxscHb/1777393435295.jpg)

> The most thrilling moment came in the second act, when the Black Swan bursts in. Everyone in the hall held their breath. There were many spins on the same pointe, perfect, relentless. The people sitting next to me were taking photos to document the moment. It was as if the music entered the dancers through their feet and burst out through every part of their bodies. >El momento más emocionante llegó en el segundo acto, cuando el cisne negro irrumpe. Todo el mundo en la sala contuvo la respiración. Fueron muchos giros sobre la misma punta del pie, perfectos, implacables. Las personas sentadas a mi lado tomaban fotografías para dejar evidencias del momento. Tal parecía que a los bailarines la música que se le metía por los pies y le salía por todas partes del cuerpo.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQjorTURqFMTPucQ1CQ9EayrdZE5Fp5D2GdzoJ4pDuT13/1777393460220.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNbeK6HcmrK26PvXyGwECXf1HEnmvw6NQ2BmFokVjycUj/1777393460263.jpg)

> When the curtain fell, I clapped until my palms burned. I stepped out into the street amidst a crowd humming the waltz. The Havana night was warm, with a sky full of stars that seemed to dance in their own choreography. Crossing the plaza, I could still hear the violins. The truth is, true art doesn't need lavish sets or big budgets; it needs bodies that believe, artists who feel, souls that vibrate. And that, at the National Theater of Cuba, I found in every measure. I don't know when I'll set foot in this place again, because I live far away, but what I do know is that it was worth traveling so many kilometers. >Cuando cayó el telón, aplaudí hasta que me ardieron las palmas de las manos. Salí a la calle en medio de una multitud que tarareaba el vals. La noche habanera estaba cálida, con su cielo lleno de estrellas que parecían que danzaban en una coreografía. Cruzando la plaza, aún escuchaba los violines. Y es que el arte verdadero no necesita escenografías suntuosas ni grandes presupuestos, necesita cuerpos que crean, artistas que sientan, almas que vibren. Y eso, en el Teatro Nacional de Cuba, lo encontré en cada compás. No sé cuando volveré a pisar este sitio porque vivo muy lejos, pero lo que si sé es que valió la pena recorrer tantos kilómetros.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTjT2d4JhEw6KNTxwJy6Y59LDLye958obcP5iLW46JnAM/1777393496041.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP69XwJidesM3wuJDqSxApHweCDTL1rgZhdxg6c8Toji5/1777393496081.jpg) https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJDibgVv7QpnG7cFRyL8RrNKwrY4Tkx4636U9mec4jSH/img_8206.gif Gracias por visitar mi blog Texto e imágenes de mi propiedad Thanks to visite my blog Text and imagen are my own https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmftReAUFLd1o6yeBP8wg9ths82CW6Fpu7doGEYgCEWV/img_7269.jpg

body.body:
[Chapters 1-12](https://ecency.com/hive-199275/@olivebluegreen/as-yet-untitled-a-space-saga-the-recap) 
[Chapter 13](https://ecency.com/hive-199275/@olivebluegreen/as-yet-untitled-a-space-saga-part-13)
[Chapter 14](https://ecency.com/hive-199275/@olivebluegreen/as-yet-untitled-a-space-saga-part)

Chapter 15
Empress Ranessa

The first time I laid  eyes on Valoria, something inside of me just settled into place. I felt whole. I felt…right. And she has always been the best thing in my life. I have done my best to help her navigate the sometimes thorny world of palace politics and encourage her empathy for the people she will one day rule. 

I know I can never explain this to anyone else, but we are connected.

This is why as much as I missed her when she disappeared, I have not actually been concerned about her wellbeing. I know that she is happy because I feel it. I know that she did not tell me she was leaving so that I would not be forced to lie on her behalf and I know that she will send word to me as soon as possible. I would bet my life a certain stablehand has run away with her too so at least she's not alone.

It's the waiting that kills me. My only child is out there in a dangerous world so different from her cloistered palace existence. It benefits me to allow people around to assume my mood is because I think some harm has come to her so I am in no hurry to correct them.

As word reaches the castle that Graxoth has rescued Valoria from the extraterrestrial monster, I can admit to a moment of uncertainty. But when he enters the castle carrying what appears to be a very battered Valoria in his arms, I feel a strange macabre sense of relief.

I have no idea who that poor creature is but, Valoria she is not.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQRDvQh7tnyiXnuDHvUDycnSabKkKGrh9snbjrZKmDtME/1000010779.jpg 

[*Image*](https://pixabay.com/photos/space-planet-earth-planet-stars-1903435/)

*****

So ends Chapter 15. Any questions or comments? I'm almost at the point where I'll finish the rest of this series offline and polished it for publishing. But I'll try to get another out soon enough, definitely eventually.

links.title: The Untouchable Elite :)
links.body: The Untouchable Elite :)\n\nI had reason to smile when I called this post \

and maybe that sounds too grandiose, but life shows that's true when it comes to photographers, or simply people like you and me who hold a camera in their hands. Yes, photographers are forgiven a lot, because what might be considered idleness in other occupations is, for a photographer, work. Imagine a steelworker standing next to a forge of molten metal, and instead of his regular duties, he stands for hours admiring the molten metal as it flows from the forge into an overflowing mold. The metal begins to spill across the floor, and he watches with curiosity. Or an engineer standing over a drawing board, instead of working on a drawing, watches a pesky fly hovering above it. I'm sure the head of the design department will reprimand him and remind him of the deadlines stipulated in the design services contract. And a photographer, in his spare time from his main occupation, can practice both steelmaking and design. ![DSC03889.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmbq4JRDYC2XtQrVnWdZ6E8vYk4TKhG5VhygFUEPvLKLmP/DSC03889.JPG) With a camera in hand, time flies. I've tested it many times, and before you can take a hundred photos, a couple of hours slip away, but there's no sense of wasted time. ![DSC03890.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmYmj7vgcgUjiLAU2h56P2RhrMsFdihp5KkufAwxA6TNoR/DSC03890.JPG) The object of such observations, which swallow up time without judgment, can be anything: insects, animals, people, landscapes, or, as in this case, ripples on the surface of a lake, in which the multicolored reflections of pedal boats pulled onto the shore are visible. ![DSC03891.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmUkCf5Fkg7v3scTZWreeDPLZKjYeyJVSfuZKKKzWLSrjM/DSC03891.JPG) No one's pushing you, you choose what you watch and how much time you spend on it. links.body:
![ideogram-v3.0_Dark_blue_background_cracked_golden_Bitcoin_coin_red_numbers_290M_glowing_on_dig-0.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdQgzzuiaDL7JcrjxbLrkX1EeZqZiQnKVqJvDhN6ArwXx/ideogram-v3.0_Dark_blue_background_cracked_golden_Bitcoin_coin_red_numbers_290M_glowing_on_dig-0.jpg)

What is it Defi ?
Decentralized Finance Is a financial system on the blockchain allows users to transfer and borrow money without a third party such as banks, the operations are managed by something called the smart contract is to transfer money and deal with requests around the clock means there is no lie or delay and confidence is very high, but with all these positives there is a strong negative, which is that there is no broker bears responsibility also if the smart contract is exposed to the breach means you are fully responsible There is no bank to compensate you or a number to contact him and inquire from him

 

what happened in the attack!
On April 18, 2026, the big attack happened, hackers stole about $290 million from Aave before we knew how the attack happened, to know what Aave is a decentralized platform where users put their money to get an annual benefit, which is the largest in this area

 

 

FDIC vs DeFi: The Insurance Gap Explained؟
When you give your money to the bank, the bank invests money and gives you interest and stores money in the event of theft of money or any error in the bank there is a party responsible for your compensation you have a guarantee but in DiFe the subject is very different There is no official body for a company that follows the money only software code on the blockchain network manages everything You don't give your money to the owner of the code to change and do everything if a mistake occurs to the code is wrong You are responsible

links.title: The Cougar's End.
links.body:
[![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSh33cG2SfC4qZags7en6XXirWmejd9cY2he6AkgagjCk/a1f782adb0c4c1f49b7d5ec076a38817)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=siaaam/c911cada)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=siaaam/c911cada)


---

I fought a desperate battle against a cougar after Jonah provided a distraction with a flare gun. Following a tense struggle through the trees and brush, I finally defeated the predator. The pair set up camp for the night to tend to Lara's wounds and share a meal before a flashback began.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWWBRhraiLVRY8j4twPc3jJfTxMQoxpsxhQJcsjkvxLJx/screenshot_1_.png)

When Lara was struggling with the cougar, Jonah threw a flare gun towards her from the cave. It was the least he could do from that position, but the bright light should've provide the distraction she needed to gain some distance. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXD8kZoow2bvcA5KRYDhURqjyGY5m5fvAm7tx7BAfQYjh/screenshot_2_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmThiBH7gmj2jdVKy8mdDtU6JsbMpoicy7ww61zDTjm9os/screenshot_3_.png)

I got only one shot on the cougar when it jumped at me with terrifying speed, and I triggered the flare gun that pushed the beast back. The impact just spooked the cougar instead of killing it. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUhtD8476vSZnwmKUsaMi6GaBCpHkfE2s653yS5k1zVJG/screenshot_4_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaToy2NYDb7H5cBEHqi8nVQ8gX9AWnykJ2YLps2uQBkv9/screenshot_5_.png)

The cougar then started charging at me again with renewed aggression. While I had some arrows left in my quiver, I used them on the beast until I was completely out of ammo. Each shot seemed to slow it down slightly, but the predator was determined to finish the fight despite the injuries.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS6GM1igJhaevyregeCbGMH2xe5YkbCeryiP2JkJNXxL2/screenshot_6_.png)

I climbed up on this tree to see if I could escape from the beast or get a better vantage point for a melee strike. However, I forgot that cougars are well-trained at climbing trees.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQJQzxfY62kqEHb1ogidCV19RVQjvK3PEE1J7wNtDg3Ch/screenshot_7_.png)

It followed me up and attacked me so I fell off the tree. Then the beast jumped on me, where I had to push its teeth using the climbing axe so it won't tear Lara apart.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUgMrQ9xo82FMg4RQWSCfRxap2GBGNjJwC2VastKzY1Qv/screenshot_8_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT1ySzf5vnKsKhwW4HCXFFGfDXKdWeJ7AkAu1yzSxwrgf/screenshot_9_.png)

After surviving this attack hardly, I had to prepare for a long and exhausting fight. The cougar kept running away into the brush after each attacks, so I had to run after it without giving it a chance to recover and come for me again. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSsMEsoRdU9TN7Uh7dK6nLToqHMnFUP3vkG2d7btRvSr7/screenshot_10_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZbKueh4QaqQit23EgDSRMdNj7eFunwoEZvJzkbRT6Jg5/screenshot_11_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZDwFC8gboRGPd5SmM7NWFEjcQJDmPwSFwA2cHWb4H4XM/screenshot_12_.png)

At last, after a lot of struggle and movement, I delivered the final attack with my climbing axe. The cougar still tried to approach me with its last bit of strength, but it finally fell down and died.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdtR8aECQ2kZnfyU68yXtcM2m1dU7kcYShCScCVPLAG8n/screenshot_13_.png)

Lara helped Jonah come out of the cave once the area was finally secured. She then started skinning the cougar to get its pelt and meat, knowing that nothing should go to waste in the wilderness.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPTPrwnETieEh2tUoh8k7ana46mfYULtUeYBoYa5mZoNE/screenshot_14_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVCsMqAcaEW9ignXYL5AeUVzcffUwxHV6FEmEdbwmt1s7/screenshot_15_.png)

While Lara was stitching the pelt of the cougar to use as extra protection, Jonah was cooking something for them at night. They had set up a small camp, and the warmth of the fire was a welcome change from the damp jungle. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSeiqUcR3zwSyZy2oBTPxe9zRadfshNoUUKTDep8DjmtZ/screenshot_16_.png)

Jonah wanted to help heal up the wound on Lara's back, and it was really bad. Lara gritted her teeth against the pain, showing the toughness that had kept her alive this far.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeiiKg8EYdKoD4zPWsLvpxur8rUT7mSRgaDMFTURsaHs6/screenshot_17_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPq6CF5wDtYmLYRHiJTxK9GjsfQ5aGGssSp9UTSeoMpFF/screenshot_18_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV2dYB6s3Ziu19qzcmMX3JFYZ1tRCen25W1r5YyR8HoPP/screenshot_19_.png)

After that, they had some of those meals that Jonah prepared over the open flame. I still wonder where they got those equipment's from, as they seemed well-prepared for a cooking session despite the plane crash. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVpDyxcqGjCzgo7tGpbnbFBHxVDVGqXgiguUNEuQnZo2C/screenshot_20_.png)

When they were having the meal, they were talking about something from their past. It looked like there was going to be a flashback next. I watched as the scene transitioned, moving from the dangerous present back to a memory from Lara's childhood.

info.title: The Cougar's End.
info.author: siaaam

content.description:
I fought a desperate battle against a cougar after Jonah provided a distraction with a flare gun. Following a tense struggle through the trees and brush, I finally defeated the predator. The pair set up camp for the night to tend to Lara's wounds and share a meal before a flashback began.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWWBRhraiLVRY8j4twPc3jJfTxMQoxpsxhQJcsjkvxLJx/screenshot_1_.png)

When Lara was struggling with the cougar, Jonah threw a flare gun towards her from the cave. It was the least he could do from that position, but the bright light should've provide the distraction she needed to gain some distance.

I got only one shot on the cougar when it jumped at me with terrifying speed, and I triggered the flare gun that pushed the beast back. The impact just spooked the cougar instead of killing it. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUhtD8476vSZnwmKUsaMi6GaBCpHkfE2s653yS5k1zVJG/screenshot_4_.png)

links.title: Community Healing Circles: Sharing and Supporting Recovery
links.body:
## The Architecture of Shared Recovery

The concept of a community healing circle is rooted in the ancient tradition of gathering to share experiences, trauma, and triumphs within a safe, non-hierarchical space. Unlike traditional clinical therapy, which often maintains a professional distance, healing circles prioritize the collective wisdom of peers who have walked similar paths.

In the modern context of substance use recovery and mental health support, these circles serve as a vital scaffold for long-term sobriety. By fostering a sense of radical belonging, participants can dismantle the shame often associated with addiction and find the motivation to sustain their journey. For individuals navigating the early, fragile stages of recovery, specifically those pursuing a [THC drug detox](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/the-right-way-to-thc-drug-detox/), the stability provided by a consistent, non-judgmental group can be the difference between isolation and connection.

## Establishing the Healing Environment

A successful healing circle relies on the intentional cultivation of a \

This is not necessarily a religious term, but rather an agreement among participants that the room, physical or virtual, is a zone of emotional safety, radical honesty, and mutual respect.

The facilitator plays a crucial role in maintaining this atmosphere, acting more as a steward than an authority figure. They ensure that communication remains respectful, interruptions are minimized, and every voice—regardless of how quiet—is afforded the opportunity to be heard.

## The Mechanics of Vulnerability

Vulnerability is the primary currency in any healing circle. It is through the act of sharing one’s deepest struggles that the power of those struggles is diminished. When a participant speaks their truth, it inevitably resonates with others, creating a powerful ripple effect of validation.

This process is fundamentally transformative. It shifts the narrative of recovery from an individual struggle against a moral failing to a collective effort toward overcoming a shared human experience.

## Navigating the Physical and Biological Hurdles

While emotional support is the heartbeat of these circles, practitioners often acknowledge the biological realities of recovery. Physical dependence is a complex hurdle, and many individuals find that medical support is a necessary bridge to the emotional work of the circle.

For many, this includes exploring medication-assisted options to manage cravings and neurochemical imbalances. If you are exploring clinical support, searching for a [vivitrol shot near me](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/vivitrol-clinics-near-me-that-provide-online-prescription/) can often provide the chemical foundation needed to engage more deeply and consistently with the psychological work conducted in a support group setting.

## Evidence-Based Collective Care

The efficacy of support groups is not merely anecdotal; it is deeply rooted in psychosocial research. Peer-led interventions have been shown to significantly improve outcomes by creating accountability networks that extend well beyond the designated meeting time.

The importance of social support in the addiction recovery process has been extensively documented by the[ National Institute on Drug Abuse (NIDA)](https://nida.nih.gov/), which emphasizes that successful long-term recovery is most attainable when a combination of behavioral therapies and social support systems are utilized in tandem. This integrated approach ensures that the individual is not only addressing the physical symptoms of dependence but also rebuilding the social infrastructure necessary to thrive in a post-recovery life.

## Overcoming Obstacles to Group Participation

Resistance to joining a healing circle is common, often stemming from social anxiety, past trauma, or a deep-seated fear of judgment. However, the paradox of recovery is that we often need the very thing we are most afraid to pursue.

Overcoming this requires small, incremental steps. Prospective participants are encouraged to observe a meeting, speak with a peer mentor, or join in a listening-only capacity. The goal is to lower the barrier to entry until the community feels like a home rather than an obligation.

## Sustaining Momentum Through Connection

Recovery is rarely a linear trajectory; it is a series of peaks and valleys. The healing circle provides the necessary community buffer during the valleys. When an individual feels the urge to relapse, the knowledge that they have a circle of peers awaiting their return can provide a critical pause—a moment of reflection that disrupts the cycle of self-destruction.

Furthermore, these groups often evolve into secondary support structures, such as sober social activities, job networking, and mentorship programs. This organic expansion turns a weekly meeting into a comprehensive lifestyle shift.

## Building a Future of Collective Resilience

As we look toward the future of addiction medicine and mental health care, the role of peer-led healing circles will only increase in importance. We are witnessing a shift away from purely institutional models toward community-integrated care.

By embracing these spaces, society acknowledges a simple but profound truth: no one heals in a vacuum. We are social beings, and our recovery is, in many ways, an act of re-socialization—a return to the warmth and safety of the human collective.

---

links.title: Encountering Corruption Everywhere
links.body:
/></center>

[source](https://marriagedynamics.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/danger.jpg)






Being a supplier in South Africa you have to tread carefully because so many companies are affected by internal corruption. When you visit these companies you do so with an open mind because not everything is as normal as it seems. Supplying packaging material should not be complicated or have any form of risk yet it is a minefield and you have to be careful where you walk.

Over the years I have learned through experience to spot things that are not normal and these red flags depending on the size of the company can have serious consequences. In the past I would poke the bear in order to unravel the internal theft, but these days I have learned to stay well clear as it consumes too much time due to certain individuals blocking you.

Packaging tells you so much about a company like how well they are doing, are they growing and how well the business is being run. If a business is growing in sales the first thing that is impacted is the packaging orders and as a supplier you know their monthly volumes so it tells you immediately. late payments suggest a cash flow problem which could be down to growth which is not normally a serious concern or it could be down to more serious financial problems internally. I have witnessed companies that were over 50 years old hit the wall and I had given them warnings 2 years before it happened because I saw the signals.

In the past week I have uncovered another bees nest of corruption and the problem is I am not sure how high the company ladder this goes. The owner could be the one behind it and see this as a way of earning tax free cash or it could be in upper management which kind of tells me the owner is involved somewhere. packaging is a cost to the business so this is written ff against the costs via tax and the business is basically hiding the real costs and pocketing the rest.

This is all about understanding the numbers and I know what volumes this company was using with regard to pallet wrap. Yes innocent old pallet wrap tells it's own story as their volume has doubled within the last 6 months telling me two things. The business has doubled in size which it has not or the pallet wrap has shrunk in size by half and they are basically paying double. The company is in cahoots with their supplier and are basically stealing R100K monthly ($6K) from their own company.

This is just an example of what is happening in the market place and why you need to be paying attention and have an open mind. I have uncovered theft happening in the millions and these people will stop at nothing to protect their little scheme. How far would they go to protect this secret I have no idea and why I step away because the risks are that high.

We are not talking about one or two companies doing these types of schemes and it is rampant. When you find what I would call a normal company you celebrate because then at least you have a chance of landing their business. 

The problem is companies are finding creative ways of generating cash due to  the harsh taxes that exist. This is not all about the employees being corrupt and the owners in many cases are the corrupt ones. When the prices rise like they have recently by over 50% and again at the end of this month by another 11% they are the ones who are benefitting because it gives them an opportunity to steal even more.

As frustrating as this is for myself being a supplier at least I am well aware of what is taking place and I am sure this is not just a South African problem and is most likely taking place all around the world. Shocking really when you think about it because the problem is growing and the task becomes harder finding legitimate companies willing to do business the normal way.

hecha por la directiva de los Medias Rojas de Boston, las redes sociales estallaron en análisis y acusaciones respecto sobre quien recalaba la culpa, del desastre en Fenway Park. Así las cosas, la única parte del cuerpo técnico que no fue despedida, fue el staff de coaches de pitcheo ¿La razón? La manifiesta recuperación de los números en ese departamento de los patirrojos, al ver como Crochet y compañía, han recuperado el control de su mecánica y la recolección de resultados como consecuencia de ello. Y si no nos creen pueden tomar como ejemplo la apertura de ayer en el Roger Centre de Toronto, del abridor natural de Pie de Cuesta Ranger Suárez, enfrentado con la estrella del pitcheo de los Azulejos Dylan Cease. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     The cream always rises to the top, and in this game, your stuff doesn't lie. After the front office cleaned house in Boston, the Twitter-verse went nuclear trying to pin a tail on the donkey for the Fenway disaster. But notice who didn’t get pink-slipped: the coaches pitching staff. Why? Because the Red Sox arms have been dealing lately. You can see it in guys like Crochet and the rest of the rotation—they’ve locked in their mechanics and are finally hitting their spots. If you need proof, just look at yesterday’s clash at the Rogers Centre. We saw a real pitcher's duel between Pie de Cuesta’s own Ranger Suárez and the Blue Jays' ace, Dylan Cease.

# ---

![Suárez.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23wWwKV1Rpcmq1DyFMXmrxZVcnLuEN12NTEKBgY61Fs6kVJME3mF3xQahBo7Wb9igmdvv.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/red-sox-vs-blue-jays/2026/04/27/822825/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     El problema de las redes sociales con Ranger, radica en que no es un lanzador de bola de humo, así de simple. El tipo usa el cerebro y su arsenal para sacar de paso a los contrarios. Y lo hizo de nuevo anoche: ocho episodios completos, un solo hit permitido (un doble en el quindo que acabó con el no-no), sin carreras en contra y pasando por la guillotina a 10 hombres, con un solo boleto. El cátcher venezolano Carlos Narváez no solo recibió el juego, sino que colaboró al botar la pelota de jonrón. Además, el maracucho Wilyer Abreu bateó doble impulsor de una, para redondear una victoria de 5 a 0, de los indígenas sobre los canadienses. Es el 3er. juego seguido donde el triunfo acompaña a los Medias Rojas y parece que el cambio de líderes en el dugout ha funcionado. La victoria ofrece la oportunidad de acercarse a los demás equipos en la división y entrega esperanzas sobre la posible remontada ya que, por vez primera en la zafra los muchachos de Massachussets logran encadenar tres triunfos en la temporada. Estaremos a la expectativa. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      The beef on social media with Ranger is simple: he’s not a flamethrower. The guy relies on his IQ and his arsenal to keep hitters off-balance. And he did it again last night: 8 frames of work, giving up just one knock (a double in the 5th that spoiled the no-no), zero runs, and fanning 10 batters with only one free pass. Behind the dish, Venezuelan catcher Carlos Narváez didn’t just call a great game; he also went yard. To top it off, Maracaibo’s own Wilyer Abreu smoked an RBI double to seal a 5-0 shutout for the Sox over the Jays. That’s three in a row for Boston, and it looks like the new leadership in the dugout is paying off. This W helps them climb back into the division race and gives fans hope for a turnaround, as it’s the first time this season the boys from Mass have strung together three straight wins. We'll be watching closely.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUAxEhpUm34jcKzjmTnT6qai2c1G7ACtYJf1GCbFBgF39/20260428_004247.jpg)


On the afternoon of April 26, I was preparing to go out on my motorcycle. Suddenly, my eyes fell on the looking glass. I saw a strangely beautiful and colorful caterpillar walking there on its tiny legs. I was fascinated by it, so without delay, I gently took it down from the glass and took some pictures.
​This small creature is called Taiwan yellow tussock moth (scientific name: Euproctis taiwana). Its most attractive feature is its bright orange head and a long line of the same color running across its back. Its entire body is covered in long, soft gray and black hairs.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWWdP9z2N6gjMhkm7nG5MDXZRAw3vjwHFMtkoHYg1dNxa/20260428_004354.jpg)

links.title: Ugliest Animal Challenge - Beauty Is Relative, But This Is Absolute, Amazing Nature (AN)
links.body:
----
Taking a little time to get out and enjoy the outdoors with the ultimate goal of finding the ugliest yet most interesting animals is an exciting challenge for me to take on this April.
----

![IMG-20260428-WA0050.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcpgEhWYpuA9GidCEnbmL1HrQx9uGeDMgpg7X7aFAE9AM/IMG-20260428-WA0050.jpg)

<div class=\

>

Hello nature-loving friends, wherever you are, I hope you are all healthy and happy so you can go about your daily activities as usual. I hope you all have a wonderful day.

In this blog, I'm taking part in the April challenge held by our beloved community, the Ugliest Animal Challenge.
In this challenge, I've chosen the Bush Cricket, also known as the Lesser Sword Grasshopper, which belongs to the Orthoptera family, along with the grasshopper, as the candidate for the ugliest animal.

So, please continue following my blog to see this animal through the images I share, along with brief explanations of each animal.

![IMG-20260428-WA0034.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTyUvUBuixLLPrbUNi2vJdCCb98rRoXmzMaaPJ8f1dQ47/IMG-20260428-WA0034.jpg)

![IMG-20260428-WA0035.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYuExPnpR3THBdxis3dAEQJdAfRQQALFQkSKCBosiDnqo/IMG-20260428-WA0035.jpg)

![IMG-20260428-WA0038.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd7Cdwa9jyrFhGvD9pjJfvRg3JHR196L7m36CXVXrsyfv/IMG-20260428-WA0038.jpg)

![IMG-20260428-WA0036.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZuKSbsvEMK1fjgF6vwdyRDnKUHrFy3ZX6r8Z6kwcZJaa/IMG-20260428-WA0036.jpg)

![IMG-20260428-WA0037.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU5isq1rndxYVfRHGLfcqbtQhzYBjCWRX6CbHgetJpzBX/IMG-20260428-WA0037.jpg)

![IMG-20260428-WA0033.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc1jLhXntgL2SH4uX7pn4pgLYRqE95FTztkc68iRDUDfL/IMG-20260428-WA0033.jpg)

![IMG-20260428-WA0032.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ5vLARivADZAHP1t59VGfqJwuWn7fe1eNefgmp4LAPFd/IMG-20260428-WA0032.jpg)

*Difficult choice*

When I first saw the title of this April's contest challenge, several options crossed my mind, one of which was a monkey.

However, after some discussion, I ultimately decided to look for another animal that met the main judging criteria. I felt the animals I needed right now were ugly, strange, and unusual.

So, I took the initiative to focus on small animals. One reason is because I like aesthetic images. It's not that large animals make images unaesthetic. However, considering that the camera I use is a cell phone, it's a bit difficult for me to capture images of large animals from angles with simple equipment that create aesthetic images. I felt a small animal was the right choice. Besides being easy to capture, it's also very interesting to explore the main judging criteria, one of which is being unusual.

![IMG-20260428-WA0029.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdxdZMUGrT1uAb74nu9FkdTxkP4ETyEZyPTKYbDqYeUxH/IMG-20260428-WA0029.jpg)

![IMG-20260428-WA0028.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRA57GgjQCeD1icqaHnWRuMGfk8MNh6VnTNpho71Ho8Ds/IMG-20260428-WA0028.jpg)

![IMG-20260428-WA0031.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPABrFUuk5UbWinsqepgPfRbxJJbJDjBtxaLwapnzQFJw/IMG-20260428-WA0031.jpg)

![IMG-20260428-WA0030.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfBqsbxE6Jv8wE4vJ7FktkUh2DSv25co87xgLnJKfYaow/IMG-20260428-WA0030.jpg)

*Looking for a Fun Area*

The green open space is the perfect place for me to look for small animals. As a farmer and often accompanying my uncle on plantation trips, I found it easy to find open areas with small animals.

Furthermore, the unique atmosphere of green open spaces with pristine forests makes a unique impression on me. The serene atmosphere and cool air make the challenge of finding small animals even more lively. And when it drizzles, I think you can imagine how that atmosphere makes me nostalgic for my childhood. It's a little scary, but I can confirm that it's one of the most memorable experiences I've ever had as a child. Have you ever been caught in an open space with pristine forests and drizzling rain as a child?

![IMG-20260428-WA0039.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPbsAb9SWFY2TBTiyFkTCFoSQxyvugdRPAqgBXRSNahj9/IMG-20260428-WA0039.jpg)

![IMG-20260428-WA0041.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdhPBUWPx9GLGHZ7jZA6PphgYRrNaCVLLfZN9Qq5ynrqh/IMG-20260428-WA0041.jpg)

![IMG-20260428-WA0040.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWJe4qw8fXrAd4TWrPGX1jVgVseRC31Z3XCx9vucLfQG3/IMG-20260428-WA0040.jpg)

![IMG-20260428-WA0042.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNq3f6n1LtmcmZTybuWXmNjPUZc25cPuRFLctnDJdr9vk/IMG-20260428-WA0042.jpg)

*Interesting things I found*

Besides completing this month's challenge, I also discovered some interesting things in the open air.

One of them is a wild plant, a childhood pastime I enjoyed, as I often picked the fruit from these plants. When I dipped the fruit in water, it would explode.

I think I'll share a blog post about this plant in the future, as it's very interesting to me.


![IMG-20260428-WA0047.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWn3SkSaTcwyXH83cGZsQPniyRhHnTDSNUuBoQzvBvcXb/IMG-20260428-WA0047.jpg)

And finally, I found a candidate for the ugliest animal challenge: the Bush Cricket, better known as the Lesser Sword Grasshopper.

My friend...
The reason I chose this little creature was because its antennae are longer than its body, making it unique. Its legs are skewed, making it appear thin and awkward, making it unusual. And most importantly, its overall shape is what made me personally choose it as the ugliest animal candidate. Besides, its perch was perfect, on the edge of a thin leaf, making the image look aesthetically pleasing.

I'm also very satisfied with the results of the image I took with this simple cell phone. The focus is sharp and the background is blurred, making it (Aesthetically Ugly) in my opinion.

![IMG-20260428-WA0045.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXfCGbj1wX9eF3BAu742HoWBj5wNd3M4WksCfqAqCHqg2/IMG-20260428-WA0045.jpg)

![IMG-20260428-WA0048.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdgCgKBuH8ZyaDGjMTnSXNKDcJqdeVLZSvvXFVWRCMqEg/IMG-20260428-WA0048.jpg)

![IMG-20260428-WA0043.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcmNgo4oscTQ1m3uznECmm8d8Vx8Zec8Nehi7s41KXZvC/IMG-20260428-WA0043.jpg)

---
Meets the criteria, Ugly, Strange and Uncommon
---
From the whole, I can conclude that this small insect is very ugly in my personal opinion, its antennae are 3 times longer than its body, its bulging black round eyes to its color combination that I don't like at all which looks very strange, and apart from that, what makes the criteria unusual is that the majority of us think that grasshoppers are green with a decent size, but this one? I can say that in my opinion this insect looks transparent, what do you all think friends?

---
Which makes it look scary
---

My friend....
For me personally, he looks very scary, one of the reasons is because of his eyeballs, which give a very scary impression, besides that, this insect is also still a nymph or young insect whose diet consists mostly of plants but occasionally they can also be predators (I personally don't know the diet of this type of nymph, please correct me if I'm wrong) then you can imagine if its size is the size of a palm, how scary the jaw of the insect is.

---
Interesting Things About It
---

My friend...
Although I chose this insect as the ugliest animal candidate, we also need to know its interesting factors. Its long antennae are sophisticated sensors that can detect threats and find food. Besides that, I think you have often heard the sound of crickets, and I can say that they are Nature's Musicians. How could they not? Male crickets sing with their wings to call females. Another interesting factor I found on the internet is that in many cultures, crickets are a symbol of perseverance.

![IMG-20260428-WA0046.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRYLVeYAqzGSF9RU4qbrV1vvZuDH53So6rG8mHijtR2Vg/IMG-20260428-WA0046.jpg)

![IMG-20260428-WA0044.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQz7aoD5WDgyQNeiwF5zM3x3PUostqs5HLtssf1wbkRVh/IMG-20260428-WA0044.jpg)

Alright, my friends, those are some of the images I'm sharing at this meeting. I chose one of the nymphs (young insects) as a candidate for the ugliest animal to participate in the April challenge held by this beloved community.

I hope you all enjoy and are entertained by what I've shared, and that there are also a few lessons we can learn from this simple blog of mine:

\

This insect also taught me that not all imperfections need to be hidden. Sometimes the most honest are the most different, and within those imperfections lies a strength that most people rarely know. That's all for now. Please leave comments, support, and input, as it means a lot to me, so I can make this blog even better in the future. Greetings everyone. See you in the next contest. ---- ---- Camera used | Handphone | - | - Lens | 64 mp F-stop | Iso speed | ISO Focal length | MM Photography | Conocephalus ictus Photographer | @antonydossantos ---- About the author ---- Maulizar Mawardi or better known as @antonydossantos. I am a student. Like taking pictures, but not a professional photographer, insect lover, nature lover, looking for momentum is my hobby. ----

Here you can see weekly chart of Hive price. Hive price is in a descending channel since 10th October market crash. Lots of altcoins touched the bottom level after this market crash. links.title: Splinterlands Diary: Gold 3 and Gold 2 wins in the same day and great rewards
links.body:
> How are you all? I hope you are all well. I am so happy today! Those who play Splinterlands regularly know how challenging it can be to progress through each tier or league in this game. Especially when you are at a competitive level like the Gold League. But today was a little special for me. Because today I incredibly made it through Gold III and Gold II at the same time. This achievement is a big deal to me, and so I thought I would share the story of my journey and the rewards I received with you. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRS2hx9qoYCVtjRBig6CvvBMtTawWAoGsEqthRBcUYK8x/1777392124458.jpg) It started with unlocking the Gold 3 league. Fighting in the Modern format is now much more difficult than before. Because everyone here enters the field with very calculated and powerful cards. After many ups and downs, when the text 'UNLOCKED MODERN GOLD III' appeared on the screen, a strange satisfaction was working. After reaching Gold 3, my rating increased, as well as the value of the rewards. But I did not know that today's surprise did not end here. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaLG719LN33ttv2183bm3MXADe9pEiNQh7RPxc2qsnFUX/1777392148193.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXkVmMiWnn93j5pmpXMWMAAekzp3MyWw2fXLXzCvRcsU3/1777392148216.jpg) After unlocking the league, it was my turn to open the rewards or loot. As a reward for the Gold 3 league, I got 7 general and 4 special chests. The excitement that comes with opening these chests in Splinterlands is difficult to find in any other game. My mind was racing to see what was inside each chest. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQN5xV3FRMadvPhCSckf7LS7TtarH5ZMSDNkDyvQzxvo2/1777392165840.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRrreTfH56idbYqnDfgDmrEX62Y5MpSn6SWzrUcypNLM6/1777392165865.jpg) Before opening the chests, I always make sure to use the right amount of potions. Because using Legendary Potions greatly increases the chances of getting good quality and Legendary cards. I had 94 Legendary Potions, from which I decided to use 11. These small tricks are what bring big wins in the game. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPSvHka7RqAtpULWn2AfybFhNf3WfbX4EwEjCvfiTiQSC/1777392187263.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdHgCPXE2gytmSiMrbBScoQGKgZvkN6a5w11QAJriWcCp/1777392187319.jpg) Then the reward reveal started. When some cards and Merits started coming, I was quite happy. I got some nice cards like 'Cullborn Revenant', 'Ironwing Juggernaut' and 'Surgeblade'. In addition, 96 Merits will be very helpful for shopping in my guild shop. Along with some Common Scrolls, which will be useful for upgrading cards in the future. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdChb598nQceRm8Ysz795tEuDpzUDHTNRetSknYJJwuyG/1777392200619.jpg) But the biggest surprise was getting a Gold Foil card! I got a 'Magmaforged' gold foil card. This card is not only beautiful to look at, but also has a high market value and gameplay value. I also added some more merits and rare scrolls to my collection. Honestly, the rewards of Gold 3 really encouraged me. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXkVmMiWnn93j5pmpXMWMAAekzp3MyWw2fXLXzCvRcsU3/1777392218999.jpg) After passing Gold 3, I didn't think I would be able to reach Gold 2 today. But after a few consecutive wins, my rating started to increase rapidly, and finally, I was able to unlock 'MODERN GOLD II'. As you know, to survive in Gold 2 and get a 10x reward multiplier, you need to have around 37,000 to 58,900 SPS stacked. This was a big milestone for me. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX7Rx2NGkqjt6bxyocdk5KHFLzFSqT198tRXQ6eX36qcT/1777392231052.jpg) After reaching the Gold 2 league, the rewards became even heavier. This time, I had 8 and 5 chests as loot. More rewards than before means the possibility of getting better cards. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRWRB7ENuZiZQGgSU4DiSybbuxTNAUfuhV7WoHjk1tAgn/1777392242501.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTCSh2N2YGAd5Kuot8WWQfcn1koeFBTYk1q4sXoUmGr35/1777392242523.jpg) When I started opening the rewards one by one, I saw 'Coralforged' and some other valuable cards. I also got Alchemy Potion Charge and Legendary Potion Charge. 146 Merit and some Common Scrolls were added to my bag. Each card will make my deck stronger. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQvUw5dyYKA1MqrQfNqkRZSNFEuzD3Z67guqJpVyzgvBW/1777392255913.jpg) Finally, among today's achievements, 'Torrent Sniper' (Rare card) and 'Grim Bonewhip' were notable. I also got some Energy and Legendary Potion Charges. All in all, today is one of the best days for me in my Splinterlands career. It's really a matter of luck to pass two important leagues on the same day and get all these beautiful cards and rewards. To those who are playing this game, I would like to say – don’t lose patience. If you use the right card combination and strategy, success will come. Your support in this journey of mine always motivates me. I am ending here as it is today. I will come back to you with even bigger achievements in the future. Everyone, stay well and healthy. My references:-https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=mirzaiqi

links.title: Life unfolding in little frames #monomad
links.body: Greetings lovely members of the community. I hope you all are doing great and enjoying quality time with your loved ones. > समुदाय के प्यारे सदस्यों को नमस्कार। मुझे आशा है कि आप सभी अच्छे होंगे और अपने प्रियजनों के साथ गुणवत्तापूर्ण समय का आनंद ले रहे है। Some snapshots from a day spent observing people, street vendors and monkeys. >लोगों, ठेले वालों और बंदरों को देखते हुए बिताए गए दिन की कुछ झलकियां। ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVNeW4d1g9K7CUTDA8DifLAmKu2AyHmmysUrJGzMYahZo/img_2980.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYQQdX8dSqVTDhqAX2rEibtKeaRZu5HPvRcxBShkPeV3x/img_2981.heic) It’s always entertaining to watch the soap bubble sellers. The way the bubbles float around, some big, some tiny, is quite amusing. It also takes me back to childhood days of playing with balloons. You can’t exactly play with these bubbles, but they still bring back that same feeling. > साबुन के बुलबुले बेचने वालों को देखना हमेशा मजेदार होता है। बुलबुले जिस तरह हवा में तैरते हैं, कुछ बड़े, कुछ छोटे, वह काफी दिलचस्प लगता है। यह मुझे बचपन के उन दिनों की याद भी दिलाता है जब हम गुब्बारों से खेलते थे। इन बुलबुलों के साथ वैसे खेल नहीं सकते, लेकिन फिर भी वही एहसास आ जाता है। ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZhNaaF4dt3gRCCUiBX4GSJbazbvpJXqDe1CTgH1yt5tM/img_2979.heic) A few kids were running around trying to catch the bubbles, and it was genuinely nice to watch. >कुछ बच्चे भी इन बुलबुलों को पकड़ने के लिए इधर उधर भाग रहे थे, और उन्हें देखना सच में अच्छा लग रहा था। ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZpeTjhwVY1j6aMehkJmxuCU6Lz55g2mHm1RsAWWT4YP9/img_2982.heic) There were also some monkeys nearby, clearly caught up in a little fight of their own. Two of them sat on a rooftop, almost like silent spectators. Being around them can be a bit unsettling since their mood shifts so quickly. >वहीं कुछ बंदर भी थे, जो आपस में किसी बात को लेकर लड़ रहे थे। उनमें से दो छत पर बैठे थे, जैसे चुपचाप सब देख रहे हों। उनके आसपास रहना थोड़ा डरावना लगता है, क्योंकि उनका मूड कब बदल जाए, कुछ कहा नहीं जा सकता। ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcvdBZLAmtyF9isoKjCQygxMaugYzAjfRmUD7PcRtJx5D/img_2983.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRV4k5P6AHKc1q7n27eDjNTqYpzrWYHnQcHSxLemWaEi9/img_2985.heic) As I moved along, I came across a frame that stood out, three statues aligned perfectly. The one in the middle, with a raised hand, was of a chief minister who served the state for many years. >आगे बढ़ते हुए एक फ्रेम नजर आया जो काफी अच्छा लगा, तीन मूर्तियां एक सीध में लगी हुई थीं। बीच वाली मूर्ति, जिसमें हाथ उठा हुआ था, एक ऐसे मुख्यमंत्री की थी जिन्होंने लंबे समय तक राज्य की सेवा की। ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdWJHLudyLcmfVBR1rciw9pMQv8sV5LZZJWGGBLp1oqWy/img_3003.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWraYmbiCj3wfK9QerN8cYKqj2i7HbtuRSACdhmPfae26/img_3002.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTJJuwgidWYfh5cmjN5wjmjtKjrUphBUwteaQ5WGscrb9/img_3004.jpg) Later, I noticed vendors sitting under umbrellas, shielding themselves from the harsh sun. Tourists often stop by to buy things, while locals casually browse. Most of what they sell is handmade, which makes it all the more interesting. > इसके बाद कुछ ठेले वाले दिखे जो तेज धूप से बचने के लिए छतरियों के नीचे बैठे थे। पर्यटक अक्सर उनसे चीजें खरीदते हैं, और स्थानीय लोग भी उन्हें देखते रहते हैं। उनके पास ज्यादातर हाथ से बनी चीजें होती हैं, जो उन्हें और भी खास बनाती हैं। That’s all for today folks. links.body:
<center>
![mockup-5215947_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/23xAptApfoD8GAxXGfzrMk4TV7RdgtqzsybxEEHsZJ3cJuXDLMfe62VNfkmKUNVArtv4V.jpg)
 [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/mockup-screen-smartphone-blog-word-5215947/)</center>

<hr>

A boy and a girl met purely by chance on a dating app: they had been talking until dawn for weeks. Their chats were filled with stickers, several-minute-long voice messages, and late-night confessions that made them increasingly close.

Through their phone screens, Jeremy and Sofía seemed like soulmates, but it was a connection created by an algorithm.

One day, they finally dared to cross the digital barrier. They agreed to meet at a quiet café downtown. Jeremy arrived ten minutes early, so he entertained himself playing with a napkin at the table. When Sofía walked in, he recognized her instantly.

They sat together, ordered coffee, and after greeting each other, silence took over the table. The chemistry from the chat was nonexistent in the real world, perhaps due to nerves. Jeremy turned out to be much more reserved than he seemed. Sofía discovered they didn’t share the same personality when speaking in person.

For an hour, they tried to force the conversation, but the reality was undeniable. In the safety of the virtual world, they understood each other, but in their flesh-and-blood versions, they weren’t compatible.

As they left the café, they looked at each other with a very forced and awkward smile:

***“You’re great, but we work better in writing, don’t we?”*** she said.

Jeremy nodded.

***“Totally. It was a real pleasure, Sofi.”***

They said goodbye with a brief and sincere hug, ready to meet new people.

links.body: 2/🧵 Here comes the big question: how often do you reflect or meditate? For some individuals, it's a daily routine; for others, it's once in a while; for some, they don't reflect at all. They live a life, and whatever the day brings, they will adjust. It's not always easy because a lot of thoughts will keep flashing, and your mind will be wandering. That's normal. Quiet moments are very important because they will help you understand yourself better. People who reflect and meditate on a daily basis are at a higher advantage because it brings them clarity and also helps to manage stress. Even if it's minutes of silence, it will go a long way in resetting your mind.
