body.title: RANDOM PHOTOGRAPHY // Capturing the beauty of some interesting objects I found today
body.body:
## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ♥️ ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYjG7mQqt79rRjTELb4yzdKkQc1drHiv7ktvWp6RsBqpr/1777381073835.jpg) In this post, I will share my experience and success in capturing the beauty of some interesting objects that I found today.Actually there is so much hidden beauty in this world that we often fail to see or simply overlook,often it comes from small objects or things,however if we look more closely and from a different perspective, each one reveals its own unique charm and stunning details. And now I’d like to share some photos I’ve managed to capture of small things like insects and flowers,and of course, these were taken intentionally, with the hope of finding satisfaction in them. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZtvk69x3EJaB9YgmeS5mi4CAQ2b7U24utBGhpfD7pgKT/1777381073882.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdwMR52sqbzKE75Q8DYr2D4sPmGb1YtTnBaVbLyh6Kjxg/1777381073941.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmckeZPLH3cPtkeLMne1Sj2rE7uMxCKfHDY4NggB9D2bUV/1777381073995.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfX6j19NSVbhaQET7HdVuvnA3chN7Y2Cd5P26ynTsp4yn/1777381074036.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJhqbeSTo4eWsh5bYvat5gBx2XCo5YVpVPi9Ndk6Rcru/1777381091787.jpg) First, let’s start with a dung beetle perched on a wild plant. This beetle has a round shape with a fairly hard shell,but it has a very beautiful color, namely red with black spots. This beetle kept moving when I took its picture, its small size also made it very difficult for me, but by using a macro lens I was able to take a picture of it with detailed and amazing results. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb56gf3M51SSgi9eKfRAJd2HBJdaUo3xcb9nk5bsrE8yP/1777381091832.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP9x785jHdwRrbrrAzHevRDS31w4RszELwSv9JaFj7ACw/1777381091871.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVcEJwH8Tr9538phc7q3Rns7KqxxVLrhb9NGxgjroanNS/1777381091914.jpg) This is a wild plant that I found in my garden, its shape is unique because it has a soft stem that is hairy, but this plant has quite a lot of sticky sap. I am interested in the shape of the leaves which look sharp and the flowers are also very different from other flowers in general. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWPii6RYkdSNjxU9ghWQ6to4Fp5CCLt35uYDv73kxwKG5/1777381091953.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmePjmyUDXKh2HFXF3sKzMm3M5uVA7xrvWSgRBLG7evpRY/1777381106592.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWDUiV45YpHjzR9SQ22vBEbmTgCnvojgRHeBwEGzRuzWd/1777381106643.jpg) When I found it, I thought it was a flower, but it turned out to be a seed from a wild plant. What's unique is that the seeds are very light and hairy, which allows them to be easily spread by the wind. This plant is also widespread in my area and is also considered a weed by many people because of its very large population. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbYAnKKUzk8DgJzfmM6EAKEHuppd9THxYT1vuMMJDXPV8/1777381106690.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYd186yHH4prn5Pv8hFAV6gyvUEkDpz9fxsJf93ZSc2a3/1777381106731.jpg) This is one of the flowers that is quite beautiful in my opinion, this flower also has various colors such as white, red and pink. This flower is very often cultivated by many people because of its beauty, besides this flower can also grow easily without having to have complicated care. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNeGMMFT72NGc1JSVnGMUYxNuRS8xKAKLtXNN2GVoRecg/1777381106765.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcdDzkLvGaNGjaYhLyTWHe8i7Ud3yuyKzQSShB4C47j5G/1777381120354.jpg) I have a pet cat at home, but I am always interested in changes in the size of the cat's pupils, according to the information I know, these changes in the pupils aim to adjust to the intensity of light for optimal vision. However, people in my village often associate these changes with natural factors, for example, when the cat's pupils shrink it means the sea water is receding, but when the cat's pupils are dilating then the sea water is high tide, I don't know whether this is true or not, what do you think.? ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRdA7suywwQok4uVaDZaSzExmvfRkVe5rUv8LiX44yiUX/1777381120402.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTneG5wRyMRe4A4aEV5ftPar2irCN238d8BCQ1RGKN6rL/1777381120450.jpg) I also managed to find a very beautiful butterfly, especially on its hind wings. This butterfly is a bright shiny blue, and has wavy or serrated edges, but what caught my attention the most is its unique pattern. This butterfly has a fairly stable population in my area so we can find it easily, but photographing it is quite difficult. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVpZzXcYyMeXBSXZYoixko6j4jZK9Q29hVieUES9m2vZQ/1777381120499.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcsHvS1btNPwSYyCkeKD3VoWw5kGUmX4j3EgWqC3zdS1f/1777381120539.jpg) And last but not least, there’s the cute little butterfly. This butterfly is small and agile,so to appreciate its beauty,we have to see it from a fairly close distance. It’s very skittish, and I only managed to take two photos. ----

Life is a responsibility Be yourself, keep learning and don't hesitate to start😉

And you can also find me on [Ecency Discord](https://discord.com/invite/m9MyMSWx)

----

Thank you very much for reading my post till the end, I am here to say thank you very much 🙏

---- ----

All images are mine, I took the photos using the Infinix 10 pro cellphone and I edited the images using the Lightroom application. I'm @riyat. See you again in my next post ♥️

body.title: 🎵Music community. À bientôt - Luis Ramirez. Original Composition for Violin/Guitar.
body.body: > ## Una obra musical en construcción. Estos últimos días he estado más enfocado en el tema de la composición, hay creaciones musicales que tardan en nacer, van transformándose, esta obra tiene esa característica, la escribí pero esta es la primera fase, todavía no esta terminada, posiblemente la modifique durante toda la vida, porque la composición no es una carrera sino un maratón de esta y la próxima vida. En sí esta pieza tiene unos elementos que desarrollé que modestia aparte, me gustaron mucho como quedaron, el Intro tiene una presencia increíble, el Coro la nostalgia que quería pero hay cosas que todavía no me convencen, por lo que debo seguirlas trabajando, pero siento que los compositores y artistas en general deberían mostrar las obras en su fase de evolución, por lo general, las personas tienden a mostrar las cosas una vez finalizadas, pero en otras disciplinas siempre vemos como van mostrando las cosas de acuerdo con la evolución, tal es el caso de la arquitectura, que vemos como abren un edificio con otras fases en construcción, o vemos fragmentos de libros como muestras al público. ## À bientôt - Una pieza para Susana Ruiz. Como lo dije en otra publicación, le escribí 3 obras a una gran Violinista llamada Susana Ruiz que espero pronto tener la oportunidad de grabar con ella, de esas 3 hay una que no me gustó para nada como quedó, y he decidido no mostrarla, otra que ya publiqué que es el primer movimiento: *Encuentro* y esta que tengo acá sería el último movimiento **À bientôt**. Esta frase esta en Francés, significa en español: **Hasta Pronto**, porque refleja el momento en el que Susana y yo tendremos que despedirnos para seguir cada quien con su destino, quise reflejar Drama, Nostalgia y Esperanza. Como les dije todavía no esta terminada, pero me gusta mostrar lo que llevo construido para apreciada Blockchain de Hive. Gracias por haber llegado hasta aquí, Dios te bendiga y espero disfrutes de mi música.

> ## A musical work in progress. These past few days, I have been more focused on the subject of composition. There are musical creations that take time to be born; they keep transforming. This work has that characteristic; I wrote it, but this is only the first phase. It is not finished yet, and I will possibly modify it throughout my life, because composition is not a sprint, but a marathon for this life and the next. In itself, this piece has certain elements I developed that—modesty aside—I really liked how they turned out. The Intro has an incredible presence, and the Chorus has the nostalgia I wanted, but there are things that still don't convince me, so I must keep working on them. However, I feel that composers and artists in general should show their works during their evolutionary phase. Usually, people tend to show things only once they are finished, but in other disciplines, we always see how they show things according to their evolution; such is the case with architecture, where we see them open a building while other phases are still under construction, or we see fragments of books as samples for the public. ## À bientôt - A piece for Susana Ruiz. As I mentioned in another post, I wrote three works for a great violinist named Susana Ruiz, which I hope to have the opportunity to record with her soon. Of those three, there is one that I didn't like at all how it turned out, and I have decided not to show it; another that I already published, which is the first movement: Encuentro; and this one I have here would be the last movement: **À bientôt.** This phrase is in French; in English, it means: **See you soon.** It reflects the moment when Susana and I will have to say goodbye to each follow our own destiny; I wanted to reflect Drama, Nostalgia, and Hope. As I told you, it is not finished yet, but I like to show what I have built so far for my beloved Hive Blockchain. Thank you for making it this far. God bless you, and I hope you enjoy my music. --- --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=guitarmcy/dbf4def3)
body.author: guitarmcy

body.title: [ENG/ESP] My unforgettable birthday at the Hotel Nacional / Mi cumpleaños inolvidable en el Hotel Nacional
body.body: > An ordinary day dawned on the calendar, but for me it was a date full of emotions. My children, far away, outside the country, and my husband had been looking at me knowingly for weeks before, with those eyes that betray a secret about to explode. And boy did it explode when, after breakfast, my husband told me: \

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX72rV9LgMLvdk17bj69m5cJxshx2UaLvnPnQBoWVrysQ/img_20260411_142628.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeSE8zaAdQS31QwRADVpNogadsxXDMC4RZghkTpczpvVE/img_20260409_102421.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRk27TvaWhC8iVg4PyNpwZbvzit27DS649RuomdGeYmZ3/img_20260411_151259.jpg) I didn't imagine the magnitude of the surprise until the car that was transporting us stopped in front of the majestic entrance of the Hotel Nacional de Cuba. That stone mass, witness to so many stories, was the setting chosen by my family to celebrate me. Tears came to my eyes. My husband hugged me tightly and my children (via video call) laughed, happy for having surprised me. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV562qYRYrFv1ZDwnZR3KtqjEcDUk4VsYfJDD1qCxwNTh/img_20260411_153407.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWAbF8HGy4omykX3p8PhEC64f6PJrU2ckVeJBHRbw8hd5/img_20260411_175136.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmenqkGhrdFFJiyM5BV7tejbSfswSpbq44QV82R7UFiobk/img_20260411_180730.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQGwAcnpET7tSmWBy5irxBFWEWgwkqN18o2VxiXnPDgRW/img_20260411_180708.jpg) The first gift was time. No clocks, no rush. We changed and went straight to the pool. The water, salty and fresh from the sea that filtered through the rocks, embraced me like a caress. I floated looking at the sky, feeling like the luckiest woman. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2gKUrqutu3d7AdhjBdtXDfMZHVpWQbhg2QkDvgzPvZT/img_20260411_141447.jpg) Later, we walked along the hotel's paths until we reached the cafeteria. The aroma of freshly brewed Cuban coffee guided us. I ordered a Cortadito, steaming and sweet, which I accompanied with a privileged view of the boardwalk. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXRBRxFqYBsZsxG6P42s2pA7MmMrwN5TuNXvANoSSdb5V/img_20260411_144700.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWXU6qy1ek3NSe1adzsbgSCZLe8PZGSeUXZYGQA8v8Rdf/img_20260411_144611.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeYqoc3HfthgDU4869ys2kb4apy5mRQ2XkSmvDVPWWtTx/img_20260411_124809.jpg) The afternoon began to turn orange and pink. We sat on one of the terraces overlooking the sea to witness the sunset spectacle. The sun was slowly sinking, coloring the horizon with fire and melancholy. The surrounding landscape, the hotel's well-kept gardens, seemed like a living painting. I took a deep breath. I felt peace. I felt gratitude. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSxUZyWecQRKBD1jitwN4axjC5ygKnGvmWDwzGFgp7bPu/img_20260411_125134.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdA32mmZ3hBwwnNtxksHP1jFZbWj8HFjngxsrUrFrR4KB/img_20260411_205410.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPyqFYUFHrbBeAQQUE8WkniUfYNEfAPdjykxXQJfWNLwf/img_20260411_213036.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRNAVhvNoQ5eTRgATDjshJPHHPVMbPeE3dPWiq2AFYfBv/img_20260411_203440.jpg) For dinner, the surprise dressed in a white tablecloth. My husband had made a reservation at La Barraca, that restaurant by the sea where the waves seem to sing while you eat. I ordered ropa Vieja, a stewed beef that we call it that in Cuba, salad and a glass of wine. My husband ordered pork chop. We toast. My children called and said some words that broke and rebuilt my soul. My husband, with that voice of his that I love so much, gave me a toast that I will keep in the box of indelible memories. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNiRE73EUwNrbLiar4bVZoCRN1vwZL2CDUPzSoGt59SEe/img_20260411_215831.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYLzAGaQmEHeSGKNUC9B1pRSt33SGbBWAH7bKBqNMenNN/img_20260411_220107.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVWYZk65boTDeaqNfixXy1SmMpzAD2bDKNTkBhYEHmtyo/img_20260411_221651.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaCRre9rJeTycFBiQBen38CFECjHKhA9G9nQdWNkonfyR/img_20260411_221724.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc7qkNW5Vhei9E1zkXeboCqBVotXKgpL4Xq3K2443zeeu/img_20260411_224034.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQX1LVHaVqAKTJTxB2YiUwUCdcZd3mnigTUej8W4LGwFr/img_20260411_233426.jpg) Just when I thought the night couldn't get any better, the final touch appeared. We cross the illuminated gardens and arrive at the Parisién Cabaret. What a show! Feathers, sequins, live music and a riot of rhythm and joy. The dancers seemed to fly over the stage. I laughed, I sang and they even encouraged me to go up for a moment. I felt like a diva, I felt young, I felt free. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWDav3qZeGjMJ2AaVhVpXaAyKCPQtbdsdVYjZWVLGZsis/img_20260412_000714.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfFVJeWJkySRbHoCWDEPkE1SE55Cz5ozx9MTKvgsTvnW3/img_20260412_000623.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS9paP4D8C9rhjjuuEY3UocNw8UUGUEHEyBh2YvtFtnkF/img_20260412_000703.jpg) To close the evening with the elegance it deserved, my husband took me by the hand and took me to the terrace of the hotel, where the legendary Club Capablanca is located. The place breathed history and bohemianism. In the corner, a pianist played soft melodies. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6TaoW2pEXEdHnjwCAgbCM8E5zNMgKUAMp2SxnhAFVBw/img_20260411_152421.jpg) Back in the room, with the sound of the sea in the background and the sleeping city, I opened my eyes wide so as not to forget a single detail. The surprise of my children, the complicity of my husband, every smile, every flavor, every musical note. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV2FTpJhYMyaRoWAXz57mBtx66SgphMTAcuk1dSHNTqbH/img_20260411_214221.jpg) It was more than a birthday. It was a two-day hug compressed into a perfect day. And as I closed my eyes, I knew that the best gift was not in the Hotel Nacional, but in the people who made it possible for me, for one day, to feel like the queen of the world. Thank you, family. Thank you, life. Credits: Images are my property. I used Google translator. ESPAÑOL Amaneció un día cualquiera en el calendario, pero para mí era una fecha cargada de emociones. Mis hijos, a lo lejos, fuera del país y mi esposo me habían estado mirando con complicidad desde semanas antes, con esos ojos que delatan un secreto a punto de estallar. Y vaya que estalló cuando, después del desayuno,mi esposo me dijo: “Prepárate, te llevo al lugar donde la historia y la magia se encuentran. Feliz cumpleaños”. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX72rV9LgMLvdk17bj69m5cJxshx2UaLvnPnQBoWVrysQ/img_20260411_142628.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeSE8zaAdQS31QwRADVpNogadsxXDMC4RZghkTpczpvVE/img_20260409_102421.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRk27TvaWhC8iVg4PyNpwZbvzit27DS649RuomdGeYmZ3/img_20260411_151259.jpg) No imaginaba la magnitud de la sorpresa hasta que el coche que nos trasladaba se detuvo frente a la majestuosa entrada del Hotel Nacional de Cuba. Esa mole de piedra, testigo de tantas historias, era el escenario elegido por mi familia para celebrarme. Las lágrimas asomaron a mis ojos. Mi esposo me abrazó fuerte y mis hijos (por videollamada) reían, felices por haberme sorprendido. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV562qYRYrFv1ZDwnZR3KtqjEcDUk4VsYfJDD1qCxwNTh/img_20260411_153407.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWAbF8HGy4omykX3p8PhEC64f6PJrU2ckVeJBHRbw8hd5/img_20260411_175136.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmenqkGhrdFFJiyM5BV7tejbSfswSpbq44QV82R7UFiobk/img_20260411_180730.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQGwAcnpET7tSmWBy5irxBFWEWgwkqN18o2VxiXnPDgRW/img_20260411_180708.jpg) El primer regalo fue el tiempo. Sin relojes, sin prisa. Nos cambiamos y bajamos directo a la piscina. El agua, salada y fresca del mar que se filtraba entre las rocas, me abrazó como una caricia. Floté mirando el cielo, sintiéndome la mujer más afortunada. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2gKUrqutu3d7AdhjBdtXDfMZHVpWQbhg2QkDvgzPvZT/img_20260411_141447.jpg) Más tarde, caminamos por los senderos del hotel hasta llegar a la cafetería. El aroma del café cubano recién hecho nos guió. Pedí un cortadito, humeante y dulce, que acompañé con una vista privilegiada del malecón. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXRBRxFqYBsZsxG6P42s2pA7MmMrwN5TuNXvANoSSdb5V/img_20260411_144700.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWXU6qy1ek3NSe1adzsbgSCZLe8PZGSeUXZYGQA8v8Rdf/img_20260411_144611.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeYqoc3HfthgDU4869ys2kb4apy5mRQ2XkSmvDVPWWtTx/img_20260411_124809.jpg) La tarde comenzó a pintarse de naranja y rosa. Nos sentamos en una de las terrazas con vista al mar para presenciar el espectáculo del atardecer. El sol se hundía lentamente, tiñendo el horizonte de fuego y melancolía. El paisaje del entorno , los jardines cuidados del hotel parecía un cuadro vivo. Respiré hondo. Sentí paz. Sentí gratitud. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSxUZyWecQRKBD1jitwN4axjC5ygKnGvmWDwzGFgp7bPu/img_20260411_125134.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdA32mmZ3hBwwnNtxksHP1jFZbWj8HFjngxsrUrFrR4KB/img_20260411_205410.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPyqFYUFHrbBeAQQUE8WkniUfYNEfAPdjykxXQJfWNLwf/img_20260411_213036.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRNAVhvNoQ5eTRgATDjshJPHHPVMbPeE3dPWiq2AFYfBv/img_20260411_203440.jpg) Para la cena, la sorpresa se vistió de mantel blanco. Mi esposo había reservado en La Barraca, ese restaurante junto al mar donde las olas parecen cantar mientras comes. Pedí ropa vieja, una carne de res estofada que en Cuba le decimos así, ensalada y una copa de vino. Mi esposo pidió chuleta de cerdo. Brindamos. Mis hijos llamaron y dijeron unas palabras que me rompieron y reconstruyeron el alma. Mi esposo, con esa voz suya que tanto quiero, me dedicó un brindis que guardaré en la cajita de los recuerdos imborrables. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNiRE73EUwNrbLiar4bVZoCRN1vwZL2CDUPzSoGt59SEe/img_20260411_215831.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYLzAGaQmEHeSGKNUC9B1pRSt33SGbBWAH7bKBqNMenNN/img_20260411_220107.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVWYZk65boTDeaqNfixXy1SmMpzAD2bDKNTkBhYEHmtyo/img_20260411_221651.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaCRre9rJeTycFBiQBen38CFECjHKhA9G9nQdWNkonfyR/img_20260411_221724.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc7qkNW5Vhei9E1zkXeboCqBVotXKgpL4Xq3K2443zeeu/img_20260411_224034.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQX1LVHaVqAKTJTxB2YiUwUCdcZd3mnigTUej8W4LGwFr/img_20260411_233426.jpg) Cuando creía que la noche no podía mejorar, apareció el broche de oro. Atravesamos los jardines iluminados y llegamos al Cabaret Parisién. ¡Qué show! Plumas, lentejuelas, música en vivo y un derroche de ritmo y alegría. Los bailarines parecían volar sobre el escenario. Me reí, canté y hasta me animaron a subir un momento. Me sentí una diva, me sentí joven, me sentí libre. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWDav3qZeGjMJ2AaVhVpXaAyKCPQtbdsdVYjZWVLGZsis/img_20260412_000714.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfFVJeWJkySRbHoCWDEPkE1SE55Cz5ozx9MTKvgsTvnW3/img_20260412_000623.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS9paP4D8C9rhjjuuEY3UocNw8UUGUEHEyBh2YvtFtnkF/img_20260412_000703.jpg) Para cerrar la velada con la elegancia que merecía, mi esposo me tomó de la mano y me llevó a la Terraza del hotel, donde se encuentra el mítico Club Capablanca. El lugar respiraba historia y bohemia. En un rincón, un pianista tocaba melodías suaves. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6TaoW2pEXEdHnjwCAgbCM8E5zNMgKUAMp2SxnhAFVBw/img_20260411_152421.jpg) De regreso a la habitación, con el sonido del mar de fondo y la ciudad dormida, abrí los ojos bien grandes para no olvidar ni un solo detalle. La sorpresa de mis hijos, la complicidad de mi esposo, cada sonrisa, cada sabor, cada nota musical. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV2FTpJhYMyaRoWAXz57mBtx66SgphMTAcuk1dSHNTqbH/img_20260411_214221.jpg) Fue más que un cumpleaños. Fue un abrazo de dos días comprimido en una jornada perfecta. Y mientras cerraba los ojos, supe que el mejor regalo no estaba en el Hotel Nacional, sino en las personas que hicieron posible que yo, por un día, me sintiera la reina del mundo. Gracias, familia. Gracias, vida. Créditos: Las imágenes son de mi propiedad. Utilicé el traductor de Google.

Good evening everyone, I hope you are all in good health.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTQ1aozoVnUSdAkv7AM6zMCz3ReebGRLkv9QYhUE9j2RE/img_20260428_wa0009.jpg)

Hi friends, wherever you are, I'm back with you again in this post. Of course, I'll show you some photos of flowers in my yard that I took this afternoon.

Earlier, I went with my younger cousin to get my motorcycle repaired at the repair shop. I accidentally spotted some red flowers in front of the house. The flowers were truly tempting. Without thinking, I immediately approached and enjoyed the beauty of the flowers in front of my cousin's sister's house.
These flowers are red and have a very interesting shape, and are perfect for planting in front of the house to beautify the yard. We can all enjoy them together tonight.

# Here's a look at the flowers I enjoyed this afternoon.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPWQcmGBkKk4Tip9ep6VuMWKSWFAaSUhu4iP1hwawGFJi/img_20260428_wa0008.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdx4HXapRDNwbLmJLukUx8J1VcP2xCAnPme4uu9nvxEiz/img_20260428_wa0007.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcd78egvfxqXirfrYhBBD55Tzae3UEboB42XAAoayWNQZ/img_20260428_wa0006.jpg)



Obviously, I was satisfied with the flowers in my cousin's sister's yard, so I immediately returned to the repair shop to get the motorcycle repaired.

I was very happy to find and enjoy these beautiful flowers this afternoon, and it really made me happy.

That's all I can share tonight. I hope you enjoy these beautiful flower photos.

# All the photos I show here were taken using my realme 7I camera.

All the stories I share here are purely my own; I have not plagiarized anyone else's work.

# Okay, friends, see you in my next post!

body.body:
Tu post tiene algo bueno y raro a la vez: **no responde la guía como trámite, la convierte en autobiografía intelectual**. Eso funciona, porque en tus tres puntos el conocimiento no aparece como dato sino como herida, rechazo y transformación lenta; ahí está el músculo del texto, y se siente en tu post anterior, [**Post Experimental sobre Reflexiones Ser y Hacer**](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/post-experimental-sobre-reflexiones-ser-y-hacer-mogzk7ry3971a52a?referral=aljif7).

Lo más fuerte, para mí, es el **primer conocimiento**: descubrir la injusticia fiscal no como teoría sino como escena concreta. Eso pega más que cualquier consigna, porque muestra cómo el saber a veces **no ilumina primero: amarga primero**. Y el tercero también está muy bien encaminado: aprender una lengua “un semestre cada vez” retrata una verdad poco glamorosa pero real — uno cambia muchas veces **sin darse cuenta mientras avanza**.

Donde yo apretaría más el tornillo es en el **segundo punto**. Ahí hay una idea muy buena —el rechazo a la autoayuda tras la universidad y el rescate posterior de una parte valiosa—, pero pide una frase más afilada, casi con bisturí: **qué te hizo desconfiar**, **qué te hizo volver**, y **qué tipo de lectura sí salva**. Ese contraste puede volver esa sección la más filosófica de las tres.

También hay una tensión interesante entre tu pregunta y tu propia respuesta: **sí, saber te hace ser, pero no de manera limpia**. A veces te hace más lúcido; otras, más incómodo. Ese matiz vale oro, porque evita el sermón de taza motivacional.

Como contexto de tu línea de trabajo, este tema ya venía sembrado en [**¿Ser, Saber y Hacer? ¿Cuál es prioridad?**](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/ser-saber-y-hacer-cu-l-es-prioridad-moe6tsdv6774782d), y aquí se nota que lo estás aterrizando en experiencia concreta. En tu actividad reciente también se ve ese cruce entre **aprendizaje, lenguaje y reflexión personal** en tu blog, aunque mezclado con tus series habituales como [**A Daily Word in Spanish #386**](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/a-daily-word-in-spanish-386-mohuyf7i), así que este post filosófico destaca justamente porque cambia el ritmo y se siente más expuesto.

Si quieres que ese texto pegue todavía más, yo haría una cosa simple: **cerrar cada apartado con una mini-conclusión de una línea**. Algo seco, casi definitivo. Sin adorno. Ahí es donde un post así deja de ser reflexión suelta y se vuelve pieza redonda.

body.body:
Blog de aljif7
Martes 28 de abril de 2026
AREA: Filosofía (?)

¡Hola amigos! ¡Hola Cripto-mundo!

Hoy es martes 28 de abril de 2026.

He aquí la mitad de mi ejercicio comentado (https://inleo.io/@aljif7/post-experimental-sobre-reflexiones-ser-y-hacer-mogzk7ry3971a52a?referral=aljif7) ayer en mi post sobre mis 4 preguntas. Pendientes 3 y 4 de la Guía.
![Screenshot 2026 04 27 at 4.31.45 PM](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRtphzCZrGot7MvgPD4XAJBdPyHu95eBc9azqYiWKxyJz/Screenshot%202026-04-27%20at%204.31.45%E2%80%AFPM.png)
# ¿Saber te hacer Ser? (Escribe tres conocimientos que te transformaron).
–1–
Un conocimiento, un aprendizaje que me confundió en su momento: Atestiguar / conocer la crudeza de la vida, la injusticia de los que más tienen y menos impuestos pagan. Eso me hizo sentir una especie de rencor ante el incumplimiento de las reglas de pagar un porcentaje de impuestos y los hoteleros que sólo declaraban dos a tres facturas de cada 15 o 20 huéspedes hospedados. A mi edad adolescente, eso me dejó impactado por unos meses.
![Screenshot 2026 04 28 at 11.13.08 PM](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWV54q2ECdgBLV14cuMdE7UEUVRZqZvzwvPXRfUcBjabs/Screenshot%202026-04-28%20at%2011.13.08%E2%80%AFPM.png)
–2–
Las lecturas de la universidad me hicieron rechazar (inconscientemente, creo) toda lectura sobre superación personal. Décadas más tarde reconozco que no toda lectura de superación personal es superflua o basura (aunque la mayoría se le aproxima). Quizás eso me permitió disfrutar intensamente las lecturas literarias, tanto que el personaje duraba incrustado en mi piel por semanas…:))
–3–
Aprender una lengua (Extranjera). 
Sin proponérmelo vehementemente fui avanzando en mis estudios de Lenguas Modernas. En mi mente sólo tenía en meta un semestre cada vez. Y luego el que seguía, y luego el siguiente. Un semestre cada vez. Creo que me fue cambiando algo sin darme cuenta. Y así llegó el final de la universidad. Para mi generación era hora de enfrentarse a la realidad de “enseñar” esa lengua que no era nuestra. Recuerdo cuando iniciamos. El grupo era enorme, casi 100. Si no me equivoco éramos 96 estudiantes. Terminamos 14. 
Afortunadamente empecé por enseñar literatura y gramática del español, mi lengua materna, aunque era un desafío me emocionaba más que enseñar la lengua extranjera que había estudiado por cinco años, tal vez por el miedo, ese elemento escondido silenciosamente. 
Un año después empecé a dominar ese miedo y empecé a enseñar francés. Aún recuerdo cuánto miedo me daba empezar a enseñar, aún sentía que me faltaban más ańos… ja ja. 
Y así sin darme cuenta se definió lo que me trajo a Asia donde por fortuna enseño mi lengua materna (y en mi tiempo libre he aprendido sobre el fascinante mundo de la blockchain, web3, blogging, etc. Y pensar que lo que me acercó a todo esto fue la búsqueda de entender el mundo de las finanzas, del trading, de inversiones. Lo que empezó sin saber ni leer gráficas se convirtió en la puerta de acceso a algo que está llegando a muchos rincones de nuestras vidas, tal vez sin darnos cuenta. Hace diez años lago pasó por mi mente que me hizo ver que con sólo las clases de tiempo parcial no podría subsistir. Este aprendizaje me ha dado satisfacciones enormes, pero también descalabros, lecciones de los peligros en el mundo virtual desde hackeos hasta el aprendizaje de que los ciclos (económicos) son engañosos. Afortunadamente aproveché mucho del buen momento del ciclo anterior en el 2020. Este otro personalmente me pareció inconcluso, y creo que tendremos que esperar hasta el próximo Bitcoin halving, a menos que me equivoque y el cripto-mundo nos dé una agradable sorpresa. Pero por ahora esto pinta como que a resignarse a seguir acumulando…
Así que ya no fueron tres conocimientos. El último que menciono es el emprendido en mi tiempo libre y que considero es un aprendizaje de largo plazo, además del agregado de los rápidos cambios con las nuevas tecnologías. De alguna manera esto fue lo que me trajo a estos espacios virtuales; esa búsqueda de algo que no dependa de otros para existir paralelamente a mi vida.
# ¿HACER TE HACE SER? (1 acción reciente)
# 

Con este ejercicio, me viene a la mente un incidente reciente que ocurrió durante una de las prácticas de conversación en español. 
Tenía a dos estudiantes en la práctica de unos 10~15 minutos. 
Mientras avanzaba con las preguntas con uno de ellos, no me había dado cuenta que Aiden, un chico tímido estaba muy atemorizado. Y estaba empezando a sollozar. Me lamenté no haberme dado cuenta antes. Me acordé del día que detuve una clase en Corea porque una estudiante se había sentido ofendida ya que una de las tareas en revisión grupal era de ella. Y en general a los estudiantes orientales no les gusta cometer errores y mucho menos que sus errores gramaticales o sintácticos sean vistos en el grupo. Para esto siempre me aseguro de que los ejemplos sean totalmente anónimos. Bueno, en esa ocasión compartí las ventajas de que los errores se revisen en grupo ya que muchos otros estudiantes comenten errores similares y eso les ayuda a mejorar. En aquella ocasión se trataba de estudiantes universitarios. Fueron mis primeros días en el mundo oriental.
Esta vez, con Aiden le hice ver lo importante que es calmarse, relajarse y aceptar lo que uno ha aprendido para el momento del examen. Le conté una experiencia de enfrentarme a un ataque de nervios y que si no lo controlaba creo que me hubiera desmayado en público. Era mi primera vez que daba una conferencia en un ámbito internacional en Pozan, Polonia. Mis piernas estaban temblando, la pierna izquierda parecía que se deshacía, que se convertía en gelatina. Tenía que hacer algo para controlar ese nerviosismo. Con la mirada busqué entre el público, fijé la mirada en un par de colegas que estaban muy atentos a mi exposición. Y eso me salvó. Claro que mi pierna quedó adolorida por un buen rato después de la conferencia. Pero en ese momento me pareció que logré anclar mi existencia en algo que me salvó del nerviosismo. 
Así que le remarqué a Aiden, si te pones nervioso de nada sirve todo lo que hayas estudiado, te vas a quedar en blanco, sin poder decir nada. Tú solo tienes que buscar tu manera de tranquilarte. No sé mira a tu entrevistador a los ojos. Si eso te parece difícil busca algún punto de la pared o al lado del entrevistador de tal manera que te tranquilices. 
Regresando de vacaciones han tenido exámenes. 
Y me ha dado satisfacción ver que Aiden salió sonriente después de su examen. Me dije a mi mismo que mis palabras habían servido de algo. 

¡Eso es todo por ahora amigos!
¡Que tengan una fructífera jornada!

body.title: Marrying a close relative what does the bible say about it// Mcgi review
body.body:
https://youtu.be/R_GVqSdYWUU?si=FGKBo0XECsCd67wC
The bible teaches us about boundaries in our family most especially those ones who are close to us. In the bible God gives detailed instructions forbidding marriage or sexual relations between close relatives such as parents and children, siblings, aunts, and uncles. These commands were given to preserve moral order, respect within families, and the health of the community. Such unions are described as improper and dishonoring to God.

The bible did not forbid us from marrying all close relatives. For example, marriage between more distant relatives, like cousins, is not specifically condemned in Scripture. Some biblical figures, such as Isaac and Rebekah, were related within the extended family. This suggests that while close blood relationships were restricted, wider family connections were sometimes acceptable within cultural and historical contexts.

body.title: Practising Delayed Gratification With My HBD Earnings
body.body: /> When I first joined Hive, I did not have a broad understanding of the use cases behind its main tokens or coins. I also did not understand how layer 2 tokens work. But last year when I returned to start posting my content again, I decided to learn more about each one of them. The one that piqued my interest was HBD, often referred to as the Hive Dollar. It is native to the Hive blockchain and, like other cryptocurrencies, it can be traded, transferred, and spent for various purposes. However, the main value of HBD lies in its stability, as it is designed to maintain a value that is considered close to the US dollar. This feature makes HBD very useful to many hive users, including myself. I fell in love with the idea of owning an asset that is stable, reliable and functional, one that is without drastic price fluctuations. Knowing all of these, I chose to save my HBD for a greater purpose. Some may call it delayed gratification, and that would be accurate because saving all or most of it has become a strategy for achieving my long-term goals. So far, I have earned a reasonable amount of HBD and, till date, I haven't withdrawn any. The amount may not seem significant to others, but seeing it remain in my wallet is proof of my effort and consistency in the past months.

/> Now, my strategy is simple: I save my HBD for a year, allow it to compound, and then use it for something meaningful or to solve a problem that I'm sure will not be easily forgotten in my memory. About two months ago, an acquaintance, @treasuree, suggested that I stake my HBDs. Initially, I thought it was needless, considering that the interest on what I had then would be very little. Later on, I realized that leaving it unstaked would result in no growth, no change in the number of HBDs I already have, but staking it would generate some profit, even if it were the smallest 0.5 addition. That realization was enough to convince me, and I chose to stake everything and earn the 20% APR rather than nothing. I have also spent a portion of my HBD to tip a few excellent posts and share as a gift to those who have been kind to me. The beneficiaries deeply appreciated this gesture and that's because HBD holds more value compared to many other tokens. In conclusion, saving the HBD I earn helps me plan towards bigger and meaningful goals. It also helps me stay disciplined in managing my total earnings on Hive. So, while others may decide to spend their HBD immediately based on their needs, I prefer to save mine until I can use it for something that feels more significant. * * * This blog post is a response to the India United weekly contest, which you can find [**HERE.**](https://peakd.com/hive-197685/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-96cce0ba58ba3) * * * [**Image 1 source**](https://unsplash.com/photos/photo-of-dollar-coins-and-banknotes-uJm-hfuCHm4) [**Image 2 source**](https://unsplash.com/photos/person-holding-black-android-smartphone-oPRU2Cne0Pw)

> Eran las 6:45 de la mañana cuando Yolanda vio una llamada entrante de un número desconocido. Su primera impresión fue que podría tratarse del Seguro Social, como sucedió aquella vez anterior, cuando reagendaron la cita de su abuela para fechas lejanas; sin embargo, dudaba que ese fuera el caso, dado que el día anterior ya había acudido al hospital a reagendar aquella cita para una fecha más cercana.

La segunda impresión fue que se trataba de algún estafador. Pero por lo general esa gente solía llamar en horarios más tardíos.

Ignoró la llamada un par de veces antes de contestar a la tercera por mera curiosidad. Pero no habló; esperó a que el que estuviera llamando diera el primer paso. El operador preguntó por un pariente suyo, quien había hecho un préstamo a través de una aplicación de tantas. Yolanda, usando un tono más bajo, dijo que se había equivocado de número y colgó. De inmediato bloqueó el número.

Fue a la planta baja; ahí se topó con su pariente, a quien le comentó lo sucedido; éste le dijo que ya les había pagado, que no tenían por qué llamar más. Incluso le refirió que estuvieron molestándole desde las 4 de la mañana.

Yolanda suspiró. Le pidió a su pariente que no la colocara de nuevo como referencia en esas aplicaciones y que tuviera cuidado en dónde estuviera pidiendo préstamos.

Unas horas después, en la biblioteca, recibió el mensaje de una tal Kate. Yolanda casi se moría de la risa.

No era la primera vez que gente desconocida la contactara preguntando si era fulana, mengana o ciclana. Eran estafadores buscando sonsacarle algún dato importante que pudieran explotar.

The Call of Duty franchise is one of the most influential and successful first-person shooter (FPS) series in the history of gaming. Originally launched in 2003 by Activision, the series quickly gained popularity for its intense gameplay, cinematic storytelling, and realistic depiction of warfare. Over the years, Call of Duty has evolved into a global phenomenon, attracting millions of players across different platforms including PC, PlayStation, and Xbox.

At its core, Call of Duty focuses on fast-paced combat scenarios that place players in the role of soldiers during various conflicts. Early titles in the franchise, such as those set in World War II, aimed to recreate historical battles with authenticity and emotional depth. As the series progressed, it expanded into modern and futuristic settings, introducing advanced weaponry, technology, and complex narratives. Games like Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare revolutionized the genre by blending gripping single-player campaigns with highly competitive multiplayer modes.

One of the defining features of Call of Duty is its immersive gameplay. The series is known for its smooth controls, realistic sound design, and visually stunning graphics that make players feel as though they are part of the battlefield. Whether engaging in close-quarters combat or participating in large-scale military operations, players must rely on quick reflexes, strategic thinking, and teamwork to succeed.

Multiplayer Mode is arguably the most popular aspect of the franchise. It allows players from around the world to compete against each other in various game modes such as Team Deathmatch, Domination, and Search and Destroy. The introduction of leveling systems, customizable loadouts, and seasonal updates keeps the experience fresh and engaging. In recent years, the franchise has also embraced the battle royale trend with Call of Duty: Warzone, a free-to-play mode that drops players into a massive map where they fight to be the last one standing.

Another important element of Call of Duty is its storytelling. Many games in the series feature compelling narratives that explore themes of heroism, sacrifice, and the harsh realities of war. Characters are often well-developed, and players become emotionally invested in their journeys. The franchise is also known for its cinematic presentation, with high-quality voice acting and dramatic set pieces that rival Hollywood action films.

Despite its popularity, Call of Duty has faced criticism over the years. Some critics argue that the series releases too frequently, leading to a lack of innovation in certain titles. Others have raised concerns about the portrayal of violence and its potential impact on players. However, the franchise continues to adapt and improve, incorporating new technologies and responding to player feedback.

In conclusion, Call of Duty remains a dominant force in the gaming industry due to its engaging gameplay, strong multiplayer community, and continuous evolution. It has set a high standard for first-person shooters and continues to influence other games in the genre. Whether you are a casual gamer or a competitive player, Call of Duty offers an exciting and immersive experience that keeps players coming back year after year.

The Call of Duty franchise is one of the most influential and successful first-person shooter (FPS) series in the history of gaming. Originally launched in 2003 by Activision, the series quickly gained popularity for its intense gameplay, cinematic storytelling, and realistic depiction of warfare. Over the years, Call of Duty has evolved into a global phenomenon, attracting millions of players across different platforms including PC, PlayStation, and Xbox.

At its core, Call of Duty focuses on fast-paced combat scenarios that place players in the role of soldiers during various conflicts. Early titles in the franchise, such as those set in World War II, aimed to recreate historical battles with authenticity and emotional depth. As the series progressed, it expanded into modern and futuristic settings, introducing advanced weaponry, technology, and complex narratives. Games like Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare revolutionized the genre by blending gripping single-player campaigns with highly competitive multiplayer modes.

One of the defining features of Call of Duty is its immersive gameplay. The series is known for its smooth controls, realistic sound design, and visually stunning graphics that make players feel as though they are part of the battlefield. Whether engaging in close-quarters combat or participating in large-scale military operations, players must rely on quick reflexes, strategic thinking, and teamwork to succeed.

Multiplayer Mode is arguably the most popular aspect of the franchise. It allows players from around the world to compete against each other in various game modes such as Team Deathmatch, Domination, and Search and Destroy. The introduction of leveling systems, customizable loadouts, and seasonal updates keeps the experience fresh and engaging. In recent years, the franchise has also embraced the battle royale trend with Call of Duty: Warzone, a free-to-play mode that drops players into a massive map where they fight to be the last one standing.

Another important element of Call of Duty is its storytelling. Many games in the series feature compelling narratives that explore themes of heroism, sacrifice, and the harsh realities of war. Characters are often well-developed, and players become emotionally invested in their journeys. The franchise is also known for its cinematic presentation, with high-quality voice acting and dramatic set pieces that rival Hollywood action films.

Despite its popularity, Call of Duty has faced criticism over the years. Some critics argue that the series releases too frequently, leading to a lack of innovation in certain titles. Others have raised concerns about the portrayal of violence and its potential impact on players. However, the franchise continues to adapt and improve, incorporating new technologies and responding to player feedback.

In conclusion, Call of Duty remains a dominant force in the gaming industry due to its engaging gameplay, strong multiplayer community, and continuous evolution. It has set a high standard for first-person shooters and continues to influence other games in the genre. Whether you are a casual gamer or a competitive player, Call of Duty offers an exciting and immersive experience that keeps players coming back year after year.

¡Hola! Bienvenidos nuevamente al espacio cinematográfico de Hive. Esta vez les traemos una nueva entrega de nuestro querido actor **Tom Cruise**, titulada **Bajo la mira**. ¡Vamos al cine!

La película de hoy, producida y protagonizada por Tom Cruise, es uno de esos proyectos que, a pesar de su complejidad, ha dejado una huella duradera en taquilla, atrayendo a seguidores de larga data y nuevos espectadores.

**Sinopsis**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQvWEhqcNSxKjhiYfx47XympxmHK9bRtfubuf5s9axL5N/1777341076745.jpg)

[www.imdb.com](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0790724/)

El filme se centra en Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise), un exmayordel Ejército estadounidense e investigador de la Policía Militar, normalmente inaccesible, quien es solicitado para ayudar en una investigación de homicidio. El caso involucra a un francotirador militar entrenado, presumiblemente responsable de un tiroteo masivo.

El enfrentamiento entre Reacher y Zek Chelovek, un antiguo prisionero del Gulag soviético, fue un elemento clave que le dio un toque único a la película. Este éxito llevó a la creación de una secuela con Cruise como protagonista, titulada **Jack Reacher: Never Go Back**, basada en la novela homónima de 2013, que se estrenó el 21 de octubre de 2016.

**Elenco**

[www.filmaffinity.com](https://www.filmaffinity.com/cr/movieimage.php?imageId=454843510)

Tom Cruise interpreta a Jack Reacher, un exinvestigador de la Policía Militar del Ejército de los Estados Unidos, ahora vagabundo. Lo acompañan Rosamund Pike como Helen Rodin, abogada defensora; Richard Jenkins como el fiscal de distrito Alex Rodin; Werner Herzog como Zek Chelovek; David Oyelowo como el detective Calvin Emerson; Jai Courtney como Charlie, sicario de Zek; Joseph Sikora como James Mark Barr, exfrancotirador y principal sospechoso; y Robert Duvall como Martin Cash, exsargento y dueño de una armería.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmTvC6NNzdJh32tZJf2fALE1BUmtioS1XGWGt7xRUSZpTg/1777341528961.jpg

Esta magnífica entrega, aunque presenta escenas de violencia y persecución típicas del cine de acción, puede ser disfrutada en buena compañía.

Para mí, posee una excelente calidad visual y estética que la hacen deseable, como todos los proyectos de Cruise. Merece una calificación de 10/10.

Espero que les haya gustado este contenido y que sea de su agrado.

After a few days of sunshine, it was overcast today, with a bit of rain in the air. I think the rain made some of the lighter coloured leaves pop a lot more in the wood, next to the dullness of the morning.

I had to look on the Royal Horticultural Society website to find out what these structures in the trees are. Apparently, they are witches’ brooms, which are unusual clumps of twigs and branches that form in trees because of either fungi, pests, diseases, etc. You learn something new every day!

body.title: Reflecting And Listening To My Inner Self
body.body:
# Hello learners and community 🥰💕.

Its good to be back to share with you again on this amazing topic and why its important to everyone for the purpose of that just one moment you are alone with yourself.

Reflection time can be that quiet moment we wonder 💭 through thoughts that can change our reasoning, planning, situations and bring some new ideas into our thoughts because we are just alone without noise and distractions, especially from children, hubby or other loved 🥰 ones . And this quiet time can also sometimes bring something that is positive which should be what reflection is centered on and not the negative side of life.

And because of the kind of environment we find ourselves most times, the noise, family problems, pressures from work, distractions from other external factors, it becomes very hard to even seat down to have inner thoughts 💭 over some certain things and how to have solutions over them.

# Thoughts During Mid-Nights:

I am not an early to bed person because of how I love ❤️ to watch movies 🎥. Watching movies is the last thing I do every day s which usually falls between the hours of 11:00 pm and 1:00 am of the new day, and this because this system has helped me mentally. So I found out that when I need to relax, I will need a movie at this time of the night. And at this time of the night? The family is already in bed 🛌 and neighbors shot out from noise. This is usually when I have time to reflect over things, especially, concentrating on the positive side of life.

I have been able to reflect and resolve many things during this time of the mid-night. Speaking to myself, asking questions and and making sure to answer those questions with one resolution or the other., because that is what being positive with life is all about. So as I watch my movie 🎥 at this hour of the mid-night and into early mornings of the next day, my mind drifts off to some certain issues of worries that I needed to find a solution to, and with focus of no noise and distractions, maybe the Holy Spirits or the Angels 😇 of the Lord directs your reasoning and thoughts 💭.

You can not know how good it is to be alone sometimes. And you can not know how important it is too, to stay away from noise. I see distractions as one external factor that hinder us most times from concentration, make us loose focus and miss out on that problem solution. So its very obvious that we should stay away from noise, distractions, once we are facing some challenges in life. 

So my mid-night time movie 🎥 watching is not just for luxury and relaxation, but a reflection time for me. This is usually when the night start being dead, but that is the appropriate time for the night owls 🦉 who knows how important this hours  are. For me, these few hours of noiselessness without distractions are the most hours I cherish.

For the past few months now, I have been having issues on my hands. Issues that I needed to find solutions to because they concerns family. So each night I will be up to watch my movie, because I don’t want to feel down. And knowing that these hours of movie watching will help me to resolve those problems, I continued. And each night one idea will come, which I will reflect upon. And as the week keep moving, more ideas were coming from my inner self, and with several thoughts 💭, putting all the ideas together has helped me to reach a conclusion towards solving these problems. 

Reflection is an unending lifestyle that has helped many people through the journey of life. Although, it happens in different ways. Some during walkouts, some during yoga 🧘‍♀️, some while working and many others during mid-night, mid-morning. Its a lifestyle that I can not do without especially now that I know how important it is to my well-being and mental health.

This is my response to the #hiveleaners featured content for week 215, edition 01.

# Thanks for reading friends 😍💕.

# Best Regards @sunshine29 🧡

Images are mine.

/>\n\nperhaps not the most exciting find but let's show a little love to our commensal feathered companions

body.title: Finding Beauty on a Hot Day
body.body:
Today really felt like we were back in the middle of summer again. The heat was unusually strong, and by mid-afternoon the sun felt like it was burning on my skin. I honestly thought that kind of weather would end with a heavy rain, because that is usually what happens after such an intense, warm day. But this time, the rain never came. Even so, I still found something worth appreciating. ![1000134875.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo1vsBr9wBZNGaPSyMfk1J7BwqhsNT9Fd6vRiMnQ7GUHEgKxz7shqF1K2e3uk9CZDzh.jpg) Despite the heat, I was able to take a few photos of some flowers that caught my attention. In moments like this, I am reminded that beauty still exists even when the weather feels uncomfortable and tiring. The flowers stood there quietly, unaffected by my complaints about the heat, simply continuing to bloom as they were meant to. That alone felt calming to me. In black and white, these flowers took on a different kind of mood. Their petals, shapes, and contrast against the darker leaves gave them a soft but striking presence. Some looked delicate, while others carried a stronger character because of their form and texture. It is always interesting to me how monochrome can make even a very ordinary subject feel more expressive. I think today’s little lesson is about accepting that not everything will happen the way we expect. Sometimes we assume relief is coming, just like I assumed the rain would arrive after the heat. But life does not always follow the pattern we have in mind. Still, even when expectations are not met, that does not mean the day has nothing good to offer. Sometimes, we just need to shift our attention and notice what is still beautiful in front of us. So even if the rain did not come today, I am still thankful I found these flowers and had the chance to capture them. I hope you’ll like the photos I am sharing. body.title: Splinterlands - Opening 4 gladius packs with blood stones
body.body:
![gc.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23w2eTHR9oVhaZSXD3mkEwjT7zgyiHrJLh592LrGt7x8qAVHnQrshGHMNXYjUxNdidnBr.png)

Hello everyone, have a nice day and good battles. This time I will be opening 4 gladius packs with blood stones, so my chances of getting legendary gladiators will increase by 0.8%. I spent a total of 9,080 merits in buying the gladius packs and blood stones.

Unfortunately, I didn't get any legendary or gold gladiators, but I did get three epic gladiators, so they were very pretty good packs.
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tRzsXXcHTHcvJXsaNfh93TDd8dBiGbEJMdxAMQpGB7qCCQ9ZviAuBVUnmKAGzQ4SRtJ.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/EoEiitEFW6jHdhP7Cv622mZrRy3F24572BrCRF2W3nid7Ten4xtWrJ5LAJc4m3x7EnH.png)
[Opening link](https://splinterlands.com/mana-well?t=08f75036557d45c2733be06da38c90518c9e99cf&ref=langice)</center>

---

Finally, my Quora Towershead is at level 4, where she gained +1 hit point. And when she reaches the level 5, she will learn the Dispel ability, which allows her to remove the positive buffs from the enemy she attacks.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23t773UmEcGseXcQ6XpaM4tufiPxhwLQFRWNTMPjXRUVKupnDuiV2fSjp6rQbhM8iyvJv.png)

---

My epic Edith Emberstar now needs eight more copies to reach the level 5, where she will learn the Strengthen ability, so while she is alive, she will increase the health of her allies and herself by 1.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23t77BAZ3E5F5oejv7jxQQdLC9CoGE3HD8es1KTgvFVKdLhK5tm8j6LHsSgsTQ9JrGySY.png)

---

Now, all my epic gladiators are at level 4. The gladiator closest to reaching the level 5 is Gorth, who only needs three more copies, and Quora Towershead is the furthest away. I hope to get one legendary gladiator next time, since I don't have many and I wish you the same; have fun opening packs and playing.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23uFH68HR1u1yuBms76mNHDd9ALaLtf1mAqjtSitbjeiXtPwEjtrX4zKVMiZmuThzbEKW.png)

---

Are you not playing Splinterlands yet? You can join with my [referral link](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=langice) and I will give you 600 DEC when you buy the spellbook.

That's all for now guys, see you on the battlefield!

---

Moonkarts: https://moonkarts.arcadecolony.com

body.title: De la idea a la pantalla: Publicar y el síndrome del impostor
body.body: >¡Llegamos al final de nuestra primera serie! Semana a semana, hemos descubierto unos de los pasos principales para ser un mejor creador de contenido en tu blog. Descubrimos la primera semana, cómo cazar ideas, léelo <a target=\
>aquí . La segunda semana, analizamos cuál es la estructura ideal para hacer un post perfecto, consulta
>aquí mis consejos. La tercera semana aprendimos la importancia de escribir con alma y editar con mente fría, descúbrelo

>aquí. La cuarta semana de este mes, sentamos las bases para vestir el contenido desde lo necesario de implementar un buen SEO (básicamente) a utilizar una buena estética alineada a tu marca personal o empresarial, aprende

>Ahora falta el paso más aterrador y, a la vez, el más emocionante: darle al botón de publicar y compartirlo con el mundo.

\n\n
>Imagen creada con inteligencia artificial Gemini.
>Batalla con el síndrome del impostor
>Justo antes de publicar, es normal que aparezca una voz en tu cabeza diciendo: \

>Mi consejo: El síndrome del impostor no desaparece, solo aprendes a ignorarlo. No necesitas ser una experta o un referente a nivel mundial para compartir tu verdad. Tu perspectiva es única y siempre habrá alguien un paso detrás de ti que necesite leer exactamente lo que tú escribiste hoy. Si tu intención es ayudar o inspirar, ya eres lo suficientemente buena.

\n\n
>Imagen creada con inteligencia artificial Gemini.
>No copies tu contenido del blog, a las redes sociales

>Una vez que el post está en línea, el siguiente paso es llevarlo a las redes sociales. Pero aquí hay un secreto profesional que aprendí y que quiero regalarte: el contenido en redes debe ser inédito. Si copias y pegas exactamente el mismo texto de tu blog en Instagram o LinkedIn, le quitas a tu audiencia el motivo para visitar tu blog.

\n\n*
>Adapta el formato: En redes, cuenta el \

o una anécdota corta que complemente el post.

\n*
>Crea curiosidad: Dale a tu audiencia una \

de lo que encontrarán en el blog, pero no les des la comida completa.

\n*

>El objetivo: Tu red social es el puente, tu blog es la casa. Quieres que crucen el puente, no que se queden parados en él.

\n\n
>Imagen creada con inteligencia artificial Gemini.
>Del blog al mundo: Estrategia de difusión\n\n*

: Busca las frases que pusiste en negrita en tu edición y úsalas como artes visuales o frases para Twitter/X.

\n*

>Habla a cámara: Haz una historia contando por qué este tema te emocionó hoy. Usa esa energía que registraste en Musa para transmitir tu mensaje de forma humana.

\n*

>Interactúa: El post no termina cuando publicas. Responde comentarios, pregunta opiniones y crea conversación.

\n\n

>Este es el cierre de esta etapa de la serie, pero es solo el comienzo de un camino prometedor. Puedo darte todas las herramientas del mundo, pero nada de esto sirve si se queda guardado en tu carpeta de borradores.

>Mi mayor deseo es que hoy te atrevas, que dejes de planear y empieces a hacer. Ya sea bloguear, vloguear o crear ese primer carrusel; el mundo necesita tu voz. No esperes a que sea perfecto, solo haz que sea real.
>¿Qué es lo que más te detiene a la hora de publicar? ¿Es el miedo al qué dirán o la parte técnica? ¡Hablemos en los comentarios y apoyémonos entre todas!

>We’ve reached the end of our first series! Week by week, we’ve explored some of the key steps to becoming a better content creator for your blog. In the first week, we learned how to brainstorm ideas—read about it <a target=\
>here. In the second week, we analyzed the ideal structure for a perfect blog post—check out my tips
>here. In the third week, we learned the importance of writing with passion and editing with a clear head—find out more

>here. In the fourth week of this month, we laid the groundwork for presenting your content, from the essentials of implementing good SEO (basically) to using a design aesthetic aligned with your personal or business brand—learn more
>Now comes the most terrifying—and at the same time, the most exciting—part: hitting the publish button and sharing it with the world.
>Image created with Gemini artificial intelligence.
>Just before publishing, it's normal for a voice in your head to say, “Who am I to write this?” or “No one will be interested.”

>My advice: Impostor syndrome doesn't go away, you just learn to ignore it. You don't need to be an expert or a global authority to share your truth. Your perspective is unique, and there will always be someone a step behind you who needs to read exactly what you wrote today. If your intention is to help or inspire, you're already good enough

\n\n
>Image created with Gemini artificial intelligence.
>Don't copy your blog content to social media

>Once your post is online, the next step is to share it on social media. But here's a trade secret I've learned that I want to share with you: your social media content should be original. If you copy and paste the exact same text from your blog onto Instagram or LinkedIn, you're taking away your audience's reason to visit your blog.

\n\n*

>Adapt the format: On social media, share a “behind the scenes” story or a short anecdote that complements the post.

\n*

>Create curiosity: Give your audience a “taste” of what they'll find on the blog, but don't give them the whole meal.

\n*

>The goal: Your social media is the bridge, your blog is the house. You want them to cross the bridge, not stand on it.

\n\n
>Image created with Gemini artificial intelligence.
>From blog to world: Dissemination strategy\n\n*

>Extract “power phrases”: Find the phrases you bolded in your edit and use them as visual art or phrases for Twitter/X.

\n*

>Speak to the camera: Tell a story about why this topic excited you today. Use the energy you recorded in Musa to convey your message in a human way.

\n*

>Interact: The post doesn't end when you publish it. Respond to comments, ask for opinions, and create conversation.

\n\n

>This is the end of this stage of the series, but it's only the beginning of a promising journey. I can give you all the tools in the world, but none of it matters if it stays locked away in your drafts folder.

>My greatest wish is that today you dare to take the plunge, that you stop planning and start doing. Whether it's blogging, vlogging, or creating that first carousel, the world needs your voice. Don't wait for it to be perfect, just make it real.
>What stops you most when it comes to publishing? Is it the fear of what people will say or the technical side of things? Let's talk about it in the comments and support each other!

body.title: Life Circles Back To Explain
body.body:
![1000136828.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/EoiUpMNtrQxzUBvsabuf9QkcD8RZAvNncknpB8hZRvd9sAgJifKx2bgcb9jBdKBBepR.jpg)






![topfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/jVIY8Tx5-top-feather.png)








<center>I listen beneath, the initial sounds rising before I can organize them into something aesthetically pleasing and satisfying to my eyes,
I listen beneath, where unfinished phrases arrive carrying a feeling as my careful mind would have edited away from what pleases my listening side,
I listen beneath, trusting that confusion sometimes guards a doorway on labels, where language cannot open too politely,
I listen beneath, wondering if I’m trying to control the message before it fully reaches my logic and my deeper understanding,
I listen beneath, and a sense of something older than planning starts to stir within my mind when it becomes clear and obvious…





<center>I burst open, the anger that had been locked away in the sealed places because I was preoccupied with appearing reasonable and accepting to everyone else,
I burst open, letting force leave my body so softer truths can stop hiding behind clenched teeth and deeper tears,
I burst open, surprised by how grief and tenderness often wait behind the mask of irritation and mask of boredom,
I burst open every time I swallow something that hurts me, what am I protecting underneath this unexpressed pain,
I burst open, and the room fills with interconnected words that I didn’t realize I was capable of sharing through expression…





<center>I write quickly before shame can tidy up the page and transform raw honesty into something acceptable and insignificant,
I write quickly, while memory is still warm enough to reveal details daylight usually scares away compared to the random nights that I’m wild awake,
I write quickly, because hesitation has stolen too many truths by asking them to sound elegant at first, neglecting the honesty behind the experience,
I write quickly, but am I censoring my pain because I fear it will become too real when I put it on paper and read it to the world,
I write quickly, and as I do, hidden rooms within me begin to unlock themselves as I willingly walk through the door of my hidden fears…





<center>I want to trust in the strange arrivals that make little sense until much later when life circles back to explain them,
I want to trust in the the accidental patterns that somehow touch wounds I had not named aloud and not ready to look at,
I want to trust in what enters sideways when direct thinking has already exhausted its narrow road towards I might destined to go,
I want to trust, can I receive guidance without having to dominate the original truest source of it
I want to trust because mystery has helped me where certainty once failed, and what is meant for me may arrive only when I loosen my grip on needing answers and just beginning to trust the process all over again…





<center>Watchwords:
Something older than planning
Mask of irritation
Fear how real in ink
Life circles back explain
Mystery helped me before certainty failed





![bottomfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/bYIitQga-bottom-feather.png)

***

<center>Here is Tikatarot, who dares you to answer the question, *“Who am I?”..*</center>


***
***

<center>As and will always be reminding you to dream:</center> 
<center>*“As you are still the Master of your destiny and the maker of your dreams…”*</center>

“**Phantom Fury**” by **Synth Berserker** is a brutal cinematic military metal song inspired by the Second Battle of Fallujah, also known as Operation Phantom Fury, one of the fiercest urban battles of the Iraq War.

This song is dedicated to the men and women who fought in the Battle of Fallujah / Operation Phantom Fury, and to those who carried the weight of that battle home with them.

This track brings together fast metal riffs, 190 BPM double-kick drums, deep bass male lead vocals, four-part harmony, heroic war bagpipes, and a dark battlefield atmosphere. The song tells the story of U.S. forces pushing house by house, street by street, through the smoke, fire, rubble, and chaos of Fallujah in November 2004.

This is a heavy metal tribute to courage, sacrifice, brotherhood, and the brutal reality of urban combat.

body.title: Hike to Bingham Falls and Covered Bridge in Vermont, USA
body.body:
![IMG_6447.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Eokc5Me9TUHAQ1HT2rjT3YAVhbQ3z5JRgpdk9YrtEJqmmucgXSMVH5cWH7yC33SV7iJ.jpeg)*There are few points like this, where you can peak over the edge and get a view down into the slot canyon and waterworks below.*

   Just out of Stowe town, on the road up into the mountains, streams tumble down through the forest, bringing countless waterfalls to the landscape. All you need to find them is a little time, and an adventurous spirit. I took off to find one of these today, called Bingham Falls. It is a picturesque mountain stream, that enters a rocky slot canyon, before falling into a clear pool, perfect for swimming on a hot summer day. 

  You can access this waterfall from either side of the river, however the shortest route is directly off an easy parking lot off the side of Route 108. The roundtrip there and back is less than a mile, however there are some steep, slippery sections. People have gotten into trouble here before, but mostly those playing around the edges of the cliffs, or trying to jump into the river itself. I was just here for photos and a hike today, so no worries!

  After spending some time in the beautiful forest surrounding the falls, I venture back towards town, along the same river. Here I found one of Vermont's famous historic wooden covered bridges. The Brookdale Bridge was lit up by the late morning sun, so I got my drone out and flew it over for some unique angles. It was a beautiful spring day here in Stowe, Vermont.


![IMG_6444.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23uFPdTWwsAnWu9G5Sy82KtyH9dcdqopC1xXJosPJPYSALhFtsGs1n6mYuKUp8RKjFdGm.jpeg)*The trail down to the bottom of Bingham Falls.*

![IMG_6442.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23u67PgfyFnNtcsfoeVSnQ1yEQG7AnvNGCTKHjmK6sRGvi5scJsTwtdxGBJX14QjLMQhP.jpeg)*Panorama of Bingham Falls on the left, heading downstream to the right.*


![IMG_6434.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Eokca3sgwKj8aFxV5buFyyWCsRL2ZNcRrwmTRRkwrCzAPiUfQnYXTrFyBRqymPMFvbA.jpeg)*Entering Bingham Falls hike, near Smugglers Notch in northern Vermont.*

![IMG_6436.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23tva9ovrqBFy5hTgLqynoN2jdpCNbNH1UStBfkkJnzyDgexn8Kzhn4Ry2NdamKSdYN1w.jpeg)*These are the first cascades visible above Bingham Falls.*

![IMG_6438.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EoeESRhGPkencxtAx1JDKsvEaFRmh8zJJUCiWHhcbpUHhA7GWbQCnip3uKoXRxtWxVx.jpeg)*Just downstream from Bingham Falls, partially hidden by this huge boulder.*

![IMG_6437.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Eokc6sjKqYGBz98kb4Aid19ke3Av64zcnXkd2h8oUs85xKRTVYDARsYopLk32Mqs7DQ.jpeg)*The trail gets steep here. I was pleased to see that there was no more ice, which can make it quite treacherous.*



![IMG_6446.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23vhwer6HLL4KBP7SsohHrv3UQcX1ECD63obgjHhAmSgQt4QGLe1dBxZh3J6RrSHKRzVy.jpeg)*More slot canyon action below.*


![dji_fly_20260427_112646_160_1777303635425_photo_optimized.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/241tQtQnVT6NZ83mQLfaPrezFBjKUAWVQ7M3CJMZ4o2EwWpxfBcs8tNr3pSK2gHTfcYhu.jpeg)*The famous Brookdale Covered Bridge in Vermont.*

![dji_fly_20260427_112556_159_1777303612483_photo_optimized.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23y8mS195WRDLPMTbqFSdaZVYcBDnf51QHcaCgvUoK7rutZhWyCbPXeHac1Ej355Ax8fe.jpeg)*Picture from the middle of the mountain stream.*

![dji_fly_20260427_112234_155_1777303434722_photo_optimized.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23tbsLqEzL66Pq2Ciz3idbicXc7p9QErFEcmeD764AqJyER5sECfkdYCf2EhXM4iPwffG.jpeg)*Aeiral view of the Brookdale Covered Bridge.*

![dji_fly_20260427_112154_153_1777303358537_photo_optimized.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23uZmPAAtcPYXKL7uXY1FA6PyJaaNQoKKSpvLQZTNFqhJhe5J5B2yp5zFAvEqnZVCRzuf.jpeg)*I sent my drone way up high to capture a typical Vermont countryside farm scene, with springtime trees, ready to bud out again as the temps warm up.*

![IMG_6450.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23wMYJ2H8rnCPLVAK1BhLHoqmdYSW5whWGRcnVVTcmoa2tDW8m6wMFKUftb7bvAULZ5bY.jpeg)*A long exposure captures the movement of this mountain stream. This was just above Bingham Falls, which is accessible after a short, but steep hike.*

As always, keep traveling and keep posting.
- Dai Mar

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ1MfFVZvptpLLmpFpZZHb3S1eqFLTwLx7tQKZM4yGC1j/1777380219360.png)

Image Generated By Chatgpt 


Throughout the week, we spend countless hours using our mobile phones; consequently, we feel the need for moments of absolute tranquility—periods entirely free from any distractions. Ideally, doing this on a daily basis would be even more beneficial, as it would help minimize our daily exposure to distractions, prevent our minds from getting entangled in them, and make it much easier for us to simply ignore them. Speaking personally, I, too, struggle with a significant addiction to my mobile phone, and I use it throughout the week—partly because it has become a necessity in today's world. While a daily digital detox can be somewhat challenging, whenever the weekend arrives, I make a point of setting my phone aside to engage in other activities. This helps shift my focus away from the mobile phone and redirect my attention toward other things. I have noticed that whenever I distance myself from my mobile phone, I feel significantly better—especially when I am connecting with nature. Friends, connecting with nature serves as the ultimate digital detox; it not only helps curb your mobile phone addiction but also mitigates the negative health effects associated with excessive phone usage. You may have observed that prolonged screen time often leads to eye strain, headaches, and a peculiar sense of irritability that leaves us feeling physically and mentally exhausted.  Just try doing this yourself sometime—perhaps you, too, have noticed that when you spend an entire day working at the office—meaning sitting in front of a screen for 9 to 10 hours—you have absolutely no energy left by the time you get home. On the other hand, on your day off—even if you spend the whole day working around the house—you don't feel nearly as exhausted as you do after working while seated in front of a screen. I can spend my entire day off gardening without feeling tired; however, sitting in front of a screen for 8 or 9 hours at the office completely drains me, and by the time I get home, all I want to do is eat and go straight to sleep. Although I often have plenty of tasks left to do, the fatigue is so overwhelming that all I crave is rest—nothing else. Mobile phones have become such an essential part of our lives that we can't simply set them aside, yet using them excessively doesn't feel right either.

The last time I engaged in a form of meditation—or rather, stayed away from things that distract the mind—was a few months ago. A group of friends and I traveled to a remote mountainous region; there, we first went trekking, after which we prepared breakfast together and then spent a long time playing games in an open field. It was a truly unique experience for me; in fact, I doubt I used my mobile phone for more than a few minutes that day, as the network coverage there was so sporadic that we simply had no need for our phones. If we were to do something like this every week, we could effectively view it as a form of weekly meditation, helping us stay free from distractions.
If you set aside some time in your daily routine each day—a period where you remain completely still, free from any surrounding distractions, and engage in a conversation with yourself—it can bring about a profound inner healing. You will experience a sense of deep repose and feel completely relaxed.






Thanks for reading my post till the end.

这几天经常刷一个卖车博主的视频。
基本上每个视频里都能看到有客户在那砍价。
其实这也是常态，我作为顾客我也喜欢去砍价。
甚至有时候都不一定是为了砍下来的那几块钱，有时候就是为了这个过程去砍的。
不过那个博主就是无论如何，都不接受砍价。
他能接受大老远跑过来的在跑回去的车票或者油费损耗，但不能接受被砍价看下去一分钱。
其实以前我也不懂，因为我去买东西的时候也经常砍价，大部分的老板都是会在权衡利弊下最终选择接受砍价。
而的确有极少数是不接受的，那时候我甚至会想这是不是傻，因为一件货品不是只看利润高低的。
还得看周转率的，周转的快，哪怕利润低，一样能赚钱。
以前我在火锅店当假期工的时候，就考虑过这个问题。
一个大包间，比如能做十个人那种，看似客单价要比两人桌那种高。
比如两人吃火锅，可能就吃掉一两百块，甚至买个团购，一百块都不用。
而那种大的包间，虽然可能一顿吃出去一两千块钱。
是那种两人小桌子的十倍左右。
但，首先大包间的位置其实就已经占了四到六个小桌子的位置了，
其次，人一多，用餐时间就会比较漫长，因为要喝酒，要交际，要吹牛……
有时候我们两人桌已经撤下去两桌人了，那种大包间的都还在让我们加菜加汤。
其实按照翻台率来算的话，大包间和小桌子最终的利润其实差不多的。
当然，这是建立在一直有人的情况下。
如果人没那么多，翻台没那么高的话，那的确大包间会更有利润。
当然，哪怕大包间利润都没小桌子高，作为一家饭店，还是得有包间的。
举这个例子只是想说明，不是只有高利润（包间）才赚钱，那种低利润但是周转快的（小桌子）也一样赚钱。
因为，有的老板会接受砍价，也就是去走这种高周转的路子。
而那些不接受砍价的老板，往往就不是为了赚眼前的钱了，有时候就是为了打造商业模式。
以后能解放自己。
而且其实有时候这是两笔账。
生意场上最经常说的就是人情可送马，生意不饶针。
就是做人情的话，你别说让你一点钱，我把这件货物给你都行，就看你要不要承这份情。
但是一旦是做生意，少一分一厘都不行。
这是原则，这也是两笔账。
这就是心灵账户。
也就是为什么我们可以接受五十块的外卖，但是无法接受五角钱的配送费。
因为这看似是一笔钱，其实完全不是的。
你会这样嘛？
