body.title: Wall newspaper with work done by the children🎨👧🧒 | Periódico mural con trabajos hechos por los niños🎨👧🧒
body.body:
>

<center>**¡Bienvenido a un nuevo post, querido Hiver!**</center>

<div class=\

> **Trabajo de última hora: Hacer un periódico mural usando los trabajos y dibujos de los niños de la escuela.** Mamá, ayer me comentaba que necesitaba hacer un periódico mural para la presentación de una estudiante. Y que ese periódico debía hacerse con los trabajos que los niños hicieron en clase. Así que nos pusimos manos a la obra. Cada trabajo era hermoso; algunos niños hicieron sus propios dibujos, otros los trajeron impresos. Aun así, se veía el corazón en cada trabajo. >Materiales utilizados: >+ Una lamina de papel bond blanco. >+ Marcadores permanentes y resaltadores. >+ Tijera y pega. >+ Trabajos realizados con anterioridad. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**Last-Minute Project: Create a Wall Newspaper Using the Children's Artwork and Drawings at School.** > >Mom told me yesterday that she needed to make a wall newspaper for a student's presentation. And that this newspaper should be made with the work the children had done in class. > >So we got to work. > >Each piece of work was beautiful; some children made their own drawings, others brought printed ones. Even so, you could see the heart in each piece. > >Materials Used: >+ A sheet of white bond paper. >+ Permanent markers and highlighters. >+ Scissors and glue. >+ Previously completed artwork.
![photo_2026-04-28_10-25-18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/Ep3fD3UXJxFMdVnHyMddwTfhTc775zpTbaK3toGMxwbcSdF55dhwpCVuofrRhryUxPd.jpg)

> Primero doblamos la lámina de papel bond a la mitad, tal como un periódico, y empezamos a rellenar la primera página. Para ello colocamos el título a lápiz y luego repasamos con el marcador negro. >! [English version available by clicking here] >First, fold the sheet of bond paper in half, like a newspaper, and begin filling in the first page. > >To do this, write the title in pencil and then go over it with the black marker.
![photo_2026-04-28_10-24-11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/EoptNsr3cSZJdXrAMGD9Pz7h6cvagAG7S34PpKvYAMb1AZbsQ4SuXGjnABsh3yFubAM.jpg)

> Después elegimos los trabajos que tendría la primera página. En este caso usamos 3, este que es el dibujo central y otros dos. También le añadimos un detalle en resaltador amarillo, que son dos muñecos que unen sus manos a través del dibujo. Al tratarse del Congreso de Panamá, era un dibujo apropiado para ello. >! [English version available by clicking here] >Next, we chose the artwork for the first page. In this case, we used three: this one, which is the central drawing, and two others. > >We also added a detail in yellow highlighter: two figures joining hands through the drawing. Since it was for the Congress of Panama, it was an appropriate image for that purpose.
![photo_2026-04-28_10-24-16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/EoErU4fDgFsbgCAUi6McMBR93KDbfYuYhPNp48G5BK8BsCkRtgtYywDHhDuJpaB1DTZ.jpg)

> Posteriormente, le dimos enfoque a algunas palabras del título. Por ahora solo tengo disponibles marcadores, así que fue lo que usamos. >! [English version available by clicking here] >Next, we focused on some words in the title. For now, I only have bookmarks available, so that's what we used.
![photo_2026-04-28_10-32-30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/EpT72qawUqMGvYnuNS3QSu269dmnTStrBBeS1ezjcZ577HMycwqzR4wxAYYxA4TJgX9.jpg)

> Antes de terminar, marcamos los márgenes del periódico con marcador azul. Estos márgenes tienen la medida de 2 cm superior, inferior, izquierda y derecha. Igualmente para cada página del periódico. Con las siguientes páginas hicimos el mismo procedimiento. Además de ello, tomamos una de las frases destacadas de un trabajo y la escribimos sobre la lámina de papel bond. >! [English version available by clicking here] >Before finishing, we marked the margins of the newspaper with a blue marker. These margins measure 2 cm on the top, bottom, left, and right. We did the same for each page of the newspaper. > >We repeated the same procedure with the following pages. In addition, we took one of the highlighted phrases from a news article and wrote it on a sheet of bond paper. |![photo_2026-04-28_10-32-14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/23w2jGPHWrdgmvvCAHRpcnqTuSMCmbZVpdgEemeuD28sJRnDcE5L4gigprkz6YKQvmH76.jpg)|![photo_2026-04-28_10-35-13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/23wC7vj2jW9kyRX1sGwMfijZQhuhKLKxjmZmc4S3ZF9Q94F283W6751f7NsfvUw8cHWKm.jpg)|![photo_2026-04-28_10-35-15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/23wMYHxsPNw9kPKt6Mrfk2z6W7t6HuxypSzcs9vVoiwTSSRXauadQirBU6bipFujixAfW.jpg)| ![photo_2026-04-28_10-35-18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/23uFTcqoUgmTkL3Qe3uFNXf3hRyYU8R71X9hjRq92vStBY2o4j4URNU2pudvunARERDdG.jpg) | |-|-|-|-|

> Aquí puedes ver el resultado de cada una de las páginas. Lo que más me gusta es que son los trabajos de los niños lo que le da vida a este periódico. Así que por ello no realizamos ninguna modificación que altere los trabajos. Solo añadimos dos esquineros al primer dibujo de la portada, para que de esta manera el periódico conserve esa esencia de algo que está hecho a base de sus trabajos, creatividad y cariño. Por ello quiero también mostrarte más de cerca algunos de sus dibujos que me gustaron un montón y son los que están en el trabajo. >! [English version available by clicking here] >Here you can see the result of each page. > >What I love most is that it's the children's artwork that brings this newspaper to life. body.title: Rumbo al escenario - Historia [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
> Luego de conseguir esa inscripción, los días siguientes se convirtieron en una especie de ritual, cada mañana directamente al estudio y cada noche directamente a casa para recargar energía. Lucas ya marcaba el ritmo con precisión, Dani repetía hasta que sus dedos ardían, Michelle afinaba cada nota y Stewie pulía los detalles con una calma. Los días avanzaba cada vez más rápido, había presión, porque no era solo tocar bien, era demostrar que esas diez canciones no eran casualidad. La noche antes del viaje, el estudio estaba en silencio por primera vez en semanas—¿Y si no es suficiente? — comentó Dani. Lucas se levantó, tomó una de las hojas arrugadas del suelo —Esto empezó aquí —dijo—. Michelle sonrió levemente. —Y ahora tenemos algo que antes no: sabemos quiénes somos. >After securing that spot, the days that followed became a sort of ritual: every morning straight to the studio, and every night straight home to recharge. Lucas was already keeping the beat with precision, Dani practiced until her fingers burned, Michelle fine-tuned every note, and Stewie polished the details with calm. # >The days were passing faster and faster; there was pressure, because it wasn’t just about playing well—it was about proving that those ten songs weren’t a fluke. The night before the trip, the studio was silent for the first time in weeks. “What if it’s not enough?” Dani remarked. Lucas stood up, picked up one of the crumpled sheets of paper from the floor. “This started here,” he said. Michelle smiled slightly. “And now we have something we didn’t have before: we know who we are.” ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmevVfFBaUNHRvBvw5obFZAiSRauHnrScu7VyvPt4zxLVV/image.png) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/guitarra-guitarra-de-concierto-4297541/) A la mañana siguiente, el autobús los esperaba para ir a su destino del concurso nacional de Banda. Había emoción, nervios, silencio y así mismo subieron al autobús, donde los instrumentos fueron guardaos con cuidado. Cuando el motor arrancó, Dani rompió el silencio —Bueno, ya no hay vuelta atrás. Lucas miró por la ventana cómo el estudio se hacía pequeño, casi irreconocible a la distancia. A medida que avanzaban por la carretera, la banda pasó por momentos de risas, nervios y silencio. Donde Michelle repasaba cada letra, Stewie golpeaba ritmos sobre sus piernas, Dani escuchaba una y otra vez la misma canción. Y Lucas solo observaba, tratando de vivir y recordar todo de esa experiencia. Al caer la noche, al fin aparecieron las luces de la ciudad y era ahí donde todo se decidiría. El autobús se detuvo frente a un hotel, rodeado de otras bandas, equipos técnicos y muchas personas. —Es más grande de lo que imagine — comentó Michelle. Un coordinador se acercó y les entregó sus acreditaciones, con sus nombres confirmando que ya estaban registrados. Pero todos quedaron sorprendidos al escuchar música y ya una Banda estaba ensayando dentro, sonaba fuerte y profesional. El silencio volvió, pero ya no era el mismo de antes. >The next morning, the bus was waiting to take them to the national band competition. There was excitement, nervousness, and silence, and so they boarded the bus, where the instruments were carefully stowed away. When the engine started, Dani broke the silence. “Well, there’s no turning back now.” Lucas looked out the window as the studio grew smaller, almost unrecognizable in the distance. # >As they drove down the highway, the band went through moments of laughter, nerves, and silence. Michelle went over every lyric, Stewie tapped out rhythms on his legs, and Dani listened to the same song over and over again. And Lucas just watched, trying to soak in and remember every moment of the experience. # >As night fell, the city lights finally came into view, and that was where everything would be decided. The bus stopped in front of a hotel, surrounded by other bands, technical crews, and many people. “It’s bigger than I imagined,” Michelle remarked. # >A coordinator approached and handed them their passes, with their names confirming they were already registered. But everyone was surprised to hear music; a band was already rehearsing inside, sounding loud and professional. Silence returned, but it wasn’t the same as before. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdifxXHpiuM9UMmSRit1TGWaRaoa4VC6Jt4qzQBpGJ4Lr/image.png) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/tres-autob%c3%bas-ciudad-2701353/) Finalmente, la Banda cruzó la entrada del hotel, sabiendo que al otro lado no solo había un escenario sino rivales, presión, expectativas y una oportunidad que no se repetiría. Y mientras las puertas se cerraban detrás de ellos, una idea quedó flotando en el aire: Mañana, alguien brillaría y otros quedarán en la sombra. >Finally, the band walked through the hotel entrance, knowing that on the other side lay not only a stage but also rivals, pressure, expectations, and a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. And as the doors closed behind them, one thought lingered in the air: Tomorrow, someone would shine, while others would be left in the shadows.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

body.title: I Met Him in Pain, I Found a Friend for Life
body.body: When I think of friends school gave me, there is always one particular coursemate of mine I can't forget in a hurry. It's been since 2013 since we graduated, and out of the many friends I got those days, one stands out. Maybe because of how we met, I don't know, but our friendship has been there even though we are all in our different families, building our homes, raising our children with our spouses. Now, to think that this friend is disabled and a male too, you may understand that he isn't my friend because of anything but because of his personality; aside from that, he is not physically fit.Now talking about this friend, I met him in a painful situation as a sick student who couldn't walk nor help himself. ![ChatGPT Image Apr 28, 2026, 04_03_33 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nkemakonam89/48RP2TYknYmKdedk3ejvtX9qJDxpmbNybk7ajsuRdWeNx9cJQwZXRAbqtKZrFeA2Qd.png) I was touched and couldn't help but show empathy. I imagined myself being in his shoes, and tears rolled down my cheeks. In my capacity, I decided to assist him in going back home so he can be taken care of. He spent almost one month at home treating himself, and I made sure to keep in touch all along. When he returned, he was very grateful for the concerns I showed towards his health and recovery, and from there, we started being close friends. This guy is so disabled that he can't stand for minutes without looking for where to sit. I didn't look down on him because of his physical condition but rather showed him care, and then I began to discover that he is too good with practicals in our course of study. I discovered in our second year when we were always doing practices while we met in year one. On my end, I was struggling with practicals so badly, but this friend will always make sure that I am okay with my projects. He taught me more than our lecturer; he devoted his time and energy always putting me through, and months after months, I kept getting better. During our practical exams, he would always keep an eye to be sure I was doing it right, and of course I was grateful. I was super good on the theory aspect of our course too and assisted him as well with that. Before you know it, we were done with school and all graduated with first-class upper division. As expected, he was there live during my wedding; he crossed different states just to attend and I introduced him to my husband, and they became friends. Today he is married too, with two boys, and my self and his wife and kids have been family friends, always checking on each other about life so far after school, family, parenting, and more. What a unique friend indeed. Unfortunately, our picture together was printed and in my father's house, not with me currently. ***Image was created using chatgpt*** ***** ----- ##### 🔗 Apps which I recommend built by body.title: Chasing the Evening at Punggol Beach
body.body:
Last Sunday, I set my sights on cycling all the way to Changi Village. It sounded like a good plan at first, and I was quite excited about it because I have always liked the idea of reaching one of the far ends of Singapore on two wheels. But somewhere halfway through the ride, I had to be honest with myself. I had overestimated my time and energy, and I realized that if I kept pushing toward Changi Village, I would most likely miss the sunset completely. So instead of forcing it, I made a detour and decided to head to Punggol Beach instead. LOL


![1000135375.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eqd7y4441BxgoVZL1UKHf97rFxFj6zotLMNSRPzK7Ph3H567i31nVGc4VXdvrTUsDPE.jpg)


Even though it was not the original destination, I think that is one of the nice things about cycling. You can change your mind anytime and still turn the day into an adventure. Changi Village may be a better spot for sunset in my opinion, but at that moment, what mattered more was making the most of the remaining light and still enjoying the ride.


![1000135327.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EqDi7VMU5vjrnkivdSHkvgnbGrMBtWY3orZ7cXXxdk1oijK6FNedHH5teFG1j7ni4Fh.jpg)

![1000135329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoMDCueHyb4MMq97iiRqnCKAF3JX7bpqPWYdPAH3gKgQkgo8NDFaKuzypH1RCFPfRrR.jpg)

![1000135328.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EqFqbVkuMqhsLpZm3MT3sDKi9R2gsBqkJVDX4S5mH9GzsgwfmCCPYqffg6GcGtaGnVs.jpg)

![1000135330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoyN3cRfHRXCzJfjZXtuF1VtDNVDVesqYaURE6d8GWZMbnuqV4tBswEoxURNsfpb7jA.jpg)


By the time I reached Punggol Beach, the sky was already entering that almost astro, blue stage. The blue hour was fading, and the dramatic colors that usually make sunset photography extra magical were no longer at their peak. Of course, I felt a little disappointed because the sky actually looked promising, and I knew I had arrived just a bit too late. Still, I did not want that to ruin the trip for me.


![1000135341.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EnaYK7RoH5N7jjdrCYzZawMwgGJkweNzk2asBTnfHZoUS4TV9YvEPqAcDDyXJJeen9V.jpg)

![1000135342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EnaYJ6p8i2FHQ3jc1ZU6x2Tdg1TDtkPUoe8wjkDzRmBDiGXL559857hytdi7RhCqGhA.jpg)

![1000135332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EqSUyrhwqD8eSLiSGWAZVkzTBnZiBbBy3sg3pD9bQhmy5ogGoiCqGxhTCXj9szksRsF.jpg)

![1000135343.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EnWHXnfgSWLxYnJYpB7H8a8QCq2B3LyBf2PbW1DXAWbLS2AT8PxW5og4EeC3vXVZ9ZH.jpg)

![1000135335.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eqd9s7Z7X28EhL2q4x3JD6QHCXqGkgEtNtoWKRcFw4pHS19hURmSz9uJRAqouVDmSbA.jpg)


### So I simply slowed down and let myself enjoy the place.


![1000135352.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpEFqxyd6LgjBth5j2ijxxbhPiLSZg6Z3fCPSEsaxyCgAnLoTgmkkMYuQgeiZ5UtKmD.jpg)

![1000135344.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoeCwaQiApzJTYZr7yLz1WW5Jo6Js6MM8m1CA5ZKHPkdSej9twAcGkXdxsag4R4LvBH.jpg)

![1000135346.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EnuiRRmQGmnN8DJeoT39646KRfTs95D3bshRfUJcXV3AHgTWWq8o5bsv4RG67rDHEsk.jpg)

![1000135350.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpVAanxQrenBqv3auSj7Ph4agK6WFUqDvrCgHc9Mg1vtKqoiiT3w6pFaSkkig32Tnhn.jpg)



Punggol Beach has that calm and subtle atmosphere that makes you want to stay a little longer. The sea was gentle, the waves were soft, and the whole area felt peaceful. Most of the visitors were not doing anything too active. Many were just standing quietly, looking out at the water as if they were letting the sea wash away the stress from the week. I could understand that completely. There is something about watching the ocean in the evening that makes everything feel slower and lighter.


![1000135359.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EqHytKXcUhvv2r95e3fkQe8b3sWfYQCkSkkHEP8kY4e8ACgp84ipDB94UudEDQPGL1W.jpg)

![1000135357.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoMEE77s3vSTwX5XtVDPD1zM6Fmj3pmoq5ptHcAW7x3mnHtMLXGG4D22MtxecmE7bgM.jpg)

![1000135358.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eq9Svi3ABKG4KMa3fYV6HXL5NJsPnzB2SFzoiswHxnfivZGvHGA5mb1tvWwzB1zSwzy.jpg)


I also noticed families strolling along the park connector, some joggers passing by, and a few cyclists making their way through the area. There was movement, but it never felt rushed. The place had a very relaxed rhythm. It seemed like everyone came there for the same reason—to breathe, unwind, and enjoy the view.

Of course, I continued exploring the area further. That is where cycling really becomes such a huge advantage for me. With just a few gentle pedals, I could cover a long stretch of the park connector in minutes. If I were walking, it would probably take me five times longer, and by then I might already feel too tired to keep going. Cycling gives me the freedom to see more without draining all my energy too quickly, and that is exactly why I have grown to love it so much.


![1000135364.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EqhLpwM3TtyWANbcquUgP8pvfz3A58S9jXGNuKjcyZV7QGNcU8Xb7aq9znRjdV5RoUb.jpg)

![1000135373.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EqWjoDcBBzLSkj5M49ViVmZxYA5YiYktYcFTEGQgFDeZs3YEwpxynyWgmzADsefAnWP.jpg)

![1000135365.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eq5ByiQm2on9TpMs4Hpe8Quk5qSFMX4Be4Z1maHpk9G97foPxtnxCZnLE7XkwTnb7Nz.jpg)

![1000135369.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoTaSzqAYvQzEURUydG2wfDHcB58ytL3kw6uzNH26QDN6cLKZV4hfc76jNcCf9m6pQB.jpg)


As I moved farther along, I also enjoyed the vibe of the restaurants nearby, especially the live seafood restaurants. Even from a distance, they added a lively energy to the evening. The mix of calm waterfront views and the warm, busy atmosphere of the dining spots made the whole place feel balanced. It was serene, but not empty. Peaceful, but still alive.

***Although I did not make it to Changi Village, and although I arrived a little late for the best sunset, I still enjoyed this cycling adventure to Punggol Beach. Sometimes, not everything goes according to plan, but the experience can still be worth it. In fact, that is part of the fun. Every ride teaches me something, about timing, distance, patience, and how to appreciate the journey even when the original plan changes.***


![1000135378.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/244xnjQLU725scGhz7cGA7zqBdowCjvWSN5z4w7mPWxzxLXkyPocvQM8EwzWnFJfqVfeX.jpg)


### I am pretty sure I will return here again, maybe a little earlier next time, so I can catch the sky at its best.

## See you on my next cycling adventure!





***


https://images.ecency.com/p/x7L2VSNEiyAB5Ux7nxKqZetUQAKDhXE3SwQAvkNJXbDxJbhhbSoDYkFW3TPedgzbYRsZXheJpwhchfs.png?format=match&mode=fit



***

body.title: I Refuse to Stay Silent | LOH #286
body.body:
>



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23wXDkb5225YZHRgBqX4DokXgvm7yFeZVDJxhbQT2To3Ya3o76wTbhtcYMNLyhGo5qZig.png)
<sub>[source](https://ph.pinterest.com/pin/763078730657064873/)</sub>

**“What if the person breaking you is someone you’re expected to trust? What if the place that’s supposed to feel safe becomes the very place you learn to stay silent?”**
Bullying doesn’t always come from strangers. Sometimes, it comes from familiar faces, people who know your name, your routine, even your weaknesses. And when that happens, the pain cuts deeper, the silence grows heavier, and the confusion becomes harder to escape.

This isn’t just another story about bullying.
This is MY story and the truth I wish someone told me sooner.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/EoeEVA2dB4QygYPPY41bZYJJ86tAiaQTj4GeJLKN9TyXuU4HXe5THbPj8pGrFHa7tEL.png)


As someone who experienced bullying and harassment firsthand, especially from my own cousins in the same school when I was younger, I can firmly say this: bullying is NOT a trend, and it should never be normalized.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23xAW4m22r9LXzuyB363VnXkVJH2M8k5gLPdzkUqhQ2nbdAXuSuTkPLb1dkadFddKgPep.png)
<sub>**AI-generated**</sub>

Yes, I’ve grown into a mature and strong woman today. But the truth is, the scars it left didn’t simply disappear. Some wounds stay, but they run deep. And no child... NO PERSON... deserves to carry that kind of pain.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/EpA3zw2SoFJ8WSppfoG4c2WMcY5TEXZJVxgozLSfNjJrjT2a9uB4NJA7FpGmh2QYU3E.png)


Back then, I thought I could stop the bullying by pleasing them, by becoming someone they would accept. I tried to be their “puppy,” thinking that obedience would earn me peace.

It didn’t.

And if you’re a child going through this right now, hear me clearly: that is NOT the solution. I also made a mistake. I stayed silent. I didn’t tell my parents. And that silence cost me more pain than I deserved. So if you’re being bullied, I’m speaking to you not just as someone who survived it, but as your aspiring attorney, @rufajane, ready to stand with you and guide you through it.

**Here’s what you need to do:**


**1. *Tell someone who can truly help.***
Not just your peers. You need protection, not gossip. Go to your parents or guardians first, 'cuz you know they have the power and responsibility to protect you. If that’s not possible, reach out to a trusted teacher, school head, or any responsible adult. You deserve to be heard, and they are accountable for your safety.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/242Y7vJv98wgkJUj6RjEn2ScvYGUKVyaqv18DC7SiMwVPVZccpYMFToa7PeyBn6B5q4Ka.png)
<sub>**AI-generated**</sub>


**2. *Stay away from the bully when possible.***
Avoid places where you’re most likely to encounter them. Don’t walk home alone if you feel unsafe. Surround yourself with people you trust. Safety is not weakness, it’s wisdom.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23x1B9udYib5SonjwUBp5kMNKWNMFtHYwBzVu9Nbfay5eYJErUvMXEYtes5EViASS7zBG.png)
<sub>**AI-generated**</sub>

**3. *Do not fuel their behavior.***
Bullies often seek reactions. Don’t give them the satisfaction. Stay calm as much as you can, and avoid engaging in arguments that could escalate the situation.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23xVK4wG2UiaEd5uq3c5vbFfCo4tEhPxnDHNbw1q1MxnS2g11pLWQ4vZg9eHdJJwwYx8g.png)
<sub>**AI-generated**</sub >


**4. *Don’t isolate yourself.***
Being alone can make you more vulnerable. Stay connected with supportive people. You are not meant to fight this battle alone.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23xVPb6bfeCc8iXLB3CjGJnDtbHWAvjuHw5JxT8ufSNszRAfFRDzaT9NM8TdXnTDMi6iJ.png)
<sub>**AI-generated**</sub>


**5. *Be firm and set boundaries.***
Look them in the eye and tell them to STOP. Clearly. Confidently. And if they continue, report them immediately. Speaking up is not DISRESPECT, but SELF-RESPECT.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23xAZphtZaubgFyfHzs5hiqgmCoUi2MWXMpjX68F1f13MsHsPLgWmJv214HQntgJjkhdr.png)
<sub>**AI-generated**</sub>


**6. *Don’t pass the pain forward.***
Never release your anger on someone else just to feel better. Hurt people (bullies) sometimes hurt other people (victims) but you can choose to break that cycle.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23y8v5E8kvzAzJRaZa9ZzTRhT1xTvDNYsn2HgnUi7JxUdvKmDPezwxVWD6GxbyLPE8Dr2.png)
<sub>**AI-generated**</sub>


---


Everyone deserves to feel safe, valued, and happy. Let me say this clearly: It is not your fault that you are being bullied.
You cannot control how others behave but you can choose how you respond and who you trust.

From my own story, I learned that silence protects the wrong people. When I finally opened up to my loving and protective parents, everything began to change and I never regretted that decision.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23zGkoKievRJWfk9yvrpf5TA6qwrALU2QyZHreivDeC7cRBZgmbuWdjLPFLSdAUtQuDqc.png)


There was a time when I believed I was the problem. That maybe I didn’t fit in. That maybe I wasn’t “enough.” But the truth is, there was NEVER a valid reason for them to bully me. I was not less. I was not weak. I was not unworthy.

And neither are you.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/242s3pyow73RinL7U18LCA2b42kTghCxYZqdva4BLtwQML2MBB9cRqnwuztiRe1v6XAiC.png)

It has been nine years since that painful chapter of my life. Today, I stand as a confident woman who speaks up for what is right. As a public speaker, addressing bullying in all its forms has become one of my advocacies because this is a conversation that needs to be heard, loudly and clearly.

I may not be a parent yet (cuz I'm 18 and no time for romantic relationship haha), but I don’t need to be one to understand pain, to stand for truth, or to offer guidance. Experience has given me a voice and I intend to use it.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/EoiY4VkLHVfdVS1UfP8yaEyM1M4BCgJVTJEWKbRi72pGDwQwEU3X6Xov5CB2sgCsnvo.png)

To every child out there who is hurting right now:
Please don’t lose hope.
You are not someone’s emotional punching bag.
You are not weak.
You are not meant to be stepped on.
You are human. You are valuable. You are worthy of respect.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23w2oQUo8jMdbdDDcz2CMMk6cJ7DJwY9UWWxXpT4v3UADWkUPGaUHpCiNETRbAL6CKXvT.png)

There are people who care about you even if it doesn’t feel like it right now. And one day, this painful experience will not define you... it will refine you. So stand up. Speak out. Protect your peace.

You’ve got this. And I believe in you.

</sub>


![Gray and White Simple Fashion Sale Facebook Fundraiser Cover Photo.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/EnYUGipUouu6yKzkTmc7tRdjcLxqjsxjsxkJXxLHFVemDL3w5NnmW83nAY3mnnAEXgm.gif)

body.title: Under the Bridge - Sci Fi Short Story
body.body: >Pixabay The man who had stalked him must be insane, this was his game. The stalk, the slow build of behavior patterns and the final devouring. What was this... amateur hour? The shadows slanted across the alley from the moon's pallid face. The smell of garbage barely masking his scent which reached my twitching nostrils in the heavy heat of summer. At least the fool had got that right, staying down wind. He shouldn't have put on aftershave though. The dank stink of dollar scent mingled with the tang of rotten veg wafting from the garbage behind the Korean place. I licked my lips in anticipation of the kill. These earthlings were not cut out for the hunt. They seemed to see it as an intellectual exercise. The hunt was an equal measure of both instinct and intelligence and this one would learn. ___ She grew pale: her voice had a harsh note in it. \
she stuttered as she glanced away from his snake eyes.\n\n\

Her voice faltered as the lizard slashed the air with razor claws centimeters from her throat. 

\

She clutched her ribs against a sudden wind that ripped down the LA river. 

\

She leaned forward as the lizard held out a fist full of cash. 

\

___

He didn't have the address, but he did have a plan. That slick off-worlder would get what was coming to him for eating his partner. 

*These cursed lizards thought they could come here and set themselves up as hit-men for the cartel, triads or whichever organised group of scumbags could stomach their methods. Not on my watch.*

He pulled the micro-drone from his pocket and dashed some of the ten dollar aftershave onto it's dull metal surface. Then he dropped it to hang in empty air and pressed the button on the units control panel. 

A second detective burst into existence from kaleidoscope of shimmering silver motes. His doppelganger echoed his smile as it walked toward the young woman on the corner. 

\

She nodded, indicating he should follow her. They walked through the wasteland next to the river, the tumbled broken girders from the demolished factory lay strewn around like the bones of an industrial behemoth. The hologram stopped under the bridge as she glanced around nervously and he adjusted to line up a shot.

___

![will-langenberg-jPERzjBp-24-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/244A6YMgJ1r6bGoqdZJ7uXENWrHwutrBcGSEd9cFM6fVRW7exuBxa5pPxEuvbhBj9v3e7.jpg)
<sub>Photo by [Will Langenberg](https://unsplash.com/photos/jPERzjBp-24) on [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com)</sub>


His nostrils twitched as the scent of that dollar aftershave mingled with the stench of sewage from the LA river. Eyes focused on the prey. He lost himself in the pump of blood and the ancient instinctual call of the hunt. The kill time was here and instinct took over.

He darted forward, lightening quick. Vaulted thirty feet over the river as the detective loomed large in his pin-point focus. 

Pain lanced through him. The taste of blood in his own mouth, but not the blood of his prey. A burning pain spreading through his legs as he looked down at the jagged splinter of cryo-shard pulsing in his flesh. He fell forward and landed in the muck at the edge of river's gully.

The detective strode casually up to the lizard shaking his head.

\

The lizard gurgled as it tried to will its vocal cords to work as the paralysis spread throughout its body.

\

*Clever earthling* Crale thought as the detective's boot descended to smash his face over and over, breaking bones and splitting skin.

\
. The detectives voice faded away as he lost consciousness. \n\n\

**The end.**

body.title: Calgary Comic Expo Party of Wonders
body.body:
The weather was too windy for our usual Parade of Wonders that kicks off Calgary Comic Expo. So they set up a dance party in front of the BMO convention center and had a live DJ. The mayor and a few attending celebs came down, and we made the most of it all with 45 minutes of dancing followed by the opening ceremony. 

All in all, it was still a great start; the mayor was dressed as Mario inside a green pipe. Calgary has had some large water main issues that the new mayor, Jeromy Farkas, has been working on fixing, so his cosplay play was very apropos. I saw some knights, some Mandalorians, and even Heisenberg himself, Walt White, getting in on the action.

Julley Everyone,


A fresh new morning over here in these beautiful corners around Himalayas as it was beautiful day where we got this magical beautiful opportunity to explore this portion of the mountain and captured the beauty of this beautiful magical Wonderland and now sharing it with you guys through this post.



![IMG_7901.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb1oamnsPsewPzjySQRnDiY5tVf8LAadeH9jjbE13ew1Z/IMG_7901.jpeg)
This particular pathway has been known, and I have been heard from the old people of the villages. They have been telling us about the stories and about the castle that was at the top of the mountain. All the way in the ancient times and still there were these few of the trails that was still alive, even after hundreds of years ago.

![IMG_7902.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXEMK1GhvZS3gUtuA8rMLtfXhDcYo2ZQ2qhBNjJzAyrMf/IMG_7902.jpeg)
So, I also without thinking, much started my hike all the way early morning until I reached at this particular spot, hiking beyond the ridge that just went all the way took the direction towards the point that I have been pointed out, and it literally felt so adventurous, just exactly like I felt like to be honest, sharing my personal experience that I have been that I went all the way into the scenes of the movie, Lord of the rings, the forest looked something just like this, depicting the beauty of the nature, and also the true nature of its adventure side.


![IMG_7903.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZSSBUMoNZZt6MiJaVH9LiMRc8wadzwhQaSk8MHVa7mKA/IMG_7903.jpeg)
Without carrying much of a hiking equipment or anything else, we decide to explore this particular portion of the mountain as raw as we could so, without even carrying much stuff only carrying the food supplies that we carried all the way from our home and calling it a day hike, all the way, not even the GPS maps, but all that we navigating were just the maps of a mobile phone and just by the direction we decided to walk and explore the place further and further.



![IMG_7905.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWT8ihb3Xv21zRmkemdZb4ng3y3y1jAkvCFnijRJaiGTi/IMG_7905.jpeg)
We even made our own hiking stick from the stick that we just chopped while we were on our way, so we made it just in order for a protection from the wild animals and also so that we could use this stick as a hiking stick hiking to the woods and the Jungle beyond another thing that I noticed when I was at this place, it was that at certain point there was few of the shaded portions around mountains that was still covered with a thick sheet of snow
Even it was the later time of the winter season that just passed last month, but still these few of the corners around mountains, silver experiencing snow that was on the portions.

![IMG_7907.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTHw3QyCQgPKgugWCtpngKEuEu6WEPiyV73pw31Adz8JZ/IMG_7907.jpeg)
Hiking through the forest, thick dense  forest. As after hiking from the nearest village, we reached at this particular portion that was that there were these thick freeze all the way in these remote, isolated locations and even much more my friends so dance we were all alone in this forest, hiking, and reaching at a higher altitude place.

Another thing that I noticed when I was at this place, it was that I saw that there was this particular portion in the forest where there was a small hole in the tree, the bark of the tree or the trunk of the tree and it acted as the nest of the birds, maybe in the olden times, any bird would have made its nest over here that looked something just like this.

*This was the main highlight of the adventure as we were walking. We came across this particular portion where there was a deep fall, but there was naturally constructed rock that was in the ancient Time. Also, we were walking over it, just not to cross this particular rather than jumping because it was so deep by the side.*



![IMG_7913.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYP2cQmYPwFNYxLYbydeLh7Mghcae1k3jkaJwoYqx7K59/IMG_7913.jpeg)

![IMG_7916.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZBSNJUG6LtAMdUizvWfFZqr1RRWs7P6iTARp7xrLrZXw/IMG_7916.jpeg)

It literally felt like that I just came all the way in the Lord of the rings movie kind of setting as it looked like the ancient Times truly tree, the dense forest and everything and much more my friends. Grateful that opportunity to share these photographs with you and share this particular moment with you, so I tried capturing as many photographs as I could all the way and now sharing these photographs, and these moments with you guys through this post.

body.title: Monomad: Details on pipe cleaners [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
>

This is my entry for the #monomad challenge.

Photography has a certain beauty that sometimes escapes the human eye when we look at simple things, and today I’m sharing the photos I took of some pipe-cleaner flowers (which I made for my girlfriend) that have some details I really liked; I hope you enjoy them.

La fotografía tiene cierta belleza que en ocasiones se escapa del ojo humano cuando observamos cosas sencillas, y el día de hoy les comparto las fotografías que hice a unas flores de limpiapipas (las cuales hice yo para mi novia) que tienen ciertos detalles que me gustaron bastante; espero que las disfruten.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmecbAv6PV9zKw1vNTwWc5TTsHQr5r9Xbm18xvAeFCx6cy/dsc08319.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmNm6XWZsk772onw9v9eu5FH1fYKGrJc5jbeXy2dS3Gmd2/dsc08328.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmXMft9JzTckzCBBEMhkaHubqPtTYkbadTgEZdcqrNkPq7/dsc08335.jpg

>

The flowers are naturally white, so when I convert the photos to black and white, the white remains, creating a beautiful contrast with the black background where I took the photos. Thanks to the direct light, it creates that dramatic effect that I love so much.

El color de las flores es blanco originalmente, por ende, al pasarlas en blanco y negro el blanco se mantiene y esto genera un contraste muy bonito con el fondo negro donde hice las fotografías, porque gracias a la luz que le daba directamente, genera ese toque dramático que tanto me gusta.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmXa6p8BnDwXYPibwCusj8C6Nes3TzJFuvbyTND9gtZ2Wj/dsc08346.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmQgBu7tXggomEeZeoLZ6C2rdK5PwtUYaX1krDVHyV6MFn/dsc08357.jpg

>

As I mentioned at the beginning, the details are what really stand out, which is why I included close-ups in some of the photos—so you could appreciate the details of the pipe cleaner, which, at least for me, I hadn’t really noticed until I decided to make this craft.

Como mencionaba al principio, los detalles son lo más llamativo y por eso hice esos acercamientos en algunas fotografías, para que apreciaran los detalles del limpiapipas, las cuales, al menos yo, no había visto muy buen hasta que decidí hacer esa manualidad.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmcfc4ZEWgmnAUpQf9DQkQEGNab6Lo85PCB6afZQ4dZKiw/dsc08358.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQma8Rcu9PnBFFxA3RcyFjCWkZgP5UthWwhr2gMgwrNoBgM/dsc08367.jpg

>

That's all for today. Thank you so much for taking the time to look at my photos and read a little of what I've written. I hope you enjoyed it. I hope you all have a wonderful Tuesday, dear friends in the community and lovers of black-and-white photography. See you next time!

Esto es todo por el día de hoy, muchas gracias por tomarse el tiempo de ver mis fotografías y leer un poco de lo que escribo, espero que lo disfrutaran. Deseo que todos tengan un excelente martes, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía en blanco y negro. ¡Hasta la próxima!

/>

body.title: The World Moves On Without You
body.body: After just one hour of your death, people begin to eat in your name as if you never existed. A day passes, and your friends quietly return to their routines. Your silence is no longer heard. A week goes by, and someone else sits in your place. Your chair is no longer yours, and your belongings start to disappear like you were never there. A year later, you become nothing more than a fading story, mentioned less remembered rarely. And yet, you spent your whole life worrying about what people would say. But the truth is no one really has the time to remember you forever. Everyone is busy fighting their own battles, lost in their own exhaustion. So live for yourself. Love yourself. Because the world

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![OH7zbPNA58WIj4Xz_mmexport1777387235821.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/lenalu/images/OH7zbPNA58WIj4Xz_mmexport1777387235821/OH7zbPNA58WIj4Xz_mmexport1777387235821.webp)
![OHf8Ie25WKI1ixBR_mmexport1777387232536.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/lenalu/images/OHf8Ie25WKI1ixBR_mmexport1777387232536/OHf8Ie25WKI1ixBR_mmexport1777387232536.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

今天又有感慨了。
跟同事的电动车真不能停得太近，本来下班收拾完东西就想直接回家，结果车靠在一起，随口聊了几句，一下子就聊上头了。
 
一开始就是互相吐槽几句上班的日常琐事，聊着聊着就扯远了，聊到大润发里面各种各样好吃的零食小吃🥲再接着往下聊，又说到街边热闹的路边摊，烤串、炸串还有各种小饮料，光说着都忍不住嘴馋。
 
本来下班打算去跑跑步活动一下，减减平时久坐长出来的肉。结果倒好，运动还没开始，各种想吃东西的念头先冒出来了，肉没减掉，反倒又要囤不少脂肪，想想也是挺无奈的😅
 
不过今天有个挺开心的消息，单位马上要放五一小长假了。天天早出晚归上班，人早就累得不行，总算能盼到假期好好歇一歇了。
 
出门闲逛的时候买了点新鲜杨梅，差不多20块一斤，酸酸甜甜的，吃着刚好能缓解一些上班的疲惫。感觉自己太容易满足了，一口好吃的，就能够让我开心好久。

---

body.title: The Bridgerton Chronicles /La Chronique des Bridgerton (season /saison 4) EN /FR
body.body:
Hello film lovers, /Bonjour les cinéphiles,

I was really looking forward to watching this fourth season, which consists of eight episodes in total, but with the ten seasons of *Smallville* to get through, we’ve taken our time before watching all the films and series that keep appearing on Netflix and that we’re interested in.

> J'avais hâte de voir cette 4e saison, composée de 8 épisodes au total, mais avec les 10 saisons de Smallville, nous avons pris un peu de temps avant de regarder tous les films et séries qui continuent d'arriver sur Netflix et qui nous intéressent.


![bridgerton.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florenceboens/EoyNZja1EQ6Fvh3NP1jyAKKgTjRnMGrtS6Ctoa6sHzLDiKdTiPfd9XxjDX2DnmUCdur.webp)
[Source](https://s1.qwant.com/thumbr/474x592/0/7/7f7e97f8658add2d5d32f57e704ce4aa0d0e3e7d4b89275a4efafce035e308/OIP.P84Tn9WxAIyx7DvewW5d-QHaJQ.jpg?u=https%3A%2F%2Ftse.mm.bing.net%2Fth%2Fid%2FOIP.P84Tn9WxAIyx7DvewW5d-QHaJQ%3Fpid%3DApi&q=0&b=1&p=0&a=0)
*Season 4 poster /Affiche de la saison 4*

***Synospis :***

The first ball of the season is hosted by the Bridgerton family at their home, and is a masked ball. 

The Queen is in attendance, of course, to choose the young lady who will be her ‘diamond’ and who will therefore be the most sought-after for marriage… except that… this year, the Queen fancies a change and will choose the man to be married, namely Benedict Bridgerton!

She even makes a bet with Lady Whistledown/Penelope Bridgerton, who doesn’t believe it for a moment, knowing Benedict well, as he is far from ready to marry.

At his mother’s insistence, Benedict deigns to make an appearance at the ball and chat with the ‘beginners’ who have eyes for no one but him. His gaze then falls upon a young lady, dressed in silver, gazing in admiration at the chandelier. He does not know her, yet something is happening.

When, at midnight, the masks must come off, this young lady in silver must leave, lest she be unmasked by her mistress.  

> Le premier bal de la saison est organisé par la famille Bridgerton, en sa demeure, et est un bal masqué. 
> 
> La reine y est présente, bien évidemment, pour choisir la jeune fille qui sera son diamant et qui sera donc la plus convoitée en vue d'épousailles .. sauf que .. cette année, la reine a envie de changement et choisira l'homme à marier, en la personne de Benedict Bridgerton !
> 
> Elle prend même le pari avec Lady Whistledown/Penelope Bridgerton, celle-ci n'y croyant pas du tout, connaissant bien Benedict, qui est loin d'être prêt à se marier.
> 
> Sous l'insistance de sa mère, Benedict daigne tout de même faire une apparition au bal et discuter avec les \

qui n'ont d'yeux que pour lui. Son regard se porte alors sur une jeune dame, vêtue d'argent, en admiration devant le lustre. Il ne la connaît pas, pourtant quelque chose se passe.
> 
> Quand, à minuit, les masques doivent tomber, cette jeune dame d'argent doit partir, sous peine d'être démasquée par sa patronne.  


---

***My opinion and a few facts /Mon avis et petites infos :***

I really love this series; even though some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, it’s a real treat.

There’s romantic and steamy love, there’s humour, beautiful settings, and different atmospheres depending on which house we’re in.

> J'aime beaucoup cette série, même si plusieurs choses sont \
, elle nous fait du bien.\n> \n> Il y a de l'amour romantique et \

, il y a de l'humour, de beaux décors et des ambiances différentes selon la maison dans laquelle nous nous trouvons.

New additions to the cast: 

Yerin Ha: Sophie Baek
Katie Leung: Lady Araminta Gun, mother to Rosamund and Posy and Sophie’s stepmother
Michelle Mao: Rosamund Li, Araminta’s eldest daughter and one of Sophie’s half-sisters
Isabella Wei: Posy Li, Araminta’s youngest daughter and one of Sophie’s half-sisters

You may have seen Yerin Ha in the series Halo, playing the role of Kwan Ha.
Katie Leung made a name for herself in Harry Potter, playing Cho Chang.

> Les nouvelles têtes au casting : 
> 
> Yerin Ha : Sophie Baek
Katie Leung : Lady Araminta Gun, la mère de Rosamund et Posy et la belle-mère de Sophie
Michelle Mao : Rosamund Li, la fille ainée d'Araminta et l'une des demi-sœurs de Sophie
Isabella Wei : Posy Li, la fille cadette d'Araminta et l'une des demi-sœurs de Sophie
> 
> Vous avez peut-être vu Yerin Ha dans la série Halo dans le rôle de Kwan Ha.
Katie Leung s'est fait remarquer dans Harry Potter, en interprétant Cho Chang.

Season 5, which will focus on Francesca, is currently being filmed and will not be broadcast until late 2027. Season 6 is also already planned and will likely focus on Héloïse.
The production company has decided to change the order of the seasons compared to Julia Quinn’s books and has also decided to announce the character who will be featured in the next season, rather than keeping it a mystery.

Roll on the end of 2027! 

Enjoy your evenings in front of the telly and see you soon, 

> Une saison 5, qui parlera de Francesca, est en cours de tournage et ne sera pas diffusée avant fin 2027. Une saison 6 est, d'ores et déjà, prévue également, qui parlera probablement d'Héloïse.
La maison de production a décidé de modifier l'ordre des saisons par rapport aux livres de Julia Quinn et a également pris la décision d'annoncer le personnage mis en avant dans la prochaine saison, au lieu de laisser planer le mystère.
> 
> Vivement fin 2027 ! 
> 
> Bonnes soirées-tv et à bientôt, 

Florence

body.title: Travel Digest #2902
body.body:
Introduction


Hello everyone, @glecerioberto here, and welcome to today's #TravelDigest! We have a fantastic and diverse selection for you today. Leading our list, in first place is the ancient Acropolis of Rhodes in Greece. In second is the massive 16th-century Convent of San Andrés in Spain. And finally, we have the mystical Basilica Cistern in Turkey. If you want to see even more, check out our Honorable Mentions. They will take you on a massive trip through Germany, Turkey, Australia, Indonesia, Argentina, and so many other places. What a great day to explore the world from your screens, wouldn't you say? Cheers!


All featured posts are visible on the Editors Choice Map and upvoted by @worldmappin, our curation trail, and potentially @blocktrades. For more travel digests check out #traveldigest.

Our winners today


🥇 The Greek Isles: Rhodes by @zo3d

The morning after our visit to Kos we arrived at another island namely the Island of Rhodes. Rhodes is the largest island in the group of Dodecanese Islands so we knew that we would not be seeing everything in the one day that the cruise allowed us.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥈 A monumental 16th-century relic – Convent of San Andrés 📷 Málaga – Spain by @avdesing

Living in a country with such a rich history means that, as I walk and explore the city, I come across beautiful relics, from small to very large, and can admire that history, that past which often stands out in truly astonishing ways.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥉 Journey to the Mysterious History of Istanbul: Our Visit to the Basilica Cistern by @oneplanet

A week ago, my brothers and cousins and I visited the Basilica Cistern, one of the most impressive historical buildings of Istanbul. This historical place, which many people who live in Istanbul or come here want to see, is really as impressive as it is described. I had seen it in photos before, but when I entered it, the atmosphere felt completely different. We had an unforgettable experience with both its historical texture and mystical atmosphere.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin

body.title: Our World Today
body.body: The economic system of the world today is deeply interconnected, fast moving, and constantly shifting under pressure from both old challenges and new realities. Unlike in the past, where economies operated more independently, today’s global economy functions like a tightly woven web, what happens in one region can quickly ripple across continents.\n\n

>

Countries depend on each other for trade, technology, raw materials, and even labor. A product designed in one country may be manufactured in another, assembled somewhere else, and sold worldwide. This interconnectedness has created opportunities for growth, innovation, and access to goods, but it has also made the system more fragile. When disruptions occur such as conflicts, pandemics, or supply chain breakdowns the effects are felt globally.

In many parts of the world, the cost of living has risen sharply, making basic needs like food, housing, and transportation more expensive. This has put pressure on individuals and families, especially in developing economies. Governments and central banks are responding by adjusting interest rates and policies, but these solutions often come with tradeoffs, such as slower economic growth or reduced borrowing.
Technology is also reshaping the economic system in powerful ways. Digital economies, online businesses, and financial technologies have changed how money moves and how people earn a living. Remote work, e-commerce, and digital currencies are no longer trends—they are becoming part of the foundation of modern economies. However, this shift has also widened the gap between those who have access to technology and those who do not.
Another major feature of today’s economic system is inequality. While wealth has increased globally, it is not evenly distributed. A small percentage of the population controls a large portion of resources, while many people continue to struggle with poverty and limited opportunities. This imbalance creates social and political tensions, pushing governments to rethink policies around wages, taxation, and social support systems.

At the same time, there is growing attention on sustainability. Climate change and environmental concerns are forcing economies to rethink how they produce and consume. Industries are being pushed toward cleaner energy, greener practices, and long-term responsibility, even as they try to remain profitable.
In summary, the world’s economic system today is complex and evolving. It is shaped by globalization, technology, inequality, and environmental challenges. While it offers great potential for progress, it also demands careful management and cooperation among nations to ensure that growth is not only achieved, but shared and sustained.

body.title: Splinterlands: Upgraded a Fire Rebellion card to Level 3! 🔥
body.body:
>I don't use this particular card very often; nevertheless, its performance is frequently remarkable—thanks to its Magic Attack Power (which bypasses enemy armor to strike directly at their Health), its Speed ​​of 3 (which is quite decent and grants the ability to strike first), and its Blast ability (which deals 50% of its attack damage to the enemy's adjacent card as well). While I generally play fewer battles using the Fire element, having a diverse range of cards in one's team invariably proves beneficial at some point, ensuring one remains prepared for the ever-changing conditions of Splinterlands. That is why—even though I already possessed two copies of this card at Level 2—since both of them were Soulbound, I purchased four additional copies; this brought the total to 5 + 5 + 4 = 14 copies—exactly the number required to upgrade this card to Level 3.

\n\n

>Now, there is an important point to note here: these four newly purchased copies were not Soulbound. However, had I combined them with my existing Soulbound copies, the final upgraded card would have also become Soulbound—meaning I would subsequently be unable to delegate, rent out, or sell that card. Nevertheless, firstly, these cards are available at a very low price, so the act of purchasing them carries no significant financial stress. Furthermore, the process for unbinding Soulbound cards from the Rebellion set has been suspended for quite some time, and I have absolutely no idea when it might resume. Given this situation, I did not feel it was prudent to indefinitely postpone the opportunity to utilize this card at Level 3; therefore, I decided that the best course of action was to combine all these copies and upgrade the card to Level 3—even if it meant accepting that the final result would be Soulbound.

\n\n

>At Level 3, this card received an increase of just +1 Health—which might appear insignificant at first glance—but often in battle, a single point of Health is enough to tip the scales between victory and defeat; thus, it certainly cannot be underestimated. Although I would have been absolutely thrilled had its Attack Power increased alongside its Health, this update is still a welcome improvement. Currently, the process to unbind this card is suspended; however, should that option become available again in the future, I will still be able to unbind this card at that time.😎

* * *

>Splinterlands isn't an easy place, but that's what makes it even more fun. A perfect strategy takes into account many factors, including stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and more. That's why it's even more important to consider all these factors when developing a strategy. Add good cards to your deck, but also work on improving your strategies, and strive to win as many battles as possible!🔥\n\n

body.title: Galaxy Tour : Elite Dangerous travel ... (EN/FR)
body.body:
Le texte français se trouve à la balise « # Français ».

# ENGLISH

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itharagaian/23vrpSH9SU17XGLwGSoJ4VFkELkRFJgdzsHSD2RhKf9DUd9pH9Tm2Ezmyo2dhK4sjTwPa.png)

And there we go, after 28 days of travel, averaging around 10 jumps per day, we managed to reach every milestone we had set in our schedule:

https://principalityofbastion.org/luxbastionistrip.html

Starting from Ehlanda, we made a break at Sagittarius A*, the center of our galaxy, home to the most massive black hole in the Milky Way… before heading straight to Colonia, the second human bubble. There, we had the opportunity to get to know the local population better, as well as its engineers. Finally, we departed once again for the Principality of Bastion.

Despite both our departure and arrival being marked by server issues, the entire journey unfolded exactly as planned.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itharagaian/23tvB2iryZfCV1z2a6djE5HJ9JBNAbZD1L48r11tMkZMoqYe8MaiuF99FqwKoNgxHd8c7.png)

Thanks to the FCOC Discord, everything was visible to Elite Dangerous players, which brought us a significant number of passengers at each of the three stages.

Each jump session was accompanied by crew messages, sent via an application I created specifically for the occasion:
https://principalityofbastion.org/luxbastionistrip.html

Every name and face shown represented real crew members—including myself, the captain. These messages were automatically sent to both the FCO server and the Principality’s server, ensuring that our passengers were always kept informed. Here is the last of these messages:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itharagaian/Eo6CkgjaCJP5NroAXWejDNdMRkxGRboaADQxnf5oMQcuChK8br1odX7hpeHqqzEYh2L.png)

Within the FCOC discussion channel dedicated to our Fleet Carrier (https://discord.com/channels/628577403043840021/1477783339036315709), we shared long conversations with our passengers. Some played alongside us, while others even joined our squadron.

It was a vibrant journey, during which we traveled over 59,000 light-years, completing more than 121 jumps of nearly 500 light-years each. We explored dozens of unknown sectors, leaving our names forever engraved in the game’s history—mine, as well as those of many passengers who also engaged deeply in exobiology.

It was a remarkable experience, even though its prohibitive cost for the captain—over one billion credits—means I won’t be able to repeat it anytime soon. It also requires a tremendous amount of time, especially when the route is planned with such precision.

The Fleet Carrier will now primarily serve our squadron, though it may also be rented out. Our goal is to quickly gather 30 billion credits to acquire the big brother of the Lux Bastionis: the Squadron Fleet Carrier.

So there’s still a lot of work ahead for our small team—unless a few generous donors decide to contribute… Legend has it that some had already planned to do so during the journey’s presentation. We’ll see whether they remember… I wouldn’t dare remind them myself.

See you soon!

# Français

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itharagaian/23vrpSH9SU17XGLwGSoJ4VFkELkRFJgdzsHSD2RhKf9DUd9pH9Tm2Ezmyo2dhK4sjTwPa.png)

Et voilà, après 28 jours de vol incluant en moyenne 10 sauts par jour, nous avons pu atteindre chacune des étapes que nous avions fixées sur notre planning :

https://principalityofbastion.org/luxbastionistrip.html

En partant d'Ehlanda, pour faire un break à Sagittarius A*, le centre de notre galaxie, hébergeant le plus massif des trous noirs de la Voie lactée… pour ensuite foncer sur Colonia, la seconde bulle humaine, où nous avons fait plus ample connaissance avec la population locale, ainsi que ses ingénieurs. Avant de repartir, finalement, pour la Principauté du Bastion.

Malgré un départ et une arrivée ponctués par des soucis de serveurs, tout le voyage s'est passé précisément comme planifié.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itharagaian/23tvB2iryZfCV1z2a6djE5HJ9JBNAbZD1L48r11tMkZMoqYe8MaiuF99FqwKoNgxHd8c7.png)

Grâce au Discord FCOC, tout était visible pour les joueurs d'Elite Dangerous, ce qui nous a fourni bon nombre de passagers à chacune des trois étapes.

Chaque séance de saut était ponctuée par des messages d'équipage, envoyés via une application que j'ai créée expressément pour l'occasion :
https://principalityofbastion.org/luxbastionistrip.html

Chacun des noms et visages visibles sont des membres effectifs de l'équipage, ainsi que moi-même, le capitaine. Messages automatiquement envoyés vers le serveur FCO et celui de la Principauté. Pour que nos passagers soient toujours avertis, voici le dernier de ces messages :

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itharagaian/Eo6CkgjaCJP5NroAXWejDNdMRkxGRboaADQxnf5oMQcuChK8br1odX7hpeHqqzEYh2L.png)

Dans le canal de discussion du FCOC dédié à notre Fleet Carrier (https://discord.com/channels/628577403043840021/1477783339036315709), nous avons eu de longues conversations avec nos passagers. Certains ont joué avec nous, d'autres ont même rejoint notre squadron.

C'était un voyage haut en couleurs, où nous avons parcouru plus de 59 000 années-lumière, en effectuant plus de 121 sauts de près de 500 AL chacun… Nous avons visité des dizaines de secteurs inconnus, en inscrivant nos noms à jamais dans l'histoire du jeu (le mien, mais aussi ceux de mes passagers qui ont eux aussi fait pas mal d'exobiologie).

Une belle expérience, même si son coût prohibitif pour le capitaine (plus d'un milliard de crédits) m'empêchera de recommencer avant un bon moment. Cela demande également énormément de temps, surtout lorsque le trajet est aussi finement planifié.

Le Fleet Carrier servira désormais en priorité à notre squadron, mais pourra aussi être loué. Nous avons besoin, le plus rapidement possible, de 30 milliards de crédits afin de décrocher le grand frère du Lux Bastionis : le Squadron Fleet Carrier.

Donc beaucoup de travail pour notre petite équipe, sauf si quelques généreux donateurs apportent une jolie contribution… La légende dit même que c'était prévu par certains lors de la présentation du voyage… Nous verrons s'ils auront oublié ou non… Je me vois mal aller le leur rappeler…

À bientôt !

![separator3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itharagaian/23t74yRdEqJTBFpCzDdcBoyfgNYiJ2vSW1c3QCARs6cMXgnDnfB3yamYCYZArYBCZD8RA.png) *Ithara Gaïan* **Principality of Bastion** - Our Leit Motiv? **Uniti Crescimus**. Deseo disfruten mucho, toda la historia fantástica con los increíbles personajes de esta historia, al lado de Alicia, El Conejo Blanco, La Liebre de Marzo, El Sombrerero, La Oruga Azul, El Gato de Cheshire y la Reina de Corazones.

Dedico este cuento a todos mis suscriptores fieles e incondicionales que tienen el buen gusto de disfrutar mis poemas y cuentos infantiles, les mando muchas energías positivas y un fuerte abrazo 🤗✨

body.title: My Guild Brawl Participation on Splinterlands
body.body:
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tbPj3Jr1jd6FPZ6xPtD82UK2xDkmpmPicjPB9heBKar8kqfwxJ36WRsrvZmeYKuHink.png)</center>
Source: Image generated from https://peakd.com/ai.

Hi there again people from the praetoria in the splinterlands universe and the bees from HIVE.

This blog is intended to share my experience regarding guild brawls. Right now I belong to the Guild Mega Therion That is Tier 3 and I am filling the Fray 1 of the brawl which solely for the Foundation cards plus of course the Gladius cards.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tGVUnm1yU6K37s9YofZwTdnagPkV6Qh4tfAvVVR7Y99E1FHrjtxjPyzqxPPuPeMSAU9.png)</center>

Well Guild Brawl is another way of gaining your SPS tokens and Merits tokens so you can buy your Gladius cases and own gladius cards. Just make sure you join your guild. 


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/Eo6CeuF1UbG45U54AcsAyrtpdFE7QESkX75SimBeAPuyey6VnbyLRMKCsC5RyAJ91ih.png)</center>

The Brawl just ended and I gather 3800 Merits and 36.208 SPS. I got a single lost with my 9 battles. Well I guess I still performed well with this brawl.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/Eo6CkiDGXEkfedsPbtLtDb6wECk5iJTpDc4kFyW3RXJ9qVBRpKkak5urDGQihcEvQy1.png)</center>

Our overall standing for this guild brawl was rank 1. Its a team effort and that just shows our guild got a lot of active players. 

# My Card Collection for Guild Brawls #

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23vhqQHb6Uc9bMvPsy4gvMcSRsbsaXcMGUca14emZchRcYDyeYwv1DqGctKPGP43EhcLS.png)</center>


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tvVWmzT1a6GiWJqHMkcG3N2yDPwgvZWDqxiGMzEeZPbEee9ewsL5YYaVDq5NfN5kfTF.png)</center>


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23u5tauZTYAmi3PQnFbNBJ4EqkdVkuxML58raSyZqpr8XY834o5BDmJy12sKqeusbYLpj.png)</center>

I have already maxed mostly my Frontier Cards aside from the extra's and promo card version of this series. About my gladius cards, i am still accumulating but already got some copies that can be considered good one even at level 1. Well, I am still accumulating for this cards right now so as long I am consistent in gathering, its not impossible to own maxed cards. 


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23u5bTPdvPrK6E5FvUB7DBRn5bL6FCPcmMCBrbaSNJ4s6bhWGxmcxHAHDZ6zDKg1fYqeX.png)</center>

For this round of the Guild Brawl, I accumulated enough merits to buy 2 gladius cases.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/48GgUR1qKHq7gEvjni1wDunmoEpPmwyZ8Y8bZWUrzVF5YkaqappakcCuAcufRAkst7.png)</center>

And I got lucky to obtain 2 epics, although not claiming any gold foils. Qoura is minted so I should not complain right?



<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tRxikK9vFyAcZyuAdzTntnWQeK9vzVBBTmWgufskFT8Nt6Q6TmRcQ8dKzKAtidhDBZW.png)</center>

And here it goes! I have enough copies to level the card! Nice additional health also for Quora. It just got more tanky! If you are not aware, Quora is one of the most sought card here in splinterlands or I could say it is one of the best to have cards for your team. 

# Guild Battle Highlight #


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tGa9A71NKZCAvgmH53qTdCetGVyNYexTxe2YejS9XTHg4A4eeWprFwVQjBp8HVUevBt.png)</center>

Here is one of my Brawl battle for this round and this is the loosing one. You can see how biased I am using a favorite card and that should be Quora Towers Head. Well, I just really believed that it can win against the odds because it is a strong card. But reality check, its not always is right to just believed in strong 
cards every time. I am aware of this, I just became really stubborn. With the presence of Counter Spell in the Ruleset, Let us find out how Quora was beaten. By the way, I am against Life Splinter here with Tatiana Blayde on their side. It is another good card to posses.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/23tGZw8b4NqPRPjSxXxBjkvDRsf11tGSpUcMZvoHKubYAdKKGi2MntuPwB3jjCczYH5Uv.png)</center>

In Round 1, Although I possessed monster units that got healing ability, the Explosive Weaponry ruleset helped a lot to lessen my team's HP. Another wrong decision in forming my team is that i have lest monster units that can take advantage both Explosive Weaponry and Melee Mayhem that was became the edge of my opponent's team.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/Eo44pV5ySUv8j8bXi3nUdSktesw4pNprdFFLCtNayPuofXEo5WBY6Fm6Zo624U7dY52.png)</center> 
Round 2, Both of our Gladius cards triggered their Bloodlust ability and the battle is getting interesting. Quora is trying its very hard to survive here but I really harm the card placing it in this type of rulesets. The return of its Magic damage with Explosive Weaponry is really cutting its HP away. I am sorry Quora.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/buratus/Eo44j9mfL2CdHFL1Pcyx1q7y7p9MAMe1hD219kd1hxn6q8Xigg7oo8PnGsxeLfDrVcW.png)</center>

And it ended the battle in round 3 where Tatiana Blayde finished Quora Towers Head's stubbornness. Its a lost for my team but I saw some good fight there. 

- If you are not yet belonged to any guilds you must seek or build one for your self if you can afford. There is a good gain on having a guild. Claiming SPS rewards and owning gladius cards are really a good boost to your assets. And when battling, it really needed to use your brain, not just what you believed. Because if you just believed, you might be wrong! 



  

###### You can watch the full battle [HERE](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_Jm0OF90xFlRRbOR9hrV4?ref=buratus). ######


---
You want to join the game? click it [HERE](https://next.splinterlands.com/register?ref=buratus) for my referral and start your journey!

This is it for this blog. 

Thank you for your time!

Disclaimer:

Images that were used, if not specified, are from [SPLINTERLANDS](https://splinterlands.com).

因为五一有舍友回家，今天下午全寝没课，所以我们决定一起去附近的昌平博物馆，收集一些资料照片来完整我们的期中实践，最后统计在一起的劳动时长必须满足毕业时长才能毕业。

下课后我们各自吃完午饭回到寝室，然后一起出去，算上路程一个小时就回来了。
 
虽然好多嘻嘻打闹的时候，但是大多数时候感觉大家都有些生分，聊的也基本是些无所谓无聊的话题。
 
特别明显的是两个平日里最亲密的室友，上课吃饭取快递都陪在一起，两个人一起拼了个单买了一包东西，A付的款，A不仅有这大包东西还有自己的东西，B两手空空，虽然A多次暗示自己抽不出手了，连我一个“外人”都听出来了，B一直默不作声没说帮个忙，要我看哪怕不是一起买的，看对方拿那么多东西也不方便，好歹搭把手啊。随便吧，需要我帮我就帮帮，不需要我也不会凑上去，至于我自己，我必须要求自己扛下来很多事，把所有注都压在我自己身上，我是自己唯一坚强的后盾！

可能我是“敏感肌”吧，想的太多了，想的多点也没问题啊，总是要先明哲保身的，先往最坏处想，再说吧。
 
军训服今天到了，臭死了，就那种劣质的塑料令人作呕的酸臭味溢出袋子直往鼻子钻，明天丢进洗衣机彻底清洗一下吧，还得买双鞋垫，鞋有些太大了，麻烦事好多啊……

body.title: The Debate on the 6x1 Shift: Between Legal Norms and Material Reality
body.body: \nThe discussion about working hours in Brazil has gained a new chapter with the recent repercussions of debates involving political figures and civil society. At the center of the controversy is the so-called \

—a system where workers work six days followed by one day of rest—and the proposed Constitutional Amendments (PECs) that aim to alter this dynamic.
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=dreloop07/6n8nxxi7

 A recent excerpt, which circulated widely, shows Congressman Kim Kataguiri being questioned about his stance on the issue, raising profound reflections on the abyss between what the law says and what workers experience in practice.

### The Questioning: Dignity at Stake

The starting point of the debate lies in the premise that a worker's life is often entirely consumed by their job. During the dialogue presented in the video, the congressman is confronted with a reality common to millions of Brazilians: exhaustion. The 6x1 work schedule, combined with hours spent commuting on public transport, leaves little or no room for leisure, study, or family time.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWfmBgDbi6x28ZAkoP4t63nXPQAzyvj3C9Vy9DgBqqSFZ/captura_de_tela_2026_04_28_113840.png)


The question posed to the parliamentarian highlights the importance of addressing these issues, even though a considerable portion of the population works informally. After all, legislation serves as a guide for rights that, in theory, should protect the dignity of the human person.

### Kim Kataguiri's Response: The \

\nIn his defense, Kim Kataguiri does not deny the harsh reality faced by workers. He himself recounts having gone through similar experiences in his first job. However, the core of his argument is pragmatic and skeptical about the effectiveness of isolated constitutional changes. According to the deputy, \
is much more complex than the approval of a law. Kataguiri uses the popular expression \

to illustrate his point: in Brazil, there is a history of legislation that, despite being approved, fails to transform daily practice due to economic factors and informality. For him, changing the text of the Constitution does not automatically guarantee that employers will stop demanding that workload or that the market will adapt without collateral consequences.

### The Conflict Between Idealism and Pragmatism
The debate presented on the **Jaguardopote** channel reveals a classic conflict in Brazilian politics:

1. **The side of social protection:** Argues that the law should be the first step to force a cultural and economic change, ensuring that technical and productive progress translates into quality of life for those who produce.

2. **The side of economic pragmatism:** Argues that, without real economic growth and a reduction in informality, new laws may only push more workers out of legality, creating an even greater abyss between the \

.

### The Reality of Informality
One of the crucial points mentioned is that, for those in the informal market, the discussion about the proposed constitutional amendment seems distant. If the worker already lacks the basic rights of the CLT (Consolidation of Labor Laws), an alteration to the constitutional work schedule has little impact on their immediate daily life. This raises the question: how to reform labor in Brazil without leaving behind the millions of invisible workers who don't have formal employment contracts?

## Conclusion
The video [JAPINHA ENCURALOU KIM! #MBL #kimkataguiri](https://studio.youtube.com/video/JuKKuDanCUs) serves as a microcosm of a necessary national discussion. Regardless of ideological position, the debate makes it clear that the 6x1 work schedule is a model that generates exhaustion and calls for revision. However, the solution seems to require more than just executive orders; it requires a careful look at economic viability, the fight against informality and, above all, the search for a balance where productivity does not cost the mental and social health of the worker.

The provocation directed at the congressman and his technical response show that the path to the \
in Brazil is still being paved amidst clashes of ideas and the harsh reality of the streets.\n

body.title: When I took a pause
body.body:
In a world filled with unending distractions, this prompt actually kicked off something in me. I had to actually pause and ask myself, when last have I reflected or had time to meditate.

![IMG_4807.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVyknBabYvDxnzvgVetFy5yFTxm5xbWN779AJ4uscWNFV/IMG_4807.jpeg)[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/drop-splash-impact-ripples-water-5971598/)

Meditation a beautiful practice that we rarely practice. I’ve had so much about meditation and its usefulness to our mind and making achievements. In our church daily devotional that we used to read and study the Bible, there are days it’s required for us to meditate and there are topics given to meditate on.

I am not proud to say that I haven’t been faithful with the meditation aspect. Sometimes we are just busy chasing things that we are caught up in a web of activities that we rarely have time to pause and think or look inwards. If only we are honest to ourselves, we find that this part is lacking a lot and I am a victim.

Lately, I have been doing a lot of reflections. I’ve had moments when I had to pause and ask myself some questions. For example this year has really been a lot for me already. The year started with a break in my relationship and I spent some good week’s mourning the breakup but in a moment of just going silent and reflecting on the past happenings, I suddenly saw a light that I missed.

![IMG_4808.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR933NdffQq2x7eVSgMFaytWCq4n8bShWnmHVJ8QktAzP/IMG_4808.jpeg)[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/meditate-lake-mood-4882027/)

When I had this breakup, I was saying that it’s his loss. Well, at a moment of reflecting on all that has happened so far, my eyes were opened to see that it’s not about putting it to the other person. It was my salvation and not his loss.

Well, sometimes you can be in relationships that you don’t even realize is toxic for you. The red flags are here and there but you keep making excuses hoping that it would work but that breakup was a deliverance for me. I just saw that I would have really suffered in that relationship of it had continued. A broken relationship is better than a broken marriage.

Well, I didn’t see all this until I had time to reflect on all that happened. I also reflected on the part I think I must have missed it or done somethings I wasn’t supposed to do and I have learnt my lessons to do better next time. But something hit me again in these reflection times and that made me feel so bad.

![IMG_4809.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcy4MVvobkkDeFo1xEyvCB9gZs5HX1mGTmtnQKNPeVE9w/IMG_4809.jpeg)[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/meditate-woman-yoga-zen-meditating-1851165/)

I was feeling bad because I had lost so much time. I spent weeks crying, locking myself up, feeling bad and abandoned my business. I stopped my content creation and was just business mourning the loss of the relationship. Well, that happens when you love someone.

But I felt so bad I had to pause my life all because of a bad breakup. I felt bad that I was mourning my deliverance cos that was actually God delivering me from a life time regret. In my time of reflection, I had to tell myself the truth and pick up the pieces of my life where I had left them.

I have decided to go back to all the things that I had abandoned and to start living again. It’s already the second quarter of the year and April is turning into May. I have so much to do and I am just about to begin for the year. Well, I am back that I am back and better. I’ve learnt my lessons and ready to move ahead. All thanks to some quiet moments of having to pause and do some life reflections.

Having time to reflect on things around me has been very helpful to me lately and has made me see things from better perspective. I do hope to continue with it more often.

body.title: Instilling Hope in the Counselee by Wayne A. Mack
body.body:
Most people today are weak in heart or in need of counseling because they feel hopeless, tired, and discouraged. That is why counseling exists to show them that there is still hope because God is present.

True hope comes from God, not from our own positive thinking or the idea that everything will eventually turn out well on its own. For me, I would use the Bible to give hope and help believers realize that they can change and that God can help them. By sharing Bible verses, they are reminded and able to understand God’s love, power, and faithfulness.
 
I have realized that a person without hope will no longer try again. But if they have hope, they will keep trying, obey God, and take steps to improve. Many people who face problems often lose hope. However, when a person has true hope that comes from God, they become more motivated to change and grow.

The goal is not only to make a person feel better, but to bring them closer to Jesus Christ and to transform their mind, heart, and whole life.
