body.title: Not Every Brawl Is Glory—Some Are Growth
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaj3vrGRtKW3VnMqCFQd8CiVRheV2UH7axDbTcrHKhdNd/brawl_thumbnails.png)

Greetings, Splinterlands warriors!

This week, I’m opening my story with a small smile—not because of a brilliant brawl result, but because I’m seeing signs of life in the HIVE price. Compared to last month, its movement feels more “alive.” The hope is simple: may the SPS chart also rise slowly, just like our spirits that sometimes go up and down following brawl results.

As usual, I was placed in fray 12 again. A position that already feels like home. Moving elsewhere feels confusing at this point, since I’ve grown too familiar with the pressure and surprises in this fray.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfRcrLQQaq4d4i7o5uesmGribkxbbooGtBrob96kBowwu/my_battles.png)</center>


Out of the total 7 battles I had to play, the results were… well, enough to make me frown a little. I lost 3 matches. Of the rest, there was 1 win because the opponent didn’t show up, 3 pure strategy wins, and 1 automatic win due to an empty opponent slot. So overall, my contribution was still “decent,” though not exactly outstanding.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW99NbSR89ABJPKgfnRhZyMQQA5pN4KmZTdubecsZZeuZ/all.png)</center>


Overall, the ClaNFT guild managed to collect only 183 points with 61 wins. That result placed us in fourth place—a position we rarely occupy. Usually, we can hold onto a top-three spot, but this time we had to drop one level. Maybe some members couldn’t participate, or perhaps our opponents were simply in top form this time.

As for rewards… still something to be grateful for. Every fully participating member received 1,950 Merits and 16.624 SPS, which went directly into staking. It didn’t quite reach 2k merits, but it’s enough to maintain progress.

Speaking of merits, after previously “breaking the ice” by opening a Gladius Case and getting a legendary card, I’m now back to the classic phase: saving up. I’ve currently accumulated 4,898 merits. That means I might need around 3 more brawls to open a more satisfying number of Gladius packs. Patience—but that’s where the enjoyment lies.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUVhr4yBeLGFZvf9XFMM2ysyaSn5zEFx4NNfGdrgATFKe/pack_2.png)

If we talk about experience, this brawl felt like a gentle—or maybe quite firm—reminder that the game keeps evolving. The opponents I faced seemed more prepared, more refined, and had more complete card collections. Strategies that used to work don’t always succeed anymore.

And that’s where the challenge lies.

I’ve realized that we can’t stay at one level. We have to keep learning, keep adjusting strategies, and if needed, strengthen our card collections. Because out there, other players are doing the same—maybe even faster.

This brawl may not have brought us to the top three, but it delivered many valuable lessons. Sometimes, we need to lose a little to realize how much we still need to improve.

A short piece of advice from me: don’t get satisfied with a single strategy too quickly. The meta is always changing, and other players keep evolving. If we stand still, we’ll be left behind.

And yeah… if HIVE keeps rising, hopefully it’s not just the price that goes up, but also the quality of our gameplay 😄

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)



Talk about Splinterlands,
If you haven't tried out this fantastic game called Splinterlands yet, I invite you to [**Join**](https://splinterlands.com?ref=rqr4).
It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens. 

___


If you already joined the splinterlands, and are looking for a place to grow. We need **YOU**. We are a chill, social guild looking for a few more active members! If you think you might be a fit, join us in our [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/5u638vHPVh)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZAXaBtYPQQcQ4fDb2DMaFETkzmZ5DNhevYHW4pANVaM2/banner.png)

body.title: Vivir sin piel: El lenguaje invisible de nuestros adolescentes.
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV3bVeZtdCnCLF1W2gx4chF3jFyCL5RkADxtbwWCnH6JM/1777378017644.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXdChXHdZaqtEEY4p9p4H9gSnz4BmT6YyY8UD8kKzPKDK/1777378073039.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ6os3dJqCZD54dYNfieZNTrFJrTHiBPLGunhbsVJsmrV/1777378166952.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQqRgzzXcZVvvgS4weNGgY9vsLHxBRXXqiybVWPmmJVCa/1777378167194.jpg)

<center>
🌷🌿——❃——🌺——❃——🌿🌷
</center>

¡Hola, querida comunidad de Holus Lotus! Es un placer saludarlos y compartir una vez más en este espacio de bienestar. Hoy quiero hablarles desde mi lente de madre, pero también desde el corazón de la adolescente que alguna vez fui.

A menudo, como padres, entramos a una habitación y lo primero que choca contra nuestra vista es el desorden: empaques de snacks, una botella a medio terminar y nuestros adolescentes \
. Nuestra reacción inmediata suele ser el reproche: \

.

Pero hoy quiero invitarte a mirar esta misma escena a través de otra lente. Porque si cerramos los ojos por un minuto y recordamos cómo nos sentíamos nosotros a su edad —aquella sensación de que los adultos vivían en un planeta distinto— cuando sentíamos que nadie podía comprendernos o simplemente esos días donde no sabías ni tu mismo lo que sentías y ese desorden emocional de vacío, es ahí donde aprenderás a llevarte mejor con tu hij@. 

<center>
🌷🌿——❃——🌺——❃——🌿🌷
</center>

Como padres, sufrimos de una amnesia selectiva. Olvidamos que nosotros también estuvimos allí, sentados en una cama, sintiendo que el mundo de los adultos era un lugar extraño y que solo nuestros amigos hablaban nuestro idioma.
En psicología, esto tiene un nombre: la necesidad de pertenencia y validación. Para ellos, este momento de \

es en realidad su oficina de salud mental.

✓Allí se cuentan lo que no nos dicen a nosotros por miedo al juicio.

✓Allí ensayan quiénes quieren ser.

✓Allí, entre una risa y un snack, se están sanando del estrés del liceo y de las dudas que les genera el futuro.

Cuando gritamos, el cerebro del adolescente entra en modo de supervivencia (ataque o huida), bloqueando la parte prefrontal, que es la encargada del razonamiento.

Si recordamos cómo nos cerrábamos nosotros cuando nuestros padres nos gritaban, entenderemos que el grito no enseña; el grito aleja.

La memoria nos permite usar la Validación. En lugar de decir \
Tu mundo es importante y aquí tienes permiso para ser tú mismo\

Cuando mires a tu hijo adolescente, recuerda que debajo de esa coraza de indiferencia o de esas respuestas cortantes, hay alguien que siente todo al mil por ciento. No le grites a su herida. Mejor, recuerda cuando tú eras quien no tenía piel, y conviértete en el abrazo que tanto necesitaste y que quizás nunca llegó.\
How very kind of you to offer....yes if you please.  ^__^

body.title: 花儿一样美丽的建设者们！
body.body:
中午的阳光暖融融的， 走在外面浑身舒坦。 我和同事沿着准备享受着日光浴，沿着俄罗斯一条街慢步溜达，突然眼前一亮，同事指着稍微远处的地面，那个地面挺漂亮呀！

我顺着她的目光，的确，地面上有很多漂亮的花朵，而且都是刚刚画上去的哪，油漆未干！再向侧面看去，几个工人师傅正蹲在地上，一点点的描绘这些美丽的花朵，让普通的地面顿时有了光彩！
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSHCMVYsysHF8fReTXs2DC62pB4nAryEsSff7joCvDa4n/_.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbyWqB3PegRkY1vMuAg9ysZrvfDe2LSmrE2mrHy217VgX/_.jpg)



我向前走过去，跨过那些小花儿，有个师傅说，“小心，当心别弄脏了鞋子！” 我向他感激的一笑，抬脚跨过了那些美丽的小花儿，栩栩如生，真的一样！

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdZvDumxDJc8rTTmHPuCXa659Gbyije6DvhSRtY6gENCM/_.jpg)


这些地面的花朵会在晚上灯光的照射下更加美丽，而且会随着灯光晃动。 这种景象最初我在厦门游玩的时候，被美丽的地方吸引，没想到很快大连的一些景区的地面也绘上了这些漂亮的花儿或者其他的图案！给城市增加了灵动的美！

而且现在城市变化特别快，几乎每天都有不同。这些都归功于默默无闻的那些城市美化工人们，是他们用自己勤劳的双手，为这个美丽的城市做出了自己的贡献。 他们是这个城市中最美的人，致敬这些美丽的建设者们！

地面上的花儿漂亮，真花也漂亮，在花园里有很多石头花盆，花盆里都栽着这些像牡丹一样漂亮的花儿，同事说这些是地瓜花儿。 我不知道是啥花儿，难道地瓜能开出这么漂亮的花儿？还是第一次看到，各种颜色的地瓜花儿，所以今天的散步也是一场colour walk ！
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQFzCZ5xEw1ZuK5U2DMeJbcBjmQTcqQr4jchMLVT2sqTn/_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT2JVcWeovqci1eWzNq59tftQRNV8Dab1xyucAxDajybm/_.jpg)



身边的美真是无处不在呀！让我们心旷神怡😊😊 感恩那些美丽的建设者们，我为他们而骄傲，我为生活在这个美丽的城市而自豪！么么哒😊🎉🎊

body.title: Hearing but not listening to God's words// The old path
body.body:
https://youtu.be/6pwIB_dM-0U?si=YEBcaAikw2_iQ6TJ
The bible warns us that is very dangerous when we hear God's words but refuses it to enter our heart. It is possible for people to listen to sermons, read Scripture, or be taught spiritual truths, yet remain unchanged because they do not reflect on or apply what they hear. This kind of hearing is shallow it reaches the ears but not the soul. True listening, in a biblical sense, involves understanding, humility, and a willingness to obey what God has said.

In the new testament Jesus explained clearly that those who hear his words but refuses to act by it are foolish and will face judgement on the last day, while those who listen to his words and acts by it are safe. The difference is not in hearing, but in responding. God desires not just attentive ears but obedient hearts. When we move from passive hearing to active listening, His word begins to shape our character, guide our decisions, and transform our lives.

body.title: Comic-style coffee with a new look! | The Coffee Shop Prompt Week 165 [EN-ES]
body.body:
> Hello coffee lovers on Hive! It's been a while since I've written in this wonderful community, and I truly missed you all. It's interesting how, upon returning, I find that @cinnccf invites us to reflect on a time when loneliness felt different. She suggests we explore the contrast between feeling alone and feeling connected surrounded by strangers in one of our favorite coffee shops. And it's true, I've been experiencing loneliness for quite some time now. It's been a long time since I've had coffee at the place I used to frequent, enjoying conversation and surrounded by flowers. My daily life has become black and white, much like Comic Coffee, the coffee shop I'm returning to after learning they've expanded their spaces with new designs. I couldn't resist sharing these new details with you all. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmagLRaT9ZR6yipwTP54m8q9ecjQt1G6QFmwf4FVdq1VWv/img_20260413_173736.jpg)
*** I won't comment on the floor that greets us, as you can find previous visits on my blog. I then ascend the stairs to the second floor. There it is, suggestive in its dynamic design despite maintaining a two-dimensional feel in its projection. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSYH9M2TusJEg1pZkSzcrzDtyzFuzpNEzMZn6c3Bi241E/img_20260413_173811.jpg)
*** On one side, a room that preserves the classic two-tone comic style, with a color addition that reminds us of the initial evolution of comics themselves. *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcRKQyfUCXR9q7S4cUGp2XPeJvtt21rW7M5kiVrWETj1R/img_20260413_173759.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmedMY8BQ4X5ETQw1s39D3tFS1pUVhprikDZbBK8w6ouc7/img_20260413_174623.jpg)| |-|-| *** See how many unique details await, sure to amaze customers and visitors. The moment we cross the threshold, Cheshire greets us with his characteristic smile, immersing us in a world of stories waiting to be rediscovered... *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaRmyNyq2sgj3oo7ykCZQiYHLZeqo44JDDvwKQZXfuXqb/img_20260413_174606.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcp9hvwYdCweisCx8JkCvwL3WqfAqYnoohnMgLQZfoQKb/img_20260413_174733.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPN8GVJQV4fga1tB9gomFiWLEwczV6BzJShJqy5NjCZA1/img_20260413_174630.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** The colors are beginning to emerge. Now with a new addition: two small, secluded areas designed to entertain young children with engaging play activities. *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSefmWM5rADVL15qSKgkzSb7Y7ojn6PFuF9sAKVgg11Gp/img_20260413_174552.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR5GN4VBe39mFPjTK436XcGR3jjuzG8LeBoj5gWTBja75/img_20260413_174600.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVASXafPAvdzcofVHVhRLUwfcBByTxo3YfSBSZLkGvB4N/img_20260413_174701.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** Of course, these are spaces designed for very young children. Personally, I liked the idea. *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfJq6NrdmRfwAuwwnMsqXXEr4o9HL2d5kRHuPv4jBkjTP/img_20260413_174723.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW5eQkTvMSVWt677ovL2Dn5XfSgAED8ZvReuW5d4UDMFA/img_20260413_174717.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUEdqqu2w8pNPeRSdk8VprNhck1RSTXhUuXBJFGrLD7Wk/img_20260413_174617.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** Here I show you a first signature of the artist who designed everything. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUrvHAjVe4wwH4Qy9JPQPzqaMohxaKXQ2RTceFb3r8hSw/img_20260413_174639.jpg)
*** And now another change, right in front, another room, but with a novel perspective on what we were witnessing previously. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRphZAADJp1urJWje94THQebor5i2oQ2cjcEAtjaBXxz2/img_20260413_173927.jpg)
*** When we first arrived, there was no electricity, yet the artist was still working, finishing each pictorial element. A truly luxurious moment. *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPyyR8TY1gj6MhdQHywKT38GHUGSJjyMZhv9yLNAEjqNq/img_20260413_173848.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQBVtduKkrf3u52HYdGEuTLBBNniL6eWGokEsK8K3pF2G/img_20260413_174129.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWAxaLaW1e3qQ8pGck8Xie9d9Nk8zuT6EcxgjLnNp7xS6/img_20260413_173856.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb6BBURTrKzxtjjPJZ6J92Jou7UCGjhTojPZXyegu8fna/img_20260413_173911.jpg)| |-|-|-|-| *** Look at the dynamism in each work, which evokes different anime and comics that culture has bequeathed to us over time... *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKxxGFKHRtq8qcRPiDmnexunhXT6Mqe2Nkd6XVn3R783/img_20260413_174153.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVHixFj9PB862cJzGGpys4MV5sPFAPgLAu4PpLuy3Cv42/img_20260413_174200.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXvRsj5EE9AXyg1yDcYKwjM79zhgUXzx89b1wBXTtgY1q/img_20260413_174223.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** Part of the live process, with all the vicissitudes that Cubans go through to destroy barriers and impose art... *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW1dRSLJrC9VZ7GYWXzGdZSW47a56MAtqXr3kka2aJZmt/img_20260413_174242.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPAGebKUHV519CztBb8V8QRtyzjtcK1Q9TtkAGTyhRxrS/img_20260413_174252.jpg)| |-|-| *** And there was light and color! *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcWaXj1CH8SzmQh3uZwjJmLg2TzBiGXdUZuQruZ3koQTi/img_20260415_112317.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNt36nNDsdLuH2SACaw3F9dvp3UUGM5MVGTTiirT1Mi4w/img_20260415_112031.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNpLQLUmJcS8uhqnxu8ozKfghtiMcEdJtMKqXYeJYfMj5/img_20260415_112320.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXPZ6VVvHVJgUMZnwFcd4J2P73duW2diSfPbFENqMohZt/img_20260423_135341.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW5Uw7pVBrCdRsUQgfH5DX5kvwPTNQHakSfAXvrovTbe1/img_20260415_112023.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb5Jz7rspWTADXaSS4vYX367DwzAc3kf6Kh27gaozpZgy/img_20260423_135345.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** And with the light, new shades to behold! ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma5nBmNjy5Zx3KmuT6k1zLfBtNmaySspqjqGNYtMg2VtY/img_20260415_111950.jpg)
*** I had already ordered an espresso from the waiter, who, incidentally, had been my student, and I was pleased to see him thriving in this café. While I waited for my coffee, I took great delight in examining each drawing, each stroke, each expression, each memory they evoked. *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXP4NVizHPnSFV6rTt8qauZiVkmFGWe6K7HoFaQtw4KJK/img_20260415_112002.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmULqDLYBJMHAqRA91iQUMxE25Pg1zCWnpXBGbq1bHZsWq/img_20260415_112011.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcrppKSNnzA1xTUcb2XsL17JsAmBvjR34WyRdVKLZYdzK/img_20260415_112026.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQBqUC6PsmRJFqHgCuC3aASfYSBpUuk63tCNYYA63yBhW/img_20260415_112015.jpg)| |-|-|-|-| *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPfCyN8CNhrLgQmn82DVzk7chQ2VaPYaeKLzW5Wi35wKw/img_20260415_112038.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ3GmS5N9MK442fAbhLHJWqer1eByxNaEPcHfiKtx32DR/img_20260415_112107.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdp9xastbgGAnKXR3m2bCAM6nzb6R9zqyzU3f7Jxq2Ft/img_20260415_112112.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYpoRMmysnKz5fepxbVbiL1FgiLf83y9fHcnbVDpiT3p9/img_20260415_112049.jpg)| |-|-|-|-| *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeg1aUZRUFBjG7Rj3SAcQuLKE8SkEqMhLm1FVtbjEYbcL/img_20260415_112236.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYuP34a4zMMneH2frG5YZYQhw2o1jYMxT13a9ui3fFoNs/img_20260415_112218.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQEs8MRDirQVBHSKudFs2hj97rL5vUFq2buFtV2qrZqzg/img_20260415_112419.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcSSAxVHwLNYZsJmf1X1YMFS6SBu7SMFo2QA8Ai7hFCVt/img_20260423_135357.jpg)| |-|-|-|-| *** So, a few selfies to emulate expressions and smile in the solitude of the moment... *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNZNcHNqoR7FptnFc3iJJsxUHnReX1wP2pvQ91yiYjSvA/img_20260423_135627.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdavf2BSv2pBTR6E5UBrnMP7sKQcTVvAcd5uZ4YH5j6Cs/img_20260423_135635.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbKzeiAwp6tKxJsZM8jfewJS4z539PjmAgxHLo9fAB6fB/img_20260423_135653.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYYh4PDWJLKPEWf37mU5fpHtcLYSF2EbidNLb2MoHLZZ1/img_20260423_135711.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaPQMUytDR9anPiBbTkr3y6pHzhRitC3pPtDXrk4E1sAH/img_20260423_135733.jpg)| |-|-|-|-|-| *** And the coffee arrived! ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUoow4jMRumPavqhEWnpBXT1EeEHBEUEcyb8BhdnJxxHM/img_20260423_135848.jpg)
*** I have to say, the contrast between my previous visits and this one is significant. These designs welcome you in a unique way. It's as if the coffee has taken on a whole new dimension... *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUEr9WH4VnNHhrWD49BzYzDTAdWPQ8br6HuT8hXNebffG/img_20260423_135900.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSPEy1CMVciTZ4m7aWX5w6iaiaRQ9rbLCyzyW17okEDY7/img_20260423_135948.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmejKjP1vDXJH1B4TW1nXA5ehqjTkGv6JJic3D9yxAYscT/img_20260423_135958.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbBcryBk4fpDnJu7egSuYMGNKh3BrNmk5fWSfnhys7kap/img_20260423_140027.jpg)| |-|-|-|-| *** So I imagine I'm not drinking the coffee alone. It's a really strong espresso, with a spectacular aroma and flavor, and it doesn't deserve to be drunk alone. So, behind those masks and drawings, I imagined stories, special people... ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQoe3F124xQGiwERbFDPpfmrzrSpEsRVqpSTsTQFrHrVS/img_20260423_140038.jpg)
*** And I imagined that the coffee was much tastier and more special... ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfJMf55PJg5h7t4qZzFP2YGGwh4UCxVJu7KgBZzJ15xbj/img_20260423_140156.jpg)
*** I hope you can visit this coffee shop. Their offerings are well worth it for their quality. And the new design will absolutely surprise you. With another signature from the artist, I'll say goodbye until our next coffee, but not before sending each of you a hug of light! Don't forget to smile! ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb9oD3Yy8wCvPrRkxPTU6dqDZP9uNkA7S7woLba9DG6wE/img_20260423_140254.jpg)

> This is my participation in the [contest](https://ecency.com/hive-152524/@cinnccf/the-coffee-shop-prompt-or-week-165-apr-23-29) that @cinnccf proposes to us through the #CinnamonCupCoffee community. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmacjkPY8VXYjSdhse2ppAJSGJwpbSJnEB2xPBoNiXWc8c/caf_2.jpg)
*** ###

>Thank you very much for your visit!

***

> ¡Hola amantes del café en Hive! Llevaba tiempo sin escribir en esta hermosa comunidad y de veras les extrañaba a todos ustedes. Es interesante cómo, al regresar, encuentro que @cinnccf nos invita a reflexionar sobre un momento en que la soledad se sintió diferente. Nos propone explorar el contraste entre sentirnos solos y sentirnos conectados rodeados de desconocidos en alguna cafetería favorita que tengamos. Y es que llevo un tiempo considerable donde la soledad me acompaña en el camino. Ha pasado mucho tiempo en el que no he tomado café donde lo hacía con cotidianidad, en compañía de algún tipo de diálogo y flores como decoración del sitio. El día a día se tornaba blanco y negro así, como el *Comic Coffee*, esta cafetería a la que regreso luego de enterarme que habían ampliado sus salones con nuevos diseños y ante lo cual no pude resistirme para permitirles a ustedes que conozcan sus detalles novedosos. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmagLRaT9ZR6yipwTP54m8q9ecjQt1G6QFmwf4FVdq1VWv/img_20260413_173736.jpg)
*** Sobre el piso que nos recibe, no les comentaré pues en mi blog podrán encontrar visitas anteriores. Subo entonces la escalera hacia la segunda planta. Ahí la ven, sugerente en su diseño dinámico a pesar de conservar la idea de dos dimensiones en su proyección. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSYH9M2TusJEg1pZkSzcrzDtyzFuzpNEzMZn6c3Bi241E/img_20260413_173811.jpg)
*** A un lado, un salón que conserva el clásico estilo comic a dos tonos, con un agregado a color que nos recuerda la evolución inicial de los comics en sí. *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcRKQyfUCXR9q7S4cUGp2XPeJvtt21rW7M5kiVrWETj1R/img_20260413_173759.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmedMY8BQ4X5ETQw1s39D3tFS1pUVhprikDZbBK8w6ouc7/img_20260413_174623.jpg)| |-|-| *** Vean cuántas especificidades esperan por el asombro de los clientes y visitantes. Apenas cruzamos el umbral, Cheshire nos recibe con su sonrisa característica para sumergirnos en la ensoñación de historias por redescubrir... *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaRmyNyq2sgj3oo7ykCZQiYHLZeqo44JDDvwKQZXfuXqb/img_20260413_174606.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcp9hvwYdCweisCx8JkCvwL3WqfAqYnoohnMgLQZfoQKb/img_20260413_174733.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPN8GVJQV4fga1tB9gomFiWLEwczV6BzJShJqy5NjCZA1/img_20260413_174630.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** Los colores se comienzan a manifestar. Ahora con un agregado nuevo, dos pequeños lugares apartados con la pretensión de que, quienes asistan con algún niño pequeño, pues encontrará que su hijo se divertirá con propuestas lúdicas bien atractivas. *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSefmWM5rADVL15qSKgkzSb7Y7ojn6PFuF9sAKVgg11Gp/img_20260413_174552.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR5GN4VBe39mFPjTK436XcGR3jjuzG8LeBoj5gWTBja75/img_20260413_174600.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVASXafPAvdzcofVHVhRLUwfcBByTxo3YfSBSZLkGvB4N/img_20260413_174701.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** Por supuesto, son espacios pensados para niños bien pequeños. En lo personal, me gustó la idea. *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfJq6NrdmRfwAuwwnMsqXXEr4o9HL2d5kRHuPv4jBkjTP/img_20260413_174723.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW5eQkTvMSVWt677ovL2Dn5XfSgAED8ZvReuW5d4UDMFA/img_20260413_174717.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUEdqqu2w8pNPeRSdk8VprNhck1RSTXhUuXBJFGrLD7Wk/img_20260413_174617.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** Acá les muestro una primera firma del artista que diseñó todo. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUrvHAjVe4wwH4Qy9JPQPzqaMohxaKXQ2RTceFb3r8hSw/img_20260413_174639.jpg)
*** Y ahora otro cambio, justo al frente, otro salón, pero con una perspectiva novedosa para lo que estábamos presenciando anteriormente. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRphZAADJp1urJWje94THQebor5i2oQ2cjcEAtjaBXxz2/img_20260413_173927.jpg)
*** Cuando llegamos inicialmente, no había fluido eléctrico en el lugar y aún así estaba el artista aún trabajando finalizando cada elemento pictórico. Un instante de lujo sin lugar a dudas. *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPyyR8TY1gj6MhdQHywKT38GHUGSJjyMZhv9yLNAEjqNq/img_20260413_173848.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQBVtduKkrf3u52HYdGEuTLBBNniL6eWGokEsK8K3pF2G/img_20260413_174129.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWAxaLaW1e3qQ8pGck8Xie9d9Nk8zuT6EcxgjLnNp7xS6/img_20260413_173856.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb6BBURTrKzxtjjPJZ6J92Jou7UCGjhTojPZXyegu8fna/img_20260413_173911.jpg)| |-|-|-|-| *** Vean cuánto dinamismo en cada obra que nos lleva a evocar distintos animes, distintos comics que la cultura nos lega en el tiempo... *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKxxGFKHRtq8qcRPiDmnexunhXT6Mqe2Nkd6XVn3R783/img_20260413_174153.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVHixFj9PB862cJzGGpys4MV5sPFAPgLAu4PpLuy3Cv42/img_20260413_174200.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXvRsj5EE9AXyg1yDcYKwjM79zhgUXzx89b1wBXTtgY1q/img_20260413_174223.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** Parte del proceso en vivo, con todas las vicisitudes por las que los cubanos atravesamos para destruir barreras e imponer el arte... *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW1dRSLJrC9VZ7GYWXzGdZSW47a56MAtqXr3kka2aJZmt/img_20260413_174242.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPAGebKUHV519CztBb8V8QRtyzjtcK1Q9TtkAGTyhRxrS/img_20260413_174252.jpg)| |-|-| *** ¡Y se hizo la luz y el color! *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcWaXj1CH8SzmQh3uZwjJmLg2TzBiGXdUZuQruZ3koQTi/img_20260415_112317.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNt36nNDsdLuH2SACaw3F9dvp3UUGM5MVGTTiirT1Mi4w/img_20260415_112031.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNpLQLUmJcS8uhqnxu8ozKfghtiMcEdJtMKqXYeJYfMj5/img_20260415_112320.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXPZ6VVvHVJgUMZnwFcd4J2P73duW2diSfPbFENqMohZt/img_20260423_135341.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW5Uw7pVBrCdRsUQgfH5DX5kvwPTNQHakSfAXvrovTbe1/img_20260415_112023.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb5Jz7rspWTADXaSS4vYX367DwzAc3kf6Kh27gaozpZgy/img_20260423_135345.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** ¡Y con la luz, nuevos tonos para contemplar! ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma5nBmNjy5Zx3KmuT6k1zLfBtNmaySspqjqGNYtMg2VtY/img_20260415_111950.jpg)
*** Ya había pedido un café expreso al camarero, quien por cierto había sido alumno mío y me alegró verle prosperando en esta cafetería. Mientras esperaba me trajesen el café, con todo deleite me dispuse a reparar en cada dibujo, cada trazo, cada expresión, cada recuerdo que evocan. *** |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXP4NVizHPnSFV6rTt8qauZiVkmFGWe6K7HoFaQtw4KJK/img_20260415_112002.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmULqDLYBJMHAqRA91iQUMxE25Pg1zCWnpXBGbq1bHZsWq/img_20260415_112011.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcrppKSNnzA1xTUcb2XsL17JsAmBvjR34WyRdVKLZYdzK/img_20260415_112026.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQBqUC6PsmRJFqHgCuC3aASfYSBpUuk63tCNYYA63yBhW/img_20260415_112015.jpg)| |-|-|-|-| *** body.title: DIY clay train
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbzq9vWUpVQZ1SdRJk8bEh8eQzbGEa6HNNGUGRmfF2MJ8/1777383502933.jpg)
Hello hi everyone how are you greetings to all of you and welcome to my another beautiful blog in the community. I hope you guys all are well and making amazing artwork in different style and also using different materials. I always try to make something unique and special clay tutorial also useful for kids toy. Today I **DIY clay train** for my little cousin. She asked me and insists for making something toy for herself using foaming clay. So I DIY it and I want to share also with all of you so let's start the process. 

**Process**

First I took multiple colours of clay like purple green orange black and white. I moulded and made small sizes boxes in square shape. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeb6G9dtsrLhyJf7LL7yQp9NotkjtZFktEbnCXdQVaByv/1777383902369.jpg)
Then I attached boxes with eachother one by one green colour box was in big size than other so I attached it in the middle.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmViEFvrCsraPZQqnAhqhPMZqoyYCbwnmbmDPw4VpDotcy/1777383952118.jpg)

On the green box I highlighted eyes and smile for beautiful look. Infront side I pasted red colour box in round shape. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRAsuSt34ZTaTFjPfihHd7LbV3pLGNosrt8oXY8JTt7J9/1777384012692.jpg)

Then I took brown colour clay moulded it and gave the shape of wallcano and pasted on the green colour box. On it I pasted white colour bubbles for showing smoke of train.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP2r7ERWTDm3SkYiuFYA4T8NFd36bBn3eCQM9LEqZcvvT/1777384291549.jpg)

Now I took black and white colour for making tyres of train. I pasted them at the both sides. After pasting tyres train looking very aesthetic and gorgeous in multiple colours. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUKNE2zrQEkB9KLBsTZ4kLJkdCXgb7yo943fDxKdRkFVE/1777384372957.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT39K8LCztn22a8qqbht911vNDS4fhoAYhzmMMfnYnzio/1777384386273.jpg)

Train is ready for leaving on it's way. You can see more shots here. 

**More shots**


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUV5t9WvY6xsFTXheEghEMH6GTbikn2CAg8NPjeH4Ggxu/1777384430184.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY4zrm7s2BSPFr5vrm1ovND6RbEE3EVweAjU1Rue1iTtE/1777384444490.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbzq9vWUpVQZ1SdRJk8bEh8eQzbGEa6HNNGUGRmfF2MJ8/1777384458540.jpg)

After making it my cousin took it and played. It's really good toy for kids. Don't forget also giving me feedback and good response on my work. See you soon guys with new creativity in the community. Take care. Bye bye.

body.title: Hive Open Mic Week 316 ǀ Qué Será, Será - Cover by @Rosana6
body.body:
>

Greetings, Open Mic friends! It’s a pleasure to be with you for Week 316, where our theme is “I Know What's Coming.”

\n\n

>

Wanting to know what will happen in the future always sparks our curiosity and, for some, even anxiety. It’s normal to want some clue about what life and destiny have in store for us; however, for the most part, we have no control over that. While we can prepare ourselves professionally or in other ways by seeking the tools that will help us build a bright forthcoming, the truth is that we don’t know exactly what circumstances await us in the future. I think what we can do is prepare ourselves as best as possible and face life with the greatest enthusiasm, having faith in God, since He always wants the best for each of His children.

\n\n

>

Today I’m sharing the song “Qué Será, Será,” a track composed by Jay Livingston and Ray Evans in 1955 and covered by the American alternative rock band Pixies as part of their album “Qué Será, Será” (Whatever Will Be, Will Be), released in 2022. This song is part of the soundtrack for the thriller series From, and it reminds us that we cannot know the future with certainty and that whatever will be, will be. I hope you enjoy this presentation.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rosana6/23zSFvcMw15iKodEz3VmQBpwG2MpYBP4McZyRguEai13vREZS7VgxRwcBubM3UUWqQELT.jpg
>

>

¡Saludos, amigos de Open Mic! Un gusto estar con ustedes, en ocasión de la semana 316 en la que nos encontramos con la temática “Sé lo que va a pasar”.

\n\n>

>

Querer conocer lo que va a suceder en el futuro siempre nos causa curiosidad y a algunos incluso ansiedad. Es normal querer tener alguna pista de lo que nos depara la vida y el destino, sin embargo, en gran medida no tenemos control sobre eso, si bien podemos prepararnos profesionalmente o en otros aspectos buscando tener las herramientas que nos faciliten un buen porvenir, la verdad es que no conocemos con precisión cuáles serán las circunstancias que nos aguardan en el futuro. Pienso que lo que nos queda es prepararnos lo mejor posible y afrontar la vida con el mayor entusiasmo, teniendo fe en Dios, ya que Él siempre quiere lo mejor para cada uno de sus hijos.

\n\n>

>

El día de hoy les presento la canción “Qué Será, Será”, un tema compuesto por Jay Livingston y Ray Evans en el año 1955 y versionado por la banda de rock alternativo estadounidense Pixies, como parte de su álbum” Que Sera, Sera” (Whatever Will Be, Will Be) lanzado en 2022. Esta canción es parte de la banda sonora de la serie del género thriller From, y en ella nos hablan de que no conocemos el futuro con certeza y que lo que sea que vaya a suceder así será. Espero que esta presentación sea de su agrado.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rosana6/242sGNp4vJ8kzkEDzWzwn6guK9KHWGLRBM3jJeDqJ4hzeu4A4WyjY6zEEhWDBLaFYQFFD.jpg
##
Qué Será, Será
When I was just a little boy I asked my father: What will I be? Will I be handsome, will I be rich? Here's what he said to me
Qué Será, Será Whatever will be, will be The future's not ours to see Qué Será, Será What will be, will be
Now I have children of my own They ask their father: What will I be? Will I be pretty, will I be rich? I tell them tenderly
Qué Será, Será Whatever will be, will be The future's not ours to see Qué Será, Será What will be, will be Quá será, será
[Source / Fuente](https://www.letras.com/pixies/whatever-will-be-will-be-que-sera-sera/)
##
Qué Será, Será
Cuando era solo un niño pequeño Le pregunté a mi padre: ¿Qué seré? ¿Seré guapo, seré rico? Esto es lo que me dijo
Qué Será, Será Lo que tenga que ser, será El futuro no nos pertenece Qué Será, Será Lo que tenga que ser, será
Ahora tengo mis propios hijos Y le preguntan a su padre: ¿Qué seré? ¿Seré guapa, seré rica? Yo les digo con ternura
Qué Será, Será Lo que tenga que ser, será El futuro no nos pertenece Qué Será, Será Lo que tenga que ser, será Qué Será, Será
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rosana6/23zGVyiuHp533zrQ98tcrJQNc7HtvviUTh1C7FhsvHqWAMh96X8ffpmZz3UeqnP2oPDMC.jpg
***The video was recorded with my Redmi Note 10 5G and edited with Movavi.***
***Logo on cover is property of the Hive Open Mic Community.***
***English Translation by Deepl***
--- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=rosana6/c46dcfe6)

body.title: The Beautiful Mask of a Patent Lie
body.body: That word which left the lips with a smile but the eyes denied it instantly that very thing... was a clear lie. What kind of truth is this that pours sweetness into the ears yet knocks on the heart’s door and slips away in silence? I have seen people hide the truth and dress a lie in garments woven of glittering words but that glitter never lasts too long. A clear lie is a mirror where the face does appear but the truth stays blurred. Those promises that were once made turned out light as air and the words wrapped in solemn oaths scattered like grains of sand. You said, Everything’s fine and I believed it too but in some corner of my heart a whisper rose This isn’t true… This is a clear lie. Because truth doesn’t raise a storm it descends into the heart in silence and a lie no matter how adorned eventually reveals itself. So why then Why do we turn our eyes from truth and embrace a clear lie Perhaps because truth sometimes hurts and a lie disguised as a beautiful illusion grants the heart momentary peace… But remember that peace is fleeting and a clear lie in the end shatters before the face of truth.

body.title: Coke Delivers Strong Quarter, But I’m Staying on the Sidelines
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbUewtiKpSkXpNZo6KTy5zm3Sm6Z9z4sjw63CghShVgbx/img_0541.png)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdgUnZjUPVcABzqdPk5DmVpDUiP2yx3AJ8MbYbhDoAEXi/img_4612.png)

**Solid Results, Weak Case**

It’s quize amazing what Coke is delivering in the current consumer environment! The latest [quarterly results](https://www.msn.com/en-us/money/companies/coca-cola-tops-estimates-raises-earnings-outlook-as-global-beverage-demand-rises/ar-AA21U4yO) are a pleasant surprise: sales rose by 12%, and the full-year outlook got been increased. Still, I wouldn’t add the stock to my portfolio. 

Why? A less than 70% price increase over ten years, even with dividends, is too little compared to the S&P, let alone the NASDAQ. The $SPX rose by +250% over the same period, and the $NDX by a whopping +530%. 

Buffett got in early enough 40 years ago to benefit from the global expansion; today, in my opinion, Coke is just yesterday’s value. 

**You can add a few shares to your portfolio as a hobby, but to actually generate returns, any broad-market ETF would likely be the better investment.**





![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdgUnZjUPVcABzqdPk5DmVpDUiP2yx3AJ8MbYbhDoAEXi/img_4612.png)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR4BLaAhatuQp5o5cJKPymYboxNL9uuefsDYoHfUMVG4Q/img_0540.png)

body.title: A Simple Bowl, A Big Blessing: How My Neighbor’s Homemade Spaghetti Reminds Me of Filipino Generosity
body.body:
![collage.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/AKs3J3dr7QqiJdUEMQRS7ZyiCu2ynwXipQadUFbXYg1p7S17gZ7u26sZv46T1fV.jpeg)

**Hello Hive Family! Most especially to my fellow BayaniHive Community members and my co-Filipino Hivers,** I hope this post finds you well and smiling today.

![1f7dc7df-370f-4220-afc1-56af5ba9b4e4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EoGxzhBqA8vQWomW69kmko1gfC3tfByhB6AHW48srLFwQeRkuPKLtyZ9PK5CJbrWhYd.jpeg)

Earlier, I received a heartwarming surprise from my generous neighbor. She had cooked **spaghetti**, not for any occasion, but simply because her son requested his favorite homemade dish. And true to her thoughtful nature, she never forgets to share a bowl with me whenever she prepares it.

![989b9b4a-d135-44e1-93bf-e50dedb1ee65.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EpJZ1k56GBQWYXnZCYTCe4oihwL6ABuLUr3Dc1j4Akte3hURietv3AMck7UELznP3EC.jpeg)

There was no birthday, no holiday, no party, just a simple craving from her son. Yet, that small act of kindness turned into a reminder of how Filipino generosity shines in everyday life. It’s these little gestures, like sharing food without expecting anything in return, that make our communities stronger and our bonds deeper.

![72302cbb-5fa1-48ca-b80f-25d01bcffa5a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23xKvQVDQDa1Me8Kdje1dKFSg5rMPRokY8Xz79xHUN8Ev7Tkw14hLo3NA6TwuYJjXjcmJ.jpeg)

Her spaghetti isn’t just delicious; it carries with it the warmth of friendship, the joy of sharing, and the essence of bayanihan, the spirit of helping and caring for one another.

**Thank you, Hive Family, for taking the time to read my little story.** May we all continue to celebrate these everyday blessings and spread kindness in our own ways. Until my next post, keep shining and keep sharing!

body.title: HBD in 2026: Supply Slightly Down, DHF Payouts Dominant, and HIVE Absorbing the Pressure
body.body:
How is HBD doing these days?

The HIVE market cap has dropped significantly in the last months, which has reduced or stopped HBD payouts to authors. In theory, this should slow down new HBD creation and help reduce the supply.

But HBD still has other supply-expanding mechanics in place. DHF payouts and HBD interest continue to add new HBD into circulation, while conversions and the stabilizer work on the other side by removing HBD from circulation.

In 2026, the result so far is a slightly lower circulating HBD supply, with DHF payouts becoming the dominant source of new HBD and conversions taking the lead in removing HBD. The key point is that while HBD supply is going down, part of that pressure is being absorbed by HIVE.






![01.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23u5bTrUFAwXbNzFK6dDA9yRzzxuaJwAtYdbyrqQNPVUNkyGqPMpuS1NcP3HSf84fwN4b.png)


 




HBD is being created and burned in multiple ways. *Like many things on Hive, it has nuances.* The main mechanics for expanding and contracting the supply are the conversions, but there are also the author rewards, proposal DHF payouts, interest payouts etc. 

For better visibility we will be categorizing the HBD created/burned in the following manner:
-	Author rewards
-	Conversions
-	DHF Payouts
-	@hbdstabilizer
-	Interest payouts

The HBD in the DHF is treated differently than the rest of the HBD. HBD in the DHF is not considered as freely available HBD on the market, so it is excluded from debt calculations and similar. 

**The focus here will be on freely circulating HBD, excluding the HBD in the DHF.**

We will be looking at the different HBD allocations here as well. 

**The period that we will be looking at is 2016 – 2026, with a focus on the last year.**

-----


## HBD Added in Circulation
HBD enters circulation via multiple ways, like author rewards, DHF payouts and interest to HBD held in savings. HBD is added in the DHF as a share of the inflation, but we will be looking at the HBD that only leaves the Decentralized Hive Fund, the DHF payouts. 

Here is the chart.


 


![image001.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23uEwte87CM6fqdWWhuHxzzV9999mKnjtQgGWSLvfve7gHye4LBjcDgSKhkAiAsjb9bNC.png)






The chart includes the following:
-	Author rewards
-	DHF Payouts
-	Interest

As we can see the authors’ rewards have been the number one source for HBD created, but in the last years the other ways have been growing faster.

HBD in theory can be created through conversions as well, but conversions can be both positive and negative depending on market conditions. Here we will be looking at the data for conversions under the HBD removed section.

A 35M HBD was created as an author reward from the very beginning. A 12.3M as payouts from the DHF, and 5M HBD as interest. These are all cumulative numbers from 2016 to now. 


We can notice that in the first years, all the HBD creation was due to author rewards, but this has changed in the last years and now the DHF is at the first spot, followed by the author rewards and then the interest rewards. In the last year, 2025, the DHF payouts have been the dominant source of inflation, with 2.5M coming out of it, and then the interest and the authors rewards each added 1.2M HBD.

## HBD Removed from Circulation
Now let’s take a look at HBD removed. Here is the chart. 


 




![image003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/EoCasUAZCHMTviyK2ykmfnTugJN3wFjgM1bHavomMjA36DYDmWPYbgjxrTobDTZUfns.png)






We can see that up to the start of the stabilizer, the main way to destroy HBD was conversions to HIVE. Since the launch of the stabilizer, it has played a major role in the decrease in the HBD supply. In the last years it has been the main method for removing HBD from circulation.  
Cumulatively, the stabilizer has removed close to 25M HBD from circulation, while 16M were removed through conversions. In the very last months there seems to be again shift towards conversions. 

The stabilizer is providing support for the HBD price on the internal market, buying HBD with HIVE if the HBD price is below the dollar. The stabilizer has scaled down its operations in 2024 and lowered the funds that it is receiving from the DHF but in the long run it’s still playing the major role. 


## Cumulative HBD Added/Removed from Circulation
When we add the two charts above, we get this.


 




![image005.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/EoEiisnBCffY2PvxXtjiQhMBsKfRQmB3JbRTMpkKTsGE7efZKWbsTFpnaBZMVi64FSj.png)





As mentioned already the author’s rewards are the main category in the positive, and the stabilizer is dominant in the negative. 
When collapsed the both sides, give approximately 10M HBD where we are now. 

**When we zoom in the period since the Hive fork 2020-2026 we get this:**


 




![image007.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23uEzR4qZRc5n47eGykemxBX7y9MtXkdTvtsF8CMsJYjmh8gVUKYpDDid6EshBy5ZLizE.png)






We can see the overlapping that happened in 2021, when there was demand for HBD due to its high price on external markets like Upbit, and there was HIVE to HBD conversions, both from users and the stabilizer creating HBD. But since then, this process has been mostly working in the opposite way, removing HBD from circulation by HBD to HIVE conversions. In the process HBD is burned, but more HIVE is created. 
Also, here we can clearly see that the HBD from the DHF is now dominant when it comes to creating new HBD in circulation. 


## HBD Supply 
Finally, the HBD supply looks like this.


 



![image009.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tkk3tVH69g8kjGvETeS324hhfYq9seUZzJK3Z8M97U6ejVkWrQTKUhX84kR3PZYpKkb.png)







The HBD in the DHF is represented with light white.
We are now at 10M HBD in circulation, while there is another 23.2M HBD in the DHF, accounting for a total of 33.2M. 
We can notice that in the last two years the amount of HBD in circulation has been quite stable with a small drop in the last months from 11M to 10M HBD.

**When we zoom in 2025-2026 we get this:**


 


![image011.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/EoEii6Yz9Q85jfwNLEeYwfu4uSzma9iVZKLUgyZUHKRTeeQJp1jkRAwAw3bNWr9NHSZ.png)





*The chart is zoomed so the movements are more visable.*

The HBD supply in the DHF has been stable at around 23M.

## HBD Liquid VS Savings Balance

The HBD in the savings is at 14% APR at the moment. It was recently changed after been at 20% for years. When we plot the amount of HBD in the savings against the supply we get this.

 




![image015.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tRvekgDCgcukCZDpE5S3otzCQGj6whPEsTFBSzJYdMMVarQAGxHHgb4jygGtE9bVYtF.png)





We can clearly see that since the introduction of the interest for HBD, back in 2021, out 2026 there is a constant growth in the amount of HBD in savings, while the liquid HBD supply went down. In the last months there is a drop in the overall supply and so does to the HBD in savings. 

We are now at 7.5M HBD in savings from the totally 10M supply, leaving 2.5M liquid HBD.


## Liquid HBD Share [%]

The chart for the liquid HBD supply share in percent, excluding the HBD in DHF and in the savings looks like this.

 






![image017.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23swgJxPS4wnChNjK6CYkvLFbPJPyV6k9KNWCtQR8oDenUYvYUExE8XcpBAh2H3hYVaSU.png)







We can see that the liquid HBD supply share keeps going down. In the last two years. It has dropped to 25% liquid HBD and 75% staked HBD, and it is around that spot in 2024 with short fluctuations from time to time. Even with the reduction of the HBD supply in the last period, the share basically remained at the same level.



## Summary for HBD Added and Removed by Category in 2026

When we sum up all the above, and check what has caused the HBD supply to expand or contract in 2026 we have this.




![image019.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/Eo8L2GRcNFpufEnXnZjqanM7HLJXGvy8LMRwEc8QwFwEopuaX4D1rdenLW96kZNX3J2.png)
 







The DHF payouts are the number one way for HBD entering in circulation in the first four months of 2026 with **450k** HBD. Next is the interest and then the authors rewards who are now very small because they stopped in February 2026. 

When it comes to removing HBD from circulation conversions have overtaken the stabilizer in 2026. These are regular users who are converting HBD to HIVE. Then comes the stabilizer. When we sum the above for 2026 we get close to 1M in HBD removed from circulation. 


Historically the creation/removal of HBD per category trought the years looks like this. 


 



![image023.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tGa1XGMUW7WHmzhQUM6dTWoafymgcsEyqtt8cvV3CJLH7jXwzi65wxbnWzuW6Pxddev.png)






*Note that 2026 is not over yet*.

We are seing that there is now a shift in the way HBD enters circulation. In the past the majority of it was put in circulation from the authors rewards (grey), and cumulative this is still the biggest position. But in the last years the shift is more towards proposal payouts from the DHF (white) and then HBD interest (green). 

The stabilizer(orange) has been the main way to remove HBD from circulation since for five years in the period of 2021 to 2025. In 2026 regular conversions are back and the mojority of the HBD removed is done by them, although the year is only a third finished. 


When we collapse the bars above, we get this:
 








![image021.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tGa1tnwLEJkCREf6DFHXdtM6CzkLF5qwZXV2vebCB9Bt25nHC1AsaoaEH3DrK1WNNYa.png)







Overall, the HBD supply in 2026 is slightly down, moving from around 11M to 10M in circulation. The main source of new HBD is now DHF payouts, while author rewards have become very small after stopping in February 2026.

On the removal side, regular conversions have overtaken the stabilizer so far in 2026. This is an important shift. For years, the stabilizer was the dominant mechanism removing HBD, but now users converting HBD to HIVE are playing the bigger role.


All the best
@dalz

https://www.hbdstats.com/

body.title: Biblical Counseling in Recent Times by David Powlinson
body.body:
In the early days, people brought their problems to the church, and the church used the Bible to help them. But as time passed, this changed. Many began to prefer counseling from psychologists instead. This may be because of financial struggles and the limited income of being a pastor. Many pastors are aware of this, and some may even feel that the Bible is no longer sufficient to address the problems people face.

However, based on my understanding, psychology mainly focuses on feelings, behavior, and past experiences. It does not usually address the issue of sin, nor does it clearly point people to what God desires or to God’s solution for their lives.

Through the influence of Jay Adams, biblical counseling was restored. People were helped to recognize their sins, repent, and change their lives.

For me, the true goal of counseling is not just to feel better, but to grow closer to God, to experience a change of heart, and to become Christ-centered.

I believe it is better to base counseling on the Bible because God is the answer to all the trials we face. No matter how heavy or difficult our problems are, God can provide a way through them. We must have faith, believe in Him, worship Him daily, and do these things with all our heart and willingness. In the end, it is also our choice if we truly desire to be saved.

body.title: Gutter Cleaning Service Guide for Safe Home Protection\n
body.body:
## Introduction
 Why a Gutter Cleaning Service Is Essential

A reliable[ Gutter Cleaning service](https://faithgutters.com/) is not just a seasonal task it’s a critical component of long-term home maintenance and structural protection. Gutters are designed to direct rainwater away from your roof, walls, and foundation. When they become clogged with leaves, debris, or dirt, they can no longer perform efficiently, leading to water damage, mold growth, and costly repairs.

Homeowners often underestimate how quickly gutters can accumulate debris, especially in areas with heavy rainfall or nearby trees. Ignoring regular maintenance can result in overflow, basement flooding, and even roof deterioration. That’s why investing in a professional solution is essential for preserving your property’s integrity.

In this comprehensive guide, you’ll discover everything you need to know about gutter maintenance, the benefits of hiring experts, and how to choose the right service for optimal results.

## What Is a Gutter Cleaning Service?

A Gutter Cleaning service involves the removal of debris such as leaves, twigs, dirt, and other obstructions from your gutter system and downspouts. This process ensures proper water flow and prevents damage caused by water accumulation.

Professional services typically include:

*   Inspection of gutters and downspouts

*   Removal of debris by hand or specialized tools

*   Flushing the system with water to ensure proper flow

*   Identifying leaks, cracks, or sagging sections

*   Minor repairs and maintenance recommendations

By ensuring your gutters are clean and functional, these services help extend the lifespan of your entire drainage system.

## Signs Your Gutters Need Immediate Cleaning

Ignoring clogged gutters can lead to severe damage. Here are the most common warning signs:

### 1. Overflowing Water

When water spills over the edges during rain, it indicates a blockage preventing proper drainage.

### 2. Sagging Gutters

Excess debris adds weight, causing gutters to pull away from the roofline.

### 3. Plant Growth

If you notice plants growing in your gutters, it’s a clear sign of long-term neglect.

### 4. Water Stains on Walls

Streaks or stains on your home’s exterior often result from overflowing gutters.

### 5. Pest Infestations

Clogged gutters create a perfect environment for insects, birds, and rodents.

Addressing these issues promptly with a professional gutter cleaning approach can prevent costly repairs and maintain your home’s value.

## Benefits of Hiring a Professional Gutter Cleaning Service

While some homeowners attempt DIY cleaning, hiring experts offers unmatched advantages.

### 1. Safety First

Cleaning gutters involves climbing ladders and working at heights. Professionals are trained and equipped to handle these risks safely.

### 2. Thorough Cleaning

Experts use specialized tools and techniques to remove even the most stubborn debris.

### 3. Early Problem Detection

A Gutter Cleaning service includes inspection, helping identify minor issues before they become major problems.

### 4. Time Efficiency

Professionals complete the job quickly and efficiently, saving you valuable time.

### 5. Long-Term Cost Savings

Preventative maintenance reduces the risk of expensive repairs caused by water damage.

## How Often Should You Clean Your Gutters?

The frequency of cleaning depends on several factors, including your location, weather conditions, and surrounding environment.

### General Recommendations:

*   Twice a year (spring and fall) for most homes

*   Quarterly cleaning in areas with heavy foliage

*   After storms to remove sudden debris buildup

Regular maintenance ensures your gutter system functions efficiently year-round.

## DIY vs Professional Gutter Cleaning

### DIY Cleaning

Some homeowners prefer cleaning gutters themselves to save money. However, this approach has limitations:

*   Safety risks from ladder use

*   Lack of proper tools

*   Incomplete cleaning

*   No professional inspection

### Professional Cleaning

Choosing a [professional gutter cleaning](https://faithgutters.com/) solution ensures:

*   Comprehensive debris removal

*   Proper inspection and maintenance

*   Safe and efficient service

*   Long-lasting results

For homeowners seeking reliability and peace of mind, professional services are the better option.

## Step by Step Professional Gutter Cleaning Process

Understanding how experts work can help you appreciate the value of hiring them.

### Step 1: Inspection

Technicians assess the condition of your gutters and identify problem areas.

### Step 2: Debris Removal

All leaves, dirt, and obstructions are carefully removed.

### Step 3: Flushing

Water is used to flush the system and ensure proper flow.

### Step 4: Downspout Cleaning

Blockages in downspouts are cleared to prevent backups.

### Step 5: Final Check

A thorough inspection ensures everything is functioning correctly.

This systematic approach guarantees optimal performance and durability.

## Common Problems Caused by Clogged Gutters

Neglecting gutter maintenance can lead to serious issues:

### 1. Roof Damage

Water pooling on the roof can cause leaks and structural deterioration.

### 2. Foundation Issues

Improper drainage leads to water accumulation around your home’s foundation.

### 3. Basement Flooding

Clogged gutters can redirect water into your basement.

### 4. Mold and Mildew

Excess moisture creates the perfect environment for mold growth.

### 5. Landscape Erosion

Overflowing water can damage plants and soil around your home.

Regular use of a Gutter Cleaning service prevents these problems and protects your investment.

## How to Choose the Right Gutter Cleaning Service

Selecting the right service provider is crucial for quality results.

### 1. Experience and Expertise

Look for companies with proven experience in gutter maintenance.

### 2. Customer Reviews

Positive feedback indicates reliability and professionalism.

### 3. Insurance and Licensing

Ensure the company is fully insured to protect against liability.

### 4. Transparent Pricing

Choose services that provide clear and upfront pricing.

### 5. Comprehensive Services

Opt for providers offering inspection, cleaning, and minor repairs.

A well-chosen professional gutter cleaning provider ensures long-term performance and peace of mind.

## Advanced Gutter Maintenance Tips

Beyond cleaning, there are additional steps to improve your gutter system’s efficiency:

### Install Gutter Guards

These prevent debris from entering your gutters, reducing cleaning frequency.

### Check for Proper Slope

Ensure gutters are angled correctly for smooth water flow.

### Repair Leaks Promptly

Small leaks can quickly turn into major issues if ignored.

### Trim Nearby Trees

Reducing falling leaves minimizes debris buildup.

### Schedule Regular Inspections

Routine checks help detect and fix problems early.

## Seasonal Gutter Maintenance Guide

### Spring

*   Remove debris from winter

*   Check for damage caused by snow or ice

### Summer

*   Inspect for cracks or leaks

*   Ensure proper drainage during storms

### Fall

*   Clean fallen leaves

*   Prepare for heavy rainfall

### Winter

*   Prevent ice dams

*   Ensure gutters are clear before snowfall

Following this seasonal routine ensures your gutters remain functional throughout the year.

## Cost of Gutter Cleaning Services

The cost of a Gutter Cleaning service varies based on:

*   Size of your home

*   Gutter condition

*   Level of debris buildup

*   Accessibility

While prices may vary, investing in regular cleaning is far more affordable than repairing water damage.

## Environmental Benefits of Clean Gutters

Maintaining clean gutters also contributes to environmental sustainability:

*   Prevents water waste

*   Protects landscaping

*   Reduces soil erosion

*   Supports efficient rainwater harvesting

A properly maintained system ensures water is directed where it’s needed most.

## Why Professional Gutter Cleaning Is Worth It

Many homeowners hesitate to hire professionals, but the benefits outweigh the costs. A [professional gutter cleaning](https://faithgutters.com/) approach ensures your home is protected from water damage, structural issues, and costly repairs.

By relying on experts, you gain peace of mind knowing your gutter system is in optimal condition.

## Conclusion
 Protect Your Home with Regular Gutter Maintenance

A dependable Gutter Cleaning service is essential for maintaining your home’s safety, value, and longevity. From preventing water damage to improving drainage efficiency, regular cleaning plays a vital role in home maintenance.

body.title: When Tomato Disease Wins: A Lesson Every Farmer Must Learn
body.body:
Farming teaches us many lessons, but some come the hard way. This season, my tomato plants (Tomato plant) reminded me that even with effort and care, things can still go wrong.
Looking at my plants, you can clearly see the signs of stress and disease. The leaves are drying from the edges, curling, and showing patches of yellow and brown. Some fruits are ripening unevenly, while others remain small or damaged. At first, I thought it was just a minor issue—maybe lack of water or sunlight—but it turned out to be more serious.
From my observation, the problem appears to be a mix of fungal infection and possible nutrient deficiency, which is very common in tomatoes. Diseases like Early blight or Septoria leaf spot often start exactly like this—small spots, yellowing leaves, and gradual weakening of the plant.
My biggest mistake? I delayed taking action.
At the early stage, I ignored the warning signs. I didn’t prune infected leaves, and I also failed to apply preventive treatments on time. By the time I reacted, the disease had already spread across multiple plants. This is something many farmers experience—waiting too long and hoping the plant will recover on its own.
Another contributing factor was poor airflow around the plants. As you can see, the tomatoes are growing close to a wall, which limits ventilation. This creates a humid environment—perfect for fungal diseases to thrive. Also, inconsistent watering may have stressed the plants, making them more vulnerable.
But every failure is a lesson.
Here’s what I’ve learned and what I will do differently next time:
Early detection is everything – The moment you see spots or discoloration, act fast.
Remove infected leaves immediately – Don’t let the disease spread.
Use preventive sprays – Organic options like neem oil or recommended fungicides can help.
Improve spacing and airflow – Plants need breathing space to stay healthy.
Feed the soil properly – Strong plants resist disease better.
Even though I couldn’t fully control the disease this time, I still harvested some tomatoes. Not all is lost—but the yield could have been much better.
Farming is not about perfection. It’s about learning, adapting, and improving every season.
If you are growing tomatoes, don’t ignore the small signs. They are warnings. Act early, and you will save your crop.

## East Meets West Collision: The Juicy & Zesty Dinner Showdown!

### 🇬🇧 English Review by Sakol

**Good evening, midnight munchers and flavor fanatics!** Sakol is back to cap off the day, and let me tell you, tonight’s dinner table is the stage for an epic culinary crossover! We are bringing together the heavy-hitting comfort of the West with the electrifying zing of Thai street food. It’s an unconventional pairing, but oh boy, does it work like magic! 

Let’s slice into tonight’s spectacular feast:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVH7TaxgqGqpfqdFCjztsTyGuycWo1raeB9woxFCYAUpC/image.png)


* **Sizzling Pork Steak (Steak Moo):** Let’s talk about a carnivore’s dream! The moment the knife glides through this beautifully seared cut of pork, the savory juices just flow. It’s got that glorious caramelized crust on the outside, but inside, it’s ridiculously tender and packed with savory goodness. Every bite is rich, meaty, and feels like a warm, satisfying reward after a long day.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNzfKWhMZbhEvPSBXqdiBVid6JgMkWgMQv396sQqcTQeQ/image.png)


* **Crispy Chicken Spicy Salad with a Sour Twist (Yum Gai Krob):** And right when you think the steak is too rich, **BAM!** This dish kicks the door down! This isn't just a salad; it’s an adrenaline shot to your taste buds. The chicken is fried to a deafening crunch, tossed in a vibrant dressing bursting with freshly squeezed lime juice. It’s unapologetically sour, slightly spicy, and incredibly refreshing. It cuts through the richness of the pork steak like a samurai sword!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcFeMkWFMX67VYiQcPTor48yqK1D9Gc3AGSYx54SimcVJ/image.png)


**The Verdict:** What a masterpiece of contrast! You get the luxurious, savory chew of the pork steak perfectly balanced by the sharp, crunchy, citrusy explosion of the crispy chicken salad. It’s Yin and Yang on a plate. **Dinner is served, and it is a 10/10 knockout!**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNfxzZLPdRWN9YCU65sG9DRcESFLk6AkGSSLSHcXqHdZd/image.png)


---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU9TzkVdzEz9skL4RFSH2WSD177kw7VTg7cTrj3j3WbvS/image.png)


## ศึกสองขั้วความนัวยามค่ำคืน! สเต็กหมูฉ่ำๆ ปะทะ ยำไก่กรอบเปรี้ยวจี๊ดสะดุ้งลิ้น!

### 🇹🇭 รีวิวโดย พี่สากล ชวนชิม

body.body: > I became familiar with HBD quite a long time ago, and I truly consider it a powerful asset. Although HBD production is currently turned off, I still like this decentralized stablecoin, Hive-Backed Dollars. One of the main reasons I prefer HBD is that, it maintains a stable value of 1:1 with the US dollar, which makes it reliable compared to other crypto tokens that often fluctuate in price. To be honest, most of the time I have used HBD for conversion. When I convert HBD, I receive an equivalent value of Hive tokens based on the market rate. I mainly did this to increase my Hive holdings. My goal has always been to grow my Hive Power, so converting HBD into Hive felt like a practical decision for me. However, people have different interests when it comes to using HBD. Some users prefer to trade HBD to increase their assets in HBD. Those who are skilled and experienced in trading often take advantage of price movements to grow their HBD. There is definitely a positive side to this approach, as trading HBD can help increase one’s overall power on the platform. But at the same time, it requires a strong and positive mindset. If someone is only focused on cashing out, then it does not really contribute to long-term growth within the platform. At present, due to the lower price of Hive, content rewards are not being received in HBD. If I were receiving HBD now, I would focus more on powering up. Since Hive prices are relatively low, converting HBD would provide more Hive tokens, and powering up would help me grow faster on the platform. Increasing Hive Power is important because it strengthens influence and supports long-term engagement. Looking ahead, I hope that when HBD production becomes active again, I will be able to use it in a more positive and strategic way. My goal is to focus on growth rather than short-term benefits and to make better use of HBD for building my presence on the platform.

body.title: Desert Demon                  ...Part 1                  ...Confronting an Enigma
body.body:
*Nobody ever takes from the desert anything but aridity and monsters...*


![Sand Devil.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnjgeddes/48WCtzkCnvRUJCTSWNnh1cj9bEv8cYWJxq8GftAySL8cfxtCRuQwzt7bnsHhhSXva7.png)
*Confronting an Enigma*


I’ve been asked to weddings and sadly funerals, but I’ve never been to a consecration. Of all my friends, I would never have predicted Damien Moshe would suddenly convert, become a monk and choose to live in the desert as a hermit. But here I am in Beersheba, in the central Negev, witnessing Damien making his public vows.

I knew Damien was serious when he submitted to tonsure. He actually allowed Abba Arsenius to cut his precious, long, black hair. The four locks of hair are cut in a cruciform pattern to symbolize Damien’s vow to leave the world and its passions and dedicate his life to God. He’ll live in a community first, on the edge of the desert, and then, after testing and spiritual growth, he’ll become a solitary anchorite, or hermit.

After the ceremony, I ask Abba Arsenius about his need for preparation to live as a hermit monk. “It’s necessary to be spiritually mature,” he tells me, “because the wilderness is the abode of demons”. It brings to my mind a picture of Christ in the wilderness being tempted by Satan. As we’re talking, a man from the town approaches the abbot—and begins talking excitedly in Arabic.

“This man,” the abbot tells me, “has found a strange artifact in a cave in the desert. “Would you be interested in seeing it?” “Definitely,” I respond, “I’d be more than happy to accompany you.” “Good, then the three of us can go in the monastery’s jeep. We’ll be met there by a Bedouin who will direct us to the cave.” I couldn’t help but notice the excitement in Damien’s eyes as once again, we were heading out on another adventure.

We drive south for about half an hour until we come to a cluster of tents. The abbot gets out and approaches a man. A flurry of excited talk follows. The man keeps pointing up a dry wash to a ridge beyond. I can’t understand him, but it’s evident he’s agitated. I ask Damien. “What’s he saying?” “He’s very upset—keeps repeating, no go back—no go back.” A woman comes out—probably his wife—and calms him. She offers him wine from a wineskin.

The man begins speaking very solemnly. Damien translates: “He says there’s an eerie presence in the cave – there’s a stone statue there—an idol. Says he feels evil coming from it.” The abbot continues talking to the man and then eventually rejoins us. “The Bedouin are very superstitious,” he tells us. “He thinks there’s djin—a genie up there.” “What exactly frightened him?” I ask. The abbot sighs. “He says while he was in the cave, it grew dark—something big and evil came in. He also said he saw demons.”

I arch an eyebrow. “He’s referring to sand devils—they often reach hundreds of meters in height—The Bedouin think devils wrap themselves in cloaks of sand because they hate to be naked.” “I’ve heard that—the demons want a house—a body to possess.” He nods. “If they can’t find a man or an animal to enter, they’ll cover themselves in swirling sand.” “Where is this cave?” Damien interrupts. “It’s about another half hour’s hike from here—I’m sure I can find it—if you still want to go.” “By all means,” I reply. I have no idea what we’ll find out in the desert but my heart is beating fast just imagining the possibilities
To be continued...

body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcBD2Bs3hgQKzJTzMjEC4aTrcWgpadJejAZucjHcgDU1D/3_unicorn_aliens.jpeg)  
 
Image created using ideogram  
 
This post contains my referral link. Though I do not receive direct compensation if you sign up using my link I may gain in game perks.  
 
[Check out Three Legacy here](https://www.threelegacy.com/?mother=pixydust)  

Not much has changed in terms of what I am doing in game from last post but I figured I'd do a quick update while I'm thinking about it.

Withdrawals are delayed. I don't really care either way (though I'd like more THREE to put into the LP)but they were supposed to be live last week I believe. I haven't kept up with all the updates but they are basically waiting until everything is functional and also making do some other in-game  adjustments.

There hasn't been any new blueprints or buildings  lately either. This is slowing things down for me a little on my main account because I do try to  birth aliens when the dowager is high enough that it makes sense to. That hasn't happened in a few weeks. When people build or upgrade buildings their dowager ranking goes  up depending on the cost of the build/upgrade. Since there hasn't been anything new in a while, makes sense that it's not happening  very quickly anymore.

I have been birthing a couple of aliens a week on my main account but I am waiting until things pick up a little more. It's more cost effective in the long run to birth when the dowry is high so that it reduces cost or in some cases it's actually profitable. I have a good balance of open slots now I don't need to rush to birth more. If/when the dowry pool grows I will birth much faster. I currently have 51 birthing tokens as well as liquid THREE to birth when those run out.  That said I will be birthing at least twice a week regardless of the dowry pool until I use up all my tokens.

I've also been slowly claiming some blueprints to increase my legacy score. I have probably close to 125 legacy points I could claim maybe more. I am claiming as I remember/log on.  As I birth new aliens I also get new blueprints to claim on that alien so these will continue to accumulate for a while until I catch up. I still have like 140 claim tokens I believe so I am not using and THREE to claim. Right now I am trying to save up the THREE so when withdrawals open I can put more into the LP.

My other accounts are still chugging along I am just waiting until I have enough THREE on my $1 account to birth another alien. I haven't been that active on the account but it is still earning a little everyday. I think I am about 40% or the way to birth another alien (if the price stays as is).  I could speed the progress up slightly if I was more active on that account. Right now I am checking it every few days. If I really wanted to speed things up I'd log in more often and make sure my aliens are working finding blueprints.

After  my next alien birth  I will being alternating  births and buildings/blueprints on that account slightly prioritizing births until I have more open birth slots/fertile aliens.

The $10 account is looking strong. Self sufficient. I am claiming legacy points there too. I also have more buildings I could upgrade.
I plan to do some of that soon, but I also want some THREE on that account for the LP as well so I am doing these things a bit conservatively. I may wait until a new  thing comes out before upgrading existing buildings. We shall see.

body.title: Valorarse sin limites
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVZeriuVRUTAYny6EKYS2mk7kWN3TAujvSP1cnStCT9GW/1777383285547.jpg)

Estoy pasando por un proceso doloroso pero tampoco es algo nuevo. Ya conozco las mecánicas de este escenario y no me siento superado por el duelo que me toca vivir. La parte más difícil es darse cuenta que alguien en quien quise creer demostró ser exactamente el tipo de persona que me advirtieron que sería. Pero no pasa nada, ya me he acostumbrado a la decepción y cada día la manejo con más gracia.

Me doy cuenta que en esta tierra el dolor es seguro y la alegría efímera. Siempre puedes volver al dolor, siempre te está esperando y ni hay ningún limite para cuanto dolor quieres sentir. En cambio si quieres sentirte pleno e inspirado debes esforzarte y enfrentarte a incontables obstáculos para sentir una pizca de eso.

Creo en Dios, siento a Dios, hablo con Dios. Pero es triste darse cuenta que a pesar de haber abierto el diálogo con la divinidad se mantiene el mismo tipo de dinámica en el mundo material y las personas. Mi expectativa es que a partir de eso todo iba a mejorar instantáneamente. Pero no dejaré que eso me aplaste, porque esta comunicación fluida que hemos establecido me da fuerza para enfrentar la adversidad y pequeñas decepciones no me harán flaquear.
