body.title: (ESP-ENG) Liar Game - Another anime premiere, other first impressions!
body.body:
Hello friends, good vibes to all.

> Hola amigos, buenas vibras para todos. 


![1.avif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23uEyyWHti3Re2n6WmpzTYZqW4sweTtPWMz4kSYNqdbJ3Md4FZNzjz55Aj7KdMU67rxaN)


[Source!](https://www.crunchyroll.com/es/series/GT00371851/liar-game?srsltid=AfmBOopFlp0hkjN-hcWnGegYb1417pnXfBTH5IS971sa2xPRahaM7VAY)

What can I say? We're still in the season of new releases, and I think this will be the last one on the list that I've decided to watch. If I find another one that looks interesting, you'll see it here. In the meantime, let's start talking about Liar Game, an anime that obviously has a very popular manga and a live-action series that aired in Japan back in 2007 with several seasons. This time, the folks at Madhouse decided to bring this version to anime, and so far there are four episodes. As is usually the case, I've only seen the first two to get a more realistic and objective first impression.

> Que les puedo decir, seguimos en la temporada de estrenos y este creo que sería el último de la lista que me he dispuesto a ver, en caso de que consiga otro que tenga una pinta interesante pues por acá lo verán. Mientras tantos comencemos a hablar de Liar Game, un anime que obviamente tiene un manga muy popular y una serie real que fue transmitida en Japón por allá en el 2007 con varias temporadas. En esta oportunidad la gente de Madhouse decidió traer esta versión al anime y hasta el momento van 4 episodios de los cuales, y como ya es normal en estos casos, solo he visto los dos primeros para así tener una primera impresión más real y objetiva. 

The theme of this story is quite different from what we've been seeing lately. What predominates here is a psychological thriller, a kind of mind game that tests people's character and mettle. We have Nao Kanzaki, a young woman with a particular trait: she's extremely honest and naive. I say this because she even went so far as to return money she found lying in the street. One day, while at home, she receives an invitation to a game, the Liar Game, which is supposedly random, but it's anything but. She's essentially given 100 million yen. The objective is to try to keep that money while stealing from her opponent, because, of course, it's a game for two players.

> La temática de esta historia es muy diferente a lo que hemos estado viendo últimamente y es que lo que predomina acá es el thriller psicológico, una especie de juego mental en donde se pone a prueba el carácter y el temple de las personas. Tenemos a Nao Kanzaki, ella es una joven la cual tiene una particularidad: es extremadamente honesta e ingenua. Esto lo digo porque llegó al punto de devolver dinero que se encontró en la calle tirado. Un día mientras estaba en su casa le llega una invitación a un juego, (Liar Game) o juego de los mentirosos el cual supuestamente es al azar pero de eso no tiene nada. Basicamente le entregaron 100 millones de yenes. El objetivo es tratar de quedarse con ese dinero mientras le roba el dinero a su oponente, porque claro, es un juego de parejas.  


![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23vsd9CZ3CoZzUuD6pnUgxJVgvqMH4MVSQx822QufUXmDA9TkvV5KZTV8fB2reg8pSfe2)


[Source!](https://www.polygon.com/netflix-squid-game-inspiration-liar-game-anime-review/)

---


![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/241thixdNYBKMx1DS6bKVVnUSfyQ3HPMq6q8VvEyyA2c2dkS9Gn4BWzhSB8PPM119N64x.jpg)


[Source!](https://us.oricon-group.com/news/8375/2/)

Being the way she is, a person without malice or ill will, she decides to seek help because she knows she can't survive on her own. One detail I forgot: there's a time limit for the test. If she fails and loses her money, the punishment will be to pay off the lost amount, which is 100 million yen. If she manages to steal it, she can keep it. Moving on. She can't do this game alone, so she looks for a con artist to help her, and that's where Shinichi Akiyama comes in, a guy who even served time in prison for his scamming. So, the two of them will try to make sure she doesn't lose her money. From what I can see, the whole anime will be about deception, betrayal, and a lot of psychological manipulation to achieve their goals. This is undoubtedly, and as I said, something very different from what's in the mainstream these days.

> Siendo ella como es, una persona que no tiene maldad ni malicia en su interior decide buscar ayuda porque sabe que por si sola no tiene vida. Un detalle que se me olvidaba: hay un tiempo límite para hacer la prueba, si ella falla y le quitan su dinero el castigo será tener la deuda del dinero que perdió, es decir, de 100 millones de yenes. Si los logra robar pues se los puede quedar. Seguimos. Este juego no lo puede hacer sola por lo que busca a un estafador para que la ayude y es acá donde aparece Shinichi Akiyama, un tipo que hasta preso estuvo por lo estafador que es. Entonces entre los dos se dispondrán a tratar de que ella no pierda su dinero. Por lo que veo todo el anime se tratará de engaños, traición y mucha manipulación a nivel psicológico para lograr los objetivos. Esto es sin dudas y como ya dije, algo muy diferente a lo que hay en el mainstream hoy en día. 

Having only watched two episodes, I have to say Nao drives me crazy. It's unbelievable that someone can be so naive and innocent. I understand those are virtues, but in the real world, you have to be a little shrewd and always view things with a healthy dose of skepticism because, yes, the world can be cruel. And she certainly suffers from that in these first few episodes. I thought I wouldn't like it, but it actually kept me entertained. This first part of the plot is peculiar; it features a detestable character whose suffering might be the main objective. The manga's genre includes mystery, suspense, and big plot twists; given the nature of the game, it's perfectly plausible that we'll see those things—it lends itself to that. I imagine the rest of the anime will be like this: test after test to bring out the best or worst in people. This formula works if they manage to make it entertaining.

> Con apenas dos capítulos vistos tengo que decir que me desespera Nao, no puede ser que alguien sea tan ingenuo e inocente, se entiende que son virtudes pero en el mundo real hay que tener cierta malicia y ver las cosas siempre con un poco de desconfianza porque si, el mundo puede ser malo. Y de hecho ella lo sufre en estos primeros capítulos. Pensé que no me iba a gustar pero la verdad es que me mantuvo entretenido, esta primera parte de la trama es peculiar, tiene un personaje detestable que verlo pasar miserias puede que sea el objetivo principal. El género del manga incluye el misterio, suspenso y grandes plot twist; dada la naturaleza del juego es perfectamente viable que veamos esas cosas, es algo que se presta para eso. Imagino que lo que resta de anime será así, pruebas tras pruebas para que las personas saquen lo mejor o lo peor de si. Esta fórmula funciona si logran hacerla entretenida. 


![4.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23tvtz5VKP3XUd1fG4wBu2CyeBQ8NEzuBPp8FvmRCkdVoRtUoByXtFuMvpFZ8Lbzrvwyd.webp)


[Source!](https://fandomwire.com/liar-game-episode-2-global-release-date-and-time-where-to-watch-more/)

---


![5.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23xVKT5u1WbpEGTqnM6MrWbhbMjDh9oby1xC9Mrobmj8o8xjHWyabfdZtUHinsiJphgtU.webp)


[Source!](https://fandomwire.com/liar-game-episode-2-review/)

As for the animation, it's one of those anime where it doesn't stand out because that's not the point. Everything is simple and everyday; you can clearly see Madhouse's signature style in the facial expressions and character designs, but that's about it. What's really important is how well it can capture people's attention without the action or the visual spectacle of fantasy. The plot will have to be truly immersive and captivating to keep fans hooked. As I said, I've only seen a couple of episodes and I'm still on board; in fact, episode 2 ends with a brutal cliffhanger. I hope it stays that way. Remember, there will be 24 episodes, so there's a lot to unpack. I'll leave the trailer below for you to check out; I think it might be worth watching.

> En cuanto a la animación pues decir que es de esos anime en donde no destaca porque no es lo importante. Todo es simple y cotidiano, claramente se nota el sello de Madhouse en las expresiones faciales y diseño de los personajes pero hasta ahí. Lo realmente importante es que tanto puede captar la atención de la gente sin la acción presente o la vistosidad de la fantasía. La trama va a tener que ser realmente inmersiva y atrapante para que logre que los fanáticos se queden. Como dije, solo he visto par de episodios y sigo en el barco, de hecho el capítulo 2 termina con un cliffhanger brutal. Espero que se mantenga así, recordar que serán 24 episodios por lo que hay mucha tela que cortar. Les dejo el tráiler por acá abajo para que le echen un ojo, creo que puede valer la pena. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EAUcBiCydRc

Well folks, that's all for today. I hope you enjoyed it.
¡Hugs to everyone, see you next time!

> Bueno mi gente por hoy es todo, espero que les haya gustado.
¡Un abrazo a todos, nos vemos en la próxima!

body.title: Building Tomorrow: My Purpose, My Progress, My Why
body.body:
***Right now in my life, my main reason for living is deeply rooted in my desire to build a better future. Every day, I wake up with a clear intention—to keep working on myself, to grow, and to move closer to the life I have always dreamed of. My purpose at this moment revolves around progress. It is not about instant success or overnight achievements, but about the continuous effort to improve my life in meaningful and lasting ways.***

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23wqgZi3mXzgnrkPzVqEUho4JejF6LYVhgrVVTBnAVKKDMxTMTuJ8n34ybssep2QoQrpG.jpg)

**I see my life now as a journey of preparation.**I am laying down the foundation for a future that is stable, secure, and fulfilling. Stability is something I value deeply because I have come to understand how important it is in creating peace of mind. It is not just about financial security, but also emotional and mental stability—the kind that allows me to live without constant worry and to fully enjoy the life I am building. Every task I complete, every responsibility I fulfill, and every challenge I overcome contribute to that sense of stability I am striving for.

**At the same time, growth plays a huge role in my purpose.** I believe that life is a continuous process of learning and becoming. I am committed to improving myself—not just in my career, but also in my character, my mindset, and my overall well-being. I want to become stronger, wiser, and more capable of handling whatever life brings. Growth, for me, is not always easy. There are moments of doubt, exhaustion, and even discouragement. But I have learned that these moments are part of the process. They shape me into the person I need to become for the future I am working toward.

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23uQkGEhgeLJnqHbqwm8GLFzZKkMLZ1rTzCzxDdAGKYkfkBsa7ibRrpo8ujeHcHC6BdPP.jpg)

What truly keeps me moving forward each day is the vision of the life I want to create with my partner, Arjay. He is not just part of my present, but also a big part of my future. The idea of building a family together gives my efforts a deeper meaning. It reminds me that everything I am doing now is not just for myself, but also for the life we will share. I imagine a home filled with love, understanding, and support—a place where we can both grow and achieve our dreams together. That vision inspires me to keep going, even on days when I feel tired or unmotivated.

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23wgKu2M9vtaZrDZ9CqvN7fMKK3ZUFQ2ddHVLGRLRLdBj2dUFKY2NQQ1X1YPEnrfoGBmY.jpg)

***There is something powerful about having a “why” in life. My “why” is simple but strong: I want a life that reflects my hard work, my dreams, and my love for the people who matter most to me. I want to look back one day and know that I did everything I could to create a better future—not just wishing for it, but actively working for it.***

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23x159oqygXxLuei8EUzcwyeMZR3XWGfgjtNGofxMDD5s5SQgLbc5G9hmzxJN2DRgnJ4h.jpg)

There are times when the journey feels slow. Progress does not always come in big, noticeable changes. Sometimes, it is found in small victories—in finishing a task, in learning something new, or in simply showing up even when I don’t feel like it. I have learned to appreciate these small steps because they are what make up the bigger picture. Each day may seem ordinary, but together, they are building something extraordinary.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23wMSCbYVAmAhceL7yoYfqYtUvTmW5xRL6tBddPVvszX6qk4DxjDp8Bz4oyMZbXqLibRN.jpg)

My purpose right now is not about having everything figured out. It is about trusting the process and believing that my efforts will lead me somewhere meaningful. It is about being patient with myself and recognizing that growth takes time. I remind myself that it is okay to move at my own pace, as long as I keep moving forward.

In this season of my life, I am focused on becoming the person who is ready for the future I dream of. A person who is responsible, resilient, and full of hope. A person who can provide, love deeply, and build a strong foundation for a family. This is what drives me every day.

***Ultimately, my reason for living is my progress. It is the commitment to keep improving, to keep dreaming, and to keep working toward a life of stability, growth, and love. And as long as I hold on to that purpose, I know that no matter how difficult the journey may be, I will continue to move forward—one step at a time, closer to the life I am meant to live.***

body.title: If digital ghosts were a thing...
body.body: > I've never been one to believe in ghosts. I think ghosts are just stories told to make people scared. The idea of a digital ghost sounds interesting though. I'm thinking it would appear on my computer and my phone. So it would be quite awkward to see a ghost while using my devices.

/> [Image Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/fantasy-spirit-nightmare-dream-2847724/) Before I go on to talk about digital ghosts let's talk about normal ghosts. I think ghosts are known for being visible to only a few persons. Sometimes they are not visible at all but one could fill their presence. I'm saying this from things I've probably watched and read. I've seen movies where ghosts move things. Sometimes they move things such that it appears that those objects are moving on their own to the normal human eyes. I think that's one of the scary things about ghosts in addition to the fact that they can hunt you almost everywhere you go. Now, speaking of digital ghosts, it would be really interesting to see. I think digital ghosts would have control and access over devices like computers or phones. So this means they could have access to your files, videos, and documents. Some of these things could be sensitive and that's the worrying part about it. I mean what if you turn on your laptop and it doesn't obey the command you give it. Maybe you're trying to open one software and another software opens. I think that's something a digital ghost can do. It would be worrying and concerning especially if perhaps it's the ghost of someone you know. I think the next step would be to find a way to cast it out. I'm thinking about ways a digital ghost could be taken out of a computer. Perhaps one way could be to flash the computer entirely. Maybe that could just wipe out everything in the system including the ghost and traces of it. That means I would lose my important documents in the process, but that's a price to pay. Maybe there could be some security system installed to prevent the ghost from re-occupying the computer. Be that as it may, while the digital ghost sounds fascinating, I wouldn't want one in any of my devices. My devices are mine and mine alone. I don't think I will be scared if I see a digital ghost. I would probably just freak out. But then it will be my mission to ensure that that ghost goes away. I know some people would get scared and never use their device again. They would probably destroy or burn it just so they can get rid of the digital ghost. But as someone who doesn't get worked up about ghosts, I think I'll find a way to get rid of the digital ghost without having to jeopardize my devices.

body.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro: Google Is in First Place and Now It Talks to You
body.body:
Being number one in an AI ranking is something that changes hands frequently. Models rise, fall, get overtaken. What draws attention to Gemini 2.5 Pro in April 2026 is not just that it sits at the top of the leaderboard — it's the margin by which it got there, and the new capabilities that came along with that advance.

## The Jump on the Leaderboard

LMArena is the most respected human benchmark in the industry: real people compare model responses without knowing which is which, and vote for the best. It's not just code. It's writing, reasoning, conversation, real-world usefulness.

Gemini 2.5 Pro climbed 24 Elo points on that platform and reached 1,470 — the highest number ever recorded. On WebDevArena, focused on web development, the jump was even larger: 35 points, also leading.

For context: climbing 10 Elo points is already considered significant. Climbing 24 and 35 at the same time is a clear signal that something changed in how the model processes and responds.

## Deep Think: Thinking Before Answering

The most technical addition is **Deep Think** mode, which uses new research techniques to make the model consider multiple hypotheses before arriving at an answer. Instead of going straight to the most likely conclusion, the model explores alternative paths and evaluates which one is most robust.

The practical result: on the 2025 USAMO benchmark — one of the most difficult math olympiad exams in the world — these results are today considered a reference point in the industry for mathematical reasoning models.

For tasks like legal analysis, business strategy, or solving problems with multiple variables, this ability to consider hypotheses before deciding makes a real difference.

## Now It Speaks — Literally

One of the most concrete additions in this update is native audio output. Gemini 2.5 Pro can now respond in voice directly and naturally, without needing a separate text-to-speech system.

This changes the user experience: instead of reading a long response, you can listen. For situations where your hands are occupied, or where the context is conversational — meetings, quick queries, accessibility — this is a real interface change.

## Project Mariner: Using the Computer on Your Behalf

Google also integrated **Project Mariner** capabilities into 2.5 Pro, which allows the model to interact with the computer like a human user: navigate pages, click on elements, fill out forms, execute tasks in graphical interfaces.

This places Gemini 2.5 Pro in the same territory as GPT-5.4 when it comes to agentic automation — the ability to not just say what to do, but do it.

## Control for Developers

For API users, Google added **thinking budgets**: a way to control how much reasoning processing the model uses per call. More reasoning means more precise responses, but also more time and cost. With thinking budgets, the developer defines the balance.

Access to the model is available via Google AI Studio and Vertex AI, with support for long contexts and deep reasoning.

## Sustainable Leadership?

The remaining question is whether Google will be able to maintain this position. The industry's track record shows that the number one changes frequently. Gemini 2.5 Pro reached the top with a convincing set of improvements — deeper reasoning, native audio, real automation, and a human score that doesn't lie. Now it's just a matter of how long before the next challenger appears.

For now, Google is in the lead. And that, in itself, is already news.

body.title: Financial Literacy Graduation Requirement For High School In Ontario, Canada
body.body: Hi. In this post, I cover this new financial literacy graduation requirement for high school students in the Ontario, Canada. This news is fairly recent on April 26, 2026 [according to CTV news](https://www.ctvnews.ca/ottawa/article/knowledge-is-power-ontario-to-require-grade-10-financial-literacy-test-for-graduation/). [Ontario Govt website source](https://www.ontario.ca/page/financial-literacy-education-schools) > Starting in the 2026–2027 school year, students who began Grade 9 in the 2025–2026 school year or later, must meet a financial literacy graduation requirement to earn their high school diploma. > Students will complete this requirement as part of their compulsory Grade 10 Career Studies course. The requirement consists of learning modules and test questions developed by TVO and provided to schools to administer. > The requirement assesses core financial literacy concepts from the Grades 1 to 9 curriculum and supports the Grade 10 Career Studies course. > To meet the requirement, students: > * have up to 2 attempts during the course > * must earn at least 70% on the modules > Once a student meets the graduation requirement, it will be recorded on their Ontario Student Transcript. > Results from the modules count for 5% of the student’s final grade in the Grade 10 Career Studies course.

>Image Source   ## Financial Literacy For Students Is Good --- Teaching young students the basics of finance is good. Topics can include: * Needs Versus Wants * Maslow's Hierarchy Of Needs * Calculating Taxes and Discounts * Unit Price & Which Is A Better Buy? * Budgeting * Foreign Exchange Basics & Exchanging Money * Cost of Living In Different Areas/Countries * Spending Versus Saving * Compound Interest * Stock Market Basics * Supply and Demand   These topics can be taught be young students in different grades. The topics may be included in math classes or in business classes.

>Image Source   ## How Would This Turn Out? --- This announcement from the Doug Ford Ontario government sounds nice and all but I do have my concerns. The Doug Ford Conservative government in Ontario did cut teacher jobs recently and did implement financial literacy and programming education for Ontario schools. The computer programming topics seemed a bit too rigorous as they wanted grade ones to learn programming. Young kids should learn how to read, write, speak and develop sentences before learning how to code. The already implemented financial literacy topics is kind of weird to me. In some grade seven math lessons, they have the students learning about compound interest. My issue with this is that a grade seven student may not know what an exponent is from math. Exponents are needed to learn how to calculate compound interest. I am interested to see what some of the questions would look like. Would the questions be fair? Would the selected topics be math heavy? Is the test online or on paper?

body.title: Escaping the Nightmare.
body.body: > Akito navigated a surreal, shaking world by walking across floating umbrellas to escape a giant version of Rinko. After returning to reality and breaking the spell connecting Rinko to the Hannya, he learned that the spirit had escaped. Rinko later contacted him via a telephone booth with vital information regarding the fog. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPsz2ini73CtW92qJN727FqdPasEPVSg9qftamGrySJYz/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQaDRqkWv4T66VLN8QLEowDZX8eKMG4JSJ9jFm4kdhASY/screenshot_2_.png) I kept following Rinko's trail through the surreal world, and it looked like this world was shaking me at its highest intensity. I watched the distorted landscape carefully, trying to keep my balance as the shadows danced across the shifting architecture of this nightmare realm. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS3QCVACHPgui5rnZaLqD3ZAPfVHQukZT5da8esGVZVnh/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmREFUv15GYvHbAweFEs1pfitTFWrSTuwsuhGqyHT7iPHy/screenshot_4_.png) I was seeing two portraits that looked real in the middle of the chaos, one with Rinko and the other one featuring an aggressive cat. I went through a portrait where a giant version of Rinko was waiting for me in the distance. Her scale was terrifying, she looked like a ghostly guardian watching my every move. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbR1CahHFBENvVVo2CkPiakBCbPxxHEnrrEG1qx7zuUEn/screenshot_5_.png) When I reached these unfinished stairs, the view ahead was truly breathtaking and unsettling. From what I could see, a giant version of Rinko was turning to the other side while there were hundreds of umbrellas floating around in the empty air. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSe6xiso5ZP4a5dcHxjAMnW1vi53V8CPCNW8uoXGfT11g/screenshot_6_.png) After checking around for any other possible route, I understood I had to use those umbrellas as a path below my foot to get to the other side where a ladder was waiting for me. It was a haunting sight, and I could see the giant version of Rinko right beside me while I was walking on those floating umbrellas. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVM8g1GXHicexJfJD1MQTNJa5jSLEz2pefBM7MHme8g3X/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRNfsW2iZmuNoKCpFAKu4V7dYEgvgsf5NLmLHyrLz9YUv/screenshot_8_.png) And at last, I reached the ladder which I used to get out of this surreal world and return to a stable reality. The climb felt long, but as I reached the top, the distorted colors of the void began to fade. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSdLCataSXfr3tAWnpeEqX6Zok8KvmzmYizCm5UFgi2Sh/screenshot_9_.png) Then I noticed Rinko was trying to hold the Hannya's influence at bay with the last of her strength. KK asked her to hold her back a little longer while we were reaching her. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSc9W9WjkUPrTEX6Vfifnwap43ne5QoGBT9r7xbBTcN9L/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU9dx1UMb6GqYYgfm9YBKCMWYCnjv2Sa1WD1qB7NZanpX/screenshot_11_.png) After reaching her, I had to try this spell breaker to separate Rinko from the Hannya. Then the whole frame became white with a blinding flash. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPuEWhLiu5awrx4tjoehcBMcXf5ZgFC9NHaPCW5d1BxiM/screenshot_12_.png) We were back outside, outside of that haunted building from where I had originally found the trail. But Rinko was not around so KK suggested we should find her immediately, sensing that her presence was still lingering somewhere nearby. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRP3BMcyxNfhtNCtokxGCgLQwgmiQ22cQ7eQDz8Gitaqb/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRy1h4tjkkV9oWQabFLp4qcvbeg4ZQzuM5roQLRvEyAeC/screenshot_14_.png) I started looking around and found the park where I broke the spell, and there was this spectral source left behind on the ground. body.title: [ESP/ENG]Hacia un mundo azul más inclusivo. Reflexión
body.body:
> El “mundo azul” simboliza el vasto espectro del autismo, una condición neurodivergente que no necesita cura, sino comprensión, aceptación y oportunidades reales. Mejorar este mundo no es una tarea paternalista hacia las personas autistas, sino un cambio de mirada colectiva que beneficia a toda la sociedad. Para lograrlo, se requieren acciones concretas en varios frentes.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCQBLW5PRrfeP4aKzuWpSnFYvgfKJHA31Vpe6Xp8WFfX/661059704_122295414848016375_7368381494840665552_n.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/AutismoObregon/posts/el-mes-del-autismo-en-abril-de-2026-con-el-d%C3%ADa-mundial-de-concienciaci%C3%B3n-el-2-de/122295414842016375/) Primero: reconocimiento auténtico. Dejemos de lado los estereotipos del “niño genio aislado” o la “persona sin empatía”. El autismo se manifiesta de formas únicas en cada individuo. El reconocimiento implica escuchar a las voces autistas —especialmente a mujeres, adultos mayores y personas con alta necesidad de apoyo—, incorporarlas en investigaciones, políticas y medios de comunicación. También significa formar a profesionales de salud y educación en enfoques no patologizantes, que respeten las diferencias sensoriales y comunicativas. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQhNkgVduui3YqSh6vrTkvD2Z9ZUybAtsPCs48VpjCCv5/662911248_1539757267901419_5820532859285950812_n.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=1539757257901420&set=hoy-2-de-abril-d%C3%ADa-mundial-de-concienciaci%C3%B3n-sobre-el-autismo-en-2026-el-lema-no) Segundo: vida saludable sin coerciones. Una vida saludable para personas autistas no puede imponerse desde parámetros neurotípicos. Significa entornos sensorialmente amigables (sin luces fluorescentes parpadeantes, sin ruidos abruptos), acceso a terapias basadas en evidencia y respeto a la autonomía (rechazando prácticas como el uso de descargas eléctricas o contenciones mecánicas). La salud integral incluye también atención a comorbilididades frecuentes —ansiedad, epilepsia, trastornos digestivos— con profesionales que no atribuyan todo malestar al “simple hecho de ser autista”. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcM9a1EqPT3FR6D66Db3W3MdAjpZ22HGeuKnddRQHb7un/657949921_1539746174569195_6844995965288401997_n.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=1539746167902529&set=hoy-2-de-abril-d%C3%ADa-mundial-de-concienciaci%C3%B3n-sobre-el-autismo-en-2026-el-lema-no) Tercero: aceptación y respeto en lo cotidiano. La aceptación no es tolerancia pasiva, sino integración activa. En educación: ajustes razonables como tiempo extra en exámenes, materiales visuales o evitar trabajos en grupo forzados. En empleo: empresas que adapten entrevistas (por ejemplo, ofreciendo preguntas por escrito) y que valoren la concentración profunda, la honestidad o la memoria sistemática que muchas personas autistas poseen. En comunidad: transportes con horarios predecibles, cines con funciones de menor estímulo, y vecinos que entiendan que una crisis sensorial no es una rabieta. Otros elementos clave: La detección temprana financiada por sistemas de salud públicos, el respeto al lenguaje de cada quien (algunos prefieren “persona con autismo”, otros “autista” o “neurodivergente”), y el combate a discursos que vinculan autismo con violencia (un mito dañino). También urge pensar en la interseccionalidad: una mujer autista, migrante o afrodescendiente enfrenta barreras multiplicadas. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU8uxtRD5eow6ieEbZjxXE7m71fqmECznwqBEDjpyabzu/661152148_1397840622360692_4415922960449489382_n.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1397840612360693&set=a.405082914969806&id=100064043022107) Mejorar el mundo azul es construir entornos flexibles donde el silencio, la ecolalia o el movimiento repetitivo no sean castigados sino comprendidos. No se trata de que las personas autistas “se esfuercen más” por parecerse a los demás, sino de que la sociedad ensanche su definición de lo normal. Como dijo la neurocientífica autista Temple Grandin: “El mundo necesita diferentes clases de mentes”. Actuemos hoy: escuchemos, adaptemos, incluyamos. El color azul no es tristeza; es la profundidad de un océano de diversidad humana esperando ser respetado. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP1VSabPs1EqGAuydsgVRMArc5pGBL7zhcVSdghXTdFmS/661158027_1539746021235877_5892493780463538977_n.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=1539746007902545&set=hoy-2-de-abril-d%C3%ADa-mundial-de-concienciaci%C3%B3n-sobre-el-autismo-en-2026-el-lema-no) Un comentario final Termina abril, pero, no podemos darnos el lujo de dejar de luchar por materializar las acciones que nos permitan hacer que el azul forme parte activa del arcoiris que colorea nuestras vidas. La lucha por hacer que el respeto, la inclusión, la igualdad de derechos y oportunidades, el respeto a la integridad y la valoración de todos los seres humanos por igual sea algo que nos distinga debe ser nuestra máxima de manera permanente y, eso significa que cada mes del año sea un abril en nuestros calendarios. Nota: He utilizado el traductor DeepL Translate. ENGLISH The “blue world” symbolizes the vast spectrum of autism, a neurodivergent condition that does not need a cure, but rather understanding, acceptance and real opportunities. Improving this world is not a paternalistic task towards autistic people, but rather a change of collective outlook that benefits the entire society. To achieve this, concrete actions are required on several fronts. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCQBLW5PRrfeP4aKzuWpSnFYvgfKJHA31Vpe6Xp8WFfX/661059704_122295414848016375_7368381494840665552_n.jpg)[source](https:/ /www.facebook.com/AutismoObregon/posts/el-mes-del-autismo-en-abril-de-2026-con-el-d%C3%ADa-mundial-de-concienciaci%C3%B3n-el-2-de/122295414842016375/) First: authentic recognition. Let's put aside the stereotypes of the “isolated genius child” or the “person without empathy.” Autism manifests in unique ways in each individual. Recognition involves listening to autistic voices—especially women, older adults, and people with high support needs—and incorporating them into research, policy, and the media. It also means training health and education professionals in non-pathologizing approaches that respect sensory and communicative differences. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQhNkgVduui3YqSh6vrTkvD2Z9ZUybAtsPCs48VpjCCv5/662911248_1539757267901419_5820532859285950812_n.jpg)[source](http s://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=1539757257901420&set=hoy-2-de-abril-d%C3%ADa-mundial-de-concienciaci%C3%B3n-sobre-el-autismo-en-2026-el-lema-no) Second: healthy life without coercion. A healthy life for autistic people cannot be imposed from neurotypical parameters. It means sensory-friendly environments (no flickering fluorescent lights, no abrupt noises), access to evidence-based therapies, and respect for autonomy (rejecting practices such as the use of electric shocks or mechanical restraints). Comprehensive health also includes attention to common comorbidities—anxiety, epilepsy, digestive disorders—with professionals who do not attribute all discomfort to “the simple fact of being autistic.” ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcM9a1EqPT3FR6D66Db3W3MdAjpZ22HGeuKnddRQHb7un/657949921_1539746174569195_6844995965288401997_n.jpg)[source](http s://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=1539746167902529&set=hoy-2-de-abril-d%C3%ADa-mundial-de-concienciaci%C3%B3n-sobre-el-autismo-en-2026-el-lema-no) Third: acceptance and respect in everyday life. Acceptance is not passive tolerance, but active integration. In education: reasonable adjustments such as extra time on exams, visual materials or avoiding forced group work. In employment: companies that adapt interviews (for example, by offering written questions) and that value the deep concentration, honesty or systematic memory that many autistic people possess. In community: transportation with predictable schedules, movie theaters with less stimulating shows, and neighbors who understand that a sensory crisis is not a tantrum. Other key elements: Early detection funded by public health systems, respect for each person's language (some prefer “person with autism”, others “autistic” or “neurodivergent”), and the fight against discourses that link autism with violence (a harmful myth). It is also urgent to think about intersectionality: an autistic, migrant or Afro-descendant woman faces multiplied barriers. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU8uxtRD5eow6ieEbZjxXE7m71fqmECznwqBEDjpyabzu/661152148_1397840622360692_44159229604494 89382_n.jpg)[source](https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1397840612360693&set=a.405082914969806&id=100064043022107) Improving the blue world is building flexible environments where silence, echolalia or repetitive movement are not punished but understood. It is not about autistic people “trying harder” to look like others, but about society broadening its definition of what is normal. As autistic neuroscientist Temple Grandin said, “The world needs different kinds of minds.” Let's act today: listen, adapt, include. The color blue is not sadness; It is the depth of an ocean of human diversity waiting to be respected. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP1VSabPs1EqGAuydsgVRMArc5pGBL7zhcVSdghXTdFmS/661158027_1539746021235877_5892493780463538977_n.jpg)[source](http s://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=1539746007902545&set=hoy-2-de-abril-d%C3%ADa-mundial-de-concienciaci%C3%B3n-sobre-el-autismo-en-2026-el-lema-no) A final comment April is ending, but we cannot afford to stop fighting to materialize the actions that allow us to make blue an active part of the rainbow that colors our lives. The fight to make respect, inclusion, equal rights and opportunities, respect for the integrity and appreciation of all human beings equally something that distinguishes us must be our permanent maxim and that means that every month of the year is an April on our calendars. Note: I have used the DeepL Translate translator.

body.title: The Rise of Short Yacht Charters in Monaco
body.body:
Short-format yacht experiences are becoming an increasingly important segment of the luxury travel market, and Monaco is particularly well positioned to benefit from this trend. The continued growth in demand for [yacht charter Monaco](https://neoyachting.com/destination/mediterranean/french-riviera/monaco/) highlights a shift toward more flexible, experience-driven travel, where guests prioritize quality over duration.

Many visitors to Monaco stay for only a limited period, often combining business, leisure, and social engagements. In this context, a half-day or full-day yacht charter provides an efficient way to experience the Riviera from a different perspective. Within just a few hours, guests can cruise along the coastline, anchor in quiet bays, swim in clear waters, and enjoy meals on board.

Monaco’s geography makes these short charters especially practical. Departures from Port Hercule or Fontvieille allow quick access to nearby coastal highlights without requiring long cruising times. Guests can explore areas such as Cap d’Ail or Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat and return the same day, making it easy to combine time at sea with activities on land.

This format is also highly popular for private events. Yachts offer an exclusive setting for celebrations such as birthdays, proposals, anniversaries, and corporate gatherings. The privacy and personalization of the experience create a more refined alternative to traditional venues.

Another important factor is accessibility. Short charters allow first-time clients to discover the yachting lifestyle without committing to a longer itinerary. They provide a clear introduction to onboard service, comfort, and atmosphere in a manageable format.

As travel preferences continue to evolve, short yacht charters are expected to play an increasingly important role in luxury tourism. Monaco, with its infrastructure, location, and reputation, remains one of the leading destinations for this type of experience.

body.title: Probably one of the biggest deal in my life
body.body:
A couple of days ago, I have a friend sharing with me regarding his insurance investment has matured. It was supposed to be a education fund he invested years ago, to prepared for the children to use during the university. However, things slightly behind his plan as the kid's exam wasn't good enough, hence the next level will have to wait.

Since there's a stash of cash, he's looking for something useful with low risk and slightly better return than hoping the bank to pay him annual interest rate at least than 3%. So, what's left behind is government bond, but people like us is hardly accessible to those kind of big fat profitable portfolio. Or, he can go for trust fund.

I thought of, maybe I can introduce this friend to Hive. Since the bank require a full year lock, he's not getting his money back by the time his children required money to go for the Uni, might as well do a short term investment in HBD savings. I do understand there may be transactional costs, but a full 14% APR can be very attractive and 3 days lock is just way beyond comprehension for people whom doesn't have any idea of how crypto verse works.

So I went to the wallet, wanting to take a screenshot of 14% APR and planning to share with this person. If he doesn't want to risk more, at least he can invest a small portion and let it grow from here. I do have some resentment towards the adjustment from 20% down to 15, and then subsequently 14% APR, but who am I to question?

What set off this bomb was the moment I click on my wallet, I realized the screen capture I was looking for, is not what I thought. The current APR shrunk to merely 12%. Frankly, if you ask someone to invest their rock hard cash into USDT or BTC, and from there to transact into Hive, and subsequently change back to HBD, I would have safely guess the fee or commission involved can easily take away 2 or 3% of the entire fund. And imagine after 9 months, the fund owner probably earned like 9% from the stake, and need to reverse the entire investment back to fiat currency, that takes away another 2-3%? Once again, this new 2-3% if including the profit.

I really can't see a point to introduce HBD as an investment to my friend anymore. The cost of buying in and out is too high, and the risk of WHAT IF is also extremely high. I can't afford to risk my reputation, or probably my freedom for trying to help a friend on his investment. And if anything goes wrong, come on those are educational fund for his children. So in the end, I told him he should just stick it to bank fixed deposit, maybe find some of those short term deposits like 3-6 months. 

---

Anyway, here's where my personal financial interest takes place. I couldn't sleep all night. I thought to myself, since I'm actively involving in communities, I'm still getting paid via blogging. Why do I still need to use my HBD to \

the APR? Moreover, it's only 12% now. So many of W3 initiative offers way above 20%, hence I don't see a reason why would we continue to burden Hive ecosystem.

**Paid with #ecency point to generate this AI photo**

3 days ago, I decided it's time. So I started the withdrawal process, without even looking at how many days before my next payout.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYzkhbDSjE2nqui1pMNRhahQ7NM4uZjhJVTVgFr7DrUeb/image.png)

This is probably one of the biggest Hive transaction I've ever done. You are free to take a look at my current stake. This single transaction of buying in 55k Hive, I think I can never see anything so crazy in my life 🤣

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ2dUvjT6UymTmb2oiph5pm3GV27xCSEry5PDKjAQcGqX/image.png)

What are my plans? I'm crazy. I have already planned to hit 60k in 2026, since now I have achieved my target, I would like to adjust my next target to be 100k. What about the rest? Probably let them stuck in the savings for safety purpose. It's not a lot, but I am hoping if one day Hive decided to revisit the moon, I will have some 10 to 15k in hand, just to make my life slightly easier.

body.title: Stiff Reality, Soft Myths: WOO Exposes the Truth About Impact
body.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

Going into this episode, I expected stories. Maybe some backstage insight. Maybe a bit of humour here and there. What I didn’t expect was how much this breakdown would change the way I think about physical impact in wrestling. There’s always been this ongoing debate among fans about how “real” wrestling is, but Saturn doesn’t dance around that topic at all. He gives it to you straight, and in doing so, he kind of shatters a few illusions along the way.

Because when he talks about Goldberg’s strikes, especially that spinning kick, you can tell this wasn’t just performance. This was physical. This was painful. And this was something you had to endure if you were standing across from him.

>*Watch WOO's very own Perry Saturn and his latest \
video over at [THIS LINK](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vStGgwstymQ). The theme for this latest video production is \

*

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23u5bbWQp43ESesJ3VXzS9CwSfQtDub6mK3Q49uRpGNerUMYTPLnZKenZVdthuHWDqLUz.png)

---

### The Truth About In-Ring Impact

* **Goldberg’s offense was legitimately stiff and hard to absorb.**
  
Saturn describes Goldberg’s kicks as some of the stiffest strikes he’s ever taken, and that says a lot considering the era he came from. This wasn’t light contact or controlled tapping. These were hits that you felt immediately, and probably long after the match ended. As a fan, it really shifts how I view those explosive moments in the ring.

* **There’s a fine balance between realism and safety.**
  
One thing that stood out to me is how Saturn talks about Goldberg wanting to be hit harder than necessary at times. That mindset might add realism to a match, but it also increases the risk. It’s a delicate balance, and this episode highlights just how difficult it is to maintain.

* **Not every “hit” in wrestling is created equal.**
  
Watching matches, it’s easy to assume that everything is more or less the same in terms of impact. But Saturn makes it clear that some moves hit differently. Some hurt more. Some are genuinely dangerous if not executed properly.

* **Experience plays a role in managing physical intensity.**
  
Saturn’s ability to handle those stiff strikes and keep the match going shows just how important experience is. A less seasoned wrestler might not have been able to adapt as effectively.

* **Pain is part of the performance, whether fans realise it or not.**
  
This might be the biggest takeaway for me. Wrestling isn’t just about pretending. There’s a real physical cost involved, and this episode doesn’t try to hide that.

### Rounding up the points I've made so far...

As a WOO fan, I think this kind of honesty is what makes the content stand out. It doesn’t try to maintain the illusion at all costs. Instead, it respects the audience enough to show the reality behind it.

And for me, that actually makes wrestling more impressive, not less. Because now, when I watch those matches, I’m not just seeing moves. I’m seeing effort, risk, and resilience.

---

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

body.title: My Daily Walks, My Quiet Therapy.
body.body:
Hello Community...

I do not think I ever really sat down one day and said, okay from today I will start reflecting on my life, It just of happened naturally, these days I will say I reflect every single day and funny enough it mostly happens during my walks my daily walks.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb1RiMdvcsix7MMgSTQc8CQGJ2gLThN8stYMxVUBZdfnH/1777382203508.jpg)


I try to hit like 10k steps daily, so I am always outside moving around, and that has quietly become my thinking time, no pressure, no overplanning, just me walking and letting my mind wander, sometimes I play music, sometimes I do not but even when I do, I have noticed something, I actually think more than I listen, like the music is just there in the background, but my mind is busy going through everything, life, decisions, random memories, even things I didn’t know were bothering me, and honestly, that alone has helped me a lot, There is something about removing yourself from noise and just being with your thoughts, youu start to understand yourself better, you notice patterns, like how you react to certain situations, or why something annoyed you more than it should have, It is like you are having a quiet conversation with yourself without even trying too hard.

I have been doing this walking and reflecting thing for over a year now, and recently I even started tracking it with Actifit, which somehow makes it feel more intentional, before, it was just  i am going for a walk, but now it is like I am actually aware that this is part of my routine, not just physically, but mentally too.





Meditation, on the other hand,  yeah, that one is still a work in progress, i only started like 2 or 3 months ago, and I won’t lie, it hasn’t been easy to stay consistent, sitting still, trying to clear your mind, or even just focus on your breathing sounds simple, but when you actually try it, your brain suddenly wants to think about everything at once. Random memories, things you forgot to do, even what you’ll eat later, everything just shows up.

The longest I have been able to go is like 10 to 15 minutes, and even that feels like a struggle sometimes, there are days I skip it completely, and days I start and just give up halfway, but I think that is part of the process, it is not something you just master overnight.



Still, I can’t ignore the little benefits I have noticed, on the days I actually sit down and do it properly, I feel a bit calmer,  bot like life suddenly becomes perfect, but there is this small sense of control, like my mind isn’t running all over the place as much as usual, so I am going to take this as a sign to get back into meditation and reflection, I think meditation and reflection for 5 to 10 minutes every day is better than doing it for 15 minutes one day and then not doing it again for a while.

I think meditation and reflection are things that I really want to keep doing, the walks are really important to me. I like going for walks and I do not want to stop doing that, meditation and reflection are also important, to me. I want to keep doing them.


I like going for walks because it is one of the few times I get to be alone with my thoughts, without anything bothering me, I get to think about things without any distractions.


In a world where everything is constantly trying to get my attention I think having some quiet time is really valuable.

Reflection and meditation are things that I believe are very useful, i think people should try to make time for them.

I’m not perfect with it yet, but I am getting there, one step, and one thought at a time.


[Image Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-person-standing-on-top-of-a-sand-dune-OCKa0AkSyRc)

body.title: Hive is finally where it should be - Hear me out
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmefzPZn4QqpoEVidB9GR18CnEg2mGGCsfV2ZYVrekmyBF/img_2913.png)


This post is going to come across as complete copium or a useful reframe, depending on how you want to read it. As far as I am concerned, it’s whatever more of us decide it is. 

After 9 years here (damn!), I think I’ve finally found a sweet spot. I am no longer dreaming of crypto solving all my problems or all the world’s problems, nor am I dismissive of what it’s actually done for me and the world. 

I recognize all tht bitcoin and Hive have done for me and I am thankful and I hope to stay involved in the future too. 

At the same time I’ve come to terms with the fact that my IRL friends and most of the people I have art and culture exchange and other interests in common with will never understand and they are important to me too.  

For my first 5 or 6 years here I neglected them because this place seemed to promise a future brighter than any other that I was able to see in the job market. 

If crypto or bitcoin does become as world shattering as the internet or AI though, it will take a lot longer than both of them and hardly be recognized for most of the impact it ends up having. 

People have short attention spans and recency bias. We have a tolerence for risk and unless it’s stupidly high, we tend to fold at some point. 

Also when money is at the center of it, so is the bullshit because people want to extract what they can. 

I don’t think I will ever fold completely, but I am quite comfortable treating this like the side hustle and online community it has naturally become instead of some moon shot dream of a semi-utopian future. 

I always knew others took it too far not hedging their bets and believing with full certainty that this was meant to be. It turns out I had taken it too far with my emotional attachment.  

Slowly I’ve come to find this sweet spot where I am involved, and invested, but still prioritizing my work and projects that allow me to meet people face to face and isn’t so influenced by markets in that knee jerk reaction kind of way. 

I am fighting an urge to censor myself here becuase when people build their lives on sand they panic easily and they carch FOMO and FUD very easily. I don’t want to contribute to the FUD, nor do I want to controbute the FOMO. 

I want to acknowledge things for what they are, and take the good and try to change the bad if I can, and protect myself from it if I can’t. 

It turns out diamond hands weren’t all they were made out to be. Someone is left holding the bags and it turned out to be me, and probably you too if you are reading this.  

Luckily I took some profits this past bull market, for the first time ever.  Luckily I got out of all alts besides Hive and Hive related projects, things that I was not connected to and that were complete gambling for me. 

At least with Hive, the tokens do something within the ecosystem.  Even if they become worthless in terms of fiat and bitcoin, they still have a function in this ecosystem and there is always some chance the price improves some day of we keep using it and projects stick around. 

I am not to saying you should sell, especially at these prices, but I’ve decided I need to start thinking about the present instead of a future that I don’t know for sure will come. 

I am not quiting. 

I am not selling everything. 

But I am taking the worst case scenario a lot more seriously now. 

I think this could be exactly what this community needs. If we are being honest with ourselves $0.50 was unsustainable considering our numbers, even when they were at their highest. $0.25 was overpriced when it was $0.25, hype aside. 

Yes, we had a valuable product. 

Yes we had promise. 

And yes, considering the best case scenario of crypto going mainstream and regulation being minimal and us making all the right decision and the right people finding us, $1 is way too low. 

But get rid of the hype and the “what-ifs” and we are now approaching a valuation that reflects what we are actually working with. 

Governments aren’t going to fold to the will of crypto maxis overnight. Inflation will flow into things people trust and that currently is not us. We have a few weak points and contentious aspects that are really hard to sell people on. AI is making it hard to tell what’s even real. 

And most importantly, there is so much noise out there, getting people to hear you AND believe you is not a given. It would be the exception if it happened, not the rule. 

But….

This may sound like cliche but it’s insanely relevent to us now, when you hit rock bottom, there’s no where left to go but up. 

We may have hit rock bottom or may still have a bit more pain to go with regards to price, but the real pain is us accepting that Hive isn’t going to solve all of our problems.  That doesn’t mean it’s useless or that it couldn’t go on to become all that one day, however unlikely. 

I am not going to say we need to double down and keep building although I fully support that sentiment.   I don’t have the right to say such things though. I am already too invested in my music and the Japan art scene to do much more than I am doing here now, and I don’t see any overlap between my online life and my offline at the monent, at least given all I’ve tried in the past. 

What I will do is stick around and do my small part to keep this place active and alive. 

I will not sell all my Hive at such low prices, even if I do end up selling a little to make my life easier when I need the money. 

I will share the opinions I was too scared to share clearly and directly before because if anyone listens to them, I believe they may help this place survive. 

I will spread a proactive but realistic mindset that keeps us from burning out and/or overinvesting, but also prevents the protocol from compeltey dying or spiraling out.  

I will keep whatever relationships I have alive and introduce Hive to anyone who seems like they may be looking for such a place, and maybe with a focus on **the right people** instead of everyone, and without the unrealistic hype and suspicious cult-like promises of a new decentralized world, they may be more likely to stick around. 

I will treat Hive as what it always was and introduce it as such. A cool place to connect with strangers and experiment with ideas and interact with an alternate economy with different rules and culture, and a place where earnings are possible but not gauranteed. 

Let’s be realistic here:

When I first joined this community in May 2017, I had no hope of it leading to anything.  It looked like a scam to me but I was mostly hoping to find a place to share my fiction and if I could convert anyone into a reader then I was satsfied. 

I found a handful. And I found friends who I still talk to 9 years later. And I earned a bit. And found my creative voice. And I learned how markets worked. And I learned a lot more about South America and Africa and SE Asia. And I learned a whole lot about how the world and money and power and decision making and community building works. 

I inspired people and I was inspired by people. 

There’s no need any of that needs to end, even if it ends up becoming a little less central to my future plans.  Maybe without any illusions, and with those of us who stick around having already faced our FOMO and FUD, we will be able to build something closer to what we hoped to build all along.

body.body: 1/5 🧵 \nNYC has a $7.1B hole, and the proposed fix here isn’t real austerity — it’s delay now, pay more later. The core argument is simple: pushing pension payments into the 2040s may ease today’s budget pain, but it’s the same kind of fiscal sleight of hand that helped drive New York to the edge in the 1970s.

body.body: 2/5 🧵 \nThe article says Mayor Mamdani wants to defer about **$1 billion** in required pension contributions even though the city is still technically on track to meet its long-term pension obligations by **2032**. That matters because pension funding isn’t optional theater — retirees still get paid, and taxpayers are ultimately on the hook if the fund weakens.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 \nWhy the alarm? Because delayed pension payments don’t erase costs — they compound them. The piece argues this makes the pension system less financially sound in the near term while shifting a bigger burden onto future budgets. In plain English: today’s politicians get breathing room, tomorrow’s taxpayers get the bill, with interest. That’s not budgeting; that’s hiding the tab under the couch.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 \nThe editorial leans hard on New York history. Its warning is that City Hall spent years using gimmicks — spending beyond recurring revenue and papering over the gap — until the city nearly went broke in the 1970s. The comparison is the whole point of the piece: once governments normalize “just defer it,” they create the exact conditions that make structural problems worse, not better.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 
It also argues there are still places to cut before touching pensions. The piece points to a **$127B** budget, a promised **$1.7B** in agency savings, possible relief if Albany delays the class-size mandate (**$1.4B**), and lower housing voucher costs (**$1.3B**) as better starting points — even if some of those are uncertain. Bottom line: the editorial sees pension deferral as a dangerous gimmick, not a solution. 📎 Source

body.body:
Усім привіт.
Попри холод в саду вже повно яскравих барв весняних квітів. Зокрема, і геллеборуса. І як би ми не називали цю неймовірну, першу квітучу навесні в саду рослину,  — черемник чи морозник, — її цвіт заворожує до глибини душі. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR5NkzVfCeJ9xiCcwBqgJx3nwhPBn46kYtTZuZyn5w3DZ/1777380711153.jpg)

На цьому найстаршому з усіх у моїй колекції кущів черемників можна простежити всі фази цвітіння: від нерозкритого бутона-пуп’яночки, легкого розкриття квітки, її найповнішого цвіту й до скидання насіння. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma4b3bo9ADoMgfUHyYE3WR2NfUqPzdJiEjJdkL7STH6Ey/1777380734963.jpg)

Я просто обожнюю цю рослину! Маю 10 різних сортів черемників, але саме цей цьогоріч цвіте найрясніше.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmexSMsczEKeKq2dCyaup4KF5gjxayCqbMKGoiKNHpWrfM/1777380755028.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPThyUjUR6JzoteVDcZp3yem9WoUfsAbJGBHWFaTSWcx8/1777380755269.jpg)

Погляньте на цю красу!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZqVkFNH25B4TY4GJxPp13jCFN7Jdrvf7m1LDsjrmhNpp/1777380775658.jpg)

Морозник, як здебільшого  геллеборус називають в народі, може рости і в тіні, і на сонці, і навіть в глибокій тіні, як-от цей, наприклад. І це додає йому ще більшої чарівності. Щоранку, перед тим як їхати на роботу, обов'язково вибігаю на пару хвилин в сад, аби до кожного кущика заглянути і «привітатися». Бо це дає мені емоційний заряд на весь день. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcsnjstTpMz1awuFwSRc6H7Hmc55GhYAsvPVTFxt4N96S/1777380790630.jpg)

А що вам у ці прохолодні квітневі дні піднімає настій і дарує натхнення?

Дякую за увагу. До зустрічі!

body.body: 1/5 🧵 ESPN turned a kid’s draft-night dream into a scouting jab on live TV — and Michael Irvin called it “classless.” That’s the whole fight: should the moment be celebration first, or brutal honesty first?
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 Irvin’s anger was aimed at ESPN flashing Rueben Bain Jr.’s arm length graphic as Bain walked to the stage after Tampa Bay took him at No. 15. The stat highlighted that Bain had the shortest arms of any first-round edge rusher since 2003 — basically, the network chose a weakness for the biggest walk of his life instead of a highlight reel stat.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 Bain’s draft story makes that hit sharper. On production, he earned first-round status: 9.5 sacks at Miami and ACC Defensive Player of the Year. But the NFL drafts on projection, not just college dominance, and sub-33-inch arms are a legit concern for edge rushers because they can affect separation, leverage, and finishing at the pro level.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 That’s where the article lands in the gray area. Irvin thinks ESPN should’ve focused on Bain’s positives in a once-in-a-lifetime family moment. The counterpoint is that the arm-length issue materially affected Bain’s stock, so ignoring it would’ve sanitized the scouting reality. Crude? Maybe. Irrelevant? Not really.

body.title: The Greek Isles: Rhodes
body.body:
![explore Rhodes.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/Eq5Cz2LtZGAq1RxgL64cqMyrEbeVQafqVThigPhzKY9HGXSBcJj5jSnQTvQZEWF8Dmy.JPG)

*Elli Beach Diving Boards*

The morning after our visit to Kos we arrived at another island namely the Island of Rhodes. Rhodes is the largest island in the group of Dodecanese Islands so we knew that we would not be seeing everything in the one day that the cruise allowed us. 

![20240711_052448802_iOS.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/244xqP3TEKbeNY6Sc5rjNaja9vZ1aZf9GKa9fdGqfJgMkLUXWmq1EofLgByEQFSyeQgMw.jpeg)
*Panoramic view of Rhodes Medieval City*

What I love about the cruises is that it gives one a glimpse into many cities in one trip, and this glimpse opens the door to future trips where my husband and I can continue to explore the places that we really would like to go back to.  

Some of the places have been tourist traps, while others have been incredible experiences, most of which have taken place as we explored on our own and not on the pre-organised ship tours.  I have learnt to investigate and then do the specific things that we prefer.

![Screenshot 2026-04-28 at 14.08.30.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/23xyWzrZZb94MaUUGGfJuwjvQMWABJoipUfP4rQNPWyPE4f9dMYnqGUFZ52d7aoLcAFHf.png)
*View from the ship of the hop-on-hop-off location*

Well, on Rhodes there was a **Hop-on-hop-off bus** stop just outside the Cruise Terminal. If this is ever an option then go for it! We have found that these tours are far cheaper than the ship tours and they go to all of the top sights of any given city. And if you happen to have a day where you don’t feel like walking then one can just sit on the bus and enjoy the round trip while you take in the views.

We got our tickets and hopped on the first available bus with an open top. The bus stop and cruise port were on the very edge of the Medieval Old city but we would come back to this much later in the day.

## ACROPOLIS OF RHODES
![Screenshot 2026-04-28 at 14.17.48.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/243MDcQEbJMzaffkqZCKs1UQtThzoFS5VvyFtMyB6KYLy1VZaZNU133714wVNXqPidZpc.png)
First the bus drove us through the leafy old suburbs along the boundary of the Old city. The bus wound up the narrow streets towards the summit of the hill where we were able to stop and visit the Acropolis of Rhodes. Unfortunately many of the structures were shrouded in scaffolding as the ruins are constantly under restoration. The acropolis is home to an amphitheatre and stadium and worth a walk through. Entry is free to visitors.

![Screenshot 2026-04-28 at 14.25.13.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/23wgN8iyTyiuwe9U3TWCwV7AiUVUr7YHF4w8KGUFe7Z8EbjNvfvgnj9ZRQ7tA6cTJN6Ry.jpg)

Next the bus began to descend. The views from this spot down towards the ocean were spectacular with the larger area of Rhodes below us with its bustling stoney beaches and busy hotels along the waterfront. 

## ELLI BEACH
![Screenshot 2026-04-28 at 14.26.47.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/23yJJcv6fP6agpwCi3mfjbGXCy1h8CuqqBmz54LpU4Mm8egirJj4VXFfsmwPUhEbuLDu6.png)

We decided to hop off at Elli Beach. The beach was pebbled with small stones so I would recommend wearing a pear of beach shoes to enter and exit the water. We laid out of towels and quickly went for a dip in the warm water. There were’t any waves but a small swell bobbed us up and down as it rolled in. 

![Screenshot 2026-04-28 at 14.29.38.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/243WMkmEHtCshSiCZDbrQhX1GMXL548YqdpagvME3yiBa8HCpmBevAk1MchPFSN3Gn12q.png)

## DIVING BOARDS
We had noticed an off-shore diving board which was fully being taken advantage of by many folk. Some dived or jumped from the lower diving board (this would be me if I had the guts) while others made their way to the highest diving board, roughly 25 feet high and plummeted into the crystal blue sea far below. 

![20240711_080915299_iOS.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/23zkgGF43NdnyNzC2ouqnoEo2YL89oecwYHWtKKJ1fUWV2JXtQ4FZ4N9HytwMg8a8NXCQ.jpg)

The diving boards were built between 1936 and 1938 and still loved by foreigners and locals alike.

If jumping from heights isn’t your thing then you can always grab a lounger and umbrella for around four euro. We weren’t planning on hanging around and still had a lot to explore so we simply put down our towels on the pebbles and swam to our hearts content.

## PAVING

![Screenshot 2026-04-28 at 14.34.57.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/23w2sLzC7FeA7RD58RT1hB7PkgXxpKAJfiMG4T8Bca5ruBi2L1NByCMThL6zx5ahs7Xtc.png)

With millions of pebbles at their disposal it is easy to see why they have been used to pave so many walkways and paths in Rhodes. This is just 1 example in front of the Casino on the beach front. The next photo shows the walkway in the ancient city.


![Screenshot 2026-04-28 at 14.39.04.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/23yJEPcEQtvUSXPUhrQow7CUPsmL9DTRV8A7URk9FS5Xd1gqKzEqWMVm2JGPQ1hP58SbM.png) 

We had decided to walk from Elli Beach towards the Medieval city and passed the buildings influenced by both the Ottoman Empire and Gothic styles. 

![Screenshot 2026-04-28 at 14.44.24.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/243zXMgGay7mSYGA6okFbZh7vepnXLpMzoZETq55q2f4r2iHKNkSVD4hpuQiUzVFp5rtb.png)

The route took us along the waterfront past boat jetties and ruins alike. 

## FORT OF SAINT NICHOLAS
Just across the Mandrake Harbour we spotted the Fort of Saint Nicholas. It was built between 1460 to 1467 to protect the harbour from Ottoman raids and provide a lighthouse to arriving boats.

![20240711_091414207_iOS.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/EqL5ryj4A425yV9fEvFRbiJTYxPBPidLBXUzVtjB78vdpsuv8zxYURnFJX9ReRe9o5u.jpeg)

On either side of the harbour entrance is a tall pillar topped by a stag and a doe. They are the symbols of the island. (see the picture above)

We continued our walk through an avenue of trees and got an ice cream in the midday heat. There’s no need for lunch when cruising because breakfast and dinner are big affairs with a lot of food, so we tend to always either have a coffee of gelato on land while adventuring.

## THE MEDIEVAL CITY OF RHODES
![Screenshot 2026-04-28 at 14.48.58.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/23wgKmwBsuFPH94jcQCTfHGtwZNSgAtQe7saYmRs4wL7P2zLUqr2EH5UdvSejewMJxGU2.png)

We finally made it to the old city, close to where our ship was moored and crossed over the old 21 meter wide moat in order to enter the Sea Gate. Once through the massive 12 meter wide outer wall we turned left into Hippocrates Square.

![Screenshot 2026-04-28 at 14.53.42.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/EonmSrigHnAp6D2eA3j5FTtc8f8aXq2DXMABgMhmEV2YbU7W1tvtPpELPbsxetsweDP.png)

We continued along Aristotelous through various arches and alleys until we found the street of the Knights. We just happened to wander up this narrow street. This is in fact where the knights would have been housed and spent time preparing for war. It is so beautifully preserved and here once again you can see the pebbled street.

![Screenshot 2026-04-28 at 14.55.13.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/23vsSmhgVnfsWMJbCN9J79uwHmhjctGF9wEAZtpnDrW91SjExp6FYwU54SGNtRnQtWcPc.png)

We were only too thankful to find a tap to refill our water bottles.  The water tasted fresh and ice cold.

## THE PALACE OF THE GRAND MASTER

![Screenshot 2026-04-28 at 14.57.45.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/2423v1Fy4GtzUupKc5YiAA1TTmMxByyqDMxZzQHd6BF4sQNa3qJJwjVvDbC9cvDyG45bz.png)

At the top of the street of the Knights we were confronted by a formidable building named the Palace of the Grand Master. Its structure is imposing and grand with its exterior entrance lined with Canons for protection.

## FOUNTAIN OF HIPPOCRATES

![Screenshot 2026-04-28 at 14.59.26.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/23xp69jBR736gJaqjBaTPY3fCfiq1UtobZouSoQmDpe7g5GjENarf9a1f4mBvj3z4zdXZ.png)

We wandered back through tiny streets until we found the Fountain of Hippocrates and the shopping and restaurant area. This part of the city was  crowded but we joined them anyway and got a few gifts for our children. We usually prefer practical gifts so I found the perfect T-shirt for my son which says: “It’s all Greek to me” and then lists and translate a whole lot of Greek words. 

## THE VIRGIN OF THE BURGH CHURCH RUINS

![20240711_110848282_iOS.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/2432DKGDoWa9Q7ioZQDwoURFmS2ctryVEeT7D9HMJ8rNRKJ3Rxjfc6VHjwJxc3FFAPbhY.jpeg)

The remains of the 3 beautiful apses are all that remains of this ancient Gothic church which is found in the Jewish quarter of the city. We stopped and sat on a bench to admire the ruins.

![Screenshot 2026-04-28 at 15.02.19.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/23wX1BevEoTuRNKN4stfrPKmjdDPAPioDanENCS9pSvqtfcmnVEkujdE1gCSFMH9jsvry.png)

We eventually exited through **The Gate of the Virgin** closer to the cruise terminal and turned right to head in the direction of the ship. By now the small low tide beach was packed with visitors and locals enjoying the Summer sun. 

![20240711_111503760_iOS.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/EoPL5cc5jsqcj7KeoEHVeLUGDh5YTmbyEHF5Q1Jsmf5ojdcuxFasyQK7bgtvRPd7Ywi.jpeg)

With tired feet we headed to the ship for a swim and a very late lunch and took a rest on a sun lounger before preparing for dinner. 

The next day was going to be a big one as we were about to visit **Santorini!**

**To see what we got up to in Kos click here:** https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@zo3d/the-greek-isles-kos


![Hive Hiking footer.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zo3d/23vsp78HoNhheV2gkypo79L8sWpg9XN6gEuCt3Khp5WVfbkp1iAvKEeCN9Nd4xdJnpsbr.png)

body.title: Counseling and the Sinfulness of Humanity
body.body:
Sin is the problem of every person today. Humanity has a fallen nature because of Adam’s sin, and it continues to affect all people. Even though God forgave Adam, the result of his sin was passed on to his descendants. In a way, it continues, as stated in Romans 5:12.

Sin affects the heart. For example, anger comes from the heart, and pride comes from being self-centered. It also affects a person’s thinking and understanding.

But there is a solution: repentance. This means turning away from sin, changing one’s mind and heart, and putting Christ at the center of life. However, a person still has the choice. If someone does something wrong but blames others or betrays a companion, that is still sin.

For me, what I learned most is the importance of turning away from sin, just like Paul. Before, he persecuted and killed Christians, but when he encountered Jesus, he changed and was transformed by the Holy Spirit.

I can relate this to myself. Before, I didn’t really care about church. I would attend just to enjoy the air-conditioning, to see people, or simply because I felt like going. I didn’t pay attention to the pastor’s teaching. But now, God has given me another chance to show unbelievers how He has changed me and to become an inspiration to them.

body.title: REINCARNATION IS IT BIBLICAL// THE OLD PATH
body.body:
We refer to reincarnation is a way which a death person is reborn into another body to come back to life. Instead, Scripture presents human life as a single, unique journey followed by judgment. Each person is created by God, lives once, and is then accountable to Him. This understanding gives weight and purpose to the choices we make in this life.

Biblically, the hope for the future is not repeated earthly lives but resurrection. On the last day God will raise the death and they will have eternal life in heaven. This resurrection is not a return as a different person or creature, but a continuation of one’s identity, renewed by God’s power and grace.
https://youtu.be/hNVrZKf9FE4?si=xmnGJSiYcPVDXa3d
Some people connect reincarnation with ideas of justice or second chances, but the Bible points instead to God’s mercy and forgiveness within this life. It emphasizes repentance, faith, and a restored relationship with God now, rather than relying on future lives to correct past actions. In this way, the biblical message focuses on redemption and eternal life rather than cycles of rebirth.

The Philippines experiences extreme fuel price effects which impact all people but create extra difficulties for the nation because its energy resources depend on imports. The local gas stations experience immediate effects whenever OPEC decides to raise global oil prices or major world events occur. The pricing of all goods will increase within a short time period.

Commuters experience immediate pain when they travel through the city. The costs of jeepney and bus rides increase while the expenses of driving personal vehicles rise. The situation progresses beyond this point.

Vehicles require fuel to operate while factories depend on it to maintain their operations and trucks need it to perform their delivery services.

The price of basic items which includes food and clothing and household goods increases whenever fuel costs experience an upward trend. Everyone experiences a cash shortage but low-income families suffer more from this situation.

People with no financial security spend their income on vital needs which include food and transportation. The higher fuel prices create more financial pressure upon them.

The group includes everyone who operates vehicles for their work which includes jeepney drivers and farmers and fishermen. Workers face higher fuel expenses while their earnings decrease which results in increased costs for customers who purchase their products.

Small businesses face difficulties when their costs increase and customers reduce their purchases while business owners delay making investments. The situation reaches a critical point when employment opportunities begin to vanish. A disaster occurs which nobody wishes to experience.

Some remains were too mixed to separate cleanly, and she declined anything that couldn’t be confirmed as belonging to her husband or son.
