body.title: Turning water into wine [EN/PT]
body.body: > *It wasn’t just a concert, it was the best concert of my life.* Not because of its size, not just because it had renowned musicians, but because it was a gathering of special pieces scattered throughout my life, all in one place, and I had no idea how big that really was. But before talking about this concert, I need to go back a bit. I grew up listening to a hardcore band from Brazil called Raimundos. It was a very authentic band, with a well-crafted sound despite being hardcore, and lyrics that were often “naughty.” If you have HC in your veins, there was no way not to become an instant fan. They were a big deal in a country that never really favored rock, but somehow, they became very popular in the 90s and early 2000s. Until the vocalist left the band after converting to Christianity, and even though the band continued with the remaining members, it was never the same again. It lost its backbone: Rodolfo Abrantes. I was outraged by that and could never understand why someone would leave a band at its peak just to be a Christian. Back then, I didn’t really understand these spiritual callings, but that was it. I never stopped listening to the band, even though the quality dropped so much after the vocalist left. I went to their concert for the first time last year. Only one of the original members was still in the band. It was good, it was a dream come true, but it felt like something was missing. The vocalist of Raimundos, after converting, soon joined another band called Rodox, a hardcore band but with Christian lyrics. I know that in some countries it’s normal for music with Christian and secular lyrics not to have much distinction, but here in Brazil, a band is either secular or gospel, so to speak. So, going back, at that time he founded this Christian hardcore band, which was very good, by the way, and after some time, due to internal conflicts, the band ended. Rodolfo, the vocalist, went on to pursue a solo career with his music becoming more gospel than ever. After I converted to Christianity in 2010, I started following his solo journey and some other works, but I also fell in love with the band Rodox. Then, at the beginning of this year, I heard the news that the band was alive again, with Rodolfo on vocals, and the most incredible part was that they would be playing in my city. I got the tickets as a gift from my girlfriend, tickets for me and my son to go, and it was the best concert of my life. I never imagined I would one day attend a concert by this band. There wasn’t a single song where I didn’t get chills, and my eyes were blurred with tears the entire time. I truly had all my emotions on the surface. My son, who often listened to this band with me in the car while we were on the road, fell in love with the band back then, and the drummer of Rodox is one of his references in his journey as a beginner musician. I cheered, I got emotional, it was inevitable. So many things went through my mind as I relived those songs that were, many times, a source of comfort during difficult moments and also in joyful ones. It was truly an incredible moment. That night, I also reunited with great friends I hadn’t seen in many years, friends I made during days of preaching the gospel in alternative churches that I was part of for a time in my life. Friends I hadn’t seen in a decade, and I was able to hug them and relive the nostalgia of that night, bonds being rebuilt. But in the end, it wasn’t just music, it wasn’t just a night of hardcore running through my veins. It was a night of communion with God in an unlikely way, a rekindling of a flame that had grown weak. It was looking back and realizing that water had been turned into wine, and I was truly living it. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbURVpvJVfy6PgeRY4Qs6PJTBnvgcdys69UCJ9nuXibvs/1.jpeg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYQig7Ft8zZNKFBoHCoSpk51DW7wrd9PBfxVRnt7mDXfV/2.jpeg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmagMGfbp5XCBMk5xiSxfYmW32ZusqVCY1QPYVKDmkWnLV/3.jpeg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNrC4xtsYgdPpRAcCfwcmxxfG78SRfGbugZg46KLrYJ6q/4.jpeg) *Não foi apenas um show, foi o melhor show da minha vida.* Não pelo tamanho, não só por contar com músicos renomados, mas por ter sido uma junção de peças especiais espalhadas pela minha história de vida em um só lugar, e eu nem imaginava o tamanho disso. Mas antes de falar sobre esse show, preciso voltar um pouco no passado. Cresci escutando uma banda de hardcore aqui do Brasil, Raimundos. Era uma banda muito autêntica, com um som trabalhado apesar de ser hardcore e letras muitas vezes “sacanas”. Se você tem HC na veia, não tinha como não virar fã imediato deles. Era uma sensação em um Brasil que nunca teve o rock como preferência, mas, de certa forma, essa banda foi muito popular nos anos 90 e parte dos anos 2000. Até que o vocalista saiu da banda depois de ter se convertido ao cristianismo, e a banda, mesmo tendo continuado com seus outros integrantes, nunca mais foi a mesma. Ela perdeu sua espinha: Rodolfo Abrantes. Eu fiquei indignado com isso e nunca consegui entender por que um cara sairia de uma banda no auge para apenas ser cristão. Naquela época eu não entendia muito desses chamados espirituais, mas enfim, era isso. Nunca deixei de escutar a banda, mesmo que a qualidade tenha caído tanto depois da saída do vocalista. Fui ao show da banda pela primeira vez no ano passado. Apenas um dos integrantes originais ainda estava na banda. Foi bom, foi um sonho realizado, mas parecia que esse sonho estava faltando algo. O vocalista dos Raimundos, depois de ter se convertido, um pouco depois estava em outra banda que se chamava Rodox, uma banda de hardcore, mas com letras cristãs. Sei que em alguns países é normal que músicas com letras cristãs e seculares não tenham muita distinção, mas aqui no Brasil ou a banda é secular ou é gospel, por assim dizer. Então, voltando, naquela época ele fundou essa banda de HC cristã, muito boa por sinal, e depois de um tempo, devido a conflitos internos, a banda acabou. Rodolfo, o vocalista, seguiu carreira solo com suas músicas mais gospel do que nunca. Depois de eu ter me convertido em 2010 ao cristianismo, comecei a acompanhar sua trajetória solo e alguns outros trabalhos mas me apaixonei também pela banda Rodox. Mas foi então que, no início deste ano, tive a notícia de que essa banda estava viva novamente, com Rodolfo no vocal, e a notícia mais incrível era que eles tocariam na minha cidade. Eu ganhei de presente os ingressos da minha namorada, ingressos para mim e para meu filho irmos, e foi o melhor show da minha vida. Nunca imaginei que um dia iria ao show dessa banda. Não teve uma música em que eu não estivesse arrepiado, e meus olhos ficaram embaçados pelas lágrimas o tempo todo. Realmente, eu estava com todas as emoções à flor da pele. Meu filho, que muitas vezes escutava essa banda comigo no carro enquanto estávamos na estrada, se apaixonou pela banda desde aquela época, e o baterista da banda Rodox é uma das suas referências em seu percurso como músico iniciante. Eu vibrei e me emocionei, era inevitável. Quanta coisa passou na minha cabeça enquanto eu revivia aquelas músicas que, por muitas vezes, foram consolo em momentos difíceis e também de alegria. Foi realmente um momento incrível. Nessa noite, eu ainda reencontrei grandes amigos que não via há tantos anos, amigos que fiz em dias de evangelhos pregados em igrejas alternativas das quais fiz parte por um tempo na minha vida. Amigos que não via há uma década, e pude abraçar e viver a nostalgia ainda dessa noite, laços sendo reconstruídos. Mas, por fim, não foi apenas música, não foi apenas uma noite de hardcore que corre nas minhas veias. Foi uma noite de comunhão com Deus de uma maneira improvável, de reacender uma chama que estava fraca. Foi olhar para trás e ver que a água foi transformada em vinho e eu estava vivendo isso de verdade. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=michupa/649efc04)

body.body: > https://youtu.be/OXbP7YWzQsA?si=zc83iCwz3hhuPQ9S There are some statements and words that I will hear which I will pause to actually reflect and one of them actually is the aspect of People Without Religion. Sometimes it really sounds so absurd for me. I usually think so deeply about how many people in the world that is currently living without not even knowing God or even not even following any true spiritual path. There are people that did not even belong to any religion probably because of their past experience with people who practiced religion. body.body: 1/5 🧵 Jimmy Kimmel’s defense made the story worse, not better. After backlash over his “expectant widow” line about Melania Trump—and after the White House Correspondents’ Dinner shooting—he went on air and repeated the joke anyway. That turned a tasteless punchline into a bigger political and cultural fight.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The core sequence matters. Kimmel first used the joke in a mock WHCD-style roast on April 23, filling in for the comedian segment that was scrapped from the actual dinner. Then, after the April 25 shooting at the Washington Hilton—where an accused gunman allegedly intended to target members of the Trump administration—the joke landed in a much uglier context.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 Kimmel’s defense was basically: it was a roast, not a call to violence. He said the line was meant to mock the age gap between Melania and Trump, plus her often-stoic expression around him. That’s the crux of his argument: bad taste, maybe, but not incitement. Problem is, repeating it after the shooting looked less like clarification and more like defiance.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 The backlash came fast and from multiple directions. Melania called the monologue “hateful and violent rhetoric” that deepens political division. Trump demanded ABC and Disney fire Kimmel immediately. The fallout also hit the show itself: mentalist Oz Pearlman canceled an appearance after being present at the dinner when gunfire broke out, and Jon Lovett filled in with his own shots at both Trump and the absent guest.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 Bigger point: this article frames the episode as a case study in how political comedy can go from edgy to self-destructive when timing is catastrophic. Kimmel tried to separate satire from violence, but by repeating the line he handed critics exactly what they wanted: proof he was doubling down, not reading the room. 📎 Source

body.title: Argentina - Discovering the city of Corrientes: art on every corner and nature to enjoy. / Descubriendo la ciudad de Corrientes: arte en cada rincón y naturaleza para disfrutar. 😃❤️
body.body:
> Arriving in the city of Corrientes as the final step in my journey through all the provinces of Argentina made me very happy. It was a long road completing my travel checklist, and seeing the trip I had been planning for months in my Excel come to life was very satisfying. Fortunately, the good weather accompanied me during my stay in this place, allowing for several beautiful walks. Long walks were part of my days in the company of Gabi and Luis, who kindly showed me their favorite spots ❤️.
Haber llegado a la ciudad de Corrientes como último paso en mi recorrido por todas las provincias de Argentina me puso muy feliz. Fue un largo camino completando mi check list de viaje, y ver materializado el paseo que durante meses estuve planeando en mi excel fue muy satisfactorio. Por suerte, el buen clima me acompañó durante mi estadía en este lugar, lo que permitió varias caminatas hermosas. Las caminatas extensas fueron parte de mis días en compañía de Gabi y Luis, en donde ellos amablemente me mostraron sus lugares preferidos ❤️.
--- ---

> --- --- Gabi and Luis are friends from Hive who hosted me in their home while I was visiting the province of Corrientes. From there, we had to take a bus to reach the city center, and in just a few minutes we were already in the most touristy part of the area. Of course, this was the most elegant zone, with many beautiful buildings, parks, and the famous waterfront of Corrientes. We had planned a long walk for that day, so we set out early to make the most of it.
Gabi y Luis son unos amigos de Hive que me hospedaron en su casa mientras estaba de visita en la provincia de Corrientes. Desde ahí, teníamos que tomar un bus para llegar al centro de la ciudad y en unos pocos minutos ya estábamos en la parte más turística del lugar. Por supuesto, esta zona era la más elegante, con muchos edificios lindos, parques y la famosa costanera de Corrientes. Teníamos planeada una gran caminata para ese día, por lo que salimos temprano para poder aprovecharlo bien.
---

> --- We began our walk in Mitre Park, a large green space designed for recreation. After walking for a bit, we took a moment to have breakfast and recharge before heading toward the waterfront. Out of all the places, this was my favorite, because you could see the beautiful Paraná River, accompanied by a lovely riverside promenade. From there, we could also see the impressive General Manuel Belgrano Bridge, which connects Resistencia, the capital of Chaco, with the city of Corrientes.
Empezamos nuestra caminata en el Parque Mitre, un gran espacio verde preparado para la recreación. Después de caminar un poco, nos tomamos un momento para desayunar y recargar energías para nuestro paso hacia la costanera. De todos, este fue mi lugar preferido, porque se podía ver el hermoso Río Paraná, acompañado de un paseo costero muy lindo. Desde ahí podíamos ver el imponente Puente General Manuel Belgrano, aquel que une Resistencia, la capital de Chaco, con la ciudad de Corrientes.
---

> --- The Corrientes waterfront is very extensive and has space for everything. Along it, we saw a yacht club, a stretch of the natural river, and further ahead, a beautiful beach with yellow sand prepared for swimmers. I liked that this space has been made enjoyable for everyone: during our walk, we came across many people enjoying the area (and even lots of small animals).
La costanera de Corrientes es muy extensa y tiene espacio para todo. En ella pudimos ver un club náutico, parte del río natural y más adelante, una hermosa playa con arenas amarillas preparada para los bañistas. Me gustó que se haya aprovechado este espacio para gusto de todos: durante nuestro paseo, nos encontramos con mucha gente disfrutando de este lugar (e incluso muchos pequeños animales).
---

> --- During our walk, we had the opportunity to see all kinds of buildings, from some belonging to the historic center to others that were a bit more modern. It’s clear that in the city of Corrientes there has been—and still is—a strong interest in preserving local history, while not missing the chance to invest and continue modernizing. A bit of everything.
Durante nuestro recorrido tuvimos la oportunidad de ver todo tipo de edificaciones, desde algunas pertenecientes al casco histórico, hasta otras un poco más modernas. Se nota que en la ciudad de Corrientes hubo y hay bastante interés en mantener la historia local, pero sin perder la oportunidad de invertir y seguir modernizándose. Un poco de todo.
---

> --- But without a doubt, the most distinctive feature of the city of Corrientes was its beautiful murals. The entire city is adorned with murals of this style, in warm colors and with textures that make them very characteristic. Of all the murals we saw, the largest one was located in front of a small shopping promenade, and through many illustrations it told the story of the first settlers. This promenade was very modern—a great combination of art and recreation.
Pero sin dudas, la parte más distintiva de la ciudad de Corrientes fueron sus hermosos murales. Toda la ciudad esta adornada con murales de este estilo, en colores cálidos y con relieves que los hacen muy característicos. De todos los murales que vimos, el más grande estuvo enfrente de un pequeño paseo comercial, y con muchos dibujos contaba la historia de los primeros pobladores. Este paseo era muy moderno, una buena combinación entre arte y recreación.
---

> --- I really enjoyed this walk around the city because, in addition to stretching our legs a bit, we were able to see many interesting spots. Our walk stretched for about 4 kilometers, until it was time to take a break and recharge our energy once again. There was still a lot left to explore in this place, so it was important to rest for a while. **We had already seen quite a lot, but luckily for this traveler, there was still more to come ❤️.**
Este paseo por los alrededores de la ciudad me gustó mucho porque además de estirar un poco las piernas, pudimos ver muchos puntos interesantes. Nuestra caminata se extendió por unos 4 kilómetros, hasta que ya fue momento de parar un poco para recargar energías otra vez. Todavía quedaba mucho para recorrer en este lugar, por lo que era importante descansar un poco. Ya habíamos visto bastante, pero por suerte para esta viajera, todavía quedaba un poco más ❤️.
--- ---

❤️ Hope you liked this post! Thanks for reading. ❤️

❤️¡Espero que les haya gustado este post! Gracias por leer. ❤️
---

> ---
With lots of love. / Con mucho amor. Lau 💕.

body.body: 1/5 🧵 Josh Hart’s box score didn’t scream “series saver.” His defense did. The Knicks’ Game 4 turnaround was powered by Hart being an absolute pest on the perimeter — ball pressure, switching, physicality, and setting the tone for a team that finally played like its season was on the line.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: we have indeed a very rich country wit cultural memories stored in musea , and we are planning to visit them more often .
body.author: stresskiller

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The clearest proof is in Atlanta’s offense falling apart. The Hawks shot just 41.0% from the field, 24.4% from three, and coughed up 19 turnovers that turned into 21 Knicks points. That’s not random variance. That’s New York forcing ugliness, and Hart was right in the middle of it by disrupting guards and wings before plays could even develop.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 Hart’s role was basically “defensive Swiss Army knife.” Mike Brown moved him around onto both Jalen Johnson and CJ McCollum, using him wherever the Knicks most needed friction. The point wasn’t to shut down one guy in isolation — it was to keep changing the Hawks’ reads, make McCollum see different defenders, and use Hart’s quick feet, strength, and long arms to generate pressure without constant fouling.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 The bigger point is the domino effect. Hart’s on-ball pressure bought time for everyone behind him. OG Anunoby flat-out said it made rotations easier because he had more time to read whether the ball handler would stop, attack, or kick. That matters because one of New York’s biggest playoff problems has been perimeter defenders getting beat too easily, which collapses the whole defense. Hart helped stop that leak at the source.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 It also killed Atlanta’s transition game. The Hawks want pace, easy runouts, and chaos. In Game 4, they got almost none of it — just 7 fast-break points, with those not really showing up until garbage time. So the article’s real takeaway is simple: Hart didn’t just defend his man, he changed the Knicks’ entire defensive ecosystem. That’s why he was the catalyst in a 114-98 win that tied the series. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/26/sports/josh-harts-defense-was-heartbeat-of-knicks-pivotal-turnaround/)

body.title: (EN-FR) Book summary and review: The way to wealth, by Benjamin Franklin-Résumé et critique du livre : La voie de la richesse, par Benjamin Franklin
body.body:
(English version)

Benjamin Franklin's timeless book on how to apply sound financial management in your life

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kV6ju75wqxI

The book “The way to wealth” is a collection of stories, letters, teachings, recommendations, and prompts of how to get rich, and it was written by Benjamin Franklin, one of the most notable and influential people in American history.

The various chapters of the book were published as individual works, as parts of the “Poor Richard’s Almanacκ” series, over a period of more than two decades, and they enjoyed huge success.

The American reading audience of that era was eager to read about new ways of reaching the American Dream.

America was the Promised Land for the first settlers who needed moral motivators and men of uncompromised ethics, who would possess the appropriate ideological background, in order to support the expansion of the initial settlements, further cultivation and exploitation of the land, as well as, setting and strengthening the foundations of an independent American state. One such moral motivator was Benjamin Franklin.

**A few words about the author**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FGx2PBgVSG4

It is generally recognized that Benjamin Franklin’s influence was immense, when it comes to setting the founding principles of the American state.

This influence has been continued throughout the history of the United States, and it is still evident to a great extent nowadays.

It can be added that Benjamin Franklin had a strong personality and enjoyed wide recognition that was not limited to the boundaries of his country.

It wouldn’t be far from the truth to say that Benjamin Franklin is regarded as one of the most important persons of all times.

If you ask a school child in any country of the world the question: “Who was Benjamin Franklin?” the most likely answer will be: “The man who invented the lightning rod”.

It becomes clear that Benjamin Franklin is most known as a physics scientist, while other aspects of his versatile talent are generally ignored.

However, during his time, Benjamin Franklin played an important role in the political and financial issues of a newly-born state, and his involvement in those fields served as the basis of writing the book “The way to wealth”.

He has offered a compilation of timeless hints and tips of advice on financial prosperity, which are believed to be valid even nowadays.

In modern times, and especially in periods of financial recession and crisis, numerous “economics gurus” come forward claiming that they know the hidden secrets that will help people overcome their financial problems and become rich.

However, we shouldn’t fool ourselves. Modern-day con artists selling their “get-rich-quick” methods, either online or offline, who just want to put their hands in your pockets for selling nothing more than hot air, have absolutely nothing to with one of the legendary fathers of the American nation.

The result of following Benjamin Franklin’s advice is not getting rich fast and without an effort. Perhaps, by following his advice, a person’s wealth can increase so fast, that the persons itself won’t realize how this happened.

However, this is not something easy to achieve, because, if you want to increase your wealth, you will have to sacrifice some of his or her daily little things that give him or her pleasure but increase his or her personal expenses. He or she should do this, in order to accumulate wealth.

Benjamin Franklin’s hints of financial wisdom are simple and easy to understand, and can be followed by anyone.

Nonetheless, theory may be difficult to apply in practice, in spite of these well-intentioned tips of advice, since many people may have been used to living in luxury.

These ideas that come from another era are very different, compared to today’s consumerism and the mentality of “live today” or “live for today”.

When it comes to instructions on how to manage personal finances successfully, as these instructions are presented in this classical work, focus is placed on encouraging a more conservative and prudent way of living.

This economic prudence is characteristic of a spirit of moderation and self-restraint, as well as application of cautious and rational management of wealth, following a lifestyle that supports the conservation of both personal and national resources.

These ideals were the norm in the writer’s era, and of course, they are not even closely related to modern consumerism, according to which, quality of life is defined on the basis of the consumption of ephemeral goods.

Conservation of resources, as expressed in saving money for the future, is central in Franklin’s analysis of successful personal wealth management.

**Benjamin Franklin’s unique style of humor**

In his narrative style, the writer uses the model of a father, i.e., Benjamin Franklin himself, who uses his unique personal style to tell stories and teach his children, i.e., his readers.

The narrative flow is not sort of humor.

Moreover, it wouldn’t be far from truth to say that humor plays a key role, when it comes to the effectiveness of the narration, since it helps in getting messages and ideas across to the reader, according to the writer’s intention.

Humor livens up the stories in the book, and in some cases, it becomes well-intentioned sarcasm.

Benjamin Franklin uses traditional figures in society during his time, such as “poor Richard” and “father Abraham”, and in the faces of those imaginary, yet perfectly believable, persons, he illustrates characters from wider social groups.

(Version française)

Le livre intemporel de Benjamin Franklin sur la manière d'appliquer une saine gestion financière à votre vie

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kV6ju75wqxI

Le livre « La voie de la richesse » est un recueil d'histoires, de lettres, d'enseignements, de recommandations et de conseils pour s'enrichir. Il a été écrit par Benjamin Franklin, l'une des figures les plus marquantes et influentes de l'histoire américaine.

Les différents chapitres de l'ouvrage ont été publiés individuellement, au sein de la collection « L'Almanach du pauvre Richard », sur une période de plus de vingt ans, et ont connu un immense succès.

Le lectorat américain de l'époque était avide de découvrir de nouvelles façons d'atteindre le rêve américain.

L'Amérique était la Terre promise pour les premiers colons qui avaient besoin de modèles et d'hommes à l'éthique irréprochable, dotés des convictions nécessaires pour soutenir l'expansion des premières colonies, la mise en culture et l'exploitation des terres, ainsi que la fondation et le renforcement d'un État américain indépendant. Benjamin Franklin fut l'un de ces modèles.

**Quelques mots sur l'auteur**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FGx2PBgVSG4

Il est généralement admis que l'influence de Benjamin Franklin a été immense dans l'établissement des principes fondateurs de l'État américain.

Cette influence s'est perpétuée tout au long de l'histoire des États-Unis et reste encore aujourd'hui largement perceptible.

On peut ajouter que Benjamin Franklin possédait une forte personnalité et jouissait d'une renommée qui dépassait largement les frontières de son pays.

Il n'est pas exagéré de dire que Benjamin Franklin est considéré comme l'une des personnalités les plus importantes de tous les temps.

Si vous demandez à un écolier, quel que soit son pays d'origine : « Qui était Benjamin Franklin ? », la réponse la plus probable sera : « L'inventeur du paratonnerre. »

Il apparaît clairement que Benjamin Franklin est surtout connu comme physicien, tandis que les autres aspects de son talent multiple sont généralement négligés.

Cependant, à son époque, Benjamin Franklin a joué un rôle important dans les affaires politiques et financières de ce jeune État, et son implication dans ces domaines a inspiré la rédaction de son ouvrage « La voie de la richesse ».

Il y propose un recueil de conseils et astuces intemporels sur la prospérité financière, dont la pertinence est encore reconnue aujourd'hui.

De nos jours, et particulièrement en période de récession et de crise financière, de nombreux « gourous de l'économie » prétendent détenir les secrets permettant de surmonter les difficultés financières et de s'enrichir.

Mais ne nous leurrons pas. Ces escrocs modernes, qui vendent leurs méthodes pour « devenir riche rapidement » en ligne ou hors ligne, et qui ne cherchent qu'à vous soutirer de l'argent avec des promesses en l'air, n'ont absolument rien à voir avec l'un des pères fondateurs légendaires de la nation américaine.

Suivre les conseils de Benjamin Franklin ne permet pas de s'enrichir rapidement et sans effort. Il est possible, certes, qu'en les appliquant, la richesse augmente si vite qu'on ne s'en rend même pas compte.

Cependant, y parvenir n'est pas chose facile. Accroître son patrimoine implique de renoncer à certains petits plaisirs quotidiens qui, certes, augmentent les dépenses personnelles. C'est le prix à payer pour accumuler des richesses.

Les précieux conseils financiers de Benjamin Franklin sont simples et accessibles à tous.

Néanmoins, malgré la bienveillance de ces conseils, la théorie peut s'avérer difficile à mettre en pratique, car beaucoup sont habitués au luxe.

Ces idées, héritées d'une autre époque, contrastent fortement avec le consumérisme actuel et la mentalité du « vivre au jour le jour ».

Concernant les conseils de gestion financière personnelle, tels que présentés dans cet ouvrage classique, l'accent est mis sur la promotion d'un mode de vie plus conservateur et prudent.

Cette prudence économique se caractérise par un esprit de modération et de maîtrise de soi, ainsi que par une gestion prudente et rationnelle du patrimoine, suivant un mode de vie favorisant la préservation des ressources personnelles et nationales.

Ces idéaux étaient la norme à l'époque de l'auteur et, bien entendu, ils sont sans rapport avec le consumérisme moderne, selon lequel la qualité de vie se définit par la consommation de biens éphémères.

La préservation des ressources, notamment par l'épargne, est au cœur de l'analyse de Franklin sur la gestion réussie du patrimoine personnel.

**L'humour unique de Benjamin Franklin**

Dans son style narratif, l'auteur s'inspire de la figure paternelle de Benjamin Franklin lui-même, qui utilise son style personnel unique pour raconter des histoires et instruire ses enfants, c'est-à-dire ses lecteurs.

Le récit n'est pas empreint d'humour.

De plus, on peut affirmer sans exagérer que l'humour joue un rôle essentiel dans l'efficacité de la narration, car il contribue à transmettre les messages et les idées au lecteur, conformément aux intentions de l'auteur.

L'humour dynamise les récits du livre et, dans certains cas, se transforme en un sarcasme bienveillant.

Benjamin Franklin utilise des figures traditionnelles de la société de son époque, telles que « le pauvre Richard » et « le père Abraham », et, à travers ces personnages imaginaires, mais parfaitement crédibles, il illustre des caractéristiques issues de divers groupes sociaux.

(Cet article a été traduit de l'anglais vers le français avec Google Translate)

body.title: A starling is a bird.
body.body:
A starling is a bird. 
I took this photo when we went for a walk in nature with friends. 
We often go for walks. I used to be a total homebody—it was hard to get me out of the house. I used to stay home, draw, do chores, and chat with friends online. But now I’m more active and go for walks more often. I want to take a walk, breathe some fresh air, and admire nature. Take photos for you. Just meet up with friends, since we miss each other. We’re interested in chatting not only online, but in person too. In person, it’s a completely different kind of interaction—you can see all of a person’s emotions, so it’s much easier to communicate that way. 
I took a photo of a bird with my camera. Photographing a bird isn’t as easy as, say, a flower or something else. Since birds rarely stay in one place for long. You have to catch the moment when the bird is standing still, and also not scare it away. 
I love birds. I often draw birds. 
I took a photo of a bird called a starling. It’s a very beautiful bird, and it sings beautifully, too.

body.title: Why Audience Matters More Than Effort in Ministry
body.body:
<center> https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdzNrCKD7cdxT1Q8sNPBjm6oopt8HaoDZWyKLaEbvS9rM/17773813421897688729500838682961.jpg 

[Source](https://www.nytimes.com/2024/09/23/us/young-men-religion-gen-z.html)</center>

At the age of 22, I've come to believe that ministry was mainly about being dedicated to God. So I decided to pray harder, work longer and stayed more committed than everyone else in my church. And the fruit of serving God will surely come. 

I've always thought that devotion was full of equation and I assumed that sincerity alone will carry me to heaven and God will actually see me. But more than 40 years now in ministry, I have reached that point where I've come to a different conclusion. One that has completely reshaped how I see impact, calling and effectiveness.

Ministry is not only about dedication, it is about having the right audience. The realization changes everything. It does not just reduce the importance of passion, discipline and spiritual depth.

What it does is that you now realize a different thing entirely. And the fact that it's not even enough, all those dedications are not even enough. A message can be true, powerful and anointed yet still fail to produce the intended effect if it is delivered to the wrong people. 

Like a pastor is preaching about the blessing of God but the people are saying something else about using their own work. That message will not surely work on them. In the wrong context of things, people will not be able to ascertain or get what is expected of them from God. 

Even through your own channels, you cannot get what you are supposed to get. In other words, good content alone does not guarantee meaningful impact. The audience matters just as much as the message.

This is one of the hardest lessons to accept because many of us are forced to focus almost entirely on effort. We are taught to preach better, serve God the more and pray the more harder and endure the more. Though these things all work, they are all factors that make things work.

So yes, it works and all of that is actually valuable. But there is another layer to ministry and it is often overlooked and that is alignment and who is listening, who is ready, who is hungry for God's word. This style, this season of truth, a message that lands in fertile soil will grow differently from one that is dropped on hardened ground.

As time goes on, I have also come to see that some of the frustration in ministry was not always about lack of faithfulness. Sometimes it comes to mismatch. You are preaching the right message to the wrong people, the wrong message to the right people.

You can be carrying something that is heavenly and you still struggle to pass it across. If you are trying to pour it onto people who are not positioned to receive it, it goes to waste. That does not mean the message is wrong. 

It means that the future needs to be right. It means wisdom must sit beside zeal so that the two can coincide together and deliver a great result. That is why audience is not a minor detail.

It is central to fulfillment and fruitfulness of Christian preaching. The right audience does not just listen. They respond. 

They recognize what is being offered. They are ready for the conversation. They can carry the weight of the message and help it multiply. 

When that happens, ministry becomes less about forcing outcome and more about stewarding connection. There is also a pastoral freedom in this realization. It means you do not have to measure your calling by visibility, applause, volume, the amount of people you had in your congregation. 

Sometimes faithfulness might look like learning who your message is for. So you can have a thousand worshippers in a particular church but the people that are ready to listen and do it are just twenty. Those are your real members, not the entire one thousand. 

Sometimes growth means narrowing focus instead of broadening reach. Sometimes the most strategic thing you can do is to stop trying to be understood by everyone or begin speaking clearly to people who are truly saints to serve. That is why this realization can feel important as I have come to know it after 14 years.

It is not just a professional insight. It is a ministry breakthrough. It reframes success.

It explains frustration. It reminds us that impact is not only about how devoted we are, it is also about whether we are standing before people and prepared to receive what we carry from God. Since this is the lesson I have come to learn in 14 years of ministry, it is what holding tightly on to and I have come to know that dedication matters but audience changes everything.



Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@timscreative/why-audience-matters-more-than-effort-in-ministry-6ss)

body.title: Encuentro de Talentos: Recordando mis travesuras
body.body: >Saludos y bendiciones para todos en este martes que promete cosas buenas. Feliz de estar nuevamente escribiendo para la comunidad de #EmpowerTalent donde la amiga @angelica7 nos motiva cada semana con los diversos temas. Por supuesto, esta semana el tema propuesto es realmente maravilloso en lo que a mí concierne, porque siento que recordar trae felicidad y más cuando se trata de \

> <div class='pull-right'>Greetings and blessings to all on this Tuesday that promises good things. I'm happy to be writing again for the #EmpowerTalent community, where our friend @angelica7 motivates us each week with various topics. Of course, this week's topic is truly wonderful for me, because I feel that remembering brings happiness, especially when it comes to \

>Desde que nacemos vamos creando recuerdos aun sin saberlo, y en la infancia es cuando mejores momentos se viven; por eso siempre digo que esa es la época de oro. Dado que la infancia es la base más importante del ser humano, donde grabamos ejemplos y quienes nos rodean dejan huella en nosotros.

>
From the moment we're born, we begin creating memories without even realizing it, and childhood is when we experience the best moments; that's why I always say it's the golden age. Childhood is the most important foundation for human development, where we internalize lessons and those around us leave a lasting impression.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmdSUJt21Aq1cUUTvTXfAB67M5yGkVD9P3DPuTropGVwT6/image.png

>De los seis hijos que tuvieron mis padres, según yo, he sido la más atrevida porque nunca me quedé con las ganas de hacer algo y de allí se sueltan mis travesuras; aun sabiendo que mamá me reprendería, eso no era obstáculo para detenerme en mi misión.

>
Of the six children my parents had, I believe I was the most daring because I never held back from doing something, and that's where my mischief comes from; even knowing that Mom would scold me, that was no obstacle to stopping me in my mission.

>Trasladándome a los recuerdos de mi infancia, recuerdo claramente que una de mis hermanas tenía un pretendiente muy pretencioso. Yo tendría unos cinco años y una noche, cuando el hombre estaba muy sentado en la sala conversando, se me ocurrió la brillante idea de tomar el martillo que tenía mamá en la cocina para pisar la carne. De esos que, por un lado, son lisos y, por el otro, tienen puntas de metal, me pareció tan oportuno al ver la mano del hombre sobre el brazo del mueble y, con todas mis ganas, le di en el dedo meñique con la parte de metal del martillo. Mamá me quería matar, pero al final el pobre hombre logró convencerla de no hacerme nada.

>
Going back to my childhood memories, I clearly remember that one of my sisters had a very pretentious suitor. I must have been about five years old, and one night, when the man was sitting deep in conversation in the living room, I had the brilliant idea of ​​taking the meat mallet my mother kept in the kitchen. It was one of those mallets that's smooth on one side and has metal points on the other. It seemed like the perfect tool when I saw the man's hand resting on the arm of the meat mallet, and with all my might, I hit him on the little finger with the metal part of the mallet. My mother wanted to kill me, but in the end, the poor man managed to convince her not to hurt me.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmRhKnJk7S1AsDDH8HZvAafbLe1Xqt8KgkDAdEC82NAVu4/image.png

>Cuando mamá lavaba, me encantaba estar cerca de ella para ver lo que hacía; ella, conociéndome, me prohibía acercarme al lavandero. Sin embargo, son esas restricciones las que impulsan a hacer las cosas; por tanto, un día mientras ella lavaba, aproveché un descuido y accioné el rodillo de la lavadora en la que lavaba la ropa; inmediatamente me metí la mano. El aparato me haló hasta donde pudo y, casualmente, en ese preciso momento me vio mi madre, quien desesperada no encontraba ni qué hacer. La presión fue tanta que el brazo se me estaba poniendo morado y al hospital fuimos a parar; por mucho tiempo tuve la marca en mi brazo.

>
When my mother did the laundry, I loved to be near her to watch what she did; knowing me, she forbade me from going near the sink. However, it's those restrictions that drive you to do things; so one day, while she was washing, I took advantage of a moment of inattention and activated the drum of the washing machine she was using; I immediately put my hand inside. The machine pulled me in as far as it could, and, coincidentally, at that precise moment, my mother saw me, desperate and unsure what to do. The pressure was so intense that my arm was turning purple, and we ended up in the hospital; I had the scar on my arm for a long time.

>Ya más crecida, hice mis travesuras y, aunque ya no causaban tanta gracia, pues quedaron también como recuerdos. En la actualidad, no experimento ninguna ansiedad. Si deseo expresar o realizar algo, lo hago debido a la convicción de que es así la vida, de realizar actividades que nos brinden alegría, siempre y cuando no ocasionen daño a nadie.

>
As I grew older, I got into mischief, and although it wasn't as funny anymore, it became a cherished memory. These days, I don't experience any anxiety. If I want to express myself or do something, I do it because I believe that's life—to engage in activities that bring us joy, as long as they don't harm anyone.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmTWCAhUmoySXxwDh2Xrtnyr69pBCxsJ4X2xrnab73e6GJ/image.png

>Mi más reciente travesura fue con un amigo de hace años que siempre me había estado enamorando y, para ver cómo reaccionaba y aprovechando que tenemos tiempo sin vernos, le dije que si me quería visitar, estaba invitado a mi casa; lo único es que no se fuera a sorprender cuando me viera en persona porque no tengo ni un diente. El hombre, por supuesto, trató de darme palabras de aliento y aun después de un año espero su visita, ja, ja.

>
My most recent prank involved an old friend I'd always had a crush on. To see how he'd react, and since we hadn't seen each other in a while, I told him he was welcome to visit. The only thing was, he shouldn't be surprised when he saw me in person because I'm missing all my teeth. Of course, he tried to offer words of encouragement, and even after a year, I'm still waiting for his visit, ha ha.

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![fC8O5RuJjiCTH1SX_3.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/fC8O5RuJjiCTH1SX_3/fC8O5RuJjiCTH1SX_3.webp)
![Rpj9CZrcpi8tgyWE_1.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/Rpj9CZrcpi8tgyWE_1/Rpj9CZrcpi8tgyWE_1.webp)
![bL9EiUiWPLRB6OWP_2.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/bL9EiUiWPLRB6OWP_2/bL9EiUiWPLRB6OWP_2.webp)
![y8x8ZwbhytbFCft3_4.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/y8x8ZwbhytbFCft3_4/y8x8ZwbhytbFCft3_4.webp)
![aOgxxltyx4axpsFY_5.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/aOgxxltyx4axpsFY_5/aOgxxltyx4axpsFY_5.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

今日是个大晴天，算是五一假期前难得的好天气了。看预报，明天开始就要转成小雨或阴天，气温也会骤降10℃左右……不得不说，这老天奶还真是调皮，一天天的，天气变脸比翻书还快。

公园里的三角梅开得娇艳欲滴。这花儿生命力着实顽强，无论春夏秋冬，总能瞧见它的身影，难怪能成为城市花朵中的常客，观赏价值很高，为城市绿化加分不少呢。

东街口附近的永辉已经关了，只好转去西湖公园旁边那家。那是个老店了，我平时不怎么去，但一进门竟有种熟悉的亲切感。这家永辉有两层，我先在一楼转了一圈，发现不少商品都贴了降价标签。走到肉摊前，没想到还能讲价！

我发现啊，凡事多问一句，总会有收获——标签上的价格其实也可以商量，最后还真愉快地砍下来了一些。至于能便宜多少，就各凭本事啦。

转了一大圈，买了不少东西：鸡鸭鱼肉、蔬菜瓜果、大米面条，样样齐全。海鲜这回就先放过，主要是实在拿不动了。说实话，论力气我可是杠杠的，提点重物全当锻炼了，哈哈。

晚上还收到教友带来的婚礼喜糖，真是要恭喜恭喜呀！又看到一对新人喜结连理，个个笑容满面，整个晚上都弥漫着喜庆的氛围。

吃着喜糖，心里也跟着甜蜜蜜，还给小姐妹留了几颗，她今晚有事没来排练，得知喜讯的她，开心得好似欢乐喜剧人，哈哈哈，也是一枚可爱的女生。。

OK，今天先分享到这儿哈，晚安，祝好梦。

**感谢大家的阅读和喜欢，您的点赞给予我莫大的鼓励，感恩❀**

body.title: War museum 1914-1945 of Montecchio Maggiore
body.body:
![1000038601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/245T1KN2WpUEAo2qpr4YitsCHEfUkNYc26qyNSYDUGPLP8zicgXm7cdbd5hDeeNVWbu8U.jpg)

For some time now my son has had a toy tank and he likes it, so I thought about how I could let him see a real one, so after some research I found a couple of museums in the region where you can see them up close. The first one we went to is the Museo 1914-1945 of Montecchio Maggiore, which from the website seemed promising. As soon as you enter the garden you come across the artillery park, there are many types and from different years, there is an Austro Hungarian train from the First World War and a couple of airplanes, as well as bombs recovered from various Second World War scenarios, standing near them was impressive because they are much bigger than a person and imagining them being dropped and exploding has a certain effect.

![1000038609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/244xq6FXH54EsbameYDPCcoh6c6kQPCJNGD4M9m3HRPtqJRo9dgdyrTW3S6VUe35tNFLf.jpg)

![1000038604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/2423qmtmjTaXMXAjCXmmoLGPZytiXpeyKMSk28cPptFpXKBMJ6M8kG4XC6XQvEt3YjX1j.jpg)

![1000038610.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/23wWyBy3KCriK4YJ4sdbrkBnygdcvcJmsSXwX7rF3sxDpvkSWHzZbcVwtNDrZvwrWy8FC.jpg)

![1000038611.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/23uQr59FF2cNURfWFFzztLZjjzwPuBTFgKo9PTWcZtwXbEeys4RJWRpnBxdkPBUtTPmFe.jpg)

![1000038608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/23qrBNNRvRDctMZWrdtYuwghpenYipsR2yT7YDi4YCTjdxW5Qp5NpQisPjYa2QrixnuPK.jpg)

Then you go inside the building, rich in collections of weapons and uniforms, the classic Lugers, rifles, bayonets, clubs used for hand to hand combat. There are also small vehicles, like motorcycles or ammunition transport carts


![1000038619.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/23xySmSY3XHgLZ3awx7wXDQKY6zxgZqMrr7DVimnaQ3DB5URoXwMQEBaoubNwJVcNNpou.jpg)

![1000038628.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/EpQvnxkJfohx2pAEVeHjMvB5FAkWM5fivMU9C7gufcyCoZv3acu8LbKLKoEk663AUAg.jpg)

![1000038627.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/23wqdv1zhYUANTTukiyyEov3VEcnmNAaVL6SHKRBFdxp7L4eT2rwDhKy43zdgHEYRELaP.jpg)

![1000038629.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/23xyX8TsyyzAi7CQvDZeH8BGhBtaJHbLeexcKMy4Tx7qZXJuH1NrHckAExVbTDuLKYp8n.jpg)

![1000038639.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/23u69FfxjULg5aQ5PysGrYiLyuXzwWv9Gex59YFGB3PRZbXNCoNhe2CWwdxrWdizbRaHs.jpg)


![1000038616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/23uFPqStNMyTokTFPrrAwFRQgwRK5UFq3dbGS5qp1zdF8frczCB3eEKEJq9CXf1ufBc1A.jpg)


A really beautiful part is the reconstructed trench of the First World War, a mountain environment of the Alps. Going inside makes you feel the tragedy experienced by attackers and defenders, among traps, barbed wire, machine guns... how those territories easily became zones of massacre, real meat grinders, I think many would not last long today in such a place

![1000038623.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/23xyXDKs8QY4zz3cykB7CBHFJK173XncMDrec82NnT4HiF9VqQeUEYJPvDMFAivZ6rQG9.jpg)

![1000038633.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/EpEHn11m7ApqeWVWt9JtXmr9RUKKbcLPvLfCoXiFmqRiFfeVrgMNENrNvuMiZkxTzxB.jpg)

![1000038630.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/23tvifxEue6LLmeWMgDxqJnR6vVvZ65kEtgAS7rYHThhvbAJwpWjCQ1GFT2LeTbGTePgq.jpg)

There was also a primary school report card from the fascist era, there was a subject that read today is almost funny “women’s work” for the girls, but also a subject that perhaps today would be good for kids, “respect for hygiene and personal cleanliness”

![1000038626.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/23wCL4YTEsDiSx28m8kTkkAjsirq2Bbr2jGiuLexULpBFK4K7cD7J8ugBE8xL5F3p9pWL.jpg)

But the highlight is the garage with the armored vehicles tanks, jeeps, armored vehicles, anti aircraft pieces... the first Italian tank made by Fiat, where you could also climb inside... all the vehicles were placed there without barriers or separators, you could get close as you liked, touch them, personally I threw a few punches around to feel the hardness and the armor

![1000038634.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/EpnBm4gf4MEMEgWztUmLwXKht3mnv6otbZnsgCudnqHgy4Qubp8v8FM5iYrGPRNTCQJ.jpg)

![1000038649.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/EogMpcKCyng7SFPDLGoLnyZwEhJZJqr2vCk8x6i2kE5wLuq76fCwFN9kwwERsZnmVPN.jpg)

![1000038652.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/23uFPUCspLWdWVxnhaQnotaC6sEnYV6QxXWbes3v7PyovfcJ8cdvhnmjUNB4zjNYWVp8o.jpg)

![1000038643.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/EowE92dWxGGKvjoUc64ULMMxsjwdY3A58Ybatbc9CGyysa3qSP3kaomFm22JhNLNUBF.jpg)

![1000038650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/23tvgJ7QX2YpUzoN1WSqLz8NpotJXzm5q9DhdpgEjdeihB58UbLsKM9ue6Ay6AVt6ncGf.jpg)

![1000038644.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/Eokd4T4Vei9WMJC5BPKMFmESviR1kZFcySLxQ1q5DLJTHou9shgNfT6oq7Gujj9iRKW.jpg)

![1000038645.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/EoGxtgSKL1TWXTwmUBD629431ZhQSvUPW4airC2Rw4rQNsFXfGiT9WyEpzEjiTD2Z36.jpg)

There was the possibility of a free guided tour, we could not do it because clearly a small child is not interested, and it is a pity because it was very interesting, but we will return when he is older. It is a museum that I really appreciated, very concrete, that lets you touch things with your hand, with many well kept pieces, it makes you appreciate peace and remember those who lived through difficult times making you realize that in war it really takes nothing to kill you. body.title: How to Select the Best Waste Removal Option for Projects
body.body:
## Introduction

Construction, renovation, landscaping, and clean-up require appropriate waste management. While the core work is frequently prioritised, waste management can affect productivity, safety, and success. Selecting the best waste collection method assures proper disposal, timeliness, and workspace organization.

Since projects create varied waste types and volumes, choosing the optimal solution can be difficult. Budget, location, environmental impact, and convenience all influence decisions. Knowing your options and project demands makes it easy to pick a waste removal strategy that promotes productivity and accountability.

### Understanding the Nature of Your Project Waste

Selecting a waste removal solution starts with understanding the sort of waste your project will generate. Different projects create building debris, household waste, green waste, or dangerous materials. All categories require specialised handling and disposal techniques to comply with rules and safety norms.

Understanding waste type helps estimate volume and weight. Some materials seem manageable but can soon amass and cause logistical issues. Recognising these elements early improves planning and saves project difficulties.

By identifying waste type and quantity, you may choose the best removal method. This stage prepares for project-related decision-making. For effective waste removal, seek help from [Skip Hire Altrincham](https://pinkskipsmanchester.co.uk/skip-hire-altrincham/).

### Evaluating Waste Volume and Project Scale

The type of disposal solution needed depends on project waste. Small initiatives may produce little waste, while bigger businesses may generate vast amounts that need regular control. Avoiding interruptions requires accurate volume assessment.

Estimating waste output helps choose a project-sized solution. If capacity is low, frequent removals may disrupt operations. Too big may underutilise resources, resulting in wasted costs. The appropriate balance enables seamless functioning.

The frequency of waste removal depends on project size. Larger projects may require continuous removal, whereas smaller ones may simply need periodic disposal. Matching the removal procedure to the project size improves efficiency and organization.

### Comparing Different Waste Removal Options

Various waste removal options are offered to [meet project](https://www.waivio.com/) needs. Some are adaptable, while others are high-capacity or long-term. Making the appropriate option requires understanding these distinctions.

Each strategy has pros and cons depending on the scenario. Some prioritise ease and speedy disposal, while others handle massive amounts over time. Assessing these possibilities depending on your project's demands assures the best choice.

Comparing also reveals limits. Understanding what each option can and cannot manage reduces the danger of picking a solution that may delay or inefficiently complete the project.

### Considering Budget and Cost Efficiency

Any project choice, including waste removal, depends on cost. Focusing on the lowest price might cause issues if the solution doesn't match project criteria. True cost efficiency comes from choosing a value-and-performance solution.

You must evaluate direct and indirect costs. Some options may seem reasonable, but they may require additional services or regular tweaks, increasing costs. Considering the entire cost structure improves decision-making.

Balancing price and functionality ensures the chosen solution maintains the project within budget. Waste management investments can avoid delays and lower costs if planned.

### Accessibility and Location Factors

Your project's location might affect the best waste removal method. Some solutions demand room or simple collection and disposal, thus accessibility is crucial.

Space constraints may limit options in urban regions, while distance and transportation may limit options in rural places. Consider these elements to guarantee the chosen solution is easy to apply.

Planning for accessibility prevents disturbances and streamlines waste collection. It keeps the project on track without logistical complications.

### Environmental Responsibility and Regulations

Modern projects must balance efficiency and sustainability. Following rules and minimising environmental damage is proper waste management. Choosing appropriate waste removal helps attain these aims.

Many materials may be recycled or treated sustainably. A strategy that supports these principles decreases landfill consumption and promotes sustainability. This method improves the environment and increases project accountability.

Equally crucial is regulatory compliance. Not following laws might lead to penalties and delays. Following waste management guidelines safeguards the project and its reputation.

### Convenience and Time Management

Waste management should help projects move forward since time is crucial. Waste disposal makes operations seamless and efficient, clearing items without interruptions.

Efficient waste management keeps workplaces tidy. This boosts productivity and lets teams work uninterrupted. Convenience streamlines waste management by reducing work.

Finding a waste removal option that fits the project timeframe streamlines operations. Integration helps sustain momentum and finish on schedule.

### Safety and Risk Management

Unmanaged waste can pose major safety risks. Sharp items, heavy waste, and dangerous materials can harm workers and the environment. Selecting the correct waste removal solution reduces these risks.

Regular removal and containment prevent accidents. Well-organised waste management prevents disruptions and safety issues. Always prioritise safety while planning waste management.

Addressing hazards early makes the workplace safer. This protects people and keeps the project running smoothly without safety hazards.

### Flexibility and Scalability of Services

Over time, projects and waste management demands change. Choose a flexible waste removal option for project alterations.

Large or long-term initiatives need scalability. Increasing or decreasing capacity as needed keeps waste management efficient throughout the project.

Flexible solutions provide more control and customisation. You can adapt to unforeseen changes without disturbing productivity, guaranteeing constant performance.

## Conclusion

waste type, volume, price, and location must be considered while choosing a waste removal solution for a project. Each decision affects waste management efficiency and responsibility.

A waste management strategy that promotes productivity and safety may be created by analysing choices and matching them with project goals. This method streamlines and improves project success.

Waste management becomes effortless with the correct plan, creating a cleaner, safer, and more organised workplace.

title.title: Mama @ 80: A Day Drenched in Love, Laughter, and Legacy 🌸
title.body:
![IMG-20260207-WA0014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23wWwEiVCHeYGQdgu4DLbX9nKEgi6mNrQDFKEgqcsCJF6x8Qf3xXATeyzF2ivHZJeiYeZ.jpg)

![macaron_1775376685157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23uFisjjjVEeVSrdyixUCxCqWuWgZh16FEYeLgWNa1o5LbzhgJVoyZMo23bcFZ7HY9AGB.jpg)

It was my grandmother’s 80th birthday celebration — and what a beautiful day it was.
As Mama clocked 80, it became more than just a birthday; it was a full celebration of love. All her children came from far and near just to be with her. Korede came in from Niger State, Gold flew down from Abuja, Nora made her way from Osun, Nife drove in from Ilorin, Felix arrived from Ibadan, Bukky came with her full crew from Kainji, and Tobi, the lastborn, also came from Ilorin. No one wanted to miss it.
We showed her love in the best way we knew how — through thoughtful gifts. Mama received beautiful attires in rich, vibrant colors. Ankara from Korede, lace from Gold, guinea brocade from Nora, aso-oke from Nife, a designer bubu from Felix, sequined lace from Bukky… and Tobi? Tobi completed the magic with matching shoes and a gele 😊
Mama had to change outfits three times because everyone wanted to see her shine in their own fabric.
The grandchildren had something special planned too. All 19 of us came together to create a large picture frame — a masterpiece filled with our photos, from the oldest to the youngest, all surrounding one big, radiant picture of Mama. As the first grandson, I had the honor of presenting it. The moment she received it, her eyes filled with tears. She gently touched every face in the frame, as though blessing each of us all over again.
We danced. We laughed. We played games — and yes, Mama joined the “pass the balloon” game… and she won!
The food? Oh, it was a feast of love. Jollof rice from Nora, pounded yam from Felix, ofada stew from Bukky, pepper soup from Korede, fried rice from Gold, amala from Nife, and small chops from Tobi… the table overflowed with goodness and joy.
There are seven children — Korede, Gold, Nora, Nife, Felix, Bukky, and Tobi — each carrying a piece of Mama’s love wherever they go.
Though our grandfather is no longer with us, Mama felt deeply loved. Still, in quiet moments between the laughter, you could see she missed him — especially when the old-school highlife songs played, the ones they used to dance to together. We held her close.
![IMG-20260408-WA0015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/EoGyTmYs8YTvjuFAueieTzPmYUxBVZ7BNpXXnzUgz47Ua1MGzj9XqJQY6TUPLrWU4RY.jpg)

![IMG-20260408-WA0011.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23w2q3vCALsQ5bBnGy1UtF6vSG3Mr5WDJ6RQ5VnYCDtBsJaQeYg8KTUdxAHFzaZy2MtaF.jpg)

“Daddy is smiling down from heaven,” Tobi whispered softly.
In blessed memory.
What a day… truly, what a day filled with love and beautiful memories.
Mama @ 80 wasn’t just a celebration — it was living proof that the love she poured into her children for 80 years has returned to her, multiplied through 19 grandchildren.
![20260406_172120.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23w2mFWwGPKGea3T3qtNzRdnkuWAxNPoViKNtEQcebwAundjLybhn1LLmgHs9NSnbKJgp.jpg)

And as we said our goodbyes, she kept repeating with a full heart,
“My cup is full. My cup is full.”
As we celebrate this beautiful milestone, we pray that the love she raised us with will never fade, but continue to grow stronger among us, now and always 🙏
![macaron_1775376685157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23uFisjjjVEeVSrdyixUCxCqWuWgZh16FEYeLgWNa1o5LbzhgJVoyZMo23bcFZ7HY9AGB.jpg)

![IMG-20260207-WA0014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23wWwEiVCHeYGQdgu4DLbX9nKEgi6mNrQDFKEgqcsCJF6x8Qf3xXATeyzF2ivHZJeiYeZ.jpg)

This sparked ethical, legal, and emotional debates. *** In this post I want to focus on what is truly valuable: the film as a work, its plot, its characters, its animation, and everything that fans have been waiting for for years. *** What is the movie about? The story begins several years after the end of Avatar: The Last Airbender, where our beloved Team Avatar is now adults, and although they have brought peace to the world, some wounds remain open.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTry7zbh19V7cb6os16nTMx4vGTtHFw5f1XWxWJB4LAkn/the_legend_of_aang_the_last_airbender_2026_1080p_.mp4_potplayer_28_4_2026_04_43_50.png)
The main plot revolves around Aang discovering the existence of an ancient and mystical power capable of bringing back the Air Nomads. Since the airbenders perished during the Fire Nation's attack, Aang has carried the guilt and loneliness of being the last of his people. This quest not only represents the return of his culture but also his chance to heal a spiritual wound that has haunted him for so long. Accompanied by Katara, Sokka, Toph, and Zuko, Aang embarks on a race against time to find this power before it falls into the wrong hands. And it won't be easy: a new and fearsome villain, Tagah, threatens to seize this very secret for his own purposes. *** One of the film's biggest draws is seeing how our favorite characters have matured. Without giving away any spoilers, I can say that:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcmjqzHbHAzN7nQLPkUAtHtXu9pYcaThpnP96PdpkGTzS/foto_de_aang.png)
•Aang is now an adult struggling to balance his responsibilities as the Avatar and husband, while also dealing with the pressure of being the last airbender.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUzDdsKzaGR6i7Jjzhj6biEib3V8CHTxqDvVkCqzrCtZd/foto_de_katara.png)
•Katara remains the emotional backbone of the group, but she's now also an accomplished bender and a respected leader in the newly founded Republic City.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmREY8TjjMqbsyrttgATgvu6zcnHbzi31ZnDd1hiHyd1mm/foto_de_soka.png)
• Sokka retains his wit and humor, but he's matured into a brilliant strategist in the Southern Water Tribe.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUwpjYgk3Jo9osFCLuJ16eXJozTFShLi2m1PvGUGrDukJ/foto_de_suko.png)
•Zuko is the Fire Lord, and although he's brought stability to his nation, he still carries the shadows of his past.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfJToR8GVCvKfv5tASWByZWfCZ9LRSFAFf4DTia4Xzb9G/foto_de_toph.png)
•Toph is still the toughest and funniest earthbender, but she's feeling bored (though she hasn't softened her character, much to everyone's relief).
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdqk1LcHRAeqzxskhCkhV7mpRPVdFfb4c9NznwsthLU4R/appa_y_momo.png)
And of course, Appa and Momo are there too, ready to make us smile more than once, as usual. *** Visually, the film is a feast for the eyes. Produced by Nickelodeon Movies and Avatar Studios, and animated by Flying Bark Productions (the studio behind The Legend of Korra and Moon Girl).
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSBdiUZVjaYP8VRaXWyi4hnuPmS9dX3pEHAJXYsVbBe9m/the_legend_of_aang_the_last_airbender_2026_1080p_.mp4_potplayer_28_4_2026_04_38_48.png)
The film respects the visual style of the original series but with impressive cinematic quality. It showcases exciting fight choreography in a dynamic and fluid manner, demonstrating masterful control of the elements. And its soundtrack maintains the essence of the traditional Asian music that characterized the series, with epic moments and others that are deeply emotional.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfUi2MNWKBTmAnTjVErySe18BjGqYNy8SvDKQ1VB1KxyZ/foto_para_mas.png)
*** Despite the leak, those of us who have seen it agree that it's the return it deserved. This film manages to capture and connect with the viewer in a way very similar to the original series, not only bringing us great moments of action and humor but also prompting us to discuss profound themes like forgiveness and hope, as has always been a hallmark of this franchise. This isn't just simple nostalgia; it's a continuation that respects its audience by maintaining what was established, but it also dares to grow, and that's what makes this film great. It shows us characters who have aged, and their personal conflicts and regrets have become more complex. They are no longer children saving the world, but adults trying to keep it at peace while dealing with their own lives.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXbMSCJQhf2zNKn9oiWGRdvtr9uDew5oBHgvAKKMtZnDy/the_legend_of_aang_the_last_airbender_2026_1080p_.mp4_potplayer_28_4_2026_02_45_58.png)
What do you think? Have you already seen it, or are you waiting until it's available on official channels? What are you expecting from this new adventure of Aang and his friends? *** ###

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbrF3wjqnRFurcyWfNq4xoBE1gy1KWwKHBSQ5bg4v4Lo/portada.png)
***

> Hace apenas unos días, se filtro completamente en internet The Legend of Aang: The Last Airbender la esperada película animada que continuaría la historia de la serie original. Esto desató debates éticos, legales y emocionales. *** En esta publicación quiero centrarme en lo realmente valioso: la película como obra, su trama, sus personajes, su animación y todo lo que los fans llevábamos años esperando. *** ¿De qué trata la película? La historia empieza varios años después del final de Avatar: La Leyenda de Aang, donde nuestro querido Equipo Avatar ya es adulto, y aunque han traído paz al mundo, aún hay heridas abiertas.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTry7zbh19V7cb6os16nTMx4vGTtHFw5f1XWxWJB4LAkn/the_legend_of_aang_the_last_airbender_2026_1080p_.mp4_potplayer_28_4_2026_04_43_50.png)
La trama principal gira en que Aang descubre la existencia de un poder ancestral y místico capaz de traer de vuelta a los Nómadas Aire. Desde la muerte de los maestros aire durante el ataque de la Nación del Fuego, Aang ha cargado con la culpa y la soledad de ser el último de su pueblo. Esta búsqueda no solo representa el regreso de su cultura, sino también su oportunidad para sanar una herida espiritual que lo ha atormentado durante tanto tiempo. Acompañado por Katara, Sokka, Toph y Zuko, Aang se embarca en una carrera contrarreloj para encontrar este poder antes de que caiga en manos equivocadas. Y es que no todo será sencillo: un nuevo y temible villano, Tagah, amenaza con apoderarse de ese mismo secreto para sus propios fines. *** Uno de los mayores atractivos de la película es ver cómo han madurado nuestros personajes favoritos. Sin spoilers, puedo adelantar que:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcmjqzHbHAzN7nQLPkUAtHtXu9pYcaThpnP96PdpkGTzS/foto_de_aang.png)
· Aang es ahora un adulto que lucha por equilibrar sus responsabilidades como Avatar y esposo, mientras lidia con la presión de ser el último maestro aire.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUzDdsKzaGR6i7Jjzhj6biEib3V8CHTxqDvVkCqzrCtZd/foto_de_katara.png)
· Katara sigue siendo la columna emocional del grupo, pero ahora también es una maestra consumada y una líder respetada en la recién fundada Ciudad República.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmREY8TjjMqbsyrttgATgvu6zcnHbzi31ZnDd1hiHyd1mm/foto_de_soka.png)
· Sokka conserva su ingenio y humor, pero ha madurado hasta convertirse en un estratega brillante en la tribu agua del sur.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUwpjYgk3Jo9osFCLuJ16eXJozTFShLi2m1PvGUGrDukJ/foto_de_suko.png)
· Zuko es el Señor del Fuego, y aunque ha traído estabilidad a su nación, aún carga con las sombras de su pasado.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfJToR8GVCvKfv5tASWByZWfCZ9LRSFAFf4DTia4Xzb9G/foto_de_toph.png)
· Toph sigue siendo la maestra tierra más ruda y divertida, pero se siente aburrida (aunque no ha suavizado su carácter, para alivio de todos).
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdqk1LcHRAeqzxskhCkhV7mpRPVdFfb4c9NznwsthLU4R/appa_y_momo.png)
Ademas de estar también Appa y Momo que nos harán sonreír en mas de una ocasión como de costumbre. *** Visualmente, la película es un festín para los ojos producida por Nickelodeon Movies y Avatar Studios, y animada por Flying Bark Productions (el estudio detrás de La leyenda de Korra y Moon Girl).
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSBdiUZVjaYP8VRaXWyi4hnuPmS9dX3pEHAJXYsVbBe9m/the_legend_of_aang_the_last_airbender_2026_1080p_.mp4_potplayer_28_4_2026_04_38_48.png)
El filme respeta el estilo visual de la serie original pero con una calidad cinematográfica impresionante. Mostrándonos emocionantes coreografías de lucha de una manera dinámica y fluidas, respetando las reglas de la maestría de los elementos. Y su banda sonora mantiene la esencia de la música tradicional asiática que caracterizó a la serie, con momentos épicos y otros profundamente emotivos.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfUi2MNWKBTmAnTjVErySe18BjGqYNy8SvDKQ1VB1KxyZ/foto_para_mas.png)
*** A pesar de la filtración quienes la hemos podido ver coincidimos en que es el regreso que merecía. Esta película logra capturar y conectar con el espectador de manera muy similar a la serie original, no solo trayéndonos grandes momentos de acción y humor sino también nos hace debatir en temas profundos como el perdón y la esperanza como siempre se ha caracterizado esta franquicia Esto no es simple nostalgia, es una continuación que respeta a su audiencia manteniendo lo establecido pero que se atreve a crecer y eso es lo que hace grande esta película mostrándonos personajes han envejecido y sus conflictos y arrepentimientos personales se han vuelto más complejos. Ya no son niños salvando el mundo, sino adultos tratando de mantenerlo en paz mientras lidian con sus propias vidas.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXbMSCJQhf2zNKn9oiWGRdvtr9uDew5oBHgvAKKMtZnDy/the_legend_of_aang_the_last_airbender_2026_1080p_.mp4_potplayer_28_4_2026_02_45_58.png)

title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbPGKuVCbSoA1mS1Rrs44hrrsxqZzrUnbiL4ebMgzndvY/1777378922255.png)

Hello blog friends, how are you? Yesterday I was a little busy, but today I'm back with a delicious recipe: a delicious pasta dish with zucchini, leeks, and gorgonzola (one of my favorite cheeses!) Of course, I'll leave you the recipe. 

To make this dish, you'll need: 

* 120 grams of pasta (I opted for penne, but you can also use fusilli or other types of pasta) 
* 1 medium zucchini 
* 60 grams of leek 
* 60 grams of gorgonzola
 * 3 tablespoons of fine salt 
* 6 tablespoons of olive oil 

First, prepare the leek: clean it thoroughly and remove any damaged outer leaves, then cut it into rounds and cook it in a pan with three tablespoons of oil for five minutes over low heat.

💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖

Hola, amigos del blog, ¿cómo están? Ayer estuve un poco ocupada, pero hoy les traigo una receta deliciosa: un plato de pasta con calabacín, puerro y gorgonzola (¡uno de mis quesos favoritos!).

 Por supuesto, les dejo la receta. Para preparar este plato, necesitarán:

 * 120 gramos de pasta (yo usé penne, pero también pueden usar fusilli u otro tipo de pasta) 
* 1 calabacín mediano
 * 60 gramos de puerro
 * 60 gramos de gorgonzola
 * 3 cucharadas de sal fina
 * 6 cucharadas de aceite de oliva 

Primero, preparen el puerro: límpienlo bien y retiren las hojas exteriores dañadas, luego córtelo en rodajas y cocínenlo en una sartén con tres cucharadas de aceite durante cinco minutos a fuego lento.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNY7KAraawdRrATatt7CJq2yRbjseRCwkdL7qi2xsRDT6/1777378922645.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma46Dn97amDLmtSBvwuafL21FTWTLHhrRNyt8CpomH2XA/1777378963510.jpg)

Next, prepare the zucchini: wash it thoroughly and cut it into rounds. Add it to the pan with the leek and cook everything together, stirring often, for about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare a pot of salted water and bring it to a boil. When it boils, add the pasta asta for the time indicated on the package, usually about ten minutes. When the pasta is ready, drain it well and return it to the pot. 

Then, take the gorgonzola and break it into small pieces. Add it to the hot pasta and stir well so that it melts and spreads evenly throughout the pasta. Then add the zucchini and leeks to the pot, stir everything together, and serve our delicious pasta with leeks, zucchini, and gorgonzola—super flavorful and delicious!

💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖💖

A continuación, prepara el calabacín: lávalo bien y córtalo en rodajas. Añádelo a la sartén con el puerro y cocina todo junto, removiendo con frecuencia, durante unos 20 minutos. Mientras tanto, prepara una olla con agua salada y ponla a hervir. Cuando hierva, añade la pasta asa durante el tiempo indicado en el paquete, normalmente unos diez minutos. 

Cuando la pasta esté lista, escúrrela bien y vuelve a ponerla en la olla. Luego, coge el gorgonzola y rómpelo en trozos pequeños. Añádelo a la pasta caliente y remueve bien para que se derrita y se distribuya uniformemente. Después, añade el calabacín y el puerro a la olla, remueve todo y sirve nuestra deliciosa pasta con puerros, calabacín y gorgonzola: ¡súper sabrosa y deliciosa!
