body.title: Aprende a controlar la ira  [SPA Vs ENG ]
body.body:
Saludos, amigos. ¿Cómo están? Espero que hoy tengan la mente y el ánimo mucho más controlados y que se sientan mucho más felices. Hoy quiero hablarles sobre cómo controlar la ira.

Hay muchas personas entre nosotros que se enojan con facilidad. Siempre están irritables por la ira. Si les decimos cosas buenas, se enojan. Si intentamos explicarles algo, siguen enojándose. No tienen la capacidad de distinguir entre el bien y el mal. Son personas muy irascibles y quienes tienen mal genio viven en el mundo como personas culpables ante todos. Porque si tenemos mal genio y mucha ira, arruinamos toda nuestra vida.



![photo-1533537841959-705741f3d3a5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/23y8v5sUfLGMzXnGchTLLCkLqxS2AhZwzy4koSscVyWAQmXwyMy9FQj5CUV9ukRoKq91u.jpeg)


[Fuente](https://unsplash.com/photos/painting-of-man-VBe9zj-JHBs)



Todos deseamos llevar una vida feliz y tranquila. En el transcurso de nuestra vida, a veces nos enfrentamos a diversas situaciones difíciles. Muchas veces, tenemos la capacidad de manejarlas con facilidad. Cuando se nos presentan dificultades, podemos superarlas con inteligencia y conocimiento. Pero a veces la situación se vuelve aún más terrible. No podemos resolver nuestros problemas solo con nuestra mente y conocimiento. Entonces nos enojamos y nos frustramos.

Debemos tener presente algo: la vida se compone de situaciones buenas y malas. Si solo existiera el bien en el mundo, no podríamos comprender el problema del mal. De igual manera, si solo existiera el mal en todas partes, no podríamos apreciar el bien. El Creador ha creado nuestra vida de dos maneras: buena y mala. Por lo tanto, debemos adaptarnos a ambas.

Es natural que a veces surjan situaciones difíciles en nuestro camino. Entonces, nos enojamos y empeoramos la situación, pero esto no debería suceder. Cuando una palabra entra en nuestra mente y el cerebro no la acepta, nuestra ira surge automáticamente. Debido a la ira excesiva, a veces rompemos los muebles de nuestra casa. Bajo la presión de la ira, insultamos a los demás y causamos dolor y sufrimiento a nuestros seres queridos. En resumen, si no podemos controlar la ira, nuestra vida fracasará y todo en ella se desmoronará.






![ChatGPT Image Apr 28, 2026, 05_49_11 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/23tbML7osbMpoXzFViczCo72W1uVGHL335x92Kqi74ziaAgcrGHXpdh6bw2NpP8BTxjh5.png)


> Imagen creada con chatgpt


Muchas veces, nuestra situación empeora. Nos enojamos con facilidad y perdemos el control de nuestra ira, lo que provoca que dañemos lo que nos rodea.

Hay muchas personas que se enojan con mucha facilidad y, cuando lo hacen, destrozan todos los muebles de la casa. Rompen los muebles y, en algún momento, se calman. Cuando su mente se tranquiliza, se dan cuenta de que todo lo hicieron por ira. Tendrán que volver a comprar todos los muebles, lo que les ocasionará pérdidas económicas.

En definitiva, la ira es lo peor del mundo. Por eso, debemos aprender a controlarla. A veces, nuestra mente se descontrola y nos impide actuar con normalidad. Debido a este descontrol, insultamos a alguien y destrozamos los muebles. Insultar a alguien arruina nuestra relación. Y cuando rompemos los muebles, tenemos que volver a comprarlos con nuestro propio dinero. ¿Qué opinas de las consecuencias?


Todo lo que hacemos con ira nos perjudica. Por un lado, rompemos relaciones; por otro, sufrimos pérdidas económicas. Además, he visto a muchas personas suicidarse por ira. Y el suicidio es un gran pecado contra la vida humana.

¿Qué podemos hacer entonces?

Solo hay una cosa que hacer. Si alguna vez nos enojamos mucho, debemos controlar nuestra ira. Debemos recordar que la ira es pasajera. El problema que nos enfureció no permanecerá en nuestras vidas para siempre. Es posible resolverlo rápidamente. En situaciones difíciles, si intentamos resolverlas con calma y con conocimiento de causa, en lugar de enojarnos, el problema se solucionará. ¿Por qué enojarnos innecesariamente y perjudicarnos económicamente? Así que intentemos controlar la ira. La ira nunca trae ningún beneficio a nuestras vidas. Controlemos la ira y cuidémonos.


***



![18.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/EoAUXZjGAPyY3oMMK4f3oHgNhH1gR25mTMmu7pBuiWx6a2eAfCbUiUbmkLz3qgzSuJv.png)


### ***Read the English version***



Greetings friends. How are you all? I hope that today your brain and mood are much more under control and you are much happier. Today I want to talk to you about controlling anger. 

There are many people among us who are very angry. They are always hot because of anger. When we say good things to them, they get angry. If we try to explain something to them, they still get angry. They do not have the ability to understand good or bad. They are very angry people and those who have a bad temper have to live in the world as guilty people to everyone. Because if we have a bad temper and we have a lot of anger, it ruins our whole life.




![photo-1533537841959-705741f3d3a5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/23y8v5sUfLGMzXnGchTLLCkLqxS2AhZwzy4koSscVyWAQmXwyMy9FQj5CUV9ukRoKq91u.jpeg)


[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/painting-of-man-VBe9zj-JHBs)




We all want to lead a happy and peaceful life. While leading our life, we sometimes have to face various difficult situations. Many times we have the ability to deal with difficult situations very easily. When difficult situations come to us, we can overcome our difficult situations with intelligence and knowledge. But sometimes the situation becomes more terrible with us. We cannot solve our problems with our brain and knowledge alone. Then we get upset and we get angry. 

We have to keep one thing in mind. Life is made up of good and bad situations. If there was good everywhere in the world, we would not be able to understand the issue of evil. Again, if there was bad everywhere, we would not be able to appreciate the good. The Creator has created our life in two ways, good and bad. So we have to adapt to good and bad together. 

It is natural that sometimes difficult situations will arise with us in the path of life. So we will get angry and make our situation worse, this can never happen. When a word enters our brain and the brain does not accept it, our anger rises automatically.  Due to excessive anger, we sometimes break the furniture in our house. Under the pressure of anger, we insult people and cause sorrow and pain to our loved ones. Basically, if we cannot control anger, our life will fail and everything in our life will end.




![ChatGPT Image Apr 28, 2026, 05_49_11 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/23tbML7osbMpoXzFViczCo72W1uVGHL335x92Kqi74ziaAgcrGHXpdh6bw2NpP8BTxjh5.png)

> Image made with chatgpt 



Many times the situation with us gets worse. We get angry a lot and we lose the ability to control our anger. Due to which we hurt the things around us. 

There are many people among us who are extremely angry. They get angry very easily and when they get angry they break all the furniture in the house. They break the furniture in the house and at one point they calm down. When their brain calms down, they realize that they have done everything out of anger. They will have to buy all the furniture in the house from the market again. And for this they will have to face financial losses again. 

Basically, the worst thing in this world is anger. So we have to learn the technique of controlling our anger. Sometimes our brain gets disturbed in the way of walking in the world. Due to the disturbed brain, we say insulting words to someone and break the furniture in the house. Because of insulting someone, our relationship with him gets ruined. And when we break the furniture in the house, then we have to buy that furniture again by spending money from our own pockets.  What do you think of the results?



All the things we do in anger cause us harm. On the one hand, we break relationships, on the other hand, we face financial losses. Moreover, I have seen many people who even commit suicide in anger. And suicide is a great sin for human life. 

So what can we do? 

There is only one thing to do here. If we ever get very angry, then we must control it. We have to remember one thing, anger is temporary. The problem that made us angry will not remain in our lives forever. It is possible to solve that problem very quickly. In difficult situations, if we try to solve it with a cool head and with our knowledge instead of getting angry, then the problem will be solved. Why should we get angry unnecessarily and cause ourselves and our financial losses? So let us try to control anger. Anger can never bring any benefit in our lives. So let us control anger and keep ourselves safe.

body.title: Sniper Elite V2 [Let's Play] - 03 - Russian Tank on Bridge
body.body:
***I think the game soft-locked near the end there... I'm glad the checkpoint wasn't far off...***

----

**Sniper Elite V2** is a Stealth Third-Person Shooter that follows a sniper's mission to stop a German mass destruction weaponry from going off during WWII. **This game is Fun!** The most standout feature is the Bullet-time moments when you snipe a critical hit on enemies.

  https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTPsLTXJajbkz89a6ZS1g5oWMaFKaFjDisG93CbLyBwWz/Sniper_Elite_V2_cover_D.webp 

I had *Sniper Elite V2* in my backlog for a long time, and I wish I played it sooner.

The game is different from the usual World War II game in that the main character is a sniper, and most of the game is about stealth and/or shooting from distance. There's enough variety in gameplay to not feel stale. I played on Easy Mode, yet I still found it somewhat challenging. Though I managed to beat the whole game without a guide.

The game has you fight both Germans and Russians, while gathering information or inflitrating enemy bases. The V2 in the title refers to the German weapon that the Sniper Elite must stop.

Watch my playthrough below:

body.title: Ritmo bajo el agua | Historia [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
> ![aguaa.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdjWjc5pmXw69Csgfyms3Vji4vT6jXWURa6z5GFk5k3Fq/aguaa.jpg) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/hombre-persona-gafas-de-sol-sentado-7348659/) El estudio de Holozing luego de hacer la tercera batalla en el desierto, todo era distinto, más ideas, nuevas expectativas e incluso las pantallas seguían encendidas, ya que lo que venía no era una prueba más, era la última batalla en un escenario muy esperado, donde ambas criaturas seguro se iban a defender, por el mismo hecho de ser agua. Apareció un océano inmenso, profundo, en constante movimiento con corrientes fuerte, remolinos, lluvia. Este era el escenario más complicado, por eso el sonido también cambió era más denso, más envolvente. Allí apareció WUZING, con mucha fuerza, además su armadura ya no brillaba como en el desierto; ahora reflejaba ondas y el agua resbalaba. Su música lo acompañaba y cada nota parecía empujar el agua a su alrededor, generando como especie de un escudo. ZINGUINI apareció segundo después deslizándose entre las corrientes, aprovechando el agua y la lluvia para esconderse. Su música era la misma aguda, ligera de esas que transmiten seguridad. Este nuevo escenario no favorecía a ninguno, por eso tenía que exigirse, moverse rápido y aprovechar cada segundo en la batalla. >After Holozing’s studio completed the third battle in the desert, everything was different—more ideas, new expectations, and even the screens remained lit, since what was coming wasn’t just another test; it was the final battle in a highly anticipated setting, where both creatures were sure to defend themselves, simply because they were made of water. # >A vast, deep ocean appeared, in constant motion with strong currents, whirlpools, and rain. This was the most challenging setting, which is why the sound also changed—it was denser, more immersive. There appeared WUZING, with great force; moreover, his armor no longer shone as it had in the desert; now it reflected waves, and the water slid off it. His music accompanied him, and each note seemed to push the water around him, creating a sort of shield. # >ZINGUINI appeared a second later, gliding through the currents, using the water and rain to hide. His music was the same high-pitched, light kind that conveys a sense of security. This new setting didn’t favor either of them, so he had to push himself, move fast, and make the most of every second in the battle. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPgiALTeXTSouCzoxG1oA6qfVo2HotvreAVRkptFi3sTg/image.png) [Source](https://peakd.com/hive-131131/@holozing/a-new-capturable-type-enters-our-roster) Todos en el estudio observando, hasta que comenzó la batalla y el primero en moverse fue WUZING, pero el agua le impidió moverse con rapidez, sin embargo, cada movimiento era pesado, pero firme. Mientras que ZINGUINI aprovecho la corriente para avanzar, y eso confundió a WUZING, puesto que las corrientes cambiaban de dirección, como el ritmo de su canción. Se notó un primer choque en la batalla, donde WUZING lanzó una onda directa, que desplazó el agua con violencia. Pero ZINGUINI no lo bloqueó, simplemente se sumergió y al salir del agua tomó impulso y devolvió el ataque. El golpe no fue tan fuerte porque WUZING creó una barrera de presión sonora y solo lo hizo retroceder, mientras que la corriente y la lluvia seguía allí. La batalla escaló, donde WUZING cerró los ojos, su música cambió, para cambiar de hacer movimientos rígidos, a comenzar a moverse con el agua, y así lograr que con cada gesto generar corrientes suaves. ZINGUINI lo notó y por eso se lanzó de una, sin embargo, WUZING activó todo y las corrientes que había generado fueron tantas que atraparon a ZINGUINI en el centro, siendo la trampa perfecta. Por un segundo, parecía el final, sin embargo, ZINGUINI no escapó con fuerza, sino con técnica, ya que ajustó su cuerpo, se alineó con la corriente y en lugar de resistir, se dejó llevar exactamente por el punto más débil del vórtice y salió, donde WUZING, no se esperaba eso y ambas criaturas se detuvieron, el agua se calmó y la pantalla se apagó. >Everyone in the studio was watching, until the battle began and WUZING was the first to move, but the water prevented him from moving quickly; nevertheless, each movement was heavy yet steady. Meanwhile, ZINGUINI used the current to advance, and this confused WUZING, since the currents kept changing direction, just like the rhythm of his song. # >The first clash of the battle was evident, as WUZING launched a direct wave that violently displaced the water. But ZINGUINI didn’t block it; he simply submerged himself, and as he broke the surface, he gathered momentum and returned the attack. The blow wasn’t that strong because WUZING created a sound pressure barrier, and it only forced him back, while the current and the rain remained. # >The battle escalated, and WUZING closed his eyes; his music changed, shifting from rigid movements to moving with the water, thereby generating gentle currents with every gesture. ZINGUINI noticed this and lunged at him, but WUZING activated everything, and the currents he had generated were so numerous that they trapped ZINGUINI in the center, creating the perfect trap. # >For a second, it seemed like the end; however, ZINGUINI didn’t escape with brute force, but with technique, as he adjusted his body, aligned himself with the current, and instead of resisting, let himself be carried exactly through the vortex’s weakest point and emerged. WUZING hadn’t expected that, and both creatures stopped; the water calmed, and the screen went dark. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNg51KVQrFMfrJXYbaKxBV7uJ2bviAUPUYBsEjVYMpJ6K/image.png) [Source](https://peakd.com/hive-131131/@holozing/december-2025-advent-calender-and-new-beta-starter-creature-reveal) Nadie en el estudio aplaudió, pero el empresario fue el primero en hablar:—Ya no están compitiendo, están evolucionando igual que el juego. Horas después, todo el equipo sacó sus conclusiones de esos cuatro escenarios, donde WUZING en el desierto resistió, en el océano escuchó. Mientras que ZINGUINI aprendió a esperar. Eso fue el final de esa prueba, pero a ahora querían llevar esto al siguiente nivel y colocar tres criaturitas en los escenarios, ya estudiado. Donde cada una tendrá que adaptarse y así poder batallar. Claudio murmuró:—Entonces ya no serán batallas. El empresario contestó la pregunta no era quién ganaría, sino qué serían capaces de crear juntos. >No one in the studio clapped, but the producer was the first to speak: “They’re no longer competing; they’re evolving just like the game.” Hours later, the whole team drew their conclusions from those four scenarios, where WUZING held its ground in the desert and listened in the ocean, while ZINGUINI learned to wait. # >That was the end of that test, but now they wanted to take this to the next level and place three little creatures in the scenarios they had already studied. Where each one would have to adapt in order to battle. Claudio muttered, “Then they won’t be battles anymore.” The businessman replied that the question wasn’t who would win, but what they would be able to create together.

body.body:
Buen día, querida amiga @avdesing.

Debe ser precioso vivir en una ciudad con tanta historia, y al recorrer sus calles es como viajar en el tiempo.

Hermosa y llamativa es la construcción del convento. Es admirable que lo hayan incautado y restaurado; la chimenea es realmente imponente.
Es impresionante este complejo histórico; como bien dices, hay mucho trabajo de restauración para su conservación. El edificio es realmente hermoso de ver en el estado en que está; todas sus huellas son parte de la historia.

Muchas gracias por compartir esta hermosa experiencia de visita y su importancia histórica.      

Good morning, dear friend @avdesing.

It must be wonderful to live in a city with so much history, and walking its streets is like traveling back in time.

The convent's architecture is beautiful and striking. It's admirable that it was seized and restored; the chimney is truly imposing.

This historical complex is impressive; as you rightly say, a great deal of restoration work has gone into its preservation. The building is truly beautiful to see in its current state; every trace of it is part of history.

Thank you so much for sharing this wonderful visit and its historical significance.

body.body:
The day we understand that God is the creator of our life and he can take it from us whenever he wants, that's the day we begin to believe in God. God is recognised in the bible as the creator of heaven and earth. When we look at the order of creation and the gift of life itself, it points to a wise and intentional Designer. 

*The bible reminds us, “The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork” (Psalm 19:1)*

God wants to build a personal relationship with us. The Bible shows that God is not distant but loving, merciful, and involved in human affairs. Through His Word and through Jesus Christ, He reveals His character and invites us into fellowship with Him. 

*“But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us” (Romans 5:8).*

The film's premiere has been delayed by a year and is now scheduled for October 15, 2027. Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz will once again star. https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/news/2124894-the-mummy-4-release-date-moved-up-for-brendan-fraser-sequel

https://www.comingsoon.net/movies/news/2124954-miami-vice-85-release-date-delayed-michael-b-jordan

[Hazbin Hotel]
The series will end after five seasons. I just hope that Season 2 was just a one-off mistake that won't happen again in the future. I watched it with a smile on my face, but some of the storylines were spoiled. In fact, I'm sure that if I rewatch it, I'll call it a disappointment.

Damn, I thought this spin-off had a natural ending, but it turned out it was canceled. >Tempus fugit is a Latin phrase that translates to \

(it escapes, irretrievable time), it acts as a reminder that time passes swiftly and inexorably. This phrase is frequently used to warn against wasting time or to lament the rapid passing of life.

It's also the title of an X-files episode (season 4, episode 17) which was what inspired me to look up the phrase. It's a really great episode that is part of the overall mythology of the show and features someone who gets abducted from a plane. The plane crashes and it's discovered that the passengers all have 90 minutes of missing time on their wrist watches. 

If you haven't watched all 10 million hours of the x-files you definitely should!

body.body:

<center>
![lBxxJg6TCJLj7XFu_IMG20260427180152.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/aellly/images/lBxxJg6TCJLj7XFu_IMG20260427180152/lBxxJg6TCJLj7XFu_IMG20260427180152.webp)

![vW0qu4vve4Jc2zX1_IMG20260427180145.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/aellly/images/vW0qu4vve4Jc2zX1_IMG20260427180145/vW0qu4vve4Jc2zX1_IMG20260427180145.webp)
![fwA15ozNicNue6uw_IMG20260427180117.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/aellly/images/fwA15ozNicNue6uw_IMG20260427180117/fwA15ozNicNue6uw_IMG20260427180117.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

这两天上班的时候精神非常的萎靡。不是说我身体虚了，还是咋的了？
而是这两天被一个新来的同事整的举手投降。差不多黑眼圈都擦不出来了。
有句俗话是这样说的，林子大了，什么鸟都有。这一句话可不是开玩笑，真的是有道理。

前几天新来了一个同事他长相还是挺斯文的。看起来还是蛮好的一个形象。
刚好我们宿舍睡了三个人，还有一张床位就让他睡。凑到1块4个人刚好。
但人不可貌相，大海不可斗量。这位新来的同事，大大的超乎了我的意料。

第一天晚上睡觉的时候，他还是蛮老实的一个。给我留下了一个非常好的印象。
第二天晚上就说梦话了。说了啥，倒是没有听清楚。不过后面很明显是在骂人。
之所以能够听得这么清楚，是因为他说的跟我一样是潮州话。大致意思是：cnmb. 

而且吼的非常大声，一下子就把我们其他三个人给吼起来抽烟了。
看到他是在说梦话，我们就原谅了也没办法，人家又不是故意的。
但是我们想的太简单了。第三个晚上，还有第四个晚上就开始来活了。

第三个晚上他就直接在床上乱踢乱摆，而且那个床板砸的砰砰响。
搞得我们三个都坐起来看他在耍猴。说实话，当时还真的被他吓到了。
最后他是从床上掉下来之后醒过来，看着我们几个在看着他。

然后第四天晚上他又来床上打拳。乒乒乓乓的，搞得像地震似的。
哪怕是富士山爆发都没这么响的声音，还有这么大的动静。这响声绝对跟东风41有的一拼。
搞得我这几天一直都睡不好，上班的时候一点精神都没有。真的遭罪。

---

body.body:
Unsere neue DJI Osmo Pocket 4 ist angekommen.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYCUwzLuyG6B8SP1zvGvAXq5YX3Teh7jrYx1CyPtvHuri/img_4810.jpg)

Bei unserem letzten großen mobilen Setup auf der TRANSFORM haben wir gemerkt, dass wir keine vernünftigen B-Rolls gemacht haben und der Aufwand jetzt da eine zweite Kamera, also eine große Kamera, mit aufzubauen, fanden wir dann doch ein bisschen zu viel Aufwand und nimmt auch noch mal extra Platz weg￼. 

Da einer unserer Gäste seine DJI Osmo mitgebracht hatte und die parallel bei uns im Bus aufgestellt hatte, war ich von der Bildqualität und den Abmassen beeindruckt. ￼ Da wir für verschiedene andere Setup sowieso die DJI Mic Mini benutzen und die kompatibel sind, war das ein weiterer Grund, die mal auszuprobieren.

Wir werden dann mal die Tage in unseren Bus gehen und ein paar Testaufnahmen machen. Nicht dass ich unser großes Setup in Zukunft nicht mehr nutzen möchte. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUtcsbU1JDTrfQonCSgFXvrZFi2RCUaDzU6ggUWUGVk3q/img_4528.jpg)


Aber für eventuell schnelle Drehs mit trotzdem guter Qualität kann das durchaus eine Alternative sein. Aber schauen wir uns erst mal die Qualität an und dann werden wir darüber in Ruhe planen. 

Seitdem die KI auch schon viel machen kann und Adobe Podcast ein cooles Tool ist, stellt sich sowieso die Frage, ist in Zukunft ein großes Tonstudio immer noch eine sichere Bank oder können auch kleine günstige Lösung mit KI Nachbearbeitung das selbe liefern ??? aber das ist sicherlich eine philosophische Frage.

body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdtChMzXWvgbkTmEwke5x39FQ55CkHp4b77299B7nLAtS/PXL_20240324_163252376.webp)

---------------------------------

The Tiffin Dragons softball team went three out of four over the weekend to clinch their spot at the top of the rankings in the G-MAC conference.  Once again the Dragons are the regular season champions as they head into the post season.  This is a really big deal for Tiffin as they are now about four years into a rebuild after their new coach took the reigns.  It was a bit bumpy at first until the coach was able to build a team that was wholly her own.  I think she appears to know what she is doing!  

Although my niece no longer plays for the team, she still stays in touch with the players and she has to go back every now and then for class, so she tries to keep up with them as best she can. 

Tiffin started on Saturday with a sweep of Walsh University for senior day 7 to 1 and then 9 to 3.  On Sunday, they dropped their first game to University of Findlay 6 to 2, but then they were able to bounce back and win the last game 3 to 2.  

That sets us up for the G-MAC tournament that starts up tomorrow believe it or not!

As I said, Tiffin finished the regular season on top of the G-MAC with a conference record of 20 wins and 4 losses.  That left Ohio Dominican right below them at 19-5 on the season.  Then we have Ashland and Findlay close behind at 18-6 for both teams.  

Only the top eight teams get to play in the tournament, so that leaves Malone, Thomas More, Walsh, Kentucky Wesleyan, and Lake Erie on the outside looking in.

As I said, the conference tournament starts up tomorrow and as the number 1 seed in the conference, Tiffin is going to face off against the number 8 seed Cedarville.  The conference tournament should be a double elimination format, so even if Tiffin struggles a little bit, they won't be out of the the running right away.

Personally, I think they are going to run the tournament, but time will tell.  They have a strong team with some amazing hitting and some really good pitching.  I can't wait to see how it all plays out.  If they win the tournament, they should get to play in the Division II national tournament.

body.title: Toradora! – Anime Review (2008) [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
>I've been featuring anime from the 2000s lately, but it's never a bad idea to revisit them. This time, I'm bringing back one that was very popular back in the day. It's still being recommended, and that's why I'm revisiting it, because it's the kind of story where you feel the characters grow and become attached to them. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-28_074241_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23yTgwUMeH6daptoZUXZiLY52kbAFvxXMA8Tp3qcuCEvPdW5pVhhaRBLZPKSawC5bWpSw.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1279024/mediaviewer/rm2948642305/?ref_=ttmi_mi_58_1) ---

>Released in 2003, directed by Tatsuyuki Nagai and produced by J.C.Staff, this romantic comedy-drama series was created by Yuyuko Takemiya and consisted of 25 episodes, plus an OVA and 4 specials. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-28_074856_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23yx459YRLwvutsMp7GSttzvkwCFytNMvDUsYATYuEc9xmbbvFT9NRxpi7iue6vsM2Qsz.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1279024/mediaviewer/rm1990838785/?ref_=ttmi_mi_50_1) ---

>The story follows Ryūji and Taiga, two teenagers burdened by social labels that don't fit them: he looks like a delinquent, but he's a gentle, home-loving boy, while she looks like a fragile doll, but she's a fierce and solitary young woman. They discover they live next door to each other and, through a mix-up with a love letter, realize that each is in love with the other's best friend, leading them to form an alliance to achieve their romantic goals. ---

>As ​​the days go by, this collaboration forces them to share much of their time, revealing their vulnerabilities, their complicated family situations, and their true personalities behind the school facade. Looking out for each other, they create a warm and close dynamic, learning to accept each other as they are and accepting each other in their essence. Will they be able to declare their love to those they love? Will there be more between them than just an alliance and friendship? ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-28_075024_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/Ep5oc8SrohSALB5T32oYLF9YyN4Htt3J5qnZgAx22Rmuc1ehEA7WXKMHRBZBKm3dHYq.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1279024/mediaviewer/rm1482212353/?ref_=ttmi_mi_49_1) ---

>Personally, I really liked the characters. It wasn't a groundbreaking story, nor was it particularly technical or masterful, but the dynamic between the characters was definitely captivating, especially how it addressed the fact that no one is who they seem at first glance. No matter how perfect someone appears, there will always be a crack, and those you perceive as dangerous shouldn't be judged by their appearance, as they might be the most loyal. That's what our protagonists convey and truly are; in short, it manifests that duality of projected identity versus real identity. I feel that the pacing of the plot also helps you understand these themes. It begins with almost cartoonish slapstick humor, but as the characters shed their social \
the narrative becomes dense, melancholic, and profoundly human. ---

>Adding to that, it not only presents the evolution of its characters, but also establishes a psychological basis for their actions, which deepens the viewer's connection with the character they are watching. The animation isn't my favorite, but it's passable and dynamic, especially in projecting the characters' emotions. The colors are vibrant yet warm, which reinforces that sense of \

that Ryūji creates for Taiga. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-28_075056_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23x18qQxYYrqX2CekxzHpoDHax4yfBYpF1Gj4R3YEgA5YJs86cpuNtW2C6xhxVPzDqw2s.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1279024/mediaviewer/rm951867904/?ref_=ttmi_mi_3) ---

> - Organic Character Development: The characters aren't static; they evolve, allowing us to see them grow from their imperfections. - Archetype Subversion: It takes clichés (the aggressive girl, the tough guy, the perfect idol) and gives them real psychological depth. It explains the reasons behind their behavior, humanizing them. - Narrative Balance: It handles the transition from physical comedy to existential drama very well. - Relevant Supporting Characters: The friends aren't just decorative. Their motivations and their own pain directly affect the main plot, creating a complex and realistic network of relationships. - The plot has closure, which is highly valued; it doesn't leave us hanging. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-28_075124_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/243fzqz9hqhxdS6DfFeVf7grqDK5TFHaEQrAboRYsBC588kZpVVnhuifBB4UGPzBsdaoP.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1279024/mediaviewer/rm2730187264/?ref_=ttmi_mi_3_2) ---

> - In certain episodes, I feel it goes overboard with the comedy, but that's a matter of personal taste. - The beginning is a bit slow. - Rushed Resolution: Although the ending is conclusive, the last two or three episodes unfold at a breakneck pace compared to the calm of the rest of the series, which may leave some viewers feeling that it needed a bit more of a finale. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-28_075218_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23w2qGx42aB7AfxBRAfVB27ibGSEKtH7zGrngodoxvJLKCkj6ptx9fkq8FqYvKRs9nX2h.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1279024/mediaviewer/rm2313995521/?ref_=ttmi_mi_34_1) ---
>9/10 Story │ 8/10 Animation │ 8/10 Sound │ 8.4/10 Character Design │ 8.5/10 Overall ---

>Toradora! is a structurally sound work. Its greatest strength lies in understanding that teenage love is chaotic, selfish, and painful, but also necessary for growth. I think the anime's strongest point is that it develops its characters and provides a satisfying ending, giving us that ending where each character has grown emotionally. ---

<center>

# ESPAÑOL</center>

---

<div class=\

>He estado trayendo puros animes de los 2000, pero nunca es malo recordarlos, en esta oportunidad vengo con uno que fue muy querido en su momento, bueno, aun siguen recomendándolos y por ese motivo, vuelvo a rememorarlo, porque es ese tipo de historia en donde sientes el crecimiento de sus personajes y que te encariñas con los mismos. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-28_074241_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23yTgwUMeH6daptoZUXZiLY52kbAFvxXMA8Tp3qcuCEvPdW5pVhhaRBLZPKSawC5bWpSw.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1279024/mediaviewer/rm2948642305/?ref_=ttmi_mi_58_1) ---

>Estrenado para el año 2003, bajo la dirección de Tatsuyuki Nagai y del estudio de animación J.C.Staff, su creador es Yuyuko Takemiya y esta historia de comedia romántica y drama tuvo un total de 25 episodios, más un Ova, más 4 especiales. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-28_074856_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23yx459YRLwvutsMp7GSttzvkwCFytNMvDUsYATYuEc9xmbbvFT9NRxpi7iue6vsM2Qsz.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1279024/mediaviewer/rm1990838785/?ref_=ttmi_mi_50_1) ---
> # En cuanto a la trama… ---

>La historia sigue a los jóvenes Ryūji y Taiga, dos adolescentes que cargan con etiquetas sociales que no les corresponden: él parece un delincuente, pero es un chico hogareño y gentil, mientras que ella parece una muñeca frágil, pero es una joven feroz y solitaria. Ambos descubren que viven uno al lado del otro y, por un error con una carta de amor, se dan cuenta de que cada uno está enamorado del mejor amigo del otro, propiciando que formen una alianza entre ellos y así cumplir sus objetivos en el amor. ---

>A medida que pasan los días, esta colaboración los obliga a compartir gran parte de su tiempo, revelando sus vulnerabilidades, sus complicadas situaciones familiares y sus verdaderas personalidades detrás de la fachada escolar, uno cuidando del otro, volviendo esta dinámica bastante cálida y cercana, aprendiendo aceptarse cada uno como es y aceptando al otro, tal cual es su esencia ¿Serán capaces de declarar su amor a quienes aman? ¿Existirá en ellos más que una alianza y amistad? ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-28_075024_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/Ep5oc8SrohSALB5T32oYLF9YyN4Htt3J5qnZgAx22Rmuc1ehEA7WXKMHRBZBKm3dHYq.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1279024/mediaviewer/rm1482212353/?ref_=ttmi_mi_49_1) ---

>En lo personal, me gustaron muchos sus personajes, no era una historia del otro mundo y algo sumamente técnico y magistral, pero la dinámica de un personaje con otro, atraída definitivamente, sobre todo, como abarcan el hecho de que nadie parece lo que es a simple vista, ya que por mucho que veas perfecto a alguien, siempre habrá una grieta, y que aquellos que ves peligrosos, no los juzgues por su portada, ya que pueden llegar a ser los más leales y eso es lo que nuestros protagonistas transmiten y son realmente, en pocas palabras, manifiesta esa dualidad de identidad proyectada vs identidad real. Siento que el ritmo de la trama, también propicia a que entiendas estos temas, comienza con un humor slapstick casi caricaturesco, pero a medida que los personajes se quitan las \
sociales, la narrativa se vuelve densa, melancólica y profundamente humana. ---

>Agregando que, no solo nos presenta esa evolución de sus personajes, también entablan una base psicológica del porque su actuar, lo cual vuelve más profunda la relación del espectador con el personaje que está viendo. La animación no es que es mi favorita, pero es pasable y dinámica, sobre todo al proyectar las emociones de sus personajes, los colores son vibrantes pero cálidos, lo que refuerza esa sensación de \

que Ryūji construye para Taiga. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-28_075056_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23x18qQxYYrqX2CekxzHpoDHax4yfBYpF1Gj4R3YEgA5YJs86cpuNtW2C6xhxVPzDqw2s.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1279024/mediaviewer/rm951867904/?ref_=ttmi_mi_3) ---

> - Desarrollo de Personajes Orgánico: No son estáticos, existe una evolución y que permite verlos crecer desde la imperfección. - Subversión del Arquetipo: Toma clichés (la chica agresiva, el chico rudo, el ídolo perfecto) y les da una profundidad psicológica real. Explica el porqué de sus comportamientos, humanizándolos. - Equilibrio Narrativo: Maneja la transición de la comedia física al drama existencial de una forma muy bien lograda. - Secundarios Relevantes: Los amigos no están de adorno. Sus motivaciones y sus propios dolores afectan directamente la trama principal, creando una red de relaciones compleja y realista. - Tenemos cierre de la trama, lo cual se valora mucho, no nos deja a la deriva. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-28_075124_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/243fzqz9hqhxdS6DfFeVf7grqDK5TFHaEQrAboRYsBC588kZpVVnhuifBB4UGPzBsdaoP.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1279024/mediaviewer/rm2730187264/?ref_=ttmi_mi_3_2) ---

> - En ciertos episodios siento que excede con la comedia, pero ya es gusto de cada uno. - El inicio es como lento. - Resolución Apresurada: Aunque el final es conclusivo, los últimos dos o tres episodios ocurren a una velocidad vertiginosa en comparación con la calma del resto de la serie, lo que puede dejar a algunos sintiendo que faltó un poco más de final. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-28_075218_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23w2qGx42aB7AfxBRAfVB27ibGSEKtH7zGrngodoxvJLKCkj6ptx9fkq8FqYvKRs9nX2h.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1279024/mediaviewer/rm2313995521/?ref_=ttmi_mi_34_1) ---
>9/10 Historia │ 8/10 Animación │ 8/10 Sonido │ 8.4/10 Diseño de personajes │ 8.5/10 General ---

>Toradora! es una obra estructuralmente sólida. Su mayor acierto es entender que el amor adolescente es caótico, egoísta y doloroso, pero también necesario para crecer. Creo que el punto más fuerte del anime, es que te construye a tus personajes y da un final satisfactorio, nos da ese final en donde cada uno creció emocionalmente. ---

body.title: Opportunity meets preparedness.
body.body:
![IMG_20260322_155840_947.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/23xyk35Vn5YTr6MKKcKbAmdm9BZkJmQvX24PAAunmkPJFjRpXJViYu8br94Q7VoG4ueHn.jpg)

No matter how expensive a phone is, it’s useless without a network.

That’s how a lot of people are moving around with potential that never translates into results.

It’s not that they don’t have ideas or opportunities. 

In fact, they start strong, then quit when it gets hard. There’s always that initial energy, that excitement that makes everything feel possible. But the moment things become difficult, that same energy disappears, and what was once a good plan quietly gets abandoned.

Not because it was impossible, but because it stopped being easy.

That’s where the real problem is.

Discipline is not in the starting. Anybody can start when it feels good, when the motivation is there, when everything is still new and interesting. 

The real test is in continuing when it becomes uncomfortable, when progress is slow, and when there’s no excitement left to rely on.

I’ve noticed this pattern not just in people, but in myself too. That point where you begin to negotiate with your own goals, where stopping starts to feel reasonable. And most times, that’s exactly where the difference is made.

Because if you keep stopping at that stage, your potential will always look good on the outside but produce nothing meaningful.

So at some point, you have to decide if you want to keep starting things or if you actually want to finish them.

And that decision will show in what you do when things get hard.

![IMG_20260322_155844_511.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/23xL4h5furRZuGuMY71FQq4stzUUAFoRvfLadMdCPmeDnJTwaP3Lp29PpiLCWZPevzhXa.jpg)

So if you really want to see results, stop waiting for things to feel easy. 

Build the discipline to continue when it gets hard.

‎As a young pn your 20s, here's what you need to do now; nobody will ever tell you. 
‎
‎I've been redefining how I live my life lately and identifying what has helped me as a young guy and I discovered this; 
‎
‎On several occasions, I have had the opportunity to work with brands and individuals to be part of creative projects, initiatives, leadership, and even more.
‎
‎On most occasions, I was recommended by PEOPLE. And this is it! 
‎
![IMG_20250601_070316_863.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/23y8ux2xB7k2vVApVX7jyERPD5Y4eeUte22bCo3Xv2xSoD1BQzFRGj3sdNwtxtwUzKtE9.jpg)

‎As a young guy in your 20s here's what you need to do now;
‎
‎- Define what relationship is to you. 
‎- Be selective in your circle of friendship.
‎- Collaborate with people, especially those who are on the track to where you're going. 
‎- Build these three as if your life depends on it because your life actually does. 
‎
‎This is how you multiply ideas, accelerate progress, and create prosperity. People are the human's highest currency. And no one ever gets to climb the ladder of success without them. 
‎
![IMG_20260415_073156_676.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/23xKxwAtErbmTy3TKWCxcj1gTiyfCFwHYiUWDdoGUQjAfsanrgMbJZmdr1v7T5erpRc8d.jpg)

‎At the highest level of power, it's always friendship, relationship, and collaboration over anything else. Learn it if you want to desire growth. 
“Life is a potato,” she would always say.
Whenever she did, we smiled.
Whenever she was sad, we told her the same thing just to cheer her up.

Being in the midst of the right set of people matters a lot—people who support you academically, boost your mental health, and always look out for you.
‎Share this with someone to educate. 
‎

‎

body.body:
>Hola grupo de Hive hoy hice un buzo o chaqueta como prefieran llamar con cierre,estilo muy deportivo,y esque me pidieron hacer uno y yo me puse manos a la obra. Los materiales que utilice fueron los siguientes:** # > Hello Hive group! Today I made a hoodie or jacket, whichever you prefer to call it, with a zipper. It's a very sporty style, and I was asked to make one, so I got to work. The materials I used were the following: ---
![1000265277.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSPHpuR1GPT2fWWitKEGGtASvRHcoBsEeRMLG7G2Ux7BZ/1000265277.jpg)
# ##
Materiales utilizados|Materials used
 #
![1000265420.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbTofuxTkDk36txezoxS13sZTNFTgazgVjDArHUe6cY4g/1000265420.jpg)
# * **Tela microdurasno color negra** * **Tijera** * **Hilo color negro** * **Alfileres** * **Cremallera** * **Patrón de suéter talla M** * **Regla y lápiz** # >* **Black microfiber fabric** >* **Scissors** >* **Black thread** >* **Pins** >* **Zipper** >* **Size M sweater pattern** >* **Ruler and pencil** # #
Elaboración||Elaboration
 #
![1000265421.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNyxerXWz7KugWraXpdUq81myHqVtn6uQdNDbdFtgkfRB/1000265421.jpg)
![1000265409.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbnFA7NcmUzwBJ3E3UEbQ136thkM7sRVK7nk8pqgr1SLS/1000265409.jpg)

# * #### Paso nro 1 **

>Doblando la tela hacia el lado que más estira corte la parte delantera y la parte trasera. En la parte delantera deje un centímetro más para colocarle el cierre.Luego corte una tira larga y ancha que usaré para la parte de abajo formando una pretina y el cuello.Y luego corte las mangas ya teniendo do todas las piezas cortadas empiezo a coser.** > * #### Paso nro 1 > Folding the fabric towards the side with the most stretch, cut the front and back pieces. On the front, leave an extra centimeter for the zipper. Then cut a long, wide strip that I will use for the bottom, forming a waistband and the collar. And then cut the sleeves. Once I have all the pieces cut, I begin to sew. ---
![1000265413.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUXcp5cCYtb8Du8ruZiaBhKEoRNUMn3RjxVaiyWwLbecV/1000265413.jpg)

>Empecé por coser las mangas tanto las de la parte trasera como la delantera.Después cosi las mangas hasta abajo cosiendo los costados del buzo.** > * #### Paso nro 2 > I started by sewing the sleeves, both the front and back ones. Then I sewed the sleeves all the way down, sewing the sides of the jumpsuit. ---
![1000265414.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmThxuL7MLvfCiVwtgTYXFgx4SF2cFWSs4TpkMKmtAdEYP/1000265414.jpg)
![1000265415.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWebYdVvW5hxzyc1hkmgpWBa4j6dNeM3rLXuNir4UyuT4/1000265415.jpg)
# * #### Paso nro 3 **

>Teniendo ya cosido los laterales voy a ponerle la pretina en la parte de abajo.Y continuando le cosi el cierre.** > * #### Paso nro 3 > Having already sewn the sides, I'm going to put the waistband on the bottom. And continuing, I sewed the zipper. ---
![1000265423.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeTTpy26DmQD5m9Ub997Rq687Yez1cjpH1uXKhZ6WpPMn/1000265423.jpg)
![1000265417.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbTgMbgZywbs4jH2pvtrwPhEvQL9okEqt1JDG4NvjyMfi/1000265417.jpg)
# * #### Paso nro 4 **

>Le puse una etiqueta a q estoy usando para personalizar mis prendas.Por último le agarre el ruedo a las mangas.** > * #### Paso nro 4 > I added a label that I'm using to personalize my clothes. Finally, I hemmed the sleeves. --- ##

body.title: Heading back to Sydney - kids time, camellia time and Vienna schnitzel time : April 27 2026
body.body:
Heading home today. No Coolangatta Mountain shot - night chickens to feed means I take the short walk to the bins. No photos 



Stopped at my wife's grandson's place on the way home. Not see him for a few weeks. He had a new racetrack which needed batteries. We all piled into the car to go to shops. \

. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9a2e7e48-b813-4358-99c7-b012c280f726.jpg) We got the track set up. We did the lessons about not pulling the cars backward. Ollie raced with his dad and ouma. It was a smart moving going to buy batteries - a fun excursion too ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/290a53ae-fbbe-41db-8b0b-bd0192928ea0.jpg) Did go for a short walk when we gpt home to get some more photos - it was short - all I wanted was photos. Apartment for sale over the way ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/54010c51-4808-4b14-b633-725c5ba78a31.jpg) One of these. It is a favoured address on the south side of the street we live in. Gordon on our side and Killara on their side ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c89c35e7-9532-4c9d-a47c-bac9ebc5dc44.jpg) Autumn always offers camellia shots - pink and white to start ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8f9484dd-4ef3-42d4-a792-bae5973817b1.jpg) Pure pink ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/168a2ffe-bb2d-42c2-beeb-4ee2748b6c01.jpg) Pure white ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0c31abe8-8451-48c8-9478-405254efe028.jpg) Cordeline flowering - not noticed the flower opening - zoom in and go up the spike - a flash of yellow ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/27a82668-cda0-4f68-a532-800326ebd6f7.jpg) Berry bunch in the setting sun ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d4d01c55-b953-4eb6-bc7d-1e835151d7d1.jpg) Autumn colours just shaping up Had a different dinner lining up - never made this - Vienna Schnitzel - step one - season with salt and pepper and roll flat. Used a passata bottle with meat in a plastic bag - stops it sticking ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/42869fc9-445e-4fd8-b1f6-aeeafb25aaa2.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d6baf5a7-af60-47a8-8dec-dda2590cabc4.jpg) Line up the batter ingredients - dip from left to right. Gluten free flower - coat well. Dip in the beaten egg - one egg was all we needed. Then coat well in breadcrumbs. These we have made drying out gluten free crusts Next step is to cook in hot oil - used sunflower oil for this - hot enough but not steaming. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1a4d490b-7add-444c-b793-f9f2f9a6a1f5.jpg) Just deep enough for the veal to lie on top. Cook two minutes and then turn ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/393ae3de-7438-4e21-8a9a-2dce4d94fc8d.jpg) Tip: If pan is not big enough to cook two (like this one) turn on oven at 180C and place the first cooked one on a tray to keep warm Served with potato salad and salad. I had airfryer reheated chips too Dinner worked really well - a win for a first time effort. Will be done again
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@carrinm/actifit-carrinm-20260428t120201507z)_

body.title: La otra historia del fútbol [Esp-Eng]
body.body:
_Saludos, comunidad._

_A la espera de los venideros partidos de semifinales de la Champions League, hoy no voy a hablarles de resultados o estadísticas; traigo una dinámica diferente, en la que comentaré algo de la historia del surgimiento y masificación del fútbol._

_Pocas cosas en este mundo logran unir a la gente como lo hace el deporte, y muy especialmente el fútbol. Su historia no es un simple capricho del destino; todo lo contrario, pues su origen responde a una lógica muy concreta, nacida en la Inglaterra del siglo XIX. Para entenderlo tenemos que situarnos en el contexto de la Revolución Industrial._

>Greetings, community.

>As we await the upcoming Champions League semifinals, today I won't be talking about results or statistics. Instead, I bring a different kind of discussion—one that touches on the history of football's emergence and mass adoption.

>Few things in this world bring people together like sports, and football especially. Its history is no mere twist of fate; quite the opposite—its origins follow a very specific logic, born in 19th-century England. To understand it, we have to place ourselves in the context of the Industrial Revolution.
*******
<center>https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2019/07/22/17/01/soccer-4355589_1280.jpg</center>
*******
<center>[Fuente/Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/f%c3%batbol-ni%c3%b1o-hierba-4355589/)</center>

_Inglaterra era en ese entonces la gran locomotora del capitalismo mundial, un imperio en plena expansión industrial y comercial, pero sus élites necesitaban algo más que riqueza material; buscaban una herramienta capaz de forjar el carácter de las futuras generaciones de líderes, administradores y soldados de su vasto imperio, y es ahí donde el deporte se vuelve clave. No bastaba con tener mentes brillantes; también se necesitaban cuerpos fuertes y saludables, y un espíritu de equipo y liderazgo, para lo que el fútbol resultó ser la herramienta perfecta._

_Por eso el fútbol moderno no nació en las calles, sino en los prestigiosos colegios privados como Eton, Harrow, Rugby, Cambridge y Oxford. Allí se empezaron a codificar las primeras reglas, transformando el violento y desorganizado \

medieval en un deporte reglado que inculcaba valores de trabajo en equipo, disciplina y fortaleza. Un momento fundacional fue en octubre de 1863, cuando se fundó la Football Association (FA) en Londres, unificando las reglas; este evento es considerado el acta de nacimiento del deporte que hoy conocemos._

>Back then, England was the great engine of global capitalism, an empire in full industrial and commercial expansion. But its elites needed more than material wealth; they sought a tool capable of shaping the character of future generations of leaders, administrators, and soldiers for their vast empire. That's where sport became key. It wasn't enough to have brilliant minds—they also needed strong, healthy bodies, as well as teamwork and leadership skills. Football turned out to be the perfect instrument.

>That's why modern football wasn't born on the streets, but in prestigious private schools like Eton, Harrow, Rugby, Cambridge, and Oxford. There, the first rules began to be codified, transforming the violent, disorganized \

of the Middle Ages into a regulated sport that instilled the values of teamwork, discipline, and resilience. A foundational moment came in October 1863, when the Football Association (FA) was founded in London, unifying the rules. This event is considered the birth certificate of the sport we know today.
********
<center>https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2016/04/08/01/08/sport-1315351_1280.jpg</center>
********
<center>[Fuente/Source](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/deporte-juegos-recreaci%c3%b3n-ocio-1315351/)</center>

_El salto de las aulas de élite a las masas se dio gracias a los propios británicos, que expandieron el deporte a diversos lugares del planeta. El fútbol viajó en los barcos y maletas de marineros, comerciantes, ingenieros y obreros que expandían el imperio._

_En el caso de América Latina, la conexión es muy directa: los primeros partidos y clubes no surgieron de forma aislada, sino de la mano de las inversiones británicas, principalmente en el ferrocarril. En Argentina, trabajadores ferroviarios participaron en los primeros encuentros hacia 1867 (el Buenos Aires Football Club se fundó ese año); en Brasil, se dice que un joven de ascendencia británica, que volvió de estudiar en Inglaterra, organizó los primeros partidos; en Uruguay, en 1891 se fundó el Central Uruguay Railway Cricket Club (CURCC) con el objetivo claro de competir contra los equipos de la colonia inglesa (aunque ya había partidos informales desde la década de 1870); en Chile y Perú la historia se repite, surgiendo clubes de las comunidades británicas._

>The leap from elite classrooms to the masses came thanks to the British themselves, who spread the sport to various parts of the planet. Football traveled in the ships and suitcases of sailors, merchants, engineers, and workers who were expanding the empire.

>In Latin America, the connection is very direct: the first matches and clubs didn't emerge in isolation but rather hand in hand with British investments, mainly in the railway. In Argentina, railway workers took part in the early matches around 1867 (the Buenos Aires Football Club was founded that same year). In Brazil, it's said that a young man of British descent, returning from studies in England, organized the first games. In Uruguay, the Central Uruguay Railway Cricket Club (CURCC) was founded in 1891 with the clear goal of competing against teams from the English colony (though informal matches had been played since the 1870s). In Chile and Peru, the story repeats itself—clubs sprang up within British communities.
*********
<center>https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2015/09/09/17/18/stadium-931975_1280.jpg</center>
*********
<center>[Fuente/Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/estadio-deportes-aficionados-arena-931975/)</center>

_La masificación no se detuvo ahí: el balón rodó rápidamente por el resto de Europa. En Suiza, por ejemplo, se formaron clubes en la década de 1870 (como el FC St. Gallen en 1879), mientras que en Dinamarca hacia 1876. El continente africano no quedó al margen del fenómeno: los colonos británicos organizaron los primeros partidos en Sudáfrica en la década de 1860, y el deporte se propagó como vehículo de los valores victorianos de disciplina y orden._

_En fin, la historia del fútbol va mucho más allá de los goles y las estadísticas; es el reflejo de una época de profundos cambios sociales. Un deporte nacido para educar a las élites se convirtió en pasión del pueblo y fenómeno global; el viaje que comenzó en los fríos campos de juego ingleses, hoy como sabemos, no para de vibrar en diversos rincones del planeta._

>Massification didn't stop there: the ball quickly rolled across the rest of Europe. In Switzerland, for instance, clubs formed in the 1870s (like FC St. Gallen in 1879), and in Denmark around 1876. The African continent was not left out: British colonists organized the first matches in South Africa in the 1860s, and the sport spread as a vehicle for Victorian values of discipline and order.

>In short, the history of football goes far beyond goals and statistics; it reflects an era of profound social change. A sport born to educate the elite became the passion of the people and a global phenomenon. The journey that began on the cold playing fields of England, as we know, continues to pulse in countless corners of the planet.
********
<center>https://images.pexels.com/photos/27309692/pexels-photo-27309692.png</center>
*********
<center>[Fuente/Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/verano-textura-polvo-vintage-27309692/)</center>

body.body:
**Hello my friends!
How are you?
I hope you all are well,**

Today I'm going to share with you how to draw 245 Jaze in Anime Style from Rising Star Game and how to buy card packs. So let's start with the drawing first!

![245 Jaze.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/myanmarkoko/23zbRaga85h5H8U5Z9xKGJcrctK5Zj8Q6NPDoXQZGFscjUynhoxqobbEDU7tird755GJT.png)
*Images: Rising Star NFT*

**Drawing Anime For 245 Jaze**
Jaze is an NFT card from the Rising Star Game. At first glance, the character in this NFT might seem female. However, according to the NFT description, he is male. \

the NFT description says, indicating that Jaze is male. He has 10 skills.

![Untitled1_20260427155559.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/myanmarkoko/23wgoMjbC2vNvGgtPhv2J9y8xWA1U8i2zh9XLK8BYfbatNc5XSJHBpHcBuf9kk5RHCQuj.png)

First, we need to draw a Body Sketch to draw Jaze's outline. Ibispaint has ready-made Body outlines for you to use. But you need to do a little Achievement. On the Body Sketch, you can draw hair, eyes, nose, mouth, and clothes. After that, you can delete the Body Outlines that are no longer needed.

![Untitled1_20260427160522.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/myanmarkoko/243zxn97WYiSmQ2VYap565SY9EaaucjpLiEzXtRKDbw2KfUGKNFDtzbCmNZfkA5SHCRcJ.png)

After getting the outlines of Jaze, I painted the base color for all the parts. Then I used the Hair pen to paint the hair. When painting the hair, I had to choose the right color for the light and dark. Then I drew the shades for the face and clothes. For the background, I chose a neutral beige color. Finally, I got the Anime Style Jzae.

![Untitled1_20260427161136.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/myanmarkoko/243zy9PYTQXg2J3Lmn5HxQ6urPbjh25vZ1TpohgfnMsoSXPVxX9t5SEeBYXx4i5bWXY3c.png)

**How do you think?
Do you like my drawing? **

**Buying Rising Star Card Packs**

Today I bought 10 Card Packs in the Rising Star Game. The cards I received from opening 10 packs were 19 Common and 11 Rare Cards. I completed the Daily Achievement mission and collected 12 Stardust Points. Lately, I haven't been getting Epic cards that are higher than Rare cards in Opening packs. Is it just me who's unlucky? Leave a comment and let me know what cards you guys got from Opening packs.

今天忙了一天，不是说生意可忙，是去进货了，进了很多的短袖和短裤，还主要这重头戏，微辣裤子和弯刀裤子这些需要我亲自去把关，其实我自己不喜欢这些，但是初中生和高中生，一放假就来买微喇裤，男生，穿的都是微喇去，父母看不惯，但是孩子们来了必买，我这些天一直没有进货，把以前的库存都卖完了，马上五一了，学生一放假，肯定要卖这些了，无论如何，五一是个大行情，所以思来想去，我进货去了，手里就那么点可怜的现金，精打细算，也算是进的圆满，然后身上就剩几十块钱，回店铺了，这趟，折腾的一整天。

好消息是通过努力，债务已经卸载了六个APP，就剩四个了，越来越少，内耗越来越少，但是自己的手里还是没有留一点钱，所有人都不让我还那些卡和网贷，但是我心里过不去，我积累点钱，就立刻还账了，所以我心里也越来越轻松，再坚持几个月，就彻底上岸了，剩下的信用卡，协商还款成功，也会越来越好，无论如何，不内耗，越来越好。

负债群的大佬说，这都是那自己的征信换来的代价，目前没有能力去还信用卡，还网贷，都是投资失败，不用焦虑，也不要害怕银行的催狗，各种催狗都不要害怕，我们生意失败了，我们接受，他们放贷给我们，发信用卡给我们，也是生意，是生意就会有赚有赔，凭什么他们只能赚，不能赔，是生意都会有赚有赔，我们是欠钱，不是欠命，好好得生活，努力搞钱，去迎接自己的东山再起。

我坚信，我会越来越好，不白活一回。加油，灰鸽子。

# 10 хитростей и библиотек Python, которые упростят вашу жизнь программиста

Привет, программисты! Если вы когда-нибудь задумывались, как сделать вашу жизнь проще, а код — чище, то вы попали по адресу! Вот 10 хитростей и библиотек Python, которые заставят вас почувствовать себя настоящим магом кода. И не забудьте: код, как и вино, лучше с возрастом... но не забывайте его декантировать!

## 1. **List Comprehensions**  
Зачем писать циклы, когда можно использовать list comprehensions? Они короче, понятнее и выглядят так, будто вы только что закончили курсы по питону для магов.

```python
squares = [x**2 for x in range(10)]
```

## 2. **`itertools`**  
Эта библиотека — как швейцарский нож для программиста. Комбинации, перестановки, фильтрация — всё на месте! Помните, что с great power comes great responsibility... и много итераций.

```python
import itertools
combinations = list(itertools.combinations('ABC', 2))
```

## 3. **`functools`**  
Запомните, если вы не используете `functools`, вы теряете время! Кеширование функций — это как хранить еду в морозильнике: всегда под рукой, когда вам лень готовить.

```python
from functools import lru_cache

@lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def fib(n):
    return fib(n-1) + fib(n-2) if n > 1 else n
```

## 4. **`pandas`**  
Если вы работаете с данными и не используете `pandas`, вы как шеф-повар без ножа. Эта библиотека сделает вашу жизнь проще, а данные — красивее. 

```python
import pandas as pd
data = pd.DataFrame({'A': [1, 2], 'B': [3, 4]})
```

## 5. **`requests`**  
Когда вам нужно сделать HTTP-запрос, забудьте о `urllib`. `requests` — это как заказать пиццу через приложение: быстро, удобно и без лишних хлопот.

```python
import requests
response = requests.get('https://api.example.com/data')
```

## 6. **`matplotlib`**  
Графики — это как коды для программиста. Без них все выглядит слишком скучно. Визуализируйте свои данные и удивите коллег!

```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.plot([1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6])
plt.show()
```

## 7. **`virtualenv`**  
Сохраняйте свои зависимости в чистоте! `virtualenv` — это как иметь отдельную комнату для каждого вашего проекта. И не забывайте, что в каждой комнате должен быть порядок!

```bash
pip install virtualenv
```

## 8. **`pytest`**  
Тестирование может быть весёлым! С `pytest` вы сможете писать тесты так же легко, как пишете код. И не забудьте: тесты — это не только для других, но и для вашего спокойствия.

```python
def test_add():
    assert add(1, 2) == 3
```

## 9. **`flask`**  
Создание веб-приложения может быть проще, чем вы думаете. `Flask` — это как ваш любимый фастфуд: быстро, удобно и всегда под рукой!

```python
from flask import Flask
app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/')
def hello():
    return 'Hello, World!'
```

## 10. **`asyncio`**  
Скорость — это важно! Если вы хотите, чтобы ваш код работал быстрее, `asyncio` — это то, что вам нужно. Но помните: не все, что блестит, — это золото... иногда это просто асинхронный код.

```python
import asyncio

async def main():
    print('Hello')
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
    print('World')

asyncio.run(main())
```

---

Вот и всё! Эти хитрости и библиотеки помогут вам стать настоящим мастером Python. Помните: код — это не только работа, но и искусство. Удачи и пусть ваш код всегда компилируется с первого раза! 🐍✨

body.title: ​Rising Star Game: My Brand New Card Collection for Today!
body.body:
Hey everyone! Today is such an incredibly exciting day for my Rising Star journey because I finally managed to grab some amazing new cards to level up my game and boost my stats!

မင်္ဂလာပါရှင်၊ ဒီနေ့ကတော့ ကျွန်မရဲ့ Rising Star ခရီးစဉ်မှာ တကယ့်ကို အံ့ဩစရာကောင်းလောက်အောင် စိတ်လှုပ်ရှားဖို့ကောင်းတဲ့နေ့လေးပါပဲ၊ ဘာလို့လဲဆိုတော့ ဂိမ်းမှာ Level မြှင့်တင်ဖို့နဲ့ ကိုယ့်ရဲ့ Stats တွေကို အကောင်းဆုံးဖြစ်စေဖို့အတွက် လန်းတဲ့ ကတ်အသစ်လေးတွေကို ပိုင်ဆိုင်ခဲ့လို့ပဲ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuFRkAP4eGF5QSaTymKv8MUd821Lx4NwGfNAyknBkPPi/1777377164270.jpg)

​I decided to invest 399,000 Starbits for the lovely FC6 Rosie card, which is a fantastic addition providing me with 150 Fans and 150 Skill points to help grow my music career.

ကျွန်မရဲ့ ဂီတလမ်းကြောင်း တိုးတက်ဖို့အတွက် Fans ၁၅၀ နဲ့ Skill ၁၅၀ အထိ ပေးစွမ်းနိုင်တဲ့ အရမ်းချစ်ဖို့ကောင်းတဲ့ FC6 Rosie ကတ်လေးကို ၃၉၉,၀၀၀ Starbits နဲ့ ရင်းနှီးမြှုပ်နှံပြီး ဝယ်ယူလိုက်ပါတယ်။

​Along with her, I also added the FC7 Stickers to my collection because these Fan Club cards are the absolute keys to unlocking those special missions we all love and increasing our standing in the game.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVgLAuWyk3AdrA15SvRQShyhEjiivyFzdjcoyND8Us8Ry/1777377192072.png)

သူ့အပြင် FC7 Stickers လေးကိုလည်း ကျွန်မရဲ့ Collection ထဲ ထပ်ဖြည့်ခဲ့ပါတယ်၊ ဒီလို Fan Club ကတ်တွေဟာ ကျွန်မတို့ အကြိုက်ဆုံး Special Mission တွေကို Unlock လုပ်ဖို့နဲ့ ဂိမ်းထဲမှာ ကိုယ့်ရဲ့အဆင့်အတန်းကို မြှင့်တင်ဖို့အတွက် မရှိမဖြစ် အဓိကသော့ချက်တွေပဲ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

​But that's not all—I also picked up the I2s The Ego card for just 11,999 Starbits, which comes with a cool 10 Luck points to help keep my ego in check and give me a better chance during my music lessons.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRrepRKcycjQMyC72oXgARitiT6eFHZEP3sHZFCgXvPX1/1777377207109.png)

ဒါတင်မကသေးဘူးနော်၊ ကျွန်မရဲ့ Ego တွေကို ထိထိရောက်ရောက် ထိန်းချုပ်နိုင်ဖို့နဲ့ Music Lesson တွေလုပ်တဲ့အခါ ပိုပြီး အခွင့်အလမ်းသာစေမယ့် Luck ၁၀ အထိပါဝင်တဲ့ I2s The Ego ကတ်လေးကိုလည်း ၁၁,၉၉၉ Starbits ထဲနဲ့ တန်တန်လေး ဝယ်ယူနိုင်ခဲ့ပါသေးတယ်။

​Having these new cards with specific stats like Fans, Skill, and Luck is essential because they balance our gameplay and ensure that our hard-earned Starbits are spent wisely for long-term growth.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbe5rby26Aw2WLhVNmFE1WkCzx2Pgh5oARvvBYfodpyPj/1777377223795.png)

အခုလို Fans, Skill နဲ့ Luck စတဲ့ အချက်အလက်တွေ အသီးသီးပါဝင်တဲ့ ကတ်အသစ်တွေကို ပိုင်ဆိုင်ရတာဟာ ဂိမ်းကစားတဲ့အခါ မျှတမှုရှိစေဖို့အတွက် အရမ်းအရေးကြီးသလို ကိုယ်ပင်ပင်ပန်းပန်း ရှာထားတဲ့ Starbits တွေကိုလည်း ရေရှည်တိုးတက်မှုအတွက် မှန်မှန်ကန်ကန် အသုံးချလိုက်တာလည်း ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

​As a player, strategic purchases like these make me feel so empowered and motivated, knowing that every single card I collect brings me one step closer to becoming a true superstar in this blockchain world.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVpvVp91TDw6vQEdjzFo7Gw54sCtnAHTChSGsr2Aur3QC/1777377239739.png)

ကစားသမားတစ်ယောက်အနေနဲ့ ဒီလိုမျိုး စနစ်တကျ ရွေးချယ်ဝယ်ယူလိုက်ရတာက ကိုယ့်ကိုယ်ကိုယ် ယုံကြည်မှု ပိုတိုးစေသလို စုဆောင်းလိုက်တဲ့ ကတ်တိုင်းဟာ ဒီ Blockchain လောကမှာ စူပါစတားတစ်ယောက်ဖြစ်ဖို့ ခြေတစ်လှမ်း ပိုနီးစပ်သွားစေတာကြောင့် တကယ့်ကို တက်ကြွလန်းဆန်းစေပါတယ်ရှင်။

​I’m constantly looking for the best deals in the market to expand my fan base and improve my skills, and today's haul was definitely a huge success that I just had to share with all of you.

ကျွန်မရဲ့ Fan Base တွေကို ချဲ့ထွင်ဖို့နဲ့ Skill တွေကို မြှင့်တင်ဖို့အတွက် Market ထဲမှာ အကောင်းဆုံးစျေးနှုန်းတွေကို အမြဲရှာဖွေလေ့ရှိပြီး ဒီနေ့ ဝယ်ယူမှုတွေကတော့ တကယ့်ကို အောင်မြင်မှုအကြီးကြီးမို့လို့ သူငယ်ချင်းအားလုံးကို ဝေမျှပေးလိုက်တာပါရှင်။

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmemzyxV8JM6D983U1ppWmghJ6nsNxgRhcxGSUdS5pz7YA/1774965657976.jpg)

​Let's keep rocking, earning, and shining together in the Rising Star music world—I honestly can't wait to see what the next mission brings and which cards I'll be adding to my deck next!

Rising Star ရဲ့ ဂီတလောကထဲမှာ အတူတူ ကြိုးစားရင်း၊ ဝင်ငွေတွေရှာရင်း တောက်ပကြရအောင်နော်၊ နောက်လာမယ့် Mission တွေမှာ ဘာတွေထပ်ဖြစ်မလဲနဲ့ ဘယ်လိုကတ်တွေကို ထပ်ဝယ်ဖြစ်မလဲဆိုတာ ရင်ခုန်စွာနဲ့ စောင့်မျှော်နေပါတယ်ရှင်။

​Thank you for being part of my journey, and I hope this inspires you to look closer at card stats and find the perfect additions for your own music career progress!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPbdWpozTonpqjCg4PLE2Pmbf5PSxoaBTAUaPaufkXGwP/img_0.07078611256928886.jpg)

ကျွန်မရဲ့ ခရီးစဉ်မှာ အတူရှိပေးလို့ ကျေးဇူးတင်ပါတယ်၊ ဒီအကြောင်းအရာလေးက သူငယ်ချင်းတို့ရဲ့ ဂီတလမ်းကြောင်း တိုးတက်ဖို့အတွက် ကတ်တွေရဲ့ Stats တွေကို သေချာကြည့်ပြီး အကောင်းဆုံး ကတ်တွေကို ရွေးချယ်နိုင်ဖို့ စိတ်ကူးစိတ်သန်းတွေ ရစေလိမ့်မယ်လို့ မျှော်လင့်ပါတယ်ရှင်။

body.title: 📽🎨 Dibujando a Mi Querida Tía Miriam/Drawing My Dear Aunt Miriam (Esp/Eng)🙏
body.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=reyghart04/pjq1weff

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXghJz63VPs5MFPV7WJXHDmpziyhdNBVDnnjifE1NP6xZ/1777374287651.jpg)

Buen día. Hoy les muestro el video timelapse de mi dibujo:
Mi Querida Tía Miriam

Good morning. Today I'm showing you the timelapse video of my drawing: My Dear Aunt Miriam.

En el video podrán apreciar cómo voy realizando el dibujo comenzando después que termino la cuadrícula. Siempre comienzo realizando trazos claros para evitar borrones en caso de que salga mal pero también di dibujamos clarito y estructuramos bien el modelo a dibujar, aunque hagamos miles de líneas claras, no hace falta borrarlas porque al final, son tapadas por el claroscuro. Durante el proceso de dibujo verán cómo voy dibujando desde valores tonales altos( claros) y voy dando valores medios y bajos (medios y oscuros) progresivamente y después realizar algún detalle. Nunca me enfrasco en hacer el realismo de un elemento y después pasar a hacer otro elemento. Voy dibujando de lo general a lo particular. 

In the video, you'll be able to see how I go about making the drawing, starting after I finish the grid. I always begin by making light strokes to avoid smudges in case something goes wrong, but also, if we draw lightly and properly structure the model to be drawn — even if we make thousands of light lines — we don't need to erase them because in the end, they get covered by the chiaroscuro. During the drawing process, you'll see how I start with high tonal values (lights), then progressively apply medium and low values (midtones and darks), and finally add some details. I never get stuck trying to render one element realistically before moving on to another. I draw from the general to the specific.

Para conocer más del dibujo, aprecien la publicación en Ecency/To learn more about the drawing, check out the post on Ecency.

https://ecency.com/hive-174301/@reyghart04/mi-querida-tia-miriam-my

También podrán visualizar el dibujo y creaciones de otros artistas en el concurso de @hiveartgallery.

You will also be able to see the drawing and creations of other artists in the contest by @hiveartgallery.

https://ecency.com/hive-177717/@hiveartgallery/the-62-round-of-hive

Para realizar el dibujo utilicé:
-lápiz HB. 
-2B con extensor inventado.
- lapicero transformado a portaminas de mina 5B.
- hoja de papel para apoyar la mano y evitar que se ensucie tanto el dibujo como la mano.
- pincel.
- goma moldeable.
- lácar de pelo para fijar el grafito( usen fijadores profesionales para dibujo si es posible) Eviten rociar demasiado el dibujo porque la hoja puede deformarse. 

To make the drawing I used:  
- HB pencil. 
- 2B pencil with an improvised extender.  
- Pen transformed into a mechanical pencil with 5B lead.  
- Sheet of paper to rest my hand and prevent both the drawing and my hand from getting dirty.  
- Brush.  
- Kneaded eraser.  
- Hair lacquer to fix the graphite (use professional drawing fixatives if possible)Avoid spraying too much on the drawing because the paper may warp.

body.title: If I could go back 5 years, I would do this differently
body.body:
If I had the chance to go back five years, I don’t think I would try to change everything about my life.
Some mistakes were necessary. Some experiences helped me understand things I wouldn’t have learned any other way.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRLj5oSZDpp433eeH84qGnbHLxKD9ayrsoWUCyZax916n/fb_img_1774074968452_1.jpg)
Past photos 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXeXDWKmo9UBJreZVv3w36hHNnmwnWTM313o5p1QwjX6C/rnfetchblobtmp_joo5oftaxou1nqqdubuts.jpg)


But there are still a few things I would do differently without thinking twice.
First, I would take things more serious earlier.
Not in a way that adds pressure, but I wouldn’t be so relaxed about time. Back then, it always felt like there was enough time to figure things out later.
I delayed things a lot. Ideas, plans, even small actions that could have made a difference.
Looking back now, I just realized that those small delays that happened in my life added up.
Another thing I would change is how I spent my time daily.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcov15DBXdn9PCTnNfBUTgxigP3LgPFMGt1VTGR9o31bz/fb_img_1774074973357_1.jpg)


There were moments I used on things that didn’t really add value. It felt normal at that time, just passing time, but now I see it differently.
Even if I had spent just one hour a day learning something useful or building something small, the results would have been clear by now.
That’s one thing I don’t ignore anymore.
Consistency is another big one.

I used to start things and stop halfway. Not because I didn’t have the ability to continue, but because I wasn’t seeing results fast enough.
So I would lose interest and move on to something else. That cycle repeated itself more times than I can count. Now I understand that results don’t come fast most of the time.

If I had stayed consistent with even one thing for those five years, just one, I would be in a completely different position right now. But I don’t dwell too much on it. Because thinking about the past too much won’t change anything. What matters is what I do now with what I’ve learned.

I can’t go back five years, but I can decide how the next five years will look. And that alone is enough reason to take things more serious now.

**All photos are mine**

body.title: My DHF Proposal: Hive Comunity Bank: A Permanent Source of Loans for the Hive Comunity
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZ8mnWx21aTytDkSoBdyJNoxm9b1DeXNAC48ggSxG9qtr/Screenshot%202026-04-28%20at%201.33.09%E2%80%AFAM.png 


---

# DHF Proposal: HiveComunityBank (HCB)
### A Permanent Source of Loans for the Hive Community

**Subject:** HiveComunityBank: Establishing a Permanent Community-Owned Credit Facility  
**Receiver Account:** `@hivecomunitybank`  
**Project Manager:** @shortsegments s

---

## 1. The Vision: Spend Without Selling
**HiveComunityBank (HCB)** is a simplified credit protocol designed to end the \

cycle. For too long, users have been forced to sell their stake to pay for real-world expenses. HCB provides a community-owned alternative: **Borrow against your HIVE, keep your stake, and spend HBD.**\n\nBy bridging Hive with global payment networks, we turn HIVE into a true \

with a built-in credit line.

## 2. Real-World Utility: Point of Sale & Global Spending
HCB is a gateway to global commerce. We leverage existing Hive infrastructure to ensure HBD is as spendable as cash:
* **Hive Keychain POS:** Use the mobile app (v3.15+) for instant scan-to-pay at Hive-native merchants with biometric security.
* **Zypto Interface:** Fund virtual or physical VISA cards using your HBD loan to spend at millions of locations worldwide.
* **Altera Bridge:** Convert HBD to Bitcoin via Altera for Lightning Network transactions or BTC liquidity.

## 3. Strengths of the HiveComunityBank Proposal
The HCB offers a superior value proposition compared to traditional \

proposals:
* **High Capital Efficiency:** Unlike a marketing proposal that might spend 100k HBD on advertisements, the HCB places the 100k HBD into a Savings Account to earn interest for the community.
* **Deflationary Pressure on HIVE:** By locking deposited HIVE into Hive Power (HP) and delegating it, the facility actively removes liquid HIVE from the market. 
* **The \

Principal:** The DHF principal remains in the wallet savings indefinitely. Only Hive-based fees and curation rewards pay the manager. This ensures the community's HBD capital is never used for administrative overhead.

## 4. Financial Mechanics & DHF Budget Context
This project operates on a **\

** model where the principal capital is never depleted.

### **The Request vs. DHF Capacity (April 2026)**
To provide perspective on the sustainability of this request, here is how our costs compare to the total DHF daily budget:
* **DHF Total Daily Budget:** ~232,566 HBD (1% of the total fund)
* **Current Daily Spend (All Projects):** ~4,596 HBD
* **HCB Daily Request:** **1,000 HBD** (This is only **0.4%** of the available daily budget).

### **The \

Principal Model**
* **Initial Setup:** 100,000 HBD (Deposited 100% into Savings).
* **The Savings Loop:** 100% of funds received from the DHF are deposited into the HBD Savings Account to earn interest (currently 20%).
* **The 3-Day Security Delay:** Loan funding requires a 3-day withdrawal wait—a deliberate security feature of the Hive Blockchain ensuring capital cannot be drained instantly.
* **Compound Growth:** All interest earned is reinvested. The DHF is effectively \
money into a community resource rather than \

it.

## 5. Lending Terms & Management Structure
* **LTV Ratio:** 50% (Deposit 100 HIVE value, receive 50% in HBD).
* **Loan Life Fee:** A 5% origination fee (in HIVE) is the only fee for the life of the loan.
* **Repayment:** 1-year term. If not repaid, capital is liquidated at 10% per month until recovered.
* **Manager Compensation:** Paid via the 5% origination fees and curation rewards (both in HIVE). All HBD interest is funneled back into the lending pool.
* **Segregated Curation:** Collateral is powered up and delegated to a separate account to keep the `@hivecomunitybank` ledger clean.

## 6. Educational Context: The Sovereignty of the DHF
The Decentralized Hive Fund is an on-chain autonomous system allowing users to fund the ecosystem's growth. 
**Current DHF Statistics:**
* **DHF Total Budget:** ~23,256,660 HBD
* **Daily Funded:** ~4,596 HBD
By supporting HCB, voters are creating a **Permanent Credit Facility**. Unlike projects that require constant re-funding to survive, HCB builds a growing treasury that remains a community asset even if the proposal eventually concludes.

## 7. Accountability & Transparency
* **Dedicated Receiver:** Using `@hivecomunitybank` ensures all proposal funds are easily tracked.
* **Trustless Audit:** Every transaction is documented via permanent on-chain memos.
* **Multi-Sig Roadmap:** As the fund grows, I plan to transition the account to a Multi-signature wallet involving trusted community members to eliminate \

risks.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**1. Is this a custodial service?** While a manager facilitates liquidations, the design uses Open Ledger transparency. All HBD principal stays in a time-locked Savings account; funds cannot be moved instantly without a 3-day public warning.

**2. What happens if the price of HIVE crashes?** We use a conservative 50% LTV ratio. If the price drops significantly, our 10% monthly liquidation protocol recovers the debt before the collateral value falls below the loan amount.

**3. Why not just use a Smart Contract?** Hive does not currently support native base-layer smart contracts for complex lending. This model provides immediate utility while avoiding the exploits (Flash Loans/Re-entrancy) common in automated DeFi.

**4. Why is there a 3-day wait for loans?** All HCB funds earn 20% interest in Savings. The Hive blockchain requires 3 days to withdraw from Savings. This protects the fund from hackers.

**5. How is the Project Manager paid?** Compensation is performance-based via 5% origination fees and curation rewards (both in HIVE). The manager never touches the HBD capital or interest.

**6. What happens if the proposal loses funding?** HCB is an asset-backed facility. If funding stops, the 100,000 HBD and interest remain in the account, owned by the community.

**7. How does this benefit the HIVE price?** Every loan requires HIVE to be removed from exchanges and \

as collateral, creating deflationary pressure on the liquid supply.

---

### **How You Can Help**
1. **Vote for the Proposal:** Visit the [Hive Proposals Page](https://peakd.com/proposals) and hit **Support** for `@hivecomunitybank`.
2. **Spread the Word:** Share this on InLeo, Hive.blog, or X (Twitter).
3. **The Bottom Line:** This is not a grant; it is an injection of liquidity. Your HIVE stays yours, and the DHF's HBD stays in the vault. **Vote for HiveComunityBank.**

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@shortsegments/my-dhf-proposal-hive-comunity-bank-a-permanent-source-of-loans-for-the-hive-comunity-2ul)
