body.title: Motovun, a Small Town In Croatian Istria [ENG/PL]
body.body:
> Our 2023 vacation in Croatian Istria ended in an incredibly charming town located in the northern part of the region. We left our accommodation in Rovinj very early in the morning to visit this place on the way back. We're talking about Motovun. Motovun is a small town perched on a hilltop. The first thing that comes to mind when you see it from a distance is that it looks like something straight out of Tuscany. Surrounded by numerous vine-covered hills, it truly evokes this Italian region.
> Nasze wakacje w chorwackiej Istrii w 2023 roku zakończyliśmy w pewnym miasteczku położonym w północnej części tego regionu. Opuściliśmy nasz nocleg w Rovinj bardzo wcześnie rano, żeby w drodze powrotnej zatrzymać się w Motovun > Motovun jest niewielką miejscowością zbudowaną na wzgórzu. Pierwsze co nasuwa się na myśl, kiedy widzimy to miejsce z oddali, to że wygląda jak żywcem wyjęte z Toskanii. Otoczone licznymi wzgórzami porośniętymi winoroślą naprawdę przypomina ten włoski region.
![line.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/EoJy9ee9vJf2Cwv6D2SAKPm8cDrt2HZEpLT3GqpRvBeYRTZ6TB2xUPkyKZowzgWTXxy.png) *** ![PSX_20260428_114759.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23sUAhq4BAQ9eY9ZvUHTgo2MJekAHyrZuYanaz7ArhWjhoXodYMTWqsj6pRm5rFAEzgen.jpg) ![PSX_20260428_114932.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/245mtbjMYJYmPcCGhGbXkAStFPm3FNEXU82e1PeJ1438f5WzTtnHaNct71YiQ3sHzoUEx.jpg) ***
First, we stopped by the road to take a look at the town, seeing how it looks against the backdrop of the hills. There are several spots along the main road where you can park your car and admire Motovun from a distance. I highly recommend taking a moment to see the town from a distance. Motovun once belonged to Italy and this is evident in its architecture and the general development of the town space.
> Najpierw zatrzymaliśmy się przy drodze chcąc zerknąć na miasto. Na to, jak prezentuje się na tle i w otoczeniu tych wzgórz. Jest tu kilka miejsc obok głównej drogi, gdzie można zaparkować samochód i przyjrzeć się Motovun z odległości. Gorąco polecam poświęcić chwilę na zobaczenie miasta z oddali. > Motovun należało w przeszłości do Włoch i widać to w jego architekturze i ogólnym zagospodarowaniu przestrzeni miasteczka.
***
![PSX_20260428_114922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/2458UWhvLic3qk8EXcVvnggxkquxmjVqkNK44kzHzjiqcUdLr9r5BhSzm5bWEm219UNeN.jpg)
![PSX_20260428_114911.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23xeg3uqnVgwjVRDjfkZPagbc2tiQTaP8V1p8fM8v29sR6C2kjxxEZdx2WRhGitpYDhnZ.jpg) ***
A very important thing about Motovun is that you can't drive into the main part of town. Unless you're a resident or have a permit, which is often granted to tourists staying within the walls. There are paid parking lots on the road right in front of the entrance gate, where you can park. However, keep in mind that these fill up quickly during the tourist season. Then, you'll have to look for parking lots at the foot of the hill and hike to the top. We arrived early in the morning, so we parked our car without any problems.
> Bardzo istotną rzeczą w Motovun jest fakt, że do głównej części miasta nie da się wjechać samochodem. Chyba że jest się mieszkańcem lub posiada się pozwolenie, które często otrzymują turyści mający zakwaterowanie wewnątrz murów. > Tuż przed bramą wjazdową znajdują się płatne parkingi przy drodze, gdzie można zaparkować. Należy jednak mieć na uwadze, że w sezonie turystycznym szybko się one zapełniają. Wtedy trzeba szukać parkingów pod wzgórzem i przejść pieszo na szczyt. My byliśmy na miejscu wcześnie rano, więc bez problemów zaparkowaliśmy nasz samochód.
*** ![PSX_20260428_114637.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/2432PuqeCvqaWB2pu9NpAhjdfMMtLcyXJjuUSoWiYWqKe2PL2PuGCgXgEs3XfoqjgYALP.jpg) ![PSX_20260428_114718.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/243MBCcamXPfmKjuRu4qqhJSjvwzNmjXrdjAUPCrXeYcR6xtmWTosjhRzGkW6H1uG6oVn.jpg) ***
Things get interesting right before you enter Motovun. It's worth stopping for a moment and taking in the surrounding hills from this vantage point. They made a huge impression on us, especially shrouded in a delicate mist illuminated by the beautiful morning light.
> Już przed samym wejściem na teren Motovun robi się ciekawie. Warto zatrzymać się na moment i przyjrzeć okolicznym wzgórzom z tego miejsca. Na nas zrobiły ogromne wrażenie. Zwłaszcza otulone delikatną mgłą, oświetloną pięknym porannym światłem.
*** ![PSX_20260428_114832.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/243M9WMeSCZ1mfHnZRYFTbhB8b4uwNJmBRkTaQbCZ41hgSMtHvXrU58cCy2TEyXfuv648.jpg) ![PSX_20260428_114843.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23ynWWWSJySt6Yw6WzuEmGjjAzuk9JzQHzP193iwkJASnRU2HbioGrJiWs1fZX77Nmtoj.jpg) ![PSX_20260428_114903.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/243qKeYaebxQiAVcpgPiNaLPZMYQz5zHMCrahwHwfrThw8SSd6FVdpfVkT4PLbBHEpC9v.jpg) ***
Tours of the town take place through narrow streets and often offer views of the surrounding countryside. It's worth exercising caution, as the roads are quite tight, and those authorized to enter the town may still find these roads difficult to navigate.
> Zwiedzanie miasteczka odbywa się wąskimi uliczkami i często towarzyszą temu widoki na okoliczne tereny. Warto zachować ostrożność, gdyż jest tu dość ciasno, a osoby z upoważnieniem do wjazdu na teren miasta i tak mają utrudnione poruszanie się tymi drogami.
*** ![PSX_20260428_114748.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23zkrZwWZTkxowMrfnSkrnUqReJBh65uii3P7MXAjpGt2eKz6PQEQjqHH1zHhLenPP3FD.jpg) ![PSX_20260428_114822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/244A4YAsFWSXKyyvPGxCwukPj4ptkusRwmc6Ni3r6WebigHi8QPWCUCQej6FNoeD51Qve.jpg) ***
One of the town's main monuments is the Church of St. Stephen, which sits atop a hill in the square that forms the center of Motovun. Nearby stands a tall bell tower, which also serves as a vantage point and can be climbed to its summit. However, we skipped these attractions. A long journey back to Poland awaited us, and time was limited.
> Jednym z głownych zabytków miasta jest Kościół św. Szczepana, który znajduje się na samym szczycie wzgórza, na placu, który stanowi centrum Motovun. W jego sąsiedztwie stoi wysoka dzwonnica, która jest również punktem widokowym i możliwe jest wejście na jej szczyt. My jednak sobie odpuściliśmy te atrakcje. Czekała nas długa podróż powrotna do Polski i czas był ograniczony.
*** ![PSX_20260428_114852.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/245HqKaZZQp6e9oFm1AsAxddyJhUyi79ZVhMf1x9xqj28SjpBZwCX7J6NcwQrqx3oymGm.jpg) ![PSX_20260428_114810.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23zbSCNSeKS5zbnRY79mCLt9qti8CQeRdt6M1zFH4xp4exXgrL6QMc7JqHtMXuzbrpZpk.jpg) ***
We did, however, take advantage of another attraction: the city walls. They are in excellent condition and surround the central part of the hilltop. Technically, there's an entrance fee, but when we visited, they were open and unattended. Perhaps outside the tourist season, you can enter for free, in a more cultured and quiet way? Or maybe we were just lucky 😉
> Skorzystaliśmy jednak z innej atrakcji, a mianowicie wejścia na mury miejskie. Są one zachowane w doskonałym stanie i otaczają centralną część szczytu wzgórza. Teoretycznie wejście na mury jest płatne, jednak kiedy my je zwiedzaliśmy, były otwarte i nikt ich nie pilnował. Być może poza sezonem turystycznym można tam kulturalnie i po cichu wejść za darmo? Albo mieliśmy po prostu szczęście 😉
*** ![PSX_20260428_114706.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/2458Q9CJxcQ3WVdZhKx78sxqJqhXarbG3k2UyYi5EoUuui4pAWz1HzqTYRzyQdQLVJisH.jpg) ![PSX_20260428_114651.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23zGZvFXeeiGdShdbFNCRWXcGN31ZUpCPE2nTQW71k1h4aDroopQdrXhhuyaBrDJkhF6D.jpg) ![PSX_20260428_114957.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/244y3zp1dJZsBy4a9ZYeUwbCG9kuYcWcbSkSW9nDsjhpyuor9MNTV56mZt5NsyoUwJF14.jpg) ***
A walk along the walls is very scenic. We can look out over the entire town and admire, among other things, the characteristic red roofs of Motovun's buildings. I highly recommend this walk. The area around Motovun is famous for truffle collecting and trading. Numerous \

of these very rare and hard-to-find mushrooms can be found here. Driving in this part of Istria, we encountered numerous roadside stands selling these mushrooms and related products. Therefore, it's worth being vigilant when driving. An equally important economic element of the region is wine. A large quantity of various varieties of this beverage is produced here, so Motovun offers not only beautiful landscapes and architecture but also something for true connoisseurs.
> Spacer wzdłuż murów jest bardzo widokowy. Możemy spoglądać na całe miasteczko i podziwiać między innymi charakterystyczne czerwone dachy zabudowy Motovun. Gorąco polecam taki spacer. > Okolice Motovun słyną ze zbierani i handlu truflami. Znajdują się tu liczne „pokłady” tych bardzo rzadkich i trudnych do odnalezienia grzybów. Jadąc drogą w tej części Istrii, spotkaliśmy liczne przydrożne punkty sprzedaży tych grzybów i wyrobów pochodnych. Warto więc zachować czujność podczas jazdy samochodem. > Równie ważnym elementem gospodarczym regionu jest wino. Produkuje się tu spore ilości różnych odmian tego trunku, a zatem Motovun to nie tylko piękne tereny i architektura, ale i coś dla prawdziwych smakoszy.
![line.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/EoJy9ee9vJf2Cwv6D2SAKPm8cDrt2HZEpLT3GqpRvBeYRTZ6TB2xUPkyKZowzgWTXxy.png)
📸 Photographed using a Nikon Z6 with a Nikkor Z 24-70 lens. 📸
Edited in Adobe Lightroom Classic
Graphic elements was added in Adobe Photoshop

All photographs are my own work. The text was written by me and translated into English using a translator. Thank you for taking the time to visit and read my post.

body.title: Mississippi Mud
body.body:
<center>![PXL_20240809_144107145.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/244UcyE1fBdSs5M5b6htxKV1dDP2vyycMfbLFAHqFzn4xSsr6dYM6CprFkaGe9H2PDtYX.jpg)</center>

----------------------------

It's interesting that just last week we were talking about Minnesota where the Mississippi River starts and now this week we are going to be talking about the state of Mississippi.  I was doing a bit of research, and it turns out that the Mississippi River had its name long before the state was ever created.  Mississippi comes from the Ojibwe/Algonquin word Misi-ziibi which means \

.  

As I said in my post last week, I have never been to the headwaters of the Mississippi, but I have a feeling it looks something like the photo above.  Perhaps with a little less water.  From what I have seen in photos, it really doesn't amount to much, but it is still impressive to think that such an amazing river has such a humble start.  It puts a lot of things in perspective to be honest.

As you might imagine, we are nearly halfway through our list of states, and this week we find ourselves at Mississippi.  I've actually not been looking forward to this #threetunetuesday sponsored by @ablaze for a while now. Mostly because it is just so tedious to type out the word Mississippi so much.  It's not one of those words that I can just throw out there and know I am going to be okay, I actually have to think about it as I type it and that makes it a bit more annoying.  


<center>![20240708_132157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/EpCAPzuxSFUfLoNsH58c9juokP4nsbUDsbGDH4bLephk6gPNhdEEHrSQiMZaop4tUvC.jpg)</center>

---------------------

In addition to that, I had a feeling it was going to be hard to find songs that have Mississippi in the title or lyrics.  Don't get me wrong, there are a ton of them, but if you really listen, the majority of songs like that are actually referring to the river, not the state.  Which might be a technicality, but it still kind of bugs me.  Despite all of that, I am not even going to try and differentiate them this week.  The songs I am going to share are in the vein of \

.  If you have a problem with a song being about the river versus the state, you can move along thank you very much! :)


<center>![20240708_132148.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/EqJ1JTMVMhG6G52F5BANvQMzWfnrT7jGjZ7WWeC36b3AYgcZkfKdwQNzJBKAtbh3UPV.jpg)</center>

----------------------------

I don't believe I have ever visited the state of Mississippi.  I have crossed over the river several times in my life, but I can't think of a single time that I ever had the opportunity to visit the state.  There was a Summer that we went down and visited one of my dad's old Navy buddies down in Oklahoma, and I think we were close to the border when we passed through Arkansas, but I don't think we ever crossed over into Mississippi.  I'd have to ask my parents about that.

I'm pretty sure a couple of the songs I am going to share with you today I have shared in the past, but after so many years of doing this challenge, that is bound to happen.  Again, you will just have to deal with it!

<center><iframe width=\

by the band Mountain.  I know I have shared this song before, but it's just such a good song that I don't feel bad about it at all.  Mountain is one of those bands that should have been really big, but they just never really got the chance. My wife and I were driving somewhere a while ago when this song came on and I asked her to look up on Google why Mountain didn't have more success than they did.  Turns out it was due to a lot of things, but mostly can be blamed on some key errors by the management of the band. 

Most importantly, they were offered a spot on the main stage at Woodstock, but the manager didn't think the festival was going to be that big of a deal, so he declined.  It's a shame, because this song rocks so hard and I think they really could have had something special if they had been given more of a chance.  

<center><iframe width=\

allowfullscreen></iframe></center>

---------------------------

[Direct Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m4oZCtfmh44&list=RDm4oZCtfmh44&start_radio=1)

---------------------------

Of course, is is only natural that I would include \

by the Doobie Brothers in this post.  Again, it's referring more to the river, not the state, but it technically has the name of the state in the lyrics, so it counts.  One of the first concerts that @mrsbozz and I ever went to together was the Doobie Brothers.  She got the tickets for me as a gift for my birthday and it was a really good time.  I remember at the time she couldn't decide if she should get me tickets for The Doobie Brothers or the Allman Brothers.  I think either way it would have been a winner.  It was a fantastic show.  Frampton opened for them, so you can't really complain about that right?!\n\n<center><iframe width=\

allowfullscreen></iframe></center>

--------------------------------

[Direct Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o0NXu0IQLbU&list=RDo0NXu0IQLbU&start_radio=1)

---------------------------------

Finally, though you have perhaps heard the previous two songs countless times, this third song is likely one you have never heard before.  In fact, I am not even sure I have ever heard it before this week.  At least I don't recollect it.  I am a huge fan of Neil Diamond, so when I saw he had a song called \

that has the word Mississippi in it, I knew I had to include it in this post.  

It actually comes from an older album with some of his bigger hits on it as well as a few covers.  it's crazy to think he used to be that young and there is something about his voice when he was younger that really adds an extra edge to the songs.  You can tell this one is a bit older because it has that kind of 50's 60's bop vibe to it.  Like the old kind of bop, not the way the term is used these days!

It's still a really cool song and it definitely brings out the soulful tone that Neil's voice has.  

So there you go, another state down.  Check back in a week to see where the road trip takes us next!

body.title: Purity amidst chaos
body.body: Hello everyone, today I'm going to talk about a flower painted on an unfinished canvas, with the aim of giving it a more feminine, more spiritual touch.\n\n

>On this canvas, I've created a very expressive close-up of a white frangipani (Plumeria) flower with a yellow center, painted against a vibrant turquoise background. The background is purely abstract; the whole composition (the background and the plumeria flower) creates a semi-abstract character with a strong expressionist feel. The flower is large and imposing, with five fleshy, slightly curved petals. It occupies the upper center of the composition. The petals are painted in off-white with soft yellow hues and bluish-gray shadows to give volume and depth.

>The background is a deep, textured turquoise, worked in layers with textural effects: thick impasto and visible brushstrokes. The splashes and splatters of red, burgundy, brown paint, with touches of green and yellow, create a dynamic effect. These splashes lend a somewhat abstract character to the purity of the white flower. The surface is rich, and the acrylic paint's texture is palpable, with smoother areas on the flower and highly textured areas in the background. The luminous white flower stands out beautifully against the saturated turquoise background. This contrast creates a sense of light and purity amidst the colorful chaos. In this exercise, I am not aiming for photographic realism. I use the flower as a symbolic motif while allowing for considerable gestural freedom (splashes, marks, drips).

>

The flower is slightly off-center, which adds dynamism. The eye is guided from the yellow center to the petals, then to the splashes that frame the scene. The palette is predominantly turquoise, pure white, lemon yellow, and burgundy red. This combination evokes both tropical freshness and a certain dramatic intensity. This work is rich in meaning because the frangipani flower is a very powerful symbol in tropical cultures. This flower represents beauty, purity, grace, life, and often love or spirituality.

In West Africa, the frangipani is associated with femininity, elegance, and spirituality. The immaculate white flower emerges from the center of a tumultuous background filled with splashes of red and dark colors. This symbolizes the beauty that arises despite life's difficulties, and inner peace amidst emotional storms. The red splashes evoke passion. The flower itself remains serene and fragile. It's a beautiful metaphor for human existence: fragile and beautiful, surrounded by chaotic forces.

\n\n

>
The turquoise color evokes the sea, the sky, and vitality. The frangipani is often associated with islands, gentle sensuality, and blossoming femininity.

Thank you for this brief read; take care.

body.body:
>

En el día de hoy les vengo a comentar todo lo que fue mi rutina de entrenamiento de full planche en mi nuevo mesociclo, ya que últimamente he estado enfocándome muchísimo en mi nuevo mesociclo, que es estrictamente el gimnasio junto con reforzamiento de algunas debilidades de la full planche y el front level. Esto me ha servido muchísimo para ganar fuerza en el hombro y mejorar demasiado la postura de mi full planche. Desde que he estado yendo para el gimnasio y fortaleciendo los músculos de la plancha, además de las debilidades de la misma, mi postura ha mejorado demasiado.

Al menos en el 1-1-1 es donde más lo he notado, ya que incluso al hacer half planche o full planche lo siento muchísimo más ligero. A diferencia de veces anteriores, siento que cada vez que voy a realizar este tipo de elementos, lo hago con muchísima más fuerza y mucha más estabilidad, además de siempre llegar al requerimiento de los segundos, que es lo que normalmente falla en la plancha y de lo que muchas personas suelen quejarse.

En las imágenes se puede ver claramente la postura de la full planche. En esta ocasión, por ejemplo, logré sostener 7 segundos de full planche bastante sólidos, lo cual me deja bastante contento, ya que anteriormente mi marca personal sí eran 7 segundos, pero con mucha menos postura. Esto me da a entender que no solamente he mejorado en comodidad, sino también en postura, ya que con este nuevo mesociclo y nueva forma de planchar me he sentido muchísimo más cómodo en la full. Siento que puedo hacer un press con mucha más facilidad, una negativa con mucha más facilidad y las flexiones me salen mucho más fluidas.

De igual forma, aunque esté haciendo plancha, siempre lo combino con un elemento de victoria, ya que es un elemento que sí estoy practicando bastante fuera de lo que es la full planche, ya que es un elemento que a mí siempre me ha gustado, Y el victorian es un elemento que a mí en lo personal me encanta. Siento que es bastante llamativo y en combo de paralelas junto con la full planche me parece ideal.

Bueno, eso ha sido todo por el día de hoy. Como siempre, muchísimas gracias a todos por el apoyo. Sé que dije que iba a seguir subiendo contenido mucho más seguido, pero de verdad los días del trabajo han sido demasiado pesados, pero aun así sigo aquí cumpliéndoles y, bueno, nos veremos en próximas publicaciones. Soy Omar Zambrano. Hasta luego.

Today, I'm here to tell you all about my full-plank training routine in my new mesocycle, because lately, I've been focusing a lot on my new mesocycle, which is strictly the gym, along with strengthening some weaknesses in my full-plank and front level. This has been extremely helpful in building shoulder strength and significantly improving my full-plank posture. Since I've been going to the gym and strengthening my plank muscles, as well as addressing my plank weaknesses, my posture has improved a lot.

I've noticed it most notably in the 1-1-1, but even when doing a half planche or a full planche, I feel much lighter. Unlike in the past, I feel that every time I perform these types of elements, I do so with much more strength and much more stability, and I always meet the required duration in seconds, which is what people usually struggle with in the plank and what many people often complain about.

In the images, you can clearly see the full planche position. This time, for example, I managed to hold a solid 7 seconds of full plank, which makes me quite happy, since my previous personal best was also 7 seconds, but with much poorer form. This tells me that I have not only improved in terms of comfort, but also in terms of posture, because with this new mesocycle and new way of doing the plank, I have felt much more comfortable in the full plank. I feel like I can do a press much more easily, a negative press much more easily, and my push-ups are much smoother.

Similarly, even when I'm doing the plank, I always combine it with a victory pose, because it's a pose I've been practicing a lot outside of the full plank, and it's a pose I've always liked. Personally, I love the victory pose. I think it's quite striking, and in a combo of parallel bars and full planche, I find it ideal.

Well, that's it for today. As always, thank you so much to everyone for your support. I know I said I was going to keep uploading content much more often, but honestly, my workdays have been really tough. Still, I'm here delivering for you, and, well, I'll see you in future posts. I'm Omar Zambrano. See you later.

body.title: happy four years anniversary to me
body.body:
Good day, amazing people of the Hive blockchain. I am so delighted to have you back in my blog today. Welcome! Today I am so happy because I am celebrating my fourth birthday here on the blockchain. Like I always say, I can't write about my journey without mentioning the blockchain.



![ChatGPT Image Apr 28, 2026 at 11_26_38 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/AKs4FfcSYwfHeCngn73W7B4LYh1UBKhvbLuqe6Xmz7ygdDG2N3bkhtVHS1Luvn3.png)



I joined this wonderful platform four years ago. I stepped into Web 3 with hope, connecting with people and willingness to learn, but today I celebrate my growth, lessons, wins and challenges that have helped to shape my life both here in blockchain and out of blockchain.

When I first joined the platform, everything was so strong; I was struggling to stand my ground on the platform. Everything was so new; at one point I was doubting myself, if I could be able to survive on this platform. It was like starting a new life, but then the moment I started connecting with people, making some transactions and writing in different communities, I began to unlock the hidden treasure in the blockchain. I got to know the power of connecting with people and the power of community. I also got to understand how transparent the blockchain is. To be honest, over these four years I can boldly say the blockchain has transformed me not just here in the platform, but also it has helped my personal growth. I have grown patient, more transparent and more informed. Sincerely, this platform will test you and, at the same time, push you. Blockchain has taught me how to bear risk; there are times the market will rise and fall, and with that I get to explore more and gain more knowledge. The wonderful thing is I learn from my success and failure.

The most amazing part of this journey is the wonderful people I have met over these years. The blockchain is full of amazing souls, people who are every ready to help once you enter their DMs. You will meet individuals with potential, vision, building skills and so on. This platform has widened my eyes to different opportunities I never imagined. The people I meet here in the blockchain are valuable to me both in the blockchain and offline.


![ChatGPT Image Apr 28, 2026 at 11_15_19 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/AKAt1ahPQPexq1mVT7eLYYCPHBKiKTmEaamaiDp6tHGDjWMys56KRZJPSrNYYyZ.png)


My success here in the blockchain is based on consistency and engaging in other people's posts, which helps to meet many amazing authors. Of course, there were moments I was full of doubt, moments of loss. In all those moments, I was strengthened and motivated here in the blockchain. Celebrating my four years in blockchain is a moment of gratitude. I am so grateful for every milestone I achieve here, every piece of knowledge I acquire, and every lesson and experience I gather over these years. During this journey I get to understand that success is not all about reaching a destination but the lessons and experience you gather along the way.





I am super excited for it, and I pray for a better future here in blockchain. The Hive blockchain has come to stay; the space is full of opportunities, and there is always something new to explore here. I am so determined to embark on more journeys.

Today I am not just celebrating myself but everyone who has in one way or the other contributed to this journey of four years. Looking back, I am so happy that I have come this far. Wow, four's down and many more to go. Cheers to four years of learning and unlearning.
 
***all image is generated with chatgpt.***

Thank you for stopping by my blog. I appreciate your comment, support and upvote. Do have a lovely day.

# 10 Советов по Оптимизации Производительности Linux-сервера

Привет, администраторы! Если ваш сервер начинает напоминать черепаху на диете, пора что-то менять. Вот 10 советов по оптимизации производительности вашего Linux-сервера, чтобы он снова стал быстрым, как заяц на кофе!

## 1. Обновите систему
Не забывайте обновлять пакеты! Ваш сервер не должен быть похож на музей старинных технологий. 
```bash
sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y
```
Помните, обновления — это не только новые функции, но и безопасность. И да, не бойтесь перезагрузить сервер после обновлений. Он не обидится!

## 2. Удалите ненужные пакеты
Сколько раз вы устанавливали что-то, а потом забыли об этом? Уберите лишнее, чтобы сервер не чувствовал себя как на диете с избыточным количеством калорий.
```bash
sudo apt autoremove -y
```

## 3. Настройте Swap
Если у вас недостаточно оперативной памяти, настройте Swap. Это как запасной парашют, когда ваш основной не сработал. 
```bash
sudo fallocate -l 1G /swapfile
sudo chmod 600 /swapfile
sudo mkswap /swapfile
sudo swapon /swapfile
```

## 4. Используйте SSD
Если ваш сервер все еще работает на HDD, пора задуматься о переходе на SSD. Это как пересадка на спортивный автомобиль после того, как вы катались на старом тракторе.

## 5. Оптимизируйте конфигурацию веб-сервера
Настройте ваш веб-сервер (Nginx, Apache) для лучшей производительности. Используйте кэширование и сжимайте файлы. Не дайте вашему серверу работать в режиме \

.

## 6. Мониторинг ресурсов
Следите за ресурсами вашего сервера с помощью инструментов, таких как `top`, `htop` или `glances`. Это как заглянуть в холодильник, чтобы убедиться, что там не завелись призраки.

## 7. Настройка брандмауэра
Не дайте ненужным соединениям мешать вашему серверу. Настройте брандмауэр, чтобы он пропускал только нужные пакеты. Это как выставить охранника на вход в клуб.

## 8. Используйте CDN
Если у вас есть веб-сайт, подумайте о использовании CDN. Это как иметь множество помощников, которые раздают ваши файлы по всему миру, пока вы сидите на пляже.

## 9. Регулярные резервные копии
Не забывайте делать резервные копии. Это как иметь запасной ключ от дома. Вдруг что-то пойдет не так, и вы не сможете попасть внутрь.

## 10. Не забывайте про документацию
Чтение документации может показаться скучным, но это как читать инструкции к IKEA. Без них вы рискуете собрать что-то совершенно не то.

---

Следуя этим советам, ваш сервер станет быстрее и надежнее, а вы сможете потратить больше времени на что-то более приятное, чем борьба с производительностью. Удачи и пусть ваш сервер всегда будет на пике производительности! 🚀

body.title: My Journey to Montenegro – Cathedral of the Resurrection of Christ
body.body:
## Podgorica, Montenegro

Some places don’t just impress you, they slow you down.
As I arrived in Podgorica, I didn’t expect that one place would leave such a strong impression on me. But the moment I saw the Cathedral of the Resurrection of Christ, I knew this would be more than just another stop on my journey.


![1000037972.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bojang/EpzwjQqJ76XjAbUMU8y4XeXZNnDgDpdVb2TiC44gEDpUPrbUojFkZkDZutvpz9gvqP5.jpg)

Standing in front of it, I felt how massive and powerful it is.
The white stone, the symmetry, the towers rising into the sky, everything feels carefully designed to inspire respect and calm at the same time.
It’s not just architecture. It’s presence.


![1000037974.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bojang/EpGQi285fmKoKQXAhkm42ddat4HPdunG1AZVyxDo9DLDCnuMeoFjqkCYby6N8wqoV5n.jpg)

As I walked closer, following the path toward the entrance, I noticed how naturally people slow down here.
No rush. No noise. Just a quiet movement toward something meaningful.


![1000037988.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bojang/Ep5nBDDQyao4Rw55ckURBWPSbHCdnDHMh89EVL3AsoaAJTQEeLvB8MA5SAs2DwhNHkk.jpg)


Then something truly caught my attention.
A massive Easter egg made of red flowers stood in front of the cathedral, with the words:
“Christ is Risen.”
The color, the symbolism, the message, everything about it felt alive.
It wasn’t just decoration. It was emotion.


![1000037994.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bojang/Ep1XwwLzavcyiJPCBAukFhuFvjnscpfpEogwTskYbZnqbPdcAtSLNGJQVXGgfg1o4UW.jpg)


Of course, I had to stop for a moment and take it all in.
Moments like this are not just for photos, they’re for memory.



![1000037975.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bojang/EpQvFjwK3o8wV1L6YYpZqdCbozqLjq8VykdUmxE3c2yPaMy3ak6LWiRuWXoW7791uxr.jpg)

When I stepped inside, the atmosphere changed instantly.
The walls were covered with icons and frescoes, each telling a story deeper than words.
I sat down for a minut and felt something rare.
Silence, but not empty silence.
The kind that fills you.


![1000037979.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bojang/EoK5nbWuKVSvYBBwyLVKGkVN5DGzm9wfpVxU2e7z7n1ywqF2x6unBSEuHDtni49kVGv.jpg)


While exploring the complex, I came across something very interesting.
A story about the vine of Saint Simeon, connected to the Hilandar Monastery on Mount Athos.


![1000037980.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bojang/EpNntVBrCzpoFKKcWoyWSixZ7CYftGLtjYoEJyeqmQ2AkkDL552VKKeCM9GrHeUFtpJ.jpg)


Seeing it there, growing quietly, made me realize how strong tradition can be.
It’s not just history, it’s something alive, still present.


![1000037981.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bojang/EppKmdT9gYwMPsssbBQ7uBwMRZvBGQmE4dRnsXMjdSRcrmCejNcJvpaTcB9M8r5ZSUY.jpg)

![1000037985.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bojang/EpGRBCiGFaDfsbktzQq2RjUGj41qPseRe4ajx9F1wR7GrJat3vdA17cidCmo8A1CMi5.jpg)


Walking around the cathedral, I noticed how much care was put into every detail.
Flowers, greenery, wooden structures, everything creates a sense of harmony between nature and spirituality.


![1000037987.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bojang/23y922rjuBvRZiYb9QfwoBNWDq3PhgUbAbZm7S8q43N14b2H7Azx6qGHLTMrd4SgqvRjN.jpg)

From the side, the cathedral reveals even more beauty.
The textures, the shapes, the small details in the stone, the longer you look, the more you see.

I didn’t come here expecting anything special.
But I left with something I can’t really describe a feeling of calm, clarity, and quiet strength.
Places like this remind us that travel is not just about where we go,
but about what we feel along the way.


![1000037973.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bojang/EqDk1gem5QJEgjXw3PNA4BLf8coB4YesXqeyKWrGA58ifsXF9CvX3kkhsV62tbSJUy3.jpg)

￼￼
Ein bisschen Musik hören, ein bisschen lesen, ein bisschen mit der KI rumspielen, ein bisschen die Augen zu machen und die Sonne genießen. Das wird heute bestimmt ein Verdammt fauler Tag.

Ich bin ja im Urlaub immer für einen Mix aus Nix tun und ein bisschen was anschauen in der Gegend wo man gerade ist, sofern es auch wirklich was zum ansehen gibt.

Was ist eure Lieblingsbeschäftigung im Urlaub? ￼

body.title: Termush by Sven Holm
body.body:
### <center>Introduction</center>

<hr>

I completed my ninth book of the year last night. I'm well on my way to reaching my goal of reading 12 books for 2026. 

This one was a very short novella of only 100 pages. I actually completed it in one day which is very unlike me, even for one so short. I'm finding that reading a short book between much longer ones is a good way to resent myself and an even better way of padding my book reading numbers. A book is a book, right? 

Anyway, the I completed book was called Termush and was originally written in 1967 by a Danish author by the name of Sven Holm. It was translated to English by author Sylvia Clayton.  

### <center>Cover Art</center>

<hr>

![1000018115.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23vhz6yamg71CV9fS8H8jVjWuQXCs838rkfwHrYYXEUQJjfyiUrc3yxAM9HtUQc2zJJT2.jpg)

Let me start this review by talking about the cover art. At first I didn't like the covers design. I thought that it looked cheap, and tacky in a way. The more I look at it the more it grows on me though. The image is a nuclear mushroom cloud set inside a hotel desk bell. Its somewhat clever and fitting to the story and I actually appreciate it a little more now.  

### <center>Brief Synopsis</center>

<hr>

The story is set in a post-apocalyptic world where an unspecified nuclear attack or disaster has ravaged the earth. A group of wealthy individuals emerge from shelter to spend their days in a luxury hotel. They paid for the priveledge of safety. The Hotel management tailors the guests life and curate their reality. Conflict arises in the story when strangers living outside the hotel, sick from nuclear fallout, begin to arrive at the hotel in order to seek help and safety.   

### <center>Conclusion</center>

<hr>

Overall I'd give this book 3 out of 5 stars with all its points going to its prose. The book was nicely written and its a very good translation. On the other hand, the books minimalist style didn't really provide anything at all. There was virtually no character development, which is to be expected in a short novella, but there was also no real plot. Nothing really happened in the story at all. I feel like the author had a message that they were trying to convey, a commentary on some aspect of life and society and the world that we live in, but it was so subtle and sparsely written about that your mind just sort of glazes over such things. Mine did at least.

I looked up an analysis on the book afterwards to see what others said about it and I could recognize the themes and ideas that they discussed and pointed out. The only idea that really stood out for me as being clever though was this idea of commodifying survival - paying for safety in a nuclear apocalypse. In the world of Termush, survival itself is a luxury that can be bought. Its an interesting concept.

The rest of the ideas amd themes might possibly have been new in 1967 but now they are well played tropes so they were sort of \

to me.       

For me this book was missing something overall. It wasn't interesting or exciting and worst of all it didn't make me think. Its the type of book that is read and immediately forgotten. Its unfortunate because I had high hopes for it. 

Personally, I wouldn't waste your time on this one, unless maybe you're an English major and really love to dig into analyzing stories for any sort of meaning. Or maybe if you want a short book with nice prose that you can read in a day. Aside from those two scenarios Termush is not something that I would recommend.

body.title: Walking through the Forest [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
![Miniatura de Youtube Tradiciones México Moderna .jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23uFTmwHMaZFEfWJiHNDzQhBrbcvrTTU76j9fV1dLBRH3Zbw7KjPi6XBFJCHVTTbEVZHa.jpg)

Yesterday, my husband and I went for a walk to make the most of the weekend. We went to one of our favorite places in Valencia, which is like our green lung. Negra Hipólita Park has a forest inside, a beautiful forest full of all kinds of trees—well, all kinds that exist here in Venezuela. Almost everywhere you look, you can find signs with detailed and important information about all the elements of this ecosystem, not only about the trees and the river that runs through the city, but also about the fauna, which is quite rich and diverse. Among the animals I saw were parrots, macaws, iguanas, and capybaras. >Ayer estuve dando un paseo junto a mi esposo para aprovechar el fin de semana, nos fuimos a uno de nuestros lugares favoritos en la ciudad de Valencia, ya que es algo así como nuestro pulmón verde. El parque negra Hipólita tiene un bosque en su interior, un bosque hermoso lleno de arboles de todas las clases, bueno, de todas las que hay aquí en Venezuela. En casi todas partes puedes encontrar carteles con información detallada e importante sobre todos los elementos de ese ecosistema, no solo de los árboles y el río que atraviesa la ciudad, sino de la fauna, la cuál es bastante rica y diversa, entre los animales que vi había: loros, guacamayas iguanas y chigüires o capibaras.

![25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23wMYapeBEaEbW1eV327ewjvtEq2DH82FZtZNyCcjEfTTrmhktvdpMR54bvvRBR6LbWtY.jpg)
![joo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/Ep1VTo4X1GR3GGnRt6WiPYREA6y9zSbhXdQCYRaQMC9QMnKP9TSKaAnoHCNT2qH3nFb.jpg)

There's a tree that really caught my eye because it's like two trees in one, or a Siamese tree, with two thin trunks at the top but a single thick base. In fact, that tree was attracting everyone's attention. I don't know its name because, strangely enough, despite being one of the most beautiful and striking, it doesn't have any information or QR code like the others.

>Hay un árbol que llamó poderosamente mi atención ya que es como si fuesen dos árboles en uno, o un árbol siamés, ya que arriba tiene dos troncos delgados pero una sola base gruesa. De hecho ese árbol llamaba la atención de todo el mundo, no sé como se llama porque extrañamente y a pesar de ser uno de los más bonitos y llamativos no tiene ninguna información ni código QR como los demás .
![jj.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23w2HQFNBoCwymFTivabgTw98FmQdFA5BZXJadgiuRbfzLbcGH2LxaBewf3SZBLWSkzcY.jpg)
![lhlh.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23vi21QSynUbnaaRsrYBzPueiDoyZR3Hs4MTe4Nv3AycDZbKrfr47Hohgm9TfK3XJYDLG.jpg)

There's also a very pretty well—well, it's not a real well, it's more of a structure that looks like one. I like it because it gives the place a fairytale feel, especially since it's right in the middle of the forest. My husband and I strolled around that area for a while, reminiscing about when we were dating and used to go to that park on weekends when he came to town. Remembering those old times and getting away from our routine now and then is always good for us; it helps us feel refreshed, especially when we're surrounded by so much beautiful greenery.

>También hay pozo muy bonito, bueno aunque no es un pozo de verdad, es una estructura que más bien simula ser un pozo, me gusta porque le confiere al lugar un aura de cuento de hadas, sobre todo porque está en pleno bosque. Mi esposo y yo paseamos un rato por esa área recordando los tiempos en que éramos novios e íbamos a ese parque a pasear los fines de semana cuando él venía a la ciudad. Recordar esos viejos tiempos y salirnos de la rutina de vez en cuando siempre nos viene bien para sentirnos renovados, y en especial cuando se está rodeados de tanta vegetación hermosa.
![ññ''ñ.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23xp4iHRLwz5xdwe9uumGe9NDSoWUN8fr2tqqsRTLYcsY7s1o4CAnPFbhoSV8DPt5orxx.jpg)

A little further on is the statue of the miraculous Virgin with her outstretched hands. It's a very popular spot, as you can see from the worn and polished material of the statue. I really like this place because it's located in a grotto, so in this area you only hear the wind rustling the tree branches and the murmur of water running in the grotto. And even though the Central Regional Highway runs alongside the park, the dense foliage of the trees prevents the sound of passing cars from disturbing the peace of the place.

>Un poco más allá está la estatua de la virgen milagrosa con sus manos extendidas, es un sitio muy visitado, como se pueden dar cuenta al ver el material desgastado y pulido en la estatua . me gusta mucho este sitio porque está situado en una gruta, así que en esta área uno solo escucha el viento meciendo las ramas de los árboles y el rumor del agua corriendo en la gruta, y a pesar de que junto al parque está la autopista regional del centro, el tupido follaje de los arboles impide que el sonido de los carros pasando perturben la paz de ese lugar.
![gdd.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23yThCUkfMSa1XcxtYWusXXthFA926MnzwHs5Azf6audhzvNAnWGiUiBLv3MBGWgVX2pB.jpg)
![khk.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EoeFNvMitJ7rdJ3vbVksVDqq9tg2bH9c6E2hr6oqJS3WCfPLxc5TLUTdNRfV11bRDHA.jpg)
![l{.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23wqeGF1CqwxDo1a4yowSnatEz238QYkmd5u2WaPjyMUkC2xLxSQZxzsUT2HwjY2s3te4.jpg)

I really enjoyed going there. I go whenever I can to feel a little more in harmony with nature. It's a beautiful place I'll always want to visit. Thank you for your attention. Sending you lots of virtual kisses and hugs 😘 🤗.

>De verdad que me gustó mucho ir allí, yo voy cada vez que puedo, para sentirme un poco más en armonía con la naturaleza, es un lugar precioso al que siempre querré ir Gracias por su atención, les mando muchos besos y abrazos virtuales 😘 🤗.
![_Miniatura de Youtube Procrastinación Simple Dorado y Crema.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/245n5WzTfDjt8QuC1CfX1iGPu5crq9bsYhnHjwPHUAnBL93vKUMEPGEND9gUCyLLvHj4k.jpg)

body.title: Magical Family Adventure [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
![Pink Yellow Aesthetic Collage Travel Diaries Vlog YouTube Thumbnail.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23x1BKXnZFGTQdgSpSHrAH4diTxDjays8iKdfcEq6WdgbHRJTZbtZA33DmNZEBrAZoLR5.jpg)
(Portada diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva)
>Cover designed by me in canva editor

Hello friends, I'm so happy to share with you a wonderful time I spent with my family. It's been a while since we've enjoyed a get-together with our cousins, and that's because my cousin Juan José lives in Chile, having emigrated from Venezuela eight years ago, like many people in the country. He came to Chile a few years ago with another cousin, but his stay was short, so we didn't have the chance to enjoy as much family time as we'd like. He and his sister @emperatriz1503 have always been like older siblings to my sister and me. >Hola amigos, me alegra muchísimo compartir con ustedes un rato super agradable que pasé con mi familia, y es que desde hace rato que no disfrutábamos una salida entre primos y es que mi primo Juan José vive en Chile, ya que emigró de Venezuela desde hace ya ocho años, como muchas personas en el país. Él vino hace algunos años en compañía de otro de mis primos , pero en esa ocasión vino por poco tiempo, así que no nos quedó ocasión de disfrutar a nuestro antojo del tiempo en familia. Él y su hermana @emperatriz1503 siempre han sido como grandes hermanos para mi hermana y para mi.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.08 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/AKLu4c915sUgVgJvjuc9w1bjA3Yn99wcRQQrLLAQPSE36ieZasnrd8fhf9SYvJ3.jpeg)

Over the weekend, my sister and I decided to go to our favorite spot in town, a café-restaurant that also doubles as a bookstore and library. Since the place is themed around Harry Potter, we thoroughly enjoyed the experience. First, we sat down to chat and catch up on everything, then we savored our desserts and coffees.

>El fin de semana mi hermana y yo decidimos organizar una salida a nuestro lugar favorito en la ciudad, un café restaurante que también funge como librería y biblioteca, pero ya que el lugar es temático, ambientado totalmente en Harry Potter disfrutamos muchísimo la experiencia. Primero nos sentamos a conversar poniéndonos al día con todas nuestras experiencias, después degustamos nuestros postres y cafés.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.50 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EpnDqWiki5VbruadVeaubo8EmAQ1oM7rJQdhFq1igtEErSitgfYhCMA4jNFPN8pA8Ko.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.53 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EopsrkEbUnA4pa5TwX4Ttk5LcGVRv5ggs6UEUceKEAUFSEg3ujFEshxS5aRHCBdz2Dv.jpeg)

After that, we explored the area and finally went to our favorite spot to cosplay as Hogwarts students. The best part was that since there were exactly four of us, we each took on a different Hogwarts house. I'm a Ravenclaw, of course, so I chose the blue robes. We had a great time and a lot of fun during our photoshoot, but without a doubt, what I enjoyed most was seeing my cousin again, hugging him, and cuddling him. He was like my first \

so to speak. Before my sister was born, I would go to my aunt's house when she was pregnant with my cousin, and then when he was born, I couldn't stop loving him.

>Después nos dedicamos a explorar el lugar y por último fuimos hasta nuestro spot favorito para hacer cosplay como estudiantes de Hogwarts, lo mejor de todo es que como éramos exactamente cuatro personas entonces cada uno asumió una casa de Hogwarts diferente. Yo desde luego soy Ravenclaw, así que elegí la túnica azul. La pasamos super bien y nos divertimos un montón en nuestra sesión de fotos, pero sin lugar a dudas que lo que más disfruté fue poder ver a mi primo nuevamente, abrazarlo y mimarlo, porque él fue mi primer “hermano” por así decirlo, cuando yo no tenía a mi hermana aún, yo me iba a casa de mi tía cuando ella estaba embarazada de mi primo, y luego cuando nació no hice otra cosa más que quererlo.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.46 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EpVDuzBUmvJe6GcgfN2fjBCoKnP45U6fcGDhusGHGaZadnHHdXZVPjkHaFweKT7Um6x.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.47 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/242DGJLNuzunbRa68ArmuYMXfMoJYGq3pBKphQEa2V7TCkUCoqk5oMMtqAwL2xeApgJW8.jpeg)

It was also a great opportunity to see my beautiful cousin and spend a lot of quality time with her, because even though she still lives in the country, she is a doctor, so she has very limited time.

>También fue una gran oportunidad para ver a mi hermosa prima y compartir con ella mucho tiempo de calidad, porque a pesar de que ella sí continúa viviendo en el país, ella es médico, así que tiene el tiempo muy limitado.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.44 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EpnFEyrJbZaSNmKg7rH2zbBR6PBkpmpHYiGL2pLjKjv2qB2kaR41NMGKoR43kpqARFc.jpeg)

Thank you so much for allowing me to share this post with you, filled with emotion and love for family; for us, it is a blessing to be able to be together 🤗.

>Muchas gracias por permitirme compartir con ustedes este post cargado de emoción y amor por la familia, para nosotros es una bendición poder estar juntos 🤗.

body.title: A Stroll Through the Shopping Center with Julian [As a babysitter] ESP/ENG
body.body:
![Un día en mi vida Miniatura de YouTube Amarillo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23ynUGNUkPkgeZcQB1gVEPsJjwT1H8dWZwVb11oHWFZjgPtsckGknXRKVhnNbKHFwhGy9.jpg)

Hello, hello internet people! How are you? Yesterday I was walking around a good part of the Sambil shopping center in Valencia while I was working, because, for those who don't know, for some time now I've been working as a nanny for a five-month-old baby and it's a somewhat new experience for me since previously, when I lived in Colombia, I was a nanny for an even younger baby, but every experience with every child is different. >¡Hola, Hola gente de internet! ¿Cómo están? Ayer estuve recorriendo buena parte del centro comercial Sambil en Valencia mientras trabajaba, ya que, para los que no lo sepan, desde hace un tiempo para acá yo trabajo como niñera de un bebé de cinco meses de edad y es una experiencia un poco nueva para mi ya que anteriormente mientras viví en Colombia yo fui niñera de una bebé incluso más pequeña, pero cada experiencia con cada niño es diferente.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-26 at 9.01.56 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23uFTmUmWB5v2RAqnUaemyifEy3UfXEfPmUbiP93NZCyPmEKScejQmnkMhD52oZvu2uQe.jpeg)

My bosses are really nice people. In fact, one of them is my former neighbor and lifelong schoolmate (we went to elementary and high school together, and we rode the same school bus to and from school). But because we had very different tastes and interests, we'd never been friends until now. Anyway, my friend and her husband were enjoying some quality time together watching a movie at the theater, while little Julian and I were wandering around the mall looking for something to do. However, since it was already late and nighttime, it didn't seem like there were many options.

>Mis jefes son súper buenas personas , de hecho se trata de mi ex vecina y compañera del colegio de toda la vida (ambas estudiamos juntas en la primaria y en la secundaria, nos íbamos y regresábamos del colegio en el mismo transporte escolar) pero en realidad debido a que teníamos gustos e intereses muy diferentes, nunca antes hasta ahora habíamos sido amigas. En fin, el caso es que mi amiga y su esposo estaban dándose un merecido tiempo juntos viendo una película en el cine mientras que el pequeño Julián y yo nos dedicábamos a recorrer el centro comercial en busca de algo para hacer, sin embargo como ya era de noche y un poco tarde parecía que no habían demasiadas opciones.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-26 at 8.27.23 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23x19F2Z8yJXaAoBDXXTjD93zR6ziiTXvoy5RqyYjS1PTDFfr5NYvi4kpBe7WcGvy7oqH.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-26 at 8.27.56 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wqi8w5TqvHnXEfy3hUSX8W3jFQ1fe4EBVnwJ4DDtPwWEAorzjoQFVykVa9UNiQuyp3r.jpeg)

It was cold, and although we were both bundled up and Julián looked fine (I'd already given him his bottle and changed his diaper), I wanted to get something to eat to warm up, and that's when I found this gem, Anella Café, a coffee shop I really like. I've been there a few times, but to other locations. I didn't know there was one in Sambil, so I ordered a coffee (Vanilla Latte) and a Red Velvet cookie. Julián didn't want any since he'd just eaten.

>Hacía frío y aunque ambos estábamos muy bien abrigados y Julián se veía muy bien, (ya le había dado su biberón y le cambié el pañal) yo quería conseguir algo para merendar y entrar en calor, y fue entonces cuando encontré esta joya, Anella Café una cafetería que me gusta mucho, he ido algunas veces pero a otras sedes, no sabía que había una en el Sambil, así que me pedí un café (Latte Vainilla) y una galleta de Red Velvet. Julián no quería ya que acababa de comer.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-26 at 7.39.21 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23xp2U93Z2GRTVcqRpFtpQadeMFx7K98fKM8Hw7535TdsLasWkJ89oMyyuK9zkTt2R1sn.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-26 at 7.18.42 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EoCbSt73V4tvkmW7ikMUfJSyvnxNUq4zWrMXdHfsF9edvxrrQBcGtsT1YL2ySSaD5Sm.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-26 at 7.18.33 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23u6DvwkWaDCtLd27kEh3vZo7HQukNMi8VJLbSGpmFZEmcB7UjGdeKcLWb5RPuSsQLct3.jpeg)

After warming up and enjoying that delicious snack, we continued our tour of the mall and found something wonderful! Ahhhhhhh! 😃 Something I love, an arcade, yes, one of those places where you can spend all day playing video games and doing really fun things (don't judge me, hehe, I'm a gamer, so I really enjoy these things). I used to go a lot to one of these arcades called Yamile's Family Center, which was in the Metropolis Shopping Center in Valencia (Venezuela), but over time that arcade closed its doors.

>Después de entrar en calor y de degustar esa deliciosa merienda continuamos el recorrido por el centro comercial y encontramos algo maravilloso ¡Ahhhhhhh! 😃 Algo que me encanta, un Arcade, sí uno de esos sitios donde puedes pasar todo el día jugando video juegos y haciendo cosas muy divertidas (no me juzguen jeje soy gamer, así que disfruto mucho de estas cosas) Antes yo iba mucho a uno de estos Arcade que se llamaban Yamile´s Family Center que estaban en el Centro Comercial Metrópolis en Valencia (Venezuela) pero con el pasar del tiempo ese Arcade cerró sus puertas.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-26 at 9.07.19 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23uQjypd3EqPrVhAydsyAb9gGGUkfjdqX8bZ1om6AHhoL1f9grGxxMoLmoqi94RXoN65n.jpeg)

I also found a shop that looks very interesting, as it sells antiques and gifts (I would like to go back another time much earlier when the shop is open, to have a more detailed look) It's called The Smoker's Emporium As for the Arcade, I plan to return with my sister, my cousins, or my friends.

>También conseguí una tienda que se ve muy interesante, ya que es de antigüedades y regalos (me gustaría ir en otra ocasión mucho más temprano cuando la tienda este abierta, para ir a curiosear más detalladamente) Se llama El Emporio del Fumador en cuanto al Arcade pienso regresar también junto a mi hermana, mis primos o mis amigos.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-26 at 8.58.52 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23yTfKwuH7w5kHvH2jyYY7bmjpLw9ixAy1aZ8ekK3gEUp4Bpok9y9ZsBxwEZjubCNHvSM.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-26 at 8.58.39 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23z79qRQR2B9d9aaXJVhXjthSKwnDNL7EyHmGj2RKNAyZrXg1gLpEGpWKpDg574DwdJt2.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-26 at 8.59.41 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23w2cuEesHrdx8zdeqhQ6g37WhmJDFn8sSjAzteeVKiTFFWKfnrK9XegvuNbYX6HjdTTg.jpeg)

body.title: MY HOME GARDEN NEWS
body.body:
My green news has come

Look what gives pleasure for my soul now!


![photo_2026-04-28_13-44-07.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQzT6eWuTswBr37EPXcMiytnpSNVX2EYAEyizA9icqDra/photo_2026-04-28_13-44-07.jpg)


I planted my first seeds on the 10th of March, and when they woke up it looked like this.



![photo_2026-04-28_13-14-43.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbA2SERm4qn7hN3x5TnGCCMzMh1iQssn6xrykgViYwvFL/photo_2026-04-28_13-14-43.jpg)


![photo_2026-04-28_13-14-42.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbm1CHTeE7vhNzhWngEn1AxkpaZ41JXF3XSTrSAKCL9gZ/photo_2026-04-28_13-14-42.jpg)


It's my first experience in growing plants for my garden at home when it's still cold outside, so I made everything without any knowledge what to do and how. 
I read about watering, sunlight, humidity, different types of vitamins but there are hundreds methods and million of advice, and which of them are good is a big question.
Internet is Internet, you know;)

I planted tomatoes and peppers, and I noticed tomatoes grow much faster!
But...peppers require less attention.
Tomatoes depand of everything - too much water, too little water, too much sun, too little sun;)
Peppers are more stable as far as I see. 
At least for now;)

Some of my tomatoes felt bad and became dry soon. Don't know why.
Peppers are still all alive.
Now I want warm weather in May come soon to plant them in the garden at last because I'm a little bit tired to guess what they need now, and what I do wrong;))
The first experience is not easy, I must admit;)

For now my home garden looks like this


![photo_2026-04-28_13-44-05.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU4L3Yg4qqtwVx7H9Sch87HFqdo1iJbFDQdpcUStQZXoW/photo_2026-04-28_13-44-05.jpg)



![photo_2026-04-28_13-44-06.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmceqz5o18grD2AVFyHLg4cYLnFqKqUEvnTPEeTKqeHQaE/photo_2026-04-28_13-44-06.jpg)

And despite all difficlulties I'm so happy looking at them!;)
They are like my kids which I grew from thetiny seed and I do want to see them big, healthy and with good harvest!;))

body.title: Just a Peek of Rancho Pogi: Exciting Moment of Visiting a New Place with Mama -It's Just the Entrance, But It's a Nice Experience
body.body:
>

![1000035294.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoH1oKPMBBXX6MsaL97z7GihQhiv9LKvFkz6BRV9wtNDoQptUvBfUqnCQWUmvHBwVqJ.png)

I'm from Bansud, particularly in Poblacion but there's still a lot of place here that I haven't visit. In fact, I can count on my fingers the number of Barangays I've been to, more than the place I haven't visited. Like, you can already tell how homebody I am right? Lol. I had the chance to do that back when I was still in my 20s, but well, having struck parents stop me from doing that, sad. Even the closest place in our home, I haven't even check it, lol.

There's this path, a minute away from home called Rancho Pogi. According to Mama, we lived in there before, I was still a baby then, and they are just renting. When I become aware of everything, we are already living in our old house, near the highway. I am not sure how big of a place Rancho Pogi is but I really wish I can check it. But its not like I know anyone just to bathe in there, lol.

<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eq5FV2krt3t6upzPHEh9jGHymvwW4hm7bYvbhsjYNWeTozz3SW3QHysV8AmrrTX5PW8.jpg Today, I didn't really walk further in there, just the entrance but I get to see what its like inside. After a really beautiful big church, inside has a lot of beautiful houses, *sana all*.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EqDkbX5Yn7HKW5ahPS5rk645LHTp9TMRHg55vzPGSRwHmBJZHFeu2btkw1KmMFPuPka.jpg I really, really want to go further but the place we had to visit -to buy a sack of charcoal, -is just near the entrance. But still, I get to see the entrance so i'm okay with that. Not really sure if Rancho Pogi is a village or what, but whatever.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EqBcEsKKbU7RyZShSv2ypVMtc5EStjsjgkdUnzaQ5D9tRtpefQQau8EQWd5LgG5EYkx.jpg There's also small houses but they have gate. Mama knows the owner, and I don't. Gosh, I really didn't know much people on earth haha. .

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EprV5sN3q7Bzwr3QcXMsHgfGL86q6LNKNeWYBAWwkPSjBfKfGt4v1QfrJJqVqJhZYT5.jpg Here'a the place where Mama bought two sacks of charcoal. When I see the sack, it is quite a bit sack and mama said there's a 20 pesos price increased. She said their charcoal is really good so she grab one even if there'a a price increased. The other sack is for Mommy D's sister, Aunt V.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Ep3fieAd2RX3XPfgUJ5j9MRnjP2dJ7QDo2Ujqk5xWYa3fzgRRKSHYBTUSBoQbtLRS5g.jpg While Mother's talking to the shop owner there, I was on the other side of the road hiding on my cap and facemask hahaha -and yeah snapping photos. This walk made me feel good, I really wish we could go further than this but maybe I will convince Mama next time. I am super curious what's its like there, on the deepest path of this Rancho Pogi

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EpxrHGU7fULyUVkQ4ZQSgfAprB63uVP9RV9tNBCgaD2Cd6eYpgVzrLJaWhkky52d4K6.jpg After minutes of talk, we then go on our way home, ahh, Creamy White is with us by the way. Hehe. And yeah, that's how my lil and quick adventure in Rancho Pogi ended. How I wish I have more to show. And I am surely sure that this place has more hidden beauty. I should make this a goal now because I am really curious, lol ----- Lead Image Edited in [Canva](https://canva.link/x8gztj8y9tt164p)

body.title: MCGI Topic Review | Marriage After Death Of Partner
body.body: > https://youtu.be/5OYmS8syUlo?si=xbwRMKkyPSVgkc3w One of the popular topic for discussion in our presently society is in the aspect of marriage. First of all, we need to establish the fact that marriage is actually a holy union that was created by God. It was built on love, on faithfulness, on respect and even also on commitment. But one of the things I have actually come to discover about the painful reality of it is the fact that what happens after the death of your partner in marriage. What is the next step of action to taken when your husband or your wife dies? Every surviving partner weather it is the husband or the wife actually faces deep sorrow and many questions that runs through their mind. The popular question in the heart of many is whether God wants us to marry again after the death of our partner or not. But thank God, the bible gives us the truth we need which I will be talking about. First of all, the bible teaches that Marriage is binding when both the husband and the wife is alive. In Romans 7:2, it says, “For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth. Marriage covenants for me remains only when both are living. But when one partner die, the bond ends. What I mean is the fact that death releases the surviving spouse from that marital obligation. In 1 Corinthians 7:39, Apostle Paul clearly said, “The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord. Can you see that even the bible point out to the fact that there is nothing wrong in remarriage. Remarriage is actually allowed but it must be done with the wisdom of God and the fear of God. Not only that, the surviving partner must make sure that if he or she is remarry, she or he is getting married to someone who follows the Lord.

Hola, amigos de Hive Es un gusto saludarlos nuevamente en esta semana 185, segunda ronda del Hive Music Festival. En esta ocasión, me siento muy emocionada de compartir con todos ustedes una pieza icónica de nuestra música llanera titulada \

, del inolvidable Eneas Perdomo. Para esta interpretación, he seleccionado el tono de Re mayor, buscando capturar toda la esencia y el sentimiento que esta canción merece. Lo que hace esta presentación aún más especial es que cuento con el honor de tener el acompañamiento de fondo del Maestro Ramón Páez en el arpa, cuya maestría y cadencia llanera brindan el marco perfecto para que la melodía cobre. Como siempre, mi intención es llevarles un pedacito de nuestra cultura, interpretada con todo el cariño y respeto que siento por el folklore. Participar en este festival ha sido una experiencia maravillosa que me permite conectar con otros músicos y amantes de la cultura en esta increíble plataforma, donde cada semana nos esforzamos por dar lo mejor de nosotros. Espero que disfruten de esta versión tanto como yo disfruté grabándola, pues cada nota está cargada de la pasión que siento por nuestra música venezolana. Agradezco enormemente el apoyo constante de la comunidad y los comentarios que siempre me impulsan a seguir mejorando y compartiendo mi arte con todos ustedes. Sin más que agregar, los dejo con los acordes del arpa y el cuatro. Les manda un gran abrazo y un saludo muy especial su amiga @Yoxibeth.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yoxibeth/242Nocwfu6Qk1t4W8UAUn3VVKaM43JNpSPJMTfXdgwdrM1F6VKVWJeo9FQbgv25TF6fBs.PNG

On this occasion, I’m thrilled to share with all of you an iconic piece of our Llanera music titled “Flor Sabanera,” by the unforgettable Eneas Perdomo. For this performance, I’ve chosen the key of D major, seeking to capture all the essence and emotion this song deserves. What makes this performance even more special is that I have the honor of being accompanied by Maestro Ramón Páez on the harp, whose mastery and llanera rhythm provide the perfect backdrop for the melody to shine. >As always, my intention is to bring you a little piece of our culture, performed with all the love and respect I feel for folklore. Participating in this festival has been a wonderful experience that allows me to connect with other musicians and culture lovers on this incredible platform, where every week we strive to give our very best. >I hope you enjoy this version as much as I enjoyed recording it, for every note is filled with the passion I feel for our Venezuelan music. Participar en este festival ha sido una experiencia maravillosa que me permite conectar con otros músicos y amantes de la cultura en esta increíble plataforma, donde cada semana nos esforzamos por dar lo mejor de nosotros. Espero que disfruten de esta versión tanto como yo disfruté grabándola, pues cada nota está cargada de la pasión que siento por nuestra música venezolana. Agradezco enormemente el apoyo constante de la comunidad y los comentarios que siempre me impulsan a seguir mejorando y compartiendo mi arte con todos ustedes. Sin más que agregar, los dejo con los acordes del arpa y el cuatro. Les manda un gran abrazo y un saludo muy especial su amiga @Yoxibeth.

body.title: Winning a Game with No Pieces Captured
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbeekaE9nXZc3NCrfGyf5n7ZF5RQvhmy9WUNgar2Zn8Kn/image.png)
white to move and win
 Greetings to all chess fans! The game I'm going to show today was played between Nigel Short and Dorsa Derakshani in 2016. Nigel Short is an English grandmaster and best know for challenging Garry Kasparov for the world title in 1993. Dorsa Derakshani is a female International Master from Iran. She was banned by the Iranian Chess Federation for competing without a hijab and subsequently moved to the US to continue her chess career. The game they played was unusual as it ended without any piece being captured. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZHVSP1DND7kdWvBkmY3VZQqhFM4pLyhqEJRoYJTuxnjg/image.png) The game started with 1. c4 e5 2. e3 Nc6 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY5wMXnRgk4tgkErgkTAAZREq3StZ9LgYgAqPvebScWkP/image.png) The English opening, also known as a reverse Sicilian. It's characterized by 1. c4 instead of the usual e4 or d4 opening for White. 3. a3 Nf6 4. Nc3 g6 5. d3 Bg7 6. g4 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdTUrVBDBdHWLPBrVniJTdHMf7GraqhMkjx6BmDN4HU5A/image.png) Short signals his intention to attack in the King side with the move g4. 6. ...h6 7. Bg2 d6 8. h3 Be6 9. Nd5 Qd7 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV3ujUP5MQiTp981ZtG7iuPGgp9iF5dAyqdPs6wAUd6Mh/image.png) Qd7 opens the option to castle on the Queen side. 10. Ne2 Nd8 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWZw3Z8AVwaxcW9FzAfUs43whogRpKMM7cmu3DKMGSY1F/image.png) Dorsa retreated her Knight with the intention of moving c6 to drive away White's strong Knight in the center. 11. b3 Nh7 12. e4 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRkFnMijHr4BFFKsuEJH98pGJeVnAQLFZXQnNeB5aa13E/image.png) Short moved e4 to prevent Black's freeing move, f5. 12. ...c6 13. Ne3 Qe7 14. Bb2 Bd7 15. d4 O-O 16. d5 c5 17. Qc2 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQBV2ytf1EG4wuNq9qqdPrJ4ErsKzii5scQfbcU7gVrmj/image.png) The position is closed. White can push f4 to begin his attack but has to protect his Bishop on b2 first. Qc2 also prepares for Queen side castling. 17. ...Qh4 18. Nc3 b6 19. O-O-O Nb7 20. Bf1 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUjcBhnGayKeXAgcJL8jc4AmyTfSSv1wBrts7MzGgnnmE/image.png) Bf1 with the intention of moving the Knight to g2 and prepare to push f4 but here Black blundered with 20. ...Ng5 21. Ng2 1-0 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbAfyC7jwHncCcSAEYCJ7NooeQ3Ax19dbwP17MWXAaXUU/image.png) Black was shocked to find her Queen trapped on h4 and resigned. The game ended without any pieces being captured. Game link: https://lichess.org/Qi9xtvdG

body.title: Tuesday A sunrise walk at Heritage State Park
body.body:
# A sunrise walk at Heritage State Park As I write this a week in advane of when I will post it, the nice spring weather we had for a week has moved away and its cooled down a lot its just on freezing point outside as I write this, but I cannot complain I made the most of the few nice days we had and got out for some nice morning walks, one of them being the Fall River Heritage State park around sunrise, and which I will share photos of today, while i wait patiently for the nicer weather to return The park is about a 25 minute drive from my house, and as it happened that morning, I had a Doctors appointment in Fall River so I headed to Fall River early to catch the sunrise and get a walk in. Its a real nice spot for a walk, there is a nice boardwalk to stroll along which I enjoy visiting, it can be quite slippery if it has recently rained, but luckily the morning i took these it was dry and fine to walk on
![sunrise heritage state park-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23ryWwqDZTJsKjxgmd3zKKwD1vLasxodMDMXacuBQDxSfzycRZ4wTnKe7AJzp9QKJXrSR.jpg) **Sony A7iv 17mm F11 4 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23ryWwqDZTJsKjxgmd3zKKwD1vLasxodMDMXacuBQDxSfzycRZ4wTnKe7AJzp9QKJXrSR.jpg)**

there are also a few spots along the walk with piers of various sizes, that one can walk out on and get views like this next shot
![sunrise heritage state park.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23ywJwpkuTpLHMCbDW4bj8xZK6NDBPeLExvJtyZQpzrVU7Y96czu6JCE97XmYjhhbCDHB.jpg) **Sony A7iv 28mm F11 3.2 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23ywJwpkuTpLHMCbDW4bj8xZK6NDBPeLExvJtyZQpzrVU7Y96czu6JCE97XmYjhhbCDHB.jpg)**

there was hardly any wind that morning so the water was quite still which made for some cool reflections a shot from another pier, gorgeous sunrise colors and a few small boats lined up, I guess they belong to some sailing club
![sunrise heritage state park-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/245mi331X2fDwPEGZrbnGkLcgjjCbDxMeCU43s7ac8qDPqz66KnFnPESUoQbWCfKSc94Z.jpg) **Sony A7iv 24mm F11 1.6 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/245mi331X2fDwPEGZrbnGkLcgjjCbDxMeCU43s7ac8qDPqz66KnFnPESUoQbWCfKSc94Z.jpg)**

Further along thew walkway, and looking back to where i had come from, I was parked in a spot close to but not quite under the Brage Bridge shown in this next shot, and that building inthe foreground is a restaurant
![sunrise heritage state park-4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23ujg7VqHTLSevhFcAzUefXpqD9QqJ5WtX3sCzaRehMHFkFRk4Vsc6BeKcdrPbvfZiLU3.jpg) **Sony A7iv 17mm F11 1.2 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23ujg7VqHTLSevhFcAzUefXpqD9QqJ5WtX3sCzaRehMHFkFRk4Vsc6BeKcdrPbvfZiLU3.jpg)**

## And that’s all folks *** ## unless stated otherwise all photos used in my posts are taken and owned by myself, if you wish to use any of my images please contact me. *** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/QGGXzaN9-4LQGm7AE-tattoodjay.gif) *** ![TEAMUSA JJ hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/4ZhsGb6n-TEAMUSA20JJ20-hive.jpg) ## TeamUSA is a Community for and supporting those from of in the United States, and now is in the process of rebuilding stronger than ever join us on [Discord](https://discord.gg/85ac2SM)
