body.title: Yan Diomande, un extremo en ascenso meteórico/ Yan Diomande, a winger on a meteoric rise
body.body:
El extremo marfileño de 19 años es una de las revelaciones de la Bundesliga, donde con el RB Leipzig ha generado más de 20 contribuciones de gol en los 33 partidos que ha jugado entre todas las competiciones, lo que ha hecho que varios de los mejores equipos del viejo continente se fijen en él. El mayor interés se ha reportado por parte del PSG de Luis Enrique, quién lo ve como un jugador importante, además de que suena que alguna de sus figuras por los extremos podrían salir este año.

> The 19-year-old Ivorian winger is one of the revelations of the Bundesliga, where he has contributed over 20 goals in 33 appearances across all competitions for RB Leipzig, attracting the attention of several top European clubs. The strongest interest has reportedly come from Luis Enrique's PSG, who see him as a key player, especially given rumors that some of their wingers could leave this year.

<center>![1000661673.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSD3FAtBKakztH3tpuwepyQyEksUSbccXwBeVK4M2dYXM/1000661673.jpg)</center>

<center> <a href=\

>Fuente Una de las cosas que más ha llamado la atención acerca del jugador es su origen, pues su formación se dió en una academia de los Estados Unidos, donde se formó por dos años para luego dar el salto al fútbol europeo. Llegaría a las categorías inferiores del Leganes, para rápidamente debutar en un duelo contra el Real Madrid, sumando 10 partidos en primera división, donde anotó 2 goles y dió 1 asistencia. > One of the most striking aspects of the player is his background, as he trained at an academy in the United States for two years before making the leap to European football. He joined the youth ranks of Leganés, quickly making his debut in a match against Real Madrid. He went on to play 10 games in the first division, scoring 2 goals and providing 1 assist. Esos 6 meses, sumado a la situación del Leganes, que terminó perdiendo la categoría, hicieron que saliera con rumbo a Alemania, convirtiéndose a la vez en la venta más cara del club (20 millones), superando a otros futbolistas como Youssef En-Nesyri o Martin Braitwaite. En el RB Leipzig ha roto todas las expectativas que tenían en el y actualmente es un jugador indiscutible en el sistema de Ole Werner, quien le ha dado total libertad por la banda derecha. > Those six months, coupled with Leganés' relegation, led to his move to Germany, becoming the club's most expensive sale (€20 million), surpassing players like Youssef En-Nesyri and Martin Braithwaite. At RB Leipzig, he has exceeded all expectations and is now an undisputed starter in Ole Werner's system, who has given him complete freedom on the right wing. Pese a que sus inicios los fueron por la banda izquierda, jugando a pierna cambiada, buscando siempre las diagonales hacia adentro, en el Leipzig se ha formado para jugar por cualquiera de las bandas, de acuerdo a las necesidades de su equipo, aprovechando muy bien su regate y velocidad para sacarse las marcas de encima, esto sumado a su explosividad, hace que una vez arranque el sprint, sea muy difícil poder pararlo. > Although he started out on the left wing, playing on his weaker foot and always looking for diagonal runs inside, at Leipzig he has developed to play on either wing, according to the needs of his team, making excellent use of his dribbling and speed to get past defenders. This, combined with his explosiveness, makes it very difficult to stop him once he starts a sprint.

>Fuente Otra virtud bastante llamativa es su olfato goleador, pues pese a ser un extremo capaz de jugar escorado a la banda, suele llegar a zona de definición, rematando tanto jugadas creadas por su misma capacidad, como pases de sus compañeros. También es un jugador muy intenso, definido así por el mismo, ayudando en la presión a su equipo, y tiene bastante sacrificio para ayudar en las coberturas. > Another striking quality is his goal-scoring instinct. Despite being a winger capable of playing wide, he frequently gets into scoring positions, finishing off both his own creations and passes from teammates. He's also a very intense player, as he himself describes it, contributing to his team's pressing and showing great commitment in providing cover. Esto hace que lidere varias estadísticas defensivas en su posición, como la de duelos ganados, donde esta en el percentil 95 en las principales ligas europeas. En cuestiones meramente tácticas y de toma de decisión, aún tiene que mejorar un poco, pues suele perder balones por decisiones erradas, pero esto es algo trabajable, por lo que su proyección es así uno de los extremos más completos en Europa. > This puts him at the top of several defensive statistics in his position, such as duels won, where he ranks in the 95th percentile among major European leagues. In purely tactical and decision-making matters, he still needs to improve, as he tends to lose possession due to poor decisions, but this is something that can be worked on, making him one of the most complete wingers in Europe. Sumado a todas esas características tácticas y físicas, hay un factor que juega muy a su favor, su juventud, pues apenas con 19 años, aún tiene muchísimo margen de mejora, por lo que si lograr sumar unos centímetros más de altura, podría sumar a su repertorio el juego aéreo, que actualmente no es uno de sus mejores fuertes, así como mayor ganancia, que le permita luchar en mejor condiciones contra los defensas rivales. > In addition to all those tactical and physical characteristics, there is one factor that works very much in his favor: his youth. At only 19 years old, he still has a lot of room for improvement. If he manages to gain a few more centimeters in height, he could add aerial play to his repertoire, which is currently not one of his best strengths, as well as gain more ground, allowing him to fight in better conditions against opposing defenders.
![diomande.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRJj1ANAo2FtDnSZ6dBwWZDVvbTr2ZMYTtTfjjmaJ2aZA/diomande.jpg)

>Fuente Aunque Luis Enrique ha sido el mayor interesado por su fichaje, otros equipos como el Barcelona, que necesita reforzar la delantera, especialmente esa banda izquierda ante las lesiones de Raphinha; o el Liverpool, que busca rehacer su proyecto deportivo, por lo que se estima que este verano saldrá a un equipo que luche por títulos el próximo año. Su precio de salida se ha comentado entre los 70 millones, por lo que es impresionante lo que ha logrado en tan poco tiempo, teniendo un ascenso meteórico, que aún no ha llegado a su tope. > Although Luis Enrique has been the most interested in signing him, other teams like Barcelona, ​​who need to strengthen their attack, especially on the left wing due to Raphinha's injuries, and Liverpool, who are looking to rebuild their sporting project, are also keen. It's expected that he'll leave this summer for a team that will be competing for titles next year. His release clause has been mentioned as being around €70 million, which makes what he's achieved in such a short time all the more impressive, with a meteoric rise that has yet to reach its peak.

body.title: four years of growth
body.body:
Good day, amazing people of the Hive blockchain. I am so delighted to have you back in my blog today. Welcome! Today I am so happy because I am celebrating my fourth birthday here on the blockchain. Like I always say, I can't write about my journey without mentioning the blockchain.



![ChatGPT Image Apr 28, 2026 at 11_26_38 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/AKs4FfcSYwfHeCngn73W7B4LYh1UBKhvbLuqe6Xmz7ygdDG2N3bkhtVHS1Luvn3.png)



I joined this wonderful platform four years ago. I stepped into Web 3 with hope, connecting with people and willingness to learn, but today I celebrate my growth, lessons, wins and challenges that have helped to shape my life both here in blockchain and out of blockchain.

When I first joined the platform, everything was so strong; I was struggling to stand my ground on the platform. Everything was so new; at one point I was doubting myself, if I could be able to survive on this platform. It was like starting a new life, but then the moment I started connecting with people, making some transactions and writing in different communities, I began to unlock the hidden treasure in the blockchain. I got to know the power of connecting with people and the power of community. I also got to understand how transparent the blockchain is. To be honest, over these four years I can boldly say the blockchain has transformed me not just here in the platform, but also it has helped my personal growth. I have grown patient, more transparent and more informed. Sincerely, this platform will test you and, at the same time, push you. Blockchain has taught me how to bear risk; there are times the market will rise and fall, and with that I get to explore more and gain more knowledge. The wonderful thing is I learn from my success and failure.

The most amazing part of this journey is the wonderful people I have met over these years. The blockchain is full of amazing souls, people who are every ready to help once you enter their DMs. You will meet individuals with potential, vision, building skills and so on. This platform has widened my eyes to different opportunities I never imagined. The people I meet here in the blockchain are valuable to me both in the blockchain and offline.


![ChatGPT Image Apr 28, 2026 at 11_15_19 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/AKAt1ahPQPexq1mVT7eLYYCPHBKiKTmEaamaiDp6tHGDjWMys56KRZJPSrNYYyZ.png)


My success here in the blockchain is based on consistency and engaging in other people's posts, which helps to meet many amazing authors. Of course, there were moments I was full of doubt, moments of loss. In all those moments, I was strengthened and motivated here in the blockchain. Celebrating my four years in blockchain is a moment of gratitude. I am so grateful for every milestone I achieve here, every piece of knowledge I acquire, and every lesson and experience I gather over these years. During this journey I get to understand that success is not all about reaching a destination but the lessons and experience you gather along the way.





I am super excited for it, and I pray for a better future here in blockchain. The Hive blockchain has come to stay; the space is full of opportunities, and there is always something new to explore here. I am so determined to embark on more journeys.

Today I am not just celebrating myself but everyone who has in one way or the other contributed to this journey of four years. Looking back, I am so happy that I have come this far. Wow, four's down and many more to go. Cheers to four years of learning and unlearning.
 
***all image is generated with chatgpt.***

Thank you for stopping by my blog. I appreciate your comment, support and upvote. Do have a lovely day.

body.title: freewrite - a patented lie
body.body:
Certified Repairs Guaranteed Results

Inside the shop, broken phones, laptops, and watches lined the counter. The owner spoke confidently, tapping a framed document on the wall. “Fully certified process,” he’d say.

Customers would walk in and be told to pay upfront. That was part of the “policy.”

In the back room, there was no special equipment, just a drawer full of identical replacement parts bought cheap in bulk. Every device got the same treatment, whether it needed it or not. Why would the customers need to now anything?

Most people came back later, still having problems. The owner would nod sympathetically and point again at the document.

“Guarantee covers the procedure,” he’d explain, “not the outcome.”

The paper looked official enough that no one argued for long.

By closing time, the register was full, the complaints were filed away, and the sign in the window still told the truth, just not the one people thought it did. And that's how it went every day.

body.title: Not Me
body.body:
I didn’t expect my name to come up.

The discussion had been going on for a while. Different opinions. Different suggestions.

Then someone mentioned me.
“At least he handled something similar before.”

All eyes turned.
I wasn’t ready.

Not because I didn’t know anything… but because I hadn’t actually done what they thought I had.

It was close.
Similar.
But not the same.

For a second, I considered letting it pass.
No one was questioning it.
No one was asking for details.
It would have been easy to nod.

To accept it.
To step into something I wasn’t fully prepared for.
I could already see how it would play out.

The expectations.
The pressure.
The moment where I’d have to prove something I never claimed in the first place.

I cleared my throat.
“That wasn’t exactly me,” I said.

The room shifted.
Not dramatically.
Just enough.
Someone corrected it.

Another person adjusted the conversation.
And just like that… it moved on.

Later, I sat there thinking about how close that moment was.
Not to success.

But to carrying something that was never mine to begin with.

This story is fictional and written to share a true life lesson

# The Social Lives of Penguins: Understanding Their Complex Communication and Relationships

Penguins are often seen as charming, waddling birds that thrive in some of the harshest environments on Earth. However, beneath their cute exterior lies a complex social structure and a sophisticated system of communication. This post delves into the intricate social lives of these fascinating creatures, exploring their relationships, communication methods, and the significance of social interactions in their survival.

## The Importance of Social Structure

Penguins are highly social animals that live in colonies, sometimes numbering in the thousands. These colonies provide protection from predators, facilitate foraging, and enhance breeding success. Social structures within these colonies can be quite intricate, with hierarchies often emerging based on factors such as age, experience, and breeding status.

### Types of Social Interactions

1. **Pair Bonding**: Many penguin species are monogamous, forming long-term bonds with a single mate. This bond is crucial for successful breeding, as both parents share the responsibility of incubating eggs and feeding chicks.

2. **Group Dynamics**: Penguins often engage in group behaviors, such as huddling together for warmth during harsh weather. These behaviors not only help conserve energy but also strengthen social bonds within the colony.

3. **Parenting Cooperation**: In some species, penguins exhibit cooperative parenting, where multiple adults may help care for a single brood, enhancing the survival rates of the chicks.

## Communication: The Language of Penguins

Penguins communicate using a variety of vocalizations and body language. Their communication methods are essential for maintaining social bonds, coordinating group activities, and signaling distress or danger.

### Vocalizations

- **Calls and Cries**: Penguins have a remarkable range of vocalizations that they use to convey different messages. For instance, during courtship, males may produce a series of calls to attract females, while parents can recognize their chicks' calls amidst the cacophony of the colony.

- **Chirps and Honks**: Different species have unique calls, which can serve as identifiers within a crowded colony. This is particularly important during the breeding season when many penguins are nesting close together.

### Body Language

- **Posture and Movement**: Penguins use body language to express emotions and intentions. For example, a penguin may bow or puff out its chest to assert dominance or attract a mate.

- **Physical Touch**: Preening and touching are common behaviors among penguins, reinforcing social bonds and providing comfort.

## The Role of Social Interactions in Survival

The social lives of penguins are not merely for companionship; they play a vital role in their survival. Strong social bonds can lead to better foraging success, increased protection from predators, and enhanced care for offspring. In harsh environments, the ability to communicate and cooperate can mean the difference between life and death.

## Conclusion

The social lives of penguins are a testament to the complexity of animal behavior. Their intricate communication systems and social structures highlight the importance of relationships in the natural world. As we continue to study these remarkable birds, we gain insight into the significance of social interactions not only for penguins but for many other species as well. Understanding their social dynamics can help us better protect their habitats and ensure their survival in the face of climate change and other environmental challenges.

body.title: Bridging Data Science and Betting Discipline in Football
body.body: The relationship between football prediction and betting strategy is often misunderstood. Many bettors seek a single source of truth—a platform or tipster that will reliably indicate winners. In reality, professional betting is less about finding a magic formula and more about process: identifying value, managing bankrolls, and understanding the difference between probability and certainty. The most successful approaches combine rigorous statistical models with disciplined risk management, treating each wager as one outcome in a long series rather than a make-or-break decision. For the upcoming 2026 World Cup, with its expanded 48-team format and unprecedented variables, this disciplined approach becomes even more critical.\n\nOne resource that has attempted to integrate these two domains is <a href=\

>Smart betting strategies from Ai-FootballPredictions.com\n. Rather than simply publishing raw probabilities, the platform contextualizes its outputs within a betting framework that emphasizes value detection and risk assessment. The underlying AI models generate expected outcome probabilities based on thousands of historical matches, incorporating variables such as team form trajectories, player availability, travel distances, rest differentials, and venue-specific conditions. These probabilities are then compared against typical market prices, allowing users to identify situations where the model's assessment diverges significantly from consensus expectations—a classic value-betting signal. However, the platform consistently emphasizes that no single model should dictate wagers; rather, its outputs serve as one input among many, alongside qualitative intelligence and personal risk tolerance.

body.title: Is there a future where DeFi absorbs itself for preservation?
body.body:
![019daa63-6e46-7505-ae20-4bd214dc407f.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/badbitch/23wC9LoPTb8ABvTtPb67Hi3HYZW5HN2TSDwcubixA7KDBosuJ3wDkLTdnYErLQL1N99FP.jpg)

Every time there's a story about a Bitcoin and ETH purchase by institutions, I question how any of this ends.

Because when you look at the practices, it doesn't suggest that these traditional entities are coming in to play nice or contribute to the fundamental values of the ecosystems or markets.

All the data points to an appetite for dominance, for control. Every purchase gets them closer to securing more than enough influence to determine the economic direction of these projects, protocols and networks.

### The risk to DeFi

Decentralized finance requires decentralized governance, without it, nothing about the finance is decentralized.

That said, at the same time, it is not enough that one market or project or network is decentralized, the industry's sovereignty requires more.

Why you ask?

Markets will trend towards interconnectedness. BTC will have exposure to ETH and vise versa.

This exposure means that if one of the markets are threatened, the other is exposed to similar threats.

So you see, at the very least, the biggest markets and the medium tiers all have to be provably decentralized.

If the Top 20 crypto assets are not decentralized, then we can conclude that this market, this industry is far from its intended design.

### Absorbance 

Every time I think about the sovereignty of this industry, decentralized acquisition always comes to mind.

This is the absorbance I speak of.

I think that a future where DeFi absorbs itself for preservation is inevitable.

This isn't like traditional acquisitions that seeks to eliminate the independence of the acquired.

There are multiple ways this can happen, in fact, current tech which I've argued to promote supply centralization can be used to absorb DeFi into itself.

The irony right?

You know the saying: a tool can serve different purposes, it just depends on who holds it. 

Solutions like restaking and liquid staking can be leverage to draw alternative projects or protocols, voluntarily into another.

This is the approach that comes with minimal capital exposure since incentives isn't the only cost involved.

The scenario with the most capital exposure would be outright acquisition of native governance assets.

If DeFi project A (a decentralized one) has the reserves or community to pull off the acquisition of threatened DeFi project B, it will have to at some point for sovereignty preservation.

The goal of course is never to acquire it all, but to acquire enough to maintain provable decentralization.

The industry has to come to realize, at some point, that collaborative building will be more important than competing. I mean, it's expected that projects or ecosystems could see the fail of another as a market opportunity, but it's important to see that opportunity necessitating stepping in because not every falling of a giant leaves a market gap or hole to fill, and if there's broader ecosystem exposure, the impact will go beyond the fallen.

body.title: Where I Go When I Need Me.
body.body: > Seriously for me I don’t think I used to take reflection that seriously before , Life has just been moving, and I was moving with it, wake up, check my phone, scroll, reply messages, think about what next… you know that kind of routine where you are always doing something but not really pausing to think, but lately, I have been trying to do better with that. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY5rRwsftut7tg6h7zBDxCdLDHe2yjm9FuAHt8MM58Y8g/1777371929553.jpg) A lot of times now, I just step away from distractions, and when I say distractions, I mean my phone especially, because let’s be real, that thing alone can carry your whole day without you realizing it, one minute you are checking one message, next thing you are deep into random videos, and before you know it, hours are gone, so what I do now sometimes is just drop my phone, put it somewhere that's far from me, and just… sit. Not in any serious, complicated way o, I am not doing anything too deep or spiritual like that, most times, I just put on music, soft music, something calm, something that does not make me start thinking too hard but still gives me space to breathe, and then I just listen. Not just to the music, to my own thoughts too at first it felt a bit strange. I will not lie, because when you are used to noise, silence can feel uncomfortable, My mind starts bringing up things I did not plan to think about, Random memories come up, things I have been avoiding small worries, things I did not know were bothering me. Over time I started to appreciate those moments, vecause that is when I actually get to understand myself. I will just sit there, think about my life. Sometimes I realize, oh, this is why I have been feeling this way.. I will notice that I have been stressing about something that is not even that serious, times I just feel calm, I feel like everything is not as chaotic as it seemed before It is like giving my mind space to breathe. Honestly quiet time has helped me more than I expected, For one I feel less overwhelmed, Life still happens problems are still there, It does not feel like everything is crashing on me at once, i have learned how to slow things down in my head to process things of just reacting immediately. Silence has really helped me to understand myself better, I can think clearly now, I feel more in control of my thoughts, I am grateful for the silence, Silence is like a friend t o me now. It has also helped me become more intentional with how I move, Like instead of just doing things because that is what is happening, I actually think about my choices more, I reflect on my actions, my decisions, even my reactions to people, and sometimes I will just correct myself quietly like, “ Yeah, you could have handled that better. Another thing is peace. That simple act of staying away from noise, even if it is just for a short time, gives me this kind of peace that is hard to explain, no pressure, no expectations, just me and my thoughts, and I won’t lie, I really want to continue this habit. I don’t do it every single day, I am a still human abeg, sometimes I get caught up again in everything, but I always find my way back to it, because once you experience that kind of calm, you will know it is something you actually need. So yeah, reflection for me now is not something serious or stressful, It is just those small quiet moments where I step back, breathe, listen to music, and check in with myself, And honestly? I think we all need that more than we realize. Image Is Mine. ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png)

body.title: My friend in school life.
body.body: > https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWZQCk8HYy2EQxSD3T74uRBVe1eowUy8seyhGAGyNYxSB/1000067593.jpg Hello friends, I hope you are doing well. Welcome to my new post. School life is one of the most beautiful moments in our life. In school life, we enjoy a lot, study, and many happiness and sorrows pass through our school life. I think school life is the best period of our life. As we study in school life, we also laugh and enjoy a lot with our friends. There are many of us who make very close friends. I will call this friendship as if I had a twin brother. Because such friendships are very beautiful and very kind. I remember when I was studying in the fifth grade, I had a friend whose name was Manjurul. We were both in the same class at the same time. When I came to school, we both used to sit in almost the same place and study and we used to do our sir's classes at the same time. I still remember when my tiffin was ready, we used to sit together and eat food. When I was in fifth grade, I met my friend. We had an assembly where we sang the national anthem and did some physical activities. I met him at that time. We talked for a long time. We were both new to the new class. Of course, my friend had been in our school for quite some time. He had been in our school for almost two years. He was in a different sector, so he was not in my sector before. Anyway, that's how our friendship developed. One of the best things about our friendship was that I used to commute from my home to my school. My friend lived in a residential hostel in the school. Because of that, I used to bring tiffin from my home and my friend used to bring food from his hostel to the school. Then we both used to sit together and then during tiffin, we used to eat together. We used to share our food and this moment was actually very pleasant and very good. Maybe we didn't realize that moment then. But when we grow up slowly, we realize those times and think about them in our minds. I still remember that my friend and I used to be naughty sometimes. One day, we were naughty in class, because of which the teacher threw us out. I still remember that day sometimes. My friend's house is in our neighboring upazila, because of which I meet him sometimes. I feel very happy when I meet him. We both remember the previous words and laugh a lot. Anyway, I want all the friendships in the world to remain strong like this. I hope you like this post, thank you all. ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) --- Divce | realmi c67 -|-| [source this picture link]( https://pixabay.com/photos/georg-and-friend-best-friends-985336/ ) ### Kind Regards @nahid43 ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@nahid43/are-intentional-relationships-stronger-than-marriage-4jk)

he financial world doesn't operate in silos anymore. Wall Street is actively bleeding into Web3, traditional macro-economics is dictating crypto cycles, and the line between centralized banking and decentralized finance is practically gone.

That is exactly why [FinArmour](https://finarmour.com/) exists.

I am the founder behind FinArmour, and I am thrilled to officially bring our platform to the InLeo and Hive community. For a long time, I have been analyzing complex market mechanics and breaking down financial narratives across the web. I currently write as a Certified Contributor on [TalkMarkets](https://talkmarkets.com/profile/sheikhshahidrasel-260416-054707) and an approved Author on [Publish0x.](https://www.publish0x.com/@heikh-hahid-asel)

But I've been watching the InLeo community for a while. The level of deep, uncensored financial discussion here is incredibly sharp. This is exactly where FinArmour belongs.

## What will you see from this account?

Simply put: Everything finance. We do not restrict our analysis to just one narrow niche. If it involves capital, liquidity, or leverage—we cover it. Expect deep-dive articles, data-driven custom charts, and completely unfiltered opinions on:

Macroeconomics & TradFi: Interest rates, global debt, private credit shakeouts, and traditional equity markets.

Crypto & Web3: Decentralized finance (DeFi), smart contract protocols, algorithmic risks, and market cycles.

The Intersection: Real World Asset (RWA) tokenization, institutional shadow banking, and exactly how Wall Street is utilizing blockchain technology.

At FinArmour, we don't just summarize the news. We look at the underlying code of the financial system. We hunt for the hidden leverage, expose the systemic \

and try to figure out what the institutions are doing before it hits the retail market.

I am incredibly excited to connect with the bright minds and fellow analysts here on InLeo. Drop a comment, say hello, and let me know what macroeconomic or crypto trends you are tracking right now.

Let’s decode the markets together.

body.title: The One Who Watched and Said Nothing #286
body.body:
I once witnessed it, “though it wasn't me that got beaten.” This is what I told myself back then when it happened during my first year in junior secondary school. I was new to the school environment after being transferred from another school, a big private school. There used to be this gentle and easygoing girl in my class then; her seat wasn't far from mine. Some students only get to remember her name whenever they want to find something to laugh about. During some break period, some ladies in my class, including two guys, would corner her where no one could hardly see them and far from the staff room. They take some of her break foods and throw them away. They said some things to her; I can still picture the event because I once stumbled on them twice. But I never got to say anything or challenge them because I was new to the school environment, and I didn't want to fall victim myself because I was also this gentle and easygoing type. I once challenged the girl to take it up by reporting to the staff, but I never thought she accepted my challenge, which made me not bother myself again, and I counted myself as being innocent. ![218265.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/218265.png) It wasn't. That understanding later came to me in a very calm way after we all left the school. When I finally got to understand, I got so uncomfortable because I never imagined it. I got to realize that I should have gone to the staff to report the situation myself because it looks like I was also participating since I kept shut. I gave those ladies and guys who bullied her a free platform to continue doing it since I caught them twice, so they kept going. It was later I got to realize that since I didn't challenge those bullies, I gave them the opportunity to think that what they were doing was right. Though other students might have seen this too, we never talked about it. That was around 2009. Still young, I guess I couldn't have named that clearly then, simply because I was trying to protect myself too. But for the fact that I told her to report the situation, I knew something was wrong; I was expecting her to do it herself; I still chose comfort over courage. Now that I am grown and I know better, though I am yet to have children of my own. But I already know the conversation that I'll have with them about what to do if anyone hurts them. And also what to do when they see someone that is being hurt. I will surely tell them that either they challenge the matter by speaking up or decide to remain silent, and I will tell on them when they grow up, not forever though. But for some time, they would sit one day and say, “I should have done something”. ![218266.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/218266.png) And if my kids eventually got bullied, I would tell them that they must never fight back or ignore, but they should tell me or find a mature person around they trust who they can report the whole situation to. Because shame usually thrives in silence. It always finds a quiet place to grow. But I know for sure that the important thing is that I am making them to become the person who will will see something like that and walk away as if they saw nothing, or it is non of their business because they can also become victim tomorrow. And when we continue to give room for bullies, they will continue to see it as fun while the mental health, courage and life of the person involved is at stake. ----- ##### 🔗 Apps which I recommend body.title: The last time I reflect about something
body.body:
## Hello everyone!!! 
### I hope so you all are fine and happy 😀 

Life is very uncertain thing and sometimes we're not ready for the situations in life which we've to faced in life but anyway we need to figure out many things and obviously we're alone to solve those thing's in life, we think about it, make plans, we failed and then we make plans until we reach to a point of hope. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdwvmWMnyj9PxXBkL4hhXbYxjYfFoDwmNU6merDqCtaRW/1777371095802.jpg)
#### Image by <a href=\

>Pixabay ### The last time I reflect about life!!!! Although this weekend i was very busy in attending a wedding ceremony of my cousin but still I've time to reflect on things. It's my habit actually think about things happening in my life. Actually during the last week when I went for evening walk in the park, after walking i sit on a bench to take a deep breath and then go back to home. But last week a girl was sitting with me on the similar bench. Although I don't know her but we started to talk about our routines and current inflation and then talking about the jobs. She said that she's working in a truck dispatching company as it's a USA based work but we can do it at home online. But you've to work from 6pm to 1am which means it's a night shift of work. And you can earn dollar's with commission. I don't know about it as i never heard about it so i discussed with my friends too and they said that they're also know nothing about it. Now i discussed with all with whome i mostly discuss my personal things for advice. They said nothing in advice because they don't know about it. So, now it's only me who have to take decision. It was Saturday night when I went to bed for sleeping and before go to sleep I've to think about it and my mind was also focused on it because I've to give answer to that person yes or no like if I'm interested or not. I reflect on many things like my sleeping shedule , coming summer's which will be intense weather and all other thing's. Basically i sleep around 10 or 11 pm as i think my sleep has more effect and it has long term effect, sometimes I've nightmares but it happens sometimes not all the night as some nights are heavy to pass. I know that everyone needs money in life, but I'm not from the one who'll destroy my health due to this job. As first good health is my priority and then everything comes in life. Also i can't believe on a stranger because there are many scammer's in online world and i can't trust so easily, that's why at that night i reflected on many things, think about different aspects attached to it and then i took a decision that I'll say that i can't do it and I'm happy that you give me offer to join you. > That's all for today and it's my entry in this week hive learner contest in #hl-exclusive for the topic of #hl-w215e1. * Thank you for your time and support 🙏

body.title: [ESP/ENG] Enjoying some delicious ground chicken to recreate my own version.
body.body:
> Saludos cordiales para toda mi gente hermosa, cada nueva experiencia nos llena de nuevos aprendizajes de esta manera quise preparar un pollo molido haciendo la diferencia de carne molida ya que tengo en casa un pica todo, el cual me sirve para triturar la pechuga de pollo y preparar una comida diferente en casa. > Warm greetings to all my beautiful people, each new experience fills us with new learning. In this way, I wanted to prepare ground chicken, making it different from ground beef, since I have a food processor at home, which I use to grind the chicken breast and prepare a different meal at home.
![GridArt_20260428_002842056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK6XztJgWpRWSAxiNB8uSLSe2CVQkvM3Rfm3GWDsL5nHLovSeSPNjfEEy9zHSEj.jpg)
Ingredientes: 1 pechuga de pollo, 1 cebolla, ají, ajo, color, aceite. > Ingredients: 1 chicken breast, 1 onion, chili pepper, garlic, color, oil. Comenzamos cortando nuestra pechuga de pollo en cuadros medianos luego lo agregamos al procesador y dejamos triturar, seguidamente vamos a cortar un poco de cebolla ahí y ajo y lo llevaremos al pica todo para que se procese conjuntamente con nuestra proteína. > We start by cutting our chicken breast into medium cubes, then we add it to the processor and let it grind. Next, we're going to chop some onion and garlic and put it all in the food processor to be processed together with our protein.
![GridArt_20260428_002427533.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK2E4dnxnuTtGjujrqtjZvmsdSP7rdZpscqze67xQs4UGyyCkX9Y9BtsBrNQ4SR.jpg)
Luego de triturar agregamos todo en un sartén con un poco de aceite, sofreímos un poco e integramos condimentos como sal, adobo y color, finalmente le agregamos una taza de agua dejamos cocinar a fuego medio y tendremos un delicioso guiso de pollo molido. > After grinding, we add everything to a pan with a little oil, sauté a little and incorporate seasonings such as salt, adobo and color, finally we add a cup of water, let it cook over medium heat and we will have a delicious ground chicken stew.
![GridArt_20260428_002629336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK7yc6kMaLjtdDZiN5Pyko9H1UvMGhZgk1d4edpGQB6Hzi5uYhwy8wVnqkvenxa.jpg)
En la cocina debemos ser prácticos y creativos, por eso en esta ocasión que mi hijo deseaba comer carne molida y no tenía en casa, quise recrear el plato tradicional con un poco de pollo molido y hacer mi propia versión acompañándolo con espaguetis, tajadas, salsa y mayonesa. > In the kitchen we must be practical and creative, so on this occasion when my son wanted to eat ground beef and I didn't have any at home, I wanted to recreate the traditional dish with some ground chicken and make my own version accompanying it with spaghetti, plantain slices, sauce and mayonnaise.

body.title: April Blooms and the 2025 Australian Proclamation Dollar
body.body:
The seeds are planted, and my west coast winter’s last blast has been only day of real snow fall that never lingered, only a few following days of near zero temperatures delayed my early attempt to sow my veggie seeds.  
On to the next step in my garden plan.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23uFXzojee8qHjBNDxRTbPC64LoPYwQbTvjTzaS115jquy5yoTWMoafT6ePTyWhRZ8oPh.png)</center>

>“Black birds tend to like shiny things.” ~ The Bloody Raven.

This week I have been re-potting most of my Strawberry plants into a fresh mix of potting soil blend, removing sprouting weeds and the wild walnuts 🐿, recycling the old tired potting soil with the new, a sprinkle of fertilizer, a spade of peat and compost. 
And that little oak chest?
Silver in the sunshine.
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23wCGNaMzrrLeMwAZXZ7Q7iwodBFBA92VL9deBBFqYMd9nMZuAD4kZnw1ykdFXPH23urS.png)</center><center>The grey silver coin on the bottom left is a genuine 1742 Philip V Spanish Pieces of Eight.</center>

As I have my latest addition to my Coffee table treasure collection with me. My little wooden chest can no longer hold that collection so I have been checking around my Thrift shops for a new, larger and used chest to put them in. For fun I am considering burying this little oak chest as an experiment to see how long it will last and test my Garret Metal detector’s sensing performance before I take it out to the beach this summer. 

<center>2025 Australia [225th Anniversary of the Proclamation Pillar Dollar](https://en.numista.com/470766) </center><center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23tmNJ4hDH8oyxF6ZkxZFbSZx7oTASZuPSeAwz5ZqRcUiPoYdKF4cr3K51gxTP5Xb7f5h.png) </center><center>Reverse; Updated Crowned Pillars and Hemispheres. Waves and rosettes.</center><center>Motto; VTRAQUE VNUM, PLVS VLTR, MO, 2025, MO  </center><center>Both are One, More beyond. Colonial Mexico mint, 2025 </center><center>Weight 31.1 g, 0.9999 Fine Silver</center><center>Diameter 40.5mm x 3.5mm thickness </center><center>Designer; Sean Rogers </center>

So while we’re on the subject of silver treasure, let’s have a look at this new coin.
The Perth mint celebrates the 225th anniversary of the proclaiming of the Spanish [Pillar Reales](https://en.numista.com/15066) as legal tender for the fledgling colony of New South Wales on November 19th 1800. These Spanish dollars have been trusted trade specie for a century and commonly accepted for trade in the region. Governor Philip Gidley King needed to address the ongoing specie shortage that hampered local commerce and trade. 

<center>2025 Australia [225th Anniversary of the Proclamation Pillar Dollar](https://en.numista.com/470766) </center><center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23u697N9nYNYhMzqoVFSYErgx5xyiL3ZgRWR5hQYYJqNpx6d5WSV97dDy4Kdbt3NoXseW.png)</center><center>Edge Design; Reeded</center><center>Brilliant Uncirculated, Reverse Cameo finish </center>

The shortage money continued to be chronic and in 1812 Governor Lachlan Macquarie imported 40,000 Spanish 8 Reales, the punched coins nick-named [‘Holey Dollars’](https://en.numista.com/19811) where valued at Five Shillings while the centers or the [‘dump’](https://en.numista.com/17316) are valued at a shilling and three pence, further increasing the needed money supply. The overt ‘damage’ to the coins made them less desirable outside New South Wales and helped keep the silver circulating within the colony.

<center>2025 Australia [225th Anniversary of the Proclamation Pillar Dollar](https://en.numista.com/470766)</center><center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23tbyYwamcmAbpqAS3ds1PU8jyBqVNZLFLYfYeMZJSx3DDJDNNJxtp8AmrDr69cmXpz8e.png)</center><center>Reverse; King Charles III facing left</center><center>Legend; · CHARLES III AUSTRALIA ·, 1oz 9999 Ag, 1 DOLLAR, DT </center><center>30,000 BU, Perth Mint </center><center>5,000 Proof </center><center>2,500 Antiqued</center></center><center>Designer; Dan Thorne </center>

Interestingly, this form of emergency specie was also used in early pre-Dominion of Canada’s Prince Edward Island using The [Colonial Mexico 8 Reales](https://en.numista.com/22552). These 5  Shillings were also refereed to as ‘Holey dollars’ with about 1,000 put into circulation by the colonial governor. The remaining plug is refereed to as the ‘Plug dollar’ valued at 1 Shilling in the colony. The issue of this specie remains controversial being in a grey area of semi-official issue.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23xyVLzTFDNsTXi3Y47DBTSEbWEcEfX8gkkNnTFMvT9URXcyNQKeC7v1D9Tb8jcf27PjP.png)</center><center>The 2025 Australia Proclamation Dollar is a fine addition to my Coffee table treasure collection.</center>

### Now back to my April Blooms ###

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23vsL5bYFGyPN8QMzp2C5oKW43zPUsTarZHVN2KBjSom1xuAjctJ4M9ZMLUht6bpk8XmD.png)</center><center>The white Poet Daffodils are back. </center>

These white poets came out a little earlier this spring and I love the way these stand out from the more common golden daffodils. The 'Goldies' did come out a few days after this shot but fewer than last spring. I could have a grub problem since this winter has been very mild.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23xedbFJhfL1WPyqEimBedGHemAocuDVz8HxLwMbRR8rWUupEKU5eUCvbGsDwzW9HTYqm.png)</center><center>The Tulips were the first April blooms but the other colors are coming in later than expected. </center>

The fuchsia colored tulips also came out not long after the Poet Daffodils. It seems odd that one color came out first and only now that the bicolored tulips are barely out and a bit stunted. I think I forgot to fertilize with Bone meal last fall when I replanted the bulbs. \

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23vhwVhKi7ciJ7CLJySYwd9isJTdz5RgGYuAXVxvquJexpaWJUxxXuP4rVu4nLvqcKZEp.png)
A surprise, I'm keeping this wild patch of pansies.
I discovered this little patch of bi-colored pansies at the furthest corner of my garden. I don't recall ever planting these adorable little blooms so why not.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23wC7mc6SKLcEAAk6pHf3V7g4PsStdDCPbtVtGuKghGHbojaemsHUt6ZqsdUtsnXHW4QD.png)
Freshly re-potted Strawberries and run out of spare pots so I gave a few away to new homes.
This photo are just a week after re-potting and they have taken well to the new soil blend. Most of these plants have white little blooms. I have a second variety with purple blooms that I expect to show soon. The stones are to discourage Steve, the squirrel 🐿 from burying his bloody nuts 🌰 in my pots. Yes, I gave this furry beast a name. Steve, my garden nemesis. I've pulled out at least six walnut sprouts out of these pots. This battle of the pots may go on all year. My little paradise on earth will always be a work in progress 🌷🌼🍓 April 27th Vitals; 113/76, 72HR, and So2 98%. Another Dental appointment April 28th this morning.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23y8yxLX4m3esCCiZtBRAEBqs7jxeK7U8FgUHYbf17yrSY9U6g2f6XiGjzd369uEKWvPn.png)
Another medical appointment coming up next week, one day at a time.
Thank you for coming aboard my blog today. ### Stacking Precious metals and Crypto for those dark stormy times! ###
https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMHVpZXNtNHBueDltd3JoNDNhcWY4aDhjM3YzZjYwOG96eG11bm8xbCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/r499ZEqvZrL8JaKHP7/giphy.gif
The #piratesunday tag is the scurvy scheme of Captain @stokjockey for #silvergoldstackers pirates to proudly showcase their shiny booty and plunder for all to see. Landlubbers arrrh… welcomed to participate and be a Pirate at heart so open yer treasure chests an’ show us what booty yea got!

> ### The Coffee Table Treasure Collection posts; ### My Christmas Wish for a [2025 Australia Proclamation Dollar](https://peakd.com/silvergoldstackers/@kerrislravenhill/my-2025-12-days-of-christmas-wish-list-part-5). Scottsdale’s [In Omnia Paratus](https://peakd.com/silvergoldstackers/@kerrislravenhill/my-2025-12-days-of-christmas-wish-list-part-2) Type 2 Silver round. The legendary Pieces of Eight [Spanish Pillar Dollar](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@kerrislravenhill/12-days-of-christmas-the-legendary-pieces-of-eight-spanish-pillar-dollar). The 2023 Daniel Carr 1622 [Atocha fantasy 8 Reale](https://peakd.com/hive-136819/@kerrislravenhill/12-days-of-christmas-2023-1622-atocha-fantasy-8-reales-cob) Cob. The 17th Century [Colonial Mexico Philip IV 8 Reale](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@kerrislravenhill/12-days-of-christmas-17th-century-colonial-mexico-philip-iv-8-reales-cob) Cob. Gold Spartan Version 2 [Silver Pirate ship](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@kerrislravenhill/2023-first-not-so-secret-santa-gold-spartan-pirate-ship-version-2). ### References & Sources ### 2025 Australia 1 Troy oz. Silver [225th Anniversary of the Proclamation Pillar Dollar](https://en.numista.com/470766). 2025 Australia 1 Troy oz. Antiqued Silver [225th Anniversary of the Proclamation Pillar Dollar](https://www.perthmint.com/shop/collector-coins/coins/225th-anniversary-australian-proclamation-coins-pillar-dollar-2025-1oz-silver-antiqued-coin/) 2025 Australia 1 Troy oz. Gold [225th Anniversary of the Proclamation Pillar Dollar](https://www.perthmint.com/shop/collector-coins/coins/225th-anniversary-australian-proclamation-coins-pillar-dollar-2025-1oz-gold-proof-coin/) Photos are my own shot with an ancient 2018 Samsung SM-A530W or otherwise indicated. </center>\nPhysical precious metals bullion stacking is only a part of my personal overall financial strategy. Meanwhile, collecting numismatics are a different set of objectives and strategy. The thin film materials market encompasses the production and application of ultra-thin layers of materials deposited onto substrates, typically ranging from nanometers to micrometers in thickness. These materials are widely used in industries such as electronics, energy, optics, and semiconductors due to their unique electrical, optical, and mechanical properties. Thin film technologies play a critical role in enhancing device performance while reducing material consumption and manufacturing costs.

The market is witnessing strong momentum driven by the growing adoption of renewable energy solutions, particularly in photovoltaic (PV) solar cells, where thin film materials offer cost-effective and flexible alternatives to traditional silicon-based technologies. body.title: Dailyprompt - Patent lie
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTMYDd75MWzzjmEdQ7Wn349dKfCS9C3LSHq4CuuJN9re3/ChatGPT%20Image%20Apr%2028,%202026,%2002_54_46%20PM.png 


When my father died, he left behind a will.

The will was simple. The house, the land, and the lie.

It was written exactly like that.

At first, I thought it was one of my father’s strange jokes. He was known to be a prankster, so it wouldn't really be a strange thing to leave a final prank like this.

Patent No. 7713 — Registered Lie.

“It’s legally yours now,” the lawyer said.

That night I went back to the house.

Before bed, I found a note left on my father’s desk.

Never admit it’s a lie.

I frowned. “Admit what?”

The lights flickered. The curtains on one side of the room started blowing. I thought there was a presence, a shadow.

My breath caught. “Who’s there?”

\

it said.

I stumbled back. “What are you?”

A few days had passed. The shadow, I could feel it roaming around the house, but it never hurt me.

“I am not afraid,” I said aloud once, hands shaking.

And my fear was gone. I looked toward the window, and it seemed something was looking back.

Later that night, someone broke into the house. I woke to footsteps, to drawers being opened. Panic surged until I remembered.

“I am safe,” I whispered.

The thing in the corner moved.

There was a scream. And then there was not.

Today, with the internet and social media, the world has become a patent for lies, with fake news being shared everywhere. We must be careful with what we see, read, believe, and share. Not everything is true. Before repeating, liking, or echoing any information, we must verify the source, check other media outlets to see if they share it, verify the URL, confirm the publication date, and read the entire article. We should be wary when we trust and share false information; we cause harm to those involved, to those who are waiting with hope for something to happen, and then we confirm it, only to find out later that what we shared was false. We not only take away people's hopes but also fill them with frustration and anxiety. Fake news is everywhere; we shouldn't trust this patent factory of lies. Stopping disinformation is simpler than we think; we just need to verify and be sure of what we share. >Hoy en día con el Internet y las redes sociales el mundo se ha convertido en una patente de mentiras, compartiendo noticias falsas, hay que tener cuidado con lo que vemos, leemos, creemos y compartimos, no todo es verdadero antes de repetir, dar like y hacer eco de alguna información debemos verificar la fuente, buscar otros medios de comunicación para ver si la comparten, verificar el URL, confirma la fecha de publicación, leer completo ella artículo, desconfiar cuando nos confiamos y compartimos información falsa causamos daños a los involucrados, a los que esperan con esperanza que algo suceda y de pronto nosotros confirmamos, luego resulta que es falso lo que compartimos, no solo le quitamos ilusiones a las personas sino que los llenamos de frustración y ansiedad. body.title: Timotes: Visiting Francisco de Miranda Square | Timotes: Visitando la Plaza Francisco de Miranda 🌳
body.body:
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!) Hello, travelers. Happy Tuesday to everyone. We started our second day of travel, this time from Timotes in the charming state of Mérida. We were really excited about all the places waiting for us that day. Ricardo and I always have a plan of the places we want to visit, and that way we can manage our time to cover everything and make sure nothing gets left out, since we don’t know when we’ll get another chance like this. ![InShot_20260427_083331729.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNTrrPfHYSDNwiRBhErgqUXXVbCwv3pTT3Yto3yeWUGxX/InShot_20260427_083331729.jpg) As you know, we travel by motorcycle. Before we start our route for the day, I wanted to show you a little bit of the hotel where we’re staying, called Hotel Caribay. It’s located two blocks from Plaza Bolívar, has comfortable facilities, and offers many room types, from singles to family rooms. In our case, it was a double room. What I liked most was that it had hot water for the shower, since the climate in the area is very cold for someone coming from Maracaibo. ![20260403_083146.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUVKmpjpAZFcCoLptZADMP8LCjQKdVjXnRaDDfw3Rzbyo/20260403_083146.jpg) ![20260403_082939.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNSrmiVtyfhUBMXgfHhg6Dh1Dt7SWnrjWnj9UdqkLuXyD/20260403_082939.jpg) ![20260403_082919.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYgXNGgAgJLHDQzVChFetv5uYTbH6hfQUtC9jvq2Q2K4y/20260403_082919.jpg) We walked through several streets of this lovely town, and after passing by the Don Jesús María Espinoza House of Culture, we arrived at Plaza Francisco Miranda. This is the square I remember most from my last visit to Timotes; some things had changed. There’s a small skating rink there, and many little dogs were enjoying the tranquility of that beautiful morning. ![20260403_084336.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmekwftKHmN4QiWUxGR7Z3mzAcoF7JzbFiYhozevB8tgSB/20260403_084336.jpg) ![20260403_084403.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeaUCbPW63izR6qhMYKTK6vZVxSUohoKwaEhDbTZa3fio/20260403_084403.jpg) ![20260403_084914.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZFDLZrNPLYPKFpSkZcCCZdcRq6LaKrzWvup6isKQXq7u/20260403_084914.jpg) ![20260403_084925.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSg8ubtJmpmhauYVn6CPmsZ3WpEzVviyNC373FY8hiwvn/20260403_084925.jpg) ![20260403_085154.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfPxbVS6FFfwP8bosFxQnMxsm9PHn2LesStEgMDbEm6Un/20260403_085154.jpg) ![20260403_085212.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd6BnHqon5zhyMFX9a4vFeGjHAJY9deMnyRkGTxXEV6P1/20260403_085212.jpg) ![20260403_085232.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd7fsGwf5zMYqBhhzr8mudDMkQe9SDVEShSwb7EgSx4Zt/20260403_085232.jpg) ![20260403_085238.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme5ENwRVSj5oqMYD8KTKwYnryPaBT7TZbdAbfFVdnGTAU/20260403_085238.jpg) ![20260403_085302.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSNwL4NsGhQB3hG2sLowB4bT6ttDMNWpyLne4eaPKuyvM/20260403_085302.jpg) This place exudes simplicity but also holds a bit of history with the small bust honoring Generalissimo Francisco de Miranda, which I almost missed on my walk. It is to him that this plaza pays tribute, as well as a small stage with a beautiful landscape in the background and colorful letters spelling out “Mérida.” I’m sure various cultural events take place here. I climbed up to the stage to get a different view and discovered a playground and another perspective of the skating rink. ![20260403_085326.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZNimEGKxuALHz531d3iWUV454fiR9XaeBi9vfdQqEbqr/20260403_085326.jpg) ![20260403_085426.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS7TkGRcPVKecW54ysmoDSwVGr3KmVUrGjuSc4xF5T2uw/20260403_085426.jpg) ![20260403_085559.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXfXFdGY6aDjQUuSxca5jnGxeAsXs5dder4LtP4P6y8VU/20260403_085559.jpg) ![20260403_085620.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmasHUZnKpcAKbpyAJGp25Tt9Peyk4LmwDpBfG44bwHFdQ/20260403_085620.jpg) ![20260403_085623.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZT1sr6d5ESHbgRpojc3bUB71cuSd1J6gaX5fSZqwgQz5/20260403_085623.jpg) In one corner of the square stands a statue of San Benito, and in front of it is a small shrine bearing the same name. People show their faith and devotion to him in Timotes, as well as during the patron saint festivities. ![20260403_085658.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW4qyFAPodV6QEJQ71PZbVLDpjvLWJQQFrWtc7mMuburc/20260403_085658.jpg) ![20260403_090407.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS8bz5h1pbkrZXhkk4hYWSyPN2amM9nSdBsF75wAN5s9W/20260403_090407.jpg) ![20260403_085336.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQJJd9yEMrvfiq3g21VBWjGLPYmTbE9knR5BXUmWJHGvA/20260403_085336.jpg) I lost myself among its paths lined with large trees and small shrubs, enjoying the cool breeze and gazing at the mountains, which were clear and fog-free in every direction, with the various shades of green that characterize them. These are the kinds of landscapes that, at least for me, leave me in awe, thinking about how beautiful my country is and the opportunity life has given me to be here. ![20260403_085247.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc6qvXUi34R7iryfVYycXJ8kbTMPLTbh7hABbSy1A6FTC/20260403_085247.jpg) ![20260403_085815.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP2JJsryGAYcAvhSf6mS2pV2YSSVeF6FaP27zkVUdcUxV/20260403_085815.jpg) See you soon, travelers!

--- Photos taken with a Samsung Galaxy A35. Collage created in [Inshot](https://v.inshot.com/invite) Content owned by me. Translation by: [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

>

Hola, viajeros. Feliz martes para todos.

Iniciamos nuestro segundo día de viaje, ahora desde Timotes en el encantador estado Mérida, nos sentíamos muy entusiasmados con todos los lugares que nos aguardaban para ese día, Ricardo y yo siempre llevamos una idea de los sitios que queremos visitar y así vamos midiendo el tiempo para poder abarcar todo y que no quede ninguno por fuera, ya que no sabemos cuando volverá a repetirse la oportunidad. 

![InShot_20260427_083331729.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNTrrPfHYSDNwiRBhErgqUXXVbCwv3pTT3Yto3yeWUGxX/InShot_20260427_083331729.jpg)

Como saben viajamos en moto, antes de iniciar con nuestra ruta del día quería mostrarles un poco del hotel donde nos hospedamos, llamado Hotel Caribay, ubicado a dos cuadras de la Plaza Bolívar, cuenta con cómodas instalaciones y posee muchas habitaciones desde individuales hasta familiares, en nuestro caso era matrimonial, lo que más me gustó es que tenía agua caliente para ducharse ya que el clima de la zona es un frío muy intenso para alguien que viene de Maracaibo. 

![20260403_083146.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUVKmpjpAZFcCoLptZADMP8LCjQKdVjXnRaDDfw3Rzbyo/20260403_083146.jpg)

![20260403_082939.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNSrmiVtyfhUBMXgfHhg6Dh1Dt7SWnrjWnj9UdqkLuXyD/20260403_082939.jpg)

![20260403_082919.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYgXNGgAgJLHDQzVChFetv5uYTbH6hfQUtC9jvq2Q2K4y/20260403_082919.jpg)

Recorrimos varias calles de este lindo pueblo y luego de pasar por la Casa de la Cultura Don Jesús María Espinoza, llegamos hasta la Plaza Francisco Miranda, esta es la plaza que más recuerdo de mi última visita a Timotes, algunas cosas habían cambiado, en ella se encuentra una pequeña pista para patinar, habían muchos perritos disfrutando de la tranquilidad de esa hermosa mañana. 

![20260403_084336.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmekwftKHmN4QiWUxGR7Z3mzAcoF7JzbFiYhozevB8tgSB/20260403_084336.jpg)

![20260403_084403.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeaUCbPW63izR6qhMYKTK6vZVxSUohoKwaEhDbTZa3fio/20260403_084403.jpg)

![20260403_084914.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZFDLZrNPLYPKFpSkZcCCZdcRq6LaKrzWvup6isKQXq7u/20260403_084914.jpg)

![20260403_084925.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSg8ubtJmpmhauYVn6CPmsZ3WpEzVviyNC373FY8hiwvn/20260403_084925.jpg)

![20260403_085154.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfPxbVS6FFfwP8bosFxQnMxsm9PHn2LesStEgMDbEm6Un/20260403_085154.jpg)

![20260403_085212.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd6BnHqon5zhyMFX9a4vFeGjHAJY9deMnyRkGTxXEV6P1/20260403_085212.jpg)

![20260403_085232.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd7fsGwf5zMYqBhhzr8mudDMkQe9SDVEShSwb7EgSx4Zt/20260403_085232.jpg)

![20260403_085238.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme5ENwRVSj5oqMYD8KTKwYnryPaBT7TZbdAbfFVdnGTAU/20260403_085238.jpg)

![20260403_085302.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSNwL4NsGhQB3hG2sLowB4bT6ttDMNWpyLne4eaPKuyvM/20260403_085302.jpg)

Este lugar aguarda mucha sencillez pero también un poco de historia con el pequeño busto en honor al Generalisimo Francisco de Miranda que casi pasa por desapercibido en mi caminata, es a él a quién se le rinde honor con esta plaza, además de un pequeño escenario con un lindo paisaje de fondo y unas coloridas letras de Mérida, de seguro aquí se realizan distintos actos culturales, subí hasta el mismo para obtener una vista distinta y pude descubrir un parque infantil y otra perspectiva del parque de patinaje.

![20260403_085326.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZNimEGKxuALHz531d3iWUV454fiR9XaeBi9vfdQqEbqr/20260403_085326.jpg)

![20260403_085426.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS7TkGRcPVKecW54ysmoDSwVGr3KmVUrGjuSc4xF5T2uw/20260403_085426.jpg)

![20260403_085559.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXfXFdGY6aDjQUuSxca5jnGxeAsXs5dder4LtP4P6y8VU/20260403_085559.jpg)

![20260403_085620.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmasHUZnKpcAKbpyAJGp25Tt9Peyk4LmwDpBfG44bwHFdQ/20260403_085620.jpg)

![20260403_085623.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZT1sr6d5ESHbgRpojc3bUB71cuSd1J6gaX5fSZqwgQz5/20260403_085623.jpg)

En una esquina de la plaza se encuentra un San Benito y al frente de ella un pequeño Santuario con el mismo nombre, a el le rinden fe y devoción en Timotes y también durante las fiestas patronales. 

![20260403_085658.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW4qyFAPodV6QEJQ71PZbVLDpjvLWJQQFrWtc7mMuburc/20260403_085658.jpg)

![20260403_090407.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS8bz5h1pbkrZXhkk4hYWSyPN2amM9nSdBsF75wAN5s9W/20260403_090407.jpg)

![20260403_085336.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQJJd9yEMrvfiq3g21VBWjGLPYmTbE9knR5BXUmWJHGvA/20260403_085336.jpg)

Yo me perdí entre sus caminerías con grandes árboles y pequeños arbustos, disfrutando de la brisa fría y viendo las montañas que en todas las direcciones estaban despejadas y sin nieblina, con los distintos tonos de verdes que le representan, son de esos paisajes que por lo menos a mi me dejan enamorada pensando en lo hermoso que es mi país, y en la oportunidad que me da la vida de llegar hasta aquí.

![20260403_085247.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc6qvXUi34R7iryfVYycXJ8kbTMPLTbh7hABbSy1A6FTC/20260403_085247.jpg)

![20260403_085815.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP2JJsryGAYcAvhSf6mS2pV2YSSVeF6FaP27zkVUdcUxV/20260403_085815.jpg)

body.title: Enjoying the Beautiful and Refreshing water of Busay Falls
body.body:
Hello Everyone, sharing to you this beautiful and refreshing view of our Busay Falls.

Natures hidden gem, the breathtaking falls here in San Pedro Iriga City, this is only about 20 minutes walking distance from my in laws house. Only few people know this place just the people nearby our barangay but when pandemic hits it become popular. And lots of visitors praise the clean and accessible fresh water and this is free to all no entrance fee, no need to spend money just to enjoy the clean and refreshing water. This stunning natural waterfalls cascades into a refreshing pool that offers visitors to escape the hustle of everday life and connect with nature's raw beauty. 


![San Pedro Busay Falls.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/AK7xzY8SKwvACMit5N5g1PhCmYgeJo7HtWyjH8n1YFyA4cEDQMpwCDzWxS6mcdL.jpg)


The journey going here in Busay falls in San Pedro is also an adventurous, if you want a hiking feels just go here. Bring your own food if you want to stay a little long because no store available there. If you want to buy some snacks or drinks you can walk about 20 minutes going to my mother in laws store.

![busay falls.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/23zbUGQhee1VZYSW87pWY5JR8frDh1YTB5J1axbbZmF2xazBsr2n4wzV9K3xpfxJ4Ya64.jpg)



![busay 2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/choiscxel01/23tmHi4i7ZWCnMyv3VNGgUvsteSqC1ejR5Bs2g1poVLJmWHXp4rNgdXyLGqpGyAZHvtRK.jpg)

Busay falls are perfect day out for you to come to relax and perfect hangout spot together with your family and friends. And this also perfect place if you want me time spend time doing nothing other than just enjoying yourself. 

Going to this kind of place (busay falls) reminds us that nature gives generously, and it gives us unforgettable experience and happy moments. So we should cared more for our environment.

body.title: What an amazing battle, with amazing ruleset.
body.body: Greetings everyone! Today I played the battle with some other ruleset, and the game was very interesting. By seeing the opponent monsters it was looking hard for my monsters to dominate. Because opponent monsters were really very strong but major impact in today battle was made by the ruleset. Ruleset really made all the monsters really very weak in the battle field meanwhile monsters were attacking on each other too. Such type of battles were really very rare, you will also get amaze after watching my battle. Now let me share you in detail from the beginning.
/> The name of the ruleset was \*\*COLLATERAL DAMAGE\*\*. All units have reckless (each successful attack also deal 1 damage to adjacent allied units).

/> So the ruleset is amazing to watch, the battle was of 97 mana cost. Of course we can choose any monster with deck as we want. I have made my deck very strong will all the monsters I need in the game. Even opponent monsters were too good in front me, the more high mana cost battle you will face more strong and good monster with high ability.
/> Now let's go ahead with the battle and let me share you where things got change.

/> So as the round starts all the monsters were ready to attack on each other, after that my monster took the first move towards opponent meanwhile my monsters get the reckless as per the ruleset and they lose their single health. In this whole round everyone was attacking on each other and their beside monster were getting reckless and losing their health. They were becoming weak for the next round. In this round I lose my second monster and opponent lose his first monster and others were very weak for next round. Game is very intense and competitive.

/> So again as round starts my monster take out the first move and as you can see opponent first monster was attacking with -7 means he can eliminate the monster within single attack, he was too dangerous. Anyhow my monsters were facing them and after making every attack the other monsters were getting reckless. Opponent first monster eliminate dread by attacking -7 health on him. I was scared of him because he can make the game one sided. Still my another monster came ahead, and in the whole round he did not make any move meanwhile opponent last second monster get eliminate because of the ruleset. And other monsters really become very weak. The game is still very intense.

/> So again as the round starts lord took the first move and eliminate opponent first monster at that moment I was like yeah! now the battle will be in my side. But still my other monsters were very weak, opponent eliminate time bandit in this round and again opponent lose his last second monster because of the ability. I was really very impress by the ruleset and my monster. And before the round ends my second monster attack on opponent second monster and eliminate him. And again I lose roc because of the ruleset. But after this round opponent was left with single monster and I was having 2 monster in the game.

/> So as you can see lord was already very strong in the game and opponent monster was on his last health and lord attack on him and eliminate him from the battle. Here I won the game from my strong opponent. It was too good, the ruleset and battle was really very impressive.

/>

While going through my photo gallery, I came across a lovely memory of this place—these delicious ice creams that took me back in time. On our trip to Asturias, we visited a really cool ice cream shop, and the flavors were absolutely delicious. There isn’t a huge variety, but the ones they do have are spot-on. It was really cold during our stay, but that didn’t stop us from trying the ice cream shop, fact that struck me was that it’s practically the only one in the whole town, but it’s actually found throughout Asturias since the name is very common; the one we visited was in Cangas de Onis. I loved the whole concept of the place because they also make chocolates, bonbons, cones, etc. Plus, if you stop by in the morning, the smell of coffee will draw you in.

I should note that although the flavors are limited, they have a weekly special, which makes the experience more fun. I chose the peanut butter and Rocher flavors—they’re very creamy and the flavors are spot-on. Rafa ordered the coffee flavor, and I was surprised by how good it was. Revisando mi galería me encontré un recuerdo muy lindo de este sitio, estos deliciosos helados que me hicieron volver al pasado. En nuestro viaje a Asturias visitamos una heladería muy chula y además demasiado ricos los sabores, no hay una gran variedad pero son muy acertados los que ya tienen. Hacía mucho frío durante nuestra estadía pero no fue impedimento para probar los helados, lo que me impresionó fuese que casi es la única en todo el pueblo, pero sí está presente en toda Asturias ya que su nombre es muy popular, esta que visitamos fue en Cangas de Onis. Me encantó todo el concepto del sitio porque también elaboran chocolates, bombones, conos, etc. incluso si te pasas por la mañana te atraerá el olor a café.

Debo acotar que aunque son limitados los sabores, tienen uno semanal lo cual hace la experiencia más divertida, yo escogí el de cacahuete y el de Rocher, son muy cremosos y los sabores super acertados, Rafa pidió café que me sorprendió lo bueno que estaba. El local se llama ***Cremela, Helados y Chocolates*** y son 100% artesanales, cosa que me encanta.


📍C. San Pelayo 37, BJ izq. 33550 Cangas de Onis, Asturias.

body.title: 挖野菜充饥
body.body:
话说上午股市跌得是一言难尽（大盘没咋跌，我得个股没眼看）。快到中午时，不舍得出去吃啦，于是和媳妇说我们挖点野菜充饥如何？

![20260428_110113.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmefcAhdStrL1JWCVLYUSPeRaP63dm6T7w4mDzWzQBEYhU/20260428_110113.jpg)

媳妇欣然同意，话说前两天一场大雨过后，院子里冒出各种新鲜的野菜，一看就很好吃的样子，想必非常美味。

其实前些天媳妇的闺蜜已经来我家院子里“扫荡”一次啦，割走了一大袋子韭菜又挖走了一大袋子野菜，给我们羡慕得不得了。

媳妇闺蜜要给我们留一半野菜，那怎么好意思呢？告诉她野菜很快就会长出来，吃不完根本吃不完。

这不，野菜就冒出来了嘛，这次我们先下手为强，哈哈哈。

院子里的韭菜和野菜，不知道什么原因，今年的韭菜不给力呀，看起来非常的瘦弱，一点也不茁壮！
![20260428_105901.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbo3uXwhxZ8Wk9CsGFJEKHxkv8PDJJ4YJjZrXpbKkXUgz/20260428_105901.jpg)

倒是野菜都肥头大耳的
![20260428_105913.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYe2nWhNB8Ff35mYE6bUN92b2bTgmYXYATsCxQi6uAfF4/20260428_105913.jpg)

还有野生的韭菜，这看起来倒是不错
![20260428_105919.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmevWczr49UTttCGe8EPiL7eivHRti8MsKQf1Fh8nzRSiu/20260428_105919.jpg)

稀稀落落的韭菜，左边大叶子的是野芹菜
![20260428_105930.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcGyhG19HXER1D9bFyH4Fry6KRuKLgzJ6cB9YrqesQxCF/20260428_105930.jpg)

弯腰挖了一会，战果辉煌
![20260428_110113.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmefcAhdStrL1JWCVLYUSPeRaP63dm6T7w4mDzWzQBEYhU/20260428_110113.jpg)

装到小盆里，中午就吃这个啦
![20260428_110217.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZaiHBQDJ5ijN1rnk1N4ZFFUyC2faCUMwJvEo5RhhKjaa/20260428_110217.jpg)

院子里的鸢尾，原来两个品种的鸢尾（紫色和黄色的），现在这是几株硕果仅存的紫色鸢尾啦
![20260428_110256.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVXyRiFfMJBzYBMkFsAbqR5a5yai75mzriNquLnN3iXN3/20260428_110256.jpg)

黄色的鸢尾比紫色的开花晚，不过也快开花啦（鸢尾中间还夹杂着一些韭菜，一会都给它割掉）
![20260428_110358.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUHnrDR7B7TEY9n2X19A3dms9FQVWQR4MAmptZQdpBHxs/20260428_110358.jpg)

从这个角度看小院还是不错的（晾衣绳上挂的是洗回来的羽绒服）
![20260428_111017.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcxDu4fpL7kAKeEz1faMGb9bS8vuzCVHtD5PTuqd5jsrD/20260428_111017.jpg)

这个角度拍得乱糟糟的呢？改天收拾一下，重新拍！
![20260428_111034.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRuAkyKa7EfZCR2gfK6STx6zX1851Ast2mAwxvMm6tDgE/20260428_111034.jpg)

午餐的菜
![20260428_120847.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZXteQkYMX9sUDETiQ6ocR8C1nFRWAbteSPWDGQC3WUJo/20260428_120847.jpg)

话说原本想着吃点野菜能省点钱又能减点肥，结果因为这野菜也太下饭了，我干了两大碗米饭，又是撑到不想动只想睡觉的一顿饭。

下午睡醒看了一样股票账户，我炸，我只不过在自家院子里挖了点野菜割了一把韭菜，结果自己在A股被狗庄当成韭菜狂割，哭晕！

body.title: Turn Your Head,Lose the Race–The Brutal Swimming Pool Rule
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZfdGQRK5Mh5rvejRrS9DFQWLs1R1GWDZie6mdKt4naHs/1777115875756.jpg)
[SOURCE](https://www.genspark.ai/api/files/s/7xlgRKk2?cache_control=3600)



This powerful image captures a high-stakes swimming race in deep blue water.In the foreground, the leader powers forward with laser focus,dark hair slicked back, goggles on, jaw set, muscular shoulders and arms driving a powerful, efficient freestyle stroke.His body is perfectly streamlined, every movement purposeful, eyes locked straight ahead toward the finish line.

Behind him, the second swimmer is struggling.His head is turned sharply sideways, eyes fixed on the leader instead of his own lane. His mouth is slightly open in strain or disbelief, his stroke disrupted, water splashing chaotically around him.The lane divider floats between them like a barrier, highlighting the clear separation that focus creates.At the bottom,the caption delivers the unflinching truth:
>\

This image isn’t just motivational art,it’s a raw, cinematic depiction of the exact moment distraction destroys performance.Turning your head even slightly in swimming creates drag,ruins rhythm,and costs critical time.In life, the price is even higher: lost momentum, missed opportunities,and goals that remain out of reach.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU5RroNnDPvUPpBFyc3u5otBXzKKCuSdg5E3isRVDZ7fQ/1764851521997.jpg)


**How This Plays Out in Everyday Living**

**Business & Entrepreneurship**.
Losers see someone succeeding and immediately turn their head,researching every detail, envying their progress, or copying surface tactics. Winners stay locked on their own customers, product development, and daily execution.While others watch, they keep moving forward and touch the wall first.


**Personal Finance & Wealth Creation**.
Losers get distracted by flashy wins,luxury displays, or sudden breakthroughs posted online, leading to FOMO(Fear Of Missing Out)and poor decisions.Winners focus relentlessly on their own budget,investments,habits, and compounding systems.They measure success against their own past results, not someone else’s timeline.

**Content Creation & Personal Brand**.
Losers obsess over why another creator is growing faster or chase trends and algorithms.Winners pour their energy into delivering consistent, high-value work and refining their craft.They improve stroke by stroke, and the audience follows.

**Health, Fitness & Daily Discipline**.
Losers compare themselves to others who appear further ahead and lose motivation. Winners tune out the noise, focus on their own reps, nutrition,and recovery, building progress one disciplined session at a time.

**Relationships & Community**.
Losers compare their personal life or circle to others, breeding resentment.Winners invest fully in becoming better in their own relationships, more present, intentional, and consistent.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU5RroNnDPvUPpBFyc3u5otBXzKKCuSdg5E3isRVDZ7fQ/1764851521997.jpg)



**The Hidden Cost of Turning Your Head**.
Every sideways glance steals energy that belongs to your own race. It fuels envy, anxiety, and self-doubt while breaking your rhythm. In a world overflowing with filtered success stories and constant noise, the biggest advantage comes from ruthless lane discipline: eyes forward, mouth closed, stroke powerful.
Winners notice competition but never let it become their main focus.They study timeless principles when useful, then quickly return to executing in their own lane.

**My Practical Action Steps for the Hive**.
I start each morning by asking myself: Am I swimming my race,or have I turned my head? I track time spent on comparison activities like endless scrolling or overthinking others success.

The instant I notice myself turning my head (mentally or literally), I redirect immediately with one focused action in my own work.

I guard my prime hours without distractions.In addition, I contribute authentic lessons from my own journey to Hive, not just polished highlights.Because true value lifts others without sparking unnecessary comparison.




**Hive Final Charge**
Turn Your Head, Lose the Race.
That’s the brutal swimming pool rule, captured vividly in this image.
In the competitive waters of life, filled with distractions and noise,winners refuse to waste energy watching the next lane.They stay locked in, driving forward stroke after powerful stroke,eyes fixed on the wall. The **Hive** exists to build,create, and dominate,not to spectate or compare.Make the choice today:Lock your eyes forward.Reclaim your rhythm.Power through with everything you have.The finish line doesn’t reward those who watch the loudest.It rewards the most focused swimmers.

What’s one area in your life right now where you’ve been turning your head too often?
Drop it in the comments or Hive thread.Let’s keep each other accountable and swimming straight.
Eyes forward.Stroke hard.Win clean.**Turn Your Head, Lose the Race**.Now go touch that wall.
For the **Hive**. Build. Win. Repeat.

Thank you for reading.Yours truly @zusi78 , signing off.
