body.title: THAT ONE FRIEND FROM SCHOOL
body.body:
Good morning everyone you're welcome to my blog today.



Entering school at the age of 16 was something that give me joy and at the same time it be scared me so much because I didn't even know how to navigate to Life by myself what was I going to do out there in a place that my parents are far away from me and my siblings are not close to me I'm all alone in a whole different environment.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSrAjXs3QPNQQDj8dG3wrwtGrz8TzJNtcE1XAZxupSUq1/165368.webp 




 I had a lot of encounters with so many people and I had so many friends in school too right from the time that I stayed in the hostel till the when I moved out of the hostel and went to a lodge because I was always dealing with hair lice or bed bugs in the hostel and it became very very unbearable for me to live there anymore.

So I moved into a lodge I lived with a girl named goodness ,goodness was actually good in the beginning she was one of these high class babes with so many wigs bags designer shoes and all that and I was just me just a normal girl from my village I wasn't into all this fashion and all that meanwhile my department you had to wear your departmental uniform all the time white and carton color for public health department.

So I stay with goodness for 2 years and in that 2 years it was not all good for me I wasn't comfortable in the room I felt suffocated ,she would always use up my full stuffs if I get provisions she will use them most times I have to travel back home to look after my dad before he died then most times I come back without bringing extra food stuff and when I'm not around and I travel and I come back hoping that I still have foodstuffs I come back to nothing and it makes me suffer a lot because what are you going to explain to people at home that you finished food stuff that they gave you while you were not even in school so I decided to leave the lodge.

I moved into a new lodge with my course mate named benita ezeala ,benita ezeala was the best thing that has happened to me she took me in as a sister and a friend she loved me . We related so well like we know each other for quite a very long time funny enough we've been in the same department and we barely talkto each other till our third year in school when we started living together.

It was one of my best moments in school I had peace of mind and everything . We barely fought people would always see us and say this to people love each other so much even the time that she was sick and she fainted I didn't know what I would do at the point because I just felt like how am I supposed to survive when my baby girl is about leaving me I made sure we took her to the hospital that night and she got better because she's hypertensive.



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdBkxJFSmQUj1ndQgbS1wfHQFNAEnDB5Msbpk5tdd6Exf/165369.webp 






To summarize I met up with her last December because she stays in Lagos and we had fun hanging out together it was so good to see one of my best persons around me again and this is me shouting out to benita Ezeala for being my best girl ever I love you girl 💕. even though she's not on hive but I want the world to know that I love and appreciate her and I value our friendship.

Thank you for stopping by my blog today.

body.title: Hive-Reachout Weekly Prompt 97>>\
body.body: Honestly, life after graduation has been a different kind of test for me.\n\n

> I recently graduated from Science Laboratory Technology, and instead of things becoming easier immediately, responsibility became more real. With my father retired and a family of six to consider, I already understood that I couldn’t afford to relax. Even during my final year, I was already supporting myself, and that mindset didn’t end after graduation. Right now, I’m in that stage where I’m trying to stand on my own—completing my clearance, pushing my projects forward, and still searching for opportunities. So when people talk about charity, I don’t just see it as a nice idea—I see it as a real-life decision. Because the truth is, when you are trying to survive, giving can feel difficult.

> There are days I have just enough for my own needs, and someone else still comes asking for help. In moments like that, it becomes a serious question: Do I give, or do I hold on to what I have? I’ve learned not to lie to myself I cannot always give money. But I’ve also refused to become someone who turns away completely. I’ve come to understand that charity is not only about money. *Sometimes, it is giving your time when someone needs direction. Sometimes, it is encouraging a friend who feels stuck. Sometimes, it is sharing the little you have, even when it’s not convenient. Sometimes, it is simply being available* There have been moments I gave from my little, and I felt the weight of it—but I also felt the meaning of it. That’s when I realized that real giving is not about comfort, it’s about compassion. At the same time, I’ve learned to be wise so I don’t go broke trying to help others. This is how I balance it: I take care of my basic needs first—because stability matters. I give only what I can afford I don’t try to impress anyone. I focus on impact, not size even small help counts. And I don’t allow pressure or guilt to control my decisions.

>

One thing is clear to me now:
Charity is not proven when life is easy it is proven when life is hard.

In this phase of my life, my giving may be small, but it is sincere. It comes from a place of understanding struggle, not abundance.

So no, I don’t believe charity should only happen when things are convenient. If we wait for comfort, we may never truly give.

Even in my current situation, I choose to keep my heart open.

Because I believe this season will not last forever. And when things finally get better, I want to look back and know that I didn’t lose my kindness while trying to survive.


*Thanks for coming to my blog*

body.title: À DAILY WORD IN FRENCH (#37)
body.body:
https://media.tenor.com/TpeE0dHU2JwAAAAC/d%C3%A9j%C3%A0.gif 


Hello everyone it’s Tuesday and the second day of the week, im hoping you’re not already tired because I am Déjà. 

So let’s quickly get into today’s French word which  is DÉJÀ. 
This is a very simple word but very useful for our everyday speech and writing or conversations, if you read the very first paragraph again you will understand what I mean by Déjà When I said its a new week but I am tired Déjà. 

 https://media.tenor.com/H0XCUkhu-m4AAAAC/i%27m-getting-d%C3%A9j%C3%A0-vu-right-now-and-i-don%27t-like-it-bunny.gif 

French is exceptions Whwn we talk about the rules Thats why I didn’t say I am Déjà tired but instead I put Déjà before tired. Now what does this mean? Déjà means already. 
Very simple but it actually means a lot and is an important word which is truly useful. 
Most times we use words like this effortlessly without even recognizing. Pronunciation is like day-zha or day jha it has a sharp tone on the second syllable but sounds sweet when you do say it like the French people. 

 https://media.tenor.com/tju-YLQCtSkAAAAC/i-just-had-this-really-odd-moment-of-deja-vu-adrian-boseman.gif 


Take these few examples into consideration 

Je l’ai déjà fait — I have already done it

Il est déjà là — He is already there

This word is very useful when talking about time and completion and also it gives a sense that something has happened sooner than expected.
Like I said earlier Déjà may look small, but it adds strong meaning to a sentence.

 https://media.tenor.com/cSlkTwOrmTkAAAAC/d%C3%A9j%C3%A0.gif 

Thank you for taking your time to read this lesson. 
I hope we are all moving forward with the French classes.

Bon chance! (GOODLUCK)

body.title: Don't You Dare Bully My Child - 286
body.body:
Just some days ago when I wrote on a prompt about physical and online bullying. Bullying has eaten deep into our society so much that it has started to look like a normal act that doesn't get an instant caution.

![1000639245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23t7DhvGUm66fQJxFrs3Z9KMjR9wiwd7L1Cd4pAgYtPgBZo5F7we4H2k96xEYu1WYBUyR.jpg)

You would see people been bullied up to the point of committing suicide, isolating themselves from the society or not feeling safe and confident in themselves being a victim and the least I can even withstand to see is having someone close to me go through such.

However, in schools now, we have students who were brought up in the hands of bullying parent or whatever and they've also grown to become an offspring of bullying.
Students especially victims dread to go to school because they will be bullied by that senior student and worst of it is that it doesn't even necessarily have to be a senior and it can always be someone from same class as the victims but born with the bloodline of being a bully.

Unfortunately, I don't think there are enough precautions on these acts and that's why bullying never cease to stop especially from this primary and basic level which is in school.
So, let's say my child happens to go to the same school with such bullying student, this is what I'll tell him or her even before I stand in to interfere:

![1000654609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/242s647jaUTC3ewo4FfFVXEAvk3YTBVUymMp5cqqfPFrDHULeC2G9AucNcXGAfnYns4xF.jpg)

When that boy or girl come close to you to bully you again, do not be afraid, he is only like a Goliath with no power and the moment you are courageous to face him, stand up to him and his guts, he won't come for you anymore.

It is one thing to fight for and defend a victim of bullying but it's another thing for such victim to be able to stand up for themselves and fight for themselves. Then if it's past what they can handle then they can seek help but their primary courage is needed to stand up for themselves and that's what I'll build in my child because I won't be there everytime to defend him/her neither will the teachers in school be available everytime.

Afterwards, the school authorities would have to hear from me on why my child has to be bullied in school without them stopping such acts amidst their students. 
I don't joke with my family so I'm sure I'm not gonna sit well with someone toying with my child's stable mind.

I'll be dropping my 🖊️ here on the Ladiesofhive community prompt 

Thanks for reading through 🤗

body.title: The Modem that Changed Our Lives
body.body: ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmddcRf7WUav45UQK8bbqCtLkuEu2AEFusAgGD8ZThUcGc/image.png) [_Source: Lowyat_](https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1195591030463081&set=a.354980616664772&id=100064585093900) Anyone had an inkling of a memory owning this modem? (If you could recognise this—or a similar speed, then we probably could guess which \

you were from 😂)

---

This, was the very modem that changed her life, the very tiny gadget that linked to her study computer in the living room, connecting her to the outside world, digitally, for the very first time.

Even if it was barely any graphics, with just flat 256 colour interface, this was where, through the keyboard, 2 souls were connected.

---

Perhaps those who are born after the \
would not have felt it much yet, but it was the same when the Nokia could connect to its data and the \

became widely active in Malaysia. It was the year 1998, with the screeching sounds of this tiny lit modem, let her to a flat screen room, where any posibilities could happen. #### It was none other than the Internet Relay Chat (IRC) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZSedQadC8widqwQePMCDHQ79pdqkzQVV5SvzDxJtgLB9/image.png) [_Source: Snapfiles_](https://www.snapfiles.com/screenfiles/mirc.gif) It may looked like just flat wordings of chatrooms, and general usernames on the right, but it was where a miraculous connection sparked at a \
command... that lasted 28 years was formed.\n\n#### Even with life's ups and downs, and several \

occured, the connection wasn't just maintained by 2 souls in 2 separate continents.

### It was sustained by the 3rd cord—The Invisible Divine Architect, Who created this very cosmos, once turned water into wine, once walked on stormy seas—and till this very day, even with a now 300MBps speed, kept the connection alive.

---

Funny it is just like #HIVE, the blockchain that is maintained across all the network servers to keep this amazing platform alive for everyone to connect with their own creative content, formed friendships that could last for decades to come, regardless of the distance.

Just like that 2 souls, connected 28 years ago in the once famous mIRC.
(It was the most hyped place, just like friendster in 2002 or Facebook in 2004.

---

Did you own this very tiny gadget or been to this public channel before?

Would love to share your experience here. We can't promise high valued upvotes, but it is definitely a nostalgic moment for you and we'd love to read your stories.

---

##### As for us...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcFFYLmteBKY7FjiZ5Bz7VuJtCfjKZZ85WTBK5GUZ6yC8/the_thirdcord_chap02.png)

I hope you will remember this cover and come back some time later to hear our story.
(We are still in the mid-stages of refining from our second draft, making sure the timeline of this miraculous journey is correctly placed)

With much love from us to you:
@littlenewthings and @aikido.hung 

This account was given a green light from @macchiata to use the #hivebookclub tag to promote the journey of our book writing, with a tiny bit of snippets here and there in the future.

body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNNebMTTTRXitH9ZPkH4osHsXEYb6B2jDwhf5sAJAvgEx/1777368207300.jpg)

[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/images/download/x-193099_1920.jpg)


The idea of a patent is often sold as a promise, a fair system where creativity is rewarded and protected. It sounds simple right? invent something new, secure your rights, and benefit from your hard work. But beneath that polished surface lies something many people never question that's a quiet distortion of truth, what some might call the patent lie.

I used to think patents were the ultimate proof of ownership, that once you had one, your idea was safe from theft or misuse. I believed the system was built to protect individuals the lone thinker, the small creator, the person with nothing but an idea and determination. It felt like a level playing field, where innovation mattered more than influence.

Until I realise that the reality is less ideal, a patent doesn’t guarantee protection it guarantees a right to fight. And fighting takes money, time, and influence. Many large corporations don’t just create they accumulate patents, building walls around industries. These walls don’t always encourage innovation; sometimes they restrict it.

The “lie” isn’t that patents exist, it’s in how they’re perceived. 

People assume having a patent means you’re secure, but in truth, it often means you’ve just entered a complex legal battlefield. Smaller inventors can be pushed out, not because their ideas lack value, but because they lack resources.

Even more, some patents are granted for minor tweaks or broad concepts, allowing control over ideas that feel almost universal. This blurs the line between true innovation and strategic claiming.

Recognising the patent lie doesn’t mean rejecting the system it means seeing it clearly. Patents are tools, not guarantees. They can protect, but they can also limit. The real advantage comes from understanding how they work, not just believing in what they promise.

In the end, innovation isn’t just about having an idea or even owning it on paper. It’s about navigating the structures that define ownership itself and knowing that sometimes, what you’re told is protection may also be a form of control.

It is almost the end of April, and the spring vibes are dying in Beijing as the temperature is increasing faster than at the start of April. Though the nighttime weather is cold but not like in the early spring, which is a good time for doing exercise or having some physical activity without wearing warmer clothes. And the afternoon is becoming longer as the days are getting longer, and the days are now brighter than in winter. As a result, the daytime temperature is also crossing the 25-degree mark, making it hot sometimes during the early afternoon.

I found the launch time of the institute a great time to walk around my institute when the day is quite bright, and nature seems to be more alive after the long freezing cold. I have found the greenery of the surrounding nature is so beautiful, with the new leaves in the trees bringing back the natural colour of nature after the dark grey colour of winter. The freshly fallen leaves are now among the most attractive scenes in nature.

The sky is deep blue, but the white clouds make the sky more scenic as a background for the green nature, and I found it like a fantastic work of art by nature to explore during this time of the year. The heating sun is often covered by these flying clouds, making the weather more comfortable with a moderate increment of the temperature, and it makes the weather a soothing one to enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings.

I hope you like my photos of the beautiful scenic views of the natural surroundings of my workplace. If you have any queries, let me know in the comments, and I will do my best to answer them.

Thanks a lot for your time and attention. I will catch up with you at the next one.

Wishing you a good day!


> I took all the photos, and these are my own property.

Just like a typical cat's tale to seal.

body.title: Alhambra de Granada
body.body: > During our recent business trip, my colleague and I decided to take a short break and visit one of the most famous landmarks in Spain, the Alhambra de Granada. Our friends highly recommended us to see this UNESCO World Heritage Site and we couldn't resist the opportunity to see this beauty with our own eyes. ![Gr (1).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfFuKjVJMdwPrA66oqoY2MmbSZpHnBeeGzZThiQFpyq8F/Gr%20(1).jfif) As we entered the gates of the Alhambra, we were awed by the view of the Generalife Gardens, which were used for entertainment by the Moorish rulers centuries ago. These extensive gardens include various fountains, pools and canals, all connected by a complex network of irrigation systems. Walking through these green spaces, we really felt the peace and harmony that reigned here. One of the most notable structures in the complex is the Comares Palace, which showcases an exquisite combination of Moorish and Renaissance architecture. Its ornate halls, especially the Hall of Ambassadors, display intricate geometric patterns and calligraphic inscriptions that captivate the imagination. Another highlight was the Nasrid Palace, where we saw the private quarters of the emirs of the Nasrid dynasty. We were amazed by the intricate ornaments and details on the ceilings, the beautifully decorated walls and the intricate design of the marble floor. ![Gsr (5).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWGgaDSE97KokNkqVXhhgmZ62fobKXstcNUuvPg11iENJ/Gsr%20(5).jpg) Moorish architecture, also known as Islamic or Arabic architecture, is characterized by its elegance, sophistication and attention to detail. In the Alhambra, this architecture is evident in the use of geometric patterns, pointed arches, and intricate ornamentation made of plaster, marble, and colored stucco. These decorative elements often include verses from the Qur'an, floral motifs, and geometric shapes that create a visually appealing and spiritually meaningful environment. ![Gr (4).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcJq3b2fmyXhcYwWHXF265HjUtCivT1e3Uk9WaX7siFfh/Gr%20(4).jfif) ![Gr (3).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRKnNb3DSgAqQGdXLMggEozBy8ccVc2QFfXDBRrCiFEVx/Gr%20(3).jfif) From the top of the Alcazaba, the main fortress of the Alhambra, there are panoramic views of the city of Granada and its surroundings. This strategic position provides an opportunity to admire the towering cathedral and the labyrinthine streets of the old town while enjoying the fresh mountain air. ![Gr (2).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQYc92ULrGugtm24pi2RQg3SVRdVQ61SkUp4UDu4Ao6VN/Gr%20(2).jfif) I can unequivocally say that our short detour to the Alhambra de Granada during our business trip turned out to be extremely rewarding. This World Heritage Site impressed us with the rich history and culture of Andalucía and will surely remain in our memories long after we return home and tell our colleagues and friends :) [//]:# (!worldmappin 37.17608 lat -3.58815 long d3scr)

body.title: Dailyprompt: patent lie
body.body:
At first I believed everything they told me.
It sounded normal.
Nothing felt wrong about them.

But then I started noticing their behaviors.
Their words didn't match their behaviors.
Something about them felt off.

And slowly I started noticing it.

They way they avoid the eye contact.
The way they talk.
The small pauses before answering.
It was not a hidden lie anymore.
It was obvious.
A patent lie.

But the strange part about that was they kept saying it like it was true.
Like I'm a fool and I wouldn't notice it.
At first I didn't say anything.
I just listened.
And in that moment I realized...
People lie to you because they think you are a fool and you won't question it.

And that hurts more than the lie itself.

body.title: 當然可以！以下是一個關於自然的部
body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g4dc738a765e0ba50596f0017aacf8fff3fa2736e427e2efdb26fcd65866b1e5ea5e71d7d1a7d4c0ac6ebf5500b42d5242698c1ce506c2c5e0a0e2248e62a7de0_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 自然的美

自然是我們生活中不可或缺的一部分，它以無窮的魅力和神秘吸引著我們。無論是壯觀的山脈、廣闊的海洋，還是繁茂的森林，自然總是以其獨特的方式展現著生命的奇蹟。

## 山脈

山脈是地球上最壯觀的地形之一。它們不僅提供了壯麗的景觀，還是許多生物的棲息地。登山者在攀登高峰的過程中，能夠感受到大自然的力量與美麗。

### 特點
- **高度**：山脈的高度和形狀各異，形成了獨特的地貌。
- **生態系統**：不同高度的山脈擁有不同的生態系統，從低地的森林到高山的苔原，各種生物在此繁衍生息。

## 海洋

海洋覆蓋了地球表面的70%以上，是地球上最大的生態系統。它們不僅提供了豐富的資源，還對氣候和天氣有著重要的影響。

### 特點
- **生物多樣性**：海洋中生活著無數的生物，從微小的浮游生物到巨大的藍鯨，形成了複雜的食物鏈。
- **氣候調節**：海洋吸收二氧化碳，調節全球氣候，對人類的生存至關重要。

## 森林

森林是地球的肺，提供了氧氣並吸收二氧化碳。它們是許多動植物的家園，擁有豐富的生物多樣性。

### 特點
- **生態系統**：森林生態系統中有許多層次，包括樹冠層、樹幹層和地面層，各層生物相互依存。
- **人類的資源**：森林提供木材、藥材和食物，對人類生活有著重要的影響。

## 總結

自然的每一個角落都充滿了生命的奇蹟，無論是山脈、海洋還是森林，它們共同構成了我們的地球。珍惜這份自然的美好，是我們每一個人的責任。讓我們一起保護這片美麗的土地，讓它永遠綻放光彩！

body.title: Buying Insurance at a younger age
body.body:
Taking a medical insurance at the age of 25 feels like waste of money to the Gen Z generation. Right?

At this age mostly we are thinking of buying a car, planning a holiday, buying a house and all those things, no one is thinking of starting to save for retirement or investing in health policies as we all feel that there's lot of time for it. And trust me in my 20s even I thought the same way. I never thought that taking an insurance policy or planning for retirement was important at that point of time. But then problems don't knock our door and come they just come uninformed at any point of time and now at this age I feel that maybe I should have started planning for my retirement earlier in my life. 

I also feel that for the new generation It's become very important to take an insurance policy at a very young age. The type of world that we are living in there are so many unexpected things that are happening. Youngsters and even teenagers are feeling stressed they get burned out so easily, the tolerance level is so low and so many heart attack cases that we you keep hearing of. There are so many diseases now which in my younger days I had never heard names of like I never knew what myasthenia gravis was until my husband got it. 

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSAvHZgB8FcGopztn9YvYAzgXRgbtBE7ECbYoaTPUFhds/image.png)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/insurance-health-insurance-care-7065113/)

I believe that Health Insurance is very important to be taken even for the younger generation. The benefit is that as you take it early in your life, the insurance premium will be very less compared to what you will take it at a later stage in your life. You also accumulate some bonus on not utilizing the insurance. 

The most important benefit of taking a medical insurance at early stage in life is that you will be healthy and you will not have a problem getting the insurance. As we age there is a possibility that we will develop some kind of health conditions, some kind of ailments and then after that it becomes difficult to get a medical insurance. Nowadays, so many medical policies don't cover autoimmune conditions. As new diseases keep coming up. The medical insurance also keeps updating their policies they keep excluding certain conditions which cost them too much money.

We do not know in future how many ailments medical insurance policy will not cover so taking it at this point of time, when the exclusions are still limited it can be very beneficial for the future where may be what is covered now may not be covered in the future.

A little extra spending for now can be of great help for future.

***Thank you for visiting my blog.*** 👼🏻👼🏻💖💖🌹🌺🌸

body.title: Once a student, now a Teacher!
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![WFHPH9pgZfSNfr7p_4d01ed49-9408-4057-b743-8864ee881f53.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/expelliarmus30/images/WFHPH9pgZfSNfr7p_4d01ed49-9408-4057-b743-8864ee881f53/WFHPH9pgZfSNfr7p_4d01ed49-9408-4057-b743-8864ee881f53.webp)
![yonXExR8WacaIjYe_21f14e0a-27ea-4f12-b33d-d143c3f7d2b8.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/expelliarmus30/images/yonXExR8WacaIjYe_21f14e0a-27ea-4f12-b33d-d143c3f7d2b8/yonXExR8WacaIjYe_21f14e0a-27ea-4f12-b33d-d143c3f7d2b8.webp)
![qB3R73rI5ZHnWIhS_42357092-93b3-4dd6-bdb6-2fa6a7f22c8c.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/expelliarmus30/images/qB3R73rI5ZHnWIhS_42357092-93b3-4dd6-bdb6-2fa6a7f22c8c/qB3R73rI5ZHnWIhS_42357092-93b3-4dd6-bdb6-2fa6a7f22c8c.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

Yes, you read that right from the title. The former student who once simply dreamed in life is now a teacher!

I still remember the bio I used on this account: “A student who’s trying her best.” That bio stayed with me for several years. I created this account back in May 2022, and from the very beginning, that was what I chose to represent myself. Now, after more than three years, I have finally updated it to: “LPT.” Yes, I am now a Licensed Professional Teacher.

Before I continue sharing my journey—from being a student striving hard to becoming a teacher—I would first like to greet all of you. Hello everyone, how have you been? It has been a while since I last visited this platform because I’ve been busy with life. I truly missed writing here and reading your posts. Although I would occasionally visit and read some blogs, I never had enough time to write again.

Now, I finally have the chance. I am currently on a one-month vacation from teaching, starting May 1 until May 31. Even though it is not yet May, I no longer have many tasks at school. I have already submitted all my requirements and completed my clearance, so I decided to return to writing.

To be honest, I’ve had free time since last week, but I got carried away watching different K-dramas online. After spending long hours watching, I started experiencing headaches and eye strain, which made me realize I needed to slow down. That’s why I decided to come back here—to make my time more meaningful.

Anyway, let’s go back to my main story. Yes, I am now a teacher!

I finished my studies and graduated in October 2023. Even before graduating, I was already looking for a job because I wanted to start reviewing for the Board Exam as soon as possible. During that time, it was difficult to find a job related to my course because of the number of competitors. However, I did not give up. Instead of limiting myself, I applied to different companies even if they were not aligned with my field.

I was hired as a staff member in a casual food establishment. While working, I continued pursuing my goal of reviewing for the board exam. I enrolled in a review center near our area and managed both work and review at the same time. That’s how determined I was to achieve my dreams.

It was exhausting—physically, mentally and even financially. I wasn’t just supporting my own needs for review; I was also helping with our household expenses. Despite all the challenges, I never gave up. I knew that everything I was doing was for my dreams, and I believed that one day, all my sacrifices would bear fruit.

Fast forward to May 2024—one of the happiest moments of my life. All my sleepless nights and hard work finally paid off. I passed the board exam! I was deeply grateful to God and to all the people who supported me along the way.

In June 2024, I attended my oath-taking ceremony—another unforgettable milestone, as I was officially recognized as a full-fledged teacher. Then in August 2024, I finally received my license. It was one of the most satisfying moments of my life—to see and hold the result of all my hard work.

However, that wasn’t the end of the journey. I thought that having a license would make it easy to find a job—but I was wrong. The competition was still intense. There were times when I felt discouraged and lost hope, but I never lost my faith in God.

Finally, in June 2025, I was hired by a private school in our province. My heart was filled with joy and gratitude because, at last, my prayers were answered. I had applied to many schools—too many to count—so when I finally received a call and got accepted, I was truly overjoyed.

My first year of teaching has been a happy and meaningful experience. I encountered many “firsts” in this school since it was also my first time teaching. I learned so much—not only from my co-teachers but also from my students.

Although the salary in a private school is not as high as in public schools, I accepted the job wholeheartedly. For now, I am not focused on how big or small my salary is. What matters most is that I am happy with what I am doing.

Of course, my journey doesn’t end here. I still aspire to achieve more, and I know in my heart that I also want to work in a public school someday. That is one of the goals I will continue striving for. I will not stop until I achieve my dreams.

But for now, I am grateful and content. I am thankful to have a job that I love, and I believe that in God’s perfect time, all my dreams will come true.

And that is the story of a student who once dreamed—and is now a teacher.

To the youth and to anyone who may read this:

Never give up on your dreams. They will come to you at the right time. Be patient, work hard, stay diligent, and never lose hope. All your sacrifices will bear fruit in the end.

Thank you very much for reading!

body.title: i240 TP 82, Drawing step by step /Rising Star
body.body: > Welcome back, everyone, to another drawing! I'm happy to be back. First of all, I want to thank you for being here every day to see my drawings; it makes me very happy. This time, I'm going to show you the one I did of the i240 TP 82 card. This is part of the series I'm currently working on, which is dedicated to microphones. As you can see, this is a very pretty purple microphone. I think in the game's universe, it would be ideal for a girl to use for singing; the color lends itself perfectly to that, and it looks lovely. Okay, so let's get down to business, which is why you're here: the drawing. I'm going to show you step by step how I did it. As I always say, it's more fun to see the creative process than to see a static, finished result. That's why I prefer to show all the steps instead of just the final result. To begin, I first drew what would be the inner frame of the card. ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BM1YUX8DAu4GsK8Tzinwq4WsxSCyTyLMTHjcd1F1pwSg5M9iJB6M6eJo94oazJQY.jpg) After finishing the frame, I moved on to the top of the microphone and then its handle in the center. With that, the silhouette sketch was complete. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZTNgCn3yuTnYcoKoydceBM2yqYPNZqqK4MP6bE6x6HtaFGS9F8wjsYG7i7.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo6S6U3zkTDdsw3tSw1RkKKp12oSMFknJy68swtbsZGLsky4rdk7Z32oY6Maq3v9uCP.jpg) After finishing the silhouette and the previous borders, I moved on to working on the inside of the device in the drawing. I drew some internal divisions to make it look nicer and, above all, to give it more detail and prevent it from looking boring. These lines also help to highlight the color. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo8ZVfHUnmBGM4PVd12CTucdnWShN2FduCtBTWZzLHwJvNF6VNAyAsjGXSNSYvBRwvB.jpg) Now I could start painting because the sketch was ready. Today's predominant colors are purple and pink. As you can see, I painted the outer background and the microphone as well. The other areas are mostly blue in various shades. And I painted some areas of the microphone dark green. You'll see in the screenshots the order in which I painted each area. I hope you like it. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoKB3ekek8PL3dKzsADhGB2kBWijPDCAtP2gc1ZmamhHyefuJnQXFuh8tRtAAwXNzoT.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EprU6SB8HizmEDSBEFJGxmC5Y4c7yVC3qTMoz4papcEJzK1AxmUeMSxU1SeL9ugPtEw.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EpxrKZAYXQCbEmUXgCNLDMAmt8EnqdSBnDatc8BzbzkkD7c6CdGtqo6CmUz3SnhMKCo.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EqDjYvFejMk3mCj6r5MzbSddXav41hvZJCvB4QExAUYYsMk8jr7qEDMdhXGkrvTocev.jpg) And to say goodbye for today, I'll show you the final result. See you in the next drawing. Blessings to all. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EpQxig2XL4M87TWweePa26ddWtoypJxJFrcpXVWEtjht1qruFXYo6KnSkGhQknmZzqv.jpg)

body.title: A MOMENT OF REST FOR THE JOURNEY AHEAD
body.body:
Welcome to the last week for April. To God be the glory because we have gradually concluded the fourth month of the year 2026. It feels like we entered the year just yesterday and today we are already in the last week.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdATWhoVUc8kcQ5RQuB2DziWtnoKpJU3jzdvRXfBdLK9V/1777366403230.jpg)
This image belongs to me 

Guys I really had a beautiful moment two weeks ago because I decided to take some days off from work and family. I really needed it because I was beginning to complain about everything happening around me and I was already looking for a way to step aside for a while because of my mental health. I have realized that most times we only think or our physical health and try our best to treat anything we notice that is wrong with us, we hardly think of our mental health. I believe that is important too. Staying healthy mentally helps us to function properly. If something is wrong with anyone mentally, there will be a total shout down in our system because of that.

WHEN WAS THE LAST TIME YOU REFLECTED? OR TOOK TIME TO MEDITATE?

As if I knew about this topic when I was embarking on that journey. Though there was a burial in my village which was meant to be on the 21st  and 22nd of April. So  I saw this as opportunity to take time to rest I traveled home on the 18th. I did not go straight to the place that the burial will take place, I went straight to visit my elder sister and also had enough time to rest. She gave me a room all to myself and I had nothing to worry about unlike my house where I will have to think about what to cook and how to take care of everyone except myself. In this place everything was made available for me and what I lack I had the liberty to ask for it. I don't go to the kitchen unless if I want to. I don't do laundry for anyone, infact someone did my own laundry because I was a visitor there. It was a very good time for me to rest and good enough there was poor network so I was also disconnected online because the me that I know will always be with my phone making my post, replying to other post or charting with people. But all of that didn't happen because my phone was kept aside for a whole week. I only go to a particular spot when I feel like making a post for the day.

HOW OFTEN DO YOU DO THIS?

Unfortunately I don't get the chance to do this more often. Most of the times I have taken to rest are when I travel home for anything serious. I will always go before the set day of I will stay back after the whole occasion. My family responsibilities will not let me have my own space or time our. 

HOW HAS IT HELPED ME?

Right from the day I traveled out I started feeling like I should not even come to the house again 😂of course I know that is not possible. I sincerely appreciate God for helping me go out of the house at the time that I did. I was able to rest, forgot the problem of the house at that moment and now that I am back I feel more strong to continue the journey of life.

body.title: Why Custom Cardboard Boxes Are Perfect for Seasonal Campaigns
body.body:
Seasonal campaigns provide brands with an opportunity to rebrand their image and reach out to the customers in new and interesting ways yearly. It does not matter whether it is Christmas, Easter, Valentine’s Day or summer sales, businesses leave no stone unturned in order to be noticed. One easy yet effective tool in these campaigns? [custom cardboard boxes](https://customboxesonly.com/custom-cardboard-boxes).

Perhaps, you do not think much about packaging but with the right box, it can market much about your brand. Let’s see how custom cardboard boxes can improve the appearance of your seasonal campaign, make it feel special, and benefit your success.

## What Are Custom Cardboard Boxes?

Custom printed cardboard boxes are packaging boxes that are tailored according to the shape of your product and your brand. You can pick among the size, shape, colour, and design. It means no more bog standard brown boxes. Rather, your packaging becomes your message.

## Seasonal Campaigns and the Presentation Skills

In seasons change people purchase things differently. At Christmas, the shopping public are seeking the festive spirit. On the day of Valentine’s, they are yearning for romance and sophistication. Custom packaging comes in handy in achieving that mood. It is like putting your product on fancy clothes for the event.

For example:

*   Winter Campaigns – Think Snowflakes, rich colours like red and green and messages of warmth.

*   Spring Promotions – Apply soft-colours, floral stars and light, clean designs.

*   Back-to-School Offers – Use energetic themes, educational prints or playful icons.

When the package goes with the season, your product is made to feel more pertinent and something special.

## Advantages of Custom Cardboard Box in Seasonal Promotions

### 1. Better Customer Experience

A pretty box opening is a part of a shopping pleasure. A lot of customers claim to become more attached to a brand when the packaging is nice to look at and touch.

### 2. Brand Recognition

Seasonal designs may have your logo, tagline, or social media handles. This ensures that your brand is always at the back of your consumer’s minds, even after the season is over.

### 3. Great for Gifting

In the course of holidays, a lot of gifts are purchased. A tailor-made box does not require buyers spending time and effort in wrapping it – they just need to place the product inside. In addition, it has a refined, considered air.

### 4. Stand Out on the Shelf

In stores or in online listings, attractive packaging has a great impact. A coloured and themed cardboard box can make your product stand out among the rest.

### 5. Eco-Friendly Options

Many businesses are now going for recyclable or biodegradable cardboard. It is a display of your concern for the planet and your customers get to have peace of mind.

## Tips for Designing Seasonal Packaging

If we are speaking of [custom dispenser boxes](https://customboxesonly.com/dispenser-boxes) for your next campaign, here is a couple of basic tips:

*   Keep it Simple: Don’t overload the design. Use one or two colours, a pattern, as well as your logo.

*   Be Consistent: Combine the box design with the marketing materials such as posters, advertisements, and website.

*   Think About the Customer: Think of what mood or feeling your customers anticipate at that particular time of the year.

*   Plan Ahead: [Custom boxes](https://customboxesonly.com/) require time to be designed and printed. Don’t leave it to the last minute!

## Ideas for Different Industries

### Food & Beverage

For party food hampers or limited-edition flavours then, special boxes give a high end appearance. Add a Printed Message, Window Cut Outs, and Inner Compartments.

### Fashion & Accessories

Use soft-touch finishes, pastel colours – spring, or metallic foils – winter elegance.

### Beauty & Skincare

Use minimal designs and seasonal embellishments such as snowflake or blossoms. Reusable boxes are also a good fit for beauty sets.

### E-commerce & Subscription Boxes

As these are provided, custom packaging helps in making a good first impression. Boxes with a theme for every season can keep the customers excited throughout the year.

## Final Thoughts

Seasonal marketing is not just sales; it is emotion, memory, and relationship. Custom cardboard dispenser boxes are a small but significant part of that journey. They make your brand look caring, attentive, and creative. And in this world, where there are so many options, that small extra effort can very much help.

Therefore, when next time you will be planning your seasonal campaign, keep in mind the box it comes in. Perhaps, it will be the most effective part.

[Last week](https://peakd.com/hive-140217/@gabrielatravels/life-is-strange-reunion-intro-mission-walkthrough-gameplay-part-1) I began my journey on here sharing the gameplay videos I recorded while playing **Life is Strange: Reunion**, and oh wow, how many of you enjoyed it! 

I did not expect it to reach so many people, as in fact this community is a pretty active one where you get to see a few tens of people posting daily from various games. But I'll take this moment to thank everyone from the bottom of my heart! I am really excited to see interest in continuing this series!

So with no further introduction, let's jump into the 2nd gameplay of **Life is Strange: Reunion**, which will show off the short amount of a chill life Max got to enjoy.

https://youtu.be/kCYQPdeK0yg?si=7KMKCknXkCJv8pHm

If you've played any of the **Life is Strange** titles before, you'll know that despite having some a story driven game with not a lot of buttons needed to be pressed, but rather clicks here and there and making some decisions during the conversations, there actually is a lot of action and drama happening, with no time to waste.

Hence why, the 2nd gameplay of the series doesn't only come with Max's return but also with a major event taking place that will quickly shape the whole story around it, forcing you to pay attention to small details, look for evidence and possible suspects, and travel back in time as many times as possible to have a smoother turnaround of events.

But as we are still at the beginning with this series, today's video will only show what I'm talking about, while there is a long way forward before I'll be able to present everyone how I managed to play my cards and the ending I got, as there are more possible endings for this game.

body.body:
____________________________________
# <center> Namaste 🇮🇳🙏🏻</center>
____________________________________


Hello Friends, How are you all ?? Wishing you all happy and prosperous life Ahead.


Today i would like to share Chilled & Refreshing **Watermelon Juice**, it is simply made-up with watermelon, it's perfect drink during scorching Summer. The recipe is very quick and easy to make as it is made with basic ingredients easily available in most of the kitchens during Summer. watermelon juice recipe is one such tropical fruit drink which can be made with different ways to hydrate the body. This drink is much better than the artificial sugar added drinks selling in the market, it helps you to keep your body more hydrated and boostup your energy level. 

![1000657920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/Ep1aEXKeK7RLjX29CA41cj6iCELnwYJpJ8CTcQUKxaw7bq3Kv6YiDUG5oAi81eHqCHR.png)


____________________________________
# <center> Timming 🕡</center>
____________________________________

|Preparation Time|5 Minutes|
|-|-|
|Cuisine|Indian|
|Course|Beverage|
|Serving|2 Person|




____________________________________
# <center> Ingredients 📃</center>
____________________________________


• 2 cup watermelon cubes.
• 2 tbsp lemon juice.
• ¼ tsp Black Salt.
• 1 tbsp sugar.
• 1 cup of Spirt Colddrink.



____________________________________
# <center> Process 👨🏻‍🍳</center>
____________________________________

![1000656497.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23tmSNKREeiPTVhSjy3tkCWcs9u8zr4cWGfa9kQgKogTJ3ygPGQEfY4iFFY9ygEaGfA45.jpg)

Take a fresh Watermelon, remove off the all the seeds to avoid the bitterness. Cut into cubes shapes.


![1000656527.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23wgUHTTUcHb53QhtTSoC91hvEBd4kbRaWqLoGZYi57ryCqCnXRqe8NSN5oNHQY6eoXi3.jpg)

Put into the grinder.

![1000656524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23wX3UfWGocddYvD3VFupdZLjMx2wZGRHqqJfuAWbYTmX5gSwMDJ6erihSAD4s7w9Vw8R.jpg)

Add Sugar as per your taste.

![1000656521.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23vi8AVVWUdvmsqJTL5u9x8tG9qqC6yU98FZJfxd2RGoaNEPVRJNmCvR6Dn75Mf3b1xSZ.jpg)

Blend it without adding the water.

![1000656518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23vsNAAuqJ4ZWWtE17Va3nKnCwYs5XziR3syF6hbLXpXoHKuV8MVoFEgafk2V9YrwLE3u.jpg)


pour into a  tall glass, take 2 tbsp crushed ice.

Tip : adding sugar to watermelon juice is completely optional and depends on sweetness of watermelon.


![1000657862.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23wX1R8BVsuZFzQxf2C83gWqjEm2iemzyGVecN1HjwPRqqdHPSe8gZ2sv88QHaoaqBwig.jpg)

Squeeze the Lemon, add black salt and pour sprite and stir before serving.

![1000656500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23xySyXZ6AQhHq3aoviV54XWurnManc3dC8WB92ff25fGnGF14nou3vSJbWvnGhsAenHe.jpg)

Serve the chilled n Fresh Watermelon juice in hot summer season.

![1000656503.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23zbPNrWhyxiYe1ifiV4q38wzv7fmyJVgtGixpeizQzuP5raGvAfbPVemDJ6XbRaKWxLJ.jpg)
____________________________________

title.title: Flip.gg Review 2026: Solana Loot Box Casino Examined
title.body:
https://cryptocrunches.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/photo\_2026-04-28\_14-41-39.jpg

## What Is Flip.gg?

[Flip.gg](https://flip.gg/a/cryptoadventure) is a Solana-based crypto gaming platform launched in 2022 by Flip Games Ltd, offering eight original game modes — including loot boxes, crash, wheel, upgrader, battles, and multiplier variants — with SOL and SPL token deposits, instant wallet withdrawals, and a provably fair system verified on-chain. It targets crypto-native players who want fast, blockchain-first gameplay rather than traditional casino formats.  

## Games Available on Flip.gg

### Loot Boxes

Loot boxes are Flip.gg's core product. Players spend SOL to open containers with randomized prize outputs drawn from transparent probability tiers. Each result is verifiable using the platform's client-server seed system, confirmed against Solana's on-chain transaction record. This is the most-played mode on the platform and the centerpiece of Flip.gg's product identity.

### Upgrader

The upgrader lets players stake SOL-valued assets at a stated probability in exchange for a chance to move up to a higher-value position. Odds are published per session. Variance is high. It is a mode for players comfortable with sharp, defined-probability bets rather than grinding incremental returns.

### Crash, Wheel, and Battles

Crash runs a rising multiplier that players exit before a random endpoint. Wheel spins assign outcomes across probability-weighted segments. Loot box battles allow head-to-head competition where players open boxes simultaneously, with the higher combined value taking the pool. All three modes use provably fair mechanics with publicly documented seed methodology.

## Deposits, Withdrawals, and Supported Tokens

### Crypto-Only Infrastructure

Flip.gg accepts no fiat. Deposits and withdrawals move directly between the player's Web3 wallet and the platform — no credit cards, no bank transfers, no PayPal. Supported wallets include Phantom and Solflare, the two dominant Solana wallet clients. Transactions confirm in under two seconds under normal Solana network conditions, reflecting the chain's average 400-millisecond finality.

### Supported Assets

Primary deposit currency is SOL. The platform also supports several SPL tokens, including BONK and JUP, giving holders of Solana ecosystem assets direct access without prior token conversion. Fiat-to-crypto on-ramps are not integrated — players must arrive with Solana-compatible assets already in their wallet.

## Bonuses and Promotions

### Welcome and Promo Codes

New players can access bonus balances through promo codes distributed across Flip.gg's community channels and partner platforms. These codes credit account balance applicable to game modes. Standard wagering requirements apply — bonus-originated funds are subject to platform rollover terms before withdrawal eligibility activates.

### Rain Events and Monthly Bonus

[Flip.gg](https://flip.gg/a/cryptoadventure) runs community \

drops through its Discord server, distributing small SOL amounts to active participants. A monthly bonus program grants additional credits to accounts verified through Discord membership. These are supplementary engagement mechanics rather than primary bonus structures. All promotional offers are subject to standard terms.

## Licensing and Transparency

Flip.gg does not currently publish a gambling license or regulatory registration. The platform operates as Flip Games Ltd without documented oversight from a government-issued iGaming authority as of April 2026. The March 2026 LCCP ownership threshold updates in the UK do not apply directly, but they signal the direction of travel across major jurisdictions — transparency requirements are tightening globally. EU-based players should note that DAC8 tax reporting obligations apply to their own individual crypto gaming gains regardless of platform licensing status.

## Who Flip.gg Is Built For

Flip.gg is purpose-built for Solana-wallet users who want on-chain, high-volatility gameplay without traditional casino infrastructure. Players who need licensed operator oversight, fiat payment rails, or conventional games like slots and blackjack will find the platform outside their requirements. title.title: First Impressions Are the Most Faithless Things
title.body:
<div class=text-




![IMG_5140.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/EoK6p9Cev3moCgs73Z6nKcSCzkvPZunZiHiQ2h8oTfNMCV9p9bS9oyZbMrZSH2ogtJK.jpeg)

I have come to regard first impressions as rather deceitful companions, charming at a glance, yet seldom trustworthy upon closer acquaintance. All my first impressions of people come cloaked in certainty, as I draw conclusions before truth has had the decency to even introduce itself.

I remember once meeting someone I was certain I would never like. I felt there was an air of being too composed and deliberate about her. She measured her words before releasing them, as if conversations were supposed to be some calculated stage performance rather than a spontaneous exchange. I found it an irksome, rather pretentious, fake life, even. So, within moments, I had made my judgment and filed her away in my invisible cabinet. How confident I was in my fleeting perception.

Anyway, time ever patient, ever revealing, has a way of undoing such assumptions as days went by, we had small reluctant talks which ended up shifting my perspective. The composure I had mistaken for pretence revealed itself as carefulness. She was not eager to impress at all, but had been unwilling to be careless with words.

And just like that, my first so assured impression began to crumble. Then it occurred to me, rather uncomfortably, that first impressions are not truths. They are merely guesses dressed in conviction where we see a fraction and declare the whole.

There is, I think, a peculiar arrogance in believing we can understand a person within seconds of their presence. That’s like saying humans are simple creatures, easily deciphered, and their complexities laid bare at first glance but, people are not portraits. They are novels and no sensible reader would claim to know a story after a single page.

Still, we persist, in judging the quiet as aloof and the reserved as unfriendly. We literally assign meaning where there may be none, and certainty where there should be curiosity. Now the greatest tragedy of all is not that we are wrong but that we rarely give ourselves the chance to be corrected.

First impressions, I have learned, are not meant to be trusted but should rather be questioned. Because somewhere beneath that hurried judgment could lie a far better story waiting to be understood.

My response to the Freewriters [daily prompt](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/27-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3086-first-impression)

title.body:
##### Hello everyone to my photoblog!

The picturesque town of Tihany is situated on the hills of the same name on Lake Balaton. In the photos below, I focused mainly on the view of these hills. Given its location, it would probably be best to arrive here with your camera at sunrise. The morning sun would then illuminate the hills, perhaps with some morning mist. Sunset would be behind the hill.

> <sub>**[ PL ]**</sub>
> ###### **Witam wszystkich na moim fotoblogu!**
> Malowniczo położona na wzgórzach miejscowość Tihany na półwyspie o tej samej nazwie nad jeziorem Balaton. Na poniższych zdjęciach skupiłem się głównie na widoku tych wzgórz. Ze względu na położenie, prawdopodobnie najlepiej z aparatem byłoby zjawić się tutaj o wschodzie słońca. Wtedy poranne promienie słońca oświetlałyby wzgórza, może pojawiła by się jakaś poranna mgiełka. Zachód słońca bedzie za wzgórzem.

I take the menu and order the dishes; there are so many delicious foods that I want to try, but my budget is sakto lang parang ganon HAHA. ![IMG_20260409_224524_901.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/laizelly05/23wMWRUxxNXGhD59ru6Kb7NiewyyXbza8qrs5A2MeSnJ74VKmX6uMHo1YRiSuxQhFbLdZ.jpg) I want to try their noodles, because I have a cough and cold and my throat is not feeling well. Wow, the smells are good, and again, I take a photo before I eat. I grab the spoon and pork and take a sip of the soup. Yummy, the aroma is fragrant. I enjoy eating and I'm very satisfied. The atmosphere is unique. While I'm eating, the sound of the song is beautiful. I feel sad for the song because I'm alone; nobody is near me if I need a companion. I miss my friends. title.title: How to find out what WordPress Theme a web site uses. Try WP Detector. Which CMS does hive.io use?
title.body:
Habt ihr schon mal eine coole Website gesehen und wolltet wissen, welches Theme die Website verwendet?

Manchmal reicht ein kurzer Blick in den Source-Code um das herauszufinden.

Alternativ gibt es Online-Tools wie ScanWP und WP Detector, um das automatisiert herauszufinden.

Aber leider funktioniert das nicht mit allen Websites. Nicht alle Seiten verwenden WordPress, der Anteil der WordPress-Seiten wird auf 42% geschätzt, und viele Seiten haben eigene Themes oder verschleiern mit Security-Plugins, welche Themes und Plugins sie benutzen.

Alternative wäre den Source-Code der Website inkl. CSS etc. in eine Coding KI zu laden (Claude Code oder Codex) und die KI zu fragen, welches Theme die Seite benutzt, oder das Theme mit einer KI klonen zu lassen.

In Zukunft wird man mit KIs wie Claude Design immer weniger kostenpflichtige Themes benötigen, da man mit Hilfe von KIs eigene Websites und Themes erstellen kann.

Habt ihr Tools wie WP Detector schon benutzt? Welches CMS verwendet hive.io?

https://wpdetector.com/

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vikisecrets/23zmC4P1tdCQ51ex6M39L56bc31Z3h7nyj4FKKs9jPqa7qrVCABVTtMHuB1j9YasGsfPZ.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vikisecrets/23wgjRG7t5X3iCrbQGM4LLQ1zYWMG8qoCoVuNDfwkYujxtohQN88ugZXw25wHStSx3Che.png)

## English

Have you ever seen a cool website and wanted to know which theme it uses?

Sometimes a quick look at the source code is all it takes to find out.

Alternatively, there are online tools like ScanWP and WP Detector to figure this out automatically.

But unfortunately, this doesn’t work with all websites. Not all sites use WordPress—the share of WordPress sites is estimated at 42%— additionally, many sites use their own custom themes or use security plugins to hide which themes and plugins they’re using.

An alternative would be to upload the website’s source code, including CSS, etc., into a coding AI (such as Claude Code or Codex) and ask the AI which theme the site uses, or have the AI clone the theme.

In the future, with AI tools like Claude Design, there will be less and less need for paid themes, as you’ll be able to create your own websites and themes with the help of AI.

title.title: Making my Favorite Pansit!
title.body:
I really believe with what they say that you are what you eat, because right now, my problem is how could I stop gaining weight if there are tempting viands in front of me and I am the one who cooked? Today guys, I’m gonna share the recipe of this home made Pansit. It’s my family’s favorite.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXkRiQsvhXszQj2tp4kbqCpfCsXxbsJquzr8wWky2yoEm/img_0518.jpg)

**My Own Version of Pansit**

Ingredients:

🍜Fresh Miki or pansit (fresh noodles)
🥓Pork belly
👨‍🍳Red bell pepper
👨‍🍳Ground pepper
👩‍🍳Cabbage
🧅Onion
👨‍🍳Soy sauce
👨‍🍳Salt
👨‍🍳Magic sarap for seasoning
🧄Garlic
👨‍🍳Water
🫛Baguio beans 


**The process:**
1. Heat the wok for five minutes. If there’s a tiny water, allow it to dry by the heat.
2. Put in the pork belly. In this way, the meat fats will come out. Wait for the meat to be browned. Minimize the amount of the oil in the wok. Just leave a tiny oil. Set aside the meat. 
2. Put in the garlic, red bellpepper and onion until cooked.
3. Add meat and baguio beans. Stir.
4. Add the ground pepper.
5. Pour down a little amount of soy sauce.
6. Add salt and Magic sarap to taste. 
7. Add the slices of cabbage.
8. Pour down the pansit and stir.
9. Add a little water if you like it to be soupy. My kids like it if dried. 
10. Serve.


The meat has less oil as I absorbed it on the pan by heating them first until the fats come out. It’s better to be health conscious because like I said, “you are what you eat.” We become sick because we eat everything that our tongue has craved and those foods are truly unhealthy. So it is my idea. The meat is even crunchier but not hard. It is still tender. The idea of adding it more water is optional too and the effect is also tasty like “***Lomi.*** You can both eat it with rice or with loaf bread during snacks. I prefer it with bread and the combination of both is heavenly for me. Try it!

import torch.nn as nn

class LSTMCellManual(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_d, hid_d):
        super().__init__()
        self.gates = nn.Linear(in_d + hid_d, 4 * hid_d)
        self.hid_d = hid_d

    def forward(self, x_t, h_prev, c_prev):
        combined = torch.cat([x_t, h_prev], dim=-1)
        gates = self.gates(combined)

        g = torch.tanh(g)
        o = torch.sigmoid(o)

        h = o * torch.tanh(c)
        return h, c

## The encoder-decoder architecture

The **sequence-to-sequence** (seq2seq) model, introduced by Sutskever, Vinyals, and Le at Google in 2014, does exactly this by chaining two RNNs together: an **encoder** that reads the input and a **decoder** that produces the output.

The encoder is an RNN (typically an LSTM, as we built in episode #49) that processes the input sequence one token at a time, building up a hidden state that progressivly accumulates information about the entire input. When it reaches the end of the input, its final hidden state is a fixed-size vector that (in theory) captures everything the model needs to know about the input. This vector is called the **context vector**.

The decoder is a separate RNN that takes the context vector as its initial hidden state and generates the output sequence, one token at a time. At each step, it produces a probability distribution over the output vocabulary, picks the most likely token (or samples from the distribution), and feeds that token back as input for the next step. A special **end-of-sequence** token (EOS) tells the decoder when to stop.

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class Encoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_sz, emb_d, hid_d, n_layers=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.embed = nn.Embedding(vocab_sz, emb_d)
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(emb_d, hid_d, n_layers, batch_first=True)

    def forward(self, src):
        outputs, (h, c) = self.lstm(self.embed(src))
        return h, c  # context vector

class Decoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_sz, emb_d, hid_d, n_layers=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.embed = nn.Embedding(vocab_sz, emb_d)
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(emb_d, hid_d, n_layers, batch_first=True)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(hid_d, vocab_sz)

    def forward(self, token, h, c):
        out, (h, c) = self.lstm(self.embed(token), (h, c))
        return self.fc(out), h, c

This separation is powerful because the input and output can have entirely different vocabularies (English vs Dutch), different lengths, and different structures. The context vector is the only bridge between them -- a learned compression of the input that the decoder unpacks into the output.

## The bottleneck problem

Here's the fundamental flaw: the context vector is a single fixed-size vector, regardless of whether the input is 5 words or 500 words. A 256-dimensional hidden state must compress \

into the same number of floats as it compresses an entire Wikipedia article.

For short sequences (under 20-30 tokens), this works reasonably well. The LSTM's cell state is expressive enough to retain the important bits. But as sequences get longer, the compression becomes lossy. Information from the beginning of the input gets progressively overwritten by information from later timesteps -- the same issue we discussed with vanilla RNNs in episode #48, now manifesting as an information bottleneck rather than a gradient problem.

## Teacher forcing

Training a seq2seq model involves a subtle chicken-and-egg problem. The decoder generates tokens one at a time, and each generated token becomes the input for the next step. But during early training, the model's predictions are essentially random. If the first generated word is wrong, every subsequent word is conditioned on that wrong input, and the entire output goes off the rails. The model can't learn from complete garbage.

**Teacher forcing** solves this by feeding the *correct* previous token (from the ground truth target) as input to the decoder at each step, rather than the model's own prediction. During training, the decoder for \
as input at step 2 (regardless of what it predicted at step 1), \

at step 3, and so on. This gives the model clean inputs to learn from, even when its predictions are still unreliable.

The downside is **exposure bias**: during training, the model always sees correct previous tokens, but during inference, it sees its own predictions -- which contain errors. The model has never learned to recover from its own mistakes. If it generates \

but then makes an error at step 3, it has no experience operating under that condition because it never encountered errors during training.

**Scheduled sampling** gradually transitions from teacher forcing to model predictions during training -- start with 100% teacher forcing, and over the course of training, randomly replace some ground-truth inputs with the model's own predictions. By the end of training, the model has seen some of its own errors and learned to cope. **Curriculum learning** starts with short, easy sequences and gradually increases difficulty. Neither fully solves the problem, but both help.

In practice, most implementations use teacher forcing throughout training (it's simpler and faster) and accept the exposure bias. The gap between training and inference performance is real but managable for most applications, especially once attention is added.

## Beam search

At inference time, the decoder generates one token per step and feeds it back as input. The simplest approach -- **greedy decoding** -- picks the highest-probability token at each step. But greedy decoding can miss better sequences. If \
is the most likely first word but \
leads to a much better overall translation, greedy decoding is stuck with \

forever.

**Beam search** maintains k candidates (called the **beam width**) at each step in stead of one. At step 1, keep the top k tokens. At step 2, expand each of those k candidates by all possible next tokens, score all k x V combinations (where V is vocabulary size), and keep only the top k. Continue until all beams produce an EOS token or hit a maximum length.

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def beam_search(decoder, embed, proj, h, c, start_tok, eos_tok,
                beam_width=5, max_len=20):
    \

# Each beam: (log_prob, token_sequence, hidden, cell)
    beams = [(0.0, [start_tok], h, c)]
    completed = []

    for step in range(max_len):
        candidates = []
        for log_prob, seq, h_b, c_b in beams:
            if seq[-1] == eos_tok:
                completed.append((log_prob, seq))
                continue
            inp = embed(torch.tensor([[seq[-1]]]))
            out, (h_new, c_new) = decoder(inp, (h_b, c_b))
            log_probs = F.log_softmax(proj(out[0, -1]), dim=0)

            topk_lp, topk_idx = log_probs.topk(beam_width)
            for lp, idx in zip(topk_lp.tolist(), topk_idx.tolist()):
                candidates.append((log_prob + lp, seq + [idx],
                                   h_new.clone(), c_new.clone()))

        # Keep top beam_width candidates
        candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
        beams = candidates[:beam_width]

        if len(beams) == 0:
            break

    # Add any remaining beams to completed
    completed.extend([(lp, seq) for lp, seq, _, _ in beams])
    completed.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
    return completed

With beam width k=1, beam search reduces to greedy decoding. With k=5 (a common choice), you explore 5 parallel hypotheses at each step. The computational cost scales linearly with k, and in practice k=5-10 gives most of the benefit -- increasing beyond that rarely helps.

One interesting side effect: beam search tends to produce shorter outputs than expected, because shorter sequences accumulate fewer negative log-probability terms. A common fix is **length normalization** -- dividing the total log-probability by the sequence length (raised to some power between 0 and 1) to avoid this bias towards short outputs.

## Putting it together: the complete seq2seq training loop

Here's how encoder and decoder connect in a full training loop. The encoder processes the source sequence and hands its final states to the decoder. The decoder generates one token per step, using scheduled sampling to gradually transition from teacher forcing to its own predictions:

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import TensorDataset, DataLoader

class Seq2Seq(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, enc_vocab, dec_vocab, emb_d=64, hid_d=128):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder = Encoder(enc_vocab, emb_d, hid_d)
        self.decoder = Decoder(dec_vocab, emb_d, hid_d)
        self.dec_vocab = dec_vocab

    def forward(self, src, tgt, tf_ratio=0.5):
        h, c = self.encoder(src)
        inp = tgt[:, :1]  # start token
        outputs = []
        for t in range(1, tgt.size(1)):
            out, h, c = self.decoder(inp, h, c)
            outputs.append(out)
            use_tf = torch.rand(1).item() < tf_ratio
            inp = tgt[:, t:t+1] if use_tf else out.argmax(-1)
        return torch.cat(outputs, dim=1)

The `tf_ratio` parameter controls the teacher forcing rate. We start at 1.0 (always teacher force) and decrease to 0.2 over training -- this is the scheduled sampling strategy. At test time we set it to 0.0 (pure free running, no teacher forcing). The sequence reversal task is a good diagnostic: it requires the model to memorize the entire input before generating output in reverse order. If the model can reverse length-10 sequences, the encoder-decoder information flow is working.

Notice we report both **token accuracy** (what fraction of individual output tokens are correct) and **sequence accuracy** (what fraction of complete output sequences are entirely correct). Sequence accuracy is much harder -- getting 9 out of 10 tokens right scores 0% on sequence accuracy. This gap matters in production: a translation that gets one word wrong might still be understandable, but an API call with one wrong character is completely broken.

## Applications that changed the field

The seq2seq framework turned out to be remarkably general. Once you frame a problem as \

Google's **Neural Machine Translation** system (GNMT, 2016) used an 8-layer encoder, 8-layer decoder with attention and residual connections. It replaced the phrase-based statistical system that Google Translate had used for a decade, and the quality jump was so dramatic that users noticed immediately -- prompting the famous New York Times article about Google Translate's \

**Text summarization** treats a long document as the input sequence and a short summary as the output. The model learns to compress -- retaining key facts while discarding details. **Abstractive** summarization (generating new words, not just extracting sentences) became possible with seq2seq.

**Conversational models** treat the conversation history as the input and the response as the output. Google's \

(2015) showed that a seq2seq model trained on movie subtitles could produce surprisingly coherent (if sometimes bizarre) dialogue without any hand-coded rules. This was a direct ancestor of modern chatbots, though the transformer architecture later replaced LSTMs as the backbone.

**Code generation** treats a natural language description as input and code as output. **Speech recognition** uses audio features as the input sequence and text as the output. **Image captioning** uses a CNN as the encoder (replacing the RNN encoder with a visual feature extractor, like the pretrained ResNet features we built in episode #47) and an RNN decoder to generate captions word by word.

The power of the framework lies in its generality: any problem that can be cast as \

fits the encoder-decoder paradigm. The specific choice of encoder and decoder can vary -- you can mix CNNs, RNNs, and (later) transformers freely.

## Multi-layer encoders and decoders

In practice, production seq2seq models stack multiple LSTM layers (as we covered in episode #49). Each layer captures increasingly abstract representations, and the final layer's hidden state is the context vector. The decoder mirrors the encoder's depth:

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class DeepEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_sz, emb_d, hid_d, n_layers=2, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.embed = nn.Embedding(vocab_sz, emb_d)
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(emb_d, hid_d, n_layers,
                            batch_first=True, dropout=dropout)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, src):
        emb = self.drop(self.embed(src))
        outputs, (h, c) = self.lstm(emb)
        return outputs, h, c

class DeepDecoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_sz, emb_d, hid_d, n_layers=2, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.embed = nn.Embedding(vocab_sz, emb_d)
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(emb_d, hid_d, n_layers,
                            batch_first=True, dropout=dropout)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(hid_d, vocab_sz)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, token, h, c):
        emb = self.drop(self.embed(token))
        out, (h, c) = self.lstm(emb, (h, c))
        return self.fc(self.drop(out)), h, c

# 2-layer encoder-decoder

dec = DeepDecoder(vocab_sz=4000, emb_d=128, hid_d=256, n_layers=2)

Notice that the encoder outputs have shape `(batch, seq_len, hidden_dim)` -- one hidden state per input timestep. The attention mechanism will learn to selectively focus on these intermediate states rather than relying solely on the compressed final state.

The dropout pattern is the same as our sentiment LSTM from episode #49: dropout on embeddings, dropout between LSTM layers (via the `dropout` argument), and dropout before the output projection. This combination is the standard regularization recipe for recurrent sequence models.

## The attention preview

Having said that, the bottleneck problem is real, and it limits seq2seq to relatively short sequences. But what if, in stead of compressing the entire input into a single context vector, the decoder could *look back* at the encoder's hidden states at every timestep? At each decoding step, it could decide which parts of the input are most relevant to the current output token and focus on those.

That's the **attention mechanism**, and it changed everything. In stead of one context vector, the decoder gets a *different* context vector at each step -- a weighted combination of all encoder hidden states, where the weights are learned based on what the decoder is currently trying to produce. Translating the verb? Pay attention to the input verb. Translating the subject? Look back at the input subject.

title.title: This Tiny Homie Ghibli Vibe Cafe In The Corner Just Made My Day
title.body: >Hi all coffee lovers, hope you're all having a great day and have already had your coffee. Back again, I would like to share a cafe from my hometown Yogyakarta Indonesia, which captured my attention. The name of the cafe is Kopi Kolondjono or Kolondjono Coffee in English. The name Kolondjono, according to my own research, refers to a type of grass commonly found in the tropical region of Africa and America which is popularly used as cattle feed.

>Located right in the street corner of quiet neighborhood, the place is relatively small compared to most cafes which I have visited. However, despite its small size, I can feel from its outside look that it must be quite cozy inside. Brick walls, large window, warm light, and a rack of books which seems to be a mini library, increases my curiosity to go inside. As I entered, I found that the cafe is actually attached to a house. Yes, it's actually a normal house that somehow, the owner modified it and turned some part of the house into a cafe.

\n\n

/>The main terrace used as outdoor seat and the entrance is the small door which surely used to be a small access to the garden. On the sign, it's written Yoga which means the place also held Yoga session at particular days. I entered the cafe and I quickly felt the \
ambience, surely it is supported by the fact that the cafe is actually a house turned into a cafe but more than that, the decoration is just awesome.\n\n

>I went inside and quickly felt the old homie ambience like my grandma house. Old sofa and chair located near the entrance door gave you a vibe of a family room. What made me more fascinated was the Ghibli toys and artworks (mostly Totoro and Spirited Away) decorated in some parts of the room which created such a Ghibli vibe and Ghibli cartoons are among of my childhood favorite.

\n\n

>I ordered their hot cappuccino, if you wish to drink other than coffee, they also had non-coffee menu such as : chocolate and matcha. The menu price in here is considered to be middle but still affordable. Apart from drinks, they also served food started from light munchies like potato wedges, chicken nugget until heavy meals like spaghetti and chicken steak. The place also has a rack full of books of novel, literature and life philosophy for those who loves reading. If you are coming in group and want to do some fun, the place also has a quartets card game with the theme of Indonesian culture for you to play on. What a fun way to learn about culture with your friends !

\n\n

>The cappuccino I had tasted so nice with a strong bold taste of coffee. Wondering how the other menu would tasted like including the non coffee. Perhaps, on my next visit I will try them. I did some work in the cafe and felt so comfortable as it was quiet, homie and the \
atmosphere of the cafe were such a great feature to improve my mood for work. Moreover, the Ghibli characters which \
around some parts of the cafe become the fun and childhood memories vibe in the place. Definitely a perfect place for you who wants to do some work or study in a quiet, homie and intimate.

>I will surely pay a visit to this place again to try their other menu and perhaps I will come during the day time on my next visit to feel a different ambience. I imagine this place would feel perfectly cozy and chill during the afternoon time and it is raining outside. But, one thing to note is this cafe only start opening on the afternoon, so its not a place for you to have a morning coffee.

>Well...that's my short story from this small cafe that despite of its small size, it has many pleasant stuff to offer. If you are Ghibli lover in Yogyakarta or planning to go to and looking for a place to chill, study or work in a quiet, homie and chill ambience, I do strognly recommend to visit this one. Hope you all having a great day and don't forget to drink your coffee today 😉

>Kopi Kolondjono

Gg. Narodo No.37, Gandok, Condongcatur, Kec. Depok, Kabupaten Sleman, Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta, Indonesia Opening hours : 02.30 - 10.00 pm
