title.title: Hatchlings - sand sculpture
title.body: /> It is always nice to go back to the Stendhal Music Festival. Even though it is on the same island it feels a bit exotic because I am going to a different country. The North of Ireland is part of Britain, a remnant left over from colonial times. Of course, There have been differences over the years, with sectarian violence leading to many killings in a war we romantically called The Troubles. I remember visiting back in those days and thinking it was quite surreal to have the British army pointing guns at me as they patrolled the city streets of Belfast. It was like we had our very own warzone tourist attraction just an hour up the road. Happily, those days are over now, peace has broken out, as they realised that violence only begot violence and an eye for an eye left many people blind. Better to let diplomacy and economics figure things out and interestingly, they have. It will take a few generations to breed out the last of the war mongers but for now the people are just getting on with their lives and there is even a growing feeling that there will be unification with the Republic. ### The Religious divide Religion was used as a dividing line: the Protestants versus the Catholics. Fighting over which team was better. A very sad state of affairs. But underlying it all was the apartheid state of the Catholics being treated as second-class citizens. I was raised as a catholic in the Republic of Ireland and never really got the concept of killing someone because they followed a different religion. Interestingly, I am the son of a refugee, as my father's family was burned out of the north when he was a child. The Stendhal festival is in a predominantly Protestant area and I, as some sort of interloper, go right into the den of the hethtans. I was surprised to find that the people are lovely and don't ask to see my passport or ask if I like the Monarch. The facilitators are the usual Carny people you find around festivals. All with their jobs to do but wanting to party as well. They joked with me that the only reason they have me there is because they get a grant from the government for outreach to downtrodden Catholics. It's so nice to be a DEI hire.

/> ### All God's children It's a lovely family-friendly festival and I get stuck in preparing my little stall. I am there to make a sculpture, but I have made it into a chill-out area and some would be forgiven for thinking a creche. I have kids around me all weekend with parents watching from a safe distance at the bar. I set up a place for the childers to play and even give workshops. It's all about fun and I find the children very respectful and excited that they get to do their own little performance at the festival.

/> ### Holy smoke In the evening, I stayed in Shane's house. He is the main organiser of the festival and one of the nicest people you could meet. We have a lot in common, philosophically speaking. At this point of the festival, he has done all his work and can be more relaxed as he watches what he created play out. I am usually too tired after my day of performing to party at the festival and so the two of us just chill out, have a joint and talk till the wee small hours. When the sun comes up, I usually grab a few hours' sleep, ready for more child minding.

/> This year, I just carved these Dinosaurs hatching from eggs. Time flies with all the public interactions, so my sculpture is usually simple enough. Nothing much to say about it, really. Just something I threw together between workshops and having fun with my audience. [//]:# (!worldmappin 55.026382 lat -6.894820 long d3scr)

ခေါင်းရိတ်ပြီး ရေချိုးပေးကာ ထမင်းခူးကျွေးသည်။
အမေနဲ့ ကျွန်တော်တို့ ဝိုင်းဖွဲ့ပြီးစားကြသည်။
အမေက စိန်တလုံး သရက်သီးဖြင့် ထမင်းစား
သည်။ အမေက ဆီးချိုရှိပေသိ စိန်တလုံးသရက်သီးကို
အသည်းစွဲသူဖြစ်ပေသည်။

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd331hEybdo7FxQaVAsSwoqPgguNaAkQkaPVQqkjtBg8J/1777364576643.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXZPDWBQ4DpLuS2G9QPYrmvV9aTadjof8Ro8ohusW5tXG/1777364642982.jpg)

အမေက ထမင်းစားနေရင်း သူပန်ကန်ထဲမှ ထမင်းနဲ့
သရက်သီးများကို ကြက်မသားအမိကို ချကျွေး
သည်။ ကြက်သားအမိကလည်း သူရို့ကို ကျွေးနေ
ကျဖြစ်သမို့ ကျွန်တော်တို့ ထမင်းစားသည့်အခါ
ဇွန်းသံ၊ ပန်ကန်သံကြားပါက ရောက်ရာ အရပ်မှ
ပေါက်ချလာတတ်သည်။ ကြက်ပေါက်စလေးက
အတောင်အလက်အတော်စုံနေပေသည်။ မိခင်
ကြက်မကြီး ပြုလုပ်သကဲ့သို့ လိုက်လံအတုခိုး
ပြုလုပ်သည်။ အမေနဲ့ ကြက်မသားအမိက
တဖွဲ့၊ ကျွန်တော်တို့ကတဖွဲ့ ထမင်းစားနေကြသည်မှာ

title.title: ArcadeColony Gaming Side || A Promising Project That Ended Too Soon || Waiting For a Strong Comeback
title.body:
![ChatGPT Image Apr 28, 2026, 10_35_06 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23yJGPGtRGJwcAdAwyNfTRot6fBWEeTfLmMM6jWw9DoA14pPo5SXxS1X9Ncp1Wh4YThYo.png)

![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)


Arcade Colony had a great gaming project that started in the Hive ecosystem. It ran for some time, introduced some good games, gathered good users and many users were highly interested in its games. 

We thought that by investing in these games we could play them for fun while also having a source of earning. Like me many other users also invested in some Arcade Colony project tokens such as Colony, Script and many NFT cards inside the games. 

Speaking about myself I used to spend more time in StakeHouse and there I bought Colony and Script tokens. I also bought ladyluck pack cards. Besides that I had investments in Moon Cards and in GLS I was planning to buy some NFT cards to start my own gaming career.

But unfortunately the games of the Arcade Colony project were shut down for some reason and all of our investments were practically lost. I think the team members should have informed users that if they wanted to withdraw their investments they could do so before the game was properly shut down. 

However I never received any such message and meanwhile the games were closed.

![Screenshot 2026-04-28 102535.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tGTqnEWAgb5fJcXx4A9apUe5rtgr5DjCTXgk7z1dz444g2VW1s41ka4P1BmLkJERdSD.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

I am not really worried about my investment but I miss the games a lot because they were a great source of entertainment and time passing for me. I used to enjoy playing them especially in StakeHouseDen where I played the roulette game with a good strategy and earned decent rewards. 

Also the Soccer Simulator in GLS was a very interesting game. It was not only fun but also play2earn meaning it had become a very good source of earning for everone of us.

Unfortunately these games are closed. My main point is that such projects should not be shut down so easily. The team should work harder on them so they can become more successful. And if there are difficulties they should definitely inform their investors so they can withdraw their investments and avoid losses.

Anyway now my main focus is on #Splinterlands. Very soon I am planning to buy some good NFT cards and some monster cards to add to my deck that will help me in battles.

![Screenshot 2026-04-28 102042.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tHTDfPJ9RbQJhM55pY68zsrYwexmt5GsSXo6j8CRwsk6KMKaksm7S4CBBU12iuSn1Fq.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

The good thing is that Arcade Colony tokens like #Colony and #Script are still present in the #Hive-Engine market and people are still trading these tokens. Although the volume is low still it is good that these tokens are still surviving. I have also seen them in liquidity pools available with different pairs.

In the end my wish and request to the team is that they should work on this project and restore #ArcadeColony games as soon as possible because they were fun2play as well as play2earn. 

![Screenshot 2026-04-28 102100.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tcEU8RsK6nz5brcrAbSRuDv7BHyrQapfmZBNhwz6Xp9TGcvoABtdRBudmLhCEYkrPfC.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

Therefore this is not only my request but also the request of all Hive users that these games should be worked on and brought back. We all are waiting...

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

## DRIP DAY 

Saturdays are Drip Day. That means it is/was drip day. Now if you are not a regular reader of mine you are wondering what is drip day.

I run a income token and tipping bot all in one. The token is BBH. Every Saturday I payout the people holding BBH tokens. Passive income if you like. I like to call it a 'drip' of a token(s) to the people that own BBH tokens. And unlike some all you have to do is own it. No staking, no nothing.

If you own 10 or more BBH tokens you got a drip of swap.hive.
If you own 1,000 or more BBH tokens you get a drip of swap.hive and TOOFUCKEH.

title.title: [EN/ES] Courtney 🎸🌟 RISING STAR GAME 🎸🌟 ART
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRFkHnGTuY4eiibpHqXdKn5jFdyeaPUeNHtHJK2mNVbLQ/292_sin_t_tulo.jpg) Hello, I saw this Rising Star Game card named Courtney and I really liked it, not only because of its statistics (it's a legendary-rarity card) but also because of its beautiful design and the girl with the guitar. I liked it so much that I wanted to make a fan art of her in my style, and I drew her as a small chibi. I really liked the result and I want to share it with you all. > Hola, vi esta carta de Rising Star Game llamada Courtney y la verdad me gustó mucho, no solo por sus estadísticas, que es una carta de clasificación legendaria, sino por su bello diseño y la chica con la guitarra. Me gustó tanto que quise realizar un fan art de ella a mi estilo y la dibujé en forma de un pequeño chibi. El resultado me gustó mucho y lo quiero compartir con ustedes. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNnPN1EYSmRREiesRHY5xKS67krkveSMad2skBfVtrdKf/captura_de_pantalla_2026_04_23_115134.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfNdSsNHLr8cVp7EVZhA5EpRBESjgXsjtjwBVz1cWzGLX/292_sin_t_tulo_20260425175635.jpg) I began my drawing with a sketch, trying to lay down all the foundations and include as many details as I could. I'm not very used to this type of drawing, but I'll do my best. > Comencé mi dibujo por un boceto tratando de sentar todas las bases en el sketch y dejar todos los detalles que pudiera realizados. No estoy muy acostumbrado a este tipo de dibujo, pero haré mi mejor esfuerzo. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWvwQMoioB9WgFm9fb126pSHhuSjKecza6fiz1FLUPLUX/292_sin_t_tulo_20260425182956.jpg) While I was perfecting my sketch, I began the line art. I'm starting with the details of the face and hair since I think that will be what identifies the character and my drawing the most. Little by little, I was perfecting and profiling each detail. > A la par que iba perfeccionando mi boceto, comencé con el line art. Estoy comenzando por los detalles del rostro y el cabello, ya que creo que será lo que más identifique al personaje y a mi dibujo. Poco a poco fui perfeccionando y perfilando cada detalle. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWSukqBiDNVZmWz3yuiD2eYkqGv8hTfAWVjx6grnpk6dq/292_sin_t_tulo_20260426220525.jpg) Drawing the legs took some effort, but after several attempts and corrections in the sketch, and refinement in the line art layer, I achieved just what I wanted. > Dibujar las piernas me costó algo de esfuerzo, pero después de varios intentos y correcciones en el boceto, y perfeccionamiento en la capa del line art, logré justo lo que quería. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma1YyD5yhHsfBMZP4HdLG6h8PGHVmRgvwHweaU75eN8vc/292_sin_t_tulo_20260426220555.jpg) This is how my entire line art turned out, ready to start coloring and adding details. I will be using the colors from the reference card in my drawing: blonde hair and a nearly black, very shiny guitar. > Así quedó todo mi line art, listo para comenzar a colorear y dar detalles. Estaré usando los colores de la carta de referencia en mi dibujo: el cabello rubio y la guitarra casi negra y muy brillante. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTbYeRMD3AQXR7t1sVKS7F1LwKpQEZkYGxykgnoZJ7CDp/292_sin_t_tulo_20260426221553.jpg) I began coloring my drawing with the skin, which I made light-colored, and added light and shadow details using different layers in soft light and multiply blend modes. I also colored the cheeks pink. > Comencé a colorear mi dibujo por la piel, que la hice de color claro y le di detalles de luces y sombras con distintas capas en modo luz suave y multiplicar. También le coloreé las mejillas rosadas. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZCzN9vDcJUFUgyGAiYhRSk1H9SLfHHLCnjWkgNXdNpMe/292_sin_t_tulo_20260426222246.jpg) I made the hair a very golden blonde, full of depth and highlights. I really liked how her hair turned out and how it falls naturally over her shoulders. > El cabello lo hice de un rubio muy dorado lleno de profundidades y de brillos. Me gustó mucho cómo quedó su cabello y cómo cae de forma natural sobre sus hombros. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeoxz8xhWXTqzbw5ZVNGi57UTaT9xh6T2J3z4fST9M4Dn/292_sin_t_tulo_20260426224607.jpg) So the dress and the guitar turned out with their colors, ready to make it play. I only had to add a very, very simple flat background that focuses on the character. For that, I created a solid pink background that contrasts a lot with her outfit, and some lines that frame the character. I hope you like how it turned out. I really liked the result. Courtney is a very, very beautiful card, and I think she will be my favorite guitarist from now on: I'm her fan, as her card says. > Así quedó el vestido con su color y también la guitarra, lista para hacerla sonar. Solo me restaba hacerle un fondo plano muy, muy simple que enfoque al personaje; para eso creé un fondo de color sólido rosa que contrasta mucho con su vestuario y unas líneas que enfoquen al personaje. Espero que les guste cómo quedó. A mí me gustó mucho el resultado. Courtney es una carta muy, muy bonita y creo que será mi guitarrista favorita desde ahora: soy su fan, como dice su carta. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRFkHnGTuY4eiibpHqXdKn5jFdyeaPUeNHtHJK2mNVbLQ/292_sin_t_tulo.jpg) Thank you for accompanying me one more day of drawing. > Gracias por acompañarme un día más dibujando. --- ***About:*** ==*Sketchbook and Journal of a Learner*== **If you like my content, join my [Fanbase clicking here](https://hive.vote/dash.php?fan=nestodibuja&i=2)**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc31AecQSitU5xAjsqS4snajcWh6CMMyapx88itjomSah/thanks.png)
___ *All photos and images are created by me. These are pictures of my sketchbook. Many of my drawings are practice pieces rather than finished works. Images from the internet may or may not have been used as references, copies, or sources of inspiration as part of my learning process.*

title.title: SOPA CON POLENTA Y FIDEO CABELLO DE ANGEL-----
title.body:
Buenos dias a todos, es muy bueno cuando los dias en que hace un poco de frio como hoy en degustar una sabrosa sopa con verduras,polenta y fideo, para cocinar dicha sopa es de la siguiente manera, agregamos la olla en la hornalla de la cocina, le agregamos un poco de aceite, la cebolla, ajo,  le agregamos mas agua y con una mano vamos agregando polenta, con la otra mano vamos revolviendo muy lentamente, el motivo de este movimiento es para que en la polenta no se formen grumos, lo podemos notar en esta fotografia, en donde la misma salio muy bien a gusto le agregamos pimienta negra la cual le da un sabor especial, lo siguiente es agregar el fideo fino antes mencionado-cabello de angel- y una ves cocinado ya esta lista dicha sopa.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/23tvnem2ACPGc5asnM7UeiBd4DMJ5hUvPKtoxiL83yZziCJrZwAqzM4Z5ewCTWivbCKqQ.png)

La diferencia de esta comida, es que al quedar bien espesa como lo podemos notar, sale muy rica, ademas amigos lo mas importante es que no contiene niguna carne, todo muy natural.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR LEERME Y SEGUIRME.

TRADUCIDO AL INGLES

Good morning everyone, it is very nice on days when it is a bit cold like today to enjoy a delicious soup with vegetables, polenta, and noodles. To cook this soup, we do the following: we place the pot on the stove, add a bit of oil, onion, garlic, add more water, and with one hand, we add polenta, while with the other hand, we stir very slowly. The reason for this movement is to prevent lumps from forming in the polenta. We can see this in the photograph, where it turned out very well. To taste, we add black pepper, which gives it a special flavor. Next, we add the fine noodles mentioned earlier—angel hair—and once cooked, the soup is ready.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/23tvnem2ACPGc5asnM7UeiBd4DMJ5hUvPKtoxiL83yZziCJrZwAqzM4Z5ewCTWivbCKqQ.png)

The difference with this dish is that, as we can see, it turns out very thick and delicious. Also, friends, the most important thing is that it doesn't contain any meat, everything is very natural.

Thank you very much for reading and following me.

title.title: My new event
title.body:
Hi, guys!

Tomorrow I'm moderating another event for a publishing house, and it's a new experience again because it's an online event for the first time. I've never done anything like this before, so naturally, I'm a little nervous again.

But it's okay; everything happens for the first time, and I need to get used to the fact that I'll now be working with so many different formats, and I need to learn them all and do them well. I hope sooner or later I'll stop being nervous before these kinds of events, become more seasoned, so to speak, and everything will start flowing more naturally.

The end of the month is coming soon, and I'll be reviewing my results, and this month they've been quite good. I've earned much more from the blog than in all the previous months, and I hope this will only continue to grow.

I have a lot planned for today, a lot of filming to do, so I won't be able to just slack off for the day. I need to film the unpacking of books, and there's a huge pile of them, plus several more packages waiting at the post office, so there's simply nowhere to put it all. I also need to test Instagram Live. I've done that before, but only once, so now I need to try again.

Also, I need to save it, and that feature wasn't available before, so I want to test everything on my backup account today and see how it works so I'll have a better idea of ​​what I'm doing tomorrow.

Have a great day, everyone!

title.title: The end is coming =/= Das Ende kommt 👹🍣🎎 Wonderful Japan ENG-GER
title.body: ![IMG_8353.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EoAafEqRNvSMbdbPo9jTxzvi8FoETPfkGjMCHvFJ8Z5WE8mnd7DX5Zin1AWjuR9cdwY.JPG) The cherry blossom season here in Japan usually unfolds in much the same way, and ultimately we know what to expect. But even so, it’s always somehow different—especially since we never quite know if we’ve timed it right, or if the weather might throw a wrench in our plans again. And that’s exactly why it’s so important not to miss a single opportunity and to enjoy this wonderful time as fully as possible. Unfortunately this grand spectacle is over all too quickly. The many magnificent blossoms that had just been delighting you are suddenly lying on the ground or may even have disappeared entirely. And as mentioned earlier, it is precisely this fleetingness and transience that makes Queen Sakura’s visit so special. But even as the blossoms on the trees dwindle, there’s no reason to feel gloomy. Because if you really look around, you’ll discover that even the final act of this magnificent spectacle has its own charm that shouldn’t be overlooked. ![IMG_8354.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/Eo6KtitZyiUqHb64sP716hLzx6GGLVyRiymzsNVMfPJS2YeUBpTD6Lf2EJtjLevucuu.JPG) DEUTSCH _Das Schauspiel der Kirschblüte läuft hier in Japan eigentlich immer ziemlich ähnlich ab und letztendlich weiß man, was einen erwartet. Aber trotzdem ist es immer irgendwie anders, vor allem, weil man dann eben doch nicht weiß, ob man das rechte Timing hat und das Wetter einem nicht doch einen Strich durch die Rechnung macht. Und genau deshalb ist es dann auch so wichtig, keine Gelegenheit auszulassen, und diese so wundervolle Zeit so ausgiebig zu genießen wie nur möglich._ _Denn leider ist das große Spektakel dann eben auch ganz schnell wieder vorbei. Die vielen herrlichen Blüten, die einen gerade noch begeistert hatten, liegen auf einmal am Boden oder sind vielleicht sogar schon ganz verschwunden. Und wie bereits erwähnt, ist es eben genau diese Flüchtigkeit und Vergänglichkeit, die den Besuch von Königin Sakura so besonders macht._ _Aber auch wenn die Blüten an den Bäumen immer weniger werden, gibt es doch keinen Grund zum Trübsalblasen. Denn wenn man sich richtig umsieht, wird man entdecken, dass auch der letzte Akt in diesem tollen Schauspiel seinen Reiz hat, den man nicht übersehen sollte._ ![IMG_8356.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/Eos1GpJrvUXGKQWhhNA3EkcARVQyojYTCCijWwshbfnKUdcC3FxHnMFA5whR1m8xR2G.JPG) And that’s why I also enjoy taking another look at the remnants of the blossoms that now hang from the branches. What remains are many red stubs, but here and there I can spot some little bits of white—a few petals seem to want to linger a little longer. _Und deshalb schaue ich mir auch gern noch einmal die Blütenreste an, die nun an den Zweigen hängen. Übrig bleiben viele rote Stummel, aber hier und dort leuchtet es immer wieder mal ein wenig weiß, ein paar Blütenblätter wollen gerne noch ein wenig länger bleiben._ ![IMG_8358.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EoeEyRiBbQ4UDrZKZzyKXGU2PS55toueBcV2SfqH3iEMn7vkAeZxqii7pst9T3qoaMN.JPG) Well, what should I say? Above all, I feel a deep sense of gratitude—a mix of warm joy and melancholy that seems to find its way to me every year at this time. It was lovely once again, and I was more than happy to let myself be swept up in the moment. And hey, it’s not over yet—because spring is just about to really pick up steam and start painting its masterpiece. It’s turning green, colorful, and above all, warmer. Of course, I’m already looking forward to that. And if all else fails, there’s always the certainty that Queen Sakura will grace us with her presence again in a year. And we’ll definitely be there again... _Nun ja, was soll man sagen? Vor allem fühle ich ein großes Gefühl der Dankbarkeit, einen Mix aus wohliger Freude und Schwermut, der sich wohl jedes Jahr zu dieser Zeit zu mir gesellt. Es war wieder mal schön und ich habe mich nur zu gern begeistern lassen. Und eigentlich ist es ja auch gar nicht zu Ende - denn jetzt wird der Frühling so richtig an Fahrt aufnehmen und seinen Pinsel schwingen. Es wird grün, und auch bunt und vor allem auch wärmer. Darauf freue ich mich natürlich auch schon. Und wenn alles nicht hilft, bleibt ja noch die Gewissheit, dass und Königin Sakura in einem Jahr wieder die Ehre geben wird. Und wir werden auf jeden Fall wieder dabei sein..._ ![IMG_8357.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23yTf841t9ZyouPruH9p38ByAbDExKm4y1iF5NvPxeiBLy6XSVdHLoPBsz3i1xmrVvpR2.JPG) ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)

title.title: Empanadas de pollo con ensalada de chauchaºººººChicken empanadas with green bean salad
title.body:
Hola a todos, la verdad es bueno  degustar empanadas como las que hacemos en nuestra casa y no compradas, asi que para preparar las empanadas de pollo, lo primero es herbir la carne de pollo, en esta ocacion se trata de pechuga, que al hervirla en una olla, le agrego, ajo, y condimentos varios, con sal a gusto, en otra olla se procede a hervir los huevos, los cuales una ves hervidos se le quita la cascara, lo trituro bien y lo mesclo con dicha carne una ves desmenusada, luego lo agrego en una olla la cual esta en la hornalla de la cocina, con condimentos a gusto, luego de quitarala de la cocina, la dejo que se enfrie y agrego el huevo antes mencionado que seria el relleno, comienzo con el armado de dichas empanadas las cuales una ves cocinadas, como se ve en la foto, despues de freirlas con aceite y grasa de cerdo las dejo que se enfrien un poco, que salen mas sabrosas.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23uQvoq925R57saoh2TtZiv9w8GDrb5PYA9gyke5ieWG9JSnzCK4rsJQBeFCFoKqSPTze.png)

Por supuesto que las tapas de dichas empanadas son compradas, asi que para acompañarlas, esta ves prepare una ensalada diferente, la cual se trata de chauchas, las mismas, se le quita la parte de las puntas que son un poco duras y luego se las hierve en una olla, cuando estan blandas, se le quita el agua y se la deja enfriarce un poco, despues a gusto de cada uno, le agrego huevo duro, cebolla morada y un poco de ajo, con sal a gusto, de esa manera sale una sabrosa ensalada para esta ocacion.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23zS1JGceh6q1TanJFU6FTxeCKUQzxwkPkY5eh1nKp1FqFR8HP8FaoEesmS1uJiDjW8uw.png)

Como les decia amigos al comienzo, las empanadas son muy exquisitas pero lo que a veces tenemos que cambiar como ahora, es la ensalada para acompañarla.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR SEGUIRME Y LEERME, QUE TENGAN UN BELLO DIA.

ENGLISH

Hello everyone, the truth is it's good to taste empanadas like the ones we make at home and not bought, so to prepare chicken empanadas, the first step is to boil the chicken meat, in this case, it's breast, which I boil in a pot, adding garlic and various seasonings, with salt to taste. In another pot, I proceed to boil the eggs, which once boiled, I peel, crush them well, and mix them with the shredded chicken. Then I add it to a pot on the stove, with seasonings to taste. After removing it from the stove, I let it cool and add the aforementioned egg, which will be the filling. I start assembling the empanadas, which once cooked, as seen in the photo, after frying them with oil and pork fat, I let them cool a bit, which makes them tastier.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23uQvoq925R57saoh2TtZiv9w8GDrb5PYA9gyke5ieWG9JSnzCK4rsJQBeFCFoKqSPTze.png)

Of course, the dough for these empanadas is store-bought, so to accompany them, this time I prepared a different salad, which consists of green beans. The tough ends are removed, and then they are boiled in a pot. Once they are soft, the water is drained, and they are left to cool a bit. Then, to each person's taste, I add hard-boiled egg, red onion, and a bit of garlic, with salt to taste. This way, a delicious salad is made for this occasion.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23zS1JGceh6q1TanJFU6FTxeCKUQzxwkPkY5eh1nKp1FqFR8HP8FaoEesmS1uJiDjW8uw.png)

As I was telling you, friends, at the beginning, the empanadas are very exquisite, but what we sometimes have to change, like now, is the salad to accompany them.

Thank you very much for following and reading me, have a beautiful day.

title.title: Potholes in my Brain
title.body: When I was a kid, one of the things that frustrated me the *most* was when I would run to say something to my mom and then promptly forget what it was I meant to say.\n\nMy mother — in her Infinite Wisdom —would turn to me and say *\

*

![1109-Squirrel.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23wCDij6w2F6YtQ5HL6As7ff7z4GqMaCk96RPH3Kv99x3p7CnoVSAPPg1qT8RsZHPxZpS.jpg)

That was the part that actually frustrated me the most, because in my youthful enthusiasm I invariably thought that whatever it was I had to relay was *extremely important!*

I look back on those incidents from my current vantage point of multiple decades later and I realize that I have always had some serious potholes in my brain. That is to say, my memory — particularly in the short term — is a pretty dodgy place.

The funny thing is that I can tell you about something that happened 25 years ago in great detail... far above and beyond what a reasonable person could be expected to and yet I have most likely forgotten what you told me *5 minutes ago.*

This was definitely not a *\

* that was of much use when I was at University or even when I was in grade school and high school!

![x0238-Lavender.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/48K7Yn4btgH8gF6eHpcRX7FnzM7EJnuqhrk7NVcnYRPeiu1AgiTxfDvJq6oshEybj8.jpg)

I recognized that I had a problem at a relatively young age, and started to keep lists — even as a teenager — because I knew there were lots of things I *\
* remember, but my natural memory was not going to be of any help in that respect.\n\nI even threw money at *\

* courses and workshops that supposedly were designed to improve memory but they never made any difference, so I always returned to writing lists. Which works fine as long as I *remember* where the list is and to bring it with me if I need to remember things when I'm somewhere else!\n\nSome friends would even refer to me as the *\

* although I would hardly call myself absent-minded and I am definitely not a professor! I just have singularly poor short-term memory. Somebody says something — even something important —and it goes straight in one ear and out the other without any of it sticking on the way through.

![x669-OakCreek.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23wWwRJ8FUJBJjw32bVJiZQaKaKiEuLLjueZ7LtmzeKrd7zE4VS7mjAMLupWGZLDmLL4M.JPG)

Human beings are relatively adaptable and amazing creatures, and I am grateful that I have managed to chart a path through life with my lists... without the majority of the world detecting that I am somehow *\

* in some way.

Thanks for stopping by, and have a great remainder of your week!

Hi mudz!

It's been a long time without you, my friend.

Our last video call was in November 2025, during my birthday week. 

I was eager to find time for our latest life updates. 

I wanted to hear your chismis in life.

What was going on with you in the last year or two?

We never talked so much because life became busy here in France, as well.

And also due to time differences.

But happy to catch up on your life updates through Stories and some FB updates.

I was glad we talked in November and had some messaging updates in December 2025.

I became worried when you told me you had some trouble underwater while scuba diving.

I told you to have a medical check-up because it was not normal.

I didn't know you were sent to the hospital in Bohol when you went on a diving excursion with your guests. 

In March 2026, you lost your life.

I felt so devastated, woke up, crying. 

A few friends in Cebu sent me a message asking if I had heard the news about you.

They never told me all the details.

I just knew.

Mudz, I missed you so badly.

I was expecting we'd have more life updates this year.

Because I told myself that I need to reach out to my old friends.

Well, see you in the next life, muds!

You are not forgotten.

You stay in my heart.

Love you!

Rox

title.body: > On an old wall, he drew a big ox to the right with thrones pointing at his opponent. With his face pointing slightly down and angry staring eyes. A huge body and a very short feet. Making sure that they look unfit to hold all that body. Probably, it is attempt to show that the ox next move is uncontrollable and unpredictable. On the other side of the painting, there comes the opponent. A ninja looking guy, with his mast on and the only visible thing is his eyes. A thin body, and the feet are drawn wide apart to show that he is flexible. Compared to the ox, he looks tiny and cannot hold a battle. But, he is holding a stick in his right hand. Probably, a resemblance of using tools to support his mission. The painter had a child in mind. A child who is fighting his cravings to candy and urges to stare at screen all day long. Maybe, those are too strong for him to fight right now. But, he is holding a stick which is the awareness that self-management is important. Or, at least that is what his mother has told him. As soon as he finished drawing, he thought.. How many of that same scenario repeats for us as adults? # PT

>

Em uma parede antiga, ele desenhou um grande boi à direita, com as patas apontando para o oponente. O rosto ligeiramente voltado para baixo e os olhos furiosos fixos. Um corpo enorme e pés muito curtos, que parecem incapazes de sustentar todo aquele corpo. Provavelmente, uma tentativa de mostrar que o próximo movimento do boi é incontrolável e imprevisível. Do outro lado da pintura, surge o oponente. Um sujeito com aparência de ninja, com seu mastro e apenas os olhos visíveis. Corpo magro e pés bem afastados, indicando flexibilidade. Comparado ao boi, ele parece minúsculo e incapaz de lutar. Mas segura um bastão na mão direita, provavelmente uma alusão ao uso de ferramentas para auxiliar em sua missão.

O pintor tinha uma criança em mente. Uma criança lutando contra a vontade de comer doces e o impulso de ficar olhando para a tela o dia todo. Talvez esses desejos sejam fortes demais para ela enfrentar agora. Mas o bastão que ela segura simboliza a consciência da importância do autocontrole. Ou, pelo menos, foi o que sua mãe lhe disse. 肯德基又出来一个与三丽鸥联名的玩具套餐，我儿子本来就喜欢吃肯德基，看到这个联名套餐更是要吵吵着买，她就算是不吃，看了这些小玩意也要买来倒腾两下。

好在这次出的是双人餐，那我的午饭也一起解决了，不然我还要考虑我吃啥。那天周六，是第一天上线卖，我这个团购券是早就买好的了，只等开售。周六他上课到11点半，我11点来点餐刚刚好。

有五种玩具可以选择，大耳狗手机无线充，帕恰狗桌面风扇，布丁狗喷雾器，kitty泳池派对音乐氛围灯，半鱼人泡泡浴皂液机，看了视频以后他一直在纠结前两个，后面两个对他来说没有太大的吸引力。

最后还是决定要桌面风扇，主要看那个帕恰狗可以单独拿来做包挂。送来还挺快的，但是我怎么感觉不是现做的，可能当天上市售卖买的人比较多，所以都先做好了放那？反正感觉没那么新鲜，也就是为了这个玩具了。

玩具拿到手他又后悔了，他说早知道要那个无线充，真想抽他，我说选了就别后悔，人家都送到家了你又说，换不了了，你也别想我再买一次套餐，我不上你的当，就这一个玩具我都嫌多。

三丽鸥的东西可爱是可爱，但是也真不实用，哈哈哈，风力太小了。就是小孩子喜欢了，天天联名搞些活动，钱包捂不住啊。

title.body:
Spray Drying Equipment Market Revenue

According to StraitsResearch, the [global spray drying equipment market size](https://straitsresearch.com/report/spray-drying-equipment-market) was valued at USD 6.42 billion in 2025 and is estimated to reach USD 11.54 billion by 2034, growing at a CAGR of 6.86% during the forecast period (2026–2034).

The spray drying equipment market refers to the global industry focused on machinery used to convert liquid feed into dry powder through rapid drying with hot gas. This technology is widely adopted across industries such as food & dairy, pharmaceuticals, and chemicals due to its efficiency in preserving product quality and extending shelf life. According to Straits Research, the global spray drying equipment market has been experiencing steady growth, driven by increasing demand for processed and convenience foods, advancements in pharmaceutical manufacturing, and expanding applications in specialty chemicals. The market is projected to witness significant expansion over the forecast period, supported by technological innovations such as energy-efficient systems and automation integration, which enhance productivity while reducing operational costs.

**Spray Drying Equipment Market Operational Factors**

Several operational factors influence the performance and adoption of spray drying equipment across industries:

Energy Efficiency and Cost Optimization

Spray drying is an energy-intensive process. Manufacturers are increasingly focusing on optimizing thermal efficiency and reducing energy consumption through heat recovery systems and improved airflow designs.

Product Quality and Consistency

Uniform particle size, moisture content, and solubility are critical parameters. Advanced atomization techniques and precise temperature control systems ensure consistent output quality.

Automation and Process Control

The integration of IoT and automated monitoring systems allows real-time process optimization, minimizing human intervention and improving operational reliability.

Maintenance and Downtime Management

Equipment durability and ease of maintenance play a vital role in operational efficiency. Modular designs and self-cleaning systems are becoming industry standards.

Regulatory Compliance

Strict regulations in food and pharmaceutical industries require adherence to hygiene and safety standards, pushing manufacturers to design equipment that meets global compliance norms such as GMP and FDA guidelines.

Key Unit Economics for Businesses and Startups

Understanding unit economics is critical for businesses entering the spray drying equipment market:

Capital Expenditure (CapEx)

Initial investment is substantial, including equipment procurement, installation, and facility setup. Advanced systems with automation capabilities command higher costs but offer long-term efficiency gains.

Operational Expenditure (OpEx)

Key operational costs include energy consumption, maintenance, labor, and raw materials. Energy costs typically account for a significant portion, making efficiency improvements crucial.

Throughput and Yield Optimization

Higher throughput and minimal product loss directly impact profitability. Optimizing feed concentration and drying parameters can significantly enhance yield.

Return on Investment (ROI)

ROI depends on production scale, application type, and operational efficiency. Industries such as pharmaceuticals and nutraceuticals often achieve faster ROI due to higher product margins.

Scalability and Flexibility

Startups benefit from modular and scalable systems that allow gradual expansion without significant additional investment.

title.body: /> Hello Everyone! Hope you all are doing great and welcome to another #Splinterlands post. Okay so today, I don’t even know where to start 😅. This was one of those days where everything just clicks. I finally reached Diamond 3! I’m still trying to process it honestly, because not too long ago I was struggling in Bronze and now I’m here. Feels kinda unreal.

> So I logged in today not expecting anything crazy. I was like okay maybe I’ll just grind a bit, try to stay in Gold, maybe get closer to Diamond. But yeah, things escalated QUICK. First few matches were actually really good. I was winning more than usual, and not just lucky wins… like proper wins where my strategy actually worked.

> One thing I noticed today… I was way more focused on rulesets. Like before I used to kinda ignore small details (which cost me a lot of matches 😭), but today I actually paid attention. And it made a BIG difference. There was one match where the ruleset looked confusing at first, but I took my time, built a proper counter lineup… and it worked perfectly. As I kept playing I suddenly realized my rating was getting really close to Diamond 3. Every match started feeling like a final exam. I was double checking everything. Maybe overthinking a bit but I didn’t wanna mess it up. 𝐑𝐀𝐍𝐊 𝐔𝐏 𝐌𝐀𝐓𝐂𝐇 ======================== Ok so I don't know if you guys want to believe this but I actually won my rank up match without even playing it xD. I was ready. I had already started thinking about my lineup in my head. But then something unexpected happened. The time limit for starting the match expired, probably because I think my opponent didn't submit their team in time. And just like that I got the win.
> And because of that, I ranked up to Diamond 3 💎. 𝐑𝐄𝐖𝐀𝐑𝐃𝐒 ============== After ranking up, I got 18 chest rewards.
> Before opening them, I made sure to use potions. No way I’m opening 18 chests without boosting my chances. So yeah activated potions and went all in.

> Opening 18 chests was honestly one of the best parts. So many rewards popping up, it just feels satisfying. I won’t say I got anything insanely rare but overall rewards were good. Definitely worth it. Some cards, some useful items, decent value.
/> Also earlier today, I purchased 1,000 credits. Not a huge amount, but it helped a bit with flexibility. Having some extra credits always feels nice when you need to adjust your setup.

/>

𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐒𝐈𝐎𝐍
====================

Looking back at today, It was a mix of hard work + a little bit of luck. But I still feel like I earned it. Because getting close to Diamond wasn’t easy. The matches before that were tough. And yeah even though the final match didn’t happen, the grind before it was real.

What I learned today:

*   Consistency matters more than streaks
    
*   Paying attention to rulesets REALLY helps
    
*   Don’t rush decisions
    

Anyway, that was my weird but successful day in #Splinterlands. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

title.title: What If a Ghost Lived Inside My Phone?
title.body:
Honestly, when I first saw the prompt, I laughed because it sounded funny, but at the same time it was really interesting to think about. 

![IMG-20260428-WA0009.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mathewdaddywah/23u5tauZ6DLgnTtDGPS15siyjBh3oYjaWXMmEf5xPMitkpXHBwuxrUA6PRThuz7usTGxc.jpg)

Images Generated with Meta AI

The idea of a ghost living inside a phone, laptop, or computer feels strange, but somehow it also feels possible in this digital age where almost everything about us is stored online.

The first time I heard something like this was actually from an anime, although I have forgotten the title. It was a newer anime where kids were fighting ghosts through their phones. These ghosts were attached to devices they used before they died, and the kids had to bring out special weapons from their phones to destroy them. It sounded crazy at first, but the story made it feel real. 

Since then, I started thinking about how much of our lives are now connected to technology.
I have also seen something similar in a Korean movie. In that movie, the owner of a big company died, but somehow his ghost remained connected to his phone. 

A young man found the phone by accident, and before he knew it, he was communicating with the ghost of the dead CEO. The ghost helped him, guided him, and eventually the young man started living a better life and even became the CEO of the company. That movie made me think that maybe not every ghost story has to be scary.

Now, if something like that happened to me in real life, I won’t lie, I would definitely be scared at first. Imagine opening your laptop at midnight and suddenly files start moving on their own, strange messages appear, or your dead colleague starts sending you messages online. That would make anybody panic. I would probably drop my phone immediately and start praying first before doing anything else.

But if the ghost was peaceful and not trying to harm me, I think my fear would reduce with time. In fact, if that person was someone I knew before they died and they were helping me with useful advice, I might even get used to it. Let me be honest, if the ghost can teach me skills that would help me make money or become successful, then omo, we are friends for life! I would not even want to disconnect the internet again.

Still, I would be careful because not every spirit should be trusted. I would want to know their intention first. Are they here to help or to cause trouble? That matters a lot.
For me, digital ghosts sound scary, but they also sound like something that could make a great movie or anime. Fear would definitely be there, but curiosity would also be there too.

Thanks for reading hope to see you again @mathewdaddywah

The eating and chewing of God's word, lightens your spirit man up.

I am the light of God in the world, I can't be hidden or downtrodden. I shine wherever I go.

As I am going into the world, I shine, I uproot, destroy, build, and dispel darkness.

title.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gf82a0df71e3f1c26407f3b9a8943d04faf92d5e0825e6ee6b5dfaac596d6802493bb9db7c7a95566d3ede941c7a72dca353ee08746c9930b2c55060752fab784_640.jpg)
Hoy decidí explorar un nuevo barrio de la ciudad durante mi caminata. El sol brillaba y el clima era perfecto, lo que hizo que la experiencia fuera aún más agradable. Mientras caminaba, conocí a una mujer mayor que estaba cuidando su pequeño jardín en la acera. Ella me contó que había vivido en la misma casa durante más de 40 años y me mostró orgullosa algunas de sus flores, especialmente unas hermosas margaritas que ella había sembrado. Más adelante, pasé por un parque donde un grupo de niños jugaba al fútbol. Su energía contagiosa me hizo sonreír, y recuerdo que uno de ellos, un niño pequeño con una gran sonrisa, me pidió que me uniera a su juego. No pude resistirme y jugué un par de minutos, ¡fue increíble! A lo largo de mi camino, vi un mural colorido que representaba la diversidad de la ciudad, con rostros de diferentes culturas y tradiciones. Me detuve un rato para admirarlo y reflexionar sobre lo vibrante que es la comunidad en la que vivo. Definitivamente, cada caminata es una nueva aventura llena de encuentros sorprendentes y momentos que valen la pena recordar. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). title.title: Título: Rayuela: un contrato de lectura roto a propósito
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQJuc6T9fELnLbWwDAPp81AUfqMWgadwLhSb1dn8jBFJz/1777321381338.jpg)

Análisis en español 


Querida comunidad de Literatos, los invito a dejar atrás la idea de un libro común. Rayuela, de Julio Cortázar, no se lee: se habita. Y esa es la primera gran provocación. Al ofrecernos dos tableros de lectura —el orden tradicional o el “saltado” que el propio autor propone— Cortázar nos convierte en cómplices de la desobediencia. Ya no somos lectores pasivos, sino jugadores activos. Cada salto de capítulo es un riesgo, una renuncia a la causalidad narrativa convencional.

Pero el verdadero centro de la novela no está solo en su estructura. Está en el personaje de Horacio Oliveira y su búsqueda insaciable de una autenticidad que París y Buenos Aires le niegan. La “rayuela” del título es ese juego infantil donde se avanza a la vez que se aprende a equilibrarse en una línea dibujada con tiza. Oliveira vive sobre esa línea: entre la razón y la locura, entre la pasión por la Maga y la imposibilidad de poseerla del todo. Cortázar cuestiona el lenguaje mismo: ensaya neologismos, introduce el humor, juega con el lunfardo y el francés, como si el idioma también necesitara ser saltado para decir algo nuevo.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmezL7pjA7Wh8xHaQPFEMTeP4V7WBm6Q2cowFe44WoSA5K/1777321400607.jpg)




Al final, Rayuela no es una novela para entender, sino para experimentar. Frustra, desordena, incomoda. Por eso es tan vital. Nos obliga a preguntarnos: ¿leemos para encontrar respuestas o para perdernos mejor en las preguntas? Los invito a compartir en Hive sus propios “saltos” y extravíos. Nos leemos.

English version 

Title: Hopscotch: A Deliberately Broken Reading Contract

Dear Literatos community, let’s forget the idea of a conventional book for a moment. Julio Cortázar’s Hopscotch is not meant to be read — it’s meant to be inhabited. And that’s the first great act of rebellion. By offering us two reading paths (the traditional order or the “skipping” one he suggests), Cortázar turns us into accomplices of disobedience. We are no longer passive readers; we become active players. Each chapter jump is a risk, a rejection of conventional narrative cause and effect.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmetQCyu6ARtG2zDiSVPLnPrKCtHkpbAjrPNATcdVEvwdy/1777321475950.jpg)


Still, the novel’s true heart isn’t just its structure. It lives in Horacio Oliveira, a man searching obsessively for an authenticity that both Paris and Buenos Aires deny him. The “hopscotch” of the title is that childhood game in which you move forward while learning to balance on a chalk-drawn line. Oliveira exists on that line: between reason and madness, between his passion for La Maga and the impossibility of fully possessing her. Cortázar also questions language itself: he invents words, introduces humor, plays with slang and French, as if language too needed to be hopped across to say anything new.

In the end, Hopscotch isn’t a novel to understand — it’s a novel to experience. It frustrates, unsettles, and disorients. That’s precisely why it feels so alive. It forces us to ask: do we read to find answers, or to get wonderfully lost inside better questions? I invite you all to share your own jumps and wanderings on Hive. Let’s read each other.

title.title: Once a Student, now a Teacher!
title.body:
Yes, you read that right from the title. The former student who once simply dreamed in life is now a teacher!

I still remember the bio I used on this account: “**_A student who’s trying her best_**.” That bio stayed with me for several years. I created this account back in May 2022, and from the very beginning, that was what I chose to represent myself. Now, after more than three years, I have finally updated it to: “**_LPT_**.” Yes, I am now a Licensed Professional Teacher.

Before I continue sharing my journey—from being a student striving hard to becoming a teacher—I would first like to greet all of you. _Hello everyone, how have you been?_ It has been a while since I last visited this platform because I’ve been busy with life. I truly missed writing here and reading your posts. Although I would occasionally visit and read some blogs, I never had enough time to write again.

Now, I finally have the chance. I am currently on a one-month vacation from teaching, starting May 1 until May 31. Even though it is not yet May, I no longer have many tasks at school. I have already submitted all my requirements and completed my clearance, so I decided to return to writing.

To be honest, I’ve had free time since last week, but I got carried away watching different K-dramas online. After spending long hours watching, I started experiencing headaches and eye strain, which made me realize I needed to slow down. That’s why I decided to come back here—to make my time more meaningful.

Anyway, let’s go back to my main story. Yes, I am now a teacher!

I finished my studies and graduated in October 2023. Even before graduating, I was already looking for a job because I wanted to start reviewing for the Board Exam as soon as possible. During that time, it was difficult to find a job related to my course because of the number of competitors. However, I did not give up. Instead of limiting myself, I applied to different companies even if they were not aligned with my field.

I was hired as a staff member in a casual food establishment. While working, I continued pursuing my goal of reviewing for the board exam. I enrolled in a review center near our area and managed both work and review at the same time. That’s how determined I was to achieve my dreams.

It was exhausting—physically, mentally and even financially. I wasn’t just supporting my own needs for review; I was also helping with our household expenses. Despite all the challenges, I never gave up. I knew that everything I was doing was for my dreams, and I believed that one day, all my sacrifices would bear fruit.

Fast forward to May 2024—one of the happiest moments of my life. All my sleepless nights and hard work finally paid off. I passed the board exam! I was deeply grateful to God and to all the people who supported me along the way.

In June 2024, I attended my oath-taking ceremony—another unforgettable milestone, as I was officially recognized as a full-fledged teacher. Then in August 2024, I finally received my license. It was one of the most satisfying moments of my life—to see and hold the result of all my hard work.

However, that wasn’t the end of the journey. I thought that having a license would make it easy to find a job—but I was wrong. The competition was still intense. There were times when I felt discouraged and lost hope, but I never lost my faith in God.

Finally, in June 2025, I was hired by a private school in our province. My heart was filled with joy and gratitude because, at last, my prayers were answered. I had applied to many schools—too many to count—so when I finally received a call and got accepted, I was truly overjoyed.

My first year of teaching has been a happy and meaningful experience. I encountered many “**firsts**” in this school since it was also my first time teaching. I learned so much—not only from my co-teachers but also from my students.

Although the salary in a private school is not as high as in public schools, I accepted the job wholeheartedly. For now, I am not focused on how big or small my salary is. What matters most is that I am happy with what I am doing.

Of course, my journey doesn’t end here. I still aspire to achieve more, and I know in my heart that I also want to work in a public school someday. That is one of the goals I will continue striving for. I will not stop until I achieve my dreams.

But for now, I am grateful and content. I am thankful to have a job that I love, and I believe that in God’s perfect time, all my dreams will come true.

And that is the story of a student who once dreamed—and is now a teacher.

To the youth and to anyone who may read this:

**_Never give up on your dreams. They will come to you at the right time. Be patient, work hard, stay diligent, and never lose hope. All your sacrifices will bear fruit in the end._**

`Thank you very much for reading!`

title.title: 🚴‍♂️ Cobblestones, Chaos, and Caffeine: Surviving the Cycling Spring Classics 🚴‍♂️
title.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvDz1nfRfqrop8jmrRU37siXeDNRsdztmUifhv8fs5gb/Schermafbeelding%202026-04-28%20084448.webp)

Pour yourself a heavy tripel beer, grab a bowl of frites, and take a deep breath. The Spring Classics are over. We have survived. From a strictly Belgian perspective, the period between the late-winter Omloop and the dying embers of Liège-Bastogne-Liège is not just a sports season; it is a two-month-long national cardiovascular event.

This year, the scriptwriters of the cycling gods gave us an absolute masterpiece of a 2026 season. We had redemption, we had tragedy, we had a generational French talent ruining our Sunday afternoons, and we had the undisputed confirmation that Tadej Pogačar is an alien sent to earth to make everyone else look like they are pedaling through wet cement.

Let’s break down the beautiful chaos of the Spring, focusing on the heavyweights who dictated the headlines from Strade Bianche all the way to La Doyenne.


## 📅 The Road to the Holy Week
The rhythm of the Spring is a masterpiece of escalation. We kicked off with the dusty, chaotic gravel of Strade Bianche, which immediately shifted gears into the agonizing, slow-burn tension of Milan-San Remo. From there, the peloton marched north to our holy ground for the build-up to the Tour of Flanders (De Ronde) and Paris-Roubaix, before pivoting through the twisting, turning roads of the Amstel Gold Race, and finally ending in the brutal hills of Liège-Bastogne-Liège.

It is a grueling marathon of one-day racing, and this year, it belonged to a select few.

## 👽 Tadej Pogačar: The Modern Cannibal
Let’s just get this out of the way: Tadej Pogačar has absolutely no respect for the modern rules of cycling, and it is glorious.

For the last two decades, we were told that Grand Tour winners are fragile creatures who must hide in their altitude tents until July, occasionally descending to ride a quiet one-week stage race. Pogačar looked at that rulebook and set it on fire. He rides everything, and he rides everything to murder the opposition. He is a modern-day Eddy Merckx, a true Cannibal. He races with a smile on his face while simultaneously ripping the legs off his competitors. Had Wout van Aert not stood in his way, Pogačar would have completed a sweep so unique and terrifying that they would have had to close down the sport.

But sport is a brutal, fickle mistress that gives and takes. Because Pogačar has set the bar so absurdly high, he is now a victim of his own success. He is the cycling equivalent of Bayern Munich. Bayern can have a record-breaking domestic season, but if they don't win the Champions League, their year is suddenly labeled a \

Similarly, if Pogi somehow fails to win the Tour de France this July, the media will treat his year as a disappointment, entirely forgetting his otherworldly Spring. That is the terrifying standard he has created.

## 🪨 Wout van Aert: The Holy Grail at Last!
Speaking of our public darling, Wout van Aert finally did it. Sound the alarms, ring the church bells across Flanders: Wout has his cobblestone.

After yet another incredibly difficult winter filled with setbacks, questions, and doubts, Wout arrived at the Spring Classics with the weight of a nation on his shoulders. Yes, he already had a Milan-San Remo trophy in his cabinet, but for a Belgian bred in the mud, your career isn't complete without the Ronde or Roubaix. Time and time again, he was plagued by bad luck, punctures, or the immovable objects of Pogačar and Van der Poel.

But not this year. In Paris-Roubaix, Wout finally put the pieces together. He conquered the Hell of the North, beat the Cannibal, and hoisted that beautiful, ridiculously heavy rock above his head in the velodrome. The collective sigh of relief from Antwerp to the Ardennes could have powered a windmill.

## 🇳🇱 Mathieu van der Poel: The Silent Spring
While we were celebrating Wout, we couldn't help but look around and ask: wait, did Mathieu van der Poel even ride this year?

As Belgians, we have a deep, grudging respect for our Dutch neighbor, mostly because he usually spends the Spring breaking our hearts. But this year? A blank. It has been a remarkably long time since MvdP went through an entire Spring campaign without bagging a massive, monumental win. We won't complain too loudly, but it was strange not seeing him launch one of his trademark, nuclear attacks on the Paterberg.

## 🏥 Mads Pedersen: Wrist Watch
A quick moment of silence for Mads Pedersen. The powerhouse Dane was tipped to be the ultimate disruptor in the cobbled classics, the man built like a tank who could roll over anyone. Unfortunately, the only thing that got rolled over was his luck, ending his Spring prematurely with ruined wrists. A massive shame for the race dynamics, but a stark reminder of how cruel these races are.

## 📉 Remco Evenepoel & Paul Seixas: The Belgian Paradox
And finally, we arrive at the great conundrum of Belgian sports media: Remco Evenepoel.

Let’s look at the raw facts of Remco’s 2026 Spring: He won the Amstel Gold Race (a massive achievement) and he finished 3rd in the Tour of Flanders (an incredible result for a rider of his profile).

Look at his palmares over the years: it is already unbelievable. World titles, Olympic titles, major Autumn classics, and even a Vuelta a España. Most riders would happily sacrifice their firstborn for a resume like that. And yet, somehow, it never seems good enough. But in sports, just like in financial investments, past performance is no guarantee of future results. You are only as good as your last race. It is genuinely hilarious to observe how both analysts and supporters seem to operate with the collective memory of a goldfish.

To be brutally honest, Remco doesn’t exactly help himself in the sympathy department. For some reason, I just don't find him all that likable. There was always an excuse. At his previous team, the squad supposedly wasn't strong enough. So, he packs up and moves to Bora, convinced that this would be the environment where he truly storms the absolute world top. In his head, he had already won the next Tour de France before the season even started.

But the illusion shattered in Liège-Bastogne-Liège. When Pogačar and the sensational French climbing prodigy Paul Seixas put the hammer down, Remco was left parked on the tarmac. He was completely chanceless against them on the steep, attritional climbs.

Now, he stands at a very painful crossroads. Does he stubbornly keep chasing a Tour de France dream with an increasingly slim chance of success? Frankly, looking at the pure climbing talent out there, I see Seixas winning a Tour much sooner than Remco. Or does he swallow his pride, re-tool, and accept his destiny as a one-day classics specialist—a discipline where he is undeniably at the very top of the world?

If Pogačar is Bayern Munich, Remco is starting to feel a lot like Arsenal: undeniably talented, capable of periods of sheer brilliance, but perhaps destined to fall just short of the ultimate prize while driving their fanbase slowly insane. It is the ultimate Belgian paradox: we have a generational talent who wins major classics, yet we spend our time agonizing over the fact that he might not win the yellow jersey.

The Spring Classics of 2026 gave us everything we could have asked for. The mud is drying, the cobbles are back to being farm roads, and the riders are heading to the mountains. It was beautiful, it was brutal, and we can't wait to do it all again next year.

Over to you, Hive! Are you a cycling fan? Do you prefer the chaotic mud of the Spring Classics or the sunny mountain summits of the Tour de France? Drop your thoughts below!

Cheers,
Peter

Okay, this may seem like I'm about post just about anything, to keep my streak. That is one of the reasons but I really needed to share this to applaud myself for what I've been doing for myself since a while ago. One of the hardest things I can do for myself, I have been doing it.

No, it may not look or seem hard to you reading once I tell you about it but I know myself well enough to know I've been doing a hard thing I once thought I'd never be able to. I just finished watching a video of a woman, a mother of three who set out to loss 10kg in 3 months and did it.

While that was super impressive to watch, I was more surprised to see the comment section filled with people who think it's still an impossible thing for them even though they are motivated to achieve what she has achieved. They've accepted that motivation will die a while after they start.

title.title: Fly of the genus Isomyia
title.body: > Atop a fresh green leaf, a small insect rested peacefully. It was a fly of the genus Isomyia. When hear the word fly, I'm sure you immediately imagine a small, annoying, and disgusting creature. In my observations, this fly is a little different. I've never found it on a carcass or in a trash can. I've mostly found this type of fly in grassy areas or small bushes along the side of the road. I'm not sure if this fly likes carcasses or not, because every time I find them, they're in clean grassy areas.

> This fly is very small, but fascinating to observe. When I observed it with the naked eye, its body was reddish-brown. However, when it appeared on camera, its entire body was a beautiful coppery red. Especially when its body was reflected in sunlight, its tiny body reflected a beautiful sparkle, like a small gem falling from the sky, caught on a fresh green leaf. Its entire body was protected by fine hairs. The fine hairs successfully add a soft impression as well as natural warmth to the tiny fly.

I started a challenge of taking 100 days off to mainly focus on my health and overall personal development and used this account as a personal blog to keep track of all my activity. I enjoyed it and continued afterward trying to build better habits and find a good balance between health, fitness, work, entertainment, and my personal life...

Monday was a pretty ok day where I resisted the temptation to get some doritos in the evening and kept my eating healthy spending some kitchen time. I also went out for a walk to already get some cash money to take with me on my upcoming thailand trip. I also created a wise account and will soon request a card for that which should make it all a lot easier and give me more options.

I also joined an early evening Hot yoga class which now puts me at 4 class in 5 days with plenty more of them to come in the next 4 weeks as I'm basically joining every day when I can. I also further cleaned my outdoor storage room getting all the glass jars out of there. I also did all my dishes and cleaned my kitchen in the evening and watched some tv in the evening.

body.title: La endémica especie de Viñales con apariencia inquietante pero de dócil comportamiento. (🇪🇸ES-EN🇺🇸)
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmemtQMSeGpnYSa32a8nR13DJnkufUg5cgSaXX5Gp1AdXA/1777358441254.jpg)


Las Tarántulas son arañas pertenecientes a una familia llamada Theraphosidae, que concentra a las arañas más grandes y vistosas del mundo. En 2008, se detectó una nueva especie de tarántula denominada Trichopelma grande o Tarántula grande. Pero su identidad no se hizo conocida hasta años más tarde cuando encontraron tres especies más. 

Gracias a la profunda investigación y análisis de los científicos, confirmaron que la trichopelma grande era una especie no conocida en anteriores momentos. Hasta ahora es la más grande de su género. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX6CJ3EFGw2hTKm3mAq29RzAjhPRdkytBPn9L1v6vWLKe/1777358485170.jpg)


Esta especie fue encontrada en uno de los lugares más conocidos e importantes de Cuba, sí, estoy hablando del Parque Nacional viñales, conocido por sus paisajes de mogotes de piedra caliza, bosques semideciduos y ecosistemas únicos que conservan una gran cantidad de especies endémicas y que además, está ubicado en el extremo de mi bella isla en la provincia de Pinar del río. Ahí un equipo de científicos halló a esta nueva Tarántula, que como ya había mencionado antes, es conocida como el mayor ejemplar de su género. Dentro de este entorno, Trichopelma Grande fue detectada en cuatro localidades distintas, todas caracterizadas por hábitats epigeos y condiciones de suelo limitadas.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUpV9smxqmgkouRMFBtKAWsFxjVJ6nXaEPDP3d4nDhi3k/1777358584486.jpg)


Así, con franjas alternas de pelo negro y marrón, con patas erizadas que han sido descritas como semejantes a \

y un cuerpo de unos 2,54 cm de ancho aproximadamente, trichopelma grande demuestra tener un aspecto imponente y singular que, a la velocidad de un rayo logró que los investigadores se sintieran atraídos por su peculiar estructura y belleza animal.

Los estudios e investigaciones de la misma, estuvieron liderados por David Ortiz, proveniente de la Universidad Masaryk de República Checa y además, por Elier Fonseca de la Sociedad Zoológica de Cuba, quien detalla que está especie habita solamente en el Parque Nacional Viñales, una región reconocida por su biodiversidad única e inigualable. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdomsrW24Z7LDjt87rQTSQ3ucoe5ULWaDfnwZtPik1kj8/1777358759643.jpg)


Sin embargo, hubo algo que me llamó la atención y es que aunque la Tarántula parece tener una apariencia intimidante, su picadura es leve y menos potente que la de una abeja, lo que la hace inofensiva para las personas. Esta característica suya, junto con su comportamiento alimentario generalista,  nos deja claro que Trichopelma grande constituye un papel ecologico fundamental sin representar una amenaza para los seres humanos.


Al parecer la vida subterránea es clave para esta especie, ya que en las investigaciones realizadas se puede observar que sus madrigueras se construyen en el suelo, lo que la compara con otras Tarántulas que prefieren un entorno diferente. Por otra parte, hasta el momento sólo se han estudiado machos jóvenes y adultos, por lo que se deberá seguir investigando a fondo para describir con mayor precisión su comportamiento y ciclo de vida.


Aunque este fenómeno no es único, ya que en otros lugares como las Antillas Mayores, que son reconocidas como laboratorios naturales de biodiversidad, donde géneros como Trichopelma, Cyrtopholis y Phormictopus, desarrollaron una diversidad muy variada, esta es una especie de gran prioridad para la conservación.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZUFA5M8ESaJqC1K5ytmhfc7RciVQqVcvTDATWhjUoywy/1777358905035.jpg)


En fin, gracias a todo lo que he leído sobre esta Tarántula, me he dado cuenta de que el hallazgo de Trichopelma grande resalta la importancia de la conservación en áreas de alto endemismo como Viñales. Esta tarántula no aparece en colecciones de historia natural y su distribución limitada la convierte en una especie vulnerable.

No obstante el trabajo de Ortiz y Fonseca no solo aporta al conocimiento científico, sino que también destaca la riqueza natural de Cuba. Mi país, gracias a su aislamiento geográfico, tiene una biodiversidad única que merece ser estudiada y protegida.


¿Te causó asombro y curiosidad saber que esta enorme Tarántula, endémica de Viñales, sea más inofensiva que una abeja como a mí? 

Si te agradó conocer sobre esta gigante pero a la vez dócil amiga que habita en los mogotes pinareños, no dejes este post en sólo una mirada.

✅ Dale tu mejor voto para que otras personas puedan conocer a nuestra famosa trichopelma. 

💬 Déjame saber en comentarios ¿te gustaría tener una de estas en tu espacio? ¿ has visto o leído sobre alguna otra especie endémica de Viñales?

Gracias por quedarte hasta el final y espero que hayas disfrutado de la ciencia de este post. 🕸️💚



--- English ---🇺🇸🇺🇸

**The endemic species of Viñales with a disturbing appearance but docile behavior.**

Tarantulas are spiders belonging to a family called Theraphosidae, which includes the largest and most striking spiders in the world. In 2008, a new species of tarantula was detected, named Trichopelma grande or \

But its identity was not known until years later, when three more species were found. Thanks to in-depth research and analysis by scientists, they confirmed that Trichopelma grande was a previously unknown species. To date, it is the largest of its genus.

This species was found in one of the most famous and important places in Cuba — yes, I'm talking about Viñales National Park, known for its limestone mogote landscapes, semi-deciduous forests, and unique ecosystems that preserve a great number of endemic species. It is located at the far end of my beautiful island, in the province of Pinar del Río. There, a team of scientists discovered this new tarantula, which, as I mentioned before, is known as the largest specimen of its genus. Within this environment, Trichopelma grande was detected in four distinct locations, all characterized by epigean habitats and limited soil conditions.

With alternating bands of black and brown hair, bristly legs described as resembling \

and a body approximately 2.54 cm wide, Trichopelma grande displays an imposing and unique appearance. At lightning speed, it managed to attract researchers with its peculiar structure and animal beauty.

The studies and research were led by David Ortiz from Masaryk University in the Czech Republic, and Elier Fonseca from the Cuban Zoological Society, who details that this species lives only in Viñales National Park, a region recognized for its unique and unparalleled biodiversity.

However, something caught my attention: although the tarantula seems to have an intimidating appearance, its bite is mild and less potent than that of a bee, making it harmless to humans. This characteristic, along with its generalist feeding behavior, makes it clear that Trichopelma grande plays a fundamental ecological role without posing any threat to people.

Subterranean life seems key for this species, as research shows that its burrows are built in the ground, which sets it apart from other tarantulas that prefer different environments. Furthermore, so far only young and adult males have been studied, so further research is needed to more accurately describe its behavior and life cycle.

Although this phenomenon is not unique — since in other places like the Greater Antilles, recognized as natural biodiversity laboratories, genera such as Trichopelma, Cyrtopholis, and Phormictopus have developed a wide diversity — this species is of high priority for conservation.

In short, thanks to everything I have read about this tarantula, I have realized that the discovery of Trichopelma grande highlights the importance of conservation in high-endemism areas like Viñales. This tarantula does not appear in natural history collections, and its limited distribution makes it a vulnerable species.

Nevertheless, the work of Ortiz and Fonseca not only contributes to scientific knowledge but also highlights the natural richness of Cuba. My country, thanks to its geographic isolation, is home to a unique biodiversity that deserves to be studied and protected.

Did it also amaze and intrigue you to learn that this huge tarantula, endemic to Viñales, is more harmless than a bee — just like it amazed me?

If you enjoyed learning about this giant yet gentle friend that lives in the mogotes of Pinar del Río, don't let this post be just a glance.

body.body:
homocysteine lactate pyruvate tricarboxylic acid citric cycle nac N-acetylcysteine menopause estrogen metabolic

Menopause initiates significant metabolic shifts, often characterized by rising homocysteine levels, altered energy metabolism (pyruvate/lactate/TCA cycle), and increased oxidative stress due to declining estrogen. N-acetylcysteine (NAC) acts as a crucial, versatile intervention in this context by boosting glutathione (antioxidant) levels, reducing cardiovascular risk, and supporting mitochondrial function. 

1. Homocysteine and Menopause

Rising Levels: Plasma homocysteine (Hcy) concentrations increase after menopause, contributing to cardiovascular risk, endothelial dysfunction, and cognitive decline.

Estrogen's Role: Estrogen promotes homocysteine metabolism. Its decline causes higher Hcy levels (hyperhomocysteinemia).

Cardiovascular Link: Elevated Hcy is an independent risk factor for atherosclerosis, often exacerbated by low estrogen. Hormone replacement therapy (HRT) can reduce these elevated Hcy levels, confirming the link. 

2. Metabolic Shifts: Pyruvate, Lactate, and TCA Cycle 
Energy Dysfunction: Menopause causes a shift in glucose metabolism, particularly in the brain, often leading to reduced energy production and increased inflammation.

Pyruvate/Lactate Shift: The decline in estrogen can lead to reduced efficiency in pyruvate dehydrogenase (PDH) activity, which converts pyruvate to Acetyl-CoA for the Tricarboxylic Acid (TCA) cycle. This increases pyruvate conversion to lactate.

TCA Cycle Changes: The Tricarboxylic Acid (TCA) cycle (or Krebs cycle) produces energy (ATP). Menopause can disrupt this process, resulting in less efficient oxidation of fuel sources.

Metabolic Syndrome: These shifts contribute to metabolic syndrome, increased visceral fat, and weight gain. 

3. N-Acetylcysteine (NAC) as a Metabolic Modulator 
Glutathione Precursor: NAC is a key precursor for glutathione, which protects against the oxidative stress generated by high homocysteine and broken-down metabolic pathways.

Metabolic Improvement: Studies show NAC can improve body mass index, fasting insulin, and lipid profiles.

Hormonal Balance: NAC influences key markers of hormonal balance, potentially easing the transition, particularly for conditions like PCOS.

Neuroprotective: NAC supports cognitive resilience and brain health during the hormonal shifts of perimenopause. 

Summary of Interplay
In the postmenopausal state, low estrogen leads to high homocysteine, which, coupled with impaired pyruvate/TCA cycle efficiency, leads to high lactate and reduced cellular energy. NAC acts to break this cycle by enhancing glutathione production to alleviate oxidative damage from high homocysteine and supporting mitochondrial efficiency to improve metabolic, hormonal, and cognitive health.

body.title: The perfect counter
body.body:
![temp1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23wMexaFPz13XsjGJxCydTqowxiapq6UuVMpzfSWyLpM2nA9yrs9RM7MbeyHQizkFu5cK.jpg)
Hey everyone, while I have some spare time let's make another Splinterlands post to make up for my week of absence. 😆 Depending on your playing style it can depend whether you even see what the other team likes to play and has played a lot on the previous five battles, some names I just recognize because I see them on a regular basis, that's the nice thing about a smaller player base while playing in a certain league I guess. 😃 When I see this name, it reminds me this person likes to use Tofu and I don't even have to see the previous battles but it's nice when it's confirmed there of course, there's also a player that uses Lorkus in every chance they get, good to know and to remember... 😈
![teeth banner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23w2kqTN8gBpWz7rz7ZmFQEDWAiPGQLJues1o7u42f9bzzU4qSUaFjgPSVQRN5NV5UDFV.png)
# Thick Skinned Melee Only
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/EoCbKhDgv4QfsshGbeTxVDVLjxyKnurT6ZcPMnxNrHELk7xEHe3C8BwPv9nW7KbaYFZ.png)
So this ruleset combination was an interesting one, we could only make use of melee units but at the same time all units will receive the *Shield* ability, in this case it's important to remember that the damage is rounded up, so if you can choose units that have 3 to 5 damage so when it gets halved by the *Shield* ability, it will still hit with 2 or 3 damage. With only 18 mana the options were very limited to begin with and if you expect Tofu to kill your team with the use of *Thorns*, there's only one answer: Elias / Slade, who isn't harmed by *Thorns* because of it's *Deflection Shield* ability.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23wCJXtvQBF9P5WE8qN4WwtRp8Y11tix4JqSHJA5EVgiG8RQthSR142xjxX9ZQnYDb1KW.png)
Without magic, Slade is a formidable tank both offensive with it's high attack power as defensive with the high armor and health points and being really fast helps him in dodging many attacks, with most of the enemy units only have 1 or 2 speed, they will have a hard time hitting Slade in this battle.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23wCJTTJoCS2ZcweETWzjbk9dJGfkDQtpaDo2imdqcmAVe9fQMYujuQ2r8ohNnSdmRVoM.png)
Because of the *Shield* ruleset the damage is halved and it took a round before Slade could start killing units,my Frigid Wolf did a nice job in keeping Buttercup Mauler busy until Slade was done with killing the front line, after that he couldn't be touched and it was all misses!
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23vsWveZTfCL8ZsNMxLGVpENYmcU6PpsJBstSQWWBYnZZFytAXeKC3NvW7UrqAKy7yMBq.png)
Just like with countering Mylor with a full Magic / Archer squad back in the day, countering Tofu is always satisfying. 😄
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23w2B31cXHn7chia4T6ETeqdp5cTAu65LDqnNtWyEesCGrmc39wvHKJw9cZuwBQPZ7GCo.png)
[You can watch the battle unfold for yourself here. ](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_db5d022d3f86214ebfa6a11d02af3f8d?ref=nozem)
![splinterlands banner.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmagiEh4dRsLX9ZHCSzcach2kTjRd6FGc8HgRaGZRcosAf/splinterlands%20banner.png) Thank you for reading!!! If you haven't made an account already, please consider using my [referral link](https://splinterlands.com?ref=nozem01) to sign up, let me know if you have done so and I can help you with any questions you have and personally guide you. Have a great day! ![splinterlands banner1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSqdyFkiNYaGrPfycJqPhfWZv8FixAPR8MpruQkMFrRo4/splinterlands%20banner1.png)
