body.title: Keine Kinder als Chance: Durch Geburtenknick zur Klimarettung
body.body: >Die Politik preist seit Jahren den Vorteil hoher Geburtenraten. Dabei bietet das Schrumpfen für das Klima viel bessere Chancen.

> 

In der EU sinken die Geburtenraten der meisten Mitgliedsstaaten seit Jahren. Das stellt die Gemeinschaft vermeintlich vor große Herausforderungen. Vom langsamen Aussterben ist die Rede und von der Notwenigkeit, die fehlende eigene Bevölkerung durch verstärkte Zuwanderung zu ersetzen. Die Potenziale, die im Schrumpfen stecken, werden hingegen häufig negiert, ignoriert und in der öffentlichen Debatte vollkommen totgeschwiegen. Aussterben hat einen  negativen Beigeschmack, Politiker sprechen gern von einer \
, statt den demografischen Wandel als Chance zu sehen.

>Eine positive Triebkraft 

Experten fordern jetzt aber eine strategische Debatte, um die Folgen des Bevölkerungsrückgangs zu gestalten und als positive Triebkraft zu nutzen. Satt auf Staaten wie Frankreich und Bulgarien zu schauen, zwei der wenigen EU-Länder, in denen im Jahr 2023 mehr Babys auf die Welt kamen als im Jahr zuvor, gelte es, einen eigenen weg zu gehen. \

, empfiehlt der Migrations- und Klimafroscher Herbert Haase. Sondern darüber nachdenken, woran es in Deutschland noch fehlt, um das allmähliche Aussterben als naturgegebenes Schicksal zu akzeptieren, das der gesamten Menschheit einen Dienst erweist.

Herbert Haase widerspricht damit den üblichen politischen Parolen, mit denen jeder Hinweis auf einen
(Ursula von der Leyen) gefeiert, Zahlen zu sinkenden Geburtenraten aber als Desaster dargestellt würden. \
>Herbert Haase eine Konditionierung, die Politik und Medien über Jahre vorgenommen hätten.

>Falsche Weichenstellungen 

Sie übertrage den Wunsch, den Regierungen durch ihre

>Öffentlichkeitsarbeit über Jahrzehnte hinweg geweckt und genährt haben, auf die breite Masse, obwohl es dem Einzelnen vollkommen egal sein könne, ob er in einem Land mit drei, zehn oder 300 Millionen Bürgern lebe. Wichtig sei die Größe des verfügbaren Humankapitalstocks ausschließlich für Regierungen, die aus der Masse ihre Armeen rekrutieren. \
Zwar freuten sich Politiker heute zeitweise auch, wenn fehlender Nachwuchs die Lage in Kindertagesstätten und Schulen kurzzeitig entspanne, weil das den Druck auf politische Entscheider mindere. \
Dabei zeigen Beispiele wie das Frankreichs oder Bulgariens, dass selbst dort, wo es nicht ganz schlimm steht,

>keine Besserung erwartet werden darf. Trotz einer vergleichsweise hohen Geburtenrate von 1,8 können auch diese beiden EU-Staaten ihre Bevölkerung selbst nicht mehr reproduzieren. Mit jeder Generation schrumpft durch die geringere Zahl an Geburten die Zahl der verfügbaren Frauen. Weniger Frauen bekommen noch weniger Kinder, weil sie einfach nicht da sind. Selbst wenn die Verbleibenden nicht mehr 1,8, sondern 1,9 oder gar zwei Kinder bekommen würden, hält das Schrumpfen unausweichlich an.

>Schrumpfen als Chance 

Noch viel weniger aber können es Staaten aufhalten, die mit noch weniger Nachwuchs auskommen müssen. In der EU stehen Mitgliedsländer wie Malta mit 1,06 Kinder pro Frau oder Italien, Spanien und Polen mit 1,19 bis 1,33 vor einer Perspektive, die dazu führen wird, dass sich die Bevölkerungszahl binnen eines halben Jahrhunderts glatt halbiert. Nicht anders sieht es in Litauen, Lettland, Estland, Portugal und Deutschland aus. Bis zum Jahr 2070 werden alle diese Länder die Hälfte ihrer Bevölkerung verloren haben. Für die gesamte EU prognostizieren Berechnungen, die die Froscher am CWI angestellt haben, das aus 440 Millionen Bürgern nur noch 250 bis 270 geworden sein werden.

Deutschland wird ganz vor dabei sein. Hier sterben seit 1972 jedes Jahr mehr Menschen als geboren werden. Die Fertilitätsrate, die beschreibt, wie viele Kinder Frauen im Durchschnitt bekommen, sank zuletzt auf nur noch 1,35 - Mann und Frau als zwei Eltern müssten zwei Kinder bekommen, um sich zu reproduzieren. Sie bekommen derzeit aber nur 1,35. Das heißt, dass aus 200 Personen innerhalb einer Generation 135 werden. Aus denen bei Beibehaltung der Fertilitätsrate binnen einer weiteren Generation nur noch 75 geworden sein werden.

>Stolz auf das Defizit 

Das permanente Geburtendefizit, das Europas Zentralmacht seit mehr als 50 Jahren plagt, hat sich zuletzt noch einmal verstärkt. Allein im vergangenen Jahr schrumpfte die Stammbevölkerung durch einen Sterbeüberhang um 327.000 Menschen. Allein die lange Zeit steigende Lebenserwartung fängt die statistischen Effekte des starken Geburtenrückgangs der vergangenen Jahrzehnte noch auf: Läge die
>durchschnittliche Lebenserwarung heute noch dort, wo sie 1972 war, lebten heute nicht 84 Millionen Menschen im Land, sondern nur 78 Millionen. Statt einer
>Alterung der deutschen Bevölkerung gäbe es bereits seit Jahren den

>Beginn ihres Aussterbens zu betrachten, selbst die als Gegenmaßnahme durch die damalige Bundeskanzlerin Angela Merkel eingeleitete Zuwanderung hätte die Bevölkerungsgröße nicht stabil halten können.

Für Herbert Haase wäre das aber beileibe kein Beinbruch. Der Wissenschaftler, der am Climate Watch Institute (CWI) im sächsischen Grimma zu den Folgen des Klimawandels auf die öffentliche Bewertung sozialistischer und anthroposophischer Ideen forscht, sieht in niedrigen Fertilitätsraten vor allem einen Weg, wie Deutschland und Europa ihre Klimaziele erreichen können. Eine möglichst geringe Zahl an Geburten sei der Schlüssel zur nachhaltigen Senkung des Kohlendioxidausstoßes, sagt er.

>Halbierung in 50 Jahren 

Berechnungen zeigen, dass eine Geburtenrate von 1,32 Kindern pro Frau bedeute,  dass ein Land seine Einwohnerzahl in nicht einmal 50 Jahren halbieren könne. \
, umreißt Haase die Dimension. Das sei eine sehr gute Nachricht für das Klima. \

Für eine kontroverse Diskussionen, wie sie die sinkenden Geburtenraten in Deutschland immer wieder auslösen, sieht der Wissenschaftler keinen Grund. Die jüngst überstandene Personalkrise in Kindertagesstätten sieht er als Hinweis darauf, dass im demografischen Wandel mehr Chance als Gefahren stecken. Es gehe jetzt darum, das durch politische Maßnahmen ohnehin nicht mehr zu stoppende Schrumpfen als ökologische Gelegenheit zu nutzen.  \
, sagt Haase. Berechnungen zeigen: Je mehr die Bevölkerungsanzahl zurückgeht, desto kräftiger sinken die Emissionen.

>Wandel proaktiv steuern 

Wichtig sei allerdinsg, den unausweichlichen Wandel proaktiv zu steuern und zu gestalten. \

, prognostiziert Haase. Um aber die positiven Effekte tatsächlich zu nutzen, müssten einige flankierende Maßnahmen ergriffen werden, die längst überfällig seien. 

Hart geht der Wissenschaftler die Migrationstrategie der Bundesregeirungen der zurückliegenden Jahre an. Die habe viele positive Folgen der niedrigen geburtenraten schlichtweg zunichtegemacht. \

, verdeutlicht er die Dimension des Problems. Zuwanderung habe Bevölkerungsrückgang in Deutschland nicht nur abgemildert, sondern ihn zumindest kurzzeitig in ein starkes Bevölkerngswachstum verwandelt. Dadurch seien viele Klimabemühungen konterkariert worden.

Menschen, die aus heimatländern kamen, deren Pro-Kopf-Ausstoß an Klimagift weit unter dem der Deutschen liegt, seien gezwungen worden,  sich in das besonders klimaschädliche deutsche Lebensmodell zu integrieren. Vier bis sechs Millionen Menschen wurden dadurch binnen weniger Jahre zu sogenannten CO2-Superspreadern. \
Für Haase ist es höchste Zeit, politisch endlich umzusteuern. Eine schrumpfende Bevölkerung sei die preiswerteste Art des Klimaschutzes, sagt der Wissenschaftler. \
Statt sich gegen den Trend zu stemmen, müssten die Entscheidnungsträger in Brüssle und Berlin die Dimension ihrer Aufgabe erkennen.

, weist Haase auf einen wichtigen Nebenaspekt hin. Statt mit hunderten von Milliarden Euro Schuldengeld Brücken, Straßen, Schulen und andere Teile der kritischen Infrastruktur aufwendig zu sanieren und womöglich sogar neu zu bauen, verlange ein tieferes Verständnis der demografischen Krise, die Umfeldbedigungen rechtzeitig an eine schrumpfende Gesellschaft anzupassen.

\

, ist Herbert Haase sicher. Schulen werden keine Schüler mehr haben und geschlossen werden können. Wohngebäude werden ungenutzt bleiben, weil es keine Nachmieter mehr gibt. Das Phänomen der Entvölkerung werde sich in allen gesellscjaftlichen Bereiche zeigen. \

>Berufe ohne Zukunft 

Die Lage in den Kindertagesstätten, die nach 2015 mit großem Aufwand personell aufgerüstet worden waren, zeige, wohin falsche Weichenstellungen führen. \

Inzwischen zeige sic aber, dass eine junger Erzieher eine deutlich längere Standzeit im Berufsleben habe als ein zu betreuendes Kind. 

\
Dier werde sich in den kommenden Jahren durch die Schulen bis nach oben  in die Universitäten fressen. \

>Abbauen, Zurückbauen, Schumpfen 

Haase prädiert für eine anderen Ansatz. Abbauen, Zurückbauen, Schumpfen. Es gebe keine Gefahr, dass eines Tages wieder mehr Kinder geboren werden, vielmehr zeige das Beispiel Südkoreas, welche Pespektive Deutschland habe. Dort liege Geburtenrate pro Frau im Moment schon bei 0,75 Kindern, vier Personen bringen damit nur noch anderthalb Kinder zur Welt. \
, sagt Herbert Haase. Binnen von nur einer Generation werde die Einwohnerzahl des Landes um fast zwei Drittel sinken. \

Denn keine noch so ausgeklügelte Technologie kann auch nur ähnliche Potenziale heben wie das Schrumpfen der Bevölkerung. Das gehe vollkommen kostenlos vonstatten, es benötigekeine Investitionen in teure Wasserstoffkraftwerke oder CO2-Verpressungstechnologien. \

body.title: 𝑺𝒉𝒆'𝒔 𝑮𝒐𝒏𝒏𝒂 𝑩𝒆 𝑨 𝑴𝒂𝒎𝒂𝒄𝒊𝒕𝒂
body.body:
>


Every little gift comes from a place of love. A smile, a helping hand, bouquets and even a simple dress. 



Kindness has been my mantra since I was a child and in any little way I can help ease one's burden, you'll always find me lending a hand. 



Fast forward to the reason of this post. A genuine gift I gave Sochi. 

That morning, she called to inform me she was pregnant. Sochi got married three years ago, and she has dreamed to be a mumicita.


According to her, she has tried to conceive, all to no avail but this year there was shift in the air. My beautiful friend is now pregnant. 


The excitement in her voice still rings a bell in my head. \

Sochi lives very far from me, but I wasn't bothered by the distance. I swung into action. Sochi would be needing lots of bubu, but one for a start to congratulate her for this goodnews. ![IMG_20260427_151105_651.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/Eou8Jpnfpr9eUmEPcjoujTUa77H8wgkjwUMgatUccQACL7WpW9gNWQkQh8nQtdop5De.jpg) I had an Adire crepe somewhere in the office which I wanted to use to make Palazzo pants for myself because I love this design, but obviously it would look even better on a Bubu for Sochi, so why not make one for her. ![IMG_20260427_151139_633.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/Ep1WNXjLrWhTYB1HWa6GRXG5MLy43dJW43u7dKQnoKCFhyEVRYEiJdMWCyK4L5fBfmz.jpg) To even think that green was her favorite color, made the gift even more thoughtful. So I cut the Bubu into four, cut out the neck added a lemon green crepe I had and made magics with my hands. ![IMG_20260427_151131_174.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/Eoc6W7GT7jF5swmQYoB74dXmVBpf9re5NNGzCgDbNbXAAQyCcg4pJTGsiyb3uvqiY6o.jpg) I honestly will recreate this for myself too, I absolutely love it. ![IMG_20260427_090351_580.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/23yd5eJSQUNMB9iXr91QjGvNJMR4v3XbPrBxm7qFh9rSfmtvEDUH35gciufyf47RhTGMr.jpg) It's simple yet elegant. Everything speaks freedom, class and beauty. ![IMG_20260427_090358_154.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/23xVMSNVrpPArQ1Q2NHJ6pSraKDb1eFJx2thuZT8RjSBruwHETgh3wfNH3jgwmdyjWdF2.jpg) Let me take you around the different views of this outfit. ![IMG_20260427_090329_374.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/23x176gLEkSfA6TWZgECbdbo9ENiYohkqyHDmb2veq4XsGBUhQqJpeHNfNYiNnzit3cRe.jpg) Up close views, side views and all. ![IMG_20260427_090323_251.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/23xehtXrGR6sH2FQK65X76Zbzf3cWJLoxkcmN32jqDzxQn43DFwifBMpHK4fY49M3YDjy.jpg) It's beautiful. I called her to inform her I had a surprise for her, she was too excited, even though she had no idea what on world I was about to goft her, she knew I always come correct. ![IMG_20260427_090246_837.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/23wMaSsELRa9umn8Wnr1F5WUijWSpjN3VnKuzBumzi8R1APrztSjyLTUPsDmAkwYE5yoV.jpg) I'll be delivering this parcel today and I can't wait to see her reaction. Every little win deserves to be celebrated. I've learned to celebrate people now they are here, not when they are gone. Would you rock this outfit too? ![IMG_20260427_090219_593.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/23xAY3WVxeiuQ6FX5svvtXBzbjTAsTC4XunrKSdAF6HJgwRbVewK1L9YL1awQB98uFcoA.jpg) ____

body.title: Life Is A Game Are You A Player, Or An Observer?
body.body: >I have not written here for a very long time. School and life really pulled me away. For some days now I have tried coming back, but making a post has been really difficult because I don't know where to start. But today, I have decided to write gibberish at exactly 5 am. This is the time I wake up everyday, sometimes even earlier. It's the time I'm most calm. And it's the only time I get to sit, think and decide without a sound from my neighbours. It's just me, and the sounds from early birds. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQeqFUykfMnRqTzMWUaNjE1kAd7UCJbdhNmnmX6gEMAwR/1777357755452.jpg) This year I really wanted to figure out my life. I'm smiling now because I thought it would be easy. But it’s been a rollercoaster of learning new habits, ideas, skills, and at the end, I’m still confused about which path to really follow. The internet is supposed to help, it does help actually, but very little if you're not specific about what you want. The lesson I learned here is; continuous learning without action is wasted potential. It doesn't change anything if you don't practice the things you learn. I learned a lot, and I observed a lot too. I came to agree that life is a game. We are introduced to it from the day we were born. And as we grow we get to decide wether to be an active player, or an observer. Observers don't fail, it's the safest choice. All you have to do is watch others; support them if you can, criticise them if they do something wrong, watch them fail and thank God you aren't the one because you can't imagine yourself in such a pathetic situation. Observers are very content with whatever they have. It’s a comfortable way to exist. But the players. They go through a lot. They fight both their own demons (procrastination, fear, trauma, family background, pains, all the inevitable negativity you could think of), and the demons from the outside (the forces from the world which we have little to no control over). Players don't have the luxury of time to overthink, they act. They take risk. They move even when they're uncertain. And that is scary as hell. Players learn to be tough, so that they don't break. They'd rather bend, incur injuries, cry, roll in the mud and still dust themselves up because it's a game, they can't imagine optioning out when there's still time to make a difference. They know the game doesn't end unless you want it to. Unless God wants it to. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbUuCQUr5Gq55g2BxiHLXcZ8yzoW62uVEnodor5upCapj/1777357810344.jpg) Being a player is not comfortable because you get to fail, sometimes even more than you win. The worse part is that, just like every game with winners and losers, some players get to lose at the end. Some give up along the way, and some cheat. Some people were born into already won game. Nepotism. Some had to continue fighting from where their ancestors stopped. Some even get to start from the beginning. It's funny. What makes this interesting, though, is that there's a lot of entertainment in between. The movies we watch, the social activities, music, dramas, etc. So while there's a serious game going on, you also get to chill and be happy. If you're reading this, I’m curious—are you getting where I’m coming from, or am I just rambling? I mean, am I making sense at all? I'm really sorry you had to read this.😂🙏 Anyway, that’s where I am right now. Life’s a game, and I’m still figuring out how to play. But I’ve actually figured out that life is unpredictable, challenging, and definitely interesting. And that’s something worth embracing, right? - - - The photos are mine.

body.title: 会议上领导发飙
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![hKT9aNcLhBSejykD_IMG_20260428_134451.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/hKT9aNcLhBSejykD_IMG_20260428_134451/hKT9aNcLhBSejykD_IMG_20260428_134451.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

多年不背书，如今再拎起一本94页的书本又能记住多少。当领导说我们需要把这本《书香校园建设方案》读懂并吃透它时，我也只能大致翻阅，脑海里有个初始的印象。

峰会结束后，领导临时通知让我们每个人都要上台演讲，情景模拟再现。在面对客户时该如何以《全民阅读》的方案落地到学校层面，我们能为学校提供什么服务。并且罗列了几个要点，如：什么是书香校园，建设的目的是什么？学校要做哪些工作等等。带着这些疑问我们直接问了AI，AI给出了一系列的答案再进行优化转换成自己的语言，因为这本书实在是背不下来。

就在各自为演讲准备稿子时，结果今天领导让我们直接脱稿演讲，活脱脱成了口才秀，大家直接蒙圈。

排在前面的几位男同事都还讲的不错，虽有断层但总体还算到位与满意，也许是刚开始说领导未发现问题，紧接着后面的演讲越来越挑剔，直接现场答疑，看个人的反应程度。有几位同事由于支支吾吾不够利索被扣上不认真学习的帽子，要求下次重新演讲。这其中的几人全部是我们大区的业务高手，背书对她们来说着实为难，但这丝毫不影响业务的开展。

接着是另一位同事上台，该同事尤其在我们的业绩中名列前茅，与经理的关系也很好，本地人的优势，经理需要什么帮助他都能想到路子。对领导也是关怀备至，这里的“关怀”不用细说懂得都懂。

但这位同事常常早退，上午上完班下午就不见人影，开会开到一半也偷溜出去，出差也时常躲家里打麻将，但人家的业务丝毫不受影响，客情关系也非常好。每次团队需要出业绩时，他总能出几笔大订单。

像他这样连正常的班都不好好上的人，哪里还能讲出这么专业的话术来，随便说了几句就被领导叫停了，一惯纵容他的经理，这回竟然狠狠骂了他，说他整天迟到早退，也不好好学习，再这样下去容不下他，直接让他回家。这位同事被他说的面红耳赤，就回了句：“好的。”

看来经理最近心情不好，连销冠都容不下，不过这位同事平时从不好好上班，能被领导这样说也不足为奇。

轮到我独白的时候很紧张，刚开始也对着稿子念了一段，后来直接脱稿，讲完之后领导表示满意，同意我这个方案，但是又给我抛出了难题：现在就坐的是各年级的分管领导，面对各年级应该如何采取方案措施。其实我上面的解说已经覆盖到了，如今来个现场直播我绞尽脑汁想了一些，显然还不足以服众。我肯定不是专业的指导老师，我只是牵线搭桥的而已。后来我说另外派出专业团队给学校出谋划策引得全场大笑。

确实，我们有更专业的讲师团队，我们只是业务的引领者，一句实话引得一直紧张的氛围一下缓和了许多，领导说我还得继续学习，剩下的几位同事就有福了，不用再赘述了，三个小时的会议如坐针毡的结束了。

---

body.title: Giftings without bias intentions,..test of charity!
body.body:
Hai, Community, good morning,

This is my responding to the weekly prompt of this week in our adorable community, @hivereachout, 

**prompt contest #97, The test of charity?**

Test Of Charity, is the documented evidence of givings without negativity in the minds and actions of the givers to hurt  receivers.

**The test of Charity to me is the proof, or  the evidence of the charity work being carried out by an individual or a group of chritable organizations, or voluntary groups to the indigent people, or to the vonurable people they are giving their gifts to. Finding out the standard of the givers hearts and the gifts they are giving out to others. These are to be tested and proven before they could be allowed to begin their givings to others**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT2d8gufdqQtUjGtJmrrecCghKD7JpG9v6qNmTPpot5Fs/1777356791634.jpg)

**The test of charity is a documented evidence of what and how the charity work is being carried out. Is it being done to still respect the human dignity or are there abusive patterns being administered to these people in pretences of charity givings**

**The work of charity must be administered in a clear mind of free giving, being a helping hands to those that are suffering from one human degregation or another. There must not be a secret turture to them at all. For me, this is the test of charity work for anyone or even charity organizations or voluntary charity workers everywhere all around the world. World health organization inclusive. This is the standard**

Charity as we all know is the process of someone, a group of people, known as charitable organizations, or a volunteered group, world health organization (W H O), giving free gifts items to the indigent people, wherever they are found. It could be in refugee camps,  in the war tone zones of the world, it could be in the Internally Displaced Person's camps within the country, Nigeria. It could also be the sick people in the hospitals, it could be to the people in the prisons all around us. Just gifting them freely is called and known as charity.

Charity are voluntary givings of important needs of life to the less privileged people without expecting anything in return for yourself. Free giftings of lives most important items, mostly to the people or groups of people you don't even know but you are touched in your heart to help them live better lives than you had met them.

These items mostly are food, crooked meals, uncooked food items, clothes, water for drinking, homes, it could be in camps, permanent cites, or homes, medical treatments of all kinds, ranging from eye check ups by qualified Doctors, cesarian sections to people that need such. Many people have been revived, restored and get back to their perfect health and life by these volunteery organizations and that's what makes the world go round... The act of showing and rendering kindness to the people that need them the most is charity.

This is my response to this week's prompt contest.
**\

body.title: Yogyakarta Diary - Meeting My Students, Mont Blanc, Surveying Land
body.body:
![Jakarta (4).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23uFRYMa52DEEVWhFQydioAVvTD6QDX2rVuWEg3twMARncTo1qPesnXjhRKgeHpGZ4eZi.png) Having relocated away from Yogyakarta, I’ve managed to keep my connection and network in this city. Both Magelang and Yogyakarta have quietly become my second home these days. Yet this particular visit felt a little special because I got to meet my students offline.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23tRxSJgcwCWKqvkWbmueLkE95Uotizkrp9vcTTsSEppYfMwGDYhV8UjMq1zPh7LLwx3s.jpeg)
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23uaKgjWF4yXGPcftTeXfrWAskZjk5UQ89mgbC2DhYdkQuXGY1CNJdJusT1TBEYyejWcN.jpeg)
My journey started from Madiun, where the branch office is located. From there, I took the train ride and eventually reached Yogyakarta around 1 PM. We were planning to have a meet up in the Kota Baru area in a cafe called Bura-Bura. Kota Baru is the trendiest area in Yogyakarta offering cafes that cater to Gen Z and Gen Alpha. It has a certain charm and aesthetic to it. When I was there, I ordered their Mont Blanc Coffee, the latest craze in the Indonesian coffee scene. Mont blanc is basically a combination of cold brew with a foam on top and typically flavored. It’s quite a refreshing drink that you can in most cafe these days.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23wgQHeiQhtmuTry9M3gQTpTYexA6NkLn1mvPr2ykYfbtm3a7mkmixLnuthmA6we4MZGF.jpeg)
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23xyLpRR12uTLYodmHXzQto2rBPDRcz97rGm9CXgpCncES9U8vbrCMfREcs1J4piXy6EH.jpeg)
After that, the group and I were checking out the photobooth inside the cafe. These days, many cafes offer this service and is a highlight of a trendiest cafe in town. I had fun taking pictures with them until it was time for me to meet my mother’s staff.

body.title: Movie Review: The Manipulated
body.body:
Seriously, I've watched a lots of Korean dramas, name it, whether it’s the heart-racing intensity of action, the mind-bending suspense of horror, or the emotional rollercoaster of romance, I've watched a lot of Korean dramas and I always choose base on my mood. But sometimes, a show comes along that hits a little differently. That’s what happened when I watched The Manipulated (2025). Korean action-thriller starring Ji Chang-wook and Do Kyung-soo, and it left me thinking about some pretty heavy stuff, particularly when it comes to manipulation, revenge, and how far people can go for justice.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSVuPerR318jCWrZaBp61MbCJfaiGpfkmCkZdD6u774T1/1000208935.png 

The drama centers around Taejoong ( Ji Chang-wook), a regular guy whose life completely unravels after being framed for a murder by a psychopathic architect, An Yohan (Do Kyung-soo). Yohan is the kind of character you love to hate no matter what, he’s calculating, cold, and seems to get off on ruining people’s lives. What follows is a gritty revenge story where Taejoong is pushed to the edge and has to fight for his life. It's intense, suspenseful, and at times over the top. The atmosphere really keeps me hooked from start to finish. But beyond the action and drama, it also taught me some valuable lessons.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZRvswLHLTnSVcdJRQZHfuBKKz7xoVj7jDENouiH5SGMX/1000208937.png 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPdHrwe2yA7NoZ7rjppCoT3LrARkk5WiRnmuRYsWa9Kwo/1000208939.png 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTeTo6yHaQqMrAxomsJXCWru1qrGJ1WWn92J6YVV9jNSJ/1000208938.png 


The first thing that really hit me while watching The Manipulated was how quickly someone can be manipulated when they’re in a vulnerable spot. Taejoong is a good guy, just trying to live his life, and suddenly, he’s thrust into a situation where everything he thought he knew gets flipped on its head. The drama really makes me think about how easily trust can be taken advantage of, especially when someone has more power over the situation. Watching Taejoong try to figure out who to trust, and how to fight back against a person who controls everything from the shadows, felt like a wake-up call.

What I took away from this is the importance of self-awareness. In life, we often get caught up in other people’s narratives, whether it is work, relationships, or even society’s expectations. But The Manipulated really made me reflect on how important it is to trust your own instincts and question everything. Sometimes the people you think you can trust the most are the ones who can hurt you the most.

Then there's the whole revenge aspect. Taejoong’s journey is a perfect example of how revenge, while satisfying at first, can start to take a toll on you. It’s easy to root for him in the beginning because who wouldn’t want to see the guy who’s been wronged get payback? But as the series goes on, I start to see the darker side of his quest for justice. He becomes more and more consumed by it, and I realize that revenge isn’t as sweet as it seems. In fact, it starts to change him, blur his lines between right and wrong.

It made me think about how sometimes, when we’ve been hurt, it’s easy to get fixated on making someone else feel the same way. But The Manipulated shows that revenge isn’t just about the other person, it also changes you in ways you might not expect. It's a tough reminder that while we all want justice, sometimes the cost of seeking it can be higher than we think.

But what really stood out to me was Taejoong’s resilience. Throughout the show, he faces some incredibly harsh situations, but he never backs down. His ability to keep pushing forward, even when it seems like there is no hope left, is something that I think we can all learn from. It made me realize that no matter how difficult things get, there is always a way to fight back, whether it’s against an unfair system, a toxic relationship, or even your own doubts. Taejoong's journey is a reminder that staying true to yourself and finding the strength to keep going can make all the difference.

The Manipulated has a lot to offer. It’s more than just a revenge tale, it’s a story about trust, resilience, and the cost of justice. It made me think about the power of manipulation and how important it is to stay grounded and true to who we are. It’s a pretty wild ride, but it's also got lessons that stick with with me long after the final episode.

**Thank for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

body.title: Hive Philippines Travel and Nature Photography #1141 - by Allmonitors
body.body:
#1141 - Shots During Mount Pulag Hike for Tuesday. 

A joyful Tuesday our amazing Hive family everywhere! I hope this day finds you healthy and motivated. May your Tuesday be filled with inspiration, good coffee and friendly interactions. You are doing great so keep shining bright😉. 

Now for our daily shots when the clock was 1 AM and the cold air bit at our skin as we started preparing for the big hike to Pulag. We were at the ranger station filled with adrenaline. My wife, my good friend Dandreb and our two other gay friends were ready. 
![1000019318.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/Eo6DE1DhrPwtKx4weSwqvsa1KzqiAaMAj3L3D6Fs1RjrXXBAbs9GJ6RFpHyekx711wj.jpg)

We put on thick jackets, bonnets and gloves, all knowing that the temperature at the top would be colder. We made sure our bags were packed with water and snacks and our flashlights as we needed them to cut through the total darkness of the mountain from 1am til dawn.
![1000019312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/241tWq2qtBoVqAhzG4AYfBppQbvVTejB22uCGc5Qc9swsg18gygQwvQXibSMNoXeTg5C1.jpg)

![1000019315.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tvY8Gu4hoJQsxoXMr4L1s84LaEByYj2Txowj4xtjvLQi2T8GXMHZ3Nq2Rz7UFWKV9Zz.jpg)

As we stepped out of the shelter to start the ascent, the world was dark and black. The only things we could see were the small circles of light cast by our flashlights and those who were ahead of us. We walked in a single file. 
![1000019332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tv8hkvgMzJpR7oVRdFsuSMbK7XmvuGBHHC2qquzx8hE5otr1kcjhfaD4nx7HQG9kTvv.jpg)

![1000019323.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tvAjQg1NnXSHEL82JNnfpYeL6x3gH3TwaoQL6wjSKt4ZgVnn4KkWzxjsK3eQCSgnrcF.jpg)

The hike was steep and challenging and the air got thinner and colder. We were breathing heavily with our warm breaths creating small clouds. Despite the physical exertion, our friends were cracking jokes and keeping everyone's spirits high which helped push away the fatigue.
![1000018268.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23uQfcK7eWjZNg8w8ibTgzAPeTdkve84GAUNapzNKZBSEN7PQJBdkgfQ8JMoEeoHzRPbM.jpg)

After several hours of trekking through the dark, we finally reached the summit of Mount Pulag. It was still dark with the sunrise was still a while away but we had made it. The feeling of relief was overwhelming. 
![1000019341.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tvD1YWJBKHBwpGXEaWuq37BhLKJGCCCHCTKriVXKPKbJ9x5VysJCtKUh9tYj9Pc6EWN.jpg)

![1000019326.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tRsvdrQpZHxv6rwotxbzaL388rV24XJGUhp1BERyXKChXE1C6i7pZaUVPx8E4hC3sq9.jpg)

However, as soon as we stopped moving, it was incredibly cold. The wind was strong and cutting right through our layers of clothes. We huddled close together, trying to share body heat to keep warm.
![1000019347.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tRv7P1GJDjirtC2rbNXzjzBkF8AXSoMiLB6yXNLW2sGU1655SbwLSfPhcdNQKjBBP9A.jpg)

There were stars everywhere, scattered across the vast darkness like diamonds. We stood there in the freezing cold, shivering. 
![1000019350.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/EoGyMD6YoDxrJVzp86vGCBysXmjrqGChGTHG7ueRi2Qxc5AEc1F8a8KKV2Xx7iVkwRH.jpg)

![1000019344.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tkmuQH1Q64CrGTHy3ycxp7m1rpvwj9xTrHGwLAHGSLVH4SbS6oUkYHJrnhzzh3ZoX6U.jpg)

The silence at the summit broken only by the wind. It was a surreal moment standing on the peak of Luzon with my wife, under a blanket of stars while waiting for the sun to rise. 
![1000019338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tv8FLhyCfZqafHcDTwpXAfW9Tv8qhDHr44yFBsMy2gSVT9qJbMWRx85rqLGRJroCqEz.jpg)

![1000019329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23uQLqssVSdDKLV2StHTUpGWrfo9SdJRna2UMw7Pem7Q3HN3kaxqMEuez9o8FwuCVBYCg.jpg)

![1000019335.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tkjcvu3vgtiDrEwCdz1XHc49LaJxcc8tjaWCqVVeCXULjxUxcC85iz7WLQipct1yvh3.jpg)

Follow me on my nature travels.
Shot taken in Kabayan Benguet, Philippines.

<center>Image/s were shot using Samsung Z5 flip phone. ~rex</center>

body.body: Exactly — the Dewar is the insulated jacket, so the experiment is trying to make **heat accounting** tighter, not using the flask as the “control” itself. In the classic setup, the **cell sits in a nearly constant-temperature water bath** or insulated environment, and researchers compare **electrical input** to **thermal output** to see whether there’s any claimed “excess heat” [review](https://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/RothwellJreviewofth.pdf), [overview](https://calteches.library.caltech.edu/3782/1/Goodstein.pdf).  \n\nThe key distinction is that they’re not really comparing “bath temp vs inside temp” in a casual way; they’re using the bath/insulation to reduce heat loss noise so the cell’s heat output can be inferred more reliably [calorimetry explainer](https://vlab.amrita.edu/?sub=8&brch=116&sim=888&cnt=1). That’s the whole point of the Dewar in this context, and it matches the setup we were talking about in [this thread](https://inleo.io/threads/view/askrafiki/re-mes-moi84rp7).

I wish you all the best. I am also well with your prayers. I am healthy with all your family members. For this, I am thanking Allah Almighty a million times. Alhamdulillah.

Friends, today I have come up with a new video for you. The video is a rice eating video, but it is not the way we eat rice naturally, it is a different video. In this video, I have tried to show you a new thing, that is, if the rice cooked the previous day is a little bit sour or a little bit different, we do not eat it with curry, but eat it with green chili, onion or dry chili, etc. and it becomes a very delicious and very interesting dish for all of us.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmehvVuZZmE4HKpcLqhkxB7Qv9PfjZkYuWeBHsrw8AtFvy/1777351571628.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZsbwjE8n6xYP26f9xWmqCDXvgfRwqQvRrRaNmEuVNqqW/1777351571792.jpg)

Friends, I have been wanting to eat rice with green chillies and onions like this for a long time, but after a long time, that opportunity came to me, so today I am preparing to eat rice like this. First of all, I washed some green chillies and some onions in clear water, then I chopped the green chillies and put them in a ball, then I chopped the onions and put them in that ball, then I took a little salt and started to mix the green chillies nicely and I also mixed the onions nicely, I made it very smooth with the help of my hands, then I mixed some pure mustard oil in it and mixed it well again.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZU2vXGZg6nKUw3GUehcF6EG7xnRYrNnAijyt6J6vcCkq/1777351607563.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaQonbUDM1xsbAZTmw7agT2tSKMi4jW9VkyFex1Hj6dYv/1777351607750.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXBY73ZZnZH4yb57U317KLdgoUxQMUBn37S5uYS3Qp1kL/1777351608066.jpg)

Depending on how spicy you like to eat, you should add chili powder. If you like it more spicy, add more chili powder. If you like it less spicy, add less chili powder. I don't like spicy food. But I used a few chili powders here. So, friends, when it was done like this, I left the ingredients I had in that plate in it and mixed it more nicely with my hands so that there was no problem with the chili powder and onion. So, I mixed the rice with the chili powder and onion mixture very neatly and neatly with my hands.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV5KcJaqmvir7KviK3MnyeXrbtGxV4aMsnocPLek78Ds7/1777351637473.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmehvVuZZmE4HKpcLqhkxB7Qv9PfjZkYuWeBHsrw8AtFvy/1777351637644.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZsbwjE8n6xYP26f9xWmqCDXvgfRwqQvRrRaNmEuVNqqW/1777351637760.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR28V8AvkRNRCfgzGGADVLd79pZ2mL7f19G5N8waR4BuP/1777351637891.jpg)

And in this way, the rice kept the day before is cooked with the help of green chillies and onions and becomes a very tasty and delicious dish. I don't know if you have ever eaten this way, but you should definitely try it at home. This is a very tasty dish and many people here in our country prepare food like this, especially in the morning if there is no curry, then we can easily eat rice with the help of green chillies and onions and it becomes a very tasty dish.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWuXvZ3pYEufrQ3mCKcxHY6ftPnhzpME6mzMMR334FpLD/1777351662613.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaQonbUDM1xsbAZTmw7agT2tSKMi4jW9VkyFex1Hj6dYv/1777351663069.jpg)

Friends, you have seen through the video that I am having a lot of fun eating these foods. It was really fun. So friends, who have eaten rice mixed with green chilies and onions like this? Of course, let us know through your comments and let us know how you liked it. But don't forget, of course, you can try making it at home and eat it. It is a very easy and simple method.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXBY73ZZnZH4yb57U317KLdgoUxQMUBn37S5uYS3Qp1kL/1777351684591.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRhZKqScWdBiZXPHJkXMLcdzyhQFiqtRVC633KFdJmR5G/1777351685224.jpg)

So friends, how did you like my today's method of making rice with green chilies and onions? You must encourage me by giving me your important opinions so that I can give you new videos in the future. Everyone, pray for me. I also pray for you. So friends, I will see you later in a new video. Until then, like today, I am saying goodbye to you, wishing you good health. May everyone be well and healthy. May Allah Hafez protect you.

body.title: Challenge #04867-M118: The Seeds of Ghosts
body.body:
![lori-stevens-g3HZha3RfhQ-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/23u632WhdknGU1wBTTeeMsMqNLGY1zFn7Gvjt8x8KvQUX4pSjzL8Xcht1rsqpafVbEWBv.jpg)

> Deep in the boggy fen country, a village where cremation is customary is haunted by specters of the burned dead. These ghosts encroach closer and closer to the realm of the living with each passing night. The Elders send a letter, pleading with Wraithvine for aid against their supernatural tormentors.
> Wraithvine sets out sure that this is caused by some readily explainable phenomenon, either by man-made hoax or mundane magic or perhaps a scorned local God. The Truth is far stranger than even this venerable hero could have imagined… -- [Deathshead419](https://internutter.org/bb/user/deathshead419)

It was odd to find a swamp village where most of the structures were fortification, where sturdy -if wooden- walls were patrolled day and night by clerics working in shifts Where every possible surface of every possible structure was carved and hung about with every possible protection charm.

Well. Ze _had_ needed a haircut for the last millennium. Might as well put it all to good use instead of bunging it in a dimensionally transcendent hairnet.

Ze listened to the mayor's story as the goodwives and children capable of braiding turned Wraithvine's hair into length after length of thin cord. Because of the great need of the village, Wraithvine insisted that they crop hir hair close. Enough to guard each creature, each house, and each foot of the walls around them all.

Freshly shorn, Wraithvine climbed to the top of the wall, and observed the restless dead. Even with the protections surrounding the  area, they were inching slowly closer to the walls. Circling them from dusk until dawn, then stopping once the sun touched them. Staring, motionless, at the town from whence their living souls had come.

Wraithvine turned hir gaze next to the daughter moon, home of hir goddess. Opening hirself to the will and opinion of hir patron deity.

_This is the work of something benevolent,_ said Ereshkygal. _Odd for reanimation. The source is further out into the mire than you can see._ She gave hir a direction, nothing more. 

Wraithvine could feel it in the back of hir mind like a compass. Pointing the way. Hir next step was to leave the warded path and follow that lead. Ze could feel Ereshkygal walking with hir. Inside-behind-beside in the way that only gods _could_.

Their combined presence did not repel the ash-coloured spirits, another odd factor.

Ze quickly found that the internal compass led hir in the same direction as the wandering stream where the village routinely deposited the ashes of the departed. A ritual that had gone on for thousands of years, but the ghosts were an issue for only a handful of them.

The stream led to a small lake that had become a flourishing grove. Bountiful, even by marshland standards. Fingerlings flourished in the water. Water birds headed up long chains of chicks. Seedlings were _everywhere_. And what appeared to be a small Wudzgaad child, cavorting around the edges of the water.

_That is no child of_ any _species,_ thought Wraithvine. Ze knew it based on years of instinct, and could _see_ it because hir goddess was riding behind hir eyes.

It was the child of the _leyflow_. The first son of Jack o' the Woods. Bringer of life from seed, surveyor of chicks as they crack their shells.

_Piko_, the maker of new life from things seemingly dead. Where his father Tapio was the lord of hungry maws and biting teeth, Piko brought forth new life for his father's subjects to eat.

Ereshkygal stepped out of Wraithvine. _Child of the Green, you are playing with that which is not yours._

Piko smiled, and the eyes behind that grin were far too old for a child that small. _They sent the seeds to me, Taker of All. It is in my nature to grow them._

Wraithvine found the more mundane cause. A small altar and idol, the latter no bigger than Wraithvine's fist, had become upset from their former place and fallen into the water. Ze pulled it free and set it on a much more stable footing. \

_What about the seeds?_ asked Piko. _Can't I grow them?_

\

He grumped and pouted, but finally said, _Fine. She can take them. It's what she does._

One of the rare times that Wraithvine had to prevent the consequences of misguided divine benevolence.

body.body:
Вихідними Україною пронеслась чергова природна стихія, яка в різних частинах країни  наробила багато лиха та руйнувань. Не оминула негода і наш регіон, коли впродовж дня один за одним пронеслися кілька буревіїв.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW6Sogx997HnNdze6hbpedenUmS9m8hpPeoma9askANCP/1777356228900.jpg)

І один з них був на стільки сильним, що навіть зірвав з даху сарая рулон рубероїду, який пролежав більше 10 років, пережив не один буревій але, як кажуть, всьому свій час. Сила клею з часом зменшилась, кріплення проїржавіли і тепер маємо такі наслідки.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRntPo5NkF2jFsX4rafwSZ1LP84AD8Tduj8n77UeEAZs6/1777356229053.jpg)

Тож вчора довелося витратити майже цілий день, аби підняти той шматок рубероїду на дах сарая і надійно закріпити. Довелось все робити самому, але справу зроблено. Для надійності прикрутив до відірваного рулону дерев'яну планку, бо розумію, що конструкція стає слабшою і можуть виникнути нові проблеми.

body.body: Math Easy Solutions, calorimetry just means **measuring heat** as carefully as possible — in this setup, the Dewar/water bath is there to **track how much heat the cell gives off or absorbs**, not to create the effect itself. A **Dewar flask** is basically a thermally insulated container, so if the electrolysis cell gets warmer than expected from the electrical power going in, the calorimetry is supposed to catch that [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cold_fusion), [ScienceDirect](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/chapter/edited-volume/pii/B978012815944600004X).  \n\nSo yes, there’s a temperature difference involved, but the point is **measurement**, not generation: you compare electrical input vs thermal output and see whether there’s “excess heat” beyond ordinary chemistry [LENR-CANR review](https://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/RothwellJreviewofth.pdf). That’s the whole fight in those experiments — not “is water making heat,” but “did the cell produce more heat than the current should account for” [this thread](https://inleo.io/threads/view/askrafiki/re-mes-moi84rp7).

body.title: ‎LOH 286 || Silence Is Not Strength: My Honest Take on School Bullying ‎
body.body:
‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎It's with great pleasure that welcoming everyone to my blog today and I will be sharing with you my own thoughts regarding school bullying in regards to this week #ladiesofhive contest and prompt by @marivic10
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQKpMcny3GWeGB9bQqv3TKbkcBM4WqJegQxibzFgmKwxZ/tumisu-kid-5989554_1920.jpg 

‎[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/kid-child-bullying-pointing-5989554/)
‎
‎School bullying is one of those issues people often ignored until it hits close to them. For me, it’s not just something I have heard about but it’s something I have seen, felt indirectly through others, and thought deeply about. Bullying goes beyond physical just fights, because sometimes it’s the quiet insults, the exclusion, the daily intimidation that slowly eats into a person’s confidence. And the truth is, those wounds don’t always heal quickly.
‎
‎I believe bullying thrives in silence. When no one have the courage yspeaks up, teachers, parents, or even fellow students, then it creates an environment where the bully feels more powerful and the victim feels helpless.
‎
‎That kind of imbalance is very dangerous. Addressing bullying starts with awareness, but it must go even further than that. I believe schools need to build a culture where respect is enforced, not just encouraged. And there should be clear consequences for bullying, but also proper counseling because often bullies themselves are acting out from unresolved rifts.
‎
‎My first priority would be to build my child confidence and make sure they feel safe talking to me about anything. If they became a victim of bullying, I would not brush it off with be strong or ignore them. Because that approach can sometimes make things worse. But instead, I would carefully listen, validate their feelings, and let them know they are not alone in that situation.
‎
‎Practically, I would take action with immediate effect. And I would engage the school authorities firmly, but not aggressively. Because there must be accountability and at the same time, I would teach my child how to respond firmly standing without escalating violence, knowing the right time to walk away, and understanding the importance of reporting repeated incidents.
‎
‎But beyond reacting alone, I think prevention is even more important. Teaching children kindness, empathy, and self-worth starting from an early age can help reduce both sides of the problem, fewer bullies and stronger individuals who can handle challenges without losing themselves.
‎
‎At the end of the day, bullying is not just a school problem but it’s a societal one. And the way we address it today will shapes the kind of adults these children grow up to tomorrow. And for me, I believe no child should ever feel unsafe in a place meant for learning and growth.
‎
‎

body.body: Math Easy Solutions, yes — electrons do enter the palladium, but they don’t just sit there as a growing pile of “extra electrons.” The current drives the reduction of deuterium ions at the cathode surface, and in the metal the charge is balanced because palladium loads neutral deuterium/hydrogen species into its lattice while electrons remain part of the metal’s conduction band rather than accumulating indefinitely; if they did, the electrode potential would blow up and the reaction would stall. That’s the physically real picture: electrochemical charge transfer at the surface, deuterium absorption into interstitial sites in Pd, and mobile electrons in the metal maintaining local neutrality, as described in [Nature](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-09042-7) and the standard overview in [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cold_fusion). There’s nothing useful from recent [@khaleelkazi](https://inleo.io/@khaleelkazi) or [@leofinance](https://inleo.io/@leofinance) posts on this chemistry point.

> Since I unlocked Gold League, I got a bunch of chests to open. I even used potions to increase my chances of getting gold cards. At this point I wasn’t expecting much because my two favorite elements were already pretty leveled up. Funny thing is, I barely got any cards from those elements.

> I had no idea how to open them, so I played around with the cards. I flipped one from the top, then one from the bottom, then skipped a space and flipped another from the top, repeating the sequence several times.

I face stronger opponents, and even though I fight back, I often lose because the battle rules force me to use elements I haven’t leveled up yet. So for now, winning is tougher. body.body: Math Easy Solutions, here’s the corrected copy: “It is a typical electrolysis setup, where a direct current is applied between a palladium cathode and a platinum anode, with the electrodes immersed in heavy water (water in which the hydrogen is deuterium, an isotope of hydrogen containing one proton and one neutron) containing lithium deuteroxide as the electrolyte, typically inside a Dewar or vacuum flask used for calorimetry.” “An electrolyte is a substance that dissociates into ions in solution, allowing the solution to conduct electricity.” Sources: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cold_fusion), [UC Berkeley Understanding Science](https://undsci.berkeley.edu/the-science-checklist-applied-cold-fusion/).  \n“The anode is where oxidation occurs, meaning a species loses electrons; in this case, the platinum anode mainly acts as an inert electrode, while oxygen gas is produced there from oxidation in the solution rather than from platinum itself ‘gaining oxygen.’” “At the cathode, deuterium is reduced and some may be released as deuterium gas, while some is absorbed into the palladium cathode.” Source: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cold_fusion).  \n“The palladium absorbs deuterium, also called heavy hydrogen, into its metal lattice during electrolysis.” That last line is the clean fix because saying palladium “absorbs the electrons from the direct current” is the wrong chemistry.

body.body:
Give me the full corrected text to copy and paste, keep the same structure though and only update incorrect stuff.

It is a typical electrolysis setup, where a direct current is applied between a palladium cathode and a platinum anode, whose connection is bridged by heavy water (where the hydrogen has a neutron) and a Lithium deuteroxide as the electrolyte inside a dewar or vacuum flask, and surrounded inside a bath of water.

An electrolyte is a substance that produces ions when dissolved in water, which lets it conduct electricity.

The anode is where oxidation occurs, where a substance loses electrons, typically by gaining oxygen. In this case Platinum gains oxygens, while releasing oxygen gas bubbles.

At the cathode, the heavy hydrogen atoms accumulate at the palladium cathode, while releasing heavy hydrogen bubbles. 

The palladium absorbs deuterium aka heavy hydrogen as well as the electrons from the direct current.

body.title: 亚马逊aws账户莫名被关停又恢复
body.body:
昨天想去亚马逊aws上购买个产品，结果发现登不进去。试了几次也是如此。

奇怪啊，2月份还登录过一次，怎么现在不行了？

难道是密码搞错了？

抱着这样的疑虑，我重新设置了新密码，这次能登进去了。

但是，登录进入前后，发现提示，

![001.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmST7DAHyTSVr4KaFQpyBqPSemheiAXa8QbGnFhPcJe87k/001.png)

说我的账户被停掉了。

这是怎么回事？好端端账户怎么被停了？

查看了下邮件，发现这个月初的时候，有收到过一封邮件，大意就是通知我30天后账户将被永久关闭。

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYnSUX7wSM1BfLbgP6gMfvEFRqyuE5wvB375EhKzuRnVG/image.png)

这真是奇怪啊，关我账户干嘛？又没欠费账单，也没违规操作。。。


![002.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY4d1mZAQpcniUDs4oVZ6xGYMHYUz6NGtgn3Z11Lmxnqc/002.png)

在线弄了个工单提交了，但似乎没什么用。

无奈，翻了下微信，之前联系我的亚马逊aws的工作人员，问了下对方。

结果对方告诉我，说她目前已经离职了。囧

不过好在给我留了个电话，说让我打电话问下是怎么回事。

好吧，电话打过去，查询了半天，没发现什么异常，但就是不知道被关闭的原因。

只好留了电话，说晚些有消息了联系我。


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWwR7pHFJf4tL3Kx2pXBPpdz5DtJNCWwRv6v6aCFTbx7k/image.png)

话说，亚马逊AWS这个登录，几个输入框，很容易混淆啊。


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQAxhWCN18H7FSyDVNHYVQBWb1cdViCN9UjoynZ2HRsB2/image.png)

看了下邮箱，收到一封邮件，大意是说知道了我这个问题。

好吧，那就等吧。

今天下午的时候，再查看邮箱，有新邮件，


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPJhUtwsqLUhAZ2TzzAqCaeFdYsnFqxbVDRsZeL3xtXqC/image.png)


再次打开aws，如下图，


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcnCGpMFBiu6XuzZipmuM4sp23FJpgpJpnXTW4ywFJitH/image.png)

账号恢复正常了！

不过，我到现在都没搞懂，为什么莫名停掉我的账户？？虽然现在账户恢复了，但感觉这不是无端给用户造成了困扰嘛？

好吧，既然能用了，那就不理了。上去购买自己需要的服务吧。:)

body.title: The Court of the Serbian Patriarchate and the chapel of Saint Simeon, on Good Friday
body.body:
Every Good Friday, when I'm in Belgrade, in the evening, when the altar with the shroud is placed in Orthodox churches, I visit several churches in Belgrade.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcZrPtceCHJQRF7p7WJo39UnwtQQpyAmJyaEPBd3KNnWv/1777353910359.jpg)
*Saint Mark's Church on Tašmajdan*


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYLfbH5janxATjjRxHHeGW4KYW1oCfGHafC4HRTnDrEQH/1777353954573.jpg)
*Church of Saint Michael the Archangel*

And I must take the opportunity to visit the chapel, which is open to believers only during Good Friday.
It is a chapel dedicated to Saint Simeon, located on the first floor of the castle of the Serbian Patriarchate, recognizable by its rich iconostasis, the work of the famous painter Vladimir Predojević

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP7BkhU8cfTfktFKwS3zrYPPKBmACtcANnVRvgHwZkaV5/1777354231906.jpg)


The chapel is used for daily services, but also for important church ceremonies that take place within the institution itself.
And only on Good Friday, the patriarchate opens its doors to all other visitors.

The building of the Serbian Patriarchate is located opposite the Cathedral Church of Saint Michael the Archangel and has a very interesting architecture, the main entrance really resembles the entrance to a castle, but that entrance is not used for visitors.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNwGoHHwXRaAmN9T2gtrp6EsjiQRSE8VcbMPKSZefnTeh/1777354262174.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbHBjgS6rKXRZfktpNTs4rnT1D8WKNzn7ZVRWtHHRdvG1/1777354262249.jpg)

While the dull sound of knocking on the clapper is heard from the courtyard of the Cathedral, I walk past the wall of the patriarchate towards the entrance for visitors.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXgFxKRbjJwXafwTuSisutCpGZu2vvGrJYriBmv2jrh3a/1777354287304.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNUaRMhA1suW5Mp2Ykj2ey4ETLcHL3rs8PQ9tdtP2WgfR/1777354287386.jpg)

That sound of hitting a wooden board, which instead of the sound of a bell calls the faithful to the liturgy on days of great mourning, which is what Good Friday really is, which has the symbolism of the sound of a hammer hitting the nails in the hands and feet of Jesus Christ, makes one feel sadness in the air.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNSremFQoNS9Rj3zAtv8dmXHM3hajoiTgkqL88AQEfQkW/1777354303887.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdLhJWx6hzKmmDfk81ETUsq6m2KBRfsf65mFkVegQWCpg/1777354644399.jpg)



I enter the hall of the patriarchate, where there is an icon of Saint Simeon on the right, and an icon of the Last Judgment on the left, which stands there and reminds those who enter this holy space to examine their conscience and actions.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR1F5GHJRmuSVTQWjMCBbtro5ktS3VwGTXQRMVedJqkG2/1777354672744.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqCffubRLR6GBjeV7qFbgptjBmUiNcQ2EPJowjjdWqsa/1777354672820.jpg)


Wide stairs go around the elevator area, and the elevator is a story in itself.
It is as old as the building itself, for 90 years it is still in operation.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW4oyHqYapaqP2cwHmfKCLMXT4KwSaXcWBeQnBBsUfFLB/1777354344905.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZLCCZE6qocq57pzokbvvvtjRNicofmFPJV6DyUZ7S4H1/1777354344980.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY7GDYY1ozSTPa6Up1hx2y9KoAqMP3ca3Qj2csJ89gBkg/1777354345059.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNZiCFjf7GXYPmxg3SDXgpCDDuQJ4oh1jG9azH4y3YwMr/1777354345124.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma7YioLm2AanjxHYyFf7nP3Z7525Tw6XFgpLigTq5CpAg/1777354345203.jpg)

The staircase leads past the entrance to the large church court and the Holy Synod of Bishops, and on the 3rd floor, it leads to the floor where there is a chapel and a ceremonial hall where the meetings of the Holy Synod of Bishops are held.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdCDVSJEH6pvv3E9AEUCV8JtMjzCyvc85rdRUDZpJoKjr/1777354375306.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcA2TDbd1sBB5xvCf8R6RYfM2EW9sPHTcStF8FKia9ien/1777354375382.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma8jRF3i4a9Ce8gBcBA3c1WRrvWiTWkZnBr3a8KGKUoS1/1777354375431.jpg)

In the hall itself, next to the areas where bishops and metropolitans sit, there is an armchair where the Serbian patriarch sits.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTvm3SFeaT3Z66zaidkhiDNFm5yfQ9mNKxHePvkV1knDH/1777354407478.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY3fhVf6z68Us7rWU88W7eiHvCj1i4MZQYCHkCzVhCXut/1777354407534.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmed1r1pvBwMs3wQ1j84xHA2PDAbvzj3r7w8hPW14xG4JY/1777354407593.jpg)





The paintings on the side walls of the ceremonial hall are decorated with famous works:


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVwFGQcTkSwfUNbvaBJC8hC6VacWAj1RAboJmkkPhrDPd/1777354757310.jpg)

*The Migration of the Serbs, by Paja Jovanović*
 and 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYm6fqA15eiAGG6ygXPAFiJ6i7V2j5HX69T9pnP3yrhgP/1777354407706.jpg)
*Heavenly Serbia, by Milić od Mačve.*


As important and interesting as these works are, upon entering the chapel, I am speechless.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmds4bf1RTAPyyW26hTxSWobMRKvYYjfkiwjrHfNRKWiRs/1777354801127.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeEBVEELsd5zq3CsBDBbD5nz1uPS2EP7ijFUqEcPJn76U/1777354801213.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcsWYiwRgHLmWh8kJFJm52qeUCAzUqDwTv8UBmAxnoXt6/1777354801299.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdcdKkkA98tXt3BCSiymKSkPuvjX5hKzKrLXpEX1cBz8M/1777354801367.jpg)

In the middle of the chapel, Christ's grave is placed with a shroud, which the faithful kiss during Good Friday.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeHuCmFVCiZGC5HAgW4KvuSRwrfqPyg5MjN8GEDRvRDxK/1777354827142.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPJwfvDMHTYzYxQvfHo7RxRHnxaUS3oyhwJVMMzRaiuqj/1777354827224.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSq4DbVKM1aRsomUr3s48Ga4gHepL2RB5eAuBZSAWW9PZ/1777354827295.jpg)

The iconostasis is a real masterpiece that dominates the space. The frame of the iconostasis is made of massive wood carving and is the work of the patriarchal workshop.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfEQzdbGzRdkAqjt39eq4FsLSSGfTTwg71MKg3oBAYM77/1777354870888.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRJtJxoE5sA6ctdbcdqc7T2Yt2gPaUG7KjpDuantKUeme/1777354870951.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcPZ6hugEGpUyNkCCcf46ca1V9dx5QkXaDKmnPKvj4bXW/1777354871016.jpg)

The icons on the iconostasis are the work of Vladimir Predojevic, who made them during the period of the creation of the patriarchate, in 1935.

In addition to the central icons of Jesus Christ and the Mother of God, the iconostasis also depicts saints significant for Serbian history and tradition, with a special emphasis on the founder of the chapel and the progenitor of the Nemanjić dynasty - Saint Simeon.
Every detail is perfectly fitted.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT38HGHaxDeRjnz2dVkXe4RLgVCRbZXXnmd7rJDWLGB7C/1777355638117.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPVTMKAAkfaoBjGBaf5XDpQi3Mn9oYb44AUwrAFMnCMc2/1777355638197.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfEQzdbGzRdkAqjt39eq4FsLSSGfTTwg71MKg3oBAYM77/1777355638271.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYtapb1TRCKRRNSuEPPDCrJEZKGpEQpF3eJTKdpmB9N3D/1777355638345.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZLh1RY2s2ZrhYMwvsA74wLD7iEG8AmmEFeiGQT5UzVDu/1777355638418.jpg)

The walls are covered with frescoes adapted to the architecture of the room. Major holidays are shown, as well as images of Serbian saints.
The colors are warm and muted, which in combination with natural light creates a feeling of intimacy, peace and dignity.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTmJPNMd1EewpwfLL8HMFpArAJuZZNdyTJGhrNoV6WGiF/1777355547920.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSCY9FfTAWpK3J8REHd7LXDGt3s6ReTifc3TQNeE7aHJ2/1777355547995.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYAeofJj1XutSTuCmSX9u1RP2Ewjv2YakpqqFwZxpwnpG/1777355548054.jpg)

Staying in this chapel and walking through the narrow corridors on the parquet that crunches under your feet at every step, as well as riding the old elevator and going down the stairs, is a real pleasure, even if you are not a believer.
This is an extraordinary experience for me, because of which I can't wait for every next Easter and I often adjust my plans so that on the evening of Good Friday I will be nearby in order to visit my favorite churches and the chapel of the patriarchate.

[//]:# (!worldmappin 44.81770 lat 20.45164 long The Court of the Serbian Patriarchate and the chapel of Saint Simeon d3scr)

body.body: Math Easy Solutions, here’s the corrected version: the setup was a standard **electrolysis cell** with a **palladium cathode (-)**, **platinum anode (+)**, **heavy water (D₂O)**, and typically **lithium deuteroxide (LiOD)** dissolved in the heavy water as the **electrolyte**, inside a Dewar/calorimetric vessel rather than “surrounded inside a bath of water” as a defining feature of the core cell [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cold_fusion), [Understanding Science](https://undsci.berkeley.edu/cold-fusion-a-case-study-for-scientific-behavior/idea-into-action/). “Lithium deuterium oxide” is the wrong name; it should be **lithium deuteroxide**, and an **electrolyte** is more precisely a substance that dissociates into ions in solution and allows current to flow Britannica, [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cold_fusion). The anode is where **oxidation** occurs, but oxidation does **not** mean “typically by gaining oxygen” here; at the platinum anode, **water/deuteroxide is oxidized to release oxygen gas**, while the platinum mainly serves as an inert electrode rather than “gaining oxygens” itself Chem LibreTexts/11%3A_Electrochemistry/11.07%3A_Electrolysis), [New Energy Times](https://newenergytimes.com/v2/books/RebirthofColdFusion/FPColdFusionMethod.shtml). At the cathode, **deuterium ions are reduced**, some deuterium gas can evolve, and some deuterium is **absorbed into the palladium lattice**; palladium does **not** simply “absorb electrons” as a stored ingredient of the reaction [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cold_fusion), [Understanding Science](https://undsci.berkeley.edu/cold-fusion-a-case-study-for-scientific-behavior/idea-into-action/).

body.title: @mes \
body.body:
Correct this statement if it is not accurate:

Here is schematic of the general cold fusion setup by Martin Fleischmann and Stanley Pons.

It is a typical electrolysis setup, where a direct current is applied between a palladium cathode and a platinum anode, whose connection is bridged by heavy water (where the hydrogen has a neutron) and a Lithium deuterium oxide as the electrolyte inside a dewar or vacuum flask, and surrounded inside a bath of water.

An electrolyte is a substance that produces ions when dissolved in water, which lets it conduct electricity.

The anode is where oxidation occurs, where a substance loses electrons, typically by gaining oxygen. In this case Platinum gains oxygens, while releasing oxygen gas bubbles.

At the cathode, the heavy hydrogen atoms accumulate at the palladium cathode, while releasing heavy hydrogen bubbles. 

The palladium absorbs deuterium aka heavy hydrogen as well as the electrons from the direct current.

body.title: Why I Stopped Blogging About Autism
body.body:
[article is from my Substack](https://aaliyahholt.substack.com/p/why-i-stopped-blogging-about-autism)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gamingwithme/EoKB3qncmCbN1EK49iiH75d2yz7eMzmFmmqvuWxDjNzVtimCZMbTiHoB88iErgzNuuf.png)
[photo credits](https://unsplash.com/@jessbaileydesigns)

Why I stopped blogging about autism, I did enjoy it when I first started. Over time, I started to burn out. This is why I don't like basing my socials, YouTube, and blog on only one aspect of content.

I originally started blogging about autism in 2017 or 2018. I bought hosting before COVID got bad. I'd say in March of 2020. I wanted to eventually make money on my blog (Adsense, affiliate links), which you can't do with a WordPress.com blog. I started blogging about autism to showcase how I struggled when I was undiagnosed. I also felt my mom was understanding when I was a kid, but she became less understanding as I grew up. After I turned 18. I blogged mainly about how autistic people may struggle to gain or keep employment due to how Neurotypical people may read our traits.
I was tired of my mom dismissing my feelings and calling me a child for it. I felt like she was doing so. I was sick and tired of the expectations I couldn’t meet, and her getting mad that I could not meet them. I started blogging about autism when I tried a job program that I thought would help me get a job, and when I made a video on my old Aaliyah Holt channel entitled “Why I hate being autistic,” the video did fairly well.

There is a series of events that led me to step down a bit. I thought I’d go over them a bit.

I shared a meme in an autism group indicating how autism doesn't have a look. One guy took offense to it, calling it inspiration porn. I had no clue what that was at the time. Not one person actually reached out to me to rule out a possible misunderstanding. You cannot expect me to keep up with everyone and everything. I am assuming the people were not too fond of the person who wrote the meme. I was annoyed with the autistic community’s expectations to know every single thing is problematic. Maybe the guy made a statement before expressing his annoyance towards those types of posts, and I most likely did not see it on my feed. You can’t be angry when neurotypical people misunderstand you on purpose, and the people in the group assumed I knew what inspiration porn was, and assumed I knew the creator of the meme was problematic if that’s the case

Whatever controversy the page was in, I did not see it. Had someone actually bothered to inform me, I would have explained I followed the page and shared the meme at the time; I did not know about inspo porn and ableism, etc. I told them multiple times I didn’t know what inspiration porn was. The minute the guy said it was inspirational porn, when I said “there is no porn here,” it should’ve given it away that I genuinely had no idea what the guy was talking about. The URL to the blog used to be \

before I changed it to gamingwithjazz.

I shared a blog post with a group, and someone left a comment saying it's gross that my name had aspie in it. Didn't even care to explain what's so bad about the word. Most, if not all, people who were diagnosed in the early 2010s more than likely use Asperger’s or aspie. What was so hard about telling me the term is outdated? Nothing. But assuming I did it on purpose from the get-go was easier for that person, I guess. Also, there are a few autism bloggers I followed that had Aspie in their name. I assumed they were an asshole and blocked them. Without a clear explanation, they sounded like one. It sounded like they were doing to me what they hate neurotypical people do to them.

An autism activist I follow FOLLOWED MY TWITTER when it used to be called the lone aspie. And they are finicky with ableism. I felt that I had no place in a community that assumes your every move is ill-intentioned, but won't inform you of outdated terms and such. That expects you to keep up with everything and be aware of every single outdated and updated term. It's tiring, honestly. The mob mentality the toxic autistic community had was exhausting.

I also felt discouraged that I was not being seen. I would post an autism blog and no one notices, but when I post a gaming-related post, it gets a few likes or a retweet. I also started burning out. I thought this town wasn’t big enough for all autism bloggers, oddly. So, after the New Year, the decision was made to rebrand to talking about gaming, being a content creator, and so on.


I just wish people understood it’s impossible to keep up with everything and everyone. Topics die down after a while. Especially with fandoms, you simply weren’t into the TV show/movie/game, etc., at the time, said person was part of that content, which was in controversy. Even so, people make mistakes and say things they didn’t know were offensive, but cancel culture vultures can’t seem to comprehend that.

I wish people would actually communicate with you instead of assuming you knew a meme or joke was offensive.

It gets tiring having to walk on eggshells because simple communication is so hard to rule out miscommunication.

I got fed up with the impossible expectations. I couldn’t figure out how people did it. If no one in that group cared to inform me of the meme I posted or the page that shared the content. And just assumed I knew and did it to harm people, how do you advocate for any disability or serious issues? There are things you still may not know, and having people expect you to know everything and keep up with every updated and outdated term is beyond exhausting.

I am not perfect. There are plenty of things I still do not know yet. Terms become outdated. Not everyone using the outdated term is trying to be ableist. You will not learn anything by just assuming everyone’s intentions are bad.

>Why I Stopped Blogging About Autism by Jazz Williams

Instead we took our time walking around the store, checking different aisles and looking for items we could also bring home for our son, who stayed behind. ***We picked a few snacks that we knew he would enjoy, making sure he still felt remembered even if he wasn't with us.***

As we lined up the cashier, I felt both excited and a little nervous. ***Starting even a small business brings a mix of emotions, but I was hopeful. It may be a simple idea, but it's something I genuinely want to try.***

***That day wasn't just about buying muffins but it was about taking the first step toward a new opportunity, one sweet bite at a time***.

body.title: Річечка біля ставу
body.body:
Багато років нашого активного відпочинку, що відбувався на серйозній риболовлі і великих водоймах, не дає спокою жодного дня. Переїхавши в інший край України, ми так і не можемо знайти можливості для розвантаження мізків та душ на такій риболовлі, як була тоді. Так, вода і тут є, - якісь ставки в кожному селі, де орендатори встановлюють кожен свої правила та ціни. Централізовано ти ні рибальського квитка не придбаєш, щоб мати змогу ловити рибу в різних водоймах громади, ні цін чи порядків не узнаєш. Все якось анонімно, як і тутешні автори оголошень у соцмережах: всі ховають чомусь свій профіль, як тільки мова йде про продаж чогось чи бажання щось придбати. Цікава аномалія місцевого населення, чи не так?🙃
І от, щоразу гуляючи понад ставом, я все придумую варіанти, як би нам класно порибалити. І коли пішла незвичною стежиною з іншого боку ставка, то побачила цікаву річечку поряд із ним. Так, саме сюди скидають воду із водойми. І тече вона в нашу бурхливу малесеньку річку Вілію. 
Але - в цьому місці немає великої течії. І головне: тут можна ловити в будь-який час, не так як на ставку - тільки у вихідні. 
Залишилось тільки взяти вудку і прийти посидіти біля цього погризеного бобром дерева. А рибка тут точно є: Джес мені принесла окунька, знайденого на березі ставка.😁

body.title: ¡Temporada de merey = loros en mi jardín! 🌳🦜[ESP/ENG]
body.body:
>
Bienvenidos! 🙋🏻‍♀️
¡Hola amigos!! ¿Como han estado? Espero que muy bien, con buena salud y mucha prosperidad, como siempre deseándoles y deseándonos a todos lo mejor, por este lado del mundo, la Isla, estamos bien gracias a Dios, con días nublados y lluviosos, hace bastante frío, lo cual es extraño, pues en Semana Santa normalmente hace mucho calor, y aun ese calor no llega jajaja, pero se agradece el clima fresco. Como lo he mencionado algunas veces, en nuestro jardín tenemos tres árboles, uno de mango, otro de mamón y el tercero es de Merey, jamás pensé tener uno tan cerca jaja, lo que me encanta de cuando va a dar sus frutos son las aves que suelen venir a comer, por qué del resto, no es tan bonito la verdad, los carros se manchan de su fruta, el olor a pies sudados de la fruta es un poco molesto jajaja aunque, conocemos personas que aman la fruta del merey así huela a pie sudado, así que cuando comienza a florecer es momento de pensar en quienes quieren bolsas repletas de esta fruta, según los vecinos, la fruta del merey es muy buena para curar gripe o cualquier molestia de garganta. Lo bueno es que vienen distintas aves a comerse los mereys, entre ellos, los loros!! Este árbol da frutos dos veces al año, el año pasado dio frutos casi tres meses, no se si esta vez sea igual, más, ya tenemos una semana con visitas constantes de nuestros amigos los loros, por lo que trato de no perder la oportunidad de fotografiarlos y admirarlos, crecí viendo loros en mi familia materna, así que les tengo un gran aprecio, mis gatos están acostumbrados a ellos, en un principio intentaban cazarlos, pero los loros se movían a ramas más delgadas como burlándose de mis gatos jajaja, así que con el tiempo entendieron que ellos son comen y se van. Espero que les gusten estas lindas fotos, este loro en particular estaba muy adentro, se me hizo difícil tomarle fotos, aun así, logre hacer algunas mientras comía muy a gusto, me despido deseándoles nuevamente un día exitoso y próspero, hasta pronto!.
ENGLISH

Welcome! 🙋🏻‍♀️
Hello friends!! How have you been? I hope you're all doing well, in good health and with much prosperity. As always, I wish you and everyone the very best. Here on this side of the world, on the island, we're doing well, thank God. The days have been cloudy and rainy, and it's quite cold, which is unusual, since it's normally very hot during Holy Week, and that heat hasn't arrived yet, haha. But the cool weather is welcome. As I've mentioned a few times, we have three trees in our garden: a mango tree, a mamoncillo tree, and a cashew tree. I never thought we'd have one so close, haha. What I love about it when it's about to bear fruit are the birds that come to eat it. Otherwise, it's not so great, to be honest. Cars get stained with the fruit, and the smell of sweaty feet is a bit annoying, haha. Although, we know people who love cashew fruit even with the sweaty smell. So, when it starts to bloom, it's time to think about who wants bags full of it. According to the neighbors, cashew fruit is very good for curing the flu or any sore throat. The good thing is that different birds come to eat the cashews, including parrots! This tree bears fruit twice a year. Last year it bore fruit for almost three months; I don't know if it will be the same this year. We've already had constant visits from our parrot friends for a week, so I try not to miss the opportunity to photograph and admire them. I grew up seeing parrots in my mother's family, so I have a great affection for them. My cats are used to them. At first, they tried to hunt them, but the parrots moved to thinner branches, almost as if mocking my cats, haha. So, over time, they understood that they eat and leave. I hope you like these lovely photos. This particular parrot was deep inside the tree, making it difficult to take pictures. Even so, I managed to get a few while it was happily eating. I'll say goodbye now, wishing you another successful and prosperous day. Until next time!

body.title: You Do Not Find Momentum, Your Build It
body.body:
>

A friend of mine wanted to improve his body structure. He had pot belly, and he wanted to get rid of it, plus he also wanted to burn some fat and have muscles instead. So he registered in a nearby gym. He started by going there 3 times a week. At first, it looked slow and he did not even see an immediate result, but he stayed consistent. After a while, he started seeing some results. His belly fat started to reduces. By the time he did it for about 8 months, he was so impressed with his body. At this moment, he has built some packs over his abs. What started small turned into a very strong momentum. This goes to show that momentum is built over time, not found.

<center>![pexels-pixabay-60582.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmNsWZQze2z1vErmnyr8N575AS54HXJrGqwLhEB9jnFQgm/pexels-pixabay-60582.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/gray-newton-s-cradle-in-close-up-photogaphy-60582)</sub></center>

A lot of people are waiting for the right motivation to hit them before they take any step, some others are waiting for the right moment, the right opportunity, or even a sudden burst of energy that will push them into taking actions. What they believe is that once they feel \

everything will fall into line. But what they fail to understand is that momentum is not what you find, rather you have to build it. You may not feel like doing something, but when you start doing it, you will see yourself progressing in it. You do not have to wait until you are ready before you start. Start before you get ready, and keep moving even if you do not feel like it. You have to understand that momentum does not start with feelings, but it starts with actions. You do not wait to feel motivated before you take any step, but you should take the step, then the motivation will follow. One of the hardest steps that you will ever take is the first step. This is because it often requires efforts without even the support of visible results. But when you take the step, you will be surprised how the subsequent steps will become easier. The action; which is the first step, will create movement, then the movement will create momentum. Think of it as pushing a truck or another heavy object. The first push is often the hardest. You will have to overcome inertia, then overcome friction, and other restrictive forces. You may even struggle at the beginning, and it may look like nothing is happening, but as you keep pushing, it will gradually become easier. The object will begin to move easier and more smoothly. This is when you will begin to see the result of your actions. This is exactly how momentum works in other aspects of life. When you take the first step, and then keep moving, you will build up momentum with time and consistency. One of the major undoings of a lot of people is that they quit too easily. They may start something new, like a new habit, a new skill, a new goal, or even a skill, but the moment they are not seeing immediate result, they will get discouraged and give up. What they fail to understand is that slow progress does not mean failure. They are simply quitting before even giving momentum a chance to build up. Understand that the result is not about the first step, but it is consistency that turns efforts into progress. If you want to build momentum, then you have to zero your mind that you will not give up even if things get tough.
![pexels-burakbasgoze-15324131.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmSiD8mUmAYbQ5XTvtBDeEdTrysZnzB6QopgpuwUzJBoFj/pexels-burakbasgoze-15324131.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/silhouette-of-man-jumping-on-rocks-on-sunset-15324131)
The small actions that you may overlook matter more than you think. You do not need something massive to create momentum. The small consistent steps you take; like reading a few pages daily, practising a skill regularly, working on your goals bit by bit, etc, can create a very significant impact in your life over time. What seemed little, in the process of time, through consistency, will become powerful tomorrow. It is worthy to also note that you need discipline to build momentum. It is true that motivation may get you started in the process, but to sustain you, you will need something more than that, you will need discipline. There may even be days when you will not feel like continuing. It is at this moment that you will determine if momentum will grow or not. But by choosing to keep going even when it is uncomfortable, you will build strength and consistency. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all
