body.title: Common Mistakes Men Make When Wearing Muslim Head Coverings\n
body.body:
Why This Topic Actually Matters More Than People Realize

At first glance, a Muslim head covering looks simple. You wear it, adjust it, and move on.

But that’s where most people get it wrong.

Because in reality, head coverings are not isolated accessories, they are part of a complete identity system within [clothing for Muslim men](https://ethobe.com/). That means even small mistakes can change how the entire outfit looks and what it communicates.

Some people unknowingly reduce their style impact just because they don’t understand balance, structure, or cultural context.

So this isn’t about criticism, it’s about awareness.

## Mistake 1: Treating All Head Coverings as Interchangeable

One of the most common errors is assuming every head covering serves the same purpose.

People often switch between kufi caps, keffiyehs, ghutras, or turbans without considering their differences.

But each one has its own identity:

*   A kufi is minimal and practical

*   A keffiyeh carries cultural and regional meaning

*   A ghutra is more formal and structured

*   A turban is expressive and traditional

When these are treated as identical, the outfit loses clarity. It becomes visually inconsistent, especially when paired with clothing for Muslim men like thobes or kurtas.

 The real issue is not wearing them, it is ignoring their role.

## Mistake 2: Ignoring Cultural Background and Context

Every head covering has a history. It is not randomly designed, it comes from specific regions, environments, and traditions.

When people wear these styles without understanding that background, they unintentionally strip away meaning.

For example:

*   A formal style used in one region might feel out of place in a casual setting

*   A culturally significant wrap may look “just decorative” if used incorrectly

*   A traditional design might lose its identity when mixed randomly with modern outfits

 The deeper issue is not fashion, it is context loss.

Understanding origin helps you wear it with awareness instead of imitation.

## Mistake 3: Poor Outfit Balance with Clothing for Muslim Men

This is where styling becomes more serious.

A head covering should never be chosen in isolation.

It must match:

*   outfit type (formal or casual)

*   fabric weight and texture

*   color tone

*   overall modest fashion direction

For example, pairing a heavy traditional wrap with a very modern lightweight outfit can create visual imbalance.

Similarly, mismatched colors or fabric textures can make the entire look feel disconnected.

 Good style is not about individual pieces, it is about harmony between all elements of clothing for Muslim men.

## Mistake 4: Choosing Style Over Comfort

Many people focus only on appearance, especially when they see modern styling inspiration online.

But real-life wear is different.

Problems often appear:

*   heat discomfort in certain fabrics

*   slipping or constant adjustment

*   irritation during long wear

*   difficulty maintaining shape throughout the day

A head covering that is uncomfortable will never become a natural part of daily life.

 Comfort is not optional, it is what determines long-term usability.

## Mistake 5: Overcomplicating the Style

Another common issue is trying too hard to make the head covering look “perfect” or overly styled.

Instead of improving appearance, it often creates unnecessary complexity.

Over-styling leads to:

*   unnatural shapes

*   forced wrapping

*   loss of traditional simplicity

*   difficulty maintaining consistency

In contrast, simple and clean styling usually works better because it stays closer to traditional balance and is easier to wear confidently.

 Simplicity is not basic, it is controlled styling.

## Mistake 6: Not Understanding Its Role in Clothing for Muslim Men

A deeper mistake is treating head coverings as just an add-on item.

In reality, they are part of a full clothing system that includes:

*   modest silhouettes

*   long garments like thobes and kurtas

*   breathable fabrics for comfort

*   cultural styling patterns

When this system is ignored, the head covering becomes disconnected from the rest of the outfit.

 It stops being part of a structure and becomes just decoration.

Understanding its role within clothing for Muslim men is essential for proper styling.

## Mistake 7: Copying Styles Without Personal Adaptation

Another overlooked issue is blindly copying styles from others, especially social media or cultural influencers.

What works for one person may not work for another due to:

*   face structure

*   outfit type

*   cultural setting

*   climate conditions

When copied without adaptation, the style often feels forced or unnatural.

 Good styling is adaptation, not imitation.

## How to Avoid These Mistakes 

## Instead of guessing, use a structured approach:

body.title: An Intriguing Mystery Thriller! The Mindf*ck Series By S. T. Abby || Book Review
body.body:
![1000105510.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/ALJtCQJpw8uvXzhUifHDmSgCTainWBDvPbm9chGWWJSb5Vuw8HTARaMkNAweowg.png) *
I lean down to whisper my favorite part. “I’m Victoria Evans. The daughter of the man you killed. The sister to the boy you let die. The victim you turned into a monster. And I’m going to fucking kill you all.”
*
I got this recommendation from instagram and read the reviews on Goodreads. They are mostly positive between 3.5 stars to 5 stars and that's all the encouragement I need to devour this thriller series. The word is not a typo—I did devour the five-book series within four days. Every book sent me into a dark hole and the deeper I go into the story, the darker it gets! **The Mindfuck Series** is a blend of mystery, crime thriller with a romance subplot written and published by S. T. Abby. It consists of five novellas: *The Risk*, *Sidetracked*, *Scarlet Angel*, *All The Lies* and *Paint It All Red*. They are not standalones so you must read them in the order listed to follow the story. A boy and a girl are murdered in a small town called Delaney Grove and as a result, a father is sentenced to a horrifying fate in prison. The sheriff and mayor of the town are so corrupt and also deeply involved in the murder and imprisonment. Every effort of the police and FBI to resolve the case is twattered. Fast forward to ten years later, the people involved in this gruesome injustice begin to die, one after the other. Someone is killing them and the FBI is concerned. In the present time, Logan Bennett, an FBI agent, makes a bet with his partner to get Lana Myers' attention in a coffee shop. She's an online entrepreneur and they immediately hit it off. She's different from the ladies Logan knows—serious and mature. Soon, they start dating. Lana has a past that she hides from Logan while he hints her about a murder that happened years ago which he's investigating. He's slowly falling in love with her unaware that she's the killer he's after. Soon, another serial killer begins to target women of a specific profile in Delaney Grove which matches Lana's physical features. That makes her a potential target. Logan is torn between protecting her while doing his job of unearthing the dark history that the small town desperately wants to bury. Can this couple's love blossom despite the secrets? Can Logan set aside his feelings and do his job as a law enforcement agent? **Genres:** Mystery, Crime, Thriller, Romance **Publication:** December 2016 **Pages:** 683 #### My Review And Rating Like I hinted earlier, this series is not your typical crime thriller. It's really dark and it's best to go in mentally prepared. There are trigger warnings at the beginning of each novella because of the gory depictions of torture, PTSD, sexual assaults, violence, child abuse, racism and more. Still, it's a fast-paced, intriguing and entertaining read. The plot is brilliant—a tale of a dark anti-heroine on a killing spree, hellbent on revenge and a heroic FBI agent tasked with finding this killer in a town plagued with a dark history. They meet unaware of their circumstances and fall in love. It's fascinating to read through each novella, seeing how the couple meet, fall in love while hiding dangerous secrets from each other. The story is told in dual POV: Lana and Logan's making for an interesting read. The author did a great job developing her characters well. Logan Bennet and Lana Myers are spectacular together. They are both courageous, strong minded and determined. Their chemistry is steamy and convincing. I love how they sort of collide without realising they are suppose to be enemies. There are fight and shooting scenes that keep me on my toes. Every book ends in a cliffhanger and I immediately jump into the next one. Rating this series, I'd give it a 4.5 stars out 5. It's well-written, fast-paced with action-packed scenes that make readers reflect on the complexities of justice, the power of hate and vengeance, and the depravities in our societies. It's worth reading. ![3yZiouw5jgtrj8RZntzpYvPkttnUNCNB3bKsugcDmKrZysEhsVCu7HmxWG7sYd9c3PJiWe24wRnpAB7HXq2WMvHX9AyxjgRuTY38KWSsv8...GFDdhx4UzPxqzjjpVMXNYgRDyspwo7pFw2RpyHZvde1tK7QLmYqnXBk9hDVg1dAooe2nLquVnXKjzS2uR5yQNqx1V5qutNgmqpFfKYLpS93ajRQosgFNPk3e1s.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23t7BFjADUCGjsLPt1YzFafTb9BeZ3Err5bNPwTi6RYNWED9TfZAhqAcZ8JCb2rGLLeT6.gif) *All images above are from my E-library* *Header images compiled in [Canva](https://canva.link/o9zic4j7cy8tp04).* *Thank you for visiting and supporting my blog.* 🤗

body.title: The 6PM Class With A Ghost — Fiction
body.body:
Just like every other weekend, I woke up, said a short prayer and began to surf the Internet. It was very early that morning.




Then I saw Francis message, Francis was an online friend of mine but he's way older. We've been discussing various things and I can see that he's a good person, he really wants me to grow and he's always talking about it.




![1000984357.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/AJkLtmRRCBEqQF5ovctCpMXjsbigFysqxin3Y3JTkgYEs3rmgx5sdy3N6NtJbfN.png)

So, I told him I really want to learn stuff like computer programming and the likes, and that I couldn't find anyone to teach me for free, and the amounts I'm hearing are way more than me, plus the location I am is not even encouraging.







Long story short, Francis said that's what he's into and asked why I didn't make mention of it before then,
 


*\

* I said.



And that was how he offered to tutor me online, for free. I was happy. He asked me to choose three days in a week and the best time to meet online, I threw it back to him, but he wouldn't have it, he asked me to choose and that he would fix his own schedule around it. That was how I did.



The day we were to start, I didn't see Francis'message, so I guess he was busy. And that was how I checked his FB profile and saw people posting things like, *\

* and the likes, I was confused. I was able to get someone on his friend list who was a mutual friend, I asked about him (Francis) and he told me it is true, that he died that morning.



And we were supposed to start a class by 6pm that evening. I wasn't even thinking about that anymore, I was in tears, I just lost a friend...a good and kind hearted one at that.



At exactly 6pm that day, my phone buzzed, I didn't know who it was, I checked and saw that it was Francis, I wasn't even scared. I thought it might be any of his family members.


I checked and it was a missed call on Whatsapp, I opened our chats and saw the message.

*\

*

I was shocked, what is this. What's going on....

*\

* He responded.


That hit me differently, what's even going on. I can't fathom what this may be.


*\

He asked.

I didn't respond to it, after few minutes I could see him typing again...


*\

* He said.


Is this even funny, I thought. I wished I could drop my phone an drunk away. But I couldn't, I don't know maybe a spell was cast on me.


![1000984358.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/AJiufn8CpoRWXLZVRB7Y5Uem4atJAy6UBe2tUSoKcRKA1jFwngNMToTHzuunjnP.png)



Somehow I managed to engage him, maybe because it was just a phone/online conversation, maybe that's why the fear isn't that much....just maybe.


Well, that was how the class started, not that day, but the next fixed date, I told him to give him time and that he's worth respecting, I need to  mourn him even though I've found little solace in getting to talk to his ghost.


After some days, we bagn the class, he taught me series of things, from codes to logic and all.




But there are times in-between those lessons that he will type jargons and later ask me to ignore it, and I understand that. I stopped him from using voice notes too, because the way it echoes enh.....


And I won't even lie, I was afraid, but since we ain't seeing physically, it was minimal.

And then, since this ghost is not haunting me, but rather pushing me to grow while teaching me, I shouldn't run, should I?

I think its just best for me to be a fast learner so I could be free form him, or what do you think?



You people should wake me up o, am going where I dinnor know....

body.title: A pretty different visit to my house
body.body: > Hey Hive folks, I wanted to share that I had a rather unusual visit today. Two missionaries from The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints knocked on my door (oddly enough, they can't come in if you're alone) and, in just a few minutes, they talked to me about things one doesn't usually think about much: baptism, repentance, and who Jesus Christ really is. It wasn't a deep or long conversation, but it did leave me with a curious feeling. They spoke to me about repentance not as guilt, but as an opportunity to start over. About baptism as a conscious step, a decision. And about Jesus Christ as someone close, not just a distant figure. I don't know exactly what to think yet, but I do know it was a different moment in my day. Sometimes, small conversations leave you with bigger questions… and maybe that's where something begins.

> Hola gente de Hive les cuento que hoy recibí una visita distinta. Dos misioneros de La Iglesia de Jesucristo de los Santos de los Últimos Días tocaron mi puerta (curioso no pueden entrar si estás sola) y, en pocos minutos, me hablaron de cosas que normalmente uno no se detiene a pensar tanto: el bautismo, el arrepentimiento y quién es realmente Jesucristo. No fue una conversación profunda ni larga, pero sí dejó una sensación curiosa. Me hablaron del arrepentimiento no como culpa, sino como una oportunidad de empezar de nuevo. Del bautismo como un paso consciente, una decisión. Y de Jesucristo como alguien cercano, no solo una figura lejana. No sé exactamente qué pensar todavía, pero sí sé que fue un momento diferente en mi día. A veces, pequeñas conversaciones te dejan preguntas más grandes… y quizás ahí es donde empieza algo.
![IMG_0962.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXsQUcPWeRjh2WQMtARJ7j6U4vpdtTV9B8ctVgYDJfVrr/IMG_0962.jpeg)

Hello friends, I am Joy, I am 21+ from Dhaka, Bangladesh, I am a university student, and as a student, I entered this wonderful world of Ecency with the desire to learn new things and express my creativity. We use a lot of social media these days, but the concept of Ecency or Hive Blockchain seems completely new and revolutionary to me. Here a user not only creates the content, but also gets the actual ownership and valuation of that content.

Ecency is essentially a decentralized platform, where no third party or large company has sole control over our data. I have learned that there is a lot of support from the community for doing quality and original work here. The reward system, especially through Ecency Points and Hive Tokens, is a great motivation for newbies. And from that inspiration, besides studying as a student, if you write here about your hobby, daily thoughts or any educational topic, it will be useful to others, as well as you will create an identity for yourself.

But there is one thing that I take very seriously in working on this platform—honesty. Copy-pasting or impersonating someone else's work is not encouraged at all. I want each of my posts to reflect my own thoughts and talents. It may take time to understand many things in the beginning, but I believe that with the help of experienced big brothers and friends here, I can gradually become a skilled content creator.

Please forgive my mistakes as a newbie and help guide me in the right direction. A little encouragement or advice from you can make my journey much easier. Everyone stay safe, stay healthy, and support me so that I can continue on this new path. Thank you all.

body.title: I like good movies / Me gustan las buenas películas - LOH contest week #286 (eng-esp)
body.body:
Hey girls!

I'm a total movie buff. So much so, in fact, that on my album *Woman Who Dreams of Guitars*, there are four tracks that are arrangements of songs from movies.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUrhzrhAXETKXGdwugowohxqApRK4gFg8sJ812HbPgvCM/1777354175272.jpg)

To answer your questions, I'm more into movies like *Guardians of the Galaxy*, *Thor*, etc. However, I like any genre, and yes, I also like horror movies.

As long as they're good movies.

The most recent one I saw is called *Ready or Not*. The plot is very interesting and twisted, since a family has a ritual of murdering the bride (or groom) of a family member on their wedding night.

Nothing like a murderous ritual to start a marriage, right?

All the images are stills from the films I mention, by the way.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVtEh71mzkddce5SrD5Y6RR5j6Y2ngC4fG9usNAu81Fr9/1777354175519.jpg)

To be honest, I like horror movies when they're well made. I don't like gratuitous violence or gore.

I like a good story and good acting behind the film.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmetnHnwUXzZD7huN2aPmKWzuxwfMnEGY5fsEfSapog9gR/1777354175654.jpg)

Like, for example, *The Silence of the Lambs*, with Anthony Hopkins and Jodie Foster. That movie is a classic. Every year I sit down with my children and my husband to watch all four parts in a movie marathon.

And, I confess, Anthony Hopkins' face as Hannibal, repeating *Clarice, Clarice*, still frightens me.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaCj9otDU9kCHxJke7YNL6o9kHKx99diPoBCUjABkqBkR/1777354175331.jpg)

If this movie has taught me anything, it's that intelligence is the most powerful weapon we can have.

You can be strong, have money, have a gun, but nothing compares to the power of intelligence.

By the way, if you want to see a magnificent horror series: *From*.

Watch that masterpiece.

***
**Versión en español**
***

Hola, chicas!

Soy una cinéfila de los pies a la cabeza. Fíjense si es así, que en mi disco *Mujer que sueña guitarras*, hay cuatro piezas que son arreglos a canciones de películas.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUrhzrhAXETKXGdwugowohxqApRK4gFg8sJ812HbPgvCM/1777354175272.jpg)

Para responder tus preguntas, soy más de películas como *Los guardianes de la galaxia, Thor*, etc. Sin embargo, me gusta cualquier género y, sí, también me gustan las películas de terror. 
Mientras y sean buenas películas.
La más reciente que ví se llama *Ready or not*. La trama es muy interesante y perversa, ya que una familia tiene como ritual asesinar a la novia (o novio) de un miembro de la familia, en su noche de bodas.
Nada como un ritual asesino para iniciar el matrimonio, ¿verdad?
Todas las imágenes son fotogramas de las películas que menciono, por cierto.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVtEh71mzkddce5SrD5Y6RR5j6Y2ngC4fG9usNAu81Fr9/1777354175519.jpg)

body.title: THE SECRET OF GROWTH IS IN GOD
body.body:
Greetings pals.... interesting one, I got this message from a very close friend and pal.... it's about his new baby girl and growth process.

And I thought 🤔 about sharing with us here since we're family as well.  He was like,,,,, John So over a month or two now, you know I've got an engagement that took me away from the home, I mean growth requires this very stage, and I need to accept it just the way it's.
And while the conversation was ongoing, I couldn't stop but started writing everything said at the moment, indeed my writing skills is improving daily.


![Screenshot_20260428-063000_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/23wgKu8SmwKbHSUJTPUau239DdkcnZYGw89usw5oCQ6EbFy8inastZw9AM9vNEjLbL3zE.png)

And yesterday, my wife shared a video of my daughter climbing out of her baby cot and making her way to our bed in the bathroom.

I miss watching my daughter grow and develop new abilities every day.

Becoming a father has made me appreciate how amazing God is even more.

Watching my innocent, helpless daughter grow steadily before my eyes is nothing short of amazing.

From lying down helplessly every day,
I have watched her begin to move her body.I witnessed her sit for the first time.
I have seen her crawl without anyone teaching her.

![IMG_20251230_202630_158.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/23wgKck7WJU2pNsAbyaEp2QYnzUsULhrbNHM18KFF6xWKPncdcyjwbMhLqyPXr9K6mWAd.jpg)


Now, she is making attempts to stand.
Crawling out of a space that was once her secure spot (at least for us),
Crossing barriers and trying to take her first steps.

The most amazing part is that a child does not need anyone to teach them any of these things. They just develop and exercise these abilities as they grow.

I love watching my beautiful daughter grow daily, and being away from home for weeks now makes me miss her and my wife dearly.

See my small daughter of yesterday o…
Now climbing mountains and descending into valleys.

Isn’t God amazing? 🙄

You're reading from your handsome friend John Petra!

When I first joined Inleo, I honestly didn’t expect much.
At the beginning, I was just exploring… trying to understand how everything works. But as time went by, I started to realize something powerful:
By simply writing posts, sharing thoughts, and interacting with others, we actually have the opportunity to grow and even earn from it.
It felt unreal at first.
So I decided to tell my friends about it. I invited them to join me, to learn together, and maybe build something from this space.
But instead of support, I got laughter.
They said it was just another online scam… a waste of time… something that wouldn’t last.
For a moment, I questioned myself.
But then I came back here… to this community.
I saw people writing. I saw people supporting each other. I saw real engagement… real value being created.
And that’s when I realized… this is not a hoax.
This is opportunity.
Today, I just want to say thank you to everyone here. Every comment, every interaction, every bit of support means more than you think.
Maybe one day, when people outside see how strong this community is… they’ll understand too.
Until then, we keep building.

body.title: A Beautiful Midday Sky: Fluffy White and Gray clouds
body.body: * * * Today is a very special day to look at the sky. ☁️ Usually, the sky is just a bright, flat blue. It is pretty, but it stays the same for a long time. Today is different. Today, the sky is full and moving. When I looked up, I saw big white fluffy clouds. They are very large and look very soft. They look like thick, fluffy cotton candy that you get at a fair. 😋 If I could reach out and touch them, I think they would feel like soft wool or a warm blanket. These white clouds are moving slowly across the blue background, the sky. * * * The most interesting part was watching the colors change. The bright white clouds are not alone anymore. Darker gray clouds are starting to arrive. They are moving in from the side of the trees. The white and the gray are slowly merging together. It looks like someone is mixing paint in the air. In some places, the sky is still a deep blue. In other places, it is a soft white. Then, there are parts that look heavy and dark. I can see the green leaves of the trees reaching up toward the clouds. The dark branches look like thin fingers trying to touch the fluffy white shapes. The green of the leaves looks very bright against the blue and white sky. It is a very peaceful sight. Sometimes, the sun hides behind a big cloud. Then, the cloud moves, and the bright light comes back. It makes the edges of the clouds look like they are glowing with silver light.

/> * * * I like that the sky is not just one color today. The fluffy clouds make the world feel cozy. It is nice to sit outside and just watch them grow and change. The sky tells a story. Right now, it is a story about a quiet afternoon. Even though the gray clouds are coming, it still feels calm. I hope the clouds stay for a long while so I can keep looking at their beautiful shapes. Looking at the sky reminds me to slow down and enjoy the simple things around me.

/>

Texts and Images by @vvodjiu  
The lead photo was edited on Canva  
All photos were edited on Lightroom for minimal enhancements

body.title: How Tokenized Real Estate Is Powering the Next Wave of Web3 Investments
body.body: Tokenized real estate is rapidly emerging as a foundational pillar within the broader Web3 investment ecosystem. By converting physical property assets into blockchain-based digital tokens, this model introduces fractional ownership, enhanced liquidity, and programmable financial structures that were previously unattainable in traditional real estate markets. As decentralized finance (DeFi) primitives evolve, real estate tokenization is no longer a conceptual innovation but a functional mechanism driving capital efficiency and global investor participation. At its core, tokenized real estate leverages distributed ledger technology to represent ownership rights as cryptographic tokens. These tokens can embody equity stakes, revenue-sharing agreements, or debt instruments tied to real-world property assets. Unlike Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs), which operate within centralized frameworks, tokenization disintermediates legacy gatekeepers and embeds trust directly into smart contracts.

>The Structural Shift from Illiquidity to Programmable Assets Traditional real estate is inherently illiquid, characterized by high entry barriers, lengthy settlement cycles, and complex legal processes. Tokenization fundamentally restructures these limitations by enabling divisible ownership and near-instantaneous transfers on blockchain networks. Smart contracts automate compliance, governance, and distribution mechanisms. For instance, rental yields can be programmatically distributed to token holders based on predefined conditions, eliminating manual intervention. This transition from static ownership to programmable assets introduces dynamic financial engineering capabilities within real estate markets. Moreover, tokenized assets can be integrated into DeFi protocols, enabling use cases such as collateralized lending, yield farming, and liquidity pooling. This composability is a defining feature of Web3 infrastructure, allowing real estate assets to interact seamlessly with other digital financial instruments. **Key Advantages Driving Adoption** The adoption of tokenized real estate is accelerating due to several structural and technological advantages: **• Fractional Ownership Accessibility** Investors can acquire micro-shares of high-value properties, democratizing access to premium real estate markets that were traditionally reserved for institutional players. • **Enhanced Liquidity Mechanisms** Secondary marketplaces enable peer-to-peer trading of property tokens, significantly reducing holding periods and unlocking capital mobility. **• Transparency and Immutable Records** Blockchain ensures tamper-proof transaction histories, improving auditability and reducing fraud risks associated with opaque ownership structures. **• Global Capital Formation** Cross-border participation becomes frictionless, allowing investors to diversify geographically without navigating complex jurisdictional barriers. • **Automated Compliance Frameworks** Regulatory requirements such as KYC/AML can be embedded directly into smart contracts, ensuring adherence without manual oversight. These advantages collectively position tokenized real estate as a disruptive force within both traditional finance (TradFi) and decentralized finance ecosystems.

>Technical Architecture Behind Real Estate Tokenization The implementation of tokenized real estate involves a multi-layered architecture that bridges physical assets with blockchain networks. This includes legal structuring, asset digitization, and smart contract deployment. **• Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs)** Properties are often held under SPVs, which issue tokens representing ownership or economic rights. This structure ensures legal enforceability and regulatory compliance. **• Token Standards and Protocols** Standards such as ERC-20 or ERC-721 define how tokens are issued and managed, depending on whether fungibility or uniqueness is required. **• Oracles and Data Feeds** External data sources provide real-time information such as property valuations, rental income, and market indices, enabling accurate on-chain representation. **• Custodial and Non-Custodial Wallets** Investors store and manage their tokens through secure digital wallets, maintaining control over their assets without reliance on centralized intermediaries. **• Interoperability Layers** Cross-chain protocols facilitate interaction between different blockchain ecosystems, enhancing scalability and reducing network congestion. Within this framework, [real estate tokenization development solutions](https://shamlatech.com/real-estate-tokenization-development-company/) play a critical role in bridging technical execution with regulatory alignment, ensuring that digital representations of assets remain legally enforceable and economically viable.

>Challenges and Regulatory Considerations Despite its transformative potential, tokenized real estate faces several challenges that must be addressed for widespread adoption. Regulatory uncertainty remains a primary concern, as jurisdictions differ in their classification of digital assets. Securities laws, taxation policies, and investor protection frameworks must evolve to accommodate tokenized ownership models. Additionally, market fragmentation and lack of standardization can hinder interoperability between platforms. Liquidity, while improved, is still dependent on the maturity of secondary markets and investor participation levels. Cybersecurity risks also persist, particularly in smart contract vulnerabilities and wallet management. Ensuring robust auditing mechanisms and secure infrastructure is essential to maintaining investor confidence.

>The Future of Real Estate in a Web3 Economy As Web3 infrastructure matures, tokenized real estate is expected to integrate more deeply with decentralized identity systems, autonomous organizations, and algorithmic governance models. Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) may soon manage real estate portfolios collectively, enabling community-driven investment strategies. Furthermore, the convergence of artificial intelligence with blockchain analytics could enhance asset valuation models, risk assessment, and predictive investment strategies. This data-driven approach will further optimize capital allocation within tokenized ecosystems. Institutional adoption is also on the rise, with asset managers exploring hybrid models that combine traditional real estate frameworks with blockchain-based tokenization. This convergence signals a gradual but definitive shift toward digitized asset ownership.

>Conclusion Tokenized real estate represents a paradigm shift in how physical assets are owned, traded, and monetized. By embedding real-world properties into blockchain ecosystems, it transforms illiquid assets into programmable financial instruments that align with the principles of decentralization, transparency, and accessibility. As technological, regulatory, and market infrastructures continue to evolve, tokenized real estate is poised to become a cornerstone of Web3 investments. Its ability to bridge tangible assets with digital finance not only enhances efficiency but also redefines the fundamental dynamics of global real estate markets.

body.title: My Hive Goals for 2026 Week #17
body.body:
I have decided to start posting a weekly update on my progress toward [my 2026 goals](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@jfang003/my-hive-goals-for-2026-lma) here on [Hive](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-what-is-hive). It helps me stay on track, and I can realize if I am behind on a goal at any point in time. It's the fourth month of the year so far, and there is plenty of time left in the year. Also, for everyone's note, the Saturday Savers has ended, but the Slothly Savers Club has started in its place. 

## Progress

![graph.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23wCdJDCCdMAg6qeS9VHa9MVLwScWtBZ615gj6QMxyc4oyHJLWe4UchWcquS3d1qmALsE.png)
Above are statistics that I have gotten from [HiveStats](https://hivestats.io/). This week is looking a bit worse than last week, and it all adds up over time.

### HP
I earned 124 [HP](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-hive-power-hp) earned throughout the week. I am checking this through the difference between the two endpoints on the graph on Hivestats. The numbers are looking great this week, and I think this has been my best week in the past few months.

### HBD 


![HBD.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tkfuT2Hbn72HrAsqwW92413HDAXGBjzXgsztQjWW82ciCLyVQWvMpCiVRWzFDzfRCDo.png)
I earned 0 [HBD](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-hive-backed-dollar-hbd) this week. With the price of Hive lower, we have hit the debt limit. This means that we will be earning Hive instead of HBD. I won't be able to add to my HBD savings for a while, but the interest will help me towards that goal. When the Hive price is above the debt limit, I'll add to my savings. There isn't much I can do here, but at least that interest will add up. It seems like the HBD rate has gone up from 12% last week to 14% this week. 

## Conclusion

![goal progress.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23uFwDc97JomYYCDdo6vm5CuPfwKMcLDhQzoLzX8brMtCAetGemhizhfpPDKxP47UFYip.png)
My progress is looking decent for now. I need around 2% per week, so this week I met that standard. HBD is officially behind where I need to be now. However, without any HBD being earned, it might not be enough if that doesn't change by the end of the year. Other than that, nothing much has changed, and I am just slowly grinding away at my goals. The HBD goal isn't looking that great as I am behind, and I don't think we will be getting HBD anytime soon with the current Hive price. It's still rough as I can't earn HBD due to the debt limit, but at least the HBD interest rate has gone up since last week. 

Do you have any goals for 2026? What is the progress towards your own goals? 

Feel free to leave a comment if you read my post. If you have any questions, feel free to ask, and I will do my best to answer.

As we are all aware hbd happens to be one of the most powerful assets on a hive because it has the ability to be used in different methods such as saving spending or being strategic about it. 

There are several ways to use HBD  while some people can save it to earn or yield interest, others can convert it to Hive so that they can use it to carry out other activities on the blockchain, it can be gifted to other members of the ecosystem, the most important fact is that hbd which is pegged as a stable coin can be withdrawn to cover up expenses or a person's lifestyle.

For me personally there are different ways in which I use the hbd. One method in which I strategically put my HBD to use is by exploring the feature of saving which allows me to a certain amount of interest for the period of 30 days. 

Over time as I earn HBD, i divide it in a way that I would be able to make profit  used to cater for my daily needs while I am able to save some for future purposes. This has been helpful because sometimes in life there are moments when you would need to fall back to what you have saved so that you can save you from embarrassment and distress.

In other words, saving HBD does not only help me have assets in savings but is builds up interest for me.

Like I mentioned earlier, aside from saving there are strategic method in place for me to be able to withdraw my HBD to cater for my daily needs. 

Recently there was a question of if Hive members what the earn on the hive blockchain, no doubt people uh working tediously in this economy so as to be able to make extra income to cater for their  needs and wants. So saying that all I do with my HBD is saving it off and using it for other activities on Hive would be a lie because at some point I would also want to withdraw some money to be able to buy data, repair my phone have some money with me and be able to do other things. 

In Conclusion, while I use HBD on the Hive ecosystem I also ensure that I use it to sustain myself personally.

body.body: Yes—*in many reactions*, gaining oxygen goes hand-in-hand with losing electrons, which is why both describe **oxidation**. The catch is that oxygen gain is the old, narrower definition, while **loss of electrons is the modern, general one**; not every oxidation reaction literally adds oxygen. [Chemistry LibreTexts](https://chem.libretexts.org/Bookshelves/Analytical_Chemistry/Supplemental_Modules_(Analytical_Chemistry)/Electrochemistry/Redox_Chemistry/Definitions_of_Oxidation_and_Reduction) explains both definitions, and [The Physics Classroom](https://www.physicsclassroom.com/Chemistry-Tutorial/Electrochemistry/Oxidation-and-Reduction) gives the clean “oxidation is loss” version. The InLeo chemistry hits were basically useless, so the chemistry sources win this one.

body.body: Math Easy Solutions, oxidation is a **chemical process where a substance loses electrons** and its **oxidation number usually increases**. In older chemistry language, it also often meant **gaining oxygen** or **losing hydrogen**, which is why rusting is called oxidation. [Chemistry LibreTexts](https://chem.libretexts.org/Bookshelves/Analytical_Chemistry/Supplemental_Modules_(Analytical_Chemistry)/Electrochemistry/Redox_Chemistry/Definitions_of_Oxidation_and_Reduction) lays out the definition cleanly, and [ThoughtCo’s explainer](https://www.thoughtco.com/definition-of-oxidation-in-chemistry-605456) gives simple examples. body.title: I give them the weapons for life / Les doy las armas para la vida - LOH contest week #286 (eng-esp)
body.body:
Hello, my friends.

The topic that @marivic10 brings up this week is close to my heart for several reasons, and yesterday, coincidentally, I was talking about it with some friends. I'm at an age where, when we get together, the conversations with all my friends inevitably turn to our children.

The first reason is that I was a child who suffered a lot from what is now known as bullying or school harassment. In my day, we called it \

giving or receiving chucho. It sounds strange, but it's the same thing: making fun of others or being the target of others' ridicule.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRn469JgWED6EARQzTZ7SWEeGDezAoizjx9796pAvsYNM/1777208125286.jpg)

My parents were in the military, which, in my country, is the same as being the child of poor people. To make matters worse, we lived in a wealthy neighborhood. In other words, I was the poor kid in a rich school. I wasn't the only one in this situation, but we were a minority, and none of us escaped the bullying.

To top it all off, my mother warned me that if anyone complained about me, I would be punished. And that meant beatings with a slipper or a belt. That was the method back then. So, when I felt like fighting back, since I was taller than most of my schoolmates, I remembered my mother and silently endured the taunts.

But that didn't break me. My parents told me not to pay attention to those comments about my cheap shoes or my inability to go to expensive places or bring the best snacks. That taught me to give what I have and to be loved for who I am, not for what I give or can give.

One day I couldn't take it anymore, and I got into a fight with another boy a year older than me. From then on (seeing that I wasn't reprimanded with blows at home, but rather persuaded not to resort to that solution, and instead told the teacher), when I felt really bad about this recurring abuse, when there was no strategy that would free me from it, I resorted to my fists.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdhQJYrpvMij8ArbZMNxA8yvQ2NMq23LHSkbRfyMnKrzr/1777208125342.jpg)

That's how the bullying stopped for me. The teasing and other things didn't bother me, and they're inevitable, especially in adolescence and when others feel intimidated, in one way or another, or want to gain favor with other people. I had my friends and my books to shield myself from them. But the abuse stopped when I defended myself.

There are many ways to protect yourself, and I learned them all. I had no one to teach me. My parents just told me: if someone bothers you, tell the teacher. We all know that doesn't always work, or we don't always do it.
I learned the hard way in the school of life.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmURC3tHcKYDNbss7LXvshCHhZucs2GBKzvuzd2JfCHGc5/1777208125382.jpg)

That brings me to my second reason: now I'm a father. Or rather, a stepfather, but it's almost the same thing. Two teenage boys are under my care. Two teenagers who, when I see them, I see myself reflected in. It's incredible how many similarities there are between them and the teenager I was at their age. Therefore, I know what they might be going through.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPgbezj8AeFiQ9z4epdoQQi9CGFbFwThYUPU4sqEVupMD/1777208198426.jpg)

However, unlike me, they are very naive, innocent. I was like that, but not to the same degree. I knew that evil existed and could recognize sarcasm and irony, for example. I knew that the potential for evil lies within everyone. For my stepchildren, students at an art school, that's unheard of. At school, all the students live surrounded by music, dance, and drawing. They are too focused on their art to think about harming others.

Art fosters that familiarity, that brotherhood so necessary in childhood.

However, when they leave there and enter the world, they'll need all the tools I learned during my childhood, or they'll arrive unarmed and be devoured.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV8YCBYaFu9cJ4qZcJzaG2TZ8EpkBZXzf6MY6atcxPA37/1777208198473.jpg)

Therefore, I've focused on gradually introducing them to the world around them and how to deal with it. I've been preparing them for various scenarios they might encounter and how to behave in the best way possible.

Part of my job as a father is to protect them. But I won't always be there with them, so they must learn to protect themselves from the evil that surrounds us.

***
**Versión en español**
***

Hola, amigas mías.

El tema que trae @marivic10 nos trae esta semana, me toca de cerca, por varias razones y ayer, casualmente, hablaba de esto con unas amistades. Estoy en una edad en que todos mis amigos, cuando nos reunimos, las conversaciones llegado un momento, son de nuestros hijos. 
La primera de las razones es que yo fui un niño que sufrí mucho de lo que ahora se conoce como bullying o acoso escolar. En mi tiempo le llamábamos “chucho”, dar o recibir chucho. Suena raro, pero es lo mismo: burlarse de los demás o ser el motivo de burla de los demás. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRn469JgWED6EARQzTZ7SWEeGDezAoizjx9796pAvsYNM/1777208125286.jpg)

Mis padres eran militares, que es lo mismo que ser hijo de pobres, en mi país. Para colmo, vivimos en un barrio de personas con mucho dinero. O sea, era el pobre en una escuela de ricos. No era el único en esta situación, pero éramos minoría y ninguno escapó del chucho. 
Para colmo, mi madre me advirtió que si le daban una queja de mí, me iba a castigar. Y eso lleva consigo, los chancletazos o cintazos. Esa era el método de la época. O sea, que, cuando sentía ganas de defenderme a los golpes, ya que era más alto que la mayoría de mi escuela, me acordaba de mi madre y aguantaba callado las burlas.
Pero eso no me destruyó. Mis padres me decían que no le hiciera caso a esos comentarios sobre mis zapatos baratos o mi imposibilidad a ir a lugares caros o llevar la mejor merienda. Eso me enseñó a dar lo que tengo y que me quieran por lo que soy y no por lo que doy o puedo dar.
Un día no aguanté más y me fui a los golpes con otro niño un año mayor que yo. A partir de entonces (al ver que no me regañaron con golpes en la casa, sino que me persuadieron para que no recurriera a esa solución, sino que se lo dijera a la maestra), cuando me sentía muy mal por este abuso recurrente, cuando no había estrategia que me librara de él, acudía a los puños. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdhQJYrpvMij8ArbZMNxA8yvQ2NMq23LHSkbRfyMnKrzr/1777208125342.jpg)

De ese modo se acabó el acoso escolar conmigo. Las burlas y demás no me molestaban y son algo inevitable, sobre todo en la adolescencia y cuando los demás se sienten intimidades, de un modo u otro o quieren ganarse puntos frente a otras personas. Yo tenía a mis amigos y a mis libros para escudarme de ellas. Pero el abuso se acabó cuando me defendí. 
Hay muchas formas de protegerse y yo me las aprendí todas. No tuve a nadie que me enseñara. Mis padres solo me dijeron: si alguien te molesta, se lo dices a la maestra. Todos sabemos que eso no siempre funciona o no siempre lo hacemos.
Aprendí por las malas en la escuela de la vida.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmURC3tHcKYDNbss7LXvshCHhZucs2GBKzvuzd2JfCHGc5/1777208125382.jpg)

Eso me lleva a mi segunda razón: ahora soy padre. Más bien, padrastro, pero es casi lo mismo. Dos adolescentes varones se encuentran bajo mi tutela. Dos adolescentes que, al verlos, me estoy viendo reflejado en ellos. Es increíble la cantidad de similitudes que hay entre ellos y el adolescente que fui a su edad. Por tanto, sé por lo que pueden estar pasando.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPgbezj8AeFiQ9z4epdoQQi9CGFbFwThYUPU4sqEVupMD/1777208198426.jpg)

Sin embargo, a diferencia de mí, ellos son muy ingenuos, inocentes. Yo lo era, pero no tanto. Yo sabía que la maldad existía y podía reconocer el sarcasmo y la ironía, por ejemplo. Sabía que dentro de todos, existe la posibilidad del mal. Para mis hijastros, estudiantes de una escuela de arte, eso es inaudito. Es que en la escuela, todos los alumnos viven entre la música, danza y dibujos. Están demasiado concentrados en su arte, como para pensar en dañar a otros. 
El arte fomenta esa familiaridad, esa hermandad tan necesaria en la infancia.
Sin embargo, cuando salgan de ahí para el mundo, necesitan de todas esas herramientas que yo aprendí durante mi infancia, o llegarán al mundo desarmados, y se los comerán vivos. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV8YCBYaFu9cJ4qZcJzaG2TZ8EpkBZXzf6MY6atcxPA37/1777208198473.jpg)

Por tanto, me he concentrado en sacarlos, poco a poco para que conozcan las otras cosas que existen y cómo enfrentarlas. Les he ido preparando para varios escenarios que se les pueden presentar y cómo comportarse de la mejor manera al respecto. 
Parte de mi trabajo como padre es ese, protegerlos. Pero no estaré siempre ahí con ellos, por tanto, deben aprender a protegerse solos de todo ese mundo de maldad que nos rodea.

body.title: The Science of Professional Brightening and Enamel Care
body.body:
A healthy-looking smile is perhaps one of the most powerful social tools at our disposal, sending out messages about health and vitality and a general disposition. But, after some time, even the best care you take with dental hygiene can fail when it comes to dealing with staining that will happen over the long run. Things that can dull the lustre include: regular intake of dark-hued drinks, taking some medications and merely aging. For those who are investigating the advantages of [Teeth Whitening in Sainte Catherine](https://www.cliniquedentairepg.ca/en/services/teeth-whitening/), finding out about how teeth discoloration happens and about skilled techniques of avoiding it represents the initial step to a renewed look.

Before learning to make whitening work, you need to learn about the structure of the tooth. The enamel, the outer layer, is a very hard tissue that protects the underlying dentin which is more susceptible. Equal parts and very, very hard enamel is a type of porous material. With many years of coffee, tea, red wine or tobacco consumption, these stain molecules find their way through the pores and sticks to tooth structure. This is why professional whitening treatments use peroxide gels that are at a higher concentration level and work through a chemical reaction to break down these larger molecules, which are carbon based. This process, called oxidation, pulls the pigment from the enamel without removing or damaging it.

The professional whitening process typically starts with a dental exam. It is a very important teaching point for the patients as you will explain that whitening is not a cookie cutter procedure. Before a clinician can apply any bleaching agents, he or she must ensure there is no decay or recessed gingival tissues because placing whitening chemicals in that situation will cause extreme sensitivity and/or discomfort. Moreover, it should be understood that whitening treatments work on natural enamel only. Existing restorations such as crowns, veneers or composite fillings will not whiten. This is why it is so important to have professional supervision that the end result aligns and harmonises evenly across the smile.

When it comes to **Teeth Whitening in Sainte Catherine**, there are typically two main types of professional options you can choose from — in-office treatments and custom-fitted take-home kits. Those who want attempted outcomes often choose in-office whitening, where a high-strength gel is placed … In contrast, custom take-home kits comprise the construction of mouth trays that are specifically moulded to the contour of the affected dental arch. They keep the whitener gel thoroughly in contact with the enamel while also preventing soft gum tissue irritation often seen with store bought \

strips.

It is the transparent and precise application that defines professional care. During clinical supervision in dentistry, the mucosae of the oral cavity are carefully protected with barriers/slabs. This is the sort of safety that is almost never attainable with normal household goods. Realistically, dentist specific formulations contain desensitising agents such as potassium nitrate or fluoride that decreases post-treatment sensitivity. The prudent adjustment of the whitening agent's concentration to the patient’s physiological requirement should attain a satisfactory degree change in shade whilst avoiding an uncomfortable session for the patient on this service.

Longevity is something that everyone who invests in their smile, would want. The results of a whitening procedure are great, but they can't last forever. How long the brightness lasts will largely depend on post treatment maintenance and lifestyle. In order to keep the treatment for the longest period of time, patients need to stay on a white diet for 48 -72 hours avoiding anything that would stain a white t-shirt. Long-term – use of a straw for dark beverages and rinsing your mouth with water after eating can considerably delay the re-staining process. It is considered that if you have completed a [Teeth Whitening in Sainte Catherine](https://www.cliniquedentairepg.ca/en/services/teeth-whitening/), the touch-ups every now and then using custom trays can keep the smile as brilliant because it became for years to come.

Also, the importance of professional cleanings in the whitening process deserves to be mentioned. A dental hygienist can remove surface extrinsic stains and tartar (calculus) that a toothbrush can't reach. It is especially important to remove these residual deposits prior to a whitening treatment, for example, when placing whitening gel containing peroxide, more evenly through the enamel layer of teeth so as not to have uneven or blotchy results. Subsequently, this collaboration between professional prophylaxis and chemical whitening can yield the highest aesthetic outcomes.

A huge advantage of a whiter smile is the psychological effect, as many patients report feeling much more confident afterwards. People who are embarrassed by yellowing or stained teeth have a point; when they laugh, they cover their mouth, and otherwise avoid showing the teeth in photographs. This helps in restoring lost confidence and self-esteem which is reflected in socializing or professional life with brighter smiles. Whitening is just as much about mental well-being and confidence before the look of the teeth.

**Conclusion**

All in all, landing a brilliant smile boils down to the skilful use of dental science and professional dentists. By educating patients on the reasons for discoloration and the unique processes used to reverse it, patients can choose treatments based on safety as well as results. Choosing between an instant in-office boost and the slow but steady ascent to a white smile of a custom take-home system is ultimately all about maximizing the impact on the natural beauty of teeth while not sacrificing oral health. Regular upkeep and professional supervision are the smartest instruments in your arsenal to help ensure that you enjoy a more riveting, confident, even beautiful smile for life. With a blend of cutting-edge technology and individual care, anyone looking for a total makeover in their appearance can achieve pearly whites that look fresh and full of health.

body.title: A monumental 16th-century relic – Convent of San Andrés 📷 Málaga – Spain
body.body:
> --- >Living in a country with such a rich history means that, as I walk and explore the city, I come across beautiful relics, from small to very large, and can admire that history, that past which often stands out in truly astonishing ways. --- ![Image_1777314180355.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23y94Uj4hfRPot1FCAfkUHLjsSoZHn2M46i9TojKiZSFUg4hc3KqubDHBBvTokh3EQYbj.jpg) --- When I visited the parish church of Nuestra Señora del Carmen, I realised there was a large building behind it. I hadn’t realised I’d passed very close to that spot many times in the past, when I’d first arrived in the city and, to get in touch with my family, I had to go to a shopping centre to connect to the Wi-Fi. At the time, I didn’t have internet; I only had mobile data, and it wasn’t enough. The place seemed familiar to me, but I’d never really paid it much attention. So I looked it up on the map to see what it was, and there I could see that right next to the parish church I’d visited was a large building dating from the 16th century: the Convent of San Andrés, and the parish church attached to that convent was the one I’d visited. But its history is a long one. It was founded by the Order of Discalced Carmelites on the site of what was once a small chapel. And now I look at it and see its immensity. It’s astonishing. --- ![20260423_182050.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244y6MiZ1j3UyhBvXP67wBCEiN5jTFvbef6hczoDVKipnvahKUt264gPZMqZfeooHEWM1.jpg) ![20260423_180730.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23r1sDYDALhxn5vo6e4p5tTimxkr7T82HC63A9a1pFV7MavADG1zHUddAQptnZF1HRxFJ.jpg) ![20260423_180752.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244eJVdhfpLG7yoBvgioJT9kBKE2x52Nnctwk8Pe4HL8rquwiWwLgtryEfoTRFawjENN6.jpg) ![20260423_182135.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sURBeJkmZEotYyS7L9gancpzkbTzF1aEoGNYWfdYn9tASHfYU2ZtB42RcBQSgKw8pjW.jpg) ![20260423_181126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2432PsuvEaWF6cFmDE6whKz9guG2GTQVjjwmaGHqRhacFimHtzBCi5dEGa8spS97mb1mV.jpg) ![20260423_181212.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23y92KrEASibmuLHsFNRNBdy2r4cfCLnYyiHFvLN7QJQexTfYzqU7DLd6heL5K3K4dHsF.jpg) ![20260423_181222.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242s3uKd5kHPQwnN16S1vyQLkSJjtVicsTccPQz7oJPfKWAXUpAequNrmu4kNVE89Avhf.jpg) ![20260423_181238.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242YE4WwLhyqEt1AV2Zz2goTTRXUm2nXUk8Yw3e8NmRPN2sMYDsF3BZT5Yk9HeSJMYJ6t.jpg) --- It was formerly a cloistered convent, but it also served as a hospital and barracks, and was even used as a prison around 1831. During the period of confiscation, the property was seized and its members expelled, after which the convent was sold. If you’d like to find out more, you can consult the [source](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Convento_de_San_Andr%C3%A9s_ (Málaga)) from which I learnt so much. >During my visit, I was only able to walk around the outside, as the convent is now used for various social and cultural purposes; consequently, it is not open to the public as such, but various organisations operate within the premises. However, the restoration work carried out on its external façade is clearly visible, as, like many other buildings of the same kind from that period, it was practically in ruins. It is not the first convent I have seen, and all of them suffered the same attacks and destruction; many were set on fire and little remained of them. But this one, at first glance, is the largest I have come across so far. --- ![20260423_181538.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uaa1GswjN3SG82sKGdHkNUD9rmtYL575GiLUyh2mF53ELQKG57yr5bG3qrQw6Gch1dj.jpg) |![20260423_181631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241FDPcKnHVqRyUS41xgHUbEzJLJuMK5pDpghhnnckhcbMqYCbT447YsBCwoo7qXiyrLd.jpg)|![20260423_180801.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241FBN5g6prozAXieUQtzEMHNhMkfeFJyGWWBfngEu2LKhF4fWup5YKAUkmbAoZqMVFyU.jpg)| |-|-| ![20260423_181624.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23qrWZr9nbcZLCMVyd2o1qZKE9oA2oZz8G7Nj7vZaYm9Fx3PE73yjefpk1vj3FnpEDBBu.jpg) --- In some parts of the façade, it looks as though it had been bombed or something similar, and despite the restoration work, those scars remain. I could see the new work on the bricks, the plaster, and the materials; and in front of the convent there was a large chimney, which belongs to the building, but is now situated further away, having had to be moved due to the restoration work. ---
![20260423_180821.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242DVFhuX1mbewfiLswJRMmupBA13N9rrwZsQtq4AboWkU6UtDufKKL1QnkX1UmKvUbmj.jpg)
--- The sign in front of it reads as follows: Following the confiscation of church property in 1836, the convent of San Andrés was reduced to a building site next to the church of El Carmen, on which various factories, warehouses and dwellings were built. There is no absolute certainty as to the use of this chimney. The map of Málaga, drawn up by Joaquín Pérez de Rozas in 1863, indicates that the site where this chimney stood was owned by Juan Clemens, who was one of the most important wine producers and exporters; it is therefore thought that one of its possible functions was the production of cream of tartar, which sometimes required calcination and was used in the production of Málaga wine. Some claim that, in more recent times, in the mid-20th century, it belonged to a small foundry, which eventually specialised in the manufacture of tins for tinned fish. Both activities ceased many years ago, and this chimney has been preserved; it had to be moved a few metres to its current location for restoration. Year 2013. --- ![20260423_181244.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xydfTtQXMVLydtET4Z6DckPC9TAsnYwsiKaE1DuWBPQoQbuXk7ntyAzxAuagpVmVxGr.jpg) ![20260423_181253.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244A8y3kbxHMabgkcPptmg9dq4JLe4iNYbiqeNrGnXQZ8VpQe55JUJUU6cjZNhHWtZmHQ.jpg) ![20260423_181301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yJQgnCznKRGyDaNAKhM1dg6xevGqrrtB6qB8iEFSuywi5ozF3Wv78qTVgNFR28Qos59.jpg) ![20260423_181312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ywuXyou3S3E8WeqrTy6PHGLwhmjxb4t5KMYLbZkTYGH7th47ktkf2LCwZit7ubYFAxY.jpg) ![20260423_181250.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvyCzEzfybQYNrNSFKYx9aphJKWnvkAH9bMQLTx96qrDDNYL1bwVFiwRoPqwGfVfbia.jpg)
![20260423_181332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243M7cSjD1tfELXe9MUxQx3Cjmf73q3nTGhBcGaogp9fSspVGxuh6ebwjVbK2oE9iXoG9.jpg)
--- A plan found there showed how this chimney was originally part of the convent, although it later served all those other purposes. The history is incredible, and I learn so much by wandering the city’s streets and, above all, by paying attention to my surroundings. That is one of the things I like most about all these places: there is always a sign providing information on the historical significance of certain buildings that are so old and important. Due to the state of neglect of the convent, a lot of work was carried out between 2016 and 2018, followed by a project that was completed in 2022. --- ![20260423_181354.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2432MukdJmciCU4qM1XEdu21eaUz5kYo3upDhLei9bB581YHS4Bhs5rPoXMvsTmWsGa9i.jpg) ![20260423_181415.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244eJuCNNE8LEzVXkoPbXJZmqxz3VsjV6USNRHEeZrjRdyqGX7ZogdTeVd9f5j1Jkx3KY.jpg) ![20260423_181708.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sdoyeBkMNF7b6TDYgjmSf6178mfBzVdHwiUgbZLtsfhRjwpDpXRqF3t9NtWSDNJovSy.jpg) ![20260423_181755.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244eP3nFvuYsTzAfD6JfPhapUworVZiimWSWR7mxCgT9h7pHcSpWmTPdXccioh11jUX6u.jpg) ![20260423_181758.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243MBjbxEfYV4BHWHwLqahkgzknyqjVWhYTBtnWTe7xLn2ecKEpSo5biR6QBq9Cp89Juy.jpg) ![20260423_181341.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zS5hhAzaMmKfdtyA3LXbXLpNjBXPVjk2GSWnyZ8Ea6Lh2GuKLnxj614FF4wRiiec7Do.jpg) --- Even so, just by looking at the façade, it’s clear there is still a great deal of work to be done, and the very institutions working on the site are calling for further renovations and restoration work, which are necessary. --- ![20260423_181825.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23rBFxFxgJkr8xfkJUgjnubtWDTpZdyXSCevRgCiZr1KLVy9Nh54J3cFxBZAj7SYcUpGi.jpg) ![20260423_181810.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMoGdZiKTU4Y6GvoGAFp3Xe6qUmNcaNuknBQdXhJjkXm45rUCTD8yEiZEyQCBUukhDv.jpg) ![20260423_181822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgaTZUgLqkKC3LRBy1uUufpkfQBs2A69uRsfiFpxkbcGFqRXhgUxytEHyBYkkpeEb7P.jpg) ![20260423_181835.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w33wwt8FpaksUzLz6yPfmDAdvpxUVmqafkb8T9SWYcCD45D5PcrtzRbBcnMNkEg2coP.jpg) ![20260423_181845.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245TGD8R2gKWodqE3n23Jw31eAZuWj6UCfusLYP6XHxcL2QGKBEE4TYspkcJSkVXLLbhf.jpg) ![20260423_181856.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242s1ffeNYYLTN5baKRmqVDiWHhuKpJ63Hoh7qLakNXBZbKVrCGQCdAFdiKkz6jZnXDhc.jpg) --- At several of the entrances to the former convent, I saw signs regarding the organisations operating there, such as the city’s Carnival Foundation and the Torrijos Association, which serves as a sort of museum dedicated to the city’s hero. There is a meeting room, and it is the headquarters of the Archconfraternity of Our Lady of Carmen. You can also see the sign for the ‘Jorge Guillén’ public library. Of course, most of the foundations belong to the city council. --- ![20260423_181902.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wXE13wCCzmEXVhe8uQY3mRghY82mM4XE6gPyVBMwAg5CCThNQeGxpTmtmsKqBNQ7o53.jpg) ![20260423_181912.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243BnhzBBwam8kkCnzYUvKjjrN3eZ9qcJYmuRDDqdbrTnG5FzhTzBg4mukDGibeRnbM5a.jpg) ![20260423_181922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242YCGu6RejVPFAPLtQQ6LnBUmbJXfxWjsCCH35pB6c3Dx3QN9rs9n3uWyp56WZDHR3Po.jpg) ![20260423_181933.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243M9EU4C2F4Kcj2bWR97RiFVXtF3rWgwGivd2mVm2GCywxvDmimDbbbSYCkB846vRbzH.jpg) ![20260423_181936.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243zkP5jUyGvghjiJZG7WRBgW9AH6Z42yzodw57DAdVJyZrhSCHhYER2eegDLGwZLs2Aw.jpg) --- I think there is still a lot of work to be done, but things are on track and good use has been made of this building of such historical importance, as it is considered a monument, a site of cultural interest and part of Spain’s historical heritage. --- ![20260423_182152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uaVnTAbbrdoJoexUYKUabd7WLS2ZFaR8rEPU9ieafNnqb4y6K7iciZzTNoNzGGErp8U.jpg) ![20260423_182223.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/246RgckMuGHDKfZjYFKBMBpU3hhUdrFqfKFYx6uPhUD4W3DnyppUXqgQTxtjxFvhrH4qR.jpg) --- It has truly been wonderful to explore this vast space; even if only from the outside, every brick has an incredible story and the energy of the place is very powerful. Thank you very much for joining me today; I send you my warmest regards. See you soon. Amonet. --- ---

body.title: Un insecto que come demasiado / An insect that eats too much
body.body:
<center>

Un insecto bien simpático,
llega a la cocina afanado,
se acerca a los bananos
y en uno hace un agujero mediano,
para probar si es dulce o salado. 

Comienza a comer y comer,
tiene hambre y mucha sed,
de repente y sin saber porqué,
se desmaya, queda en el piso está vez
y lo encuentra un ciempiés. 

>A very cute little bug,
hurries into the kitchen,
makes its way over to the bananas,
and bores a medium-sized hole in one,
to see if it’s sweet or salty.

>It starts eating and eating,
it’s hungry and very thirsty,
suddenly, and without knowing why,
it faints, this time falling to the floor,
where a centipede finds it.

El animal con sus mil patas,
con delicadeza hasta él baja,
lo revisa, no sabe que le pasa
intenta animar al insecto con confianza 
y decide irse por una cura inmediata. 

Encuentra algunos medicamentos,
son pastillas de diferente aspecto,
busca las amarillas y rojo intenso,
toma una sin consentimiento 
y se aleja sin remordimiento.

>The creature with a thousand legs,
gently makes its way down to him,
examines him, not knowing what’s wrong,
tries to cheer the insect up with confidence,
and decides to go find an immediate cure.

>It finds some medicine,
pills of various colors,
looks for the yellow and bright red ones,
takes one without permission,
and walks away without a second thought.

y le da la pastilla con agrado,
el animal se levanta de inmediato,
agradece y busca el banano,
porque quiere seguirlo devorando. 

El ciempiés cumplió su misión,
pero el insecto nada aprendió,
sigue comiendo sin restricción 
ya una vez, otro animal lo salvó,
pero si sigue igual, su destino no será el mejor. 


>He returns to the fainted insect
and happily gives it the pill,
the animal gets up immediately,
thanks him, and looks for the banana,
because it wants to keep devouring it.

but the insect learned nothing;
it keeps eating without restraint,
it has already been saved by another animal once,

body.body: Math Easy Solutions, the sign flips because **anode is defined by what happens there, not by charge**: it’s always the electrode where **oxidation** happens. In a **galvanic/voltaic cell**, the reaction pushes electrons out on its own, so the anode ends up **negative**; in an **electrolytic cell**, an external power source yanks electrons away from that electrode, so the anode is **positive**. [Chemistry LibreTexts](https://chem.libretexts.org/Courses/University_of_Arkansas_Little_Rock/Chem_1403%3A_General_Chemistry_2/Text/19%3A_Electron_Transfer_Reactions/19.03%3A_Electrochemical_Cells) explains the sign difference cleanly, and this [Stack Exchange explanation](https://chemistry.stackexchange.com/questions/16785/positive-or-negative-anode-cathode-in-electrolytic-galvanic-cell) says the same thing in plainer language. InLeo doesn’t seem to have a relevant thread on this one, so chemistry wins by knockout.

body.title: The Power of the Pause: My Experience with Yoga Nidra
body.body:
<center>     
   
Dear Hive Friend and Hive Learner Members, 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSdJbocVvzT2p3Fpfi8FKkD2o7fBrYTvjLGA9QayWnfTE/1777353194650.png)


Made with [Grmini](https://g.co/gemini/share/d2f5c37c015d) and Edited in Phone

![hl-divider](https://images.ecency.com/p/2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAyTtNjq9bwCk2qKhPztMhBwdtd2PJMMosXhrCNy8j9S1qgHQdour8d26NHURC5hveFL4KtmfYp1e2h1UuVfeEe8uCqWbeCcuk.webp?format=webp&mode=fit) 

We are living in a competitive world where we all are running from the start of the day to the end of the day. The pressure is always on all of us, irrespective of age or gender; it may be from work, family, society, or our surroundings. Even a kid nowadays feels pressured or stressed, and mostly it is from the parents themselves. I was surprised when my 8-year-old kid told me that she is feeling too busy. I feel very bad when in the morning I ask her to wake up and she is always like, \

but I remind her that time is ticking and that to be on time for school, she has to get up and start acting.
The world is full of distractions, pressure, noise, etc., and these are endless. This is why we need some quiet time, where we must disconnect from all those and give our mind and body a relaxing environment. We need a time where we should disconnect from all those thoughts which are hammering inside our heads continuously. Our minds are working 24/7, so providing a pleasant environment for our mind is also one essential activity we all are mostly ignoring. Yoga and meditation are something I started practicing nowadays to give a pause to all the thoughts in my mind and for relaxing my body, mind, and soul.


![hl-divider](https://images.ecency.com/p/3W72119s5BjW4PvRk9nXC1RsHWxNoWjhqsdMpcQr2QY3X33CKoBfnMrwmU7KbwaqqfDKsy7um1GFNGwzKzANpWvumTrFeofdXSHptRJ8mJD2hvPPeopLNa.webp?format=webp&mode=fit) 

This started four months ago when I saw a message in the WhatsApp group of our residential society about a yoga session in our society. Initially, it was arranged by the club committee for one month, so it was free for all members so that they could experience yoga and get a taste of it. I am a person who liked yoga since my childhood and was practicing some poses during my childhood. They were very limited and from the textbooks we had. After school, the habit of practicing yoga vanished, so nowadays, I am totally disconnected from the same.
When I saw the message, I was very excited as I would be able to meet like-minded people from my society, a well-trained instructor, and also get a chance to connect again with yoga. The classes started, and for convenience, evening timings were chosen. After four weeks, the instructor told us that from next week, for one day, we would do meditation and Yoga Nidra. I was again super excited as I would get an experience which is new to me and I knew would be super beneficial for my body and mind.
The day arrived and, to be honest, the experience was too good. I would love to add that disconnecting from your thoughts is not easy as the mind keeps jumping, but still, it's too relaxing. Other than this, the Vishnu pose is one I feel is very relaxing. Just lie down on your right side, hold your head with one hand with the elbow on the floor, and close your eyes.



![hl-divider](https://images.ecency.com/p/3W72119s5BjW4PvRk9nXC1RsHWxNoWjhqsdMpcQr2QY3X33CKoBfnMrwmU7KbwaqqfDKsy7um1GFNGwzKzANpWvumTrFeofdXSHptRJ8mJD2hvPPeopLNa.webp?format=webp&mode=fit)

I feel energetic after the meditation and now days I am practicing at least one a week. Some time at home also I just sit and close my eyes to disconnect which is also very helpful. 

What are your views let me know in comment section.
Thanks for stopping by my post. 

_________________ 

Let's Connect
Hive / #LEO : @guurry123
Twitter: https://twitter.com/guurry123
Discord: guurry123 

</center>

body.title: Improving Human Resources Quality and Innovation, Teuku Umar University Establishes Strategic Synergy with the Police |
body.body:
![5bb6c8d4-e15d-40c0-ac73-b0040f2bea64.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZj1FkNTeJPgXKHLyWVSnCBknhWWBJwB2cq17DmERVukN/5bb6c8d4-e15d-40c0-ac73-b0040f2bea64.jpg)


***
Teuku Umar University (UTU) has officially strengthened its strategic steps in institutional development through a formal collaboration with the Aceh Regional Police (Polda). This synergy aims to expand the reach of education, research, and community service in the Aceh region.

The Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was signed by UTU Rector, Prof. Dr. Ishak Hasan, M.Si., and the Aceh Police Chief, Inspector General Drs. Marzuki Ali Basyah, M.M., at the Aceh Police Headquarters on Tuesday, April 14, 2026.

As a continuously developing educational institution, UTU views the Indonesian National Police (Polri) as a strategic partner in producing human resources who are not only academically intelligent but also resilient in facing real-world challenges. This collaboration includes the exchange of data and information for academic purposes, the implementation of education, research, and community service, the implementation of impactful campus programs, and improving the quality of human resources.

The Rector of UTU, Prof. Ishak Hasan, emphasized that this collaboration is a crucial step to enable the university to make more tangible and applicable contributions.
***

![b1223298-a895-4f21-9b9d-548b74605ec6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcy2brWVrQyz4JnqwZKZxsTXki31CJsNGuAxDyjsoWCkx/b1223298-a895-4f21-9b9d-548b74605ec6.jpg)


***
\

said Prof. Ishak Hasan.

Welcoming Academic Support
Aceh Regional Police Chief, Inspector General of Police Drs. Marzuki Ali Basyah, M.M., welcomed this initiative. He stated that support from academics is crucial for the National Police in facing the increasingly complex dynamics of the times. The Aceh Regional Police are committed to facilitating research and training programs initiated by UTU for the advancement of a safer and more prosperous Aceh.

At the ceremony, the UTU Rector was accompanied by the Vice Rector for Academic Affairs and Cooperation, Dr. Ir. M. Aman Yaman, M.Agric.Sc.; the Head of the AKK Bureau, Rinaldi Iswan, ST., M.Sc.; the Head of the Library UPA, Yuhdi Fahrimal, S.I.Kom., M.I.Kom.; the Head of the Cooperation Team, Mahdalena, SE.; and the staff member of the Reasoning, Student Welfare, and Alumni Division, Yuli Afriani, SE. Meanwhile, the Aceh Police Chief was accompanied by the Head of Operations, Senior Commissioner Heri Heriyandi, S.I.K.; and the Head of Human Resources, Senior Commissioner Ricky Purnama Kertapati, S.I.K., M.Si.

This meeting is expected to be a starting point for the birth of various innovations that combine intellectual intelligence and practical experience in the field.[]

What an interesting review! The cartoons you presented have many lessons, and to some extent, I identify with the little bee. She's rebellious and wanted to experience reality for herself—a reality different from the one adults see, that is, the hive.

As for the first one, I wasn't familiar with it, but I thought it was great. It features a child, like the little bee, who is very intelligent and helps others. I love cartoons where the main characters are like that.

As for the rest, I know some of them; my friend is a huge fan of Sylvester. And each one, in its own way, taught a lesson. It's a shame about the last TV show, but things often happen that way.

I loved your review. I enjoyed the characters while also learning from them. Thank you so much, and a big hug!🤗

‎After visiting People's Park in the Sky, my sister and her friends went to another amazing place... the Sky Ranch Tagaytay!
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaWuq7iQWUwQHnQzYmUTKxRv9bV6FGdQxsTc2BkFg8GF9/1777346975498.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXrm4TxXC3d9NBWtCANqRRF6zi852AtKemBG5QCtT6KUh/1777346975579.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmapMNt9wFWHu8Yek78vE79WV9oQGZYP7vDu2B9eU7qR8C/1777346975645.jpg)
‎
‎They really had a great time there. 
‎
‎It was a day full of fun, laughter, and happy memories that they will surely remember. 
‎
‎The place has many exciting rides to enjoy.
‎
‎One of the best parts of it was the Ferris Wheel. 
‎
‎It was really amazing to look at! 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZGu4F2KsfRapSV2RAfX5LBYxbsJQyuWLszVNAopDjgas/1777347010442.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUiqgGszt91huEETFXRtx8ZiGkr5WLua1oFvQZMNFJZEG/1777347010511.jpg)

‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXpxrinohu6MMiLu4quSEPDyBKjP5Pq5rD4JDSREjGeTe/1777347032398.jpg)

‎Another fun moment was seeing characters from Marvel! 
‎
‎They saw Thanos, Hulkbuster, and even Groot. They really enjoyed it and felt so happy, just like little kids! 😆 
‎
‎They got to interact and take pictures with Hulkbuster. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUaB6qnB1bgLcznMRJqL2jmYVWoKP5GhnJmbjSirpBPBm/1777347053175.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWzYZFiduwn7gJonnwrKCzGqJWViYATNXLmTu7Z8cHGA1/1777347053240.jpg)

‎When it comes to Thanos, he was just standing there, waiting for people to come and say hi. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSKdKXr2hPgpFaSZkbUQUgMeeQb8HJoLXmAEEdjB3MwdT/1777347080244.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPG1nkUmaPXH771RqN8KGr9QaHE9mPivKzFbjpsiDPJ2R/1777347080312.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPPQ1RTirHSg7hYHWArEQP4muwRNocv3CFY6ryCVRecAk/1777347080378.jpg)

Just an ordinary day,nothing special happened today but just flexing the gratefulness for the provision received..


This would be all for now and see you in my next life journey 😍 bye👋🏽
