body.title: An Afternoon at the Beach and a Bittersweet Celebration with Friends
body.body:
Hello everyone! Truly grateful in this platform where I could freely express my emotions other than using a pen and a paper. 

![Cold escape with friends_20260426_224328_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23wqrZ6E3V7T5f9BnhiiNti9kQDf35Pi1BtfuWKH8dcb4HYHR4aWxgvy3Jx7tj8SQ3bL1.jpg)

As you can read from the title, I am actually feeling bittersweet today. Well, not just me, but it is a common feeling I am sharing with all of my friends, with everyone who are present during that moment.

We actually had a joyful morning as we spent it again in our volunteer work of sharing the good news to people. Right after, we went to our worship hall for a brief cleaning activity.

![1777179700920_011014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23wWyPYSptb9oFDu8j419XttTYfCLxRrKXSosB81Zughs52fpi4S6uQqywiaha6qx191K.jpg)

![1777179700954_011038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23yJBuUjhHfpq14K4wHDJGfvSYwFokL5fjPqVkqNjHEMCUnFQJNa5uFfpJgnNQkjfHdE5.jpg)

![1777179700897_010946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23vsHpwZfcfmQUu9XYPQ8YFAv38Qxos7V9b5wGfhTDzQucmwQiLtpLmCJYEbvW6rMZfG7.jpg)

It was already planned days ago that in the afternoon, we will have a short bonding by the sea at the place near our home. So, starting at noon, we started preparing foods. Mom cooked pancit and boiled sweet potato, while some of my friends brought and cooked other food like chiffon cake and some crispy cassava chip called \

, which is served with latik or caramelized coconut cream.

It is not just an ordinary bonding though, because this afternoon we also planned a double celebration surprise for some of our friends. This is to congratulate them for the privileges that some of them had and going to have soon in the future.

![1777179700524_010308.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/242hSbFb4F88MPeM9x1XyjGje3i9G4cruCWkfPYUJu9JxjDCbCQ4JfhbiUwfafDU8m5Ld.jpg)

Two of our friends have finished their one week education, where they gained deeper understanding on God's word and how to become more effective in teaching by showing love and kindness to all kinds of people. They were surprised and grateful for the gifts they received. 

![1777179700481_010226.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23wMTpeFfepi3wueqNHNQLuNkrwz4qozA5Z3zWRMCzkEFzt65yD2zc9zh26hHDaEZpe6c.jpg)

![1777179700604_010443.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/243MBCjnhTAgrUvV7L1Nw7vrVcvVGQcrR2frm9YeGKVJYGN8My8K5MSsgXT6Fzuezr1Gg.jpg)

On the other hand, two of or friends, which is a couple so dear to me are also privileged for another educational training but lasting for two months and after their schooling, they will be reassigned to help people in another place. That means, they will be leaving us. And that is when the ambiance started to change into crying moments as we sang a farewell song for them and watched a slideshow presentation of our memories together. Each one of us, said a message for them and them to us. We cried even more.

It may be a sad thing the they are leaving us soon but we are way more happy of their privilege. For us, it is not goodbye but seeing each other next time. 

And that is the reason we all felt bittersweet today but joy outweighs any emotion that we are having right now. 

![1777179700875_010902.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/242NankLLgGb1vWMpT7XFLSSAhXqRJkU7MQM4b3hHA4p6rQdokrVejoVXRQYfSkLr422k.jpg)

Despite all the drama, we took time to enjoy the nature and the sea. Some of my friends were already enjoying swimming despite the big waves. It was nearly eve and and it is getting colder so we decided to go to the house.

Since everyone is feeling full because of the food we ate, we decided to exercise. So we had zumba at night. We served hot drinks while everyone is still dancing. We shared lots of laughter this time forgetting all the tears we witnessed earlier. 

It was a fun night after all. I am truly happy to be able to make wonderful and fun moments like this with my precious friends.

Photos are mine and edited with Canva.

body.title: [ENG/ESP] A different kind of Monday, brightened by the beauty of a gray day.
body.body: > **I hope you all have a wonderful and productive day. Today I have to go do my routine chlorination and disinfection at the Parque Costa Azul shopping center, and I sincerely hope the weather is much better than it was yesterday. Sometimes the weather in Margarita decides to surprise us, and this past Monday dawned a bit cloudy. Only a few timid rays of sunshine peeked out, only to hide again behind the gray sky moments later. It was as if the day couldn’t quite decide whether it wanted to be bright or remain shrouded in that soft mist that covered everything. Although the weather wasn’t the usual radiant sunshine that cheers us up so much, my husband and I left early to do our work. In the morning, we were at the Sunsol Unik hotel, carrying out our maintenance routine, and in the afternoon, we had to go to the Sunsol Isla Caribe hotel, located on El Tirano Beach. That place always has a special charm, even when the sky is capricious.**

> *Les deseo un día maravilloso y productivo a todos.   Hoy debo ir a hacer mi rutina de clorado y desinfección en el centro comercial Parque Costa Azul, y sinceramente espero que el clima esté mucho mejor que el de ayer. A veces el tiempo en Margarita decide sorprendernos, y este lunes que recién culminó amaneció un poco nublado. Apenas salían unos tímidos rayos de sol que, por momentos, se escondían de nuevo detrás del cielo gris. Era como si el día no terminara de decidir si quería ser luminoso o quedarse envuelto en esa neblina suave que cubría todo. A pesar de que el clima no era el acostumbrado sol radiante que tanto nos anima, mi esposo y yo salimos temprano a realizar nuestro trabajo. En la mañana estuvimos en el hotel Sunsol Unik, cumpliendo con nuestra rutina de mantenimiento, y en la tarde nos tocó ir al hotel Sunsol Isla Caribe, ubicado en playa El Tirano. Ese lugar siempre tiene un encanto especial, incluso cuando el cielo está caprichoso.*
![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqFrvA9347geYHiEzHEdhAPFUqwCEitov8XCDsntqiY3deTqnXvU6a4WhN5JthKAuFY.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-38-43.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep3erpiKsUbdmWB9nVPysGTuGt3cqUxw1LGjkwDgefUyXDnn5JKVTHhnZBUYawvcLYw.jpg) ![a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eou7ELsHHDjq1591wdEZQJVo2qVQX8FssZdYtKVapWAatwa4ekg7npTfy1KSpQfLm9z.jpg)

> **After finishing our work, we decided to take a short stroll through El Tirano, because it always has beautiful scenery to offer. As lovers of the sea, we really enjoy these impromptu walks, which give us a chance to unwind after a day’s work. The smell of the sea mixed with the aroma of fried fish wafting from the restaurants right on the shore is, without a doubt, one of the most delightful attractions of this tour. It’s a scent that envelops you, reminding you that you’re on a vibrant island steeped in tradition.**

> *Después de terminar nuestras labores, decidimos dar un pequeño recorrido por El Tirano, porque siempre tiene paisajes hermosos que mostrarnos. Nosotros, amantes del mar, disfrutamos muchísimo estos paseos improvisados que nos regalan un respiro después de un día de trabajo. El olor a mar mezclado con el aroma del pescado frito que sale de los restaurantes pegados a la orilla es, sin duda, uno de los atractivos más deliciosos de este recorrido. Es un olor que te abraza, que te recuerda que estás, en una isla viva y llena de tradición.*
![photo_2026-04-27_22-39-13 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq36d5wmsKw9BRpSgehcUGTMS8JvajF6RoZQUaw4KWAM7hJLUBVHd8sRt7wnNHe4Mzc.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-39-12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoiPWbjeQD12J3mGsDPuhEWKdtKtDW8G5vc8UqPvxdqfHHPSkhY3nzmtygEqH6y5cPJ.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-39-05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpC83JNBALp9WkWg9yog3XbWtbxWteycqXuqZBzXFD5Y8eaFPvgr52EmVdktor5R4d2.jpg) ![a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EogLLnW6aqGr39MrR1hAE6c2Xawu8FG7C6tTGr4BvvyPxq9GUp3hXXDUnS5oiQFveAs.jpg)

> **It’s also a privilege to watch the fishermen stow their traps in their boats as they prepare for the day’s work. Even watching them repair their boat engines is part of the everyday scene—a sight so authentic that you can’t help but stop and watch. It’s like seeing the very essence of coastal life.**

> *También es un privilegio ver a los pescadores acomodar las nasas en sus botes, preparándose para la faena. Incluso observarlos reparar los motores de sus lanchas es parte del paisaje cotidiano, una escena tan auténtica que uno no puede evitar detenerse a mirar. Es como ver la esencia misma de la vida costera.*
![photo_2026-04-27_22-39-12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EptaZ8r3TK8c15gG8oSD6diSBNMCGt9ynMZZMJEs5sXopkPD355TVn97rN9udpQMRJ7.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-39-09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpC8R1wxEDyUwJDjG5WhtsTUmbRDZAKLvrw3FH1bckT9zhhVWbzKaL78h6V45PWzZXb.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-39-08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eou6roh4PmwWX6wXBjau2gmEHayHaTbnNEUta8tmJhfje3wFUT9ekMkC5ZqDioEkAVE.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-39-07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoryNpmfxL3z6g9NH2Uhe8P38FZqee9MyQuUEx9vzPp6aS4LDt8PR6o5Tw6m7rSJhLZ.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-39-02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep1VSmrUkttj9XQDzGZaJWWyvATmHmNZ4PpKvBTgnChXERpWYjaV2W5SAz5Jfg5DYs8.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-39-01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpvgUiURabLy1nyuofhBBBo5kbsWYYT8Gb4JLeVEhqDkiJabfcPevXMzALM8Bjw5bQe.jpg)

> **We continued our walk because the plan was to make it all the way to Puerto Abajo Beach. We’d decided to sit down for a while to clear our heads. On weekdays, this beach is usually very quiet, almost silent, which makes it perfect for relaxing. On weekends, however, it fills up with families with children, since it’s not a deep beach and doesn’t have much of a surf. We love it, but we definitely prefer it on weekdays—and if it’s in the afternoon, even better.**

> *Continuamos nuestro paseo porque la idea era llegar hasta la playa Puerto Abajo. Habíamos decidido sentarnos un rato para despejar la mente. Entre semana esta playa suele estar muy tranquila, casi silenciosa, y eso la hace perfecta para relajarse. Los fines de semana, en cambio, se llena de familias con niños, ya que no es una playa profunda ni de mucho oleaje. A nosotros nos encanta, pero definitivamente la preferimos entre semana y, si es en la tarde, mucho mejor.*
![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/243fxZGv7jZy3g5PdCX2QK1ZRQFj1hkprgRqF7pHduZXRZwiBtPdGwU7YTGFUG18MDayJ.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-38-53.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqNDn6QPiCDZFBhHPGpWVCNa6pYCM614JGV77WqX3MzDRVNwtn8DDHFgHuk4ryLn6fV.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-38-49.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EppKg4syNNUSN2JXQpyAjoaTrecrTbHWSTMWxFAvBrGg9k8AkUfywE8NwWphfT9pw9v.jpg) ![video_2026-04-27_22-24-49.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/243fnBq816zU1xbJQyBipD4F56QUKKeDiAKP8ygxagrTSu7pk8vXYcxZb3bhZd8zCtqex.gif)
> **From Puerto Abajo, you can see a stunning view of Guayamurí Hill. I love that view; I could spend hours looking at it because its beauty never gets old.**

> *Desde Puerto Abajo se puede ver una imagen genuina del cerro Guayamurí. Esa vista me encanta; podría pasar horas mirándola porque tiene una belleza que no cansa.*
![photo_2026-04-27_22-38-59.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eqd9TetbQrHzSPnHSpN3VhPdK6oF97zpLmSsbHc22PNjj4M4ZnhnoVKgfZ5mnxxCySJ.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-38-51.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqQP4VbUiiiGJHYywuKwa48Br3LEfNKPabqXCgvN3t9vmTRGgvyqH8ZhGJQtGADKwFn.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-38-48.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpQvMd3KDfYa1bdD72RFBTkvtAXkz4S3qsvWs7DHKVTRApYUhPom2aQcRv9JA1J6v1h.jpg) ![a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eos1E48CFBaUT31aNCUuXX5YoRQPrSAivZcvDEuDce4wRPurwdeomEtVnZdEeQKmYq9.jpg)

> **Given the time of day and the weather—which had been a bit rough for fishing—all the boats were tied up at the shore. I didn’t waste any time: as we walked, I sat down for a moment and my husband took some photos of me to capture the memory.**

> *Por la hora y por el clima, que ha estado un poco hostil para la pesca, todos los botes estaban en la orilla. No perdí el tiempo: mientras caminábamos, me senté un momento y mi esposo me tomó algunas fotos para guardar el recuerdo.*
![photo_2026-04-27_22-38-56.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqYrpDuuMzwR8piy7Djm1kooPjqnCMkf3XsuuczMtJgwkK8DZXSFZ3MCyPKTxHEN3EY.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-38-54.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqNGDQRGjR5upvB9qrBRX6yML9hzCPPKLUiG5WZLyqepDLmbpLC6x83oCmCER7Wk5J3.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-38-52.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqSW4JE1sk3zNyHMnZnJQFpriT4xz7qxiAhuMBxQtLrbTzZF1AZxSTKzVGB9KDUYadE.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-38-50.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EprSDTYoidG7qBgGz65WFSv3i2w4PWtCm6JhUYEEDzxwadTAUcHPnA3JR6SJe5nsi3Y.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-38-45.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/243M55U1F73gtG9Q3YGoWZpmwvn4Ekk2oPLnyUn6V7mfqw2MKs3QarifTtfoPu7A9Hs1D.jpg)

> **When there are so many boats gathered together, there’s always someone looking after them—and, of course, there’s no shortage of furry four-legged friends who come up with that sweet look, hoping you’ll give them something to eat. I know bread isn’t the best thing for their coats, but it was the only thing I had on hand, and they happily accepted it.**

> *Cuando hay tantos botes juntos, siempre hay alguien cuidándolos, y por supuesto no faltan los amigos peludos de cuatro patas que se acercan con esa mirada dulce, esperando que uno les regale algo de comer. Sé que el pan no es lo ideal para su pelaje, pero era lo único que tenía a mano, y ellos lo recibieron felices.*
![photo_2026-04-27_22-38-57.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq36d6pKLcU3nc7wc3yuXgVhsAJL4ocpYqrqWqAT7LUM3kGMJASKJNrii2xxGJo7DHw.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-38-57 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EprT68AABeLECAedjHU277qULWXnmYFP2bPe5Qqrmh5kRMdckxTFr474bDpJE3XfhDC.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_22-38-44.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqUdwoNqbzzqQaRQYdKW71b9CVn31qWCBUvmYHkfjozY2fe65bRq4NtxfuVMELYN2uZ.jpg) ![a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23x1BKYTESxzsM4MECpkqHF1gGWGUhPLdPXY5gyidtwY4UtWJBxNc33wPuuMBKWrccJGL.jpg)

> **With our lungs filled with sea breeze and our eyes fully satisfied, we headed home feeling light and with clear minds. That’s the effect the sea has on us; it renews us, calms us, and restores our energy. Well, dear friends, I wish you a fabulous day. See you soon. Bye.**

> *Con los pulmones llenos de brisa marina y la vista completamente satisfecha, nos retiramos a casa ligeros, con la mente despejada. Ese es el efecto que el mar tiene sobre nosotros; nos renueva, nos calma, nos devuelve la energía. Bueno, queridos amigos, les deseo un día fabuloso.   Hasta pronto.   Chao.*

body.title: Encounter with the Sarcophaga carnaria fly, in the town of Cariaco (Eng - Esp)
body.body:
> **
INGLÉS
** Hello fellow nature lovers, it's a pleasure to greet you and wish you a happy and blessed day with your loved ones. This is my entry for the [**Qurator's Photo Quest | Animals**](https://peakd.com/qurator/@qurator/qurators-photo-quest-or-animals). During my visit to Cariaco, Ribero Municipality, Sucre State, we took a drive along the main road, and while waiting for the transport that would take us to the beach, I spotted a fly and took the opportunity to take several pictures. I approached as quietly as possible, set my camera to macro, and managed to take two photos. Its name is **Flesh Fly** [Sarcophaga carnaria](https://trakta.es/control-de-plagas-valencia/tipos-de-plagas/desinsectacion/insectos-voladores/sarcophaga-carnaria-mosca-de-la-carne-o-moscarda/), and it is characterized by its grayish body and reddish eyes. I was struck by its size, the color of its eyes, and its wings. While it was on the wall, I could observe its wings and legs, which have several segments and spine-like structures. I also saw circles at the ends of the legs, which perhaps help it adhere to surfaces. According to one of the women at the bus stop, this fly is very common in homes, and one should be careful because it tends to lay eggs in decaying organic matter. It can also transmit microbes and diseases by landing on food. Its body is elongated at the rear, ending in a circular point. Behind the eyes, it is flattened, and several black, white, and gray lines are visible. The hind legs are extended, and the middle legs form a V-shape. The circles at the ends of the legs are also visible. The wings are transparent and shiny.

> **
ESPAÑOL
** Hola amigos amantes de la naturaleza, es un placer saludarles deseando que tengan un feliz y bendecido día en unión de sus seres queridos, esta es mi entrada para el [**Qurator's Photo Quest | Animals**](https://peakd.com/qurator/@qurator/qurators-photo-quest-or-animals), durante mi visita al a Cariaco, Municipio Ribero, estado Sucre, hicimos un recorrido por la vía principal y mientras esperábamos el transporte que nos llevaría a la playa, pude observar una mosca y aproveché la ocasión para tomarle varias fotografías, me acerqué lo más callada posible coloqué la cámara en macro y logré tomarle dos fotos, su nombre es **Mosca de la carne** [Sarcophaga carnaria](https://trakta.es/control-de-plagas-valencia/tipos-de-plagas/desinsectacion/insectos-voladores/sarcophaga-carnaria-mosca-de-la-carne-o-moscarda/), se caracteriza por el cuerpo grisáceo y ojos rojizos. Me llamó la atención su tamaño el color de los ojos y las alas, durante el tiempo que permaneció en la pared pude observar sus alas, las patas que contienen varios segmentos y especie de espinas, también unos círculos en la parte final de estas, que tal vez le sirven para adherirse a las superficies, de acuerdo a la información de una de las señoraa que estaba en la parada, esta mosca es muy común verla en los hogares y hay que tener cuidado con su presencia, porque suele poner huevos en materia orgánica en descomposición, además puede transmitir microbios y enfermedades al posarse sobre los alimentos. El cuerpo es alargado en la parte de atrás con una terminación en punta circular, posterior a los ojos es aplastado y se observan varias líneas de color negro, blanco y gris, las patas traseras se ven estiradas y las del medio forma una especie de V, también se aprecian los círculos en la parte final de las patas, las alas son transparentes y brillantes. ![animal 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23xAcMFA3g54cJdWhLewJZxsaBRV9KoRf4Ph1ZWy44QWCuHfQereEGzcqfhGxm8xy5DGG.png) ![animal 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23w2wf6SivtgTkLJVFnAXKqZKiLzoLADBTBpfkkcFgmVGEyVfRMN4irFCCDNimjGgrxHF.png) ![Cariaco (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eq9ToHXi7sWC5iFJ19BqZ96DXvbsV1tsGwxCCP778Za7vVRv5HMHnqezFTHsD2CFySp.jpeg) ![Cariaco (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqNDmzNCLtJzCAQFfU31EmrGb9c9xVbRW2HoP6pouwrHP36RYYkttaky74fkeqn6Pty.jpeg) ![Cariaco (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eq5CZnT6hnhpx5m3A3kzEWEvFZdJFUxxwXGhD4z9QkawXPcg3TWj1s8KLPG4iL531rV.jpeg) ![Cariaco (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EprT86FoBjA8PCSFmwPDrtjCRDyrcK472oLyDn32KjYCAvMgjBuWtJS4yPVLdTCUgUb.jpeg) ![Cariaco (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqHyQ4m4unrTuhGG9NW6YrmfxPqawGBseYK6MoSsE9aTS9pKKMFJAgiwrFL2djUEkuR.jpeg) ![Cariaco (10).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpLeURn6HEf18MDTLznAhaVYt4qWyAppjW6ExXGgPkhDkd9dMGSQqYoGethZbaH9gBQ.jpeg) ![Cariaco (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqYrKiNPHv1e7sRB7VU5BPARPX7StTKZmAy1oDuyFAtSMkxa6av3EZ2ZZdibAsrCiAW.jpeg)

body.title: Family Reunion Continues Despite Loss as Husband’s Aunt’s Final Wish Brings Everyone Together With Love Today
body.body:
![1000198113.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/EoH1r3sGpiMz1bqjaPtMm9V9QYPiyfXawnvfAx2brJahJ43NiFvtK1jFYaKC7FpK46d.png)


Today was one of the most unforgettable family reunions I have ever experienced on my husband’s side of the family. It was not the usual kind of reunion filled only with laughter and celebration. This gathering carried both joy and sadness in our hearts, making it deeply meaningful for all of us.

![1000197937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wgFZ2rmKy142jvAqXyud4sfuv8F3UqEPigQDQHY37LnmR68g7AavjTA9rk21EFM4AKg.jpg)

My husband’s aunt was the one who truly wished to host this reunion. She personally requested it and was so excited to welcome everyone. She first scheduled it last April 8, but it was postponed because her eldest daughter, who works as an OFW in Saudi Arabia, was unable to come home on time. Even with the delay, she continued preparing everything with so much love and dedication. She had already arranged the wood for cooking, the plates, the cloth decorations, and many other things needed for the event. You could really feel how important this reunion was to her. 



![1000198011.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vi6PTwzTQfg1v6ZJ2o4cvGKXEZ6wG18EwBVB8NHNo59i6wmmw3uAkaZoMtZNFLj9tQG.jpg)

![1000197995.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wMTp52irFfTqaBCjLRgrSntvrZadPTzMuLR2gtkB5h7yePyPAgNSEv1aKKnMUdS523n.jpg)

Sadly, on April 12, she was brought to the hospital and did not survive. It was heartbreaking for the whole family. Her passing left pain in everyone’s hearts, especially because she had been looking forward to this special day. But today, April 28, the family decided to continue the reunion even while she lies in wake, because this was truly her wish to gather the family together under one roof.



![1000197981.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/244odPhgdfrDFQ4jAhrukfjuNfp7QWihYdC6JXC2GUEdXqAddQEfi4T2VNhMeE75rM2Fv.jpg)

![1000197958.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/241tdHASzDZCHNQbmeUzwLcDaWUKyw99enqvyoHnxEBu2zyH5aqDiQZTu4Ta5StfAbn11.jpg)

We prepared food and shared a simple but heartfelt program. We gave flowers and honored the elders of the family. It was emotional to see everyone gathered, carrying both grief and gratitude. There were tears, but there were also smiles. There was pain, but there was also love.



![1000197930.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vhyoh4d2pYmUr3WUA4r97yAvELbZWwwuqD9HfDQFCNfgXNVAZSV8koqrQQotHSuzpwN.jpg)

We started the program with a Bible service to thank God for all the blessings we have received. It reminded us that even in times of sorrow, we still have reasons to be grateful. Family is one of the greatest blessings of all. We are all emotional starting up to lunch. I feel the heavy heart and as shared messages all of us get emotional. 



![1000198049.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xVMED76orbJa9wspP5HJGAcnXPLCBiMBTcahyVoa4ibq8qhG8Doaoe4uhzu1hLjCQ8m.jpg)

As I looked around, I saw the elders sitting together, eating side by side. I admired them so much. They have gone through many struggles, misunderstandings, and differences over the years. Sometimes there were hurt feelings, but when it comes to family, they choose humility. They swallow their pride for the sake of peace and unity. That is something truly inspiring. All I can say we must be good and loving to our siblings. No matter what siblings is siblings despite of understanding and disagreements. 



![1000198051.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tvgqNYWofGcnGc1u8o2zhQSAJgroWuVEwfkP5sBhwuE2rW5UPSrz51V2DeamAaUgcHn.jpg)

This reunion taught me that family is not only about celebrating happy moments. It is also about standing together during painful times, reconciling, forgiving, and choosing love above all else. Though our hearts were heavy today, we were also thankful because we knew we were fulfilling the wish of someone who loved this family dearly.



![1000197939.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/242NmeAL3WNNhZQZ842DnXbjQ6DGLQweyD6GDXEaSoTE5PrNHuz8s5HsvFxAjnhF9eh5f.jpg)

![1000197925.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xL2YJXDDrigHRDtgjMTg3uNzg1kp45p2LHe26s4ZXTyWjWP3dX2xStq9M6HiRHiMBu7.jpg)

Thank you for reading my story, this is my owned picture and Edited in Canva. Have a nice day!

body.body: Yes — the classic Fleischmann–Pons setup used a **palladium cathode**, often a **platinum anode**, **heavy water (D₂O)**, and typically **lithium deuteroxide (LiOD)** as the electrolyte, not plain lithium metal floating around like a bad lab idea. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cold_fusion) and Berkeley’s [Understanding Science](https://undsci.berkeley.edu/the-science-behind-cold-fusion/) both describe the heavy-water electrolysis approach with deuterium loading into palladium. If people say “lithium was used,” they usually mean **lithium dissolved as LiOD in heavy water** to make the electrolyte conductive, not lithium by itself. I’m not seeing anything useful from InLeo on this topic right now, so the clean answer is: **heavy water + LiOD + Pd cathode**.

body.title: Food & flower 🌼🌿🥗
body.body:
‎
‎
‎Hello friends, how are you?
‎This afternoon I went for a short walk near our house. While walking, this plant caught my eye and I really liked it. Its name is Indian heliotrope.
‎The environment was very calm and peaceful, and the fresh air made me feel relaxed.
‎I always enjoy spending time in nature because it refreshes my mind.
‎
![IMG-20260425-WA0013.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXFCFa8x9vK9EPwEnukB8RufbJrSJavF4XGXrzCnc3HNk/IMG-20260425-WA0013.jpg)

‎Indian heliotrope is a small wild plant with tiny purple flowers.
‎It usually grows easily beside roads, in open fields, and on unused land.
‎The shape of the flowers is simple but very attractive.
‎When I saw it closely, I felt that even small things in nature can be very beautiful.
‎This plant has medicinal properties and is used in rural areas for primary treatment of different diseases.
‎Many people still depend on such natural plants for simple remedies.
‎Nature is truly full of useful and wonderful things.
‎
‎So friends, how did you like it? Let me know, okay?
‎Do you also notice such beautiful things around you?
‎
‎
![IMG-20260425-WA0014(1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmahC8EeaQ87hKj6ucv1m9dPb8Zr9XZx1dYMMuKG4nX5Kx/IMG-20260425-WA0014(1).jpg)

‎---
‎
‎
‎Today, three of us friends went to a nearby restaurant where kacchi is available.
‎We planned this outing suddenly, and it turned into a very enjoyable moment.
‎The place was nice and the environment was friendly.
‎
‎The kacchi there is very delicious—it looks beautiful and tastes amazing. I can’t even describe how good it is!
‎The rice was perfectly cooked and the meat was very soft and juicy.
‎The aroma of the spices made the food even more tempting.
‎We enjoyed every bite and felt very satisfied.
‎
‎Today’s treat was from me.
‎Spending money on friends sometimes feels really good because it creates happy memories.
‎We laughed, talked, and spent a great time together.
‎Moments like these make friendship stronger and more meaningful.
‎
‎Kacchi biryani is a popular and delicious dish in Bangladesh.
‎It is cooked with basmati rice, meat (usually mutton), and aromatic spices.
‎It is mostly served on special occasions like weddings or parties.
‎People of all ages love this dish for its rich taste and flavor.
‎It is not just food, but also a part of our culture and tradition.
‎
‎
![IMG-20260426-WA0020.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma7svsMNfzfBtZcCdaYWFJAbyqpVt9exvUjeHkT7nfdtm/IMG-20260426-WA0020.jpg)


‎

‎I have a close female friend with whom I share everything, and she also shares everything with me.
‎Our friendship is very strong and full of trust.
‎We support each other in both good and bad times.
‎
‎One day, suddenly she asked me for a bouquet of flowers.
‎It was a simple request, but it meant a lot to me.
‎How could I not give it? So I gifted her this beautiful bouquet.
‎Seeing her smile made me really happy.
‎Sometimes small gifts can create the biggest happiness.
‎
‎Giving a bouquet to a friend is nice, but it becomes more special when you add some feelings with it.
‎Words can make a simple gift more meaningful and memorable.
‎You can say a small, sweet line like:
‎
‎“These flowers are for you—because you are the most beautiful part of my life.” 🌸💖

body.title: Heads In Art
body.body:
Today I'm going to turn back to art as I've neglected it lately, with all kinds of topics that crossed path with my thoughts and sewing or course. It's nice to diversify topics, so I'm not complaining at all. 

![Heads In Art.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/48QS4pzKZGh6UQ15tBh6U39WLnUnMqrGxJ4CHaPC7G2TKtR2R2cGuMaK3tDQTbMNAh.jpg)

This week I think it's going to be an art week as I've skipped a few exhibitions and it's time to get back to my old routine. I hate missing out as you are missing unique chances with private collections that you only see once in life, but then again, there's life outside art as well. 

Anyway, today I'd like to show you the rest of the photos I took at the solo exhibition of Simion Moldovan, a very talented artist with a unique style in art and vision of the world.  

But before I start, I'd like to mention something I've been thinking about lately. Last week I was talking to my dad. At some point art came up and he mentioned he read it in the local paper, that it's going to be an exhibition in one of the galleries I frequently visit, but based on the photos presented, it's not going to to be a good one. To my question \
, he said it's abstract. He's not a regular art visitor and this shows his taste is limited to the so called \

art, and abstract is not covered by this expression. This conversation made me think of how much I've evolved in this regard as my interest in art used to be very limited too. Anyway, let's get back to today's topic. ![20260311_111142a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23yJNqn8AS8hADNGyvuQggpA3ede3ZZEKXt9sqsbV7PasTvGQKNb3xsNYMQJ5yp7NwmpW.JPG) It's a wooden board, with a very unique pattern on it, that reminds me of labyrinths. maybe it is a labyrinth, who knows. ![20260311_111200a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23w2uhktmgnyDQoEdtKxsgTjM1pVYAzcQHTuedkqJVzs8WYGXqAR5ybeZvBbZTy3ubN2v.JPG) ![20260311_111205a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wgS5ENnRvqGN3sqWDVUm7ZVsDiQHf1gqYujeCyXrsGgtCzf4YTQPRZPUPqdqqz6W51q.JPG) A very interesting head with some unusual accessories or additions. Headsets we all have I suppose, but this individual has some special glasses, or a mono lens as well, which can indicate something. ![20260311_111213a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EopuSUuKquaJutoXrKNwdeKSrgmpnB5tUWTj3gFhPdhPDJz6hptAhj98x6ULVtAasPV.JPG) This will be the riddle of the day for you. It's horizontal, but not because the image is in the wrong position. This is how it has been intended. Tell me what you see and then I'll tell you what I see. Or what I think I see. I'm sure it has a deep meaning. ![20260311_111535a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EpEJfnYtkQGdgMSc4uFNCBNmRenf2wgBDYFnZ4n8Hm9YC9CwWeXFQtKooKqefUDJ7hs.JPG) Now I'm in deep trouble here. I think I recognize the face, but can't remember the name. He's been a well known person, have seen him on X all the time. In a wheelchair, paralyzed from the neck down, speaking with the help of the computer. He passed away not long ago. Let's see if you know who it is, or if you see the resemblance. ![20260311_111547a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23ywwQPgm6S2dnEHk7DQR7TMegfZpJ8GD89yXvQoVLeYmdrmmLmufpQgkZnVMmLdLJLVT.JPG) ![20260311_111555a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xpCe8vvTD4GNJZVNt63Z2xUYA4UzE2yhyV8nGWTg5DPnxoncJBzYVHLeEuCQ9k8WSLy.JPG) Another head, with what I would hardly call a happy face. What I see here is a time shaped face with emotions and scars. ![20260311_111605a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23y8uxWMi2W3kDGdmVP4WZJTCek5Ngi6bEjihsYKJijj9BHemoXpSbaJLVyHkXsJ1FaKo.JPG) Sadness? Disappointment? Both? What do you see here? ![20260311_111614a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EpLhTRHKdun1KvvR7W2AguH2uLqUVbquwhugoEVaGxiVZAqrfUApGEv5JEpwjJNSLYi.JPG) Three very different portraits, all a bit abstract or scientific if you like. I see the particularity of each, but if I were to choose, I'd go with the one in the middle. It's less scary in my opinion :) ![20260311_111701a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wgS9evPY1bEem3CWMJQ8y4D2SejPEcZymJm2VisCWi1bWPUenuCdgf1LAkaiXfZ8W2D.JPG) Now this is an interesting piece with deep meaning in my eyes, at first glance, it looks like a normal human head, but the inside is not, by far. The inside looks like the head of a robot and if you think a bit deeper, we're not robots yet, but we need to think like one and learn quite a lot, to have a competitive advantage, so I see this piece as the future human. Or, the other explanation could be a humanoid robot. Which one it is? ![20260311_111801a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wWyQ2CyQu3GezM53hdWfwJKmuf5KkzhJtyEpnx24LD56ikc4Ca5g66VZPSchQLa59yQ.JPG) Last, but not least, another head, but not a usual one. Let's see if you see why this is special. This is it for today. Let me know what you think and if you have a favorite :)

></center>

body.title: Lo que callas también enferma [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVuufYfbj26n74jPY7rCfqC8XDja41MM23rLxaRY29pL3/surprising_media_woman_9200701_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-young-girl-casual-leaning-9200701/)

---

🇪🇸 En Español

# Lo que callas también enferma

---

El cuerpo nunca grita primero.  
Susurra.  
Y cuando no lo escuchamos… aprende a hablar más fuerte.

---

Hola querida comunidad @holos-lotus,

Recuerdo una etapa en la escuela de medicina en la que todo parecía acumularse al mismo tiempo: estudios, exigencias, problemas personales.

Hubo un momento en el que el cuerpo empezó a dar señales. No eran alarmantes… pero estaban ahí. Y como suele pasar, decidí ignorarlas.

Una mañana, un amigo me miró y me preguntó: “¿Te pasa algo? Te veo mal”.

Le respondí lo más automático: “No, todo está bien”.

Pero no lo estaba.

Días después, sin previo aviso, el cuerpo habló más alto: mareo, visión nublada, un colapso que no dio tiempo a seguir posponiendo nada.

Ahí entendí algo que luego vería repetirse muchas veces en consulta:  
no siempre enfermamos por lo que decimos… sino por todo lo que nos guardamos.

---

A veces creemos que estamos manejando la situación… hasta que el cuerpo decide hablar por nosotros.

---

En consulta, es común escuchar frases como “no tengo nada” o “solo es cansancio”. Pero detrás de esas palabras, muchas veces hay algo que no se está diciendo.

El cuerpo, sin embargo, no necesita palabras.

El sistema nervioso no distingue entre lo que expresamos y lo que reprimimos. Para el cuerpo, la carga emocional sigue estando presente, aunque no se nombre. Por eso, lo que no se procesa de forma consciente muchas veces se manifiesta de forma física, como una vía alternativa de expresión.

Responde.

---

Desde una mirada médica, sabemos que el estrés sostenido, la ansiedad contenida y las emociones no procesadas tienen un impacto directo en el organismo. No es algo abstracto.

Se manifiesta en forma de:
- dolores de cabeza persistentes  
- tensión muscular  
- alteraciones del sueño  
- problemas digestivos  
- fatiga constante  

Pero más allá del síntoma físico, hay un patrón que se repite: el silencio.

---

Callamos por muchas razones.

Por evitar conflictos.  
Por no preocupar a otros.  
Por no saber cómo expresar lo que sentimos.  
O simplemente porque creemos que “no es tan importante”.

---

Pero lo que no se expresa… no desaparece.

Se acumula.

Y lo más curioso es que muchas veces aprendemos a convivir con ese peso sin cuestionarlo. Nos acostumbramos a funcionar en automático, a seguir adelante como si nada pasara, mientras por dentro algo pide atención.

No es falta de fortaleza. Es, en muchos casos, falta de espacio para detenernos y reconocer lo que sentimos sin sentirnos débiles por ello.

Y muchas veces, termina encontrando otra forma de salir.

---

No siempre se trata de grandes traumas o situaciones extremas.

A veces es algo tan simple como una conversación que no ocurrió.  
Un límite que no se puso.  
Una emoción que se dejó pasar.

---

Como médica, he aprendido que escuchar al paciente va más allá de lo que dice.

También implica prestar atención a lo que evita decir.

Y como persona, he entendido algo aún más importante:  
escucharnos a nosotros mismos no debería ser una opción de último momento.

---

Porque el cuerpo no es el enemigo.

Es, muchas veces, el único que está diciendo la verdad.

---

Tal vez no se trata de hablar todo el tiempo.

Pero sí de dejar de ignorar lo que sentimos.

De darnos el espacio para reconocerlo.

De no esperar a que el cuerpo tenga que gritar para que finalmente lo escuchemos.

---

**¿Cuántas veces has dicho “todo está bien”… cuando en realidad no lo estaba?**

---

Tal vez la próxima vez, antes de responder, valga la pena detenerse un momento.

Y escuchar.

---

Gracias por leerme.

Las imagenes son de pixabay y la traducción al ingles fue hecha en DeepL Translate.

---

🇬🇧 In English

# What you keep silent can also make you sick
---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVuufYfbj26n74jPY7rCfqC8XDja41MM23rLxaRY29pL3/surprising_media_woman_9200701_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-young-girl-casual-leaning-9200701/)

---

The body never screams first.  
It whispers.  
And when we don’t listen… it learns to speak louder.

---

Hello dear @holos-lotus community,

I remember a time during medical school when everything seemed to pile up at once: studies, pressure, personal problems.

There was a moment when my body started sending signals. They weren’t alarming… but they were there. And, as often happens, I chose to ignore them.

One morning, a friend looked at me and asked, “What’s wrong? You don’t look well.”

I gave the most automatic answer: “No, everything is fine.”

But it wasn’t.

Days later, without warning, my body spoke louder: dizziness, blurred vision, a collapse that left no room to keep postponing things.

That’s when I understood something I would later see many times in medical practice:  
we don’t always get sick because of what we say… but because of everything we keep inside.

---

Sometimes we think we are handling everything… until the body decides to speak for us.

---

In medical consultations, it is common to hear phrases like “I’m fine” or “it’s just tiredness.” But behind those words, there is often something unspoken.

The body, however, does not need words.

The nervous system does not distinguish between what we express and what we suppress. For the body, the emotional load is still present, even if it is never spoken. That is why what is not processed consciously often finds a physical way to manifest, becoming an alternative form of expression.
It responds.

---

From a medical perspective, we know that prolonged stress, contained anxiety, and unprocessed emotions have a direct impact on the body. This is not abstract.

It can manifest as:
- persistent headaches  
- muscle tension  
- sleep disturbances  
- digestive issues  
- constant fatigue  

But beyond the physical symptom, there is a recurring pattern: silence.

---

We stay silent for many reasons.

To avoid conflict.  
To not worry others.  
Because we don’t know how to express what we feel.  
Or simply because we think “it’s not that important.”

---

But what is not expressed… does not disappear.

It accumulates.

And what’s most striking is that we often learn to live with that weight without questioning it. We get used to functioning on autopilot, moving forward as if nothing is happening, while something inside is quietly asking for attention.

It’s not a lack of strength. In many cases, it’s a lack of space to pause and acknowledge what we feel without judging ourselves for it.

And often, it finds another way to come out.

---

It’s not always about big traumas or extreme situations.

Sometimes it’s something as simple as a conversation that never happened.  
A boundary that was never set.  
An emotion that was pushed aside.

---

As a doctor, I have learned that listening to a patient goes beyond what is said.

It also means paying attention to what is not being said.

And as a person, I’ve understood something even more important:  
listening to ourselves should not be a last resort.

---

Because the body is not the enemy.

It is, often, the only one telling the truth.

---

Maybe it’s not about speaking all the time.

But about no longer ignoring what we feel.

Giving ourselves the space to acknowledge it.

Not waiting until the body has to scream for us to finally listen.

---

**How many times have you said “I’m fine”… when you weren’t?**

---

Maybe next time, before answering, it’s worth pausing for a moment.

And listening.

---

Thank you for reading.

The images are from Pixabay and the English translation was done using DeepL Translate.

---

body.title: Film Review of 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
body.body: ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXEUZUzDFKfZQTBLpAZdbMpvAhuGyd6uX9QWQafCJhQEF/image.png) source denofgeek.com 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple immediately follows after [\

](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@crypto-hokage/film-review-of-28-years). It's the continuation of the long running zombie movie series that started with 28 Days Later. Picking up directly after the previous movie, the film is about Spike who joined a sadistic cult led by the Jimmy Crystal (the kid at the start of the last installment). Meanwhile scientist Dr. Ian Kelson searches for a possible cure through zombie alpha named Samson.

**<center>Plot Summary</center>**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWkzr939QBaXywLwpdMKcHSUYK9MFrCyFiYs8xMJTEbaD/image.png)



The story follows Spike’s survival in the cult he joined at the end of \

. There's another story about Dr. Kelson’s experiments at his hideout, the Bone Temple. The cult arc explores power and manipulation, as Jimmy Crystal exerts control through fear and ritual. Meanwhile, Kelson’s arc focuses on the possibility that the infected may still be cured. These two storylines combine in an exciting climax.

**<center>Analysis</center>**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRhD31wfTVzpUepRgQj4WBj5Ui8jh2pGbcDL1Vs6zJyDZ/image.png)



The movie is brutally violent but strangely, the violence comes more from the humans and not the zombies. The movie leans heavily into the idea that humans can be just as monstrous as the infected, especially through the cult’s violence. 

Meanwhile, the film balances its grim tone with unexpected humor and emotional depth. Ralph Fiennes’ portrayal of Kelson is praised for bringing warmth and humanity. His scenes with Samson bring hope and even moments of joy into an otherwise bleak world. 

<center>**Conclusion & Recommendation**</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdWvxhoTwkK9faTQHHzH4p3C1vB3dkEHS6A2btMLVf8Eo/image.png)

28 Years Later: The Bone Temple is a solid follow up to the latest installment. It continues the story of Spike and Dr. Kelson and opens up possible sequels to the series. At the end of the movie, we see the main character of the first film, Jim (Cilian Murphy) and his daughter watching Spike. If you're a fan of the 28 series, then this movie is a must watch.

body.body: >Espavlog/ acompañenme a ensayar en el teatro Luis mariano Rivera (Cumaná - Estado sucre) by D-rock [Esp]-[Eng]

>



<centro>


![Picsart_26-04-27_23-28-42-457.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/d-rock/Eoc75wsyDiYqiC5mpmE7osX52cpgCVpaCFyK56KdZNyuDpuzgPVfutKmTxRWJae9bLs.png)

Espero se encuentren muy bien amigos de Espavlog y de hive! El día de hoy les traigo un vídeo, de un pequeño ensayo para una de las presentaciones que tengo a final de mes, ya qué me llamaron nuevamente para participar en un número donde ya había bailado antes, este performance es parte del musical \
un musical presentado por una de las academias de canto de aquí de mi ciudad  Cumaná- estado Sucre llamada \
pero donde vamos a presentar este genial baile es en otra muestra llamada \

qué también la realiza está talentosa academia.
 
<centro>


![photo_4936476771566594757_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/d-rock/243MHgc6wWxWkEeujvJf9xn7aiYoi1FFwzCJjpXTr6ZCwFcKK4JVw3zTUaXDBTZPjPh5C.jpg)


</center>
</center>


># <center><div class=\
>Espavlog/ Join me for a rehearsal at the Luis Mariano Rivera Theater (Cumaná, Sucre State) by D-rock [Esp]-[Eng]

>

>I hope you're all doing great, friends of Espavlog and Hive! Today I'm sharing a video of a short rehearsal for one of the performances I have at the end of the month, since I was asked again to participate in a number I've danced in before. This performance is part of the musical “Broadway,” a production presented by one of the singing academies here in my city, Cumaná, in Sucre State, called “Germán Segura.” However, we’ll be performing this amazing dance at another show called “Homenajes,” which is also put on by this talented academy.






<centro>

***
<div class=\

> ![IMG_20260414_163818.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/d-rock/23vsDnH94xE1QYpLT6eSTERA31V3BPdiqTGWjvdgJUyunoCXuxJdnUbxt6jfUpjDs8SqP.jpg) La presentación será en uno de los teatros más icónicos de mi ciudad y la verdad en uno de los más reconocidos, llamado teatro \

, Inaugurado en el año 1998, el teatro lleva el nombre de Luis Mariano Rivera, el célebre músico y poeta sucrense conocido por sus composiciones dedicadas a la naturaleza y a la vida campesina (como la famosa canción \
). Su construcción fue un paso decisivo para dotar a la \

de un espacio digno para las artes escénicas de alto nivel. Aquí no hay muchos teatros de esta magnitud, y la verdad es que ya me había presentado varias veces en él, y por eso quise mostrarles un poco de este hermoso lugar donde crecemos varias personas de esta ciudad llena de talentosos artistas.

>The performance will take place at one of the most iconic theaters in my cityand, to be honest, one of the most renowned called the “Luis Mariano Rivera” Theater, Opened in 1998, the theater is named after Luis Mariano Rivera, the celebrated musician and poet from Sucre known for his compositions dedicated to nature and rural life (such as the famous song “Canchunchu Florido”). Its construction was a decisive step toward providing the “Firstborn of the Continent” with a worthy venue for high-level performing arts. There aren’t many theaters of this magnitude here, and the truth is that I had already performed there several times, which is why I wanted to show you a little of this beautiful place where many of us from this city full of talented artists—have grown up.


***
<div class=\

> ![IMG_20260414_161516.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/d-rock/EoCh5SxbwVrhYsF57jyyuBRgYvCBUBDJLFuSmMRxAX2T6BtXsa9gaxQqNaocKNStJFk.jpg) La canción que bailaremos es titulada sparkling diamonds\
de Nicole kidman interpretada por una hermosa chica y cantante que es bastante reconocida aquí en Cumaná llamada\
y la puesta en escena la realizó el profesor \

, y obviamente casi todos los bailarines de el músical Broadway.

>The song we’ll be dancing to is titled “Sparkling Diamonds” by Nicole Kidman, performed by a beautiful young singer who is quite well-known here in Cumaná named Luisy Peña. The choreography was created by Professor Andrés Villarroel, and, of course, almost all the dancers from the Broadway musical.


***
<centro>



![IMG_20260414_162639.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/d-rock/23zGcZZBYC7AtEZQmJ1sDWCChyaHLF6oULUHQb954QqJ2CdRsNFKtE8iv69ViHuyHgJXT.jpg)


</center>


Para mí es un gran honor poder bailar en ese hermoso escenario una vez más, y demostrar en lo que realmente soy bueno, bailar es mi pasión, mi amor y lo que más amo hacer, esto ya lo he aclarado muchas veces por acá, pero nunca está de más hacerlo de nuevo.
Así que espero que les guste mi video y lo disfruten, un saludo a todos y nos vemos en la próxima.
<centro>


![photo_4936476771566594757_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/d-rock/243MHgc6wWxWkEeujvJf9xn7aiYoi1FFwzCJjpXTr6ZCwFcKK4JVw3zTUaXDBTZPjPh5C.jpg)


</center>
</center>



<div class=\

>

It’s a great honor for me to be able to dance on that beautiful stage once again and show what I’m really good at. Dancing is my passion, my love, and what I love doing most—I’ve made that clear many times here, but it never hurts to say it again.
So I hope you like my video and enjoy it. Best wishes to everyone, and see you next time.


<centro>
***
Canción de la presentación://Theme song:
https://youtu.be/vjvX7c-YhUg?si=UpVqp_qOQSsUMGIN
***


![PicsArt_05-10-01.07.40.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/d-rock/23w38iCLMGT8m9Rzcq4Ed1HG7HFvvGWS9stepeZxnqhpCY1NJceoLKY7BNKGLxMGKHwFb.jpg)


<hr>

Las fotos y el video son de mi autoría y son editados por picsart e inshot.
Las fotos y el vídeo fueron tomados por mí y editados con PicsArt e InShot.

Espero que el mar te haya devuelto la calma que necesitabas.\n\nThank you for bringing such real and human content; your perspective on grief and the need to be kind to ourselves adds a very deep touch to your story. I hope the sea returned the calm you needed.

body.title: How fluted pumpkin is Harvested, the do's and don't . Harvest process and market day.
body.body:
# Hello Hive 



![4244.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23vhyoiFodDd6aFhHQiQYmdgxZdDC2geu9w8doyfnURge2iHm74NLyQGdWko7zKFK1n1r.jpg)

A beautiful new morning to us all,  I hope that our night was blessed and restful.


![4271.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/Eo8TjUKxxzJDYnpvJTPBVJpGdHtfDdFiogDQ4b55jCqk5YQQM9cPqgP98bCpeBfdbwm.jpg)

Yesterday was a fluted pumpkin harvest day and the women were at work with the knives cutting and preparing vegetables for sale at the market. Due to popular demand for this particular vegetable the market women followed us to the farm to come and get their supply of fluted pumpkin that will be sold at the market 


![4262.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23u63FeTzUdWgbqxYud3JY9L7d6NQwq1dY3kMq9yPZTC6ggf4VYcTY6g7UJDAKoXqjYAm.jpg)

There are guidelines regarding the harvest of fluted pumpkin and it is more preferable to carry out the harvest with knives than with our bare hands.


This is a perennial crop in which it can last for more than two years. But since harvest is often consistent, we often allow the crop to die off after a year. Once it gets to more than a year been a commercial product the leaves will begin to harden and no longer become soft enough for consumption.


For the other type which I usually plant at home without much of a frequent harvest, the leaves often remain young and fresh over a long period of at least 2-3year. Imagine planting a vegetable and being able to continually eat from it for 2years

body.body: We're thrilled to announce the release of Ecency 4.3.8, our most performance-focused update yet. This release brings a major React 19 upgrade, deep SDK improvements, smarter caching, and a wave of refinements across Waves, Decks, and the wallet experience.\n\n

>Performance & Architecture * React 19 upgrade with comprehensive bundle optimization * SDK unification with separated broadcast timeouts and dedicated broadcast modes * hive-tx migration for faster, lighter transaction signing * Parallelized requests with smarter abort logic for stuck queries * SSR timeout handling to keep server rendering snappy * Smarter caching layer for fewer redundant fetches

>Waves * My Waves and Your Waves views with Keychain mobile login * Improved images, video thumbnails, and hashtag filtering * Design refresh across the Waves experience * X (Twitter) embed fix on Decks

>Wallet & Security * Improved manage/add keys flow * Unified browser extension support (Keychain, Keeper, Peak Vault) * Wallet simplification with speed optimizations * Refresh token signature fix * Balance analytics and unified polls
>Editor & Media * HEIC/HEIF auto-conversion on upload * Simplified video uploading flow * LCP image srcset for faster perceived loads * Render helper and DOM parser improvements
>Notifications & Real-time * Real-time comment indicator * Notification toast system * Improved notification iframe handling * Query invalidation refinements
>Decks * Replaced drag-and-drop package for smoother reordering * Waves embed fixes inside Decks
>Self-Hosted * Self-hosted tipping support (thanks @dkildar) * Self-host staging deploy pipeline
>Polish * Witness voters pagination fix * Gray content improvements * 3Speak thumbnail type safety * Profile cover image refactor * Updated translations via Crowdin

>Full Changelog [https://github.com/ecency/vision-next/compare/4.3.7...4.3.8](https://github.com/ecency/vision-next/compare/4.3.7...4.3.8) Thank you to our community for the continued feedback and support. Try it now at ecency.com and let us know what you think!

body.title: Últimos servicios
body.body:
*…se quedaron en silencio, mirando la puesta de sol, 
hasta que el último rayo de aquel día abandonó las nubes.*
*Sus almas rezaban y daban gracias por estar juntas.*

**Brida**
**Paulo Cohelo**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW9rDyUxF1xhDCJuK5wPQxBWfs6b6cahvDeBPHMa6UKGm/1777352011818.jpg)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/sign-open-sign-signage-business-8032702/)

Hacía más de un año que llevaba recibiendo terapia. Supuestamente me iba mejorar… o al menos eso fue lo que dijeron los doctores. De verdad no sé cómo una terapia iba a cambiar o eliminar, las causas que me llevaron al fallido intento de suicidio. 
Aquellas sesiones solo remplazaron un motivo por otro: o me mataba cuando me despidiera mi jefe, o cuando la doctora nuevamente comenzara su letanía. El día de mi última reunión, solo me hacían preguntas sobre lo que pensaba hacer en el futuro, cómo iba a ganarme la vida y otras por la misma línea. La verdadera decisión no se las dije, esa me la reservé. Solo escucharon de mis labios lo que querían oír. Realmente no puedo decir que durante las terapias no recibí ayuda de su parte, ya que ellos mismos fueron los que me dieron la idea de lo que en el futuro inmediato haría para buscarme el pan. 
Llegué a mi casa luego de salir a la carrera de la clínica. Organicé los objetos del garaje y boté aquello que no iba a utilizar. Complacido por lo hecho, al concluir, eché un vistazo a mi obra y me retiré a dormir. Al rayar el alba obtuve mi licencia de proveedor de Últimos Servicios. 
Claro está que nunca expliqué a cabalidad de qué iba mi negocio.


Colgué el cartel publicitario bien visible en la entrada, y con lo que me quedaba del dinero ahorrado en el hospital, compré los materiales e insumos que necesitaría en el futuro. Imprimí volantes y tarjetas promocionales, que repartí en las reuniones de terapia que sesionaron esa semana para personas que, como yo, habían dudado -o arrepentido- quitarse la vida en el último instante. 
Un día vino mi primer cliente. Entró por la puerta con temor, miraba a su alrededor con ojos llorosos.
—Buenos días, ¿en qué puedo ayudarlo? —saludé de forma afable.
—Buenos días —repitió si fijar la vista en mí—, ¿es cierto esto que pone en su volante?
—Cada palabra —respondí reprimiendo mi alegría.
—¿Y qué lo hace usted experto en… eso? —preguntó aún sin establecer contacto visual.
—Aprendí todo en carne propia, a ensayo y error se puede decir. Me di cuenta que hacerlo uno mismo puede resultar difícil y doloroso. Pero eso, tanto usted como yo, lo sabemos por experiencia. Mírelo de esta manera, si le proporciono su Último Servicio ambos ganamos: yo, mi comisión, y usted de esta manera, no comete pecado ni va al infierno.
—¿Es seguro?
—No puede fallar. Además, usted mismo puede escoger el método. Los catálogos están en las paredes laterales junto a lo demás que ofrezco… si tiene alguna sugerencia, puede decírmela. Con gusto intentaré complacerlo, siempre y cuando no vaya en contra de mis políticas establecidas en el volante.
—Bueno, si es así… tengo que pensarlo. Si me decido, vengo a verlo mañana.
Me dijo y se despidió.
—Piénselo bien y me dice —le sugerí—. Si se arrepiente…de todas maneras estaré aquí todos los días.
La mañana siguiente me recibió tan tranquila como sus precedentes. Ya mis ahorros se estaban agotando. Si no recibía algún interesado pronto, mi propio negocio vendría perfectamente para mi uso personal. 
Qué ironía. 
Con el ocaso, entró el señor del día anterior carpeta en la mano. Trajo consigo la totalidad de lo que pedía en los volantes: dinero en efectivo, comprobante del banco, testamento (aunque este era opcional) y, por supuesto, la declaración jurada, donde se registra, estar de acuerdo a realizar el procedimiento elegido por él, firmada por un testigo.
Mi regocijo fue inmenso. Enseguida me puse en marcha y realicé los preparativos para que el cliente tuviera la máxima comodidad. Josh (ese era el nombre del usuario) había elegido la alternativa cinco. Esta tenía lugar en la cama. Era la más cómoda y tranquila de todas, tanto para él como para mí. Se acomodó encima del colchón lo mejor que pudo. Le pregunté si prefería música y asintió. 
La puse. 
Me acomodé a horcajadas sobre su pelvis, y lo veía sonreír mientras le ataba las manos. Tomé el almohadón y con suavidad lo coloqué sobre su rostro. A medida que los segundos se sucedían, yo mantenía la presión; sobre todo al comenzar los espasmos. Sus gemidos y gritos ahogados acompañaron perfectamente el ritmo de la música. Al parecer, por azar había realizado una buena selección. Mientras seguía en la espera, a punto de terminar el trabajo, pensé en dejar aquel repertorio para esa alternativa. Diez minutos más tarde de la última sacudida, retiré la almohada y ahí estaba: un cliente satisfecho. La sonrisa de felicidad en su rostro era algo exquisita a la vista; un poco arrugada por la tela, pero eso no era asunto relevante. El trabajo había sido cumplido y, sobre todo: 
Él era feliz. 
Como me había pedido, explícitamente -por anticipado y por escrito-, llamé a su mujer. Esta se encontraba en casa de su amante tal y como había predicho. Josh me había proporcionado el número. Le di la noticia a su viuda y le pedí que recogiera a su esposo en la funeraria. Los gritos de histeria de la señora me hicieron pensar “hay que hacer algo al respecto”. No era posible que en cada trabajo tuviera que aguantar tan grande hipocresía.
La noticia de mi negocio se propagó como la peste por el estado. Entraban tantas llamadas para averiguar sobre mi negocio que pensé en contratar una secretaria. Y así lo hice. Contraté a una muchacha que encontré en un centro de rehabilitación un día de esos que repartía mis volantes. Lucy había ingresado por adicción a la marihuana, e igual que me pasó a mí, no solucionaron su problema en absoluto. Lo que lograron fue transformarle una adicción en otra. Es cierto, había olvidado aquella por la que ingresó, pero una peor –y legal- fue la que ocupó su lugar: el dulce. 
La contraté por caramelos. Agregándole la facilidad que al final de su contrato podía elegir una alternativa como Último Servicio. Entre la crisis económica y Lucy (que tenía una imagen que al verla sentías ganas de morir), desde esa semana los clientes me llovieron. Menos mal que la tenía a ella, quien, pese a su adicción y diabetes, era buenísima con los números. Lucy llevaba lo contable, y me pude dedicar por entero la parte creativa.
Algunos de mis consumidores argumentaron hallarse bastante apurados; esos eran los que menos daban ganas de atender. Siempre pedían lo mismo: tiro en la cabeza, en la boca y cosas así. Ni en el mayor de los aburrimientos, a Lucy le animó el mínimo ver esos trabajos. Aunque, hay que reconocer que otros se esforzaron en ser originales, y querían concluir su existencia igual que Hemingway, por lo que tuve que comprarme una escopeta idéntica. 
Si bien, hubo días bastantes entretenidos y clientes muy interesantes. Atendimos a una señora, que estaba en sus cuarenta, había sido ayudante y eterna amante de un director musical famoso. Ella fue su admiradora más ferviente. Su obsesión llegó hasta el punto de querer irse igual que él. Para eso: tuve que casarme con ella, cegarla, asistirla en su final y terminar el trabajo de un disparo.
Otra que recuerdo con agrado fue la señora Pimpet. Su mayor frustración había sido no llegar a ser periodista y no quería irse de esa manera. Lucy grabó todo cámara en mano, mientras la amable señora hacía un testamento digital en forma de noticia. Luego, me le acerqué por detrás le disparé en la cabeza, mientras Lucy aún filmaba. Linda cliente aquella. 
Otro aspecto interesante de mi negocio eran los destinos de los cuerpos. Algunos querían ser enterrados en los lugares más extraños (y por consiguiente más caros), como la Siberia, el jardín de su vecino, o quemado en una hoguera. Hubo un hombre al que la mujer lo tenía loco con el asunto de la comida. Él me hizo molerlo y dárselo a la esposa en bolsas de picadillo. Su último sacrificio. Eso sí era amor. 
Aunque tenía lados buenos, también tenía sus malos. Varias veces tuve que hacer de tripas corazón, para decirle no a aquellos adolescentes que venían a diario a solicitar mis servicios. He tenido a lo largo de mi carrera clientes con razones serias de veras, otros con algunas para nada convincentes y unos que no me dijeron en absoluto sus motivos. Pero estos ya eran personas mayores. ¿Quién no se ha sentido igual que esos muchachos en la adolescencia y han querido morirse? Los jóvenes de esa edad siempre tienen las excusas más tontas y superficiales de todas. Aunque la mayor razón por la que no los atiendo es que no tienen forma de pagar lo que pido por mi trabajo. 
Pasaron años y mi fama llegó a ser mundial. Llegué a trabajar para artistas famosos, embajadores y presidentes. Escribí un libro, o, mejor dicho, un manual de procedimiento. Me entrevistaron en la televisión, e incluso llegué a poner un comercial en el horario de la telenovela. 
Pensé que mi felicidad estaba completa, hasta que Lucy me presentó la carta de renuncia. Nunca creí que ese nefasto día llegaría. 
Pensándolo bien, se había demorado bastante. Los años no habían sido nada amables con Lucy. Le habían cobrado por la diabetes, varios dedos, una pierna, y amenazaba con la otra. Intenté convencerla ofreciéndole un aumento de sueldo y vacaciones pagadas. No me imaginé el trabajo sin ella. Mi compañera de los años. La inspiración y alma de tantas alternativas. Sin embargo, no era solo la baja lo que quería mi amiga, sino también que probara en ella nuestro último invento.
Veníamos trabajando en él desde hacía un mes y algo, casi lo teníamos concluido. Al inicio me mostré reacio a conceder el deseo de Lucy, aunque al final accedí. ¿Cómo decirle que no a ella? No obstante, no era mi intención que lo hiciera sola. Busqué las tarjetas de contactos que tenía, de todas aquellas personas que habían reservado turno conmigo. Incluso, algún que otro adolescente de esos que se pintan los ojos de negro, y el pelo cubriéndoselos, se sumó a última hora. De repente, tuve a decenas acampadas frente a mi casa. 
Les hice una oferta que ninguno rechazó. 


Para la noche teníamos todo listo. Nuestra última alternativa tenía lugar en un espacioso loft que habíamos adquirido especialmente para aquello. Abrí la puerta de la habitación y entraron. Enseguida se dirigieron hacia el bufet. Bailaron y jugaron como en sus mejores días de infancia, mientras que de los reservados salían gritos y gemidos de placer. Los observaba a través del cristal de la ventana mientras subía el interruptor liberando el éter que suponía el fin esa nueva alternativa creada por nuestro talento. Nunca había visto tanta felicidad en mi vida y Lucy disfrutaba de un buen pastel entre beso y beso de los chicos que tenía a cada lado. 
—¿Qué haces aquí?  —preguntó ella asustada cuando me vio aparecer.
—Quiero probar esta alternativa contigo —le respondí—. El éter casi no se siente. Es perfecto. Bastante divertido.
—Vete. Corre. Sabes cómo termina esto —me apuró.
—Como mismo empezó —repliqué mientras la besaba—, con una sonrisa en los labios.


Y esa es la historia de mi vida. Siempre trabajando para el prójimo. Todo por ellos. Por ella. Nunca pensé en mí. Y, sin embargo, usted me dice tan fácilmente a la cara, que no puedo entrar aquí al cielo. Que tengo que bajar.

body.title: Tamago Sushi
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSf3nCkrPq8Wnqsq2YLSDE8zZLV6HjPERyFA45GhwChRh/1777351272048.png)

Hi bloggers and food lovers! Today I’m sharing a recipe for savory and delicious Tamago ( egg ) and sushi rice. It’s a simple, easy-to-make dish perfect for everyday meals. I make this tamago sushi whenever I want to prepare a bento in the morning—it doesn’t require many ingredients and is really easy to make. Let’s get started.

**Ingredients:**

- 3 eggs
- a pinch of pepper
- 1/2 tsp bouillon powder
- 25 ml water
- 200 grams white rice (to taste)
- 3 tbsp aonori
- 2 tbsp sesame oil
- a pinch of salt
- nori strips
- cooking oil

**Steps:**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWYYwfyNqdFrDC5PLsBXCypJVEKRRqNFxUgxdzMXdGdew/1777351296724.jpg)

- Crack the eggs into a bowl

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNcybTK4S2y2adCRCommjtpf2uc1uNfAbmpWDVaMCNFrh/1777351316089.jpg)

- Add salt, pepper, and bouillon powder

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUPRsjHBZKnHRuaqAHj4nLbYYyhk3e1bBGwPyKPjpPHJ7/1777351385528.jpg)

- Whisk the eggs until well combined

- Add the water and whisk them

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTSZyp84rYaJZXtdoSzWrBQakNSRHgVFwjx6ets2FkVev/1777351419596.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6WW8jZVB8j4DGF7VmPGUh5ApdFwYtvt5bYNgsXohBWi/1777351419782.jpg)

- Prepare a pan

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdJBgnMAUnt6aGmwTuJ8n1pwP9z69hpGnVvYfbBpkvS7p/1777351442371.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ2FCoykNiQi8znUqCe2NAvzruChUHCbhQHe4V927PXuj/1777351442528.jpg)

- Heat a little oil, then pour a small amount of the egg mixture into the pan

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZrXP2XvsBK9s7tDZnAGH7yxTHKxvBRwRKg9Psv5e1vxr/1777351459066.jpg)

- Roll the omelet

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmejowTHUCoigkigDDogXGq6hMDqhdYKTz5sWU8kijxkk8/1777351482285.jpg)

- Add more of the egg mixture to the pan

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQutaqUPBTq6r2hav13GXVFhzSWrwZCPDHt6ULuk7qwbK/1777351482436.jpg)

- Wait until it’s half-cooked, then roll it together with the previous omelet

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYrjbQPeRR9LG2o3B1ndhVRiyvJrGhREi9nTcksB5BGkA/1777351513987.jpg)

body.title: Lo que duele en silencio… y lo que deja huella. Ladies of Hive Community Contest #286. [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
🇪🇸 En Español  

---  

## Lo que duele en silencio… y lo que deja huella  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeThECSWyLiwipuKkV6shq3DDb9kLtNN2gYnJXPm4aJCV/amayaeguizabal_alone_279080_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/alone-girl-woman-dreaming-279080/)

---

Hola hermosa comunidad @ladiesofhive 

Hay cosas que uno no vive directamente… pero igual se le quedan.

Porque las ve. Porque las siente cerca.

### Sobre el acoso escolar  

Recuerdo haber visto a alguien pasar por eso.

No había golpes.  
No había gritos.  

Pero había algo peor.

Las miradas.  
Las risas por lo bajo.  
El no encajar en ningún lado.  

Y poco a poco, esa persona dejó de ser la misma.

Hablaba menos.  
Se aislaba más.  
Como si empezara a creer todo lo que otros insinuaban.  

Y eso fue lo que más me marcó.

Entender que el daño no siempre es visible.

Que a veces ocurre en silencio, y por eso mismo cuesta más detenerlo.

Si algún día tuviera un hijo, creo que lo primero que intentaría enseñarle es esto:

Que su valor no depende de lo que otros digan.  
Que no tiene que aguantar en silencio.  
Que hablar no es debilidad.  

Y sobre todo, que no está solo.

Porque si algo aprendí viendo eso, es que el apoyo cambia mucho más de lo que imaginamos.

No siempre podemos evitar lo que otros hacen.

Pero sí podemos evitar que alguien lo enfrente solo.

---

###  Sobre las películas y lo que nos dejan  

No tengo un género fijo.

A veces veo algo solo por desconectar… pero hay películas que, sin esperarlo, se quedan.

Recuerdo una en particular donde el personaje tenía que tomar una decisión difícil.

Nada espectacular.

Nada heroico.

Solo elegir entre quedarse donde todo era conocido… o irse hacia algo incierto.

Y durante toda la película dudaba.

Tenía miedo.  
Se cuestionaba todo.  

Y eso fue lo que me atrapó.

Porque no era perfecto.

Era real.

Al final no fue la decisión lo que más me marcó.

Fue el proceso.

Entender que dudar también es parte del camino.  
Que no siempre vamos a sentirnos seguros.  

Y que aun así, a veces hay que moverse.

Esa idea se me quedó.

No como una enseñanza grande.

Sino como algo que vuelve cuando lo necesito.

---

A veces pensamos que lo que nos marca tiene que ser algo grande.

Pero no siempre es así.

A veces es algo que vimos.  
Algo que sentimos cerca.  
O una historia que, sin darnos cuenta, se queda con nosotros.  

Y en esos pequeños impactos… también nos vamos formando.

Gracias por leerme 

---

 *Esto es Vera, aprendiendo a sostenerse en lo simple.*

Las imágenes son de Pixabay.  
La versión en inglés fue hecha utilizando Google Translate.

---

🇬🇧 In English  

---  

## What Hurts in Silence… and What Stays With Us  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeThECSWyLiwipuKkV6shq3DDb9kLtNN2gYnJXPm4aJCV/amayaeguizabal_alone_279080_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/alone-girl-woman-dreaming-279080/)

---

Hello dear @ladiesofhive community 

There are things you don’t experience directly… but they still stay with you.

Because you see them. Because you feel them close.

### About school bullying  

I remember seeing someone go through it.

There were no physical attacks.  
No loud words.  

But there was something worse.

The looks.  
The quiet laughter.  
The feeling of not belonging anywhere.  

And little by little, that person stopped being the same.

They spoke less.  
They withdrew more.  
As if they were starting to believe what others implied.  

And that was what stayed with me the most.

Understanding that harm is not always visible.

That sometimes it happens in silence, and because of that, it is harder to stop.

If I ever had a child, I think the first thing I would try to teach them is this:

That their worth does not depend on what others say.  
That they don’t have to stay silent.  
That speaking up is not weakness.  

And most importantly, that they are not alone.

Because if there is something I learned from seeing that, it is that support changes more than we imagine.

We may not always stop what others do.

But we can make sure no one faces it alone.

---

###  About movies and what they leave us  

I don’t have a fixed genre.

Sometimes I watch something just to disconnect… but there are movies that stay without warning.

I remember one where the character had to make a difficult decision.

Nothing spectacular.

Nothing heroic.

Just choosing between staying where everything felt familiar… or moving toward something uncertain.

And throughout the movie, they doubted.

They were afraid.  
They questioned everything.  

And that’s what caught me.

Because it wasn’t perfect.

It was real.

In the end, it wasn’t the decision that impacted me the most.

It was the process.

Understanding that doubt is also part of the journey.  
That we won’t always feel sure.  

And that even then, sometimes we have to move forward.

That idea stayed with me.

Not as a big lesson.

But as something that returns when I need it.

---

Sometimes we think what shapes us has to be something big.

But it’s not always like that.

Sometimes it’s something we witnessed.  
Something we felt close.  
Or a story that stays with us without us realizing it.  

And in those small impacts… we are also shaped.

Thank you for reading  

---

 *This is Vera, learning to sustain herself in the simple things.*

The images are from Pixabay.  
The English version was made using Google Translate.

body.title: The Grief That Has No Name
body.body:
Today I want to share something simple, but heavy. Not something from books or big knowledge… just a thought that stayed in my mind for a long time. Maybe you have also felt this, maybe you haven’t. But if you read it slowly, you might understand what I’m trying to say.
In our lives, people keep leaving us. Almost every day, someone we know, someone we love, goes away. Some departures are normal, expected… but some leave a mark that never really goes away. We have words for many of these losses. If a husband dies, the woman is called a widow. If parents pass away, the child is called an orphan. These words are small, but they carry meaning. When we hear them, we understand there is pain behind them.
But there is one kind of loss… that has no proper name.
When parents lose their child.
I used to think about this a lot. Why is there no word for it? Is it something we forgot to name… or is it something too deep to be captured in a single word?
Just think for a moment. A parent raises a child with so much care. They protect them from everything — cold, pain, even small discomfort. Many parents don’t even let their child walk barefoot on a cold floor, worried they might get sick. They lose sleep, they sacrifice their own comfort, just to see their child safe and happy.
Now imagine… that same child is suddenly gone.
An accident. Illness. Something unexpected.
How does a parent live after that?
The same hands that used to protect the child… now have nothing to hold. The same eyes that watched every small movement… now search for someone who is no longer there. It’s not just loss. It’s a silence that stays forever.
Maybe that’s why there is no word for it.
Because some pain is too big for language.
We can say “widow,” we can say “orphan,” and somehow we understand. But this… this kind of grief cannot be explained so easily. You can listen to it, you can imagine it, but you cannot fully feel it unless you go through it.
And the truth is a bit hard:
People don’t really “move on” from this kind of loss.
They just learn how to live with it.
Time doesn’t erase it. It only teaches a person how to carry it quietly. From the outside, everything may look normal again. Smiles return, routines continue… but deep inside, something always remains missing.
So maybe instead of searching for a word, we should focus on something else — understanding, patience, and presence. Sometimes just sitting silently with someone, without trying to fix their pain, is enough.
Because not every grief needs a name.
Some are simply too deep… to be spoken.

⬇️ 2 places from last week 614/621 for HBD in Savings - ⬆️ 7 places from last week 1542/1562 Reputation - ⬆️ 20 places from last week ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Over the past week I gained ***+140.172 Hive Power***, ***0.001+ HBD in Savings***, and ***+0.05 Reputation Points***, which means that I still have ***6,821.405 HP*** and ***112.014 HBD in Savings*** to go to achieve my 2026 year-end goals. body.title: Let's Make a Collage - Round 249 - \
body.body: # Hola Amigos! # Entramos en otra semana activando la capacidad creadora en nuestro concurso: [Let's Make a Collage - Round 249](https://hive.blog/hive-174695/@lmac/lets-make-a-collage-a-contest-for-all-creatives-on-hive-round-249-55-hive-in-the-prize-pool) al que te invitamos, si quieres generar ideas y expresarlas libremente a través del arte del Collage. #

>Al mirar la fotografía de @sekorama, lo primero que vino a mi mente fue un refugio y rápidamente me puse a investigar para saber más acerca de ella. Mientras leía, me di cuenta de que la imagen de la escultura que ahora fungía como plantilla para mi collage fue hecha, justamente, con la intención de que pareciera una capa abierta creando la sensación de un refugio o abrazo. #
>Recordé entonces un lugar en el que siempre me sentí segura y feliz cuando estaba un poco triste y  al que los niños, por el simple hecho de serlo, tienen el privilegio de ir cada vez que quieren: \

>Es la inocencia, la que les permite sentir seguridad en medio de los escenarios mas sórdidos e indescriptibles. Es su inocencia la que los lleva a vivir las mas hermosas y especiales aventuras, aunque se encuentren sumidos en el caos de la vida dirigida por los adultos, quienes en su afán de conseguir lo que quieren, vulneran su seguridad y bienestar. #

>Con mi cabeza llena de todas estas ideas, me permití crear este Collage y compartirlo con ustedes. Espero, realmente que sea de su agrado. ### _English translation_ Hello, Friends! We’re kicking off another week by sparking our creativity in our contest: [Let’s Make a Collage – Round 249.](https://hive.blog/hive-174695/@lmac/lets-make-a-collage-a-contest-for-all-creatives-on-hive-round-249-55-hive-in-the-prize-pool]) We invite you to join us if you’d like to generate ideas and express them freely through the art of collage.

>When I looked at @sekorama’s photo, the first thing that came to mind was a refuge, and I quickly started researching to learn more about it. As I read, I realized that the image of the sculpture—which now served as the template for my collage—was created precisely with the intention of resembling an open cloak, evoking the feeling of a refuge or an embrace.

#
<div class=\

>I then remembered a place where I always felt safe and happy when I was a little sad—a place that children, simply by virtue of being children, have the privilege of going to whenever they want: “Innocence.”

#
<div class=\

>It is innocence that allows them to feel safe even in the most sordid and indescribable situations. It is their innocence that leads them to experience the most beautiful and special adventures, even when they find themselves immersed in the chaos of a life directed by adults, who, in their eagerness to get what they want, violate their safety and well-being.

#
<div class=\

>With my head full of all these ideas, I allowed myself to create this collage and share it with you. I truly hope you like it.
