body.body:
Hi everyone! We know that the best friend of nature for us is tree. Without trees the earth will turn into a dessert.  It will seems like the Mars, a silent red planet of solar system. No plants, no oxygen. Every year industries around the world emits carbon dioxide. Our earth is turning into a green house. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS28o7qLhvRMt9oguvt38vAN96sAjV3fRMuEpXn4Qhe7H/1777351181433.jpg)
Image source: I drew this image in water color.

Carbon dioxide has the power to absorb heat. Now a days the weather is not the same as 90's weather. In my country once we saw the beauty of six seasons but recently we feel three seasons. Summe winter and a little part of rainy season. Cutting down a lot of trees, destroying forests by tree smuggler  and not plant enough trees is mainly responsible for increasing carbon dioxide in air. Dhaka city tha capital city of Bangladesh is in top 5 cities for air pollution. Here are a lot of industries that emit not only carbon dioxide but also CFC and heavy metals  like lead, Mercury etc. Besides air pollution water pollution is also a regular incident in Bangladesh. 

Even the government water supplier never purify water prooerly. So every family havevto use filter for purifying water. Typhoid,  hepatitis and other chronic diseases may attack of they use polluted water. A matter of sorrow that some industries situated besides river ir canals. Some farmers cultivate vegetables and use water from these rivers and canals. For this the heavy metals and harmful chemicales are slowly poisoning the vegetables. Another fearful things is the waste of tanary is mixed with poultry feeds. So radio active and heavy metals both entering into poultry products.  

To fulfil the demand of protein middle earning countries like us are mostly depend on poultry industries. So everyday a lot of people are effected by many diseases. It is high time we prevented the environment pollution. If we don't take essential steps for controlling global warming the polar ice will melt so quickly that's why the low lying lands like Bangladesh will go under water and this process has already been started. The earths temperature is rising for green house effect, the water and air is polluting for industrial waste. China, The USA and India emits more carbon dioxide than any other countries of the world.  These are the top three countries to rising earth's temperature. Recent COP30 summit was held. The main two amendment was to save Amazon and control the rising temperature below 1.5 °C. And the a summit was held in Colombia to prevent emitting Carbon dioxide by the top listed Carbon dioxide emitting countries by controlling the use of fossil fuels. If we want to save our earth and giva a green world to our next generation we have to control the use of fossil fuels and need to take scientific way of waste management.

Also we have to develop our ethics to safe our next generation. Money is not everything. If I destroy nature for money nature will show us its result in feedback and that will be responsible for destroying mankind. So plant trees and try to use solar power for keep the environment pollution free and cool.

我之前的文章有提到过和孩子的相处问题，就拿上个星期来说吧，基本上我每天都会因为学习、各方面的事情跟Sheya大吵一架。我总觉得她不管是生活方面还是学习方面，各种习惯都不好，我看不顺眼就喜欢说几句。加上我当老师的性格本来就比较唠叨，在孩子看来就是一直不停的碎碎念，她自己也会觉得特烦。

周末，点哥跟她好好交谈了一番，我不在场。这一周孩子变化挺大，大人说什么就赶紧去做，反倒减少了很多说教，不用来回周旋辩论，大家都很开心。

上周星期四，学校进行了半期考试。说实话，看完她上期期末考试的成绩，我就减少了对她的一些期待，尽量把要求、期望值都放低。一旦接受这种设定，在很低的期望值基础上，她只要考得不错、有进步，反而会让人觉得挺好。

这次也是一样，我没有像以前那样抱着很高的期望。成绩当然不算特别好，两科都是90+，我随后跟老师了解过，她的语文和之前差不多，数学有进步，整体在班上属于中等水平。

这完全符合我的预判，她本来岁数就小，在班里应该算是最小的。接受知识的时候，有些内容不是她不会，更多是不理解、题目没读懂，才导致得分比较低。

我的观点就是继续保持这样的态势，慢慢往上走。要是一二年级就学得特别拔尖，我反而担心后期后劲不足。这样稳步发展，何尝不是一种良好的状态。

现在在家，她做作业的速度也比以前快了很多，能够在规定时间内完成。当然有时候也会粗心，只能慢慢引导。时间允许的情况下，会让她做一做学而思的零基础奥数，锻炼一下思维，跟着听课，再搭配做两道练习题，她其实完全跟得上，也听得懂。

语文方面，每天坚持阅读，没有刻意去做精读。打算等她升入二年级，或者利用暑假，给她报一个写作班。

英语的话，隔三差五会让她拿出Big muzzy绘本阅读，再结合看动画片培养兴趣，就按这个路线慢慢走。

总的来说，孩子一直在一点点进步。

body.title: MONTALBÁN, DOORS AND WINDOWS -  (PHOTOGRAPHY SERIES)
body.body:
![Ccats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AK3eHwVAmJXaJFDjPFJxW26nn8JXW692DCrCVPnfiegoHYg2C7oJLganUCQo7om.jpg)

----

**T**his series of photographs has a rather amusing story: It turns out that I left my house that morning intending to run some errands, then do some shopping, and finally return home around noon, as the weather forecast predicted heavy downpours starting around 12:30 PM. But, as is almost always the case, I took my camera with me, and after completing my errands, I decided that my walk home was a good opportunity to do a sort of \

of some of the doors and windows of the houses in town. This idea occurred to me precisely because my route back passed through some of the streets with the oldest houses, and these tend to have interesting windows and doors, whose visual character is constantly changing due to the passage of time and the effects of the weather. But, and here's the funny part, shortly after I started taking these photos, I noticed the immense gray clouds looming menacingly on the horizon to the southeast of town... Good heavens, in just a few minutes a downpour seemed imminent, and thunder began to rumble in the distance!... Realizing this, I started to pick up the pace, but I couldn't help stopping, looking at a door or a window, and snapping a picture... I even ran the last few blocks before getting home as fast as I could, taking photos almost at a trot! 😂... Fortunately, there were very few people on the street, as the impending rain brought the town to a standstill, leaving its streets deserted. But the few people who saw me couldn't help but laugh as they watched me practically run through the streets taking pictures of doors and windows, laughing at myself, and trying to get caught in the downpour before I even got home... Luckily, it all turned out alright, and only a few drops managed to reach me! It was so nice to get home and not have to wait for the rain to stop somewhere else, because it rained for almost four hours straight, and I wouldn't have been able to spend all that time downloading and processing photos to share... But here are my photos of doors and windows taken while I was running from the rain, and they're for you on #Hive! 😃📷👍\n\n>**E**sta serie de fotografías tiene una historia relativamente divertida: Resulta que durante la mañana salí caminado de mi casa con la intención de hacer algunas entregas, luego hacer unas compras y finalmente regresar al mediodía a casa, pues el reporte del clima anunciaba fuertes aguaceros a partir de las 12:30 PM aproximadamente. Pero, como casi siempre ocurre, llevé mi cámara conmigo y, luego de hacer las cosas que tenía pendientes, decidí que mi recorrido de retorno a casa era una buena oportunidad para hacer una especie de \

de algunas puertas y ventanas de las casas del pueblo. Y esto se me ocurrió precisamente porque mi ruta de retorno pasaba por algunas delas calles con más casas viejas y estas suelen tener ventanas y puertas interesantes, cuyo carácter visual suele cambiar continuamente debido al paso del tiempo y los efectos de la intemperie. Pero, y aquí viene lo divertido, es que poco después de comenzar a hacer estas fotos, me percaté de los inmensos nubarrones grises que aparecían amenazantes en el horizonte al sureste del pueblo... ¡Santos cielos, en pocos minutos el aguacero parecía ser inminente y comenzaron a escucharse truenos en la lejanía!... Al percatarme de esto, comencé a apurar el paso, pero no podía evitar detenerme, mirar una puerta o una ventana y disparar... ¡Las ultimas cuadras antes de llegar a casa incluso las hice corriendo lo más rápido que pude y disparaba fotos casi al trote! 😂... Afortunadamente había poquísimas en la calle, pues la inminencia de la lluvia hace que el pueblo se paralice y sus calles queden solitarias. Pero las pocas personas que me observaron no pudieron evitar reír mientras veían casi correr por las calles haciendo fotos de puertas y ventanas, riéndome de mi mismo, e intentando terminar siendo atrapado por el aguacero antes de llegar a casa... ¡Afortunadamente todo terminó bien, y apenas algunas gotas llegaron a alcanzarme!... Y fue bueno llegar a casa y no tener que esperar a que cesara la lluvia en un lugar foráneo, pues llovió durante casi cuatro horas seguidas y no hubiera podido pasar todo ese tiempo descargando fotos y procesándolas para compartirlas... ¡Pero aquí están mis fotos de puertas de ventanas tomadas mientras huía de la lluvia, y son para ti en #Hive!...😃📷👍 body.title: Revealed mysteries of the oceans.
body.body:
> A little more than 2 and a half years ago, there was a discovery that attracted a lot of attention. It was described as a golden orb, it was an unidentified object that aroused great public interest when it was collected during a NASA expedition in 2023, at a depth of 3,250 m in the Gulf of Alaska. La Noa is like NASA but from Earth. It stands for the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Office of the United States.


The scientists were exploring the bottom with an underwater Rober when they came across this strange object shaped like a mound, an orb, with a hole, so many speculated that it was, in the end they analyzed the DNA, compared it with other species and came to the conclusion that this golden sphere is actually the base of an anemone, a giant anemone. A giant deep-sea anemone, specifically Recantus Dafna, that would be the foot of the anemone. They achieved it by analyzing the DNA, so we already know that there was never anything inside here, but rather it was the glue that the foundation of that animal had to fix the rock, they were 30 to 40 cm, something like the size of the palm of a hand.

https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

>the Kraken research published, a gigantic octopus, has existed. This research was published in Japan and the researchers analyzed the fossil jaws or beaks of fin octopuses, enormous fin octopuses that lived between 100 to 72 million years ago in the Late Cretaceous, the time of the dinosaurs.


These beaks were found mainly in Japan and on Vancouver Island, because of course, octopuses do not have bones, but they have beaks, they have a very hard structure, it is a golden-shaped beak, that is, if one of these octopus captures you, it will strangle you with its tentacles, but then it will eat you and tear you to pieces with this beak.

> In the image below, you have a diver who has gone into a time capsule and has traveled to the past, we have the giant fish, the mosasaur, and in general it shows several dinosaurs from that time in scale, researchers have cataloged the species of two prehistoric octopuses that lived in that time of the Jurassic. One would be the small one, the Jeletzkyi, which would be the “small” pulp that lived between 100 and 72 million years and measured from 3 to 8 m, which would already be a huge octopus, it would be the size of a car to the size of a camper van and then the beast, the 17 m mosasaurs, would have a very bad time against this other one, the Nanaimoteuthis, which lived between 86 and 72 million years ago, it was colossal


Researchers believe that it measured 19 m and weighed several tons, it would be as big as an adult sperm whale. There are currently giant squids, the largest is the colossal squid, which is an invertebrate that can reach 9 to 14 m in total length, but of course, including the tentacles, the weight does not reach half a ton.


There is some estimate that there may be some specimen of these in the depths because they live at great depths and we do not know everything that is down there, which may be a little larger and reach 600 or 700 kg, but even so the structure of a squid is much more elongated and stylized, octopuses, on the other hand, are much more compact and muscular, it would be which would be the squid or a horse with that of a rhinoceros, which would be the octopus, this means that the body density of the octopus at similar sizes, the octopus would weigh much more, we would be talking about the order of tons.


In addition, these colossal squids have another characteristic that makes them safer for humans and that is that they live in the deepest depths, their blood and tissues are full of ammonia and they are practically extraterrestrial, they are extraterrestrial beings compared to those we live here on the surface because of how strange they are and because of their biology, they have an extreme adaptation that allows them to survive in the cold and total darkness and at such a tremendous depth, 2000 m deep or it is believed even more, but it also makes them very vulnerable to the changes in pressure, in fact, the few specimens that have reached the surface were already dead or dying, however, if a giant octopus like this had survived, a 19 m Cretaceous octopus, the history of humanity would have been very different, because these bugs can live on the surface and on top of that their level of intelligence, if it is like that of current octopuses, would be enormous.


It is one of the most intelligent animals that exist, in addition, it is believed that with that size it would also live many more years, because one of the circumstances of current octopuses is that they live for only a few years, another advantage for humans is that current octopuses are solitary animals, except in a very rare case, if they were to build colonies, octopuses could be a species to take into account as a future civilization on this planet, because their level of intelligence is truly quite astonishing.

body.title: Actitudes al descubierto # 13. El poder de no exponer a alguien. [ES/EN]
body.body:
---

**Serie:** Actitudes al descubierto  
**Capítulo 13**  
**Título:** El poder de no exponer a alguien  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcr1ycaTAvAb5tib4c2Wzn7ExSWurzFDgqYV4ZWr9DBF4/espelhosocial_brazil_6755880_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/brazil-football-flamengo-6755880/)

---

Hay momentos en los que alguien puede dejarte en evidencia… y decide no hacerlo.

Hola querida comunidad de @holos-lotus,

Continúo con *Actitudes al descubierto*, esta serie donde observo escenas cotidianas que, aunque parecen simples, terminan revelando mucho más sobre las personas que cualquier discurso.

Esta vez no fue una escena cualquiera.

Fue una de esas situaciones donde la autoridad, el carácter y la forma de tratar a los demás quedan completamente al descubierto.

Se trataba de un grupo de hombres. Un entorno donde el respeto no se regala, se construye. Donde la disciplina es parte del día a día, y donde los errores no suelen pasar desapercibidos.

Había una persona a cargo. Alguien que dirigía con firmeza. Sabía exigir, sabía poner límites, pero también sabía mantener el respeto sin cruzar esa línea que convierte la autoridad en humillación.

Y eso, aunque no siempre se diga, se nota.

En ese grupo ocurrió una falta. No una pequeña. Una de esas que, en otros contextos, habría terminado en una exposición pública, en palabras duras delante de todos, en una corrección que no solo busca ajustar, sino también marcar jerarquía.

Primero, habló con él en privado.

Un llamado de atención directo. Sin rodeos. Sin suavizar lo que debía ser dicho.

Hasta ahí, todo dentro de lo esperado.

Pero después vino algo más.

Le indicó que debía dirigirse al grupo. Pedir disculpas delante de todos.

Y ahí cambió el peso de la situación.

Porque una cosa es reconocer un error…  
y otra muy distinta es hacerlo frente a un colectivo donde la imagen también cuenta.

El grupo fue reunido.

Todos presentes.

El ambiente, sin decirlo, tenía esa carga silenciosa que aparece cuando todos saben que algo va a ocurrir.

El hombre se colocó al frente.

Se notaba la incomodidad. No tanto por el error en sí, sino por lo que estaba a punto de hacer.

Respiró. Se preparó.

Y comenzó:

> “Yo quiero pedir disculpas…”

No pudo terminar.

La persona a cargo lo detuvo.

No con dureza.

No con enojo.

Simplemente dijo:

> “Ya, caballero… aquí no pasó nada.”

Y en ese momento, algo cambió.

No hubo discurso.  
No hubo exposición.  
No hubo necesidad de llevar la situación más lejos.

Se rompió la formación.

Cada cual volvió a lo suyo.

Desde fuera, podría parecer un detalle pequeño. Un simple cambio de decisión.

Pero no lo fue.

Porque tenía todo el poder para hacerlo hablar. Para hacerlo quedar expuesto. Para reforzar su autoridad frente al grupo.

Y eligió no hacerlo.

Mientras observaba esa escena, no pude evitar pensar en cuántas veces ocurre lo contrario.

Cuántas veces alguien, teniendo una posición de poder, decide usarla para marcar distancia, para imponer, para dejar claro quién manda… incluso a costa de la dignidad del otro.

Y sin embargo, en este caso, ocurrió algo distinto.

No se trató de suavizar el error.

Ni de ignorarlo.

Se trató de reconocer un límite.

De entender que corregir no siempre implica exponer.

Que la autoridad no pierde fuerza por evitar una humillación.

Al contrario.

Se vuelve más sólida.

Porque el respeto que nace del miedo puede ser inmediato… pero el que nace de la forma en que se trata a las personas, permanece.

Y ese tipo de decisiones no se olvidan.

Ni por quien las toma…  
ni por quien las recibe…  
ni por quienes las presencian.

Porque hay gestos que no hacen ruido…  
pero dicen exactamente quién eres cuando tienes el poder de hacer lo contrario.

---

En los próximos capítulos de *Actitudes al descubierto* seguiré explorando estos momentos donde una decisión, aparentemente pequeña, revela mucho más que cualquier palabra.

---

## English Version

---

**Series:** Attitudes Uncovered  
**Chapter 13**  
**Title:** The Power of Not Exposing Someone  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcr1ycaTAvAb5tib4c2Wzn7ExSWurzFDgqYV4ZWr9DBF4/espelhosocial_brazil_6755880_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/brazil-football-flamengo-6755880/)

---

There are moments when someone could put you on display… and chooses not to.

Hello dear @holos-lotus community,

I continue with *Attitudes Uncovered*, this series where I observe everyday scenes that, although they seem simple, reveal far more about people than any speech could.

This was not just any scene.

It was one of those situations where authority, character, and the way we treat others become fully visible.

It involved a group of men. An environment where respect is not given freely—it is earned. Where discipline is part of daily life, and mistakes rarely go unnoticed.

There was someone in charge. A person who led with firmness. He knew how to demand, how to set limits, but also how to maintain respect without crossing that line where authority turns into humiliation.

And that, even if not spoken, is something people feel.

A mistake happened within the group. Not a small one. The kind that, in other contexts, would have led to public exposure, harsh words in front of everyone, a correction meant not only to fix but to establish hierarchy.

First, he spoke to him in private.

A direct warning. Clear. Without softening what needed to be said.

Up to that point, everything was expected.

But then came something more.

He told him he would have to address the group. To apologize in front of everyone.

And that changed the weight of the situation.

Because one thing is to acknowledge a mistake…  
and another is to do it in front of a group where image also matters.

The group was gathered.

Everyone present.

There was a silent tension in the air—the kind that appears when everyone knows something is about to happen.

The man stepped forward.

The discomfort was visible. Not just because of the mistake, but because of what he was about to do.

He took a breath.

Prepared himself.

And began:

> “I want to apologize…”

He didn’t get to finish.

The leader stopped him.

Not harshly.

Not angrily.

He simply said:

> “That’s enough… nothing happened here.”

And in that moment, something shifted.

There was no speech.  
No exposure.  
No need to take it further.

The formation was dismissed.

Everyone went back to their tasks.

From the outside, it might seem like a small detail. A simple change of decision.

But it wasn’t.

Because he had all the power to make him speak. To expose him. To reinforce his authority in front of everyone.

And he chose not to.

As I observed that moment, I couldn’t help but think about how often the opposite happens.

How often someone, holding a position of power, chooses to use it to impose, to create distance, to make clear who is in charge… even at the cost of someone else’s dignity.

And yet, in this case, something different happened.

It wasn’t about ignoring the mistake.

Nor about softening it.

It was about recognizing a boundary.

Understanding that correcting does not always require exposure.

That authority does not lose strength by avoiding humiliation.

On the contrary.

It becomes stronger.

Because respect born from fear may be immediate… but respect born from the way people are treated, lasts.

And those kinds of decisions are not forgotten.

Not by the one who makes them…  
nor by the one who receives them…  
nor by those who witness them.

Because there are gestures that make no noise…  
but say exactly who you are when you have the power to do otherwise.

---

In the next chapters of *Attitudes Uncovered*, I will continue exploring these moments where a seemingly small decision reveals far more than words ever could.

---

Las imágenes son de Pixabay y para la versión en inglés utilicé el traductor de Google.  
The images are from Pixabay, and for the English version I used Google Translate.

---

Thank you for reading.
Special thanks to @bradleyarrow for supporting the community.

title.title: Bistec de res con ensalada y arroz [ESP/ENG]
title.body: # Bistec de res con ensalada y arroz [ESP/ENG]\n\n<div class=\

>

Buenas noches amigos de la comunidad de @hivefood, espero que todos se encuentren bien de salud. Yo por acá me encuentro relativamente mejor de la virosis. Sean todos bienvenidos a mi blog. 

![27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/242YEDdwwM5yNFCr2HYbAeU6cSw2KkdcRfSPRzJzcCrRq14V284NQTFUXTtdabwAQunrN.jpg)

Hoy una vez mas paso por esta gran comunidad, de la cual me siento agradecida de formar parte de ella, ya que me ha permitido mostrar mis recetas culinarias que día a día, mes a mes preparo para degustarlas en familia, con amigos en fin. es por tal motivo que hoy les traigo una receta sencilla pero muy deliciosa: Bistec de res con ensalada y arroz, lo prepara para degustarlo en mi almuerzo con mi familia.

![24.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EogPMBjFdF9T59qaZrG6sYNvchT2MtgSTYaFQvx9CGTLJ3UYZTYz3g1KtYHTrb83gtQ.jpg)

Les comento que este deliciosos plato quedo muy rico, la carne estaba jugosa y con una textura bastante suave, la ensalada deliciosa un poco dulce y el arroz bastante suelto por lo que me deleite un delicioso almuerzo acompañado de un rico jugo de guayaba que tanto nos encanta.

![25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EouACZFozk1gahqrCYcdYxSsnBYPjd1HSPsopKXLbakTtQDUoYBo4cYcgqKXZBSU1my.jpg)

Ahora les indico los ingredientes que utilice para este almuerzo

# Ingredientes
* 3 Bistec de pulpa negra
* aceite para freír
* 1/2 cucharadita de comino
* pimienta negra al gusto
* 1 cucharada de Orégano entero
* salsa de ajo
* 1 y 1/2 taza de arroz blanco
* 3 dientes de ajo
* 1 cucharadita de vinagre
* 200 gramos de lechuga
* 1 zanahoria mediana
* 1 cucharada de azúcar
* 3 cucharadas de mayonesa
* 1 cucharadita de mostaza

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23x19EyW5DkWPP81yC29ATG9URsvHEn4iiKmx7aZttz2k32f1r4LdUu7dbXakddWKVtLY.jpg)|![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wqkRtwn3u8Hx4ytpcRLVDaj8xibvJdBxvU8yduW3hi5c2YdyJaPM7Hj1guNW675EroY.jpg)
-|-

# Procedimiento
Lo primero que hice fue lavar con abundante agua los bistec, luego tome un sarten agregue un poco de agua, sal, deje cocinar por 10 minutos de modo de ablandarlos un poco para luego freírlos.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoAaAsJgC7Pq4YWW6jcYeausg57CNHF1XEANo1FkVdFzQJJRnsTp3bZvTJEdQCVASJK.jpg)
![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eou8Ar1uhfQg7nhAQEGFea14am7YXLXyeEaSfzXmFAVGEdKPWmrDx6NPfscHai4xpNr.jpg)

Luego que ya se ablandaron los baje del fuego y los sazone con salsa de ajo, comino, orégano y pimienta negra. tome un caldero le agregue aceite y los Frei durante  5 minutos dando vuelta por ambos lados hasta dorar.

![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23x19AhUVWoqVMukH52U53cEAQSBrJMfeKwpgnr2w1aq4LJuAJ8dFmWoQkCPcjrwZaQgh.jpg)|![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vho8ArnTppfTx8otfFRhgacG88EsLuULovnmDLZr8MEYpAiQECgjhNc4uN8i3Sqptzi.jpg)
-|-

![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoke6r7i9dCWLnBMj5V9kqMkDTtGC4v8jLfJGQzcpcydknYmqa51mqCuDDLarZoew6N.jpg)

Posteriormente prepare el arroz blanco y una ensalada de lechuga con zanahoria y de bebida un delicioso jugo de guayaba y de esta manera deguste mi delicioso almuerzo.

![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23z7Bzpa8Mp6xzcXTDauEFHhza1HGjzBN845xKLv2hkoNjeMhrFh7Q1KTRsfgETTMfexU.jpg)

![26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xyXRNNTKqgwChLuxdRMgHeopmrxJkLqxLxWeF7XrjKp4LpQNoeGYPuzDXXQAVNvANNc.jpg)

Esta receta es bastante sencilla y rápida de preparar como para esos días que andamos apurados con el día a día podemos prepárala ya que nos ira bien.

Hasta aquí mi contenido, les dejo algunas fotos de todo el procedimiento, nos vemos en un próximo contenido. saludos y Dios los bendiga a todos. 

* Fotos tomadas con Iphone 8 plus
* Portada diseñada con Canva
* Texto traducido con Deepl

<div class=\
> # English Version # Beef Steak with Salad and Rice

> Good evening, friends of the @hivefood community. I hope you’re all in good health. I’m feeling a bit better here after my stomach bug. Welcome to my blog. ![27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/242YEDdwwM5yNFCr2HYbAeU6cSw2KkdcRfSPRzJzcCrRq14V284NQTFUXTtdabwAQunrN.jpg) Today, once again, I’m stopping by this wonderful community, which I’m grateful to be a part of, as it has allowed me to share the recipes I prepare day after day, month after month, to enjoy with family and friends. That is why today I’m sharing a simple but very delicious recipe: Beef Steak with Salad and Rice, which I’m preparing for lunch with my family. ![24.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EogPMBjFdF9T59qaZrG6sYNvchT2MtgSTYaFQvx9CGTLJ3UYZTYz3g1KtYHTrb83gtQ.jpg) I have to tell you that this delicious dish turned out great—the meat was juicy and had a very tender texture, the salad was delicious and slightly sweet, and the rice was nice and fluffy, so I enjoyed a delicious lunch accompanied by a tasty guava juice that we all love so much. ![25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EouACZFozk1gahqrCYcdYxSsnBYPjd1HSPsopKXLbakTtQDUoYBo4cYcgqKXZBSU1my.jpg) Here are the ingredients I used for this lunch: # Ingredients * 3 black beef steaks * oil for frying * 1/2 teaspoon cumin * black pepper to taste * 1 tablespoon whole oregano * garlic sauce * 1 1/2 cups white rice * 3 cloves garlic * 1 teaspoon vinegar * 200 grams lettuce * 1 medium carrot * 1 tablespoon sugar * 3 tablespoons mayonnaise * 1 teaspoon mustard ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23x19EyW5DkWPP81yC29ATG9URsvHEn4iiKmx7aZttz2k32f1r4LdUu7dbXakddWKVtLY.jpg) |![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wqkRtwn3u8Hx4ytpcRLVDaj8xibvJdBxvU8yduW3hi5c2YdyJaPM7Hj1guNW675EroY.jpg) -|- # Procedure The first thing I did was wash the steaks thoroughly with plenty of water. Then I took a skillet, added a little water and salt, and let them cook for 10 minutes to tenderize them a bit before frying them. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoAaAsJgC7Pq4YWW6jcYeausg57CNHF1XEANo1FkVdFzQJJRnsTp3bZvTJEdQCVASJK.jpg) ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eou8Ar1uhfQg7nhAQEGFea14am7YXLXyeEaSfzXmFAVGEdKPWmrDx6NPfscHai4xpNr.jpg) Once they have softened, remove them from the heat and season them with garlic sauce, cumin, oregano, and black pepper. Take a skillet, add oil, and fry them for 5 minutes, turning them on both sides until golden brown. ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23x19AhUVWoqVMukH52U53cEAQSBrJMfeKwpgnr2w1aq4LJuAJ8dFmWoQkCPcjrwZaQgh.jpg) |![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vho8ArnTppfTx8otfFRhgacG88EsLuULovnmDLZr8MEYpAiQECgjhNc4uN8i3Sqptzi.jpg) -|- ![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoke6r7i9dCWLnBMj5V9kqMkDTtGC4v8jLfJGQzcpcydknYmqa51mqCuDDLarZoew6N.jpg) Afterward, I prepared white rice and a lettuce and carrot salad, and for a drink, a delicious guava juice, and that’s how I enjoyed my delicious lunch. ![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23z7Bzpa8Mp6xzcXTDauEFHhza1HGjzBN845xKLv2hkoNjeMhrFh7Q1KTRsfgETTMfexU.jpg) ![26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xyXRNNTKqgwChLuxdRMgHeopmrxJkLqxLxWeF7XrjKp4LpQNoeGYPuzDXXQAVNvANNc.jpg) This recipe is simple and quick to prepare, perfect for those days when we’re in a rush with our daily routines—we can make it ahead of time since it will keep well. That’s all for now. I’ve included some photos of the entire process. See you in my next post. Best wishes, and God bless you all. * Photos taken with an iPhone 8 Plus * Cover designed with Canva * Text translated with DeepL Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@morepina/bistec-de-res-con-ensalada-y-arroz-espeng-3if)

title.title: EJERCICION FOTOGRAFICO PARA LA CREATIVIDAD ARTISTICA - PHOTOGRAPHY EXERCISE FOR ARTISTIC CREATIVITY(ESP/ENG)
title.body:
![DINAMICA 51 - FOTO 1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielacarrasco/23tRok9FE4EabD5TeVYTCACLpnFNZGmz1e9p745ZK1qH1CT15TdDHLx1SpN9g7uudQGWq.jpg)

---
Saludos amigos de hive, últimamente me ha costado un poco publicar por temas de laborales, de verdad que el horario se vuelve complicado. Sin embargo, aquí estamos retomando, en este nuevo reto intentare postear por lo menos una vez por semana en relación a alguna creación artística de mi autoría o la de algún amigo en la que yo haya tenido participación de alguna manera en el proceso. Esto en el intento de mantenerme cercana a mi arte y seguir en la búsqueda en la que estaba antes de tomar este empleo. Mi búsqueda hoy se mantiene vigente gracias a dos interrogantes, ¿Cuál es la estética de mi arte? y ¿Qué quiero comunicar? 
>Greetings, Hive friends! Lately, I’ve had a hard time posting because of work—my schedule has really gotten complicated. However, here we are, back at it. With this new challenge, I’ll try to post at least once a week about an artistic creation of my own or one by a friend in which I’ve been involved in some way. This is an attempt to stay connected to my art and continue the journey I was on before taking this job. My journey remains relevant today thanks to two questions: What is the aesthetic of my art? and What do I want to communicate? 
---

![DINAMICA 51 - FOTO 2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielacarrasco/23tGTV2AxkR4AHUEMhK2qaXbMEdxzfc1Jbyz9WHqTzupj59gdqMpExFFFi9KnzEi96U8n.jpg)

---
Hoy les comparto un ejercicio fotográfico que realice en mi hogar, el objetivo era contar una historia en 5 fotografías, estuvo un poco difícil porque estaba sola en casa así que no tenia a quien fotografiar. Pero el cine es tan maravilloso que nos brinda la posibilidad de abordar cualquier perspectiva que sea imaginable.
>Today I’m sharing a photography project I did at home. The goal was to tell a story in five photographs. It was a bit challenging because I was home alone, so I didn’t have anyone to photograph. But cinema is so wonderful—it gives us the ability to explore any perspective imaginable.
---

![DINAMICA 51 - FOTO 3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielacarrasco/23tGbnYPFUkpLBL7aXUbuFGL4QuLAktmddm3QjU66eT2EYXeNrJP8c3QoTjtfGnDD6BzR.jpg)

---
Jugué con la subjetividad, en la primera foto vemos un sendero desde la perspectiva de quien transitará por allí, luego en la segunda tenemos el mismo encuadre, pero todo está desenfocado.
>I played with perspective: in the first photo, we see a path from the viewpoint of someone walking along it; in the second, we have the same composition, but everything is out of focus. 
---

![DINAMICA 51 - FOTO 4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielacarrasco/23tGa9BkxeEDQd3P5z3cvmTVuiJL6eQzLvaLsrg5rtpWfhoFBRKL6PjbDyAbGRZMr4XKG.jpg)

---
Mas adelante vemos como alguien esta en el piso, pero siempre usando la subjetividad. Esa misma mano que se muestra aprieta el puño, para en la ultima foto tomar una postura recta con el cielo de fondo.
>Later on, we see someone lying on the floor, but the perspective remains first-person. That same hand clenches into a fist, and in the final photo, the person stands up straight with the sky in the background.
---

![DINAMICA 51 - FOTO 5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielacarrasco/242NaN1rqBBhVXRMhzzBrP78TGUDFCdQnn8xEDmGgCJYz4kHTH7LzKhhzp5iFKiXho4qz.jpg)

----
Los invito la realizar una observación desde la semiología, siempre hay una historia para quien se da la libertad de leer. Esta fue una tarea realizada para la materia de lenguaje cinematográfico.
>I invite you to take a semiotic approach; there is always a story for those who take the liberty to read between the lines. This was an assignment completed for the course on cinematic language.

title.title: The Power of Gratitude in a Busy Digital World Image Error
title.body:
In today’s fast-moving digital world, everyone is running. We scroll, we click, we compare, and sometimes we forget to pause. Social media shows us perfect lives, expensive cars, luxury vacations, and endless success stories. Slowly, without even noticing, we start feeling that we are behind. This is exactly why gratitude has become one of the most trending and powerful topics right now. People are realizing that happiness is not always about getting more — sometimes it is about appreciating what we already have.
Gratitude is a simple habit, but its impact is huge. When a person starts noticing small blessings — like waking up healthy, having food on the table, or receiving a kind message from a friend — their mindset changes. Instead of focusing on what is missing, the mind begins to focus on what is present. This shift reduces stress and anxiety. Many psychologists and motivational speakers now emphasize daily gratitude journaling because it helps people stay mentally strong in a world full of pressure and comparison.
One interesting thing about gratitude is that it costs nothing, yet it gives so much. You don’t need money, fame, or special talent to practice it. A simple “thank you,” a smile, or helping someone without expecting anything back can instantly lift your mood. In fact, research and real-life experiences both show that grateful people often sleep better, feel more energetic, and maintain stronger relationships. It’s like a small daily investment that gives lifelong emotional returns.
Another reason gratitude is trending is because people are tired of negativity. News, conflicts, online arguments, and toxic comparisons can drain energy quickly. Gratitude acts like a mental reset button. It reminds us that even in hard times, there is always something good to hold onto — family support, a lesson learned, or even the strength to continue. This doesn’t mean ignoring problems; it simply means not letting problems control your entire outlook on life.
Social media challenges such as “7-Day Gratitude Challenge” or “One Thing I’m Thankful For Today” are becoming popular because they encourage positivity and community interaction. When people share what they are grateful for, it creates a ripple effect. Others start thinking about their own blessings too. Suddenly, timelines become less about competition and more about connection.
In the end, gratitude is not a trend that will fade away quickly. It is more like a timeless life skill that is being rediscovered by modern society. In a noisy world full of expectations, gratitude brings calm. It teaches us to value moments, people, and experiences that truly matter. When we learn to appreciate the little things, we often realize that life is already richer than we thought. Sometimes, the secret to moving forward happily is simply pausing for a moment and saying, “I am thankful.

title.title: Betrayed but not broken
title.body:
I once loved a woman so deeply…
it felt like heaven had touched my life.
She wasn’t just beautiful—
she was an angel in my heart,
a saint in my soul,
a blessing I thought I had prayed into existence.
She spoke about forever like it was already written.
She described our wedding like she had already seen it.
The car we would ride in…
the life we would live…
the future we would build together.
And me?
I believed every word.
Even when I had nothing—
when I was still struggling just to stand on my own feet—
I told myself,
“Work harder. Hustle more. Become better… for her, for us.”
She would look into my eyes and ask,
“Are you sure you’ll never leave me?”
And I would answer without hesitation,
“It’s forever.”
Because I meant it.
I gave her loyalty.
I gave her trust.
I gave her a version of me that had no backup plan.
But what I didn’t know…
was that while I was building dreams,
I was standing inside a game I didn’t even know I was playing.
You see, betrayal from a stranger hurts…
but betrayal from someone you trust?
That hits differently.
My own friend—
someone I laughed with,
someone I confided in—
was fighting a silent battle I knew nothing about.
He had wanted her first.
She turned him down.
And instead of letting go…
he held onto that pain.
Quietly.
Patiently.
Dangerously.
Then one day, without my knowledge,
he passed her contact to another man…
with one mission—
destroy what I had.
And it worked.
Just like that…
everything I thought was real
fell apart.
And when the dust settled…
he didn’t apologize.
He laughed.
That moment…
it broke something inside me.
I asked myself questions that kept me awake at night:
“Why would a friend do this?”
“Why would someone who begged me to stay… be part of my downfall?”
The pain was loud.
It showed in my silence.
It lived in my thoughts.
It followed me everywhere.
But here’s what I’ve learned—
Pain can destroy you…
or it can introduce you to a stronger version of yourself.
Because right in the middle of that darkness,
life sent me someone I didn’t expect.
A neighbor.
He saw the weight I was carrying
without me saying a word.
He asked.
He listened.
He understood.
And that was the beginning of my comeback.
He became more than a neighbor—
he became my brother, my mentor, my guide.
He didn’t just tell me to “move on.”
He showed me how to level up.
We trained together.
We talked about discipline, purpose, growth.
Day by day…
I started rebuilding.
Not for her.
Not to prove anything to anyone.
But for me.
And slowly…
the same pain that once broke me
became the fire that built me.
Today?
I’m stronger.
I’m wiser.
I’m more focused than I’ve ever been.
I may not be where I dream to be yet…
but I’m far from where I used to be.
And that means everything.
Because now I understand—
some people don’t enter your life to stay.
Some come to teach.
Some come to reveal.
And some come to redirect you.
What I thought was love… taught me awareness.
What I thought was friendship… taught me boundaries.
What I thought was betrayal… became my transformation.


They tried to break me…
but they only introduced me to my strength.
So if life ever puts you in a place where you feel betrayed,
don’t let it bury you.
Let it build you.
Because sometimes,
your greatest setback…
is actually your greatest setup for growth.
I was betrayed—
but I was never broken.

title.title: My pets, my responsibility  (ENG-ESP)
title.body:
***Greetings, dear and beautiful Hive Pets community 😊***

+ ***Saludos querida y hermosa comunidad de Hive Pets 😊***

A couple of days ago, my husband and I went to visit my mother. She lives miles away, so we left home early, and that usually means we're gone for 10 to 12 hours.

Whenever I go to visit her, I make preparations the night before, and my main concern is leaving my pets alone for so long. Personally, I think 12 hours is too long, especially since my dog ​​is getting old and needs more care than when he was younger. He used to come with us, but now that our cat, Mitchu, has joined us, we prefer they keep each other company until we get there.

+ Hace un par de días mi esposo y yo salimos a visitar a mi madre, ella vive a kilómetros de distancia por ese motivo salimos temprano de casa y normalmente eso nos ausenta de 10 a 12 horas.

+ Siempre que voy a visitarla hago preparativos la noche anterior, y mi principal preocupación es el dejar solas a mis mascotas por tanto tiempo, personalmente me parece que 12 horas es mucho, sobre todo porque mi perrito está ancianito y necesita de más cuidados que cuando estaba joven, antes él se iba con nosotros, pero ahora que nuestra minina Mitchu llego a nuestro hogar preferimos que se hagan compañía mientras nosotros llegamos.

////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
![photo_5152643682463845674_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/243zi2WhtR4EVfjVeXAQbSLhLCFTgZNDXUHANokrEnm1JPdrbmWYqkCi9JaycnGe1zHWQ.jpg)

---
---
I would love to take my pets with me everywhere, but Mom is sick, and it's not a good idea to take them because my focus is on taking care of her. So, what I do is leave everything ready for them: their food, water, and a light on.

When we have to be gone for so many hours, I ask God to protect them until we get back. Maybe some people will say I'm exaggerating, that they're just animals. Yes, they are animals, but they have needs just like any of us.

That day we went to visit Mom, my dog ​​had a bit of an upset stomach, and even though it wasn't serious, I left feeling very worried, knowing I might find something unusual at home. And that's exactly what happened. When we returned, Sortario and Mitchu were glued to the door waiting for us, as they always do. But this time there was something else, something unpleasant: Sortario, our dog, had peed and pooped inside the house. I wasn't upset; I just immediately started cleaning everything up with my husband's help.

How could I be upset? I couldn't; I was exhausted. But my little dog needed me too, and I have the full responsibility of caring for him and treating him with patience. After cleaning everything in the house, I set about cleaning them. My cat hadn't gotten dirty at all. When she sees poop and pee, she doesn't go near it, although she's always very curious. But Sortario did have pee on his paws. I cleaned him, gave them lots of cuddles, and then fed them.

For many years, I've understood that having a pet is a huge blessing because they fill our home with joy, but they are also a great responsibility. It's like taking care of children. Animals will always be innocent; they depend on us: food, keeping them groomed and clean, taking them to the vet when necessary, providing them with a place where they feel happy. Our mood also affects them; they feel. That's why, when we adopt a pet, we must be aware that they are living beings with needs very similar to our own.

+  Me encantaría llevar a mis mascotas siempre conmigo, pero mamá está enferma y no es muy buena idea llevarlos porque en ese momento mi foco está en cuidar de ella, entonces lo que hago es dejarles todo preparado, su comida, agua, y una luz encendida.

+ Cuando tenemos que ausentarnos por tantas horas le pido a Dios que los proteja mientras llegamos, a lo mejor algunos dirán que exagero, que solo son animales, si, la verdad son animales, pero con necesidades como cualquiera de nosotros.

+ Ese día que fuimos a visitar a mamá, mi perrito estaba un poco mal del estómago y aunque no era grave me fui con mucha preocupación consiente que me podía conseguir con alguna novedad en casa, y así fue, cuando regresamos estaban Sortario y Mitchu pegados a la puerta esperándonos como siempre lo hacen, pero esta vez había algo más y desagradable, Sortario nuestro perrito se había hecho pipi y popo dentro de la casa, no me molesté, solo me puse de inmediato a limpiar todo con la ayuda de mi esposo.

+ ¿Como molestarme? no puedo, yo venía agotada, pero mi perrito también me necesitaba y tengo toda la responsabilidad de cuidarle y tratarle con paciencia, después de limpiar todo en casa, me dispuse a limpiarlos a ellos, mi gatita no se había ensuciado con nada, ella   cuando ve popo y pipi no se acerca mucho, aunque siempre es muy curiosa, pero Sortario si tenía pipi por las patitas, lo limpié, les hice muchos mimos y después les di de comer.

+ Desde hace muchos años entendí que si iba a tener mascota, es una bendición enorme porque ellos llenan de alegría nuestro hogar, pero también son una gran responsabilidad, es como cuidar de los niños, los animales siempre serán inocentes, ellos dependen de nosotros, alimentación, mantenerlos peinados, limpios, llevarlos al veterinario cuando sea necesario, tenerles un lugar para que se sientan felices, nuestro ánimo también les afecta, ellos sienten, por eso cuando adoptemos a una mascota tengamos conciencia de que son seres vivos, tienen necesidades muy parecidas a las nuestras.

***Love your pets, take good care of them, and enjoy their company 💕***

+ ***Amen, cuiden a sus mascotas y disfruten mucho de su compañía 💕***

前一天缴完费回家之后，第二天就可以直接去抽血室抽血了。但是帅哥太磨蹭了，我又不想一个人去，后面去到已经8点22了，排队取号的时候前面有19个人在排队，我直接崩溃了。

这时师姐发信息问我，抽到第几次血了，我说才排队，发了那个排队的号给她看。她说她们那边是有个专门的窗口，直接去说做糖耐量检测人家就直接给测了，不用排队。

我就抱着试一试的态度，去找了窗口的抽血工作人员。我说我要做糖耐量检测，这里有专门的窗口吗还是要排队，她就问我取号没，我说我去了，需要排队吗，她就说等抽完这个给你抽。然后她抽完那个就到我了，我真的超感谢我的师姐，不然不懂等到什么时候，过来人的经验就是帮大忙。

一边抽血工作人员一边吩咐我，糖水怎么喝，我说我带了杯子，不懂咋喝，没有刻度。然后她就说叫我用他们的杯子，一次性杯子一杯半就是300ml，300ml的水要配75g糖，也就是一整包都要倒进去，她说水温要比平时喝的烫一点，不然溶不掉那个糖粉，我带了一个果茶杯，还有一个勺子。

抽完第一次空腹血他们就给了我一个牌子说等下一个小时拿着牌子过来直接抽血，不用排队。抽完之后我就和帅哥出来接水，结果不会用那个饮水机，以为没有热水了，最后一个工作人员来接水，才发现原来有热水，要先解锁。

后面按照指示把水倒进粉里面搅拌，从喝第一口开始计时，需要五分钟内把糖水喝光。我们刚好从8:55开始喝，9:00要喝完，下次抽血时间是9:55，后面是10:55和11:55，一共要抽四次血。中途不能吃任何东西，需要做完实验才能吃东西。我们早上来的时候就先买了早餐但是还不能吃，要等到中午。

后面就是坐了一个上午，检查终于做完了，结果要下午才出。

title.title: Refuerzo con: Las Tramas - El dolor de cabeza en lo diferente [ENG/ESP]
title.body:
>Greetings to everyone in the Lifestyle community! Today I’m joining you here to share a new day in my life in the classroom. On this occasion, I want to share with you what our class was like as we reviewed a rather controversial—and at the same time intriguing—topic. Contrary to what I thought, that the children would find this topic fun, it turned out to have the opposite effect, and the children hate it: the use of patterns. Hatching is a set of graphic elements (lines, dots, or any strokes) used to create volume, texture, and depth. For example, by placing lines in succession and quite close to one another, it creates the effect that that area is darker or that there is a shadow.

\n\n

>It’s also the ideal way to draw, as it creates a very pleasing visual effect that isn’t usually achieved with conventional (or more common) drawing methods, where you constantly try to “soften” or blend every shadow and every highlight until not a single line is visible. Let’s say the effect of the hatching is much cleaner because it doesn’t leave that “somewhat messy” trace of blending (which almost always leaves an unattractive smudge that looks like it came from your fingers or the tool used to distribute the charcoal); instead, the blending is achieved with very thin, small, and juxtaposed lines. I’ve included an example below so you can see what I mean.

\n\n>

>Saludos a todos en la comunidad de Lifestyle, el día de hoy me uno por acá para compartir con ustedes un nuevo día en mi vida en el aula de clases. Para esta ocasión quiero compartir con ustedes lo que fue nuestra clase con el repaso sobre un tema bastante controversial... y al mismo tiempo curioso. Contrario a lo que yo pensaba sobre que los niños iban a encontrar divertido este tema, resultó tener el efecto contrario y los niños lo detestan: el uso de las tramas. Las tramas son conjunto de elementos gráficos (líneas, puntos o cualquier trazo) que se usan para generar volumen, textura y profundidad. Por ejemplo, al colocar líneas de forma sucesiva y bastante cercanas las unas a las otras, se genera un efecto de que en esa zona esta más oscura o hay una sombra.

\n\n>
>También es la forma de dibujo ideal, pues genera un gesto muy agradable a la vista que no se suele lograr con el tipo de dibujo convencional (o más conocido) dónde uno intenta constantemente \
o difuminar cada sombra, cada luz, hasta que ya no se nota ni una sola línea. Digamos que es mucho más limpio el efecto de las tramas al no dejar ese rastro \

del difuminado (casi siempre deja una mancha no muy agradable que parece ser de los dedos o de la herramienta para distribuir el carboncillo), sino que el difuminado se da con líneas bien delgadas, pequeñas y yuxtapuestas. Les dejo un ejemplo aquí abajo para que se puedan ilustrar.

![IMG_3585.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Ep3fJQfbwuygHBQ79QDBPBbLpLNbZLRAGfNyrivS3RkYnVFhoXyJ6hLg35UASy8bG3f.jpeg) ![IMG_3584.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eoc8W5dkSjzQANXqaLZj6KR9qkcq9etHBjo9kFKqfipDwb52PfVcKCp4UpCg3NMeKSC.jpeg) ![IMG_3583.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eoc8yHGScAy7f9eYrcSzSThKAsPrnmARr4W7TB8FK7ZgTraCkmqWzQmeRghrRbQVo1n.jpeg) ![IMG_3582.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EoeHG8CRenHm3mEYa3PFaCNWANyYAzswZerfF6Kwi9fdsAnWr6GBEHzWTFJT7ptQLbm.jpeg) ![IMG_3568.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eq7Nm8YMaXVCSTZgUHjZ7JXPmm5xNZMNEUgy7WQocqY94RpgYSwPyQgRZFTNm42wqjN.jpeg) ![IMG_3566.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eq5FQLATpHzb9odneeiEM5aGpNLwkPPJDn6QiJpjpmM9p7hAhAYUmxn2ybKkXaYrN9u.jpeg) ![IMG_3562.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EoyRUA9LC4b4ug46VuJVUCU7qN49yW8xSU4FVekvWxTWiHQjALRQMPtRpcjo3PzHNgP.jpeg) ![IMG_3560.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpxrJFQMhzFaVLA6Qva6WKLVMsbZud9PNDY5N6g2Njf8ozJFkF4D8riYXpbkz6M61BB.jpeg) ![IMG_3564.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpzzbyoZZnPvdgg342MyhE4h55hWPBF2LpF38z84YU5XeFKHfRhRyoSM6CbQB9JJ87Z.jpeg) ![IMG_3555.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EowJYZgR5R7xvKZU55H3B1md3xq9iBzVk4j3q8Mc3FppdiEBeNxg9w88DN1n2ovuqtc.jpeg)

>Children often dislike halftone screens because they don’t quite produce that “perfect” shading effect you get with a shading tool or your finger. The secret lies in learning how to create shading with halftone screens by mastering the placement of those lines, dots, or strokes. As I mentioned, the effect is far superior and of higher quality, not only because of the effort involved in the work but also because it showcases the artist’s skill, character, and technique, as well as the beauty of the line in the drawing when it isn’t “cleaned up” or “smoothed out” with blending tools. It’s something that’s underappreciated because the popular understanding of drawing is based on creating drawings that have (ironically) less of a “drawn” quality and more of a photographic one, moving as far away as possible from those “ugly lines” created by the stroke… so finding value in hatching takes time and also a shift in the artist’s attitude. It’s curious because many people draw with hatching and don’t even realize it. That’s all for today. Thank you very much for stopping by.

\n\n>
>Los niños suelen detestar las tramas porque no genera, precisamente, ese efecto de difuminado \

que se logra con el difumino o con el dedo. Y el secreto está en aprender a hacer el difuminado con la tramas, dominando la ubicación de esas líneas, puntos o trazos. Cómo ya dije, el efecto es muchísimo más elevado y de calidad, no solo por el esfuerzo implícito en ese trabajo sino porque se aprecia la destreza del dibujante, su carácter y técnica, además de la belleza que tiene el trazo en el dibujo cuando no se intenta \

con los difuminos. Es algo poco apreciado porque el conocimiento popular del dibujo está basado en crear dibujos que tengan (irónicamente), menos de dibujo y más de fotografía, alejándose lo más posible de esas \

que crea el trazo... por lo que encontrar valor en la trama lleva tiempo y también un cambio de actitud del artista. Es curioso porque muchos dibujan con tramas y no se dan cuenta. Hasta aquí el día de hoy. Muchas gracias por pasar.

![IMG_3599.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eou9BAFKwNibcdKghfwmn4QCvLAP4qn4U6JgRPf2NJJdyCqN392QPB4nfbXR13bRtqz.jpeg) ![IMG_3596.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eo6KSWDdviYZ2yCZjm7arQPx9QrLZ1Bjcdrj1VgTRcsixLf6hERcUrq6po2JMomQaYc.jpeg) ![Thank You for stopping by_20251222_235935_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqQRuBXhDFu9VJKoUi9KYBHi1fizexq9zibK9463CkCj7BCiSq9HsujVhAP8Vem6kgg.png)

title.title: Guardian's responsibilities towards students
title.body:
Assalamu Alaikum. Greetings students. How are you. I hope everyone is doing well. I want to talk about the responsibilities of students and guardians on you. 

Basically, the most important thing for a student is the guardian. If a guardian is responsible, then he can do everything in life. For a student, the guardian is a guide. 

After a student becomes an adult, he goes to school. But before going to school, the guardians have some responsibilities. Even after going to school, the guardians have some responsibilities that must be fulfilled by the students. Otherwise, students can never do anything good and cannot be educated in life and enrich themselves. If a student wants to improve himself, then the responsibility of the guardian is a must-do for him. 

Now you can ask here, what responsibilities can a guardian fulfill for a student? 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcaeiPmNkrNu9tqCKxM1G7wx15wSVJoXhb73XquZ1Umw8/pexels-dothanhyb-12294163.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/mother-and-daughter-in-graduation-day-12294163/)


Basically, a guardian has a lot more responsibilities. A guardian will wake up early in the morning to sit down to study than a teacher. Due to the young age of students, they are very lazy and have a habit of sleeping in the morning.  A parent must wake up early in the morning and then he will call his child for his study activities. The student should listen to the parent and sit down to read the book and start all the activities. 

Then the student must arrange for his breakfast along with his study. A parent must prepare a nutritious breakfast for his child in the morning. I think it is very important to have vitamin-rich food in the breakfast. So a parent will prepare a vitamin and nutrient-rich breakfast for his student in the breakfast. After ensuring breakfast, the responsibility of a parent is to send his child to school. The responsibility of the parent does not end until he sends him to school. Rather, the parent has a lot more responsibility in terms of whether his health is good, whether he is able to reach school safely on time and even whether he has taken the school tiffin. If necessary, a parent will go to school and drop his child off and keep him informed about his health. 

The issue of tiffin is very important. A student needs food along with his studies. He must be provided with vitamin and nutrient-rich tiffin. 

There is an important discussion with the teacher about whether the student is studying or not after going to school.  A parent will send his student to school and then keep track of the classroom. A parent's responsibility does not end until he sends him to school. Rather, whether the child is studying well while going to school? How he is behaving with his classmates? How he is behaving with the teachers are among the responsibilities of a parent. So, of course, a parent will take these issues into consideration. 

Basically, the responsibility of the parent for the student is very high. Whether the students are studying and whether their health is good or not, even the overall aspect should definitely be the responsibility of the parent. Basically, a student can never do anything good in life if his parent does not help him. 

We all want our students to do good. So as parents, we definitely have some responsibilities. I have already talked to you about the responsibilities of parents. I hope you will try to fulfill the above responsibilities towards your child. If there are any responsibilities outside, then you have to fulfill them. Because we all want the best for our students. We should ensure that the students study well and that they get higher education. And only the parents can investigate this. 

 Thank you so much for reading today's post. Thank you so much for being part of the education community.

body.title: Impostor 1893 \
Morgan Silver Dollar
body.body:
Sometimes you see something and it's just too good to be true. That was the case with the most recent batch of Sterling scrap I got. It looked decent enough at first glance, but then I noticed something interesting.

When I looked in the bag, it had what looked like a Morgan dollar in it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ8r9p5r4WqbqDftDMUN2vvC6jDXFX55tdhezfoFaphNE/1777348188902.jpg)

The 1893 year piqued my interest, so I opened it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSdxMiUDF6cLsHnvjx6uwv8su1sh4p3XUJrWDb2yDarBT/1777348236457.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcVcB1ceMHvVFmy1dQC3mFm51ithyffsDAQ5cC6CGXrgB/1777348247300.jpg)

Holy cow! An 1893 \

Morgan! For those who don't know, this coin in far worse condition than this go for $200 easily. There are so few left, these are hard to come by. No way someone accidentally included a $200 coin in a lot of scrap.

So, I grabbed my Sigma to test it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdjKnHzDzQ6jZA3mzgsRWEU9CmwL9nnPrvPBTYRnPUf8a/1777348364239.jpg)

It failed the pre-1900 test.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYQTmQgmVZtvzn2hSiHoWBqsESCDNMtZQwPSr53M2U1T9/1777348388055.jpg)

It wasn't even close on the pre-1945 test. I was 99.99% sure by now that it's a fake.

I grabbed my 1921 Morgan dollar and weighed it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmStn3agvCKSRa4ArfvUKcrxGhoUYHqWMZ4jvjicx2xoJT/1777348443672.jpg)

Then I weighed the suspect \

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbKLwZzFkJksLxoHHkWSwfjyLco9h4CYB2yHMoCneMcNo/1777348465875.jpg) Not even close! ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd73CG9hbzSqDL7oCUXbMnMZnunYQGd5xn9AC4ssszqeH/1777348495524.jpg) A real Morgan dollar is 38mm in diamater. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV9DTRR1ycU9skGBbbUC1uw7gpjXDLcnP28pdXvukzwKh/1777348514557.jpg) The fake, not so much. Some of the fakes were still made of 90% silver, so I'm going to take it in to the pawn shop near me. There are a couple of other pieces that are also suspect, so I'm going to ask them to test them with their XRF gun in order to identify the composition. If it's still 90% silver then I'll still come out ahead on the lot. If it's not, you can bet I'm getting a refund. ![1000017156.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulliontools/23uEyyyWCHidcDUBLiCySb4thnoMosshmypAS8GVUkhHC52LCiQqrB6L9Fom29shmtCMN.gif)

title.title: Checking in with the dogs and cats at Wat Nong Chik
title.body:
We don't have the resourced to constantly monitor all the temples in the region so some of them receive less attention from us than others.  Temple generally speaking are a hot spot for dog drop offs and you can count on there always being some work to be done.  While we try to count on the monks to help us out we know that they have their own duties to attend to and can't always count on them to let us know if there are diseases, hunger, or unsterilized animals that have been dropped off.

So we do a check in every now and then and this week it was at Wat Nong Chik

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kbv.animalwelf/23vi86mhMRG7hhLCFmAfKNCk9wyWZ4N4iPR1fcS5wRZx8ayMu1wUMiNzbnoxiDs3d42Gu.png)
</center>

The animals  here don't know us as well as they do at other locations.  Actually, they don’t really know us at all, so we have to be quite careful when we approach them.  Always keep this in mind, readers.   If you do not know a dog you need to be very careful with handling them, even a dog that is wagging its tail could be moments away from getting spooked by something and then biting you out of nowhere.   Mostly I think it is a bad idea to approach stray animals but this is what I do for a living so I know how to do it without getting hurt.  Food always helps, but I do this with chopsticks or with some utensil until the dog or cat starts to understand I am not a threat.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kbv.animalwelf/23wWyP8YK9eoykoiwMHNeq1yPM4oGuLrcaJgkJp4UXWrGbnNbvmhELxF3qcDR1Jh3Va8w.png)
</center>

Cats just in general are easier to lure in with food and these little guys and girls were quite pleased to jump on the back of the truck to get a feed while I slyly checked them for any health issues they might have.   I also checked their ears for the tell-tale signs of whether or not they have been sterilized.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kbv.animalwelf/EoGzns5wB1WhUxS45qW7TfF7d57RPMDPUrv6eaL1bVwGUSXvzKKCgEECYTxcFuFtxYQ.png)
</center>

After a while cats and dogs alike realized that I was there bearing gifts and I think we all had a bond of friendship by the time I left.  I don't plan on them remembering me but we did have some good news from this visit in that there were no new dropoffs outside of one, which already had the marking on the ear indicating that it has been sterilized.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kbv.animalwelf/AKNLwacekJXMUowCQbtRhX96kFy45gKnfGUUfbF1p9k4QxEkxpkB8ZKJ7Jx4sDT.png)
</center>

This is the mark in question by the way and this is the universal marking to indicate that an animal has already been sterilized.   It should be rather evident with males but with the females this marking comes in really handy.  We don't want to unnecessarily perform surgery on them only to find out that it has already been done.  

If for whatever reason the dog that you encounter doesn't have this marking this could be the decision of the owner (previous or current) to not get this marking but the dog is friendly and you are able to view their belly, the female dog will have a slightly raised line about midway up her belly, where the surgery took place however long ago.  

Getting back to the temple though, it was nice to see that the numbers had not blown up in our absence since it has been a good 4-6 months since we last checked in with this place.  Wat Nong Chik is a bit more remote than other temples and therefore isn't much of a hot spot for middle-of-the-night abandonment.

title.title: Asadura guisada 🍛😋
title.body:
> Feliz noche chicos, espero que todos estén muy bien! Hoy tenía pensado compartirles un trabajito manual, pero lo terminé un poco tarde y la luz no colaboró mucho para obtener buenas fotos, así que lo dejaré para mañana y hoy les compartiré una receta que aunque me gusta mucho, no solemos prepararla con frecuencia en casa porque mis hijos no son súper fans y se trata de **asadura guisada con papas y plátano.**
Good evening everyone, I hope you’re all doing well! I’d planned to share a little craft project with you today, but I finished it a bit late and the lighting wasn’t great for taking good photos, so I’ll leave that until tomorrow. Instead, today I’m going to share a recipe that, although I really like it, we don’t usually make very often at home because my children aren’t huge fans: **stewed tripe with potatoes and plantains.**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPXENq9hmK3YAMc8JtRQuxsUZtxuMft2iJ6uyz2rjrWsM/1777349379987.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) La asadura son las vísceras toráxicas del animal, en este caso la res, y son el hígado, corazón y pulmones, pero aquí en los supermercados venden de forma separada tanto el hígado como el corazón, y los pulmones es lo que se conoce como la asadura, pero no estoy segura si se trata solo de los pulmones porque se sienten dos texturas muy diferentes y de hecho de sabores diferentes, pero juntas hacen una gran combinación y como un plus es rica en hierro, vitamina B, zinc y proteína, pero apartando eso, este es un platillo que me trae lindos recuerdos de mi infancia, específicamente de mi papá a quien le gustaba mucho tanto comerla como prepararla, pero sin más vamos con la receta.
Offal refers to the internal organs of the animal, in this case beef, and consists of the liver, heart and lungs; however, here in supermarkets, the liver and heart are sold separately, whilst the lungs are what is known as ‘offal’. I’m not entirely sure if this refers solely to the lungs, as there are two very different textures and, in fact, different flavours, but together they make a great combination and, as an added bonus, they’re rich in iron, vitamin B, zinc and protein. But putting that aside, this is a dish that brings back lovely memories of my childhood, specifically of my dad, who really enjoyed both eating it and preparing it. But without further ado, let’s get on with the recipe.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZypgihHHkU7sorS61WFwCLwaBDbKMEKJ2phVaFV7Bj1f/1777348688291.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) ## Ingredientes 500 grs de asadura 3 papas medianas 1 plátano maduro 1 cebolla pequeña 3 ajíes 3 dientes de ajo 1 ramita de cilantro 1 cucharadita de paprika 2 cucharaditas de orégano 1/4 de cucharadita de pimienta Sal Aceite
## Ingredients 500 g tripe 3 medium potatoes 1 ripe plantain 1 small onion 3 chillies 3 cloves of garlic 1 sprig of coriander 1 teaspoon of paprika 2 teaspoons of oregano 1/4 teaspoon of pepper Salt Oil
## Procedimiento/Procedure Lo primero que haremos será cortar en cubos pequeños la asadura y lavarla muy bien en agua con vinagre por unos 10 minutos aproximadamente para eliminar un poco el olor y el sabor fuerte que suele tener.
The first thing we’ll do is cut the tripe into small cubes and wash it thoroughly in water and vinegar for about 10 minutes to remove some of the strong smell and taste it usually has.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXn5gm6apt9oe2RLxTyCz89j8zW8yc7g2d2YH2Ee1WgbN/1777348688814.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Una vez transcurrieron los 10 minutos eliminamos el agua con vinagre, lavamos y finalmente escurrimos bien para luego agregar los condimentos y llevamos al refrigerador por 30 minutos.
Once the 10 minutes are up, drain off the vinegar water, rinse the vegetables, and drain them thoroughly before adding the seasoning and placing them in the fridge for 30 minutes.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW1sGLUecuCMTciv4U7ohBDgqdSweK2yJQjt7fkxQdmrX/1777348688544.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX911u5tQ7HbKVsZRQhRSHtidRhe28diwJbG5Gpo4BXQr/1777348689130.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Mientras la asadura descansa en el refri vamos a cortar todos los vegetales, y una vez han transcurrido los 30 minutos nos preparamos para cocinar, y para eso agregamos 2 cucharadas de aceite a la sartén agregamos los vegetales y sofreímos por 4 minutos.
While the tripe is chilling in the fridge, let’s chop all the vegetables, and once the 30 minutes are up, we’ll get ready to cook. To do this, add 2 tablespoons of oil to the frying pan, add the vegetables and sauté for 4 minutes.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUVfEiTWzVVCSkc2x62LuHTMbidiejeHDp9cahCsT3kui/1777348689446.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS8GzosebBWBFTXvpEhubF5m64TY5eDAqzMzH8VFvjMqd/1777348830725.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) En este punto agregamos la asadura y la sofreímos por 5 minutos aproximadamente para finalmente agregar tres tazas de agua, sal y un toque más de pimienta, tapamos y dejamos cocinar 20 minutos.
At this point, add the offal and fry it for about 5 minutes, then add three cups of water, salt and a little more pepper, cover the pan and leave to cook for 20 minutes.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbxQbp42QAF5jNcNaXQh9NPhRMkxaGMhvirWCiFSKNF33/1777348831054.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaaok2u3QW7tLkaSeLrnqXhB8aWiG4PTAtYYVsgTyYFJT/1777348831337.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) El siguiente paso es cortar en cubos las papas y transcurridos los 20 minutos las agregamos a la asadura, mezclamos bien, y si sentimos que falta líquido le agregamos un poco más de agua, tapamos y dejamos cocinar hasta que las papas estén suaves, y en ese punto agregamos el plátano cortado en cubos, rectificamos la sal y dejamos cocinar por 10 minutos más. >The next step is to dice the potatoes. After 20 minutes, add them to the offal, mix well, and if it seems a bit dry, add a little more water. Cover and leave to cook until the potatoes are tender. At this point, add the diced plantain, season with salt to taste, and leave to cook for a further 10 minutes. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT32DvGcj5VVxamriDmtWCc2HoRJB9MMmYvdtEf66ayvQ/1777348831604.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXFnVgpaEPLeBEYDYVgJLb5UJy6zBvELFWh4yxepLpRS3/1777348831841.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdrvBGCX3Pp59bu54PMf9FZSVkuof3CuPJfSkti1SriHD/1777348979366.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXiWpAGmfCdbpfcGG14y1K2FtKVJ9YT8YSurZ4iTxMUDs/1777348979601.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWAUdUNb3bNDqSd8gxZYZLjmZYjorwM8mcmNjffKG2g7o/1777348979841.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSbw6DLXsxbRpm8ZN1brmyJZjGjQbu5VxWn3RJWSizFqL/1777348980051.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Una vez lista sirven con el contorno de su elección, en mi casa por ejemplo la mayoría de las veces la acompañamos con arroz y aguacate o arroz y plátano frito. Ustedes con qué la acompañan? >Once ready, serve with a side dish of your choice; at my house, for example, we usually serve it with rice and avocado or rice and fried plantain. What do you serve it with? ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png)

## <center>[Vinnie & Mags Airdrop — Splinterlands Archivist Series](https://hive.blog/splinterlands/@splinterlands/vinnie-and-mags-airdrop-splinterlands-archivist-series)</center>

<center>Initially announced during the **Winterfest**, these cosmetics have gone from being a promise in **gift boxes** to a tangible reality that redefines how our units look on the battlefield. This release is not just a visual addition; it represents the evolution of the characters' visual identity and **stories**.</center>

><center>Anunciados inicialmente durante el **Winterfest**, estos cosméticos han pasado de ser una promesa de **cajas de regalo** a una realidad tangible que redefine cómo lucen nuestras unidades en el campo de batalla. Este lanzamiento no es solo un añadido visual; representa la evolución de la identidad visual e **historias** de los personajes.</center>

### <center>The Origin: From Winterfest to the Archivist Series | El Origen: Del Winterfest a la Serie Archivist</center>

<center>The journey of these Skins began with the **Winterfest Gift Boxes**, an event that generated high expectations for the possibility of obtaining **exclusive items**. However, it wasn't until the recent publication of the **Archivist Series** that we could appreciate the level of detail and artistic concept behind **Vinnie** and **Mags**. These characters are no strangers to those of us who follow the **lore** and the team's updates; seeing them integrated now as applicable skins to specific cards is a brilliant move to connect the narrative of **Praetoria** with daily gameplay.</center>

><center>La travesía de estas Skins comenzó con las **Winterfest Gift Boxes**, un evento que generó una gran expectativa por la posibilidad de obtener **ítems exclusivos**. Sin embargo, no fue hasta la reciente publicación de la **Archivist Series** que pudimos apreciar el nivel de detalle y el concepto artístico detrás de **Vinnie** y **Mags**. Estos personajes no son extraños para quienes seguimos el **lore** y las actualizaciones del equipo; verlos integrados ahora como aspectos aplicables a cartas específicas es un movimiento brillante para conectar la narrativa de **Praetoria** con la jugabilidad diaria.</center>

<center>What makes this launch special is its **exclusivity**. Skins in **Splinterlands** have always been a status symbol, but the **Archivist** series raises the bar with art that respects the essence of the original cards while granting them greater depth. For a collector and **strategist**, owning these versions is a way of **marking territory,**, proving that the account is not only powerful in **statistics**, but also in legacy.</center>

><center>Lo que hace especial a este lanzamiento es su **exclusividad**. Las Skins en **Splinterlands** siempre han sido un símbolo de estatus, pero la serie **Archivist** eleva el listón con un arte que respeta la esencia de las cartas originales mientras les otorga una profundidad mayor. Para un coleccionista y **estratega**, poseer estas versiones es una forma de **marcar territorio,**, demostrando que la cuenta no solo es poderosa en **estadísticas**, sino también en legado.</center>

## <center>SKINS</center>

### <center>**Caravan Guard**</center>

|||
|---|---| 
|https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfAV69cm3FAQx2ZAfjiPcM421Y6ovesmQj1obvA88Waqk/Caravan%20Guard%20-%20Archived.png|https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPKNodFGTtKtLFboUvV4Q5iUHaKsyfPhRMcNHtLVeuRVi/Caravan%20Guard%20-%20Whispered.png|
|**Archived**|**Whispered**|

<center>Very interesting Skins with intriguing stories. My favorite is the **Archived** version for giving more context to their motives, but the **Whispered** is also interesting for showing what happened to them in their **lore**.</center>

><center>Unas Skins muy interesantes con unas historias donde mi favorita es la **Archived** por dar más contexto a sus motivos, pero la **Whispered** también es interesante por su **lore** mostrando qué les ha pasado.</center>

### <center>**Commander Slade**</center>

|||
|---|---| 
|https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcfn5tYmACubCzZJpdEHuiuBPfQq328jCChBM61hg3zyb/Commander%20Slade%20-%20Archived.png|https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQoMzbzmfu9Jf1L9TENG45wmgcAgdxFvZgYwC3ZJE2zsN/Commander%20Slade%20-%20Whispered.png|
|**Archived**|**Whispered**|

<center>Very cool Skins with excellent stories. I loved both for providing context and deepening the story, showing that transformation from a warrior into a **monster**.</center>

><center>Unas Skins muy geniales con historias muy buenas donde ambas me encantaron tanto para darle contexto como profundizar la historia mostrando esa transformación de un guerrero a un **monstruo**.</center>

### <center>**Rila Fen**</center>

|||
|---|---| 
|https://img.leopedia.io/DQmanvWv1nZ4GpunPTBNMrpZTuqdUzUz8Pgvr2W7LV5WZKi/Rila%20Fen%20-%20Archived.png|https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVUP2VDtWtFCP76zEJPvA9TpnaSwATncYmi11eCmPnUXc/Rila%20Fen%20-%20Whispered.png|
|**Archived**|**Whispered**|

<center>One of my favorite reward cards due to its abilities and lore connection to **HANV**. The Skins are striking, especially the **Archived** version, as the **Whispered** version lost a bit of that connection with **Hanv**.</center>

><center>Una de mis tarjetas de recompensas favoritas por sus habilidades y lore con relación a **HANV** y que sus Skins son llamativas, en especial la versión **Archived**, porque la versión **Whispered** perdió un poco esa conexión con **Hanv**.</center>

### <center>**Jicarilla the Rime**</center>

|||
|---|---| 
|https://img.leopedia.io/DQmR4GVn7mCoYKhCiED8nKnworBwi6jAppPuzhnqf9HtoRC/Jicarilla%20the%20Rime%20-%20Archived.png|https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYoNaYRfdRB5RankdTw3PdMAFL8P8CDY142uMoo8TF5Cn/Jicarilla%20the%20Rime%20-%20Whispered.png|
|**Archived**|**Whispered**|

<center>Sincerely, the card and skins that catch my attention the least because they don't develop the lore much, although their skins have a very **anime** look that gives them a striking touch.</center>

><center>Sinceramente la tarjeta y skins que menos me llaman la atención porque no desarrolla tanto el lore, aunque sus Skins tienen una aspecto muy **anime** que le da un toque llamativo.</center>

### <center>**Doctor Blight**</center>

|||
|---|---| 
|https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQsTbadWHnAGo68ywtZ5iPnYimDDgQCsLQLAHTHEUoJnF/Doctor%20Blight%20-%20Archived.png|https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPNEPi5zrLg8LFZLrpvoHRT6eUYaD1DDSwih9SG8xBz2G/Doctor%20Blight%20-%20Whispered.png|
|**Archived**|**Whispered**|

<center>The card that brought one of the most interesting Skins by showing the face of a mysterious **lore** character. Its **Archived** version doesn't show a cool appearance, but rather a **crazy obsessed** man who shows a lot of confidence but is very stubborn.</center>

><center>La tarjeta que trajo una de las Skins más interesantes al mostrar el rostro de un personaje bastante misterioso del **lore** con su versión **Archived**, no con una apariencia genial sino como un **loco obsesionado** que muestra mucha confianza pero es muy necio.</center>

### <center>Conclusion</center>

<center>Today will be an exciting day for all of us who enjoy the **visual part** of **Splinterlands**. These Skins are the perfect prize to close a season of great effort, and it will be fun to face players using these **Skins**. Furthermore, with their arrival, the possibility opens up to see the appearance and stories of various cards that could be interesting, whether recent or older ones, like **Skok Duskblight** before his transformation or versions of early sets joining the **Chaos Legion**, the **Conclave Arcana** or other events within **Splinterlands**.</center>

><center>Hoy será un día emocionante para todos los que disfrutamos de la **parte visual** de **Splinterlands**. Estas Skins son el premio perfecto para cerrar una temporada de mucho esfuerzo y será divertido enfrentar a jugadores con estas **Skins**. Además, con la llegada de estas se abre la posibilidad de ver la apariencia e historias de varias tarjetas que pueden ser interesantes, tanto tarjetas recientes como más antiguas como con **Skok Duskblight** al que me gustaría ver antes de su transformación tentaculosa o tarjetas de los primeros conjuntos y sus versiones de haberse unido a **Chaos Legion**, al **Conclave Arcana** o de otros eventos dentro de **Splinterlands**.</center>

#### <center>Which of the two is your favorite? I'll read your thoughts in the comments!</center>
