title.body: > [Esp] ¡Saludos comunidad! Hoy encontré unos contratiempos que me gustaría mejorar, los marcadores son geniales, pero tienen la punta muy gruesa, quizá si el trazo fuera más delgado el acabado fuera más delicado y prolijo. El nivel de dificultad hoy fue bastante para mí y no entendí, quizá muchos factores influyen, lo bueno de todo es que sirve la práctica y podemos ir mejorando al detectar los fallos. Estos últimos días han sido algo rudos por aquí, comienza la semana y con altos deseos que todo mejore inyectando buena vibra, así que: mis mejores deseos de que esta semana sea estupenda para todos y muchas bendiciones. Adicional a eso, grabé todo mi proceso en vídeo, por si gustas ver.

> [Eng] Hello everyone! Today I ran into a few snags that I’d like to sort out. The markers are great, but the tip is quite thick; perhaps if the line were finer, the finish would be more delicate and neat. Today’s level of difficulty was a bit much for me and I didn’t quite get it – maybe there are lots of factors at play. The good thing is that practice helps, and we can keep improving by spotting our mistakes. The last few days have been a bit rough round here. The week is starting, and I’m really hoping things will improve by spreading some good vibes, so: my best wishes for a fantastic week for everyone, and many blessings. On top of that, I recorded the whole process on video, in case you’d like to watch it. ---

|||| |-|-|-| ![Snapshot_17.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23tSayJsovwgx1VzEkdxSEe9Fn4fKfY3o8FMyeen8ctBhfjr59R3VEW75XEq9KZb647C9.JPG)|![Snapshot_18.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23xp8m3cfXQAJEuVFxypnSTk37bXnrYTjiuCfLEjrcA24DhKceh5M4GWo5EmCde3yc3x3.JPG)|![Snapshot_19.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23yJLmEFvdyCeWy3bMzEJ8S49hhZ6ibohY51nD1SENJgbuzNPhNQn6sxv6Ugf6ShdrS1v.JPG)

> [Esp] Empecé mi proceso creativo en una hoja en blanco, para saber cómo iba a distribuir las flores en la letra, este termina siento entonces nuestro boceto, recomiendo eso para agilizar el proceso y la inspiración. Luego cubro la letra con la cinta washi, es un paliativo mientras compro la cinta adecuada, esta cinta no se pega tan fuerte como la que usé anteriormente, para evitar desprendimiento de la cartulina. Luego marqué los bordes con marcador blanco.

> [Eng] I began my creative process on a blank sheet of paper to work out how I was going to arrange the flowers on the letter; this then became our sketch. I recommend doing this to speed up the process and spark inspiration. I then covered the letter with washi tape; this is a stopgap measure whilst I buy the right tape. This tape doesn’t stick as firmly as the one I used previously, to prevent the card from peeling away. I then outlined the edges with a white marker.
---
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg?token=7e431c7db164fa4bff1436ce826f5301151c488c57a5dd67 |||| |-|-|-| ![Snapshot_20.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23xejtdCQ17QErLJEsmUmNFwfSsTqeYMaXpVY6y3bLUtXsXHk5tzprEE7SNaeEu4hjVpm.JPG)|![Snapshot_21.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23wqnwyuMhsMv3pnFiQ91VPqccqC1piKLsCEZt9fMR8tdGkp8oqJFyeANGnzTNoVWiiXS.JPG)|![Snapshot_22.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23xek6fhdWFvmURmCnxKs5nJUya7RWNHyQDd817dGDZ9PF3iLw3R8qcfXHJsh3XaPzT6q.JPG)

> [Esp] Nada fácil tratar que no se vean vetas o disparidad de trazo al pintar, pero se hace en varias capas de pintura. Cada una dejando secar. Luego hice un lineart con marcador negro. Apliqué unos sombreados y puntos de luz.

> [Eng] It’s not easy to ensure that brushstrokes or variations in line thickness aren’t visible when painting, but this is achieved by applying several layers of paint, allowing each one to dry in between. I then drew the line art using a black marker. I added some shading and highlights. ---
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg?token=7e431c7db164fa4bff1436ce826f5301151c488c57a5dd67 |||| |-|-|-| ![Snapshot_23.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23xVMWZQJEPVYQACHJM34a2b6Cspbd3fWvWR3fa9XDmDaCMiQhWXzVEYVt8DinQEUUSCR.JPG)|![Snapshot_24.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23wgQ8RV8KiwwENU93ebGTBk47roEot99hgEnibfieN3ppmMhDwgzRshcygRGomZscfZ9.JPG)|![Snapshot_25.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23wWyUS6AhmBBwFWbebT4KBEbniFKEHXMe9KApdYsAesHSHfF98v4MjibQpM61V7oZzM8.JPG)

> [Esp] Siguiendo el boceto continúo con el proceso de pintura. Estos marcadores son tal cual como pintar con pinceles, solo que tiene la punta muy gruesa. Trato que el line art de cada sección sea un tono más oscuro. Otra cosa que debemos tener en cuenta es, la pintura del marcador al secarse revela otro tono, a veces más claro, a veces más oscuro. Casi siempre uso elementos simbólicos en mis creaciones, hoy integré una mariposa, por su simbolismo de transformación, es un arquetipo que me va muy bien en estos momentos de cambios personales.

> [Eng] Following the sketch, I continue with the painting process. These markers are just like painting with brushes, except that they have a very thick tip. I try to make the line art in each section a shade darker. Another thing to bear in mind is that, as the marker paint dries, it reveals a different shade – sometimes lighter, sometimes darker. I almost always use symbolic elements in my creations; today I included a butterfly, because of its symbolism of transformation; it’s an archetype that suits me very well at this time of personal change. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1WoriLEgtUuXtiuPFvDSbme6bzm4pnHvzeSUG7iJHaUhrSJVUcrX55dWB69ueUGs13.png) |||| |-|-|-| ![Snapshot_26.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23wgPzkFAmUFqTshGrZ5LrJwQQYASjARZkZhc2SZvMeNuM6ubxCTQYjC71d1t8KqCs71A.JPG)|![Snapshot_27.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23ywpnGWH6h8Kwx5qnqdngqocLUYtCA72nqX4rnt1c1UuWYSEvJrSnCMQHvNikE6bMYkj.JPG)|![Snapshot_28.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23zkpGyE6LKe45KDef5teVUeoDV1qfwr1YfpYEeGfWeHv81SvHmiNuf9ZsvpGPaQHXs9C.JPG)

> [Esp] Creo que la parte más satisfactoria es, luego de terminar y esperar que todo seque bien, desprender la cinta washi para que revele la letra, eso lo hice con una pinza de bisutería. Por mucho cuidado que tuve, hubo desprendimiento de papel y algunas pinturas se corrieron, pero el marcador negro nos salva el trabajo. Espero les guste.

> [Eng] I think the most satisfying part is, once you’ve finished and waited for everything to dry properly, peeling off the washi tape to reveal the lettering – I did this using a pair of jewellery tweezers. No matter how careful I was, some of the paper came away and a bit of the paint smudged, but the black marker saved the day. I hope you like it.
---

title.title: ZenoDEX: Tau Net exclusive
title.body:
ZenoDEX is in development, as of April 27 2026. It's one of the most advanced and most secure decentralized exchanges, and in this post you're going to find out how it works, from the inventor. In this post I will explain the design philosophy, the architecture, the math, and why it's revolutionary compared to how a DEX is usually built.

**Why is it called ZenoDEX?**

ZenoDEX is named after Zeno, an ancient Greek philosophy and mathematician. In fact Zeno is one of the earliest mathematicians in history. Zeno, like Cantor, asked questions about infinity, and in one of his thought experiments, he invented Zeno's paradox. This is significant, because one of the core aspects of DeFi is the concept of the \

. We may ask the question, in a hyper deflationary economic scenario, wouldn't the tokens eventually run out? The answer is, no, the tokens never run out, because you can do effectively infinite sub divisions. Let's zoom in on that?

Zeno’s story is the old puzzle of infinite subdivision. The story goes something like this...

To walk across a room, first a person must cross half the room. Before finishing the second half, they must cross half of what remains. Then half again, then half again: 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/8 + 1/16 + ... There are infinitely many stages, so Zeno asks: how can motion ever finish? That's the paradox. 

Why is this significant in the context of Tau Language? Tau Language has atomless boolean algebra. Like Zeno's paradox, like ZenoDEX, the boolean algebra that is atomless, can be split an infinite amount of times. To help this make sense, I'll zoom into the math.

In a Boolean algebra, an atom is a nonzero piece that cannot be split any further:

Ex. atom(a) := a ≠ 0 and there is no b with 0 < b < a

An atomless Boolean algebra has no such indivisible pieces:

Ex. atomless := for every a ≠ 0, there exists b with 0 < b < a

So you can see this same mathematical shape, Zeno's paradox, and in atomless boolean algebra which makes up Tau Language. We also see this same shape in ZenoDEX, where token supply can be subdivided into smaller and smaller burnable pieces, while a floor prevents the process from destroying the token. This allows for buy and burn to be safe mathematically.

**ZenoDEX is correct by construction and math first

**ZenoDEX is correct by construction, which means the math was worked on prior to the code. In fact, for ZenoDEX, custom formal tools and entirely new formal methods were invented to create it. ZenoDEX has a functional core, an imperative shell. The core, are formally verified components, which we can mathematically prove have correct behavior. The imperative shell, which includes input/output, the cryptography, and other aspects which cannot be formally verified, are thoroughly tested. While we cannot mathematically guarantee the behavior of some of these components, what we can do is approximate the behavior through rigorous testing.

For those interested, this includes unit tests, integration tests, fuzzing, and more. While I won't go into too much detail, I can say that branch coverage is over 90%, behavior is tested. And now many will wonder, even if behavior is tested, how do we know the algorithms are safe? The algorithms were created in Lean, using state of the art methods. 

**ZenoDEX algorithms**

Some of the algorithms of ZenoDEX I'll share, and I'll give both the plain English and in formal math:

Canonical Route

K(r) := (inputTotal(r), legCount(r), legsLex(r))

r\* ∈ C ∧ ∀ r ∈ C, K(r\*) ≤lex K(r)

Plain English: among all candidate routes C, the winner r\* is the lexicographic minimum. The lexicographical minimum is the string or sequence that appears earliest in dictionary order when compared to all possible variations (rotations, rearrangements, or transformations) of an original input.

Guarded Quote

guardOk = true ⇔ runtimeChoice = canonicalWinner

Equivalent:

quote = some(runtimeChoice) ⇔ runtimeChoice ∈ C ∧ ∀ x ∈ C, runtimeChoice ≤key x


Plain English: a quote is emitted exactly when the runtime choice is the canonical minimum. Note that exactly when can also be read as if and only if.

Canonical winner Lean formula
∃! k, k ∈ S ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, k ≤ x

 The canonical winner formula is:

  r\* ∈ C ∧ ∀ r ∈ C, K(r\*) ≤lex K(r)

  where:

  K(r) := (inputTotal(r), legCount(r), legsLex(r))

  So expanded:

  r\* ∈ C ∧ ∀ r ∈ C,

(inputTotal(r\*) < inputTotal(r)) ∨ (inputTotal(r\*) = inputTotal(r) ∧ legCount(r\*) < legCount(r)) ∨ (inputTotal(r\*) = inputTotal(r) ∧ legCount(r\*) = legCount(r) ∧ legsLex(r\*) ≤ legsLex(r))

Plain English: there exists exactly one candidate w such that w is in the candidate set and w is key-less-than-or-equal to every candidate in the set.


To see more of the math you can look at this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TV4npEC151U


Each proof in ZenoDEX was reviewed and curated. The original proofs were good, but were of lower quality. After review, according to criteria, I refined the proofs. The proofs are ranked by tiers. S tier is the highest tier. It's not enough to just have proofs that check, as the original proofs passed the Lean checks, but more about which proof is better between two viable proofs. For example a proof which is by exhaustion, is correct, but may not be as elegant or reusable as another kind of proof, as to prove by exhaustion requires  total enumeration of all possible states. 

**Conclusion and summary**

The overall point, the ZenoDEX will hopefully be the first DEX on Tau Net. The math guarantees the behavior is correct by construction under certain assumptions. For example that the compiler isn't bugged. Under standard assumptions, ZenoDEX in the critical areas, is correct by construction. The proofs can be replayed, so it's easy to audit using proof carrying certificates. The questions I can't predict, will Tau Net have the ability to support app tokens? If the answer is yes, then ZenoDEX is buildable.

ZenoDEX is a hybrid language technology. The critical parts which could be built in Tau Language, are Tau Language specifications. These are executable specifications. The parts which deal with complex math, are in Python. Tau Language cannot handle complex math due to the limits of CVC5.  Because of the problem of state explosion and intractability, there has to be a compositional design for the Tau specifications, and for anyone who knows how functional programming works, or railway oriented programming, you can chain together  Tau specifications, using decomposition to avoid the state explosion problems which come from a big specification with complex formulas.

This decomposition tactic is also used to keep the formal core components small. Small components can be formally verified without being intractable or having state explosion problems. These are micro kernels. In the future I will post more about this, but for now, you can look at Github:  https://github.com/TheDarkLightX/ZenoDEX

title.title: A Vegan Pound Cake with Banana — but Surprisingly Not “Banana-y” / 意外とバナナっぽくないヴィーガンパウンド
title.body:
In vegan baking, bananas are often used as a substitute for eggs. I absolutely love the banana bread from *[A NEW WAY TO BAKE](https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/122403654-a-new-way-to-bake)* — I’ve baked it so many times over the past year that I’ve lost count. 

The recipe is incredibly simple: bananas, oil, sugar, flour, and baking powder. That’s it. You can add nuts or anything you like. And yet, the result looks and tastes so good that you might wonder, “Wait, no eggs, no milk, no butter?” 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23uQnHkj92yJ2QXMjAQQsBYwnctob7N1yvRsuZ35cSmxsJBww1xRAwmm3i3WS2nwB33GM.png)

This banana cake from *[A NEW WAY TO BAKE](https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/122403654-a-new-way-to-bake)* has become a staple in our home.

There’s also a video by the author explaining the process, so if you’re interested, it’s definitely worth watching. Not whole the recipe is revealed but the you'll see the overview and the tip for getting that beautiful crack on top is especially useful — I’ve been able to get it almost perfectly every time thanks to the technique. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l6UmwOw3to0

There was one thing I had been curious about for a while when it comes to vegan baking and bananas. How much does something actually taste like banana when I use bananas in recipes other than banana bread?

One day I saw someone on Instagram making a matcha pound cake using banana. That inspired me to finally give it a try. I adapted the banana bread recipe, using slightly less banana and adding matcha.

And to my surprise — it worked great! Maybe the slight bitterness of matcha balances out the banana flavor? It turned out so well that it was received well a local plant market. 

![Vegan matcha cake with candied beans and cherries (with banana 😉)](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23vsZ9LxiKDp4KEtg7gY8KvrgoS7G3kADn17AyEntuiDgBMEk8ZCJdbfaEuMGjGHgJ5Sa.png)

Once I got started, I couldn’t stop experimenting. Chocolate and banana go very well together, and it also worked nicely in the chocolate pound cake with cherries and walnuts.


![434227C3-2F43-422B-ABB9-EDEFEDFC79E7_1_102_o.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EonmTyShN7wE8RiHS7zuUddfU6HPeKiaZppajbBZb6TgpqjbdvY4pefNvHGVmqsagVU.jpeg)


In Germany, the combination of banana and cherry is known as “Kiba” (Kirsch + Banana), and you sometimes see it at ice cream shops. My partner says it’s been around since his childhood — a true long-time favorite. No wonder it works so well in a pound cake too. 

It seems to pair especially well with slightly bitter or bold flavors like matcha or chocolate.

If you add too much banana, the flavor will become more noticeable, so it might be a good idea to start with about one and a half bananas for a 25 cm loaf tin and adjust from there.

I’m also curious how it would work with lemon — a classic summer flavor with sourness…
My imagination keeps going, and I’d love to keep experimenting with different combinations. 

Happy vegan baking 🧑‍🍳

---

昨天公司组织了集体聚餐，起因是光谷分公司的所有同事，全都搬迁到总部办公，两边人员正式合并。
 
这次聚餐一方面是为了欢迎新来的同事，增进彼此熟悉度，另一方面也安排了几位上级领导现场讲话发言，简单做一下交流。
 
聚餐地点定在万达，公司提前订好了好几个包间，整体安排得很周到。比较有意思的是，我们公司每次集体聚餐，老板都会准备一摞福利刮刮乐彩票。
 
彩票靠个人手气兑换运气，每个人可以自选一两张试试手气。昨天不少同事都刮中了几十块的小奖金，只有我一如既往手气平平，一张都没有中奖。
 
席间还有位性格超级开朗外向的同事特别搞笑，全程自带搞笑人设。他故意大喊自己中了五千块，引得大家全都围过去看热闹，结果只是中了五十块，逗得全场大笑。整场饭局氛围特别轻松，大家说说笑笑，热热闹闹持续了两个多小时。
 
领导的发言也十分接地气，简单聊了几句就宣布正式开餐。大家边吃边聊天放松心情，下午上班时间也顺势往后推迟，差不多快三点才正式开始工作。

还听到小道消息，五一之后公司可能会压缩工作时长，缩短半小时到一小时左右，不过暂时还没有正式通知，一切以官宣为准。就算工作时间缩短，该完成的工作任务也不会减少，对我们日常工作的影响其实并不大。

So What is The Prominent Author of The Week About?
--- > The aim of the Prominent Author of the Week is to reward five great contents of authors shared from our weekly prompts in the community. This way, we get to encourage authors to be more active and try to be the best they can be in their content creation. ![Copy_of_Rules__Guidlines_20240104_043746_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prayzz/23w2qUuQTxiBdznKW16rFJz258PSWssihzrjjBdFC965Fufjco91vhvbmnHbPjhzZtpm5.png) ---

title.title: 4 dấu hiệu có bầu sau quan hệ mà chị em cần biết
title.body:
Dấu hiệu có bầu sau quan hệ là điều nhiều chị em quan tâm, đặc biệt khi quan hệ không sử dụng biện pháp tránh thai hoặc đang mong con. Nhận biết sớm các biểu hiện mang thai giúp phụ nữ chủ động chăm sóc sức khỏe, điều chỉnh lối sống và thăm khám đúng thời điểm để đảm bảo an toàn cho cả mẹ và thai nhi.

▶️▶️▶️ Tham khảo thêm:

<https://afamily.vn/nhan-biet-som-dau-hieu-thu-thai-thanh-cong-sau-quan-he-chuyen-gia-phenikaamec-giai-dap-23625123122525582.chn>

<https://www.deviantart.com/sonyasaran/journal/Dau-hieu-thu-thai-sau-quan-he-bao-lau-co-1326769725>

\-


## **Trễ kinh **

Trong số các dấu hiệu có bầu sau quan hệ, trễ kinh là biểu hiện phổ biến và dễ nhận biết nhất. Khi trứng được thụ tinh và làm tổ thành công, hormone hCG tăng lên, ức chế quá trình bong niêm mạc tử cung – từ đó khiến chu kỳ kinh nguyệt tạm ngừng. Nếu bạn trễ kinh từ 3–7 ngày so với chu kỳ bình thường, nên thử thai để kiểm tra. Tuy nhiên, cần lưu ý rằng căng thẳng, rối loạn nội tiết hoặc thay đổi sinh hoạt cũng có thể gây chậm kinh.

## **Ra máu báo thai**

Ra máu báo thai là một trong những dấu hiệu có bầu sau quan hệ xuất hiện khá sớm, thường sau 6–10 ngày kể từ khi thụ tinh. Đây là hiện tượng xảy ra khi phôi thai bám vào niêm mạc tử cung. Đặc điểm của máu báo thai thường có lượng rất ít, chỉ vài giọt, có màu hồng nhạt hoặc nâu sẫm và thường kéo dài 1–2 ngày rồi tự hết.

## **Căng tức ngực và thay đổi quầng vú**

Sự thay đổi nội tiết tố trong giai đoạn đầu thai kỳ khiến vùng ngực trở nên căng tức, nhạy cảm hơn. Quầng vú có thể sậm màu và nổi rõ hơn. Đây là dấu hiệu có bầu sau quan hệ khá thường gặp, nhưng cũng dễ nhầm lẫn với triệu chứng tiền kinh nguyệt. Nếu cảm giác căng tức kéo dài kèm trễ kinh, khả năng mang thai cao hơn.

## **Buồn nôn, mệt mỏi, nhạy cảm với mùi**

Buồn nôn – đặc biệt vào buổi sáng – là biểu hiện đặc trưng của thai kỳ. Ngoài ra, nhiều phụ nữ cảm thấy mệt mỏi, dễ buồn ngủ hoặc nhạy cảm với mùi thức ăn, nước hoa. Những thay đổi này liên quan đến sự gia tăng hormone hCG và progesterone trong cơ thể. Tuy nhiên, không phải tất cả phụ nữ mang thai đều gặp triệu chứng ốm nghén sớm.

## **Kết luận**

Dấu hiệu có bầu sau quan hệ có thể bao gồm trễ kinh, máu báo thai, căng tức ngực, buồn nôn và đi tiểu nhiều. Tuy nhiên, các biểu hiện này khác nhau ở mỗi người và dễ nhầm lẫn với rối loạn nội tiết thông thường. Để xác định chính xác, chị em nên thử thai đúng thời điểm và thăm khám chuyên khoa khi cần thiết. Chủ động theo dõi cơ thể là bước quan trọng để bảo vệ sức khỏe sinh sản và chuẩn bị cho hành trình làm mẹ an toàn.

title.title: You could have stayed
title.body: It was obvious from the beginning that she could leave me at any point. I had made that clear, I am the temporary, you are the permanent. Visually, you were never there. We moved past ten years of our life. When I slipped in front of many, you gave me your hand. Despite all the chants of she loves him, look, she loves him. Not for a single moment did she look back. Her eyes bigger than usual, still the same, however, I cannot recall them fully. For her, my **_first impression_** was struggling in the dirt, weary of the eyes. All those years, I never figured out what it was, love or just familiarity.

/>

Photo by [Dilan NaGi](https://unsplash.com/@dilannagi?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=creditCopyText) on [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/silhouette-of-woman-hugging-mna-under-starry-night-sky-Vb1sJ4vc__I?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=creditCopyText)

At night, when she told me years back that she cannot hide it, the colleague in her office she cannot resist talking to. Emotional, she feels like cheating. I stood there. It doesn't matter to me. Or does it? Could I have resisted, or begged her to stay?  
  
She has never been that. Confined. Free flowing. I liked that about her. Although now, reminiscing, I feel like I loved her the most. I do not know how to feel; sad that she left me, or privileged that she was the only one. From that day still, I have never found someone I could tell everything to. I think of the day that I slipped. If not for her, would I have ever known love?  
I am still mad at you. You could have stayed.  
  

[27 April 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3086: first impression](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/27-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3086-first-impression)

title.title: Preparando mini sándwiches de pollo | #FoodieMood | Esp-Eng
title.body:
![1000513779.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wCJA5dNvUUFXf1UhtPHv4kQ1PKzvpN7gcVizfmKSiUgwzPFYcLvXwEyUkpWQvyTGDgc.jpg)
Yo que trato de alejarme de los carbohidratos y entonces le traen pan blanco a mi mamá; así no es fácil cumplir la meta, pero bueno, ya veremos. Yo debía salir el fin de semana y quise dejar preparados unos pequeños sándwiches de pollo para que mi mamá tuviera algo rico que comer. Cada sándwich lo dividí en cuatro pedazos cuadrados. > I’m trying to cut back on carbs, but then they bring my mom white bread; it’s not easy to stick to my goal that way, but oh well, we’ll see. > I had to go out over the weekend, so I wanted to make some small chicken sandwiches for my mom to have something tasty to eat. I cut each sandwich into four square pieces. ![1000513736.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23ydBzAPfKhVrgC57CmVnZtxqtxd2twJgJu2DAm1jKR3SLzVaDocVPYv5eezRJvCpJCeH.jpg) ![1000513755.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wgSTU9YodrWfNfL7L5oWtHoPNMbRcmGhuJbnHSUjCS9Nzprvd35szYw58t8Fue955BZ.jpg) Fui bastante fuerte para aguantar la tentación de comerlos todos; solo probé algunos, no me juzguen (lol). Nunca antes había hecho estos pancitos quitando los bordes del pan y la verdad que resultan excelentes, muy suaves y delicados. Esta idea vino a mi mente porque en días pasados fui a un baby shower y uno de los canapés que ofrecieron fueron sándwiches de este estilo. Yo les puse más relleno que el que usualmente llevan y me gustó bastante el resultado. >I was strong enough to resist the temptation to eat them all; I only tried a few—don’t judge me (lol). >I’d never made these little rolls by cutting off the crusts before, and honestly, they turned out great—really soft and delicate. >I got this idea because I went to a baby shower a few days ago, and one of the canapés they served was this kind of sandwich. I put more filling in them than they usually have, and I really liked the result. ![1000513756.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23u69Qri5fxPtugaytH42XvL3zMhXJJQKaMEtr38cGfHk6u5EYBMD53eax81Uq396s9sa.jpg) ![1000513780.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wqq7pQK4Wq3kcP9kfGsYCsNN8Y71UwhxHjmift2GCC4LzP34QyFEg7QT3JfPS18AWUS.jpg) Evite usar mayonesa o alguna salsa industrial para no añadir calorías extra. Para prepararlos empecé sancochando media pechuga de pollo, luego la desmeché. También sancoché tres huevos. Los huevos los corté en trozos muy pequeños y los añadí al pollo desmechado. También agregué cebolla y pimentón verde cortado en trozos muy pequeños. Le coloqué un toque de paprika para sumar sabor ahumado y color. Le suma un poco de caldo de la cocción de la pechuga ya que esto aumenta el sabor y permite unificar los ingredientes. Agregué sal al gusto. >Avoid using mayonnaise or any store-bought sauce to keep extra calories to a minimum. To prepare this dish, I started by poaching half a chicken breast, then shredded it. I also poached three eggs. >I chopped the eggs into very small pieces and added them to the shredded chicken. I also added onion and green bell pepper, both chopped into very small pieces. I sprinkled in a pinch of paprika to add a smoky flavor and color. >Add a little of the broth from cooking the chicken breast, as this enhances the flavor and helps bind the ingredients together. Add salt to taste. ![1000513757.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23zkvnnmj9xw8StuschQ9FsWZ3JYQ3UbCL47UNWyvHGQNWLiFkR35pe6SBVeEg2EQawrD.jpg) Una vez que está hecho el relleno, paso a colocarlo en la rodaja de pan, cubro con otra rodaja de pan y retiro los bordes. Estos hermosos y deliciosos sándwiches saben mucho mejor cuando los dejas reposar; el relleno se adhiere mejor a las lonchas de pan de sándwich. *Los encuentro estupendos para una reunión entre amigos; no ocupan mucho tiempo de preparación y puedes variar el relleno de acuerdo a tus ingredientes favoritos.* >Once the filling is ready, I spread it on a slice of bread, top it with another slice of bread, and trim off the edges. >These beautiful and delicious sandwiches taste much better when you let them sit; the filling sticks better to the slices of sandwich bread. >*I think they’re great for a get-together with friends; they don’t take long to prepare, and you can vary the filling according to your favorite ingredients.* ![1000513776.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23uQyCH3B9qNhA3psCFzWrAiugcDUtdhfxTfTDhFyYWh88e3LEd8edhaZbohWD82WVqA8.jpg)
**I hope you like it!**

Mykonos in Margarita: The Best-Kept Secret for a Leisurely Dessert

If there’s one thing I’ve learned from living on the island, it’s that timing is everything. There’s a little haven of flavor called Mykonos, an ice cream shop that transports you straight to the Greek Cyclades without ever leaving the Caribbean, and today I want to tell you why it’s become my must-visit spot.

The Pleasure of a Perfect Cone
I’m not lying: the cones here are on another level. They have that crunchy texture and artisanal flavor that makes you close your eyes at the first bite. Whether you go for the classic creamy flavors or something more refreshing, the quality is consistent. It’s the kind of ice cream that not only cools you down in the Margarita heat but also brightens your afternoon.

The “Golden Hour” of relaxation: Why go at 3:00 PM?
Here’s my best tip: go at 3:00 PM. At that time, while most people are still finishing lunch or taking a break from the intense sun, the ice cream shop is an oasis of peace. You can pick your favorite table, take amazing photos without people in the background, and enjoy the silence. Starting at 5:00 PM, the place transforms; people arrive in search of their sweet treat, and the atmosphere gets super lively. But if you’re looking for a zen experience and ultra-personalized service, 3:00 PM is the key.

Bring your best friend! (Yes, they’re pet-friendly)
One of the things I love most is that I don’t have to leave anyone at home. Mykonos is totally pet-friendly, so you can take a stroll with your furry friend and enjoy your ice cream while they also relax in a pleasant atmosphere. Seeing dogs welcomed always adds a thousand points to any place.

If you’re on the island and looking for a little slice of Greece with the best ice cream cones in the area, you know where and when to show up.

title.title: The Philosophy of \
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbi4nk2rTh3WQgwUzExN9hecKj1wDD8mUp8SprzSibQNZ/Gemini_Generated_Image_2m9z6i2m9z6i2m9z.png 

image generated using Gemini AI

It is usually a joy for me whenever I have the opportunity to lend a helping hand to another person in genuine need who cannot provide for themselves. I see it as part of the purpose for which I exist on earth. People say it is wrong for a person to go out of their way to help others, but my philosophy has never been of that kind. I have people who go out of their way to support me. Why should I be different when another person requires my help? After all, I have come to learn from the Bible to do unto others what I would want others to do unto me, so I give and help, even if it means going out of my way.

My neighbour will always advise me not to be too generous with my limited resources. He will say that he understands how I am still struggling to make ends meet, and as such, I should set boundaries with how I give to others, but the question I always ask myself is what will Jesus do if he were in my situation, and why should I have for tomorrow when the other person has nothing for today?

Charity is a voluntary act of providing for the needy. This entails providing things like money, food, clothes, or even one's time to others who need them. When a person provides services to another person for free, which was intended to be an exchange for money, the act can be described as charitable.

We indulge in charity every day, helping our neighbour to hold their baby when they are busy or engaged in something and are unable to find time for their baby, offering help to take our neighbours children to school or serving as a representative for the parent in schools and other social gathering, going our neighbours and people around us items like food, clothing or any item they might need.

Being charitable is not about having too much; being charitable is about showing love to the next person close to you, it is about going out of your way to see that the next person is okay, and it is about making yourself and your resources present to the neighbour who requires it. When we only decide to give when we have it in mind, it has already defeated the essence of charity.

I love being charitable. I only get angry whenever I don’t have to meet the next person close to me, I don’t give only when it is convenient for me, I give because I believe in giving. After all, I believe that I am casting my bread on the waters expecting it to come back after many days. In the end, it only shows how much you love humanity.

title.body: I have a fondness for racing games that aren't super complicated.  If you read my writing you know that I am not a fan at all of games that involve all the buttons on the controller because I am not a teenager and I have to do other things in my day such as work, socialize, and clean up around the house.  Oh and I have to sleep every now and then as well.  So if a game involves a buttload of buttons, let alone buttons that change depending on the situation, I am going to forget these controls and therefore am not going to enjoy the game.\n\nIn Hot Wheels Unleashed 2, there are only a handful of buttons to remember and this makes the game appeal to me.   What doesn't appeal to me is something that was done just for PS-Plus customers (perhaps other bundles as well) and while it is meant to be a \

it kind of ruins the game.

<center> https://image.api.playstation.com/vulcan/ap/rnd/202305/1610/a63668c38fbe4c31f62d77a2863300dcf26c3e50576d75e2.png
[src](https://image.api.playstation.com/vulcan/ap/rnd/202305/1610/a63668c38fbe4c31f62d77a2863300dcf26c3e50576d75e2.png)</center>

The idea behind this game is that you go and do some neat tracks and eventually build up your garage of cars, bikes, and monster trucks that all have their own particular strengths and weaknesses depending on the terrain in question.   The goal behind completion of any track is simply to complete the track, get a reward for having done so, and then purchasing additional cars that make those runs even faster.

Much like in Need for Speed or really any other game that starts you out with a basic car, the desire to continue playing is driven by you wanting to get more upgraded cars so that future tracks can be done faster and easier.

<center> https://i.psnprofiles.com/guides/17866/5854fa.jpg
[src](https://i.psnprofiles.com/guides/17866/5854fa.jpg)</center>

By simply firing the game up you are gifted this car called the \

before you even do your first race.  When you compare the stats on this car to the other basic ones in your garage that the people who bought the retail version of this game had as their only choices, it is significantly better.  

It is NOT the best car in the game but it is much better than any of your other options at the start of the game.  Of course you could always choose to not use it and I honestly wish I had just deleted it or sold if (if that is even an option) because once you have seen the top end of performance in this game, it is kind of tough to return to the basic models that are in there specifically to introduce you to a slower version of the game and gradually work you up towards faster and faster cars.

But in the \

version of the game you are given one of the best cars in the game right at the start and while this is a nice gesture I guess, it kind of ruins the game.   I am no longer excited about what sort of car I am going to unlock after a race because the one I am using is already leaps and bounds better than anything I am going to have offered to me until I get a lot further in the game and therefore I do not feel inclined to go further in the game.

Even though this is the case I will say that the gameplay or the racing, is a lot of fun in this game.  They have a map of sorts that is going to somewhat change your environment and there are various games that you have to play in your car that keeps things fresh.  

The only issue is that the reward for doing well in any of these competitions, other than pride and unlocking another track, is simply going to be cars that most of the time are inferior to the one that I am already driving.

Therefore, if you do have this on your free list and you haven't played it yet, you are likely going to have the same gift-car that gets put into your garage just like I did.   I *highly suggest that you sell this car before you ever use it* because although it is fast and makes passing all the other cars on the track a piece of cake, it kind of ruins the overall game.

<center> https://i.ytimg.com/vi/aXwXHyf64UE/hq720.jpg?sqp=-oaymwEhCK4FEIIDSFryq4qpAxMIARUAAAAAGAElAADIQj0AgKJD&rs=AOn4CLAJxNWPop6I8GYMNs-TVhWpzpmSqw
[src](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/aXwXHyf64UE/hq720.jpg?sqp=-oaymwEhCK4FEIIDSFryq4qpAxMIARUAAAAAGAElAADIQj0AgKJD&rs=AOn4CLAJxNWPop6I8GYMNs-TVhWpzpmSqw)</center> 

Giving someone too much power right at the start kind of devolves their desire to get any better at it.  As it is now, I will always finish in 1st place unless I fly wildly off the track multiple times in a row... even then, I am still likely going to be in the top 3 without even trying.   That's not very competitive now, is it?

title.title: Eggplant 🍆 omelet 🫓 stuffed with ham
title.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Feliz y bendecido inicio de semana para todos mis amigos amantes de la buena comida; les deseo a todos una linda noche, y les comparto la receta de una tortilla de berenjena que preparé para mi cena el día de hoy, la cual rellené con una rebanada de jamón; fácil, sencilla de preparar y además muy saludable y deliciosa; les muestro el procedimiento

> **
ENGLISH
** Happy and blessed start to the week to all my food-loving friends! I hope you all have a lovely evening, and I’d like to share the recipe for an eggplant omelet I made for dinner today, which I stuffed with a slice of ham. It’s easy and simple to make, and also very healthy and delicious. Here’s how to make it ![IMG_20260427_192623_557.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23uQrDm6CPVREQcVQB76c8w9aA6MHHyjVxSHqSWY47oSbust13jpfStMxECSeKfdNWLg9.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** Lo primero que hice fue lavar muy bien la berenjena, retiré la cáscara, la corté en finas láminas y las dejé remojando en agua con sal para eliminar el amargor, por espacio de unos 15 minutos; la lavé nuevamente y la llevé a cocinar en una sartén con un poco de aceite, una vez que estuvieron cocidas reserve. Agregué el huevo batido, encima coloqué una capa de jamón y finalmente las berenjenas, cociné por ambos lados

> **
PROCEDURE
** The first thing I did was wash the eggplant thoroughly, peel it, slice it into thin strips, and soak them in salted water for about 15 minutes to remove the bitterness; I rinsed them again and cooked them in a skillet with a little oil. Once they were cooked, I set them aside. I added the beaten egg, placed a layer of ham on top, and finally the eggplant slices; I cooked them on both sides. ![IMG_20260427_185750_718.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23u63LxrxsYYBdyfRtCGx1Up3bV7bUzTMeU3ZMradQWcC2xGUSQJYjeybYXRVCJ7pVtPz.jpg) ![IMG_20260427_191330_479.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23vhqZvj4LPtqwxTnKTNNdjotmFg7j4WbJkX9oUkFTn36GmUXDHuJv8cpRLLLr1dkERvT.jpg) ![IMG_20260427_191607_928.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23uQhz61vvhTMCLQ9HryPHnd3YbSyxA9HiyCYQE3nhhKCFAmfTao5JE99jqwsgrCLx9kY.jpg) ![IMG_20260427_192207_253.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wWq36MC3Km2X4dP2r6kfs7dkRpCbNg1Gqk6jZ1FK8f93mDXqt9tjXdHzMLduFSGUSVD.jpg) ![IMG_20260427_192328_620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23vsEEFUitjkUCySnxVEDynJ3RQn5A3HCJvcLZ9vyv2x1aNdw5HuuMgyuUsMbSrQ52C2L.jpg)

Muchas veces tenemos que hacer algo rápido ya que el trabajo y las ocupaciones diarias algunas veces no nos dejan mucho tiempo, otra de las cosas que nos tiene a la carrera es que la luz se va cuando uno esta cocinando y por ello hay que tratar de hacerlo lo más rápido posible  y me ayuda mucho cocinar en la freidora de  aire pues es solo colocar y esperar que este listo para comer.

Aproveche de realizar un pollo frito rápido, el arroz siempre está listo en poco tiempo y no puede faltar para mi unas deliciosas tajadas para acompañar cualquier comida, hoy no salio ensalada pues no había vegetales, igual fue un delicioso almuerzo.

Así que les invito a ponerse manos a la obra y ver esta pequeña receta rápida para un día comolicado, se que de seguro muchos ya han realizado a su gusto, manos a la obra mis queridos creativos.

>

links.title: MakerWorld收益如何？
links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![T7Zu47pQSZwTNMnU_ScreenShot_2026-04-28_111217_121.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/T7Zu47pQSZwTNMnU_ScreenShot_2026-04-28_111217_121/T7Zu47pQSZwTNMnU_ScreenShot_2026-04-28_111217_121.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

其实，我还没完全玩明白MakerWorld，之前以为的一些操作，一些数据，现在又发现新的数据。

首先我很关注一个热门模型，突破1K下载的模型有多少收益？

之前以为数据一个月就清理了，后来发现原来可以看到所有的历史数据。这可太好了。我目前唯一有一个突破1K模型的陀螺。目前有1.1打印+1.6K下载，按照MakerWorld的规则1打印=2下载，大约就是3.8K的下载量。

目前3.8K的下载量对应收获了1994.5积分，按照1积分=0.575元，约等于1150元。也就是我最热的一个模型，收益当前是1150元。这看起来比我想象的低很多。靠热门模型赚钱，也不是一个很好走的路。

另外，我也很关注我目前一个月在MakerWorld到底有多少收益？

以4月份的数据为例，4月份是我非常闲的一个月，所以这个月比较活跃，模型产量也高。国内站+海外站，共收获2407积分≈1384元。

这个数据出来，比我想象的高很多，按照目前每天都有个7~8元的收益，简单预估我一个月可能也就200~300元的样子。但实际这个月的数据跑得不错。

通过这些数据，我也大概理解了，作为一个“创作者”在MakerWorld发布模型获得收益，这个赛道对于普通人来说是有上限，之前有大佬给出的数据是2万，目前来看，我觉得这个数据还算真实，对于我这样目前数据水平就是在5000~10000万/年 之间了。

另外，还是受限于流量。

每天每次能给大家展示的也就手机屏幕那个大小，再刷几屏，能展示出来的真是有限。目前平台应该有200万个模型，你要在这200玩个模型中竞争出来。唯一的突破可能就是积累忠实粉丝，靠粉丝而不靠平台的推荐流量。

这也是为什么大佬们的随便发一个模型就是热门，粉丝的权重占了很高，粉丝的数据又会带动平台算法，正向循环。

目前我还只有129个粉丝，还是个小人物~~~但我相信“持续出摊”的长期复利效应。

---

State and utilities can add another chunk! So it’s not completely free, but it’s very close to it!” After that my friends, it’s basically pure profit going forward for Walmart!😊 “Liz I can see why they got rid of one of the return shopping cart corrals!”🙄 “Honey so that means I need to push my empty shopping cart back up to the front of the store, because some guy needs to charge his electric car?”☺️ Sometimes “Little Silvertop” gets to come outside and play……….Today was the day!😇 “Liz…..I think both the Walmart employees retrieving the carts, and the drivers of the electric vehicles, need more @actifit steps Lol! I think I will just leave this empty cart next to our car, I want everyone to get healthier Lol!”😇 Of course they could join us for an invigorating hike in the mountains!🤗☺️ “Silvertop I am going to put “Little Silvertop away if he doesn’t play nice Lol!”🥰 “Yes honey Lol!”………….😍 Silvertop is getting a “Charge” out of our Spring weather, enjoy the day my friends!😎 Till tomorrow Silvertop Mike😊

links.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71777336823.923624) It’s Monday! Normally, a day I don’t mind too much. Unfortunately somewhere around 3 AM I woke up and I knew…….. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71777336886.444944) ……..I was coming down with a bug. It was a burning feeling in my throat. It’s still here and probably means I picked up the bug the doc so graciously brought to work last week. The office space we share for desk work is small and with the duct for the forced air furnace being just behind him and up at the ceiling, it blows directly over him. Then the air hits the wall and comes my way. 🙄 He really should have called off last week……… ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71777337135.159446) There is a ladies event this coming Saturday so I’m now sweating being able to attend! Then, the following weekend is the one where we are supposed to go see baby Olivia and our son and his wife! If I’m still ill or heaven forbid @silvertop comes down with it, well needless to say I’m not too happy with the doc! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71777337302.104352) I had a Facebook live video to watch today, so being a captive audience so to speak, I pedaled the hour away while watching on the stationary bike. I also had planned to do some gardening today, but with the weather being cool and cloudy and this bug-well I opted not to. So here’s to this NOT lasting long; to @silvertop NOT taking it and to feel better super fast! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71777337516.510426) That’s gonna be it for now. Take care and enjoy the rest of your day wherever you are! 🙏🌏🙏 👣🐑☕️🌥️🌻🌹🙄🙃🌙🥱😴 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71777337693.865797) BSB 1 John 3:1-3 Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him. Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is. And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.

links.title: Chayotes stuffed with chicken and carrot // (Eng-Esp)
links.body: <center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tc9ooUVFVT56udPG3fjf4ogxoK9wiPBmogWYfr3LZqYee8Dme7L1fL1WNVe6zaZ9Lkf.png)</center>\n\n* Good evening, Hivefood friends! I wish you a happy start to the week... Next, I'll explain how to prepare some delicious **\

**. This recipe is very versatile; you can complement it with your favorite side dish. In my case, I served it with: steamed rice and boiled plantains.\nChayote is a vegetable that offers countless benefits and properties... Its high fiber and water content makes it a great ally if you suffer from constipation. It's also a food that helps reduce cholesterol and control blood sugar.\nIts \
flavor allows you to include it as a star ingredient in \

is one of my favorites, and I promise to share this recipe VERY soon!
Now, let's put on our aprons to begin our wonderful process!

>* Buenas noches amigos de hivefood, les deseo un feliz comienzo de semana... A continuación, les explicaré cómo preparar unas exquisitas **“chayotes rellenas con pollo y zanahoria”**. Esta receta es muy versátil, pueden complementar con el contorno de su preferencia, en mi caso acompañé con: arroz al vapor y plátanos sancochados. 
El chayote, es un vegetal que aporta infinidad de beneficios y propiedades... Su alto contenido de fibra y agua, lo convierte en un gran aliado si sufres de estreñimiento, por otra parte es un alimento que ayuda a reducir el colesterol y a controlar el azúcar. 
Su sabor “neutro y delicado” permite que puedas incluirlo como ingrediente estrella en recetas “dulces y saladas”, les confieso que la “mermelada de chayote” es una de mis favoritas, prometo compartir esta receta MUY pronto! 
Ahora, pongámonos el delantal para comenzar nuestro maravilloso proceso!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EpA5s91p7RFdwrcaNMruodkUkLafYCPGL5ALxpy1oiGetfpdszyRXnT6iT4BJEHYGNV.png)</center>

* INGREDIENTS: chayotes, shredded chicken, grated carrot, ripe tomatoes, onion, crushed garlic cloves, sweet paprika, turmeric powder, cumin, pepper, olive oil, white cheese, mozzarella or parmesan for garnish, and salt to taste.

>* INGREDIENTES: chayotes, pollo desmechado, zanahoria (rallada), tomates maduros, cebolla, dientes de ajo (triturados), pimentón dulce, cúrcuma en polvo, comino, pimienta, aceite de oliva, queso blanco, mozzarella o parmesano para decorar y sal al gusto.

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARACIÓN</center>

* Wash the chayote well, cut it in half... add enough water to a deep pot, and add 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
Add the chayote halves, skin side up. Cover and cook over high heat until tender.
The cooking process will take approximately 25 minutes.

>* Lavamos bien la chayote, cortamos por la mitad... incorporamos suficiente agua a una olla honda, colocamos 1/2 cucharadita de sal. 
Integramos las chayotes con la piel hacia la superficie. Tapamos, cocinamos a fuego “alto” hasta que se ablande.
El proceso de cocción tardará aproximadamente 25 minutos.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23uFgT5ZHMYKwk2cnEb2MMHzr5VrygqGhALahpjhEc3svnKYMtT46PmLophxrDXxcPSFr.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23x16t7unaYYKFbcvf21jV218TmTkQtqEMx9vQREQBa51CpFGe8J1oxr3qKR7oeaWKoQ6.png)</center>

* When it's ready, remove the seed and the vein in the center.
Extract the pulp and mash it well with a fork until you get a smooth purée, or cut it into very small cubes.

>* Cuando esté lista, extraemos la semilla y la parte venosa que  tiene en su parte central. 
Extraemos la pulpa, con ayuda de un tenedor trituramos bien hasta conseguir un puré con textura homogénea o cortamos en cubos muy pequeños.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EqBebMbUHMsZAHGddSGabZL4cQAhbYYXeq8GGEr1Xku9WRVxutucNuZFam7iSKhnMY4.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EoCk6ASm4nm19kdcu7D3ioRrYUR4Ct8TwPjYzHKfzuycrbiZBeciP4g388XCgjma3eb.png)</center>

* Add olive oil to the pan... sauté the onion along with the garlic cloves (credded). When they have taken a crystalline texture, place the shredded chicken.
Sauté for 3 minutes (salt and pepper).

>* Añadimos aceite de oliva al sartén... sofreímos la cebolla junto con los dientes de ajo (triturados). Cuando hayan tomado una textura cristalina, colocamos el pollo desmechado. 
Salteamos durante 3 minutos (salpimentamos).

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23w2oL9wLBTKEPf9ke1G7RoAJDXW7UJk72WzCvKqq9eUCpdkFeCLasRaJe9oo2CruA5YN.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xVRKMb1Yog4KLGWKXWKew8ewq2h2ibDtznmZ2NuivbZFT55wnJUcj5crS6gST6xeLrT.png)</center>

* Next, we integrate our colorful carrot... In this step, we proceed to season with: sweet paprika, turmeric powder, touch of cumin and salt. Add 1/2 cup of water.

>* A continuación, integramos nuestra colorida zanahoria... En este paso, procedemos a sazonar con: pimentón dulce, cúrcuma en polvo, toque de comino y sal. Agregamos 1/2 taza de agua.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xAiCbtKAvWWKdHDszSgMrCB4ATk488w3JZCCbLfnTK1cvgG9JigAzB8ezvw7nr83CJo.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xepBKfYjvL3LQXx3AmjCAzp7i1ntkfm5GdekDReVLSRWyjPjofbCD8XAGf1WTZPDLoC.png)</center>

* Add the tomatoes (remove the seeds)... stir in the chayote puree or cubes that you set aside. Mix well and cook for 25 minutes, or until tender. It's important that the stew has a thick consistency, with no excess water.

>* Añadimos los tomates (extraemos las semillas)... incorporamos el puré o cubos de chayote que teníamos reservado. Mezclamos bien, cocinamos durante 25 minutos o hasta comprobar que está listo. Amigos, es importante que la textura del guiso les quede sin contenido de agua.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23viCcwfijxC9Ry7fPigNVHcPXN5FRDfXNG9X6LowCBew6ttiXt56fzvuks89UPuQ5cpJ.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wMf8cSH6C5VAdAG9nSKEA9Qm4BgWUkhiGjySAHhttMVFBnkH9iCdFZRHfNFTbS2TwxR.png)</center>

* Let's start our fun process... Next, we are going to abundantly and generously fill our canoes with chayote. It is important that when doing so, the temperature of the chicken and carrot stew is at room temperature.

>* Empecemos nuestro divertido proceso… A continuación, vamos a rellenar de forma abundante y generosa nuestras canoas de chayote. Es importante que al hacerlo la temperatura del guiso de pollo y zanahoria esté a temperatura ambiente.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/243Wc3q6Sb1auY8dGeLNFi7yb95iJ3YChbUosGgxDvPLH4dredKNCB6svHX9U46H6Pdyc.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EqFuQjJxGcQohuzPCZCUkHNA2ZUgyVv5Z6nLiBSM4XnkGy4KVQ3NxZr1p9BFgVFWghq.png)</center>

* Whenever I make this recipe I usually put white cheese or parmesan, it is also tasty to decorate with mozzarella cheese.
This time use Palmizulia type cheese. You can bake until the cheese melts or cook in the microwave, this last option was my choice, since all the ingredients are cooked, it is a more practical, fast and simple way.

>* Siempre que realizo esta receta suelo colocar queso blanco o parmesano, también queda sabroso decorar con queso mozzarella. 
En esta ocasión utilice queso tipo Palmizulia. Pueden hornear hasta que el queso de derrita o cocinar en el microondas, esta última opción fue mi elección, ya que todos los ingredientes están cocidos, es una forma más práctica, rápida y sencilla.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23z7QHjiMsvhx9Dfd77uGLPjb4RgkVXTg81XzpWFWYiJCiAg9cokGn3gAegSh1Ecq3bP2.png)</center>

* Next up, I present our healthy and nutritious \

an excellent option for lunch or dinner with family and friends... A true delicacy!
Thank you so much for visiting my blog. I wish you a fantastic week! Hugs!

>* A continuación, les presento nuestras saludables y nutritivas “chayotes rellenas con guiso de pollo y zanahoria”, una excelente opción para almorzar o cenar con sus familiares y amigos... Un auténtico manjar!
Muchas gracias por visitar mi blog, me despido deseándoles una fantástica semana, un abrazo!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EpA5s91p7RFdwrcaNMruodkUkLafYCPGL5ALxpy1oiGetfpdszyRXnT6iT4BJEHYGNV.png)</center>

* All photos are my own work
* Todas las fotos son de mi autoría

links.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g229f031139eae6ba44f208ab4d2256e7f1eeb408d2f11de42f60deaea6d3eb7575f832d78933adff7fa7925549696cbe_640.jpg)
Hoy, mi caminata fue realmente revitalizante. Empecé mi recorrido por un parque que estaba más vibrante que nunca. La brisa suave y el canto de los pájaros creaban un ambiente perfecto. Durante mi paseo, conocí a un artista de calle que estaba pintando un mural increíble. Se llama Javier y me contó que lleva cuatro años plasmando su arte en diferentes puntos de la ciudad. Me encantó su pasión por el arte urbano y la forma en que transformaba espacios comunes en algo único. Más adelante, me detuve en una pequeña cafetería que acaba de abrir. Conocí a Laura, la dueña, quien me ofreció un café con especias que estaba delicioso. Me comentó que su objetivo es crear un espacio acogedor donde las personas puedan reunirse y compartir ideas. A medida que avanzaba, noté cómo la ciudad va cambiando: nuevos murales, más espacios verdes y una comunidad que se siente cada vez más unida. Fue un día lleno de pequeñas sorpresas y conexiones que realmente hicieron que mi caminata fuera especial. ¡No puedo esperar para salir de nuevo mañana! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). links.title: ¿Que hay en la mente de un artista? [ESP-ENG]
links.body:
/>

(Esp)

Alguna vez te has preguntado:

¿Que hay en la mente de un artista?

A simple viste ves a una persona la mayoría del tiempo con la cabeza en alto, sonriente, elocuente, soñador, siempre con ideas nuevas y alocadas en ocasiones, perseverante, positivo ante la vida.

¿Pero? ¿Realmente es así?, ¿Todo el tiempo es como se ve?, ¿O realmente...es lo que muestra?

Detrás de esa cara sonriente y dedicada al desarrollo, hay una persona muy adentro, que en la mayoría de los casos no es tan reluciente como parece.

Me atrevo a decir que el artista es la persona con más dudas e insegura que te podrías encontrar. No es una metáfora ni algo que me estoy inventando, es una realidad... porque así lo siento.

El verdadero artista no crea solo por un gusto o por \

, un verdadero artista crea porque lo necesita, porque no le cabe dentro todo lo que expresa...y en la mayoría de los casos, ni su arte alcanza para desahogarse. Aveces es tanto lo que quiere decir, que no sabe cómo, pero lo hace, porque debe, porque nace...pero no significa que luego de crear se sentirá mejor.\n\n\

/> Al arte es hermoso sí, la vida de un artista no es para nada aburrida, y por supuesto tampoco es fácil. El artista se intenta superar a sí mismo, tiene como barrera solo lo que sí mismo puede bloquear, porque si, el único enemigo de un artista, es él mismo. Otro punto importante que hay que tener en cuenta es: ¿Todo el tiempo es arte? En la mayoría de los casos no solamente se hace arte, hay que trabajar, estudiar, no todos tienen la suerte de vivir de esto...y no todos tienen la suerte de estudiar esto. Cuando el artista debe dividir su tiempo en -trabajo+estudio+arte+casa+familia, se crean varias personalidades, varios caracteres,varios personajes en una misma persona, lo cuál el mismo debe saber diferenciar, balancear, y dividir su tiempo para cada rol. Cuando se vive en diferentes roles, es difícil separar las cosas, y aunque intentara unir todo para no complicarse, sería adquirir más situaciones complicadas que una solución. Y todo esto afecta al factor psicológico, entonces sería la lucha de su yo interno como artista inseguro y su otro yo como persona común. Es algo cruel decirlo pero... Aveces el artista piensa que su vida sería más fácil si no supiera tocar una nota musical, si no supiera entonar, si no supiera mezclar colores, o interpretar un personaje... Si no supiera expresar con su cuerpo lo que otros con la boca temen comunicar. Y entonces te acostumbras a TOCAR FONDO, a sentir que no eres suficiente, a sentir que no lo estás haciendo bien, a sentir que sueñas en vano o tal vez deberías dedicarle más tiempo a lo que llena un bolsillo y pone un plato en una mesa. Si...el arte es hermoso y necesario... Y ser artista es el verdadero arte. Autor: Andy Díaz Sosa (persona común) TitoDíaz (artista) Muchas gracias 🙏 27 de Abril del 2026

/>

ENG:
Have you ever wondered:

What goes on in the mind of an artist?

At first glance, you see someone who is usually upright, smiling, eloquent, a dreamer, always full of new and sometimes crazy ideas, persevering, and positive about life.

But is that really the case? Is everything they seem like? Or is it really just what they show?

Behind that smiling face, dedicated to their craft, there's a person deep inside, who in most cases isn't as radiant as they appear.

I dare say that the artist is the most doubtful and insecure person you could ever meet. This isn't a metaphor or something I'm making up; it's a reality... because that's how I feel.

The true artist doesn't create just for pleasure or as a \

A true artist creates because they need to, because they can't contain everything they express... and in most cases, even their art isn't enough to release all their emotions. Sometimes there's so much you want to say that you don't know how, but you do it, because you must, because it's in your blood... but that doesn't mean you'll feel better after creating.\n\n\

/>

 Art is beautiful, yes, the life of an artist is anything but boring, and of course, it's not easy either. The artist tries to surpass themselves; their only barrier is what they themselves can block, because, yes, the only enemy of an artist is themselves.

Another important point to consider is:
Is art all the time?
In most cases, it's not just about making art; you have to work, study, and not everyone is lucky enough to make a living from it... and not everyone is lucky enough to study it. When an artist has to divide their time between work, study, art, home, and family, several personalities, several characters, several personas are created within the same person, which they must learn to differentiate, balance, and divide their time for each role.

When you live in different roles, it's difficult to separate things, and even if you try to bring everything together to avoid complications, it only creates more problems than it solves.

And all of this affects the psychological aspect; it becomes a struggle between your inner self as an insecure artist and your other self as an ordinary person.

It's cruel to say, but... Sometimes the artist thinks their life would be easier if they didn't know how to play a musical note, if they didn't know how to sing, if they didn't know how to mix colors, or how to portray a character... If they didn't know how to express with their body what others are afraid to communicate with their mouths.

And then you get used to hitting rock bottom, to feeling like you're not enough, to feeling like you're not doing it right, to feeling like you're dreaming in vain, or maybe you should dedicate more time to what fills your pockets and puts food on the table.

Yes... art is beautiful and necessary... And being an artist is the true art.

Tito Díaz (artist)
Thank you very much 🙏

links.title: Oatmeal torticas (Eng/Esp)
links.body:
> For dinner, I wanted to make some wheat flour pancakes with oats and cheese. I thought they’d be perfect for a light meal with a rich, delicious flavor. Here’s how I made this easy recipe. I hope you like it, try making it at home, and let me know how it turned out.
![1000112099.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/EpXKYfDaSVpXvwWMR1GJdBLmUV7R4DHXMXsmjd5sfPfmDrBNqRH4FwTaiNK9yGdyjYP.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 100 grams of self-rising wheat flour - 50 grams of rolled oats - 1 tablespoon of butter - Salt to taste - Oil - 1/2 cup of water
![1000112090.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23w2ckSJ3XkVnaZtto4EZQNqouP3EgCMzuZcp89f2jj5wbjRpBay9tMQFufar7LhKBSBi.jpg)
## Preparation: I placed the water and a pinch of salt in a bowl and gradually added the wheat flour. I kneaded the dough for a good while until the mixture reached the ideal consistency. Next, I added the rolled oats and continued kneading to combine the ingredients. Finally, I stirred in a tablespoon of butter to enhance the flavor. Then I dusted the dough with a little flour, and it was ready.
![1000112094.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23w2AmB9a9cCccfoShN9MLtSiAh5Q5Btk7qEdcUSFxj6rvbSTxaytK64zMxyahbwxK2xS.jpg)
![1000112097.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tmKrJAQsTWWNoT1rHppgavVwEkX2He6ka1pfXBdshouZov2a5m86KKAzZCqbe6dB9Ec.jpg)
I heated a skillet, added a splash of oil, and then shaped the pancakes. I cooked them over medium heat until they were golden and crispy on the outside; I knew they’d be soft and fluffy on the inside, since this self-rising flour is great for achieving that texture. I kept an eye on them periodically so they wouldn’t burn; they cooked very quickly, so in about fifteen minutes I was enjoying my dinner. I added some cheese sticks that melted on top beautifully. It’s always nice to savor that flavor. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Para mi cena quise preparar una tortitas de harina de trigo con avena y queso. Me pareció que serían perfectas para comer algo ligero pero con un sabor intenso y agradable. Les muestro cómo realicé esta práctica receta. Espero que sea de sus agrado, puedan elaborar la en casa y luego me cuenten cuál fue la experiencia.
![1000112099.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/EpXKYfDaSVpXvwWMR1GJdBLmUV7R4DHXMXsmjd5sfPfmDrBNqRH4FwTaiNK9yGdyjYP.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 100 gramos de harina de trigo leudante - 50 gramos de avena en hojuelas - 1 cucharada de mantequilla - Sal al gusto - Aceite - 1/2 taza de agua
![1000112090.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23w2ckSJ3XkVnaZtto4EZQNqouP3EgCMzuZcp89f2jj5wbjRpBay9tMQFufar7LhKBSBi.jpg)
## Preparación: En un envase coloqué el agua, un toque de sal y agregué la harina de trigo de forma gradual, estuve amasando un buen rato para que la mezcla tomara una consistencia ideal. Posteriormente, agregué la avena en hojuelas y continué el proceso de amasar para integrar los ingredientes. Finalmente le vertí una cucharada de mantequilla para que tuviera mejor sabor. Luego le rocié un poco de harina de trigo y así quedó lista la masa.
![1000112094.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23w2AmB9a9cCccfoShN9MLtSiAh5Q5Btk7qEdcUSFxj6rvbSTxaytK64zMxyahbwxK2xS.jpg)
![1000112097.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tmKrJAQsTWWNoT1rHppgavVwEkX2He6ka1pfXBdshouZov2a5m86KKAzZCqbe6dB9Ec.jpg)
Monté un sartén, coloqué una medida de aceite en la superficie y luego formé las torticas, cociné a fuego medio hasta obtener una textura dorada y crujiente, sabía que estarían suaves y esponjosas por dentro, pues esta harina leudante es muy buena para lograr este efecto. Vigilé de forma periódica para que no se quemaran, se hicieron muy rápido, así que en unos quince minutos estaba degustando de mi cena. Agregué unos palitos de queso que se derritieron encima espléndidamente. Siempre es agradable sentir ese gusto.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

json_metadata.body:
>Hello to all members of this wonderful community, welcome to a new section of my blog. This time, I'll be introducing you to the Aeronautical Museum of Maracay, as I had the opportunity to visit these grounds during a recent concert with the guys from El Sistema. I hope you enjoy it.

>Hola a todos los miembros de esta hermosa comunidad, sean bienvenidos a una nueva sección de mi blog. En esta ocasión, les presentaré el Museo Aeronáutico de Maracay, ya que tuve la oportunidad de visitar estos espacios durante un reciente concierto con los muchachos del sistema. Espero que lo disfruten.

<Center>![363423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/uri07/EpT3JWUxL4yeHM3RsVAZedMhuz9Xk4WoU9m6osoaXp2vwifCZws2PpYvs1wzkev7wEB.jpg)</Center>

To begin, it's important to understand that Venezuelan aviation began in Maracay in the 1920s, under the leadership of General Gómez, who revolutionized and modernized everything related to the military in Venezuela. This museum is a space to remember and commemorate all the important aircraft that have arrived in the country. Among them are numerous models of fighter jets. It also houses the most faithful reconstruction of the \

the plane that took Marcos Pérez Jiménez into exile after his overthrow on January 23rd. Other artifacts are also on display, such as convoys and some of the trucks used at the time for aircraft maintenance.\n>Para empezar, debemos tener claro que la aviación venezolana comenzó en Maracay en la década de 1920, bajo el liderazgo del general Gómez, quien revolucionó y modernizó todo lo relacionado con la materia militar en Venezuela. Este museo es un espacio para recordar y conmemorar todos los aviones importantes que han llegado al país. Entre ellos, podemos encontrar aviones de combate de numerosos modelos. Además, se encuentra la reconstrucción más fiel de la \

, el avión que llevó a Marcos Pérez Jiménez a su exilio tras su derrocamiento el 23 de enero. También se exhiben otros artefactos, como convoyes y algunos camiones que se utilizaban en la época para el mantenimiento de los aviones.
![363420.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/uri07/23yTdBjDCUwcDxC3ofodx9AjC7FPKoTbqKukcwFaqcY2SDckDZdh9mfDRwQi6pp7PwtQ5.jpg)
In addition to this, it also features artistic monuments, such as the large canvas I showed in the first image, which depicts Gómez alongside the first pilots and some of the most influential people in his aviation project for Venezuela at that time. There is also a hall with numerous awards and paintings, although it is not open to the general public and must be visited on a specific day. Furthermore, they have several specialists who offer tours and explain a bit about each aircraft and its history. Visitors are also allowed to board the planes and touch some of the parts, though not all of them.For my city, this museum is quite important and significant, as it covers the entire history of aviation in the nation, as I mentioned before. Many aircraft that were previously located in other states have been moved here, and there is also a replica of the car that ran over Saint José Gregorio Hernández. It's a truly beautiful place that I recommend visiting at least once. The atmosphere is captivating, and the stories behind each aircraft are truly beautiful and meaningful. >Además de esto, también cuenta con monumentos artísticos, como el gran lienzo que mostré en la primera imagen, el cual retrata a Gómez junto a los primeros pilotos y algunas de las personas más influyentes en el proyecto de aviación que tenía para Venezuela en esa época. También hay un salón con numerosos reconocimientos y pinturas, aunque no está accesible para todo el público y se debe visitar en un día específico. Asimismo, cuentan con varios especialistas en la materia que ofrecen recorridos y explican un poco sobre cada avión y su historia. Además, permiten que los visitantes se suban a los aviones y toquen algunas de sus piezas, aunque no todas.Para mi ciudad, este museo es bastante importante y significativo, ya que, como mencioné antes, abarca toda la historia de la aviación de la nación. Muchos aviones que anteriormente estaban en otros estados han sido trasladados aquí, y también existe una réplica del carro que atropelló al Santo José Gregorio Hernández. Es una obra bastante hermosa que recomiendo visitar al menos una vez. El ambiente es cautivador y las historias de cada avión son realmente bellas y significativas.
![363422.jpg](2)![363419.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/uri07/23u63L1Pcw95zaT6tcx4QeP4C4VSnU8RaGB1AAgBh52d6opw5W8ckftopkfUNpTZACyvD.jpg)
It also has a small plaza with a statue of Gómez, who isn't considered the father of Venezuelan aviation, and of other influential figures. It's truly a beautiful and quite large space; at first glance it seems small, but as you walk around, you'll find dozens of airplanes, from small to very large. We were there because we attended a concert for the system's 51st anniversary, and they allowed us to use the front of the museum, which is like a stage in the middle of the main aircraft displays. >También cuenta con una placita con la estatua de Gómez, quien no es considerado el padre de la aviación venezolana, y de otros hombres influyentes. De verdad, es un espacio muy lindo y bastante grande; a simple vista parece pequeño, sin embargo, a medida que uno va caminando, puede encontrar decenas de aviones, desde pequeños hasta muy grandes. Nosotros estuvimos allí porque asistimos a un concierto por el 51 aniversario del sistema, y nos permitieron utilizar la parte frontal del museo, que es como un escenario en medio de las secciones importantes de aviones. It's a truly beautiful place that I highly recommend visiting at least once. I had the opportunity to come a few months ago, when I was younger, and every time I return, I experience a different feeling. Thank you so much for reading my post and getting this far. Let's share some similar experiences and whether you were already aware of it. See you next time!All photos were taken with my Infinix Note 50 Pro phone. >Es un lugar muy hermoso que recomiendo visitar al menos una vez. Tuve la oportunidad de venir en meses anteriores, cuando era más pequeña, y cada vez que regreso experimento un sentimiento diferente. Muchísimas gracias por leer mi publicación y llegar hasta aquí. Hagamos algún comentario sobre experiencias similares y si ya conocían de su existencia. Nos vemos en otra oportunidad.Todas las fotos fueron tomadas con mi teléfono marca Infinix modelo Note 50 Pro [//]:# (!worldmappin 10.25265 lat -67.59443 long Museo aeronáutico d3scr)

json_metadata.title: The Powerful Naga Fire Wizard Against the Sneak Ability
json_metadata.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXvefAcpF2VwGAv1L8Jqkm32RhdmtEs1spjy6U8RXB2i4/naga.png</center>

Today I'm going to talk about the Naga Fire Wizard card in Splinterlands, so join me on this brief journey of learning about the game.

I've mentioned several times how much of a fan I am of cards from older editions, and the Naga Fire Wizard was one of the ones I used most in my fire deck when I had a lot of mana available in battle.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZipccKtxcboXyr5UcjSBRUg5kBNkzEriXdGZ5MGTyvWr/m.png</center>

This is the Naga Fire Wizard, it's a Reward Card from the Beta edition and belongs to the Fire Deck. The reason I like the Naga Fire Wizard card is because it has the Thorns ability, and for that reason it's a great option to position in the last slot.

To better understand this strategy, let's look at the abilities of the Naga Fire Wizard.

****The Naga Fire Wizard has 2 abilities****: Shield and Thorns.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZx9wyAo6Nd5bUzpHTBttHVEnQgyUM6L8SHfeRp5dHuro/mm.png</center>

**Shield**: 50% less damage (rounded up) from physical attacks or 0 damage from physical attacks of 1 power.

*It's very common to find melee and ranged cards in battles, so the Shield ability will be very useful in battle.*

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZh29cF2PA5QcxyeRMvL56G8fM1SYwSSaBpr6G57w2pTb/mmm.png</center>

**Thorns**: Returns 2 physical damage to the attacker when hit by a melee attack.

**This ability is the terror of melee cards in Splinterlands and also the reason I like Naga Fire Wizard in my strategies.**

My strategy for Naga Fire Wizard is to use it in the last position, and in this way it will be a great ally against melee cards that have the Sneak ability.

Now let's go to the practical part and see how Naga Fire Wizard performs in battle.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXyzDJGSmgBag983PbMvvDQhACb8EHZu3oDxXEi2ezzE6/mmmm.png</center>

## <center>[Watch The Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_e8e32665e6fb518df969b119abd06ee4?ref=moonblast)</center>

In this battle I can clearly show how Naga Fire Wizard in this position is a great defense and also a great option for dealing damage. It wasn't an entirely easy battle, and the only reason I won was because I had the Naga Fire Wizard on my side, so it's a great example of how a single card can change the entire course of a battle.

## Arcade Colony

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeVhSb4SzdyDLvV8kzgZHxx6k28Qf7zRFm1ENJnTfcxxR/mmmmm.png</center>

Now I'll talk about the **[Arcade Colony](https://arcadecolony.com/)** platform. On it, you'll find the games: **[Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=moonblast)**, **[Moon Karts](https://moonkarts.arcadecolony.com/)**, **[StakeHouse Den](https://stakehouseden.arcadecolony.com/)**, and **[Genesis League Goals](https://goals.genesisleaguesports.com/)**.

*For those unfamiliar with Arcade Colony, it's owned by Invennium Corp. Arcade Colony is a platform for arcades and video games with a functional economy based on a governance token, \

.*

**Invennium Corp. is a 100% subsidiary of Splinterlands.**

Find more information about Arcade Colony in my post: **[Discover the Arcade Colony Platform](https://peakd.com/hive-13323/@moonblast/discover-the-arcade-colony-platform-lne)**.

json_metadata.body: >Unsplash 今年到目前為止，我中了網頁上的智商稅陷阱兩次，我指的是那種小物看起來好用，但也沒多少錢的。很多都是用幾次發現根本不好用，好一點的是正常運作，但沒啥作用，能遇到真的有用的才算是運氣好。 第一個中的是空氣循環小扇，是屬於可以運作的，有沒有用就是心裡感覺，我也不知道當時想甚麼，腦一熱就下單了，廣告裡看起來小小一台風力很強，但實物就是一個普通的小扇，至於他加快懸浮物落地的功能，也就只能用心靈去感受了😌。 第二個是洗髮皂，目前還在運輸的路上，主要是他標榜的效果都有中我在意的點，保溼跟去屑是我目前在意的點，市面上大多是去油去屑止癢，我以前用了之後，發現更油更癢，然後又去尋找更去油去屑的，形成了惡性循環。 後來在洗面乳方面改用保濕的得到成效，就想到頭皮方面的嘗試，我嘗試了一次後，頭皮長痘油膩發癢的情況就改善了，不過頭皮屑的事情依舊，印象中小時候就有這個問題，但沒有那麼嚴重。 這次嘗試這個洗髮皂，說起來是個嘗試，雖然有違我的理財觀念，但在有限度的嘗試，若是能夠改善頭皮狀況是最好。如果沒效，就當作嘗試洗髮皂，我以前也沒試過，也許他沒有去屑的成果，但愛上了那種洗髮感覺也不一定😁，網頁電商肯定抓準了我這種心裡。 --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@azazqwe/4rg27g)

json_metadata.title: My first attempt at pollinating adeniums (A doctor who dreams in green) [Eng/Esp]
json_metadata.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdxfN9gajyGaEJehNcMx3JgQZEwxvQU37B83HzKvWbC5m/1777345170707.jpg)



***
***
After a long shift at the hospital, the kind where your legs beg for mercy, I finally did what I had been longing to do for days. I took off my high heels, took a deep breath, and without stopping at the couch, I went straight out to the garden because today was the day.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfHpGTDkLMXYWGVsNWWsD88DTASsfYwDkHKCczcWSgTgD/1777345374756.jpg)

***
Adeniums have long become my little oasis of sanity. That swollen base and their pink flowers, which look like they come from another planet, remind me that despite the noise of the emergency room and the weight of the decisions I make every day, there are things that follow their own slow and perfect rhythm.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNUA5Dx5XcB2Ng1mr48NwDdzcLxeTV3VYnCSxMu2S3Pfb/1777345373751.jpg)


***
I have already managed to reproduce my adeniums by cuttings, and watching them take root fills me with an almost maternal pride, but seeds have always eluded me. I have never managed to get a pod to mature, to burst open and give me that magical dust from which new worlds are born. Every flower that withered without fruit left me with a small thorn stuck in my side.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNVaPy1MSgXTAxTGvYYGuuzKKhy9WgD4AA3GYPVd73Ybd/1777345374479.jpg)

***
So, with post shift syndrome still dancing on my shoulders, I armed myself with patience and simple tools. I had watched tutorials, I had taken mental notes, but seeing it on a screen is one thing, and having the flower trembling between your fingers is quite another. I chose a mature flower, one that was already wide open, with golden pollen showing among its stamens. Then, with the same precision I would use for a suture, I looked for the stigma of younger flowers. A touch here, a rub there, a movement almost like that of a jeweler, and I attempted that ancient dance that nature usually does on its own, but which today I wanted to help bring about.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZS9i3b665FXAnPetgTmY8vUEeNwpMvpMezJGH3ZkrVj4/1777345374145.jpg)


***
My fingers trembled a little, and in my head the constant doubt lingered: have I damaged something? Did I put the pollen in the wrong place? Is such a small gesture enough? I really don't know, but there we go, learning things as we go through life, in my forties, with soil under my fingernails and my heart as open as an adenium flower.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUjnyncgPLiatZtCdsv5zH6gTvjww9qVakqMgAcMedfSc/1777345487385.jpg)


***
When I finished, I looked at my chubby, robust adenium and felt I needed one more gesture, something small, almost superstitious. So I placed a small Mammillaria elongata at the base of the pot, that friendly cactus with elongated little balls that look like little green fingers, to keep it company and bring it luck. Because who said that female doctors cannot have our little rituals and our domestic magic?
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaVLAczr3DjeiTrhCwnhXrm7rLD7NESKGVUM1Dg8Szygc/1777345375070.jpg)
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRuH6DpoSyGREWyVmAQ76t1Ck6evu5xkEPUekQxsZkK2w/1777345796452.jpg)
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVxYG9Wckhq8bUy2khqzdQDzABvbf6LAiDpcK2m91wqeo/1777345796098.jpg)


***
Nothing, just little tricks from this doctor who takes off her heels, goes barefoot, and believes that maybe, just maybe, the miracle also lies in knowing how to wait for a seed to germinate, for a little cactus to bring luck, because life always finds a way to bloom.

<center>🌱</center>
<center>🌱</center>


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYweGm8mMxKLmFZYSPAHak3F6Zz1vgqfa4B6ixGv588XE/1776476176320.jpg)


<sub>🍃 **𝑻𝒉𝒂𝒏𝒌𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒈!** 🍃
𝑰𝒇 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒅𝒐𝒏’𝒕 𝒌𝒏𝒐𝒘 𝒎𝒆 𝒚𝒆𝒕, 𝑰’𝒎 𝒂 **𝑪𝒖𝒃𝒂𝒏 𝒏𝒆𝒖𝒓𝒐𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒊𝒔𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒘𝒓𝒊𝒕𝒆𝒓**, 𝒂 𝒎𝒐𝒕𝒉𝒆𝒓, 𝒂 𝒘𝒐𝒎𝒂𝒏, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒂 𝒅𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒎𝒆𝒓 𝒘𝒉𝒐’𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒖𝒏𝒅 𝒊𝒏 𝑯𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒂 𝒃𝒆𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒊𝒇𝒖𝒍 𝒔𝒑𝒂𝒄𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝒔𝒐𝒂𝒓.
